title: 模型火了之后
body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![v8pq5NWzb3sAEM9c_MEITU_20260520_230954585.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/v8pq5NWzb3sAEM9c_MEITU_20260520_230954585/v8pq5NWzb3sAEM9c_MEITU_20260520_230954585.webp)
![WwVoQK9frYK4SKsc_Screenshot_2026-05-20-23-03-34-725_com.bambulab.c.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/WwVoQK9frYK4SKsc_Screenshot_2026-05-20-23-03-34-725_com.bambulab.c/WwVoQK9frYK4SKsc_Screenshot_2026-05-20-23-03-34-725_com.bambulab.c.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近，运气好。我的一个3D打印模型作品，“星星萝卜塔解压拍拍棒”莫名火了。

说是莫名的火了，是我觉得这个模型没有什么高超的技艺，可能能提的，也许就只是一个小小的结合创意，把拍拍掌跟萝卜塔结合了下，然后造型上做了一个星星的造型，比较圆润~~~仅此而已。

起初没有任何指望，但是还是给我带来了惊喜。

今天看，我的作品模型，已经冲到了MakerWorld国内站的排名第二了，可见最近热度很高。

我之前幻想过什么时候我能有个个人典型作品，个人热门作品，没想到来得这么快。

当然随之而来的，是咸鱼平台开始又售卖我模型的盗版商家了，还不止一家。排第一的商家，连图片都盗用我在MakerWorld上的~~~真是个低成本的拿来主义啊。

有时在想，我是开心呢，还是不开心呢。

可能当前开心会多一点，能被人盗版，也侧面说明了受欢迎的程度了。是不是可能成为摆摊爆款呢？

有没有一种画面，以后，大家在外面看到3D打印的摆摊的，就可以看到这么一个星星棒，嗯，原作者就是我了。这可能又是一个奇妙的体验。

我暂时没想过要去维权，我没有走自己卖货的这个模式。维权的精力成本挺高的，暂且听之任之吧。在国内，这个情况还是非常非常之普遍的。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@yellowbird/6n1qgn)

title: Incertidumbres que aterran. Una historia real que suena a ficción [esp-eng]
body:
![1000028133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFH1dUuEyxn8JP13pUKCRZpdzdNZCRCnRHs4v81x8APFtj392zWi3eqzduRzXumKByG.jpg)
@zonadeescalofrio, como cuna de lo paranormal, misterio, terror y horror, es el lugar justo donde soltar este tema, que quizás más de alguno de ustedes ha leído o visto en alguna red social, tal como fue en mi caso. ​Hace algunas noches atrás, luego de subir mi contenido de cdramas a mi canal de tiktok, comencé a consumir contenido variado; fue ahí, entre que subía uno a uno los videos, que caí en uno que hizo clic y al mismo tiempo erizó cada vello de mis brazos. ​Una historia extraña, paranormal para algunos y demasiado normal para otros, pero el chiste acá es saber: ¿qué ocurrió en realidad?

El caso de Clélia Verdier

![1000028131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/242rsJjZXpJ9BSZJdorXX4GTdttXp46nvVRQpX8mx5Xkvn2EdCaywKh5hhwaqW2WxfG96.jpg)
[Fuente/Source](https://share.google/6mXLv7VnikbVaihiG)
**​Una joven de 19 años, quien estuvo en coma inducido por tres semanas, despierta de este; sin embargo, colapsa mental y emocionalmente al no encontrar a su familia.** ​**La joven asegura haber tenido una familia y reafirma que dicha familia la formó hace siete años, es decir, ella llevaba siete años con esta familia, donde inclusive dice tener tres hijas quienes eran trillizas.** **​Ahora que está consciente, busca a sus hijas, donde recuerda cada sonido y aroma de sus niñas, a lo que los especialistas y su propia familia le indican que esto nunca fue así.** ​Bajo este tema, y siendo algo conspiranoica, siento que este caso va más allá, directamente a un tema que desarrollamos hace algún tiempo; siento que este caso pertenece a otra línea de tiempo, donde esta joven saltó de una dimensión a otra, es decir, en su dimensión, plano o línea temporal, específicamente ella era madre de tres niñas y esposa. Quizás un accidente en coma con la versión de ella de este plano hizo que al despertar fueran cambiadas de algún modo. ​O sea, la joven de nuestro plano quizás ahora esté en el de la chica y está atravesando esta misma paradoja, mirando aterrada una familia que desconoce mientras su versión de ese plano lucha buscando la verdad. Es una hipótesis, pero imagino que quizás no esté tan errada. ***

​El extraño trasfondo real y el misterio del número 7

​Investigando más a fondo para no quedarme solo con el video observado en TikTok, descubrí que la joven se llama **Clélia Verdier**, originaria de Francia 🇫🇷, y aquí es donde la realidad supera la ficción y nos deja con desconcierto. En las redes se dice que estuvo tres meses en coma, pero el reporte real dicta que estuvo solo 3 semanas (21 días) en coma inducido. ​**¡Y aquí es donde la cabeza me hizo una explosión volcánica!** Si calculamos el tiempo, para que ella haya vivido esos 7 años completos en otra dimensión durante apenas 21 días de nuestro plano, significa que por cada día real en coma, ella vivió exactamente 4 meses en el otro plano. **​¿Es acaso una casualidad matemática?** La verdad no lo creo, ya que muchas veces las casualidades no existen. Si observamos bien, el número **7** y el número **3** se repiten como un patrón constante que parece ser una llave de conexión entre ambos planos, o una especie de coordenada interdimensional oculta a simple vista: ​Vivió 7 años en la otra dimensión. ​Pasó 21 días en coma (que es exactamente 3 x 7). ​Despertó en la semana 3, de un coma de 3 semanas, donde asegura haber tenido 3 hijos (que en el caso real se especifica que eran trillizos). ​El **3 y el 7** son números con una carga mística, esotérica y cabalística gigantesca en la historia del ocultismo. Por otro lado, si reducimos el 21 en suma, sería 2 + 1=3 y nuevamente el 3 sale a la palestra.
![1000028132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23swibWLrmZchvdybeehT6fNn5WkGKffMqpYb7DKA5FMn1okopmeqniLQADvd8AhLviKd.jpg)
**Significados esotéricos de los números:** **El número 3 es la trinidad y la creación**, justo la cantidad de hijos que dice tener y semanas que estuvo en coma inducido. **El número 7 es la perfección de los planos universales**, cae justamente en la cantidad de años que dice haber vivido con su familia. **El número 21 es la suma multiplicada de ambos dígitos, la cual representa el éxito, maduración espiritual y propósito de vida**, sin embargo, despierta justo en el día 21 con el desconcierto. Es decir, ¿podrá haber algo que aún no se refleja? Quizás alguna delgada línea que uniría todo y ¿Cuál sería ese éxito que refleja el número 21? ***

Preguntas para debatir

¿Será que el trauma del accidente activó un portal numérico en su conciencia? ​¿Qué creen ustedes, comunidad? ¿Fallo en la Matrix, un salto cuántico real a través de frecuencias numéricas, o simplemente una mala pasada del cerebro humano? *** ###
English
***
![1000028133.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFH1dUuEyxn8JP13pUKCRZpdzdNZCRCnRHs4v81x8APFtj392zWi3eqzduRzXumKByG.jpg)
@zonadeescalofrio, as a hotbed of the paranormal, mystery, terror and horror, is just the place to bring up this topic, which perhaps some of you have read about or seen on social media, as I did. A few nights ago, after uploading my K-drama content to my TikTok channel, I started browsing through various videos; it was then, whilst uploading them one by one, that I stumbled upon one that really caught my attention and, at the same time, made every hair on my arms stand on end. A strange story, paranormal to some and all too normal to others, but the point here is to find out: what actually happened?

The case of Clélia Verdier

![1000028131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/242rsJjZXpJ9BSZJdorXX4GTdttXp46nvVRQpX8mx5Xkvn2EdCaywKh5hhwaqW2WxfG96.jpg)
[Fuente/Source](https://share.google/6mXLv7VnikbVaihiG)
**A 19-year-old woman, who had been in an induced coma for three weeks, wakes up from it; however, she suffers a mental and emotional breakdown upon not finding her family.** **The young woman claims to have had a family and insists that this family was formed seven years ago; in other words, she had been with this family for seven years, and even claims to have three daughters who were triplets.** **Now that she is conscious, she is searching for her daughters, remembering every sound and scent of her girls, whilst specialists and her own family tell her that this was never the case.** ​On this subject, and being somewhat of a conspiracy theorist, I feel that this case goes further, directly to a topic we explored some time ago; I feel that this case belongs to another timeline, where this young woman jumped from one dimension to another, that is to say, in her dimension, plane or timeline, specifically she was the mother of three girls and a wife. Perhaps an accident that left her in a coma, involving her version of this plane, meant that when she woke up, things had somehow been altered. ​In other words, the young woman from our plane may now be in the girl’s plane and is experiencing this very same paradox, looking on in terror at a family she does not recognise, whilst her version from that plane struggles to seek the truth. It is a hypothesis, but I imagine it may not be so far off the mark. ***

​The strange real-life background and the mystery of the number 7

​Digging deeper so as not to rely solely on the video I’d seen on TikTok, I discovered that the young woman’s name is **Clélia Verdier**, originally from France 🇫🇷, and this is where reality surpasses fiction and leaves us baffled. Social media claims she was in a coma for three months, but the actual report states she was in an induced coma for just 3 weeks (21 days). ​**And this is where my head went into a volcanic explosion!** If we do the maths, for her to have lived those full 7 years in another dimension during just 21 days of our reality, it means that for every real day in a coma, she lived exactly 4 months in the other dimension. **Is this perhaps a mathematical coincidence?** I really don’t think so, as coincidences often don’t exist. If we look closely, the number **7** and the number **3** recur as a constant pattern that seems to be a key linking the two planes, or a sort of interdimensional coordinate hidden from plain sight: ​She lived for 7 years in the other dimension. ​She spent 21 days in a coma (which is exactly 3 x 7). ​She woke up in week 3, from a 3-week coma, during which she claims to have had 3 children (who, in the real case, are specified as being triplets). ​The **3 and the 7** are numbers with a massive mystical, esoteric and kabbalistic significance in the history of the occult. On the other hand, if we reduce 21 to its sum, it would be 2 + 1 = 3, and once again the number 3 comes to the fore.
![1000028132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23swibWLrmZchvdybeehT6fNn5WkGKffMqpYb7DKA5FMn1okopmeqniLQADvd8AhLviKd.jpg)
**Esoteric meanings of numbers:** **The number 3 represents the Trinity and creation**, precisely the number of children he claims to have and the number of weeks he spent in an induced coma. **The number 7 represents the perfection of the universal planes**, which coincides exactly with the number of years he claims to have lived with his family. **The number 21 is the sum of both digits, which represents success, spiritual maturity and life purpose**; however, he wakes up on the 21st day itself, feeling bewildered. In other words, could there be something that hasn’t yet been revealed? Perhaps some fine line that would tie everything together, and what might that success represented by the number 21 be? ***

Questions for discussion

Could it be that the trauma of the accident activated a numerical portal in his consciousness? ​What do you think, community? A glitch in the Matrix, a real quantum leap through numerical frequencies, or simply a trick of the human brain? *** Links para informarte más del caso. [El telégrafo, caso Clélia Verdier](https://www.eltelegrafo.com.ec/noticias/tendencias/213/impactante-joven-desperto-de-un-coma-convencida-de-que-habia-criado-a-trillizas) [El imparcial, caso Clélia Verdier](https://www.google.com/amp/s/www.elimparcial.com/locurioso/2026/05/14/el-aterrador-despertar-de-clelia-verdier-estuvo-en-coma-3-semanas-pero-vivio-7-anos-y-tuvo-hijos/%3foutputType=amp-type). ***
![1000028134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/244A4vGtGaUJ7NambzGFXuwZYaXSt2cLkrY6EE47iuHJ5NBhvtUQzHr46qYSAhRcjo36Y.jpg)

Feliz miércoles Para todos mis apreciados amigos lectores, reciba respetado abrazo virtual de bienvenida mi blog personal, la noche de hoy aprovecho para compartirles un nuevo contenido como parte de mis actividades diarias en mi jornada laboral, elaborando un Araguaney, un material didáctico para presentar el valor de este recurso natural de nuestro país. Durante la mañana del día de ayer, se realizó la planificación para poner en práctica con los estudiantes de tercer grado también se le solicitó parte del material para la construcción de esta maqueta representando el árbol nacional de nuestro país, el bello Araguaney, uno de los recursos naturales representativos de nuestra identidad nacional. Aproximadamente a eso de las 9 de la mañana, me dirigí al salón de tercer grado para dar inicio al desarrollo de esta actividad donde previamente se les conversó sobre este importante tema además se le dio las diferentes orientaciones a seguir para la construcción de dicho material también cómo iban a trabajar los materiales hasta ir poco a poco armando cada pieza y obtener el resultado final. Fue una actividad muy significativa ya que se logró el objetivo de la construcción de dicha maqueta y la retroalimentación de la información.
![1001738500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKGa5SThmg5arnUAYiUgrq5hyydqn2MrcCr2yAVCSuQAHFZXCztT35xW39ob4yP.jpg)

title: Bond Yields Spike In The US, UK, And Japan As Investors Lose Confidence In Fiat
body:
In today's article, we are going to discuss the recent spike in global bond yields, an possible loss of confidence in traditional fiat currencies, and some potential solutions.

# Surging Interest Rates

Since the 1980s until about six years ago, interest rates on US bonds had been trending downwards.  

The 30-year treasury, for example, fell from 15% in 1981 to less than 1% in March of 2020. The trend reversed sharply in 2021 though, when the US central bank (the Fed) hiked rates to curb inflation from the unprecedented covid bailouts.

Interest rates then rose sharply throughout 2021/2022, and began to consolidate between the 4% to 5% range. Yesterday however, the 30-year jumped to nearly 5.2%. This coincided with long-term rates surging on Japanese and UK government bonds as well.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXSdabqYreEfccAuKUJ19AxYNW9Ejt4SBRiGKb6ZyCbNa/30year.png

# What's The Big Deal?

Some people will claim that these higher rates aren't really a problem. After all, the 30-year was over 5.2% back in 2004. 

This time is different, however. 

Consider how back in 2004 the US national debt was *only* $7 trillion. As of 2026, the US govt has racked up nearly *$40 trillion* of debt. Also, the debt to GDP ratio was only 60% back in 2004. Now it has exceeded 120%. 

A rate of 5.2% today means *much higher* borrowing costs for governments, as well as higher payments for home owners who have their mortgages up for renewal. 

So why are bond yields surging?

# Rising Inflation And Loss of Confidence

As if inflation wasn't bad enough in 2022 (when it *officially* peaked at 9%), it has started to rear its ugly head again, increasing from 2.3% in January to 3.8% in April. 

Anyone on the ground who's actually paying for gas, groceries, and electricity would probably say that the rising cost of living is much worse than reported, however.

**Keeping ahead of this inflation is one reason why investors are demanding higher yields on bonds.**

The other possibility is that **bond holders are finally starting to lose confidence in governments' ability to service their massive debts**, and they are selling off their treasuries before a crisis hits.

The Fed is going to need to take action.

# Will The Fed Hike Or Cut?

The Fed's next scheduled meeting is June 16-17, and will be led by someone new.

Throughout his term, Trump had been complaining that former chairman Powell set interest rates too high, and threatened to replace him with someone who would lower them. 

A few days ago, Trump got his wish. Powell's term ended, and he was replaced with the more dovish Kevin Warsh.

Despite having a new chairman at the helm of the Fed however, *the market is still predicting that the Fed will actually raise rates at the next meeting,* due to rising inflation. 

That's quite something, considering how **interest payments are on a trajectory to become the US government's number one expense**:

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRVrnGAWCDUqEZgaXbafCC1k3aoN7wxgxzqNvZn4K58Xs/usinterest_costs.jpeg

Where will the government get the money to pay the additional interest if rates go up? 

Especially considering that the #3 holder (China) is no longer buying US treasuries ([they're selling them](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/china-dumps-record-number-of-us-treasuries-and-buys-gold-in-latest-de-dollarization-move)), and the #1 holder (Japan) will probably need to dump more of them to save their own economy. (The UK took #2 spot earlier this year).

Add to this the fact that in recent years [the Fed has shifted to issuing more short-term than long-term debt](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/how-the-us-treasurys-shift-to-shortterm-debt-could-undermine-inflation-control--bhj), raising rates this time around will cause interest costs to skyrocket even faster.

# The Worsening Predicament

To keep interest on federal debt under control, the Fed would need to lower rates. However, doing so would encourage more borrowing and only make inflation worse.

On the other hand, if they do raise rates to fight inflation, the cost of servicing government debt (as well as mortgages and car loans) would get out of control.

At the end of the day, if rates do rise, the Fed will need to buy more bonds from the government in order to fund the increasing interest costs, which just results in more inflation. 

The tightrope that the central banks have been walking for years is getting thinner, and we appear to be reaching a breaking point.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSAZn9Q6jydmJo6gS6fBy33kukaEzXhPSGqCSPfGhdXKq/powell_tight_rope.jpg

# So What Is The Solution?

The *powers that be* have likely had a solution planned out for over a decade. In fact, they have been openly talking about the need for a \

ever since covid.

We keep hearing more and more rhetoric about the implementation of digital IDs, and the roll-out of panopticon-like AI infrastructure.

A new financial system, powered by CBDCs or centralized [stablecoins](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/stablecoins-are-useful-for-now-but-doomed-to-failure), is just one component of the reset.

# Are There Any Other Options?

If you don't want to live in a prison planet (or a remote shack in the woods), I have a suggestion.

Bitcoin was introduced in 2009 as a permissionless, decentralized form of money, engineered to bypass intermediaries such as banks. Since then, the technology has evolved to enable smart contracts, decentralized autonomous organizations, AI agents, privacy, and more.

Using this technology, we can build out *parallel economies*, free from central control. Such a system would be run by and for the people, instead of the elite.

# AI Assets Are Waking Up

Just as bond yields spike around the world, [there are AI tokens skyrocketing](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/ai-spotlight-crypto-wakes-up-agentic-ai-tokens-are-skyrocketing-2dp) in the crypto ecosystem at the same time. 

Some of these tokens power AI agent launchpads and frameworks. These platforms could be used to build ZHCs (zero human corporations) under our supervision, but operated entirely by autonomous software.

For better or worse, these AI agents will eventually become the main economic actors of our world. They will take care of the details as we give them general guidance. 

Who controls these AI agents, and [which currencies will be used to power them](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/which-currencies-will-fuel-the-aipowered-economy-gu3), is still yet to be determined.

# Until next time...

Spiking bond yields in the US, UK, and Japan indicate that the traditional financial system is close to the breaking point, and may not last much longer. 

Thankfully, there is an alternative. Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies have been quietly laying the foundation for a new, decentralized economy.

Instead of closed systems, permissionless and unbridled competition in the AI/crypto space will ensure that everyone has a chance to participate. 

If you learned something new from this article, be sure to [check out my other posts](https://inleo.io/profile/brennanhm/blog) on crypto and finance here on [the Hive blockchain](https://inleo.io/@brennanhm/how-to-monetize-your-content-on-the-hive-blockchain). You can also follow me on [X](https://x.com/brennanhm) or [InLeo](https://inleo.io/profile/brennanhm) for more frequent updates.

# Further Reading

title: Television Review: Babel (Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, S1x05, 1993)
body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/6EgzraenXd92uCpvq0geqntgQmb.jpg)

**Babel (S01E05)**

Airdate: 24 January 1993

Written by: Michael McGreavy & Naren Shankar
Directed by: Paul Lynch

Running Time: 46 minutes 

From its very inception, *Star Trek: Deep Space Nine* set itself apart from its predecessors by embracing a distinctly darker, more morally ambiguous tone. It traded the *Enterprise*’s hopeful exploration for the grim reality of a war-torn, politically fractious frontier outpost. A prime and early example of this deliberate tonal shift is the fifth episode of the first season, *Babel*. Its premise is, upon reflection, quite terrifying—a creeping, silent disease that dismantles the very fabric of society—and is rendered all the more unsettling because it is rooted in a real-world medical condition. The episode’s genius, and its ultimate failure, lies in how this horrifying concept is initially presented through a lens of the mundane and even the faintly comical, a disarming tactic that the script never fully capitalises upon.

The episode begins in a deceptively mundane tone, perfectly capturing the station’s central metaphor as a decaying, bureaucratic nightmare. Chief Miles O’Brien, the everyman engineer, is visibly frustrated with the Sisyphean task of maintaining the Cardassian-built station. His life is a litany of constant repairs, particularly of the malfunctioning replicators left behind by the former occupiers. It is during one such routine repair that he accidentally triggers a hidden device,. This is the episode’s first masterstroke: embedding a planet-killing weapon within the banal headache of faulty plumbing. At first, the consequences seem minor. O’Brien merely acts more exhausted and irritable than usual. Then, with chilling suddenness, he begins to talk in gibberish. He is swiftly diagnosed with aphasia, a condition where the brain’s language centres are compromised, severing a person’s ability to communicate with the outside world. When Lieutenant Dax begins exhibiting the same symptoms, Dr. Bashir realises this is an infection. Captain Sisko’s order for a quarantine comes too late; the silent plague begins its inexorable spread through the population.

The investigation that follows reveals the virus’s insidious mechanism. It infiltrated the station’s replicators, which the entrepreneurial Quark had been illicitly rerouting to supply his bar. Initially spread through contaminated food, the pathogen mutated, becoming airborne and untraceable. Dr. Bashir discovers the virus is an artificial creation, a sleeper weapon planted during the Cardassian occupation. As the command staff, including Sisko, succumbs to the gibbering silence, the burden falls to Major Kira. In a race against time, she identifies the creator: a Bajoran scientist named Sumrak Ren (Matthew Falson), a former resistance fighter. After he refuses to help from the safety of Bajor, Kira has him beamed directly to the infected station. Once infected himself, his self-preservation instinct overrides his principles, and he is forced to develop an antidote.

Parallel to this central crisis, the episode offers its most successful element: the burgeoning ‘frenemy’ dynamic between Quark and Odo. With the station in chaos, a Boslic freighter captain, Jaheel (Jack Kehler), attempts to breach the quarantine to save his spoiled cargo. His damaged ship, still docked, threatens to explode and take the station with it. Quark, revealed to be immune, and Constable Odo, whose shapeshifting biology makes him invulnerable, are forced into an uneasy alliance. Their efforts to jettison the freighter, which succeeds in a safely distant explosion, provide the episode’s only genuine pulse of tension and heroism. It is a compelling subplot that saves the narrative from becoming a static medical mystery, showcasing the series’ unique potential in pairing its most ideologically opposed characters.

The script, co-written by television veteran Michael McGreavy and *Star Trek*’s unofficial science advisor Naren Shankar, is built upon an intellectually intriguing premise. The concept of aphasia as a vehicle for societal breakdown is potent, illustrating how the collapse of language unravels professional, familial, and communal bonds, leading to a near-apocalyptic scenario. Yet, the pervasive sense of doom is fundamentally tempered by the audience’s conditioned expectation. Much like the recurring ‘*Enterprise* will explode’ plots of earlier *Trek*, there is an inherent safety net; viewers know that by the episode’s end, the status quo will be restored. This inevitability drains the narrative of genuine stakes. The solution itself arrives with an almost *deus ex machina* convenience—the discovery of the Bajoran scientist and the subsequent development of the cure happen with remarkable speed, and the actual administration of the antidote is relegated to a voiceover narration. The crisis is resolved off-screen, a narrative cheat that feels particularly egregious given the build-up.

This structural weakness is compounded by a more profound script-level disappointment: the decision to make the creator of the bio-weapon a Bajoran resistance fighter rather than a Cardassian oppressor. This is a twist with immense potential, one that could have forced a brutal examination of the ethical quagmire of freedom fighting. What moral line is crossed when a resistance movement contemplates a weapon of apocalyptic devastation against a civilian population, even that of an occupying force? Does the cause justify any means? *Babel* raises this provocative question only to immediately drop it. Sumrak Ren is less a character than a plot device, his motivations and moral conflict left unexplored. The episode sidesteps the rich, dark complexity it itself introduced, opting instead for a simple, race-against-time thriller resolution.

To a degree, this failing is compensated for by the excellent character work, particularly the scenes between Quark and Odo. Their antagonistic yet weirdly respectful partnership is given room to breathe, and their action-packed subplot allows them to emerge as an unlikely heroic duo. It is a glimpse of the nuanced character dynamics that would later define the series. Furthermore, the direction efficiently sells the creeping horror of the outbreak, with the station’s corridors growing progressively quieter and more chaotic as language fails.

While *Babel* is a solid piece of television with a memorably terrifying premise, it remains a disappointing and largely forgettable episode. It does not transcend the standard clichés and procedural limitations of 1990s American broadcast television. It introduces profound ideas—the weaponisation of communication, the moral compromises of rebellion, the fragility of society—only to resolve them with a safe, conventional, and intellectually lazy conclusion. It is a fascinating blueprint for what *Deep Space Nine* could be: darker, more challenging, and willing to stare into the abyss. For this early instalment, however, it merely glances at the abyss before quickly looking away and restoring order with a comforting, and ultimately hollow, voiceover.



RATING: 5/10 (++)

title: Delicioso pollo al ajillo // (Esp/Eng)
body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![El texto del párrafo (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQvx53uhLFkUYvJZUjLHV6nhAhTU4Vaoov1qpkSRhbQGpWX54rkASSAPZLVdAbnRrKh.jpg)

> Hola a todos mis amigos. Esta vez les traigo una receta tan sencilla como deliciosa se trata de **Pollo al ajillo.** Me encanta preparar este tipo de comidas para consentir a la familia y disfrutar juntos en la mesa. Este plato tiene un toque increíble; ya que el ajo y el perejil fresco se unen para darle un aroma y un gusto espectacular. Lo mejor de todo es que a todos en casa les fascina, es facilísimo de hacer y combina perfectamente con un buen arroz con cúrcuma, una pasta o unos panes tostados. Espero que les guste y que se animen a hacerla en sus casas. ¡Aquí les dejo el procedimiento paso a paso! > Hello, everyone. Today I’m sharing a recipe that’s as simple as it is delicious: **Garlic Chicken.** I love making dishes like this to treat my family and enjoy a meal together. This dish has an incredible flavor—the garlic and fresh parsley combine to create a spectacular aroma and taste. Best of all, everyone at home loves it, it’s super easy to make, and it pairs perfectly with a nice turmeric rice, pasta, or some toasted bread. I hope you like it and feel inspired to make it at home. Here’s the step-by-step process!
![1000473530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23u69QkMV9wXSqTRCSG7jTSuf2uWuH7GAwskREmriVQpen3qUpYTEvbckaxnbLAJbDTAX.jpg)
--- ![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)

> - 1 pechuga grande - 1 cabeza de ajo - Ramas de perejil - 1 cucharadita de paprika - 1 cucharadita de ajo molido - 1/2 cucharadita de pimienta - 3 cucharadas de mantequilla - Aceite de oliva - Orégano - Sal

> - 1 large chicken breast - 1 head of garlic - Sprigs of parsley - 1 teaspoon of paprika - 1 teaspoon ground garlic - 1/2 teaspoon pepper - 3 tablespoons butter - Olive oil - Oregano - Salt

![1000473472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wX1YVRBPCnRVYj2hBdzpjS2vNzCR39jmRiRWpdWk6jDdpdXQsBty7UsKc5YAWo2hTXb.jpg)
![El texto del párrafo (31).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EowNPiUud55yj2BkuDpKGUA8asqcUnP2g4hytTz9iUtwoeMREbopLjBeaQpT27KBKrK.jpg)
- Lo primero que hacemos es cortar en trozos medianos y lavamos el pollo. >- The first thing we do is cut the chicken into medium-sized pieces and wash it.

title: Life System Analysis Part 2: The Hidden Provincial Economy Behind My City Life
body:
![104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/23yJLXQDJAstMpK6sVUedtaVYD4PSe9qN6RDdgQLyTuRTgVTr2tHPev1EBjrzLCnk5mZM.jpg)


Right now, I live in Makati but my real system is not here.

My income generating assets are 700 kilometers away in Antique, running quietly in their own rhythm, mostly without daily interference from me.

I used to think that meant distance. Now I realize it means structure.

The farm was not designed as a business at first. It became one through survival, trial, and necessity.

I have two hi bred sows that usually generate around ₱35,000 per parity.

![205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/AJhYKaQLecNXfThmiMK53khXThkS4fHmbCNZRB9wpuQ5K751WGd5aUH9kRVbyGV.jpg)
(*Duroc-pietrain sows, Bleach and Brenda.*)

 In good cycles, gross can reach around ₱50,000 per batch depending on survival rates and timing.

I also keep two mestisa sows managed with the help of my now separated cousin who is single at almost 40. Their piglets are usually sold at around ₱2,500 each at about 60 days old.


![209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/AJoHG8NN2vQHo3a7pPSi3wYde4SrSmvGtpfRcGtQQt8iDM6sY1SMJsR5E2bjNMm.jpg)
(*Mestizas sows Lyne and Maia with her piglets born last May 2, 2026.*)

Sometimes we do not treat everything as pure inventory. Some are butchered for kilo sales or family consumption, so the system also feeds the household directly.

There are also remaining chickens. I reduced them by about 75 percent when I left Antique because my mom could not manage them the way I used to. What remains is still active in the system.


![211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/AK3eHCqqXgVih8X7F3Wr4y5YZajgGbGV8BbuKrJEtXsWCnZg3UUuSBBsPj2JwPg.jpg)

![0cd44408-bcbe-410f-bf0c-a490002d153f-1_all_1544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/23vsQDBS9DMCkMR4mxp8HhqYozcW1Q7a9zEznQmMeygpeyTcng2iiUjKU9BMUy3tRW6AK.jpg)

(*When I was hands-on with my chickens.*)



She continues raising them. Some are used for family meals. Some are sold in pairs for around ₱500.

It is not a large operation on paper.

But it is complete.

Together with the ₱8,000 monthly allowance from my aunt, the structure produces roughly ₱250,000 in clean annual net income.

It does not look impressive to outsiders.

But it is powerful because almost nothing is wasted on overhead.

The system does not need to look big. It only needs to stay alive.

My Makati life, on the other hand, is unusually quiet.

People hear Makati and imagine constant spending, pressure, or fast city living. My reality is different.

I stay at home most of the time. I do laundry, wash dishes, write on my phone, and watch YouTube with my cousin Sachi while checking updates from Antique.

My aunt covers household expenses. Food, electricity, water, and internet are already handled.

So my farm income does not get swallowed by survival here. It grows. It stabilizes. It pays down obligations and strengthens the system back home.

That is the real difference.

In many setups, income disappears immediately into city life costs. In mine, the structure is separated. One side lives simply. The other side produces.

The family is what makes the system work.

My mom handles daily operations in Antique including feeding, care, and reporting cycles.

My dad, who drives a tricycle, (our very own from my Mom's wage caring for my pets), integrates farm supply runs into his normal routes. This removes delivery costs that would normally break small farm economics.

My youngest brother is currently in college, 2nd year. Like many students in a province setup, weekly GCash support has become part of the natural flow. It is not always predictable, but it is part of how education is sustained in a family based system. It also creates a constant reminder that cash flow is not only about production, but also timing and responsibility.


![0cd44408-bcbe-410f-bf0c-a490002d153f-1_all_2413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jellyvine/AJpjDgSpJJW8zusaRRiUbKKyQZKAFiYMxM5wS3oFwoFpg89kG4JfuncuZsbY7U7.jpg)
*Sweeney (first sow of mine) farrowing, my brother cared for her because he was more experienced. I just observed it then I did it later with Brenda and Bleach.*

He also handles critical labor during high risk periods in the farm when he is home, helping care for newborn piglets, trimming tails and teeth, and staying awake during difficult farrowing nights when attention decides survival.

In livestock systems like this, infrastructure matters, but human attention matters more. Especially at night when nothing is predictable.

There is also a circulation system built into the family itself, powered by mobile load and digital payments.

My mom sells data promos as a sideline. When capital runs out, I send load from Makati. She collects cash locally and uses it for household needs and small operational expenses, including basic food and necessities like bread that sustain her strength through constant work on the farm.

Part of the flow also goes to my dad for fuel and daily mobility, and he eventually sends money back through digital channels when needed.

Money does not stay in one place.

It moves through people.

It circulates instead of leaking.

What we built is not a corporate system.

It is a provincial survival economy upgraded with smartphones, GCash, and basic coordination.

It is not perfect.

But it works.

And for now, that is enough.

___
All photos are mine.
___
Thank you for reading this far.
PeakD literally became my diary, reflection platform on how far I went already to keep myself grounded.

See you on part 3.☺️
___

title: Casablanca (1942)  Is One Of The Most Famous Films Ever Made For A Reason. It Is Romantic, Stylish, Emotional, And Even Though Parts Of It Feel A Little Corny By Modern Standards, It Is Still An Absolute Classic To Me.
body:
Released in 1942 (yes that’s correct! Only my second pre 1969 film:) and directed by Michael Curtiz, Casablanca is one of those rare films that completely lives up to its legendary reputation. A lot of older classics get overhyped over time, but this one genuinely earns its place in film history. It combines romance, war drama, suspense, and unforgettable dialogue into something timeless.

![IMG_1772.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUo6U35UGLhaFqXzeT3xg9g7NdwH3i4BtHCPCEoRsrBnq/IMG_1772.webp)

Humphrey Bogart stars as Rick Blaine, the cynical American nightclub owner living in Casablanca during World War II. Rick tries to stay neutral and detached from the political chaos around him, running his nightclub while avoiding emotional attachment to anyone. Bogart gives the character a cool toughness, but underneath that you can feel the regret and heartbreak constantly simmering.

Then Ingrid Bergman enters the story as Ilsa Lund, and the entire movie changes. Bergman has an incredible screen presence here. She brings warmth, sadness, and mystery to the role, making it completely believable why Rick cannot move on from her.

The plot centers around stolen letters of transit that could allow important political refugees to escape Nazi controlled territory. Rick suddenly finds himself caught between doing what is safest for himself and helping Ilsa and her husband Victor Laszlo escape.

Paul Henreid plays Victor Laszlo, the respected resistance leader fighting against the Nazis. Laszlo could have easily been written as a bland heroic figure, but Henreid gives him dignity and intelligence. The love triangle works because all three characters feel understandable in their own way.

Claude Rains is also fantastic as Captain Renault, one of the most entertaining characters in the film. Renault shifts between humor, corruption, and genuine humanity throughout the story, and Rains delivers some of the movie’s best moments with effortless charm.

Michael Curtiz directs the film with elegance and confidence. The black and white cinematography gives everything a dreamlike quality, especially in the nightclub scenes filled with smoke, music, and tension. Every frame feels carefully constructed without ever becoming stiff.

The screenplay is legendary for a reason. So many lines from this movie became part of pop culture forever. “Here’s looking at you, kid,” “We’ll always have Paris,” and “Louis, I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship” still hold power because they are delivered with genuine emotion rather than feeling forced.

The film also works because it balances personal romance with larger historical stakes. Rick’s emotional struggle mirrors the larger question facing many people during wartime—whether to stay safe and detached or risk something for a greater cause.

Now yes, some parts of Casablanca definitely feel a little corny by modern standards. Certain romantic moments are heightened in that old Hollywood style, and the dialogue can occasionally feel theatrical compared to today’s more naturalistic films. But honestly, that charm is part of why the movie still works.

There is a sincerity to the film that modern movies sometimes lack. It is not embarrassed to be emotional or romantic. It fully commits to its drama, and that confidence gives it lasting power.

The famous “La Marseillaise” scene inside Rick’s café remains one of the strongest moments in classic Hollywood cinema. Watching the crowd drown out the Nazi officers with the French anthem still carries emotional weight decades later.

What makes Casablanca such a classic to me is that it understands sacrifice. The ending works because the characters make difficult choices instead of easy ones. The film values doing the right thing even when it hurts personally.

Over the years, countless films tried to recreate the same mix of romance and wartime drama, but very few matched the emotional honesty and atmosphere this movie created. It feels timeless because the emotions inside it are timeless.

![IMG_1774.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWsPdcGNMzTgLmdsSTck3QKE8avVf5mAXrrxQSHokXTjz/IMG_1774.webp)

In the end, Casablanca remains a classic to me because it is romantic, smart, emotional, and beautifully acted. Even with a little old Hollywood corniness around the edges, the heart of the film is completely genuine. That sincerity is exactly why it still holds up more than eighty years later.

body.title: The Beginning of My Vanilla Latte Journey ☕✨
body.body:
>

Hola amigos coffeelovers, espero que se encuentren súper bien. Por mi parte, estoy muy feliz de traerles un nuevo post para esta hermosa comunidad ☕✨


Revisando mi galería de fotos encontré estas imágenes que había tomado especialmente para compartirlas aquí, pero entre tantas cosas fui posponiendo esta publicación hasta ahora. Para comenzar, quiero contarles que esta panadería abrió sus puertas a mediados del año pasado (2025), pero no había tenido la oportunidad ni el tiempo de visitarla hasta que un sábado por la tarde mi novio me propuso ir a conocerla.

<div class=\

> ![Coffee 1.5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/Eoc6xqkvcFdmpftTGSwdw1wURw1nAcTABHLwH2SRoKLXh1Ec6Eo77t4hC7ZzwEQedpe.png) Obviamente, acepté la invitación, porque tenía muchísima curiosidad por probar su Latte Vainilla. Y sí, por si no lo sabían, estoy oficialmente en búsqueda del mejor Vanilla Latte, así que este post se convierte en el primero de esta pequeña serie cafetera que quiero compartir con ustedes 🤎 Mi primera impresión fue bastante curiosa, porque me sorprendió el tamaño de la taza. Generalmente, siempre pido el tamaño pequeño porque normalmente equivale a un “mediano” en muchos lugares, no sé si me explico 😅, pero esta vez sí era realmente pequeño comparado con lo que estoy acostumbrada. Ahora sí, hablemos del sabor. Honestamente, no tenía expectativas muy altas, ya que normalmente el café de panadería suele ser bastante simple o incluso demasiado tostado. Pero este latte definitivamente me hizo cambiar de opinión.

> ![Coffee 1.1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/EogNNjJo2hUjb4VFGsJnJuZAXFiDkKGnD6L1M2VVwumBxV1HN9w8aquWXnDAgJEyFcC.png) Lo primero que hice fue probarlo sin azúcar para evaluar bien el sabor del café y comprobar si estaba muy tostado o aguado… y para mi sorpresa, estaba perfectamente equilibrado. El sabor del café se sentía suave, cremoso y muy bien preparado. Luego le agregué un poco de azúcar y, aunque mejoró aún más el sabor, sinceramente podía haberlo tomado perfectamente sin nada adicional ☕✨ Sin duda fue una experiencia bastante agradable y un inicio prometedor para esta búsqueda del mejor Vanilla Latte. Ahora necesito seguir visitando cafeterías para comparar sabores y descubrir cuál terminará llevándose el primer lugar en mi ranking personal 🤭 Cuéntenme ustedes, ¿tienen algún lugar favorito para tomar un buen latte de vainilla? Los leo en los comentarios 💕

> ![Coffee 1.4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/Eoc5YQVRNAFDtfftUAGEUt5fHbCnG6F4k69LUWVEqGaMkCHqkoqSaAQ5FfQvdtT1mcL.png) **English ver.** Hello coffee lovers, I hope you’re all doing amazing. As for me, I’m really excited to share a new post with this wonderful community ☕✨ While going through my photo gallery, I found these pictures that I had originally taken specifically for this community, but with so many things going on, I kept postponing this post until now. To start, let me tell you that this bakery opened its doors around mid-2025, but I hadn’t had the chance or the time to visit until one Saturday afternoon when my boyfriend suggested we go check it out. Of course, I said yes immediately because I was really curious to try their Vanilla Latte. And yes, in case you didn’t know, I’m officially on a mission to find the best Vanilla Latte, so this post becomes the very first entry in this little coffee series I want to share with you all 🤎 My first impression was actually pretty funny because I was surprised by the size of the cup. I usually order the small size since in many places it ends up being more like a medium not sure if you know what I mean 😅 but this one was definitely smaller than what I’m used to. Now let’s talk about the flavor. Honestly, I didn’t have very high expectations because bakery coffee is usually pretty average or sometimes overly roasted. But this latte completely changed my mind. The first thing I did was taste it without sugar so I could really evaluate the coffee itself and see whether it was too strong or too watery… and to my surprise, it was perfectly balanced. The coffee tasted smooth, creamy, and very well made. Then I added a little sugar, and while it made the flavor even better, I honestly could have enjoyed it just the way it was ☕✨ Overall, it turned out to be a really pleasant experience and a promising start to my search for the best Vanilla Latte. Now I definitely need to keep visiting more coffee shops to compare flavors and discover which one will eventually earn the top spot in my personal ranking 🤭 Now tell me, do you have a favorite place to get a good Vanilla Latte? Let me know in the comments 💕 **Créditos** - La traducción del texto fue hecho a través

body.title: Go Kart in Danang:   This is a once in a lifetime experience
body.body: When you live in a tourist-rich environment like Da Nang you know it is only a matter of time before you end up with a Go Kart track. It just seems to be the way of the world. I have always wondered why they didn't have one already with all the unused land that exists around here and I would imagine that it probably has something to do with the astronomical rents that people charge for usage of land. I feel like the only way that a place like this could exist would be if someone was already a very wealthy landowner and a kid of theirs happened to be a fan of motorsports. Maybe that is what happened here, maybe not. But me and some friends went over that way to the track and decided to give it a go. It was reasonably fun and that cars were actually considerably faster than I thought they would be.

> This is something that I am glad I went and did it but I can say after going around the track twice, that was enough and I will almost certainly never go back to do this again. Why? Is it too expensive you stingy prick? No, it's actually very inexpensive at 100K ($4) a round.

> Are the karts pieces of crap that are falling apart and barely move? Quite the opposite actually, I was very impressed with the shape these things were in and it is the first time I have ever been on all electric go-kart type things in my life. The steering was very tight on them and the acceleration was a lot more intense than I expected.

> It's pretty scenic as well along the bay like it is and since we went there just as the sun was going down that made it even nicer. So it isn't too expensive, the track and cars are in good shape, and it is a good time. So why will I probably never go back? Well, it is because it is quite far away from everything else and all in I think me and my friends spent about 12 minutes racing go-karts and about an hour in the taxis. That's not a good tradeoff in my world.

> If you visit Da Nang you are most likely going to be in a similar situation because almost all the accommodation that tourists end up in, as well as most of the housing that expats tend to stay in, are all in this general area to the right of this map. While it doesn't seem very far looking at that, it takes a long time because going east to west in this fine city is a bit of a traffic nightmare and there isn't anything you can do to avoid that. Maybe living close to almost everything has made me more fussy about how much time I am willing to spend in a taxi but for the most part I don't want to spend any time at all in transit. That 20 minute estimate that google maps is suggesting is not at all true. If you can get from point A to B in less than 40 minutes you are doing quite well considering the traffic is going to be damn-near gridlocked the entire way. [I'll leave the location here if you want to try it out anyway](https://www.google.com/maps/place/GoKart+%C4%90a+Ph%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Bc/@16.0692622,108.2061315,14z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x314219d97d4df4bd:0xf2e40c0a618d255b!8m2!3d16.0792351!4d108.2064255!16s%2Fg%2F11z2y5_6g8?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDUxMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D). If you have more patience than I do for traffic then maybe it would be a worthwhile experience for ya. one thing I would like to see improved about this track is that there isn't a pit lane nor was there any sort of race imposed. You leave one-by-one with strangers as well as your friends and there wasn't any sort of competition. There was also parents with little kids on the track at the same time and some of the areas are so narrow that you can't safely pass anyone. I crashed once and can attest to the safety of the corners though as well as the straps and the guards on the vehicles. I crashed because I was trying to Tokyo drift around a corner and the wheels didn't skid. It kind of rattled me but it wasn't a big deal. If I had my foot on the outside of the cart, which is something they specifically advise against, it could have been a very nasty thing for my leg though! If they had a pit, laps, and structured races, I think I would have enjoyed it more but this wasn't really like a race so much as it was a relaxed drive in a retro-fitted parking lot.

>
<sub> this car was parked there as well and Mustangs are very rare over here in Vietnam.  I suspect it is a kit car but still impressive regardless </sub> </center> 

At the price though, I can't complain.  We had fun and none of us have really so much as mentioned going back again.  On the other hand we have gone to the VR place 5 times already and intend to go back to do it again every week!   

There is a restaurant, coffee shop (of course), and an arcade on site as well.   They don't open until 4pm and stay open pretty late and this closing time is dependent upon demand as they don't have official closing hours.  I would imagine they are obligated to close at some particular time but that was not posted.

Check it out!

body.title: Título para cocinar [resumen en cuento de los desesperados]
body.body:
Por Marien Cabrera Sánchez 
La caida número 56 del SEN había roto los ventiladores  y la noche prometía ser mortal. Sobre la mesa de madera, una hoja papel opalina brillaba bajo la lámpara solar: era el título universitario, impreso con sellos y firmas oficiales. Junto a él, una bolsa de carbón y un viejo fogón de hierro, que irónicamente fue una bala de gas licuado en otra época. Fuera, no tenía intención de escuchar los mismos sonidos y los mismos lamentos de la enfermedad.
Primero intenté rasgar una esquina de la primera hoja, solo para sentir el papel resistirse, como si supiera su destino. Recordé cinco años de becas, los viajes desde el pueblo, las noches de café de rayo y libretas interminables. Comogracias a ella forjé a la persona que soy. Los trabajos para mantenerme, los tiempos felices que no vuelven más. Luego los miré. El dilema no era si quemar el diploma, sino cómo hacerlo sin que el carbón prendiera antes de que el título se consumiera por completo.

Coloqué la hoja sobre la parrilla. El fósforo vaciló en mi mano. Si encendía primero el papel, las llamas devorarían años de esfuerzo en segundos, pero tal vez el carbón no reaccionaría y todo habría sido en vano. Si acercaba la llama al carbón directamente, quizás nunca chispearía sin un buen iniciador. El dilema ardía más que el fuego ausente.
Respiré hondo. Rocé el fósforo encendido contra la hoja, justo donde decía \

. El papel se retrajo, se retorció, y de su borde negro brotó una chispa que se enredó en las astillas de carbón. Entonces ocurrió: la hoja se incendió, como si hubiera esperado ese instante, y mientras el título se deshacía en volutas grises, el carbón lanzó un resplandor anaranjado. El calor, por fin, llegó para cocinar la comida.

body.title: A Wednesday stroll along Rotaria Avenue and 60th Street [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
>

Greetings, dear friends of the @wednesdaywalk community, which allows us to discover a new corner of the world we live in every Wednesday. I wish you all the best today.

This time, I want to show you another area in the western part of the city of Barquisimeto, between Rotaria Avenue and 60th Street, where I went looking for a store that sells wood and similar products to decorate my kitchen.

![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xKtCmNGf6gdyF2VveaUru47vdmHibkjh5JEKbVtqZyuYmcTgE6pF9UtrLktvQU28M2J.jpg)

In previous posts, I’ve shown you the western part of the city, starting at Las Industrias Avenue and going all the way to the El Obelisco roundabout. Now the tour heads south of the obelisk, heading toward the exit to Ribereña Avenue.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/244UmRW8ukRdjd4GrC5RdeXp1s2idGGcvZxMu6uWQmVrKSjfKUoEZfYStMA2UvnVu68JN.jpg)

If we take Rotaria Avenue from the obelisk, we will pass in front of the baseball stadium, home of the Lara Cardinals. The photos only show the fence and part of the stadium’s towers due to the camera’s position.


![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eptb1fMptC1AEgVucmfYkG9brcL6js1yQXmhcDN2vm29Fzo4nXx5eZryuREvZScRGTi.jpg)

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Ep3ePsRmnsAExpnLq6H5ZrYgCHsG9ssET7oM8LXZjXJLVGSihVKgHKjXU9dxwjhSp9b.jpg)


![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/243fn36bJf8qKZ8nAVCJBqMaSNQwYiVNXkjmFBsMiMVLRjZUUghNjREdNBfBGdb3xsBSb.jpg)

Then I arrived at Plaza Miranda, located one block from the Rotaria, and from there I walked along Calle 60, which is practically an avenue but without the median strip. This street is very busy because it crosses the city to Avenida Ribereña, which leads  toward Cabudare, and many taxi routes and shared taxis travel along it.


![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWmHB2g2vsstEHTfiTurwjyELfRZjNxThRNdgKMs2vtcg2weQt4eedjKierj9xnVNG.jpg)

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpVAandhWhVKSQoS8sb9bFG5mAy6sg2yAa6FQCqnJLyipptYePgRue2WVssLZXRfk7V.jpg)

It is generally a quiet area, but as noon approaches or in the late afternoon, traffic increases as people head out toward Cabudare, since many people who work in Barquisimeto spend the night there.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23qrL36KdvSv6AZ2wFrMQ3W7Pe2fxRj9bKVHxiKaRyNoHXNMDkGGZSye9YTegZ9YZy5y7.jpg)

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/245T3hEafxYbaaP4HDrSHDYoeeZzbHmwgp1ZvhfLSyNTVQM2UDu7LjNdJWYU8ssaNQTVr.jpg)

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eqd9Um5ENtcuZD4ubwS7wJP9UVfcBHN1oZPBrKraKYRy7S7NLCkLHEiUGdY5vQvUJtQ.jpg)

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2449z6gcFFqraCCMwSJrAoCzBfStujgGcMWFnahAG16AfJxCC9ZSbUzkVX2A4CMAMRPF3.jpg)


![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWmF5sArQtiTMbytFMEVweX8JEHfgYj4g14Ena61AYnmmtfDjZfrAQQuHz4bytoVSz.jpg)

<div class=\

> # Version en Español # Un miércoles recorriendo la Avenida Rotaria y calle 60 Saludos estimados amigos de la comunidad @wednesdaywalk que cada miércoles nos permite conocer un rincón del mundo en que vivimos, les deseo lo mejor en este día. En esta oportunidad les quiero mostrar otro sector del oeste de la ciudad de Barquisimeto entre las avenidas Rotaria y la calle 60, cuando salí a buscar un negocio donde venden madera y productos similares, para decorar mi cocina. ![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xKtCmNGf6gdyF2VveaUru47vdmHibkjh5JEKbVtqZyuYmcTgE6pF9UtrLktvQU28M2J.jpg) En anteriores publicaciones les he presentado la parte oeste de la ciudad, entrando por la avenida las industrias y llegando hasta la redoma el obelisco. Ahora el recorrido es hacia la parte sur del obelisco buscando hacia la salida a la avenida Ribereña. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/244UmRW8ukRdjd4GrC5RdeXp1s2idGGcvZxMu6uWQmVrKSjfKUoEZfYStMA2UvnVu68JN.jpg) Si tomamos la avenida Rotaria desde el obelisco, vamos a pasar frente al estadio de beisbol, sede del equipo de los cardenales de Lara. Las fotografías solo muestran la cerca y parte de las torres del estadio por la posición de la cámara. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eptb1fMptC1AEgVucmfYkG9brcL6js1yQXmhcDN2vm29Fzo4nXx5eZryuREvZScRGTi.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Ep3ePsRmnsAExpnLq6H5ZrYgCHsG9ssET7oM8LXZjXJLVGSihVKgHKjXU9dxwjhSp9b.jpg) ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/243fn36bJf8qKZ8nAVCJBqMaSNQwYiVNXkjmFBsMiMVLRjZUUghNjREdNBfBGdb3xsBSb.jpg) Luego llegué a la plaza Miranda, ubicada a una cuadra de la Rotaria, y desde allí recorrí la calle 60, que prácticamente es una avenida pero sin la isla central. Esta calle es muy concurrida porque atraviesa la ciudad hasta la avenida Ribereña que sale hacia Cabudare y por allí circulan muchas rutas de taxis y por puestos. ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWmHB2g2vsstEHTfiTurwjyELfRZjNxThRNdgKMs2vtcg2weQt4eedjKierj9xnVNG.jpg) ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpVAandhWhVKSQoS8sb9bFG5mAy6sg2yAa6FQCqnJLyipptYePgRue2WVssLZXRfk7V.jpg) Generalmente es una zona tranquila, pero cuando se aproxima la hora del mediodía o a finales de la tarde, el tránsito aumenta debido a la salida de las personas hacia Cabudare, ya que allí pernocta mucha gente que labora en Barquisimeto. ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23qrL36KdvSv6AZ2wFrMQ3W7Pe2fxRj9bKVHxiKaRyNoHXNMDkGGZSye9YTegZ9YZy5y7.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/245T3hEafxYbaaP4HDrSHDYoeeZzbHmwgp1ZvhfLSyNTVQM2UDu7LjNdJWYU8ssaNQTVr.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eqd9Um5ENtcuZD4ubwS7wJP9UVfcBHN1oZPBrKraKYRy7S7NLCkLHEiUGdY5vQvUJtQ.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2449z6gcFFqraCCMwSJrAoCzBfStujgGcMWFnahAG16AfJxCC9ZSbUzkVX2A4CMAMRPF3.jpg) ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWmF5sArQtiTMbytFMEVweX8JEHfgYj4g14Ena61AYnmmtfDjZfrAQQuHz4bytoVSz.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/244oUahvQj76TxR7XdqMBN1xUwoXuM6JBGaxTiTFc9yFsYAa3oQY8KGmSHAYuBySjD5xJ.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23yTYkiFKKudz5SC5Ft3SapjZnCpvpqMnYyzXsj5kxESRHGqqKuqy8xNKDokUbu9Pozox.jpg) ![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xeba53nVV2Li1v4rfiCqKpd7D5bUe5VZEgvyZyjKYDsPjJbtjttnSq8vghVnxm7V5mi.jpg) ![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/242NYj8ZWNythAko14LXPKyUtH4oS7z3Uyfrz5xawDgvtDy6FkLcrWaqRR4RbRaZwLwPz.jpg) Hasta aquí este breve recorrido por esta parte de la ciudad, espero encontrarnos nuevamente en otra oportunidad. Bendiciones para todos. ![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5tAfanGoki9gRgA1nn2EzvYT5vv3UHJpGVYDF6ChQArJuJ8CVE1AkE1RuurNAtemxv.jpeg) * Imágenes tomadas con Samsung Galaxy A12 * Portada elaborada con Canva * Traductor de texto utilizado: Deepl [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.059375 lat -69.352357 long d3scr)

### Hola Queridos amigos 🤗 😘🫂

---

<center>
Me complace estar una vez más por acá para continuar contándoles un poco de lo que son nuestras convivencias en familia, en esta ocasión les comento que nos fuimos a apoyar a mi hijo mayor en un torneo de kenpo karate 👊 ya saben valioso que es estar allí para apoyar cada paso que den nuestros hijos y bueno Yo como mamá orgullosa estuve en primera fila aplaudiendo cada una de sus presentaciones y viendo todo el avance que ha tenido en este deporte. 

---

Me sentí muy feliz al ver su desenvolvimiento y mucho más al ver que obtuvo cuatro medallas por ocupar el segundo y tercer lugar en cuatro de las competencias de las que participo y quedando en primer lugar en una de ellas 🤩  mi hijo está súper feliz con una sonrisa radiante que reflejaba su emoción 🥰

---

Sin duda fue un momento lleno de grandes satisfacciones y el cual celebramos con un familiar por qué es importante apoyar cada logro de nuestros hijos y demostrarles que siempre vamos a estar a su lado para brindarles todo el apoyo y la protección que ellos necesitan 💖
</center>

---

> ###  Hello Dear friends 🤗 😘🫂

---

> <center>
I’m happy to be back here once again to share a little more about our family outings. This time, I wanted to tell you that we went to cheer on my oldest son at a Kenpo karate tournament 👊 You know how valuable it is to be there to support every step our children take, and well, as a proud mom, I was in the front row cheering on each of his performances and watching all the progress he’s made in this sport. 

---

I felt so happy seeing how well he did, and even more so when I saw that he won four medals—taking second and third place in four of the events he competed in and coming in first in one of them 🤩  My son is over the moon, with a beaming smile that showed just how excited he was 🥰

---

It was undoubtedly a moment filled with great satisfaction, and we celebrated it with a family member because it’s important to support every achievement our children make and show them that we’ll always be by their side to give them all the support and protection they need 💖
</center>

body.title: La Tripleta [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

La Tripleta. Hoy estamos activos con tres ejercicios diferentes, que harán que todo tu cuerpo entrene como nunca. Imagínate realizar unos saltos cortos, mientras estás apoyado en una rodilla; no podrás elevarte mucho para ejecutar este movimiento. También; sentirás todo el peso sobre el tren superior, mientas las rodillas se flexionan hasta el ras del suelo y la cadera baja. O simplemente; sentirás el poder de la plancha, mientras codos y rodillas se encuentran. Simplemente; ejercicios muy completos y que estoy seguro te animarás a realizar; claro está, siempre trabajando a tu ritmo. >The Triple Play. Today we’re working out with three different exercises that will give your whole body a workout like never before. Imagine doing some short jumps while resting on one knee; you won’t be able to lift yourself very high to perform this movement. Also, you’ll feel all the weight on your upper body as your knees bend until they’re parallel to the floor and your hips drop. Or simply, you’ll feel the power of the plank as your elbows and knees meet. Simply put, these are very comprehensive exercises that I’m sure you’ll be eager to try—of course, always working at your own pace.

![1000461287.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKYPHvH9HiEwyeRhFQ3LUqNNcWaaHPD67r9gp8DsT8GTGybi1aNwjmJM67QjgpG.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **CAMINATA EN SITIO EN PUNTA DE PIES**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; elevamos un talón y dejamos el otro pie casi apoyado totalmente en el piso. El codo del lado del pie no elevado se flexiona. El otro brazo se extiende hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 1**, **ON-THE-SPOT WALK ON TOES**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; lift one heel and keep the other foot almost completely flat on the floor. Bend the elbow on the side of the foot that is not lifted. Extend the other arm downward.
![1000461251.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZncAECiAXCQc2aQdNm7BS2D9QrehZLbTKrx186PgtnGZmoC4syUmGiFRjw9EP.gif)
[Ejecución]() Simplemente; durante 3 minutos, vamos elevando y bajando los talones sin que peguen del piso. Se acompaña el movimiento con la flexión y extensión alterna de codos. >[Execution]() >Simply put, for 3 minutes, lift and lower your heels without letting them touch the floor. Accompany the movement by alternately bending and straightening your elbows.
![1000461260.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKqaQtKkoSKUVENhpBjt1GDrv2d71pTRc4db5D5cfbPFVdNB9imbH3j4UokC94o.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TIJERAS CON APERTURA Y CRUCE DE BRAZOS Y PIERNAS**]() [Postura]() Para activarnos con el movimiento; iniciamos con las piernas juntas y los brazos juntos al frente extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 2**, **SCISSOR KICKS WITH ARMS AND LEGS CROSSING**]() >[Position]() >To get moving, start with your legs together and your arms extended downward in front of you.
![1000461262.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKZnqsu1Rnq9MudxmuipzaLPgp92LAyFfavpXUGRPXeHVQiFdRg2pYtd7UrFmsM.gif)
[Ejecución]() A través de saltos; vamos abriendo a los lados, brazos y piernas al mismo tiempo. Al regresar; los brazos y piernas se cruzan. Los cruces se intercambian. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >As you jump, spread your arms and legs out to the sides at the same time. As you land, cross your arms and legs. Alternate the crosses. 3 minutes of movement.
![1000461264.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKcfNtowya54D6oFhFhBzrNXXKzcX1G15ov1wsa5hQhN8u8GhiV4YQWNSAn8KFy.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **SALTOS CORTOS CON APOYO EN UNA RODILLA**]() [Postura]() Usamos un material acolchado para proteger las rodillas. Apoyamos una rodilla sobre el cojín; la otra rodilla se flexiona y quedamos apoyados con la punta de ese pie. Codos flexionados con brazos al frente; manos a nivel del mentón y cuerpo recto. >[**Station 1**, **SHORT JUMPS WITH ONE KNEE ON THE GROUND**]() >[Posture]() >We use a padded mat to protect our knees. We rest one knee on the mat; the other knee is bent, and we balance on the ball of that foot. Elbows are bent with arms in front; hands are at chin level, and the body is straight.
![1000461266.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL7NfNhYvPfgqYEJt9SkfHaggRr745NtJ7mfAzzDLX1jukwReiA2qGpxvDCXWoJ.gif)
[Ejecución]() Aquí activamos todo el tren inferior y el abdomen; brazos se tonifican. A través de saltos; vamos quedando apoyados con una rodilla de forma alterna; se acompaña con el movimiento de brazos. Ejecutamos 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >This exercise engages the entire lower body and core; it also tones the arms. As you jump, land on one knee at a time, alternating sides, while moving your arms in time with the movement. Perform a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000461268.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL8owfFyBNtXPNfiMs8dyLF3CDBpfzYzNcQXyKbiCiqhhDnrrFUuyVNxiqurYmx.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **FLEXIÓN DE RODILLAS AL RAS DEL SUELO, EN POSTURA DECLINADA DE FLEXIONES EN PICA**]() [Postura]() Apoyamos las manos en el piso; llevamos los pies al mueble y elevamos la cadera. Caminamos de manos un poco hacia atrás, para quedar en postura de flexiones en pica declinadas. Piernas rectas. >[**Station 2**, **FLAT-KNEE PUSH-UP IN A DECLINED PUSH-UP POSITION**]() >[Position]() >Place your hands on the floor; bring your feet to the bench and lift your hips. Walk your hands back slightly to get into a decline push-up position. Keep your legs straight.
![1000461272.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AL7NhHpBDFbk6Qu7uBGUhYGFmLEKxN4V3jz8hUZUU3fvkMQRhna2KD1zY163Zqd.gif)
[Ejecución]() De verdad que se siente una tensión absoluta en todo el tren superior. Se trabaja de forma importante el núcleo y los cuádriceps. Simplemente; flexionamos ambas rodillas y las bajamos sin tocar el piso. Realizamos el movimiento en 20 repeticiones por 4 series. >[Execution]() >You can really feel the tension throughout your entire upper body. This exercise works your core and quadriceps intensely. Simply bend both knees and lower them without touching the floor. Perform 20 repetitions for 4 sets.
![1000461276.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AL5wA2sAPq7LXN5UxYUqkQKdsEhJ6eLDf8FnJhpcctjroQa1bbTjTFW4G8SbHsZ.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **RODILLA A CODO EN PLANCHA CON APOYO DE ANTEBRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Igualmente, podemos usar un apoyo para proteger los antebrazos. Apoyamos los antebrazos sobre el cojín; extendemos las piernas, las cuales quedan separadas al ancho de la cadera. >[**Station 3**, **PLANK WITH ELBOWS ON THE GROUND AND FOREARMS SUPPORTED**]() >[Position]() >We can also use a support to protect our forearms. Rest your forearms on the cushion; extend your legs so they are hip-width apart.
![1000461279.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKZoCrxrieSKQCxM97YHxRcC98ufw3gMUhSxRRDhqdAYb1sXWMP2pRwvSUDMm3H.gif)
[Ejecución]() Tren superior, abdomen y tren inferior en acción; los oblicuos se activan mucho más. Para realizar el ejercicio; damos rodillazos alternos casi laterales y los codos se llevan hacia atrás, al encuentro con las rodillas. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Upper body, core, and lower body in action; the obliques are engaged much more. To perform the exercise, bring your knees up alternately in a nearly sideways motion, and bring your elbows back toward your knees. 20 repetitions total in 4 sets.
![1000461281.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKZoACavUeKMwfE1mqAVBazvhSrUZQYspYBNxy45Dm8bRfRaxqreUQZGudUSeW4.gif)

The perks of not being dependent anymore. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b99d593d-d379-4ec9-a550-4b76aad42485.jpg) I worked all morning on ideas for a friend of mine, to boost his business a little. Different reason, but same result. We went to two different locations. It’s hard to find alcohol free beer here, so we got the last two bottles at one location, and then the last two bottles at another location. Great conversations. He’s a really good guy, coming out of a rough patch, but seemingly handling everything better by the day. It’s always great to see friends getting better. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/258ba02a-7403-4b13-8905-66e33abbf46b.jpg) In the late afternoon, I cleaned the improvised cat sand box. I had brought Nero to the garden in the morning, but something spooked him and he took off directly. Weird cat. I had left the door to the roof terrace open, and for some reason he went there instead of back into the flat, and then on to other roofs. Probably to do his rounds. Haven’t seen him since, but he’s probably catching up on the cat gossip and will be back for food, soon. So far for tonight. Hope you’re doing well, thank you for reading and have a good night!

body.title: TOP 3 mẫu chiếu điều hòa kích thước 1m6x2m bán chạy 2026
body.body:
Mùa hè với thời tiết oi bức khiến nhu cầu tìm kiếm các sản phẩm hỗ trợ làm mát khi ngủ ngày càng tăng cao. Trong đó, chiếu điều hòa 1m6x2m được nhiều gia đình lựa chọn vì phù hợp với kích thước giường đôi phổ biến hiện nay. Không chỉ giúp bề mặt nằm thoáng hơn, sản phẩm này còn hỗ trợ hạn chế tình trạng nóng lưng, đổ mồ hôi và mang lại cảm giác dễ chịu hơn trong những đêm hè khó ngủ. Tuy nhiên, nhiều người vẫn thắc mắc liệu chiếu điều hòa có thực sự “mát lạnh” như quảng cáo hay không.

Thực tế, chiếu điều hòa không tạo hơi lạnh như máy điều hòa mà hoạt động theo cơ chế tản nhiệt và tăng độ thông thoáng cho bề mặt nằm. Hiệu quả làm mát sẽ phụ thuộc vào chất liệu, thiết kế sản phẩm cũng như môi trường sử dụng. Nếu dùng trong phòng có điều hòa hoặc quạt mát, chiếu sẽ phát huy hiệu quả rõ rệt hơn và giúp người dùng cảm thấy dễ chịu khi ngủ.

Hiện nay trên thị trường có nhiều dòng chiếu điều hòa 1m6x2m với chất liệu đa dạng. Trong đó, chiếu sợi mây được đánh giá cao nhờ khả năng làm mát tự nhiên và thoáng khí vượt trội. Bề mặt chiếu không giữ nhiệt nên mang lại cảm giác dễ chịu kể cả khi không bật điều hòa. Tuy nhiên, loại này cần được vệ sinh cẩn thận vì khá khó giặt bằng máy. Bên cạnh đó, chiếu điều hòa Tencel cũng rất được ưa chuộng nhờ chất liệu mềm mại, thân thiện với làn da và có thể giặt máy tiện lợi. Dòng này phù hợp với những ai thích cảm giác nằm êm ái và sử dụng trong phòng ngủ có điều hòa.

Ngoài ra, chiếu điều hòa cao su non cũng là lựa chọn nổi bật nhờ khả năng nâng đỡ cơ thể tốt và độ đàn hồi cao. Thiết kế nhiều lớp giúp tăng sự êm ái khi nằm và hạn chế xô lệch trong quá trình sử dụng. Tuy nhiên, dòng sản phẩm này sẽ phù hợp hơn với không gian có máy lạnh vì phần lõi cao su có xu hướng giữ nhiệt nếu phòng quá nóng. Trong khi đó, chiếu lụa và chiếu 3D lại được yêu thích nhờ cảm giác mềm mại, thoáng khí và tính thẩm mỹ cao, phù hợp với các không gian phòng ngủ hiện đại.

Một số mẫu chiếu điều hòa được nhiều người quan tâm hiện nay có thể kể đến như Doona Aqua, Doona Wave 5D hay Amando Aero 3D. Các sản phẩm này đều được cải tiến về công nghệ làm mát, khả năng tản nhiệt cũng như độ êm khi nằm. Bề mặt vải làm mát kết hợp lớp lưới 3D hoặc lõi đàn hồi giúp tăng lưu thông không khí, hạn chế hầm bí và mang lại cảm giác thoải mái hơn trong suốt thời gian ngủ.

Khi chọn mua chiếu điều hòa 1m6x2m, người dùng nên ưu tiên sản phẩm có kích thước phù hợp với nệm để tránh xô lệch khi sử dụng. Đồng thời nên lựa chọn các mẫu có đai chun cố định hoặc mặt đáy chống trượt để tăng độ ổn định. Ngoài ra, cần chú ý vệ sinh và bảo quản đúng cách nhằm kéo dài tuổi thọ sản phẩm, đặc biệt với các dòng cao su non hoặc sợi mây.

Hiện nay, nhiều người lựa chọn mua chiếu điều hòa tại Vua Nệm nhờ hệ thống phân phối uy tín, sản phẩm chính hãng và nhiều chương trình ưu đãi hấp dẫn trong mùa hè. Có thể thấy rằng, nếu lựa chọn đúng chất liệu và sử dụng phù hợp với nhu cầu thực tế, chiếu điều hòa 1m6x2m sẽ là giải pháp hữu ích giúp cải thiện chất lượng giấc ngủ trong những ngày nắng nóng.

body.title: Walk and stroll along Morrocoy Beach in Falcon State [ENG/ESP]
body.body: # Walk and stroll along Morrocoy Beach in Falcon State [ENG/ESP]\n\n<div class=\

>

Good evening, friends of the @Wednesdaywalk community. It’s a pleasure to greet you. Today, once again, I’m joining the excellent Wednesday walk initiative led by my friend @tattoodjay. I hope you’ve all had a wonderful Wednesday with your loved ones. Welcome to my blog.

![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7Dn1HWrpgNimLsN8Bu4jNGSB38HVAia9NsV4B142KMRqWFg5bZrv5VwByffHY74CsZ.jpg)

Today  I’m going to tell you about a trip I took with my family a couple of months ago. We went to the beautiful Morrocoy Beach, located about two and a half hours from my city, specifically in Falcón State, Venezuela. I had forgotten to share this with the community. 

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqFrRXNYGLB8KgwnRe5tRjSjcheFmXrV4aimiu27MEgkkZ35dkc6buCbk2Fqj9m9sCn.jpg)

One fine day, we woke up thinking we wanted to visit the beach that weekend, just to get away from the daily grind a bit. Besides, it had been a while since we’d been to any of the beaches for various reasons; sometimes, when we had the time to go, we didn’t have the money, or other obstacles came up. Venezuela has beautiful beaches all along its coastline, including beaches along the Atlantic coast, the shores of Lake Maracaibo, the eastern coast, the coast of Carabobo State, and the coast of Falcón State, among others. The beaches in Morrocoy, in Falcón State, are the closest to me, which is why I chose to go to Morrocoy.

![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqYtDBFMkhW87ts2iQxC9aehoSmXgCRaD41Q6yAHL4Tju9rvG3arPMPemJg1DCn1k7S.jpg)

![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqfEuo8bgXVpCd192NQTXyNDmBPCbiupkgouYD8k1kjUB8DTQrF67hoWdcwmMpm9CUo.jpg)

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogPoWfgwgbVj71e4cUACZUoYtvPybtaz5qnZe11BkgWy63asEsmoyYWaDDiukmp6FB.jpg)

The beaches and cays are absolutely stunning, with crystal-clear water and soft, shifting sand free of stones or rocks. That day we enjoyed beautiful sunshine and a clear sky free of rain clouds—just a few scattered clouds that, as I watched them, moved and passed over or beneath one another.



![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xp2258rkpXhba9RCC2jUenM4ux9SVU44jjiD1Xwuug1TSUzKYdTmDfU92ZqHz9arCHJ.jpg)

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EnqT53AJ6S1wV57mSDzzFQ1gDFPQAk6S8YmCYLxQBPKqVbavHtrZsYvfTUHMYQKJ3P8.jpg) |![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpxrFBNpiTKtBzoLiuafXnJhwdAy9jW1vJv26YGdFdwEWsEtkwxWW3da1YXL7Wzs3sT.jpg)
-|-

When we arrived in Morrocoy, we drove quite a distance to drop off the car, and from there we walked so much that by the time we reached the beach, I was very tired. I sat down to rest so I could go for a swim, then walk along the entire shoreline, feeling the soft sand beneath my feet and taking in the scenery surrounding this beautiful beach.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/2423srW2oCpZkqqA7wh2PyGswjL8Gy8snmjBKbGfpE4mCCdJ4sykg5Dmw2WVEGbRgZ7z5.jpg) |![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqQQXEpmhxrr5YPWPnSBENK1PVCf4TdurQ8KEP2iJUYQquVresk3dbQT2QzTagEE2op.jpg)
-|-
