# Caminata y paseo por la playa de morrocoy en el Estado Falcon

<div class=\

> Buenas noches amigos de la comunidad de @Wednesdaywalk, gusto en saludarlos, hoy una vez más me uno a la excelente iniciativa de la caminata de los días miércoles del amigo @tattoodjay, espero que todos hayan pasando un lindo miércoles, junto a sus seres queridos. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog. ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7Dn1HWrpgNimLsN8Bu4jNGSB38HVAia9NsV4B142KMRqWFg5bZrv5VwByffHY74CsZ.jpg) Hoy les voy a comentar sobre un paseo que realice junto a mi familia, hace un par de meses atrás, dicho paseo lo realice a la hermosa playa de morrocoy, ubicada a unas dos horas y media de mi ciudad, específicamente en el Estado Falcón - Venezuela. Se me había olvidado traerlo a la comunidad. ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqFrRXNYGLB8KgwnRe5tRjSjcheFmXrV4aimiu27MEgkkZ35dkc6buCbk2Fqj9m9sCn.jpg) Un buen día amanecimos pensando en que queríamos visitar ese fin de semana la playa, para salir un poco de la rutina, además teníamos un buen tiempo sin ir, a ninguna de las playas, por diferentes motivo, algunas veces cuando teníamos disponibilidad de tiempo para ir no teníamos dinero o se nos presentaban diferentes inconvenientes. Venezuela tiene lindas playa por varios costados del pais, tanto playas del litoral como de la costa del lago de Maracaibo, costas orientales, del estado Carabobo, de las costas del estado falcón, en fin. Las playas ubicadas en morrocoy, del Estado Falcón son las mas cercanas que tengo, motivo por el cual elegí ir a morrocoy. ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqYtDBFMkhW87ts2iQxC9aehoSmXgCRaD41Q6yAHL4Tju9rvG3arPMPemJg1DCn1k7S.jpg) ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EqfEuo8bgXVpCd192NQTXyNDmBPCbiupkgouYD8k1kjUB8DTQrF67hoWdcwmMpm9CUo.jpg) ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogPoWfgwgbVj71e4cUACZUoYtvPybtaz5qnZe11BkgWy63asEsmoyYWaDDiukmp6FB.jpg) Las playas y cayos son muy ricos, donde el agua es cristalina y una arena movediza sin piedras o rocas. Ese día gozamos de buen sol, de un cielo claro libre de nubes llenas de agua, sino unas nubes que al contemplarlas observaba como se movían y pasaban unas por encima o por debajo una de las tras. ![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xp2258rkpXhba9RCC2jUenM4ux9SVU44jjiD1Xwuug1TSUzKYdTmDfU92ZqHz9arCHJ.jpg) bañarme, luego caminar por toda la orilla del mar y sentir esa arena tan rica en los pies y poder observar todo el paisaje que rodea a esta hermosa playa. body.title: Electric In Your Light 2
body.body:
by @manuel78 on Manuel 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/manuel78 [![Electric In Your Light 2](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/9f0584e6-9ac5-460a-995d-eb37cbf6e428.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/5NjACq2ULZwBW3gNL4C9nq) 
 
 Lyrics by me plus lyric generator 


- Wings Through Time

Let’s talk about Elara. No, not the kind of Elara you’d find in a modern coffee shop sipping matcha and scrolling through her phone. I’m talking about the Elara who has walked this earth for seven thousand years. Yes, you read that right. Seven millennia. And before you start picturing some brooding, 

cape-wearing creature lurking in castles, let me clear that up right away: she’s a vampire bat girl. But not the kind from horror movies. Think elegant 

wings that fold like silk, eyes that hold the patience of ancient forests, and a presence so quietly commanding that kings and queens naturally made room for her at their tables.
She didn’t conquer the early world with fire and fangs. She walked into it as an observer, a traveler with wings and a mind sharp enough to outlast empires. And here’s the beautiful part: she wasn’t treated as a monster. In the courts of early river valleys, the palaces of bronze-age city-states, and the marble 

halls of ancient Mediterranean realms, rulers didn’t fear her. They welcomed her. They treated her as an equal. Why? Because she listened. She sat with pharaohs under starlit courtyards, debated philosophy with scholars in silk robes, and shared quiet evenings with queens who were more than just figureheads—they were strategists, poets, and survivors. She absorbed their 

wisdom long before she ever considered questioning their rule.
For centuries, she served. Not as a servant, but as a confidante. She helped draft treaties that brought decades of peace. She advised on irrigation, on astronomy, on the delicate balance of keeping a kingdom stable. She learned statecraft from kings who valued her counsel. She learned diplomacy from queens who trusted her with their deepest fears. She learned architecture, medicine, music, and the quiet art of ruling with a gentle hand. Every court 

she graced treated her with respect, and in return, she gave them her loyalty, her insight, and her wings when they needed protection.
But seven thousand years is a long time to watch history repeat itself. You start to notice patterns. You see how even the best rulers, the kindest monarchs, the most enlightened councils eventually fall prey to pride, corruption, or the slow rot of inherited power. Elara watched as empires that once championed justice turned inward, hoarding wealth, silencing dissent, and waging wars over borders that shouldn’t have mattered. She watched as the very people who had once treated her as an equal grew distant, paranoid, or cruel. Not all of them, of course. But enough. And when you’ve lived through the rise and fall of civilizations, you stop waiting for the world to fix itself. You realize that sometimes, the only way to make room for something new is to let the old crumble.


So she began to destroy kingdoms. Not with rage. Not with bloodlust. But with precision. She used everything they had taught her. The same strategies kings used to outmaneuver rivals? She turned them against the corrupt. The same diplomatic tricks queens used to unite fractured lands? She used them to quietly unravel alliances built on greed. She didn’t storm castles with an army. She walked into courtrooms, into treasury vaults, into war rooms, and she pulled the threads. She exposed hoarded gold to the starving. She leaked battle plans to the oppressed. She whispered truths that shattered illusions of divine right. And when the structures finally collapsed, she stood in the 

dust, wings folded, watching the sky clear for the first time in generations.
People call her a destroyer. They don’t understand that she’s a gardener. She learned from the very people who treated her right, and when those lessons turned into warnings, she applied them. She doesn’t take joy in ruin. She takes solace in renewal. Every fallen crown, every crumbling fortress, every shattered dynasty was a necessary winter before a new spring. She’s watched humanity repeat the same mistakes for millennia, and she finally accepted that she couldn’t just advise from the sidelines anymore. She had to intervene. Quietly. Carefully. With the grace of someone who has loved this world enough to let it break so it could heal.

Today, she still walks among us. You won’t find her in palaces or on thrones. Those days are behind her. Now, she lives in the quiet spaces between cities, in libraries, in community centers, in places where people gather to build rather than conquer. She still has her wings, still carries seven thousand years of memory in her eyes, but she’s no longer waiting for kings to call her to court. She’s already at the table, sitting with everyday people, sharing stories, listening, learning, and occasionally nudging history in a gentler direction.

If you ever meet someone who speaks with the calm certainty of centuries, who looks at you like they’ve seen your ancestors and still believes in your future, don’t be surprised if you notice a faint shadow of wings behind them in the lamplight. It’s probably her. Still learning. Still guarding. Still reminding us that even the oldest crowns are just metal, and the truest power has always belonged to those who choose to build, to break, and to begin again.
And honestly? I’m just glad she’s still here to tell us the story. 
 ***

>[Herald Economy = Reporter Seo Ji-yeon] Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin made their stance against sanctions and pressure on North Korea official in a joint statement, emphasizing the maintenance of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. However, as the mention of North Korea's denuclearization was excluded, a subtle temperature difference was also revealed from the results of the recent summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and President Xi.

>According to China's state-run Xinhua News Agency on the 21st, President Xi and President Putin adopted a \
after the Beijing People's Great Hall summit the day before.\nIn a joint statement, the leaders of the two countries said, \

>The two countries said that considering the geopolitical reality, each country should balance concerns in a political and diplomatic way on the basis of respecting mutual sovereignty.
He added that he will continue close communication and cooperation in the future, play a constructive role in political resolution of the Korean Peninsula issue, establishing a peace regime, and maintaining long-term stability in Northeast Asia.
The joint statement is interpreted as a message aimed at the recent moves by the U.S., South Korea and Japan to strengthen cooperation with North Korea and the U.S. to strengthen extended deterrence. In particular, given that the statement came right after criticizing the U.S. and Israel's military actions against Iran, analysts say that China and Russia have made clear their stance against the U.S. pressure on the Korean Peninsula.
However, the joint statement did not include expressions related to North Korea's denuclearization.
This is different from the recent White House announcement that \

after the summit between President Trump and President Xi in Beijing.
Markets and diplomats also analyze that China maintains the principle of denuclearization in terms of managing relations with the United States, but in actual approaches to North Korea, it is focusing on stabilizing the North Korean regime and easing sanctions along with Russia.

>Meanwhile, the possibility of President Xi visiting North Korea as soon as next week is also being discussed.
A senior government official told Yonhap News that \

and the U.S. weekly Time also quoted an anonymous source as saying that Xi will visit North Korea as early as next week.
Seo Ji-yeon, sjy@heraldcorp.com

For a stable inter-Korean situation, cooperation with China seems increasingly important at this moment.

Fortunately, our country does not have poor relations with China or Russia, so this is a good opportunity to actively bring North Korea to the table for dialogue together.

Let’s work to ease these tiresome geopolitical risks.

body.title: 소남머리(소낭머리)-담수욕장
body.body:
서귀포에 용천수가 나오는 자구리공원이 있습니다.
자주 가는 곳인데 그동안 못 봤던 곳이 멀리 보이더라구요.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_08.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcabo4NhLpmTkPEBXEyiZF9YL1S56wWvEyfPxEz83EfAj/KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_08.jpg)

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbs7VF8DARP8e25bZdLYVTwxqaW8BNENTLMApdb5FAHvN/KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353.jpg)

그동안 여기를 왜 못가봤을까? 하는 마음에 찾아가봤습니다.

이곳의 명칭이 소남머리인지 소낭머리인지는 정확히 모르겠습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQUon1WDW7gAYPdjaU6VQcuHzidjK1847mUpcNLuA6FTs/KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_03.jpg)

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdL3noZsKZ6BLCzfM7axHiEGS1F6kW5V8Jwm5VVnEKiM1/KakaoTalk_20260521_103812353_02.jpg)

입구에 안내판에 두가지 모두 씌여있거든요.
계단이 있었지만 많이 내려가지는 않았습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_28.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXMSUD4wUymbP37699TiLpfUdpBm29wcqaisQNWZPqYC6/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_28.jpg)

서귀포 앞바다가 한눈에 보이는 용천수가 흐르는 목욕탕입니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_26.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeewjWMt1t4h5pKAQcxqj3RLmMFocexEAkZh18VeUKC3k/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_26.jpg)

그런데 목욕탕이라고는 하지만 사용한 몸을 담그고 있는 것보다는 조경시설처럼 보이긴 했습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_26.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeewjWMt1t4h5pKAQcxqj3RLmMFocexEAkZh18VeUKC3k/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_26.jpg)

왼쪽은 남탕, 오른쪽은 여탕인데요.
안에 들어가보기 전에 보니 남탕에서 내려오는 용천수가 바다로 흘러들어 가는 물길이 마치 시냇물처럼 보였습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_21.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgZRgbSfLq6pNnNm5FTUaKpRpD75wAgGV6GvHUx83dT6/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_21.jpg)

물길을 따라서 내려가면 바다로 입수 가능하도록 되어 있었는데 제가 간 날은 파도가 무척 거칠었습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_19.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQJoz6X99sc7P46Rb2bJohgKCExnBrx7sKphanyyTc8Jk/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_19.jpg)

이용안내문을 보니 이곳을 사용하긴 하나봅니다. 

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_05.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWz54YzKQBFZVeyUvMyLRFt8jtPxuJ8UJHTUfNzxebwQj/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_05.jpg)

남탕만 들어가봤습니다.
밖은 거칠게 파도가 치는데 안은 굉장히 아늑한 느낌까지 들었습니다.
그리고 수건이 걸려있는 걸로 봐서 최근까지 누군가 이용한 흔적(?)처럼 보였습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_16.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9yJDmLkY3E1CjPChymFAjPshnfzs8n68PcTpSgXJSqj/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_16.jpg)

바닥만 조금 청소를 하면 용천수가 흐르는 담수욕장으로 이용하기에 전혀 부족함이 없어 보였습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_09.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoVwGjtkoD2oMvspAXGptTtGjXn4JimiNyTx51dcPMgA/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_09.jpg)

누군가 면도를 할려는지 씻고 나와서 단정을 하기 위해서 인지는 몰라도 거울도 달아놨더라구요.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_11.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmahF4b9K95NEuzPrRCNbhTv5w6Hz7uxgvYWiYiuyQTCLg/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_11.jpg)

여탕까지는 안들어가봤지만 여탕 입구에서 바라본 바다도 참 멋졌습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_04.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjKaukagymC1kHVGP7MDRprNp2NuaRM3639PE7HngwD3/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_04.jpg)

여탕에서 흐르는 물은 바다로 직접 들어갑니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ255pQAVyNftNj4N2g3j5EWqQHFw7Y1TQBCXzyZNmoWq/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138_03.jpg)

저는 해변이 아니라 한여름에도 바닷물에 들어가보진 못하겠지만, 어릴적부터 서귀포에서 사셨던 분들은 이곳을 정말 자주 이용하셨다네요.

![KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRR8kskNh2YU6cZKffxGz6W5qWE5M7FUQg9xDKjKJjkf9/KakaoTalk_20260521_103810138.jpg)

서귀포항 근처 오시면 자구리공원과 함께 산책코스로 한번 다녀오셔도 좋을 것 같습니다.

body.title: Wednesday Walk #20 of '26, \
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRBvriuFJChtnEnm4FQGgyLL4g3uQ1TGm1ZK11Pgbm6gP/1779329520913.jpg)

Hello Friends, and thank you for your visit!
🙋🏻‍♀️☺️🙋🏻‍♀️
It is #wednesdaywalk #20 of 2026, and Spring 2026 is heating up!

But first as always I want to thank @tattoodjay for this community -
\
!\n\nAnd so for this weeks #wednesdaywalk I stuck pretty close to home - the weather has been pretty much unpredictable so I didn't want to take any chances. We have been having some pretty severe \
Showers here, so better to stay in the Island!\n\nAnd so to get started I rode my bike down the street and saw my friends \

,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3DHGU9HPqFZ74fu2YfecqHsUA8zRZ8EH6iShpcWQM4P/1779329544010.jpg)

And a little closer,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUWFDF7nS4jYUqWbjycoGBNGxc5EJ5pVK777BZzmpwkkW/1779329557474.jpg)

Yes indeed the Olives are about to start falling - \

!

Leaving there, I continued on to the Park and this was the first thing I saw,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNit5RN5Q4F3NxDoqxxv8aovVBZZ9dHaEscRyztKGnGVn/1779329573350.jpg)

I moved a little closer,

It is a Great Blue Heron, staring...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaXouk6TgvESmfpJzEW9Ln7vPQ2DvWdMHNKMxNLx2N9RH/1779329590184.jpg)

And I also saw this \

. They have been around a few days now and I do hope they make it! With the Duck Hunters here (early autumn) I hope they migrate somewhere safe!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUbYqwRHzxRrnFAP832NQEreSMDgGfs9fUkZeUMMCoqdv/1779329607389.jpg)

Here the male is in the water,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRp6YDEUHcgxZvCcTYNcFWJdv3Vu3oA9xMQGipE45MXpq/1779329625806.jpg)

And here he is either getting a drink, or hunting. The female is always by his side,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGigqS4nGRAXLqnFzWF2wKHpDf16AubyFf6evf9Dn2Qo/1779329641465.jpg)

This I am going to sneak in. I went back this afternoon as all of these photos are from yesterday and I saw them again in a rain puddle,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWM2zzgLt1CCwuS2XZWGPXhxTfWaygkKw3JQ5QBWiDMdp/1779329655157.jpg)

I hope they do not use me as a gage for trusting humans!

Leaving the Park I rode up the street and saw these Sunflowers growing in a ditch,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQcrRLkrB3C1e1mEESWMQWBwT6wKRTxbW3HUyFCmzhd4V/1779329669608.jpg)

And also these Wildflowers, mostly Daisies and Firewheels,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWK616pzDTfgmLKr8rUTzSVwihTpyq6TzyFxXVga4Sffs/1779329680119.jpg)

And a little bit closer,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQw1bFp85CatMbzetvo2kwWU4uuUhNFhMV6JUgSYg9ZvG/1779329690239.jpg)

I also took a photo of this Sunflower,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUAtJj9epFbY3oueeJGNDU1dt7aym7A35M3pcx4ujQhY/1779329699636.jpg)

And a single plant, so that you could see what they look like,

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT4cj1zTmgNXCBXMnPZs92RqBp1Z3Epr2DCoJdaCMx693/1779329709440.jpg)

And from there I headed home, the occasional rain drop was starting and I wanted to stay dry!

And that was my #wednesdaywalk this week, I want to thank you again for your visit - \
!\nPlease Take Care of Your Loved Ones, \

🙋👍🏼🙏🏼😇🙏🏼👍🏼🙋

body.title: El mejor plan/ The best plan 😍💗
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVuSeFGyoquVETFyURsd2ptiHn8mCriR8znE37TcfDiH7/1779329649315.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzrw3hC7PtoPpYGa2bHYVpdDZh37V46a59ZNm1np7Aef/1779329733525.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZX8zhLVZsnVbm9LRXARb9H5UgTgjZcpLL9RRjKLPVYM/1779329733762.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWYeexzQ2kfnvZrFE9ooGsVprw5gzUwJCAHEzKmMNMGff/1779329734327.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBz9ysovioRzBW1Wkf27xyRr77N7M59CKxhJjtyMfaWw/1779329734105.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQrrrjfiDnYtoP4NPpnJ8zkQQepaVKwJKAKAVyyBvYhJj/1779329733961.jpg) *** Hello chicos! Qué tal su día? Hace ya dos domingos que se estuvo celebrando el día de las madres, y hoy me di cuenta que no había documentado en mi blog una salida en familia el día antes, y es que ya saben que no me gustan las aglomeraciones de personas, por lo que en días festivos no suelo salir de casa, ya que todo es un completo caos. En vista de esto decidimos tomar el sábado para salir y disfrutar un poco recorriendo algunas de mis tiendas favoritas y comprando algunas cositas que estaba necesitando, pero entre todas las cosas que hicimos ese día, la mejor parte fueron los helados, y es que aunque ya habíamos comido, siempre hay un lugarcito extra para un dulcito, así que cuando veníamos de regreso a casa, al pasar frente al supermercado Rattan nos recordamos de sus deliciosas barquillas y sin dudar nos detuvimos a disfrutar de un tiempo especial con mis personas favoritas. Lo genial de todo, es que esta vez no tuvimos que cruzar hasta la plaza para disfrutar de nuestras barquillas, sino que en cuanto nos entregaron los helados nos sentamos en el área especial al aire libre que habilitó Rattan para este fin. Conversamos un poco, disfrutamos de la brisa fresca y nos comimos unas barquillas de chocolate y mantecado que como de costumbre estaban deliciosas. Pero no se crean que esa fue toda la celebración del día de la madre, porque el domingo disfrutamos de una tarde de parrilla y juegos de mesa con mis niños (no tan niños) y mi esposo. Sin dudas el mejor plan!
Hello everyone! How’s your day going? It’s been two Sundays since Mother’s Day, and today I realised I hadn’t posted anything on my blog about the family outing we had the day before. As you know, I don’t like crowds, so on public holidays I don’t usually leave the house, as everything’s complete chaos. With that in mind, we decided to take Saturday off to go out and enjoy ourselves a bit, visiting some of my favourite shops and buying a few bits and bobs I needed. But of all the things we did that day, the best part was the ice cream, because even though we’d already eaten, there’s always a little extra room for a sweet treat. So, as we were heading back home and passed the Rattan supermarket, we remembered their delicious ice cream cones and, without a second thought, we stopped to enjoy some special time with my favourite people. The best part of it all is that this time we didn’t have to walk all the way to the square to enjoy our ice creams; instead, as soon as we were handed our ice creams, we sat down in the special outdoor area that Rattan had set up for this very purpose. We chatted for a while, enjoyed the cool breeze and tucked into some chocolate and butter wafer cones, which, as usual, were delicious. But don’t think that was the extent of our Mother’s Day celebrations, because on Sunday we enjoyed an afternoon of barbecues and board games with my (not-so-little) children and my husband. Without a doubt, the best way to spend the day!

body.title: Avoid Street Foods and Drinks to Remain Safe From Waterborne Disease.
body.body:
Hi! It is summer in Bangladesh now and I am feeling very hot from a few day's. Very often we drink cold water, juice, cold drinks natural or processed drinks etc. But we don't try to know whichbare healthy and which are unhealthy for us. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBYbKFCKQTf8PTtDvv4beJhASQqo9148jRSJmgUYqf8h/1779329310315.jpg)

We know some diseases causes for bacteria and virus which enter in pur body by water. Like typhoid,  hepatitis,  cholera etc. Lemon juice from street shop is the most common drinks. They use ice for keeping the water cold. But there are two types of water produced in factory.  One is for keeping the fishes and another is for using in food items. But the drinks sellers buy the industrial ice at a cheaper rate for making more profit. It may causes waterborne disease. But most of the people ate not concern about this. Sometimes they affected by waterborne disease and suffer for long time. Often we see sugarcane juice seller with ice. They don't wash their hands and put the sugarcane in the machine without wearing hand gloves. 

They never seperate the sugarcane affected by fungus. In Cholera Hospital, Mohakhali, Dhaka we see a lot of people are admitted there. Most of them are children. Even at the age of seven months I was also admitted into this hospital. Everyday a lot of people are affected by waterborne diseases. A few day's ago a report has been published that millions of cholera and diarrhoea microbials are found in chatpati, a food made by boiled dried yellow peas, masala water and salt. 

Some days ago a girl named Karina Kaiser Grand daughter of the famous chess grandmaster of Bangladesh Rani Hamid. She was died for eating chatpati which was full of Hepatitis A and E virus. Most of the food sellers don’t maintain the hygiene and that causes life threating diseases. So we should avoid street foods especially juice or other drinks. Amd we should chek their hands before purchase foods.

body.title: Many conversations while visit a coffeeshop
body.body:
>

 **A warm greeting to all of us coffee lovers in this community #cinnamoncupcoffee.**  

  



 


<div class=\

> During my visits to coffee shops, I’ve had some wonderful moments, because every cup of coffee brings with it many interesting conversations. Honestly, we talk to so many people, and after every sip, we feel more energetic and joyful; often those words are carried away by the wind, and other times they leave a lasting impression, but the coffee cups are witnesses to the ones we always remember. There’s a conversation I overheard when my uncle was alive—he was a coffee addict; he was a very wise man. I remember we were at a table with lots of food, and I only drank coffee. While everyone else ate, my sister didn’t want to have coffee because it was almost nighttime and coffee gives her insomnia. Well, one of the sayings my uncle always used to say—and I repeat it often because it really stuck with me—was: **“Between eating and sleeping lies living.”** Wow, as I sipped my coffee, I started thinking about it, and it’s true: if you eat healthily and get the sleep you need, you can live well, because you spend your day full of energy thanks to rest and good food. Another conversation that left an impression on me was when I once traveled to Caracas on vacation and visited a coffee. I was alone, and at a table there was a couple; they were talking about witchcraft or black magic. I was just having a small cappuccino with a cookie; it seemed to me like they were planning something. The strange thing was that they were discussing it so casually and in loud voices, which scared me, so I left quickly; such a nice coffee, and such strange people talking about such things.That scared me, so I left quickly; the café was so nice, but there were such strange people saying the kind of nasty things I hate On another occasion—a romantic date I had with my current partner—he said some beautiful things to me. It was one of our first dates, and he spoke to me as if he’d known me my whole life. His words were so meaningful that I still remember his tender words to this day, and that’s what I loved about him. We always look back on that special date, even though that coffee no longer exists; that moment was truly special. The conversations that remain etched in our minds, in that moment when you sip a cup of coffee, are experiences filled with a deep passion for coffee. That’s all for now, my fellow adventurers. Thanks for reading. .

>

>!    
[Spanish,Here]> Un cordial saludo a todos los amantes del café de esta comunidad #cinnamoncupcoffee. En mis visitas a las cafeterías, he pasado gratos momentos, pues con cada taza de café existen muchas conversaciones interesantes. Sinceramente, hablamos con muchas personas,después de cada sorbo, con más energía y alegría; muchas veces son palabras que se las llevó el viento, y otras nos marcaron,pero las tazas de café son testigos  de aquellas que siempre recordamos.  Hay una conversación que escuché cuando mi tío estaba vivo, superadicto al café; era una persona muy sabia. Recuerdo que estábamos en una mesa con mucha comida y yo solo tomé café. Mientras todos comieron, mi hermana no quiso tomar café porque era casi de noche y a ella el café le da insomnio. Bueno, uno de los legados y frases que mi tío siempre decía y siempre la repito, porque esa frase me marcó, decía: \

. wow mientras tomaba café, me puse a analizar y es cierto, pues si te alimentas sanamente y duermes tus horas necesarias, puedes vivir bien, porque pasas un día con mucha energía a través del descanso y tus alimentos. Otra conversación que me marcó fue que en una oportunidad viajé a Caracas de vacaciones y visité una cafetería, pero estaba sola y en una mesa estaba una pareja; ellos hablaban de brujería o magia negra, yo solo tomaba un cappuccino pequeño con una galleta; me parecía que estaban planeando algo. Lo extraño fue que lo conversaban con naturalidad y voz fuerte, lo que me asustó y salí rápido; tan agradable la cafetería y gente tan extraña hablando cosas feas que odio. En otra ocasión, que fue una cita romántica, que tuve con mi actual pareja, me dijo cosas hermosas. Eran nuestras primeras salidas y como que me conociera toda la vida, tan significativa que aún recuerdo sus palabras tiernas, y eso fue que me gustó de él y siempre recordamos esa cita especial, aunque ya esa cafetería no existe, ese momento fue especial. Las conversaciones que quedan grabadas en nuestra mente, en ese momento que tomas una taza de café, son experiencias con mucha pasión por el café. Hasta aquí mis aventureros, gracias por Leer.

body.title: La estupidez humana solo puede llegar a cambiar con la autoconciencia | Human stupidity can only be changed through self-awareness 🧠 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
##### La estupidez humana solo puede llegar a cambiar con la autoconciencia. 


![1000027329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/Epzxfo1ZmTgR6au6TuxEhkyHyDzngiNAJSNzLtHvwekfADQDH8qnKuE7DxFhxbPNdeU.jpg)


Hola, amigos de Holos & Lotus. Me alegra estar de nuevo escribiendo en esta comunidad de la que tanto he aprendido de todos los usuarios que nos dedicamos a escribir fragmentos de la vida y reflexionamos sobre nuestras propias acciones y decisiones. Ayer leí el post de nuestro amigo @emiliorios donde habla sobre [**La rigidez mental y la maldad en el ser humano.**](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/el-peligro-de-la-rigidez-mental-es-la-estupidez-mas-peligrosa-que-la-maldad-esta-es-una-conversacion-esen) Y precisamente eso me hace recordar una de las clases que tuve hoy. 

En la clase la profesora nos hablaba de que debemos no solo dentro de la materia, sino en general, tener un pensamiento crítico. No solo hablar para dar una opinión de forma ligera, es llevar a cabo un proceso mental y de autoconciencia para desarrollar eso que nos permite discernir o aprobar lo que otros nos dicen o lo que incluso, investigamos pero que tal vez solo es la percepción de un autor o escritor. Cada uno debe crear su propia visión de la vida, no solo con las experiencias sino también con lo que vamos aprendiendo de otros en la medida en que nos vamos relacionando como seres humanos. 

Cuando hablamos de maldad podemos pensar que hay mucha inteligencia dentro de ese sentimiento que solo produce cosas detestables. Pero en realidad, hay muchas personas que viven experiencias no tan agradables y que no siempre tienen las herramientas para en vez de pensar en repetir el mal que les fue causado, buscar la manera de aprender de una forma más positiva o de interpretar de una mejor manera las situaciones. Hay casos por mencionar alguno como el tema del bullying, donde se sabe que hay una víctima y un victimario, pero para que exista el que produce el dolor o el miedo, también debió haber pasado por maltratos en su vida. Solo que no encontró la manera de procesar lo que sentía y decidió seguir causando malestar en los demás. 


![1000027330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EopuSUuJmsU8SMwh962GWqwMMd6z6QjVo7Nq1XhEda7G4Xm7yhKvAhRcKXoVtUmx6st.jpg)


Este caso puede darse en muchos contextos pero no es justificable que alguien por haber tenido una infancia o adolescencia difícil, pretenda que todos sus actos sean aceptados. Y allí viene un poco la ignorancia y la estupidez en el ser humano, buscamos siempre que nos vaya bien en la vida o que tengamos éxito en lo que hacemos. Pero al mismo tiempo podemos con nuestras acciones estar causando daño a nuestro entorno y la forma más fácil de justificarse es que todo es una broma o que los demás son muy sensibles y no fueron criados para \

los juegos que hay entre las relaciones interpersonales. En Venezuela hay mucho que hablar sobre el trato hacia los demás y el tema de que cualquier cosa se hace como una broma, muchas veces pesadas y de mal gusto. 

Entonces, pienso que la ignorancia puede llegar a generar mucho daño en la sociedad, no es que todos los que han estudiado o se han preparado en la vida de forma profesional sean las mejores personas del mundo, pero si existe un nivel donde el estudio te permite ver que hay cosas que se pueden mejorar, por ejemplo en mi caso que estudio Psicología hay mucha ignorancia en cuanto al valor que tiene esta carrera y a lo que nos tendremos que enfrentar en un futuro al culminarla. Dicen que deberíamos ser ejemplo para los demás, puede ser cierto, como también que somos seres humanos que sentimos y padecemos como cualquier otra persona. 

En la carrera veremos muchos casos donde tendremos que tener un alto nivel de empatía y por supuesto dependiendo de cada persona y como perciban la vida, tendrán diferentes maneras de enfrentar los casos clínicos. Pero si me parece que es necesario tener siempre conocimientos de cualquier ámbito, que debemos saber pensar, interpretar y analizar, no solo quedarnos con lo que otros piensan o repetir como manada lo que la mayoría hace porque es así como se comporta la sociedad. La conciencia es la que nos permite principalmente dar el paso para decidir cambiar aquellos aspectos negativos que tenemos como personas, entre esos puede estar saber si está bien hacer el bien o el mal.


![1000027331.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23rB5eb2AzTAHYWJsRKHZFW84QMEANTShMTZD7eepiDNDwDqMeHxEtrFgyaT8V1wABKNC.png)



##### Human stupidity can only be changed through self-awareness.

![1000027329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/Epzxfo1ZmTgR6au6TuxEhkyHyDzngiNAJSNzLtHvwekfADQDH8qnKuE7DxFhxbPNdeU.jpg)

Hello, friends of Holos & Lotus. I am glad to be writing again in this community, from which I have learned so much from all the users who dedicate themselves to writing fragments of life and reflecting on our own actions and decisions. Yesterday I read the post by our friend @emiliorios where he talks about [**Mental rigidity and evil in human beings.**](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/el-peligro-de-la-rigidez-mental-es-la-estupidez-mas-peligrosa-que-la-maldad-esta-es-una-conversacion-esen) And that precisely reminds me of one of the classes I had today.

In class, the professor was telling us that we must have critical thinking, not only within the subject but in general. It is not just about speaking to give a light opinion; it is about carrying out a mental and self-aware process to develop that which allows us to discern or approve what others tell us or even what we research, which might just be the perception of an author or writer. Each person must create their own vision of life, not only through experiences but also through what we learn from others as we relate to one another as human beings.

When we talk about evil, we might think there is a lot of intelligence within that feeling that only produces detestable things. But in reality, there are many people who live through not-so-pleasant experiences and do not always have the tools to look for a way to learn in a more positive way or interpret situations better, instead of thinking about repeating the harm that was caused to them. There are cases, to mention one, like bullying, where it is known that there is a victim and a perpetrator, but for the one who causes pain or fear to exist, they must have also gone through mistreatment in their life. Except they did not find a way to process what they felt and decided to keep causing discomfort to others.

![1000027330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EopuSUuJmsU8SMwh962GWqwMMd6z6QjVo7Nq1XhEda7G4Xm7yhKvAhRcKXoVtUmx6st.jpg)

This case can happen in many contexts, but it is not justifiable for someone to expect all their actions to be accepted just because they had a difficult childhood or adolescence. And that is where ignorance and stupidity in human beings come in a bit; we always seek to do well in life or to be successful in what we do. But at the same time, we can be causing harm to our environment with our actions, and the easiest way to justify it is that everything is a joke or that others are too sensitive and were not raised to \

the games that occur in interpersonal relationships. In Venezuela, there is a lot to be said about how we treat others and the issue that everything is turned into a joke, often heavy and in bad taste.

So, I think ignorance can cause a lot of damage to society. It is not that everyone who has studied or prepared themselves professionally in life is the best person in the world, but there is a level where studying allows you to see that there are things that can be improved. For example, in my case, studying Psychology, there is a lot of ignorance regarding the value of this career and what we will have to face in the future upon graduating. They say we should be an example for others, which might be true, but it is also true that we are human beings who feel and suffer just like anyone else.

In this career, we will see many cases where we must have a high level of empathy, and of course, depending on each person and how they perceive life, they will have different ways of facing clinical cases. But I do think it is necessary to always have knowledge in any field, that we must know how to think, interpret, and analyze, not just stick to what others think or repeat like a herd what the majority does because that is how society behaves. Awareness is what mainly allows us to take the step to decide to change those negative aspects we have as people, among which could be knowing whether it is right to do good or evil.

![1000027331.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23rB5eb2AzTAHYWJsRKHZFW84QMEANTShMTZD7eepiDNDwDqMeHxEtrFgyaT8V1wABKNC.png)

<div class=\
>Espero que les gustara este post, también me gustaría que me dejen sus comentarios; con gusto los leeré y responderé. Un abrazo grande. 🤗\n\n

>I hope you liked this post, and I would also like you to leave me your comments; I will gladly read them and will respond to them. Big hugs. 🤗 ![1000027331.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23rB5eb2AzTAHYWJsRKHZFW84QMEANTShMTZD7eepiDNDwDqMeHxEtrFgyaT8V1wABKNC.png) Todo el texto de esta publicación es de mi autoría - All the text in this publication is my own. body.body:
![portia-weiss-RjYq5xypQgg-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/EoEiMV3YGXjvz6TWMb5yZABwQJqN4DMca8gS6vaR8nE2Fidih6bsrqvnDxZ9PnKjSsE.jpg)

> Rather a long one, but what is the fascination of humans with explosives? -- Prompey

[AN: Long one?]

Humans like spectacle. Huge amounts of people working together. Everyday miracles. Teamwork to help some otherwise helpless creature. And big things falling down. They also love watching things explode, from a safe distance, of course.

From a certain perspective - everyone else - this is yet another example of Humanity's collective insanity. Most leave it at that.

Companion Xryk was curious enough to ask his Humans about it. \
he asked. He took notes for his records, to be collated and counted at a later day.\n\n\
Human Jor idly played with one of their omnitools. \

said Human Nisse.

Every Human had a different answer. Not one answer that was close to a similar theme. It was baffling. It would have been easy to dismiss it as the species wide mental disorder. It would have been _simple_ to declare it as the result of Deathworlder evolution trauma.

There had to be something underneath that surface.

It would be a long time before Companion Xryk found any kind of common thread.

Today I want to share with you photography of natural mushrooms or frog umbrellas. There is a small forest near our house. Basically there is very little human traffic and only some frogs and other animals live there. 

In the morning I was spending my relaxing time after waking up. The light and cool morning air fascinated me a lot. I enjoyed the cool morning air and I saw a beautiful frog umbrella. Basically it is called a natural mushroom.

body.body: 由上年9月到現在，足足炒了8個多月，這次，真的要end game了。\n\n

/>

如果所見，原價$10199的iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB，現在的回收價都已跌穿正價，橙色甚至低至$9900，就算算上信回卡回贈都沒有什麼肉可吃了。

這次價格暴跌都可算是突如其來的，尤記得5月第一個星期，256GB的i17回收價依然很高，銀色甚至高至$10800，即是說一部賺$600，這裡還沒有算信用卡回贈和里數回贈。本來我其實都準備收手了，畢竟iPhone 18按過往的時間表應該9月尾就推出，現在都5月了，買機一般要等1個月出貨，即是到6月才收到貨，到時候都不知道什麼情況了，所以這個5月我只買了2台新機。

然而到了第二個星期，價格在幾天之間突然暴跌，起初大家都以為只是剛好蘋果出大貨的一時回調，然而到了再下一個星期，價格卻再跌，終於三色都跌穿原價，連續兩個星期跌價，讓我深信這次遊戲終於要玩完了。

正所謂，出來行，遲早要還，我仍有數台iPhone還未或準備出貨，有部分是不能取消的，讓我算一下，一共有9台iPhone，其中6台我已經低於正價放掉了，有1台下星期才到，2台要下個月才到，幸好我算上了信用卡回贈和里數獎賞，還算打個平手，已經是不幸中的大幸，之前數個月賺的不需要回吐。

不過先不說賺差價，我之後幾個月都不能再那麼輕鬆的賺信回卡回贈了，這幾個月我已經習慣了信用卡積分多到用不完，還有飛行里數每個月過萬的增長，未來幾個月，都要暫時停頓一下。

這遊戲，要等到9月尾再開始了。

body.title: Mi tío versión amigurumi
body.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, como les había contado en mi post anterior una prima me encargó hacer a sus padres versión amigurumi, ya les compartí el post del amigurumi de su mamá y en esta ocasión les comparto a su padre que es mi tío, realmente estoy muy contenta por haber finalizado esta comisión, pues últimamente me he visto muy afectada por los cortes del servicio eléctrico 5 horas diarias en diferentes horario, aunque la labor de las agujas no se hace con una máquina sino con las manos, la electricidad es muy necesaria, incluso si hay que buscar un referencia o también para tener registro del proceso es necesario tener los celulares con carga, también es necesario un espacio iluminado y dependiendo de la hora a veces es difícil encontrar un lugar de la casa donde haya luz natural porque debo cuidar mis ojos , también afecta que no me pueda quedar trabajando en la noche para recuperar las horas perdidas, pues si el apagón es nocturno no hay de otra, pero también debo aprovechar el tiempo de descanso y lamentablemente es una situación que escapa de las manos, por eso me pongo la mano en el corazón cuando les digo que cada amigurumi lo hago con mucho esfuerzo para que todo quede bien y a tiempo, por eso me llena de alegría cuando finalizo. > Greetings, dear community! As I mentioned in my previous post, a cousin commissioned me to make amigurumi versions of her parents. I've already shared the post of her mother's amigurumi, and this time I'm sharing her father's, who is my uncle. I'm truly happy to have finished this commission, as lately I've been greatly affected by the power outages—five hours a day at different times. Although knitting isn't done with a machine but by hand, electricity is essential. Even if you need to find a reference or keep track of the process, you need to have your cell phone charged. A well-lit space is also necessary, and depending on the time of day, it's sometimes difficult to find a place in the house with natural light because I have to protect my eyes. It also affects me that I can't stay up working at night to make up for lost hours, because if the power outage is at night, there's no other option. But I also need to make the most of my rest time, and unfortunately, this is a situation beyond my control. That's why I say with all my heart that I make each amigurumi by hand. I put a lot of effort into making sure everything is done right and on time, so it fills me with joy when I finish.
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Para este amigurumi hice unas variaciones en las proporciones del anterior para que mi tío se viera mas alto que su esposa porque trabajé igualmente con ganchillo de 1.25mm, hice 6 cadenas de base para la suela de los zapatos, hice aumento en los extremos para crear un óvalo de 20, hice disminuciones en la punta y luego continué con la pierna de 16 puntadas por 12 hileras, luego uní la entrepierna por 2 cadenas y continué con el pantalón por 9 hileras, cambie al torso con el color piel porque al igual que el amigurumi pasado la camiseta se la hice aparte, los brazos los hice de 9 puntadas por 17 hileras y los uní a los lados del torso en hice las disminuciones para los hombros y el cuello que se extendía por 12 hileras, debo decir que entre tanto ajetreo no pude tomar fotografías del proceso de la cabeza, pero la hice empezando por el agujero de 12 puntadas por 12 hileras para introducir el cuello, luego 6 hileras de 6 aumentos para obtener un ancho de 18 e hice 12 hileras sin aumentos y luego 6 disminuciones por 7 hileras hasta cerrar, coloqué los ojos antes de cerrar. > For this amigurumi, I made some variations to the proportions of the previous one so that my uncle would look taller than his wife. I also worked with a 1.25mm crochet hook. I made 6 foundation chains for the sole of the shoes, increased at the ends to create a 20-stitch oval, decreased at the toe, and then continued with the leg, crocheting 16 stitches for 12 rows. Then I joined the crotch with 2 chains and continued with the pants for 9 rows. I switched to the skin-colored torso because, like the previous amigurumi, I made the shirt separately. I made the arms with 9 stitches for 17 rows and joined them to the sides of the torso. I made decreases for the shoulders and the neck, which extended for 12 rows. I must say that in all the hustle and bustle, I couldn't take pictures of the head process, but I made it starting with the hole of 12 stitches for 12 rows to insert the neck, then 6 rows of 6 stitches. I increased to get a width of 18 and made 12 rows without increases and then 6 decreases for 7 rows until closing, I placed the eyes before closing.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AKAqkJZ2fp7CJUPU7gfY6ncQtzXVeyZ1An4MBMqfdSy3z8P1LY9n1WcS4zGVPco.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Después de hacerle los detalles al pantalón, hice aparte la camiseta con 18 cadenas en circulo para formar la base, luego 6 aumentos por 4 hileras la formar el canesú de 42 puntadas, luego hice los agujeros para las mangas y continué con el torso, para las mangas levanté 16 puntadas e hice 5 hileras, para el dibujo del frente usé la técnica de bordado a punto cruz. El reto de este amigurumi era hacer la gorra de beisbol porque nunca había hecho una, realmente me llenó de satisfacción poderla hacer, para la visera usé alambre floral en el borde para dar firmeza y me encantó el resultado. > After adding the details to the pants, I separately made the shirt. I started with 18 chains in a circle to form the base, then increased 6 stitches for 4 rows to form the 42-stitch yoke. Next, I made the armholes and continued with the torso. For the sleeves, I picked up 16 stitches and worked 5 rows. For the design on the front, I used cross-stitch. The challenge of this amigurumi was making the baseball cap because I had never made one before. It was truly satisfying to finally make it. For the visor, I used floral wire around the edge for added strength, and I loved the result.

body.title: The majestic Flamboyant tree (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> One of the most striking trees, whose colorful flowers adorn the landscape of tropical regions, is the flamboyant tree (Delonix regia). And at this time of year, at the start of the rainy season, it is in full bloom.
![1000719102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23ynQg5T4RQWdzpwUTNziEMm2kJd8hLsfLCu37WPQm7eiv2ub2RFGv34EkeU75cjTTbWn.jpg)
Although it is not a native species, it has adapted very well in my country, Venezuela, and graces the city’s streets, avenues, and parks with its majesty.
![1000719103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wCA61kV41DhNubPSwVZYYTRUjbvnw8QYYubRS3hKkcnyK5BxfBGxSEnkkeLLKa4sWj1.jpg)
During my walk through Michelena Park in the city of Maracay, I was able to admire it in all its splendor. It is a very leafy tree with bright green leaves and flowers ranging in color from red to orange.
![1000719111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23xL59DwD94mNqKK51Jni9drjVeo8ASBquTgCwkuQXc3Zpfw9pjPUVHsVeSqV3NHyroL8.jpg)
Its petals and sepals are large and come in different shapes. This is a typical characteristic of the Fabaceae family, formerly known as the Leguminosae. The central petal is white with yellow stripes.
![1000719112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23y8xQDqFGL4cSZTq5L9TSZPUJ7oGXdD4FRi3QRCY7vUVDhupXXcgsMFMf4GB43u7ibct.jpg)
***
![1000719103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wCA61kV41DhNubPSwVZYYTRUjbvnw8QYYubRS3hKkcnyK5BxfBGxSEnkkeLLKa4sWj1.jpg)
The flamboyant’s fruits are also striking—they are long, dark brown pods containing many seeds. And while the plant continues to bloom, it is also in the process of fruiting. I saw bumblebees flitting among the flowers, searching for nectar and aiding in pollination.
![1000719105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23xVPJFh79pAjJTFoE4E4hdf6LzhDLTdx3Tqyf5YZKGxu4EZdFY3HdTBXKNTowh2QagoQ.jpg)
***
![1000719094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23zbHTgeQFbfrPoaHqetTXqv3ZtCxbmE6zSt6MAaJUq1Vcu8Fdy2pAtxgj9JuuChzUhqj.jpg)
As the fruits ripen, they fall to the ground and split open to release their seeds, which will germinate if conditions are right.
![1000719083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23uFYHC5xLkxC7mdHwCsHDtTSqK3w2wjvSL7PQnw9k8pMmAtPiud1bvsZkJfh9zvAgZg9.jpg)
But here in the park, competition from other plants and maintenance and cleaning efforts prevent the plants from continuing to grow. If that weren’t the case, there would be a large forest of flamboyant trees.
![1000719146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23u6DdccDb4jYKoDyKjqgazKvwRsvLVihxvG16FLeqPsais6yjbrS6jvrKFoTSPpBK1BW.jpg)
I took photos of other trees with very distinctive trunk textures, like the thorns on this ceiba tree.
![1000719097.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wC9vS5aDsUyFWaeyqU8V6Ckqh8SUtJAw4JdR2BFsBbUVT2A4C5F6j3XWRuWwBLA5JZo.jpg)
There are trees that shed their bark, which falls off in pieces, creating this mix of colors and textures.
![1000719077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wWuGXsK7euT1zvf6x3WUwUH7daZ1Nhfh14eubDQyKjmzdvtUWPMmexZmKh5LqTsGxeD.jpg)
On this walk, as always, Isis came along with me. She has a lot of fun chasing squirrels, birds, lizards, and any other animal that moves, as well as rolling around in the dry leaves and damp earth.
![1000719142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23vhya9wyzmAaSbKnMD7q2PqVM2Jvj6qfZ7oH9YfNgJcGTrSwmH56FHnpUH6aeFQXsdFS.jpg)
Thank you for reading
![1000324457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yU4h4sgk1R5FcNZXmMuzUHvtTpLrN84AHj2ems3ckmeUJxTFe8qjwBwgggvNHnTbW3Z.jpg) *** Uno de los árboles mas vistosos, que adorna con el color de sus flores el paisaje de las regiónes tropicales, es el flamboyan Delonix regia. Y en esta epoca del año al inicio de la temporada de lluvia, esta en plena floración.
![1000719102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23ynQg5T4RQWdzpwUTNziEMm2kJd8hLsfLCu37WPQm7eiv2ub2RFGv34EkeU75cjTTbWn.jpg)
Aunque no es una especie autóctona se ha adaptado muy bién en mi país Venezuela y adorna con su majestuosidad las calles, avenidas y parques de la ciudad.
![1000719103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wCA61kV41DhNubPSwVZYYTRUjbvnw8QYYubRS3hKkcnyK5BxfBGxSEnkkeLLKa4sWj1.jpg)
En mi recorrido por el parque Michelena en la ciudad de Maracay, lo pude admirar en todo su esplendor. Es un árbol muy frondoso de hojas muy verdes y flores de colores entre rojo y anaranjado.
![1000719112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23y8xQDqFGL4cSZTq5L9TSZPUJ7oGXdD4FRi3QRCY7vUVDhupXXcgsMFMf4GB43u7ibct.jpg)
Sus pétalos y sépalos son grandes y de formas diferentes. Esto es una característica típica de la familia Fabacea antiguamente llamada Leguminosas. El pétalo del centro es de color blanco con rayas amarillas.
![1000719109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23xpF4U3K9aCLivAJFbtTEZ3DZgGsXnrSkRpdPdPxvX2qqqaek24DTZn4XvYHXK7wZdy5.jpg)
Los frutos del flamboyan también llaman la atención, son unas vainas largas de color marron oscuro, que contienen muchas semillas. Y mientras la planta continua floreciendo también está en proceso de fructificación. Vi abejorros revoloteando las flores buscando néctar y ayudando a la polinización. ***
![1000719094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23zbHTgeQFbfrPoaHqetTXqv3ZtCxbmE6zSt6MAaJUq1Vcu8Fdy2pAtxgj9JuuChzUhqj.jpg)
Los frutos al madurar caen al suelo y se abren para soltar las semillas, que si tienen las condiciones adecuadas germinaran. Pero acá en el parque la competencia con otras plantas y las labores de mantenimiento y limpieza no permiten que las plantas continuen su desarrollo. De ser así habría un gran bosque de flamboyanes.
![1000719083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23uFYHC5xLkxC7mdHwCsHDtTSqK3w2wjvSL7PQnw9k8pMmAtPiud1bvsZkJfh9zvAgZg9.jpg)
*** Tomé fotografías de otros árboles cuya texrura del tronco es muy particular . Como las espinas de esta Ceiba.
![1000719097.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wC9vS5aDsUyFWaeyqU8V6Ckqh8SUtJAw4JdR2BFsBbUVT2A4C5F6j3XWRuWwBLA5JZo.jpg)
Hay árboles que mudan su corteza y se van cayendo en pedazos creando esta mezcla de colores y textura.
![1000719077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23wWuGXsK7euT1zvf6x3WUwUH7daZ1Nhfh14eubDQyKjmzdvtUWPMmexZmKh5LqTsGxeD.jpg)
En este paseo como siempre me acompañó Isis, quien se divierte mucho correteando a las ardillas, aves, lagartijas y cualquier otro animal que se mueva y tambien revolcandose entre las hojas secas y la tierra humeda.
![1000719142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23vhya9wyzmAaSbKnMD7q2PqVM2Jvj6qfZ7oH9YfNgJcGTrSwmH56FHnpUH6aeFQXsdFS.jpg)
![1000593103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23twCGEjH2xuU7mRjzfHme268u6XkieKjTRWRM9gYSEdHBwmn2Ljw4USibmjQtSGuPVx4.jpg)
Muchas gracias por leer
*** ![1779328396853951955484998686629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yJLuSDVwFfxjCTSHxZWiY4o7ZnrwH96deWhqKQeQJDbiJtiAa3WBUFDQifakvWbjsCT.jpg) All the photos were taken by me using a Samsung A15 phone. I translated this into English using the website www.deepl.com

body.title: Harmony.
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g5e82430a27a964ac7e78112a6b4783487a37d5e4ff95c68db132732d16e410b1ca9fb6fbdaf4332661a1100a74a8f2e8fae91ac8390fbd25b7dd83884fd2f69f_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a quaint village nestled between rolling hills, there lived a community known for its unparalleled harmony. The villagers prided themselves on their ability to work together, share resources, and celebrate each other's strengths. They sang songs of unity and danced in circles, believing that their bond was unbreakable.

## The Arrival of the Stranger

One day, a weary traveler arrived at the village. He was a storyteller, and as he shared tales of distant lands and cultures, the villagers were captivated. They had never considered that their way of life might not be the only way. Intrigued by the stranger's stories, they began to question their own traditions and practices.

## The Seeds of Discontent

As days turned into weeks, the villagers started to adopt some of the stranger's ideas. They began to prioritize individual aspirations over collective goals, believing that personal fulfillment would enhance their harmony. Slowly, the vibrant songs turned into whispers of dissent. The once-unified community began to fragment, as villagers pursued their own paths, forgetting the values that had once bound them together.

## The Breaking Point

One fateful evening, a grand festival was planned to celebrate the village's heritage. However, instead of the usual joy, the event became a battleground of competing interests. Some wanted to showcase individual talents, while others insisted on preserving traditional group performances. The festival ended in chaos, with villagers arguing and retreating to their corners, leaving the once-harmonious village in disarray.

## The Lesson Learned

As the dust settled, the villagers realized that harmony is not merely the absence of conflict but the presence of understanding and compromise. They learned that while individual expression is important, it should not overshadow the collective spirit that had once made their village thrive.

## A New Beginning

With newfound wisdom, the villagers invited the traveler back to share his stories once more. This time, they listened not just to the tales of distant lands but also reflected on their own values. They crafted a new way of living that celebrated both individual aspirations and communal bonds, ensuring that harmony would thrive in a more profound and balanced way.

---

## Wisdom to Take Away

**Harmony is a delicate balance. It thrives on mutual respect, understanding, and compromise. Embrace individuality, but remember that true harmony is built on the foundation of collective strength.**

#


**Nos Pusimos Viejos**

Si quieres saber
Cuánto te quiero
Ven y abrázame
Que yo te abrazaré
Que yo te amaré

Tu mundo es mi mundo
Tu luna es la mía
Aunque yo sea tu sol
Amada mía.

Entre susurros escondidos
Tras los árboles
Entre hojas amarillas
Vestían los caminos.

Será tu mano con la mía
Paseando por el parque
Un lazo de amor y ternura
Entre pasos entrecortados.

Hoy siento lejos de aquí
Esos momentos hermosos
Que solíamos vivir sin prisa
Y sin lamentos.

Hoy ya no es ayer
El ayer se marchó
Con los pasajes del tiempo
Que hoy nos volvieron viejos

#

![Photoroom-20260520_201411004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcaaR7t6zLTjrmuMtJYJx5dABUnvXeTfb9eyCU6qEfcAv/Photoroom-20260520_201411004.jpg)

#

We've Grown Old

If you want to know
How much I love you
Come and hug me
And I will hug you
And I will love you

Your world is my world
Your moon is mine
Even though I am your sun
My beloved.

Among hidden whispers
Behind the trees
Among yellow leaves
Were dressed along the paths.

It will be your hand in mine
Strolling through the park
A bond of love and tenderness
Among halting steps.

Today I feel far from here
Those beautiful moments
That we used to live without haste
And without regrets.

Today is no longer yesterday
Yesterday has gone
With the passages of time
That today have made us old

body.title: MOVIE REVIEW: “The Farm” (2018)
body.body: <center>[IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt7959500/mediaviewer/rm149778688)</center>\n**Synopsis**: *Before continuing their journey back home, a young couple decides to stay (to rest) in a kind of \

located on a deserted highway; however, they end up being kidnapped and treated like animals on a farm surrounded by mysteries*.
Almost all the foundation of horror cinema, especially the subgenre of the well-known *B movies*, is aimed at an adult audience. Betting on plots with shocking narratives and scenes of explicit violence (usually with the gore atmosphere being exalted) combined with cartoonish characters (for the most part), the recipe is already written for any filmmaker who wants to venture into this type of product. However, precisely here, it is quite easy to say that filmmaker **Hans Stjernswärd** did an extremely superficial job even though he had a good structure at his disposal.
<center>[Giant Freakin Robot](https://www.giantfreakinrobot.com/ent/peaceful-getaway-horrific-broad-daylight-the-farm.html)</center>
What could have been thought of as \

of conventional ideas ended up becoming just another movie with less impact (even though it has a minimally curious plot, and which brings different reflective aspects inside and outside the cinematic context). The audience follows the struggle for survival of the couple Nora and Alec, who, when imprisoned on a mysterious farm (and literally treated like caged animals), do not realize the real danger they are facing (at least not until they are faced with a very brutal reality).
Perhaps the only positive aspect of this whole movie is its pretension to be something bigger than it actually manages to be. Ironically, this could be a traditionally negative aspect... But here, this audacity ends up working relatively well because it manages to arouse the audience's curiosity about what is really happening. At the same time, there is a tense atmosphere inside the farm, which, being located in a desert location far from civilization, becomes a very interesting place to explore (even though the cinematography doesn't help much here).
<center>[Tem Alguém Assistindo?](https://temalguemassistindo.com.br/conheca-os-canibais-polemico-filme-de-terror-onde-humanos-sao-tratados-como-animais/)</center>
Although the script fails to take full advantage of what would be its best quality, throughout its almost 80 minutes (yes, only that; and it becomes more than obvious that this entire script would need to be longer so that there wouldn't be so many narrative gaps to fill) the premise insists on sounding like a \
movie. Just pay attention to the lack of dialogue (something that happens in more than half the time, by the way), and some \

camera angles to conclude this... However, the result of this attempt is flawed, because everything is quite superficial.\nTechnically, this is a very low-budget project that tries to use its brutally violent aspect to remain a relevant product within the subgenre to which it belongs. This wouldn't be a problem if the editing work were so bad, and the flow of events were so implausible. There are some major inconsistencies in the main facts presented, as well as a lack of conflict that minimizes the urgency of the \

struggle for survival (who, incidentally... are not treated that way by the script itself).\n<center>[Giant Freakin Robot](https://www.giantfreakinrobot.com/ent/peaceful-getaway-horrific-broad-daylight-the-farm.html)</center>\nBy mixing elements already well-known in horror movies (in general), the script tries at all costs to shock through the absence of explanations (as if it wanted to \
the audience with so many doubts and uncertainties regarding not only how that \

- *humans wearing animal masks* - lives on that farm, but also how religion enters as a determining factor within the entire narrative), as well as the use of graphic violence that really brings some unsettling moments due to the banal motivation disguised as real motivation.
For a while this even works in a positive way, but then everything becomes tedious due to the repetition of themes, which highlight the script's lack of creativity in feeding its own essence. Here, the cast also does not perform well at all. Everyone involved plays characters that are cartoonish (and poorly developed), to the point of being forgotten throughout the plot simply because they have no impact (whether narrative or more stylized, visually speaking). The level of acting is elementary and reminded me of a theatrical play staged by amateurs.
<center>[The Scariest Things](https://scariesthings.com/2018/04/23/erics-review-the-farm-2018/)</center>
If you, like me, are a fan of horror movies (in general), ***The Farm*** isn't a complete disappointment (because there are some good ideas within the project, but the crucial problem is that many of them weren't even minimally explored to the point of becoming truly important elements within the essential context). However... It's best to watch this movie with the lowest possible expectations, because the level of frustration will certainly be much lower. It's worth mentioning that the \

here is something that defies common sense.
---
<center>**CRÍTICA DE PELÍCULA: “La Granja” (2018)**</center>
**Sinopsis**: *Antes de continuar su viaje de regreso a casa, una joven pareja decide alojarse (para descansar) en una especie de “albergue” situado en una carretera desierta; sin embargo, terminan siendo secuestrados y tratados como animales en una granja rodeada de misterios*.
Casi toda la base del cine de terror, especialmente el subgénero de las conocidas películas de *serie B*, está dirigida a un público adulto. Apostando por tramas con narrativas impactantes y escenas de violencia explícita (generalmente con una atmósfera gore exaltada) combinadas con personajes caricaturescos (en su mayoría), la receta está ya escrita para cualquier cineasta que quiera aventurarse en este tipo de producto. Sin embargo, precisamente aquí, es fácil decir que el cineasta **Hans Stjernswärd** realizó un trabajo extremadamente superficial a pesar de tener una buena estructura a su disposición.
Lo que podría haberse considerado una propuesta “fuera de la caja” y poco convencional terminó convirtiéndose en una película más, de escaso impacto (a pesar de tener una trama mínimamente interesante que introduce diversas reflexiones dentro y fuera del contexto cinematográfico). El público sigue la lucha por la supervivencia de la pareja formada por Nora y Alec, quienes, al ser encarcelados en una misteriosa granja (y tratados literalmente como animales enjaulados), no se dan cuenta del verdadero peligro que corren (al menos no hasta que se enfrentan a una realidad brutal).
Quizás el único aspecto positivo de toda la película sea su pretensión de ser algo más grande de lo que realmente logra ser. Irónicamente, esto podría considerarse tradicionalmente negativo… Pero aquí, esta audacia funciona relativamente bien, ya que consigue despertar la curiosidad del público sobre lo que realmente sucede. Al mismo tiempo, se respira una atmósfera tensa dentro de la granja, que, al estar ubicada en un desierto alejado de la civilización, se convierte en un lugar muy interesante para explorar (aunque la cinematografía no ayuda mucho).
Aunque el guion no aprovecha al máximo su mayor potencial, a lo largo de sus casi 80 minutos (sí, solo eso; y resulta más que evidente que debería ser más largo para evitar tantos huecos narrativos), la premisa insiste en sonar como una película “cult”. Basta con fijarse en la falta de diálogos (que, por cierto, se repite en más de la mitad del tiempo) y en algunos ángulos de cámara poco convencionales para concluir... Sin embargo, el resultado de este intento es deficiente, pues todo es bastante superficial.
Técnicamente, se trata de un proyecto de muy bajo presupuesto que intenta utilizar su brutal violencia para mantenerse relevante dentro del subgénero al que pertenece. Esto no sería un problema si el montaje fuera tan malo y el desarrollo de los acontecimientos tan inverosímil. Existen algunas inconsistencias importantes en los hechos principales presentados, así como una falta de conflicto que minimiza la urgencia de la lucha por la supervivencia de los \

(quienes, por cierto... no son tratados de esa manera por el propio guion).\nAl mezclar elementos ya conocidos en el cine de terror (en general), el guion intenta a toda costa impactar mediante la ausencia de explicaciones (como si quisiera \
al público con tantas dudas e incertidumbres sobre cómo esa \

- *humanos con máscaras de animales* - vive en esa granja, y también sobre cómo la religión entra como factor determinante en toda la narrativa), así como mediante el uso de violencia gráfica que genera momentos perturbadores debido a la motivación banal disfrazada de motivación real.\nDurante un tiempo, esto incluso funciona de forma positiva, pero luego todo se vuelve tedioso debido a la repetición de temas, lo que evidencia la falta de creatividad del guion para desarrollar su propia esencia. En este sentido, el reparto tampoco está a la altura. Todos los participantes interpretan personajes caricaturescos (y mal desarrollados), hasta el punto de ser olvidados a lo largo de la trama simplemente porque no tienen ningún impacto (ni narrativo ni visual). El nivel de actuación es elemental y me recordó a una obra de teatro amateur.\nSi, como yo, eres fan del cine de terror (en general), ***La Granja*** no te decepcionará del todo (ya que tiene algunas buenas ideas, pero el problema principal es que muchas de ellas ni siquiera se exploraron lo suficiente como para convertirse en elementos realmente importantes dentro de la trama). Sin embargo... Es mejor ver esta película con las expectativas más bajas posibles, porque la frustración será mucho menor. Cabe mencionar que el \

desafía toda lógica comum. ---
**CRÍTICA DE FILME: “Os Canibais” (2018)**
**Sinopse**: *Antes de seguir com sua viagem de volta para casa, um jovem casal decide se hospedar (para descansar) numa espécie de “hostel” localizado em uma autoestrada desértica; no entanto, eles acabam sendo sequestrados e tratados como animais em uma fazenda cercada de mistérios*. Quase toda base do cinema de horror que pavimenta especialmente o subgênero dos conhecidos *filmes B* é voltada para o público adulto. Apostando nas tramas com narrativas chocantes, e cenas de violência explícita (geralmente com a atmosfera gore sendo exaltada) aliadas a personagens cartunescos (em sua grande maioria), a receita já escrita para todo cineasta que quer se aventurar nesse tipo de produto. No entanto, precisamente aqui, é bem fácil afirmar que o cineasta **Hans Stjernswärd** fez um trabalho extremamente superficial mesmo tendo uma boa estrutura em suas mãos. O que poderia ter sido pensado “fora da caixa” das ideias convencionais, acabou se tornando apenas mais um filme de menor impacto (ainda que tenha uma trama minimamente curiosa, e que traz diferentes aspectos reflexivos dentro e fora do contexto cinematográfico). O público acompanha a luta pela sobrevivência do casal de namorados Nora e Alec, que ao serem aprisionados em uma fazenda misteriosa (e literalmente sendo tratados como animais enjaulados), não se dão conta do real perigo que estão enfrentando (não pelo menos até estarem diante de uma realidade muito brutal). Talvez, o único aspecto positivo de todo esse filme é a pretensão dele em ser algo maior do que ele realmente consegue ser. Ironicamente, isso poderia ser um aspecto tradicionalmente negativo... Mas aqui, essa audácia acaba funcionando relativamente bem porque consegue despertar a curiosidade do público sobre o que está realmente acontecendo. Ao mesmo tempo, há uma ambientação tensa dentro da fazenda, que por estar localizada num local desértico e longe da civilização, se torna um local muito interessante para ser explorado (ainda que a cinematografia não ajude muito aqui). Embora o roteiro não consiga tirar o devido proveito daquela que seria à sua melhor qualidade, ao longo de seus quase 80 minutos (sim, apena isso; e fica mais do que óbvio que todo esse roteiro precisaria ser maior para que não houvesse tantas lacunas narrativas a serem preenchidas) a premissa insiste em soar como um filme “cult”. Basta apenas prestar atenção na falta de diálogos (algo que acontece em mais da metade do tempo, aliás), e em alguns enquadramentos de câmeras “não convencionais” para concluir isso... Porém, o saldo dessa tentativa é falho, porque tudo é bem superficial. Tecnicamente, esse é um projeto de orçamento muito baixo, e que tenta se valer do seu aspecto brutalmente violento para se manter como um produto relevante dentro do subgênero ao qual ele pertence. Isso não seria um problema se o trabalho de edição fosse tão ruim, e a fluidez dos acontecimentos fosse tão inverossímil. Existem algumas grandes incoerências nos principais fatos apresentados, bem como existe também uma falta de conflito que minimiza toda uma urgência na luta pela sobrevivência dos “protagonistas” (que aliás... não são tratados desse jeito pelo próprio roteiro). Fazendo uma mistura de elementos já bastante conhecidos nos filmes de horror (de um modo geral), o roteiro tenta a todo custo chocar pela ausência explicações (como se quisesse “sufocar” o público com tantas dúvidas e incertezas em relação não apenas a como aquela “sociedade animal” - *humanos usando máscaras animalescas* - vive naquela fazenda, mas também, como a religião entra como um fator determinante dentro de toda a narrativa), bem como o uso de uma violência gráfica que realmente traz alguns momentos inquietantes pela motivação banal disfarçada de motivação real. Por algum tempo isso até funciona de maneira positiva, mas depois tudo se torna enfadonho pela repetição de temas, que evidenciam a falta de criatividade do roteiro em alimentar a sua própria essência. Aqui, o elenco também não tem um desempenho nada bom. Todos os envolvidos interpretam personagens que são cartunescos (e mal desenvolvidos), a ponto de serem esquecidos ao longo da trama simplesmente por não terem nenhum impacto (seja narrativo ou mais estilizado, visualmente falando). O nível de atuação é primário e me lembrou uma peça teatral encenada por amadores. Se você, assim como eu, é um apreciador dos filmes de horror (em modo geral), ***Os Canibais*** não chega a ser uma total decepção (porque realmente há boas ideias dentro do projeto, mas o problema crucial aqui é que muitas delas não foram sequer minimamente exploradas a ponto de se tornarem realmente elementos importantes dentro do contexto essencial). No entanto... É melhor assistir a este filme com as mais baixas das expectativas, porque certamente o nível de frustração será muito menor. Vale à pena mencionar que a “conclusão” aqui é algo que foge do senso mais comum. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/movie-review-the-farm-2018-cgd)
