body.title: Headquarters of Maracaibo’s oldest print newspaper. | Sede del periódico impreso más antiguo de Maracaibo
body.body:
> **Grato saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos viajeros de todas partes del mundo, es un placer para mí saludarlos en este lindo miércoles ya ombligo de la semana, para seguirles mostrando un lugar con gran historia de nuestra ciudad de Maracaibo.** **A warm greeting to all my dear travelling friends from all over the world; it is a pleasure for me to greet you on this lovely Wednesday, right in the middle of the week, to continue showing you a place steeped in history in our city of Maracaibo.** Justamente enfrente del centro comercial ciudad chinita en todo el casco central de Maracaibo, podemos encontrar el periódico de medio impreso más importante del occidente del país, como lo fue en su tiempo diario panorama, inaugurado justamente en el año 1914, que funciono de forma impresa, el periódico más importante de Venezuela durante muchos años se dedicó a vender de forma física cada una de las noticias importantes en el ámbito deportivo noticias, entre otros, pero fue justamente en el año 2018, cuando en la crisis fuerte económica que atravesó nuestro país Venezuela que decidieron debido a la escasez del papel paso únicamente a medio digital, incluso hasta la actualidad todavía funciona. >Right opposite the Ciudad Chinita shopping centre, in the heart of Maracaibo, we find the most important print newspaper in the west of the country just as *Diario Panorama* once was. Launched in 1914, it operated as a print publication and, for many years, was Venezuela’s leading newspaper, dedicated to publishing all the major news stories in print, including sports news, amongst others. However, it was in 2018, during the severe economic crisis that our country, Venezuela, was going through, that they decided, due to a shortage of paper, to switch exclusively to a digital format, and it continues to operate in this way to this day. ![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Sencillo Blanco y negro_20260520_090036_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTivt7PvccvFQVg9DE95qMyoF8ac4epGcmr7breTmmfxD/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20Feliz%20San%20Valent%C3%ADn%20Sencillo%20Blanco%20y%20negro_20260520_090036_0000.png) Podemos ver su enorme fachada en lugar completamente en perfecto estado muy bien cuidado en donde se imprimían, los distintos tipos de periódicos que esto rápidamente eran distribuidos por todo el occidente del país ya justamente a partir de las 7:00 de la mañana se encontraba distribuido por todas las ciudades más importantes del país, este periódico marcó de manera importante nuestra infancia y juventud, pues la información que daban era totalmente veraz. Simultáneamente contaban con ediciones informativas de revistas, como las facetas e incluso el famoso pitoquito, un periódico especial para los niños donde aparecía información general, y también servían para que los niños pudieran hacer las tareas del colegio, así como también un periódico qué permitía reciclar y ser de utilidad. >We can see its enormous façade, which is in perfect condition and very well maintained; it was here that the various types of newspapers were printed, which were then swiftly distributed throughout the western part of the country. By 7:00 am sharp, they had already been distributed to all the country’s major cities. This newspaper had a significant impact on our childhood and youth, as the information it provided was entirely accurate. At the same time, they published magazine editions, such as Las Facetas and even the famous Pitoquito, a special newspaper for children containing general information, which also helped children with their schoolwork, as well as a newspaper that could be recycled and put to good use. ![20260502_113442.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeCBDf2oFrN9ExhibYfxUMKiXfQgjbQZaw1VobrDtk5rr/20260502_113442.jpg) ![20260502_113443.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWXf1bcBMpVqrFy3oER5WjfyJEBATrAUMdd9LdxNDUdb/20260502_113443.jpg) ![20260502_113457.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZstHgSnx1g5Yx4K8bJFNbg8UjEiBtpZcnvcaXrc8QZed/20260502_113457.jpg) ![20260502_113503.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrp4GRbvEbdkXmXuf76TYhGbbaeuMBCyzUfDpKHp8Exm/20260502_113503.jpg) ![20260502_113505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPiyxVb13kZTRCEkPDKyNAsAXT4Tq82uuoUs5uM4XPxu1/20260502_113505.jpg) --- La historia de panorama en inicia con la fundación justamente los creadores fueron el empresario Abraham y David Belloso Rossell, dura durante todo el siglo XXX, este periódico fue parte fundamental de la información en el Zulia, puesto que justamente fue creado en el momento del auge petrolero, ya que nuestra ciudad es muy alta en producción del petróleo dando mayor impulso. A toda la industria de petroleo mediante este periódico marcando así pauta, en una transición de gran importancia para la urbanidad de la ciudad de Maracaibo, sin duda alguna estas grandes letras que podemos ver en su fachada principal, son las letras centrales que se encontraban plasmada tal cual en la portada inicial del periódico. >The history of *Panorama* began with its founding by the entrepreneurs Abraham and David Belloso Rossell; it spanned the entire 20th century. This newspaper played a vital role in providing news in Zulia, as it was established at the height of the oil boom, a period when our city’s oil production was at its peak, giving the publication a significant boost. Through this newspaper, it set the tone for the entire oil industry, marking a transition of great importance for the urban development of the city of Maracaibo. Without a doubt, the large letters we can see on its main façade are the central letters that appeared exactly as they are on the newspaper’s original front page. ![20260502_113456.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhz4DoBQaTQEGdV9S8ZnGU63AsMZ7uMp3fi2W1SDA8KX/20260502_113456.jpg) ![20260502_113506.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXxZprX61QSELopnGBo8WBtg3211qTazvBhUuVmSvd6YN/20260502_113506.jpg) ![20260502_113556.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvZWZnTYpN58DCBc5bs5mxMfVa4qKQgQJ8nuSxNscKSU/20260502_113556.jpg) ![20260502_113732.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvDp1CSXfwcBY5zRyqGqr8DmipS4dVn6BoS5sKh4yYSD/20260502_113732.jpg) ![20260502_113734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxjFLxFWc74v53WD45QP5knoHyKn4teEijV8mpWvSm9X/20260502_113734.jpg) --- Inicialmente durante sus primeros años de fundación estos operaban en la plaza Baralt hasta mudarse a la sede en la que se encuentran actualmente, en la actualidad del periódico solamente funciona 100% digitalmente, pero sus instalaciones se conservan totalmente intactas siendo bastantes amplias ubicando una manzana completa y podemos ver que se encuentran totalmente un estado perfecto, justamente el 14 de mayo del 2019, fue la última vez en la que pudimos ver todos los lectores y fanáticos de este prestigioso periódico impreso, su última edición física e imprenta que marcó a todo el occidente venezolano, pues desde ese entonces, el periódico no volvió a circular más de manera física. >Initially, during its early years, the newspaper operated from Plaza Baralt before moving to its current premises; today, the newspaper operates entirely online, but its premises remain completely intact and are quite spacious, covering an entire block, and we can see that they are in perfect condition. It was precisely on 14 May 2019 that readers and fans of this prestigious print newspaper were last able to see its final physical edition and print run, which left its mark on the whole of western Venezuela, as since then, the newspaper has not been published in print form again. ![20260502_115243.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUh64emDbJEFSEjotGnULExSAgZzYjZoC8m8e6X4hnzs2/20260502_115243.jpg) ![20260502_115246.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTr37i6cv4akqrStbmCufMBs6JypLiZqckK7LbXizemcQ/20260502_115246.jpg) ![20260502_115321.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeQdTakT17vxJsRsYY5zVidAdsxS2WLLkHaB4ZEaaFVpB/20260502_115321.jpg) ![20260502_115323.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKT8TDvd6wikump5kZC2AE6vK526DJ87qyHJEdp2nrZk/20260502_115323.jpg) ![20260502_113735.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwstQwMA2F4ykCVuFufnPqxxKofAY8BAhpgawdRBKNmg/20260502_113735.jpg) Por último como dato curioso de este famoso periódico es que en su momento inicial tenían una máquina para imprimir el periódico que esta funcionaba netamente con vapor, este periódico tuvo papel protagónico en la promoción de acontecimientos importantes como la creación del primer hospital tubérculoso de Maracaibo, así como también la era del inicio del petróleo en su máximo punto muchas gracias amigos viajeros por conocer conmigo este lugar importante de mi ciudad, me despido hasta pronto. >Finally, an interesting fact about this famous newspaper is that, in its early days, it had a printing press that ran entirely on steam. The newspaper played a leading role in publicising important events such as the establishment of Maracaibo’s first tuberculosis hospital, as well as the peak of the early oil industry. Thank you very much, fellow travellers, for joining me on this tour of this important part of my city. I’ll say goodbye for now – see you soon. ![20260502_113602.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWH6MiDXobMGVvbFG6Fzt3ud2qcs4F1dWhep35BXQWXF/20260502_113602.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.64484 lat -71.61930 long d3scr)

body.title: A Robot Friend?
body.body: > We all need friends in life. I think it's one true thing about life that we can't ultimately deny. Some people withdraw into themselves and mostly prefer to be alone, yet these people have those they call friends. It may be just a few of them or one or two individuals they trust and hold closely to. Whatever the case, we need friends and even the most reserved and withdrawn people need and have them. Friends are there for many good reasons. These are the people who can be a support system to one, those who could help to uplift one, help one become and do better, and even the people who will listen and give emotional support. Friends play a great role in a person's life. Well, good friends. But what if we could have a robot as a friend, would that be something we would welcome? https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSci2469kr2fjq5JhSfbDauJEFsYUYokzqcyrLvh7XGkG/photo-1682159672286-40790338349b.jpeg [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-holding-a-robotic-hand-in-front-of-a-mirror-_7ceGXTAtyQ) From some of the things I mentioned, you would understand that a friend goes beyond a name or a presence, but something more. I reckon that a robot could provide time and presence and should be able to listen when you communicate either good or bad moments and offer some good feedback. The issue is, it lacks emotions, which is one vital attribute, and one thing that helps in how we relate with friends especially in difficult moments. A robot doesn't have this element of emotions owing to the fact that it acts based on command. This is to say that, it can't really understand the various situations to be able to give the needed support. Well, we can say such a robot could be advanced enough to understand a person's situation and give the best possible support according to that situation. But again, these are commands, and what if it fails to understand a command? https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaYEGsGKDTxNZv7NQ3y2ZVxQLfPHLe2xiwz3rd61kkYKJ/geralt-hand-3685829_1280.jpg [Image Source.](https://pixabay.com/photos/hand-robot-human-keyboard-networks-3685829/) In whatever sense, I don't think I'll welcome the idea of a robot as a friend. I don't see myself running out of friends to depend on the friendship of a robot. Humans understand humans better, no matter how advanced and developed a robot can be. A valid reason could be that humans betray, and many have gone through that from so-called friends, so a robot could be a good option. However, it's those humans that are the problem here not humanity. The lack of feelings and emotions from a robot, and that it acts based on commands makes it not a welcome option for me. The robot can fail, and perhaps that is its own betrayal. It can experience a glitch and act on the wrong command and might even end up becoming harmful to me. Also, the fact that there'll be a lack of a deep connection doesn't make it appealing to me. So, I don't think I would really want a robot friend. --- ###### Thank you for reading! At first I didn't have a song prepared for the weekly theme, but the opportunity came on its own: my friend Antonio Rodríguez, an outstanding artist of the central Venezuelan harp, arrived with his 35-string instrument and that awakened in me nostalgia and the desire to play. | | Hace casi un año que no toco mi arpa porque aún está quebrada, así que cuando empecé a practicar con el arpa central me enfrenté a un reto. Este tipo de arpa tiene cuerdas de acero, distintas a las cuerdas de plástico de la arpa llanera a la que estoy acostumbrado. Me tomó un tiempo adaptar el pulso y la forma de rasgueo, pero poco a poco fui encontrando el compás. En plena práctica se reventó una cuerda; por suerte tenía una de acero de guitarra y logré improvisar la reparación para seguir tocando. | It's been almost a year since I played my harp because it's still broken, so when I started practicing with the central harp I faced a challenge. This type of harp has steel strings, different from the plastic strings of the llanera harp I am used to. It took me a while to adapt my pulse and the strumming technique, but little by little I found the rhythm. Right in the middle of practice a string broke; luckily I had a steel guitar string and managed to improvise the repair to keep playing. |

> | Español | English | | :--- | :--- | | De esa sesión nació una melodía que titulé “Joropo por siempre”. No fue fácil, pero la emoción de volver a tocar el arpa me llenó de energía. Improvisé el tema con el corazón, recordando las raíces y la música del llano que corre por nuestras venas. El joropo central, aunque por décadas estuvo en las sombras, ha ido ganando espacios y recuperando su justo lugar en la escena musical venezolana. Los músicos han mantenido viva la llama y hoy celebramos esa herencia. | From that session, a melody was born that I titled “Joropo por siempre”. It wasn't easy, but the emotion of playing the harp again filled me with energy. I improvised the song from the heart, remembering the roots and the plains music that runs through our veins. Central joropo, although it was in the shadows for decades, has been gaining ground and recovering its rightful place in the Venezuelan musical scene. Musicians have kept the flame alive and today we celebrate that heritage. | | Si escuchas la pieza y te dan ganas de bailar, hazlo con mucho gusto: este género es para gozarlo, para sentir la tierra y honrar a nuestros ancestros. Gracias a Antonio por traer su arpa y permitir que surgiera esta inspiración. Un abrazo grande a toda la comunidad del Open Mic; pasé una semana excelente y espero que disfruten “Joropo por siempre”. Nos seguimos viendo en la próxima presentación. | If you listen to the piece and feel like dancing, do it with great pleasure: this genre is to be enjoyed, to feel the earth and honor our ancestors. Thanks to Antonio for bringing his harp and allowing this inspiration to emerge. A big hug to the whole Open Mic community; I had an excellent week and I hope you enjoy “Joropo por siempre”. See you in the next presentation. |

body.title: Another robotic company in the humanoid race.
body.body:
Another robotic company in the humanoid race.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTY4Bg3Vq9o1tQ5m6zhjoVNL3GueZR2gAJLBxHcy1f94Q/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> The British company Humanoid has just closed a gigantic agreement with the German supplier Sheffler to deploy thousands of humanoid robots on wheels in industrial units around the world. The plan foresees a large-scale gradual implementation until 2032, starting as early as 2026 in real factories in Germany.


At Sheffler's unit, robots will perform box-moving tasks within active industrial environments. Meanwhile, another unit of the company will serve as a center for operational testing and full-scale validation. And the most important detail is in the way in which these robots will be used, Humanoid is not just selling machines, it is offering something much more similar to a continuous automation infrastructure.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1K1phiQCftY
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> The model works as a subscription service where the company provides the robots, maintenance, software updates, permanent technical support and complete fleet management. The robots begin to be treated as part of the operational infrastructure of the companies, almost like computing servers or industrial cloud systems and there is another even more interesting layer in all this, the collective intelligence of these machines.


The robots operate using an architecture called Kinnect IQ, an AI system created to coordinate large groups of humanoids simultaneously. Instead of each robot acting in isolation, the platform functions almost as a distributed intelligence capable of dividing tasks, reorganizing priorities and adapting operations in real time. There is a system responsible for overall fleet coordination, another that translates objectives into specific subtasks, vision and language models for physical manipulation, and even a layer dedicated to fine control of the robotic body using reinforcement learning.


The above creates something close to an operational ecosystem of connected workers or robotics and as these machines enter factories, another challenge begins to be faced, teaching robots to learn in the virtual world to work naturally in the real world and this type of advance opens space for greater reflections. Could it be that we are facing


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

body.body:
Stopped by McDonald's for a quick dinner before going to St. Gabriel's secondary school.
去麦当劳吃了顿简单的晚餐，然后去圣加俾尔中学。

>

🎶Meanwhile, some music for you to enjoy as you read. This piece is part of Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons, particularly the first of the 4 violin concertos, called Spring.
🎶让大家继续读的时候，欣赏一点音乐。这件作品是维瓦尔第的“四季”的一部分 - 4小提琴协奏曲中的第一首，名为“春天”。
Source | 来源:

> Source | 来源: https://musopen.org/music/2213/antonio-vivaldi/the-four-seasons/
Walked towards the school and saw it.
走向学校，看到了它。

>

\nCrossed the road and went to the side passing by a children's playground.
过马路，绕到路边，经过一个儿童游乐场。

>

\nThen passed by an exercise corner.
然后经过一个锻炼角落。

>

\nReached the road near the back gate.
到了靠近后门的路边。

>

从4号登机口进入室内体育馆。 爬了几段楼梯，才到达大厅，那里我将与圣加俾尔中学校旧校友打匹克球。

大厅内有四个球场，一些人已经开始热身。我们旁边有厕所和饮水机。AED在一个角落。

>

我自拍了一张。

>

\nTook some pictures of other people warming up.
拍了些其他人热身的照片。

>

拿到一件队友T恤所以又自拍了一张。

我们只用一个球场来进行友谊赛。我赢了两局，对结果很满意。

body.title: The Weight of Words
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNj7pE7fwa5LK9y6mN6sRgPHv8N6y25dHwGepmmxfrU8H/tuntt123ipsun.jpg 

Being a nobody. Being reduced to nothing
before the watching eyes, an unknown figure
behind glasses, that thin shield against sight.
Otherwise blindfolded. Blindsided.

The words are literal, deliberate.
But I am far gone now,
buried in rubbish, a ghost
hoping someone finds meaning in my decay.

Farther away, the strings find me.
They always find me.
They drag me back.
I write to preserve
otherwise a blur throughout the day,
the moments I don't recognize,
mechanism of lonesome built in.

Writing for now. But the rest...
I don't want to think about the rest.
Idle as I share, staring till it wills.

Give out what is not yours.
The heinous nature. The nurture.
Nothing new. Same old me.
Spare me some decency.
How am I to tell?
Other than to write 
words  they don't come out.

The image is mine.

Saludos queridos y apreciados amigos, Feliz y bendecido día tengan todos, en esta oportunidad les comparto unas lindas fotitos de mi día a día, los cuales he tomado la decisión de vivirlos y disfrutarlos al máximo agradeciendo a Dios por cada bendición. Mis días en familia son maravillosos y pues el tener la dicha de poder despertar y disfrutar mi día en compañía de mi hermosa familia es más que una bendición.

Está última semana he estado un poco débil pues como está recién mi primera sesión de tratamiento me ha pegado un poco de malestar pero he tratado de ser fuerte y levantarme por mis pequeños. Y pues aquí les comparto unas hermosas fotografías en familia.

El contenido de esta publicación es completamente original y todas las fotos son mías y fueron tomadas con mi celular Redmi note 13. ___ ENGLISH ___

Today I'm sharing some lovely photos of my daily life, which I've chosen to live and enjoy to the fullest, thanking God for every blessing. My days with my family are wonderful, and having the joy of waking up and enjoying my day in the company of my beautiful family is more than a blessing.

body.title: Once Again, Politics Reveals Its Nature
body.body: Yesterday, many states held primary elections where candidates within political parties competed for whose name would appear on the ballot this coming November. One of the states holding such elections was Kentucky, where incumbent [Thomas Massie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Massie) has served since 2012. Massie belongs to the libertarian-leaning wing of the Republican party, meaning he advocates for limited government power, budget restraint, non-interventionist foreign policy, and strict construction of the Constitution.\n\nWhen I was becoming aware of politics in the 1990s, and Bill Clinton was President, this was essentially the mainstream Republican platform, or at least the rhetorical position they took. However, between the excesses of the Global War on Terror staring with George W. Bush and the insanity of Donald Trump, it  became quite obvious that \

was only a slogan to most in the party leadership. Outliers like Massie now, or Ron Paul in the past, were merely tolerated despite actions which the party supposedly celebrated.

Trump and Massie have had a contentious relationship, with Massie standing up for Trump against some of the more outrageous accusations made by the Democrats. [Trump endorsed Massie in 2022,](https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-donald-trump-kentucky-thomas-massie-1a75ba7b28a5f889210e703a72b85630) and [Massie endorsed Trump in 2024.](https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/4954246-massie-endorses-trump-2024/)

That swiftly collapsed.

- Massie took Trump's campaign promise of Epstein file transparency and [pushed it through.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epstein_Files_Transparency_Act) despite sudden disinterest and opposition.

- He dared [oppose](https://massie.house.gov/news/email/show.aspx?ID=LJCWZJNIK2RRHMAA7VEDGB5KV4) the \

when the rest of the party set aside fiscal conservatism. 

- He sought a [Congressional war resolution on Iran](https://massie.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=395731) when the party decided to ignore the clear Constitutional mandate for Congress to declare war instead of the President.

The war party, AIPAC, and arguably the *Epstein* lobby, responded by pouring money into support for his opponent. This was the most expensive U.S. House primary ever, with more than $32 million reportedly spent on ads by various political action committees (PACs), all for a small Kentucky district with one representative who didn't toe the party line. Fox News, AIPAC, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, and Trump himself all lined up to back upstart Ed Gallrein, a man who didn't even show up for a single public debate and avoided serious media interviews.

So, what does this all mean? Do we blame the Baby Boomer Fox News Republicans? Young folks who didn't vote hard enough this time? Israel? the Military-Industrial Complex? The media?

No.

The root problem is not who holds the office. I'm only interested in the race because Missie is the closest there is anymore to a voice for restraint in Republican politics, not because I think he's some mind of political savior. This race is interesting because now it should be beyond a shadow of doubt that politics has nothing to do with protecting our interests, and everything to do with consolidating power in the hands of a few dishonest, greedy bastards who consider us pawns in their games.

I saw this happen before during the Ron Paul campaigns in 2008 and 2012. I saw Republicans abandon their principles again and again to chase whichever politician the party presented as their new prospective leader in every election cycle, and movements like the TEA Party either be subsumed by the machine or marginalized out of the discussion altogether. I have seen deep corruption and petty tyranny in Idaho and Washington local politics. It's not just a Republican problem, either. The Democrats are transparent in how they rig elections at a national level, and their local politicians don't give a damn about principles either.

Politics isn't about finding the best person for the job who will make the best long-term decisions to defend our liberties, it's about political plunder. It always has been, and always will be, even if the occasional outsider gets elected. Trump campaigned as one such outsider, but his actions demonstrated otherwise to anyone willing to see. For Republicans, the pitch is always some variation on \

at least when there are cmapaign ads to run. Democrats similarly proclaim their respect for peace, diversity, and protecting the underdog on the campaign trail before legislating for war, suppression of dissent, and crippling taxation which disproportionately burdens the working class no matter how it is portrayed as, *\

*\n\nThere is no salvation through politics. We cannot vote our way to freedom and prosperity. Government exists to violate our rights, not defend them. The challenge is finding ways to thrive and build in spite of their nterference, and without their permission. Our rights do not come from \

As the old saying goes, if voting could actually change anything, it would be illegal. No matter who you vote for, the government always gets in. [Have you learned that lesson yet?](https://peakd.com/liberty/@jacobtothe/the-myth-of-representation)

body.title: Un día con amigos en el trabajo [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![373102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmHnoFBE7ArVAdf5yMPUbLeHknM8ELosXAX3EdSpxe7KAt8gPYgwRonvcPNRTuUwVry.png) Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos, cómo están? Por aquí todo muy bien, gracias a Dios. De verdad que hoy fue un día bastante espectacular, que luego les voy a estar contando, porque hoy tengo otra cosita que contarles que no se me escape. Saben que el día de hoy, ayer fue la fiesta de los trabajadores, la cual fue llevada a cabo en el hotel Sunsol Ecoland, que, aunque trabajo en otro lugar, la fiesta fue llevada a cabo allí para todas las unidades, pero separada por día, porque por lo menos hoy le tocó a otra unidad y ayer a nosotros, y la verdad la pasamos muy pero muy bien.
Hello, how are you all, friends? Everything’s going very well here, thank God. It really was quite a spectacular day today – I’ll tell you all about it later, because I’ve got another little thing to tell you that I don’t want to forget. You know, yesterday was the staff party, which was held at the Sunsol Ecoland hotel. Although I work somewhere else, the party was held there for all the departments, but on separate days, because today was another department’s turn and yesterday was ours, and to be honest, we had a really, really good time.
![IMG-20260519-WA0037.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23ywuFb2BMD92g1VQgqqxEThp2KmkWCmpkQ7y5NYRec23J9Jvs9oAtpPbkiBLnWuVEXKG.jpeg) ![20260519_122942.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23x19NjKwkgEaWkUB7Mz7s9WkewonJrZHVYF5FJ1xavvUswPzy7mjD1g6r7xN3LmXXwft.jpg) ![20260519_125826.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMVxvS1972ya3Fa2yKmekweDMh13A1QYUL5Woo4ksRjSTV3Zw63osFTezJEj8PghDxE.jpg) En mi caso, yo estoy de vacaciones. Pero mi compañero Antonio, que es el que se la pasa conmigo y tiene carro, se ofreció a llevarme al lugar y yo claramente accedí, ya que fuimos él, el señor Jesús, que es otro amigo, mi persona y le dimos la cola a 2 compañeras. La verdad, llegamos bastante temprano, que nos dio tiempo de agarrar una buena mesa para ver el grupo tocar y a la gente haciendo el ridículo bailando, porque es que de verdad hay personas que como que se pasan, jajajajajaja. La comida me gustó muchísimo, esta vez estuvo bastante buena, así como el grupo que tocó, que hasta vallenato cantaron. Igualmente, el postre estaba superdelicioso, que yo quería estar repitiendo, y nos dieron un obsequio a todos, por ejemplo, un hermoso termo; la verdad, estaba bonito, me gustó.
In my case, I’m on holiday. But my mate Antonio, who’s always hanging out with me and has a car, offered to drive me there and I obviously agreed, as it was just him, Mr Jesús—another friend—myself, and we gave two female colleagues a lift. To be honest, we arrived quite early, so we had time to grab a good table to watch the band play and people making fools of themselves dancing, because there really are people who just go a bit over the top, hahahahaha. I really liked the food; it was quite good this time, as was the band that played – they even sang some vallenato. The dessert was absolutely delicious too; I could have gone back for seconds. They gave us all a free gift – a lovely thermos flask, for example; to be honest, it was nice, I liked it.
![20260519_125821.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/241tZ87NfA5su1w8bSVgzP9ZZ2mFpniFFxoc21XvzNMTPQwLizuju2BPhwb9cWpdmupzG.jpg) ![2026-05-19-14-46-00-326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/Eos2mcbxxErL71Ch24qfs4X9bN9dAREoDvRaDej2hHgV74giPKygfqEvm2pS6jYvKf9.jpg) ![20260519_130230.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23y8sU2fy1EWiPsnbepMK524D2fRPXv2pxZe2RadBNuTYaaxPZQvWvDSR2ZFNi48FX1hf.jpg) ![20260519_135216.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u67LGnL1Rcr96Sb4yNKyqEHkM8Lmzdy41EzJRsSFvmcmfsy8Y8zP55aPcmM7FJ83e5z.jpg) ![20260519_142226.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23u6338epZ441cKC3UzNgUGVc3tuaVhxSTiYVByeJbQMhmmnFHXUHirE9Z2RdBhdbTXQL.jpg) ![20260519_142928.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmHdatKUemfEWRmhMNvjrJJDhMR912VjGUJjAPLTEBJGpNYiQnaKSENXFQJJUfcm9F8.jpg) ![IMG-20260519-WA0054.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wCBzRPqPwfTBSpQns3G1HckiGNy4es4hD8siqsXb8snyUtoi8YxcHtqxQbD29JPCaLG.jpeg) Pero la cosa se puso buena fue cuando terminó todo porque mi amigo Antoniodijo: “Vamos a tomarnos una cerveza, yo invito\

I'd do exactly what I'm doing now - living, without slaving for a job that is disatisfying me. I'd love to see UBI in play. Although I don't think it should be given to those who are obviously rich - that extra money could be used for bettering health care, for example. I know that makes it not universal, but certain threshholds make some people not need that extra money at all!

Hola, ¿qué tal, amigos de Actifit? En este día les traigo un reporte lleno de energía y motivación para todos ustedes, para que sigan avanzando en el maravilloso deporte del dominio del peso corporal, especialmente la calistenia. # Normalmente no suelo entrenar cuando salgo de paseo, pero esta vez, al ver la cancha con césped artificial tan cómoda y llamativa, no pude resistirme y terminé haciendo algunas planchas para probar mis habilidades. La verdad, fue un momento bastante espontáneo y divertido que me permitió disfrutar aún más el día. # Además de compartir con mi familia y pasar un rato agradable en la piscina, también disfrutamos de un partido de voleibol que llenó el ambiente de alegría y buena energía. Son esos pequeños momentos los que hacen que un día común se convierta en un recuerdo especial. # Quiero resaltar que estos espacios ayudan muchísimo a liberar el estrés y la ansiedad. Caminar, compartir, hacer deporte y mantenerse en movimiento forman parte de un estilo de vida saludable que no solo fortalece el cuerpo, sino también la mente. # Me siento muy feliz de poder seguir disfrutando de la calistenia incluso en momentos de descanso, porque esto ya forma parte de mi vida. Espero que ustedes también encuentren tiempo para cuidar de su salud, disfrutar del proceso y nunca dejar de avanzar hacia sus metas. # Gracias por acompañarme una vez más en este reporte. Los invito a seguir pendientes de mi contenido, donde continuaré compartiendo entrenamientos, experiencias y mucha motivación para todos ustedes. ¡Nos vemos en la próxima aventura! 💪🔥

Teacher Bisola gestured to the kids. \

Educator Bisola also mentioned examples such as the compression of the piston in a car engine, as well as tornadoes and hurricanes.

After the class, I noticed some students getting into a disagreement. Lekan and one of those boys at the back started throwing words at each other. Immediately, I shouted, \

I demanded they stop all forms of quarrel between them, which of course they did, and I re-oriented the class about bullying and its consequences.

Every one cooperated and bullying ended. That day, the class learned more than just thermodynamics. They learned that just as an adiabatic process involves no unnecessary exchange, we too must learn not to transfer our negativity onto others.

 Knowledge is powerful, but character is even more so. Be kind, be respectful, and always remember that *a great scholar is not only measured by what they know, but by how they treat others.
Until next time.*

body.title: Recital de música española en Cumaná
body.body: \n\nEn la tarde de hoy, miércoles 20 de mayo de 2026, se llevó a cabo en la Casa Ramos Sucre un hermoso evento, que fue promovido como \

.

Se trató de un concierto organizado por el Conservatorio de Música Simón Bolívar del Sistema Nacional de Orquestas, con la participación del Programa Alma Llanera del mismo sistema, y el auspicio de la Dirección de Cultura de la Universidad de Oriente y la Casa Ramos Sucre.

Contó con la presentación de tres muy jóvenes y talentosos estudiantes de la Cátedra de Guitarra Solista del Programa Alma Llanera: Iverson Prieto, Daniel Viera y José Daniel Centeno, quienes, bajo la dirección del maestro Daniel Centeno, ofrecieron la interpretación de piezas para guitarra de Johann Sebastian Bach, Agustín Barrios y Antonio Lauro.

Luego, asistimos gustosamente a las interpretaciones de Rafael Becerra y Samuel Almeida, estudiantes de la Cátedra de Canto Lírico \

(Conservatorio de Música Simón Bolívar, Caracas), que nos pasearon por obras de José Marín (siglo XVII), Fernando Sor (s. XVIII-XIX) y Federico García Lorca (s. XX), acompañados en la guitarra por el maestro Daniel Centeno. \n\nCabe resaltar la participación de tres jóvenes y bellas bailarinas, integrantes del grupo de danza \

, bajo la conducción del maestro Leobaldo López, quienes acompañaron algunos de los momentos del recital. Fue un emotivo y placentero evento musical que engalanó los siempre hospitalarios y atractivos espacios de la Casa Ramos Sucre con esta tradición hispana, que el público cumanés supo agradecer con sus aplausos y vivas. A continuación, un grupo de fotos hechas por mí con mi celular.

body.title: Un paseo por Paseo/A Walk Along Paseo (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
> Hola, mis amigos de worldmappin y todos los que visitan mi blog. Estuve dos días alejada de los caminos de Hive por falta de conexión a Internet en casi toda Cuba, cosas que pasan por acá de vez en cuando. Hoy estoy feliz de regresar. En otras ocasiones les he mostrado y comentado mis aventuras y peripecias por el Vedado habanero, pero hoy me voy a centrar en un área en especifica: La Avenida Paseo. Al caminar por allí, uno se da cuenta de que esta es una amplia calle con un gran separador en el medio de ambas vías que posee muchos árboles y algunos bancos para sentarse. Basta recorrer este tramo que conecta la majestuosidad fría de la Plaza de la Revolución con el bullicio civil del Malecón, lugar donde termina esta inmensa avenida, para darse cuenta de la grandeza de la capital de Cuba. >Hello, my friends from worldmappin and everyone who visits my blog. I spent two days away from the paths of Hive due to a lack of internet connection across most of Cuba — just one of those things that happen around here from time to time. Today I'm happy to be back. > >Other times I've shown you and told you about my adventures and escapades through Havana's Vedado neighborhood, but today I'm going to focus on one specific area: Paseo Avenue. When you walk along it, you realize this is a wide street with a large median strip between the two lanes, full of trees and a few benches to sit on. Just covering this stretch that connects the cold majesty of Revolution Square with the civilian bustle of the Malecón — where this immense avenue ends — is enough to grasp the grandeur of Cuba's capital.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNP5AGG2rLkRynZaG4Ng5ZoP7c9F8ZDungeqHYgeAFp9L/1779326265152.jpg)

> Esa franja, de unas diecinueve o veinte cuadras refleja, quizá como ninguna otra, la dualidad habanera, lo épico y lo cotidiano, el proyecto y la ruina, la sombra y al final, el mar y el trópico. Partiendo desde la Plaza, aún siento las miradas imponentes de José Martí, Che Guevara y Camilo Cienfuegos. Pero basta cruzar la calzada y enfilar hacia el norte para verse envuelto entre las copas de los almendros, árboles que abundan en esta zona. La avenida, aquí, se vuelve doméstica, residencial. Los edificios de los años 40 y 50, algunos elegantes, otros desgastados, custodian aceras rotas por las raíces de los grandes árboles. >This strip, about nineteen or twenty blocks long, reflects — perhaps like no other — Havana's duality: the epic and the everyday, the project and the ruin, the shade and, finally, the sea and the tropics. Starting from the Square, I can still feel the imposing gazes of José Martí, Che Guevara, and Camilo Cienfuegos. But just cross the road and head north, and you find yourself wrapped in the canopies of almond trees, which abound in this area. Here, the avenue becomes domestic, residential. The buildings from the 40s and 50s — some elegant, others worn — stand guard over sidewalks cracked by the roots of the big trees.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRt6oQ4neqSbjFQCeUJb6j72YyqU8J1jJvcocyj7znyco/1779326396153.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYpfiAZPdYZzjNfT6nTpgVcA2ckVkevz6LvQ5XsbEbxBa/1779326396271.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRN6r5a6aRSLUQtavmL7jABDXMGDWrF19TT1aENipnV2z/1779326396444.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFNQ7ySU9obXuhe9Tqard98Q5REJvQ2qmguWyaMqyRAq/1779326396554.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJ55Vvbs3eKRrvXEtAQZ5nmUerASg957VaojNx1wrLk5/1779326456313.jpg)

>





En una de las esquinas se encuentra esta inmensa iglesia y luego muchas casas con su hermosas arquitecturas. Este tramo del Paseo es un museo viviente del movimiento clásico y moderno en La Habana. Las fachadas narran la reslidad de una modernidad interrumpida. Sin embargo, los transeúntes como yo, no solo buscan arquitectura, buscan la sombra de un mango callejero o el ruido de los carros americanos que aún desafían la pendiente. Porque toda la avenida  es una gran loma, por fortuna esta vez me toco bajarla y como dice el refrán: \

.\n\n>On one corner stands this immense church, and then many houses with their beautiful architecture. This stretch of Paseo is a living museum of classical and modern movements in Havana. The facades tell the story of an interrupted modernity. Yet passersby like me are not only looking for architecture; they're looking for the shade of a street mango tree or the noise of American cars that still defy the slope. Because the whole avenue is a big hill — luckily, this time I got to walk downhill, and as the saying goes: \

> Esta es una avenida monumental, un sendero romántico. Una calle donde La Habana se explica a sí misma sin necesidad de grandes discursos. Porque el Vedado no está solo en sus mansiones o sus cocteles, está en la respiración de los habitantes y visitantes. Es un sitio que no se recorre, se habita, se sufre y, a veces, hasta se goza. >This is a monumental avenue, a romantic path. A street where Havana explains itself without needing grand speeches. Because Vedado is not just in its mansions or its cocktails; it's in the breath of its inhabitants and visitors. It's a place you don't just stroll through — you inhabit it, you suffer it, and sometimes, you even enjoy it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMrcM76HNxx2QBndoTMh8UDDRQDKK9hGR69NgMyM3rUS/1779326617076.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCn8tqrx1FE18zg1uvza7D8BGAQPVBrmc5NBxkQGqFbg/1779326617370.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTBccAZjRwMP3RfjEZjbPwsfqgda53z7xE8ZgRSrEXdcU/1779326617669.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsVh9ife5k4KVYqYmjgFSXBdd6dvCtg45YcPBMHozffb/1779326617998.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmenP8v4jsiX89NYYu2xdaMSVGH654RjQgrEc1ncKg8Q8h/1779326618366.jpg)

> Al acercarme a la calle Línea, la avenida se intensifica. Aparecen los primeros carteles de música, las colas frente a la pizzería improvisada. La imponencia inicial de la Plaza queda atrás, vencida por la vida diaria, el grito del pregonero, el reggaetón desde un balcón oxidado y el olor a mar que sube desde el Malecón, ya cercano. >As I approach Línea Street, the avenue intensifies. The first music posters appear, lines form outside the improvised pizzeria. The initial impressiveness of the Square is left behind, defeated by daily life — the street vendor's cry, reggaeton from a rusty balcony, and the smell of the sea rising from the Malecón, now close by.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtQvZ5iF4XnTCWvemMcZWqB58aPddXUY51Xzq8z7dfpq/1779326676877.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejwYE2tuMjMz1PdVVXVeamQu5pMPJ7ozKQsjZF8uYhjB/1779326677163.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc5wGTg1dMG27utPJX56UCpPM27sYqRLWLW281uQVG1Nm/1779326677303.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtfxihVAG6yBS2fsCzdddCt6434aAdkjE56wYjKJzggP/1779326677494.jpg)

> Justo después del cruce con Línea, hay una gran estatua de un hombre a caballo. La placa dice: Mayor General Alejandro Rodriguez y Velazco, primer alcalde de elección popular >Right after the intersection with Línea, there's a large statue of a man on horseback. The plaque reads: Major General Alejandro Rodríguez y Velazco, first popularly elected mayor.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbkXADvXszdjQS6co9Bmt6dh7cmxn2YssDxGUeA61rTpb/1779326735874.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7Z4zD848B5TGmH3wHMCzj3zXorRWSQ7xFdU1HLmJ9eE/1779326736021.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPkuS2AQkZ3KQXsHFKoB72BnTAm27njwE7iWxNH9MpG2/1779326736295.jpg)

> Más adelante y casi al final está el Hotel Cohiba junto a otros edificios de vivienda y luego un parque donde se encuentra la llamada fuente de la juventud. Que tiempo atrás exhibía un hermoso chorro de agua. A un costado de la fuente también se puede ver el Hotel Rivera y Galería Paseo, una gran tienda. >Further on, almost at the end, stands the Hotel Cohiba along with other residential buildings, and then a park where the so-called Fountain of Youth is located — which, years ago, displayed a beautiful jet of water. Beside the fountain you can also see the Hotel Riviera and Paseo Gallery, a large store.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcW4C8KrLMojbF871zwYbwoeWAKvUNbR2EGAGyXChoafi/1779326828568.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpKtYaiD3Qvdn1RibxnCmk7rc9Gk4HTx9WNC6poLT4gS/1779326828709.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHr6EPDRfb9XspahHezLNk8vgndxxiPBTnDKT1SFBgv2/1779326829002.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjntohMqoanKcuaiaaK5vyAKKGD2XkYpUnXHfnHvJUMh/1779326829338.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTiQGBB4FSrbEfLj4jpqzomTw6CZcBMAKMZjrLKykMvym/1779326829757.jpg)

> Pasear por la Avenida Paseo es eso, un respiro. No es la Quinta Avenida ni el Prado, pero si es una parte importante del pulmón de la ciudad. Un lugar donde uno va a despejarse, a encontrarte con algún amigo por casualidad o simplemente a ver caer la tarde mientras los almendros echan sus florecitas amarillas. Si vienes por acá, no te lo pierdas. Ahí les dejo estas fotos para que las disfruten sin apuro. >Walking along Paseo Avenue is just that: a breather. It's not Fifth Avenue or the Prado, but it is an important part of the city's lungs. A place where you go to clear your mind, to run into a friend by chance, or simply to watch the evening fall while the almond trees shed their little yellow flowers. If you come around here, don't miss it. I leave you these photos to enjoy without rushing.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYbEURTjvVaC4W3MY1PRxGPhUGACS92JGSVh2urwwj8z/1779326958259.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRZ9PcM9LmzMkDfSreGRYZe176eXtNESc39Kc6AXFSMZi/1779326958431.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5V3WneZNEnKbsSBX2XsbPwdSVzehDukYsvNtStxQnhU/1779326958527.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

body.title: 小区喷药
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Do9EpMV65NVj33o0_ph10.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/Do9EpMV65NVj33o0_ph10/Do9EpMV65NVj33o0_ph10.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

可能是今年到目前为止有些风调雨顺，再加上小区的大树都长的茂密。树叶遮天蔽日的，基本能把阳光全挡住。导致的后果就是树上蚜虫特别多，上周下雨许多蚜虫就被雨水冲刷到地面，再加上混着大量蚜虫粪便的泥土，小区有些臭。因此许多业主向物业投诉，往年虽说也有蚜虫，但不像今年这么泛滥成灾啊。今天下午我正准备去接孩子放学，听到不远处有持续的轰鸣声，骑着小电驴到附近一看，原来是物业正在往树上喷洒杀虫剂。

因为树木比较高，树叶也非常茂密，杀虫剂是从地面往高处喷洒，必须要很大的水压，所以就需要外置马达。可是看起来效率比较低，只有一个人拿着水枪往树上喷洒。一个人举着水枪一会就累了，要休息好一会才能继续喷洒。喷一棵树就需要一段时间，小区这么多棵树，照这个速度要喷到什么时候。接孩子回到小区，我又看到物业另一伙人马在朝地面喷，是用高压水枪把蚜虫和泥泞的垃圾冲到路两边，然后扫到垃圾桶，这样就不会踩到了。

孩子妈今天出差回来，明天就要骑电动车上班。电动车放小区一周上面堆满了蚜虫粪便，我从家里拿了一条废旧毛巾费了好半天劲才把大部分地方擦干净，有些根深蒂固实在擦不掉，尤其是挡风被上面，就这么凑活着骑吧。要想彻底干净除非换新的，可用不了几个月又变脏了。希望物业快点喷洒杀虫剂，明年要早点给物业投诉，让他们3月份就喷洒杀虫剂。

body.title: Congratulations Aston Villa
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxjSGbo89ciFBRKcYPMssPCqcmB98TGN7q3LV9p9egj4/1779326820511.jpg)

ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ Europa League final ပွဲစဉ် အဖြစ် Freiburg vs Aston Villa အသင်းတို့ ကစားခဲ့၏။ Bundesliga ကတော့ ရာသီ သိမ်းသွားခဲ့ပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ EPL ကတော့ ပွဲစဉ် ၁ ပွဲ ကျန်နေပါသေး၏။ Bundesliga ပြီးဆုံးချိန်မှာ Freiburg အနေနဲ့ ရမှတ် ၄၇ မှတ်၊ အဆင့် ၇ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေခဲ့၏။ လာမယ့်ရာသီ Conference League ဝင်ရောက် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ခွင့်ရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ အကယ်လို့ Aston Villa ကို အနိုင်ရပြီး ဗိုလ်စွဲခဲ့ရင်တော့ လာမယ့် ရာသီ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ရမည် ဖြစ်၏။

Aston Villa အနေနဲ့ ပွဲစဥ် ၃၇ အပြီးမှာ အဆင့် ၄ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ ပွဲစဉ် ၃၈ မှာ ရှုံးခဲ့မယ်ဆိုရင်တောင် UCL ဝင်ခွင့်က ရထားပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ ၂ သင်းလုံးက Europa League မှာ မျက်နှာသစ် အသင်းတွေ ဖြစ်၏။ Freiburg အနေဖြင့် ဥရောပ အောင်မြင်မှု မရှိထားပေမဲ့ Aston Villa ကတော့ ၁၉၈၁/၈၂ မှာ UCL ချန်ပီယံ ဖြစ်ခဲ့ဖူး၏။ ၄၄ နှစ်အကြာမှာ ဥရောပပြိုင်ပွဲတခု၏ ဗိုလ်လုပွဲစဉ်သို့ သူတို့ တဖန် ပြန်လည်လို့ ရောက်ရှိလာခဲ့၏။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRjqh8YAGQUZRczU1tHCgjRvdu3z1oqqNK3DvGadQxH9V/1779326820490.jpg)


ဗိုလ်လုပွဲ ပီပီ ပွဲက အကြိတ်အနယ် ရှိလှ၏။ ဘောလုံးပိုင်ဆိုင်မှု အနေနဲ့ သိပ်မကွာပေမဲ့ ဂိုးပေါက် ချိန်းခြောက်မှုနဲ့ ဂိုးရနိုင်ခြေတွေမှာတော့ Aston Villa က ပိုသာ၏။ ပထမပိုင်း ၄၁ မိနစ်မှာ Aston Villa တို့ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး စတင် ရရှိ၏။ Tielemans ၏ လှပသည့် အဝေးကန်ချက်ဖြင့် ဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကို ဖွင့်လှစ် လိုက်၏။ ၄၅+၃ မိနစ်မှာ Buendia က ဒုတိယဦးဆောင်ဂိုး ထပ်မံ သွင်းယူ၏။ 

ပထမပိုင်းကို Aston Villa တို့က ၀-၂ ဖြင့် ဦးဆောင်ထား၏။ ဒုတိယပိုင်းမှာ Freiburg အနေနဲ့ ချေပဂိုးတွေ ပြန်လည် သွင်းယူနိုင်ဖို့ ကြိုးစားပေမဲ့ ဂိုး ထပ်ရသွားတာကတော့ Aston Villa ဖြစ်၏။ ၅၈ မိနစ်မှာ Rogers က တတိယဦးဆောင်ဂိုးကို သွင်းယူ၏။ ပွဲက ပြီးသလောက် ရှိသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ Freiburg အနေဖြင့် ပြန်လာဖို့ မဖြစ်နိုင်တော့ပေ။ လက်ကျန် မိနစ်တွေမှာ Aston Villa က ပွဲကို ထိန်းပြီး ကစားသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ 

Arsenal နည်းပြ ဘဝမှာတုန်းက လောက်လောက်လားလား အောင်မြင်မှုတွေ ချမပြနိုင်ခဲ့ပေမဲ့ EPL တကျော့ပြန် Aston Villa အသင်းနဲ့ Europa League ဖလားကို သိမ်းပိုက် နိုင်ခဲ့လေ၏။ Unai Emery အနေဖြင့် Europa League နဲ့ အတော်လေး လမိုင်းကပ်သည့် နည်းပြဟု ဆိုရပေလိမ့်မည်။ Villarreal နဲ့ တကြိမ်၊ Sevilla နဲ့ သုံးကြိမ် သုံးကြိမ်ကိုမှ သုံးနှစ်ဆက်တိုက်၊ ခု Aston Villa နဲ့ တကြိမ် ဗိုလ်စွဲထားပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ 

_(photos from Europa League Page)_

我看到家附近星爸爸最近重新装修了，我很多年没去过！我家附近的，我真的一次没进去过喝东西！移植出来后，我只在市一医院门口的星爸爸逛，每次坐着哪里呆呆看别人！

看到人在哪里喝咖啡的，拿笔记本打字。我坐门口餐桌上喝水吃早餐吃药，忐忑等报告！好惊又要回去住院，我没心情留意别人！我只进去拍照打卡，装饰品挺好看，心情会变好！

试过有一次看到一杯红色的杯子挺好看的，我买了！还坐在轮椅上，叫老公给我拍照，那时候我还是小光头哈哈哈哈！

最近听到一首歌，好符合今天的主题的！（未来梦，就如世界一切，没有一些东西可预计！友情同样美丽，让无尽暖意回归，也许一生到底，一切超出估计，但是我总会找到你鼓励！）这段我最喜欢的部分，我运动完又去唱歌了一下，也是练气！

我在抖音团购了一个套餐，有咖啡加蛋糕的！但是蛋糕，我又纠结了，怕肥，可能喝一杯大冰星冰乐应该可以饮的！当年我买了红颜草莓星冰乐的，2023年的夏天，也差不多五六月的！这次套餐也有这个，但是我想要套餐里的比利时巧克力星冰乐了哈哈！朱古力味应该好味道……很划算啊哈哈！结果我下错了，变成比利时黑巧红茶拿铁！

看到很多小姐姐收到漂亮的花花，她们也穿的很漂亮！我觉得现在的人都很幸福的！但是我学会了爱自己了，以前笨笨的我！

---

Hola, comunidad de Hive! 👋

Hoy no vengo a hablarles de pan, sino de futuro. 

Muchos conocen mi historia: soy un panadero en Caracas que decidió aprender programación y tecnología desde su móvil para salvar su negocio. Por eso, hoy anuncio con mucha emoción el lanzamiento de: Zamora Digital Agency.

¿Qué es Zamora Digital Agency? 💻
Es mi propia agencia de soluciones tecnológicas donde ayudo a negocios y marcas personales a tener una presencia digital de alto nivel sin que pierdan tiempo ni fortunas. Mi enfoque es usar la Ciencia de la IA para producir resultados rápidos y profesionales.

|     Genus Oxyopes      |      May 20, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday afternoon, I captured this little spider hiding behind a leaf. Although it may seem very ordinary at first glance, its body structure and long, spiny legs looked quite interesting when viewed up close. In nature, they move silently and attack their prey.

The subtle beauty and survival techniques hidden in every tiny creature in nature could never have been experienced so closely without macro photography. If you look closely in this picture, you can see that this spider already has a prey in its mouth. Perhaps because it had a prey in its mouth, it sat quietly and calmly, which is why it was easy for me to take pictures.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this spider below, I hope you like it and enjoy it.

body.title: Benefits, effectiveness and my personal experience of the Grayhammer Painsmith card
body.body:
I recently bought a card in the Splinterlands game the Grayhammer Painsmith card. Since I got the Grayhammer Painsmith card I have become more interested in playing the game. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is not just nice to look at it is also very effective. There are some cards in the game that are used to attack and to make the teams strategy better. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is one of those cards. When I first saw the stats and abilities of the Grayhammer Painsmith card I knew it was going to be very important for my battles.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbojGFatJWRn7PjvmqWL4aCDB3EK96TBjD5ECNe2kDqLF/1779326492683.jpg)

The biggest advantage of the Grayhammer Painsmith card is its ability. Most cards only. Defend, but the Grayhammer Painsmith card can give the team more advantages. In long battles the Grayhammer Painsmith card starts to show its effect. Sometimes a card can change the match without dealing much damage. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is one of those cards that can put a lot of pressure on the opponent if used correctly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbojGFatJWRn7PjvmqWL4aCDB3EK96TBjD5ECNe2kDqLF/1779326492683.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcnEH717g2MwfLfqep3A5hffrgXmApHWWJrfxYpx3EH4M/1779326493058.jpg)

The Grayhammer Painsmith card costs a bit of mana. It is worth it. In the Splinterlands game you cannot always build a team with low mana. Sometimes you have to use cards that take mana but they can help you win the match. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is one of those cards. I have noticed that when I use the Grayhammer Painsmith card with tank cards the whole team plays better.

Another big advantage of the Grayhammer Painsmith card is that it gets abilities as it levels up. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is effective at the level but it becomes even more powerful at higher levels. After reaching high levels the Grayhammer Painsmith cards power increases a lot. That is why I think the Grayhammer Painsmith card is an investment for now and for the future. Cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card are very important for people who want to play the game for a time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2TFpeBrTkBJFhgYZSJgvvtE9LKSxnhmvAaKaeYCbdVB/1779326492785.jpg)

I really like the design of the Grayhammer Painsmith card. It looks like a warrior on the battlefield. The Grayhammer Painsmith cards weapon, face and presence make it look even better. Not winning battles but also collecting nice and unique cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card is a great pleasure. After I added the Grayhammer Painsmith card to my collection my whole deck looks even better.

I like to play battles. Cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card are very valuable to me. Attacking often does not always win battles. Sometimes the right plan and coordination are the key to victory. The Grayhammer Painsmith card helps to make that plan stronger. When I use the Grayhammer Painsmith card I try to arrange my team according to the opponents cards. Then I see how effective the Grayhammer Painsmith card is.

The Grayhammer Painsmith card is especially good in high mana battles. I may not always be able to use it in mana matches but when I have enough mana it is one of my favorite cards. Because with the Grayhammer Painsmith card I can slowly weaken the opponent. If I can play patiently the Grayhammer Painsmith card gives results.

I also like that the Grayhammer Painsmith card can be used with team combinations. Some cards only work well with teams but the Grayhammer Painsmith card is useful in many situations. As a result I can use it to make strategies. I have already used the Grayhammer Painsmith card in a battles and got great results. The Grayhammer Painsmith card helps a lot especially when the opponent has a defense.

The competition in the Splinterlands game is getting tougher. New players are. Everyone is trying to collect strong cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card. In this situation it is hard to survive without cards. So I always try to collect cards that will be useful for a time. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is one of those cards for me.

I also noticed that the Grayhammer Painsmith cards presence can make the opponent feel pressured. Sometimes seeing a card like the Grayhammer Painsmith card makes the opponent change their strategy. As a result I have an advantage from the start of the match. A good card like the Grayhammer Painsmith card does not just attack it also changes the atmosphere of the match. I saw that feature in the Grayhammer Painsmith card too.

When I first started playing Splinterlands I played with cards. As I gained experience I realized how important strong and strategic cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card are. Now when I use cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card I feel a lot of changes in my gameplay. Now I can play battles with confidence than before.

I think the Grayhammer Painsmith card has a future. Because though the games meta changes over time some cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card will always be useful. The Grayhammer Painsmith card has the potential to be one of those cards. So I plan to upgrade it in the future. If I can take the Grayhammer Painsmith card to a level it will become one of the most important cards in my deck.

To be successful in the game it is not about having good cards like the Grayhammer Painsmith card but also knowing how to use them correctly. I am still testing combinations to get the most out of the Grayhammer Painsmith card. I can learn something from every battle and that experience will bring better results in the future. The Grayhammer Painsmith card is giving me the opportunity to learn that.

I am really happy, with my purchase of the Grayhammer Painsmith card. It is not a new card it has become an important part of my gaming journey. The Grayhammer Painsmith cards powerful ability, design and strategic importance have impressed me. I want to use the Grayhammer Painsmith card in the future and take it to a higher level. I believe that if used correctly the Grayhammer Painsmith card will be able to bring victory in very difficult battles.

body.title: The beauty of white wildflowers.
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNa4S2oLFnpNCpfmBcLfFHUd2Qta8k7zZ6mAeZNJRKbu/1779324763710.jpg) Every creation of nature is like a perfect canvas. Today I am sharing with you a beautiful white flower captured on my camera. At first glance, it may seem like an ordinary flower. But if you look closely, you will see its unique features. It is basically the flower of a plant of the eggplant family. Many people call it thorny eggplant or creeping eggplant. Looking at the flower, you will notice a strange contrast in nature. On one side, its petals are a soft, white, and the yellow-orange stamens in the middle create a wonderful contrast. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLswfmgTGqyUZexvs3aGUTFdEhfuee2Ycznb2yGRbdNd/1779324763909.jpg) The main attraction of this flower is the stamens hanging right in the middle of the five-pointed white petals, which look like tiny banana leaves. As gentle and peaceful as the flower looks, its surroundings are just as aggressive. If you look closely, you will see that just below the flower, the stem and leaf tips are covered with sharp, needle-like green thorns. Nature has created a wonderful protective shield to protect its beautiful creation. These trees, growing carelessly in village bushes or along roadsides, are an integral part of the biodiversity around us. Many of us may pass them by out of negligence, but when seen face-to-face with a macro lens or up close, their beauty can rival any expensive orchid.

body.body:

**_Imagen de mi propiedad editada en canva/Image of my property edited in canva_**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV76NVvUB2vveMfqDbpX8gfTGbWMSHHAHiWKxsf4PGuWt/_bienvenidos_a_mi_blog_.jpg)
   _Han pasado ya casi 2 años desde que emigramos a Brasil y aunque recuerdo que esos días fueron bastante difíciles para nosotros también recuerdo que vivimos muchas primeras experiencias que hoy en día han quedado como buenos recuerdos de una nueva etapa de nuestras vidas._ >_It's been almost two years since we emigrated to Brazil, and although I remember those days being quite difficult for us, I also remember experiencing many firsts that have become cherished memories of a new chapter in our lives._ _Una de las tantas cosas que tuvimos que hacer por primera vez fue subir a un avión, pues, nunca antes los habíamos hecho y para llegar a nuestro destino era necesario. Nuestra primera parada luego de pasar la frontera fue **Boa Vista**, llegando directo al aeropuerto para comprar boletos y seguir hacia nuestro destino. Obviamente tampoco sabíamos cómo comprar boletos de avión y además de no saber nada del tema también estaba el factor del idioma, el cual no entendíamos y eso nos dificultó bastante las cosas._ >_One of the many things we had to do for the first time was board a plane. We had never done so before, and it was necessary to reach our destination. Our first stop after crossing the border was Boa Vista, where we went straight to the airport to buy tickets and continue on to our destination. Obviously, we didn't know how to buy plane tickets, and besides our lack of knowledge, there was also the language barrier, which made things quite difficult._
![1000276543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23u65VnWV3JsQxPPp1baqDyTRTJ3fjUZFhKnuXGmdD1ZJAK8w9CsgCjM13FqiHbcFHCh6.jpg)
![1000276544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23tmL4wWyHCct6Tmzus1MmYEQZBnBqg9JDBcNaDsE6xKxs1UZpFkvrG3QG5nVvoQgRW7t.jpg)

_Tuvimos la suerte de contar con una persona que nos ayudó en todo este proceso, incluyendo la compra de los boletos de avión y toda la asesoría necesaria para nuestro primer viaje de avión. Después de tener los boletos en mano nos explicaron cómo era todo, cada parada, cada abordaje y todo lo que debíamos hacer y como._ >_We were fortunate to have someone who helped us throughout the entire process, including purchasing the plane tickets and providing all the necessary guidance for our first flight. After we had the tickets in hand, they explained everything to us: each stop, each boarding procedure, and everything we needed to do and how._
![1000276546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23tmMvwoXZn2ZAch3xmFeHCu9ucF9gMevw1XMKLYce6YNeQ9dJBeBdShKCJNJV1XTF7bP.jpg)

_Nuestro vuelo lo hicimos por medio de la aerolínea **LATAM** y nuestro vuelo tenía 3 escalas, la primera era de **Boa Vista** a **Brasília** el cual debía partir a las 12:10 del mediodía y aunque abordamos el avión a tiempo el vuelo tuvo un retraso de al menos 30 minutos._ >_Our flight was with LATAM Airlines and had three layovers. The first was from Boa Vista to Brasilia, scheduled to depart at 12:10 PM. Although we boarded on time, the flight was delayed by at least 30 minutes._
![1000276549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23x12eEvp8wdcdm6p8BUUD3qkqEk4218utLSQ269aBZKFAc6fmUnSkyGoWB8xVM9pkAdW.jpg)
![1000276548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/244xuUMDjvNkXQwNkFNGfeGfdR8WnvCnVMD477SHJCcei6GmexLNVW4ypps3NpYKCvv6i.jpg)
_Cuando subimos al avión ubicamos nuestros asientos y esperamos a que el avión despegara pero mientras tanto tomamos algunas fotos y leímos el instructivo que estaba en nuestros asientos._ >_When we boarded the plane, we found our seats and waited for takeoff, but in the meantime we took some photos and read the instructions on our seats._
![1000276555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23zkfxscjaZ3g8NNC7kchTVFkFu4BoHtmJpH8LmYQh4L4DCuLfb1Ahdai1fe7mzgfwcSp.jpg)
![1000276556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vi1fYbCgRizL7tVTZAWc1dGqM9EKAC5BG8KuLi3gVx5ViEqMeThDLeScHzH8fzQavpM.jpg)
_Despues de un rato el avión despegó y debo decir que para ser nuestra primera vez fue una experiencia que mezclaba emoción con miedo pero que al final de todo terminamos disfrutando._ >_After a while the plane took off and I must say that for our first time it was an experience that mixed excitement with fear, but in the end we ended up enjoying it._
![1000276557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wMMuQuR2hVYCcDkx26rx5kLJd7gX4ANQhpwfquvbjdsQDL2GfiToCwA7n6niqK3uSCq.jpg)
_Ese vuelo duró aproximadamente unas 5 horas en total, lo que fue bastante para nosotros que no estábamos acostumbrados pero al aterrizar y llegar a **Brasilia** estábamos más emocionados aún por estar un paso más cerca de nuestro destino y por haber vivido esa primera experiencia._ >_That flight lasted approximately 5 hours in total, which was quite a lot for us since we weren't used to it, but when we landed and arrived in Brasilia we were even more excited to be one step closer to our destination and to have lived that first experience._

body.title: The Art and Science of Sports Architecture
body.body:
I have to admit that I'm not keen on the defacement of public property, but in this case, I'm going to make an exception. The building in the following image is the domed geodesic home of Science World, which holds scientific exhibits and a few cultural events like the Dragonboat festival and New Years Party 🎊

<center>![science world.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep1UUKPvmvTqW6DN7qXD2vfqXWJJpP7aJVG8GYHRXTD7fqcPPP5FDLB97Agsu21MPZY.jpg)</center>

Now, the geodesic dome- reimagined by architect Buckminster Fuller decades ago- is being transformed into a soccer ball. Genius!

<center>![Science World Ball01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/246FrAZwhTnEwjKm3UbeMHSJkR1jVmYHfcPJiY4Zfxng7yx4LPjbaVVDQ9CKeCtDmeb1c.jpg)</center>

As you can see, it is not finished yet. There's a FIFA exhibit inside that I hope to attend once the dome is fully set up.

And as a wild coincidence, I just learned that Buckminster Fuller's geodesic dome structure was the basis for the design of the modern soccer ball that was adopted in 1970. It has become the standard with 20 hexagons and 12 pentagons. Ole!

<center>![Science World Ball02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/241ESQRU693o1ksiScttpr1kAMf34DNTttdbnVKiYDUCzWhTLT4ki8hRn9MGvAc19oKMv.jpg)</center>

body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wC9VpwcsMyuHNE7bEGdF6Ga6WRF9rcuyzqgX9dCz9pxvAXyfCpLRrGBmftVSnCugy7n.jpg)
Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I want to share with you a new set of photographs that I took in my studio for some guys who hired my services because they wanted to do a photo session to have professional images of the perfumes they sell. I started by photographing the store owner since he had the idea very clear in his mind and that way we established the lighting standard and how he wanted the following photos to look.
  Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy les quiero compartir un nuevo set de fotografias que hice en mi estudio para unos chicos que contrataron mis servicios porque querian hacer una sesion de fotos para tener imagenes profesionales de los perfumes que venden. Empecé por fotografiar al dueño de la tienda ya que el tenia la idea muy clara en su mente y de esa manera estableciamos el estandar de iluminacion y como queria que se vieran las siguientes fotos.  
![IMG_1317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EpLgUxG76ECBDFcVcD5XxMYihHF4VFt3pyBa3a3qNVvxdA9qt95ggN1S5kE5xzFyJ9s.jpg) ![IMG_1369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xp224UhbDTB25B8nYfaeFFh4MQjEZYswLrzxaXxqkrzgRr64ji36ZxtReF8aPLsir1S.jpg)
Very quickly I noticed that I could take a good photo with the texture of the guy's flannel:
  Muy rapidamente noté que podia make una buena foto con la textura de la franela del chico:  
![IMG_1355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23tvArm8ysX8vZLz2RhqwrXwunbFv4FgW4uoAD6wXRDWjWd4aUSmAukVHS2ihZpY7HoJM.jpg)
The guy was accompanied by quite a few friends so that each one would have their turn in the photos and thus have greater variety in the photographs!
  El chico fue acompañado por bastantes amigos para que cada uno tuviera su turno en las fotos y asi tener mayor variedad en las fotografias!  
![IMG_1426.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xei2eDTWbmbgVA1quP1QV5K4vuV2VK3Jhwg6uspMRcemD6t7Ghv1aq12L5upi19f1v3.jpg)
The truth is we made hundreds of photos that day but here I am only showing you the best ones!
  La verdad hicimos cientos de fotos ese dia pero aqui solo les estoy mostrando las mejores!  
![IMG_1461.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23w2ijy84i4Wj6M1pmVdf4FLL4oA2U925FYDZK1NHpubKUJSg2gSZTsEc8ZTWse52nggy.jpg) ![IMG_1525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Ep5mfBp4uUqsFhkmEWye8ZFHvXErekMD5GodfAkHDk3pj9xhLybeyAjGuq9Hu775RPN.jpg)
Then it was the girls' turn, first we took a couple of photos together, this was one of my favorites:
  Luego fue el turno de las chicas, primero hicimos un par de fotos juntas, esta fue de mis favoritas:  
![IMG_1602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23zkhuBkfSE2juhg1wAKwux6FyRPFoi31EPdLEHGa5a9w1ssq7PV5ekUGZ8XiD7i5xtcd.jpg)
And then we took photos of the girls individually:
  Y luego hicimos fotos de las chicas por individual:  
![IMG_1568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xVMSNWFTHaSJ5t7E6UMH4Rg7K3iftr9RP2wy7j9UnEuWUcMsPWrZPedTkGDZ3aY3sJZ.jpg) ![IMG_1583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgQ1ApVBfduuR3tFUY5ktkLFrEm4BpPCohUSihLRroSzr5uQmb5vLk5yAhCLYzGjKFX.jpg) ![IMG_1599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23x12ia7Tf9B7C3ufskRY4QHATdTV4KPokSKGTPJCHTgHVtEAb6HvosNDWhFYXc4LTpCw.jpg) ![IMG_1622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23yJJYAZQs78XdH1Q8jVMrBC9a5rKCBGJ2P3NYDPcKsGQvGPaL3NgMuPjdsWNSruWvHxi.jpg) ![IMG_1640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wMajfbMT2qdZD8vYjKQ3RpYbs6SN4RsvHBTjEaFPsRYTi3sHAdj3Vssw4HoXpLHPwjv.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm lens at 4/f and two light points. At the end of the photo session we were all super happy with the results and I hope you like them as much as we do!
  Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm a 4/f y dos puntos de luces. Al final de la sesion de fotos todos quedamos super felices con los resultados y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!

body.title: When AI Content Stops Looking and Sounding Artificial | Jeanine Wright + Robert Scoble #663
body.body:
by @geeknewscentral on New Media Show w/Rob Greenlee 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/newmediashow [![When AI Content Stops Looking and Sounding Artificial | Jeanine Wright + Robert Scoble #663](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/b2fdd93b-e85b-4343-8ce1-61253dec18f6.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/1dFnpvLYjVe7S1YRzvBcyA) 
 
 ![New Media Show - #663 ](https://newmediashow.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/NMS-663-Episode-Scoble-Wright-300.png)In episode 663 of the **New Media Show**, hosted by **2017 [Podcast Hall of Famer](https://podcasthall.com) [Rob Greenlee](https://robgreenlee.com)**, Rob talks with **Jeanine Wright, CEO** of **[Inception Point AI](https://inceptionpoint.ai),** and **Robert Scoble,** known as [**Scobleizer**](https://scobleizer.blog), **Founder** of [**AlignedNews.ai**](https://AlignedNews.ai) for a deep conversation about one of the biggest and most uncomfortable questions facing podcasting, video, social media, and the creator economy: what happens when AI-generated content stops sounding and looking artificial? 

**I apologize for the lower audio quality of this episode, which was affected by recording source errors, and I used the best audio enhancement tools to improve it.**

> _**AI-generated media is no longer just an experiment. It is becoming shows, hosts, voices, personalities, clips, channels, avatars, and soon, live interactive media experiences.**_

**Podcasting has always been built around voice, trust, authenticity, and human connection.** But that foundation is now being challenged by AI-generated voices, cloned likenesses, synthetic video, autonomous podcasters, and AI systems that can research, write, produce, publish, and personalize content at a scale human creators cannot match.

> **_The conversation explores whether the podcasting/new media industry is reacting too broadly by labeling AI-generated media as “AI slop” while missing the bigger shift beneath the surface._**

**Some AI content is low quality, deceptive, or spammy.** **Some AI content is becoming polished, useful, creative, and scalable.** **Some human-created content is also low quality,** **misleading**, or **poorly produced**.

**The real issue may not be whether content is human-made or AI-made.**

> _**The better question may be whether it is transparent, authentically-human, accurate, consent-based, valuable, and trustworthy.**_

**Jeanine joins Rob to discuss what Inception Point AI is building with AI-generated personalities, autonomous creators, synthetic audio, video characters, quality control systems, and AI-native media workflows.** She explains why the future may include AI podcasters, AI influencers, AI brand personalities, and AI-generated shows that serve audiences in ways traditional human production cannot easily support.

**Robert brings a broader technology lens to the conversation, connecting AI-generated media to agents, real-time news systems, spatial computing, glasses, robots, synthetic people, and the next phase of human-computer interaction.** He also discusses his own work using AI systems to read large volumes of AI industry activity and turn that into new forms of media intelligence.

> **_The conversation asks whether “AI slop” is a useful label or is becoming a way to dismiss an entire category before quality, ethics, and trust systems have had time to mature._**

**Rob, Jeanine, and Robert also dig into the complicated issue of [AI disclosure](https://shouldIdisclose.ai).**

*   Should every AI voice be labeled?
*   Should AI-written scripts be disclosed?
*   What about human voices reading AI-written material?
*   What about cloned voices using human-written scripts?
*   And if most media becomes materially assisted by AI, will audiences still care in the same way?

**The episode also explores the darker side of synthetic media, including unauthorized voice cloning, fake likenesses, impersonation, fraud, deceptive content, misinformation, platform abuse, and AI bias.** The discussion makes a clear distinction between ethical AI-generated media and synthetic media designed to mislead audiences.

**This is not a simple pro-AI or anti-AI conversation. It is a discussion about the future of media trust.**

> _**The bigger question is whether podcasting and new media should reject AI-generated content outright or help build better standards around disclosure, quality, consent, ownership, monetization, brand safety, platform rules, and audience transparency.**_

**The future may not be human versus AI.**

> _**It may be human plus AI, human extended by AI, AI personalities supervised by humans, and audiences deciding what they trust based on usefulness, quality, transparency, and connection.**_

**Key Topics Covered**

*   AI-generated podcasts, video, and synthetic media
*   Why the phrase “AI slop” may be too broad
*   How AI-generated voices and video hosts are becoming more realistic
*   The difference between low-quality AI content and responsible AI media
*   Why podcasting is emotionally tied to human voice and trust
*   How AI personalities and autonomous podcasters are being created
*   What Inception Point AI is building with synthetic creators
*   Robert Scoble’s view of AI agents, X, and real-time AI media systems
