body.title: [EN/PT] 100% Transparent
body.body:
> # [EN] ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wWRXRxXgu1qHQ4zdMtPceZwWNgMnKDZumxD5VBqh29ptRzvtEeC6xQdUZ7apYBcqXpg.png)
Source: Made in Canva
Transparency is a beautiful word until the moment it starts directly affecting our own lives. I often see people defending the idea that salaries, assets, and income should be completely public on the internet. At first, the idea sounds interesting. After all, if everyone knew how much each person earns, it might become easier to identify corruption, money laundering, illicit enrichment, and other suspicious activities. In theory, this would help society better monitor what is happening around us. But would this really work in practice? In my country, something similar already exists: the Transparency Portal. Through it, people can see salaries, contracts, public spending, and several types of information related to the public sector. The intention is good, and I genuinely believe that some level of transparency is necessary. The problem is that, even after existing for years, corruption still happens normally. Even worse, many things became so repetitive that people simply normalized them. Today, any citizen can enter a public portal and find million-dollar contracts, absurd bidding amounts, and clearly overpriced public projects. You look at a construction project that supposedly costs 100 thousand dollars and realize it could probably be completed for less than half that amount. People see this, comment on it for a few days, and then life goes on as usual. Transparency exists, but it does not necessarily create consequences. And that makes me think that maybe the real problem was never just a lack of information. Another topic that made me reflect deeply about this was DREX, related to the CBDC concept in Brazil. For those unfamiliar with it, it would basically be a digital currency issued by the government itself. One of the biggest concerns involving this kind of system is exactly the level of control and transparency it could bring. In many cases, ordinary citizens could end up having their financial lives practically traceable. What is interesting is that many people reject the idea of total transparency when it affects their own privacy, yet support it when it is used to monitor other people. In the case of DREX, many became concerned because the government could potentially gain extremely detailed access to the financial transactions of the population. And honestly, I can understand both sides. On one hand, it would be interesting if everyone could also see how much money actually reaches the accounts of politicians, high-ranking officials, and people living off public money. Maybe that would create much stronger social pressure against abuses. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoK9foBAhoTXSHPRCdLxBcUCVe73exiCTL6oaQZsPYSBSAWsnCRKukVVWc42SfTk3PU.png)
[src](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/cifrao-dourado-sob-o-frasco-de-vidro-do-sino-renderizacao-3d-com-caminho-de-recorte-3a1oNOh7pGo)
On the other hand, there is also a huge risk involved in all of this. For example, I try to invest most of the money I earn. Many times, I give up traveling, buying things, or simply “enjoying life” in order to invest and think about the future. Now imagine a scenario where anyone could discover how much I have invested or how much money enters my account. It would not only be friends or family seeing this information. Criminals could also use it. It would only take someone noticing that a person has a reasonable amount of wealth for that individual to become a target for scams, kidnappings, robberies, or extortion. The transparency that was supposed to bring security could end up creating the exact opposite. At the end of the day, I believe transparency is important, especially in the public sector. But when it completely invades the private lives of ordinary people, the issue stops being simple. Because there is a huge difference between fighting corruption and turning society into one giant financial reality show. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpk8XmD9saKCRkgWgUfevxjjBPzjDMBXhVaa7Kc3su4oY8cgNUgCnWDH.png) # [PT] ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wWRXRxXgu1qHQ4zdMtPceZwWNgMnKDZumxD5VBqh29ptRzvtEeC6xQdUZ7apYBcqXpg.png)
Source: Made in Canva
Transparência é uma palavra bonita até o momento em que ela começa a atingir diretamente a nossa própria vida. Sempre vejo pessoas defendendo que salários, patrimônio e rendimentos deveriam ser totalmente públicos na internet. A ideia parece interessante no começo. Afinal, se todos soubessem quanto cada pessoa ganha, talvez fosse mais fácil identificar corrupção, lavagem de dinheiro, enriquecimento ilícito e outras atividades suspeitas. Em teoria, isso ajudaria a sociedade a fiscalizar melhor o que acontece ao redor. Mas será que isso realmente funcionaria na prática? No meu país já existe algo parecido: o Portal da Transparência. Nele é possível ver salários, contratos, gastos públicos e diversas informações relacionadas ao setor público. A intenção é boa, e eu realmente acredito que parte dessa transparência é necessária. O problema é que, mesmo existindo há anos, a corrupção continua acontecendo normalmente. E pior: muita coisa acabou sendo tão repetitiva que foi normalizada pelas pessoas. Hoje qualquer cidadão consegue entrar em um portal e encontrar contratos milionários, licitações com valores absurdos e obras claramente superfaturadas. Você olha uma obra que custaria 100 mil dólares e percebe que ela poderia ser executada por menos da metade desse valor. As pessoas veem isso, comentam por alguns dias e depois tudo segue normalmente. A transparência existe, mas ela não necessariamente gera consequência. E isso me faz pensar: então o problema talvez nunca tenha sido apenas falta de informação. Outro assunto que me fez refletir bastante sobre isso foi o DREX, relacionado ao conceito de CBDC no Brasil. Para quem não conhece, seria basicamente uma moeda digital emitida pelo próprio governo. Uma das maiores preocupações envolvendo esse tipo de sistema é justamente o nível de controle e transparência que ele poderia trazer. Em muitos casos, o cidadão comum teria sua vida financeira praticamente rastreável. O curioso é que muita gente rejeita a ideia de transparência total quando ela afeta a própria privacidade, mas apoia quando ela serve para vigiar apenas outras pessoas. No caso do DREX, muita gente ficou receosa porque o governo poderia ter acesso extremamente detalhado sobre movimentações financeiras da população. E sinceramente? Eu consigo entender ambos os lados. Por um lado, seria interessante se todos também pudessem ver quanto realmente entra na conta de políticos, altos funcionários e pessoas que vivem de dinheiro público. Talvez isso gerasse uma pressão social muito maior contra abusos. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoK9foBAhoTXSHPRCdLxBcUCVe73exiCTL6oaQZsPYSBSAWsnCRKukVVWc42SfTk3PU.png)
[src](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/cifrao-dourado-sob-o-frasco-de-vidro-do-sino-renderizacao-3d-com-caminho-de-recorte-3a1oNOh7pGo)
Por outro lado, existe um risco enorme nisso tudo. Eu, por exemplo, tento investir a maior parte do dinheiro que ganho. Muitas vezes deixo de viajar, comprar coisas ou “curtir a vida” justamente para investir pensando no futuro. Agora imagine um cenário onde qualquer pessoa consiga descobrir quanto tenho investido ou quanto entra na minha conta. Não seriam apenas amigos ou familiares vendo isso. Criminosos também poderiam usar essas informações. Bastaria alguém perceber que determinada pessoa possui um patrimônio razoável para ela virar alvo de golpes, sequestros, roubos ou extorsões. A transparência que deveria trazer segurança poderia acabar criando exatamente o contrário. No fim das contas, acho que transparência é importante, principalmente no setor público. Mas quando ela invade completamente a vida privada das pessoas comuns, o assunto deixa de ser simples. Porque existe uma diferença enorme entre combater corrupção e transformar toda a sociedade em um grande reality show financeiro. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-100-transparent-jkb)

body.body:
The main reason most game economies go tits up is almost always unilaterally bots and sybil attack.  It is a higher priority to sell the game and turn a profit for the corporation than to ensure the sanctity of the in-game economy.  Banned a cheater?  Let them pay another $60 for a new copy of the game and they can start cheating all over again.  Cheater wins, corporation wins; everybody's happy!  Except for the actual players of course. 

It's like when a bank gets a fine but the fine is less than the profit extracted. 
There is zero incentive for the cheater to stop. 

Especially true because cheaters are banned in big batches so they are actually allowed to keep cheating even after they've been caught (they will be banned during the next banning wave).  The reason to do this is that if you ban them in real time it's far more likely they'll figure out exactly how they got caught and then tip off all their other cheater friends so that they don't get caught.  This is actually a huge business and there are literal gangs of hackers that make money together doing this. Those gangs even have enemy gangs and will rat each other out and make sure the rival gang can't get an \

cheating advantage lol. \n\nThe real solution to all of this is for the community to regulate itself.  I want to make an invite-only system where the community has to vote to let you in, and someone (or multiple people) have to vouch for you.  If you get banned for cheating it looks bad on them as well. The community and players need to be the police of the server and not some centralized company hiring some underpaid game-master who doesn't actually give a shit.

body.body: No te preocupes amigo, el arte no es perfecto y por eso estamos siempre aprendiendo, lo más importante es seguir dibujando y nunca rendirse. Con trabajo y esfuerzo se va avanzando poco a poco y el dibujo con erroros de hoy, ayudará a perfeccionar los dibujos de mañana. Cuando comenzamos a dibujar rostros, los retratos salen con muchos errores y algunos  parece retratos de fantasmas aterradores pero  a medida que seguimos dibujando, los monstruos y fantasmas van desapareciendo. Lo importante es no rendirse y seguir trabajando, se puede fallar 1000 veces en un mismo retrato pero 1001 vez, debes seguir intentándolo. Como consejo evolutivo, nunca rompas los dibujos que no salen como nos quisiéramos, a todas las obras ponle la fecha de realización y así podrás ver tu evolución cuando aprecies todas las obras juntas. El mejor dibujo de hoy será el dibujo menos avanzado en el futuro. Mente positiva y para adelante. Qué lástima que no encontré mi primer retrato para mostrártelo 😱. Lo mejor de todo es que eres persistente, creativo, estudioso y practicas todos los días a pesar de los obstáculos de la vida. El esfuerzo tarde o temprano se premia y los buenos frutos llegarán. \n\nDon’t worry, my friend, art is not perfect and that’s why we are always learning. The most important thing is to keep drawing and never give up. With work and effort, progress comes little by little, and today’s mistakes will help perfect tomorrow’s drawings. When we start drawing faces, portraits come with many errors, some even look like terrifying ghost portraits, but as we keep drawing, the monsters and ghosts disappear. The important thing is not to give up and to keep working—you can fail a portrait 1000 times, but on the 1001st, you must keep trying. As evolutionary advice, never tear up the drawings that don’t turn out as we wish; date every work, and later you’ll see your evolution when you look at them all together. The best drawing of today will be the least advanced one in the future. Positive mind, keep moving forward. Too bad I couldn’t find my first portrait to show you 😱. The best part is that you are persistent, creative, studious, and practice every day despite life’s obstacles. Effort is rewarded sooner or later, and good fruits will come.

Interesting that you bring that up because the D3 RMAH was... kind of my idea :D 
It was around that time that I was pitching so many ideas to my friend that worked at Blizzard and a lot of my ideas were implemented (So many Starcraft 2 ideas).

I begged and pleaded for them to make all items in D3 BIND ON EQUIP and my friend was like nah we don't like that.  It created item hyperinflation.  Once a good item enters the economy it will literally never leave because it will just be resold over and over and over again.

There was also clear and blatant corruption in the background.  The search functionality in the AH was trash so devs that could tap into the backend and search it with custom algorithms made an absolute killing until the entire thing blew up.

body.title: Splinterlands: Analyzing one of my best battles. A double reward[Eng-Spn]
body.body:
Greetings Hive friends, @suisver here with a new post for the channel, and this time we're going to analyze this last battle where I emerged victorious to claim my rewards.

My last battle was a resounding victory.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23t78uP8c2RZuu47E416RjvpWA1vxs3g9VKeyKZdAXkK3vubx2cK1vifgY4ikAy9YSAtx.png)
[My last victory](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_7751d9169deb348ac1e50e69d4555dcd?ref=suisver)

We will analyze this great feat today.

---

We faced off against **SLBB_SIMPLEIVORY** in a **28 Mana** battle where we both chose to rely on the dark power of the Death element, the Demon **THALGRIMORE**.

We both chose against the Epic rarity summoner: **Thalgrimore**. The big difference is that my summoner is level 2 and my enemy's is level 1. I have every advantage in this fight.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23x14wKLgd37RNTgvy7DfxA1Fvuxzi6wkr7gaL99FZkHvT7YUEc1AUJBtPFUqVN5K9iVh.png)

The enemy set up a massive distraction strategy in their backline, leaving a lighter tank up front:

* **Main Tank:** **Nim Guard Captain** (7 Mana, 1 Attack, 5 Health, 3 Speed). He has a good ability that halves magic damage. A very annoying war rat.

* **Position 2 (The Hit Magnet):** **New Beluroc Aegis** 🦍 (8 Mana, 1 Attack, 5 Health, 2 Speed). Forcing my ranged and magic units to attack him, protecting his tank.

* **Back Line:** **The Spiny-Tailed Demon** (6 Mana, 2 Attack, 4 Health, 3 Speed). A fast unit to finish off enemies from behind.

---

### My Great Team

We went with a combo of absolute tankiness in the front line and cards with negative status effects to slowly whittle them down. A Great Strategy.

🕷️
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/Eoc7RcTEkSu28NgoWiAw5fCqCz94tc6qXUc1u5bwc4VH6gLMThEEHQr2mYzfPuResyr.png)

**Super Tank:** **Great Bear Druid** (9 Mana, 1 Magic Attack, 6 Health, 2 Shield, 2 Speed). A Great Bear on my team. Not only does he tank thanks to his stats, but he also has the ability to heal, which will keep our first position alive round after round.

**Position 2:** **Savage Butcher** (5 Mana, 1 Melee Attack, 4 Health, 2 Shield, 2 Speed). A robust support unit ready to step in if things get rough.

**Back Line:** **Black Widow** (8 Mana, 2 Ranged Attack, 6 Health, 2 Speed). Our primary source of heavy ranged damage, ideal for piercing those enemy shields.

The battle will hinge on how quickly we can take down their **New Beluroc Aegis**. Since our **Black Widow** and the **Great Bear Druid**'s magic attack will be forced to target the ape in the second position, their main tank (*Nim Guard Captain*) will be left to absorb any direct hits we manage to land.

On the other hand, our bear druid's healing ability gives us a fantastic long-term survivability advantage. While they try to lower our shields, we heal our wounds every turn. It's a solid strategy.

---

My team achieved victory; it was definitely a huge advantage that the demon **THALGRIMORE** was at Level 2.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23u652LsDc59Lf3foj1b5NNoNxXborHzLhb7KNhxEobSEokPgra5UvZURzWYBWWN1BKdP.png)

Once the battle ended with this fantastic victory, we claimed our rewards.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23swnorwthjwhYzRxLZLZsnQ7nMxenczU7EjWAddWkRh9iKTZTNTMNDk9gXmvqDrW75Km.png)

This time I received 2 letters from **Port Guardian**

Saludos amigos de Hive aquí @suisver con un nuevo post para el canal y esta vez vamos a analizar esta última batalla donde obtuve la victoria para hacer el reclamo de mis recompensas.

Mi última batalla fue una contindente Victoria

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23t78uP8c2RZuu47E416RjvpWA1vxs3g9VKeyKZdAXkK3vubx2cK1vifgY4ikAy9YSAtx.png)
[Mi última victoria](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_7751d9169deb348ac1e50e69d4555dcd?ref=suisver)


Haremos un análisis de esta gran hazaña el día de hoy

---

Nos enfrentamos cara a cara contra **SLBB_SIMPLEIVORY** en una batalla de **28 de Maná** donde ambos decidimos confiar en el poder oscuro del elemento Muerte, el Demonio **THALGRIMORE**

Ambos elegimos al mismísimo invocador de rareza Épica: **Thalgrimore**La gran diferencia es que mi invocador está en el nivel 2 y el de mi equipo contrario nivel 1.
Tengo todas la ventajas en este combate.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/23x14wKLgd37RNTgvy7DfxA1Fvuxzi6wkr7gaL99FZkHvT7YUEc1AUJBtPFUqVN5K9iVh.png)


El rival armó una estrategia de distracción masiva en su línea trasera, dejando un tanque más ligero adelante:

* **Tanque Principal:** **Nim Guard Captain**  (7 Maná, 1 de Ataque, 5 de Vida, 3 de Velocidad). Viene con una buena habilidad que reduce a la mitad el daño mágico. Una rata guerrera muy molesta.

* **Posición 2 (El Imán de Golpes):** **New Beluroc Aegis** 🦍 (8 Maná, 1 de Ataque, 5 de Vida, 2 de Velocidad). Obligando a mis unidades de ataque a distancia y mágicos a pegarle a él, protegiendo a su tanque.

* **Línea Trasera:**  **El Demonio de Cola Espinosa**  (6 Maná, 2 de Ataque, 4 de Vida, 3 de Velocidad). Una unidad rápida para rematar desde atrás.

---

### Mi Gran Equipo

Nosotros fuimos con un combo de aguante absoluto en la primera línea y cartas con efectos de estado negativos para desgastarlos lentamente. Una Gran Estrategia.

🕷️
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suisver/Eoc7RcTEkSu28NgoWiAw5fCqCz94tc6qXUc1u5bwc4VH6gLMThEEHQr2mYzfPuResyr.png)


**Súper Tanque:** **Great Bear Druid** (9 Maná, 1 de Ataque Mágico, 6 de Vida, 2 de Escudo, 2 de Velocidad). Un Gran Oso en mi equipo. No solo aguanta por sus estadísticas, sino que tiene la habilidad de **Curación**, lo que mantendrá viva nuestra primera posición ronda tras ronda.

**Posición 2:** **Savage Butcher** (5 Maná, 1 de Ataque Melee, 4 de Vida, 2 de Escudo, 2 de Velocidad). Un soporte robusto listo para entrar al relevo si las cosas se ponen feas.

**Línea Trasera:** **Black Widow** (8 Maná, 2 de Ataque a Distancia, 6 de Vida, 2 de Velocidad). Nuestra fuente principal de daño pesado a distancia, ideal para perforar esos escudos enemigos.



La batalla va a depender de qué tan rápido podamos derribar a su **New Beluroc Aegis**. Como nuestra **Black Widow** y el ataque mágico del **Great Bear Druid** van a verse obligados a dispararle al simio de la segunda posición, su tanque principal (*Nim Guard Captain*) se va a quedar solo recibiendo los golpes directos que logremos darle.

Por otro lado, la capacidad de curación de nuestro oso druida nos da una ventaja de resistencia genial a largo plazo. Mientras ellos intentan bajar nuestros escudos, nosotros nos curamos las heridas en cada turno. Es una buena estrategia.

---

Mi equipo logró la victoria, sin duda alguna fue una gran ventaja que el demonio **THALGRIMORE** estuviera en el Nivel 2.

body.title: De la Harina al Código: Cómo mi horno me enseñó a programar para salvar mi negocio
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEuuZV1UPY9PrnjjBhNRj4MZxPFwpPpKBJBB4LLmJhBV/1779322730795.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQhSShDcvmEyaBzzfijyMyPgxrK4uFQibprj82UskvF6g/1779322758792.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5dA7AcQeJR2PGSBrftrEymeTHwb5zHtukkMXZSUpWCH/1779322778104.jpg)

body.title: The universal income of Sam Altman and Elon Musk
body.body:
The universal income of Sam Altman and Elon Musk


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaJaJQFqAbdnhFkpFB4PFJgxSgamMvRUmbayoGw7qs7qa/image.png
AI

> There is a silent question growing behind the explosion of artificial intelligence and perhaps it goes much deeper than that machines are going to replace jobs, the real question is, what happens to a civilization when work is no longer necessary for survival? because during practically all of human history, employment and personal value walked together. Working was not just a way to make money, it was the way society distributed dignity, purpose, and access to one's life. But now that logic is slowly beginning to come into conflict with technology, as generative artificial intelligences, humanoid robots and autonomous systems advance, some of the biggest figures in Silicon Valley began to defend an idea that a few years ago seemed too radical, even for academic debates, universal basic income. And perhaps the most curious thing is to notice who is saying it, people like Sam Altman and Elon Musk talk about basic income as social charity, they talk about it almost as a mathematical necessity of capitalism itself in the face of automation, we are not talking about socialist utopias, but rather that there is a paradox that is beginning to appear. They know that if machines produce wealth more and more efficiently while eliminating so many jobs, capitalism will simply collapse if people have no money to consume. It was precisely trying to understand and prove this that Semotman financed one of the largest basic income experiments ever carried out through Open Research, for 3 years, thousands of people received close to $1,000 per month without any specific requirement, without obligation to work, without goals and without conditions. The results attracted attention for a simple reason. People did not stop living their normal lives, much of the money was allocated to health, education, emotional stability and even opening small businesses. Instead of abandoning any activity, many participants began to make less desperate decisions about their own lives and perhaps that reveals something important about human behavior, because much of modern work does not exist only to generate economic value, it often exists because people need to survive financially within a system based on artificial scarcity of income, only artificial intelligence is slowly beginning to break that logic. So the inevitable question arises, where will that money come from for billions of people? Some economists and businessmen defend completely new models of wealth distribution. Bill Gates, for example, has already suggested something similar to a tax on robots, where companies that use a robot to replace a human worker must pay the equivalent in taxes to finance basic income. Sam Altman follows another line, he proposes sovereign funds bequeathed to AI companies, allowing part of the valuation generated by automation to be distributed directly to the population, the idea is simple, revolutionary and in some cases controversial. If artificial intelligences were capable of generating practically unlimited wealth, perhaps human beings would stop depending exclusively on their own work to access basic resources and here the discussion stops being economic and begins to become existential. If machines do everything, what are we left with? The end of compulsory work opens space for what philosophers call the post-work era, without the pressure for survival, humanity will be able to focus on arts, sciences, space exploration and philanthropy. The economy will stop being based on physical production and will focus on creativity and well-being, universal basic income is not a way to sustain the unemployed, it is the key to freeing human potential from the slavery of repetitive work, that is what those who support this idea say. And if perhaps for the first time humanity enters an era where survival and employment cease to be synonymous for better or worse, I confess that this has been brewing for a long time, but one thing can be said and affirmed, that future also brings enormous risks, extreme inequality, absurd concentration of technological power and total economic dependence on large corporations. Those are real possibilities. Now tell me, in the best case scenario, what would you do with your life if money was no longer a concern? Would you continue in your current job as a hobby or would you look for a new passion?

links.title: Why do we let crazy politicians get us worked up?
links.body: I don't follow politics very closely anymore but I do subscribe a couple of telegram channels that I peruse every morning.  I rarely even read the articles that they are linking to.  Every now and then though I will see an article that I think is specifically designed to get people angry or as I call it \

This has a purpose in the political sphere I guess but to me I think that if someone were to look at situations like this one and then think it over about the plausibility of anything actually coming from it, then it isn't really worth getting angry about.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzebubba/242YCHJaM8s7GjnfCRMoqFg3CSW3tcjvadJaMa6Wp19rvJj6Mf3XXFRbASkUUnnYYuSta.png)
[src](https://thepostmillennial.com/sex-therapist-dem-texas-house-hopeful-vows-to-turn-ice-facility-into-prison-for-american-zionists)</center>

[Here is a link to the article if you want to read it,](https://thepostmillennial.com/sex-therapist-dem-texas-house-hopeful-vows-to-turn-ice-facility-into-prison-for-american-zionists) I didn't.  

So this person named Maureen is running for office in Texas and says that if she is elected she is going to covert the ICE facility into a detention center for Zionists.   I'll be honest with you and say that I don't really know what Zionists are and that this is a buzzword that a lot of people are saying these days and this is part of the reason why I don't bother to learn what it is or to use that word.  Something to do with Jews I believe, lol.  I honestly don't know.

But there are people that are getting angry about this politician's claims but lets take a second to think about it rationally.  What are her chances of actually getting elected... in Texas of all places?   If she magically did get elected what are the chances of this sort of legislation that she is talking about drafting getting passed.... in Texas of all places? 

Let's say that she hypnotized all the other representatives in Texas and this legislation passed, what are the chances that what will almost certainly be a Republican governor not vetoing it... in Texas of all places?  

Even if all of those things happen in Texas of all places ICE is a federal function of the government and state politicians aren't really allowed to just do whatever they feel like with their buildings nor can they put whoever they feel like in jail, right? 

These statements were attacked by everyone of course but honestly, I don't think it is even worth a person's attention.  Someone can claim anything they want when they are running for an office, it doesn't mean that they are actually going to be able to do anything with that.   You can claim that you are going to cure cancer on your first day in office and people might think that is great until everyone starts to realize that there is no magic politician wand and things like that take a bunch of time and there are many other factors at play.  

yet the comment section of this telegram post is filled with people losing their damn minds about this woman as if she was already in office and this kind of nonsense was moving forward.  

Sometimes I feel like people say outlandish things like this and they themselves know that this wouldn't actually work and they would never be able to get anything done with these notions but they say it anyway knowing that it will go viral because apparently people are idiots these days and this going viral is going to put her name out there in a way that advertisements probably couldn't buy.

There are probably a lot of people out there that had no idea who this woman was until today and we were probably better off that way.

\

is something I see written as a warning all over the internet, but yet, we still continue to do it.  I guess this gets people to look at the article and also look at Maureen, which was probably the objective to begin with. \n\nThere's probably some people out there that will \
their way into a rebuttal with me but I feel as though my life is actually improved by focusing on things that are likely to happen and also affect me.  This is neither one of those things IMO.

咱们老登啊，今个是真高兴，我这不是早早的就开了店面呢，一开门就进来一个小姐姐，买了个短袖，开心的走了，她买得开心，我卖的开心，大早上，这不是妥妥的开门红么，一扫前几天下雨的阴霾，生意变化变得越来越好，是我的幸福，我的努力的动力源泉。

赶紧的打开电脑，记录自己的心情，播放自己的偶像尚雯婕的新歌曲，听这也很舒服，今天都是正能量，就不吐槽她了哈哈做我的偶像，也怪不容易的，不停的挑毛病，鞭打自己的偶像去发布新的作品。

昨天晚上在负债群里，一条接一条的开嗓子，唱歌，唱自己喜欢的歌曲，一通的情感宣泄，后来，越来越开心，群里的一个山东的大佬要来找我，我的妈呀，我可是典型的嘴炮小王子，我实际上在生活里是社恐患者呢，赶紧拒绝了，可能人家也是故意那么一说，逗逗我，来个开心的娱乐。

我们约好一起把荆棘走遍
漂泊的云终聚成一片天
梦的地方
心在徜徉
我们约永不散场

今天心情是非常的哇塞，开门红来了，新的业绩新高，还会远，看上午场，中午场，下午场，夜场的亮眼表现吧

希望今天的业绩突破新高，对的起今天的开门红，对的起努力挣扎，拼命向上的自己。

links.title: WHAT FEAR CAN DO.
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>
It took me little time to grasp the concept of today's prompt, but now that I think I've gotten a hold of it, there's one main thing with which I want to CUT THE CORD.

![IMG_20240909_103232_440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyinye-chi/23wMggLjgk5Pto8DYf6SYaeKPKoutAdHRVKB8vZRNgGvnGsxto8xVXXQLJnLezXA2Lej3.jpg)

That one thing is fear. I know many people have said things about fear. Many books have been written, talks and sermons have been held on the topic, but it seems to persist. And I'm not talking about the fear that comes when one's life is threatened, no not that. I'm talking about fear of the unknown. At first, it starts as skepticism, and then gradually becomes chest-throbbing fear, and it has affected many areas of my life. 

One vivid memory I have is when I was younger. One of my cousins had a certain kind of influence on my siblings and me, not a very good influence if you ask me. One day she just woke up and decided to keep malice with her own siblings. It didn't mean anything to a lot of us because we knew that was how she behaved. All of a sudden, she called me aside and asked to keep the malice with my own sister otherwise she was going to report \

(in her words) to our mother. All of a sudden the fear of being ostracized by her and still being punished for things she influenced me to do overshadowed the love I have for my sister. It was her elder brother who put an end to the whole rubbish. Now I know it can be dismissed that the story in the previous paragraph only counts because I was a child, but growing up in such an environment and atmosphere did instill that fear up until adulthood. I was very afraid of being ostracized even if what would keep me included didn't sit well with me. Thank God I have understood and those fears are now behind me. In conclusion, fear, since it makes one feel alive and all, if left unchecked can and will lead to mental blockage. Yes, because when fear becomes too loud it becomes the voice one always listens to, and it becomes normal. Therefore, I am cutting the cord of fear of the unknown. Thanks for stopping by my blog. See you soon. 🤗 ### peace out ✌️ ##### ALL PICTURES ARE MINE

links.title: Not everything turns out the way we expect; the Mukumbari Cable Car seems out of reach | No todo resulta como esperamos, el Teleférico Mukumbari parece inalcanzable ⛰️
links.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Good evening, travelers from around the world. It was our third day of travel, and we were still in the city of Mérida. It was Holy Saturday, and our plan for the day was to visit the Mukumbari Cable Car, so we got up as early as we could. The main goal of the trip was to reach Pico Espejo and experience that breathtaking view. ![InShot_20260520_073448873.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedPCms3NizxPsEndU6ZYb8y7hGpuUELMRuMT25JLqKE1/InShot_20260520_073448873.jpg) We walked several blocks to get there, and it wasn’t a problem because the weather was cold. Beforehand, we stopped to buy breakfast at a stand selling empanadas and pastries that we found near the cable car. Being true Zulianos, we picked up some pastries so we could have breakfast at one of the stations—that’s what we’d been craving up until that point. ![20260404_074324.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX3ckUhGAtc3AjNaKXVigqMKKLZE7BptUF2S4WsD3fpAA/20260404_074324.jpg) ![20260404_074242.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeH39SM9mmAH78tqD5gc3rhw55ivPTt5i3uwKaTeVwA1M/20260404_074242.jpg) The excitement grew as we approached the cable car, since it was a dream for both of us. When we arrived at the nearby ticket booths to buy tickets, we found out that there were no tickets left for that day (it was 7:00 a.m.). It was a hard blow for us to learn that we couldn’t share the experience together. For me, it was my second time going, but for Ricardo, it was his first, and it was frustrating not to be able to accomplish one of the main goals of the trip basically, it was the most important thing he wanted to do in Mérida. ![20260404_082419.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNZocaqTSjTeAeU2bHbQv2GLedLw83ZXHPqcVCvKFhRS5/20260404_082419.jpg) We decided to put the disappointment aside, so while we were having breakfast at the Plaza de las Heroínas, we started thinking about the good things and how, even though we couldn’t go up, the rest of the trip had met our expectations; now all that was left was to keep enjoying other beautiful places in Mérida. ![20260404_074952.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc7LeewDaJR8p33WaNhzZuCj3LsYC1Yo3J2q41tZ2zuJF/20260404_074952.jpg) ![20260404_075046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQHcw4PdngiuiK88s3CZ4P8FsiWExek1S7MkUzpeTrRp/20260404_075046.jpg) ![20260404_075249.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKeS35Dk8TN3vnWkWXAERpjCqGJ5CCswFBqq6CSxVUkr/20260404_075249.jpg) ![20260404_082634.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZx2U6zt7z9JeSyF9wz9o7fL7yEXhxHds2mge7KxofJzK/20260404_082634.jpg) As we walked through this magical city, gazing at the imposing Andean mountains and sipping frothy coffee, we came upon a billboard listing various places we could visit. We decided our next destination would be the Enchanted Forest, but to get there, we had to return to the hotel to pick up the motorcycle and bid farewell to the city to set off on a new adventure that I’ll soon be sharing with you. ![20260404_082852.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewRd9x5X833QuwSW9ySPbtDXhzfdzEFwi5ju2UWH7gEj/20260404_082852.jpg) ![IMG-20260407-WA0057.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQpTkgD9aDtBVYWXbUtNLGM8RPYo9ACJDRjQe4FMYXkx/IMG-20260407-WA0057.jpg) ![20260404_083623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeueSvqGxtuDPYX5VcHv3Bfu5uSrVm5cHyMyVTWkuJyqL/20260404_083623.jpg) For now, I’ll sign off by saying that not all travel experiences are the same, but one thing I learned the hard way is: Don’t travel to Mérida during Holy Week, since tickets sell out early because they’re reserved by travel agencies and foreigners. We don’t know exactly how they operate since they don’t have a website, but the silver lining is that there’s a reason to return to Mérida at other times of the year.

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenas noches, viajeros de todo el mundo. 

Llegamos al tercer día de viaje y seguiamos en la ciudad de Mérida, lo que correspondería al Sábado Santo, nuestro plan para este día era ir al Teleférico Mukumbari, así que nos levantamos lo más temprano que pudimos, el objetivo principal del viaje era llegar al Pico Espejo y vivir esa experiencia que deja a más de uno sin aliento.

![InShot_20260520_073448873.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedPCms3NizxPsEndU6ZYb8y7hGpuUELMRuMT25JLqKE1/InShot_20260520_073448873.jpg)

Caminamos varias cuadras para llegar y no había ningún problema porque el clima era frío, antes pasamos a comprar el desayuno en un puesto de empanadas y pasteles que nos encontramos cerca del teleférico, cómo bueno Zulianos nos llevamos algunos pasteles para poder desayunar en una de las estaciones porque eso queríamos hasta ese momento.

![20260404_074324.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX3ckUhGAtc3AjNaKXVigqMKKLZE7BptUF2S4WsD3fpAA/20260404_074324.jpg)

![20260404_074242.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeH39SM9mmAH78tqD5gc3rhw55ivPTt5i3uwKaTeVwA1M/20260404_074242.jpg)

La emoción aumentaba cuando nos acercabamos al teleférico ya que era un sueño para ambos, cuando llegamos a las taquillas cercanas para adquirir la entrada, nos encontramos con que ya no habían entradas para ese día (eran las 7:00am) fue un duro golpe para nosotros saber que no podíamos vivir la experiencia juntos, en mi caso era la segunda vez que iba pero en el caso de Ricardo era su primera vez y eso se sintió frustrante no poder completar uno de los objetivos principales del viaje, básicamente ero lo más importante que él quería hacer en Mérida.

![20260404_082419.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNZocaqTSjTeAeU2bHbQv2GLedLw83ZXHPqcVCvKFhRS5/20260404_082419.jpg)

Decidimos dejar la molestia a un lado, así que mientras desayunabamos en la Plaza de las Heroínas, nos pusimos a pensar en lo bueno y en que, aunque no se pudo subir, el resto del viaje sí había cumplido con las expectativas, ahora solo nos quedaba seguir disfrutando de otros bonitos lugares en Mérida. 

![20260404_074952.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc7LeewDaJR8p33WaNhzZuCj3LsYC1Yo3J2q41tZ2zuJF/20260404_074952.jpg)

![20260404_075046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQHcw4PdngiuiK88s3CZ4P8FsiWExek1S7MkUzpeTrRp/20260404_075046.jpg)

![20260404_075249.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPKeS35Dk8TN3vnWkWXAERpjCqGJ5CCswFBqq6CSxVUkr/20260404_075249.jpg)

![20260404_082634.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZx2U6zt7z9JeSyF9wz9o7fL7yEXhxHds2mge7KxofJzK/20260404_082634.jpg)

Mientras caminábamos por esta mágica ciudad, observando las imponentes montañas andinas y tomando un espumoso café, llegamos hasta una valla publicitaria donde habían distintos sitios que podíamos visitar y decidimos que nuestro próximo destino sería el Bosque Encantado, pero para eso debíamos volver al hotel a buscar la moto y despedirnos de la ciudad para ir por una nueva aventura que pronto les estaré compartiendo. 

![20260404_082852.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewRd9x5X833QuwSW9ySPbtDXhzfdzEFwi5ju2UWH7gEj/20260404_082852.jpg)

![IMG-20260407-WA0057.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQQpTkgD9aDtBVYWXbUtNLGM8RPYo9ACJDRjQe4FMYXkx/IMG-20260407-WA0057.jpg)

![20260404_083623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeueSvqGxtuDPYX5VcHv3Bfu5uSrVm5cHyMyVTWkuJyqL/20260404_083623.jpg)

Por lo pronto me despido diciendo que no todas las experiencias de viaje resultan iguales pero algo que aprendí a la mala fue: No viajar a Mérida en Semana Santa, ya que los boletos se terminan antes porque son reservados por agencias de turismo y extranjeros, no sabemos con exactitud cómo funcionan ya que no cuentan con página web, pero lo bueno que me dejó es que hay una razón para volver a Mérida en otros momentos del año.

links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLMKKdQC7cyHBYAbVBhGGbw7Sgkjs9UjBfX4tKwMHYU9/_20260520200830_13_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZi2SGhVVszUJTYJS8NMPNJLuFuy1YcURbity9PP8AKGh/_20260520200841_25_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPuSgvEFUK9BaEdNHufRiYHD5JsmtUikTu3qnitRzz11d/_20260520200841_26_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNyNwentk1kyB4FwTusX78Bo1diUrgE4U8HLuVQrGGRet/_20260520200842_27_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMsr1tvmmavGRWeRTeBvAfEpVi7rdfMTNTwWyG2BwSA2/_20260520200843_28_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHkhKn7gJ4dVkLcpUwYsoVGrxczGuRjeKb4mVCoESD7f/_20260520200844_29_9.jpg)

好不容易, 終於爬了二十多層樓的高度爬到去塔那裡. 都怪我, 沒看清楚原來有電梯可以直接上去的, 搞到我們兩個爬完之後沒了半條人命. 不過, 也當是做運動好了. 反正現在的湘不怕走路, 爬樓梯的話, 多練幾下應該也不怕了.

上到去, 基本上都沒甚麼風景, 我們都是沿路走下山, 上去好難, 下來好快容易, 永遠都是這個定律. 我們由山頂慢慢走下坡回去山腳, 其實另外一邊也有樓梯走的, 但我自己知自己事, 腳不好嘛. 別搞這些了, 等會走下去又腳痛, 車都開不了就麻煩. 

慢慢回到山腳, 有個涼亭, 我就跟湘坐下來吃個面包, 本來我說多拿幾個面包, 帶張墊當是露營好了, 但湘聽完都不想理我了, 加上只有兩個人, 她無聊喔. 也是, 現在的我不是太愛說話了. 當時覺得在老頭那裡上班的日子, 身心疲累,  主要不是工作量太大, 是他的情緒問題影響到我. 所以...這也是當初要離開的主因啦.現在? 沒人唸我, 也沒人罵我了, 反而不是很慣. 算了, 過去的由他去了.

吃完面包, 打算去小紅書見到的打卡點看看, 現在我都知那些圖是照騙中的照騙, 就是想對比一下到底現實情況跟網上看到的可以差多遠. 不過時間尚早, 不想直接走過去, 我們故意在山腳另一邊拐一圈走回去. 你別說, 一走就40多分鐘, 運動量可以十足了. 

回到草地的露營點, 看了一下, 我笑了, 看來會拍照真的很能騙人. 一片爛草地加幾根破柱子, 配個塔的遠景人家可以拍出大片來. 而我? 自己看吧, 不堪入目. 用了兩個小時差不多把公園80%的地方逛了, 差不多可以回去.

回去之前, 見到油價由之前高位由落了一些, 去加一下吧, 加滿了也就用了二百多. 因為我只在週末用車, 加油是在4月25日加的, 到現在還有大半箱油. 不過要再熬到下一輪油價回落, 估計可能性不大了. 由他吧, 加油他也就差個30元左右. 大錢沒有, 小錢不缺. 愛著就漲吧. 又不是天天開車上下班. 管他死呢. 

突然好慶幸, 這6年都幾乎無間斷記錄生活, 就算最近不是日更, 但一有機會出去就會逛拍照, 這個習慣是不會變的了. 因為這是一個給我記錄每天的舉動, 等我以後翻看照片時, 又可以回味一下過去. 

嗯, 我才離開老頭那邊一週不到, 已經翻了最後幾天拍的所有照片看了N次了. 沒走的時候, 天天罵罵咧咧, 走了之後, 又覺得意難平, 覺得帶著遺憾離開 !! 人啊, 好矛盾. 也很犯賤呢!!

2026.5.20

links.title: Mi Experiencia en la Reapertura de La Institución Educativa
links.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @education, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes mi experiencia en la reapertura de la institución educativa donde laboro, en el municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to everyone at Hive and @education. Today I’m going to share with you my experience of the reopening of the school where I work, in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260520_200547041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zbYRKNNnk7QD1dfKVGpeAPNfse5x1DCQQyyQWiKdLaWQhi67Ue5V4sU7S7gkQ2oVpfA.jpg) Cabe destacar que esta reapertura fue como una inauguración , esto se inició hace uno meses con la propuesta del proyecto el cual se incluyó en la opciones para las elecciones, cuyo proyecto de la escuela fue el ganador, gracias al apoyo de todos el personal docente y representante, que votaron a favor del proyecto, para solventar la situación de la institución educativa. Una vez aprobados, el gobierno le bajó los recursos para comprar los materiales necesarios para la recuperación de la infraestructura. >It is worth noting that this reopening was effectively an inauguration; the process began several months ago with the proposal for the project, which was included among the options for the elections. The school’s project was the winning entry, thanks to the support of all the teaching staff and representatives who voted in favour of the project to resolve the educational institution’s situation. Once approved, the government allocated the funds to purchase the materials needed to restore the infrastructure. ![IMG_20260520_100127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23yThZmjCz4GGXckgQcC6YADoU9kwMu3Ny5N6gQKxfbDNU5qx8ajPNpGHJw77dt5C1cVn.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_100330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wzzvraYtLYK7WQKdaAnveLc6BjAv8bKPestXoxkM4FNga4PocGvtZYFtvJtBWKTFT1y.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_100424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23tvYJstRgVL1ieijrcmUp7WmF4xZFnBbUy3LKjY1KxVqkUBFRb23CUJyAHahUFfoa2nK.jpg) Asimismo, todo nosotros el personal docente, nos unimos para apoyar en la rehabilitación de los espacios, como pintura en las diferentes salones de la escuela. Por otro lado unas personas de la comunidad y docentes, apoyaron en la instalación de la parte eléctrica, tuberías de aguas. Se compraron Tanques, cocina industrial, refrigerador para la cocina y fue acondicionado el área de la cocina y todos los salones. >Furthermore, all of us teaching staff joined forces to help refurbish the premises, including painting the various classrooms. Meanwhile, members of the local community and teachers helped with the installation of the electrical and plumbing systems. Water tanks, an industrial stove and a fridge for the kitchen were purchased, and the kitchen area and all the classrooms were refurbished. ![IMG_20260520_100701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244UqeMorUjinKKzPuwkfeztT2C66Z6k2qjYzWKShTiL7xtp9xKB3wNWLEpmp8Rr4qBE7.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_102142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245wPeEggZsTp8njsGbY1Q8WGQME8you3wgUpF46Mqmb3BXw5gpYuajZtM1etSQ2uAzDb.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_100227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xyZ12wDJVEQdoqRxb1DWYBnxpabqD5AngT2guPMxLWKiWhbxz5JWAskubCs255Em1Vk.jpg) Es importante mencionar que todo esto se dió con el apoyo de la triada escuela - familia y comunidad, donde todos pusieron un granito de arena para que se hiciera realidad. Este acto fue significativo, ya que se aperturan nuevamente la escuela como un mejor ambiente para el beneficio de los estudiantes que hace vida en esta comunidad. >It is worth noting that all of this was made possible thanks to the support of the school, families and the local community, with everyone playing their part to make it a reality. This was a significant event, as it marks the reopening of the school as a better environment for the benefit of the students who live in this community. ![IMG_20260520_103937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zRzmUggrXCy8Kmkp1hqBKHYBb4PwXtLhPXXrFgRtV81Y31N7JYicjV5mv5zkoXCqynw.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_100322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ywipezoZoAxsxmgyYDUt7xtXA7qpCXC29D7sjBDP9Cp7FSSmWen1zw7P7ZLGXY7ZgrC.jpg) ![IMG_20260520_100345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23uFPm8mu3u8hv6UrRyqMd2sMVzEPrxuP31v4sumECDgzmQjHNHDcBSdTs5drvpjkaQu9.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post.  My thoughts on farmers 

Today I am back with a new video. Today's video talks about a very good topic. In fact, the contribution of our farmers is very high in our lives. If farmers did not do agricultural work, today we would not be able to survive by eating rice or other vegetables. Its price is very high. But even after this, farmers are still neglected. If there is any kind of budget for them, they do not get it properly from the government. And if they got their agricultural materials properly, their income would have increased many times. That is why it is very necessary to stand by our farmers. If they stand by us, then of course an agricultural revolution is possible. Currently, many educated people are also devoting their time to agriculture. Even then, it is very necessary for the government to come forward to stand by the farmers. I hope you all will like today's video.

links.title: La momia de Lee Cronin | Movie Review [ENG-ESP]
links.body:
![moimss.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2wPaBhxCij63GBW9U1JLEwezhFEK79YpKriAm7aTRVW/moimss.jpg) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=126148) Every year, a wide variety of movies are released, and the great thing about today’s technology is that we can use various tools to create better versions of old movies and turn them into hits. That’s why a new adaptation of *The Mummy* series was recently released—it’s very exciting to see how this new director is embracing modern elements to create a quality horror film. I was a kid when I saw some of the first Mummy movies, and they were really entertaining just because they included things you only see in those kinds of movies. This new film aims for something different—it’s not the same dark humor or tomb-raiding. Instead, it transforms a horror story into one of grief, family, guilt, and revenge, creating the perfect combination to give you some good scares. >Cada año salen una gran variedad de películas y lo bueno de hoy en día con las distintas herramientas se pueden crear versiones mejores de películas viejas y llevarlas a que se conviertan en un éxito. Por eso hace poco se estrenó una nueva adaptación de la saga de la momia, la cual es algo muy emocionante y ver cómo este nuevo director apuesta por lo moderno y así crear una de algo de terror que sea bueno. # >Estaba pequeño cuando vi algunas de las primeras películas de la momia y eran muy entretenidas por el mismo hecho de colocar cosas que solo salen allí. En esta nueva película busca algo diferente y que no sea el mismo humor negro, ni tumba. Si no más bien transforma una historia de terror en dolor, familia, culpa y venganza creando la combinación perfecta para llevarse rubia buenos sustos. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUsNKwYFRp89Diujxa3pxfXEDpjoERN6rNKLfpCNQjsUe/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=126148) Here, the plot introduces us to a family that lost their daughter during an expedition—a devastating loss for anyone—and from there, the suspense and adventure unfold, driven by the fact that she reappears years later, making the film compelling and drawing you in to find out: What happened? Where was she? Is it really her? It’s also a film for audiences who enjoy horror and for those who want to see another installment of The Mummy. Each of the special effects and props used adds a great touch, which is impressive because it feels very real—and surely no one would want to experience something like that. Plus, there’s that shift from a moment of calm to a moment of sheer terror. Another thing that adds value is each of the characters; in my case, I don’t know any of them, but the way they convey those emotions and decisions is well done. Despite having a lot of filler to cover the entire story, it doesn’t turn into a bad adaptation. >Aquí la trama nos presenta a una familia que perdió a su hija en una exploración, la cual es un gran dolor para quien sea y a partir de allí se crea ese suspenso y aventura, por el mismo hecho de que años después aparece haciendo que la película funcione y te enganche a descubrir ¿Qué paso? ¿Dónde estaba? ¿Será la misma?, además es una película para un público que le gusta el horror y para quienes quieren ver una secuencia más de la momia. # >Cada uno de los efectos y equipos que usan le da un gran toque, la cual es de admirar porque se siente muy real y seguro que a nadie le gustaría pasar algo como eso. Además, esa combinación de estar un momento de tranquilidad a pasar a un momento de mucho susto. Otras de las cosas que le da valor es cada uno de los personajes, donde en mi caso no conozco a ninguno, sin embargo, como transmiten esas emociones y las decisiones, son buenas. A pesar de contar con bastante relleno para así poder abarcar toda la historia y se convierte en esa adaptación mala. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRTB5oN5HLgBKx2AHza73ZsMyz87MKTn6iG3PJVhstChD/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=126148) This was a pretty interesting result, and what really stands out about this installment isn’t the monsters, the gods, or the tombs, but the fear of not being able to let go of the past—something every human struggles with. However, this new Mummy movie is for those who want a more modern take, but personally, I prefer the earlier ones. >Este fue un resultado bastante interesante y lo que realmente vale de esta entrega no son los monstruos, ni los dioses o tumbas, sino del miedo a no poder dejar ir el pasado, algo que todo ser humano le cuesta. Sin embargo, esta nueva entrega de la momia es para quienes quieran una versión más moderna, pero en mi caso me quedo con las primeras.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1YQAsu4GB81sVj4eS7YynfmSoXYhjpF5CvEkReLPj1r/image.png)

links.title: Tribute to the artist Armando Reverón || CCC´s Art Contest # 301 || en-es
links.body:
>My friends, today I’d like to share with you a mural honoring an exceptional artist born in our country: Armando Reverón.
\n\n

>An artist ahead of his time, his body of work includes paintings, drawings, and objects that brought him national and international renown; moreover, his works and “eccentric” style continue to serve as a reference point in leading art schools, thanks to his legacy.
\n\n

>I was unaware of his existence or life; beyond his name or reputation as a painter, I knew nothing else about him. This led me to deep reflection because we have wonderful, influential artists who made a great contribution to the world of art, yet schools simply do not teach us about their lives or legacies. On the other hand, I’ve heard of art schools named after him, but I believe we should all know his story.
\n\n

>For me, because I like to understand the context of people, beyond their works; it’s about knowing their life, their beliefs, their history, and then seeing how that impacted their work.
\n\n

>Reverón, despite being born in Caracas, spent his final years precisely in the community where this site is located, in Macuto, La Guaira, Venezuela.
\n\n

>Thanks to a renovation of the tourist attraction, several walls were set aside for murals, and this one is located across from a park; I’ll describe my experience in that community.
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>Mis amigos, hoy les traigo un mural en honor a un artista excepcional que ha nacido en nuestro país: Armando Reverón.\nUn artista adelantado a su tiempo, y entre sus obras se nombran pinturas, dibujos y objetos que hicieron su nombre renombrar a nivel nacional e internacional; además, sus obras y estilo \

siguen siendo referente en las principales escuelas de arte, por su legado. Yo desconocía su existencia o vida; más allá de su nombre o referente de pintor, no tenía más detalle sobre él. Esto me causó una profunda reflexión porque tenemos artistas maravillosos y vigentes, que hicieron un gran aporte al arte mundial y simplemente en las escuelas no nos enseñan sobre su vida ni su legado. Por otro lado, he escuchado de escuelas de arte que tienen su nombre, pero pienso que todos deberíamos saber de su historia. A mí porque me gusta conocer el contexto de las personas, más allá de sus obras; es conocer su vida, sus creencias, su historia, para luego ver cómo eso impactó en su obra. Reverón, a pesar de nacer en Caracas, sus últimos años de vida los pasó precisamente en la comunidad donde se encuentra esta comunidad, en Macuto, La Guaira, Venezuela. Gracias a una rehabilitación del atractivo turístico, tomaron en cuenta varias paredes para realizar murales y este queda frente a un parque, que describiré mi experiencia en la comunidad respectiva.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.32.01 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wqiSewG333qZXkNRRbJzhWizkoN2hYyxMPW33Ro9jnH9Nt7iuucCGQwaZx7vwZJ4Mg4.jpeg)

>Why does this man, who was born in Caracas, have a mural in La Guaira? And, specifically, in that community? Well, it’s a long story, but he ended up there because he suffered from paranoia as a result of a fever he had as a child, and he decided to build “his little castle” there to let his imagination run wild. Over the years, he developed schizophrenia, which ultimately led to his death.
\n\n

>The work we see—though I’m unfamiliar with many of them—prompted me to do some research to understand the mural. So I’ll describe it this way:
\n\n

>I’ll start with his palette of colors, which I assume is his tool for creating his work.
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>¿Por qué este señor nacido en Caracas tiene el mural en La Guaira? ¿Y, específicamente, en esa comunidad? Bueno, la historia es larga, pero él llega allí porque sufría de paranoia producto de una fiebre que le dio en su niñez y decide construir \

allí para dejar volar su imaginación. Con los años, se le desarrolló una esquizofrenia, que lo llevó a la muerte. La obra que vemos, aunque desconozco muchas de ellas, incluso me documenté para comprender el mural. Por lo que describo de esta manera: Inicio con su plato de colores, que asumo es su herramienta para plasmar su obra.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.32.03 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23zS3FXoG7pE2HyfWNnQGz7uNGZnY5P92VBqMm5BLbuMdgQrccUfZ1WbGRXCzyhHCAgjT.jpeg)

>I read that his work was carried out in several stages, one of which involved creating objects. I think this part of the painting goes in that order:
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>Leí que su obra se llevó a cabo en varias partes y una de ellas fue la creación de objetos. Creo que va en ese orden esta parte de la pintura:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.32.00 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xp8mUCBFRyRU2pY72MGKat2FKPjc68A69hReT6rJxPM9fRJSPXYs7Z9xRzomFCi5H2h.jpeg)

>The one I did recognize, because it’s characteristic of his work, is his rag dolls. Reading his story, I think he associated them with his childhood or with the absence of a mother he experienced in his early years.
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>La que sí conocía porque es característico de su obra y son _sus muñecas de trapo_. Leyendo su historia, creo que lo conectaba con su infancia o con esa falta materna que tuvo en sus primeros años de vida.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.32.00 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wWn9rjDHHUcfPmZN3L1Aw5PzoQv4xxsN9MJCrb9rYF6ydMBbb5p2Yh5r3fBWutjvCZb.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.31.59 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23ycw8DqvPrBZ8MyCy1udy55ziZdFFHwWYLiL4iy3chAgULGxHgavuu5gWBgBioUD8ZKP.jpeg)

>I read that this part of the mural went through a phase where it was painted blue, and I even saw that it was one of his painting techniques, but I can't remember what it's called. This is also one of his famous paintings after studying in Europe and returning to Venezuela.:
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>Esta parte del mural, leí que tuvo un periodo de pintura azul e incluso vi que era una de sus técnicas de pintar, pero no recuerdo cómo se llama. Esta también es una de sus famosas pinturas después de estudiar por Europa y devolverse a Venezuela.:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.31.57 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xV8LbSuUVoXcELAGs6Hrj37Wkz9BcYjVrFf2xvHZfxBQGNatChY7VefCu3AriZBndMy.jpeg)

>Finally, the color blue dominates because his art includes a period known as the “blue period” and another known as the “white period.” That is why I think this part of the mural blends the two periods. I also imagine that this is Juana, his lifelong companion:
\n\n>![Spanish version]
>Por último, el color azul predomina porque en su arte existe un período llamado \

. Por eso pienso que esta parte del mural fusiona las dos partes. Además, imagino que esta es Juana, su eterna compañera, quien fue una persona importante en sus creaciones:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.31.57 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23zkdXgq3s7QT9XDaKmrqBS8YWTFJ4qwxAkzhjhyVtAEcpuMnqwgRBv7we8oaewB1StXM.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.31.57 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wC5aS9oxJ3qJmVxMs6TnRo8R8f6dKLhS3L5bDj4TjbD3Wfxvqkp5EXPBKfwfdL56sZ6.jpeg)

>Everything I described are assumptions, so I set out to look for information about the house or the museum and it turns out that IN 1999 WHEN THERE WAS A TRAGEDY IN THE STATE OF LA GUAIRA, THE RIVER TOOK ALL HIS LEGACY TO BURY IT IN THE SEA 😭. For now, it will only live on in memory and in the works that are preserved worldwide.
\n\n

>The work is by DE LA ROCA; it was created in 2024, and for a piece that’s only two years old, I think it’s very beautiful, imposing, and hard to miss when visiting this neighborhood in the city:
\n\n>![Spanish version]

>Todo lo que describí son suposiciones, por lo que me propuse a buscar información sobre la casa o el museo y resulta que EN 1999 CUANDO HUBO UNA TRAGEDIA EN EL ESTADO LA GUAIRA, EL RÍO SE LLEVÓ TODO SU LEGADO PARA SEPULTARLO EN EL MAR 😭. Por ahora, solo vivirá en el recuerdo y en las obras que se conservan a nivel mundial. La obra es de DE LA ROCA, fue realizada en el 2024 y, para tener dos años de creación, me parece muy linda, imponente y difícil de ignorar cuando se visita esta comunidad en la ciudad:
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-15 at 3.32.02 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23ywwQSXUVz1TWVLaX7YmEW3mMJrBXRecxCtgsQSJqnc9mRQ7CRCtfq3SabFwpJ8p2w2i.jpeg)
_The photos are my own. I created the cover and banner in Canva. I used DeepL for the translation._
# See you next time 🐟 >![Spanish version]

>Las fotografías son de mi propiedad. La portada y el banner los hice en Canva. El traductor usado fue DeepL. Hasta la próxima 🐟.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wrE6CM8aYD9sK9BCSAzpm9fZJh9oWMaq4qjXBCo9KasNqQn3DTG9FaAH7ywupqrx3Vn.png

**“Nieve”** está perfecto. Es una palabra básica, visual y muy útil para estudiantes, y la frase **“Quiero tocar la nieve”** suena natural en español.

Lo más fuerte del post es la combinación de **inglés + chino + español + imagen**. Eso no solo enseña vocabulario; también le da al lector un ancla visual clara. Y el ejemplo de **“Nevado Verónica, en Cusco (Perú)”** añade contexto real, que siempre mejora este tipo de serie.

Pequeño ajuste de estilo: en vez de **“Now we have snow”**, suena más natural decir **“Today’s word is snow”** o **“Now let’s learn the word ‘snow’.”** El resto mantiene bien la intención didáctica.

También encaja muy bien con tu serie reciente, como [A Daily Word in Spanish (408) – Humo](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-span...). La estructura ya se siente reconocible, y eso es una ventaja: cuando una serie funciona, no hay que reinventar la rueda cada día.

links.title: Some of the best moments are hidden in the forest.
links.body:
![IMG_20190820_140642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/EpT2gZQ4fiiG9Fq9Xjd2wR9qTqTiiCedAyvKcU7WWfUqnr1kTavFxxcNb5Sy9dRq1SF.jpg)


There is something magical about walking through the forests of Ghana. There is something very appealing about being able to walk into a space where you feel nature is still pure and alive. Once you step inside, you will be greeted with fresh air, towering trees and a sense of peace that quickly becomes a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of the outside world.

I love the greenness of Ghana's forests. The lush vegetation at times appears endless. As you venture further into the forest, you start to realise just how rich and deep your connection to nature is. In fact, it may seem as if you're stepping into a completely different world altogether.

I've been lucky enough to spend many days exploring and enjoying various forests throughout Ghana. Each location has brought its own experiences and beauty. While some of the areas I visited provided the perfect opportunity for listening to the songs of birds and insects, other locations offered me a time for reflection on the simple beauty of nature.


![IMG_20190821_112443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/EprTaHxyWPi3R4UASD2u2xem9NsigJ4iYXZowahn254r3QXGqWH2AvtBEjcpp2YNU6k.jpg)


In addition to their sheer beauty, Ghana's forests are home to numerous types of natural resources including valuable tree species, medicinal plant species and animals which provide sustenance for people's livelihoods. Therefore, forests continue to be significant in many individuals' and communities' lives. They represent more than visually pleasing landscapes; they are sources of life and value.

These kinds of experiences help illustrate why we need to both appreciate and preserve our natural environment. The forests of Ghana are treasures which should receive appropriate attention so that future generations can also experience the same level of beauty and awe inspired by them today.


![IMG_20190821_114118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/EpA1WsDQEMuV6HnSdFkbQ6pVPG79E6A6P61C2D4WHwQAQsHTDTATBJ3NuV5zCzuBghh.jpg)

links.title: ChainersGame Launches First Season Pass: “Peacock Domination”
links.body:
On **May 19, 2026**, ChainersGame introduced its inaugural **Season Pass S1: Peacock Domination**, marking a major milestone for the free, browser-based Web3 farming MMO. Running until **June 29, 2026**, the event delivers exclusive rewards, a new flagship animal, and enhanced earning opportunities for players.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2QhDzKRo2UxkWoVghFRFpn7Nh4TE2yLSQHtGmw5R5YD/chain.png)




## **Season Highlights**
- **Duration:** May 19 – June 29, 2026  
- **Progression:** 25 levels of rewards through daily play, missions, and quests  
- **Tracks:**  
  - **Free Pass** – accessible rewards for all players  
  - **Golden Pass** – premium rewards plus Infinity Levels with Epic & Legendary drops  

### **Key Rewards**
- $CFB (in-game currency)  
- Limited seeds and fertilizers  
- Decorative farm items  
- New animals, including the **Peacock** in multiple rarities  

The centerpiece is **Max Peace the Peacock**, boasting a **65% critical hit chance** that significantly boosts production efficiency.

---

## **Community Momentum**
- Active **Max Peace event** alongside the Season Pass  
- **Zealy quests** with early rewards for top participants  
- Upcoming **Grand Anniversary Celebration** with additional surprises  
- Roadmap includes minigames, farm upgrades, tier systems, and arena battles  

ChainersGame already engages **over 1 million players**, with **1.8 million daily transactions** and a thriving community of **250,000+ members**, supported by Immutable for seamless asset ownership.



## **Why It Matters**
Chainers continues to differentiate itself in Web3 gaming by prioritizing **fun-first gameplay** with accessible earning mechanics. The Season Pass reinforces long-term engagement, offering both casual and dedicated players meaningful progression and rewards.

---

## **Getting Started**
1. Visit [chainers.io/game](https://chainers.io/?r=mobs3dqz)  
2. Create a free character  
3. Plant seeds, raise animals, and complete missions  
4. Choose between Free or Golden Pass tracks  
5. Join the community on X (@ChainersGame), Discord, and Telegram  

---

### **Conclusion**
The launch of **Peacock Domination** signals ChainersGame’s commitment to sustained growth and rewarding gameplay. With new content, powerful rewards, and anniversary events on the horizon, this season is an ideal entry point for both newcomers and veterans.

물빛 속의 기억

잔잔한 물결 위에  
흩날리는 햇살,  
추억의 조각들  
반짝이며 춤춘다.

그리움의 속삭임,  
물속 깊이 잠든  
사랑의 그림자.

물빛 속에 남아  
영원히 빛난다.

Hola, Leidy.

Viendo tus publicaciones anteriores, estoy seguro de que tienes mucho que aportar a Hive.

Acá no está bien vista la creación de contenido con IA, a menos que se trate de imágenes como la que usas acá, cuya función sea apoyar el texto. En ese caso siempre se recomienda indicarlo claramente.

Pero los textos deben ser creados completamente por ti. Los contenidos creados con IA no suelen ser recompensados en Hive. 

Quizá solo le das tus textos a la IA para que los ajuste o algo así, pero la mayoría de detectores marcan este texto creado por IA en más de 70%.

Hive es una plataforma maravillosa que nos ofrece muchas oportunidades, si sabemos aprovecharlas.

5月20日，近年來逐漸被許多人視為特別的日子，因為「520」的諧音聽起來像「我愛你」，因此，不少情侶會選擇在這一天約會、送禮、告白，甚至登記結婚，當然，商人們也嗅到了商機，或者說，創造了商機，紛紛推出各式各樣的520促銷活動，希望吸引消費者上門消費。 就連我常買的必勝客也有促銷活動，只要花一百八十九元，就可以折抵五十元，不薅白不薅，於是，我抽空去拿了一個披薩，等我到了我常外帶的店家後，發現店內累績了不少訂單，有不少做好的披薩，正等著外送員來處理，此外，店員也忙進忙出的處理外帶客人們的需求，看來，除了我之外，也有不少人來薅這羊毛， 我訂的是必勝客推出的新口味，熱帶鳳梨海鮮總匯口味，明明母親節是上週的事情，不過，披薩用的是母親節字樣的外帶盒，有點跳躍感，哈，店家是打算物盡其用吧，打開一看，披薩上鋪滿鮮蝦、魷魚及甜中帶酸的鳳梨，配上番茄紅醬與沙拉醬，賣相不錯，一口咬下剛烤好的酥脆餅皮，喀滋喀滋作響，味道還不錯。 總之，520是一個很有趣的日子，它不是傳統節日，如七夕等，它是網路時代與商業文化結合後誕生的新型態節日，某種程度上，也反映出現代人對情感交流與儀式感的重視，不過，這類的節日有些太商業化了，各位，今年的5月20日這天，你們過得如何啊？
---
May 20th has gradually become a special day for many people in recent years because “520” sounds like “I love you” in Chinese. Because of that, lots of couples choose this day to go on dates, give gifts, confess their feelings, or even register their marriages. Of course, businesses have also noticed the opportunity — or rather, created one — by launching all kinds of 520 promotional campaigns to attract customers. Even Pizza Hut, which I often buy from, had a promotion. If you spent NT$189, you could get NT$50 off. A deal like that is too good to pass up, so I made some time to pick up a pizza. When I arrived at the branch where I usually get takeout, I noticed the store had already piled up a lot of orders. Many finished pizzas were waiting for delivery drivers to pick them up, and the staff were constantly rushing around handling takeout customers. It seemed that plenty of people besides me were also taking advantage of the deal. I ordered Pizza Hut’s new flavor, the Tropical Pineapple Seafood Supreme. Even though Mother’s Day was already last week, the pizza still came in a Mother’s Day themed box, which felt kind of random, haha. I guess the store wanted to make full use of the leftover boxes. When I opened it, the pizza was covered with shrimp, squid, and sweet-and-sour pineapple, topped with tomato sauce and salad dressing. It looked pretty appetizing. The freshly baked crust was crispy with a satisfying crunch, and overall, it tasted pretty good. Overall, I think 520 is a pretty interesting day. It’s not a traditional holiday like the Qixi Festival. Instead, it’s a modern type of celebration born from the combination of internet culture and commercial marketing. In a way, it also reflects how much modern people value emotional expression and a sense of occasion. Still, holidays like this can feel a bit too commercialized sometimes. So, how did you spend your May 20th this year? --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/i-love-pizza)

links.title: The perspective of those of us witnessing the collapse.
links.body: >\n\nToday I woke up and realised that the world is already racing ahead without me. It’s not that it’s set off without my permission; it’s that it never stopped. And as I try to catch up, a phrase keeps echoing in my head, borrowed from someone who writes from the trenches of everyday observation: [*“Attention is our most valuable possession. Without it, we are practically useless as humans\

links:
*. A comment under that reflection read: *‘How many “geniuses” have we seen make destructive decisions because they never stopped to ask themselves if they were in the right?’*.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZyWMSwyBGh6pxVLemMtd6588QM6EMwvE32ERDRStPXWH/llegando_el_verano.png)
I’d like to believe that the future will find us more united, more aware, more compassionate. But I also know that won’t happen by magic. It will take work. It will require us to stop waiting for ‘someone’ to sort out what is everyone’s responsibility. It will require us to speak, yes, but also to listen. To question, but also to build. To doubt, but to act. As one voice in a recent conversation shared by TarazKP pointed out: [*“It’s not about being right, but about seeking the truth together”*](https://peakd.com/hive-126152/@tarazkp/behind-the-curtain-tepsyw), that search, I believe, is what defines us as a species. Not perfection, but the attempt. Not certainty, but the question. Today, as I write these lines, I look out of the window. The sky is grey, but there is no sign of rain. A bird is perched on a tree branch, motionless, watching. And I think that perhaps that is the lesson: *knowing how to be. Knowing how to wait. Knowing that, sometimes, the most revolutionary thing we can do is simply to remain, with our eyes open and our hearts ready*. Tomorrow will come, with its lights and shadows. And we, with our wounds and our dreams, will be there to welcome it. Not as spectators, but as protagonists. Not as victims, but as creators. Someone commented recently, and I quote them because it sums up how I feel: *“The future is not predicted, it is built”*. I don’t know who said it first, but today I’m making those words my own. Because in the end, it doesn’t matter so much where we’re going, but how we walk. With what gaze. With what intention. With what love. And if you, reading this, have also asked yourself these questions, if you too feel that sweet and terrible vertigo of living in a time of transition, I’d like to know what you think. What do you see when you look ahead? What are you afraid of losing? What are you willing to build, even with trembling hands? Leave a comment. Not to be right, but to add your voice to this imperfect chorus that we are. Because perhaps, just perhaps, in that sincere exchange, in that shared vulnerability, lies the seed of what is to come. The world cannot be fixed with a single text. But perhaps, just perhaps, a text can remind us that we are not alone in asking these questions. And that, in these times, is already an act of resistance. It is already a step towards tomorrow. It is already, in its own way, a form of hope.

>

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)
