links.title: Tarde de danza y compartir familiar [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
>

¡Saludos, gente! Si me han seguido por aquí, saben que he estado inmersa en el trabajo y en las preocupaciones de la vida diaria. Sin embargo, si hay algo que me obliga a salir de esa rutina es cuando mis sobrinos me piden que haga cosas por ellos; queriendo o no, muchas veces termino aceptando sus invitaciones.

Acepto también que la mayoría de las veces no quiero acudir a reuniones o a eventos de ningún tipo, y menos ahora mismo, porque me siento extremadamente cansada los días en los que estoy libre. Pero mi sobrinita insistió tanto esta vez que cedí por completo; sabía que estaba estresada y sentí que debía darle algo de apoyo moral, aunque en realidad ella es bastante independiente y ya tiene experiencia en lo que hace, pues practica desde que era muy pequeña.

>Hi, everyone! If you’ve been following me here, you know I’ve been swamped with work and the worries of everyday life. However, if there’s one thing that forces me to break out of that routine, it’s when my nieces and nephews ask me to do things for them; whether I want to or not, I often end up accepting their invitations.

>I also admit that most of the time I don’t want to attend gatherings or events of any kind, and even less so right now, because I feel extremely tired on my days off. But my little niece insisted so much this time that I gave in completely; I knew she was stressed and felt I should offer her some moral support, even though she’s actually quite independent and already has experience in what she does, since she’s been practicing since she was very young.


***
![20260424_185857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23xATSTTQX9BpxqN6LCKdNFT3wYup13Z1DTFbiLYDrmfJPfwmYkAy8fHddbHT8RWTJ1rr.jpg)
***

Todo comenzó con una presentación de danza lírica en la que, por cierto, me concentré tanto que no tomé fotografías. No sé qué me pasa, pero últimamente solo me decanto por vivir los momentos más que por guardar recuerdos. Puede ser porque últimamente olvido todo, y sé que es porque no me concentro lo suficiente. Justo por eso quiero dejar esto por aquí, para archivarlo en caso de que mi mente falle en el futuro.

El asunto es que mi sobrinita es bailarina de danza lírica y tuvo una presentación donde tenía que aparecer en varias escenas, razón por la que estaba más estresada de lo habitual y, como era de esperarse... ¡estuvo espectacular! Verla en el escenario, con sus movimientos perfectamente sincronizados y esa sonrisa nerviosa antes de presentarse, pero llena de ilusión, fue indescriptible. Tanto, que me hizo llorar varias veces pensando en la cantidad de ocasiones en las que se ha presentado y yo no he podido verla.

>The thing is, my little niece is a ballet dancer, and she had a performance where she had to appear in several scenes, which is why she was more stressed than usual—and, as expected… she was spectacular! Seeing her on stage, with her perfectly synchronized movements and that nervous smile before going on, yet full of excitement, was indescribable. So much so that it made me cry several times thinking about all the times she’s performed and I haven’t been able to see her.

>It all started with a lyrical dance performance where, by the way, I was so focused that I didn’t take any pictures. I don’t know what’s wrong with me, but lately I’ve been more inclined to live in the moment than to preserve memories. It might be because I’ve been forgetting everything lately, and I know it’s because I don’t concentrate enough. That’s exactly why I want to write this down here, to save it in case my memory fails me in the future.

***

![20260424_185746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23xAPJRaok4t1hHLtidaQ91ZHanx3DEjqbVXuuQo22jT8gvKTE4Se9cZ5sga5R77wPgjf.jpg)

***

Lo hizo extremadamente bien (cosa que nunca dudé, porque es muy dedicada y todo lo que hace lo hace bien), así que todos estábamos súper orgullosos y, como se imaginarán, ella flotaba de felicidad. Ahora me lamento horrible por no haber tomado fotos del acto, pero ni modo; por eso decidí dejar registro de las imágenes que capturé el resto de ese día y aprovechar de hablar un poco del sitio que visitamos para recordarlo en el futuro.

Después de tantos aplausos y emoción, el hambre empezó a hacerse sentir y lo que comenzó como una tarde de artes escénicas terminó en una pequeña reunión familiar en un lugar que nos dejó encantados. Queríamos celebrar el éxito de la función con algo especial y, por casualidad, terminamos conociendo un sitio nuevo de venta de pizzas y helados en La Asunción que resultó ser toda una sorpresa.


>She did an amazing job (which I never doubted, because she’s very dedicated and does everything well), so we were all super proud, and, as you can imagine, she was floating on cloud nine. Now I really regret not taking any photos of the performance, but oh well; that’s why I decided to document the images I captured the rest of that day and take the opportunity to talk a little about the place we visited so we can remember it in the future.

>After all the applause and excitement, we started to get hungry and what began as an afternoon of performing arts ended up as a small family gathering at a place that we absolutely loved. We wanted to celebrate the success of the performance with something special, and by chance, we ended up discovering a new pizza and ice cream spot in La Asunción that turned out to be quite a surprise.

***

![20260424_193506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23tbiE4T4mYTWSrkyCM6E2qDFQbBhoyVfTLx7G1EFo2zWAXVnLJSaUGTrh3C7J4Qcr43F.jpg)


![20260424_193504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23w2aNDeBEiFzV9xDiJumeMTYAe4drV3Q51vW6gLwBdS6acewfKLoXcmiJkdeVzyytnnh.jpg)

***

La entrada del local, que por cierto se llama \

, está iluminada por una cascada de luces que te invita a entrar. Esto fue lo primero que nos llamó la atención: esa iluminación la lograron con una serie de luces tipo guirnalda que creaban un ambiente súper cálido y festivo. ¡Era perfecto para una celebración!

El establecimiento cuenta con un espacio al aire libre que es pura magia; un rincón súper fresco y relajante porque está rodeado de vegetación, palmeras, y la decoración es de un estilo muy natural. ¡Se sentía una brisa deliciosa a esa hora! Es el lugar ideal para disfrutar de la noche asuntina. Probablemente en el día haga un poco de calor por el clima actual, pero al final de la tarde se sintió bastante bien.

Si el exterior nos gustó, el interior nos dio una sorpresa mayor y es que, si me conocen, saben que soy fanática del estilo Pop Art. ¡Y este lugar lo tiene por todos lados! Me encantó lo vibrante de los colores, los diseños tipográficos súper originales y los elementos icónicos de la cultura pop, lo cual le da una energía increíble al espacio y hace que cada rincón sea perfecto para una foto.

>The entrance to the venue—which, by the way, is called “Zona Happy”—is lit up by a cascade of lights that invites you inside. That was the first thing that caught our eye: they achieved that lighting with a series of string lights that created a super warm and festive atmosphere. It was perfect for a celebration!

>The venue has an outdoor space that’s pure magic; a super cool and relaxing spot because it’s surrounded by greenery, palm trees, and the decor has a very natural style. There was a delightful breeze at that time of day! It’s the ideal place to enjoy the night in Asunción. It’s probably a bit warm during the day given the current weather, but by late afternoon it felt quite nice.

>If we liked the exterior, the interior gave us an even bigger surprise—and if you know me, you know I’m a huge fan of Pop Art. And this place is full of it! I loved the vibrant colors, the super-original typographic designs, and the iconic pop culture elements, which give the space incredible energy and make every corner perfect for a photo.

***

![20260424_185756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23xAg8dn5MdbLiSDwd7NwEx8W1Tyzwvop9AeUv3byu9VKwWUBoGGMHMGaPhGUq4oVW5pv.jpg)


![20260424_185803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23tbuCNtsBWzV7V9uFDs9YJgFtkFkFV9AL9SJUAr3t4k61JGZidwJRuf88AGohK7dVfPn.jpg)


***

Por supuesto, no podíamos dejar de probar sus especialidades. Compramos dos combos de pizza que estaban deliciosas, con una masa perfecta, y bebidas (también venden helados). En general, ¡fueron el broche de oro para terminar el día! Pero más allá de la decoración y la comida (que estaban increíbles), lo que realmente marcó la diferencia fue la atención.

Desde el momento en que llegamos, el trato hacia el cliente fue excepcional. Fueron súper amables, pacientes con todos nosotros (que éramos bastantes) y siempre nos trataron con una sonrisa. Mi sobrinita estuvo feliz por su celebración, y gran parte de eso fue gracias al ambiente tan acogedor y al trato estupendo que recibimos.

>Of course, we couldn’t resist trying their specialties. We bought two pizza combos that were delicious, with perfect crust, and some drinks (they also sell ice cream). Overall, they were the perfect way to end the day! But beyond the decor and the food (which were amazing), what really made the difference was the service.

>From the moment we arrived, the customer service was exceptional. They were super friendly, patient with all of us (and there were quite a few of us), and always greeted us with a smile. My little niece was thrilled with her celebration, and a big part of that was thanks to the warm atmosphere and the wonderful treatment we received.

***

![20260424_193157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23tveCzUgLFjE9er9MtLG8ZKmHDjFqUMBU7t8uKhN3b5htmv8aTMXByDockHW8VZRQEtw.jpg)

![20260424_193802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23u5zbHWoGWTop6XF1hUsSksMUxUZb2z7YjFHrU1fddzE2VVr9aWVrZpj54tGv6Dt29GN.jpg)
 
***

Por si fuera poco, hasta nos encontramos con un rincón especial para fotos que parece sacado de un sueño. ¡Hasta un columpio tienen! Todo decorado con globos para amenizar el espacio. Aproveché de sacarle fotos a ella y a la abuela después de comer, para que posara feliz por la excelente presentación de su nieta y una entre las tres.

En conclusión, esta fue, sin duda, una de esas salidas familiares que guardaré con mucho cariño, porque fue un día de orgullo por mi pequeña gran artista y de descubrimiento de un lugar que nos llenó de \

. Fue un día especial, me hizo salir de la rutina, recordar lo realmente importante de la vida y que debo salir un poco más. Lamento nuevamente no haber tomado fotografías del evento; sin embargo, estoy casi segura de que mi hermana montará sus fotos pronto por ahí en su blog e igual existirá el recuerdo. Por lo pronto, les agradezco por pasar y leerme. >As if that weren’t enough, we even found a special photo corner that looked like something out of a dream. They even have a swing! Everything was decorated with balloons to liven up the space. I took the opportunity to snap some photos of her and Grandma after lunch, so she could pose happily for her granddaughter’s excellent performance and a shot of the three of us together. >In conclusion, this was undoubtedly one of those family outings that I’ll cherish dearly, because it was a day filled with pride for my little big artist and the discovery of a place that filled us with “good vibes.” It was a special day; it got me out of my routine, reminded me of what’s truly important in life, and made me realize I need to get out a little more. I’m sorry again for not taking any photos of the event; however, I’m almost certain my sister will post her photos on her blog soon, so the memory will live on. For now, thank you for stopping by and reading. *** ![SNOW_20260519_031248_419.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23vsQJwPyt9QqFT5JrDRgwjj1FLBMVGRgkZCvUjYPwGU9jofUuCfuWHth7b1W9nusvHfv.png) *** ***

Ten-year-old Andrew Ludlow had more questions about the impending of the Ludlow Bubbly, and he expected his grandfather and adoptive father, Capt. R.E. Ludlow, to have answers.

The captain looked with a tender smile on his eldest grandson.

“Explain your question,” he said.

“I mean, it has our name on it,” Andrew said. “You built the company using your mother and grandmother's recipes to make an inheritance for your grandchildren – so how hard is it to just sell it all – just cut the cord and let it all go?”

“Not as hard as you might think,” he said, “because first, I'm not selling the recipes. I'm leasing them, just like in the Ludlow Winery, my father obtained the leases from a cousin who needed money, which is why when Cousin Astor got mad that the Ludlow Bubbly out-competed the Ludlow Winery and threatened me, I shut the Ludlow Winery down in two hours and eventually acquired it.”

“Oh,” Andrew said.

“Never sell foundational creativity if you don't have to; lease it to businesses that can use it if you can,” the captain said gently. “The other thing, Andrew: I would never sell off the right to make you some Ludlow Bubbly right here at the house any time you want some.”

“Thank you,” Andrew said. “It would be too weird to have to buy our own soda.”

“Well, sometimes we might want to support the brand we are selling to the workers who make it now, and, over time they may well develop their own recipes and the company will, by the time you are my age, be producing more kinds of soda that you and your grandchildren may want to sample. But, as my heirs, there are founders' clauses on discount prices, in perpetuity, for you and your siblings.”

“Good, because it would also be too weird to be paying for markup,” Andrew said.

“But by that time, you will be able to run the carbonator by yourself, too,” the captain said.

“Oh yeah,” Andrew said.

“But the main thing, my grandson, and my son: I built the company to provide you a certain inheritance, and sometimes you can build a business to exit it when its real goals have been achieved. I did not expect to exit quite this soon, but, the workers are willing to come together to keep this and make it work for all of them and their families long-term, and I can get your inheritance done before I get too much older. Mission accomplished all the way around. I will not even miss being Mr. Big-Time Businessman. My favorite title is Papa.”

“Yeah, we like that one too, Papa,” Andrew said, and grinned in his (grand)father's embrace.

links.title: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (269-272)
links.body: Several years ago I bought a flatbed scanner with a slide adapter to scan some old film slides that my grandparents had. After I finished scanning those, I picked up several batches of slides from Goodwill and on eBay out of curiosity. I am not sure why these commonly wind up at such places but I know that at least some of them have ultimately come from estate sales. Maybe family members just don't know what to do with them. I've seen them advertised as being for arts and crafts but I was more interested in the actual contents. Each slide is literally a snapshot in history. These pictures span from as early as the late 1940s to as late as the early 1990s. There are thousands of these slides. I will be scanning some from time to time and posting them here as an interesting way to look back at the past.\n\nI'm using the term \
to refer to a group of slides I bought in a single purchase. Usually they are from the same ultimate origin. Typically, a batch will have 100s or even 1000s of slides.\n\nI'm using the term \

to refer to a subset of a batch that I scan together. There are normally four slides in one set because that's how many slides my scanner can scan at once. Likewise, a post will typically have one set of four slides. It's just easier to keep track of that way. This batch contains photos spanning from the late 1950s to the early 1980s. Other than these slides coming from eBay, I have no idea of their ultimate origin other than the clues provided in the photos themselves. The photographer seems to have been from Lansing, Michigan and many of the photos are from there. These were all scanned with an Epson Perfection V600 Photo scanner. All of the photos in this set were taken in the 1960s, probably in Michigan. The first photo was taken in October 1962 and is labelled 'Installation Oct 62' though I'm not really sure what it is referring to. The photo features a woman all dressed up but the photography cut off her head. The second photo was processed in September 1965 and features a woman standing outside by some flowers. The third photo appears to have been taken at the same time and place as the previous photo. It features several older individuals including the woman from the last photo. Perhaps these are family members of the photographer. The last photo is sort of a meta shot featuring another photographer taking a photo of a large group of mostly kids.

>

See the previous post in this series
>here. \n\nThe entire batch that has been scanned and uploaded so far can also be found

>here. 家人们，据说最近泰国下雨，榴莲都涨价了，原来超市23.99一斤现在涨到26.99一斤，而且外观也都不咋好看。

以前路边摊随处可见的金枕取而代之的是猫山王、甲仑，现在随处可见的是干尧和金腰。

昨晚我突然很想吃榴莲，就去了超市，发现好多没熟，又很大个，然后涨价了之后也没有降价，一个就182，我舍不得买，然后后面有个人买了，开的时候我就去录人家开的视频，有一种变态窥视别人开果的感觉，像小偷一样。

开的时候我发现那个果熟过头了，然后我就暗自庆幸我没有买，因为不是我想要的干包黄肉。然后我又骑车去之前去过的路边摊，发现全是我不认识的榴莲，可能就是干尧或者金腰，但是他们都是当金枕卖。

我一路向前，走到了那个榴莲直销店，标价19.9、26.9、33不等，其中19.9的她就直说是金腰，贵的那两款的果型不一，越贵果型越好。我手机没电了，在那里充了一会，来看榴莲的人络绎不绝，但是真正成交的寥寥无几。后来她一直跟我说旁边有充电宝，我就知道我该走了。

没买到榴莲，我不开心，又继续往前走，基本都是要100+以上，金枕的话就是200+。最后我在一个路边摊看到了金枕，我感觉应该是金枕，价格也不贵，不是太大一个，38、48、58不等。然后我挑了一个58的。当场开了就吃了好几块，味道绝美，但是核大，我感觉很奇怪，本来想多买一个，又犹豫了。

后来返程的时候，路边又看到一个，好大，可能是干尧或者金腰，才68、88。我最后选了88的，80块成交。打开一看，肉很袖珍，软塌塌的。说好的干包，一点都不干。

回到家已经晚上11点了，我居然逛了一晚上榴莲，回看拍的照片，我居然跨越了四个区去买榴莲。。。。

---

links.title: LOH289 ||  Why mistreat me with self-demands? ...
links.body:
>

>In general, I always have a lot of things to do, and it seems fine to me. Now I don't take them to heart like I used to. Whatever is provoking me. If I am my judge and my dictator, why mistreat me with self-demands? . This week, I'm busy for health and well-being reasons, but that's okay, because these demands make one feel useful, active, and resolute. Doing those errands with everything and the setbacks, which I have in my country, because it already speaks of me being in good condition.... When I understood that and that my children are already grown up fulfilling their life purposes, I also realized that if I were my husband, he would have me in a display case to contemplate me, something like a Barbie —hahahaha— that's when I knew that it was *Me and my habits and my beliefs* that made me attack my own abilities, time and also jumping over my needs, and priorities. Pretending that I can always do it my own way, without counting on the energy of others, takes me away from the possibility of being an eternal learner, to dismantle the old and to make room for the new, while everything happens. I hope I don't have so many answers. It also helped that I am not working at the same pace as I did in previous years. I like the experience and the dimensions it takes for everyone, the way to ignore or set physical and mental limits. Big hug for everyone. Nice day. Janitze.🐝

links.title: The Walk Ended Where My Feet Decided!
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRXkPMA45Bb5mTgxzUhGRVfNvgugtvjQUiSLYpChCFhxT/1779316724043.jpg)


A few weeks ago, I took a walk that ended up being longer than usual. It wasn't planned, just happened. Something was just weighing on me that day. I’d cleared my desk, and nothing else was calling for my attention. That’s what pushed me to step out — not for work, but to clear my head and find my way around whatever was sitting heavy on it.

 > So I hit the road...

What started as a short walk turned into something else entirely. From my office along Azikiwe road, I walked my way through Market road, down to Mosque street. On both sides of the road were fabrics of different colors and designs. Temptation in broad daylight, but I refused to fall for it. However, I couldn't resist that of taking pictures. Not possible. Lol. 

**Market Road.**


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQSP1UYcjkNeZ6H5mTSdGEMxuoFbeFG7Mk8QTXvFQT1i/1779261212402.jpg)
***
**Mobile shop. Turned his car into a shop. That's what you get around here. 😂**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQrRxNzG5QyPD76Ni99usrzYmDVdmfYj2h81jty8ppcY/1779261212673.jpg)
***
**The hustle is real.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZUzsGkeBShy9G82UBpaeggrTg3zxxiWSd9C7UgJx1uF/1779261212932.jpg)
***
**Bend down select (thrift) footwears.**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbfoKS6yDpjANg1idNyTYkCQu6Zay9yBQnNp5CuWsLAu/1779261213164.jpg)

***
***
**Mosque Street.**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1zh5YZLkXMzZuQpFd8kqdWRcyvNHh1FoY7on1a7eubq/1779261657386.jpg)
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5zKYQou9XgNXJa4hFtzWLPa46VwaTqpkPj9CupC2tnh/1779261657612.jpg)
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdyTZ5ii5CsgWSx5ke88HRJ3UZV9an5gFcc47JagWUQ2L/1779261657928.jpg)

***
***

First Bank Plc came into sight, I snapped it and continued. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCgu6VmZL9v3nTtR9WgXN43avE9HYNoWSt4h84KhmjAe/1779261556568.jpg)

From there, I cut onto Clifford Road to check on a client. I met his absence, no stress. I moved on. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmduTi3ruKPjZN5A6utpTy56xt8ShiHVAP4afCvM17rrfD/1779316987788.jpg)

****
**Sanitation officers on duty**
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZ4Q87nVvPFzrh8w6NihUaACAcFRNa59Tf7kf51Z6uN2/1779316988104.jpg)

Clifford Road led me to the *Cosmetics and Industrial chemical raw materials market* at School Road, behind Christ the King College (CKC). This stretch is known for perfume oils, soap-making chemicals, pesticides, herbicides and packaging materials. 


But that’s not all. There’s another side to it — the recyclables or *condemned materials* section, as it's called here. Used bottles, cans, plastics, metals, iron — anything people have discarded. 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeSAPFPcCZXnMdnbct6G3pwvbRGX61idz9iH5spykcQnA/1779315687381.jpg)
***

***






People make real money from trading on these recyclables. Some of these materials are packaged and shipped to companies that need them. Other individuals often come around to buy them for different purposes. The air, a mixture of fragrances, chemicals and sweat filled my nose. I stopped by my oil perfume vendor, said hi, and hit the road again. 

I walked the full length of that market until I hit Ngwa Road. At that point, I started wondering if this was a walk or something else entirely. It felt like those endurance treks from my NYSC days - honestly, it was starting to feel like punishment rather than a getaway for whatever was bothering me. I couldn’t make sense of it anymore.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbhTwuKo9XXxqPYttSqSVZA2RajsE5NyL8ZpjnjxsjHpN/1779315687678.jpg)




> Still, I continued... Lol. 

From Ngwá road, I cut into Obohia road by Asa Triangle just after Christ the King Cathedral. That stretch opened up into Asa road, and that’s where I finally stopped — at my friend’s office, just a few blocks away. 

That stop at my friend’s office changed the mood of the whole day. I wasn’t planning it, but seeing her surprised and happy made it worth it. We didn’t stay long, just talked for a bit and agreed to make out time to see each other properly later.

After that, I headed back to the office. Whatever was weighing me down after the long walk was gone. I felt better, more relaxed, relieved. 

> Sometimes, you just need to move and let the rest sort itself. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVx9jYhZwA14h7QdtZXu3QpB8d6EEJRziD646ZCVqaTkz/1779317657794.jpg)

It was a long walk. Longer than I expected. But that’s the point of the Wednesday walk, right? You don’t plan the moments. You just walk, observe, and also capture them. 

This is my contribution to the #wednesdaywalk, an initiative by @tattoodjay. You're welcome to join. Have a fabulous day. 
***

***
**Author's Photos**
***
Thanks for stopping by.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuavB1TQ4H4UZnrridAehLxZjNowSUYK7oFXXXdCBNmQ/1000013948.png)

links.title: Superando el cansancio | Overcoming Fatigue
links.body: > Fue un largo día y me sentía cansada, al llegar al apartamento descubrimos que no había energía eléctrica y decidimos salir a comer a la calle, a la vez que dábamos tiempo de que regresara. Es una ciudad que me encanta y que hubiera podido disfrutar más, si mi agotamiento me lo permitiera. Sólo quería dormir. Aún así sonreí lo más que pude y fingiendo estar animada acompañé a mi tribu de la mejor manera posible.

> It had been a long day and I was feeling tired. When we got back to the apartment, we found out the power was out, so we decided to go out for dinner while we waited for it to come back on. It’s a city I love, and I could have enjoyed it even more if I hadn’t been so exhausted. All I wanted to do was sleep. Even so, I smiled as much as I could and, pretending to be cheerful, I did my best to keep my family company. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmahzEJ8sYeL71ZqTTSX37sSabj9Te5X7XTqjqXTv2Vybx/20260520_174604.jpg
***

> 
 
Una vez, un colega me compartió algo que a él le había hecho clic y que a mí también me quedó grabado.

Él me contó que había visto un video, que decía algo más o menos así: Si lo más valioso que tenemos es nuestra familia ¿por qué nos esforzamos tanto en quedar bien en la calle y llegamos a casa y les damos a ellos nuestra peor parte.

Pensé en esas veces que llego a casa, me tiro a la cama y sólo alcanzo a decir \
. Para ellos debe ser mi mejor versión.

> 
 
Once, a colleague shared something with me that really struck a chord with him—and it stuck with me, too.

He told me he’d seen a video that went something like this: If the most valuable thing we have is our family, why do we try so hard to put on a good face in public, only to come home and show them our worst side?

I thought about those times when I get home, collapse into bed, and can barely manage to say, \

To them, that must be the best version of me. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmSD4vmyzTFf71e3s4wUgtkhicLjN7syHStxi2w9wiHTbJ/20260520_174509.jpg
***

> En fin, fuimos a cenar, mis hijos comieron pollo en Arturo's; a ellos les encanta y como ese restaurant no existe en la ciudad donde vivimos, cada vez que viajamos los llevamos. Sé que no es comida saludable, pero la comen de forma ocasional.

> Anyway, we went out to dinner, and my kids had chicken at Arturo's; they love it, and since there isn't a branch of that restaurant in the city where we live, we take them there every time we travel. I know it's not healthy food, but they only eat it once in a while. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjYgNehwMT3Cj4B5VL6uUQeLRvjXArjHXU5NfJGS13vb/20260520_174311.jpg
***

> Mi esposo es solidario conmigo y come donde yo elija. Se me ocurrió pedir un shawarma para armar y no me comí el pan. Fue una muy buena opción, quedé más que satisfecha. Creo que si tuviera suficiente dinero almorzara eso con frecuencia.

> My husband is supportive and eats wherever I choose. I decided to order a shawarma to take away and didn't eat the bread. It was a great choice; I was more than satisfied. I think if I had enough money, I'd have that for lunch often. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmXsBfs2gtXjRZiRhT2NAuCyrhqYc33WNQfLen59Gd88ER/20260520_174354.jpg
***

> Aunque comimos en dos restaurantes distintos y eso toma bastante tiempo, aún la electricidad no había sido reconectada, por lo que fuimos a caminar un rato al centro comercial. Yo tenía puestos unos botines altos, pero como son cómodos, no fue tan difícil para mí. Ya eran como las 9 PM, casi todas las tiendas estaban cerradas y decidimos ir al edificio en el que nos quedamos para ver si ya habían conectado la electricidad. Por fortuna así fue. ¡Bieeennn! Un baño ¡y a dormir!

> Even though we ate at two different restaurants—which takes quite a while—the power still hadn’t been restored, so we went for a walk around the mall. I was wearing high-top sneakers, but since they’re comfortable, it wasn’t too hard for me. It was already around 9 PM, almost all the stores were closed, and we decided to go back to the building where we were staying to see if the power had been restored yet. Luckily, it had. Yay! A shower, and then off to bed! ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmXetzC4XD6KxFKf42SFEn4Ta4jRqVpjTTETZJuT2sjdXc/20260520_174453.jpg
***
> Aunque estaba cansada la pasé bien. Creo que la buena disposición a a hacer las cosas marca la diferencia. Y si estoy con las personas que amo, todo es más bonito.

> Even though I was tired, I had a good time. I think a positive attitude toward doing things makes all the difference. And when I'm with the people I love, everything is even better.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***

links.title: The 20% dilemma
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTsdCNqRPDfqtbF1uvuspt58mi7ayjsn5iaZ5As7iZFND/1779320099406.png)

I've been working with #ecency for quite some time now. One of my biggest stepping stones was being selected as a translator. I admit it was originally all about profit, as I get to make progress post and earn an upvote as \

. Who would think they can be an online translator and earn crypto payout? Mind you it wasn't all the way smooth sail. Learning how to adapt and improvise in the translator world is one of the major surviving skill. There are things that doesn't jive if the language changed, such as \

the window 😅 in Chinese, it can literally mean open the window 🪟 

I must say, it was a tough one as there's many Chinese translator out there did a pissed poor job to the Chinese translation to the app(probably Google translating directly and then copy pasta to the translation output), it's so difficult to repair a translation then translating from its original language. Especially Chinese is probably from alien planet, if the translation screwed up, I will have to look up for the slot front he English database, where I have absolutely know nothing about wat that column does to the app. 

Fast forward to a couple of years later, I took on curator role. From there, I started to learn. Learn how to be a community curator. Learn to NOT self vote. But ofcourse, the community doesn't stop me from doing that. And if I use my curation towards my own benefit, that leave me a huge opening for criticism. It was a huge struggle during that time when I am having a huge dilemma if there's no one else would vote for me, especially my fellow \
\n\nAs I grow older and having more experience in community curation, I started to understand this kind of dilemma will never end if I do NOT stop looking at the amount of \

I'm getting back from what I did to the community. Someone gotta step up and take up the responsibility, and I know that person is me. I learn to spread my votes so the community curation program can be continued and I will be able to continue to vote for more users, good content that will nourish the community instead of AI spam.\n\nSo, if you seen me vote for 100% on your post, chances are it's really that good that I'm enjoying it so much, or my finger slipped 🤣 I usually lazy to adjust the voting weight as well, I sometimes I will just make a few full votes and call it a day if I'm not in the mood for doing a full curation for hours. And I would also like to tell you, if you get a 20% vote from me, that's not because I don't like your post. I have active 10k HP standing by and my community vote is following behind. 20% simply means I am doing my job and a supporting you. I hope you can understand and not taking it personally. If you don't like my 20%, you may leave me a message.

links.title: Digital Art | Jossant, Incandescent Energy 🔥
links.body:
>

![36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKs2JWxLvWwjUarFFgpMzkaAp7a9BspX3BweXo5YhTSXjJYWqYebxpVrFgW62B2.jpg)
Good evening, my dear readers in the #Hive art community! Happy Wednesday and happy midweek, everyone. I hope you’re all doing great and, of course, having a wonderful and productive week. It’s your friend Manuel here again, super happy to share a new art post on my blog. This time, I’m bringing you an illustration in which I wanted to explore the theme of space a bit. In it, I came up with the idea of creating a kind of alien named (Jossant), a creature with mysterious powers, such as telekinesis, but his most powerful ability is to generate massive spheres with the intensity of a sun right from the palm of his hand… I hope you really like my idea, and here I’ll leave you with a glimpse of the process behind how I created it—I hope you enjoy it! >*Muy buenas noches mis queridos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #Hive, feliz miércoles y feliz mitad de semana mi gente, espero que se encuentren super bien y que, por supuesto estén teniendo una maravillosa y productiva semana, por aquí los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel super feliz de poder compartirles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog. En esta oportunidad les traigo una ilustración en la cual quise tocar un poco la temática espacial, en ella lo que se me ocurrió fue crear una especie de alíen llamado (Jossant), una criatura con misteriosos poderes, como por ejemplo la telequinesis, pero su mas poderosa habilidad es la de generar grandes esferas con la intensidad de un sol justo de la palma de su mano…espero les guste mucho mi idea y aquí los dejare con un poco del proceso de como lo realice y espero que les guste mucho:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFJ3X924nNzc5NbRYb2o5vXaDGo3eaL1yvYDRH7y9s6strWgFiD7q54XBUrKJ.jpg)
To start, I began by giving (Jossant)'s body some shape and structure. What I came up with was to create him with arms that had some volume and were quite elongated, a fairly rounded head, and ears like a troll or an elf. Once I had finished the sketching process, I moved on to coloring. In this case, I wanted to start with a greenish color palette to give some shape and volume to what would become Jossant’s body. Using an airbrush, I outlined the main volume, and with watercolor and a stiff brush, I defined the details and features of the face. >*Para comenzar partí dándole un poco de forma y estructura al cuerpo de (Jossant), lo que se me ocurrió para el fue crearlo con brazos con cierto volumen y bastante alargados, con una cabeza bastante redondeada y con orejas como de troll o elfo. Ya habiendo culminado con el proceso de boceto me pase al proceso de coloreado, en este caso quise partir con una paleta de colores verdosa para ir dándole un poco de forma y volumen a lo que seria el cuerpo de (Jossant), con el pince aerógrafo centre lo que seria el volumen principal y con la acuarela y mi pincel duro fui definiendo los detalles y rasgos del rostro.*
![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJizEboxPSCZcKLw7m5PQWLL2wtiHo6o1PKhQZFt6N3Dm7yRX9VktMnAg4jatdf.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJizDE1uq6aGADXFvxts7KeoZgF2ho3Ch3HG9i2R8XSejAicka4oQSBDXRbBbQ7.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJkRRfivKE14WRRXRNMVq5BZ4knw1rcD8eoLcdbXAhqKB3u8we1FeN4A5MFccqH.jpg)
As for the eyes, I decided to use some yellowish tones for the base of the eyeballs—in this case, I wanted to make them a little elongated—and then for the inner parts, like the iris and pupils, I used red and dark brown tones; Another thing I did on the face was create a sort of large fang protruding from the upper left lip to give it a slightly more unique look. >*En lo que respecta a los ojos decidí usar unos tonos amarillentos para la base de los globos oculares, en este caso quise hacerlos un poco alargados, y luego para la parte interna como el iris y las pupilas use tonos rojos y marrones oscuros; otra cosa que hice en el apartado de la cara fue crea una especie de gran colmillo saliendo desde el labio superior izquierdo para darle una apariencia un poco más única.*
![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJkRRfivKE14WRRXRUZqLGkdubTxGJk6AWUtTyBBueUSF9iZmmrj7uT3EEdha9G.jpg) ![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJkRRfivKE14WRRXRNMVq5BZ4knw1rcD8eoLcdbXAhqKCagvL9B5Lsxu2fWw164.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJkR9vJaeLERWcjSsJ4b1dkfsSzSuBCG2NjWgzWeVG8rSpnfGRFSqzEmrY6Bn79.jpg)
As for the clothing, I first used some brown tones to create a sort of rough, rudimentary pair of pants—something that looked quite old; then, using purple tones, I created a piece of fabric around the waist that reached down to the calves, but I also had a similar piece of fabric cover his shoulders like a sort of cape. To represent the energy resembling a large star or sun emanating from (Jossant)’s hands, the first thing I did was take the airbrush and create a sphere; then, using my finger brush, I stretched the edges out a bit while adding orange and red tones to give it some illumination. >*En lo que respecta a la vestimenta primero tome unos tonos marrones para crear una especie de pantalón de tela tosca y rudimentaria, algo que se viese bastante viejo; luego con tonos morados cree una tela superior alrededor de la cintura que llegara hasta las pantorrillas, pero que también una tela similar cubriese sus hombros como una especie de capa. Para representar la energía con apariencia de gran estrella o sol que emana de las manos de (Jossant), lo primero que hice fue tomar el aerógrafo y crear una esfera, luego con mi pincel de dedo fui estirando un poco los bordes, mientras iba agregando tonos naranjas y rojos que dieran un poco de iluminación a la misma.*
![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJmrPZQRLcwNtenndi3qwoEW6EDCTikaE8PnRCZ2ThJLvLFTPhVaR3ibBA2cGGx.jpg) ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJoHZaAoe1EN4Cx74zMQx3vTnvasQ9RhBXeEnStygF9jpkJc5wBqB1REZWqnoh7.jpg) ![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJpj9dwUErtW4S4C4RwFKYS5hwiGUJpKk2KkapRTA7gKzxURRQMX1P2zzTAq1mq.jpg) ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJoGwVj2Y1736VdPA7weDjkF7sywHmc1hJXSjTwn8jmPFexQzPfu78toyCbVqQF.jpg)
###
MATERIALS / MATERIALES
- Sai Paint Tool Program - Huion inspiroy h610 v2 tablet >- *Programa Paint Tool Sai* >- *Tableta Huion inspiroy h610 v2*
![arqgp8.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFHPcsV7z4crjjkAdKiQkBpqYZcJ2KZ61MGcmUBLcn78qMqEZKtcFswTqjwoF.gif)
Well, folks, that’s all for today. Thank you so much to everyone for sticking with me this far and for reading. I hope you really liked the final result of my drawing. Without much more to add, I’ll sign off now. Big hugs to everyone, and we’ll see each other again in my next post… see you later!🤠. >*Bueno mi gente, eso ha sido todo por el día de hoy, muchísimas gracias a todos por haber llegado hasta aquí, por leerme, y ojalá que el resultado final de mi dibujo les haya gustado muchísimo. Sin mucho más que añadir, me despido, les mando un gran saludo a todos, y ya nos volveremos a ver en un siguiente post…hasta luego!🤠.*

links.body: I want machines to take over the repetitive and monotone jobs. But why would I celebrate the current trend of AI taking over everything creative? Repetitive jobs like growing food, building and so on, are mere necessities, that us humans have to do to survive. If those things could be automated (which often times they still can't; it's just work that gets somewhat simplified with tech) it would be a great win. More people could live their passion and enjoy creative tasks. But what we currently see, is exactly those creative tasks getting taken away by AI. I don't want to watch an AI movie; I don't want to read an AI-written article. I don't want AI to write my article! The things that make us human should stay human!

links.title: Emprender en tiempos difíciles
links.body:
Hola personas lindas de hive a todo aquel que me lea quiero agradecerles su apoyo , sus votos ,y sus comentarios. También quiero que empiecen a leer y a interactuar con la cuenta de mi mamá @milagroscmiranda que está muy entusiasmada con este mundo y sobre todo tiene historias increíbles ya que su vida a sido bastante movida 
Ahora sí espero que disfruten está públicación
Mi camino con las croquetas :
Como mujer en un país donde la escasez y las necesidades son parte de la vida diaria, he tenido que buscar formas de salir adelante y mantener a mi familia. Así nació mi pequeño emprendimiento: hacer croquetas caseras para vender.
Al principio, fue un desafío. Todo parecía difícil: conseguir ingredientes, encontrar clientes, organizar mi tiempo. Pero cada croqueta que elaboro lleva conmigo la ilusión de poder subsistir, de generar ingresos para comprar comida, pagar la renta y cubrir otras necesidades básicas.
Sé que este negocio crece poco a poco, que los logros no llegan de inmediato, pero eso no me desanima. Cada pedido, cada cliente satisfecho, me da la motivación para seguir adelante. Me apasiona elaborar comida que me gusta y que, además, me permite soñar con un futuro más estable.
Mi meta es que este emprendimiento no solo me ayude a subsistir, sino que también crezca y se consolide como un proyecto que pueda compartir con más personas. Hoy celebro cada pequeño avance, cada croqueta vendida, porque son pasos hacia un sueño más grande: construir algo propio, con esfuerzo y dedicación, en medio de las dificultades que nos toca vivir.
![IMG-20260520-WA0020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23yJGk23smdCkFKusnBuFCiKawLp6qmhHvpVt3tTg6iuTTXnWcazqR8a4DdB1DY1dvTij.jpg)
Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛

With a growth rate of almost 2k BP per month, reaching 30k BP will come quite quickly indeed, likely in fewer than 2 months. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260517_162621637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqiSF23q1ptcMaCiFMD3dAHMXG89W8ZQdDp8seyRfStkKNTY9tuCPy9v5X9AtU8iDef.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_090918456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tkk3vaRMSMysMhsC7xt4HePyLo3KGR3tKit38ieWeno2JS2P9FQVrDo11RUQoVk1M7A.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I finished going through my Hive notifications a bit earlier last night, so I spent some much-needed time doing asset management on my own account, and on @heartbeatvault01 and @aliveandthriving. Since delving so deeply into building my agentic-AI system, and also the shock from the We Are Alive Tribe losing its primary weekly HIVE income source due to collateral damage from the Hive-Engine hack, I haven't been managing assets as regularly as I usual do, or even up to up to this point. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_090946389.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vrtbkMUTNrX2nFFqYc273kLdSGGC7ps7gbotGSq1r3ZPwKRWDP4aEaaxF5sgzJYv5qn.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_144717457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC7r1ZkmVB6WUgUgAy6sBwpGmXnmceP7GdsByMWu9VjZttkzagaz7CLs76KQBrVfHH9.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) With the loss of two primary income sources for the We Are Alive Tribe within a period of fewer than two months, the loss of our daily SWAP.HIVE income from the SWAP.HIVE:PWR pool due to the ending of the PWR project, and now our weekly HIVE income from our delegation of 20.4k BEE to @bee.voter due to the Hive-Engine hack, I'm still at a bit of a loss for how to rebuild them, as comparable options seem to be dwindling rather quickly. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_144814278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWvfVhRC3jDfKMQFr9YPDGLF5GCg66xR8d2pnWasFTSAcZArHZ15N7mf8TPk5UcJZLn.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_151226948_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2igdouf6XM2WFojh8D6BYJSpbVuCgQiDPhDfTbXi4s2DsKZXEJejXvph1XztgBWV7Y.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) When our delegation of 20.4k BEE fully recalls within a few days time, @aliveandsocial's BEE Power vote is going to pack quite a punch, which means that everyone getting upvoted by that account (*which is in our curation trail*) will be receiving quite a bit more BEE from post and comment rewards. It also means that the amount of BEE that comes in from curation rewards will increase substantially on that account, so our BEE, both liquid and staked, will start growing quite a bit more quickly. This is the one positive that comes from the end of the HIVE-for-BEE delegation service; we're going to have a lot more BEE with which to play. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_151457391_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhwRGMLvUnmYAySHdEneriayJdsbsVFfM5Sbm6ud8Ycs6RBJCxHWhFtV2HvJWNHNoxX.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_151557641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGe1kgsYZ1Bo9AdjA7SdRbJsJNJTMLA5YB9Cm6JDF4pwVKcaVxMU14m4fHKd2xPtfXT.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) While there aren't many services left which pay HIVE or SWAP.HIVE for the delegation of layer-2 tokens, one that is still operating is the @centtoken project, which accepts delegations in various layer-2 tokens, some through direct delegations, and some through leases. The most interesting, based on the staked tokens that we have available, is the BEE-delegation service, since it offers daily SWAP.HIVE payouts for accepted BEE leases. This might be one option to rebuild our daily SWAP.HIVE income, and using BEE, of which we have a lot, instead of HP, of which we have much less. This could be very useful leverage indeed. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_151829275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uEwd5wbTprqkLZ5EWzPJtEUGhrsYTmRmjBa7eVFHi6SLQ3bVhxifMQ2X4hDBj8V8o1r.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260518_152512310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsLFJJJsxXDp9FhFA6DgauREo6w5EETJ8wvftW4QSmhWyb2a3fyUkGs7SdRp56pFHrU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Tuesday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by just before 2:45PM, giving my attention to some photography for my posts, and to a few small jungle-community tasks, first, before taking a quick break up at the Flow House, and then going to collect, move, and unload a wheelbarrow full and a half of soil, to better cover the roots of a tree that had fallen over, and had been brought back to an upright position. With that completed, I took a shower, made myself some food in Wabisabi, collected my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge, and with those in hands, I headed back to the Flow House, to work a bit more work Hermes, and to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by just after 9PM, and after the above-mentioned much-needed asset management, and working with Hermes some more, I went to bed just after 12AM. I woke up around 4AM, and unable to sleep, I did some research into FOSS mesh-network VPN frameworks, before making another partially-successful attempt at sleep. I woke up again by about 7AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to power up my BBHO, write and publish my post about it, and finally to write this post. links.title: Splinterlands:Nephket – The Dual-Attack Jackal Assassin with Stun & Knock Out Combo!
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXkFtH3T5w1bqtJAt4hXPWvQoSRVJRbx75ekztWFDsk1m/1779224682320.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKWgxGLSB8pWZ96HGw8MLmouXrWj5CS4QdDmCFdxj3Sq/1779224682372.jpg)







Good morning, warriors! The season is still fresh — how’s the grinding going so far? Win or lose, there’s always something awesome to learn.

Welcome to my blog @zusi78.

Last season, in one of my posts (read it [here](https://ecency.com/hive-13323/@zusi78/splinterlands-my-dual-attack-elements)), I talked about my love for dual-attack monsters. I went ahead to mention the ones I really liked, and **Nephket** was among the dual-attack monsters I highlighted. At the time, I didn’t have her in my collection.

But this new season, I rented **Nephket**, and she has truly shown how formidable she is in the  few battles where I’ve featured her.She's been outstanding.I became interested in **Nephket** because of how effectively she executes her **Stun and Knock Out** abilities.
Out of approximately 38 monsters across all splinters that have the **Stun** ability, **Nephket** stands out because she has Stun available at Level 1, combined with her strong dual attacks (Melee+Ranged).
Other monsters, like the ones shown below, only unlock their **Stun** ability from Level 2 upwards.

**SOME OF THE MONSTERS WITH THE STUN ABILITY**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPwHvBpBczd1e38anbHcZ8wNVvW6chkxTtEStFyP8kuDc/1779272656640.jpg)
**THE STUN ICON**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWypahGDiWj288wbJW2yML81uZHREoHKXaoNtBKaRnwe5/1779272908868.jpg)


**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**FEATURED CARD**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxy7LGdUR7CdmQscDZVHmjaKQBEy3KhVT2sgVpF6sNxU/1779224857488.jpg)
**Nephket** is a powerful Legendary Promo Card from the Hall of Legends series (Rebellion era).She is a Life/Water Canisan jackal warrior equipped with dual attacks (Melee + Ranged) and strong control tools.
This high-impact monster is especially feared for her disruptive control and explosive burst potential through the powerful Stun + Knock Out synergy.

At max level;
It has mana cost of 7, health 5, Speed 3, Ranged attack 1,Melee attack 4 and No armor.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjKD8KhDcJSNP52YWzZfC9f4auWTBHuKTGnBktiUibma/1779282601257.jpg)

**Complete Abilities**
**Nephket** gains powerful tools as he levels up:

At level 1(**Bronze**),she has both the **sneak and stun** abilities.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtukv5Y1NW4oX2K2VURu64KLZQE4V8KLduosEkbU8nq4/1779283013499.jpg)**Sneak** :Targets the last monster on the enemy team (instead of the front). If the last has Camouflage, she hits the second-to-last. Perfect for sniping healers, mages, or backline threats.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWypahGDiWj288wbJW2yML81uZHREoHKXaoNtBKaRnwe5/1779283108871.jpg)**Stun**: 50% chance on a successful hit (usually attacks with ranged first) to stun the target. Stunned units skip their next turn and cannot retaliate (no Thorns/Return Fire during that turn).



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

At level 2,(**Silver**),it unlocks the **Knockout** ability.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZubPNTmv6TNBph293KBGQfkTBJzyp7cZKrxRLtA2LgKd/1779283696756.jpg)**Knock Out**: Deals double damage when attacking a Stunned enemy. This creates massive burst potential.




At level 3 (**Gold**),it gains another ability called the **Divine Shield** 🛡️.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZRtSBMkcHyFkwFHSvrUwtyGVcTUS1xHFZooSJTvpiD5w/1779283671573.jpg)**Divine Shield**: Ignores the first instance of damage each battle. Excellent for surviving focus fire.



At max level (**Diamond**),It unlocks her last ability, **Piercing**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7oKb1pcBDYVsieh4FGWdKpEPKpYdAYGB5kWJRAKVcA9/1779284051391.jpg)**Piercing**: Excess Melee/Ranged damage after armor goes straight to health. Strong against tanky armored teams.




**Market Value**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYkYwDJDosuMMpf3mgR1pb488eJMuDBQgGqWoFcuMxiaf/1779282601316.jpg)Important Note:**Nephket** is not a regular Modern Legendary — she is a limited Hall of Legends Promo card. With only **228** copies in circulation,she commands a high market price.This makes renting her a very smart move for testing her power without the huge upfront cost! At the moment,It is been sold for about **$77**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**The Battles**:
**Stun and knockout** abilities of **Nephket** well explained in these two epic battles.It was a beauty 😍 to behold watching Nephket doing **Stun and knockout**.I rented her at level 4(Max)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPjmXmibXQuFBqdKh71GpN49oMjhLFXdbcb6YvhJ8Dtw/1779304353033.jpg)The total mana cost of this battle was 53,and you are to choose splinters from fire,life and dragon.The rulesets are;
> **fallen angels and might makes right**
Without much ado, my summoner was incessant sage with +1 armor.It is always important you protect Nephket,since she doesn't have armor.


Battle 1,this is how she does it;
**First Attack (Ranged)**
Nephket used her Ranged attack and did 1 damage (-1 shown).
**Stun** is triggered, the stun symbol appeared on the enemy.
**Second Attack (Melee)**
Because the target was already Stunned, **Nephket’s** Knock Out ability activated.
Her Melee attack of 3 damage was doubled and 6 damage (-6 shown).
This is the perfect demonstration of Nephket’s combo:
>**Stun on the first hit and Knock Out (double damage) on the second hit**.



**Round 1,Scene 10,Stun attack,first with his +1 ranged attack,you can see the stun symbol as captured**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP2RNzfJRCZE4Dq2QDLKLGrxkVJhzyCrkazjRQPY35Mk8/1779299445099.jpg)


**Round 1,Scene 11,Second attack(follow up), with the melee and dropping a damage of -6 as capured**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRK4u87yx7H5mtW8X7zmmeRH4szYELndpADz4VuzLfTnm/1779299445166.jpg)




**Round 2,a repeat of Round 1**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmceuxakSG8oHyJnXC8pkb2Tgu7FEbxn6G8enXjCTXgcPu/1779299445216.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZArAAUjDwondNKiLLpjGTviAUxYMBQTGGJDYXUdU99UA/1779299445272.jpg)




**Round 3,second victim of Nephket**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzZ9D5YZ6fzCP9gpEXWruS1pJVVRPHMtG3zVcZ64yAf1/1779299445349.jpg)


**Round 3, completing the attack with knockout**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqS1SVuaLBey65sjTqV1G4JXv1GW9qerHA9EKaNYuGS9/1779300532404.jpg)



**Round 6,in this round when she landed with his ranged attack stun was not activated,hence knockout was not activated as well on her second attack,using the melee attack.Every thing was normal**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWmi47zHmmGCSKn1RWgxxTrV2VqXKHAnHbtoeBpASbDy2/1779300713461.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeBkcwL8U6UjCTjDsqqPjYXJjM7LHMhSHhvB2SwCoNcQ/1779300713517.jpg)

**Game Over, Nephket single handedly took out three monsters in this battle**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4ecDL9JCX2zgqi8zsMEoa7eCAbB318Enw4yDVG6HVV2/1779303446580.jpg)









[Watch the Replay](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_6d66d039281fe7deb299afc6775fb0a7?ref=zusi78)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)




**In this battle my summoner was **Elias Max Pruitt**, granting +1 armor and +1melee to all friendly units.It therefore means Nephket, would now have ranged attack 1, Melee attack 4.So for the stun and knockout you would see -1 damage and -8 damage respectively**.
**STUN**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV3Gm7kW4GUpQ23njXB8Db9Qtpt6KY1b1Qv2SQbn3JDub/1779305513820.jpg)

**KNOCKOUT**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWjNbsBpK7Yc1strDMYyGoJehk5x9NGu7Wxdb4DkacEkH/1779305513881.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYRFckajKGSPEsAhV7TyJnhFrz9iT7UTBow1KRLKXPv2/1779305318235.jpg)

**I lost Nephket,but won the battle**![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrMmL11sFuf9FKtjajHZBNM4mLNQo6THNaKQ59T6xbdE/1779305318300.jpg)


[Watch the Replay](://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_97863c06e6cdad4fc2c695209803fd4f?ref=zusi78)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)



**My Experience So Far**.
Renting Nephket this season has been rewarding. Nephket is a formidable Legendary that rewards aggressive, disruptive play. Her **Stun + Knock Out** combo, combined with dual attacks and Sneak, makes her one of the more exciting modern cards for players who enjoy control-oriented strategies. At max level with good positioning, she can single-handedly swing battles by removing key enemy pieces.

Though weak in rulesets like Return Fire, Thorns, Fog of War, Little League, and any that disable Melee or Ranged.So always try and protect her at all cost.


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading and watching my post. @zusi78 signing off.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3Po5XTffZDQfLVv6ftrDnbv3hKcAoZsVsPs8r9ZhySC/1767438491028.jpg)

links.title: Flower scrunchies🌺//Scrunchies de flores🌺
links.body:
<center>

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 5.06.06 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKF8YnU1GyAbUCWSYvfbAi7HsjH41ka5pfbvr8e5qUgfj8YpZbtudTZaR39ULA8.jpeg)


</center>


![Separador_de_texto_costura-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/EoCh8pE4fzkgoHFSQZ8Riwd7mbVhRgZ1LQ2VHvRaVsfe7p6xURwbpZ3g2gfmjW3miTU.png)

---

  <center>

#### 🌺🌺Welcome to my blog//Bienvenidos a mi blog🌺🌺</center>

		
---

<div class=\

> ***Hello #NeedleworkMonday*** Today I had some free time, so I made these multicolored flower 🌺 scrunchies using up some leftover yarn. I decided to quickly crochet this pattern since it’s so eye-catching and colorful. Here are the details on how I made them.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #Needleworkmonday*** Hoy tuve algo de tiempo e hice este scrunchies de flores🌺 de diferentes colores aprovechando de reciclar hilos y me dispuse de tejer rapidamente este patrón, ya que es muy vistosa y colorida. Paso a dar detalles de su elaboración.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Cotton yarn in green, ecru, burgundy, yellow, red, pink, orange, and blue. - Size 2 crochet hook - Rubber band or hair tie.
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo de algodón verde, crudo, vinotinto, amarillo, rojo, rosado, naranja, azul. - Aguja crochet Nº 2 - Goma o colita.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 4.09.54 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKDgtU4AJGB1NH648qerdy2m7ona12HUnNqdpdWaY6hHsMfS59NFiY16QTXcqDK.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> #### Green. - Row 1: Cover the entire elastic band with green yarn using single crochet (sc). - Tie off, cut, and weave in the ends. #### Ecru. - Row 2: Insert yarn, 5 ch, dc, 2 ch, skip one stitch, 2 dc together, repeat sequence, sc. #### Burgundy, yellow, red, pink, green, orange, and blue. - R3: Insert yarn into any space while making a sl st, 5 dc, sl st, repeat sequence 4 times, let go of the loop, insert hook into the first sl st, pull through the loop, sl st, repeat sequence, skip two spaces, insert another yarn in the color of your choice, sl st. - Tie off, cut, and weave in ends.
ESPAÑOL

#### Verde. - v1: Se cubre toda la goma elastica con hilo verde con mp, pr. - Anudar, cortar y ocultar hilo. #### Crudo. - v2: Insertar hilo, 5 chs, pa, 2 chs, saltar un espacio, 2 pa juntos, repetir secuencia, pr. #### Vinotinto, amarillo, rojo, rosado, verde, naranja y azul. - v3: Insertar hilo en cualquier espacio en el hacer mp, 5 pa, mp, repetir secuencia x 4, soltar asa, meter crochet en el primer mp halar el asa, mp, repetir secuencia, saltar dos espacios, insertar otro hilo del color de tu preferencia, pr. - Anudar, cortar y ocultar hilo.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 4.44.28 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23uQvaM5iA4cj8m6ZKX5LGRGCxk4b6pc6aUCg2qyB8V6bxTnvhiTXqPQ17RCzxqvArMoW.jpeg) ---

links.title: Exploring Asgard Through Atreus’s Eyes
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

One of the great additions that God of War Ragnarök brings us is the ability to play as a character other than Kratos. You can explore several worlds and take on multiple missions—both main and side quests—as Atreus, Kratos' son. After a falling out, they decide to split up. This expands the game significantly; while they share the same storyline, we now have to upgrade the characters separately, finding armor, runes, and weapons for each of them.

<center>  
![1000398136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/244obKhx5z8mKo9HperZgBVZsNytJ57RnqF471qTEQQoEJKPwK4powgV2cB6sqVQ9F3Sp.jpg)
![1000384680.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23ywgspu8WvTP2AeUHajtvnUdmsGPNEBnWRQWVWeTHV8wRweBpWkTi9zK5hxE6DJ26RJ3.jpg)
![1000384681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wzxVjiFfjXanBofRmVPCPtoVfbPbUyNaDZkQE9yjgciboDDzJKsaviSZCAC7mUprPMT.jpg)
![1000384678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23zbQ3sfpie9REUX2T1cP6brMJQ9nbNxf2krYCGUiiYeq9PjoRSJ6axdDMYJGDtnxkiLV.jpg)
 </center>



One of the many places we visit with Atreus is Asgard. The reason is that Odin has recognized the magical capabilities Atreus possesses and has manipulated him into helping him solve a mystery and access new powers and information—things that Atreus is susceptible to. After his fight with Kratos, like any son, he decides to defy his father and go with Odin, who is clearly behaving like an enemy.

<center>
![1000384686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23z7DhB5bePs6MXMYvTNLCbNpZ4jPEqdz6VSpgYJQ11erNxBLNExbCXCXMmu1ndrEgHK7.jpg)
![1000384684.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23z7DZPpR3AYSLDBCfH5nNhUbye7Hk3eVJb9vupAtP2UnY3X5Tq2wVz88DKwKboZmBNo8.jpg)
![1000384663.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23zbDTqQNA79ag39HC6aEZzV9HEqakauwreCK3kYHZ5AcBB8a18LWaiqPmfdHcLhFL2Xi.jpg)
  </center>

The one who greets Atreus upon his arrival is Heimdall, Odin's son and the guardian of the entrance to Asgard. He clearly doesn't share his father's end goal of using Atreus, so he is abusive and defiant toward us. He outclasses us in strength and speed, and his eyes allow him to anticipate every movement, so when it comes time to face him, he will be very difficult to defeat.

<center>  
![1000384667.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/243BXfxYopextJvLZrHzFunatFRRcRp538BrTT69StyoEYi4xHoRo89mqHCoYBkCK9HXd.jpg)
![1000384666.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23zGPmG2zrdvqJghhvAuPBVQncH29cAkipvNZbEJTwoNPkEbnbcEjJRtoK8P9dbyTyhNc.jpg)
![1000384664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wqbmBMXac36cjWnhS6HV2AP5hMn2cu3Bw2inATKdKoD33zaez2NhHjLnLqw5U5mKd7e.jpg)
![1000384665.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23xp2ZRnTXbbMkQhsDqTNmDh9SWq3CxWdZJXVAnjG9YsT4dmef2QSErBtbFomiFD5BvLd.jpg)
  </center>

After the conversation with Odin, you can explore Asgard freely. The landscapes are incredible, the views are breathtaking, but I was surprised by how \

it feels; everything has an ancient, very Nordic vibe, full of creatures like the Valkyries. The gods are located behind a great wall that surrounds Odin's palace, where he lives alongside several of his children and other deities, while outside the walls, we can find human settlements.
![1000384669.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tm93GLd5ejKFUKrg8RWeD5WCJimGBynaVU83eWrpk5pAnyutrGwTp19YuaGjtFrbvzf.jpg) ![1000384668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tSN1ohM73b1hUF4QUqXAevnkxP4ZXGUGYxhfHrWrxkVk7gU3A7q36XB5pGduoDAYEE6.jpg)
It was great to be able to explore a world like this, full of life, sun, and greenery, especially since all the others we've visited so far have been cold and dark. It was also a total surprise to actually play as another character, because in the previous game, we could only trigger certain attacks with Atreus. I suppose being able to play as him now is a sign of his growth, maturity, and the skills he possesses that he didn't have before.
![1000384670.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tm9YdtTphsJvqcTLytC6ejNWau67wJbz66NWRzdkBE8M46mTZ4Mf76YW1GCPMfnZzDR.jpg) ![1000384671.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23u5vRRFy9ehQB22RyAagBwGZ1eP8pF4TCo4yeMdK1gjv4VgC2ogJ3mCQK8bSc9qcAxCL.jpg) ![1000384672.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tS13J8HFmJ2SAy9yig18WcNDymorXL6L7PnthSNEPMgrVsiBnQHHCCFgHpeEf9RFw5u.jpg)

links.title: Homestead Hodgepodge
links.body:
<center>
![IMG_8938.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/242hSRAS7QhWzSp8491YgusdS5ovS5tGxNcYeyUmm4qxRi6M5ita8BEZceUpo4V243jCm.jpeg)
</center>



<center>![paw divider transparent.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/48KZyd16wthLszaeq8fk7G1E4ouNCTPmsydXQQeMc23jdxuFbbxjwqu3LKfLB9x6LQ.png)</center>

----------

Many, many years ago when I first read about the University of Saskatchewan's Romance series of cherries I very much wanted them, specifically the Juliet variety. Their cold tolerance, sour yet sweet taste, and compact yet productive habitat appealed to me greatly. There were just so many barriers in the way for many years.

They weren't licensed to be sold in the states. Then it was just the Carmine Jewel, and only through one retailer. I waited and waited, and by the time I could purchase the variety I wanted, I had about a billion things that I had to spend any money I had on (show steer and competition accoutrement), plus, I wasn't going to drop monies on premium, licensed plants and not be around to tend to them.



![IMG_8933.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/EowFho9morxusYi91rWLeCU2vCBREgMjZsQ8W2pYz5CBy6NVN33TMKemPXXw8VV7M36.jpeg)

So I waited. And waited. And then on Monday, a great thing happened, two, three gallon Juliet bush cherry plants arrived on my doorstep!

Our weather up here is very broody and moody right now, but honestly it was perfect for transplanting shrubbery, so yesterday I waited between squalls and went out and got the beautiful little plants settled in to the garden enclosure. 


![IMG_8942.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/23y8siwwXRWHt6UpAQHPBehgBnmyNkJuyHBtEwWwUrP2mUTqLr2TqcJFcLnC9JW2PR9bE.jpeg)


I had picked out two spots I thought would work beautifully for my new plant friends. One I put in the space between an elevated garden box and a very old English rose I am trying to bring back. The other I plunked between the end of the raspberry rows and the honeyberry bushes. 

After they were settled and watered in, I marveled that almost twenty years after I had first heard of them I finally had some Juliet cherries in the ground. I think they may fruit next year, but I may pluck most of the flowers off of them next year, aggressively fertilize, and enjoy the fruits of awesomeness the following year. I may be a little excited...


![IMG_8935.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/EpJVjoqBZxuqgWDEt4N8u9f9PKMQVCLeYAi5ApaxtC5dH5MDDm6ouRxXkuPpnSUwDhc.jpeg)


With the weather being just crazy, I have been doing a lot of work inside, work outside roulette. Today, I finished shoveling all the compost in the garden I needed along with burning a slash pile of stumps. In between huffing and puffing as I shoveled, I often stopped and smiled at all my animal friends. The baby geese were taught to swim today, and they were just precious all in a row. 


![IMG_8941.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/23tSWkxANkBYq6gr2rX4xPDnFvECKx4rmubRNzgmc4HAMh8iWCgssNvMvu9XTwCCu3dzA.jpeg)


My deer are getting ready to drop fawns, I shoveled many little frogs into my ATV trailer, and there are nightcrawlers and red worms EVERYWHERE! Life is definitely lifing all over the place here. The hubs even saw fresh bear scat down at the other end of the lake, and I played MarioKart with a huge moose on my way home Monday. It's never dull in the Montana mountains for sure.

This next week it looks like I can get my warmer weather crops going. The cold weather crops are doing fantastic. I've got carrots, beets, turnip greens, cabbage, radishes, chives, and all manner of lettuce popping up all over the place. a thing I am not sad about, as I would much rather eat food I grow than food I go pick up in town.

Now if I only had a bit more writing time, I would feel like I had achieved a bit of balance...

--------------




<center>![paw divider transparent.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/generikat/48KZyd16wthLszaeq8fk7G1E4ouNCTPmsydXQQeMc23jdxuFbbxjwqu3LKfLB9x6LQ.png)</center>

------------------
<center>*And as most of the time, all of the images in this post were taken on the author's thoroughly covered in compost and larch pollen iPhone.*</center>

-----------

I am delighted with the progress of my work now because there were now clients in the past that contacted me about the work that I did and they were happy about it.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/48XfTMj9UEwMgDwx3X5pBUArxHeSvzwSTCycFk7ccDBbSRsCL6YDRggXWhNiPYj6C8.png)

While I was working with the new client, which is getting leads of their business, the old client contacted me about the past work and that client was satisfied with my work and wants me to continue. Although, I have other work to do but I think this is my time to shine and to give my best to the client. 

Well, I am planning to get both of the clients that I currently have and the past client since there's no time tracking for the work and I only need to update the client with the work that I have done, they are good for me to on with it. 

It's been a while since my urges of working rose up and it's my time to shine again to work on with the work that I have been given and make the work done as soon as possible and yeah, it's really tiring but who am I to declined the client's offer? Well, not me since I am a money slave worker because of my family that I also need to take care of. 

I might get sleepless nights for this but I think this will be worth it because I am now working in another country's client and it's not that it's a lowball but it's enough for me and my family to live on. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/48ZbwXanGnMx4qZe7uS36k6Yu11zTGHBrCBX9QYAWMLBRUUSvbZoxUQsN8NbUiMYZy.png)

There's some extra that we could go outside and have fun together so that I can unwind with the work for a little time and then continue working with it. 

Hmm... I am questioning myself if I can do it but with the help from above and think more thoroughly, I think this will be worth it even if I will get sleepless nights for this.
