links.title: Jeringa 💉 tejida. // Knitted syringe 💉
links.body:
![Polish_20260302_072619737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/48RPnNiwie55F9hsu4D8dRSEUuFrUpUtTHqyRiDwCEdL8MMcpfzqBM999ZbcKtL5Lk.jpg)

Hola hola...espero que todos estén muy bien. ¡He vuelto! Muchísimas gracias por continuar haciendo seguimiento a mi perfil, no me he ido de #hive sino que me estoy dedicando casi por completo a cuidar a mis hijos y realizar labores domésticas. Sin embargo siempre que puedo los leo porque hive siempre seguirá siendo como mi segundo hogar. Confieso que el hecho de no recibir hbd en mis post me desmotiva un poco ya que mucho o poco lo que se va acumulando siempre me hará falta, más aún en la situación en la que me encuentro con mi hijo en la que solo yo cubro gastos médicos y de alimentación. Como muchos saben él tiene un canal de Youtube, pero en estos momentos no podemos acceder a ninguna de sus cuenta monetizables ya que por su falla de memoria no ha podido compartirnos y desconocemos contraseñas y esas cosas. En fin, hoy me dió tiempo sentarme a redactar uno de muchísimos trabajos que he hecho y quiero compartirles. Espero que esté sea de su agrado. ¡Bienvenidos a mi blog! 

>Hi there... I hope everyone is doing great. I'm back! Thank you so much for continuing to follow my profile. I haven't left #hive; I've just been focusing almost entirely on taking care of my kids and doing household chores. However, I read your posts whenever I can because Hive will always be like a second home to me. I’ll admit that not receiving HBD on my posts demotivates me a bit, since whatever amount accumulates—big or small—will always be needed, especially in my current situation with my son, where I’m the only one covering medical and food expenses. As many of you know, he has a YouTube channel, but right now we can’t access any of his monetizable accounts because, due to his memory loss, he hasn’t been able to share them with us, and we don’t know the passwords or any of that information. Anyway, today I finally had time to sit down and write up one of the many projects I’ve worked on, and I want to share it with you. I hope you like it. Welcome to my blog! 

### Jeringa 💉 tejida. 
### Knitted syringe 💉. 

Hace unos cuantos días quise empezar a realizar amigurumis que a mí parecer podrían ser más comerciales; una jeringa 💉 y una enfermera fue lo primero que se me ocurrió por la cercanía del día de la enfermera, los bioanalistas y el médico. Mi intención era hacerla pequeña tipo llavero, sin embargo conseguí un patrón en imágenes para recrearlo, como siempre trato de tejer a ojo, está jeringa me quedo grande. La teji con hilos pabilos, un gancho de 2,25mm, usé las tijeras, algodón sintético, ojos plásticos, papel de aluminio, pegamento y aguja lanera.

>A few days ago, I wanted to start making amigurumi that I thought might have more commercial appeal; a syringe 💉 and a nurse were the first things that came to mind since Nurses', Medical Technologists', and Doctors' Day was coming up. My intention was to make it small, like a keychain, but I found a pattern with pictures to follow. Since I always try to crochet by eye, this syringe turned out too big. I crocheted it with Pabilos yarn, a 2.25mm hook, and used scissors, synthetic cotton, plastic eyes, aluminum foil, glue, and a wool needle.


![Polish_20260302_073046333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/2423wXxPXeYXeKDrpdy2LHftVKpVqk38KnoDBM63JLndWtLwmswCgXbvz28wNHoqYDPSZ.jpg)

Empecé tejiendo desde la parte de abajo de la jeringa donde se pondría la aguja. Por cierto esta la realicé con un palillo que forré con papel de aluminio. Todo el tejido lo realice puntos bajos, como ven inicie con los colores verdes. A medida que fui tejiendo fui colocando el algodón sintético. Se inicia con un am de 6pb y se va realizando aumentos hasta lograr el diámetro deseado para el círculo. Una vez logrado el círculo de la aguja de tejer la parte plana, solo fui haciendo aumentos hasta lograr el tamaño apropiado. Después cambié de hilo a color blanco para empezar a tejer solo punto sobre punto y darle la forma y tamaño al cuerpo de la jeringa. 

>I started crocheting from the bottom of the syringe, where the needle would go. By the way, I made this using a stick wrapped in aluminum foil. I used single crochet stitches throughout; as you can see, I started with the green colors. As I crocheted, I added the synthetic cotton. You start with a chain of 6 single crochets and keep increasing until you reach the desired diameter for the circle. Once I had the circle for the flat part of the knitting needle, I just kept increasing until I reached the right size. Then I switched to white yarn to start crocheting single crochet stitches only and give the syringe body its shape and size. 


![Polish_20260302_073127034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AJkT85rmR3bK47dbw7PjtRsCSZ9BYqWhUvrp7uVJsRn6AWygkNkSLb2CVJJ4FbG.jpg)

Hasta cierto número de vueltas tejo con el hilo blanco, aproveche de pegarle los ojos y bordar la boca, igualmente fui colocando el algodón. Cambie nuevamente de color de hilo y seguí tejiendo. Es cuestión de hacer aumentos y reducciones en redondo para ir dándole la forma a cada una de las partes de la jeringa. Los colores que utilice fueron el blanco, verde, gris, rojo y negro. Me encanta como se ve está jeringa tejida. 

>I crocheted with white yarn for a certain number of rows, taking the opportunity to attach the eyes and embroider the mouth, while also stuffing it with cotton. I changed the yarn color again and continued crocheting. It’s a matter of increasing and decreasing in the round to shape each part of the syringe. The colors I used were white, green, gray, red, and black. I love how this crocheted syringe looks. 


![Polish_20260302_073218309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AK9QA7c8NVwisecMCZRrRwQmGWDmbRDscne7AuDY8tSqiVTRmytFAHZRiWrMYrp.jpg)

Como pueden ver es un tejido bastante sencillo. Para lograr la forma ovalada de los laterales de la jeringa empleé puntos altos y puntos medios altos. Al final coloqué el resto del relleno y el palillo forrado con papel de aluminio para simular la aguja. ¿Qué les pareció? Todavía tengo esta jeringa 💉 disponible por si deseas hacer un obsequio o tenerla de adorno en tu consultorio. Muchísimas gracias por leer. 

>As you can see, it’s a pretty simple crochet pattern. To create the oval shape of the syringe’s sides, I used double crochet and half-double crochet stitches. Finally, I added the rest of the stuffing and a toothpick wrapped in aluminum foil to simulate the needle. What do you think? I still have this syringe 💉 available if you’d like to give it as a gift or display it in your office. Thank you so much for reading. 


![Polish_20260302_073312334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AK6Xkti3xoB2mGKArrcdvrwcqaceJBxyosz76KQYbz25NikupbBEniP1WnCv8EX.jpg)

Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad. Edite con Polish. Use el traductor de Deepl. Muchas bendiciones para todos. Gracias por el apoyo. 

>All photos are my own. I edited them using Polish. I used the Deepl translator. Many blessings to everyone. Thank you for your support.

links.body: Contexto: ok explico, si se preguntan \

fue otro que quiero juntar las 3 tipos de narraciones en esta serie, y por último está serie está inspirada en una etapa de la adolescencia y además en las etapas los personajes como representación del \

y también de la naturaleza.

La luz de la noche cubre tu rostro, sabiendo que entre la pérdida de tu última hijo: Romeo, había muerto. Ves al pequeño monarca, sabiendo que venía con una misión: construir el nuevo diamantus.
Decide entrar a una cueva pequeña, pero cómoda para pasar la primera noche, y duerme en el piso.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRFwz2G7cSxf7drqPiYkFeuqgE3BE2pxTnpsJbdosSBZw/1779319870839.png)

 Al día siguiente te das cuenta de algo: no está el pequeño cachorro.
Decide buscarlo por toda la cueva y también sales en busca de lobos que había visto al rey, no sabe dónde está, hasta que se da cuenta que era demasiado tarde.
__________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXa9qWdEFBGKq9W7F3Bhr7YoKaJ23eiZMUHs8eDdq8fdJ/1779319896419.png)

Unos científicos ya se habían llevado al rey de diamantus y te sientes miserable, al principio siente que tú cuerpo se quiebra al perder a la única familia que te quedaba, pero sabes muy bien que esa consecuencia es obra del futuro destino del cachorro y por el bien de diamantus.
Mientras tanto en el barco, tú cómo el próximo rey de los lobos, no entiende nada de lo que pasaba a tu alrededor, y muchos menos quiénes eran esos hombres que sostienen, jeringa, lentes y máquinas rara. Uno de los hombres que estaba viendo unas de las máquinas Dice: —Lobo despierto, es hora de hacer el experimento (4LF)— dice.

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 19 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd5b57db-c7fc-4b38-a233-8915d513f19c.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday started with a visit to the vet for Kaia. Without X-rays, they couldn't confirm the issue but just like me, they're suspecting she tore her ACL. Since she already tore her ACL on the right leg, the chances she does the same on the left are high. But just in case it's not as bad, or just a partial tear, she put her on anti inflammatory pain killers for a month, along with rest. No running, no jumping, and very little walking. As you know, that's going to be a tough one for Kaia and me! Anyways, after the storms in the afternoon, I thought we could spend time in the yard where I can monitor she doesn't run too much. Le Chat was also monitoring... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2c60acf5-a804-4ef0-aba8-b92cad20c028.jpg) Since Kaia looked somewhat calm, we slowly moved towards the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/50e439fc-e4f6-4e19-b8d0-f020b15a6a5e.jpg) She wanted to go in but I didn't let her of course. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/174d3880-ac57-4753-ab4f-7508df918e0e.jpg) It was nice to see the sky clearing up after the heavy storms earlier. Our weather continues to be very changing. After summer temps for a few days, we're supposed to get closer to freezing the next couple of nights. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/76752da4-1524-46cf-9934-283a21014eca.jpg) Le Chat joined us, the slow pace Kaia has to follow, is easier for Le Chat. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a5ca4988-2aa8-4e59-a881-02607b9e8d56.jpg) The vet said we could walk a little bit if it's easy terrain and slow, so we tried to roam in the neighborhood. But like the day before, it already seemed too much for Kaia. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4d0e326a-2e71-46e3-bc8e-edd0783eee6f.jpg) So it was a really short walk and we just spent more time in the yard, admiring the light end of day colors in the sky. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b099bd22-958e-43c7-949f-1cb755719172.jpg) Well, not a great news that Kaia is forced to rest for at least a month. I feel weird going for a walk in the neighborhood or forest without a dog. So I will have to find another way to keep my activity level up. Definitely running should be one, but that won't be sufficient, I'll find something else. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260520t234109042z)_

links.title: Detour Ahead - Herb Ellis, John Frigo & Lou Carter (Cover) by @yisusth
links.body:
>\n\n

A warm greeting to everyone in this wonderful #Music community. I'm delighted to perform \

on my trumpet, a classic jazz song from the 1940s composed by Herb Ellis, John Frigo, and Lou Carter. The lyrics compare a road trip to a romantic relationship. On our journey, we may encounter difficulties, obstacles, and even failure. We may lose a battle, but never the war. The lyrics are very common in post-war American culture. The message of this piece is that it's best to recognize when something is wrong before it's too late. It most likely originated from a period of improvisation while they were playing together in a trio called The Soft Winds. I play this piece in the key of D major, and I love how its melody reflects emotional tension. It has fleeting modulations that reflect the nature of detours on a highway.

Spanish | Español (click here) Un cordial saludo para todos en esta bella comunidad de #Music. Tengo el agrado de interpretar con mi trompeta «Detour Ahead», una clásico del Jazz de los años 40 compuesto por Herb Ellis, John Frigo y Lou Carter. La letra de la canción compara un viaje de carretera con una relación amorosa. En nuestro viaje podemos encontrar dificultades, obstáculos, e incluso con el fracaso. Se puede perder una batalla, pero jamás la guerra. La letra es muy común de la cultura estadounidense de postguerra. La reflexión de esta pieza es que es mejor reconocer cuándo algo va mal antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Lo más seguro es que haya surgido de un tiempo de improvisación mientras tocaban juntos en un trío llamado The Soft Winds. Esta pieza la interpreto en la tonalidad de D mayor, y me encanta como su melodía refleja tensión emocional. Tiene unas modulaciones pasajeras que reflejan el carácter de los desvíos en una carretera.

> I recently woke up excited to go to a meeting on a Sunday morning. I stood at the bus stop waiting for public transportation for three hours. Many buses passed, but none were going to my destination. Since the meeting was about to end, I decided against going and took a bus to a different place. Although I hadn't planned to take that bus, it was too easy to get to the unplanned destination. I don't know if not going was the best thing to do. I probably missed something good, or perhaps something bad. Maybe I insisted on going to that place and something unexpected happened. A warm greeting to everyone in this wonderful #Music community. I'm delighted to perform \

on my trumpet, a classic jazz song from the 1940s composed by Herb Ellis, John Frigo, and Lou Carter. The lyrics compare a road trip to a romantic relationship. On our journey, we may encounter difficulties, obstacles, and even failure. We may lose a battle, but never the war. The lyrics are very common in post-war American culture. The message of this piece is that it's best to recognize when something is wrong before it's too late. It most likely originated from a period of improvisation while they were playing together in a trio called The Soft Winds. I play this piece in the key of D major, and I love how its melody reflects emotional tension. It has fleeting modulations that reflect the nature of detours on a highway.

Spanish | Español (click here) Un cordial saludo para todos en esta bella comunidad de #Music. Tengo el agrado de interpretar con mi trompeta «Detour Ahead», una clásico del Jazz de los años 40 compuesto por Herb Ellis, John Frigo y Lou Carter. La letra de la canción compara un viaje de carretera con una relación amorosa. En nuestro viaje podemos encontrar dificultades, obstáculos, e incluso con el fracaso. Se puede perder una batalla, pero jamás la guerra. La letra es muy común de la cultura estadounidense de postguerra. La reflexión de esta pieza es que es mejor reconocer cuándo algo va mal antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Lo más seguro es que haya surgido de un tiempo de improvisación mientras tocaban juntos en un trío llamado The Soft Winds. Esta pieza la interpreto en la tonalidad de D mayor, y me encanta como su melodía refleja tensión emocional. Tiene unas modulaciones pasajeras que reflejan el carácter de los desvíos en una carretera.

links.title: Pistol Duels 🔫
links.body:
By now, I'm pretty sure that it's common knowledge that I like downloading the most random games to help pass the time when waiting or bored or brain fried.
The idea is not to get a game that is cognitively and/or mentally taxing. If possible, a game that can be played offline, low end graphics, simple buttons and yet has an interesting and interactive gameplay.
Just something to relax with..
And I believe I hit the jackpot with this one...

## <center>Pistol Duels</center>

![1003758373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23uEz8HmVZpQMgbfThD6uPyBWMChzyLTsSnB2gSCZy1b2EHmmYFG6WBQ2CSjib8tEcy3i.jpg)

The game, takes simplicity to a whole new level.
Buttons and controls?
**We don't need them!**
Just tap the screen, shoot the bullet and allow recoil and gravity be your wheels.
It gets fun pretty quick and the opponents, are randomized so well. 
The levels get more chaotic as you go up but it is still so easy to go.

It isn't much of a full brain game and the only change in landscape is when the walls shrink or there are turnmills or sliding barriers in some levels which adds to the games chaos.
No need for graphics, characters and all those other stuff.
Take aim, fire your gun and pray that the person who is hit, isn't you.

links.title: Yet another low effort entry
links.body:
Alright, I am back again for the pure hell of it because why the fuck not? 

Having been on such a crazy sleep cycle (or lack thereof) lately I have not been able to stay in any sort of routine in a meaningful way... which yup sucks as much as it sounds... regardless of the 'progress' that I have made on various projects. The real shit part to that, is that I would not be adjusting my sleep cycle every day if my frigging internet connection was more reliable.

In other words, in order to get anything done I have to use the connection *when it is actually working* and *that* seems to be an entirely random affair... and to make it worse... it more often than not... only happens in the middle of the night. I am still unsure if it is true... but I *think* that it only works 'well' during those times because traffic on the network has dropped rather low by then.

Even during the 'best connection' times, it still randomly drops, fails to load things... and from what I can tell... wastes a solid half (or more) of my limited data each month due to all the failed connections, dropped fetches, timeouts, page reloads and so forth. In all truthfulness it drives me utterly fucking bonkers... and although I tend to not abuse my tools... I have come incredibly close lately to taking a fucking hammer to everything and being fucking done with it.

As aggravating as *that* is, what really gets me (as I have stated in another entry) is how disruptive that those disconnections are to my 'work flow'. Which, (given the already highly technical nature of things (and the interconnected nature of various systems) things tend to get 'lost in the shuffle'... *long before* the connection 'starts working well' again... and I try to get back on track.

Combining that level of annoyance, with constantly running out of food and clean drinking water (and not being able to afford either of them more often than not) is undoubtedly a recipe for disaster... but the alternative of 'laying down and dying' is only slightly less appealing... and that 'slightly less' part only occurs because it would impact others... so go fucking figure.

On top of all that horseshit to deal with, there has been this super extreme financial pressure on me the last few years (even more so than in previous years) and with the way the shitheels have driven up the price on everything... and driven the *value* of other things *down* (like cryptocurrency assets) it is almost impossible to ignore the 'squeeze' occurring for me... where I am caught *being fucking crushed between* those two pressures.

Then there is the whole thing about not being able to have any sort of 'music' therapy where I live at... due to some local shitheels that cannot help themselves from opening their fucking mouths at the slightest sound of someone actually enjoying life! Not to reiterate all that jazz again... but yeah a place where loud explosions, gunshots... and loud domestic disputes are *totally okay* but a little music is *not okay* should tell folks exactly what type of folks that I am surrounded by.

As I have said before, I could (if I so chose to) still play the damned music however I want, as loud as I want, as often as I want... all *legally* and do it with 'extra' legality given the place is a farm... and there are laws specifically protecting music being played at such places. The thing about that little *fact* is that the actual law does not matter to the folks around here... because (just like the rest of those kinds of ultra-conservative christo-fascist pieces of shit) the 'law' is only considered 'valid' when it serves *their* ends.

I have long said, that I am living in a 'microcosm' that is a *perfect mirror* of what is going on in the rest of this country at the moment... and if this is the future 'they' want for everyone else... things will be getting *much worse* long before they *can* start to get better. As much as I do not enjoy the sort of dead-end future this country is heading towards... the realities of the current moment... are so damned *tangible* that I would have to engage in some sort of cognitive dissonance to *not* see it all.

In regards to all that stuff, I often say 'modern problems deserve historical solutions' and when it comes right down to it... I think that the French did it best in seventeen eighty-nine... and (whether I fully approve or not) it may well take a similar approach to solve the current problems. Forced inequality and 'silencing' folks... has a way of brewing up a kind of deep resentment in folks... that it *inexorably* creates the kind of common bond (common struggle) scenario that paves the way for literal 'blood in the streets' as the expression goes... historically speaking of course.

Do I personally *want* that to happen would be a good question... but also an incredibly fucking *disingenuous* one to ask (of me) given my long track record of 'keeping the peace', promoting folks being treated well... and generally *not perpetuating* any of the abuses that I myself have been subjected to (or seen) throughout my life. In other words (for you truly simple minded fucks) I can absolutely see the necessity (or probability) of one thing being a *direct response* to another thing... and while gruesome... history shows how *effective* such tactics are... so who am I to judge if it turns out to be the 'will of the people' in the current scenario... or any scenario for that matter?

Anyways, that stuff could all be summed up as 'observations on my own perspectives that I am having in this moment'... rather than me simply expressing my opinions, pushing ideas, promoting bad behavior, outlining an agenda... or any horseshit like that. Being a 'doer' of things... and being *fully capable* of 'taking action' with zero fucks given along the way... if any of *that* was on my personal itinerary... I damn sure would not be writing and posting about it all... especially since I would be totally consumed by *action*... versus pontificating upon the zeitgeist of the moment... but hell I honestly do not expect folks to understand the nuances to any of that... especially when it comes to such a volatile (and albeit violent) topic.

For my part, the path that humanity has chosen for itself is a forgone conclusion... and what is happening now... is simply a part of the cycle as an incredibly unsustainable scenario tilts towards its inevitable closure. Will I laugh at the 'suffering' of those that caused it would be a good question to be asking... and my answer is: \

because after all... they are the dimwitted shitheads that think infinite growth in a finite system is anything other than cancerous behavior... and pushing (and/or enforcing) that way of thinking/behaving onto everyone else is even more damning... so spare me because I am a firm believer in the paradox of tolerance.

As much as I know *exactly* what all the simple-minded folks will read into all that... I also know that anyone looking at the scenario on the planet and thinking 'everything is fine' is either a full-blown psychopath... or the moral equivalent of/to one... and quite frankly... I think they can go fuck themselves in the neck with the closest sharp object... and do the rest of the planet a fucking favor in doing so. Mark my words here, because the time is coming when *those* kinds of folks will either 'rule over the ashes of a dead world' or they will be 'wiped off the face of it'... not because I want it... or see it coming... but because most (even slightly intelligent critters) tend to want to avoid 'self extinction' via making wholly unwise choices.

Well that is enough 'low effort content' for this entry. Ciao for now and if my words rub you the wrong way I suggest that you deeply analyze the contextual meaning of my latest life motto: Come stepping.

Yap, Arsenal akhirnya kembali bisa membawa trofi Liga Primer Inggris ke Emirates untuk pertama kalinya. Terakhir kalinya mereka menjadi juara adalah saat mereka masih menggunakan Stadion Highbury, dan itu sudah lebih dari 20 tahun yang lalu. Nah, semua fans Arsenal sekarang ini pasti sangat senang melihat perjuangan tim ini akhirnya membuahkan hasil dan penantian panjang para fans setia Arsenal berakhir. Kali ini, mereka sudah bisa melawan ledekan fans-fans dari tim lain, apalagi fans dari Tottenham Hotspur yang menjadi rival utama sekota, di mana di liga kali ini mereka terseok-seok di papan bawah klasemen. Mereka masih berjuang untuk tetap bisa bermain di Liga Primer musim depan. Akan tetapi, meskipun Arsenal menjadi juara, kali ini aku yang macet lagi di Hive. body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Where is Fallen Legends?
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS4is7SZgmxXXkLvijf6LBzQb36RfkikDGYPgKpTjQzRV/Portada%20-%20Donde%20esta%20Fallen%20Legends.png </center>

<center>A few days ago, I shared with you my enthusiasm and a breakdown regarding the arrival of the new **Ruleset** called **Fallen Legends** (the one that prohibits summoning **Legendary Archons**). On paper, this **Ruleset** promised to be an earthquake for battles, especially for those of us who depend on **Legendary Archons** in many matches.</center>

><center>Hace unos días compartí con ustedes mi entusiasmo y un desglose sobre la llegada de la nueva **Ruleset** **Fallen Legends** (aquella que prohíbe la invocación de los **Legendary Archons**). En el papel, esta **Ruleset** prometía ser un terremoto para las batallas, especialmente para quienes dependemos de **Archons Legendarios** en muchas de ellas.</center>

### <center>Fallen Legends</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPe1QgUVMJKYcx1hiAhTCeftAxLsrVwf9n51PtVXUwvjS/img_combat-rule_fallen-legends_150%20V2.png</center>

- **Fallen Legends:** You can not summon Legendary Archons.
> **Fallen Legends**: No puedes usar Archons Legendarios.

<center>However, after a full week since its implementation last **12 de mayo de 2026**, my experience in the trenches has been radically different from what I expected. Today, I want to do a critical analysis of a phenomenon that strikes me as curious although it might just be my own perspective and experience which is the incredibly low appearance rate of **Fallen Legends** in the **Wild** format. This situation strongly reminds me of what we discussed in my post about the **Missing Rulesets**.</center>

><center>Sin embargo, tras una semana completa desde su implementación el pasado **12 de mayo de 2026**, mi experiencia en las trincheras ha sido radicalmente distinta a lo que esperaba. Hoy quiero hacer un análisis crítico sobre un fenómeno que me ha parecido curioso aunque puede ser solo mi perspectiva y experiencia que es el bajísimo ratio de aparición de **Fallen Legends** en el formato **Wild**. Una situación que me recuerda enormemente a lo que discutimos en mi publicación sobre las **Missing Rulesets**.</center>


### <center>Expectation vs. Reality in the Wild Format | La Expectativa vs. La Realidad en el Formato Wild</center>

<center>When **Fallen Legends** was announced, my main interest was the immediate shift in the meta. The idea of not having to face those legendary titans, and not being able to depend on them, seemed to open a perfect window to revive old glories and synergies that are sometimes eclipsed by the raw power of **Legendary Archons**. I expected to enter the arena and see this **Ruleset** with a moderate frequency to test my skills, intelligence, and hypotheses.</center>

><center>Cuando se anunció **Fallen Legends**, mi principal interés era el cambio inmediato en el meta. La idea de no tener que enfrentar a esos titanes legendarios y el no poder depender de ellos abría una ventana perfecta para revivir viejas glorias y sinergias que a veces quedan eclipsadas por el poder bruto de los **Archons Legendarios**. Esperaba entrar a la arena y ver esta **Ruleset** con una frecuencia moderada para poner a prueba mis habilidades, inteligencia e hipótesis.</center>

The reality has been a bucket of cold water. So far since the update, I have only had **2** or **3** battles with this active **Ruleset**.

>La realidad ha sido un balde de agua fría. En lo que va de la actualización, solo he tenido **2** o **3** batallas con esta **Ruleset** activa.


### <center>[Battle Vs Faz007](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_8cf0e386433a0c0f9674aa7e8e84b458?ref=durlan)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdrDkEntGuL7AE7rUduaJaUq5EnzVRejdgQm6EQdDiq7S/Faz007%20V2.png </center>

### <center>[Battle Vs Toqs1986-b](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_6a19ab987e7c88c735e068594e806a91?ref=durlan)</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcsabcSK5PrWiXrVLukcLM9V5mZEF1JrgfYbKrfUA4ZE6/Toqs1986-b%20V2.png</center>

<center>I do not know if the story is different in the **Modern** format due to its smaller card pool, but in **Wild**, **Fallen Legends** has turned into a sort of **Ghost Ruleset**. This alarmingly low appearance rate has caused the meta of my daily battles to not change at all. I keep facing the same predictable lineups over and over again, completely defeating the primary purpose of introducing new **Rulesets**: keeping the game fresh, dynamic, and unpredictable.</center>

><center>Desconozco si en el formato **Modern** la historia es diferente debido a su pool de cartas más reducido, pero en **Wild**, **Fallen Legends** se ha convertido en una especie de **Ruleset fantasma**. Este ratio de aparición tan alarmantemente bajo ha provocado que el meta de mis batallas diarias no haya cambiado en lo absoluto. Sigo enfrentando las mismas alineaciones predecibles una y otra vez, anulando por completo el propósito principal de introducir nuevas **Rulesets**: mantener el juego fresco, dinámico e impredecible.</center>

### <center>The Impact on Content Creation and Strategic Analysis | El Impacto en la Creación de Contenido y Análisis Estratégico</center>

<center>For those of us who enjoy sharing technical breakdowns and guides on Hive, the scarcity of a mechanic is a direct blow to our plans. My original intention was to bring you a post full of practical examples, screenshots, and real battle links demonstrating how to win under this restriction. I wanted to give you viable alternatives for when you cannot use the global **Void** from **Immortalis** or the support of other legendary summoners.</center>

><center>Para quienes disfrutamos compartir desgloses técnicos y guías en Hive, la escasez de una mecánica es un golpe directo a nuestros planes. Mi intención original era traerles un post lleno de ejemplos prácticos, capturas de pantalla y enlaces de batallas reales que demostraran cómo ganar bajo esta restricción. Quería darles alternativas viables para cuando no puedan usar el **Void** global de **Immortalis** o el soporte de otros invocadores legendarios.</center>

<center>Unfortunately, with only three battles in my history, it is statistically impossible to carry out a solid strategy analysis. I cannot assure you how effective a team or strategy is if the **Ruleset** does not appear enough to measure the consistency of the results. Much like what happened to me in the **Missing Rulesets** post, where I analyzed the strange absence of certain matches, I find myself in the position of wanting to theorize over a void. The meta does not shift if the **Ruleset** is not played.</center>

><center>Lamentablemente, con solo tres batallas en el historial, es estadísticamente imposible realizar un análisis de estrategias sólido. No puedo asegurarles qué tan efectivo es un equipo o estrategia si la **Ruleset** no aparece lo suficiente como para medir la consistencia de los resultados. Al igual que me ocurrió en el post de **Missing Rulesets**, donde analizaba la extraña ausencia de ciertas mecánicas, me encuentro en la posición de querer teorizar sobre un vacío. El meta no se mueve si la **Ruleset** no se juega.</center>

### <center>Bad Luck in the Algorithm or Covert Exclusive Design? | ¿Mala Suerte en el Algoritmo o Diseño Exclusivo Encubierto?</center>

<center>There is, of course, the possibility that this is simply a matter of chance. The **Splinterlands** matchmaking algorithm manages dozens of combined **Rulesets** and, sometimes, mathematical variance can cause an individual player to experience streaks where a **Ruleset** seems non-existent. However, the total absence of **Fallen Legends** during my first few days of play was so severe that it raised alarms for me.</center>

><center>Existe, por supuesto, la posibilidad de que esto sea simplemente una cuestión de azar. El algoritmo de emparejamiento de **Splinterlands** gestiona docenas de **Rulesets** combinadas y, a veces, la varianza matemática puede hacer que un jugador individual experimente rachas donde una **Ruleset** parece no existir. Sin embargo, la ausencia total de **Fallen Legends** en mis primeros días de juego fue tan severa que me hizo activar las alarmas.</center>

<center>In fact, I seriously came to think that we were facing another case like **Outsider**. As you will remember, **Outsider** arrived as a **Ruleset** thought out and designed specifically for the **Modern** format, having zero impact on environments like **Wild**. Seeing days go by without **Fallen Legends** appearing on my matchmaking screens in **Wild**, my first hypothesis was that the development team had programmed it with an appearance rate close to zero for **Wild**, or that they had directly left it as a Modern exclusive without properly noting it in the patch logs.</center>

><center>De hecho, llegué a pensar seriamente que estábamos ante otro caso como el de **Outsider**. Como recordarán, **Outsider** llegó como una **Ruleset** pensada y diseñada específicamente para el formato **Modern**, teniendo un impacto nulo en entornos como **Wild**. Al ver que pasaban los días y **Fallen Legends** no aparecía en mis pantallas de emparejamiento de **Wild**, mi primera hipótesis fue que el equipo de desarrollo la había programado con un ratio de aparición cercano a cero para **Wild**, o que directamente la habían dejado como una exclusiva de Modern sin avisar adecuadamente en las notas del parche.</center>

<center>Although I have already verified that it can pop up in **Wild** (due to those **2** or **3** countable battles), the fact that its presence is so residual reduces a great design idea to a simple anecdote in the battle log.</center>

><center>Aunque ya comprobé que sí puede salir en **Wild** (por esas **2** o **3** batallas contadas), que su presencia sea tan residual reduce una gran idea de diseño a una simple anécdota en el registro de batallas.</center>

### <center>Losing the Window of Opportunity for Fallen Legends | Perdiendo la Brecha de Oportunidad de Fallen Legends</center>

<center>Truthfully, I think a great opportunity is being lost to have a season or a timeframe where we could take advantage of seeing the effect of not being able to depend on **Legendary Archons** before new **Rulesets** arrive and take priority over them. Even so, I can understand that if **Fallen Legends** were too common, it could affect the card market by making them less useful or limiting them, which would make rentals or sales less profitable if they cannot be used.</center>

><center>La verdad pienso que se está perdiendo bastante la oportunidad de tener una temporada o un plazo de tiempo donde se podía aprovechar para ver el efecto de no poder depender de los **Legendary Archons** antes de que lleguen nuevas **Rulesets** y se les dé prioridad a esas nuevas. Aun así, puedo entender el efecto de que si **Fallen Legends** fuera muy común podría afectar al mercado de tarjetas al no ser tan útiles o limitarlas, lo que haría que las rentas o ventas no sean tan rentables si no se pueden usar.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>In conclusion, **Fallen Legends** has left a rather bitter taste in my mouth, not due to its mechanical design which I still consider excellent and very necessary but because of its execution and distribution in the **Wild** format. We cannot learn to fight without legends if the game refuses to tear them down from their pedestal in our day-to-day encounters.</center>

><center>En conclusión, **Fallen Legends** me ha dejado un sabor de boca bastante amargo, no por su diseño mecánico el cual sigo considerando excelente y muy necesario sino por su ejecución y distribución en el formato **Wild**. No podemos aprender a pelear sin leyendas si el juego se niega a derribarlas de su pedestal en el día a día.</center>

<center>I sincerely hope that this behavior is just a bad luck streak on my part within the game's probability balance. Otherwise, if the rate is intentionally configured to be this low, the team should give it a review and change those stats because we want variety; we want challenges that force us to think outside the box.</center>

><center>Espero sinceramente que este comportamiento sea solo una mala racha de suerte de mi parte en el balance de probabilidad del juego. De lo contrario, si el ratio está configurado para ser así de bajo de forma intencional, que el equipo le dé una revisión y cambien esas estadísticas porque queremos variedad, queremos desafíos que nos fuercen a pensar fuera de la caja.</center>

<center>What about you, players? Have you had better luck than me with **Fallen Legends** in your leagues? Is it appearing often for you in Modern or are you experiencing the same scarcity in **Wild**? Leave your comments below with your battle count for this week to see if we can decode the algorithm's mystery! See you in Rankeds (hopefully with fewer legends next time!).</center>

><center>¿Y ustedes, jugadores? ¿Han tenido mejor suerte que yo con **Fallen Legends** en sus ligas? ¿Les aparece seguido en Modern o están experimentando la misma escasez en **Wild**? ¡Dejen sus comentarios abajo con su número de batallas de esta semana para ver si desciframos el misterio del algoritmo! Nos vemos en Rankeds (¡espero que con menos leyendas la próxima vez!).</center>

body.title: Project Hail Mary // Proyecto Fin del mundo | Movie review
body.body: > Source of images || Portada creada en Canva.

> “Project End of the World,” also known as “Project Salvation,” is a 2026 science fiction film directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller. The story is a cliché—a plot we’ve seen in other films that deal with the end of the world, aliens, and space adventure. I have to say that this used to be one of my favorite genres, but for a while now I’ve been interested in other kinds of stories; even so, I decided to give it a chance, and overall I really liked the result. As always, I want to make it clear that this isn’t a professional review—it’s an opinion based on my personal experience, taking into account how entertained I was and the feelings the film evoked in me. The film begins with a fair amount of uncertainty, as we find a man on a spaceship—the only survivor—who can’t remember anything. Then, little by little, we begin to understand where the story is headed, with Ryland Grace, a science professor, waking up on the ship in space. I like this movie for its story because it combines several interesting genres, including the thriller, as we have several possible scenarios within the story and the plot’s twists and turns gradually unfold. As a story in general, I find it interesting—nothing new, but it does have some unique details, which is why I consider it original. I must say it surprised me quite a bit because I didn’t expect it to also involve aliens. Life on Earth is in danger because the sun is dying due to a strange substance that is killing it, so Ryland Grace is sent to investigate the situation and report back, putting his life at risk because he will most likely not have the chance to return. In the film, we encounter a series of mysteries; as the protagonist regains his memory, we learn more details, so we may be surprised by how it differs from other stories we’ve seen. At first I thought the movie would be boring, since having just one person on the ship is pretty tedious, but we get plenty of great flashbacks to Earth, a smooth transition between the present and the past, which gives the movie meaning. > Proyecto Fin del mundo, que también se conoce como Proyecto Salvación, es una película de este 2026, un filme de ciencia ficción dirigido por Phil Lord y Christopher Miller. La historia de esta producción es un cliché, una trama que podemos ver en otras producciones donde se toca el fin del mundo, los extraterrestres y la aventura espacial. Debo decir que en el pasado este era de mis géneros favoritos, pero de un tiempo para acá me he interesado en otras clases de historias; aun así decidí darle una oportunidad y el resultado logrado con esta película me gustó bastante en general. Como siempre, me gusta aclarar que esta no es una crítica profesional, es una opinión basada en mi experiencia personal, tomando en cuenta mi entretenimiento y las sensaciones logradas con el filme. > La película comienza con bastante incertidumbre, pues nos encontramos con un hombre en una nave espacial, siendo este el único vivo, donde el personaje no se acuerda de nada. Luego, poco a poco nos vamos enterando hacia dónde va la historia, con Ryland Grace, un profesor de ciencia, quien es el que despierta en la nave, en el espacio. Esta película me gusta por su historia porque combina varios géneros interesantes, entre los que se encuentra el thriller, pues tenemos varios escenarios posibles dentro de la historia y poco a poco se van abriendo las aristas de la trama. Como historia en general me parece interesante, nada nuevo, pero sí que tiene algunos detalles, por lo cual la considero original. Debo decir que me sorprendió bastante porque no me imaginé que se trataba también de extraterrestres. > La vida en la Tierra se ve en peligro porque el sol está muriendo por una extraña sustancia que los está matando, por lo que Ryland Grace es enviado a investigar la situación, para que enviara la información, poniendo su vida en riesgo porque lo más probable es que no tendría la oportunidad de regresar. En la película nos encontramos con una serie de enigmas que, a medida que el protagonista va recuperando la memoria, vamos conociendo detalles, por lo que nos podremos sorprender más allá de ser una historia similar a otras que hayamos tenido la oportunidad de ver. Al principio pensé que la película sería aburrida, pues tener a una persona en la nave solo es bastante tedioso, pero tenemos múltiples recuerdos en la Tierra muy buenos, una buena transición entre lo actual y el pasado, dándole sentido a la película.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/EpA2bLxpSnuMFM4qxAFFKwCq3USqzLEjM6ybDvLh2N1qUrx7qQU3QoeZJSL9EKzcJB3.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/Eo8M4dbcqmu5gqYaJEJEAoL5BJZdKJ3ktoR2yjSh83vnaF89aXjXfyaR83vQmpxwDHb.png)

> Source Life on Earth is in danger because the sun is dying due to a strange substance that is killing it, so Ryland Grace is sent to investigate the situation and report back, putting his life at risk because he will most likely not have the chance to return. In the film, we encounter a series of mysteries; as the protagonist regains his memory, we learn more details, so we may be surprised by how it differs from other stories we’ve seen. At first I thought the movie would be boring, since having just one person on the ship is pretty tedious, but we get plenty of great flashbacks to Earth, a smooth transition between the present and the past, which gives the movie meaning. > La historia de la película está bastante bien ejecutada; al principio algo lenta pero luego va agarrando ritmo. La mayor parte de la historia se centra en el profesor Grace, que es interpretado por Ryan Gosling, haciendo un maravilloso trabajo con su personaje, un personaje un poco extraño, con bastantes conocimientos, pero también divertido, dándole un toque de humor al filme en algunos momentos; no solo es tensión. Pues en cuanto al cast, no tengo mucho más que ofrecer, pues tenemos otros personajes secundarios, que algunos tienen algo de relevancia en la historia, pero todo se centra en el profesor, quien debe tratar de cumplir con su misión, incluso cuando se haya sentido traicionado.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/23uQNnbJ2RSvM7prFczPjMASVrnKzfEFWBoFP4DGpogRNAM51r3U3MsmwpwAsNo9Cyq16.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/EoCbQb4xkCsgztVeF67mdELwKGgaimTW13iTDStGV4gDXzFpxJtA4Pt9HAHoKmGThMB.png)![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/EoEiitr6hQpH2bqAwRrwAHT6J9x61fLm2StLPy1Bp1uAKVvtiKUs2fQXV1PSfG1UYsU.png)

> Source Greig Fraser handled the cinematography and did a fantastic job. I loved the film visually—from the spaceship itself to how they recreated all the systems inside it, the technology, and more. I also loved the flashbacks to science teacher Ryland Grace, showing how they conducted all the tests for the mission and the research they undertook to find a solution—otherwise, there would be no tomorrow. But from my point of view, the best part of all is the soundtrack—compositions that reflected the moments our protagonists were going through, the moments of tension, of not knowing what was happening, some tracks even in dark moments that are perfect for a thriller, but also those with more movement for certain moments that can bring a smile to our faces. “The Martian” is a film adaptation of the novel written by Andy Weir, and even though I haven't read the book, I think the adaptation—while perhaps not perfect—was certainly good enough to capture my attention, despite my low expectations. It’s a production with a story that builds steadily, cinematography that lives up to the film’s scale, and a soundtrack that I consider exceptional—the best part of all. I really recommend watching the film if you haven’t already; I’m sure you won’t be disappointed. > La fotografía estuvo a cargo de Greig Fraser, haciendo un gran trabajo. Me encantó la película en lo visual, tanto la nave especial, como recrearon todos los sistemas dentro de ella, la tecnología y más. Además, también de los recuerdos del profesor de ciencias Ryland Grace, como realizaron todas las pruebas para la misión, las respectivas investigaciones para encontrar una solución o no habría un mañana. Pero desde mi punto de vista, lo mejor de todo es la banda sonora, unas composiciones que reflejaban el momento que estaban pasando nuestros protagonistas, los momentos de tensión, de no saber lo que está pasando, unos temas incluso en momentos oscuros que son perfectos para un thriller, pero también aquellos más movidos para algunos momentos que nos pueden sacar una sonrisa. > Proyecto Fin del mundo es una película, una adaptación de la novela escrita por Andy Weir, y, aun no haber leído la historia literaria, considero que la adaptación no sé si fue perfecta, pero sí bastante buena para captar mi atención a pesar de tener expectativas bajas. Una producción con una historia que va de menos a más, una fotografía que está a la altura de un proyecto como el filme y una banda sonora que considero que es excepcional, lo mejor de todo. Realmente les recomiendo ver el filme si aún no lo han hecho; estoy seguro de que no se llevarán una decepción.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/franz54/23tvVqaTVf4fxNdNrxSLCXgUZMaX8R6pT9XWczEurpjNvYNLRiehNQuxXyfy7gz84wnTz.png)

body.body:
***I took this photo from the tourist bus I was traveling on. I was touring India and always had my camera ready. That's how I came across this truck on the road and this friendly gentleman on top. body.title: La soledad de ser amada por lo que no eres |  The loneliness of being loved for what you are not
body.body:
> Hay personas que aseguran haberse enamorado, mencionan lo perfectas que son sus parejas y lo afortunados que son de tenerlas en su vida. Para ellas todo es como un sueño, y aunque para sus parejas aparentemente sea de la misma manera, con el tiempo se darán cuenta de que la persona que ellos aman y lo que son es totalmente diferente. Quizás en un principio sea difícil aceptar este hecho porque el otro es tan increíble que no quisiera romper ese vínculo ni admitir que el amor era solo una ilusión. Sin embargo, tarde o temprano tendrá que aceptar esa realidad, la realidad de que era una idealización.
\n\n

> Esta de ese lado es difícil; te hace sentir mal que todas esas palabras tan bonitas y esas acciones increíbles que hacían latir tu corazón fueron hechas para alguien que estaba en su cabeza y no para quien realmente eres. Tal vez incluso llegas a aceptar su realidad después de escuchar tantas afirmaciones o termines amoldándote a sus ilusiones para no quedar solo.
\n\n

>Yo pasé por algo así, al principio era maravilloso, era la persona perfecta y nos llevábamos increíble. Algunas veces decía cosas sobre mí que no eran verdad, pero lo afirmaba con tanto entusiasmo que se me hacía difícil contradecirlo; además, me invadía el miedo de desagradarle. Con el tiempo ya era demasiado obvio y eso rompe el corazón, te hace sentir realmente mal que todos los momentos juntos no te hubiese visto como lo que eres en realidad, sino como imagen de ti.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/6142392/pexels-photo-6142392.jpeg
Imagen de

> Emocionalmente es terriblemente agotador porque muchas veces, ya sea de forma consciente o no, no se quiere romper esa ilusión por la comodidad que ofrece o por el tiempo invertido. Pero en el camino te pierdes a ti mismo. Es realmente solitario ser amado por algo que no eres.
\n\n

> Es difícil descubrir o por fin admitir que los sentimientos que creíamos verdaderos eran solo producidos por su imaginación y que todo el tiempo no fuiste más que un medio para cumplir sus fantasías. Duele darse cuenta de que todo el tiempo fuiste manipulada hasta convertirte en la imagen más cercana que esa persona tenía en su mente; duele darse cuenta de que esa persona no te conoce realmente y no te ama por lo que eres.
\n\n

> Cuando salí de una relación así, estaba confundida, realmente confundida, y a veces me sentía como si estuviese en el limbo. Después comencé a aceptar y querer todos los defectos que formaban parte de mí, en especial aquellos que él negaba. No fue fácil ni algo que pasó de la noche a la mañana, tal vez porque era bastante joven, pero me afectó bastante.
\n\n

> Todos nosotros somos valiosos y dignos de ser amados con todo y nuestros defectos, por eso no permitamos que alguien nos encapsule en una imagen o intente cambiar lo que somos. No aceptemos esa clase de relación solo porque es cómoda y agradable, después de todo, al final nos sentiremos solos y perderemos nuestra identidad. Para nuestra propia paz mental, es mejor buscar a alguien que tome nuestra mano con todo lo que eso conlleva.

Gracias por leer

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png

English

![usuario ss (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/s-alvarez/23yd1iPnxnGFQdHMyNprcrSSSs7mYNxbXsNStMpC5bZtkSGajGSsXkbLFGuBTXM4LV2Cf.png)

> There are people who claim to have fallen in love, talking about how perfect their partners are and how lucky they are to have them in their lives. For them, everything feels like a dream, and although it may seem the same way to their partners, over time they will realize that the person they love and who they really are are two completely different things. Perhaps at first it’s hard to accept this fact because the other person is so incredible that you don’t want to break that bond or admit that the love was just an illusion. However, sooner or later you’ll have to accept that reality—the reality that it was an idealization.
\n\n

> This part is tough; it makes you feel bad that all those beautiful words and incredible gestures that made your heart race were meant for someone who existed only in his head, and not for who you really are. Maybe you even end up accepting his reality after hearing so many assurances, or you end up conforming to his illusions just so you won’t be alone.

>I went through something like that. At first, it was wonderful—he was the perfect person, and we got along incredibly well. Sometimes he would say things about me that weren’t true, but he said them with such enthusiasm that it was hard for me to contradict him; plus, I was overcome by the fear of displeasing him. Over time, it became too obvious, and that breaks your heart—it makes you feel really bad that during all the time we spent together, he hadn’t seen you for who you really are, but only as an image of yourself.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/6142392/pexels-photo-6142392.jpeg
Image by

>Emotionally, it’s incredibly draining because so often—whether consciously or not—you don’t want to shatter that illusion, either because of the comfort it provides or because of the time you’ve invested. But along the way, you lose sight of who you really are. It’s truly lonely to be loved for something you’re not.
\n\n

> It’s hard to realize—or finally admit—that the feelings we thought were real were just a figment of their imagination, and that all along you were nothing more than a means to fulfill their fantasies. It hurts to realize that you were manipulated all along until you became the closest thing to the image that person had in their mind; it hurts to realize that that person doesn’t really know you and doesn’t love you for who you are.
\n\n

> When I came out of a relationship like that, I was confused—really confused—and sometimes I felt like I was in limbo. Then I started to accept and love all the flaws that were part of me, especially the ones he denied. It wasn’t easy, nor did it happen overnight—maybe because I was pretty young—but it really affected me.
\n\n

> We are all valuable and worthy of love, flaws and all, so let’s not allow anyone to box us into a certain image or try to change who we are. Let’s not settle for that kind of relationship just because it’s comfortable and pleasant; after all, in the end, we’ll feel alone and lose our sense of self. For our own peace of mind, it’s better to find someone who will take our hand—with all that entails.

body.title: Reality of AI work
body.body:
Stuff that folks make with AI is often scrutinized hard and hated, it's almost like cheating right? ![aa0ffd11-00d9-40c5-b837-7f03e0546e1c.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bitcoinman/EpnDfoBH5wxYkbNiK5iTMXyMVNFmRKfYnS424GMJwHhNQBGbfsKab5fgmh2aznEA1i2.png) An image I generated with AI I don't agree, AI more so shifts the work dynamics. We move more from conducting the raw work to delegating and validating the work AI does for us. Essentially our work moves to a managerial position, the best managerial gig ever.... With humans there is no way to have management without subordination, now subordination isn't inherently bad however this power dynamic often leads to abuse. Taking the human element out of the subordinates makes for a more humane system, often people just feel like cogs in the machine being utilized until they crap out and are replaced. These AI models do not mind being cogs in your machine, beyond this giant ethical benefit of AI work, there are other benefits that do not come with exploiting human labor, let's be real folks if we breaking even where is the profit come from bud ? Someone gotta get shorted. So we got AI workers that do not mind being exploited, do not get tired or need brakes or compensations or vacations... You want to be future proof? Step up your managerial skills. That's going to be the job to stick around the longest before everything is fully replaced, and this doesn't mean you have to necessarily be using the AI. It's going to get way easier to use it. It's more so the managerial skills that would apply in any situation

body.title: Bamble church, Norway's first Gothic Revival (neo-Gothic) wooden church
body.body: > Hello, friends, travelers, and community members! I hope everyone is doing well. It's Wednesday, which means it's time to share a midweek walk in our community and some enjoyable experiences. We visited the Bamble Church, which is known as Norway's first Neo-Gothic church, alongside the ruins of the Olav Church. We hadn't originally planned to visit this church, as our friend Anni lives nearby, and over the years, we've visited her several times. However, we had never thought of seeing the church. The last few years it was under some repairs.
> Last week, we celebrated Anni's birthday, and after enjoying a hearty meal, we decided to go for a walk. We were fortunate with the weather—sunshine, no wind, and pleasant walking temperatures.
> The church is conveniently located just 200-300 meters from Anni's house, right along the old highway E18.
> On the other side of the highway, you can find charming, typical Norwegian houses surrounded by beautiful green landscapes.
> The highway E18 is an optional route used when rushed traffic, so for people's convenience this small cross-under the highway. It is a small shortcut to get to the other side.
> On the other side, some residential houses are also located.
> After crossing the road, we enter the rear side of the church campus. There are some houses surrounding the church, some storage rooms, the priest's residence, etc.
> This attractive stained glass window must be very beautiful at night.
> The west side of the church wall. Very skilled woodwork.

> Here is the front side of the church. I’ll share a bit about it based on what I heard from Anni and what is written on the information sign. Bamble Church is a neo-Gothic wooden church located in the Bamble and Herre parish within Bamble municipality. It was built of wood and consecrated in 1845. Although it looks small, it has a seating capacity of 400. Unfortunately, Norwegian churches are not open to visitors every day; they are typically open on Sundays and for special services, which are the only opportunities to see the interior. We visited on a Saturday, so it was closed. The church is situated directly north of the cemetery, which contains the ruins of a previous stone church from the Middle Ages.
> The monument for people from that parish killed in 2world war.
> The whole area surrounded the church
> If we know the read Norwegian, here is the sign written about the Bamble church and Olav church.

>\nOn the south side of the church lies the cemetery, and beyond it, the ruins of the old Olav church. All the graves are clean and decorated with flowers; some are new, while others date back to the 19th century. Walking along that path isn't scary; it feels more like a stroll in a park. Walking along that path isn't scary; it feels more like a stroll in a park.\n

> At the end of the cemetery, the church's ruin, it was made of stone. The sign mentioned it was built in 1150 and was the largest church in Telemark County. It was bigger than what ruins are standing there now.

> This metal sign indicates the background of this church. It mentioned it was classic Roman Northern style. When it started falling apart, the new Bamble church had planned to serve the parish of the surrounding area. The church was consecrated in 1845 and 1846 the old church was demolished.
> We were strolling around it had some evidence of how nice it was at that time. After seeing this arch no doubt about.

> After looking at the ruins of this historical building, we just imagined how beautiful it was at that time. With this thought, we turned back and headed to Anni's house. But I didn't forget to take a few more photos of the church in evening lights.

>
This is all about today's post.
Thank you for stopping by.

昨天晚上接欢欢时，香港老大给我发信息，说是要我买瓶碘伏，我说好，我在想是不是哪里刮伤了，回到家楼下，买好就放在包里。

今天一早上班，也是很忙,q老板还要我买些水果给这写客人吃，所以一大早来到公司也挺忙的，以至于香港老大发信息给我，我也没有看到，后来他又打电话我，说是要我问问行政部有车没。

跟行政部问了问，他们说9点才有车，今天也不知是什么天气，一大早雨下得特别大，我到办公室时，我的裤子都湿了。上了公交，那司机还把空调开得很低，我冻死了，我跟司机说明情况，问他可不可以关空调，结果他说关了空调，这么大的雨，到时玻璃会有很多的雾,听到他这样说，我也不无话可说。

话说老板找我找车，做什么呢，原来是去医院 ，我们也不知老大怎么了，别人问我，老板怎么了，我说也不知道，过了大概四十多分钟，老板回来了，叫我去他办公室，他把眼镜取下来了，这一看更是吓死了，眼睛都肿了，他跟我讲，昨天晚上出去跑步，不小心摔了一交。

看着他的伤心，感觉挺严重的，想着这几天真的是天天有受伤的人，今天也不例外，又有一个人受伤，想着就恐怖，老板去医院看过两次，看到他那样，我今天跑了几次医院室，帮他拿药。

到了医务室，那医生说，最近交通事故发生多，还有虎门什么地方，有一个本地人开车撞了三个本地人，那个三个本地人，有个是大人，两个是小孩，结果那个本地人把这三个撞死了，后来那个本地人既然想逃到国外人，不过，还是被抓到了。

看着这些， 真的不知下一刻会怎么样，还是好好珍惜现在好呀，老板还把他开始受伤的情影拍照了，给我看，看着这一张一张受张的相片 ，更加怕了，我又有感慨，这人活着真的太难了，每个人不容易。

今天也不是怎么搞的，雨下得好大，回到家雨还在下，同事们都说，端午节前一直会有雨，而且里内的湿气也重，还是多锻炼身体好，520还好收到老公祝福，有点小开心哟。

---

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

The other day, my brother and I were working with a set of cord, it was a big set. We decided to cut the cord in pieces to make it faster and easier, we thought it would be better working with the cords cut than doing everything all at once.



Eventually it worked out well.
We were faster than usual and it was less stressful.
But we had cut more cord than we should, it was a small price to pay for the easier method we just applied.
At least, the left over cord can be used some other time.
We were skeptical about cutting the cord but cutting the cord eventually paid off.

> ![español.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23yd9wZPBaPKw5HFDYLUPN9j4qLYrD8Xci2NgBKrFwgWe14NHavfwHUnjC1sQvQXLjGFp.png) Hola hivers de la cocina creativa, ¿A quién no le gusta una pasta calientita con bastante queso gratinado? La receta que te comparto hoy es una de las favoritas de mi sobrino Miguel, que recién cumplió 15 años; siempre que puedo le preparo una bandeja para él solo. Se trata de la lasagna italiana. En Venezuela hicimos nuestra propia versión de este popular plato italiano, le pusimos por nombre *pasticho*, que se prepara normalmente para celebrar ocasiones especiales: día de la madre, día del padre, cumpleaños, aniversarios, navidad o año nuevo. La *lasagna* es uno de los platos más antiguos de Italia. Dicen los historiadores que su aparición data desde finales del siglo XII, donde se describe en un poema de Jacopone di Tadi. Esa receta combina pasta al huevo con espinacas, intercalando capas de salsa de carne y salsa bechamel, y en la última capa se añade queso parmesano y se gratina en el horno. Esta receta hoy recorre el mundo y puedes degustarla en los mejores restaurantes del gourmet italiano. El palabra *pasticho* proviene del griego *pasticcio*, un plato similar al nuestro que se prepara con capas de pasta, carne en salsa y bechamel. En el caso del *pasticho* venezolano, cada hogar tiene su propia versión de la receta original (pasta, espinaca, salsa boloña, salsa bechamel y parmesano) de acuerdo a sus costumbres y su sazón. Nosotros no le ponemos espinacas a las capas. Por lo general, ponemos entre las capas de pasta y las salsas lonjas de jamón y queso mozzarella. Hay familias que a la salsa boloña le agregan guisantes; hay quienes le colocan plátano frito a las capas junto con el queso y el jamón; incluso hay una variante que se prepara con una salsa de pollo desmenuzado y la pasta es reemplazada por láminas de berenjenas. ¡Todas muy buenas y deliciosas jajajaja!. A mi sobrino no le gustan esas versiones que tengan berenjenas, guisantes, plátano o pollo. Hoy te traigo mi versión, bien sencilla, pero deliciosa. Esta preparación lleva varios ingredientes; para algunos puede resultar un plato algo costoso. **``` INGREDIENTES:```** Para 6 personas

>

## MY VERSION OF VENEZUELAN PASTICHO

<div class= \

> ![ingles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23ynYxDZufJebWDsXDADMnf4UrueESVTkKmtp3k8NsBqytTwT4tYy4fXexYVGR6T8BUkp.png) Hello, creative cooking fans, Who doesn’t love a warm plate of pasta topped with plenty of melted cheese? The recipe I’m sharing with you today is one of my nephew Miguel’s favorites—he just turned 15—and whenever I can, I make a whole tray just for him. It’s Italian lasagna. In Venezuela, we created our own version of this popular Italian dish; we call it *pasticho*, which is usually prepared to celebrate special occasions: Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, or New Year’s. *Lasagna* is one of Italy’s oldest dishes. Historians say it dates back to the late 12th century, as described in a poem by Jacopone da Tadi. That recipe combines egg pasta with spinach, layering it with meat sauce and béchamel sauce, and the top layer is sprinkled with Parmesan cheese and baked until golden. Today, this recipe is enjoyed worldwide, and you can savor it at the finest Italian gourmet restaurants. The word *pasticho* comes from the Greek *pasticcio*, a dish similar to ours that is prepared with layers of pasta, meat in sauce, and béchamel. In the case of Venezuelan *pasticho*, every household has its own version of the original recipe (pasta, spinach, Bolognese sauce, béchamel sauce, and Parmesan) according to their customs and seasoning. We don’t add spinach to the layers. We usually layer slices of ham and mozzarella cheese between the pasta and the sauces. Some families add peas to the Bolognese sauce; others include fried plantains in the layers along with the cheese and ham; there’s even a variation made with shredded chicken sauce, where the pasta is replaced by slices of eggplant. They’re all really good and delicious, hahaha! My nephew doesn’t like the versions with eggplant, peas, plantains, or chicken. Today I’m sharing my version—very simple, but delicious. This recipe calls for several ingredients; for some, it might be a bit pricey. **```INGREDIENTS:```** Serves 6 *** ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23xAcRzNYFubiMJsFKZqyVob4pJTyg3CDnEtyCmnQgofJfBDmnUtUsjyozEQc8qrtehfK.png) ***

> **Para el armado del pasticho** 🍝 3 cajas de 250 gramos de láminas de pasticho directo al horno 🍝 Salsa boloña 🍝 1 litro de salsa bechamel 🍝 Queso parmesano al gusto 🍝 ½ kilo de queso mozzarella 🍝 ½ kilo de jamón de pierna **Para la salsa boloña** 🍅 1 kilo de carne molida 🍅 1 cebolla 🍅 3 tomates maduros 🍅 3 dientes de ajo 🍅 1 ají dulce 🍅 ½ pimentón rojo 🍅 Sal y orégano al gusto 🍅 Albahaca en polvo al gusto 🍅 2 cucharadas de aceite 🍅 Hojitas de cilantro **Para la salsa bechamel** 🥛 1 litro de agua filtrada 🥛 Sal al gusto 🥛 1 cucharadita de nuez moscada rallada 🥛 45 gramos de mantequilla 🥛 3 cucharadas de harina de trigo 🥛 6 cucharadas de leche en polvo **```PREPARACIÓN:```** Esta receta tiene varios pasos previos antes de armar el pasticho y hornear. **Vamos con la salsa boloña** En un recipiente, coloca la carne molida y sazona con sal, orégano y albahaca en polvo al gusto. Si tienes, puedes colocarle un chorrito de vino tinto para cocinar. Reserva.

> **To assemble the lasagna** 🍝 3 250-gram packages of oven-ready lasagna noodles 🍝 Bolognese sauce 🍝 1 liter of béchamel sauce 🍝 Parmesan cheese to taste 🍝 ½ kilo of mozzarella cheese 🍝 ½ kilo of ham **For the Bolognese sauce** 🍅 1 kilo of ground beef 🍅 1 onion 🍅 3 ripe tomatoes 🍅 3 cloves of garlic 🍅 1 sweet pepper 🍅 ½ red bell pepper 🍅 Salt and oregano to taste 🍅 Dried basil to taste 🍅 2 tablespoons of oil 🍅 Cilantro leaves **For the béchamel sauce** 🥛 1 liter of filtered water 🥛 Salt to taste 🥛 1 teaspoon of grated nutmeg 🥛 45 grams of butter 🥛 3 tablespoons of all-purpose flour 🥛 6 tablespoons of powdered milk **```PREPARATION:```** This recipe involves several steps before assembling the pasticho and baking it. **Let’s start with the Bolognese sauce** In a bowl, place the ground beef and season with salt, oregano, and dried basil to taste. If you have it, you can add a splash of red wine for cooking. Set aside. *** ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zkph2o8Vsk3Fu6H3R57dWpjTqQhPR9jPRmgbUHRTdkdo6cstqJGZHAcjpAdfXMe7yw9.png) ***

> En una tabla, corta los vegetales previamente lavados con agua filtrada y vinagre. Tritura los ajos; corta la cebolla, el ají dulce, los tomates y el pimentón en cubos; corta las hojas de cilantro bien pequeñas. Reserva.

> On a cutting board, chop the vegetables after washing them with filtered water and vinegar. Mince the garlic; dice the onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, and paprika; finely chop the cilantro leaves. Set aside. *** ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23yJM3dwSS8cEYhHz8Zwx9Gvn92uvMU2MUobriPuyiBtyd5ScLbAx7giMoHTeoL9hXPhZ.png) ***

> En una olla grande, coloca una cucharada de aceite y espera a que caliente. Incorpora la carne molida y revuelve poco a poco, rompiendo la carne en trozos pequeños, ayúdate con un tenedor. Deja cocinar a fuego bajo hasta que la carne haya perdido su color rojo.

> In a large pot, add a tablespoon of oil and let it heat up. Add the ground beef and stir gently, breaking it up into small pieces with a fork. Cook over low heat until the meat is no longer pink. *** ![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zS3SgEzo3bCF5Km9LNk3kfdR4czyJcykrRbW5gtnkrfERr9JkMhmw4cdGn97viffCaq.png) ***

> Mientras tanto cocinemos los vegetales. En una sartén calienta una cucharada de aceite. Incorpora al ajo triturado y cocina fuego medio durante unos segundos o hasta que empiece a dorar. Agrega la cebolla y cocina por 1 minutos aproximadamente. Incorpora el ají, el pimentón y los tomates; condimenta con sal, orégano y albahaca al gusto y continúa cocinando por unos minutos más hasta que los vegetales suelten todos sus jugos y sabor.

> In the meantime, let’s cook the vegetables. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook over medium heat for a few seconds, or until it begins to brown. Add the onion and cook for about 1 minute. Add the chili pepper, paprika, and tomatoes; season with salt, oregano, and basil to taste, and continue cooking for a few more minutes until the vegetables release all their juices and flavor. *** ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zS7ExhpPbvBirWPc7Wr5DHh7pXdgn5eDmWTQgSCdpT7oPmUnQoiaCa77F6vj3cBwjcV.png) ***

> En la licuadora, procesa este aderezo de vegetales con un poquito de agua a velocidad alta. Incorpora esta mezcla a la olla con la carne molida. Revuelve para mezclar bien y cocina a fuego lento hasta que hierva. Una vez que la salsa haya hervido, agrega el cilantro picadito para que le de sabor, también puedes incorporar unas hojitas de laurel. Algunas personas le colocan pasta de tomate o salsa de tomate para darle un toque dulce, yo trato de hacerlo lo más natural posible.

> In a blender, blend this vegetable mixture with a little water on high speed. Add this mixture to the pot with the ground beef. Stir to combine well and simmer until it comes to a boil. Once the sauce has come to a boil, add the finely chopped cilantro for flavor; you can also add a few bay leaves. Some people add tomato paste or tomato sauce to give it a sweet touch, but I try to keep it as natural as possible. *** ![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/241tZGibF2W8m2ABaiRvf7cbJ8o7KVbgEQr74GCb7TQYgEcPTcMPvRfA26Zb74v8PqY96.png) ![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23y8wwGcUV2y2tFhbrThm3rinREGaQPGJorX12fiJiKygRiPsyPgEnsvLvC1JZkJBgaVX.png) ***

> **Mientras tanto, vamos con la salsa bechamel** En una tabla, corta media cebolla morada en cubitos pequeños. Reserva. En la licuadora, coloca el litro de agua y procesa la leche en polvo y la harina hasta que queden bien mezcladas. Muchas personas, cocinan la harina con la mantequilla y luego colocan leche líquida en la olla y cocinan. Pero, para que no me queden grumos a la salsa, yo prefiero licuar los ingredientes primero y luego cocinarlos y me queda con buena consistencia.

> **Meanwhile, let's make the béchamel sauce** On a cutting board, dice half a red onion into small cubes. Set aside. In a blender, add the liter of water and blend the powdered milk and flour until well combined. Many people cook the flour with butter and then add liquid milk to the pot and cook it. But to avoid lumps in the sauce, I prefer to blend the ingredients first and then cook them, which gives me a nice consistency. *** ![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zGh2sJ5t3LFs7pa8W6YGUc19AZXc7LTqNoT1Jb9EnZKcdV6cZiPZ4kSPAyHQfHSqNZX.png) ***

> En una olla, derrite la mantequilla. Una vez que esté fundida, incorpora la cebolla picada y cocina por aproximadamente un minuto. Agrega la mezcla anterior y mueve constantemente con una paleta de madera para evitar que se pegue o queme. Una vez que comience a espesar, añade la sal y la nuez moscada. Continúa moviendo por 5 minutos más. Apagar el fuego y reservar.

> In a saucepan, melt the butter. Once melted, add the chopped onion and cook for about a minute. Add the previous mixture and stir constantly with a wooden spoon to prevent it from sticking or burning. Once it begins to thicken, add the salt and nutmeg. Continue stirring for 5 more minutes. Turn off the heat and set aside. *** ![10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zktR1xxXNzhe6Rp3CFmfLG6X7CGd9DuE2zTMc4XSRwH1B2RusRHpFLy7ziUdkW2USaD.png) ***

> **Armemos el pasticho** Precalentar el horno a 180ºC. En una bandeja para horno, extiende salsa bechamel. Luego, agrega una primera capa de pasta y sobre ella extiende salsa boloña; coloca una capa de queso mozzarella y una de jamón y finalmente agrega otra capa de salsa bechamel.

> **Let's assemble the lasagna** Preheat the oven to 180°C. Spread the béchamel sauce on a baking sheet. Next, add a layer of pasta, then spread the Bolognese sauce over it; add a layer of mozzarella cheese and a layer of ham, and finally top with another layer of béchamel sauce. *** ![11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/242YACFFumT2nLfLXoKCKY6DiintwQjpAJqd1v8MLJ3UmBL7ew9vNKbUEAauddqTBTSHW.png) ***
> Repite este proceso hasta llegar al tope de bandeja, en mi caso hice 3 capas de pasta. En total 18 capas, sigue el esquema:

> Repeat this process until you reach the top of the tray; in my case, I made 3 layers of dough. A total of 18 layers—follow the diagram: *** ![12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23uR7A3qdGykLsxfUrN339RrGQaNHHnNxM8XhMPJBzDi1vdib3yi8QYYe7EZnXRcyPkBN.png) ***

> Al finalizar la última capa de salsa bechamel, espolvorea queso parmesano sobre toda la superficie y coloca unos puntitos de salsa de tomate. Lleva el pasticho al horno y cocina durante 30 minutos aproximadamente o hasta que sientas que la pasta este blandita. Introduce un cuchillo de mesa en el centro del pasticho, si sale seco es porque la cocción ya está lista. Retira del horno y deja enfriar por unos minutos antes de cortarlo.

> Once you've finished spreading the last layer of béchamel sauce, sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the entire surface and dot it with tomato sauce. Place the pasticho in the oven and bake for about 30 minutes or until the pasta is tender. Insert a table knife into the center of the pasticho; if it comes out clean, it’s done. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before cutting. *** ![13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23zbRyCjPQJsSyFYT3hW4qBa69FFAAdhvfNhdhFVNJ3t7if6xBqC3aUtuRiDmV4VF2QfL.png) ***
> Muchas gracias por leerme hasta aquí. ¿Has preparado pasticho? ¿Cómo es tu versión? Te leo en los comentarios. ¡Nos leemos en la próxima receta creativa!

> Thank you so much for reading this far. Have you ever made pasticho? What’s your version like? Let me know in the comments. See you in the next creative recipe! *** ![14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23xAdykBSeLAmguKrgfqnGnHNW6pNwpPRVnnscWFgTdpZ7JEpJcYtC8Kr5Hn3sfMjGxpB.png) *** *** *Versión en inglés traducida con DeepL / English version translated with DeepL *100% contenido original / 100% original content. *Banners elaborados con la combinación de diferentes vectores de Canvas y Adobe Photoshop / Banners created using a combination of different Canvas vectors and Adobe Photoshop. *Tomas realizadas con mi celular Nokia 2.3 / Shots taken with my Nokia 2.3 cell phone. *** ![banner.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23sxr5U7merW4D381Nx3vGwdkqEoy9iSYNyK5rwzVwogg1x5mkWd7KwPfV6ei4C84BHaS.gif)
