body.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: olor desagradable / 5 Minute Freewrite: unpleasant perfume
body.body:
>



# Eliminar

​

#


Los olores pertenecen a cada lugar, cosa y hasta las personas tienen un aroma particular que los distingue y ese recuerdo queda en la memoria olfativa que inmediatamente te lleva a un viaje solo por un olor que puede ser que esté cargado de mucha historia, sentimientos, momentos inolvidables que siempre te llevara a esos recuerdos. 

Una casa por ejemplo que es para muchos ese lugar seguro a donde no olvidas volver tiene características únicas entre muchas el olor la identifica en ciertos casos es a flores, perfume, pan dentro del horno, a galletas o a chimenea y eso es muy cálido y reconfortante para muchos. A veces el olor a una prenda nos gusta tanto que queremos dormir con ella cuando nos recuerda a alguien como huelen los bebés, las mamás o las abuelas con aromas incomparables; en lugares así como el hogar o con personas que nos gusta su olor no nos queremos separar y son fácil de recordar.

En cambio, cuando se trata de un **olor desagradable** que no puedes tolerar ni por un minuto es algo que no quieres oler nunca; cuando entramos a un lugar que huele a humedad, desechos, animal muerto, basura descompuesta y hasta otros tantos tipos de olores que pueden ser más que desagradables porque te descomponen el cuerpo puedes vomitar, desmayar o sentirte realmente mal. Un mal olor no trae nada bueno y cuando se trata de limpiar un espacio lo hace tratando de eliminarlo por completo y si fuera una persona que lamentablemente tiene muy mal olor tratas de alejarte porque es vergonzoso decirle que huele mal.
​


​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



#  Delete

​

#
Smells are unique to every place and thing, and even people have a particular scent that sets them apart. That memory is stored in your olfactory memory, which instantly takes you on a journey—all because of a single scent that may be steeped in history, emotions, and unforgettable moments that will always bring those memories back.
​
Take a home, for example—for many people, it’s that safe haven they never forget to return to. It has unique characteristics, and among them, its scent sets it apart. In some cases, it smells of flowers, perfume, bread baking in the oven, cookies, or a fireplace, and that’s very warm and comforting to many. Sometimes we like the smell of a piece of clothing so much that we want to sleep with it when it reminds us of someone—like the way babies, moms, or grandmothers smell, with their incomparable scents. In places like home or with people whose scent we love, we don’t want to be apart from them, and they’re easy to remember.

On the other hand, when it comes to an **unpleasant odor** that you can’t stand for even a minute, it’s something you never want to smell; when we walk into a place that smells of dampness, waste, dead animals, rotting garbage, and even other types of odors that can be more than just unpleasant—because they make you physically sick—you might vomit, faint, or feel really ill. A bad smell brings nothing good, and when it comes to cleaning a space, you try to eliminate it completely. And if it were a person who unfortunately smells very bad, you try to stay away because it’s embarrassing to tell them they smell bad.
​


#

body.title: Dzambhala
body.body:
Long ago, while the Buddha was teaching, a dark energy sought to silence his words of peace, raining heavy stones down upon him. 
Without a second thought for his safety, Dzambhala stepped forward. He used his own body as a shield, taking the blows meant for his teacher.

He was struck, and he felt the pain-just as we feel the \

of life-the worries about our families, the fear of not having enough, and the struggle to survive.

Seeing his distress, the Buddha approached Dzambhala. He didn't just use medicine; he emitted a soothing, nectar-like energy from his hand and poured it over Dzambhala's head.

The cooling sensation of the sacred nectar immediately cleared the heat of the injury, healed the wound, and relieved Dzambhala's suffering.

Overwhelmed with gratitude, Dzambhala bowed to the Buddha and made a vow. He promised that if anyone ever found themselves in poverty or suffering, and they poured water over his head, He would help them.

body.title: The Good and Bad Side of Financial Transparency
body.body:
> *One thing I have come to learn about life is that there is an advantage and a disadvantage to everything…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTs12jceFNekitDumXzk2eTduNeaqG8jww95tfCSgaa5/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/office-meeting-business-7853103/) *The Hive Learners prompt of the week is another topic that has both advantages and disadvantages, and I will talk about the advantages first…* *If we ever find ourselves in a system where everyone’s salary and earnings are published online for the public to see, one major advantage of that kind of setting is that crime will reduce drastically*… *First, it will affect our politicians and leaders. All the money they collect from us through taxes will no longer be easy to hide or spend recklessly because people will be watching. They won’t be able to move public funds into personal accounts freely because they will have to explain why government money is sitting inside a private account instead of being used for the welfare of the country and its citizens*… *Our politicians and leaders are heavily overpaid. Some people know this already, but many people don’t know the exact salaries and benefits they receive from public funds. If everyone gets to know this information, it may force them to adjust and become more careful with how they waste public money…* *Another advantage is that youths involved in fraud will find it difficult to hide illegal wealth. Imagine a secondary school student without a job, driving expensive cars, and living in luxury; people will naturally ask questions about where the money came from. Ritualists and criminals with sudden wealth will also struggle to explain themselves if financial records are publicly visible…* *Another important thing is the issue of pretenders. It is funny how someone with 100 million in their account can sit beside you complaining about hardship and claiming they haven’t eaten all day, while you, with just 100k in your account, still feel pity and give them money… and they will gladly collect it!* *It is similar to how the Hive platform works. Our wallets and earnings are visible to everyone, so nobody can easily lie about being broke when Hive, HBD, or Hive Power is clearly sitting in their wallet… Now that we know the advantages of such a system, let us talk about the disadvantages…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFmuVcyRf8vSuhSw4Nopn8HUTTEyzxXtza58C2bFkF3k/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/money-banknotes-coins-euro-darling-2991386/) *One major disadvantage of this kind of system is envy. When everyone knows what you are earning, it can become dangerous because you could easily become a target for armed robbers*… *It also makes the work of evil people easier. They already know the financial worth of their victims and can decide to strike at any time they want…* *Another issue is something I don’t even know whether to call an advantage or a disadvantage. If everyone can see what others earn, it could create serious problems in some workplaces*… *Some people are very hardworking and good at their jobs, yet there is another person in the same position doing far less work while earning more money. There are also people without certificates earning more than people with master’s degrees. If salaries become public and people start seeing these differences, it could lead to frustration and chaos…* *People will start asking questions like: “Why am I earning less than Mr. A when I am more qualified, more experienced, and even work harder than him?”* *At the end of the day, transparency can help reduce corruption and expose fake lifestyles, but it can also create jealousy, insecurity, and unnecessary tension among people…* *Another problem is that you can’t even hide how much you earn from your family, and that is one thing many men prefer to keep private*… *Because if you are earning 50k and you already give your extended and nuclear family 30k, they will still expect you to share from the remaining 20k…* *And please, don’t start defending your family here, it is just the reality of life, not because anyone’s family is bad*… *Once people know exactly how much you earn, expectations automatically increase. Some people will believe that since the money enters your account, you must always provide help, even when you are also struggling to survive and plan your future…* *So if I am to choose, I think salaries and earnings shouldn't be fully publicized because of the insecurity, pressure, envy, and unnecessary problems that can arise when everybody knows what everyone is making…*

[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/hand-arrange-white-letters-as-growth_1179247.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=11&uuid=96b77ed3-793f-4820-9bb1-c7ea95823bad&query=growth+ai+generated) 
“Sow your seed in the morning, do not withdraw your hands in the evening for you do not know which will be good either one or both”---words of the teacher “Cast your bread upon the water for after many years you will still find it. Invest in seven ventures, yes, in eight; you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.”---words of the teacher.  

It is going to be a very brief article with something to take home. I can even say the few lines above are life transforming. Growth is like sowing a seed, it will need you to commit something; self building, learning, unlearning, exposure, time investing, meeting up with new people, taking up a course, discovery, academics, entrepreneurial exposure, faith and whatever. You will sacrifice; it was a scripture I was sharing this evening with a friend of mine in the faith.   She asked a question of what was and what is special about this great man of God. I was led by the spirit to start expanciating on some scriptures with her and all of a sudden, my spirit clinged to the anchor talk in Isaiah 55:1 “Isaiah 55:1 “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! body.title: Combating afflictions  (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
***Greetings, beautiful Gems community! 🤗***

+ ***Saludos hermosa comunidad de Gems 🤗*** 

---
---
![photo_4931821396388678782_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23yx61JzrxbaCYSHhEm3rNZkj8aK86WzstYK6hRyHY6owMGKy755Kp7H4mStCXPPdkEQd.jpg)

---
---
There are trials in life that seem endless. For example, my mother's health remains very fragile. It's been several years now watching her struggle, and honestly, it causes a lot of helplessness and exhaustion.

In addition to this, at the beginning of the year, my husband became seriously ill. He had two brain surgeries. Thank God everything went well—the medical expenses, the excellent doctors, and the supplies. I can't complain about that, but I can't deny that it was very draining.

Over the weekend, I felt terrible because I suffer from very sharp pains (endometriosis). I hadn't suffered from this condition for a few months, and I thought the disease had disappeared. But no, there it was again, those pains that keep me awake at night and seem stronger than ever.

Feeling those pains again, that struggle, stirred up negative emotions: anger, hopelessness, bitterness, sadness, complaints. Everything around me felt clouded.

The pains subsided, yes, even so, I still had that negative feeling, but despite everything, I mustered the strength to tidy and clean my home. One of the things that relaxes me most is having everything in its place and my house smelling clean and fresh.

The day after tidying everything up, I took some time to relax. My husband had made coffee and had to go out, so I sat down in a very comfortable chair that my dear, kind neighbors had given me. I looked out the window with my cup of coffee in my hand. The best part was the view I could see. Oh my God! What beautiful colors! The sun was setting, with those gorgeous orange hues, the sky a soft blue, and the sea—yes, the sea, so majestic and calm. At that moment, I could only thank God for showing me such beauty. Then I snapped out of it again and told myself, \

Yes, even amidst so many struggles and afflictions, there are also many, many things to live for—to live with hope, to live with passion, to live with gratitude.

***The struggles and afflictions are still there, but it definitely depends on us how we face each challenge that life puts in our path. Complaining and being angry might be good for letting off steam for a moment, but living in complaint and bitterness brings nothing good; it only limits us and blinds us to the many beautiful things that life offers us every day.***

+ Hay pruebas en la vida que parecen interminables, por ejemplo, la salud de mamá sigue muy delicada, ya son varios años viendo a mi madre luchar y la verdad esto causa mucha impotencia y cansancio.

+ Sumado a esto, a comienzo del año mi esposo se enfermó gravemente, fueron dos operaciones del cerebro, gracias a Dios todo fluyó bien, los gastos clínicos, buenos doctores y la provisión, no me quejo de eso, pero no les puedo negar que hubo mucho agotamiento.

+ El fin de semana me sentí muy mal, pues sufro de dolores muy agudos (endometriosis) tenía unos cuantos meses sin sufrir de este mal que me deja sin fuerzas y creí que la enfermedad había desaparecido, pero no, allí estaba, otra vez, esos dolores que no me dejan dormir y al parecer más fuertes que nunca.

+ Sentir nuevamente esos dolores, esa lucha, despertó emociones negativas, ira, desesperanza, amargura, tristeza, quejas, definitivamente se nublo todo a mi alrededor.

+ Los dolores se calmaron, si, aun así, seguía con ese sentimiento negativo, pero a pesar de todo tome fuerzas para ordenar y limpiar mi hogar, una de las cosas que más me relaja es tener todo en su lugar y que mi casa se sienta con ese olor a limpio y fresco.

+ Un día después de ordenar todo, tome un tiempo para relajarme, mi esposo había hecho café, tuvo que salir y en ese instante me senté en una silla muy cómoda que me obsequiaron mis queridos buenos vecinos, mire por la ventana con la taza de café en mi mano, lo mejor de todo fue el paisaje que podía observar, oh, ¡Dios mío! ¡Que belleza de colores, el sol estaba en su ocaso, con eso colores naranjas preciosos, el cielo con un color azul suave y el mar, si el mar tan majestuoso y tranquilo, ese instante solo pude agradecer a Dios por mostrarme tanta belleza, allí nuevamente reaccioné y me dije, oh si, el vaso está medio lleno! 

+ Pues sí, en medio de tantas luchas y aflicciones también hay muchas pero muchas cosas por el cual vivir y vivir con esperanza, vivir con pasión, vivir con agradecimiento.

+ ***Las luchas y aflicciones siguen allí, pero definitivamente depende de nosotros de como enfrentamos cada reto que la vida pone en nuestro camino, el quejarse y tener ira, puede ser bueno para desahogarte por un momento, pero vivir así en la queja y amargura no trae nada bueno, solo nos limita y nos hace ciegos ante tantas cosas hermosas que la vida nos ofrece cada día.***

![photo_4931821396388678784_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAXcYGPi1AkoRRWpdRPpmyjjDnCvMqZ5ciJGMJLp4iycHTg81grhraLWt2ZEipuWkFQ.jpg)

body.title: Cuba, the “Independence Day,” and the indictment against Raúl Castro
body.body:
></center>

As is customary every year, the sitting U.S. president issued the official statement because of the date on which Cuba was _formally_ constituted as an “independent” republic. “Today, we commemorate Cuban Independence Day—the 124th anniversary of a once free nation’s birth, forged through sacrifice, courage, and an unbreakable desire for liberty,” reads Trump’s statement. “Across generations, the Cuban people have demonstrated an unyielding devotion to the cause of freedom and a resilience of spirit that no regime—past or present—has been able to extinguish. On May 20, 1902, that defiant vision was realized when the Republic of Cuba was established, marking the beginning of self-government for our island neighbors,” it further states.

May 20, 1902, was, without question, a great day in Cuban history. In this regard, the near-total negation of that date imposed by the Cuban Revolution —for the reasons I explain below, as every victorious historical process reconstructs and resignifies the past— is just as misguided as its uncritical exaltation. From the Cuban side, I believe there is undoubtedly a need to find a better way to deal with May 20, 1902 —perhaps, who knows, by declaring it a public holiday, but not a festive celebration. From the other side, one must never forget that what was born that day was a republic critically limited in its autonomy, supervised by Washington through a provision—[the Platt Amendment](https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/service/ll/llsl//llsl-c56/llsl-c56.pdf#page=944)—embedded like [an infamous appendix](https://www.crteducazione.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Cost.-Cuba-1901-inglese.pdf#page=39) in the Cuban constitution of 1901.

> That the government of Cuba consents that the United States may exercise the right to intervene for the preservation of Cuban independence, the maintenance of a government adequate for the protection of life, property, and individual liberty, and for discharging the obligations with respect to Cuba imposed by the treaty of Paris on the United States, now to be assumed and undertaken by the government of Cuba.

The naval base that the United States continues to maintain in Cuba at Guantánamo—against the popular will—originated from this formulation of the amendment:

> That to enable the United States to maintain the independence of Cuba, and to protect the people thereof, as well as for its own defense, the government of Cuba will sell or lease to the United States lands necessary for coaling or naval stations at certain specified points, to be agreed upon with the President of the United States.

From the Congressional Record of February 27, 1901, I quote three senators who, regardless of their positions on other highly sensitive issues such as racial relations, expressed with great clarity what the Platt Amendment actually meant.

> Henry M. Teller: “I greatly fear that it will wound the sensibilities of those people down there and that it may get us into trouble. I wish \[Cubans\] would accept it, for it would be infinitely better for them to accept it than it would to have other terms, infinitely harder and more drastic, applied to them, as I am sure they will be applied if this bill fails.”
> 
> Augustus Octavius Bacon: “I do not think that the amendment is in harmony with the pledge which we made when we went to war with Spain. I think that we are bound by that pledge, Mr. President \[of the Senate\]. That pledge is not consistent with the pronunciation by us of an ultimatum to the people of Cuba, saying that we will not release them from military control until they comply with that ultimatum... \[The\] amendment is not consistent with the obligation which we then solemnly took in the presence of the world. Cuba can not be free and independent if we can enforce these restraints upon her. If we are determined to violate our pledge, why stop half way? In that case we should go the whole way and take the island without reservation.”
> 
> James Kimbrough Jones: “\[It\] seems to reserve the right to the United States to judge at all times what sort of a government the Republic of Cuba has, and to intervene whenever the government does not suit the purposes of the Government of the United States. In other words, it seems that there is an intention to reserve to the Government of the United States a supervision and control of the government of Cuba, which is directly in the face of our pledge that Cuba should have an independent government.”

### The new indictment against Raúl Castro

The extraordinary pressure that the U.S. government is currently exerting against Cuba —in violation of all principles of international law— has much to do with the kind of coercion to which the early twentieth-century imperial pioneers subjected us after thirty years of hard and bloody struggle against Spain. Many Cuban constitutional delegates ultimately accepted the amendment because they understood that, although it compromised independence, it was the best framework possible, in line with Senator Teller’s position. Better that than dealing indefinitely with the presence of U.S. troops, or accepting the possibility of entering into another long conflict.

Today we face a crossroads with different nuances, but within the same political register: either accept that the United States dictates to the authorities on the Island —whatever one’s assessment of them may be— how they should conduct themselves domestically and internationally —that is, how to organize the economy and democracy, and with whom they should or should not relate—, or confront the possibility —more real than at any other time in the last 63 years since the Missile Crisis— of direct military confrontation.

The [indictment](https://t.co/eQTDTESlfV) introduced today against Raúl Castro for events that occurred in February 1996 forms part of this strategy of economic, diplomatic, and military pressure. Beyond constituting a highly symbolic development for the so-called Cuban exile community in Florida —which now has Marco Rubio heading Foggy Bottom— it opens the possibility of repeating in Cuba an extraction operation like the one carried out in Venezuela last January 3.

I have spoken elsewhere about the events that took place thirty years ago, very near to, or within, Cuban airspace. As with May 20 itself, public debate sees _only the extremes_—for instance, [look at Rubio today](https://x.com/SecRubio/status/2057069290637889876), distancing himself from _even the slightest responsibility_ for the current state of affairs on the Island. Thus, from Miami, people see only the two planes shot down and the four fatalities, but nobody wants to examine and clear away the much more complicated history of repeated incursions and blatant, disrespectful violations of Cuban airspace, about which the Clinton administration possessed ample and sound knowledge.

Trump said this Wednesday —in yet another of his reversals— that there would be no further escalation. Still, I insist that the stances are irreconcilable if the United States continues pushing Cuba toward capitulation. As I have also said, my position in this regard does not mean that I do not believe —and, in fact, I strongly believe— that this country must undertake comprehensive political and economic reforms, which in many respects could correspond to things Washington wants to see here. But any development in that direction can only emerge from the decision and will of Cubans themselves—that is, as the resultant vector of that dialectical and geographically dispersed social structure that we are.

> [Source](https://x.com/EmbaCubaUS/status/2057114129886847155) for the cover image.

<div class=\

> Hello, good morning or afternoon, my dear fellow Praetorians. This time, I’d like to tell you about my progress during the last season in the Frontier format and the rewards I’ve earned. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Frontier

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Participating in this format, my first priority has been to max out the Foundations set. Overall, I’m making great progress toward that goal. As I collect new cards, I’m trying to earn plenty of entries for the Monday giveaway; I’ve already been lucky enough to win three black copies, and I hope to win more.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdb4eA9cfFLjmFgTR6okLmWUMr9q4b7rdkodAMX1DxW4/image.png)
As for the Extra Foundations, I've only come across Aimee so far. Apparently, I only get lucky with that common card when I claim my chests every day; the golden and regular versions are the ones I usually find, hahaha.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgnaNa6VHkcnxVre4Z7gG8TKCjG4w24btqMRzd3NLCXh/image.png)
Something that surprised me when I claimed a chest a few days ago was that I received an extra chest that looked different. I didn't know I could win a Splintervibes in this format. I like being able to win some exclusive items just for being active in the game.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbh9U57EcL6KiTGNGToGMZch3n5fmvkNFkyczU25NAUM1/frontier_vibes.gif)
----- Since my activity level has remained fairly consistent, I receive the packs I earn from chests every day now that I'm in Gold I. Below, you can see the cards I received from the last ten Foundations packs over the past few days.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5LwTYdFoR89JvZuipQSTBg2uNtz3ffd3CdLg9Gd81qs/frontier_5.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2ybMkGpmRzZLA3Qag2CfWQKjfbpgNL5JC1qr4gAtkgU/frontier_1.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecoKnMpQ99bCYzoEZSjSAfubY9thzvqPsHAfQapdhHCv/frontier_2.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEyuSu1LEghPiHtAtwfXq1feMAQeCAnpcEpDWta1EdYS/frontier_3.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf2VZm9B6F7yAEbLZhYCNXpzU4Zg8pJsiHS7fopBe4YLn/frontier_4.gif)
--- --- Five warriors ranging from rare to legendary have reached their maximum level. This brings me closer and closer to completing the set. Sherringham Logger is a warrior I used to enjoy playing, but I started using him less because of the low level of the Incessant Sage archon. Having the Incessant archon at level three severely limits my use of life-element warriors.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP36wcH3GL7JVKyjCFQ1gYCJnCnXd1m7YxUxCTE47PUzR/frontier_comb_1.gif)
I don't use Savage Butcher very often, but it's good to have him maxed out in case I need him down the road.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSYgS6wLBJZsV7nmy3kUWNsHSQcSq68rhQZpDijtq536/frontier_comb_2.gif)
Vengeful Monk: I use this opportunistic melee warrior a lot; since he’s neutral-element, I can unleash his full potential. Now that he’s finally maxed out, he’ll be able to withstand more damage in battle and take down more enemies.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3XXUsVfEpqrULThakLvkF1eWZWAY5gmRqoMwrEkyuAf/frontier_comb_3.gif)
Glimmermancer: My dear magical lizard, I'm glad to see you're full of life again and that you're no longer a target for opportunists.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4HDCAiVL9P8k5MoLPCxkT6tXeLRzebEwMcGVfXKyFYT/frontier_comb_4.gif)
Great Bear Druid: This neutral-element legendary with a double attack is very useful in battle; I’ve already had a lot of experience fighting this warrior and have lost many battles against him at max level, but now I’ll finally be able to use him in battle. That boost in power and speed.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbSpAc4KF2Z6vmNKmrBT2xcFVAuRJUgdU6ChELKEHp76x/frontier_comb_5.gif)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> I’ll keep working toward my goal of completing the set, and I’ve really enjoyed the surprise factor of the other rewards available in this format. I’m hoping to finally get lucky and find an extra card I don’t already have, though I wouldn’t complain if I got another Splintervibes either. Now I just need to max out one Archon, one common warrior (Grand Consul Minion), one rare warrior (Moros Malik), nine epic warriors, and one legendary warrior (Giam Root). I’m not planning on buying any from the market yet; I hope to be lucky enough to complete them with the packs I win. -----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. En esta oportunidad quiero contarles sobre mi progreso durante esta última temporada en el formato Frontier y sus recompensas. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Frontier

> Al participar en este formato, he buscado completar en primer lugar el set Foundations al nivel máximo. En general, en este objetivo tiene un muy buen avance. Mientras voy acumulando nuevas cartas, estoy intentando ganar un buen número de entradas para el sorteo de los lunes; ya he tenido la suerte de ganar tres copias negras y espero tener la suerte de ganar más.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdb4eA9cfFLjmFgTR6okLmWUMr9q4b7rdkodAMX1DxW4/image.png)
En cuanto a las Foundations Extra, solo me he encontrado a Aimee. Al parecer, solo tengo suerte con esa carta común cuando reclamo los cofres cada día; la versión dorada y regular es lo que encuentro, jajajaja.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgnaNa6VHkcnxVre4Z7gG8TKCjG4w24btqMRzd3NLCXh/image.png)
Algo que me sorprendió al reclamar un cofre hace unos días es que recibí un cofre extra y que tenía un aspecto diferente. No sabía que podía ganar un Splintervibes en este formato. Me gusta poder ganar algunos artículos exclusivos por estar activo en el juego.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbh9U57EcL6KiTGNGToGMZch3n5fmvkNFkyczU25NAUM1/frontier_vibes.gif)
----- Al mantener una actividad más o menos estable, cada día tengo disponibles los packs que gano en los cofres al estar en Oro I. A continuación podrán ver las cartas que recibí de los últimos diez packs Foundations de estos días.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5LwTYdFoR89JvZuipQSTBg2uNtz3ffd3CdLg9Gd81qs/frontier_5.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2ybMkGpmRzZLA3Qag2CfWQKjfbpgNL5JC1qr4gAtkgU/frontier_1.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecoKnMpQ99bCYzoEZSjSAfubY9thzvqPsHAfQapdhHCv/frontier_2.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEyuSu1LEghPiHtAtwfXq1feMAQeCAnpcEpDWta1EdYS/frontier_3.gif) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf2VZm9B6F7yAEbLZhYCNXpzU4Zg8pJsiHS7fopBe4YLn/frontier_4.gif)
--- --- Cinco guerreros que van desde raros a legendarios llegan a su máximo nivel. Esto me acerca cada vez más a completar el set. Sherringham Logger es un guerrero que me gustaba usar, pero que comencé a usar menos por el bajo nivel que tiene el arcón Incessant Sage. Al tener el arconte Incessant en el nivel tres, limita mucho el uso de mis guerreros del elemento vida.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP36wcH3GL7JVKyjCFQ1gYCJnCnXd1m7YxUxCTE47PUzR/frontier_comb_1.gif)
Savage Butcher no es un guerrero que suela usar mucho, pero me es bueno tenerlo en su máximo por si necesito usarlo en un futuro.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPSYgS6wLBJZsV7nmy3kUWNsHSQcSq68rhQZpDijtq536/frontier_comb_2.gif)
Vengeful Monk: Este guerrero melee oportunista lo suelo usar mucho; al ser del elemento neutral, lo puedo usar con todo su poder. Al por fin tenerlo en su máximo, soportará más durante las batallas y podrá derrotar más enemigos en batalla.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3XXUsVfEpqrULThakLvkF1eWZWAY5gmRqoMwrEkyuAf/frontier_comb_3.gif)
Glimmermancer: Mi querido lagarto mágico, me gusta verlo con más vitalidad y que ahora ya no sea el objetivo de los oportunistas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4HDCAiVL9P8k5MoLPCxkT6tXeLRzebEwMcGVfXKyFYT/frontier_comb_4.gif)
Great Bear Druid: Esta legendaria del elemento neutral con doble ataque es muy útil en batalla; ya tengo mucha experiencia en batalla contra este guerrero y he perdido muchas batallas al enfrentarme a él máximo y ahora por fin lo podré usar en batalla. Ese aumento de poder y velocidad.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbSpAc4KF2Z6vmNKmrBT2xcFVAuRJUgdU6ChELKEHp76x/frontier_comb_5.gif)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Seguiré trabajando en mi objetivo de completar el set y se me ha hecho muy entretenido el poder llevarme una sorpresa con las otras recompensas disponibles en este formato. Espero por fin tener suerte y encontrarme alguna carta extra diferente a la que poseo, aunque tampoco me quejo si gano otra Splintervibes. Ahora solo me falta subir al máximo a un arconte, un guerrero común (Grand Consul Minion), un guerrero raro (Moros Malik), nueve guerreros épicos y un guerrero legendario (Giam Root). Aún no considero comprar ninguno en el mercado; espero tener la suerte de completarlos con los packs que gane. -----

> Muchas gracias a los que leen mis publicaciones y muchas gracias por sus votos o comentarios. En el siguiente enlace podrás unirte al juego y conocer este fantástico mundo: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99). Espero verlos pronto en un Challenge contando sus batallas y experiencias. Nota: Esta publicación no es un consejo de inversión; realicen sus propias investigaciones. ___

body.title: Guaiacum officinale: A critically endangered tree (ENG - SPN)
body.body: > Greetings to all, hoping that health and prosperity are present in your lives. Today I want to share with you a very special tree, of which I have two specimens in my yard, and which is also common on many streets in the town where I live. It is a Guaiacum officinale, whose common name is Blue Guayacán, It is a native tree of tropical America, evergreen, slow-growing, with a semi-globular, very dense crown, and can reach between 5 and 20 meters in height, although they are generally seen at a smaller size, as they are pruned. Something that surprised me when researching this species is that it is critically endangered. I really didn't know it had such a status, but apparently its wood and resin have been used intensively for many years, as it has very hard wood and the resin is used for medicinal and perfumery purposes. ***

> > Saludos a todos, esperando que la salud y prosperidad estén presentes en sus vidas. Para hoy quiero compartirles un árbol muy especial, del cual tengo dos especímenes en mi solar, siendo también usual en muchas calles del pueblo en que habito. Se trata de Guaiacum officinale, cuyo nombre común es Guayacán azul, siendo un árbol nativo de América tropical, perenne, de crecimiento lento, con una copa semiglobosa, muy tupida, pudiendo alcanzar entre los 5 y 20 metros de altura, aunque generalmente se observan de tamaño bajo, ya que son podados. Algo que me sorprendió al investigar sobre esta especie, es que se encuentra en peligro crítico de extinción, yo realmente no conocía que tuviese tal estatus, pero al parecer su madera y su resina se han usado de manera intensiva por muchos años, ya que tiene una madera muy dura y la resina se usa para fines medicinales y de perfumería.
![IMG_20260408_091206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/23xARfomP35duRtyLoxoksjGHNPeWVNyGQb4VDmJytCbLxNLPGxa2CYb4BCdjCewQqF4Y.jpg)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Rph0Ryfn-04.png

> The Blue Guayacán tree is very drought-resistant and adapts to all types of soil, even poor ones. It is a beautiful species that provides shade year-round, which is very useful in hot climates with high solar radiation. This is why it is often used as an ornamental tree along streets and avenues in some towns and cities. Its leaves are small, no more than 2 cm long, and grow in opposite pairs on the branches. ***

> > El Guayacán azul es un árbol muy resistente a la sequía y se adapta a todo tipo de suelos, sin importar que éstos sean pobres. Es una especie muy bonita, que ofrece sombra todo el año, lo que es muy útil para climas calurosos, en donde la radiación solar es muy alta, de ahí que en algunos pueblos y ciudades sean especies ornamentales en calles y avenidas. Sus hojas son pequeñas, de máximo 2 cm de largo, y se observan en una posición opuesta en las ramas.
![IMG_20260408_091621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/23tbktmu7QGB1K9iPUm72TgC9sDWmCxoUi5gJohrpgSQp37opjMdMqgu4qFksAJGu7ZZe.jpg)
![IMG_20260408_091631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/23u5bmDwakotVTQNzXXLtzZ3SrDcJw7tuG9dAfv9fqYh7s1a1tLsfeEbGZZrSs86TXXpd.jpg)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Rph0Ryfn-04.png

> This species blooms beautifully, with pale blue, almost white, and also blue-violet flowers, which attract several pollinator species, especially butterflies and moths. These flowers produce a yellow capsule containing a bright red seed with a black spot. When the seeds are ripe, the capsule detaches and falls to the ground, where I collect and store them. Upon learning that these trees are facing extinction, I decided to propagate them. ***

> > Esta especie florece de un modo muy hermoso, con flores que son azul pálido, casi blancas y también de un azul – violeta, las que atraen algunas especies de polinizadores, especialmente mariposas y polillas. Estas flores producen una cápsula amarilla que en su interior tiene una semilla de color rojo vivo con una mancha negra. Al estar maduras las semillas, la cápsula se desprende y cae al suelo, de donde las recojo y guardo, ya que al enterarme que estos árboles van vía a la extinción, he decidido reproducirlos.
![IMG_20260408_091305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/2423o1R1gHAoQf9SBEutTWYn6ZvZboNBxfgtRtkqQAzo36S5hfRkbtFEabCu5ua8iV9aB.jpg)
![IMG_20260408_091239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/EoEodFhc2veS24YxoumxNZeKinX7668mJGsN5syE3YcdFuVKE22SgKvoCZrbhcuWDkV.jpg)
![IMG_20260408_091237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/23uFKB2EsNdJt5YDcLcJ5reQfHCeffjztU3cPb52ycbgcjVftC8gybfUrkWxfBAmhsR4M.jpg)
![IMG_20260408_091551.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/Eokc5Tdb4Lmo6HPQ7EMtGuqspJrL2qHwPn8oGzPTQKk6KetY8AfgpVKCKCzXymATKD3.jpg)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Rph0Ryfn-04.png

> The specimen you can see in the photos in this post took 13 years to reach this size (2 meters), as I received it in 2013 when it was only a few centimeters long. You can see it as a baby in a post from 2021. [Here's the link to that post](https://peakd.com/hive-120078/@sirenahippie/espengl-marzo-2021-en-mi-solar) so you can compare. I'm very happy with this specimen and with another, smaller one that I'll share with you later ***

> > El ejemplar que pueden ver en las fotos de este post, tardó 13 años en alcanzar este tamaño (2 metros), pues yo lo recibí en 2013 cuando tenía pocos centímetros de longitud. En un post del año 2021 pueden verlo de pequeño. [Aquí les dejo este post]( https://peakd.com/hive-120078/@sirenahippie/espengl-marzo-2021-en-mi-solar) para que puedan compararlo. Yo estoy muy contenta con este ejemplar y con otro más pequeño que luego compartiré con ustedes.
![IMG_20260408_091614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sirenahippie/23tm7V7n1QmzNFa9jTuvh3zcPMzsFiXq1U6DQWcuDAaSqH6uqzt87ferLu37ZXsLnmdzk.jpg)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Rph0Ryfn-04.png
Here I end my post today, in which I have shared the images of a beautiful, sturdy tree, which also serves as a home for some little birds. I say goodbye to you, wishing you good health and well-being and remember: Not all days are the same, and even more important: Everything you give, everything you do, will inexorably return to you. Hugs!
***
> Aquí termino mi post de hoy, en el que les he compartido las imágenes de un árbol hermoso, resistente, que también sirve de casa para algunos pajaritos. Me despido de ustedes, deseándoles mucha salud y bienestar y recuerden: No todos los días son iguales y más importante aún: Todo lo que das, todo lo que haces, inexorablemente volverá a ti. ¡Abrazos!

Rick works in mysterious ways, I guess. Oh, I wanted nothing more To hear you knocking at my door Cause if I could see your face once more I could die a happy girl, I'm sure When you said your last goodbye I died a little bit inside I lay in tears in bed all night Alone without you by my side But if you love, why'd you leave me? Take my body Take my body Oh, I want Oh, I need it To find somebody I'll find somebody Like you Oh, like you You brought out the best in me A part of me I've never seen You took my soul and wiped it clean Our love was made for movie screens But if you love Take my body Take my body Oh, I'll I'll find somebody Like you Oh, like you Did you hear that, Sheila? The second voice was my 16-year-old daughter who just came from work and just... That was beautiful! I thought it was part of the song. 

No, I was supposed to surprise Juan yesterday with a duet with her, but he had to go for dinner, so... Next time in your space, Juan, I'm gonna do another song with my daughter.

I was about to ask you if you were free next Saturday. So, check your schedule. I will.

Okay, that was crazy. I have a request for Juan in the next time period, whatever. I request a Chris Cornell song.

That is like... Anyway, the last song was... Wow, 16 years old, that was very emotional. And I request the same emotion from Juan. Actually, Rikito, we can ask DJ, because I proposed to him on the list that I sent, obviously, as well.

So if he's fine with me singing obviously now, we can change. I was about to sing you two, but it's up to DJ. It's not my space, guys.

It's your birthday! It's your birthday, DJ, accept it. I've been overwhelmed with the amount of gratitude and love, so I'm perfectly content to just sit here and go along with the flow and enjoy the space. Obviously it is.

Okay, Chiquita, whenever you tell me. The floor is yours. Oh my God, I own the floor? I don't own nothing, but I own the floor.

body.title: # 🌍 La Ruta Invisible de lo que Comes: ¿Qué es la Agricultura Regenerativa?
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKgC5Cd5xXHTBKTs7Ay74VhrmGvj9Rv7TCHoEnLVtnWb/1779316917295.jpg)


¿Alguna vez te has detenido a pensar en el viaje que hizo ese tomate, ese pedazo de pan o esa taza de café antes de llegar a tu mesa? 

Normalmente vemos el mercado o la tienda como el punto de origen, pero detrás de cada bocado hay una **ruta invisible**: un complejo sistema de interacciones bajo la tierra, uso de agua, energía y trabajo humano. Sin embargo, la forma en que gestionamos esa ruta está cambiando el destino de nuestro planeta.

Hoy queremos hablar de dos caminos opuestos: el modelo que agota la tierra y la revolución silenciosa que busca sanarla: **la Agricultura Regenerativa**.

---

## 🚜 1. El modelo actual: El Monocultivo Industrial

Durante décadas, la producción masiva de alimentos se ha basado en el monocultivo industrial (plantar una sola especie en extensiones enormes de tierra). Aunque es muy eficiente a corto plazo, este sistema genera una \

de desgaste profundo:

* **Suelo agotado y compactado:** Al sembrar siempre lo mismo, la tierra pierde sus nutrientes naturales y se vuelve casi estéril.
* **Dependencia química:** Como el suelo ya no tiene vida propia, se vuelve dependiente de fertilizantes artificiales y pesticidas para poder producir.
* **Poca retención hídrica:** Un suelo compactado no absorbe el agua; la lluvia corre por la superficie, arrastrando los químicos hacia los ríos y provocando sequías más severas bajo el suelo.

> **En pocas palabras:** Es un sistema que trata a la tierra como una fábrica, extrayendo recursos sin reponerlos.

---

## 🌱 2. El nuevo camino: ¿Qué es la Agricultura Regenerativa?

A diferencia del modelo industrial, la **Agricultura Regenerativa** no se limita a \

el medio ambiente; su objetivo es **devolverle la vida al suelo**, imitando los ciclos perfectos de la naturaleza. No ve la granja como una fábrica, sino como un ecosistema vivo.

Sus pilares fundamentales cambian todo el resultado:

* **✨ Diversidad de cultivos:** En lugar de un solo tipo de planta, se combinan diferentes especies (árboles, pastos, cultivos). Las raíces se ayudan mutuamente, fijando nutrientes de forma natural.
* **🪱 Suelo vivo y rico en carbono:** No se ara la tierra agresivamente. Al mantener el suelo cubierto de vegetación, se alimenta a millones de microorganismos y hongos benéficos que crean un abono natural constante.
* **💧 Alta retención hídrica:** Un suelo lleno de materia orgánica y raíces profundas funciona como una esponja perfecta, reteniendo la humedad incluso en épocas de calor extremo.
* **🐓 Integración animal y biodiversidad:** Los animales pastan de forma controlada, fertilizando el suelo de manera natural con su estiércol y estimulando el crecimiento sano de las plantas sin necesidad de químicos.

---

## ⚖️ El veredicto: Tu plato tiene el poder de decidir

La diferencia entre ambos sistemas es radical. Mientras uno rompe el equilibrio Hombre-Tierra dejando suelos áridos a su paso, el otro sana los suelos, produce alimentos más nutritivos y combate el cambio climático desde la raíz.

La próxima vez que disfrutes de una comida, recuerda esa ruta invisible. Consumir de productores locales, apoyar la diversidad de cultivos y entender cómo se produce lo que compramos es el primer paso para regenerar nuestro hogar.

---

### 💬 ¡Quiero saber tu opinión!
¿Habías escuchado hablar de la agricultura regenerativa? ¿Crees que estamos a tiempo de transformar la forma en que alimentamos al mundo? **¡Déjame tu comentario abajo para debatirlo!**

---

​Por aquí comparto ya el detalle final del listado de materiales del Sistema de Filtrado y Fertirriego para el sistema de riego por goteo que publiqué hace unos días. Algo que hay que hacer con mucho detalle. Con ese listado es que se solicitarán todos los recursos para ejecutar esta obra.

​Evidentemente es como un salón de operación, se trabaja en equipo multidisciplinario siempre bajo la guía de un especialista principal. Aquí trabajamos un Ingeniero Hidráulico, un Ingeniero Civil, un Arquitecto, un Ingeniero Mecánico y un presupuestista.

body.title: 📿 Haciendo un collar estilo gargantilla//📿 Making a choker-style necklace.[Es/En]
body.body:
>Saludos a todos espero esten pasando un lindo día, espero me puedan acompañar hoy, porque les vengo a mostrar como hice un collar pero estilo gargantilla, usando un nudo plano como tejido,y cuentas reutilizadas,para así crear un collar lindo y auténtico. # > Greetings everyone, I hope you're having a lovely day. I hope you can join me today, because I'm going to show you how I made a choker-style necklace using a flat knot as a weave and repurposed beads to create a beautiful and unique necklace. # ---
![1000273730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQPoE5pR5HVipipdMW6KcM7c48BcQTmEfn1zn2G2psEmh/1000273730.jpg)
| Materiales | Materials | | :--- | :--- | | • Hilo pavilo | • String| | • Cuentas en todos morados, blanco y estrellas de mar| • Beads in all shades of purple, white, and starfish | | | • Tijeras | • Scissors | # --- ## 📸 Paso a Paso / Step by Step ### **Paso 1 / Step 1**
![1000273646.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUzW1maqwHN9VdneX7r9nQQDT7HSnEwJ1M9GTaZkRHbkp/1000273646.jpg)
![1000273650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTjMLxXQCT3xDHw53EgKY8bwJvKgvEvUCnp6DWDrm6cg6/1000273650.jpg)
#

>Comencé por medir un metro de hilo de lana,más o menos una medida que sea lo suficiente para que sobre y no falte,y que sea de la medida de la cabeza ya que tienen que pasar por la cabeza y ya luego se ajusta al cuello,ya que es un collar sin ningún broche,solo hilo y cuentas. Cuando ya tenía la medida del hilo principal , ahora medio dos más de la misma medida para los lados ya que así voy a comenzar con el tejido. Este tejido se llama nudo plano o cuadrado en el macramé. Este dudo se puede hacer en este tipo de hilo y quedó muy artesanal ,me recuerda a la bisutería que venden en las playas. # > I started by measuring a meter of wool yarn, roughly enough so there would be some extra but not too little, and the right length for the head since it has to go over the head and then adjust around the neck, as it's a necklace without any clasp, just yarn and beads. Once I had the length of the main yarn, I measured two more of the same length for the sides, as that's how I'll begin weaving. This weave is called a flat or square knot in macrame. I doubt it can be done with this type of yarn, and it turned out very handcrafted; it reminds me of the jewelry they sell on the beaches. # --- ### **Paso 2 / Step 2**
![1000273731.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyVY7FDhLFhLiRjgBi1YNmZ4uqRVtpeCFECZqij2kqdX/1000273731.jpg)
![1000273733.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR5hQhWdVTf3Wd8GhqCtmeWgQvMrSpckFzWSWbKf3QRch/1000273733.jpg)
#

>Ya para este paso iba un poco más adelantado el tejido,en este momento ya estaba contando los nidos porque me estaba acercando a la parte en dónde ya tenía que ir colocando las cuentas,y entonces no quería que se viera desordenado. # > By this stage the weaving was a little further along; at this point I was already counting the nests because I was approaching the part where I had to start placing the beads, and I didn't want it to look messy. # --- ### **Paso 3 / Step 3**
![1000273656.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcG1NKppj5MTV29tiW45LR41nQVCxSXSLZMNyRfd54zWh/1000273656.jpg)
![1000273743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXMxSZ2a4Prpvcz7aAaJ9gZeer6mJh5AFYV77PbHR7KUc/1000273743.jpg)
#

>Y aquí tenía puesta ya varias cuentas,la cuentas van en el hilo base,y así los hilos de los laso van siguiendo con el tejido pero alrededor de las cuentas y luego iba tejiendo varios nudos más para así colocar la siguiente cuenta, dejando la misma distancia para que se vea bien. Las cuentas que estoy usando en el collar,son las cuentas de una pulsera que se me daño porque se óxido, entonces las cuentas seguían intactas para seguir teniendo un nuevo uso,así hago yo con las cuentas que me van quedando,las dejo para hacer algo nuevo siempre y cuando estén en buenas condiciones. # > And here I already had several beads attached. The beads go on the base thread, and the loop threads continue the weaving around the beads. Then I wove several more knots to place the next bead, leaving the same distance so it looks good. The beads I'm using in the necklace are from a bracelet that was damaged because it rusted. The beads were still intact and could be reused. That's what I do with any leftover beads; I keep them to make something new as long as they're in good condition. # --- ### **Paso 4 / Step 4**
![1000273744.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6ovZj5UTVYW7mUzLrCVPBGXUb7rq94tPj9iwhwB276R/1000273744.jpg)
![1000273745.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNY5js6RfykDuiXsKcaQu9RZyFppyqGgkKEarJxPHcu42/1000273745.jpg)
#

>Entre cada nudo y cuenta no me había dado cuenta que ya está llegando hasta donde ya la última cuenta,la verdad este tipo de manualidades como la bisutería,me concentro tanto en el tejido y en como va a ir colocada la cuenta,es una forma de solo dedicarse a concentrar la mente en lo que estás haciendo y olvidarse un poco de los problemas. # > Between each knot and bead, I hadn't realized that I was already getting to the last bead. The truth is, with this type of craft, like jewelry making, I concentrate so much on the weaving and how the bead will be placed. It's a way to just focus your mind on what you're doing and forget about your problems for a while. # --- ### **Paso 5 / Step 5** #
![1000273664.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdGXjoZoY5H7y17DYEUDM8ZsiZfv7AHoeMmGTARng18tC/1000273664.jpg)
![1000273776.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZuBya7WvU5QD8b2Lm9AwqtvbEqxfoYcF1DRkEjtDtY9/1000273776.jpg)
#

>Y así se ve el collar con el tejido finalizado, ahora solo me faltaba un último detalle y es hacerle un nudo ajustable,le hice uno que une las dos partes de los lados del collar,y así sea más fácil de colocar,si no me equivoco se llama nudo fransiscano,o de barril. # > And this is how the necklace looks with the finished weaving. Now I only needed one last detail, which is to make an adjustable knot. I made one that joins the two sides of the necklace, making it easier to put on. If I'm not mistaken, it's called a Franciscan knot, or barrel knot. # --- ## 🌸 Resultado Final / Final Result #
![1000273748.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQA8GVhpBWvWN64f8AUJVBdM7FRNo5JTw15s3PFLTAUzt/1000273748.jpg) ![1000273747.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTXCQSCaWqDP3WfUWZk3tggYEEMvTCoJuiJPyydTDzUVB/1000273747.jpg)
#

>Y así quedó ya listo el collar, ahora queda solo lucirlo con atuendos con los colores que hagan juego,espero está manera de hacer este collar les sea de referencia, gracias a todos por visitar este post, chaooooo. # > And so the necklace is finished! Now all that's left is to wear it with outfits in matching colors. I hope this method for making this necklace is helpful. Thank you all for visiting this post, bye! ---
**Créditos:** Todas las fotografías son de mi autoría, tomadas con mi teléfono Infinix Smart 7 y editadas en Canva. Texto traducido al inglés con el traductor de Firefox.

body.title: Is The Global Economy Slower Than Governments Want Us To Believe?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT8UfN5PhWH1KjZpBPJCMQQ3oC4XRN4S7NBWRegTfidx5/1000703225.png 

The world today feels strangely divided between two realities.
On one side, governments and financial media continue talking about “economic resilience,” market recoveries, AI growth, and technological progress.
On the other side, millions of ordinary people across the world feel something very different:
higher living costs
more financial stress
slower opportunities
growing uncertainty
and a constant feeling that survival is becoming harder.
Recently, even political figures in the United States have begun indirectly admitting that economic conditions are not as strong as headlines sometimes suggest.
And personally…
I think this may be one of the most important global shifts people are underestimating right now.
Because beneath the surface, the global economy may already be entering a long-term psychological slowdown.
The Economy Is Not Crashing…
But It Is Quietly Exhausting People
This is what makes the current situation dangerous.
The world is not experiencing one sudden collapse.
Instead, people are slowly being drained over time.
Inflation may no longer be exploding like before, but prices remain high.
Housing is expensive.
Food is expensive.
Insurance is expensive.
Education is expensive.
Healthcare is expensive.
At the same time, wages in many countries are not rising fast enough to restore real purchasing power.
So even if economies technically avoid “recession,” ordinary people still feel poorer.
And when populations begin feeling financially trapped for long periods of time, something deeper starts happening psychologically.
People stop thinking long term.
Survival Mode Changes Human Behavior
This is something I believe governments and economists often underestimate.
When uncertainty becomes chronic, people slowly shift from:
building → surviving
investing → consuming
creating → reacting
planning → worrying
And once entire populations enter low-grade financial stress for years, the effects begin spreading everywhere:
lower productivity
lower innovation
lower risk-taking
lower entrepreneurship
lower optimism
This becomes especially dangerous for younger generations.
Many young people today no longer believe traditional systems guarantee stability anymore.
They see:
rising debt
expensive housing
unstable careers
inflation destroying savings
and increasing global uncertainty
So naturally, many begin searching for alternatives:
crypto
online businesses
AI tools
side income
global investing
digital assets
Not necessarily because they are greedy…
but because they are trying to escape economic fragility.
Why Global Trust May Be Quietly Weakening
Modern economies are built heavily on confidence.
Confidence in:
governments
currencies
banks
markets
institutions
and future stability
But globally, that confidence is becoming more fragile.
People now see:
wars continuing without resolution
geopolitical tensions rising
central banks struggling with debt
political polarization increasing
and economic inequality widening
As trust weakens, societies become emotionally reactive.
And emotional societies make unstable economic decisions.
That is one reason markets today swing so violently between: fear and euphoria
panic and greed
hope and despair
The system itself is becoming psychologically unstable.
Why Crypto Continues To Matter
This is one reason crypto continues surviving despite extreme volatility.
Many people misunderstand crypto as “just speculation.”
But underneath that speculation is something deeper:
a global search for financial alternatives.
People want:
assets outside traditional systems
protection from currency debasement
global mobility
independent wealth creation
and financial freedom
Whether crypto fully succeeds or not…
the reason people are attracted to it is very real.
It reflects growing distrust in the long-term stability of existing systems.
The Bigger Risk Nobody Talks About
Personally…
I do not think the biggest future risk is one giant market crash.
I think the bigger danger is a slow global erosion of: confidence
motivation
creativity
and long-term thinking.
Because economies are not powered only by money.
They are powered by human belief in the future.
And when populations stop believing the future will improve, growth itself begins slowing from the inside.
That type of damage is much harder to repair than a temporary recession.
So What Can Ordinary People Do?
We may not control governments, wars, or central banks.
But we can control how we prepare.
Personally, I think the most important things going forward are:
build adaptable skills
reduce unnecessary debt
diversify income streams
stay informed about macro trends
focus on long-term thinking
protect mental resilience
and avoid emotional financial decisions
Because the next decade may reward people who remain: patient
flexible
calm
and strategically prepared.
Final Thought
The world economy may not collapse tomorrow.
But something deeper may already be changing beneath the surface.
A long period of uncertainty can slowly reshape how entire societies think, spend, invest, and live.
And perhaps the biggest battle ahead is not only economic…
but psychological.
The future may belong to those who can stay rational while the world becomes increasingly emotional.
#EYS_|_Turning patience into power 🌱🌾💎

body.title: Famous Signatures
body.body:
![signatures.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ds-tech/23tHZ6Y2xKzwbxqMVCDo5Ao2xfVcCxXgDaNkyqxeSfDU7eqnJYs1kVf9EWyLJwpGvdYSb.png)


Anyone else obsessed with signatures?
As a designer/artist there's an obvious appeal to them. 
I used to do graffiti, and many of my friends were also graffiti artists.
 
The 'tag' or hand-style was basically your signature, and done with a large-nib marker or a spray-can. 
Usually if you didn't have a good tag/signature you probably didn't have good real pieces or throw-ups. 
Your tag could also be done very quick/discrete.

Wikipedia has a surprising number of SVG's of signatures for famous people.
Here is my collection of the ones I thought were good or interesting.

The absolute stand-outs: Donald Trump, John Hancock(obviously).
Donald Trump's signature reminds me of a style you'll see repeated in graffiti artists in the USA.
There was a painter local to me who went by the name ORACLE, and his hand-style was sort of similar.

body.title: Writing in the Vinton Cemetery
body.body:
Hello writing community. This is my first post in this community. I have been on the blockchain since 2018. I am mostly a travel blogger. I have decided to write a historical fiction book about my grandparents and the honeymoon trip they took in 1939. 

I wanted a place to record the stories I write that I could share with others and--- maybe find a writing community to help keep me motivated. 

---

In April I went to Iowa to do some research. Here is the post about Vinton [Share Our World: The Vinton Benton Iowa Cemetery](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@sjarvie5/share-our-world-the-vinton-benton-iowa-cemetery)

 I wrote this piece while sitting in the Vinton Cemetery next to my ancestors graves. I am a photographer and so there will be pictures with my writings :) 

|https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-WntDbcw/0/KHmpGqMRqH5Pr4snDz9gRdwSCFKTBvj2mBJ3tV8CC/XL/PXL_20260420_195749978~2-XL.jpg||https://photos.smugmug.com/Personal/2021-Photo-Book/2026-Book/n-j8srDw/April/i-hZjSZqS/0/MfhGR5PqvczbD34MvmmgHvzJSL5Lp8kNt4RfRT8Md/XL/PXL_20260420_192057648.PORTRAIT-XL.jpg|
|-|-|-|


The book is a Multi POV with Pauline and Russell and this scene is well into the first section of the book. 




**Pauline**

**Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, May 3, 1939**



\
I said, as I paused next to a headstone, \

Russell nodded. With his real estate business, he had been all over Iowa. 

I really liked going to Vinton and seeing my dad's family. One of my favorite parts was the big Victorian houses that my dad would always make sure to drive past and point out to us on the way to the cemetery. I thought they were beautiful with all the different colors and I felt so connected to them after my dad told us that his father and grandfather were both painters and painted some of these old houses.

Walking along side Russell, I said, \

Russell took my hand in his as we continued walking.  

I cried when my grandma died and my heart broke when my dad died. Even though he was withdrawn he was still there. One day in January he went to the hospital. He was there for a couple of weeks and I visited him almost every day with my mom and brother and two days after my mom's birthday, he died of a blood clot following his appendectomy. We missed him so much.

With a heavy sigh, I thought, *I miss him so much.*

Turning back to Russell, I said, \

Looking out at the headstones here in Gettysburg, I think of the cemetery in Vinton where my grandpa's parents are buried next to two of their girls—Leila and Lizzie. I remember standing by their graves on the day we buried my dad, and how, when I calculated their ages, I realized that they were teenagers when they died…the same age I was right then. Leila was sixteen and Lizzie was fifteen years old. I felt so close to them in that moment.

\
, I said looking out at the graves of so many soldiers. \
Yes, Polly, the things I have read and hear on the radio point to a war in Europe coming and I don't know how we would stay out of it.\
What do you think happens when we die? Easter was three weeks ago... do you believe we will be resurrected?\
Yes, I believe that we will be resurrected and reunited with our loved ones.\
Good morning all, started the day earlier than usual as I had a slide deck to prepare for work. Today is also 20 anniversary of Spotify, how time flies, wishing all a great day ahead!

body.title: [ENG - ESP] Running Through Vitoria 🏙️🏃‍♀️| My Entry for Phone Photography Contest #113
body.body: /> 🏙️🏃‍♀️ ======== A Quick, Beautiful Escape to Vitoria-Gasteiz ============================================ Una escapada exprés y hermosa a Vitoria-Gasteiz ----------------------------------------------- * * * 🏙️Last year, a very special friend of mine came to visit. She is much more than just a friend; she is practically family to me. She needed to run some errands, so we decided to take care of them in a neighboring city, and that is how we ended up visiting Vitoria for the day. 🛣️_El año pasado vino de visita una amiga muy importante para mí, que más que una amiga es un miembro de mi familia. Ella necesitaba hacer algunas diligencias y aprovechamos de hacerlas en una ciudad vecina a donde yo vivo. Así fue como acabamos visitando Vitoria por un día._ * * *

/> 🏙️We had to sort out several things in just a few hours and in an unfamiliar city, where we actually got lost a few times just trying to find a bus stop. I remember us running around from one place to another, but it was so much fun! Part of the reason we chose to do those errands there was to get to see at least a little bit of the city, since I had never had the chance or the excuse to go, despite living so close. 🛣️_Ese día teníamos varios asuntos que resolver en pocas horas y además en una ciudad desconocida, donde de hecho nos perdimos varias veces buscando alguna parada de autobús. Recuerdo que andábamos corriendo de un lado para otro, pero fue muy divertido. En parte el propósito de hacer las diligencias allí era ver aunque fuera un poco el lugar, pues a pesar de vivir cerca yo nunca había tenido ocasión ni excusa para ir._ * * *

/> 🏙️Of course, we didn't get to see much, and while we didn't stop often to take pictures, we did manage to capture some lovely moments. You can tell by the smiles on our faces that we were rushed but incredibly happy. 🛣️_Por supuesto que vimos muy poco y, aunque no nos detuvimos mucho a tomar fotos, sí logramos capturar algunos momentos lindos y por nuestras sonrisas se puede apreciar que estábamos apuradas pero contentas._ * * *

/> ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 🏙️After taking a quick break to grab a drink and recharge our batteries, we pushed on with our scheduled errands. Time was running out, and we had to make sure we caught the bus back home on time, but the beautiful views of the Plaza de la Virgen Blanca, the Cathedral of Mary Immaculate, and the labyrinthine monument at the Plaza de Los Fueros remained etched in our memories and in some of these photos. 🛣️_Después de tomar una pausa para tomar algo y recargarnos las pilas, continuamos con las diligencias programadas. Ya nos quedaba menos tiempo y teníamos que alcanzar el autobús de regreso a casa a tiempo, pero en nuestras memorias y algunas de estas fotos quedaron grabadas las hermosas vistas de la Plaza de la Virgen Blanca, la Catedral de María Inmaculada y el monumento laberíntico de la Plaza de Los Fueros._ * * *

/> ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 🏙️We stumbled upon these three places without even knowing they existed, which added a wonderful sense of excitement and surprise to the whole experience. 🛣️_Con estos tres lugares nos topamos sin saber de su existencia, eso añadió emoción y sorpresa a la experiencia._ * * *

/> 🏙️The Cathedral was closed at the time, so exploring its interior will have to wait for our next visit when my friend comes back this year. Since that trip will be more planned and with the sole purpose of getting to know Vitoria better, we will be able to take way more photos (I promise!). 🛣️_La Catedral estaba cerrada en ese momento, así que apreciar su interior nos quedará para la siguiente visita, cuando mi amiga vuelva este año. Como esta vez será más planeado y con el único propósito de conocer más de Vitoria, podremos tomar más fotos (lo prometo)._

/> * * * 🏙️The next photo is one of my absolute favorites from my entire album last year. I took it from one of the sides of the Plaza de la Virgen Blanca, and I think it has a special charm—in fact, I stood there for a while just taking in the view. It was the sun, the vapor trail left by a plane passing through the sky right above the bell tower of the Church of San Miguel Arcángel, the white glass balconies, the awnings of the restaurants and terraces, and that bright pop of color from the little red tourist train, all pointing towards the steps. 🛣️_La siguiente foto es de mis favoritas de todo mi álbum del año pasado. La tomé desde uno de los laterales de la Plaza de la Virgen Blanca y me parece que tiene un encanto especial, de hecho me quedé un rato allí parada apreciando esa vista. Eran el sol, la estela que iba dejando un avión al pasar por el cielo, encima de la vista de la torre campanario de la Iglesia de San Miguel Arcángel, los balcones acristalados blancos, los toldos de restaurantes y terrazas, y el toque de color brillante del pequeño trencito turístico rojo, todo señalando hacia las escalinatas._

/> 🏙️And that is why I have chosen it as my entry for the Phone Photography Contest, created and hosted by @untilwelearn in this lovely Feel Good community, en su edición #113th. 🛣️_Y por eso la he escogido como mi entrada para el concurso Phone Photography Contest, creado y organizado por @untilwelearn en esta linda comunidad de Feel Good, now on its 113th edition._ * * *

/> ### Thank you for reading! 🫶 🏙️Thank you so much for stopping by and sharing this memory with me. I hope you enjoyed this quick glimpse of Vitoria! See you in my next post. Hugs! ### _¡Gracias por leer!_ 🫶 🛣️_Muchas gracias por pasaros por aquí y compartir este recuerdo conmigo. ¡Espero que hayáis disfrutado de este vistazo rápido a Vitoria! Nos vemos en el próximo post. ¡Un abrazo!_
