body.body:
## Warm greetings to hivers and my creative community 😍💕.

![2338E285-475D-4C72-AD72-7667DB802FE1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458b6yjBLQzgSkMHuiJgStjJfWk7XtQ4BJohGyhL1dLCV6c2dNupUGE8XnvqAAwJxvMK.jpeg)

![41639DEE-FCBC-4423-8565-6C319A54ABA1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458bK3fS1EgNbg1rjzWfemc9NyT1gzDfbV1ZX72JByy8H4XXqkym3oKgcfD5BGnuY8VP.jpeg)

![7C3E68B6-FBEE-442E-A63D-2A892EA0F871.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpFih8rec1owoytahoGc6SzRcx161YuY1Q1vERF3bpRwNvNL7dvsKHdekWCMpdwtCj.jpeg)

Am happy to be back today to share with friends who  love delicious meals, especially  Continental dishes because this is what this recipe that is of fish sauce I made represents 🍤🐡. Versatile in the kitchen that you will enjoy a stress free work week

Fish is one healthy protein source we all enjoy, so rich that we can just make it the only protein we eat if we don’t want too many fat that red meat 🥩 provides. Fish 🐠 is even more appetizing when we make a sauce with it because it becomes so versatile in the kitchen as we pair it with any  meal of our choice 🥘.

And honestly, this recipe of fish sauce is not an easy one which is why the weekend is usually the best timing to prepare it, after which all the ingredients are readily gathered and made available during groceries. So you really need to arrange ingredients ahead of time if you want to truly enjoy this best tasty and spicy 🌶 fish sauce with family over the weekend. 

This fish 🐟 sauce is very versatile in your kitchen because you can serve and treat your family and loved 🥰 ones for a lunch 🥙 or dinner of hot bowl of rice, boiled potatoes 🥔, spaghetti 🍝, beans with plantains by the side, macaroni and even hot boiled yam 🍠 with side vegetable.

![7AB97F47-AE51-4A2B-A271-8A423898FD1C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYQs3s3y7afXNVJRAz3C66j3H6qGbBCY36sySGz6DDvCcN7AzDixU15TKUj6vNiiiL.jpeg)

And because its time consuming, you can prepare it in large quantity with enough ingredients to store and refrigerate it properly for weeks, helping to ease off stress of making sauce every weekend. Taste so delicious that you will be hooked to this fish sauce I made for family dinner 🥘 over the weekend.

Come with me as we explore the kitchen making this continental versatile sauce 🍝🥫🍅🌶🧅

# INGREDIENTS: ( Family Dinner)

![BBE2D7A7-63C5-44AB-9F71-4AF6FF11555B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvncKbfBdbGSRsFhG9HRjFrUixm8cENvtyyhFwr6F3VozfAQUZSMnxWY5fG4FPbVKeC.jpeg)

![EE92B148-F62A-4E53-9C79-EBB4420B1090.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xySdLGzWBjzYxox5dqMBeXgt6DRCC1LFE5xLS5ZFvG5sknPBHZ5RBbLCwTqYjKm72AT.jpeg)

1 (one) large Titus Fish 
Bowl of fresh tomatoes 🍅 
2 medium red onions 
Handful of fresh chili 🌶 peppers
1/2 cup of vegetable oil
1 teaspoon  of salt 
1 teaspoon of curry powder 
1 teaspoon of thyme herb 🌿 
1 teaspoon of chili powder 
3 seasoning cubes 
1/2 glass of water 
(Spices shared for the fish and sauce)

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![970262E4-ABBD-4531-BC75-DDDE228240A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKuvRVfM84xJuh21DfJSGFkzSCPR8U7M9Zv5PGahMMXVZ5YBCxDSy1L9DGHCvpp.jpeg)

![E3455FA9-2920-4A15-991A-1838CA151519.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tSPsPscVyo6LKfue8w9YH5AtDLbsoAbjTJL44jzgAGBV9fZJQVLfp3PQwCpeSNR6Nzn.jpeg)

![DD273BDA-7340-4577-A158-5F3AE1B4C0A0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xehVHYdQ9PdAuMgV9PvNR5faxw2NpPUqnTTsXiMoCu6yv5oqXaWurjQeKd9orTz42jw.jpeg)

First thing to do is to properly cut, slice and clean our fish, Before we thoroughly wash it with salt.

Step 2.

![71E85A62-E764-43D1-961E-582B987F5D92.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2423z1YKEywd7N5WNcbKU6FJ2eAToCQnb2PmFixxW36kctRoJWZhSR2A1GhkR5mMd2gqb.jpeg)

![B218C432-1DCD-4FA1-983C-BAE154969405.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsBujcqrmfwGyt69NuSpbD3yLZD1wwSJdGEEVd6QAZYQdutnK9MAhe7o4Lb5k1Xe79h.jpeg)

We place the fish into a cooking pan and set it on the cooker to start heating up and bring out its first water.

![9F6BAB9D-71E0-401F-B3F1-5F32A65A04A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2D67ouqioQPmrAmKzDF42DC8BR3hmADfh5PKbf5Me8VUSPdSDBhJEtaWpJLvK.jpeg)

![02CC96B4-2491-455C-BD45-F5C76A99122B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsBdQmhThcQAUFpTHhaSAtFjzmsuQRzRWuBhvKxTPHweYHJv5xK68rDgwM865cafRsX.jpeg)

Once it heats up, we add the seasoning ingredients. The salt, curry, thyme herb and chili powder. As above. 

Step 3.

![738EB8CD-1ED3-4894-B939-2994E6180C55.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhnpvGZAPBtVbxvJ2XrzWJSorveoUA64z7TWQQp9MdYEvX1uwW5oCXD6sGc6vVjmVst.jpeg)

![9EB9DEAA-6241-4942-9405-26119695FE07.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhViQyeJBNazmzAo5QWkE1NAjAdvmwkep19teYzoY5iSAj8swRRw7GmE7c9qj3Zda6C.jpeg)

Allow for a second or two for the fish to absorb the seasoning, then we add a half glass of water

![57267143-B7E5-47DA-96BA-DA1F57C42B87.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhoLGX58rU5iz14SgDsEZVM11L8FQtMHAnMoBmp2fD16zdEANCMyjRrYbUyb8GL6npc.jpeg)

![53641725-99EB-4A46-AB34-82C31188EEB3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsEDnNwJS9YDepSsfd8ghPrVQCVuYFdiekPFyjuAQXcMVhx3xrLgkKPDywNB5BtYaKq.jpeg)

Then we cover and cook the fish properly.

Step 4.

![DBC3677F-CC5F-4751-BB87-3703B0F695E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpjUrgLisK9mukAzoSAPJE7Bq6Ar2unNsihDGz8WQUZugsYwo51utdsGfqiK5F.jpeg)

Here we add the seasoning cubes in a while after and allow to absorb as it cooks for few more minutes.

Step 5.

![C08C2DA5-2E70-444C-B611-727225985DB4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/241ZzJMqDA25GW4SVzmdmnqKzdRMKftNmENEg48oz16jmTVVKFNVKiRktkPrVGuEVRgDH.jpeg)

![96D8E476-1D2B-4AD8-98F3-3744CAC69A22.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xenF7JdZLP4Ed9iSUJSgw4MkMdPGn5wYFg2kvNTNQ9ZtY9xLva3qhGo8GnPCqJcn6QY.jpeg)

![1A2369F7-B94F-4BC9-BF54-E4DE4F4179FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKpBsGJFxVcZaRokADf3mLskaRcVjpLVy1USYzRv1LvYJs7L6MCdQ5ZTHV3zmGR.jpeg)

![330C5D5D-707E-4E25-977C-30D773CFAE6F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244yCE7z5XCJKPU27PHYiceiF4xiWwT614vq9KgMSzWRyCFjJEvU6MKkZwoU3qeG4UeUA.jpeg)

Next, we wash and slice the tomatoes 🍅 in chunks , the onions and peppers too. As above.

![5D794337-8C3B-4F81-A1AA-E5E9C923254B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK578EAjU5BYQm5Z25pa7mexDPRMqLe9DE8iB3ueH9HyCPa2NQmKeHR3FnQM7Ps.jpeg)

![62E99DBE-47EC-4142-AACC-A4D985BBAFBF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xpCe6qH3rRrpCKx59bxGVQVeb1H4yBNH2DP8YmKLdrUf88EuHUyCVaAzvT9pnPyhcvB.jpeg)

Add them into the blender and blend into tomatoes 🍅, onions 🧅 and chili 🌶 puree paste . 

Step 6.

![0233821B-DAA6-442F-8AB0-2D4F93CE7B2A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2D4JEX6QrWFJ3FANJurvGFzG7DNBRkDXJVXs2gMnjKZbgP2Sxs89aCQvbxpjj.jpeg)

To fry our tasty and spicy sauce, we heat up our vegetable oil, add the paste purée to start frying and cover it up.

![9592BE8E-F0F1-4726-B875-4F51E8DA85B4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhoQfkNwWSJk5FUBzb5BQW4mn12LoxrLELux4v588BkjQvG5RQ5e8nrsGwjtJgpE1rs.jpeg)

We stir from time to time to prevent sticky and burning.

Step 7.

![D10F1B70-8A8B-4714-992E-8882C7A04644.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKDhXsX7AwyWzLydLHyr5W2MRpsB6pNjr8uTgDdTsajeQyhg2Eb4mYydqnNGiHA.jpeg)

![5C621B0D-04BB-4648-9CC1-CD7BFEC66052.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242NeoSizLreeijrHcRdFuAFmvPVwpF3Xm8xVR2H94wQVvsfU7sNDzAgn5SQzenfsZUyR.jpeg)

Once it starts to dry, we lower heat, add our salt, chili powder, thyme herb 🌿 and the curry powder. As above.

![AA0BE089-2E5D-4D23-8EA0-CBBD194D09DA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK7xg86sYCr6mqFqRHNfPJjXTPuyGqjXkeoSzzZyrXeeCeveNSwVPRZyyUNrLgD.jpeg)

We stir to incorporate, adding the seasoning cubes and the fish water to also incorporate.

Step 8.

![49E4F72A-281C-4C63-B8A6-A5DAAB7C6868.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zkkG7XAfnq3Hqkj54zWGY4HzP3EQxVYRpiJFradvcUKVqNCkDGZDe1CdN4uPuqjr71H.jpeg)

![9BF31F5E-9158-4312-9A40-981FE8D16131.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALPBaJ6mYCERCwQBsLJkjGxik46VVDdURDnjJgVEuT1WQtyJp2kkKULyLsoaswN.jpeg)

Then, we will notice oily surface sauce once it’s properly dried. We then gradually add our fish into the sauce.

![80679B56-72FC-4982-A7B5-89D15B25E411.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbKSy3jDYgMs2yFq6UStMZaCdzGsCod7dCKFBWu5ucz57Gr58gQgcGbTGtzG78Ljoos.jpeg)

![0C7DC142-C8CA-4D1A-BB18-A38CBAD985DA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vho3KCeV5xxQaZREWMca7kLZDjhu9952DPuSwn5FbXn1YPw7R88VPLSAMxDkgGCHDHM.jpeg)

Allow the sauce to penetrate into the fish with low heating covered. Set it down in a while.

![A3D74366-47C5-4341-A8E6-5AC7465A175C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpFih8rec1owoytahoGc6SzRcx161YuY1Q1vERF3bpRwNvNL7dvsKHdekWCMpdwtCj.jpeg)

Oh waoh! You see why this recipe is a weekend timing because you really need lots of time on hand to be able to prepare this delicious sauce to treat family. But I tell you it’s worth all the time it consumed. You can never beat a sauce like this anytime.

![C39972EF-6ABA-455E-8E72-362EF579F33F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1yfiL2fUr5taqH5iWppUC8sRQtZep5xMaiuN9C9h81SYUMCeUSZySmhM25mPrQb3qr.jpeg)

![78E54862-6EFD-4646-AE98-805E19CD4364.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUTFfzvrUksF9MCov3Skf2RQ4bJnDx7zyUnwM8WMq3Y8DUxRTTJNhYjhZmMceX5AGXb.jpeg)

Begin right now to start gathering your ingredients for this sauce as the week keeps ticking towards the weekend. So delicious that you will never not want to make this sauce. Tasty, spicy and delicious. Enjoy 😊 

## Thank you creative friends for joining me.  Hope you enjoyed 🥰❤️.

### Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

![B297FCDE-15B1-4DD6-9B15-318189E25920.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wrCDE2h44bLTEYSEBGxB6ZehD3N2pQsNLmW9rQUmRRK84pKoeCsTcUMgKE4vVnsSq4X.gif)

### Espanol Version

## Un saludo cariñoso a los hivers y a mi comunidad creativa 😍💕.

![2338E285-475D-4C72-AD72-7667DB802FE1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458b6yjBLQzgSkMHuiJgStjJfWk7XtQ4BJohGyhL1dLCV6c2dNupUGE8XnvqAAwJxvMK.jpeg)

![41639DEE-FCBC-4423-8565-6C319A54ABA1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458bK3fS1EgNbg1rjzWfemc9NyT1gzDfbV1ZX72JByy8H4XXqkym3oKgcfD5BGnuY8VP.jpeg)

![7C3E68B6-FBEE-442E-A63D-2A892EA0F871.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpFih8rec1owoytahoGc6SzRcx161YuY1Q1vERF3bpRwNvNL7dvsKHdekWCMpdwtCj.jpeg)

Me alegra volver hoy para compartir con los amigos a los que les encantan las comidas deliciosas, sobre todo los platos continentales, porque eso es lo que representa esta receta de salsa de pescado que he preparado 🍤🐡. Es tan versátil en la cocina que te permitirá disfrutar de una semana laboral sin estrés

El pescado es una fuente de proteína saludable que todos disfrutamos, tan rica que podemos convertirla en la única proteína que consumimos si no queremos el exceso de grasa que aporta la carne roja 🥩. El pescado 🐠 resulta aún más apetecible cuando preparamos una salsa con él, ya que se vuelve muy versátil en la cocina al poder combinarlo con cualquier  plato que elijamos 🥘.

Y, sinceramente, esta receta de salsa de pescado no es fácil, por lo que el fin de semana suele ser el mejor momento para prepararla, ya que para entonces todos los ingredientes están reunidos y disponibles en la despensa. Así que realmente tienes que preparar los ingredientes con antelación si quieres disfrutar de verdad de esta deliciosa y picante 🌶 salsa de pescado con la familia durante el fin de semana. 

Esta salsa de pescado 🐟 es muy versátil en la cocina, ya que puedes servirla y deleitar a tu familia y seres queridos 🥰 en un almuerzo 🥙 o una cena con un plato caliente de arroz, patatas hervidas 🥔, espaguetis 🍝, frijoles con plátanos como guarnición, macarrones e incluso ñame hervido 🍠 con verduras de acompañamiento.

![7AB97F47-AE51-4A2B-A271-8A423898FD1C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYQs3s3y7afXNVJRAz3C66j3H6qGbBCY36sySGz6DDvCcN7AzDixU15TKUj6vNiiiL.jpeg)

Y como lleva bastante tiempo prepararla, puedes hacer una gran cantidad con los ingredientes necesarios para conservarla y refrigerarla adecuadamente durante semanas, lo que te ayudará a aliviar el estrés de tener que preparar salsa cada fin de semana. Está tan deliciosa que te vas a volver adicto a esta salsa de pescado que preparé para la cena familiar 🥘 del fin de semana.

Acompáñame a explorar la cocina mientras preparamos esta salsa continental tan versátil 🍝🥫🍅🌶🧅

## INGREDIENTES: (Cena familiar)

![BBE2D7A7-63C5-44AB-9F71-4AF6FF11555B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tvncKbfBdbGSRsFhG9HRjFrUixm8cENvtyyhFwr6F3VozfAQUZSMnxWY5fG4FPbVKeC.jpeg)

![EE92B148-F62A-4E53-9C79-EBB4420B1090.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xySdLGzWBjzYxox5dqMBeXgt6DRCC1LFE5xLS5ZFvG5sknPBHZ5RBbLCwTqYjKm72AT.jpeg)

1 (un) pescado Titus grande 
Un cuenco de tomates frescos 🍅 
2 cebollas rojas medianas 
Un puñado de chiles frescos 🌶
1/2 taza de aceite vegetal
1 cucharadita de sal 
1 cucharadita de curry en polvo 
1 cucharadita de tomillo 🌿 
1 cucharadita de chile en polvo 
3 cubitos de caldo 
1/2 vaso de agua 
(Especias comunes para el pescado y la salsa)

## PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![970262E4-ABBD-4531-BC75-DDDE228240A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKuvRVfM84xJuh21DfJSGFkzSCPR8U7M9Zv5PGahMMXVZ5YBCxDSy1L9DGHCvpp.jpeg)

![E3455FA9-2920-4A15-991A-1838CA151519.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tSPsPscVyo6LKfue8w9YH5AtDLbsoAbjTJL44jzgAGBV9fZJQVLfp3PQwCpeSNR6Nzn.jpeg)

![DD273BDA-7340-4577-A158-5F3AE1B4C0A0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xehVHYdQ9PdAuMgV9PvNR5faxw2NpPUqnTTsXiMoCu6yv5oqXaWurjQeKd9orTz42jw.jpeg)

Lo primero que hay que hacer es cortar, trocear y limpiar bien el pescado, antes de lavarlo a fondo con sal.

Paso 2.

![71E85A62-E764-43D1-961E-582B987F5D92.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2423z1YKEywd7N5WNcbKU6FJ2eAToCQnb2PmFixxW36kctRoJWZhSR2A1GhkR5mMd2gqb.jpeg)

![B218C432-1DCD-4FA1-983C-BAE154969405.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsBujcqrmfwGyt69NuSpbD3yLZD1wwSJdGEEVd6QAZYQdutnK9MAhe7o4Lb5k1Xe79h.jpeg)

Ponemos el pescado en una cacerola y la colocamos en el fogón para que se caliente y suelte el primer jugo.

![9F6BAB9D-71E0-401F-B3F1-5F32A65A04A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2D67ouqioQPmrAmKzDF42DC8BR3hmADfh5PKbf5Me8VUSPdSDBhJEtaWpJLvK.jpeg)

![02CC96B4-2491-455C-BD45-F5C76A99122B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsBdQmhThcQAUFpTHhaSAtFjzmsuQRzRWuBhvKxTPHweYHJv5xK68rDgwM865cafRsX.jpeg)

Cuando se caliente, añadimos los ingredientes para condimentar: la sal, el curry, el tomillo y el chile en polvo. Como se ha indicado anteriormente. 

Paso 3.

![738EB8CD-1ED3-4894-B939-2994E6180C55.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhnpvGZAPBtVbxvJ2XrzWJSorveoUA64z7TWQQp9MdYEvX1uwW5oCXD6sGc6vVjmVst.jpeg)

![9EB9DEAA-6241-4942-9405-26119695FE07.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhViQyeJBNazmzAo5QWkE1NAjAdvmwkep19teYzoY5iSAj8swRRw7GmE7c9qj3Zda6C.jpeg)

Deja que el pescado absorba el aderezo durante un segundo o dos y, a continuación, añade medio vaso de agua

![57267143-B7E5-47DA-96BA-DA1F57C42B87.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhoLGX58rU5iz14SgDsEZVM11L8FQtMHAnMoBmp2fD16zdEANCMyjRrYbUyb8GL6npc.jpeg)

![53641725-99EB-4A46-AB34-82C31188EEB3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsEDnNwJS9YDepSsfd8ghPrVQCVuYFdiekPFyjuAQXcMVhx3xrLgkKPDywNB5BtYaKq.jpeg)

A continuación, tapamos la olla y cocinamos el pescado como es debido.

Paso 4.

![DBC3677F-CC5F-4751-BB87-3703B0F695E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJpjUrgLisK9mukAzoSAPJE7Bq6Ar2unNsihDGz8WQUZugsYwo51utdsGfqiK5F.jpeg)

Aquí añadimos los cubitos de condimento un poco más tarde y dejamos que se absorban mientras se cocina durante unos minutos más.

Paso 5.

![C08C2DA5-2E70-444C-B611-727225985DB4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/241ZzJMqDA25GW4SVzmdmnqKzdRMKftNmENEg48oz16jmTVVKFNVKiRktkPrVGuEVRgDH.jpeg)

![96D8E476-1D2B-4AD8-98F3-3744CAC69A22.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xenF7JdZLP4Ed9iSUJSgw4MkMdPGn5wYFg2kvNTNQ9ZtY9xLva3qhGo8GnPCqJcn6QY.jpeg)

![1A2369F7-B94F-4BC9-BF54-E4DE4F4179FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKpBsGJFxVcZaRokADf3mLskaRcVjpLVy1USYzRv1LvYJs7L6MCdQ5ZTHV3zmGR.jpeg)

![330C5D5D-707E-4E25-977C-30D773CFAE6F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244yCE7z5XCJKPU27PHYiceiF4xiWwT614vq9KgMSzWRyCFjJEvU6MKkZwoU3qeG4UeUA.jpeg)

A continuación, lavamos y cortamos los tomates 🍅 en trozos, y lo mismo hacemos con las cebollas y los pimientos. Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

![5D794337-8C3B-4F81-A1AA-E5E9C923254B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK578EAjU5BYQm5Z25pa7mexDPRMqLe9DE8iB3ueH9HyCPa2NQmKeHR3FnQM7Ps.jpeg)

![62E99DBE-47EC-4142-AACC-A4D985BBAFBF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xpCe6qH3rRrpCKx59bxGVQVeb1H4yBNH2DP8YmKLdrUf88EuHUyCVaAzvT9pnPyhcvB.jpeg)

Échalos en la batidora y tritúralos hasta obtener un puré de tomates 🍅, cebollas 🧅 y chile 🌶. 

Paso 6.

![0233821B-DAA6-442F-8AB0-2D4F93CE7B2A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2D4JEX6QrWFJ3FANJurvGFzG7DNBRkDXJVXs2gMnjKZbgP2Sxs89aCQvbxpjj.jpeg)

Para preparar nuestra sabrosa y picante salsa, calentamos el aceite vegetal, añadimos el puré de pasta para empezar a sofreírlo y lo tapamos.

![9592BE8E-F0F1-4726-B875-4F51E8DA85B4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhoQfkNwWSJk5FUBzb5BQW4mn12LoxrLELux4v588BkjQvG5RQ5e8nrsGwjtJgpE1rs.jpeg)

Removemos de vez en cuando para evitar que se pegue o se queme.

Paso 7.

![D10F1B70-8A8B-4714-992E-8882C7A04644.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKDhXsX7AwyWzLydLHyr5W2MRpsB6pNjr8uTgDdTsajeQyhg2Eb4mYydqnNGiHA.jpeg)

![5C621B0D-04BB-4648-9CC1-CD7BFEC66052.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242NeoSizLreeijrHcRdFuAFmvPVwpF3Xm8xVR2H94wQVvsfU7sNDzAgn5SQzenfsZUyR.jpeg)

En cuanto empiece a secarse, bajamos el fuego, añadimos la sal, el chile en polvo, el tomillo 🌿 y el curry en polvo. Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

![AA0BE089-2E5D-4D23-8EA0-CBBD194D09DA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK7xg86sYCr6mqFqRHNfPJjXTPuyGqjXkeoSzzZyrXeeCeveNSwVPRZyyUNrLgD.jpeg)

Removemos para mezclarlo todo, añadiendo los cubitos de condimento y el caldo de pescado para incorporarlos también.

Paso 8.

![49E4F72A-281C-4C63-B8A6-A5DAAB7C6868.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zkkG7XAfnq3Hqkj54zWGY4HzP3EQxVYRpiJFradvcUKVqNCkDGZDe1CdN4uPuqjr71H.jpeg)

![9BF31F5E-9158-4312-9A40-981FE8D16131.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALPBaJ6mYCERCwQBsLJkjGxik46VVDdURDnjJgVEuT1WQtyJp2kkKULyLsoaswN.jpeg)

Una vez que se haya secado bien, veremos que la salsa tiene una capa aceitosa en la superficie. A continuación, vamos añadiendo poco a poco el pescado a la salsa.

![80679B56-72FC-4982-A7B5-89D15B25E411.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbKSy3jDYgMs2yFq6UStMZaCdzGsCod7dCKFBWu5ucz57Gr58gQgcGbTGtzG78Ljoos.jpeg)

![0C7DC142-C8CA-4D1A-BB18-A38CBAD985DA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vho3KCeV5xxQaZREWMca7kLZDjhu9952DPuSwn5FbXn1YPw7R88VPLSAMxDkgGCHDHM.jpeg)

Deja que la salsa penetre en el pescado a fuego lento y con la tapa puesta. Déjalo reposar un rato.

![A3D74366-47C5-4341-A8E6-5AC7465A175C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpFih8rec1owoytahoGc6SzRcx161YuY1Q1vERF3bpRwNvNL7dvsKHdekWCMpdwtCj.jpeg)

¡Vaya! Ya ves por qué esta receta es ideal para el fin de semana, porque realmente necesitas mucho tiempo libre para poder preparar esta deliciosa salsa con la que dar una sorpresa a la familia. Pero te aseguro que vale la pena todo el tiempo que lleva. Una salsa como esta es insuperable en cualquier ocasión.

![C39972EF-6ABA-455E-8E72-362EF579F33F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r1yfiL2fUr5taqH5iWppUC8sRQtZep5xMaiuN9C9h81SYUMCeUSZySmhM25mPrQb3qr.jpeg)

![78E54862-6EFD-4646-AE98-805E19CD4364.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUTFfzvrUksF9MCov3Skf2RQ4bJnDx7zyUnwM8WMq3Y8DUxRTTJNhYjhZmMceX5AGXb.jpeg)

Empieza ya mismo a reunir los ingredientes para esta salsa, ya que la semana avanza hacia el fin de semana. Es tan deliciosa que siempre querrás prepararla. Sabrosa, picante y deliciosa. ¡Que la disfrutes! 😊 

## Gracias, amigos creativos, por acompañarme. Espero que lo hayáis disfrutado 🥰❤️.

## Un saludo, @sunshine29 🧡

Traducido con DeepL

Las imágenes son mías.

body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

> **Hoy ha sido un día largo.** Acabo de llegar a casa hace un rato y aún me sorprende todo lo que hice hoy. Todo comenzó esta mañana; me desperté temprano, ya tenía todo arreglado para llevar mis documentos a la universidad, así que solo era cuestión de arreglarme para salir. Fui a la parada de bus y, afortunadamente, llegué temprano. Encontré a algunas amigas, recibí las planillas y las llené con la información necesaria. En el proceso empezamos a reírnos, bromear y disfrutar de casi nuestro último trámite juntas. No puedo creer aún que ya terminamos la universidad, que ya estamos a punto de graduarnos, que ya culminamos nuestro proceso de aprendizaje para ser licenciadas. Es simplemente una hermosa experiencia. Así que aproveché de romantizarlo y he tomado fotos desde ayer. Quiero documentar todo lo que pueda, porque no solo nos quedan los recuerdos, sino también esas fotos, esos videos que, al verlos dentro de años nuevamente, nos harán rememorarlo todo. Continuando con mi storytime, al entregar los papeles me notificaron que faltaba un requisito, el cual tramité en la tarde de hoy. Ahora solo espero a tenerlo para terminar de consignarlo todo. body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - Cut the Cord
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Cut the Cord. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTaHrjFiz6GA8WIhimBj5DfcgRh2KWrFOb4DW1zzynsEA&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTaHrjFiz6GA8WIhimBj5DfcgRh2KWrFOb4DW1zzynsEA&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTaHrjFiz6GA8WIhimBj5DfcgRh2KWrFOb4DW1zzynsEA&s=10)

The nurse passed James a pair of scissors after hearing the loud cries of the new born. 
\

A visibly touched James who has accompanied his wife Junie through the whole delivery process, slowly snaps the cord linking his son and his wife with steady hand. After he cuts the cord and hands the scissors back to the nurse, he reached out to his wife and plants a kiss on her forehead saying his thanks and appreciationfor Junie.

Our journey of life indepedently all begins when the doctor or our father cuts the cord and bring us to the world. It also means we leave the safe zone of our mother's womb that we had stayed rent free for months and sharing nutrients from our mother, putting her body to the test and adding weight to her. 

Cutting the cord also signify the meaning our parents are responsible for us in a different way from that during pregnancy stages. Thus cutting the cord is not merely a simple action but behind this action it has various significance of life.

body.title: Neutral | Macro Photography Session - Technical Description
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23wqiSGnDevBV4LwaHtAsJspBQoNCFunBYqfd5gpDVhJYcK8o5gaZRKVmiuV95rGiJyoH.jpg)

##### Hi everyone :)

The biological records are gone, and we're back to minerals.
That little bee came to bring a bit of fresh air to these sessions, not because I don't like minerals, but because it's always good to change the subject matter from time to time.
Other specimens that I love to photograph are plants; I still remember those series focused on secculents and cacti, and how surprised I was time and time again. And they're not entirely ruled out; I know a place where I can photograph quite a few :) we'll see.

---

##### Session Purpose

In these sessions of macro photography, or objective, in order to spend a good amount of time reflecting on oneself, and go as long as possible in no detail, within the limits of the technique that is to be used, of course, sometimes it is difficult to obtain the result that is initially intended, it is better to always make the effort. What interests me is to look carefully, really stop in front of the chosen object and record everything that it reveals, opting for different angles and perspectives, recording the textures, the small irregularities, different contrasts and those small marks that normally go unnoticed. There is also a very visual side to this process, because I don't just want to document, I want to build interesting visual compositions. When I publish this work on my blog, I intend to share this experience of close observation and show the discreet beauty and complexity that exists, many times in the most banal objects, others not so much.

##### Let me present today’s model:

![IMG_4138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23vhq37iB6qiyzicte7yJNJmEth3LziDETRELCBSjJzHMWmj5UgLGbKh2QiJgCngrpxqN.jpg)

<center><sub>F-stop: F/4 | Exposure time: 1/250 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

![IMG_4144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23w2q1ywByfum38H2WageJJRWuHLEqL7Zaw9gj2CSRwQzHTQ36BhJWsHso1BrLmVDuVoj.jpg)

![IMG_4136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23xoz6pY3JD36EWRxW6C9NcDiP4KCWkYctJ4dvCJupCBLuQ3C4yNvnq1eUfAhypT1rvPZ.jpg)

![IMG_4143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23y8soAgPLcz6VWAfhK55Jbr9U7ujgAgJ8AsJzcfXRnXjSoG2X4jFaxogoy5s3ekWG8kp.jpg)

![IMG_4135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23x15EauY3Cu8PCBuNjMajAMcUPnNu9bunjJJUmABm3yjaYLp4zUxtNTcwwQNrtN8HGE9.jpg)

![IMG_4139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23uQkLxqhx1iJaT1SDTgkU73W5Aa1SeJAoMe46m7t5menCKk1CEKZsspoN8uXbG7QbSLe.jpg)
<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/350 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

![IMG_4142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23tbqBvVYUs3oT7Fm4XLvZXJrbUPtwVYeFtUmwXkSR1mcphQ9RxXwHcQ9WpHG1dXiKheQ.jpg)
<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/200 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

![IMG_4141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23tbwQXxZFpHeYqMJ5r5YxqqATcFkYJRVcywqm1qC7prP43SMGmZEr8s5m3V4dXB6khu8.jpg)
<center><sub>F-stop: F/4 | Exposure time: 1/250 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

![IMG_4140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23vsG1X12xdoqFpueHTXBE7Zmtbg9fxTpDDgnwDAEBGkSWiE3cZ9MFE5iuBDTCbHSwHzG.jpg)
<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/350 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

---

There are not several ways to shoot macro photography, but among the possible ways, this is, for me, one of the most simple and mainly the most accessible and very effective, especially for having a camera with objective movement. By removing the lens and inverting it, it is possible to get closer very close and reveal details that normally go unnoticed. With the help of an inverter, the process becomes practical, although it becomes a little instável and difficult to control. What most attracted me to this method is the relationship between the simplicity of the method and the minimally decent result I tend to have with the minimum resources, once it achieves a surprising extension and a new way of working for all types of objects, no matter how common it may seem.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

##### Used equipment & Camera Settings

For these images I used a Canon EOS 600D, a DSLR with a CMOS sensor that gives me a good response to detail and a fairly balanced reading of texture and color.
Worked with an EFS 18–55 mm objective, taking advantage of its versatility and reduced depth of field to isolate small areas of the surface and highlight very specific details. I also reviewed an inverter panel, essential in this process, for allowing the lens to be transformed into a simple and effective macro solution, as it has the opportunity to display the GIFs that part of this article.
Do not use a tripod.
The lighting was made with adjustable LED lights, designed to distribute light softly, control harsh shadows and enhance the structure of the subject.

Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (400) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)

See you soon
Thank you for watching


Never forget
The price of anything is the amount of life you trade for it.
Time is life... value yours, make every fraction worth it.

body.title: La ciudad que no conozco/The city I don't know(ESP-ENG)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJFho9MX1bTYvBKAjXXgaChtQynCyZjXZw3Sw18KAmUm/img_20251204_171555_407.jpg)
Por la ventana, cristal opaco de los ojos,
existe la ciudad, no la conozco,
no la puedo alcanzar con las manos.

Ese grupo de ruinas que revelan la vieja república,
la extraña receta, vetusta, perdida.
Lo que no se invoca en la forma de los hombres.
Las huellas debajo de otras huellas imborrables.
La otra ventana donde observo la rutina
desde una posición ingrata hacia las cosas.

He dicho:
He querido conservar la palabra,
la posibilidad de la tormenta.
El punto desojado de las normas
más allá de la utopía que me invento,
y antes del fondo, la absurda posición de las figuras,
el alma de las bestias que no recorro.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSc7JwGNfhUMw5Wywv3gQkhRwF3jo366vaiZUD2UNGYAt/texto_12_.jpg)

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUNqDXZ5CVYPvhJr369ApccLYKQU3ANCKR6XqUPbQJhB/versi_n_en_espa_ol_3_.jpg)</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJFho9MX1bTYvBKAjXXgaChtQynCyZjXZw3Sw18KAmUm/img_20251204_171555_407.jpg)
Through the window, opaque glass of my eyes,
the city exists, I don't know it,
I can't reach it with my hands.

That cluster of ruins that reveal the old republic,
the strange recipe, ancient, lost.
That which is not invoked in the form of men.
Footprints beneath other indelible footprints.
The other window where I observe the routine
from a position ungrateful toward things.

I have said:
I wanted to preserve the word,
the possibility of the storm.
The point stripped of the norms
beyond the utopia I invent,
and before the background, the absurd position of the figures,
the soul of the beasts I do not traverse.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

body.title: Degustando nutritivo almuerzo de: Hígados de pollos fritos, arroz, plátanos hervidos.(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español

# Saludos amigos amantes del rico y variado sazón.💁☀️

¡Feliz día para todos!

Estos días amigos, han sido tensos para mí y mi familia por la fuertes lluvias que se encuentran azotando en horarios de la tarde en la zona donde habito, y créanme pánico es poco a lo que me generan estos fenómenos ambientales.Hoy, miércoles, para aminorar esta angustiosa sensación colectiva, quise elaborar un delicioso almuerzo combinado de: Hígados de pollos fritos, arroz, plátanos hervidos.Los invito amigos, a que me acompañen a conocer la recetas que empleé para este sabroso almuerzo reparador de emociones.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155608879.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23yJRGxZorXe7DjKZ5UjQG2ffGxX7mD1XoQygxz35vnEg9nhjjbS8jYwEdqvUe8uXpE3d.jpg)
</center>
#

# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú para 4 personas✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_132740185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sorPYB2y3x5wCaevHtoj9e7uD8e8fUdMACgKB6jTARfVShHG5UGsMZ6vt3CnpcXSA.jpg)
</center>
#
.Especias: 8 ajíes, 5 dientes de ajo, 1/4 de cucharada de comino molido.
.Aceite de Oliva: 4 cucharadas
.Hígado de pollo 1 libra
.Arroz: 3 tazas
.Plátanos: 5 unidades
.Vinagre: 2 cucharadas
.Sal: 1 cucharada distribuida en los alimentos.
.Azúcar: 1/2 cucharada
.Agua: 3 tazas para el arroz, y suficiente en el preparado de los alimentos.

# ✨Modo de confección✨

El primer alimento que elaboré fue el hígado de pollo.

# ✨Hígados de pollos fritos
Inicié abriendo un paquete de hígado de 2 kg, extraje de él la mitad de su contenido, y lo lavé con abundante agua. Seguidamente, preparé las especias: ajíes, ajos, retirándoles sus partes no comestibles, lavándolas, cortándolas, y proseguí a cocer el hígado con los pasos siguientes:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_132958512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi5jqGQb6mRKt9tSnSLZ4A9Q62R7es6cusYoz88vLp9gFXXcjgyWXCX9tXddhDrr6nU.jpg)
</center>
#
En un sartén coloqué: 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, las especias, y comencé a darles un leve salteado por unos segundos. Seguidamente, agregué los diminutos hígados al sartén, y continué removiendo con ayuda de una espumadera, mientras le agregaba: 1/2 cucharada de azúcar, 1 cucharada grande de vinagre, 1/4 de cucharada de sal, 1 taza de agua, y un toque de sazón Iberia, para generarle ese apetecible color rojo.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_134019809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCE6WFikpeqRRESnTKfScpuu23qCYmSEfbCoknqvDc5AAUuQ1aMipMRaZsKHCLn5rKo.jpg)
</center>
#
Tapé el sartén, y dejé cocinar el hígado a fuego lento por 20 minutos.Transcurrido el tiempo el hígado había gastado toda su agua y se había quedado sólo en la grasa condimentada, dónde comencé a realizarle movimientos envolventes con ayuda de una espumadera para que se impregnara de la misma, mientras le agregaba un toque de comino y retiraba del fuego.Tapé nuevamente por 1 minuto para que el comino, realizara su trabajo perfecto de aromatizar el alimento, y seguidamente, serví.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155755369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynbG7hyTNeqQcE9Cr2jhEGB4k8SLEpYvKr3AfVgd1q5srZz4Sf88GXXkk2CR8hM8JpH.jpg)
</center>
#
Delicioso el sabor dulzón, vinagrentado, que dejaba deleitar su suave textura.

El segundo alimento que elaboré fue el arroz blanco, apoyándome de mi útil olla arrocera.

# ✨Arroz
Pasos para elaborar el arroz :
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_154737276.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tvwDLknFeeUFqTr4ziJCLctKsbTLbCxu11iENFKKngv7k8uExfkPTmAHEEwjAFEMhNL.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié midiendo 4 tazas de arroz, revisándolas y lavándolas. Seguidamente, las incorporé en una olla con: 4 tazas de agua, 1/2 de cucharada de sal, 2 cucharadas de aceite de oliva. Removí el arroz, tapé la olla, y puse a cocinarlo por 6 minutos, el tiempo exacto en que disparó la olla, dónde se apreciaba un esponjoso y brilloso arroz.¡Divino su sabor a mantequilla, combinó perfectamente con el hígado!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155945701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynb4C6rn7BMhbLUdx9mkv3QKknRRdQrmJ5Fkv94MEjRUN7YWuVXb4M8ZTnj2G6uaxMf.jpg)
</center>
#
El tercer alimento que elaboré de forma fugaz, fue los plátanos hervidos.

# ✨Plátanos hervidos
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_135727111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wMj4EVmXyCrQJ2Nht3UxWJzCJYm26665Lk8SEVu6ko838S64vdLC7XvQ8KcDe3YteW7.jpg)
</center>
#
Tomé 5 plátanos verdes, los lavé y corté en delgadas rodajas con ayuda de un cuchillo.Seguidamente, incorporé las rodajas en un recipiente con 1 taza de agua, 1/4 de cucharada de sal, 1 cucharada de vinagre. Dejé cocinar tapados los plátanos por 7 minutos, y seguidamente los extraje para un plato donde los impregné con una cucharada de aceite pre condimentado con ajo.Espectacular la suave textura lograda de estos plátanos, en tan corto tiempo.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_160048216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zSDUzeeFWEvv2VRpoioWEouaXZxQDoK3Y2HwqbeMhLWzJFFYFiKXuX3rbLWPyQafqmT.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, mi objetivo en el día de hoy de aminorar tensiones con un delicioso almuerzo familiar, fue logrado, pues el menú de: hígado de pollo, arroz y plátanos, fue un éxito en degustación, que encantó a todos los comensales. Espero, que a ustedes, amigos, también les haya resultado apetecible, y que pronto lo recréen y deleiten en familia.Me despido, deseándoles vibras positivas y días con climas agradables.¡Abrazos! 💁🌈
Fotografías propias.
*** 
# English
# Tasting nutritious lunch of: Fried chicken livers, rice, boiled bananas.
# Greetings friends lovers of the rich and varied seasoning.💁☀️
Happy day to everyone!
These days, friends, have been tense for me and my family because of the heavy rains that are hitting in the afternoon in the area where I live, and believe me panic is little to what these environmental phenomena generate for me.Today, Wednesday, to lessen this distressing collective feeling, I wanted to make a delicious combined lunch of : fried chicken liver, rice, boiled banana.I invite you friends, to join me to know the recipes that I used for this tasty lunch restorative of emotions.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155608879.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23yJRGxZorXe7DjKZ5UjQG2ffGxX7mD1XoQygxz35vnEg9nhjjbS8jYwEdqvUe8uXpE3d.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨General menu ingredients for 4 people✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_132740185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23w2sorPYB2y3x5wCaevHtoj9e7uD8e8fUdMACgKB6jTARfVShHG5UGsMZ6vt3CnpcXSA.jpg)
</center>
#
.Spices: 8 chili peppers, 5 cloves of garlic, 1/4 tablespoon of ground cumin.
.Olive oil: 4 tablespoons
.Chicken liver 1 lb.
.Rice: 3 cups
.Bananas: 5 units
.Vinegar: 2 tablespoons
.Salt: 1 tablespoon distributed in food.
.Sugar: 1/2 tablespoon
.Water: 3 cups for rice, and enough for food preparation.

# ✨Mode of preparation✨

The first food I made was chicken liver.

# ✨Fried chicken livers
I started by opening a 2 kg package of liver, extracted half of its contents from it, and washed it with plenty of water. Then, I prepared the spices: peppers, garlic, removing their inedible parts, washing them, cutting them, and I continued to cook the liver with the following steps:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_132958512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi5jqGQb6mRKt9tSnSLZ4A9Q62R7es6cusYoz88vLp9gFXXcjgyWXCX9tXddhDrr6nU.jpg)
</center>
#
In a frying pan I placed: 2 tablespoons of olive oil, the spices, and started to give them a slight sauté for a few seconds. Next, I added the tiny livers to the pan, and continued stirring with the help of a skimmer, while adding: 1/2 tablespoon of sugar, 1 large tablespoon of vinegar, 1/4 tablespoon of salt, 1 cup of water, and a touch of Iberia seasoning, to generate that appetizing red color.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_134019809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wCE6WFikpeqRRESnTKfScpuu23qCYmSEfbCoknqvDc5AAUuQ1aMipMRaZsKHCLn5rKo.jpg)
</center>
#
I covered the pan, and let the liver cook on low heat for 20 minutes.After a while the liver had used up all its water and had remained only in the seasoned fat, where I began to make enveloping movements with the help of a skimmer so that it was impregnated with it, while I added a touch of cumin and removed from the heat.I covered it again for 1 minute so that the cumin did its perfect job of flavoring the food, and then I served.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155755369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynbG7hyTNeqQcE9Cr2jhEGB4k8SLEpYvKr3AfVgd1q5srZz4Sf88GXXkk2CR8hM8JpH.jpg)
</center>
#
Delicious the sweet, vinegary taste, which let delight its soft texture.

The second food I made was white rice, leaning on my useful rice cooker.

# ✨Rice
Steps to make rice :
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_154737276.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23tvwDLknFeeUFqTr4ziJCLctKsbTLbCxu11iENFKKngv7k8uExfkPTmAHEEwjAFEMhNL.jpg)
</center>
#
I started by measuring 4 cups of rice, checking and washing them. Then, I incorporated them in a pot with: 4 cups of water, 1/2 tablespoon of salt, 2 tablespoons of olive oil. I stirred the rice, covered the pot, and put it to cook for 6 minutes, the exact time the pot fired, where a fluffy and shiny rice was appreciated.Its butter flavor is divine, it combined perfectly with the liver!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_155945701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23ynb4C6rn7BMhbLUdx9mkv3QKknRRdQrmJ5Fkv94MEjRUN7YWuVXb4M8ZTnj2G6uaxMf.jpg)
</center>
#
The third food that I made fleetingly, was boiled bananas.

# ✨Boiled bananas
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260518_135727111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wMj4EVmXyCrQJ2Nht3UxWJzCJYm26665Lk8SEVu6ko838S64vdLC7XvQ8KcDe3YteW7.jpg)
</center>
#
I took 5 green bananas, washed them and cut them into thin slices with the help of a knife.Next, I incorporated the slices in a bowl with 1 cup of water, 1/4 tablespoon of salt, 1 tablespoon of vinegar. I let the bananas cook covered for 7 minutes, and then I extracted them for a dish where I impregnated them with a tablespoon of oil pre-seasoned with garlic.Spectacular the soft texture achieved of these bananas, in such a short time.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260520_160048216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zSDUzeeFWEvv2VRpoioWEouaXZxQDoK3Y2HwqbeMhLWzJFFYFiKXuX3rbLWPyQafqmT.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, my goal today to ease tensions with a delicious family lunch, was achieved, because the menu of chicken liver, rice and bananas, was a success in tasting, which delighted all the diners. I hope, that you, friends, also found it appetizing, and that you will soon recre and delight in familia.Me farewell, wishing you positive vibes and days with pleasant climates.Hugs! 💁🌈
Own photographs.

body.title: Efootball friendly match with a friend 😕
body.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![Efootball friendly match with a friend 😕](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/d3db53c6-a167-43c4-a1d7-28a2897cedb3.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/fRYEgcnXvRSNmQfgxZoy7Y) 
 
 I had a friendly match with my friend on eFootball today, and honestly it was a bit frustrating at first. I kept going for through balls every chance I got, thinking it would break his defense open. But if you check the clip, you’ll see what I mean. Almost every single through pass I tried, he read it and cut it off before it even got to my striker. It felt like I was rushing things instead of actually building up the play the way I should.

After a few failed attempts, I decided to slow down and just stick to normal passes. And that’s when things changed. He barely intercepted any of those, and I started finding more space to work with. Once I switched up my style, I ended up scoring two goals back to back. It got me thinking that through balls probably work only about half the time, while regular passes feel a lot safer, maybe around 75 percent. But at the same time, through balls make some plays look cleaner and faster, so I get why people still rely on them even with the risk.

One other thing that stood out was how good my friend was with dribbling. That’s actually how he got his only goal. He didn’t force it, he just waited for the right moment and made it count. Most of his passes were on point too, so he barely gave me a chance to press him. Playing against him made me realize that mixing up your passes and not overdoing the fancy stuff makes the game feel smoother. I guess the key is knowing when to play it safe and when to take the risk.
Thanks for visiting. 
 ***

body.title: [Movie] Spoiler-Free Review: Passengers (2008)
body.body:
Greetings, friends! Today we'll be doing a spoiler-free review of this movie I saw a few weeks ago.

What's this movie about? Let's give you a brief, spoiler-free explanation.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KG7t3xvrqEs

The story follows Claire, a young and dedicated therapist who receives an extremely complex assignment: to provide psychological support to the few survivors of a tragic and catastrophic plane crash. However, as the group sessions begin, Claire notices that the passengers' accounts of what really happened on board don't match the airline's official report, which insists that it was all due to human error. Things get even more complicated when the survivors begin to mysteriously disappear one by one, raising many suspicions and forcing the protagonist to become obsessed with uncovering the corporate truth behind this major event, all while grappling with an unexpected and intense connection to one of her most enigmatic patients, and a somewhat strange and unusual relationship begins to develop.

![MV5BMjE2MTE2MzQ3NF5BMl5BanBnXkFtZTcwMDM1Nzg0Mg@@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23xeZRihZe8aA8kVVYHRun4xeKKKoYarbHiBtL7bMR4wt7LxK9ojeXxAJtjsm9LmQbpMN.jpg)

Throughout the film, we experience an atmosphere of paranoid mystery and a constant sense of doubt about what is real. It keeps us wondering if the airline is orchestrating a conspiracy to silence the victims or if it's all a product of the characters' post-traumatic stress.

As for the performances, I liked the chemistry between the therapist and the passenger, although at one point it didn't seem right. As the plot unfolds, I understand the meaning of that strange connection.

I don't think it's trying to be a commercial action film. It leans more towards psychological suspense and a slow-burning drama, focusing on how people process trauma and find ways to overcome the pain or get used to something they can't escape.

![MV5BNDUzNTgwNDkzM15BMl5BanBnXkFtZTcwMDk0ODk1MQ@@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23vhW9qjZf2UnXxPMTPzKs5VCyHx2sxeufQnS3m5REZJG2pL2YTaLnmGX8VKFy7KCVmYo.jpg)

I recommend you watch it because it's an ideal choice for those who enjoy psychological thrillers that challenge audience expectations. Although it seems like a classic conspiracy drama, the film gradually transforms into a very intimate reflection on human relationships, connections, missed opportunities, and the importance of making peace with our past.

It's an ideal movie to watch on a weekend if you like intrigue and unexpected twists. I assure you that the ending will make you want to rethink the entire plot and reflect on life.

___

Images from https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt0449487/?ref_=fn_t_1
I used Google Translate.

_Rating: **100/100**_

---

body.title: 20 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3109: cut the cord
body.body: There are some things we carry for so long that we no longer notice how heavy they have become. When I saw today’s prompt, “Cut the Cord,” I did not think about scissors or ropes first. I thought about the invisible things I have been trying to separate myself from quietly over time. For a long period, I used to make certain decisions based on what people around me considered acceptable. Not because I was weak or confused, but because I wanted peace with everyone. I wanted to avoid disappointing people. But somewhere along the line, I realized that constantly living for approval can slowly disconnect you from yourself. Even recently, I noticed it again in small moments. I spend a lot of time studying, reading, and writing. Sometimes people look surprised because they believe graduation should mean the end of serious reading. A young girl from our compound once entered my room, saw books scattered around, and asked if I was still going to school. I smiled, but that moment stayed with me. Another older woman had asked me something similar months ago.

>

At first, those comments made me question myself a little. I wondered if I was doing too much or if I should slow down so people would understand me better. But I have come to realize that growth sometimes requires cutting the cord from other people’s expectations.

The truth is, I genuinely love learning. I love sitting with books, researching ideas, and improving myself quietly even when nobody notices it. That part of me is real, and I do not want to abandon it just because it looks unusual to someone else.

Cutting the cord does not always mean leaving people behind. Sometimes it simply means refusing to let outside opinions control your direction anymore.

I am still learning how to do that fully.

Still learning how to trust my own path without constantly explaining it.

Still learning how to move forward without needing everybody to understand why.

And maybe that is part of becoming stronger.

body.title: A real beauty….
body.body: Afternoon everyone…. You all know by now that I love old Mexican coinage. I have several graded silver coins. Plus numerous raw coins. So today I’m going to share with you a five ounce silver Aztec Calendar round from the Golden State Mint. On the obverse side of the coin is depicted the great Aztec emperor, Cuauhtémoc. He is an honored figure in history for his being the only Aztec emperor to survive the Spanish conquest. The Mexican people honor him everywhere by making statues of him and putting him on their coinage. The name, Cuauhtémoc, translates to “one who descends like an eagle” in reference to the determined, aggressive way an eagle swoops down on its prey. By all accounts, this emperor honored his name by governing in determination and aggressiveness. The reverse of the coin depicts the Aztec calendar. The Aztec calendar is a very complex calendar that marks time in a very different way than we do. This calendar tracks 52 years and depicts the days in what to us would be an unusual way. We mark days, months, and years where they mark things like rabbits, and reeds and wind as well as what deity governs that particular year. In addition to giving what day it is, the Aztec calendar indicates what kind of a day it is going to be like our horoscopes. The Aztec calendar is unusual in its shape as well. It is round and so is a perfect fit for a coin. For over 45 years the Golden State Mint has been making coins from Central Florida. They have made a name for themselves as a mint that delivers on fantastic coins using quality metals. They are serious about using cutting edge technology and often upgrade and add machinery to keep their production up to the quality standard they have set.

body.title: Over-Bridged
body.body:
when it comes to Puusti the dog, I am glad that Smallsteps has made him a part of her life, even though occasionally she does complain about having to take him out - *even though I am the slave dog-walker most days.* But, that is part of being a kid. She is really good with him and feeds him when she needs and when the weather is good at least, will take him on longer walks, talking to him all the way.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23wX7dobMeQDioHZzJ6U1uC5AZ575TGFmn7M7YVVAvBJESGGHKTD81ub7Y4CkZ6b5UmKe.png)


---

It is also nice when the two of us go for a walk with him together and we talk about random silly things. I don't get a lot of spontaneous joy from life these days, so I take what I can get when Smallsteps and I talk our nonsense and I love that she is getting wittier and more sarcastic, but still has that little kid innocence. 

> She might be the only reason I am still semi-sane.

She is also the only reason I want this world to be a better place. If it wasn't for her, I'd likely just throw my hands up in the air and say \

and turn a blind eye. I could try to live the *ignorance is bliss* life, be completely selfish, do only the things I want and not care about the consequences for me, or for others.   

---

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xKzWCDTupnheRzAwgrVfQyBh9GFDXxWYHamP2JnaMooavZ6p3d1XjVJ9dUZnrf3QvfS.png --- > But she is here, so I have to try something. *Even if it doesn't work.* When unattached to others, it doesn't matter how many bridges are burned, because no relationship needs to survive. Just flit from place to place doing what is desired and when it no longer works, move on and leave the damage behind. With kids however, that isn't really possible - at least for most parents. There isn't the possibility to live life on a burning platform, because the children will need somewhere to stand. I think there are a lot of people without kids who think they care about what is happening in and to the world, but I think they would have quite a different perspective, if they had kids of their own. There is something about the attachment and the assumed responsibility that requires a kind of seriousness that might not be possible with other circumstances. Perhaps it is possible, but maybe it is very unlikely. It forces consideration for the future and in so doing, exploring what is required now. It means sacrifice and putting the needs of others first. It could be a selfish act because there is skin in the game, but it is an act that has kept us evolving and advancing for hundreds of thousands of years. So what happens when the majority of people do not have children and therefore, do not have a tether to the future? > Will anything past an individual life matter? And if not, that is the end. body.title: 3rd day of lecture in a new semester 😕
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![3rd day of lecture in a new semester 😕](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/73134e03-507a-4b8c-880f-0403b6123c95.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/j6Vtc8d6SirMLJNeSfRiBM) 
 
 My third day of lectures in the new semester was kind of a mixed bag, and it started on a disappointing note. I had only one lecture scheduled for today, from 8am to 10am, so I made sure to wake up early, get dressed, and head to school on time. But when I got there, I found out the lecture had been cancelled. That one really got to me 😕💔. You know that feeling when you’ve already prepared your mind for class, carried your notebook, and then you just get there for nothing? Yeah, I didn’t even bother staying around. I just turned back and went home.

Once I got home, I was still a bit annoyed, so I just slept off the stress. I didn’t wake up until around 12 noon. After that, I spent a good part of the afternoon just messing around on my phone, replying to messages and checking a few things I’d been putting off. Before I knew it, it was already 3pm. 

Later on, I linked up with some friends and we decided to go to the market. I also needed to pick up a few things for myself, so it worked out fine. We spent a couple of hours moving around, buying stuff, and just catching up while we walked. By the time we got back home it was around 5pm. One of my friends had already made moi at home – that local Nigerian dish made from grounded beans – so we all sat down, ate together, and honestly that was the best part of my day. After eating, we just chilled and ended up sleeping again till this evening. 

So yeah, that was basically how my day went. Started with disappointment, but ended up being relaxed and lowkey fun with food and friends.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/j6Vtc8d6SirMLJNeSfRiBM)

body.title: Nature's Rumble & Such
body.body:
Magandang buhay💛 A downpour occurred mid-afternoon (2:45) yesterday. It went on without stopping until past 5. Nature is truly generous. We were in the kitchen around 3. I was about to prepare snacks when a really bright flash of lightning came through the open windows, followed quickly by the loudest thunder we have ever heard, and then the lights went off.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/13658673/pexels-photo-13658673.jpeg
I screamed (unintentionally). Then my legs went numb, and my body trembled. I had muffled hearing, as though my ears were filled with water. Frozen where I was, until I remembered... Where's my little boy? I moved away from the windows and frantically looked for him. He was hiding under a chair, under the table. He was trembling uncontrollably. I took him in my arms, and we sat on the floor, cuddling for 10, or maybe 20 minutes. We still saw flashes of lightning and heard the rumble, but at least, it was not as loud as the very first. It seemed more distant, like it was moving away from us, thank goodness! My boy calmed down, and so did I. The lights came on (power was restored), and I noticed my phone on the floor. I must have dropped it while screaming. The scenario in my mind made me laugh out of amusement. Some crazy things happen when we are terribly frightened (or maybe it's just me). It's quiet now. The evening is cool, and we are doing fine. We might already be snoring by the time this goes out.😅 But before that, it's that time again for the weekly update of our *slothly goal.* 80 HIVE was added, ending the week (20) with 842 in the [wallet](peakd.com/@fg-ss/wallet). That means only 158 HIVE more to go, and the 1k target is reached, yay! We will set a new one when that happens. Until then, we keep on. Cheers to a wonderful midweek!
--- ---
*Lead image by [Renan Almeida](https://www.pexels.com/photo/lightening-over-a-city-at-night-13658673/) via Pexels. 21052026/05:49ph*

body.body: ** ** ** ** ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8Lyo6nGDx9ENZa2Ju3o21qzpu6FWBiPdxwXZGw6VH1j/img_2647.jpg) ** ** ** ** “Cut the cord” means to let go of something that holds a person back. It may be fear, bad habits, unhealthy relationships, or dependence on others. Sometimes people stay connected to things that stop them from growing because they are afraid of change. However, growth often begins when the cord is finally cut. Let’s get it down to a true life story which I will share with you guys. Some time ago after my secondary school days, I wan always dependent on my friends for every decision i made. They influenced how i dressed, spoke, and even the career i wanted to pursue. Deep inside, i dreamed of becoming a doctor, but my friends mocked my passion and pushed me toward another path. For years, he ignored my dream just to please them. One day, i realized i was unhappy living someone else’s life and not taking my own decisions. Then I woke up one morning and decided to “cut the cord.” I stopped seeking approval from people who discouraged me and focused on my passion, although it was late to still pursue my old dreams. Though the decision was difficult at first, but i slowly gained confidence and freedom. In the end, i’m becoming a successful farmer and also doing what i loved. body.title: Why Expose People's Earnings? \n
body.body:
>We have accustomed ourselves to complaining and making life look like all that there is: lack and poverty. Day in and day out, we complain that there is no money and the economy is crashing, but do you know that there are people who don't know what poverty actually looks like? There are people who only know poverty and lack by definition but don't know what they are experientially. Let no one deceive you and me that there is no money; people have money, a lot of it. Some have so much that it can even scare you. But the concern is, where is it coming from? It's a beautiful thing to be wealthy and rich, but if the source is not genuine, the work done equals zero because in the end, you would regret it. Nowadays, there are many rich people with unclean money. You check their accounts, it is full of money; they have different kinds of assets, but it was not their sweat that got all of it. For some of them, it took the tears of others; for some, it took some dirty and despicable deals to get to that point. The annoying part is that these same people who decided to use shortcuts to get to the top are making life unbearable for those who are legitimately following the process to earn a living making it look like they are not trying enough. Several efforts to curtail people who earn illegally proved abortive, as it is not easy to tell who is making an honest income from who is not. To worsen the situation, the government, who are supposed to take the matter into their hands to dislodge the act are corrupt and only care about what they can make at the end of the day. But will exposing what everyone earns solve the issue? Well, it might work if manipulation and corruption didn't have their way into the system. Many people would be scared of earning dishonestly because they will be forced to give an account of how the money was realized, and in the situation where they are found wanting, the law would decide their fate. But the bad side to this is the increase in crimes like robbery and kidnapping. Imagine what will happen to people who earn large amounts of money legitimately? Won't revealing what they earn expose them to so much danger. I fear greatly for people who are into business; I can only imagine how often they would get visits from thieves and robbers. Instead of making things good, this kind of system would complicate it. Those who prefer to live a low-key life would be exposed, and I see that as a right infringement. We all have the right to privacy. I think the government should respect that. Everyone has the right to keep their earnings as private as they want. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUVhTHvDB3JH5tqrQ26VeZ5Ze6ZkZ9zCEo8K485mMgStY/1779313136859.jpg) Exposing it will cause people harm one way or another, and it won't be fair. Things are better off the way they are. There are other ways to curb the issue of money laundering and illegal earnings; those methods should be employed. Left to me, there is no law that is as powerful as karma; it never fails. At the appointed time, it will catch up with everyone accordingly. ------ N.B: All Images Were Generated By Gemini AI -------

Thanks For Reading

body.body:
<center>


![IMAG Ciudad Bienestar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/Eq391gFsHp3motbSeLHV1EE6y54AC3VqLoThVsrmMKUoXAvXEvxRzrKhg6tsgdhKkMF.png)


<sub>Imágenes tomadas y editadas en Canva. 
</sub></center>


<div class=\

>


El hogar gatuno estaba conformado por Mario, papá, tres gatitos y Blanca, la mamá. Esta tenía días con un mal presentimiento; le comentó a su esposo y él se preocupó. En Asirú, ciudad donde vivían, frontera con Narí, ya habían comenzado a bombardear; los humanos y su soberbia.

Buscaron hablar con los otros, y decidieron dirigirse al norte, hacia **Ciudad “Bienestar”**.  Debían proteger y salvar a la generación de relevo. Blanca era la líder; era una gata no muy agraciada, pero inteligente; destacaban sus bigotes supersónicos, que detectaban lo que fuera. Fue también el mono Hugo; era el único adulto sin pareja y siempre cargaba unos binoculares.

Los más grandes llevarían a los pequeños y a las recién paridas, olvidándose de los depredadores que algunos podrían ser, y en caravana, elefantes, jirafas, ratones, perros, burros, águilas, y muchísimos más formaron una manada para sobrevivir. Equipos de trabajo, administraban el agua y las provisiones y así se fueron alejando. 

Blanca le decía a Hugo: “Avista para ver cómo vamos”, y este, montado sobre Lucia, la jirafa, se volteaba y fruncía el ceño. “¡Confiemos en Dios!”, clamaba Blanca al cielo. 

Transitaban por sitios inhóspitos; Blanca intuía las trampas. Bajo una tempestad, con rayos y centellas; el sonido del viento les perforaba el tímpano. El pavor se acrecentó cuando Kuky, un gatito, se desprendió del lomo de Moncho, el burro, y antes de caer al abismo, el halcón Billy lo sostuvo con sutileza entre las garras. Blanca exclamó: \
. “Padrenuestro, que estás en el cielo…” y el cielo se iluminó, y Hugo exclamó: \

. “Es **ciudad ‘bienestar’**”, concluyó Blanca emocionada. Lloraron, bailaron y hasta cantaron. Tomaron café caliente, y cerca, Hugo miró a una hermosa mona con labios color rosa; le guiñó un ojo; ella dulcemente le sonrió.
![Separador Ciudad Bienestar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dorytagil2022/23wXBrh8PkycueLn39h6x3bRc6XqRmMNUZXRKKjDrqwKHDovB7MUed4pbkzEQKu9ciN3w.png)

Hello, my friends!

First, I want to give praise to God for bringing me here, from Nigeria to another country, that's Cameroon, with peace and safety. God brought me here without any problem on the road or anything happening to us. Thank you Abba Father. 


![Screenshot_20260520-214027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23yTsWj7odsZuNZigQgFHwBwWmE2aSb5uUps1VoupPHX5uazAqZVbRRy1ruERhbgkXxVF.jpg)


![Screenshot_20260520-104850.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23z7LMCoB7UpBd9phiuAkyJSMAmRirzF9u3L6fSwSo1cr3ji21cjP7N8JUXjHQtbAZYHg.jpg)


I was in Lagos during my fashion business, as some of you know, I'm a young fashionista. I just got a contract, after taking some time to think and pray about it, I decided to move to the country for the offer. Thank God, my younger brother is there too, doing his own business. We dey business men in the world.

![Screenshot_20260520-214027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23yTsWj7odsZuNZigQgFHwBwWmE2aSb5uUps1VoupPHX5uazAqZVbRRy1ruERhbgkXxVF.jpg)



One of the things I don't like about Cameroon is the restriction of movement, you can't move freely the way it's done in Nigeria. If you are going anywhere, you must carry your 🆔 ID card as a means of identification, if not, you will be arrested for being a stranger in their land, and that can cost you a lot. 


![Screenshot_20260520-214047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23vsZH8KexKacwCSa54p11tiRwVwjBvvF6fr6T7mHWx9iAgkaPx8vFNg3b54Zk3S36bzj.jpg)


And another thing is that language is a barrier here. They are speaking French throughout. Some understand English and pidgin, and some understand the English language and the pidgin too. 

Moreover, traveling is part of Education, the more you travel, the more you get to learn new things, build new relationships, and more as you stay in the environment.

Thank you

body.title: My one-hour break | Mi recreo de una hora.Mi informe de Actifit: mayo 20 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/143b4a72-4fb2-4459-979c-1b5495692186.jpg) A break for a walk || Un recreo para caminar. Sometimes you hear people say they don't have time to work out. I feel like those are just excuses, because honestly, if you want to, you can. Twice a week I take my son to physical education class, and in the winter it’s a little harder. But I take the opportunity to go for an hour-long walk and get some kind of physical activity in. But when things get a little more contemplative, I nd feel more connected to my surroundings. Mi informe de Actifit: mayo 20 2026 ___ A veces se escucha decir a personas que no tienen tiempo para hacer algún tipo de entrenamiento. Siento que son simplemente excusas, porque sinceramente el que quiere, puede. Dos veces por semana llevo a mi hijo a educación física y en épocas de invierno todo cuesta un poquito más. Pero aprovecho la oportunidad para realizar una caminata de una hora y así hacer algún tipo de actividad física. Pero cuando la cosa se pone contemplativa me gusta un poco más y me siento más conectado con mi entorno. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b98f9940-901b-43d3-83bc-09dbcbc0435b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ca3a7621-0911-4bb9-85ed-e328b450e57d.jpg) One thing I’d like to highlight about the municipality of Ezeiza—and specifically the neighborhood of La Unión, where my son’s school is located—is how well-maintained its public spaces are. You can see municipal staff cleaning these areas every day: the lawns, the streets, the trees, the painted surfaces, and all the other tasks that contribute to a clean city and make you want to walk around it. I also want to highlight that there are older adults who perform these tasks, giving people who are sometimes left out of the system an opportunity to engage in some kind of activity and, of course, help support their households. ___ Algo que destaco del municipio de ezeiza y en este caso de la localidad La Unión, que es donde está el colegio de mi hijo, es la pulcritud de sus espacios públicos. Y se nota en estos lugares a personas o personal del municipio, limpiando todos los días. Tanto el césped, las calles, los árboles, pinturas y demás quehaceres que hacen a una ciudad limpia y que dan ganas de caminar por la misma. También destaco que existen personas mayores que realizan estas tareas, dándole una oportunidad a personas que a veces quedan fuera del sistema, para que realicen algún tipo de actividad y por supuesto, ayuden con el sustento de sus hogares. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/26aeb524-e581-4ed2-8967-f6e22ef3952c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d7ab519-ac4a-4bc5-9817-7bd9744df34c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a5002755-acc6-48a2-b743-f94b052ce204.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d43a302e-33c0-41e1-b759-4ca0db935a48.jpg) It’s freezing in Argentina, especially in Buenos Aires, but thankfully the sun is shining, making the mornings a little more bearable. I always dress in layers since I ride my bike with my friend Don Juan, and walking alongside my trusty steed is always a good alternative. In between, I send a message or chat in a WhatsApp group, and an hour goes by absolutely flying. Before I know it, my son is already by my side, waiting to go home. I’ve already walked for an hour, and that’s no small feat. ___ Mucho frío en la Argentina y especialmente en la ciudad de Buenos Aires, pero gracias al universo nos acompaña el astro rey y hace que las mañanas sean un poco más llevaderas. Siempre es algo muy abrigado ya que vamos en bicicleta con el amigo Don Juan, y caminar junto a mi caballito de hierro, siempre es una buena alternativa. Entre las envío algún tipo de mensaje o charlo en algún grupo de WhatsApp, una hora me pasa absolutamente rapidísimo. Cuando me doy cuenta ya tengo a mi hijo al lado mío, esperando para volver a casa. body.title: Attack on Titan: Consequences of Escaping Reality and Changing History ENG 🇬🇧///Ataque a los Titanes: Consecuencias de huir de la realidad y cambiar la historia Esp 🇪🇸
body.body:
Eng 🇬🇧 
I want to recommend @milagroscmiranda, who is just starting out in this Hive community, and ask you to support the BBH community, which is doing an amazing job.




What would happen if we could escape our reality? What if we had the power to erase mistakes, change decisions, or live in a world where nothing that hurts us could reach us? Attack on Titan (or Shingeki no Kyojin in Japanese)


![IMG_20260520_171418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/242hUZYruLoYZSmHXoQYSsmigxPpf8QCkg7TGSGx38Vju3hqCv3SdvJWw4xppMiXEZAwP.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_171353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23ynUXE9JMF8uAj1miSkYTGLWUpx8BVpZQ92ZQ24KW2n7h1BCzaVA74TZGWRfRhTchc87.jpg)
 confronts us with these questions, albeit disguised as giants and walls. Beyond the action and conflicts, the dilemmas faced by Eren, Mikasa, Armin, Annie, and other characters powerfully show the consequences of trying to escape reality and alter fate in our favor.
In the story of Paradis, the walls not only protect but also represent an illusion of safety. The humans behind these walls seek to live peacefully, ignoring the external threat. Many of us do something similar: we look for excuses, avoid facing difficult problems, or take refuge in routines and distractions. At first, this strategy may seem to work, but Attack on Titan makes it clear that ignoring reality is never without a cost. When the truth finally asserts itself, the consequences are harsher and more complex. Escape, though temporarily comfortable, only postpones the inevitable confrontation.
Eren is an extreme example of this phenomenon. His desire for freedom and revenge leads him to want to change history, even at the expense of those he loves. The series shows how obsession with rewriting the past or imposing an ideal future can lead to destructive decisions. In real life, this translates to trying to change events that have already occurred or control everything around us, which can generate conflict, pain, and regret. History, like the Titans, is a force that cannot be ignored or completely manipulated. Recognizing our limitations and accepting reality is, in many cases, the first step toward finding a healthier path.
Another important aspect is how escaping reality can affect our relationships. Characters who seek to evade the truth end up isolating themselves, distrusting those around them, or manipulating the narrative to justify their actions. In everyday life, this translates to family conflicts, tense friendships, or damaged work relationships. Facing reality together, sharing fears and doubts, is what allows us to build strong connections and make more balanced decisions.
However, Attack on Titan also teaches us that confronting reality does not mean giving up or resigning ourselves. Mikasa and Armin, for example, find ways to act with courage and strategy without losing sight of the consequences of their decisions. This balance between accepting reality and acting with determination is a crucial lesson: we can fight for our goals, but we must do so with awareness and responsibility. The fantasy of changing history may be tempting, but true strength lies in how we face present challenges.
In conclusion, Attack on Titan is not just a story of battles and giant monsters. It is a mirror that invites us to reflect on our relationship with reality, our decisions, and the history we are building every day. Escaping the inevitable, trying to change what has already happened, or manipulating our own narrative may seem appealing, but the consequences can be devastating. The series reminds us that accepting, learning, and acting responsibly is the true way to move forward. The Titans, in the end, are not only external enemies: they are also symbols of our internal fears and challenges, the ones we must face to grow.
Thank you for your attention and support, and I hope you continue to enjoy the content I bring for you.
And, as always, I want to remind you that if you know someone who could use some help with a good story, share it in the BBH community 💪 or share it with @Bradleyarrow.
Thank God for everything He has put in my path. Thank you, and have a good night.

En la historia de Paradis, los muros no solo protegen, sino que representan una ilusión de seguridad. Los humanos detrás de estas murallas buscan vivir tranquilos, ignorando la amenaza exterior. Muchos de nosotros hacemos algo similar: buscamos excusas, evitamos enfrentarnos a problemas difíciles o nos refugiamos en rutinas y distracciones. Al principio, puede parecer que esta estrategia funciona, pero Attack on Titan deja claro que ignorar la realidad nunca es gratis. Cuando la verdad finalmente se impone, las consecuencias son más duras y complejas. La huida, aunque momentáneamente cómoda, solo aplaza la inevitable confrontación.
Eren es un ejemplo extremo de este fenómeno. Su deseo de libertad y venganza lo lleva a querer cambiar la historia, incluso a costa de quienes ama. La serie muestra cómo la obsesión por reescribir el pasado o imponer un futuro ideal puede conducir a decisiones destructivas. En la vida real, esto se traduce en intentar cambiar hechos que ya ocurrieron o controlar todo lo que nos rodea, lo que puede generar conflictos, dolor y arrepentimiento. La historia, al igual que los Titanes, es una fuerza que no puede ser ignorada ni manipulada completamente. Reconocer nuestras limitaciones y aceptar la realidad es, en muchos casos, el primer paso para encontrar un camino más saludable.
Otro aspecto importante es cómo huir de la realidad puede afectar nuestras relaciones. Los personajes que buscan evadir la verdad terminan aislándose, desconfiando de quienes los rodean o manipulando la narrativa para justificar sus acciones. En la vida cotidiana, esto se traduce en conflictos familiares, amistades tensas o relaciones laborales dañadas. Afrontar la realidad juntos, compartir miedos y dudas, es lo que permite construir conexiones sólidas y tomar decisiones más equilibradas.
Sin embargo, Attack on Titan también nos enseña que enfrentar la realidad no significa rendirse ni resignarse. Mikasa y Armin, por ejemplo, encuentran formas de actuar con valentía y estrategia sin perder de vista las consecuencias de sus decisiones. Este equilibrio entre aceptar la realidad y actuar con determinación es una lección crucial: podemos luchar por nuestros objetivos, pero debemos hacerlo desde la conciencia y la responsabilidad. La fantasía de cambiar la historia puede ser tentadora, pero la verdadera fuerza radica en cómo enfrentamos los desafíos presentes.
En conclusión, Attack on Titan no es solo una historia de batallas y monstruos gigantes. Es un espejo que nos invita a reflexionar sobre nuestra relación con la realidad, nuestras decisiones y la historia que vamos construyendo cada día. Huir de lo inevitable, intentar cambiar lo que ya ocurrió o manipular nuestra propia narrativa puede parecer atractivo, pero las consecuencias pueden ser devastadoras. La serie nos recuerda que aceptar, aprender y actuar con responsabilidad es la verdadera manera de avanzar. Los Titanes, al final, no solo son enemigos externos: también son símbolos de nuestros miedos y desafíos internos, aquellos que debemos enfrentar para crecer.
