body.title: Wednesday Morning Walk
body.body:
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9pj9MZiodgMYbuyuWDVXijRrGB9ymFPGarCXFiQmJeP/20260505_6.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9pj9MZiodgMYbuyuWDVXijRrGB9ymFPGarCXFiQmJeP/20260505_6.jpg)
***This is a post to go with #WednesdayWalk challenge by @tattoodjay.***
Am I wrong, or have I really not written anything about my Wednesday walks for over a month? Time flies faster than I have time to process and publish all the reports about my walks. The real summer has come to us.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWVUtZGoxftEbnRkaogzfEMLNezhn9NxjQyaiL2bwiv7/20260505_5.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWVUtZGoxftEbnRkaogzfEMLNezhn9NxjQyaiL2bwiv7/20260505_5.jpg) At 5 a.m., the dog is waiting for me to go out to her, take her leash and we will go to the forest, or rather for a walk towards the river. It is very pleasant to walk through the forest now, because there are no blood-sucking insects - mosquitoes, gadflies. The only danger is ticks.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9yD6asGbqKFLYpajzmHcMQH4FxC3zowX5ztj6DrwVbL/20260505_7.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9yD6asGbqKFLYpajzmHcMQH4FxC3zowX5ztj6DrwVbL/20260505_7.jpg) For almost a week now, during the day, the thermometer has been showing temperatures in the shade around +30 degrees Celsius. Believe me, friends, that such a temperature regime is abnormal for our region, even in the middle of summer, and now it's only May. And this temperature is predicted before the end of the week.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUybTSWeLEoAMaJMbFEES4Z3XgEMRrqDVDkCndbDyf8EX/20260505_10.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUybTSWeLEoAMaJMbFEES4Z3XgEMRrqDVDkCndbDyf8EX/20260505_10.jpg) Yesterday morning, while walking, looking at the river, I thought it was time to take a spinning rod and go fishing, but today I couldn't do it because I had to prepare the fishing gear. Now I plan to do it on Friday. To do this, I will need to wake up not at 5 a.m., but at 3 a.m. By the way, the photo is not a river, but a lake.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRGvMzPqNLKRnWjYKBgah7L6kFnez78eRF9MynjWQCW7E/20260505_1.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRGvMzPqNLKRnWjYKBgah7L6kFnez78eRF9MynjWQCW7E/20260505_1.jpg) The seagulls are expressing their displeasure in my direction, I have disturbed them. There are probably nests of them somewhere on this lake.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTpuJ9fPbpEsqHgRAoK59KrhCQzAcZXZnU92JaLd2cMi/20260505_3.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUTpuJ9fPbpEsqHgRAoK59KrhCQzAcZXZnU92JaLd2cMi/20260505_3.jpg) So yesterday I was not mistaken when I thought that fishermen were already on the river. I saw their footprints and the remains of food on the table, which is at the resting place. I want to go fishing!
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXh9YY7Ctk3Z8oNPop2fBSzN3gmBqW4rRXLoRGDckwQ6Z/20260505_2.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXh9YY7Ctk3Z8oNPop2fBSzN3gmBqW4rRXLoRGDckwQ6Z/20260505_2.jpg) Yellow wagtails fly and are not afraid of me. @nelinoeva, this is already your topic, my next post will probably be about birds.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZiyB3fK8haMvaQoWiXW4pAqxdsGZ3nm4R8G4cKVP26y/20260505_4.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbZiyB3fK8haMvaQoWiXW4pAqxdsGZ3nm4R8G4cKVP26y/20260505_4.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKzXpRZd3C6iWZ9q7kfXd5hAu3Y7CoSb7cSGGGeWjEUW/20260505_11.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKzXpRZd3C6iWZ9q7kfXd5hAu3Y7CoSb7cSGGGeWjEUW/20260505_11.jpg) The bird cherry is already finishing blooming. There is such a sign that when it begins to bloom, it gets cold. This is exactly how it was at the beginning of its flowering. On Sunday, my mother picked some cherry blossoms and brought them into the house. I explained to her that the scent of wild cherry can give you a headache. After half an hour of our conversation, my mother brought a vase of flowers from her room to me and said - yes, they need to be removed, they smell very strong. Mom is 85 years old and she has already apparently forgotten about this feature of bird cherry and lilac.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRupphCuCBAyDpxbZR7KsYa8Bm4C8gbZYRZ5T44quzuwd/20260505.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRupphCuCBAyDpxbZR7KsYa8Bm4C8gbZYRZ5T44quzuwd/20260505.jpg) Oh, how much I sweated during the walk. You have to wear rubber boots on your feet, because you have to cross several streams on the way to the river and the grass is very wet from dew. There was the same heavy dew yesterday. There was no such thing on Sunday. So... is there always a choice - to go through the ravine or just go up the path? I chose the road through the ravine. But I usually take the upper path from home.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPoyHSTfJn6p6WjE6rhpmGtH44bKwrFfQdjaV7S1w8iBP/20260505_9.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPoyHSTfJn6p6WjE6rhpmGtH44bKwrFfQdjaV7S1w8iBP/20260505_9.jpg) Mom plucked bird cherry branches from this tree. Bird cherry grows very fast. So this tree is getting bigger every year. But I've never eaten berries here before.
***Friends, goodbye! Until the next walk.***

*Well. Have all my friends, observers, and readers, wonderful walks on Wednesdays. And also on Sundays and any other day!*
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png)

When the truth finally asserts itself, the consequences are harsher and more complex. Escape, though temporarily comfortable, only postpones the inevitable confrontation.
Eren is an extreme example of this phenomenon. His desire for freedom and revenge leads him to want to change history, even at the expense of those he loves. The series shows how obsession with rewriting the past or imposing an ideal future can lead to destructive decisions. In real life, this translates to trying to change events that have already occurred or control everything around us, which can generate conflict, pain, and regret. History, like the Titans, is a force that cannot be ignored or completely manipulated. Recognizing our limitations and accepting reality is, in many cases, the first step toward finding a healthier path.
Another important aspect is how escaping reality can affect our relationships. Characters who seek to evade the truth end up isolating themselves, distrusting those around them, or manipulating the narrative to justify their actions. In everyday life, this translates to family conflicts, tense friendships, or damaged work relationships. Facing reality together, sharing fears and doubts, is what allows us to build strong connections and make more balanced decisions.
However, Attack on Titan also teaches us that confronting reality does not mean giving up or resigning ourselves. Mikasa and Armin, for example, find ways to act with courage and strategy without losing sight of the consequences of their decisions. This balance between accepting reality and acting with determination is a crucial lesson: we can fight for our goals, but we must do so with awareness and responsibility. The fantasy of changing history may be tempting, but true strength lies in how we face present challenges.
In conclusion, Attack on Titan is not just a story of battles and giant monsters. It is a mirror that invites us to reflect on our relationship with reality, our decisions, and the history we are building every day. Escaping the inevitable, trying to change what has already happened, or manipulating our own narrative may seem appealing, but the consequences can be devastating. The series reminds us that accepting, learning, and acting responsibly is the true way to move forward. The Titans, in the end, are not only external enemies: they are also symbols of our internal fears and challenges, the ones we must face to grow.
Thank you for your attention and support, and I hope you continue to enjoy the content I bring for you.
And, as always, I want to remind you that if you know someone who could use some help with a good story, share it in the BBH community 💪 or share it with @Bradleyarrow.
Thank God for everything He has put in my path. Thank you, and have a good night.

Eren es un ejemplo extremo de este fenómeno. Su deseo de libertad y venganza lo lleva a querer cambiar la historia, incluso a costa de quienes ama. Reconocer nuestras limitaciones y aceptar la realidad es, en muchos casos, el primer paso para encontrar un camino más saludable.
Otro aspecto importante es cómo huir de la realidad puede afectar nuestras relaciones. Afrontar la realidad juntos, compartir miedos y dudas, es lo que permite construir conexiones sólidas y tomar decisiones más equilibradas.

La fantasía de cambiar la historia puede ser tentadora, pero la verdadera fuerza radica en cómo enfrentamos los desafíos presentes.
En conclusión, Attack on Titan no es solo una historia de batallas y monstruos gigantes. Es un espejo que nos invita a reflexionar sobre nuestra relación con la realidad, nuestras decisiones y la historia que vamos construyendo cada día. body.title: 🎮 2026 Video Game #3 | Ball x Pitt
body.body:
>Image Source
This blog is a personal journal of all the movies, Tv-Shows, & Games I consume during a year which enhances my overall experience. The ratings that I give are fully based on my personal preference and enjoyment at the time of watching and I'm writing spoiler-free reviews. (All HBD earnings are used to get extra Hive Power Delegations!)

Choosing A New Game!!

I literally have 100+ games that I potentially want to play on my Steam Watchlist and quite a bit more ready to start which should make it easy to pick. However, I want to get the most out of the games that I play and I really enjoy gaming the most when I'm fully into it which for most games just takes a ton of time. Zelda Tears Of The Kingdom is one of those that I really want to play but where I fear it will control my life. Outer Wilds is also one of them. So I often end up picking games that I know can be played in small bursts like Balatro & Slay The Spire who eventually also end up controlling my life as I always want to play one more game. The one that kind of trapped me this time was Ball x Pit...

Ball x Pitt (7.9/10)

The way I would describe Ball x Pitt is as a combination of those fake Mobile Game Advertisements which look really fun, with the dynamics of Vamipire Survivors and the Arkanoid retro game. https://images.hive.blog/DQmYeXq5GMAM5dzhpdcmUAxjg2gFQykGBBte4RTBqackXPf/image.png +|https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9djahynVpiNiAHPgFjTFD7XoAGi1CRKRzbsjgz8oJnx/image.png +|https://images.hive.blog/DQmY8xm4rfLjJBdEeeMCWktm5AV634kxQWS5mMS2GiD5cQ8/image.png -|-|-
The basic Gameplay Loop of Ball x Pitt is that you control a character that shoot balls into a pit where hordes of enemies come at you along with 3 bosses each level. Each enemy that is killed drops some gems and once you picked up a certain amount of gems, you can buy upgrades like special balls or passive abilities with the goal to beat the level. https://images.hive.blog/DQmVBCcV6dgU2KUwtuJSc7TFNwzX85RkH9JbWVMrznvrgbC/image.png There are 21 Different characters that can be unlocked which each have their own abilities and also 8 different levels to unlock along the way which gives you something to play for and progress. https://images.hive.blog/DQmTo92tVwPWAyA1uWHGyrD7KqTQpWvf9ebgob4GuQMnjsu/image.png Levels also drop blueprints and after each run, you can build your base with the money you earned to pretty much make everything stronger. To me, this is one of the aspects of the game that took up way too much time and also made it kind of feel too easy in a way since the power you have going into a level is variable this way instead of giving a fixed difficulty to beat which for everyone is the same. This is one of the things I generally don't like about modern day gaming. https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPoqb3ZLHEcXrjKkUB2mBLsTVLVXpZn9T65Ax9uCGZJH/image.png Special balls that have extra abilities als can be leveled up during the game or combined to always make them stronger. Honestly, all these different balls and upgrades I never really had an idea about during my 20+ Hours with the game of which is best or how the upgrades actually worked. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSh5WtrqqjmX8WVbJ7p4Ecn63qoAWYLdB9D6CoiDtgZfy/image.png)

>Image Source The game was released near the end of 2025 at a price of 14.99€ and I managed to pick it up for 11.99€ which I would say offers good value for the time I got to spend with it as it takes about 20 Hours to unlock and finish all the levels at least once. https://images.hive.blog/DQmSAGsm9xJ2obeQmMGfiLzcEgmBwiT97YoinPpMQNfGBZM/image.png

Conclusion

Ball x Pit is one of those games which when picking up at first, I layed it down again after playing 1 level only to pick up my steamdeck again a couple minutes later. It was a bit challenging at first and not too difficult to come up with some good strategy. As Characters leveld up, it felt like it was getting a bit too easy though and I missed a real challenge. That said, I still had 20+ Hours of fun with it completing all levels even though I didn't really care about trying most of the new characters. So Ball x Pitt certainly is a fun game for a while but it doesn't fully live up to the potential for me. A Good 7.9/10

Next Up

I still aim to play Outer Wilds as I have a hunch that if I manage to pull trough the first couple of hours (which I failed to do on 2 previous attempts), it might be one of those game experiences that last me a lifetime. I will try to complete that one somewhere in the next 2 months! #|2026 Played Games|Platform|Price|Score -|-|-|-|- #01|
>Slay The Spire|Steam Deck|2.29€|8.6/10\n#03|Ball x Pitt|Steam Deck|11.99€|7.9/10\n

Retomando un poco el dibujo, y la idea de aprender a crear frases bonitas, se que esto es un proceso, como todo, y mas si no se practica diario, toma mucho mas tiempo, pero bueno, lo importante es intentarlo, cada vez que podamos.

Y como me gusta hacerlo, mas a mi favor, hoy es uno de esos días, en los que las ganas de crear no están al 100%, solo es un día mas, intentando hacer algo, luchando con lo que llevamos por dentro, para ello, que mejor forma que un poco de arte terapia,  para drenar esos pensamientos, seguir activa y no permitir que los pensamientos me consuman. 

Un lindo dibujo creativo, con una frase motivadora, para mantener el espíritu optimista de la vida, enfocada en lo que somos y queremos ser. 

Con un poco de lettering, letras bonitas y decorativas, con algo de color..

El lettering, sin duda es la mejor terapia, es una buena manera de drenar nuestras emociones, de expandir esas ideas que tenemos en la cabeza, manteniendo activas, distraídas, creando, fortaleciendo esa habilidad artística, que todos llevamos por dentro, sin duda, una terapia saludable y fructífera. 


---

>Getting back to drawing a bit, and the idea of learning to craft beautiful phrases, I know this is a process—like everything else—and especially if you don’t practice every day, it takes much longer. But hey, the important thing is to try, whenever we can.
>
>And since I love doing it—which works in my favor—today is one of those days when my creative drive isn’t at 100%. It’s just another day, trying to do something, wrestling with what’s inside us. For that, what better way than a little art therapy to let those thoughts flow, stay active, and not let them consume me. 
>
>A lovely creative drawing, with a motivational phrase, to keep an optimistic spirit about life, focused on who we are and who we want to be. 
>
>With a bit of lettering, beautiful and decorative letters, and a touch of color...
>
>Lettering is undoubtedly the best therapy; it’s a great way to release our emotions, to expand on the ideas we have in our heads, keeping us active, distracted, and creative, while strengthening that artistic ability we all carry within us. Without a doubt, it’s a healthy and fruitful form of therapy.

body.title: Visitamos el MBK Center en Bangkok [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! otro centro comercial que visitamos mientras estabamos en Bangkok (Tailandia) fue el MBK Center, y la verdad es que al igual que los demás, este también nos encantó, pues es grande y su ambiente es diferente ya que no parece lujoso como los otros que visitamos y tiene muchas tiendas pequeñas donde venden una gran variedad de productos, así que sí, aquí vas a conseguir un montón de cosas y a precios asequibles o negociables, lo digo por experiencia jajajaja. Fuímos allí porque queríamos comprar una pequeña mochila para cargar cosas y como ven en las fotos si compramos una ya que conseguímos una muy bonita, pero en realidad estuvimos un rato viendo todas las cosas que vendían allí, queríamos comprar de todo jajaja, y es que tenían ropa, zapatos, recuerdos, accesorios, y sí, también muchos sitios para comer, nosotros ya habíamos almorzado pero allí decidimos comprar un coco para tomar el agua y refrescarnos del gran calor que hace en Bangkok y debo decir que la atención siempre fue buena y no paraban de saludar a Olivia y es que en Tailandia aman los niños. Y a pesar de que había mucha gente allí porque sí, es un centro comercial muy conocido entre turistas y también locales, debo decir que todo allí es muy ordenado y claro que es un sitio que recomiendo conocer si van a Bangkok pues estoy segura que les va a encantar la experiencia tanto como a nosotros, y es que allí van a conseguir de todo, hasta un supermercado con muchas cosas buenas y frescas y como dije antes a buenos precios. ## English Hi everyone! Another shopping mall we visited while we were in Bangkok (Thailand) was the MBK Center, and honestly, just like the others, we loved this one too, because it’s big and has a different vibe—it doesn’t feel as luxurious as the others we visited, and it has lots of small shops selling a wide variety of products. So yeah, you’ll find tons of stuff here at affordable or negotiable prices—I speak from experience, hahaha. We went there because we wanted to buy a small backpack to carry things, and as you can see in the photos, we did buy one since we found a really nice one, but actually we spent a while looking at all the things they sold there—we wanted to buy everything, hahaha— and the thing is, they had clothes, shoes, souvenirs, accessories, and yes, plenty of places to eat too. We’d already had lunch, but there we decided to buy a coconut to drink the water and cool off from the intense heat in Bangkok, and I have to say the service was always great—they kept greeting Olivia, because in Thailand, they just love kids. And even though there were a lot of people there just hanging out, it’s a shopping center that’s very popular with both tourists and locals. I have to say that everything there is very well-organized, and it’s definitely a place I recommend visiting if you’re going to Bangkok—I’m sure you’ll love the experience just as much as we did. You can find just about anything there, including a supermarket with lots of great, fresh products—and, as I mentioned before, at great prices.

body.title: Zero Day Vulnerability
body.body:
# Zero Day Vulnerability

First, a couple of disclaimers.

1. I am not a developer, before this incident that I am going to talk about, I didn't know about Zero Day Vulnerability
2. I am a major stakeholder both and Hive and Splinterlands, and I deeply care about both ecosystem and I also recognize that they are inseparable
3. I am good at research, these days with internet, most people can be

Therefore, if I don't know something, it is not hard to at least get some basic familiarity on the subject. I am obviously no expert on it, but there are other who are completely clueless about this and they do read this sometimes. Also this is my blog, so I treat it like my journal and this topic is on my mind right now, so I am going to write about it.


![Vulnerability_timeline.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqKR8nXft589Jd9QkxvUHDY6xSg5SyPCYQtDGYhFBPYN/Vulnerability_timeline.png)

[Source](https://www.rand.org/content/dam/rand/pubs/research_reports/RR1000/RR1024/RAND_RR1024.pdf)

# What is a Zero‑Day Vulnerability?
A zero‑day vulnerability is a security flaw in software, hardware, or firmware that is unknown to the vendor or developers and has no available patch at the time it is discovered or exploited.
* The term “zero‑day” means developers have had zero days to fix the problem before it is used in an attack. 
* Because no fix exists yet, attackers can exploit it before defenders can prepare, making it especially dangerous.

# Origin of the Term \

In early computing, “zero day” referred to the number of days since software was released. The term became popular in the 1990s piracy (warez) community. Pirated software was categorized by “age”:

* 30‑day (released 30 days ago)
* 100‑day (older software)
* Zero‑day (brand new or pre-release)

The most valuable category was:

- “Zero‑day” → software cracked and distributed immediately (or before official release)

# The Defender's Dilemma



Lot of what I learned the topic is from the report titled The Defender's Dilemma, which I felt is a good resource. It talks about Cyber security in general. The report argues that cybersecurity is an ongoing economic and strategic “arms race” between attackers and defenders, where:

- Costs are rising rapidly
- Effectiveness is uncertain
- Attackers may be gaining the advantage



<center> ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBbJNx78h4P33ntVW2zyneievRWyA3EcEZPyZNSmLNrB/image.png) </center>

The real goal is not perfect security, but:

> minimize (security spending + expected losses from attacks)

Organizations:

- Can measure what they spend
- Cannot easily measure what attacks were prevented



This leads to inefficient or misaligned security investments. In other words, security is fundamentally an economic trade-off problem, not just a technical one.  

There is the structural imbalance between attackers and defenders. Attackers operate with a clear advantage: they only need to find a single vulnerability, while defenders must secure every possible entry point. Moreover, attackers can reuse tools and techniques across multiple targets, scaling their efforts efficiently. Defenders, on the other hand, must operate under uncertainty, constantly reacting to new threats, including unknown vulnerabilities such as zero-days. This asymmetry creates a persistent “defender’s dilemma,” where even well-funded and highly capable organizations remain exposed to compromise.

# Splinterlands

That brings us to Splinterlands. Recently, @louis88 published [a post regarding a vulnerability](https://peakd.com/hive/@louis88/when-security-becomes-a-one-way-street-my-experience-with-responsible-disclosure-in-the-hive-ecosystem). I have read the post when it was published but didn't know the details, and certainly didn't know the monetary aspect of it. Also, recently, there have been a major hack at hive-engine with significant loss of funds. Suddenly I am made aware, that we have been asked a bounty fee. So I had to do further research and find out more about it.

### What is a “White Hat Bounty” for Zero‑Day Vulnerabilities?

A white hat bounty (commonly called a bug bounty) is a legitimate financial reward paid to ethical hackers (white hats) for discovering and responsibly disclosing vulnerabilities—including zero‑day vulnerabilities—to the software vendor or platform owner.

- Key idea:

	- A zero‑day vulnerability = unknown, unpatched flaw
	- A white hat bounty = legal incentive to find and report it safely instead of exploiting or selling it illegally

### How does it work?

1. A security researcher discovers a vulnerability (potentially a zero‑day) 

2. They privately disclose it to the vendor (responsible disclosure)


- The vendor:

	- Verifies the issue
	- Fixes it
	- Pays a bounty based on severity and impact

	- The vulnerability may later be published after patching

# Here comes the money part

Louis here is asking for a payment. As a Splinterlands SPS DAO treasurer (I am one of the 13), it now comes to the DAO to sign a check for Louis. That is when I was made aware of this situation yesterday by the DAO Manager @clayboyn. We have a discretionary nominal amount <$5000, which we can pay without running a proposal. These are for \

. This is where I fall into a bind. How do I define the following:

- How much money do we pay to Louis, meaning what is a fair price?
- How exactly do we pay him as per procedure?

Am I comfortable in just signing a transaction sending a dollar amount to Louis's wallet? Or is it better for Louis to write a proposal as ask for the funds?

# What do the community thinks? 

https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaDBldXhqODk4emZrcnNsMWFkZWhwbnc0OHI3OGxjcTdrdnJsc2hzeSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/35pTQFiy14OeA/giphy.gif

body.title: Kuragehime (2010)
body.body: >  \n\n   Hello everyone, among the various anime genres and stories, as I mentioned in previous posts, one of the things I enjoy is when there's a theme that's a little different from what we commonly know as school-related or similar, but that manages to connect with viewers and become a good anime, offering valuable insights or leaving a profound impact on those who watch it. And for this reason, there's one that caught my attention because of how unique and, in some aspects, realistic it can be about surviving when anxiety or fear of connecting with others leads us to hide our dreams and talents until we find that trigger we need, often unexpectedly. So today I'll give you my opinion on \

\n\n>Hola a todos, entre los géneros e historias de anime, como dije en anteriores posts, una de las cosas que me gustan es cuando existe una temática un poco distinta a lo que conocemos comúnmente como escolar o similares, pero que logra conectar y volverse un buen anime de conocimiento o marcar de forma profunda a quienes lo ven. Y para esto hay uno que me llamó la atención por lo singular y en algunos puntos realista que puede ser el sobrevivir cuando la ansiedad o el miedo a relacionarse con otros lleva a que ocultemos sueños y talentos hasta que damos con ese detonante que necesitamos, muchas veces de forma inesperada, por lo que hoy les daré mi opinión acerca de \

.

Created and illustrated by Akiko Higashimura, it began as a manga series serialized in Kodansha's Kiss magazine from 2008 to 2017, totaling 17 volumes plus some specials. It was then adapted into an anime in 2010, directed by Takahiro Ōmori and produced by Brain's Base, with a total of 11 episodes. This work also has a live-action film adaptation released in 2014, as well as a drama series based directly on the manga, directed by Junichi Ishikawa, which aired in 2018 and consisted of 10 episodes (I must say I was surprised by the latter, as I didn't know they existed, so I will definitely venture to watch them). >Creada e ilustrada por Akiko Higashimura, inició como una serie manga serializada por la revista Kiss de Kōdansha y la editorial Kōdansha desde 2008 hasta 2017, con un total de 17 volúmenes más algunos especiales, pasando luego a la adaptación al anime en el año 2010, dirigida por Takahiro Ōmori y producida por Brain's Base, con un total de 11 episodios. Esta obra posee también una adaptación a la vida real o película live-action estrenada en 2014, así como también una serie o dorama basada en el manga directamente, el cual fue dirigido por Junichi Ishikawa, que salió en el año 2018 y que contó con un total de 10 episodios (de los cuales, de estos últimos, debo decir que sentí sorpresa, ya que no sabía que existían, por lo que sin duda me aventuraré a verlos).
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sipUVHlDbgI

[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1746043/mediaviewer/rm157401088/)
We move directly to the plot, which focuses on the life of Tsukimi Kurashita, a jellyfish lover whose affection for these creatures stems from memories of her late mother. She lives in an apartment building in Tokyo with other girls, all of whom are socially withdrawn and shy. Entering Tsukimi's life is Kuranosuke, a wealthy young man who dresses as a woman not only for pleasure but also because it brings him closer to his mother. Together, they embark on various adventures to save the building, which is threatened with demolition, and they must employ various strategies to prevent it. >Pasamos directamente a la trama, en donde nos centramos en la vida de Tsukimi Kurashita, una amante de las medusas cuyo amor por estas criaturas proviene de los recuerdos de su fallecida madre. Esta vive en un edificio en Tokio junto con otras chicas, en donde la cualidad de todas es que son muy retraídas socialmente y muy tímidas, y a la vida de Tsukimi llega Kuranosuke, un chico adinerado que se viste de mujer aparte de por gusto, por el hecho de que así se siente más cerca de su madre, y juntos harán diversas aventuras para salvar el edificio, el cual está siendo amenazado en ser demolido, por lo que tendrán que emplear estrategias para evitarlo.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ7FT9Z3EaKzsVhkCK13xtGSKFMr1gxu4rr8S6Kp72Gwd/1779311876668.jpg
[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1746043/mediaviewer/rm375504896/)

https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfuyezq1yn4jssnWLXsDbi4TNvHiygp2xZ5BpUTzrkEx/1779311909809.jpg
[link](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1746043/mediaviewer/rm894107392/)
Although this anime is a romantic comedy with slice-of-life elements, its true strength lies in how the characters rationally process their emotions and accept themselves through the dreams and goals that emerge from those experiences, opening up from the heart. We see several life stories, some similar and others that, while not following the same path, complement each other beautifully. Each member of this building will face difficulties in order to achieve their shared goal, and in turn, they will evolve and mature in their roles, confronting their insecurities and the fear of leaving their comfort zone. This anime is very sweet and charming, and although it had few episodes when it aired, it managed to win over audiences and foster a sense of connection, much like the jellyfish. >Aunque este anime es una comedia romántica y casos de la vida, en cómo toman de manera racional las emociones y el aceptarse a través de los sueños y metas que van surgiendo de esas experiencias y el abrirse desde el corazón es donde está lo importante de este. Vemos varias historias de vida, algunas similares y otras que, aunque no van por la misma vía, se logran complementar muy bien, ya que cada integrante de este edificio pasará por dificultades para así lograr lo que quieren como meta en común y a su vez lograr una evolución y maduración hacia los roles en cuanto a sus inseguridades y lo que es no salir de su espacio de confort o zona segura. Este anime es muy tierno y lindo y, aunque tiene pocos episodios en su tiempo, logró ganarse bien al público y lograr esa identificación propia, como lo fueron las medusas.

Personally, I quite enjoyed it, especially the way it focused on the evolution of a shy young woman's journey into a designer who expresses her feelings through her designs. Essentially, she finds herself and transforms a maternal memory into something that defines and elevates her. So, well, it's highly recommended for those who want to enjoy something short. Anyway, that's all for now, and I hope you like it. Thank you for reading. >Personalmente, a mí me gustó bastante, tanto que se enfocara en la evolución de la ruta de una joven tímida a una diseñadora que muestra sus sentimientos a través de los diseños, básicamente logrando encontrarse a sí misma y hacer de un recuerdo materno algo que la definiera y la elevara, por lo que, bueno, es muy recomendable para quienes quieren disfrutar de algo breve, pero bueno, ahí queda, sin más, y esperando que sea de su agrado. body.title: Version 0.4 of the Merg-E language specification :  Deprecating float/complex for qfloaf/qcomplex for full dimensional type-safety.
body.body:
![merg-e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pibara/AJhTrCUwiYtRz1r6ekKRv2NZwtfLPxPqFQb8bBcpSQRaLqCyzGHV93h6d2n9xB8.jpg)

This is part twentytwo in a series on the language spec for the [Merg-E Domain Specific Language for the InnuenDo Web 3.0 stack](/hive-139531/@pibara/merg-e-a-different-type-of-least-authority-language-and-runtime-top-level-overview). Where most previous posts were about v0.3, this is the third post that is about the v0.4 version of the spec. I'll add more parts to the below list as the spec progresses:

* [part 1](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merge-e-language-specification--files-merging-scoping-name-resolution-and-synchronisation) : coding style, files, merging, scoping, name resolution and synchronisation
* [part 2](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merge-e-language-specification--reverse-markdown-for-comments) : reverse markdown for documentation
* [part 3](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--actors-and-pools) : Actors and pools.
* [part 4](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--locks-blockers-continuation-points-and-hazardous-blockers) : Semantic locks, blockers, continuation points and hazardous blockers
* [part 5](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--semantic-lexing-dags-pruneent-and-alias) : Semantic lexing, DAGs, prune / ent and alias.
* [part 6](/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--dags-and-dataframes-as-only-data-structures) : DAGs and DataFrames as only data structures, and inline lambdas for pure compute.
* [part 7](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--freezing) : Freezing
* [part 8](/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--attenuation-decomposition-and-membranes) : Attenuation, decomposition, and membranes
* [part 9](/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--sensitive-data-in-non-mutables-and-future-vault-support) : Sensitive data in immutables and future vault support.
* [part 10](/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--scalars-and-serialization-to-and-from-high-fidelity-json-hf-json) : Scalars and High Fidelity JSON
* [part 11](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--operators-expressions-and-precedence) : Operators, expressions and precedence.
* [part 12](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--robust-integers-and-integer-bitwidth-generic-programming) : Robust integers and integer bitwidth generic programming
* [part 13](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--the-merg-e-ownership-model-capture-rules-and-the-trustmebro-compiler-flag) : The Merg-E ownership model, capture rules, and the **--trustmebro** compiler flag.
* [part 14](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--actorcitos-and-structural-iterators) : Actorcitos and structural iterators
* [part 15](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--explicit-actorcitos-non-inline-structural-iterators-runtimes-and-abstract-sch) : Explicit actorcitos, non-inline structural iterators, runtimes, and abstract scheduler pipeline. 
* [part 16](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--async-functions-and-resources-and-the-full-use-of-innuendo-vaultfs) : async functions and resources and the full use of InnuenDo VaultFS
* [part 17](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--ram-points-ram-points-normalization-bag-and-the-quota-membrane): RAM-Points, RAM-points normalization bag, and the quota-membrane.
* [part 18](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--literal-operators-and-rational-and-complex-numbers): Literal operators & Rational and Complex numbers.
* [part 19](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-03-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--interaction-between-operators-integer-bitwidth-generics-and-the-full-numeric-): Interaction between operators, integer bitwidth generics, and the full numeric type-system.
* [part 20](/merg-e/@pibara/version-04-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--compile-time-dimensional-analysis-siplanck-units-and-the-scaling-literal-oper) (v0.4): Compile-time dimensional analysis, SI/Planck units and the scaling literal operator. 
* [part 21](/hive-139531/@pibara/version-04-of-the-merg-e-language-specification--tensors-and-tensor-literals) (v0.4): Tensors and tensor literals.
* **part 22** (v0.4): Deprecating float/complex for qfloaf/qcomplex for full dimensional type-safety.

In this post I'm doing a short follow up on my previous post on dimensional analysis on floating point type families `float` and `complex`.
As you may have read, in my post on dimensional analysis, I was hesitating if I needed to make dimensions mandatory for all floating point types. I have decided that **yes** I should, Merg-E should be radically safe by default and explicit where being implicit comes with risks.

However looking into this, it's not simple because we also need to take into account how we handle operator demotion on exact types.

## How operator demotion fits in

In part 19 of this series we saw that exact types will promote when used with operators, that the result of an `int64` times a `whole32` plus an `int16` is an `int128`, and how virtual compile time types somewhat reduce the bitwidth explosion.  We also saw the absolute promotion limits stemming from virtual types like `Vint20740`. The biggest `int` family runtime type is `int16384`, and as `Vint20740` has no other place to promote to, it demotes to `float256`, the highest precision floating point. 

So if we say that all float and complex based values need dimensional annotations and the un-demoted exact countable types never have such dimensional annotations, how do we keep unintended dimension type errors from occurring?

We do that by leveraging a unit static field we already discussed, the **sys** or system field. So far we discussed **SI** and **PLANCK** as possible system designations. We add a third value to our spec: **DEMOTE**. 

```
inert whole128 a = 4041424344 * 4041424344 * 4041424344 * 4041424344;
inert whole1024 b = ( a + 1 ) * a * a * a;
inert int8192 c = b * b * b * b;
inert quantity::<tensor::<float256,0>, unit::<sys: DEMOTE>> d = c * c + 1;
```

So what is the purpose of this? Well, as we discussed earlier, quantities with a defined sys parameter don't mix in expression with quantities with a different defined sys parameter. That was the reason we discussed using an empty sys field for dimensionless quantities, so they work well with both PLANCK and SI quantities. 

And right here that is exactly what we want. The result of a demotion to a float or complex quantity can **only** be used in expressions with non dimensional quantities, and the result of these expressions also can only be used with non dimensional quantities. This is the highest dimensional safety we think we can achieve in Merg-E. Remember, we are mixing two worlds with demotions, and this is the only dimensional way to do that without implicit anything.

## From float/complex to qfloat/qcomplex with modifiers

In v0.4 we take the radical step to declare that you can no longer write:

```
inert float16 pi = 3.140635;
``` 

These types can only be used as type in a quantity annotation:

```
inert quantity::<tensor<float16, 0> unit::<sys: SI>> pi = 3.140635;
```

This is quite a bit of verbosity. To overcome this verbosity we introduce a language feature called parameterized aliases. Detailed specs of these will come in a later post on the subject, for now we just show how they will work for floats. The base idea is that a type plus a set of modifiers together have an alias, and the modifiers become parameters in the alias. We use this feature to allow us to write something like:

```
inert nodim qfloat16 pi = 3.140635;
```

Here `qfloat16` is a parameterized alias to something along the lines of quantity::<tensor<float16, 0> unit::<sys: ${SYS}, @{DIMS}>> . 

The `nodim` modifier defines the two alias parameters. ${SYS} and ${DIMS}.  This way other modifiers allow us to create shorter notations for common units as well. Some examples

| modifier | SYS | dims |
| --- | --- | --- | 
| nodim |  |  |
| demote | DEMOTE | |
| plancklength | PLANCK | lengh: 1 |
| silength | SI | length : 1 |
| plancktime | PLANCK | time : 1 |
| sitime | SI | time : 1 |
| planckmass | PLANCK | mass: 1 |
| simass | SI | mass : 1 |
| plancktemp | PLANCK | temp: 1 |
| sitemp | SI | temp : 1 |
| planckcurrent | PLANCK | charge : 1, time: -1 |
| sicurrent | SI | current : 1 |
| planckcharge | PLANCK | charge : 1 |
| sicharge | SI | current : 1, time: 1 |
| planckspeed | PLANCK | length: 1, time: -1|
| sispeed | SI | length: 1, time: -1|
| planckaccel | PLANCK | length: 1, time: -2|
| siacceleration | SI | length: 1, time: -2|
| sisubstance | SI | substance: 1 |
| siintensity | SI | intensity: 1 |

The above table is illustrative for now, a complete version will be part of the language spec but is too long for this blog post series.

You might have noticed the `demote` modifier. We can use that one in our first bit of code to rewrite:

```
inert quantity::<tensor::<float256,0>, unit::<sys: DEMOTE>> d = c * c + 1;
```

as:

```
inert demote qfloat256 d =  c * c + 1;
```

Some verbosity is left, but this time it's the right amount of verbosity.

Looking at actual quantities, things also become less verbose for most meaningful physical quantities using these parameterized aliases:

```
inert quantity::<tensor::<float16, 0>, units.meter> height = 1.825;
inert quantity::<tensor::<float16,0>, unit::<sys: PLANCK, length: 1, time: -1>> |||
     speed = 0.07;
inert quantity::<tensor::<float16, 0>,unit::<sys: SI, length:1, time:-2>> g = 9.80665;
inert  quantity::<tensor::<float256, 0>, units.meter> tinybit = 1.437 þ -9;
```

becomes

```
inert silength qfloat16 height = 1.825;
inert planckspeed qfloat16 speed = 0.07;
inert siacceleration qfloat16 g = 9.80665;
inert  silength qfloat256 tinybit = 1.437 þ -9;
```

## A note on PLANCK vs SI

As you may have noted in the partial modifier table, PLANCK and SI dimensions are usually the same, but not always, and some SI units don't have a PLANCK equivalent unit.

| modifier | SYS | dims |
| --- | --- | --- | 
| planckcurrent | PLANCK | charge : 1, time: -1 |
| sicurrent | SI | current : 1 |
| planckcharge | PLANCK | charge : 1 |
| sicharge | SI | current : 1, time: 1 |
| sisubstance | SI | substance: 1 |
| siintensity | SI | intensity: 1 |

The reason for this is that even if they share a lot of dimensions for core units, they are not fully equivalent:

| unit | SI | PLANCK |
| -- | -- | -- | 
| length | base | base |
| mass | base | base |
| time | base | base |
| temperature | base | base |
| electric current | base | composite (charge / time) |
| charge | composite (current * time) | base |
| substance | base | - |
| intensity | base | - |

Note that even an SI quantity will have a charge slot and a PLANCK quantity a current, substance and intensity slot, so it is possible to define a quantity with impossible combinations. Checking for these impossibilities won't be a task the compiler will perform due to semantic lexer design, though it is likely we will provide a separate linter that will include checks for this. 


## A Note on nodim Interoperability
You might wonder: if `sys: DEMOTE` isolation is so strict, how do we use dimensionless scale factors with it? In Merg-E, a nodim quantity has an empty sys field. This allows it to act as a universal scalar. When you multiply a DEMOTE quantity by a nodim quantity, the expression is valid, but the result immediately locks into the DEMOTE branch. This gives you the flexibility to scale demoted values without ever allowing them to leak back into SI or PLANCK spaces.

## Conclusion

In this post we discussed a major and breaking change to the language spec from v0.3 to v0.4: The deprecation of `float` family and `complex` family numerics as valid type for immutables and mutables. Instead of float, the new quantity float or `qfloat` parameterized type aliasses and `quantity` types now takes their place and in doing so enhances the type safety of Merg-E with full dimensionaly analysis type safety. Dimensional type safety that croses the barrier between countble dimensionless types and inprecise floating point types in case of type demotion of huge precise types.

#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and animal lovers! While browsing my phone's gallery, I came across some photos I took of Julieta, the tortoise who lives in the countryside with my cat, Ikki. Since the house is located in an open area, Julieta spends most of her time in a small enclosure they set up for her. This not only prevents her from getting lost in the countryside but also keeps other animals away.
When it's time to go for a walk, Julieta gets excited, and if you're not careful, she's capable of disappearing into the bushes. We always have to supervise her in case she gets stuck or falls into the holes that were dug for renovations. She also likes to eat some plants—not all of them, in fact, her favorite are some heart-shaped leaves. I also saw her eating small pebbles, which scared me! But I read that it's normal for them.

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de los animales! Mientras revisaba la galería de mi teléfono, me encontré con unas fotografías que le tomé a **Julieta**, la morrocoy que se encuentra en el campo junto a mi gato, *Ikki*. Como la casa está ubicada en un espacio abierto, Julieta se la pasa la mayor parte del tiempo en un pequeño espacio que acomodaron para ella. Esto no sólo evita que se pierda en el campo, sino que no se le acerquen otros animales.
Cuando llega el momento de salir a pasear, Julieta se emociona y si la descuidas, es capaz de meterse entre los arbustos. Siempre hay que supervisarla, por si se mete en un lugar de dónde no pueda salir o caiga en los agujeros que se han hecho para algunas remodelaciones. También, le gusta comer algunas plantas, no todas, de hecho, su favorita son unas hojas que tienen forma de corazón; también la vi comiéndose unas piedritas pequeñas ¡Eso me asustó! body.title: How To Buy Bitcoin With Hive (Without Using Coinbase)
body.body:
I just joined Hive less than 3 weeks ago at #hod Hive Open Days Alicante, so I'm still exploring the ecosystem and testing different apps and tools.

*(You can read my intro post [here](https://peakd.com/hive-148309/@iamkaye/how-a-bitcoin-atm-led))*

Since I'm already familiar with apps like Coinbase and Metamask, I wanted to try **Altera** by @magi.network — to see for myself how easy it actually is to **buy Bitcoin using Hive**.

So I recorded the full process as a quick UX test and **video walkthrough** 👇


[![Buy Bitcoin With Hive - A 60-second Guide for Newbies](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23ynSjXQEfRuiAC41QtcxDhYXYjwpEeBm2YrWimMnLPfcMqA2ApHp8dPfemiVNsJeDaMw.png)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=iamkaye/4da41b77)

## First Impressions

What surprised me the most was how straightforward it was. 

I’m new to Hive and figured this out. If it's this easy for me, I think a lot of people are sleeping on this.

**The steps I tested:**
1. Login to Altera with Hive Keychain
2. Deposit HIVE into the Magi wallet




Dashboard view - starting balance 0

![iamkaye_altera1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23u5Sa89P2pFWBrNz2ereuMYoLwMBXffYvBLsdyjL1gUG5tzhhfgwFUnkRdSsvV8S6Jxe.png)


3 Swap HIVE → BTC on Altera


![iamkaye_altera3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/23u5SnZH6rh1Hx8ymAYx95uVJj5YX8xjDb7CUdR9Z115yi8eEndZiYnCAoQ2Tigiw25dK.png)


![iamkaye_altera4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamkaye/EoAS6FUym5vNPDkcH3SxXPnguDpYCSW3PRiM6c4nYSPUgUfo2HgVDHX2tFXJ8HUnQJb.png)





The actual process is really simple. I walked through the whole thing in under 60 seconds. The transaction took a few minutes to confirm on-chain but that's normal. 

And I didn't even read the docs.


## Final Thoughts
Honestly if it's confusing, nobody's going to bother — but it wasn't. That's the point. 

For anyone new to Hive and curious about DeFi, just go try it. You don't need to know what you're doing.

Thanks to @magi.network for running the contest and giving newer Hive users a reason to explore the ecosystem 🙌

body.body:
## Introduction: Recovery Beyond Detox

Recovery does not end when detox or inpatient treatment concludes. For many individuals, the most vulnerable stage begins afterward—when structure is reduced but cravings, triggers, and emotional instability may still be present. Sober living homes provide a bridge between clinical treatment and full independence.

New Jersey has developed a broad spectrum of recovery housing options due to its proximity to major urban centers and a strong network of healthcare providers. These homes are designed to reduce relapse risk while helping individuals rebuild daily routines, employment stability, and social skills in a substance-free environment.

## Understanding Sober Living Homes

### Definition and Core Principles

Sober living homes are shared residential environments where individuals in recovery live together under structured, substance-free rules. Residents are typically expected to maintain sobriety, contribute to household responsibilities, and participate in recovery-related activities such as counseling or peer meetings.

The core principles include accountability, peer support, structure, and gradual reintegration into independent living. Unlike inpatient treatment, these homes do not provide medical detox services, but they strongly reinforce ongoing recovery behaviors.

### Difference Between Rehab, Detox, and Sober Living

Detox focuses on safely managing withdrawal symptoms, often under medical supervision. Rehabilitation programs address behavioral patterns and psychological dependency through therapy. Sober living, however, is a transitional environment that supports long-term habit change in real-world settings.

This distinction matters because many individuals underestimate the importance of the transition phase. Without it, relapse risk can increase significantly.

## The Sober Living Landscape in New Jersey

### Urban vs. Suburban Recovery Housing

In New Jersey, sober living homes are distributed across both urban hubs like Newark and Jersey City, as well as quieter suburban areas. Urban homes often provide better access to job opportunities, public transportation, and outpatient clinics. Suburban homes, on the other hand, may offer calmer environments with fewer external triggers.

The choice often depends on personal recovery needs. Some individuals benefit from structured city life, while others require distance from high-risk environments.

### Licensing, Oversight, and Quality Standards

New Jersey has taken steps toward improving oversight of recovery residences, though regulation can still vary. Reputable homes typically align with national standards such as those promoted by recovery housing organizations. Quality indicators include clear rules, drug testing protocols, staff supervision, and connections to clinical services.

## Types of Sober Living Arrangements

### Peer-Run Homes

Peer-run sober living homes are managed by residents or recovery peers rather than clinical staff. These environments emphasize mutual accountability and shared responsibility. They are often more affordable but may require stronger personal discipline.

### Clinical-Linked Recovery Residences

These homes are connected to outpatient treatment providers or counseling centers. Residents may attend therapy sessions, medication management appointments, or group counseling as part of their routine. This model provides additional structure for individuals with higher relapse risk.

### Private Transitional Housing

Private sober living homes often offer enhanced amenities such as private rooms, structured schedules, and career support services. While more expensive, they can be beneficial for individuals who need stability while rebuilding professional or academic lives.

## Health Considerations in Early Recovery

### Medication Awareness and Physical Recovery Factors

Physical health plays a significant role in early recovery success. Many individuals are also managing unrelated medical conditions that require careful medication use. Awareness of drug interactions, mental health stability, and overall physical recovery is essential when transitioning into sober living.

In some cases, individuals may have questions about medication effects during recovery, such as concerns similar to [how much alcohol can i drink on prednisone](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/prednisone-and-alcohol/), which highlights the importance of medical supervision even outside substance-use treatment. While sober living homes are not medical facilities, responsible ones encourage residents to consult healthcare providers regularly.

## Choosing the Right Sober Living Home

### Safety, Structure, and Accountability

Choosing the right home requires evaluating both structure and environment. Strong sober living homes enforce curfews, mandatory drug testing, and participation in recovery meetings. Safety also includes emotional safety—supportive peer relationships and conflict resolution systems.

Location matters as well. Homes near recovery resources, employment opportunities, and transportation systems often support better long-term outcomes.

### Financial Planning and Insurance Considerations

Costs vary widely across New Jersey, depending on location and services provided. Some homes accept insurance indirectly through affiliated outpatient programs, while others are private-pay only. Transparent financial policies are a key sign of legitimacy.

## Life Inside a Sober Living Environment

### Daily Structure and Expectations

Daily life in sober living homes is structured around accountability. Residents often follow schedules that include chores, job searching, therapy sessions, and recovery meetings. This structure helps rebuild discipline that may have been disrupted during addiction.

Consistency is one of the strongest predictors of success in these environments.

### Community Support and Peer Accountability

Peer support is central to recovery housing. Living with others who share similar goals reduces isolation and reinforces positive behavior patterns. Many residents form long-term supportive relationships that extend beyond their stay.

## Treatment Integration and Medication Support

### MAT and Recovery Stability

Some individuals in sober living are also part of Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) programs. These may include medications designed to reduce cravings or stabilize recovery progress under medical supervision.

Discussions around MAT effectiveness often appear in community forums, including topics like [brixadi reviews](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/brixadi-vs-sublocade/), where individuals share experiences with extended-release treatment options. While opinions vary, medical oversight remains essential for safe and effective use.

For individuals seeking broader behavioral health support and recovery resources, national services such as[ SAMHSA National Helpline](https://www.samhsa.gov/find-help/national-helpline?utm_source=chatgpt.com) provide confidential guidance and treatment referrals.

## Challenges and Long-Term Recovery Success

### Relapse Prevention Strategies

Relapse prevention involves identifying triggers, maintaining structure, and building coping mechanisms. Sober living homes reduce exposure to high-risk environments while reinforcing daily accountability. However, long-term success depends on continued effort after leaving structured housing.

### Transitioning to Independent Living

Leaving sober living is a major milestone. Many individuals transition gradually by securing stable employment, continuing therapy, and maintaining peer support networks. Without these supports, the risk of relapse can increase.

## Resources and Support Systems in New Jersey

### State Programs and Community Networks

New Jersey offers a range of recovery resources, including outpatient clinics, peer recovery specialists, and nonprofit housing support programs. These systems are designed to complement sober living environments and ensure continuity of care.

Community-based organizations also play a major role in helping individuals find stable housing and employment after treatment.

Sober living is not a single solution but part of a larger recovery ecosystem. In New Jersey, the combination of structured housing, community support, and clinical integration creates a pathway for sustained recovery when used consistently and thoughtfully.

---

body.title: One Piece _ Too Many Seasons But Worth the See.
body.body:
Okay so, One piece

I will be honest with you I did not think I was going to like One Piece it has over 1000 episodes, The main character is a boy who can stretch like rubber, He wants to be the King of the Pirates, yes this anime sounded like something I would watch for a while and then stop watching but here I am and I have a lot to say about this anime -  One Piece..

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYGiUQJbJjVJhCLKSfkEE2VvciWzEGX4uenWwhiXAxUK/img_20260520_wa0017.jpg)

So yes, let's start from the beginning.

The story follows Monkey D Luffy this guy is goofy, loud, fearless , he ate something called a Devil Fruit and got a very stretchy rubber body from it, Monkey D. Luffy wants to find a treasure called One Piece and become the Pirate King, sounds Simple enough right? except it is not simple at all, Because what One Piece actually is, underneath all the fighting and the islands and the ridiculous powers  is actually about people and about belonging it is about what it means to have friends who care about you.

This is what I like about One Piece.

One Piece does not try to be flashy it just tells its story in a way with a little backstory here and a small moment there and before you know it you care about the characters and you do not even feel bad about it.

Every character in Monkey D Luffys crew the Straw Hats has something that bothers them, they have dreams they almost gave up on they have wounds that never fully healed and somehow One Piece makes you feel like you are part of their joy and their pain this is something about One Piece.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiRT3mvm1wGx6qum6jCtkPVNqhGniLp7W49HxLxYHdg1/img_20260520_wa0018.jpg)

Now I will not say that One Piece is perfect.

The pacing of One Piece is not always great some parts of the story are longer than they need to be there are episodes that do not add much to the story and they can be boring if you like stories that move fast you might get bored with the episodes of One Piece I understand that.

If you keep watching One Piece it is worth it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTZAExykfMp5SBzrSVbFBFN7no213dpYDs7Ur54dtUhz/img_20260520_wa0025.jpg)

The world of One Piece is very detailed the creator of One Piece, Oda has been working on it since 1997 you can tell that he put a lot of thought into every part of the world of One Piece, every island, every bad guy, every detail that becomes important later it is a kind of storytelling that makes you want to watch it again to see what you missed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbdHQV3D8R7fKVW4PYS8SRmF6CiZJhz68NoeKNaP3ggCM/img_20260520_wa0020.jpg)

The emotional moments of One Piece I do not want to spoil anything but some of these moments will stay with you and not because they are loud or exciting but because they are real you have spent so much time with the characters of One Piece that when something happens it feels real like something big is happening and you feel it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRFN2J7XRpxGyjB2uc5cAhKSzqzrMexZis6CtJezcqFH/img_20260520_wa0024.jpg)

That is what I keep thinking about when I think about One Piece, One Piece knows that the important moments are not always the biggest ones sometimes,   it is a small decision, a quiet conversation,  a character being happy and those moments stay with you.

If I had to give One Piece a rating , I would say 8.5 out of 10.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNHmtCz5ZVQfk3bAWEr63UkTADZ35S63ksPUb9RjAQDT/img_20260520_wa0019.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWnUKi4zu9piDeLxUSfz3v7YW88deQwSTwQRH3QBqan9T/img_20260520_wa0021.jpg)

One Piece asks for your patience and also your time, it needs a lot of both, but what it gives you in return is a world that feels real characters that feel like real people and a story that reminds you why friendship and chasing your dreams are important.

One Piece is not perfect, It is the kind of imperfect that you end up loving and honestly that is enough, for me.


<sub>***Images are from my video player***</sub>

body.body: Fear is a dual force; it can protect us from certain dangers in violent and chaotic environments, making us more cautious, but it can also paralyze us when making important life decisions. Without fear, we would be reckless and suicidal, wandering down dark alleys where we could be mugged and assaulted, for example. On the other hand, with too much fear, we become cowards and let important opportunities pass us by. The right answer lies in knowing how to balance these two extremes.

Aimee actually grew up near the studio where it was mostly filmed, and then the studio went on to do big brother.

CGI is great, don't get me wrong, I do like it - especially when done well. But, I wish films would go back to using models predominantly. There's something about costumes, makeup and practical effects in general. One thing I always use as a comparison example is the original Lord of The Rings films and The Hobbit films. 

LOTR still holds up today, while The Hobbit in many ways looks dated, even though it's 10 years more recent.

Let me know what you think of it, if you go. We're hoping to get to it, but it can be tough sometimes to organise going out.

body.title: The Winter Help
body.body:
/>](https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=karenmario/0joc7hzy)

On a freezing winter night, snow covered the small village of Pinewood. The wind howled through the empty streets, and everyone stayed inside their warm homes.

Near the marketplace, a poor boy named Leo shivered in the cold. His clothes were torn, and his hands were numb. He had no family and nowhere to sleep. The cold felt unbearable.

Behind a shop, Leo saw a small pile of coal. Desperate to stay warm, he quietly took a few pieces and ran away. He knew stealing was wrong, but he feared he might freeze during the night.

As he hurried away, a girl named Clara saw him. Clara was kind-hearted and curious. Instead of shouting or calling for help, she followed him to an old shed near the forest.

There she saw Leo trying to light a tiny fire with the coal. His hands trembled from the cold.

“Why did you steal it?” Clara asked softly.

Leo looked down in shame. “I was cold and hungry. I didn’t want to steal, but I didn’t know what else to do.”

Clara felt sorry for him. She realized he was not a bad boy—just someone trying to survive the harsh winter.

“Wait here,” she said.

A few minutes later, Clara returned carrying a basket with warm soup, bread, and a thick blanket. Leo’s eyes filled with tears.

“You’re helping me?” he asked in surprise.

“Everyone deserves kindness in winter,” Clara replied with a smile.

Leo ate the food gratefully while warming himself by the fire. From that day on, Clara often visited him and helped him find work in the village. Slowly, Leo’s life became better.

The villagers later learned what had happened. Instead of punishing Leo, they helped him too. Clara’s kindness had changed not only Leo’s life but also the hearts of the people around her.

And in the coldest winter, the warmest thing of all was kindness.

body.title: 35mm film in the streets of Yerevan
body.body:
![surf 8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23uQvsFUp4ozdNHA399w8RZ4R4AF9YMsojXVVnjPuYBTMAseJmDLBTEi314ErSLMVbYTc.jpg)

It has been a while but I feel like the love and itch for shooting film has returned. With prices in Armenia for film being incredibly high, I never really bothered to buy any. Though I recently noticed that film prices back in the UK are actually quite reasonable. Being half the price! This made me very interested in picking up the Canon AE-1 again, so much so that I'm looking to buy some film in bulk but also a Canon FD 28mm 2.8 lens for a wider street focal length. The street stuff has been incredibly appealing nonetheless, with the sunlight out and a few events here and there. I've been going crazy with the film photography over the digital. There's just something so fun about pressing that shutter, hearing it, and the mechanical feeling of winding the feel to the next shot.

![surf 4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23z7Qjj33caHrq45M4bdH7df1qVzQywgD5yMX53b7sTiHQLWsS119RkzqQ1zjHjc4rtuD.jpg)

I've also really missed that film look. While digital film emulation has improved and there are some great general templates out there, nothing quite lands the same. And getting a roll of negatives back after development is another experience entirely. The very physical image that you can archive and cherish beyond your life. Not quite the same as digital images. Film is what I started with, and I feel like I never would've really stopped shooting it had the prices not gone crazy. To some degree they still are, but certainly not as bad as I had assumed. I've also noticed my interactions with people have increased as they see the 35mm film camera instead of a digital one. More people come and speak to me about cameras and photography as a result. That's always something fun, having people connect through the interest. Though the photographer community in Yerevan genuinely sucks in regards to being so painfully recluse. An actual community is definitely needed.

![surf 7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/244KTaiBG9HBa4qNjtQ1G9M8CpwKzgeG8gyfhFYc3ZEJwCEESgfgbWSycdmmq8Ft95X9p.jpg)

I've taken more interest in people and feel the confidence of photographing them improving. These were from a roll where I was still a bit nervous. Still a bit cautious of being noticed or getting too close. Still range focusing and trying to hit that 5 - 7 feet range at F8. It's more the angles that need to improve, more that I need to face people head-on and accept that they might be curious about what I'm doing. Naturally that comes with knowing who is more likely to accept being photographed and who is more likely to throw a punch at you. That comes with a general intuition, I guess. But so far I think I have been fast enough for people to not care, and to have gone for unique characters that generally are more used to being photographed elsewhere in other nations. Rather than the fat Armenian men that chain smoke all day in the city.
![surf 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/244A6yRv7b9kmcThFLVLxbW33W892Hjxn1ULRzG4WRN4CK4L7dNNNRHU38TCZXzjccKLy.jpg)

Street photography and film have revived the love for photography for me suddenly. I feel that passion stronger than ever before. I feel hooked. All I can think about. All I want to do. I feel as if I have genuinely found and accepted my calling in life, and it is to explore and witness life with a camera in hand.

body.title: Pros and cons of publishing earnings online
body.body:
/>

### \#### picture is mine

This topic reminds me of the current situation in Nigeria where we barely know what the elites are collecting. In this post, I would like to share the both sides. Publishing everyone's earnings and salaries online for public consumption could be a difficult or simple thing depending on the side of the coin. There are varied schools of thoughts to this important topic for this edition. Some people believe that if this is published, it would promote fairness, honesty and accountability especially for the elite and politicians.

On the other hand publishing salary online could raise some questions and create insecurity, jealousy and other problems. Introducing such system might affect some individuals directly or indirectly. Salary transparency might lead to lots of benefits however the disadvantages could result to another thing.

Let's scroll through some of the advantages of publishing salaries. I think it will reduce the rate of corruption and promote transparency. This is an essential factor that is lacking today in Nigeria. People are involved in some illegal means of living. If earnings is made public, it would be easy to detect certain people's wealth. For instance in Nigeria, you would notice someone that collects small salary but the kind of things he does is beyond his or her earnings. This is completely wrong. Society tries to measure individuals according to their earnings and what they have to offer.

Advantage of this kind of thing is that it would help workers to deal with unfair treatment. If salaries are published at least it would cut the rate of under paying other staff. At least every organization will sit up in order to meet with demands. Most workers will compare how much they earn with their similar colleagues in another establishment.

I think many that have potential in securing jobs with government and other private sectors publishing salaries would help them to make critical decisions.Young people would better understand which professions pay well and which do not. This information could help them plan their education and future more wisely. Employers might also become more careful and professional in the way they structure salaries because the public would be watching. Organization and government will have no option than to restrategize in order to boost the confidence of their workers.

As I earlier stated that there are also disadvantages of publishing salaries online. One of the things or setback that it would bring is that there won't be privacy which could put one in a tight corner. Many people consider their earnings to be personal information. Publishing salaries online could make individuals uncomfortable and expose them to unnecessary public judgment. Some people may not want friends, neighbors, or extended family members to know how much they earn. If financial desire of people is high, it will put pressure on one especially those of in Nigeria. Different people and family members will call for support.

Another disadvantage of publishing salaries online is that it increase danger, bitterness. Fraudsters will easily access information and plan something evil. Like in Nigeria where the rate of insecurity is just on th increase. Publishing names will result to kidnapping and other scam activities.For employers, salary transparency could have both positive and negative effects. On one hand, companies would be encouraged to pay fairly and avoid discrimination. On the other hand, businesses might struggle with constant employee comparisons and disputes over salaries.

### Conclusion;

Making known salaries and earnings is to ensure lots of benefit

body.title: Missebo, the New Face of the Second-Hand Market in Benin
body.body:
Beneath great halls of silver steel,
Where daylight filters through to reveal,
Missebo rises again in all its glory,
A renovated market with a brand new story.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNAscDockZAWxHijTde2aT16FCKqjGGjCTtC8GftwaS1/1779310436490.jpg)

The president wished to offer something better,
To relocate, rebuild, down to the letter,
Gone are the dusty stalls soaked by the rain,
Now bright and luminous great halls remain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuZzAzFvQToXFRVaW5CtE4V2oEBp58XHkqZSeUrDrG1d/1779310460074.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUauTLM6QLzX2kbZKSTi5rHGE4c1TWy27X3cnYBWW7tgZ/1779310460138.jpg)

Translucent rooftops let the sunshine pour,
Ceiling fans spin gently, keeping cool the floor,
Fresh clean concrete welcomes every step,
Of thousands of visitors who come to prep.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNAscDockZAWxHijTde2aT16FCKqjGGjCTtC8GftwaS1/1779310478807.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWEf27H3cfnbpkcmP8xUdmLkM5xNwX7xzY926S1c2LDj/1779310478920.jpg)

Nike, Adidas, golden sandals catch the eye,
White sneakers, heels and leather moccasins too,

People try things on right there, without a care,

Second-hand shopping is an art worth your money.
Hanging garments dance in the warm breeze,
Colorful t-shirts, dresses, trousers, all with ease.

body.title: A Rose is a Rose is a Rose - My Actifit Report Card: May 20th, 2026
body.body:
<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Wednesday ☀️ 10118

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779310419.532874) 

A quick three-bridges morning walk today, then I picked up a few treats at the market, including some fresh strawberries, yummie, and then I had a few odds and ends to take care of. I treated myself to some relaxing breathing exercises and a few moments of meditation on my terrace in between, and since my calendar says today is “Flower Day,” here are a few roses for you that I caught along the way in the rose garden by the River Spree. And believe it or not, those little photobombers weren’t planned, they just flew into the shot the moment I pressed the shutter button. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779310423.090201) 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779310425.7871342) 

Ein kurzer Drei-Brücken-Morningwalk heute, dann ein paar Leckerlies auf dem Markt, unter anderem frische Erdbeeren nomnom, einsammeln und dann war da heute noch so dies und das zu erledigen. Entspannende Atemübungen und ein paar meditative Momente hab ich mir zwischendurch auf meiner Terrasse gegönnt und da mein Kalender sagt, heute sei „Flower Day“, gibts für euch heute ein paar Rosen, die ich unterwegs im Rosengarten an der Spree eingefangen hab. Und glaubt es oder nicht, aber die kleinen Fotobomber waren so nicht geplant und flogen just in dem Moment ins Bild, als ich auf den Auslöser drückte. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779310427.818603)
