body.title: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL ANIMAL: \
body.body:
> Hello, good morning to the entire Amazing Nature community. Today I'm joining this new contest titled: [THE MOST BEAUTIFUL ANIMAL](https://peakd.com/hive-174680/@hive-174680/new-contest-may-nuevo-concurso-mayo-the-most-beautiful-animal), and I'd like to invite my friends @irenenavarroart, @chacald.dcymt, @cirangela, and @germanandradeg. I'm sure they'll provide us with some very special content.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[🕊️ INTRODUCTION 🕊️]()**
--- # I wanted to participate in this contest with a species that, although not considered a domestic animal, nor usually part of our pets, we live with very closely because they've carved out a space for themselves in our urban environment. And if we're talking about beauty, they possess a very peculiar kind that inspires a lot of tenderness in us. I'm talking about pigeons, those birds we often see walking on our rooftops, and even on the ground pecking at any little bug or grain they find that might serve as food. It's common to find many of them in parks, and of course, on farms, specifically in the poultry area. They mingle among the birds, pecking at the grain they're fed.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQsArry2UUi1oF6FkMgRVTiFE7fHMfuhEaRVnHE4U3S4/7c05a2d9_54ee_49b0_a411_f43a1f98c590.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTsCM8yXAGgUx9JCpM6ZT8dBX1a6y9UTzVqFoZnuj9fa/82c0a94e_9a9a_4288_a24e_1c68b948baa9.jpg)

> In the housing development where I live, they've taken over the unoccupied houses, especially the two-story ones, and have made the upper floor their own, sneaking in through broken windows. Many people chase them off their roofs and walls because they consider them a pest that affects and pollutes the environment with their droppings, which they leave everywhere. I don't question the act of chasing them away; it's their right. However, I don't condone the mistreatment some people inflict on them. Less extreme solutions are needed. In fact, I currently have a pair of tenants living under my roof for some time now, right on a section of the supporting structure. Their droppings fall right onto one end of a wooden piece of furniture, and for now, what I do is clean both the furniture and my porch daily until I figure out how to move it and rearrange everything else. Rest assured, if they're in my house, it's because they've found peace and security here, and if I block that space from them, they'll find another, more comfortable spot in my home, just to stay. Pigeons have many connotations in the world, not only in nature but also symbolically… for me, the most significant is seeing them as a symbol of peace. But getting into the natural realm, I'm going to give you some characteristics of this bird, its lifestyle, habitat, and diet.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[🕊️ THE DOVE 🕊️]()**
--- # Pigeons, or Columbidae, are birds of the order Columbiformes, comprising a total of 353 species. They are distributed worldwide, except in Antarctica and the Arctic, and have a center of dispersal in Central America. These birds congregate wherever food is offered, strolling through parks and gardens, perching, or even on top of buildings; pigeons are part of the fauna of many cities.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Description]()**
--- # Pigeons are relatively small birds with compact bodies. Their heads are small, and their legs are short. They have a small, slightly downward-curved beak with two nostrils on its surface, protected by a membranous layer called the operculum. Their wings are large, and their tails are short.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbsicVdNKCeQViBPH1BRFvKXfKk14UAX3NANCcAdiJbV/8e36e95c_d299_4c8e_8dd5_8fdd3f36cd3a.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR6K7dMfXkkU3a4YNiw3YByYXaVX7v4yYEhu2eYMv9tMG/c594e27b_2225_4cda_95b2_8ef0f72ba561.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXmA4hsF6sF7e66hVy2X9JDGxHaNZdSaEjvAc44TpRjha/70bd755d_803b_42f1_b767_c103d02e677b.jpg)

> The size, weight, and plumage color vary considerably among species. Wild pigeons can weigh from 238 to 380 grams, but domestic pigeons are usually a bit heavier due to the abundance of food they consume in urban areas. Plumage color also varies; some are white, others light brown or dull gray, and still others are darker, bluish, or have lighter stripes.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Habitat]()**
--- # Pigeons can be seen in urban parks, around farms, in agricultural fields, on tall urban and rural buildings, on rooftops, walls, balconies, and railway bridges, among other places. Wild pigeons regularly inhabit rocky cliffs.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Diet]()**
--- # They feed on seeds, grains, and fruits. Depending on the species, they may eat grains they find on the ground or feed in trees. Some catch invertebrates, such as insects and spiders, to supplement their diet. Domestic pigeons consume a slightly more varied menu, which may include breadcrumbs and even food scraps. They drink water continuously in small sips and then tilt their heads back to swallow the liquid.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Behavior]()**
--- # They are timid birds that prefer to flee from danger rather than attack. During the day they can be seen everywhere, and at night they usually rest. They spend a lot of time together and feed in flocks. They emit various types of sounds for different purposes, such as attracting a mate or signaling alarm.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTNZtbK8rvEcea4ePNiPYqQDssdDRZrtWm6DTDD41T54k/2d5892ef_e7f4_45ff_8b00_ef5c4da78a4b.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTFHJ1sjVFsUMhGwa7qHxaqWGaXCTYJR9od6afdd17fJv/5af6c8d0_7102_4481_a7bd_e00abc14f2f6.jpg)

> They are very intelligent and have a prodigious memory, both visual and olfactory. They can remember the scent of the area where they live and the way back to their nest from very long distances. There is the case of homing pigeons, which were bred to send small packages or papers with messages attached to one of their legs. They were widely used during World War I. These birds also exhibit monogamy, a characteristic that allows them to take good care of their young and maintain a strong emotional bond between parents and offspring.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Reproduction]()**
--- # They are oviparous species. Each has a specific breeding season. Wild pigeons build their nests with twigs and debris high on rocky cliffs, while those living in urban areas nest on roofs, beams, or other tall structures.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWhmzb9ndnFobg6f8xiBnw5vSX2FWgSyCYibNuHXo7ex9/9f6e313a_c358_45ce_9f9a_ce8ddc093d72.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZHjUjfT5oRU8kMG1vdUtgHHiCSDjoDYGABmno618UPNb/13ec2d13_662b_49a2_ba16_b376c6bc076d.jpg)

> Once in the nest, the female typically lays 1 to 3 eggs, and both she and the male take turns incubating them. The incubation period is around 18 days.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Taxonomy]()**
--- # Kingdom: Animalia Phylum: Chordata Class: Aves Order: Columbiformes Family: Columbidae
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Threats]()**
--- # In some cities, pigeons have come to be considered a pest. People are concerned that they can transmit diseases through their droppings, such as psittacosis, histoplasmosis, and cryptococcosis.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[The Symbolism of the Dove]()**
--- # The dove is a universal symbol of peace, purity, love, and hope. Its meaning has transcended history in various cultures and religions. The most important are listed below: 1.- As a symbol of peace and reconciliation: This connotation comes from the Judeo-Christian tradition and is found in the story of Noah's Ark, where the dove returned to the ark carrying an olive branch in its beak, signifying that the flood had ended and that the earth and God were at peace with humanity.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhnrahRnFNNVU4yosyb9ixeuQsWRHWQFGqT8MSiH8qpb/e114ba32_86a2_4275_94c5_b5f2d986f8c4.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd26smoQGBqACaEw4xjS4WLmGUsHt8nmGJpnKa8DsAurK/ecbc9687_9bb4_49fe_b08c_8498ea11afde.jpg)

> 2.- The Holy Spirit: In Christian theology, the white dove represents the Holy Spirit. This symbolism is based on the biblical passage of the baptism of Jesus, where the Holy Spirit descended upon him in the form of a dove, thus representing purity, innocence, divine grace, and the love of God. 3.- As a symbol of love and fidelity: These birds are known for mating for life, which has historically made them symbols of love, fidelity, and devotion. In Greco-Roman mythology, doves were associated with goddesses of love and beauty, such as Aphrodite and Venus. In Chinese culture, two doves together represent a symbol of lasting marriage and loyalty. 4.- As a representation of purity and the soul: Because of their white, immaculate plumage and gentle demeanor, doves are linked to innocence and simplicity. In early Christian funerary art, these birds represented the soul of the deceased and their desire to attain peace and eternal life.
With this information, I conclude my participation. I hope you enjoyed it... thank you all for visiting my blog. Happy day.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8Tm6j6CZ1keLr5f9JMYmDJDbkKvjj81zBSHWLdFAhfa/fba7f7f7_e534_4288_a8cd_599258d8e5fe.jpg)
---
**ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola, muy buenos días a toda la comunidad Amazing Nature. Hoy me integro a este nuevo concurso titulado: [\

](https://peakd.com/hive-174680/@hive-174680/new-contest-may-nuevo-concurso-mayo-the-most-beautiful-animal), y me gustaría invitar a mis amigos @irenenavarroart, @chacald.dcymt, @cirangela, y @germanandradeg. Estoy segura de que nos van a brindar un contenido muy especial.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[🕊️ INTRODUCCIÓN 🕊️]()**
--- # Yo quise participar en este concurso con una especie que aunque no está considerada como un animal doméstico, ni habitualmente forma parte de nuestras mascotas, si convivimos con ellas muy de cerca porque se han consagrado un espacio en nuestro entorno urbano. Y si de belleza se trata, ellas poseen una muy peculiar que nos inspira mucha ternura. Se trata de las palomas, estas aves que vemos a menudo caminando por nuestros tejados, e incluso en el suelo picoteando cuanto bichito o granito encuentran que pueda servir de alimento. Es habitual encontrarnos muchas de ellas en los parques, y por supuesto, en las granjas, exactamente en el área de las aves de corral, ellas se mezclan entre éstas para picotear los granos con los que son alimentadas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVXmVuEz5FYgw6SSMN35g6AA4c4KaccCQ9oYKpVSvyLD/9415e4b2_e796_45a6_9021_09d18ae14cfc.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPY1P67JHxLfSGrVw6khoPyDdLdoNAEGCFsAsD86BPzbH/a86e2731_750b_41d9_9e8a_0ba8ea217c29.jpg)

> En la urbanización donde habito, se han apoderado de las casas deshabitadas, sobre todo las que son de dos pisos, y han hecho de su propiedad, el piso superior, filtrándose por alguna ventana rota. Muchas personas las ahuyentan de sus techos y paredes, porque las consideran una plaga que afecta el ambiente y lo contamina, debido a su excremento que depositan en todos lados. No cuestiono la acción de ahuyentar, están en su derecho, más no apoyo el maltrato que algunos les propinan. Se buscan soluciones menos extremas. De hecho, en mi casa ahora mismo tengo una pareja de inquilinas que alberga bajo mi tejado desde hace un tiempo, justo sobre un fragmento del tubular de soporte. Sus cositas caen justo sobre un extremo de un mueble de madera, y por ahora lo que hago es limpiar a diario tanto el mueble como mi porche hasta que busque cómo rodarlo y darle un giro a la posición de lo demás. Tengan por seguro que si están en mi casa, es porque aquí hallaron paz y seguridad, y si bloqueo ese espacio para que no se posen, encontrarán otro más cómodo en mi morada, con tal de seguir aquí. Las palomas tienen muchas connotaciones en el mundo, no sólo en la naturaleza sino simbólicamente… para mí la más significativa, es verlas como un símbolo de paz. Pero entrando en materia natural, les voy a dar algunas características de esta ave, su estilo de vida, hábitat, y alimentación.
**[🕊️ LA PALOMA 🕊️]()**
--- # Las palomas o colúmbidas, son aves del orden de las columbiformes que tienen un total de 353 especies. Están distribuidas por todo el mundo, excepto en la Antártida y el Ártico, y tienen un centro de dispersión en América Central.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDYHqDuGfVu8HfadTCCWnAP1Zm3fjBnq1GQiSmCdxvtM/7c3811c2_d801_4141_b4fb_8d72818181df.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCEG9ahziF5Ka4AXX3q8t8LiUjkWcnEDbsh8gBvutEdp/76d7c53e_b828_48f1_81ee_ce33a2f5f008.jpg)

> Estas aves se arremolinan en cualquier lugar donde les ofrecen comida, andan caminando por los parques y jardines, también en posadas, o en lo alto de los edificios; las palomas son parte de la fauna de muchas ciudades.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Descripción]()**
--- # Las palomas son aves relativamente pequeñas y de cuerpo compacto. Su cabeza es reducida y sus patas son cortas. Tienen un pico pequeño y ligeramente curvado hacia abajo, con 2 orificios nasales en su superficie, protegidos por una capa membranosa llamada opérculo. Sus alas son grandes, y su cola es corta. El tamaño, peso y color del plumaje varían mucho entre las especies. La paloma silvestre puede pesar de 238 a 380 gramos, pero las domésticas suelen ser un poco más pesadas debido a la abundancia de alimento que consumen en las zonas urbanas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVkCCGzW5yubtTWAAapggcz6wA1BpzC5h4WVJ2KmChap/551b7b4c_d88c_4c92_a76a_ef64bb31322c.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTmLVSfw9gKDHxwPqLypuhqn4ZwnGxMn88fwXJYsQsfaL/b7165065_a291_435e_ae72_014ed08437d3.jpg)

> El color del plumaje varía, algunas son blancas, otras de color marrón claro o grisáceo opaco, y otras son más oscuras, azuladas o con franjas más claras
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Hábitat]()**
--- # Pueden verse palomas en los parques urbanos, alrededor de las granjas, en tierras de cultivo, en altos edificios urbanos y rurales, en los techos de las casas, en paredones, en los balcones, y en puentes de ferrocarriles, entre otros sitios. Las palomas salvajes regularmente habitan en acantilados rocosos.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Alimentación]()**
--- # Se alimentan de semillas, granos y frutos. Según la especie, pueden consumir los granos que encuentran en el suelo o comer en los árboles. Algunas atrapan invertebrados, como insectos y arañas, con los que complementa su dieta, las domésticas consumen un menú un poco más variado, que puede incluir migas de pan y hasta desechos de comida. Beben agua continuamente en pequeños sorbos y después inclinan hacia atrás la cabeza para tragar el líquido
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Comportamiento]()**
--- # Son aves tímidas, que prefieren huir frente al peligro antes que atacar. Durante el día se les observa por todos lados, y por la noche acostumbran descansar. Pasan mucho tiempo juntas y se alimentan en bandadas. Emiten varios tipos de sonidos con distintos fines, como atraer una pareja o mostrar alarma. Son muy inteligentes, y tienen una prodigiosa memoria, tanto visual como olfatoria. Pueden recordar el olor de la zona donde viven y el camino para regresar a su nido desde distancias muy largas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYasohPAsy7jzWbKXkcjtbZhswYXTD1H7PvfULYCvWfvE/af411875_21a3_4634_94ce_e7bc01df6a59.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmatZFTAVkUZJVWxim6dhL5CoHPrWxXcJWRen6VNuNHQrD/b213bbfd_2b00_4e9b_a2a4_b9e3b7d9d020.jpg)

> Existe el caso de las palomas mensajeras que fueron criadas para enviar pequeños paquetes o papeles con mensajes sujetos a una de sus patas. Fueron muy utilizadas en tiempos de la I Guerra Mundial. Estas aves también presentan monogamia, cuya característica les permite cuidar bien sus crías y poseer una relación afectiva importante entre progenitores y descendencia.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Reproducción]()**
--- # Son especies ovíparas. Cada una tiene una temporada de reproducción específica. En el caso de las palomas salvajes, construyen su nido con palitos y desechos en lo alto de un acantilado rocoso, pero las que viven en zonas urbanas, lo hacen en techos, vigas u otras estructuras altas.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7anTyvopwPqUNt5t6d5QKQyGvQQGCHLKZn1GAw9Y9Lh/c7433e75_6b8e_4fd0_ae2e_d0578b7ac1b6.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYiNWsXPLCXktwtiQq6padQBCKZN3F1fmuCaewfayr7yj/cad7d7e5_4f78_4138_805a_264bb02ac27e.jpg)

> Una vez en el nido, la hembra pone regularmente 1 a 3 huevos y tanto ella como el macho se turnan para incubarlos. El período de incubación tiene alrededor de 18 días.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Taxonomía]()**
--- # Reino: Animalia Filo: Chordata Clase: Aves Orden: Columbiformes Familia: Columbidae
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Amenazas]()**
--- # Las palomas en algunas ciudades, se les ha llegado a considerar una plaga. A la gente le preocupa el hecho de que pueden transmitir algunas enfermedades a través de sus excrementos, como la psitacosis, la histoplasmosis y la criptococosis.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Simbología de la paloma]()**
--- # La paloma es un símbolo universal de paz, pureza, amor y esperanza. Su significado ha trascendido históricamente en diversas culturas y religiones. Las más importantes las cito a continuación: 1.- Como símbolo de paz y reconciliación: Esta connotación proviene de la tradición judeocristiana, y reza en la historia del Arca de Noé, que la paloma regresó al arca llevando una rama de olivo en el pico, como significado de que el diluvio había terminado, y la tierra y Dios estaban en paz con la humanidad.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd5HB3MkvWTUiHymLPjTzuRt9ZS4aoZ9JNB3Y4L2jyCKQ/e5c22c29_3491_4cb9_978a_499b9b918774.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTignsZyWWC2nBTybgSKzkUktenE9ptDJ8tZDknWmbVCp/f62e4df2_3937_4cf8_881b_690157c02b47.jpg)

> 2.- El Espíritu Santo: En la teología cristiana reza que la paloma blanca representa al Espíritu Santo. Este simbolismo está basado en el pasaje bíblico del bautismo de Jesús, donde el Espíritu Santo descendió sobre él en forma de paloma, representando así, la pureza, la inocencia, la gracia divina y el amor de Dios. 3.- Como símbolo de amor y fidelidad: Estas aves son conocidas por aparearse de por vida, lo que las ha convertido históricamente en símbolos de amor, fidelidad y devoción. En la mitología grecorromana, se asociaba a las palomas, con las diosas del amor y la belleza, como Afrodita y Venus. En la cultura china, dos palomas juntas representan un símbolo de matrimonio duradero y lealtad. 4.- Como representación de la pureza y el alma: Por su plumaje blanco e inmaculado, y su comportamiento apacible, se vincula a las palomas con la inocencia y la sencillez. En el arte funerario paleocristiano, estas aves representaban el alma del difunto y su deseo de alcanzar la paz y la vida eterna.
Con esta información concluyo mi participación, espero que la hayan disfrutado... gracias a todos por visitar mi blog. Feliz día.

body.title: Aquí bonita con algo de calor
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmV5GBt1nTJssAWWNUMbFMUfUkVHKR1KJqh3UJxhSxUKvP/IMG_0205.jpg 

Mi gente bella, hoy ando por aquí sintiéndome bonita, aunque no les voy a mentir… con un calorcito que está fuerte, fuerte. De esos días donde una quiere estar arreglada y coqueta, pero al mismo tiempo está buscando sombrita y airecito por todos lados. Igualito, no dejo que eso me quite la sonrisa, porque cuando una se siente bien por dentro, eso se nota por fuera.

Me arreglé sencillo, algo fresco, nada complicado, porque con este clima lo que provoca es estar cómoda sin perder ese toquecito bonito. Me miré al espejo y dije: “bueno Gisela, estás linda así, naturalita y sin tanto esfuerzo”, y eso también se vale. A veces pensamos que para vernos bien hay que hacer mucho, pero no, mi amor… la actitud lo es todo.

El calor puede ser intenso, sí, pero también tiene su encanto. Provoca moverse más despacio, tomarse algo frío, buscar momenticos de descanso y disfrutar lo simple. Hoy decidí llevar el día con calma, sin apuros, dejando que todo fluya suavecito y sin estrés innecesario.

Te deseo un día bonito, que aunque haga calor encuentres la forma de sentirte cómodo, de sonreír y de mantener esa vibra linda. No dejes que nada te quite las ganas de sentirte bien contigo mismo.

Por aquí sigo yo, bonita, con calorcito pero feliz, disfrutando mi momento con toda la actitud venezolana. 💛✨

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@gysela/aqu-bonita-con-algo-de-calor-khp)

body.body: It's funny, but of all the everyday fears, I never had stage fright when speaking in public because I did it with the mindset that no one was going to eat me alive or beat me up if I said something wrong. Sometimes I gave interesting presentations, sometimes boring ones, but I never stressed about it much. However, what did stress me out were the multiple-choice exams at university because in secondary and primary school, we were assessed with four or five questions and that was it. When university started giving me multiple-choice exams of 20 questions or more, it caused me quite a bit of panic, and I almost never finished them (luckily, it wasn't a common practice among professors, who usually gave us essays rather than exams). I always preferred essay exams because multiple-choice exams used very similar terms, and it was almost random to find the correct answer (in fact, most students avoided that type of exam, just like me).

body.title: Financial privacy is needed
body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYG9TbEW8skQRe5enzAqRY2WqUiNtY718NYaWakSiRL76/1779310600544.jpg)

One thing about the public knowing about our earnings is that it's against the right to personal privacy as people would come to know what one is earning which might not be good enough. Publicizing one's earnings to me is a violation of the privacy of the person earning the salary which may equally put the person in question in danger.

Having said so much about the effect of salary publication, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is about, “Making our salaries known to the public.”

To me, this particular idea of making people's earning known to the public is not the best of idea for me as everyone knows how they are packaging themselves, some with the meagre they are collecting knows how the carry themselves in the society so that people would not be looking down on them and as for others, they know how they pretend not to be earning as much as they are earning so that they would not be a centre of attraction to the public who if they not may be billing them anyhow.

So, making the public know what people or others are earning is a way to jeopardize the financial secrets of people in the society which should be made known to them and them alone.

The issue of finances, especially when it comes to salary is not something that should be publicized and this is for the known reasons which could undermine the security of the salary earners in the public space.

For instance, if someone is collecting a huge amount of money as salary, the life of the person might be under threat if the said amount he's collecting is made known to the public as he or she might be under attack from any angle. So, for this to be prevented as prevention is better than cure, salary earned must be made personal and confidential to the person working and earning it.

Aside from this. If someone who is collecting less amount as salary is being advertised to the society with what he or she is earning as salary, such a person might be feeling inferior in the society whereby he or she loses his or her identity in the society.

Also, there might be this kind of rivalry among those working in the same organisation or company as one thing is sure and certain, people don't earn the same amount in the same company. Now if the pay is now leaked to the public, there would definitely be envy among the workers which if not properly managed can affect the company and their output.

Although, the purpose at which the publication of people's salary is recommended is good so as to curb the excesses of people who would spend more than what they earn in the society, but even at that we should not forget those who work hard and legally to earn their hard earned salary.

This is my entry to week 218, episode 02 of the weekly featured contest in the Hive Learners community.

Thanks for reading.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSDS2BNN52NdCF8gGPktsoib99CuHAtNt8tFrssNaZ21w/1000008430.png 

Setelah kemarin jatuh bangun, hari ini Rabu (20/05/2026), IHSG masih belum bisa lepas dari tekanan. Indeks kita ditutup di level 6,318.500, turun sekitar 52.17 poin atau minus 0.82 persen. Memang penurunannya nggak sedalam kemarin, tapi ya namanya merah tetep aja bikin was-was.

body.title: Moving Vlog part one
body.body:
I promised to keep everyone posted on my moving journey from my old apartment to a new one.


![IMG_20260519_165731_525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23zbMEZM5H4K3Lpia3ZHtw6YWVZuY19sx7URF39K4W7uK87awnJ37f2HoeAaG8jXXC38o.jpg)


Hi everyone, it's your girl again, this vlog will be posted in sequence as I move out of my old apartment to a new one, I will post my step by step procedures which I carried out during my moving out.

In this part of my country, individuals own everything needed to use and live a comfortable life, ranging from gas cookers which comes in cylinders. The gas cylinder is used to fill gas into it, which on many occasions one can use to cook with a direct head burner or a pipe is connected to an external burner placed far away from the cylinder.

One can also own a stove or decide to use firewoods to cook outside the house. Also people do not just move in to new apartments with just luggages, rather they move in with their mattresses, cooking gas, luggages, refrigerators, ceiling fan, kitchen utensils, and other personal belongings. 

I hear there are houses people move into and all they just go with is their luggages, because everything has been provided for them already. If that's true then, wow.

I did laundry yesterday, I washed lots of clothes, my bedspreads and curtains, I also washed my kitchen utensils, plastic table and chair because I want everything to be sparkling clean as I move into a new apartment.

I got so busy that I forgot to eat and just when I was done, my stomach began rumbling for food. I ate my remaining okro soup, but it wasn't filling, I just got tired of the food and decided not to eat anymore.


![IMG_20260519_192711_842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23w2cu6ZfCUpG3kr9vF5TXAuoCDMy27tMeKz9DoYmaKvFJSMDeLwMTq6s5W58ut9M3MJw.jpg)


Later in the evening, I felt very hungry and I went to a nearby kiosk where I bought garri, (cassava flakes) sugar, milk and groundnuts.


![IMG_20260519_193238_324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/EoptQqs8eiVcEVQS912Mpy4gAHJWoyDbjcugcLGmYqyQKZEbAXbyqyuwCuUNPMTpFJQ.jpg)


I mixed everything with enough water and the result was amazing, funny enough, the garri began to rise more than normal, until it filled the plate, it became too much, but I sipped everything though.

Right now my current apartment is very scattered as I am trying to pack everything together in order for my belongings to be portable for moving.

Source: Photos were taken with my Infinix smart5 phone camera
Writing is my own writing

body.title: Improvement of the automated curation bot
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23tRrW9ouo9ruPSidhpjJiscpbJS2vJasLP2EfLgQuZiq4JcuUAupm6aTZh2TpXJfyAZZ.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/EpvoES1HnkWZTTut5QS5sXEgfN5dgqgyvvyQ1AGZfgW4GKgXYjGBhCqAh3h7rG7LhkG.png)








Right now I’m working on improving my automated curation bot. It still follows the same rules as before, but I’ve redesigned the interface so it’s much cleaner and easier to read than what I had until now.

It tracks my VP in real time and updates every 5 seconds (after testing it, it does seem to follow things properly in real time). I’ll need to improve it later so it’s accurate down to the decimal, but honestly it’s already working pretty well at this stage.

The bot automatically votes on posts that match the rules, and I can modify those rules directly from the top of the screen. I can also add new ones whenever I want, which makes it pretty flexible and easier to adjust over time.

At the bottom, there’s a results section that’s supposed to show how much curation reward I’ve earned over the last 24 hours. I’ll know whether it’s actually working within the next 24 to 48 hours, since I just added that feature and don’t have any data yet.

Today I barely used the bot for curation. I spent about 12 hours cleaning windows at work, and when I got home I focused on improving the bot’s UI. Before that, it had buttons everywhere, sometimes overlapping and hiding parts of the page. I could still navigate it, but over time it became messy and a bit confusing. I also took the opportunity to clean up the code properly instead of stacking tons of patches on top of each other.

This weekend, I’m planning to look into whether it’s possible to add an AI detection score for posts. It should be doable — I came across a GitHub repository that talks about it, but I haven’t had time to dig into it yet. It could be a pretty useful feature if I manage to integrate it properly.

body.title: Salary Transparency: A Blessing or a Disaster?
body.body: > Growing up, I always dreamed of when I will be an adult and finally start working do I could have my own money to spend. I mean, we all dreamt of what we would our first paychecks for but honestly, nothing prepared us for the reality of those paychecks. There are days when you really don’t know where all of that money went. Sadly, that’s what adulthood looks like for most people until they’re able to get their feet and find a way around their earnings. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRDnR8LFRPzsUM76z1tvBGLPVkgtGJaBP8HoWHN7kQpY/4996d499_fa65_4274_a8a6_cea62e1a4a66.jpeg) Speaking of earnings, most of us in the working class are making money from the work we do. At the end of every month, we expect to receive our pay which is a testament to our hard work all month. For some , it’s not much but manageable while others receive more than enough. For as long as I’ve known, your pay depends on your qualifications and your position at the work place. You don’t expect an intern to receive the same pay as the managing director, things don’t work that way. When it comes to how much people earn at work, what I know is that most people don’t know how much others they work with earn but what they know is probably an estimate of how much everyone earns. This I would like to believe is the same in most institutions. There’s no sheet with everyone’s payslip pasted on it for the whole company to find out. But when it comes to the medical field, how much workers earn is more of common knowledge. Everyone knows how much house officers, doctors or even physician assistants earn. What makes the difference is how much allowance they each earn and even with that, there’s a high chance of knowing it and adding it up to get their exact salary. And honestly, I don’t really think it is or has ever been a big deal for the people in the medical field. I don’t know about other fields but this is what I’m conversant with and that’s why I’m talking about it. I honestly wouldn’t mind others knowing how much I earn unless I stand a risk or for safety reasons. I don’t think i have ever heard someone talk publicizing everyone’s salary for the general public but to some extent, I think it’s both crazy and a great idea. Crazy because most people would see that as an invasion of privacy and a good idea because then, we will get to know the people who are stealing for us, examples are our politicians and what have your. Either way, I’d like to believe that 80 percent of the population would be against this for their own reason while the remaining 20 percent wouldn’t mind at all. What I think would work would be publicizing the salaries of government workers and it could be all government workers or only those in higher positions and the allowances they receive so that the public will we able to track where their taxes are going. As for private companies, I don’t think they would even agree to the thought of this because most private institutions are there for the profit and most at times we see how their employees end up being underpaid. This topic I would say is a very tricky one and most people would have different views on the topic which is totally fine. We agree to disagree. - - - image belongs to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: To wash undies
body.body:
Yesterday I did the craziest in the line of my work...

On Saturday of last week, one of my customers who hadn't shown up for a long while, came with two of her girlie bags loaded with clothes to the brim.

_\

_ She said as she dropped and hopped on the bike waiting for her and zoomed off. For me, I was happy seeing her come by after a long while and also with bags filled with clothes, which means a lot of money for me. That Saturday was so occupied for me, so I shifted the bags to a corner. It was yesterday that I was finally free to work on the clothes, I opened the bags, brought out the clothes and behold, they had her undies there. I paused, my mind traveled far thinking she made a mistake by adding those for me to wash because it's very uncommon for ladies to take their deep undies to laundry persons to wash especially when the laundry person is a guy.

/>

  
When I say her deep undies, I meant her panties and some of her inner tops that serve as her bra.

OmG! It was hard and unbelievable to me that I got to wash someone's undies but what can I say or do? I needed the money and there was no way I would return the clothes that I won't wash them.

So I washed. It was laughable but I washed and I'm waiting for her to come and get them and pay me my money. Of course, I'm going to charge her heavily for bringing such for me to wash.  
I won't lie, washing them was simple, because I used a washing machine but even at that, I still used my hand to pick them 😂

Photo: Chatgpt

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#137
body.body: > ![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48b2WGieYiYE5hDgP14Niiv42dkFLNzgNpTHoQa4BXQG9USj3rjs1W4Lj7Tk9H88s9.jpg) Po czterech dniach biegania na terenie bazy nadszedł czas na zmianę scenerii. Mons w środku tygodnia to okolice kampusu, zielone parki, belgijskie bulwary obsadzone platanami i całkiem urokliwy staw z makami na nowym osiedlu za stadionem. A wszystko to znowu z jednym konkretnym zadaniem: tętno poniżej 142 bpm. To był kolejny z pozoru łatwy bieg, który w rzeczywistości wymagał ciągłego kontrolowania pulsu i korygowania tempa. > ***[ENG] After four days of running around the base, it was time for a change of scenery. Mid-week Mons offered the campus area, green parks, Belgian boulevards lined with plane trees, and a rather charming pond with poppies in a new housing estate behind the stadium. And all of this came once again with one specific task: keeping my heart rate below 142 bpm. It was another seemingly easy run that actually required constant heart rate monitoring and pace adjustments.*** ![IMG_4672.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xySzXyaPBMQfTEC4NE1EY8KZ91FjrQ5pTbp8pYQQWpXaL7eEfNH1RqGqS6aUnUicqu2.jpg) ![IMG_4675.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xp2ZUk53NyhXaYSg8LdxUHhtCjwTmPwN9friWnHAbddCESY7cfBEiNHf5srvFQiLugi.jpg) ![IMG_4676.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wgHd6R9Dm4nJ2nnRGkd42ZJ3JnG9y9xiCYTGqCLYYdQkEx12D9f5UDEzcjpcawL8LJP.jpg) Trasa miejska rządzi się innymi prawami niż bieg po spokojnym terenie bazy. Mamy tu sygnalizację świetlną, chodniki, pieszych, rowery i skrzyżowania, ale z punktu widzenia ciekawskiego biegacza taka trasa jest o wiele bardziej wciągająca. Mons około godziny 16:00 ma swój specyficzny rytm, regulowany przez korki blokujące drogi dojazdowe do centrum. Z tego powodu dystans między moim mieszkaniem a centrum można pokonać zdecydowanie szybciej biegiem niż samochodem. > ***[ENG] An urban route follows different rules than running on the quiet grounds of the base. There are traffic lights, sidewalks, other pedestrians, bicycles, and intersections, but from a curious runner's perspective, such a route is much more engaging. Around 4 PM, Mons has its own rhythm, dictated by traffic jams blocking the roads leading to the city center. Because of this, it’s much faster to cover the distance between my apartment and the center on foot than by car.*** ![IMG_4677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xKvR54QdqrHBWLFnd4MV8LKLBetp9JkZnPqdLZq2nwhqXdNUVvJ8anxfCjf1Ehn8sUQ.jpg) ![IMG_4679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zbMXrSxyRjoEnz15JxAYSqCSqnUDWiv6tVqotvNBdg1xhhx795iHNsHaQsueoMAdSUK.jpg) ![IMG_4681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zRvdrQY1XYnCw6Aq2tNK2mWc5PNionnNDRQGzqkDECs93p4JrYvxPhXQ7WsoaaTcTty.jpg) Trzymanie założonego tętna zakończyło się wynikiem 88%. Do piątego kilometra miałem wszystko pod kontrolą, ale później coraz trudniej było utrzymać puls poniżej 142 bpm. Na ostatnich dwóch kilometrach limit pękł – niedramatycznie, ale jednak. Zwolniłem nawet do 7:35 min/km, a tętno i tak nie chciało zejść niżej. To klasyczny objaw skumulowanego zmęczenia. > ***[ENG] Sticking to the target heart rate ended with an 88% success rate. Up until the fifth kilometer, I had everything under control, but after that, it became increasingly difficult to keep my pulse below 142 bpm. On the last two kilometers, the 142 limit broke—not drastically, but it broke. I slowed my pace down to 7:35 min/km, yet my heart rate still refused to drop. This is a classic symptom of cumulative fatigue.*** ![IMG_4682.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vsLcvSsLbLvhPWFACUxWdkyRQu6Bi5w2zXRgjjKmzE6is5FLXpg7nDtgWZHcFdJVAEE.jpg) ![IMG_4687.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2432BavLSJvEJD492C28Ub7iPYN6zxuowijaW6A4rkedUFaaEUAdUcwbeNTE2UQxJj9Hr.jpg) Teraz do końca tygodnia nie będę miał już okazji biegać. Nadchodzący city break w nowym miejscu będzie zapewne wymagał długich spacerów, które posłużą za aktywną regenerację. > ***[ENG] Now, I won't have a chance to run for the rest of the week. A city break in a new location will likely involve long walks, which will serve as active recovery.*** ![IMG_4690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xehwq4uVUJurTUkWJi6nycEWch8s9NsoQJV6CrXsvUCnGmvkghQ2v6fFybXbdt27XTx.jpg) ---

body.title: First Solar And Now Boreholes Under Attack
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://groundup.org.za/media/uploads/images/Graphics/outlier_series/22_january_2026_v2.png)

A report published back in 2023 recommended that R400 billion was required to fix the ageing water infrastructure. The budget given to the water department was R26 billion for 2025/26 and where the real problem lies. Africa in a nutshell does not maintain anything and only when it is broken is it now a full blown crisis. Maybe if it is bad enough some other country from the West will help pay for it.





Over the last 15 - 20 years services has been the main problem for the citizens of South Africa. The never knowing whether you will have electricity tonight or tomorrow has lead many to invest in alternative energy sources like solar. This was at first promoted by the government with tax incentives which were abruptly turned on their head rather looking to exploit those that did by underhanded financial penalties.  

Over the course of last week boreholes are now in the spotlight due to the number of households having these installed. Over the last 12 months I can recall 3 properties in our small enclosed secure community having had boreholes installed. I only know this as the mess the drilling companies leave behind and actually need to ask one of these households how much the process costs and how deep the drilling was. We are in a valley so at least we are not on a hill and the ground water should be plentiful.

The problem is not the climate or drought, but the human made factors such as ageing infrastructure that is not maintained with extensive leaks, poor or no municipal management and planning with no accountability. These human factors is what undermines confidence in the system forcing households to fend for themselves. We know there will be a water crisis here in South Africa due to no investment in maintenance and the entire water system is hanging by a thread.

When you here reports that the water board is having to pump double the volumes to maintain the current supply due to losing 60% in the process due to leaky pipes. The dams are full yet we have water warnings blaring across the radio daily pleading for consumers to use the water sparingly. This is not normal and there is a hidden message that you no one is telling us and that water is the next big problem households are about to face through a lack of supply.

This week it was announced by the Department of Water and Sanitation that those with boreholes have to register with the department. As it stands currently businesses with boreholes are registered but households are not. All borehole owners would need to capture their details and borehole information on the National Groundwater Archive. 

Anyone planning to drill a borehole would now need to complete a geosite identifier before any drilling can begin. Drilling data needs to be submitted within 60 days of completion.  Thereafter once pumps have been installed yield test need to be submitted which will then result in sustainable extraction rates being given. Apparently ground water reserves are under pressure which has to be a joke because the households who have boreholes is very rare.

The Department of Water and Sanitation have stated that they need to protect the groundwater so this is not depleted. Why would they be so worried with their leaky pipes making sure these underwater reserves remain full? I would be more concerned about industries such as mining or manufacturing with how much water thy are extracting.

We know of schools that had to have bore holes installed or otherwise the school would of had no water. The municipalities failings nationwide is what is forcing households looking for alternative supply. We have looked into this and will be a future project once the solar is complete The problem is how much red tape will there be to get a borehole installed as these new additional hoop s to jump through are more about putting people off and delaying them from doing do. The ones that can afford the boreholes are the clients the Department of water wants to keep much like the electricity clients who have left the grid are the households that pay their utility bills.

body.title: The Strange Addiction of Hate Watching
body.body:
A few days ago, a friend brought up to me a curious yet increasingly common activity. A sign of the times, I suppose.

*Hate watching.*

The idea that people actively subscribe to content creators they absolutely despise, just so they can attack, insult, and bash everything they do.


![f2b17c04-06c5-4357-93c4-2b39b71914c8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23u5XSWwQrKhcyYkkBbEX3izRe5f117LRNX7V58PBZUU6QPsk9fbhNUA7E3HBPnk67mRr.png)


**Hate watching?**

I thought to myself: who is so bored that they end up adopting this sort of lifestyle, if we can even call it that?

To be clear, I'm not saying I've never watched videos from people I disagree with, especially when they’re discussing subjects I’m passionate about. That's <u>normal</u>. I'm trying to make a distinction between occasionally exposing yourself to opposing ideas, and intentionally seeking out content you already know you’ll hate, purely to fuel the <u>bile brewing in your gut</u>.

Maybe I simply value my liver a little more, but I can’t think of a worse way to spend a day.

It’s almost as if these hate watchers wake up in the morning, add two squirts of ammonia into their coffee, and begin pondering what new levels of resentment they can achieve before bedtime.

A sort of <u>self-pleasuring</u> ritual.

Auto-erotic outrage stimulation, to be *crystal clear*.

Recently, Kyla Turner appeared on the Whatever podcast. Yes, that podcast — the one that regularly invites women on only to shame them for having OnlyFans accounts or for existing outside a very specific ideological mold.


![kyla.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/meno/23vsX3NYcqdCeQyKZUgniMvqja2xzzC7LcRJNRJZUKZ7Arb1p7pxkuC22icxrs4tRYisa.png)


Kyla was there to discuss her political views, her liberal Christian perspective, and throughout the entire thing there was a “fan” sending hundreds of dollars in superchats to insult her.

**Hundreds!!**

At one point, he sent $200 just to call her an Adderall sniffer.

*How lovely*.

And that’s the point I’m trying to make.

What we’re witnessing feels like a kind of mental rot. Not just worrying because of the social invoice we’ll eventually have to pay for it, but also comically stupid.

EQ — emotional intelligence — seems about as present in these individuals as ticks on a stuffed animal.

But maybe the sentiment itself isn’t entirely new. It’s simply wearing modern clothing.

People have always poisoned themselves emotionally trying to hurt those they resent. Literature is full of it. The idea of drinking poison and expecting someone else to suffer isn't exactly a modern invention.

Social media simply industrialized it.

Now resentment comes with subscriptions, notifications, algorithms, and **donation buttons**. HAHAHAHA!

Still, I can’t help but wonder:

Is hate watching, in some strange way, a *sign of relevance*?

Meaning... if one day I manage to gather my own small army of hate readers, does that mean my writing has finally become important enough to emotionally **infest** people?

Maybe.

But even then, it wouldn’t change the fact that this is still a profoundly sad state of affairs.

So I summon thee, hate readers.

Speak now, I say.

Amusing.

MenO

body.title: More Windows - May 18 & 19, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Melted cat in front of fan crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23vsJHcdZENMGVttmCNLbo6NW4rHyA5LqW7Hjv3vd2tbfePAoGB2KACLyDubhGHRWv5Tf.jpg)

*Hot cat in front of running fan*

On Monday I was up at 5:30AM and got ready to leave for an appointment at 8AM. I had gotten the laundry started before I left. When I got back, I was awful tired and it was wicked hot. 

I’d forgotten to open the cold frame before I left so I did that immediately. I got something to eat, changed over the laundry and was in bed dozing for a few hours.

It was just too hot to do much. That was the whole day.

![New West - columbine flowers crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/244KRQmnGXpWEo75RqgXj13euvj9qsUMSS4XyFJmFQqMMNHFrixvbk6tYSDcT9oCiYqkX.jpg)

*New West garden – columbine flowers*

On Tuesday morning I was up at 4:45AM as I intended to go to the gardens while it was cool. I got a load in the dishwasher and was working on my bills while I waited for my brother to get up. I’d forgotten I had to take the truck into be inspected. I finally had to wake him up. 

![Garden shed emptied for tarp totes crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpGRjJSnnwc98a2gMEp7DBmgj1Ffj24xxtb6tAGjMJ9QrooY6SGfW6G3VAKMt8h7Epg.jpg)

I also had to unload the truck of all the garden wood and clean out the garden shed so I could get the tarps totes out. My helper friend was coming at 10:30AM and the very first thing before it got hotter was to take down the tarps and put them away.

![Garden wood stacked crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23z7BuZgHrdBj6Sbw2qaG24dDuwycmFnBeuHN3nJRVpbd3mjskRfRtaw6JqwTZiZTs73x.jpg)

*Garden wood stacked*

My brother drove the truck and we stopped to put gas in it after running it for 1½ hours on Sunday. I went ahead and secured a parking place for the truck and my brother brought me home.

![House plant flowers collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eq9VhbP1wCCaifUHYvMt18KxTSsnd8h8U6SVgPq94sf8DHWMsFb6yZ7iBWLjKgWEtBG.jpg)

So no garden, so I was working on the checkbook when I heard someone call hello from the kitchen. It was my good window guy! I had mixed up the dates in my head, thinking he was coming Wednesday and Thursday, not Tuesday and Wednesday.

Well, it turns out there’d been ANOTHER scheduling mistake and he was only here for Tuesday this week, Tuesday next week and who knows after that. Sigh…

So, of course, I was all prepped for him…NOT! So I got up and started running around to get ready while trying to figure out how I was going to keep the balls all in the air: getting the truck back, working with my helper friend as planned, and washing windows for 4 hours, all at the same time. Sigh… it’s never boring here….

![Around the yard collage6 text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/48iGPq89arNCpNv4QeyswcEJMp51vCjr5XUK88euon3jFUzSzsPiC8w3732eHX31VW.jpg)

I’d left most of the window cleaning stuff on the second floor because I wanted to finish up there first. So we got those 2 small windows done, and picked up the mess and moved to my bedroom.

My helper friend arrived at 10:30AM and we went right out to do tarps. I had set my window guy up to wash down exterior doors with windows while I was outside. 

My helper friend and I got the tarps off, measured them as they had been outside so long the numbers had worn off, folded them and got them all in the totes. Then we got everything back in the garden shed.

![Hall curtains blowing crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23x16sC9qRjJWwPWTHZb6WZcXc9uxJBevpxT7LiLZ15bR4X8caBd1wTzb6DW33xgTj2DE.jpg)

*Hall curtains, 2nd floor*

My window guy and I got those 2 big windows done in the bedroom when I was back inside and then started on the 4 small ones in the living room. I wasted time hunting for the tool to put the retaining balls for the grills in those windows, to no avail. I have no idea what I did with it. Last time I used it was when my brother and I did the outside windows, weeks back.

My window guy and I managed to get 3 of the 4 windows done before he had to go. I had arranged with a neighbor to take me down for the truck as soon as he left, so I headed out to do that.

![Temp on liar 100F crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpxrffH4gCoWBWWyWU6qsLBfRuAg7mP2K9qk1PdNRoHpRjEVavExzu1H6Z8i8dP9jvT.jpg)

According to the front porch liar, it was lovely out…NOT! (And humidity was really at 50%) And the truck doesn’t have AC. But the bigger thing was, had it passed inspection yet again?? The tires were badly dry rotted, it has no floor boards, the exhaust is a mess, and it’s had no backup lights for 5 years. And sometimes it even starts.

![Truck passed crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpA2vLsAb8FCdQ4hwvapDnJTmMWYvDj4NCrU1WUVqD2xmh1hvzbJRke6D1uQ2nr9qeK.jpg)

But as we passed it parked on the street, it had a passed sticker, again!! The ride home through traffic and lots of stoplights wasn’t fun. I started to drift just before the last light. I looked up, 30’ away, and it was red! Brakes work…

I made it home and didn’t kill anyone. My helper friend had been doing chores all day and had finished. So he decided to leave early as he has AC at his house, and it was miserable here…

It was too late to go to bed and too hot so I just sat in front of the fan being a vegetable on TikTok and Solitaire.

At 7:45PM I got the house opened up, got a shower and was in bed by 8:15PM.

On Wednesday I don’t know if my window guy is coming. I didn’t hear, so I assume not. I plan to get up around 5AM, start my post until it’s light enough, and then go out and try to get some peas planted!  It’s to be another miserable hot and humid day so I don’t know how far I will get.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: Fears
body.body:
>We all fear something. Some people fear loneliness, heartbreak, violence, illness, death, economic hardship, or the lack of opportunities. However, if there is one thing all these fears have in common, it is that they stem from something real. No one can permanently avoid death, illness, or conflict; these three factors are part of nature and have existed in every society and every era.
For thousands of years, fear was a survival mechanism. Fear of fire prevented accidents, fear of predators kept our ancestors alive, and fear of rejection helped preserve social bonds within communities. The modern problem is not feeling fear, but becoming trapped in it or ignoring it completely, especially because today there are two extreme tendencies that make it harder for us to confront it.
The first is information oversaturation. Many people believe that remaining permanently connected to global or local conflicts will help them overcome the fear these events create. In reality, this only generates more anxiety, helplessness, and stress. The result is often paralysis when it comes to making decisions to solve a problem or, at the very least, reduce the impact it has on daily life.
Furthermore, in the digital age, fear has become a commodity. Alarmist news, extremist political discourse, and content designed to provoke outrage succeed because they capture our attention. A brain constantly exposed to threats eventually reacts as if it were permanently in danger, even when no immediate danger actually exists.

>The second tendency is denialism. If the first produces paralysis through excess, this one chooses to deny the existence of the problem, acting as though it were not there and hoping it will not affect us or will simply disappear on its own. This sometimes works when the conflict is caused by an external factor (such as a pandemic or a natural disaster), but it fails completely when applied to human relationships: friendships, workplaces, family relationships, or romantic partnerships.
That is why, if the source of our fears is real, the solution is not to hide from them, but to build mechanisms of resilience that help us manage them. Fear can destroy, but it can also compel us to act.
Fear of economic hardship, for example, can become the motivation to diversify our sources of income. Fear of illness can be addressed through medical consultations that allow us to assess our health. Fear of isolation can encourage us to care for our human relationships. Fear of failure can motivate preparation and learning. Even fear of death can lead us to value our time and the people we love more deeply.
Many times, the worst effects of fear do not come from the original danger itself, but from our inability to respond in a balanced way.
On the other hand, there is also a collective dimension to fear. Societies with high levels of distrust, violence, or instability often develop entire cultures based on fear. In those contexts, resilience depends not only on the individual, but also on families, friendships, communities, and support systems capable of reducing the sense of abandonment and uncertainty.
Perhaps the goal is not to live without fear, because that would be impossible, but to learn how to coexist with it without allowing it to control our lives. Ignoring it makes us vulnerable, but obsessing over it paralyzes us. Between these two extremes, we must seek a balance that recognizes the real dangers of the world without giving up our ability to act, build, and move forward.

>

**Note 1.** This post was translated from Spanish to English using Gemini AI.

**Note 2.** The images were generated using Gemini AI.

body.title: El futuro es hoy| A disfrutar al máximo cada día|The future is now | Enjoy every day to the fullest
body.body:
>

¡Hola queridos usuarios! Hace más de dos décadas que los adultos mayores han tomado espacios para recrearse, hacer vida en lugares para su esparcimiento, para nadie es un secreto que con la despedida de nuestros hijos a otros países hemos tenido que hacer comunidad para tratar de apaciguar algunas emociones y llenar de alguna manera esos vacíos que en momentos nos desequilibran.



>Hello dear users! For more than two decades, older adults have been taking up spaces to recreate and enjoy themselves in places for leisure. It's no secret that with our children leaving for other countries, we've had to build community to try to soothe some emotions and somehow fill those voids that sometimes throw us off balance.



<center>![IMG_20260327_083007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4WbcRXUxLdKNXh6vsskwfj3xHgd4s22kG27Z33xG9qS/IMG_20260327_083007.jpg)</center>

Podemos conseguir grupos de yoga, reiki, grupos que hacen ejercicios al aire libre y otros que desde algún gimnasio cubierto realizan muchos ejercicios podemos ver a grupos haciendo bailoterapia, aeróbico, tonificación, salud intima, charlas y terapias de sanación. En esta oportunidad nos visitó una consteladora, ella hablaba de los ángeles, arcángeles y otros temas bien interesantes. Algunas de las compañeras se emocionaron mucho al punto de llorar recordando la partida de sus seres queridos a otro plano ya de una manera más profunda, ya sus seres queridos no están en este plano terrenal.




>We can find yoga groups, reiki groups, groups that exercise outdoors, and others that do a lot of exercise in an indoor gym. We can see groups doing dance therapy, aerobics, toning, intimate health, talks, and healing therapies. On this occasion, a family constellations facilitator visited us. She spoke about angels, archangels, and other very interesting topics. Some of the women were very moved, even to tears, remembering the passing of their loved ones to another plane in a deeper way, since their loved ones are no longer on this earthly plane.




<center>![IMG_20260327_082638.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTbVjstY77N7GRAQ4BPp7Am86Qzd8MsF5pTY6fry1q1vm/IMG_20260327_082638.jpg)</center>

Debo confesar que no me gusta saber nada del futuro, pienso que con un padre nuestro todo estará bien, tratar de hacer las cosas bien, no escudriñar tanto con adivinos, lectura de cartas, aunque respeto todas las creencias, prefiero no estar adivinando el futuro siento que es algo que genera ansiedad, querer saber más de lo normal es algo que nunca me ha gustado.



>I must confess that I don't like knowing anything about the future. I think that with a simple prayer everything will be alright, trying to do things right, not delving so much into fortune-tellers or tarot card readings. Although I respect all beliefs, I prefer not to be trying to predict the future; I feel it generates anxiety. Wanting to know more than usual is something I've never liked.





<center>![IMG_20260327_082643.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmahtUtRJfcCxxpGFSkhCgNGjM8HJMJfMk8bYGnWhAQRFJ/IMG_20260327_082643.jpg)</center>


Esta semana nuestra amiga y moderadora de la comunidad #empowertalet nos invita a plasmar nuestros pensamientos sobre ese futuro incierto que ya a mis 60 años puedo decir que podemos construir nuestro futuro con educación, valores, con esa mística, ese cuidado para no cambiar una vida de satisfacción, una vida llena de felicidad por una vida vacía. No debemos azararnos por un futuro incierto, que la angustia no nos lleve a enfermarnos, no andar nerviosos, esperar en Dios. Cuando sabemos que lo estamos haciendo bien las cosas no debemos desesperar, todo estará bien.




>This week, our friend and moderator of the #empowertalet community invites us to share our thoughts on that uncertain future. At 60 years old, I can say that we can build our future with education, values, and a sense of purpose—a commitment to not trading a fulfilling, happy life for an empty one. We shouldn't be overwhelmed by an uncertain future; we shouldn't let anxiety make us sick, we shouldn't be nervous, but rather trust in God. When we know we're doing things right, we shouldn't despair; everything will be alright.



<center>![IMG_20260327_082721.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU6Zc7qGixEo2HLLKo86i66VSGx9hPg6y9ha1W8AX4nkT/IMG_20260327_082721.jpg)</center>

En estos momentos estoy compartiendo en varios grupos, me gustaría seguir por este caminar, estoy en un grupo de viajes, excursiones, en otro grupo donde nos reunimos mensualmente y salimos, en un grupo donde nos ejercitamos haciendo spinning sin pensar mucho en el futuro, simplemente disfrutando al máximo el día a día, pidiendo a Dios que nos de vida y salud, lo demás es cuento de camino.


>Right now I'm involved in several groups, and I'd like to continue down this path. I'm in a group that travels and excursions, another group where we meet monthly and go out, and a group where we exercise by doing spinning without thinking too much about the future, simply enjoying each day to the fullest, asking God to give us life and health; the rest is just part of the journey.

<center>![IMG-20260511-WA0205.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeVqhFzMidxYPH9T5cWdW6jho8GSicayYdV4jtYHCm7vL/IMG-20260511-WA0205.jpg)</center>

Quiero compartir situaciones que pasan en los grupos de los adultos mayores, vamos compartir menú que recordaran a futuro. En los grupos de adultos mayores no puede faltar un antipasto, crema de berenjenas, para tomar; café, mucho café, té de Jamaica, frutas, galletas de soda, yogurt, frutos secos y mermelada de cualquier fruta. Ya le adelanté algo del futuro.



>I want to share some things that happen in senior citizen groups. We're going to share a menu that they'll remember in the future. In senior citizen groups, you can't go wrong with an antipasto, eggplant dip, and to drink: coffee—lots of coffee—hibiscus tea, fruit, soda crackers, yogurt, nuts, and jam of any fruit. I've already given you a little preview of what's to come.




<center>![IMG_20260327_082743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeNB8VQwqSsnZk126MtKp4CiremidFj3JXc6e9Ffka7qm/IMG_20260327_082743.jpg)</center>

body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wie der ein oder andere bereits gehört hat, kam ein Ebola Patient nach Deutschland. Um genau zu sein ein Arzt der für eine Missionsgesellschaft aus den USA in Afrika tätig ist und US Amerikaner ist. Er und ein anderer Betroffener Patient wurden nach Europa gebracht, der andere Patient wurde nach Prag gebracht. Man hat sich dazu entschlossen die Patienten in Europa zu behandeln, da wir hier entsprechende Kapazitäten haben und gleichzeitig der Flug nicht so lang ist wie in die USA, was bei Patienten in einen potentiell kritischen Zustand durchaus wichtig ist, da man in der Luft nicht viele Möglichkeiten hat, die Patienten zu versorgen. 

Man muss dazu sagen, dass die Behandlung in spezialisierten Einrichtungen stattfindet, bei denen Intensivstation und Isolierstation kombiniert sind, was relativ selten weltweit vorgehalten wird. Und in Deutschland ist das Robert Koch Institut direkt mit an Board um den Erreger zu untersuchen, da es für diese Form von Ebola noch keine Behandlung gibt. Mal schauen ob sie was hinbekommen. Aber wir haben den Vorteil, dass entsprechende Stellen den Umgang mit Ebola schon kennen und Erfahrung darin haben, seit dem Ausbruch 2014/2015 in Westafrika. Damals kamen bereits mehrere Patienten aus dem entsprechenden Raum nach Europa. Vor Ort ist eine Behandlung schwierig, da entsprechende Behandlungskapazitäten kaum vorhanden sind. Um ihre Mitarbeiter zu schützen, haben deshalb eigentlich alle Organisationen Versicherungen abgeschlossen um ihre Mitarbeiter versorgen zu können, weshalb auch davon auszugehen ist, dass die Versicherung der Missionsgesellschaft, die ihn in das Krisengebiet geschickt hat, die Kosten zu tragen. In anderen Fällen in der Vergangenheit waren auch die Arbeitgeber entweder Kostenträger, also meistens staatliche Organisationen oder Wohlfahrtsverbände, oder die WHO hat die Behandlung von Patienten getragen.

Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

body.title: I Completed Mass Effect 3 Yesterday
body.body:
I played the Mass Effect games back when they were originally released, and fell in love with the series during the first game. The second in the series cemented my love of it, as it took everything from the first game and refined it. I loved the third game in the series up until the end and remember being disappointed when I first completed it. 

I completed the first game, then completed it a second time before the second game's release. I went back and completed both of them again in time for the third, and never replayed the games after finishing the third. 

Then the legendary edition was released a few years back, and I replayed the series once more. I got right to the middle of the third game at the time, and life got in the way, so I stopped, but recently I loaded my save and instantly became obsessed with it. 

Each night, when the kids were asleep, I'd get in 1-2 hours of it until I inevitably passed out.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdGi3VScj4WVYVuydzd4xGMamoZW3nNeETwtAt9CEhqZ2/image.png)

[Source](https://www.reddit.com/r/masseffect/comments/10bxi6l/the_greatest_story_in_gaming_write_your_pros_and/)

****

**My Character Felt Very Over-Powered**

That's one thing I noticed during my playthrough of the final game. 

Firefights were not challenging at all, and that kind of spoiled the fun, and took me out of the story of this game a bit.

We are in this epic final push against the reapers; all the worlds of the Milky Way are fighting desperately for survival. The bodies pile high all around us, entire battalions being wiped out in minutes, cities and - at large - worlds are falling... nobody can stand against this horde of cosmic terrors.

**Who's that?** It's Commander Shepard, of course. He and his two companions are just strolling through the streets where the fighting is thickest, and their shields haven't dropped once.

That was kind of funny to me; hearing the absolute chaos taking place, and the total annihilation of worlds, while I was barely breaking a sweat.

I had a pistol which took out the biggest enemies in a matter of seconds, so yeah, it was a little bit immersion-breaking.

For my next playthrough, I'll be doing it on insanity difficulty, for the achievements, but also to feel like my squad and I are in danger to some degree.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbpK9m21D3ebKCSDawwKmx5K9hT8GXB3XtBwNVayDhs6f/image.png)

[Source](https://www.gamesradar.com/mass-effect-5-guide/)

****

**The Ending**

I was so sad when it was all over, and because I only ever played the third game once, most of it was brand new to me, which I was so happy about.

The end was heart-wrenching because I felt like I needed some sort of epilogue to say goodbye to all of the characters.

I played the Citadel DLC, which has us throw a massive party where we can invite all of our companions around for a last hurrah. It did help to have those final moments with everyone, knowing the end was near, but I just wish there was a bit more.

I chose the destroy ending, and had nearly 8,000 military assets, so I managed to get the ending slide where Shepard survives. But, rather than having to imagine what happened, I would have loved it if there was a small additional DLC released, where we could explore the aftermath of the war, and just talk with everyone, and get started on the rebuilding efforts.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4W1T9mX6U4kgM1KaKq1foM8TAbwMejvSykuVoysa2kD/image.png)

[Source](https://www.space.com/entertainment/space-games-toys/10-things-we-want-from-the-next-mass-effect-game)

****

**What Was Lacking?** 

One major thing that bugged me about the game's ending was primarily during the final battle when we arrived back on Earth.

I felt like going around and doing all of the side missions and gathering the huge force was a bit of a waste of time, as I saw very little evidence that anyone I gathered was there helping us.

Sure, the fleet was immense, but I didn't see any Geth, whom I managed to help, or the Quarians. I didn't see any of Aria's mercs, or any of the other races I managed to recruit. It was mainly just Humans, Turians, and Krogans. So, what was the point?

It would have been nice to see the final battle drastically change based on our war assets. I almost got all available assets, but, narrative-wise, I felt like I gathered barely any.

I know it would have been tough on the team, but I would have loved to see that final battle look completely different based on how much we managed to accomplish throughout the games. 

For example, imagine getting there and seeing the top brass completely disappointed in the severe lack of help, or vice versa, seeing them jump for joy with complete confidence based on how many people we brought together.

I heard some mods help expand it, but seeing it in the official game would have been great.

****

All in all, it was a brilliant end to the series, and when it was all over, I was satisfied, but it left me wanting so much more.

In fact, it left me wanting to stay in the universe a bit longer, so I went and bought a series of four Mass Effect novels. Which, I can't wait to arrive.

body.title: KISS BLOG IDEAS: WEEK #212/ Without haste and with calm in the heart 🚶🏻‍♀️💞
body.body: >Without haste and with calm in the heart

> In another era, my life was a daily whirlwind. I rushed through everything, trying to do a thousand things at once. While sometimes I managed to accomplish them all, and relatively well, I was left with a feeling of exhaustion, or worse, a frustration of not having enjoyed the moment, of not having dedicated more time to it, or of doing things soullessly, just to get them over with. I complained that I needed a clone to complete all my pending tasks, or wished the day had more than 24 hours so I could do everything I had in mind.

/> I was younger then, and I felt I had to be involved in everything, that I was losing a second of my life if I slowed down. In fact, I boasted about reading a book every day, even though I'd forget what I'd read afterward, about doing a thousand things at the same time: walking, thinking, and solving problems while chewing gum. I was like a toy car with brand-new batteries, bumping into everything, but still not stopping.

/>

But one day, I think it might have been related to the deaths of some close friends and family, I asked myself what the point was of living in such a rush. Why do a thousand things half-heartedly when I could do a few well? I asked myself. Then I understood that life isn't a sprint, but a marathon, and that at the pace I was keeping, exhaustion wouldn't allow me to enjoy anything.

That's when I slowed down, took my foot off the gas pedal, and began to appreciate the scenery of each day more. Now, I only do what I want and can do, when I can. It's not the end of the world if I can't make it to an event, even if it's the event of the year. I respect my body, and if my body is tired, I don't push it, nor do I get upset about it. I don't accept anyone telling me, \
because I feel that those words, rather than encouraging speed, create stress. \n\n

/> That's why now I savor my morning coffee, each sip unhurried, without looking at the clock. If I don't have to work, I turn off my alarms. I've learned the pleasure of walking and letting people pass: those behind me can't rush me. I appreciate looking out the windows, underlining in a book as I read and take notes. I draw, listen to music, walk barefoot. At this pace, I'm able to hear my own heartbeat, delight in flavors and moments, smell the present in every detail, see the signs of the universe. Like someone slowly eating a delicious cake, I've learned that to truly live life, you have to enjoy everything you do, walk, and watch the sunrises and sunsets unfold before your eyes.
>All images are from my personal gallery and the text was translated with Google
>Thank you for your support, for reading, and for your comments, friends. Until next time\n\n

body.title: Living With a Functional Addict
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5642.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Eo1wKxKX9ALQGAit5TmAvp2UPRfPVJLz6xkxAuUufqK4UCJJvDpTfFAztb6uSKT4Giv.jpeg)


I think my dad is addicted to taking pills. The sad part is, I don’t think he even realizes it.

Growing up, one thing that was always normal in our house was seeing my dad swallow drugs. There was always one illness or another he believed he needed to treat. Headache, body pain, stress, stomach discomfort, fever, I mean there was always a pill for something. As a kid, I didn’t think much of it as I thought adults took medicine all the time. 

But now that I’m older and still watching the same pattern, only worse, I’m beginning to realize this goes beyond simply taking medication. It feels like some sort of dependency.

In my house, my siblings and I absolutely hate taking drugs. Whenever we fall ill to the point where we have to see a doctor or pharmacist and drugs are prescribed to us, the moment we start feeling okay, we abandon the medication somewhere in our rooms and move on with life. Terrible habit, honestly, but we do it a lot.

My dad, however, sees abandoned drugs as some sort of personal offense. Whenever he walks into our rooms and finds unused medication lying around, he picks them up and takes them himself. According to him, he doesn’t like seeing drugs go to waste. Then he calls us ungrateful for wasting money. At first, it used to sound funny but now, it honestly scares me.

I remember one time my brother fell from a one-story building and landed badly on his back. He lost consciousness and had to be taken to the hospital. After he was discharged, he was prescribed medication for recovery. My brother took the drugs for a while, felt better, then abandoned the rest like he usually does.

My dad found them. Despite not having any symptoms or medical reason to take those drugs, he started using them himself. Morning without food, evening again, consistently, until everything finished. That was the moment I started realizing this wasn’t normal behavior anymore.

Now things have gotten worse. My dad has taken so many antibiotics over the years that they barely work effectively on him anymore. What would normally help a normal person recover quickly barely does anything for him. Most times when he falls seriously ill now, regular medication from a pharmacy doesn’t work. He ends up needing stronger hospital-grade drugs before his body responds and that terrifies me.

Because I think this is how dependency on something forms. It doesn’t always begin the way we assume it. It starts with one pill for a headache, another for body pain, something for stress, something to sleep better, something for just in case. Then over the years, your body becomes so used to constantly receiving medication that living without it starts to feel abnormal.

![IMG_5638.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Eo45gHCpQ9ateXGsYaYKRY8r7138nvt8w41YfoGhqEBtGW72CnYs8hdvBCLKZqtUDKv.jpeg)

I tried bringing it up with him recently, but he dismissed me almost immediately. According to him, he’s getting older and his body reacts differently now, so of course he needs medication more often. Part of that may be true because aging comes with health challenges. But what worries me is his habit of taking drugs that were never prescribed to him in the first place. That can’t be healthy.

The hardest part is knowing there’s very little I and my siblings can do. My dad is extremely dogmatic about things he believes in. Suggesting therapy or medical counseling would probably be seen as disrespectful or unnecessary. He genuinely doesn’t think there’s a problem but I worry anyway. Because when sickness worsens or when people die, they are not always the ones who carry the heaviest burden of pain. It’s the people who love them. The ones left behind to grieve, panic, and wonder if they could have done more.

Now that’s why this scares me so much. It’s not just because of the pills, but because watching someone I love slowly harm himself while refusing help has made me feel helpless in the most exhausting way possible.


>Images are mine



</diva>

body.body:
We're back in **Wynwood** to explore all the #StreetArt this **Miami** neighborhood has to offer. I ventured a little outside the center, around the [Museum of Graffiti](https://museumofgraffiti.com/) , to discover the various warehouses between Fifth Avenue and the freeway. Everywhere you look, there are high-quality works, as you'll see in this post.

> *Nous sommes de retour à **Wynwood** pour découvrir tout le #StreetArt que ce quartier de **Miami** à offrir. Je me suis éloigné un peu du centre, autour du [Museum of Graffiti](https://museumofgraffiti.com/) pour aller découvrir les différents entrepôts entre la 5ème avenue et l'autoroute. Partout des oeuvres de grande qualité comme vous allez le constater dans ce post.*

![FO Estudio & Falopapas](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/243BgCZdk6oDRjYrBQKV3wi3DEd2CYtmCAxvAJgitcj3i8toLBvf8F1aCUs22nP1iCLQx.JPG)

At the corner of 5th Avenue and 24th Street, you'll find **Here Comes The Sun** featuring a portrait of **the Beatles** done in 2025 by [**FO Estudio**](https://www.instagram.com/fo__estudio/) and [**Augusto Falopapas**](https://www.instagram.com/falopapas/), two visual artists. The combination of the different elements is really cool. It instantly gets the song stuck in your head* 😀.

> *Au coin de la 5ème avenue et de la 24ème rue, on retrouve **Here Comes The Sun** avec le portrait des quatre Beatles réalisé en 2025 par [**FO Estudio**](https://www.instagram.com/fo__estudio/) et [**Augusto Falopapas**](https://www.instagram.com/falopapas/), deux artistes visuels.
