body.title: Simon's Kitchen
body.body:
Gad, an elderly man, dislikes eating fries or burgers that weren't made by him. He believes he cooks them better and it would be a real waste of money to eat anything less delicious.

In his neighborhood was Simon's eatery where fries and burgers were sold, but he never tried any of their meals despite the great reviews he sees about them.
\

he often says whenever he sees videos of customers rating the eatery.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbxpESB7TbS5p3XBFN3WSYhcGyUibWMctUXqVHzEGGjVU/1779307166757.jpg)

[Photo source](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tef88e)

One fateful day, he came back from work late and couldn't cook anything because he was tired. He decided to get a burger from Simon's eatery, not because he wanted to, but because that was the only choice left for him at the moment. He got an ice cream too, hoping it would serve him if the burger didn't taste good.

He got home and decided to take a few quick bites. For a moment he seemed unsure about the taste and took another bite—this time paying more attention to the taste. He nodded in delight as he took a bigger chunk of it. It tasted better. He couldn't believe how good it tasted compared to several others he had eaten in his youth.
\

body.title: Robot Companions: Would I Want One?
body.body:
Robot companion, it's sound crazy but amazing. This prompt make have a weird imagination, thinking about the idea of having a robot as a friend. Sounds kind of fictional, right? But considering how fast technology is moving, it might actually happen sooner than we think. Just imagine coming home after a rough day and your robot friend is just there, ready to talk, help you with chores, or even just keep you company. Sounds nice… but also kind of strange.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRv27afJ4P2yg2Wub5KAMYqQJ9Pd8UEgQvfSM4q8gdaPX/1000217683.png 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-cyber-robot-8846765/)
I mean, how would I really want a friend who doesn’t have feelings? Even though a robot can smile, laugh, or act like it cares, but deep down, it doesn’t actually feel anything. At first, that might not seem like a big deal. I would still have someone or let me say something is there for me all the time. But then I wonder… is that really friendship? Human friends argue, laugh, cry with each. They mess up, but they learn but robots They follow commands. They don’t really understand what friendship *means

I was really thinking,what if the robot makes a mistake? Maybe I  told it to “clean the house,” and it throws out the things I  actually wanted to keep. Or it misunderstands a task and ends up causing more trouble than help. Will I be able to forgive it like I forgive a human friend? Or would i just see it as a machine doing its job wrong and that is another question keep coming to my mind.

Still, I can’t deny the appeal. A robot friend would never judge , never get annoyed, and could always help when need it. For someone feeling lonely, it might feel amazing to have that kind of presence. Maybe friendship doesn’t have to be emotional to be meaningful. Maybe it’s enough that someone, or something is there for you consistently.

Personally, I think I’d like to try having a robot friend. But I also feel like it would be weird knowing they don’t actually feel anything back. It makes me wonder if we’re ready to rethink what friendship really is. Is it about shared feelings, or just being there for each other? Maybe in the future, robots will change the way we see connections completely. For now, I’m not sure. But it’s definitely something I would like to see, and maybe even experience.


**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

body.title: Observing nature at the park near home
body.body: /> _Banner created in ChatGPT_ Sometimes, walking near home, you can get a nice nature view! I just wish that I had gone more prepared for these walks with my good digital camera. The maximum that I have for these moments is my iPhone, which lacks good zooming. There was a beautiful Saturday morning when I went jogging and I saw so many different birds, but I didn't even have my phone with me. Last Sunday, I went for a bicycle ride with my youngest and I stopped to take some pictures of interesting visitors that aren't always around here all year long.
/> _The Pelican swimming calmly in the lake_

/>

_Another picture of the same pelican._

The Sunridge Park is one of the artificial parks built by the city. It has two big lakes, and I usually start jogging from home, and I complete around 5 km after two and a half laps around the park. While riding the bicycle, we saw this lonely pelican swimming in one of the lakes. I saw pelicans on the river that cuts the city in two, called Oldman River, but never saw them around my home. I'm not sure if it is the same one, but I also saw a pelican while jogging two Saturdays ago.

Pelicans appear here in the spring and summer since they go south during the winter. And it is nice to see something different in these lakes. Normally we only see ducks and the \
, or better, the famous Canadian geese. This one was a bit far even for my poor iPhone zoom, so I tried to get closer to the lake, but in the end, it probably made him fly when he saw me.\n\n

/> _The pelican was flying after I got closer to it._ I read today from @thekittygirl about AI image editing to try to improve images, so I decided to see what AI could do for the picture. Well, it looks clearer, but it also looks so unnatural, don't you think? I just asked it to improve the quality of the image.

/> _The AI edited picture to improve quality using ChatGPT._ I will continue with the originals. Maybe I should be more prepared with a good camera to capture these moments. Three weeks ago, I also got a seasonal visitor, the Yellow-headed Blackbird. By the way, this bird has a very noisy sound. I even registered this one in the iNaturalist app to confirm the species: [https://inaturalist.org/observations/358492538](https://inaturalist.org/observations/358492538) It is a nice season to do some bird watching around home.
/>](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg) _Banner created in Canva_ * * * Observando a natureza no parque perto de casa =============================================

/> Às vezes, caminhando perto de casa, você pode se deparar com uma bela paisagem natural! Só queria estar mais preparado para esses passeios levando minha câmera digital. O máximo que tenho para esses momentos é meu iPhone, que não tem um zoom muito bom. Num lindo sábado de manhã fui correr e vi muitos pássaros diferentes, mas nem meu celular estava comigo. No domingo passado fui andar de bicicleta com meu filho caçula e parei para registrar alguns visitantes interessantes que não estão sempre por aqui o ano todo.
/> _O pelicano nadando calmamente no lago_

/> _Outra foto do mesmo pelícano._ O Parque Sunridge é um dos parques artificiais construídos pela cidade. Possui dois grandes lagos, e eu costumo começar minha corrida em casa e completar cerca de 5 km após duas voltas e meia ao redor do parque. Enquanto andávamos de bicicleta, vimos este pelícano solitário nadando em um dos lagos. Eu já tinha visto pelicanos no Rio Oldman, mas nunca perto de casa. E não tenho certeza se era o mesmo, mas também vi um pelicano enquanto corria há duas semanas. Os pelicanos aparecem por aqui na primavera e no verão, já que migram para o sul durante o inverno. E é bom ver algo diferente nesses lagos. Normalmente só vemos patos e os famosos gansos-do-canadá. Este estava um pouco longe até mesmo para o zoom do meu iPhone, então tentei me aproximar do lago, mas no fim provavelmente o assustei quando me viu.

/> _O pelícano voando depois que me aproximei dele._ Li hoje no blog da @thekittygirl sobre edição de imagens com IA para tentar melhorar fotos, então resolvi ver o que a IA poderia fazer com a imagem. Bem, parece mais nítida, mas também parece muito artificial, não acha? Eu só pedi para melhorar a qualidade da imagem.

/> _A imagem editada por IA para melhorar a qualidade usando ChatGPT._ Vou continuar com as originais. Talvez eu devesse estar mais preparado com uma boa câmera para capturar esses momentos. Há três semanas também recebi a visita de um pássaro sazonal, a graúna-de-cabeça-amarela. Aliás, esse pássaro tem um canto muito alto. body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779299819797-548fb04434927d21.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/b8ee2fb0)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/b8ee2fb0)


---

Upon reaching Kuwak Yaku, Lara and Jonah met Abby, who shared intel about local ruins and a carved symbol. Leaving Jonah behind, I explored the village market, utilized a campfire, and bought gear from a trader. Inside the ancient ruins Lara uncovered a hidden wall translation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXeHyRwrACN2MMeWB8sLYu3JfSfwpZGruZBD2Tyie6o8z/screenshot_1_.png)

So we at last reached the village we were looking for, which is named Kuwak Yaku, and it's in Peru, nestled deep in the dense forest. It was stood in stark contrast to the thick, untamed green canopy surrounding the isolated settlement.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbELimPAbfMXCg2wN5E7UMrLKrvhBZ8fKp8YK4LQWMUg9/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmepsW4ptMfqqhyhMMooQXvejb9LJtHC3c5couc4nwK8d2/screenshot_3_.png)

After getting to the village, we met this lady who was interested in talking to us and mentioned she needed a break anyway. So they first got introduced among themselves.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmmqrFcEt2RGqgBYfqsfLCtEmrCYg6QU7FAtp7xk1Rgg/screenshot_4_.png)

Then this lady, Abby, offered them drink, while mentioned she own the only bnb in his village despite the external troubles. And after seeing a photo of our artifact, she said she has seen this symbol before and mentioned there are some ruins nearby, having similar symbols.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbVteHcwEcgWd4iyMF3f5LvbBN5nZnVUoKGjRWddcLzCT/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2Kjc4mRsaMEYDZSrwLnMuxohU2nkVARk1px3RR92M9g/screenshot_6_.png)

Leaving Jonah behind alone with Abby to enjoy her hospitality, Lara decided to check the symbol and the ruins immediately. So I started questioning people around for hints, talking to fishers and workers along the dusty paths of the village.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTTRpbp9Cb3dgHXbtMg2DUvjCrRMFogPrG71PVUuB1rVS/screenshot_7_.png)

On my way through the outskirts, I found this campfire that I used to save my progress with while giving Lara some rest as well. The warmth of the fire allowed me to look over our inventory and upgrade skills before pushing forward.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaNEf9sPaLjRxBZERx7dhPaMiEoDrSWL278pdsknQiFxb/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcj2v9UCtjHHnmrTn9z5Eh2DAA7xMHWbmcbYkfLJNqr7p/screenshot_9_.png)

Then I started moving through the village where I noticed the villagers were gossiping around about various things. And there was this market area where I found people selling various kinds of stuffs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRYq3rcQ9b2XJ7399eTWWztYAJ19Dw14D6FDPCoMjAaDT/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVFoM68kKsopQdeyhnhG8JL34VdF99Ewd9EZK4hyaNoy2/screenshot_11_.png)

And at last I reached the ruins gate on the edge of the jungle, and there I found a friendly trader from whom I bought a lot of things. I loaded up on resource bags and helpful gear modifications that would aid in exploration.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZs8anjbZxSFoBccs3D1diPM9yzSY3j93Nhddz8ZeTBT2/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU73qDQngnrrEVff9Euiv5ojKUzgESRZdzdY6P1DogCg5/screenshot_13_.png)

And at last, I found the ruins Abby was talking about and it looked like really ancient, covered in centuries of moss and vines. So I started moving inside carefully, checking the structural integrity of the stone ceiling as we entered.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKL9PSu8JL6Hy9r384Y9YcL9XHVXA4vbNzBFCbB1MAmS/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVxzKQ2ELNgUVb99u9HMZTisztzwbbpv4TSq2sTxMurP1/screenshot_15_.png)

After getting inside there to examine the chambers, suddenly, Jonah appeared out of nowhere, which surprised me, as I thought Lara was alone there. I guess, he finished his drink and decided it was time to watch his partner's back again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaHRPThasuvHiiUgLfWjUKoz1ikH1B926vNRUaYW9NJY/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTprhUGYRjakYkHqCjaQT8y2CPVGZw8aApGZdepMASi8Y/screenshot_17_.png)

Lara found the symbol that we mentioned carved deeply on a crumbling wall, which translated textually to \

Lara studied the crude markings, realizing it was a vital piece of a much larger chronological puzzle.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVJMSXXqfvqKHTj3r3tYH8WbmYdL7qpWLhDzLSMUiCE27/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRDKyi7mKWDodh5twZJswjAn3wC9kXrYLd92nn8fXUe8C/screenshot_19_.png)

Then Lara understood something was hidden behind the wall based on the structural hollow sound, so she started hitting on the wall with her ice axe. And it looked like it was a false wall, and the full symbol got revealed. Which says \

body.title: No phone || no fun
body.body:
Greetings!

The coming of technology has really brought to us an easy life where we all enjoy life more than ever. Before now when technology was not in place, we were told that things were not as easy as they were supposed to be. Then we were told by those who lived in those days that, it always takes a long time for us to get things done. 

However, because of the advent of technology, things can now be done without time wasting. People can cultivate their farm on time, as if that's not enough, people can communicate and interact with the outside world even in the comfort of their room. That's the essence of technology.

But to make my contribution to the topic of prompt before me which is about, “Life without smart phones.” I would respond by saying that a life without smart phones will be kind of boring and this is because the smart phones which we are all using have provided for us liveliness more than anything else. 

Without the smart phone, life would be so boring and no one would want to live in the past where our forefathers had once lived when to us in this generation is the most boring moment ever. Although to them, it is not.

The availability of smart phones has really made the world be at our palm and we can now connect to the whole world without travelling. Another thing is that everything needed, being it entertainment, sport, drama and to cap it all, social media is right there with us on our smart phones and with all these, there can never be a dull or boring moment.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTcLw5nWMRXqiUSMTJ3QC8wyL1xL8eBaQmR79HAU67urH/IMG-20260520-WA0048.jpg 

However, as good as the smart phone is, there's other aspects of it that are of great disadvantage to us. One of those is the break in relationship it's brought to the human race, most especially, among the family members where everyone would only be attached to their phones rather than communing together even under the same roof.

Although smart phones have strengthened our relationship with the outside world, it's really weakened the in house relationship.

In conclusion, a life without smart phones would be a boring life, but even at that, it really weakens family ties and relationships. 

Thanks for reading.

Picture sourced from metaAi.

Anoche tocaba sumar kilómetros y devorar el asfalto. 🔥 El plan estaba clarísimo: una ruta de **7 kilómetros por La Floresta**, saliendo con toda la actitud y el enfoque desde **LPG**. 🏙️👟 Las piernas respondían de maravilla, el ritmo se sentía súper sólido y la noche caraqueña nos regalaba el ambiente perfecto para correr. 🌌✨ Todo fluía en perfecta sincronía... hasta que a la tecnología le dio por inventar su propia carrera. 📱🤷🏽‍♀️
Completamos el circuito con éxito, regresando con la satisfacción al mismo punto de partida en LPG, pero al revisar el reloj, ¡vaya sorpresa! **Strava enloqueció por completo**. 🤯🛰️ Según el mapa satelital, parecía que habíamos cruzado portales interdimensionales, saltado techos o corrido sobre el agua. 🌀 Nos dibujó una ruta abstracta digna de un museo, cambiando las calles reales por trazos salvajes que desafiaban cualquier ley de la física. 🎨😂
Al final, más allá de los gráficos locos y los datos alterados de la aplicación, lo que realmente cuenta es lo que se queda en el cuerpo: el esfuerzo real de esos 7K bien sudados, la constancia de seguir entrenando duro y las risas compartidas al ver el mapa. 🏁💪🏽 ¡Strava podrá delirar, pero los kilómetros corridos no nos los quita nadie! ⭐ 💥

body.title: Breaking Records in the Midweek 13k+ Steps and a 12-Day Streak!
body.body:
​Hello, Hive blockchain community and my fellow fitness trackers! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f37bc7e-cf80-49cb-bebf-2705a1c2b1dd.jpg) ​It is Wednesday, May 20, 2026, and today has turned out to be an absolute powerhouse of a day on my wellness journey. As we reached the exact middle of the week, I felt a massive burst of energy and decided to stretch my walking route to the limit. I am incredibly proud to report that I locked in a phenomenal 13,592 steps today! Looking down at my Actifit app tonight and seeing that full green circle next to a burning 12-day consistency streak feels absolutely amazing. Keeping this momentum strong for nearly two full weeks is a huge personal win. ​Today's walk was a sensory treat. After enjoying the elegant white Calla Lilies yesterday, today’s journey was blessed with a completely different explosion of colour. While pushing my pace along the pavement, I came across a stunning, deeply saturated pinkish-red Peony flower blooming beautifully against a concrete wall backdrop. ​The layers upon layers of rich, ruffled petals were incredibly dense, and a few fallen petals on the ground beneath it just added to the natural drama of the scene. It is amazing how stopping for just a moment to admire a striking bit of nature can totally reset your mental battery during a fast-paced walk. These small, colorful discoveries are exactly what make daily walking feel like a reward rather than a chore. ​Looking back at the graph of my 12-day streak on the dashboard, it represents a beautiful story of dedication. From the banks of the River Thames to the historic pathways of Hampton Court, through the rolling green hills of Richmond Park, and now into the colorful suburban corners of my local area every single day has added a new layer to my fitness habits. Hitting over 13,500 steps on a Wednesday means I have set a wonderful benchmark for the rest of the week. ​Staying active consistently has completely shifted my mindset. Instead of counting down the minutes on a treadmill, I am out in the fresh air, exploring the changing spring scenery, tracking my progress, and connecting with all of you. ​How is your midweek going so far? Have you managed to find any hidden gems or beautiful blooms on your daily walks? Are you pushing your own tracking streaks to new heights this May? Let me know in the comments section below!

body.body:
> > The contest themes of @gamingphoto helps us seeing things in a video game that we normally ignore. After learning of a starving widow, Jin spoke with her and launched a quest to retrieve her stolen rice. I tracked the bandit group, cleared them out in open combat, and returned the food. Upon delivery, Jin discovered the widow had lied about the bandits stealing it from her directly.
[Gaming Photography Weekly Contest.](https://peakd.com/hive-185676/@gamingphoto/gaming-photography-weekly-contest-26b0bcb83827)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4F3zYHyLN3hVeDJTJ7GccFsMBnfGKnnt7e77YiXmdkU/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfToyRyffAWYngR3fCJGp1NQJLxx7g92s4qiRyEJ6JHRi/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdP36HtAD8WEMH74hyoMke5kJ9FRTtG2H6BBmGS861JZr/screenshot_3_.png) I was still inside that camp that I liberated from the bandits last time. I found two peasants there who told me there is a widow on the outskirts of Tsutsu who live alone and has no means of securing food for herself. . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiGg1Nyf9nc9sT2aPsT8JTNBCKtedcJZ94hkzyRnczTF/screenshot_4_.png) Bandits are stealing food from the people in Tsutsu, leaving them desperate. If I don't stop these criminals, these people will starve before long, so I decided to check on that area first to investigate the situation. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNnxUKR4bGfBFtfEepu2BCQtMgvCTp4BeDWJRGWUS2eR/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRefAUSG5GQhox6nfAKNTv61e3GYtUuCxugt8G43hvrc4/screenshot_6_.png) And I found the widow the peasants were talking about, who was outside her house, likely crying or waiting for some food. And it looked like the golden bird was also there, fluttering around. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfNAXhjYQSXxbr3d9RREj1jEhT3XjD3EZdRawjgezFWxC/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaf5QZy8b1hYU9KpADmUZJ8en4HTjj6tP4f5uyxBk6PMj/screenshot_8_.png) Before getting to the widow to hear her story, I mistakenly threw a smoke bomb around my own feet, which spooked my horse instantly. The thick gray cloud blinded me for a moment while Nobu reared up and whinnied in total confusion. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUu4XAXLwtDx8vQppWA4YfSGn6S8Wx63H7drUvMJE6wGV/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqxpCwsjJGXgBkPgdr6JTn8Dd3F2g3BdBvkHnW6UuZdK/screenshot_10_.png) Then I spoke to the widow, who said some bandits took all her food and ran toward the wood, and she didn't have anything to eat. And with this, a quest began, with Jin vowing to return her supplies. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNxmCKABxj1SaTu2KsCLmhpzAXiYdqUG5LRX8TkiNtKTq/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaYL6HLRZbtNJBVkrrkJXitpFTLWjyjQjv3ZoHS782Kk/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaqrXuPACof3Rqmyyo3RQKookEnCg1BsDHUxogGQyyVa/screenshot_13_.png) I started riding toward the wood, and after a moment, I reached this open field from where I saw the bandit group. I used the photo mode to check on them from this far. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9tWXkjXmhpsaEBdZ9k77gjgm9mQ6FvYECwPhytJrY79/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcLsuuAT9J3dxsR9XGcHV24DDq8ofZvhr2L4NWvLLisLq/screenshot_15_.png) Ignoring stealth completely, I rode my horse for them real fast, and I jumped off my horse toward one of the bandits and hit him. The impact threw him to the ground. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXnu1hGHTynjxjVv9FqxDxVBDF21AU3Hq5ccNtEHiYV6M/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqEtQWun2MoQenYaaXsvtNVv9NrQuH8161gYebwA7fBP/screenshot_17_.png) But the bandit somehow survived, as Jin, I don't know why, didn't use his katana on him during the initial leap. So I had to take him down next using standard strikes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmezDat8zJw31s8mC1ikWWssAQz2uhhDfWJchnVWupiTvu/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAAmYt1EsPctfsr4pnVFBLe37EJujdD2Njy6CUqGhMHp/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeN66HWTW9MX945xqiN74bARiJs7oYCAndEFzCxZDJ75j/screenshot_20_.png) The bandit around him was trying to attack me right after with a spear, but I dodged his attacks effortlessly. And then I took him down along with some more of them. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUAc93gW6Pgw4LMsA1sYG7hi3EssNFP2fsKTcDHUg4Wzm/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdnuwnKek78veCeSY4G1Ki9tMTpe1bvJ7RwzjmhWjKDto/screenshot_22_.png) When I noticed there was only a single bandit left who was an archer and was already shooting me from afar, I shot him down with an arrow after dodging his arrows. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMrrJ4MW5Gkp9KhS3Dicf32MWEX37eQpVeZMtbj3CtAy/screenshot_23_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcVTSgBuyeFyFGESRMpzNDbJUzKj6oWVwVTDofbNAEHj1/screenshot_24_.png) Then I found the rice they stole from the widow tucked inside a secure sack. After collecting it, I had to return to the widow, but I stopped there to check on this dead body nearby, who got a horrible death. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaqYEN1UXP7dwwpeJGuuYh2xU7GjMKxUvTJVt5cegkqq/screenshot_25_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZh8bm47nk6ST4T5f5YV9UN1Kwga3mNjDf2GZPqaVkLp8/screenshot_26_.png) I rode to the house of the widow to deliver the food, but after reaching there, I didn't see the lady outside anymore. Which made me worry that maybe something happened to her while I was away fighting the thieves. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvSw5TVPw7ZCKoxPkKVLF481G9Xf5t6s1fxuvdAwB7cW/screenshot_27_.png) But after rushing inside the house, I found her safe and sound, and she looked extra happy having the rice in her hands. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKsR967QK6REuT6UP9ggQMb6tkAarnEPTJY9988T8TAv/screenshot_28_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCY1DgvYBQoUCfyBQ7cnCw2Uaae7vRmj1r74inmEVmHg/screenshot_29_.png) In the way the lady was expressing her happiness, Jin understood she lied to him about the bandits stealing from her. Actually, they stole it from somewhere else, and the lady mentioned the bandits doesn't deserve the food. And Jin suggested her not to lie again before ending the mission. --- If you like the post, feel free to like, comment & share. I will soon come with another post. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=naeemulnepun/ebadadae)

body.title: 🖤 Not everyone will understand your vibe
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeL8EYDkpx7twPpztaCNBB8irb7EZY2PAs4JbYgZgUaDu/IMG_9323.PNG 

And honestly… that’s perfectly fine ✨

I’ve stopped trying to explain myself to people who only understand ordinary energy. Some of us were meant to dream bigger, move differently, and create our own path 😌

Today I was working as a *creative image strategist* (which is basically my way of saying I help brands feel cooler and more unforgettable 🖤), but deep down I know my real goal is bigger than any job title.

I want a life that feels free.
A life where I can travel, create, model, and wake up excited about what’s next.

And maybe that’s why I love moments like this… just me, confidence, good music, and the feeling that I’m becoming more like the woman I always imagined.

Still rare.
Still focused.
Still unapologetically myself 💫

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@melyna/-not-everyone-will-understand-your-vibe-jct)

body.title: Historic sites in Murcia, 20K+ steps and sore feet. My Actifit Report Card: May 20 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/557751d0-aec3-4396-a254-dc15e4ddaff2.jpg) Yesterday I posted early in the day while my wife was taking a walk on a walking path. Today she is napping on a park bench. It is pretty hot so it's nice to just relax. Still I have to stand guard which is a little boring. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/326bdc6d-dbba-496e-8749-10259060bd9e.jpg) I take it back she just woke up :) So this morning so far? Took the train halfway into town. Got tickets which is good. Almost didn't realize the conductor was asking for my ticket. That would have been embarrassing. Walked to a convent (really old one dating back to the Muslim time of Spain (12th century). ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/91420d64-057f-4bfb-b026-763b6c26b3a9.jpg) Then went to a museum not too far away. Lots of cool stuff there but they mostly had artifacts from the Muslim and subsequent Catholic periods. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/447fffb6-3d63-45f3-89a4-bad5482faf17.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2217df15-57a0-46b4-a9af-eb352f132ebd.jpg) Saw the gold and silver coins here and totally though of the silver communities here in hive. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2e8f77a2-d960-4469-92fe-c4c3e12d82ea.jpg) They had beautiful grounds with some of the original masonry but what I thought was clear was the orange tree :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/83a8706d-9f33-45d0-8b02-7833c0825714.jpg) After that we went to the casino. Not the gambling type but rather it used to be a gentleman's club. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f3735842-3647-481d-abeb-2e7fdf9e6a37.jpg) There were lots of cool rooms but the library was one of my favorites ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/54b6420b-9d15-4907-a999-b9d75a938583.jpg) The ballroom was the other. As for my wife? She liked the statue (Yeesh) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/64cf4061-f547-4958-9d49-ad57ef646204.jpg) After that... My wife had a nap in the park and she woke up grumpy. So I figured I'd better feed her fast :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7d7fe968-ca2b-4c09-b177-d38b3eca0af2.jpg) Then we were supposed to go to the aquarium museum but they were closed for siesta so floridablanca path instead. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b4f44756-0c6b-4774-8abf-4a4d4337bf05.jpg) Lots of flowers and old trees there. Then back to the aquarium museum. It was cool but not really photo worthy ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e0c8cf74-c5f2-4a71-b223-33eae87171b0.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2fb5b888-97b6-4f37-b61b-6e4a967dab70.jpg) The next photos worth taking were on the river walk and by this time I was getting tired. Finally finished the river walk and then it was only 4km back to the hotel. Hahaha But we got to see the bullfighting arena ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c4e9df80-c5ef-4f37-8ca7-38c8023e6f22.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/99a2d205-a498-4515-ab9f-e52d35fa141d.jpg) See. Plaza de Toros. And then we just kept on walking and walking until we got home. 8 hours walking around town and my feet were sore. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3a0fa85f-565b-4ec5-8751-82ccf984ac4f.jpg) But we had a $20 food credit at the hotel so choose a couple of desserts and raised it mini fridge for leftover food. Neither of us wanted to walk and go out for food after a long long day :) But pretty proud of almost 21K steps. And that was my day. Tomorrow? Walking around Cartagena all going well ... Will see :D
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260520t201210662z)_

📽️ **Project Hail Mary** (2026) · **80/100**

![poster](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/3/3b/Project_Hail_Mary_poster.jpg)

![UfBBpUoneYc7fzGF_20260515_164705.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mamaemigrante/images/UfBBpUoneYc7fzGF_20260515_164705/UfBBpUoneYc7fzGF_20260515_164705.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Es impresionante como el movimiento de graffiteros pareciera oler cuando hay paredes recién construidas o pintadas, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos, aparecen tanto verdaderas obras de arte, como también este tipo de expresiones en letras que en lo particular no les veo mucho sentido.

Sin embargo, y dada mi ignorancia en cuanto al mundo interno de los graffiteros, puedo rescatar que estos me parecieron en cierto modo, \

, pues me gustó la selección de los colores, así como también algunos de los detalles adicionales que tuvieron a bien colocarles, dándoles profundidad al diseño y una cara nueva a esa pared recién pintada de gris, que junto con el pavimento, hacían ver demasiado monocromática toda la avenida.\n\nDe entre todo el colorido, rescato una frase que se entreve em el borde de uno de ellos que dice \

, aunque realmente eso lo dejo al libre albedrío.

![English version.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliento/48J9YkGKrR8LhuixubW6apdJkDarA9uZ5JUiBcYvGqiJaSUAvKZUQq5odtDrD2584U.png)

It’s amazing how the graffiti scene seems to spring into life whenever there are newly built or freshly painted walls, and in the blink of an eye, you see both genuine works of art and this sort of lettering that, personally, I don’t really see the point of.

However, given my lack of knowledge about the inner workings of the graffiti scene, I can say that I found these somewhat ‘pretty’, as I liked the choice of colours, as well as some of the additional details they saw fit to add, giving depth to the design and a fresh look to that wall, freshly painted grey, which, together with the pavement, made the whole avenue look far too monochrome.

Amidst all the colour, I’d like to highlight a phrase glimpsed on the edge of one of them that reads ‘suffering was permitted’, though I’ll leave the interpretation of that up to you.

***

body.title: Is the battle between good and evil real?
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcpYzY9AcMAo2TMSMSjg3t2G89tbUBPkqjXNa2V8Yqy5s/1779307740943.jpg)


Sometimes, when I get serious about getting my act together and liberating myself from the chains of destructive addictions, my algorithm starts to pump in biblical content and Christian perspective, as if this energy of resistance was directly related to my Christian foundations.

This makes me question whether the Bible was the correct information for a good life, and I just strayed away but now have to find my way back. For a long time, I've believed that good and evil don't really exist, only action and consequence. But something else happens when I begin resisting addiction: I get sick in unexplainable ways.

In these Christian videos, they will usually say that if you decide to move away from *sinful* behaviors, hellish forces will be after you because they are losing a source of energy. This actually makes sense from an esoteric perspective as we are creators, and every action either reinforces a reality or diminishes its power.

Since last week, I've been having the worst back pain ever, and my usual healing methods are not working. If you've read my latest posts, you'll know I've been cleaning myself up from several addictions during the last two weeks and with all this pain they just keep popping up in my mind as a good solution to feel better instantly.

It might all have a neuroscience explanation, but I would expect other kinds of withdrawal symptoms, not this insane backache, which makes me add this religious or magical perspective to the deal. Anyway, what do you think? Am I under attack or just my brain releasing insane cortisol to bring me back to get my dose of cheap dopamine?

body.title: The Law of cause and effect: when things cannot be undone
body.body:
at some point in my life after I have thought about  somethings  deeply I came to the conclusion  that everything  we see  in life is a product  of our choices and decisions,  because life is just there, it's  like when someone gives you a blank sheet of paper and said draw whatever it is you want, your ability to draw that exact same thing well, making sure everything  aligns is how you have it in real life.


I read in an article where the writer said  even if money actually  grow on trees, do you know there will still be people who will  tell you the trees are too tall,  the can't climb rather they will wait at the tree trunk for the leaves to fall,  instead of them getting up looking for ladder to climb.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbsTWFgzVeVHnkb4BtY3pVFaJ4iE7VNevypZdjhSCimyJ/1779307220904.jpg)

I've you seen or heard where people will blame everything  on life?, the family they come from, the type of life their parents lived and how it's affecting theirs, their country  of birth,  their village people and so forth, then forget to blame them selves too.

but here's  the sad reality everything  in life anchors on  these  laws:cause and effect, I'll  explain,  what we call life is a pile up of all the consequences of our actions and inactions.


everything in life is about cause and effect,  somethings only happens because we make them happen,  life is about input and output, not about wishes, it's  not in hoping thing will get better or believing times will change things,  rather life ony recognizes effort,  real input, real work and not just wishes.

if you want something,  you have to get up and go get it,  make it happen  customise it the way you want, the life is yours, be all you can be, there is  no limitation, except  the one you place on your self, that is to say, there is nothing  that can stop you from achieving  anything  once your mind is on it,  once you say I can do it, and getbon with it, then it's  possible to get it done,, don't stop at where you are when you can upscale break boundaries  and leveled up...

time is very important  in life because it's the  only factor  that regulate human activities  that's why it must be handled  with care and so to make the most of life be mindful of how you spend time, what you do per time.

nothing  happens out of the blues except God grants miracle  even the miracles  demands a move of faith, that's  a cause the effect is God stepping in because you initiated the process .

every big business and every life you wish for or admire someone's else, there is work to be done, a move you must initiate,  there must be a cause for there to be a corresponding  effect, know this nothing happens  when there is no cause 

one of newton's  law of motion says, a body will remain in a state of rest except an external  force acted on it, bring that to life,  nothing will happen if you don't  engage all the initiative  needed to make it happen.

body.title: Codeberg - świetna alternatywa dla Github i Gitlab.
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmak4jTk155naw5o8Y1hxV7ctB9odgySUHsxdjcyZfT3KD/image.png)

Źródło: codeberg.org

Codeberg to europejski hosting Gita (czyli najpopularniejszego narzędzia do kontroli wersji [czyli dla programistów] na świecie).

Oto wszystkie zalety Codeberga:
- otwartoźródłowy
- europejski
- szanujący prywatność, nie zbiera i nie sprzedaje danych użytkowników
- używa Forgejo napisanego w języku Go, który jest bardzo szybki i wydajny energetycznie
- używa ekologicznych serwerów (np. Hetznera, europejskiego lidera ekologicznego hostingu, mającego np. serwery zasilane elektrowniami wodnymi w Finlandii albo wiatrowymi w Niemczech)
- jako mniejszy gracz, jest znacznie mniej narażony na cyberataki, bo cyberprzestępcom bardziej się opłaca atakować wielkich graczy, nawet jeśli są lepiej zabezpieczeni, niż tracić czas na małych graczy, po to, żeby ukraść tysiace razy mniej danych. Ponadto, na Codebergu trzymane są głównie projekty hobbistyczne i non-profit, co tym bardziej zmniejsza sens cyberataku.  

Github niedawno padł ofiarą cyberataku, a od kilku lat należy do Microsoftu, co samo w sobie jest wystarczająco dobrym powodem, by szukać alternatyw:
https://ithardware.pl/aktualnosci/github_cyberatak_haker_kod_zrodlowy_platformy_tysiace_repozytoriow-51062.html

Zachęcam programistów do wypróbowania Codeberga.

body.title: HOW I WANT TO BE REMEMBRED
body.body:
Hello everyone, welcome to my blog; it's your favorite girl @betheloji12.

How do I want to be remembered when I am no more on the surface of the earth? Have you ever asked yourself this question, and what were your answers to this question? Do you want to be remembered as a very good influence on people or a bad influence? Do you want to be remembered as a kindhearted person who impacted positively, or do you want to be remembered as someone who makes people frown at the mention of their name? Or do you want to be remembered as a criminal who terrorizes people even in the afterlife? Everyone in life wants to be remembered for one thing or another, and I would love to share mine.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdnEfpxjXgAocxW1afqR7kXxA8826EhBGeV9DM1fyfojN/18680.png 




So this brings me to this weekly prompt: how do you want to be remembered when you are gone? Do I want to be remembered as Bethel, the passionate public health officer, or do I want to be remembered as the brutal public health officer who snaps back at everyone and is always very wicked? Do I want to be remembered as a good child to my parents or do I want to be remembered as a very wicked sister to my siblings? Do I want to be remembered as a bad influence in my community, or do I want to be remembered as a good influence in my community at large?

Well, as a journalist, a public health officer, a hairstylist, and a seamstress, I encounter a lot of people every day, and these are my clients. Treating them right is my top priority, and the way I handle my clients keeps them loyal and dedicated to my brand. That is one good way to be remembered by people.

As a public officer, I want to be remembered as someone who is passionate about saving lives and building good communication and friendship with my patients. I want to be a strong support system to those who need my support, and to wrap it all up, I want to be remembered as a good influence on my family, my community, and the people within my workspace.

Thank you for stopping by my blog.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/how-i-want-to-be-remembred-5pk)

body.title: The Tale of Belle - ENG- SPA
body.body: > Belle had always been an incredible singer. She started off strong on stage by winning a singing competition. That competition opened doors for her in the music industry very quickly. She received contracts, interviews with big names, and later, all kinds of collaborations. This helped her pave the way to one of her most important destinations: joining DWE, the band that would truly launch her career. They discovered her after seeing the buzz she generated by winning the competition and her subsequent successes. So, they thought she was an excellent choice to be the group's vocalist. She loved the idea of ​​joining them because they were among the best, and being part of them was almost an honor, because she was an up-and-coming singer. But although the band was good, they had been declining for a while due to the lack of a good vocalist. With her, everyone won; Belle became famous, and the band returned to stardom as it always should have been. Their relationship was special because together they had surpassed themselves on every level. But that relationship wouldn't last forever. After achieving great success, Belle got married, but this didn't affect the band at all, as she remained as active as ever. What began to strain their musical relationship was her unexpected and unprepared pregnancy. So, she gradually needed to dedicate more time to her pregnancy and care, and couldn't be as active as she had been a few months prior.

> Belle desde siempre había sido una cantante increíble. Empezó pisando fuerte en el escenario al ganar un concurso de canto. Ese concurso le abrió las puertas a la industria de una forma muy rápida. Recibió contratos, entrevistas con grandes personalidades, y más adelante colaboraciones de todo tipo. Esto la ayudó mucho a crear un camino para llegar a uno de sus destinos más importantes, llegar a DWE la banda que la vería despegar de verdad. Ellos la conocieron al ver el revuelo que formó al ganar el concurso y sus éxitos posteriores. Así que les pareció excelente para ser la vocalista del grupo. A ella le encantó la idea de unírseles porque ellos eran de los mejores, ser parte de ellos era casi un honor, porque ella era una cantante emergente. Pero aunque la banda era buena llevaban un tiempo en decadencia por falta de una buena vocalista. Fue con ella que todos ganaron, Belle se hizo famosa, y la banda regresó al estrellato como siempre debió ser. Su relación era especial porque juntos se habían superado a todos los niveles. Pero esa relación no duraría para siempre. Luego de llegar a un éxito muy alto Belle se casó, eso no afectó en nada a la banda ya que ella seguía activa como siempre. Lo que comenzó a romper un poco su relación musical fue que quedó embarazada sin previo aviso y sin preparación. Así que poco a poco necesitaba dedicar más tiempo a su gestación y cuidados y no podía estar tan activa como hacia unos meses atrás.
![ajoy-das-rmULKjr_I0M-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23y8yoKWquAMgHD3XeKacib3qg1GYVk9DjCXGLGRYG4Jb62AyYmd8B2uerdUm1JPU6syA.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> This began to bother the band, because they wanted her with them 24/7 and always available, as they had many projects underway and couldn't do them without the vocalist. They were so cynical that they even asked her not to have her baby. This angered Belle immensely, leading her to argue with them and put them in their place. While it didn't completely break their relationship, it severely strained it; the tension between them was palpable. They had to postpone certain projects many times while she was pregnant. Often, just to please them, Belle would go on stage to sing at eight months pregnant, even though she was no longer up for such a commotion. These appearances appeased them, but they showed her how little they valued her, because they didn't understand her. Then her youngest son was born, and that's when everything truly fell apart. At first, she couldn't continue singing or attend rehearsals because she had just given birth. Then she couldn't sing as much because she needed to make time for her son; she couldn't be on tour or rehearsing all the time. All these delays caused the band to implode; they didn't understand her. They were only focused on numbers, money, and efficiency. So they resented her for not being there when they needed her. So they simply fired her and found another vocalist, saying she was better and would always be there.

> Esto comenzó a incomodar a la banda, porque la querían 24/7 con ellos y que siempre estuviera disponibles, pues había muchos proyectos en marcha y no podían hacerlos sin la vocalista. Fueron tan cínicos que le llegaron a pedir que no tuviera su hijo. Eso enfadó muchísimo a Belle y la hizo discutir y ponerlos en su lugar. Pero eso no rompió completamente su relación, eso sí, la quebró gravemente, ya se sentía la tención entre ellos. Tuvieron que retrasar ciertos proyectos muchas veces mientras ella seguía en gestación. Muchas veces Belle por tal de quedar bien con ellos iba embarazada con 8 meses a cantar en el escenario, ya ella no estaba para tanto jaleo. Esas participaciones los tranquilizaba, pero le demostraban a ella lo poco que la valoraban, porque no la entendían. Luego de aquello nació su hijo pequeño, y aquí si se acabó de destruir todo. Al principio no pudo seguir cantando ni ir a los ensayos porque estaba recién dada a luz. Luego no podía cantar tanto porque debía sacar un poco de tiempo para su hijo, no podía estar de gira todo el tiempo o ensayando. Todos estos retrasos hicieron que la banda explotara, no la entendían. Ellos solo se concentraban en los números, el dinero y la eficiencia. Así que la despreciaban por no estar con ellos cuando hacia falta. Así que simplemente la despidieron, y se buscaron a otra vocalista, decían ellos que mejor y que siembre estuviera ahí.
![hoi-an-and-da-nang-photographer-Nzk9qFs43Wk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tvkxWea21SkVBr3giuHT5irt3nT5cr715iU7mtqNgGMpSVmPX8wmpLyQF3mBR65aDm2.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Belle felt hurt. They just needed to understand her and wait a little longer for her triumphant return, but they only wanted money and immediate results. Since there was no other option, she simply accepted what had happened and didn't dwell too much on the injustice they had done to her. When her son turned about five, she returned to music, just like before, but without neglecting her family. This time she did it as a solo artist; she set her own schedule, and no one told her what to do. She wouldn't make the same mistake of joining the wrong crowd; better alone than in bad company. Some time later, she reclaimed her place in the spotlight, as it always should have been and as she always was. She was killing it as a solo artist, and on top of that, she learned that her old band had just broken up because they never achieved success again, since their lead singer was never like her. Now she knows that justice has been served. If they had waited, they would still be with her at the top; now they are nothing. She will continue with her head held high, for herself and for her loved ones.

> Belle se sintió herida, solo debían entenderla y esperar un poco más para su regreso triunfal, pero ellos solo querían dinero y resultados inmediatos. Ya que no había de otra ella solo aceptó lo que había sucedido y no pensó tanto en la injustica que habían hecho con ella. Cuando su hijo cumplió unos 5 años ella regresó a la música, como antes, pero sin descuidar a su familia. Esta vez lo hizo como solista, ella ponía sus horarios, y nadie la mandaba. No cometería el mismo error de unirse a gente inadecuada, mejor sola que mal acompañada. Un tiempo después recuperó su puesto en el estrellato, como siempre debió ser y como ella siempre fue. La estaba rompiendo como solista, en cima se enteró que su vieja banda había acabado de desintegrarse porque nunca más triunfaron, pues su vocalista jamás era como ella. Ahora sabe que se hizo justicia, si hubieran esperado aún siguieran junto a ella en la cima, ahora ya no son nada. Ella con la frente en alto continuará, por ella, y por los suyos.
![ajoy-das-6EniFTfUn9A-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23yJLkGUwc1ZCXzeeRM32qx9XHgPVY8t5LBHzFMNuxHx1iwUpxTRKNuiuf5zGHupdXc9d.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

body.body:
# LIMA STREET DIARIES: THE HUMAN FRAMING IN THE CHAOS / EL ENCUADRE HUMANO EN EL CAOS [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>


![_DSC2082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23vsBsQcyAUwH3PtFF5Uh9jVgHbySnsDcTJJ2iwRuRK68Sr85xqFJsUyoZwwMGgvbvfht.jpg)


*“The heavy grain and the chaotic framing capture the raw reality of the working class.”*
*“El grano pesado y el encuadre caótico capturan la cruda realidad de la clase trabajadora.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello friends of the Black and White community! One more day, one more series from my projects. I am still shooting inside the *micros* (buses) because that is my main photographic spot lately. As I mentioned before, I am organizing all my photo archives to build a portfolio. My dream is to eventually put together an exhibition showing the best photos taken inside these buses over the years. 

Everything I find there interests me: those slightly uncomfortable portraits when a camera points at you inside the packed, sardine-like reality of Lima's buses. I don't know why I’ve become a bit obsessed with this theme. I think it’s because it allows me to observe the characters better and find a tighter, more compelling frame amidst the crowd. I absolutely love human framing and chaos. I am intentionally adding grain to my photographs to strip away that overly digital, ultra-sharp \

look that sometimes robs a photo of its purity. That grain, though it might not seem like it, adds a more realistic touch and connects deeper with the moment.

Those of us who travel by bus here are the proletariat, the working class, the ones who struggle day in and day out. We have to move in ways that are sometimes barely humane just to reach our jobs or places of study—especially since people here drive as if there were no tomorrow. All of this creates a crossroads of emotions and total chaos that ensures every single photograph tells a story: the rush, the exhaustion, the worry, or the occasional moment of relaxation. I hope you enjoy this series. As always, the best vibes to everyone. Until tomorrow, my friends!

### Español

¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro! Un día más, una serie más de mis proyectos. Sigo metido en los micros porque ese es mi punto fotográfico últimamente. Como les comenté, estoy organizando todos mi archivos de fotos para poder armar un portafolio; tengo el sueño de hacer una exposición con los años, reuniendo las mejores fotos en los micros. 

Todo lo que encuentro ahí me atrapa: esos retratos tan incómodos de cuando te apuntan con una cámara en medio de la incomodidad \

de los buses limeños. No sé por qué me he obsesionado un poco con ese tema; creo que es porque me permite observar mejor a los personajes y sacar un mejor encuadre en medio de la multitud. Me encanta el *framing* humano y el caos. Estoy tratando de añadirle grano a mis fotografías para quitarles lo digital y ese procesado tan \

que a veces le quita la pureza a la foto. Ese grano, aunque no parezca, le da un toque más realista y conecta más con el momento. Los que viajamos en bus acá somos el proletariado, la clase trabajadora, los que luchan día a día y tenemos que movernos de una manera a veces poco humana con tal de llegar a nuestros centros de trabajo o estudios. A eso hay que sumarle que acá manejan como si no existiera un mañana. Todo eso es un cruce de sentimientos y un caos total que hace que cada fotografía cuente una historia: el apuro, el cansancio, la preocupación, el relajo... todo en general. Espero que esta serie les guste y, como siempre, les dejo las mejores vibras a todos. ¡Hasta mañana, mis amigos! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)
## 🖼️ LA GALERÍA / THE GALLERY ![_DSC2125.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo6JR5YzMoJjPYqMnVDUoMrbjeDea56qm8LK6qV6sZxiXtuNRNJb6ce4ZBdbgHSvh5N.jpg)
![_DSC2124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo8QyU58T8eLRUdANPxyv9CrHZ8eLashnET1zCuoK9FwbWDCvMrNzyHJYNu4jd29eFs.jpg)
![_DSC2117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/EoEo6A7jvMMQpTza4WhXJtu3N8kAbH36V5V7CSJGopbrcxteuE6JitEdqwX7vpRWZEQ.jpg)

body.title: ‎The Hands That Hold Us
body.body:
‎
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎
‎Sometimes, the person giving you strength is secretly struggling to stay strong too. The one encouraging you not to give up might also be fighting a silent battles they never speak about. Life has taught me that not every smile means peace, and not every helper has everything figured out.
‎
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSW5V5Z5UspN5rsiDWAwPf1KAPhiHWQnPYB7FLt2bdmRj/IMG_20250904_160910_491.jpg 

‎
‎We sometimes become so focused on our own pain that we actually forget the people standing beside us are human too. We assume they can always carry more, give more, sacrifice more. But the truth is, even the strongest hearts get tired too. Even the loudest encouragers also cry in silence. Some people are surviving while aldo trying to help others survive too.
‎
‎That is why I have learned never to underestimate any help offered to me. A simple call, kind advice, financial support, prayers, or even someone checking up on you might have cost them more than you thought. What looks so little to you might have come from a place of deep sacrifice.
‎
‎Entitlement has a dangerous way of making us forget gratitude. The moment we begin to feel people owe us support, it's that moment that we stop appreciating their efforts. Nobody truly has it all together. Everyone is fighting a silent battle that the world cannot see. Some are battling fear, disappointment, loneliness, financial pressure, heartbreak, or emotional exhaustion behind closed doors.
‎
‎Yet , grace keeps carrying us somehow.
‎
‎That is why kindness truly matters. Patience matters. Gratitude matters. Be gentle with people because you do not know what they are going through internally. Appreciate those who show up for you, even when they are struggling for themselves.  People pouring into others are sometimes running on empty too.
‎
‎At the end of the day, none of us walks this journey alone. It is grace, mercy, and the support we give each other that keep us moving forward.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

body.title: People Change with Time ⏳
body.body:
There was a time when I used to believe that if someone smiled with you, talked to you every day, and stayed close during good moments, they would remain the same forever. But life slowly teaches us something different. People do not always change suddenly; sometimes time reveals who they truly were from the beginning.
I once had friends I trusted deeply. We shared long conversations, dreams, laughter, and even difficult moments together. At that time, I thought these bonds were permanent. But as life moved forward, priorities changed, distances grew, and silence replaced those daily talks. Some people who once promised loyalty slowly became strangers.
At first, it hurts. You question yourself. You wonder what went wrong and why people become cold after being so close. But with time, I realized that not everyone is meant to stay forever. Some people enter our lives only for a season. Their role is temporary, even if their words once sounded permanent.
The truth is, time is stronger than emotions.
Time tests every relationship quietly.
It shows who truly values you and who only enjoyed your presence for a moment.
I have seen people changing after success, after money, after fame, and even after meeting new people. Sometimes a person changes because life becomes hard, and sometimes they change because life becomes easy. Either way, change is unavoidable.
One thing I learned from experience is that we should never become completely dependent on people. Respect them, love them, care for them — but also understand that humans are unpredictable. Today someone may stand beside you, and tomorrow they may not even remember your struggles.
But this realization is not completely sad. In fact, it teaches maturity. It teaches us to appreciate genuine people more and to stop chasing temporary connections. The smaller the circle becomes, the more peaceful life feels.
Now I believe that loyalty is rare, honesty is valuable, and consistency is more important than beautiful words. Because words are easy to speak, but staying the same with someone through difficult times is what truly matters.
In the end, people change, situations change, and life keeps moving.
But the lessons we learn from those changes stay with us forever. ✨

body.title: Friendly match with a friend on efootball
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfGJ5eUMXckjd3H7adDwRQiWjT5uXyN5wksqAX7arunGR/img_3606.png)
_____________________________________________________


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcd6sJym28Ne8wKPkZPVbwC28q1uBhNkW9nbZYwc1ydmS/img_3620.png)

_____________________________________________________

I had a friendly match with my friend on eFootball today, and honestly it was a bit frustrating at first. I kept going for through balls every chance I got, thinking it would break his defense open. But if you check the clip, you’ll see what I mean. Almost every single through pass I tried, he read it and cut it off before it even got to my striker. It felt like I was rushing things instead of actually building up the play the way I should.

After a few failed attempts, I decided to slow down and just stick to normal passes. And that’s when things changed. He barely intercepted any of those, and I started finding more space to work with. Once I switched up my style, I ended up scoring two goals back to back. It got me thinking that through balls probably work only about half the time, while regular passes feel a lot safer, maybe around 75 percent. But at the same time, through balls make some plays look cleaner and faster, so I get why people still rely on them even with the risk.

One other thing that stood out was how good my friend was with dribbling. That’s actually how he got his only goal. He didn’t force it, he just waited for the right moment and made it count. Most of his passes were on point too, so he barely gave me a chance to press him. Playing against him made me realize that mixing up your passes and not overdoing the fancy stuff makes the game feel smoother. I guess the key is knowing when to play it safe and when to take the risk.
_____________________________________________________
MY GAME PLAY

body.title: Mango Season is here
body.body:
Hello Hive Fam!

I hope your day is going well and that you're having a good time. 

It is summer season in India, and it is also a season for the mango, which has just started, and this time it's really great. Although this is just the start of the season, and in the next one or two weeks, it is going to be even better, and I love it because I'm a big-time fan of mango fruit. It is one of the seasons that I wait for the entire year, and for the next one to two months, I am going to enjoy the mangoes every day. 


I try to enjoy every variety of the mango that is available nearby, and it's like I eat mangoes for two months and wait for ten months every year. I'm sure there are so many mango lovers, and I'm also one of them, but it is one of the fruits that I eagerly await every year for this season to start. There are many other fruits also, but honestly, I don't wait for them. But mango is a kind of fruit that is my favourite. I literally wait for the mango season every year.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/48QRmJwBFGVcUewMaW61zfP8KTitVbYNE8myHRZ3QVEQxQGZtEveqMnwDx4nu61Rw9.png)

Image created by GPT AI

I don't like summer, to be honest, but I like this weather just because this is the time when mango season starts, so the hot season is fine along with mango. It has got a lot of varieties available and different ways to eat mangoes, where some people prefer to have its juice or shake and also eat the fruit itself. no matter how you eat, because as long as you eat the fruit, it makes you feel good. And I'm really excited for another two months, because at least till the middle of July or maybe till the end of July, this will be available. So June and July are both going to be full of fun for me. Thank you!

body.title: Blazer-style medical gown with a princess cut - Diseño de Bata Médica Estilo Blazer con Corte Princesa

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbnjG8VKzNLi4PHr2DX9YXWTpXwrsNkgzuGfdBo6DHojJ/image.png)

Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well. I’m delighted to be back in my creative space after several days of working long hours in my profession. 

But I’ve returned to my favourite craft, which is sewing, and as a result I’ve made a doctor’s coat. I hope you like it! 

# Medical Fashion. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmchbcwcjL1eduZKcmNMkwej8MSuuT4TjdQaBEfRgu6GFV/image.png)

The design features a princess cut for this gown, which gives it a sophisticated touch and also flatters the female figure.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNS5GfKDtWDHoVNwxKqTBwts2LZETxCWJPqpFCADzhGs/image.png)

This is the first main layer of the robe. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtdyu4SPqh3ZaXJag1WFXHnapKTfPooiSebciqoJXsQ9/red_minimalist_fashion_presentation.gif)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUM5Pe1pZEDiWK4SrWKbRgRuUNEytBcztzD6qEr7jeuJm/red_minimalist_fashion_presentation_1_.gif)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPg7gotKrV8WGMkWEDxVyeFGo9i3271zUYfEZW2jmSykA/image.png)

This is the design for the doctor’s coat; I gradually tested the drape and the design of the coat. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXDaWVXhs4HqyeiedcRGn5iXX2j2oaUS8j1pCwe247Z9j/image.png)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRN8VJKnQDxbJWRfE2EeCuFspfSBRC4NDnFD3PXz1noqW/image.png)

This is the wonderful result I’ve achieved; I’m delighted with it. Despite everything, continuing to sew is something that really helps me relieve stress, even though I did get stressed at certain stages too. 😆

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfPqztBGQvqqgtASaM3h6gvhz69AxpjsmhbZdn5Wxd8BM/image.png)


***Thank you so much for this space and for letting me share my work with you!***

***

Pero he vuelto a mi oficio preferido que es coser, y como resultado de esto he realizado una bata médica. Espero que les guste!
