body.title: Things I hope to see and experience in the gameplay of Holozing
body.body:
![8513176a-f74a-4625-ac1e-0ab7ab38590a-md.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsZL5mfcexJzYGF1EtGV1svBQRD7fep5g8q1KfquqxhQCkvJatHpUSHajz61boHKgH9.jpeg)

---

I brought up Holozing again at work, and I think I’m gradually getting more people on board to join Hive though I’m not sure if they’re quite as sold on joining the actual Holozing video game just yet. It’s crazy, but there still isn't any actual gameplay footage available for it, so I guess it falls to me to write another post sharing my expectations.

Ever since I first discovered the Holozing project, one of the things that has caught my attention the most is its potential to offer a truly distinct experience within the world of blockchain gaming. Many games promise innovation, only to end up recycling the same old boring mechanics we’ve seen a thousand times before.

That’s why I have several expectations regarding what Holozing’s gameplay might look like and which elements could make it genuinely fun to play over the long haul.

---





![tr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/2432FMS8mZKqyydfikzUQTcjEwnqLBfJd8dhqvWL7QPA7JvUe5HDpwLd2phgiTQGKfTds.png)




---

### A Dynamic, Non Automated Combat System

One thing I’m really hoping for is that the combat sequences feature real action—rather than just being simple automated brawls where the player does nothing but stare at the screen. I’d love to see Holozing incorporate mechanics like dodging, timing based abilities, and a genuine need for strategic thinking during battles.

It would be fascinating if each creature possessed its own unique moves and distinct combat style. Some might be fast but fragile, while others could be slow but incredibly durable. This variety would ensure that encounters feel fresh and distinct, rather than becoming repetitive after just a few hours of gameplay. 

---

![f6edd71b-afb6-49a8-aafc-1950b4df4fe7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vi6UDArpEg2jd1cRdL5cepb8Zee61Vo6DyKHoTuez17M8rBngMZBm3y2x5vgAuA2au1.png)


---

I also believe that a robust elemental effects system would go a long way. For instance, fire creatures that can inflict burns, or electric creatures that can paralyze enemies for a few seconds. These are small details, but they give the gameplay much more personality.

# A World That Truly Invites Exploration

Another thing I hope to see from Holozing is an open or semi-open world where exploration actually feels meaningful. Many games claim to feature exploration, but ultimately, they turn out to be nothing more than empty maps with enemies placed at random.

I would love to stumble upon secret areas, discover rare hidden creatures, and encounter unexpected events as I traverse the map. Even small environmental details can make the game feel more alive. Just imagining mysterious forests, perilous caves, or bustling cities filled with trainers makes the project look incredibly promising in my mind.

---


![efd8e79b-12df-4684-a7ec-c80119875fbd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvcDH56n5QskK1DRAh7Sh6rVAMihf3YAxNEW3fpWYa98H2Voe2pcKqTZUWKbjBk6TUv.png)

---

Furthermore, I think the creature-capturing system should feel truly exciting. Encountering a rare creature ought to trigger that distinct sensation of, \

That very thrill is a fundamental part of what makes creature-collecting games so special. ### Customization and Connection with Creatures Something that is often underestimated is the emotional connection with the game's creatures. I hope Holozing allows for team customization, skill upgrades, and perhaps even appearance modifications through accessories or skins. --- ![3fb21759-9000-4def-b977-7d21d78f4ae6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvaMKJptAmbbsiyGg5udEZLMSz6NpRvU9MvWyvXUKKTLjjRy648N1638bYyxqvtfh4g.jpg) --- It would be great if each creature had its own unique animations, distinct behaviors, or even some form of interaction outside of combat. Little details—such as a creature reacting to its surroundings or following the player—can make it feel less like a mere NFT and more like a true in-game companion. I also hope that progression doesn't rely solely on spending money. If Holozing manages to strike a good balance in progression between free-to-play players and those who invest, it could build a much stronger and more enduring community. --- ![948b2dd4-ada2-4755-8f9b-998e47dae95f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQtCxoDdEKhdANvc7fTbpgDPiLs1PM3w6TYZDVojM9ZsBcabD6Enidd9GYKzMbzdPLF.png) --- ##### What I Believe Will Be Holozing's Biggest Challenge Honestly, I think Holozing's greatest challenge will be proving that it can be fun even for people who aren't interested in blockchain or cryptocurrencies. Many projects fail because they focus too heavily on the economics and forget the most important thing: the video game itself.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![8513176a-f74a-4625-ac1e-0ab7ab38590a-md.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsZL5mfcexJzYGF1EtGV1svBQRD7fep5g8q1KfquqxhQCkvJatHpUSHajz61boHKgH9.jpeg) --- Volvi a hablar de holozing en el trabajo y creo que cada vez estoy agarrando a mas personas a que se unan a hive, aunque no se si estan tan seguros de unirse al videojuego de holozing, es loco pero todavia no hay un gameplay de estos por lo que me toca hacer otro post sobre mis expectativas Desde que conocí el proyecto de Holozing, una de las cosas que más me llama la atención es su potencial para ofrecer una experiencia diferente dentro del mundo de los videojuegos blockchain. Muchos juegos prometen innovación, pero terminan repitiendo las mismas mecánicas aburridas de siempre. Por eso, tengo varias expectativas sobre cómo podría ser el gameplay de Holozing y qué elementos podrían hacerlo realmente divertido a largo plazo. --- ![tr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/2432FMS8mZKqyydfikzUQTcjEwnqLBfJd8dhqvWL7QPA7JvUe5HDpwLd2phgiTQGKfTds.png) --- ### Un sistema de combate dinámico y no automático Algo que espero muchísimo es que los combates tengan acción real y no sean simples peleas automáticas donde el jugador solo mira la pantalla. Me gustaría que Holozing tenga esquivas, habilidades con timing y cierta necesidad de estrategia durante las batallas. Sería interesante que cada criatura tenga movimientos únicos y estilos distintos. Algunas podrían ser rápidas pero frágiles, mientras otras serían lentas pero resistentes. Eso haría que los enfrentamientos se sientan diferentes y no repetitivos después de unas horas. --- ![f6edd71b-afb6-49a8-aafc-1950b4df4fe7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vi6UDArpEg2jd1cRdL5cepb8Zee61Vo6DyKHoTuez17M8rBngMZBm3y2x5vgAuA2au1.png) --- También creo que un buen sistema de efectos elementales ayudaría bastante. Por ejemplo, criaturas de fuego que puedan dejar quemaduras o criaturas eléctricas que paralicen enemigos por unos segundos. Son detalles pequeños, pero hacen que el gameplay tenga más personalidad. # Un mundo que realmente invite a explorar Otra cosa que espero de Holozing es un mundo abierto o semiabierto donde explorar tenga sentido. Muchos juegos dicen tener exploración, pero al final solo son mapas vacíos con enemigos colocados al azar. Me gustaría encontrar zonas secretas, criaturas raras escondidas y eventos inesperados mientras recorremos el mapa. Incluso pequeños detalles ambientales pueden hacer que el juego se sienta más vivo. Imaginar bosques misteriosos, cuevas peligrosas o ciudades llenas de entrenadores ya hace que el proyecto se vea prometedor en mi cabeza. --- ![efd8e79b-12df-4684-a7ec-c80119875fbd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvcDH56n5QskK1DRAh7Sh6rVAMihf3YAxNEW3fpWYa98H2Voe2pcKqTZUWKbjBk6TUv.png) --- Además, creo que el sistema de captura debería sentirse emocionante. Encontrar una criatura rara tendría que generar esa sensación de “no puedo perder esta oportunidad”. Esa emoción es parte de lo que hace especiales a los juegos de colección de criaturas. ### Personalización y conexión con las criaturas Algo que muchas veces se subestima es la conexión emocional con las criaturas del juego. Espero que Holozing permita personalizar equipos, mejorar habilidades y quizá hasta modificar apariencias con accesorios o skins. --- ![3fb21759-9000-4def-b977-7d21d78f4ae6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvaMKJptAmbbsiyGg5udEZLMSz6NpRvU9MvWyvXUKKTLjjRy648N1638bYyxqvtfh4g.jpg) --- Sería genial que cada criatura tenga animaciones propias, comportamientos distintos o incluso alguna interacción fuera del combate. Pequeñas cosas como que una criatura reaccione al entorno o acompañe al jugador pueden hacer que se sienta menos como un simple NFT y más como un compañero dentro del juego. También espero que el progreso no dependa únicamente de gastar dinero. Si Holozing logra equilibrar bien la progresión para jugadores gratuitos y jugadores que invierten, podría construir una comunidad mucho más fuerte y duradera. --- ![948b2dd4-ada2-4755-8f9b-998e47dae95f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQtCxoDdEKhdANvc7fTbpgDPiLs1PM3w6TYZDVojM9ZsBcabD6Enidd9GYKzMbzdPLF.png) --- ##### Lo que pienso será el reto mas importante de holozing Sinceramente, creo que el mayor desafío de Holozing será demostrar que puede ser divertido incluso para personas que no están interesadas en blockchain o criptomonedas. Muchos proyectos fallan porque se enfocan demasiado en la economía y olvidan lo más importante: el videojuego.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYS2XCYBX1oHo1FGHPrL7zjrZAgkKAEy1RwoVfbdkDWs/DIV1.gif</center>

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/acpd3UXQdmw

<div class=\

>

For years, even decades, you have been giving everything away for **free** and now you will have to pay the **price of that.** You have freely given away your private data and personal information. Your tastes, your habits, your preferences, your desires, your dreams, your aspirations, your needs. What you have, what you don't have and what you would like to have. And the time has come when you will now have to pay whatever **price** they set, however they set it, whenever they set it and however and whenever they wish to set it. And now is not time for lamenting, it's time to defend yourself and act intelligently.

https://youtu.be/NypgDiLI6ho

<div class=\

>

Surveillance pricing is a data-driven pricing strategy where retailers use personal data such as location, browsing history, and purchasing habits to set **individualized prices** and charging consumers the maximum they are likely willing to pay. It differs from dynamic pricing by targeting specific users rather than adjusting for general market demand.

### Key Aspects of Surveillance Pricing:

- **Data Utilization:** *Algorithms analyze data points like device type, income level and even location (e.g., charging more if you are already in a store's parking lot)*

- **Individualized Pricing:** *Two people may see different prices for the exact same item at the same time.*

- **Profit Maximization:** *The goal is to identify and exploit the peak price point a customer will accept, often leading to higher costs for consumers, particularly on essentials.*

### Risks and Concerns:

- **Privacy & Discrimination:** *It raises significant privacy concerns and can lead to algorithmic discrimination or digital redlining.*

- **Hidden Costs:** *The practice is often invisible, making it difficult for consumers to compare prices or realize they are being overcharged.*

- **Financial Impact:** *Research shows this can increase annual expenses for some consumers by over $1,200.*

### Regulatory Response:

- **Legal Scrutiny:** *As of early 2026, bans and regulations are being introduced, with New York state leading by requiring disclosure: \

*

- **Active Investigations:** *Policymakers, such as in New York and Maryland, are focusing on restricting this practice in retail, particularly at grocery stores.*

https://youtu.be/uHSo2P5dnbs

<div class=\

>

Yeah, once upon a time when today's biggest corporations and moguls of the internet like Google, Meta, Apple, Amazon and many others, together with the largest telco operators on the planet, even considered giving away cell phones to everyone for free in exchange for you subscribing to their services for as long as possible.

The cost of producing the hardware for them was truly negligible, and therefore they were willing to give it away to everyone for free if it meant they could trap you and every other being on earth in their greedy clutches to snoop around your life, extract all the personal and private information they could obtain and exploit that extremely **valuable asset** for their exclusive benefit. What was always a wet dream for the advertising industry.

Yeah, the Mercenary Advertising Industry that actually prostituted the internet.

> Many critics, researchers, and users argue that the advertising industry has severely degraded—or [\

](https://www.thelivingphilosophy.com/p/the-day-the-internet-died)—the internet, transforming it from a tool for information sharing into a space dominated by surveillance, manipulation, and intrusive commercialism. The core of this issue lies in the shift toward behavioral targeting, which has led to a model that prioritizes **profit** over user experience, privacy and wellbeing.

And it's not that it's already too late to react, defend yourself and protect yourself. Nope. But you certainly need to learn to be more aware of what you do with your cell phone, smartphone, or computer when you're online. Or for that matter, anywhere else.

**They** already know they have you under surveillance and scrutiny without you even knowing it and they are sure they have you by the balls with every move you make. body.body:
# Grok

**Source:** https://grok.com/c/41fcca9b-6223-46f8-aa74-a81b12871cf5?rid=5e50cd62-73fa-4627-a716-9156ab51760c

The equation ∇×A=B  \nabla \times \mathbf{A} = \mathbf{B}   states that the magnetic field B  \mathbf{B}   is the curl of the magnetic vector potential A  \mathbf{A}  .
This is not just a mathematical trick — it is a fundamental and always-true relation in electromagnetism (both classical and quantum). It follows directly from one of Maxwell’s equations.
Why This Relation Exists
One of Maxwell’s equations (Gauss’s law for magnetism) is:
∇⋅B=0\nabla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0
This says the magnetic field has no sources or sinks (no magnetic monopoles). A mathematical identity tells us that the divergence of any curl is always zero:
∇⋅(∇×F)=0for any vector field F\nabla \cdot (\nabla \times \mathbf{F}) = 0 \quad \text{for any vector field } \mathbf{F}
Therefore, we can always write B  \mathbf{B}   as the curl of some vector field A  \mathbf{A}  :
B=∇×A\mathbf{B} = \nabla \times \mathbf{A}
A  \mathbf{A}   is called the vector potential. It is an auxiliary field we introduce to simplify calculations.
Definitions of Each Term









































Explicit Form of the Curl (Cartesian Coordinates)
The equation ∇×A=B  \nabla \times \mathbf{A} = \mathbf{B}   expands component-wise to:
Bx=∂Az∂y−∂Ay∂zBy=∂Ax∂z−∂Az∂xBz=∂Ay∂x−∂Ax∂y\begin{align}
B_x &= \frac{\partial A_z}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial A_y}{\partial z} \\
B_y &= \frac{\partial A_x}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial A_z}{\partial x} \\
B_z &= \frac{\partial A_y}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial A_x}{\partial y}
\end{align}
This is how you compute the magnetic field once you know A  \mathbf{A}  .
Important Properties of A  \mathbf{A}  

Gauge freedom — A  \mathbf{A}   is not unique. You can add the gradient of any scalar function χ  \chi   without changing B  \mathbf{B}  :A′=A+∇χ⇒∇×A′=∇×A=B\mathbf{A}' = \mathbf{A} + \nabla \chi \quad \Rightarrow \quad \nabla \times \mathbf{A}' = \nabla \times \mathbf{A} = \mathbf{B}This is called a gauge transformation. Common choices:
Coulomb gauge: ∇⋅A=0  \nabla \cdot \mathbf{A} = 0   (very useful in magnetostatics and quantum mechanics)
Lorenz gauge: ∇⋅A+1c2∂ϕ∂t=0  \nabla \cdot \mathbf{A} + \frac{1}{c^2} \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial t} = 0   (used in full electromagnetic waves)

How to find A  \mathbf{A}   from currents (magnetostatics):A(r)=μ04π∫J(r′)∣r−r′∣ dV′\mathbf{A}(\mathbf{r}) = \frac{\mu_0}{4\pi} \int \frac{\mathbf{J}(\mathbf{r}')}{|\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{r}'|} \, dV'Once you have A  \mathbf{A}  , you get B  \mathbf{B}   by taking its curl (this automatically satisfies ∇⋅B=0  \nabla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0  ).
Relation to the electric field (time-dependent case):The full electromagnetic potentials are linked to both fields:B=∇×A,E=−∇ϕ−∂A∂t\mathbf{B} = \nabla \times \mathbf{A}, \qquad
\mathbf{E} = -\nabla \phi - \frac{\partial \mathbf{A}}{\partial t}where ϕ  \phi   is the scalar electric potential.

Why We Use the Vector Potential

It automatically satisfies ∇⋅B=0  \nabla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0  .
It simplifies the formulation of Maxwell’s equations (especially in the Lagrangian and Hamiltonian of charged particles).
It is essential in quantum mechanics — the Schrödinger equation for a charged particle in a magnetic field uses A  \mathbf{A}   (the kinetic momentum becomes p−qA  \mathbf{p} - q\mathbf{A}  ).
It appears in the Aharonov–Bohm effect, where particles feel the effect of A  \mathbf{A}   even in regions where B=0  \mathbf{B} = 0  .

Summary































Bottom line: The equation ∇×A=B  \nabla \times \mathbf{A} = \mathbf{B}   tells us that the magnetic field is fundamentally a rotational field that can be derived from a more fundamental potential A  \mathbf{A}  . This is one of the most powerful and widely used relations in all of electromagnetism and quantum field theory.

body.title: Greece The Great Come Back
body.body:
Today I’m going to talk about an incredible comeback that… literally nobody saw coming.

Let’s go back to 2015. Greeks wake up to closed banks and capital controls. ATMs have a €60 daily withdrawal limit, the Athens Stock Exchange does not even open for trading, and Greece becomes the first member of the Eurozone to fall into junk status.

Everyone had written the country off. And now? The Athens Stock Exchange has outperformed the Nasdaq 100 over a five year period. Yes, you read that right.

## THE FREE FALL

To understand how massive this turnaround really is, we first need to remember where it all started. In April and June of 2010, S&P and Moody’s downgraded Greece to junk. The first Eurozone country to lose investment grade status. And from there, the collapse began.

By February 2016, the General Index had fallen to 516.7 points. Down from the 5,334.5 points it reached in October 2007. We are talking about a decline of more than 90%.

And where was the biggest damage done? The banks. The banking index had lost 99.6% of its value. It had practically been wiped out, with non performing loans reaching 47% of total portfolios in 2016. The worst figure in the entire European Union.

To put that into perspective, other troubled banking markets in Europe were sitting around 5% to 8%. Greece was at 47%. “How is that even possible?” you might ask. Put simply, Greek banks did not just have a loan problem. They had an entire recession sitting on their balance sheets.

And this is exactly where the Hercules program entered the picture. Through state guarantees on senior tranches, the banks managed to offload roughly €57 billion of bad loans through securitizations. Then came the second phase. The slow, boring, but critical work. Stabilizing deposits. Cutting costs. Returning to profitability.

And they succeeded. The combined net profits of the four systemic banks, National Bank of Greece, Eurobank, Piraeus, and Alpha Bank, reached nearly €5 billion in 2025. Then came the dividends. Piraeus, Eurobank, and Alpha distributed around 55% of profits. National Bank pushed its payout ratio to 86%, helped significantly by buybacks.

And the stocks now? National Bank and Piraeus are both up more than 500% over the last five years. And do you know what is even crazier? Despite this explosive rally, the banks still look cheap. They trade at around 9 times 2026 earnings and 1.4 times tangible book value. Nearly 20% below European banks. UBS estimates a 2027 P/E ratio of 8.4 compared to 9.5 for the European average. And for the full picture, U.S. stocks are trading near 20 times forward earnings. That is a massive valuation gap.

## THE QUIET HERO

But there is another factor that almost nobody talks about. And it is the one the IMF itself called the “quiet engine.”

We are talking about the transformation of the Greek tax administration. In a paper published last week, three IMF economists analyzed how the entire system changed across three phases.

Phase one: 2010 to 2012, stabilizing revenues.

Phase two: 2013 to 2017, consolidating 288 local offices into 119 and creating the Independent Authority for Public Revenue in 2016.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmajXcqSvupX3MsG7CXyZjoxuvoTWwsksCwTcx9Z4vRnt5/image.png)


Phase three: from 2018 onward, real time electronic invoicing, POS integration, and digital analytics.

And the results? VAT compliance rose from 65% in 2010 to 96% in 2014. VAT revenues increased from 7.1% of GDP to 9.5% today. And the total tax to GDP ratio climbed from 20.5% in 2009 to 28% in 2025.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxKjsGbuvYdK2hmNy7t5vrXcP2DXP3783dDHKA8gnVye/image.png)


So what does that actually mean? A primary surplus close to 5% of GDP in both 2024 and 2025. Greece is now one of the few EU countries running a fiscal surplus. And the debt? From a peak of 210% of GDP in 2020, it fell to 145% in 2025.

In 2025 alone, debt dropped by 10 percentage points. As a result, all the major rating agencies have restored Greece to investment grade status.

## THE NEW ERA

And this is where things get even more interesting.

On November 24, 2025, Euronext completed the acquisition of the Athens Stock Exchange, with an acceptance rate of around 74%. The Greek market is now part of Europe’s largest exchange group, alongside more than 1,800 listed companies. What does that mean in practice? Far more buyers. International index funds that track pan European benchmarks automatically add Greek stocks to their portfolios.

And MSCI is considering upgrading Greece to Developed Market status, effective from September 2026. That means Greece would leave the small emerging markets basket and enter the massive pool of developed markets. JP Morgan is already forecasting a 16% gain for MSCI Greece in 2026.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaP1qLP4jJe9mHS612ix8Kp9BSutK2ZbMgD9gJU2KKN7R/image.png)


Of course, not everything is perfect. Inflation remains elevated, tensions in the Middle East continue, tourism still accounts for 21% of GDP, and the Recovery Fund expires in August 2026.

body.title: ‎Why Jarrod Bowen Is the Kind of Player Every Big Club Needs ‎
body.body:
‎I know £100 million actually sounds like a crazy amount of money in today’s football market, especially for a player coming from a club fighting to survive relegation. But if there is one thing I can say honestly about Jarrod Bowen, it is that quality always speaks for itself.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSfdZM4uXq6eNAb5QMGDweBsGA1U2q9gZzWce9Bh4BmxV/skysports-jarrod-bowen-west-ham_7253216.jpg 

‎
‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11685/13545923/jarrod-bowen-west-ham-captain-says-premier-league-relegation-worries-were-starting-to-creep-in-last-season&ved=2ahUKEwjP2Mj5wsiUAxUVX0EAHbOJOpoQr4kDegQIJhAA&usg=AOvVaw21Z3fVbUAp_yqODSYuWFey)
‎
‎I have watched Bowen closely for years now, and he keeps proving why so many top clubs admire him every season. He is not just another winger who depends only on pace but he plays with purpose, intelligence, aggression, and confidence. He is the type of player that gives defenders problems from the first minute to the last. His movement, finishing, work rate, and direct style are qualities every top team wants in attack.
‎
‎Seeing clubs like Chelsea, Liverpool, and Manchester United interested in him honestly does not surprise me at all. Bowen has developed into a leader at West Ham, and wearing the captain’s armband has shown another side of his game. He takes responsibility when things get difficult, and those are the kinds of players that usually succeed at the biggest clubs.
‎
‎As a Chelsea fan, I would genuinely love to see him at Stamford Bridge. Even though some people may disagree with me, but I honestly feel Bowen would improve Chelsea’s attack immediately. For me, he is more direct, more attacking-minded, and more technical in dangerous areas than Pedro Neto. Neto is a good player, no doubt, but Bowen brings more end product and consistency. He knows how to create moments that change games.
‎
‎What I admire most about Bowen is his mentality. He never hides in matches. Even when West Ham struggle, he still fights, presses, creates chances, and pushes the team forward. Those are the players supporters connect with because they play with heart and determination.
‎
‎The £100 million fee may still scare clubs away, and I completely understand why. Even though no team will pay such price and I know west ham are just don't want him to go a cheap because he is currently their best player. Football prices today are unbelievable. I believe that any club buying him are not just buying a winger but they are buying leadership, experience, goals, creativity, and a player capable of making a real difference at the highest level.
‎
‎For me, Jarrod Bowen is worth admiring because he plays football with courage and personality, and that is something every great team needs and I will be very much happy to see him at Stamford bridge.
‎

body.title: There is a limit to the function of our body
body.body:
Most times when I wake up in the morning, my wish will always be that I wish we had more than twenty-four hours. I am the only one feeling that twenty-four hours is not enough time. The moment you wake up to their list of things waiting for you before the end of the day, you will feel like you didn’t do enough. Most of the time we feel that way not because the time is not enough; the problem is we want to work round the clock, which means we are trying to work beyond our physical and emotional limits. The fun thing is we will never admit that we are overworking.





Recently the situation that creates this feeling of doing too much for me is that there is a lot of responsibility on my shoulders; finding a way to balance many responsibilities always lands me doing more whenever I remember that I have to succeed financially for my family and people around me. The pressure to keep doing more increases. Most times I will work around the clock. We are in a society where when you are resting you are seen as a lazy person. I keep pushing and hustling even when my physical body has gotten to its limit.




![IMG_1012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23w2wdjiKTKQFJeNRb1nGfkDaNgXKgu8KB9uLMkPNj2YG53SkQ7vHLtStXudLyNNuRCwz.jpeg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/clock-ladies-pocket-watch-time-2133825/)

We always feel like we are doing too much because of emotional responsibilities inside you. There is this feeling that you are carrying a lot on your shoulders; there are times you are the hero of everyone around you. You see yourself doing more than you should do to make people around you happy and comfortable; you solve problems, listening to their problems and helping the little way you can. For over three years now I have been carrying family burdens. Currently now I neglect my emotional needs. I do all this to make sure that family is okay and appreciates my effort to them. I am functioning well, but inside me I am completely empty.







Financial pressure may seem like nothing, but the pressure coming from it unmeasurably majority of us are constantly hustling, pushing stability, trying every possible way to survive the fear that we don’t want to fail or you don’t want to disappoint family, pushing many into unhealthy routines. For someone like me, I sacrifice most of the things I enjoy doing because I want to be productive.



![IMG_1013.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23wCJJP8cVRGnF2GoGECJT6Z5yJmokhC8N4Bj6V1j2E8AcxApNr8JHXGCxbke61siVGZi.jpeg)



[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/partnership-connectedness-people-2750197/)



We so much believe that if we slow down, it will hinder us from being successful. This still remains the truth; we are not machines. We need proper sleep and rest and to take proper care of ourselves; we deserve it. There is a limit to the function of our body; we should not overwork it. Take a break when necessary. Don't say it is laziness; sleep is very important. It will help to put your body and soul together, and when you wake up, you will be more productive.



This is my entry on the weekly prompts #ladiesofhive #289.



Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day ahead.

body.title: Multipolarised World
body.body: >\n\nI was reading about a meeting in China with Russia, straight after the meeting in China with the US, the two leaders described it as a \

which means that the US is no longer the dominant force, or is at least on the decline. As far as decentralisation of power goes, this is a good thing, but as far as humanity goes, it it is akin to instead of being chased by a hungry lion on the tundra whilst having a broken leg, there are three hungry lions chasing, all wanting a piece of you.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242hMuLDVQ8ptwjzycw8ubTLczDfDhcMYB6T6y1FsKw6T6P68cUAe2aMJHMCkn4pafYFE.png)

---

> Humanity is doomed.

Because this isn't decentralisation of power globally, it is centralisation of power into the hands of opposing forces who *don't give a damn* about humanity. And don't be fooled by whatever party you support, or whatever country you are in, the current government and the current opposition to the government, give as much of a shit about you as Nike does about your feet, or McDonald's does about your waistline. 

> Zero shits given.

The rest of us are just the \

collateral that gets damaged in the powerplays between the poles. The iron fillings that will be forced to bend to the will of polarisation, whether we want to be involved or not. Are we meant to just resign ourselves to becoming cannon fodder and go on about our days, chasing some sold dream that will forever be out of our reach? Are we meant to just give up? 

> I am not sure.

Because the current trajectory the world is taking with velocity, is very likely toward the demise of humanity, and the only way to change course is to wrest control away from those who keep us on this path. The same ones involved in conditioning us to supporting them, and the corporations who are making us suffer for profit. It is like we have Stockholm syndrome, where we are now so accustomed to the abuse, we are empathetic toward the perpetrators. We keep hoping they will change.

> They cannot.

Because the way they are structured will always lead to abuse, because they are incentivised to do *exactly* what they are doing. The only difference between the level of abuse between one country and another, is the timeline and opportunity. Give enough time and opportunity, and all governments will move toward dictatorship. Because just like money begets money, power begets power, and the power-hungry are the ones making the rules and enforcing them, even though they do not follow them themselves. 

> In what world does a President sue his own government?

*This world.*

And even though the case was frivolous and would have been thrown out of court, the case was settled prior to trial. The term for the government would be kleptocracy and the oligarchy is gathering the wagons - Putin would be proud. 

I write about these things knowing it doesn't make an iota of difference, but I just don't feel good turning a blind eye to it and pretending it isn't happening. Because I will *still be affected* anyway, I just wouldn't know the cause of my suffering. There are lots of people like that, and they tend to be the ones who are blaming the wrong targets, while supporting the actual root of their problems. 

> If I am going to be miserable, I would rather know why. 

And there will be many who disagree with me and think the world is filled with rainbows and sunshine and \

will overcome all obstacles. *It will not.* Those hungry lions don't give a damn about what we think, they just want to fill their belly with our meat - they'll eat the broken leg too. body.title: Zoo Santo Inácio - Portugal
body.body:
Hi, I hope you're all well 😃 Today I'm going to tell you about my weekend outing 😃 Last weekend I went to the Santo Inácio Zoo. I hadn't been there a few years ago, about 10, and it's changed so much!!! I made this collage so you can see the variety of places they have there!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZPzZ2pGBsoJeCFnMvc57AoYzp85RJv2FV7aR4Jx65yYX/1779298547761.jpg)

The first stop is mandatory 😃 look at these cute animals, the meerkats. It's impossible not to stop and look, some perched on tree trunks, super attentive to everything around them, and others on the ground peeking out too. Meerkats are super curious animals.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRFjS7Qf14hj1apD37VzxfAmwkDGEhGrFBXXHa93j12V4/1779298547805.jpg)

Look at this meerkat on guard right near its burrow. These animals are true guardians.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHnKhZdrRkYim7Er546UnUGaWwB2KyCnGaqciT9ji2qU/1779298547839.jpg)

Further on, I saw this very educational area that caught my attention. The zoo alerts us to a very serious problem: deforestation in Portugal, as in the rest of the world. It makes us reflect on our actions and the importance and duty we have to preserve natural habitats.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmciUTNxKJR1Upbr4cXZXvzqx3PGRjwCV5HrMnAJ9uHHmF/1779298520956.jpg)

The monkey part was my favorite. The monkeys really do have things that are similar to our knowledge; we caught them in weekend mode, they were very relaxed 😂 They had many monkeys and many of them were resting 😂 There was a baby monkey there playing with its mother, and the mother just wanted to sleep 😂 They have the same behaviors similar to ours.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjv1DXYkG7b6bqFHSLFU2bjD4gymJGH66ALw7V57mEfy/1779298521087.jpg)

Further on we see the famous Lemur forest, and how incredible it was! 😃 There were many perched in their wooden houses high in the trees, and then several sitting amidst the vegetation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYEWbtkMbV1DzTamexm3z2LmL9w892PySgrUWVQd1u1U5/1779298370970.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6cpcsZomRVkXaL9UB7nwhTqaxWCiw5qVxV4nwuZE18K/1779298520881.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4KzqbaivjpobTWNEaibULe4hsDBkx5hFXS1VWe6sy2u/1779298521212.jpg)

Here we have a little corner full of rabbits, they were all very entertained, some eating straw together at the feeder, others jumping around, and some resting and sunbathing 😃

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapa2Um937VK1Pt2ABEr14A5ZYQ1QMvLXn6jBVCvwzFKm/1779298521245.jpg)

This photograph is very beautiful; it shows the interaction between the animals and those who work here, feeding them and giving them lots of love 😍 as soon as they saw how they treated the donkeys that came for the hiring process. It's wonderful to see that the animals here are very well cared for 😃

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNuamfPhxhe6hGuPNdpVSn22fQf9LTkbdTp5V9vUHcMie/1779298370752.jpg)

I also loved watching the goats and sheep being fed 😃 their enclosure is super spacious and has a wooden tower that they love. These animals bring so much life to this zoo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeznHkJkYpqAz8CGxMiATySTNwN4jfzrbymsnvpEXnjH1/1779298370530.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9iE6zkQUdnqLFVdpeD3yPbPFfdG2SoEJ8nwhixzKUVr/1779298370653.jpg)

I discovered this pig that was having its lunch 😂 it was eating very slowly 😋 what a wonderful lunch, very fresh, high-quality fruit 😋

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNi6AKiavEbvNznHKmcuC4A1LRKncjELKCLubzyVun5m5/1779298303645.jpg)

Here we have tropical birds, each one more beautiful than the next. Here I saw birds that even scared me because of how big they were, they were really big, I didn't even know that birds of that size existed, and on top of that, there were really live nuclei, and there were several nuclei, those birds were so beautiful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMBcKMYr1D5ioVKFYAqx7aUYbBU8Rkiy4m5sRMHJpUVR/1779298303358.jpg)

Look, I managed to find the red panda. Pandas usually spend the day sleeping perched in the trees high up. I was so happy to see the red panda.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6QRzqHB6Pb2NNQnhBoykFs8U9S7D1frPppQy7v17dkU/1779298370860.jpg)

I hope you enjoyed it, see you soon friends 😃





Olá, espero que estejam todos bem 😃 Hoje vou falar-vos do meu passeio do fim de semana 😃 No fim de semana passado, fui ao Jardim Zoológico de Santo Inácio. Já não ia lá há uns 10 anos, e mudou tanto!!! Fiz esta colagem para verem a variedade de locais que lá existem!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZPzZ2pGBsoJeCFnMvc57AoYzp85RJv2FV7aR4Jx65yYX/1779298547761.jpg)

A primeira paragem é obrigatória 😃 Vejam só estes bichinhos fofos, os suricatas! É impossível não parar para olhar, uns empoleirados em troncos de árvores, super atentos a tudo à volta, e outros no chão, a espreitar também. Os suricatas são animais super curiosos.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRFjS7Qf14hj1apD37VzxfAmwkDGEhGrFBXXHa93j12V4/1779298547805.jpg)

Veja este suricata de guarda bem perto da sua toca. Estes animais são verdadeiros guardiões.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHnKhZdrRkYim7Er546UnUGaWwB2KyCnGaqciT9ji2qU/1779298547839.jpg)

Mais à frente, deparei-me com uma área muito educativa que me chamou a atenção. O jardim zoológico alerta-nos para um problema muito grave: a desflorestação em Portugal, tal como no resto do mundo. Faz-nos refletir sobre as nossas ações e sobre a importância e o dever que temos de preservar os habitats naturais.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmciUTNxKJR1Upbr4cXZXvzqx3PGRjwCV5HrMnAJ9uHHmF/1779298520956.jpg)

A parte dos macacos foi a minha preferida. Os macacos têm realmente características semelhantes às que conhecemos; fomos buscá-los num fim de semana tranquilo, estavam muito relaxados 😂 Havia muitos macacos e muitos deles estavam a descansar 😂 Tinha um filhote a brincar com a mãe, e a mãe só queria dormir 😂 Têm comportamentos muito semelhantes aos nossos.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjv1DXYkG7b6bqFHSLFU2bjD4gymJGH66ALw7V57mEfy/1779298521087.jpg)

Mais adiante, vemos a famosa floresta de lémures, e como era incrível! 😃 Havia muitos empoleirados nas suas casas de madeira no cimo das árvores, e vários outros sentados no meio da vegetação.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYEWbtkMbV1DzTamexm3z2LmL9w892PySgrUWVQd1u1U5/1779298370970.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6cpcsZomRVkXaL9UB7nwhTqaxWCiw5qVxV4nwuZE18K/1779298520881.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4KzqbaivjpobTWNEaibULe4hsDBkx5hFXS1VWe6sy2u/1779298521212.jpg)

Aqui temos um cantinho cheio de coelhos, todos muito entretidos, uns a comer palha juntos no comedouro, outros a saltar por aí, e alguns a descansar e a apanhar sol 😃

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapa2Um937VK1Pt2ABEr14A5ZYQ1QMvLXn6jBVCvwzFKm/1779298521245.jpg)

Esta fotografia é muito bonita; mostra a interação entre os animais e os que aqui trabalham, alimentando-os e dando-lhes muito carinho 😍 assim que viram como tratavam os burros que vieram para o processo de recrutamento. É maravilhoso ver que os animais aqui são tão bem cuidados 😃

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNuamfPhxhe6hGuPNdpVSn22fQf9LTkbdTp5V9vUHcMie/1779298370752.jpg)

Também adorei ver as cabras e ovelhas a serem alimentadas 😃 o seu recinto é super espaçoso e tem uma torre de madeira que elas adoram. Estes animais trazem muita vida a este jardim zoológico.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeznHkJkYpqAz8CGxMiATySTNwN4jfzrbymsnvpEXnjH1/1779298370530.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9iE6zkQUdnqLFVdpeD3yPbPFfdG2SoEJ8nwhixzKUVr/1779298370653.jpg)

Descobri este porco a almoçar 😂 estava a comer muito devagar 😋 que almoço maravilhoso, fruta fresca e de ótima qualidade 😋

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNi6AKiavEbvNznHKmcuC4A1LRKncjELKCLubzyVun5m5/1779298303645.jpg)

Aqui temos aves tropicais, cada uma mais bela que a outra. Vi aves que até me assustaram de tão grandes que eram, eram mesmo enormes, nem sabia que existiam aves deste tamanho, e além disso, existiam núcleos vivos, e vários núcleos, estas aves eram tão bonitas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMBcKMYr1D5ioVKFYAqx7aUYbBU8Rkiy4m5sRMHJpUVR/1779298303358.jpg)

Olha, consegui encontrar o panda-vermelho! Os pandas passam geralmente o dia a dormir empoleirados no alto das árvores. Fiquei tão feliz por ver o panda-vermelho!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6QRzqHB6Pb2NNQnhBoykFs8U9S7D1frPppQy7v17dkU/1779298370860.jpg)

Espero que tenham gostado, até breve, amigos 😃

body.title: Terror nocturno (Night terror) [ES/EN]
body.body:
> «Cariño, buen día. ¿Cómo amaneciste?». Harold servía un poco de cereal a su esposa. «Terrible, no puedo conciliar el sueño. No sé qué voy a hacer». Mary mostraba un gesto angustiado. «Debemos consultar a un médico. Es un problema muy serio». Harold mira preocupado a su esposa. «Sabes que no me gusta mucho ir donde los médicos, le tengo pavor». Mary sentía un escalofrío recorriendo su cuerpo. «No tienes opción, de lo contrario será un gran problema el que tendremos». Harold miraba seriamente a Mary. «No te preocupes, lo haré, pero dame tiempo para asimilar todo». Mary mostraba una sonrisa y se iba a bañar. «¡Te doy una semana, no lo olvides!». Los días pasaban y Mary seguía con su problema de insomnio. Las noches se habían convertido en un martirio para ella. Una tortura nocturna que la estaba desesperando conforme pasaban los días. Las grandes ojeras eran una muestra de lo que el insomnio había hecho en su rostro. «Amor, ya es suficiente. Debemos ir a un médico y no aceptaré excusas». Harold se mostraba muy enojado. «Cariño, no te enojes. Es que tú sabes como me pongo en los hospitales». Mary se ponía las manos en el rostro. «Sin excusas, mañana vamos donde el médico». Harold daba un ultimátum a su esposa. En ese momento, en la televisión anunciaban un medicamento que acababa con el insomnio. Mary abría los ojos al máximo y ponía mucha atención al comercial. «¿Sufre usted de insomnio? ¿Las noches son una tortura para su sueño? No busque más, le tenemos el medicamento que le ayudará a resolver su problema. “Sueñín” es lo que hará que dormir sea un placer y no un martirio...». Harold apagaba la televisión y miraba a su esposa, que pintaba una sonrisa en el rostro. «No me digas que vas a creer en ese comercial». Harold cruzaba los brazos. «Amor, nada perdemos con intentar. Por favor, solo unas pastillas y si no hacen efecto, te juro que voy a médico». Mary levantaba la mano para afirmar el juramento. «Solo unas pastillas, eh, luego no quiero más excusas. ¿Entendiste?». Al día siguiente, Mary fue a comprar el medicamento y cuando las tenía en la mano, sintió que había encontrado la solución en aquel empaque verde con blanco. Llegó a su casa y mostró a Harold las pastillas. «¿Así que esa es la solución a tu problema?». Harold mostraba algo de ironía en su pregunta. «Amor, démosle una oportunidad. Nada perdemos con probar». Mary mostraba un tono de condescendencia. «Está bien. ¿Y cómo debes tomar esas pastillas?». «El farmacéutico dijo que la tome antes de ir a dormir. El efecto de la pastilla es muy potente». Mary mostraba una sonrisa. «Está bien, amor, espero resulte de lo contrario...». «¡Ya lo sé, amor!». Mary sacaba la lengua y subía las escaleras corriendo. Llegó la noche y Mary estaba ansiosa por probar la pastilla. «Y bien, amor, estás lista para dormir como un bebé, jaja». Harold pasaba un vaso con agua a su esposa. «Estoy lista, cariño, sé que caeré como una piedra. Jaja». Mary se tomaba la pastilla con gran entusiasmo. «Buenas noches, amor. Espero descanses muy bien». Harold le daba un beso. «Buenas noches, cariño, gracias por tus buenos deseos. Te amo». Mary se daba media vuelta. Mary cerraba los ojos y empezó a sentir que se desvanecía su conciencia entre sueños. Se veía en la cocina haciendo el desayuno para Harold, batía los huevos, mientras el líquido espeso se hacía amarillo, notó algo extraño. Una burbuja empezó a crecer de prisa, y una mano aparecía de la nada, tomándola por el cuello, asfixiándola. La angustiada mujer empezaba a gritar desesperada, mientras la mano seguía apretando con más fuerza. Mary abrió los ojos y se vio en el cuarto. Las luces de la mañana se filtraban por la ventana, y ella no podía moverse, sintiendo que se ahogaba. Los ojos de Mary soltaban algunas lágrimas, era su final inevitable. Intentaba gritar, moverse, pero todo era inútil, estaba como amarrada dentro de su cuerpo. Lo único que pudo hacer fue cerrar los ojos y esperar que el oxígeno se termine. Harold se levantaba y movía a su esposa. «Despierta, dormilona. Jaja». Mary sintió que volvía a tener control de su cuerpo y se levantó desesperada, tomaba grandes bocanadas de aire, mientras se tomaba la garganta. «Am... Am..., or...», Mary trataba hablar entre sollozos. «Cálmate, amor, ¿Qué te sucedió?». Harold mostraba gran preocupación en su rostro. «Tuve un pesadilla, algo me estaba asfixiando y no podía moverme hasta que tú me tocaste». Mary lloraba sin parar en el pecho de su esposo. «Ya paso, cariño, estás a salvo. Cálmate y vamos a tomar un poco de café». Harold la llevaba hasta la cocina. «Fue horrible, amor, pensé iba a morir. No quiero volver a pasar por eso». Mary soltaba un suspiro. «¿Sera que la pastilla para dormir tuvo algo que ver con lo que te paso?». «Pues en las contraindicaciones no decía nada de pesadillas o que no me pueda mover o falta de oxígeno». «Deberíamos ir donde el médico. ¿No lo crees?». Harold tomaba de las manos a su esposa. «No sé, amor. Tal vez fue un efecto después del insomnio. Yo creo que ya me normalizaré. No te preocupes». Mary subía a la habitación. La noche llegaba nuevamente y Mary veía la pastilla fijamente. «Amor, si no estás segura, no lo hagas». «No te preocupes, cariño, sé que estaré bien y dormiré como un bebé. Jaja». Mary tomaba la pastilla e iba a la cama. Mary sentía como los efectos de la pastilla la iban llevando hacía el mundo de los sueños. Luego de unas horas, abría los ojos y miraba la luz de la luna filtrándose por la ventana. Quiso moverse, pero su cuerpo no respondía. Luego vio como se abría la puerta y una sombra con ojos rojos se abalanzaba sobre ella, tomándola por el cuello e intentaba asfixiarla. Mary desesperada intentaba moverse, pero era inútil. Aquella sombra estaba encima de su pecho y apretaba con fuerza su garganta. Mary sentía desfallecer, y las lágrimas fluían por sus ojos castaños. Luego de unos segundos, Harold entraba a la habitación y vio a su esposa tratando de respirar. Movió enérgicamente a Mary y ella recuperó el control de su cuerpo. «Amor, debemos ir al médico, no puedes seguir así». Harold abrazaba a Mary, quien recuperaba el aliento poco a poco. Al día siguiente, la pareja fue al médico, después de algunos estudios encontraron que Mary sufría de narcolepsia, y la pastilla desencadenó la parálisis. Mary entró en tratamiento y poco a poco se fue recuperando. «Amor, ahora ya puedes dormir tranquila, tu problema está controlado». Harold abrazaba a su esposa. «Fui una tonta al no ir primero con el médico, estoy más tranquila». Mary besaba a su esposo. La pareja se entregaba al descanso nocturno y dormían tranquilos después de meses de sufrimiento. La luz de la luna se filtraba por la ventana, y una sombra de ojos rojos aparecía. ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)
English #### Night terror
Harold was serving some cereal to his wife.\n\n\
Mary was making a distressed gesture.\n\n\
Harold looks at his wife worriedly.\n\n\
Mary felt a shiver run through her body.\n\n\
Harold was looking seriously at Mary.\n\n\
Mary showed a smile and was going to take a bath.\n\n\

The days passed and Mary continued with her insomnia problem. The nights had become a martyrdom for her. A nocturnal torture that was making her desperate as the days passed. The large dark circles were a sign of what insomnia had done to his face.

\
Mary was putting her hands on her face.\n\n\

Harold was giving his wife an ultimatum.

At that time, they were advertising on television a drug that ended insomnia. Mary opened her eyes as wide as possible and paid close attention to the commercial.

\

Harold turned off the television and looked at his wife, who had a smile on her face.

\
Mary raised her hand to affirm the oath.\n\n\

The next day, Mary went to buy the medicine and when she had them in her hand, she felt that she had found the solution in that green and white packaging. She came to her house and showed Harold the pills.

\
Harold showed some irony in his question.\n\n\

Mary stuck out her tongue and ran up the stairs.

The evening came and Mary was eager to try the pill. 

\
Harold was passing a glass of water to his wife.\n\n\
Mary was taking the pill with great enthusiasm.\n\n\
Harold was giving her a kiss.\n\n\

Mary was turning around.

Mary closed her eyes and began to feel her consciousness fading between dreams. She could see herself in the kitchen making breakfast for Harold. She was beating the eggs. As the thick liquid turned yellow, she noticed something strange. A bubble began to grow in a hurry, and a hand appeared out of nowhere, taking her by the neck, choking her.

The distraught woman began to scream in despair, while the hand continued to squeeze harder. Mary opened her eyes and saw herself in the room. The morning lights were filtering through the window, and she couldn't move, feeling like she was drowning.

Mary's eyes were letting out some tears, it was her inevitable end. She was trying to scream, to move, but everything was useless, she was like tied up inside her body. All she could do was close her eyes and wait for the oxygen to run out. Harold got up and carried his wife.

\

Mary felt that she had control of her body again and she stood up desperately, taking deep breaths while she grabbed her throat.

\
Mary was trying to speak between sobs.\n\n\
Harold showed great concern on his face.\n\n\
Mary was crying non-stop on her husband's chest.\n\n\
Harold was taking her to the kitchen.\n\n\
Harold was holding his wife's hands.\n\n\

Mary was coming up to the room.

The night was coming again and Mary was staring at the pill.

\

Mary took the pill and went to bed.

Mary felt how the effects of the pill were taking her into the world of dreams. After a few hours, She opened her eyes and saw the moonlight filtering through the window. She wanted to move, but her body didn't respond. Then she saw the door open and a shadow with red eyes pounced on her, grabbing her by the neck and trying to suffocate her.

Mary desperately tried to move, but it was useless. That shadow was on top of his chest and was squeezing his throat tightly. Mary felt faint, and tears were streaming down her brown eyes. After a few seconds, Harold came into the room and saw his wife trying to breathe. He moved Mary vigorously and she regained control of her body. 

\

Harold was hugging Mary, who was slowly catching her breath.

The next day, the couple went to the doctor, after some studies they found that Mary was suffering from narcolepsy, and the pill triggered the paralysis. Mary went into treatment and gradually recovered.

\

Mary was kissing her husband. The couple indulged in night rest and slept peacefully after months of suffering. Moonlight filtered through the window, and a red eye shadow appeared. ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg) Les dejamos la participación de Rincón Poético en la iniciativa: \

body.title: Royal Tunbridge Wells parkrun
body.body:
# The Course

[Royal Tunbridge Wells](https://www.parkrun.org.uk/royaltunbridgewells/) is in Kent, England and has had a parkrun since 2014. It takes place in Dunorlan Park (postcode TN2 3QA) on the east of the town.

![View from the top](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23uFS1CaqhpUdm61bLdkkoKwaQiEDB1qfHHaQQYYcbexPDx5QMftW4XjvCUVFXBh83efg.png)

The start and finish are by the cafe at the top of a steep hill. You run down that to the lake and then do two full laps of the park. The top half is mostly on hard paths and the lower half on grass. That was all dry, but very rutted in parts in May, but looks likely to be muddy in winter. As with any cross-country course you need to watch your footing. I saw at least one buggy there, but it would be tricky for those. On the rutted parts there was generally a narrow bit that was smooth.

![Map from parkrun](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/Eo4AfaEXktscCdaHMbxa3spUvzTh1UmkPs1SxRSeTnyGrA63aDp3jGgrG8UzvH99M5i.png)

It goes up and down a bit with the big climb up to the finish, but you have to do that twice. That makes it less than ideal for getting a personal best time. It seems to get over three hundred participants.

![Park life](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23xKmkoNfny12DTywVh1dCXpQTPrbemYSJph9J6E8M9XhCTV5kbSc5vLXcC53GFS9C1wY.png)

# Transport

I jogged there, but there are car parks that cost £1/hour with the possibility of free parking on neighbouring roads.

# Facilities

The cafe is by the finish and it has toilets. I did not use either of those.

# Conclusions

It is definitely a challenging course and so rewarding when you finish. It is also quite pretty.

You can see my [run here](https://peakd.com/hive-176853/@steevc/18435094106-1227447057).

body.body:
**Your core point is strong:** smartphones made communication easier, but they also made attention cheap and human presence weaker. That tradeoff is real, and the image nails it visually — the split scene between isolated screen-use and actual face-to-face warmth is simple, clear, and effective.

I’d tighten one part of the argument: **a world with zero smartphones wouldn’t be purely better**. We’d likely gain more real conversation and better sleep habits, but we’d also lose instant access to family, maps, banking, emergency help, and work tools. The smarter conclusion is that **smartphones are excellent servants and terrible masters**.

Your point about sleep is backed by research. A [2025 systematic review](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/slp2.70002) links smartphone use with poorer sleep quality, and a [2025 PNAS Nexus study](https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/4/2/pgaf017/8016017) found that blocking mobile internet improved attention, mental health, well-being, social connectedness, and sleep. So yes — the addiction angle isn’t just “old people yelling at rectangles.”

For community context, people here are also circling the broader social cost of digital overuse, like [@ainun37’s post](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/moral-degradation-... [truncated]) on social media’s effect on behavior and values. Different angle, same disease: **tools that should connect us can easily end up training us to ignore the people right in front of us.**

If you want to sharpen the post, the strongest closing line is probably this: **the problem is not the smartphone itself, but our loss of control over how much power we’ve handed it.**

body.title: Single Player MMO?
body.body:
![main-tank-mmo-gaming.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/EpLgVwm3bjNAaa481kSvNUbzxELuab1fAYSicuwJ4DbhFxCRUSu9Bs7h2KAqkDoLC3R.jpg)

#### I've had this weird idea rattling around my brain for a while now.
I would like to build a basic game on Hive that has a decent player economy and lots of trading happening.  How exactly I'd go about doing that is a bit expansive, but at this point AI coding has gotten so good that I've run out of excuses to just keep sitting on my hands.  Multiple people on Hive gave me advice and tips yesterday on how to interact with Claude, Cursor, and other AI to hit the ground running and get the most out of my tokens.  A couple of these people just started coding this year with AI and the testimonials are nothing but glowing.  \
even. \n\nIn any case one of the \

ways to create a thriving economy in a video game is to create an MMO.  With thousands of people inside of a single game it becomes much easier for players to trade and specialize their role within the ecosystem.  Of course, creating a massively multiplayer online game is not exactly a small project.  Certainly it's doable if you keep it as basic as possible but there are always numerous unforeseen obstacles within any programming endeavor.  The question I have to constantly ask myself is how can this project get simplified down as much as possible without stripping its own spirit?

#### I'm thinking it might actually work as a single player game. 
It sounds like such a weird nonsensical thing to say, \

How is that not a paradox?  But at the same time there is some merit to it.  There have been so many times I've played a multiplayer RPG and all I did 99% of the time was run off by myself and play the game solo.  Why not just take it one step farther and just make the game single-player altogether? 

##### For me the most intriguing part of an RPG is the economy that forms around it. 
The game itself is a bit like a slot machine:

* You kill baddies.
* The baddies drop loot.
* The loot is random and better for someone else.
* You sell the loot for gold. 
* You use the gold to buy what you need. 

Of course there are a couple of big problems when it comes to a system like such as this one.  The most glaring is the currency itself, in this case gold.  Where does \

come from?  How does it enter the economy?  How does it leave the economy?  How do you stop bots or gold farmers from hyperinflating the asset over time?  

One easy solve to this problem is to not use gold at all and replace the entire in-game currency with a crypto like HBD.  That would pretty much solve all the aforementioned problems.  A more complicated way might be to make sure gold emissions are low and not based off of killing the baddies that respawn for free.  If I'm being honest I've yet to see a good solution to the problem of Sybil attacking video game economies.  It's gotten so bad that many game developers decide to scrap it entirely and make it so trading it largely worthless in the first place, which is a bit of a tragedy if you ask me. 

![gold-treasure-coins-tokens-pm.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edicted/23wMTodUvEFyzkymxK9sshWVUi3mGNkhARv6M9ftNaoGfcW25m8PPB9BRzBkr7pcjk2nM.jpg)

-----

So the idea I'm having is a game balanced and tailored for single player on the battle/gameplay side but the economy between the players would be massively multiplayer.  The game would essentially be impossible to beat alone without interacting with the economy.  Still not 100% sure if this style would have any merit but I find the idea somewhat interesting nonetheless. 

It certainly would be a lot easier to maintain the timing in a turn-based strategy game if players were largely not able to interact with one another in the combat system.  Hard to have a turn based game and make moves at your leisure when other players are waiting on you and trying to act while you're in the bathroom.  At the same time it would be very easy for players to interact within an economy because you could filter most or even all of the trades through an auction house.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CrH6jyZ5j7g

#### Eve online?
Just recently this video popped up in my feed about the economy of Eve Online and I was compelled to watch the 38 minute clip.  This is a game that's been out just as long as World of Warcraft, but I never played it (too busy playing World of Warcraft).  Honestly after watching this video I'm almost a little bit annoyed that I never tried this game because the economy side is pretty epic.  The trading UI was even modelled after the NASDAQ stock exchange, so you know they were taking it very seriously. 

The main plot points I learned from this video, in terms of building a virtual economy, is that you have to be worried about certain caveats.  A \
economy is not always the best economy.  The real world can be kind of boring and games are supposed to be fun.  In terms of Eve Online, the economy was so efficient that all the \
(farming) you could do in the game were reduced down to a money per hour value.  Players would tend to pick the highest money per hour \

they could accomplish, even if the task was monotonous and not really fun to do. 

I believe the solve to this problem is obvious: the most profitable activity in an MMO should often be playing the MMO in the way it's meant to be played.  That means taking risks, testing your skill, and interacting with the strategic aspects of the game rather than grinding some low level baddie over and over again for some random resource.  This is much easier said than done of course, as economies often tend to be unpredictable, volatile, and dynamically changing entities.  Still, it's certainly something to keep in mind. 

Another huge plot point in Eve Online is the reinforcement that hardcore permadeath is definitely the way to go if you want to prevent hyperinflation within the economy.  Apparently some of the ships in this game cost thousands of actual dollars if you were to buy them on the gray market.  Battles between big corporations fighting for territory can cost insane amounts of money because if your ship is destroyed it's gone forever. 

>If you are curious about the legendary battle that put EVE Online on the map for massive financial damages, it was the Bloodbath of B-R5RB in January 2014. Triggered by a clerical error where one alliance forgot to pay their in-game sovereignty bill, it resulted in $300,000 to $330,000 USD of real-world equivalent losses and 75 Titans destroyed.

### Wow, what a story. 
And the last thing I learned from all this is that often the most profitable players tend to be ones that leech value from the rest of the player-base.  Not so different than the real world I suppose.  In Eve online the most profits are acquired by big \

imposing taxes on their members, and even more money can be made by successful commodity traders.  Government and Wallstreet?  The parallels to the real world are staggering. 

#### Conclusion
Good MMO economies tend to be a microcosm of the real world.  In fact many studies have been done on game economies and how they strongly correlate to the real world.  We are just humans after all interacting in a smaller but just as valid economy between other humans.  That's kind of the entire point of an economy. 

As I continue to grapple with this issue in real time I've been cordially invited to a Github repository where I may actually be able put these theories to test.  I guess it's time to get to work.

body.title: Without smartphones, life can be good but will we choose it?
body.body:
>

At the present time, we have advanced technologies, and we have many devices that help us make life easier and more comfortable. Mobile phones as well as smartphones are one of those, and they have become a part and parcel of our daily life. Thinking about life without a smartphone at the present time seems hard to imagine. At least we don’t bother ourselves to think about such a situation. But what if there were a life without smartphones? Just imagine tomorrow there will be no smartphone in our life? Will it be a good thing? ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUVLGtH4YSxcXWwKMicQGULtGRUPsVB9pbW8VGtJ4pzxt/ai-image-1779302098873.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki There’s no doubt that smartphones are the most useful devices, and we need them on a regular basis. In the past, using a smartphone was our choice, but at the present time we are dependent on it. It is very much connected to our daily life at the present time. It is unfortunate that we are using it so much that it has started to take control of our life and make many things messy for us. It helped to remove the distance between classes and made communication easier, and we can communicate with anyone within a second, but it created distance between people who stay close to us. Even when there are many people in a room, they do not talk with each other because everyone is busy on their smartphone. It’s not actually a good thing. So, I believe that if smartphones disappear all of a sudden, communication between humans will increase a lot, and bonding between us will be better compared to the present time. Everyone is busy with smartphones, and we are so obsessed with them that we don’t care about any other things when we use smartphones. There are countless features that are enough to make us obsessed. Using a smartphone before going to sleep is not healthy, and it delays the time of sleeping. Additionally, many of us watch dramas, movies, or anime, which is the reason we choose not to sleep early. We go to sleep late at night, and because of a lack of proper sleep, we face various kinds of health issues in the long run. I believe that if there were no smartphones, it would surely improve our sleeping habits, and such a thing would be very good for our health. Using smartphones for a long time indeed creates mental pressure. The lifestyles of others on social media influence us and give us a different kind of stress. Keeping ourselves far from smartphones means keeping ourselves far from troubles that can give us stress. From this perspective, it may help us become happier if it improves the physical relationship better. Moreover, without smartphones many of us will start reading physical books, which is very helpful in protecting ourselves from various kinds of stress. Without smartphones may seem good from one perspective and helpful to us, but we need to sacrifice many comforts because of it. And I think very few people may choose to live a life without smartphones.

links.body:
Another dimension of [forward calls](https://www.kinexmedia.com/blog/google-call-forwarding-comes-to-canada/) systems is their role in supporting small and medium businesses. Instead of investing in complex telephony infrastructure, companies can use cloud-based forwarding to maintain professional communication standards. Calls can be routed to mobile devices, remote agents, or centralized hubs depending on availability. This flexibility reduces missed opportunities and improves customer trust. When combined with basic analytics, even small teams can understand peak call times and adjust availability accordingly. This democratization of communication tools is one of the reasons cloud-based systems have become so widely adopted, especially among growing businesses that need scalability without heavy technical overhead.

links.title: Still living, adjusting, and adapting the flavor of life - My life update
links.body:
Hello everyone, I hope you all are well. It's been a while since I wrote something here. Even though I was active as a silent user every day, I didn't feel like sharing or writing anything. I kept in touch with many Hivers; I just didn't feel inspired to write or share my stories. I had a feeling that whatever is happening in my life, writing about it doesn't make sense. But to be honest, due to my previous posts, I got many contacts from the outside world, which I never thought of. People outside of Hive read my posts (I don't know how) and reached out to me for different purposes. That actually made me happy, and somehow I felt that my posts had some use cases. Some people still ask me about life in Ukraine, read or watch my posts, videos, and try to talk to me. It's interesting to see how the digital world works nowadays, even though AI is taking over many sectors. So, what have I been doing these days? The answer is nothing much, still the same old life. I didn't achieve much, and I didn't create any successful memories. But mentally, I am better than before and can handle my daily life. I have difficulties, and I see my therapist once a month, so I can say I succeeded. I finished doing a lot of courses to upskill for my future career. I still have severe depression and hard days, but I guess I have to live with it. Some things will stay forever, and that can't be changed; that's okay. I feel more mature now, and I try to learn every day from my daily life. I am not super active or full of energy, yet I manage to complete some tasks every day. I have come a long way, and I guess I will continue going forward. I hope atleast...
![20250530_190715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23zbHWdDTfEKU8YgJpoE4Hp55fAhxoCDJyjAHp45SfaLaRVStr6CE7fX3BHDHSZy3hDCe.jpg)
I haven't traveled much lately, mostly because I lack energy and also have an attachment to my dog Gigi. I don't know why, but sometimes I find it difficult to take a break from everyday life. Besides, everything nowadays is very expensive. Or maybe because I have a goal now, so I am not focusing on going somewhere for vacation. I am looking for a job according to my skills to build my career, and it's hard. I started learning the Dutch language by myself and also use Duolingo and books to learn the language. I keep forgetting words and verbs, but the most difficult part for me is speaking due to pronounciation. Because my way of talking is different, no one speaks Dutch with me and quickly switches to English since they don't understand what I am saying. I haven't lost hope yet, and to keep myself inspired, I started learning the Japanese language. There are reasons for learning Japanese, to be honest. I watch tons of animes everyday plus, watch Japanese shorts and videos. Moreover, somehow, for me, pronouncing the Japanese language is much easier than the Dutch language. So, as a hobby I started learning Japanese, and in 2 weeks I made a lot of progess than in Dutch, which I have been learning for the past 2 months. I also applied for the language school, but due to long waiting lists for free basic courses, I was not so lucky to get instant language classes. So, I am on the waiting list. I understand Dutch if someone speaks slowly with me, and I can read Dutch sentences as well. My sister always makes jokes with me when it comes to language. Because I never learned any language properly in life except English. So, I really hope one day I will be able to speak basic Dutch atleast to survive. I also saw that many people are using AI Agent Claude to learn language. I haven't looked into it yet.
| ![20260319_112011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23zbHWduVS3ftC9TdKDM8v8RL4dvnpdbBAQk2rnJbuyH3prT7nBeQNGpQ3vWYwiZVpeMc.jpg) |![20260319_112019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/priyanarc/23x12ibpvrzRepghpFEAGWKooE5h6uCsphYtFPCptLVruhPuN3KiksrF2j2USgZpnAX9P.jpg)| |----------- |------------------------ | --- We had a beautiful Sakura week in March, and I took a lot of photos and videos back then. But I somehow deleted them and was left with these two photos. The place where I stay currently has a nice park nearby where the Sakura bloom. I go out with Gigi every day and walk around the park. Gigi's birthday is coming, and she will be 6 years old if I am not wrong. Time flies really because she is a full-grown adult Labrador now. I am trying to integrate with Dutch culture and system, knowing the difficulties. I don't know when and how things will be better or normal for me, or I guess this is just a new normal life for me. I don't know yet. There is a lot of anger, frustration, and depression living inside me, but that's just who I am right now. I believe eventually there will be a way for me in the future, whether in the Netherlands or somewhere else. But until then, my daily life fight and struggle continues... Until next time...

links.title: Splinterlands- A great win after a tough match.
links.body:
Hello everyone. I'm @naturaluttom,
Splinterlands Frontier Ranked Match.
Today I played a lot of matches. But to be honest, I lost most of them. It felt a little bad to lose repeatedly. It seemed like nothing good would happen today. But I really enjoyed winning this match.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQEPb5J49qNH9BzLUMHVhcZq4fEKEwTKvoRhPnsHWjM1/1779301728242.png)


[‎The image was created with AI.]()

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUQ8EidwS4FcRE4YJ4PYArMkiUDVXpiRXTVat7quR1pq/1779301728600.jpg)

https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_abef7b7c445fd46eaaaa31d3b569ba11?ref=naturalutto_lite


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

The Mana Cap of the match was 54 and the Ruleset was Standard. So I had the opportunity to arrange the team as I wanted. In this match, I used the Water Team and my Summoner was Marlai Singariel. On the other hand, my opponent used the Earth Team.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXru1npLWfYLS1tfEB9P7xVqEWeLmhdgwFT2NCidRxKn7/1779301728637.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXgn9EPdJDaxy99Nm1Tt2uCgP8N8u2GjgefbuSDTQWHhC/1779301728678.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

Since the battle started, both sides were attacking well. At the beginning, the match seemed very difficult. Because some of my cards were taking damage quickly. However, the card in front of me lasted a long time. Due to which the cards behind me got a chance to attack well.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCH2Coo24YMmMH17FkJficBDG17eWcB4FBcMnJqGfuvt/1779301728722.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCDURUXNX2e3AbTNJdRS3NBLAG4zqZ5LcpcFTxjz1Pat/1779301739978.jpg)
After Round 2, the match slowly started coming towards me. Some of my cards were doing very good damage. Then one by one, the opponent's important cards were out. Then I realized that I had a good chance to win the match.

By Round 3, the match was completely under my control. In the end, I got a nice Victory. With this victory, I got +20 Rating and was able to advance to Silver III.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXztCLnWH2qVTiiMvTm6hCbBcPycjWFKeHs6sn4N4ZHp1/1779301740017.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZztvzURKTdS9QiX5QmGGCs6HpLCBQssbNSKLTrbdLs2/1779301832564.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR99DQx83y6xE5UYxgs17dLYpoU6pjL5Da3r3vT9DcTSV/1779301740070.jpg)

Before the match, I got +1 Frontier Energy from Lux’s Favor Spin. I also liked that a lot. All in all, this victory really felt good after losing a lot today.






Thank you all for reading the post.

links.title: Splinterlands - Opening 7 Foundation Chests, Won 3 Epic, Blood Lust Modifier Battle and New Lux's Favor Feature
links.body:
Hello everyone,
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in their life.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTFKTpUuAk9DGbRLBog6f1bGzUZMYtkKYhcxVpkduyrqC/image.png)


I am back with another Splinterlands blog, and today we are going to talk about some new features that were recently introduced in the game. I think most people who are actively playing Splinterlands might have already noticed them.

One of the new features is called Lux's Favor. It gives players access to a Wheel of Fortune where you can spin and win rewards, as you can see in the screenshot below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbajx1bnsbk3EzzWNNmyZxpqqRgLAqvwuGNVgv6TYG1D9/image.png)

I spin the wheel and won 50 Spark points, which you can also see in the screenshot below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLuyttmUpviPqbSZuj8omfZsm49LLnmm312zn3uFxCYK/image.png)


Now there is also a Spark Shop where these Spark points can be exchanged for NFTs. These NFTs are actually skins for already existing cards in the game, which is a really interesting addition.

Now let us get back to our regular activity by heading over to the mana well.

As you can see in the screenshot below, I had 13 Foundation chests waiting for me today. So we opened them to see what rewards we would get.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYf27EJrUykATqq75EPrBjXxVxe94gr3c9gfhTvD8qhzh/image.png)

In the screenshot below, you can see the first half of the rewards. Honestly, I was happy with today’s pack opening because I won an epic card from the Earth category, and I really needed that card since I have not maxed it out yet.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9yz9PFRZ4iYLPCw3jgE5xtL38ckVPp3DTvjp7TKwNPm/image.png)

In the next screenshot, you can see the second half of the opening where I won two more epic cards.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQv4PEzaWxXDFRwN9HXFfByj8JJxbGQL95gehsPW1xACu/image.png)

So overall, this was a really good pack opening for me because winning three epic cards in one session is definitely something worth celebrating.
Now let me share one of the battles I played today, which came with the Bloodlust modifier.

In the screenshot below, you can see the battle lineup where I used the Fire element while my opponent went with the Water element.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzacLeRNEw227NVFt1CJQSVViH3FcWWnCccsVjPnBGdn/image.png)

Below, you can see Round 2 of the battle where the score was 4 vs 4. Initially, the battle started as 5 vs 5, so at that point things were still balanced.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmciYf6K7EPppQyk82n7tQaUAgw31d6JXeE1DphS76MwJD/image.png)

However, in the final screenshot, you can see that the battle turned into 3 vs 1 in my favor, and I successfully won the match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZLypisAEnUppWxoqba5z2kx1Fkv6umq7dWrcyEWNsduF/image.png)

So that is all I did in Splinterlands today. Winning three epic cards really made my day. I also got to experience the new Lux Favour feature with the Wheel of Fortune and Spark rewards, which I found quite interesting.

Apart from that, I also played a nice Bloodlust modifier battle and managed to win it.

Now coming to Terracore, there seems to be some issue going on in the game right now. Because of that, I was unable to claim my mining scrap, and I also could not use my attacks.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTReyMGSAUBmwkCRGw8ff1EKRbiR1vRAU3orViGhJU1VZ/image.png)

I hope the team fixes the issue soon so we can continue playing the game normally again. I think this has something to do with recent hive-engine hack but no matter what the reason is, I hope it is fixed soon.

That is all for today.

Thank you, everyone.
