links.title: Stalker 2: Untold Stories
links.body: **The GSC Game World spent the entire 2025 mostly doing serious damage control after the troubled release of Stalker 2. It took dozens of patches and hotfixes to get rid of countless bugs, and the game engine required serious tweaking. Luckily for the fans, the devs managed to find enough time and resources to slowly add new content, including two new weapons (which just happened to be some of the fan's favourites) and especially night vision googles. One of the recent patches even included a short quest with full voice acting that involved a popular character from the previous games. The recently released Patch 1.8 is a milestone, though, because it’s something more than just an update: with a pinch of generosity, you could call it a free DLC.** ![titulky.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/48RNzk9PAGjJojDNCTaqAxP9ukqhqjptvaRA9NemYtAJR5CbXEtZrJUiBWuEybWyo5.jpg) **A handful of disclaimers** All screenshots were taken by myself. The post was originally written in Polish and then I translated it into English **without any online translators or so-called AI.** I played using the GeForce Now streaming service with a high graphics setting. Obviously, what you see in me screenshots may differ from what you’d get playing on your own PC rig or console. I finished Stalker 2 two times and stopped my third playthrough right before the final ending. Moreover, I’ve been following the development of the game since the release day and tested out all the subsequent patches and updates. On the other hand, I’m just a casual Stalker fan who finished the original trilogy just two times and never touched such popular total conversion mods as Anomaly, Gamma, or Gunslinger. Recently I did start playing another important mod, Anomaly, but so far I’ve got just a dozen hours on my counter. More than that, my participation in the Stalker community has been (mostly) limited to the dedicated subreddit and Steam comments. I’ve never touched the game’s discord channel and I have no idea what’s happening in the Russian and Ukrainian fan communities. To sum it all up, I’m a really casual fan of the Stalker series and if you’re expecting an expert’s opinion from a veteran fan who’s been following it since 2007, you won’t find it here. **Update 1.8: What's inside?** ![kazkowyj01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/242D9UYpdrDfAYUDBXk6niDYusGaCmHB9XyEdiW2NR5TfaZaC9DGXLF4CAJPsjk5fAdck.jpg) *Kazkovyi, a former Sovietjugend camp and potentially a new stalker outpost in the middle of nowhere, if you play your cards right.* The list of new features available on the official Stalker 2 page looks quite promising. First of all, there’s a new questline now, supposedly enough to spend at least five hours playing. And this includes other things, obviously, so new characters, locations, and a unique weapon. We should all remember that the GSC studio hinted at two DLCs shortly after the initial release of the game. Some excited fans were wondering on Discord and reddit about the content in those addons, and a few curious souls even searched for hints in the game code and pre-release media. The future DLCs were supposed to be playable, but in the case of Untold Stories the fans are getting new content for free. And then, even if we had to pay for it, anything new would be great for those dedicated fans who already finished the game several times and explored every single corner of the Zone. I am among their ranks, by the way. **Radio, live transmission: the new story questline**

> ![banzaj-wzywaje.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23tGTYrdQPxf12EComSp3KLbY9E7wufPQrVmE3L8h6irHUZFaizrEwE2zXnsJXpGmA1qG.jpg) One fine day, our protagonist Skif hears a desperate radio call for help. A panicking stranger begs everyone who listens to free him from the claws of some bandits who are keeping him locked inside an abandoned mine located in the southern part of the Iron Forest, just a little to the west from the grim Chornobyl Nuclear Plant. Skif, being himself, would never miss a chance to get mixed in more trouble and off a few criminals. After filling up his backpack with two dozens of energy drinks, he sets out towards the mine. The protagonist encounters a handful of thugs at the mine entrance. They’re disposed of in a moment, after all a goon in a tracksuit and with a rusty Kalas has no chance with a Ukrainian marine veteran wearing a state-of-the-art exoskeleton. Skif then enters the mine and soon finds a symbol well-known to all Stalker fans. The Renegades are here! ![renehaty.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23tbHLLoaasgboap2Stod1D2f9nWhaMbuUi3aNd6dyYvQ51g9Sv6kLhLrVxra2maVDRKn.jpg) *The only faction to have appeared in just one part of the original trilogy, the Renegades were the first enemy players met in Clear Sky. Basically, a bunch of outcasts so stupid or degenerate that even ordinary self-respecting bandits didn't want to mingle with them.* A few minutes and a few more corpses later, our adventurer finds the captured man who made the call for help. Banzai quickly explains the situation: together with a couple of stalkers was ambushed and everyone except him managed to escape. The captors put him into an impromptu prison cell and took his advanced tools, something that’s really valuable in the Zone. Since Banzai’s only skill is being a mechanic, he won’t survive an ordinary stalker’s wife, being shot at by bandits and crawling into anomalies, so he refuses to flee without his instruments. Skif agrees to carry out a little search&rescue operation. ![nora-kilofa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23t732azaVVtBHXxwCNTfS6Dyb1vgAza3yybbQHGtVf4CquDNgKuzcLJXt9p5ntCVzhyW.jpg) *Pickaxe's humble abode.* Banzai gives him two choices: an open attack or something more sophisticated. Choosing the latter option makes Skif turn off an electric pomp to flood the bandit hideout at the bottom of the mine, and then all he needs to do is to wait for them to unlock the entrance. The second step is to launch a power generator. Most of the Renegades are loitering around the bottom cave without bothering about standing in the water and promptly get fried to the bone. All that remains to do now is to shoot a few survivors, including the boss called Pickaxe (no doubt the nickname refers to his IQ), and loot the foreman’s office he’s been hiding in. There’s no trace of Banzai’s tools or the ominous recording, but Skif manages to find some useful information on the kidnappers and their plans. More than that, he discovers a flashdrive which apparently contains the blueprint of some really odd radiotechnic device. Banzai isn’t exactly happy when our ex-Marine returns to him and explains that his precious instruments are gone. The mood becomes even worse when the kidnapped technician hears that somebody put a bounty on him and his team, and the Renegades only kept Banzai alive to use his technical skills, much to the dislike of the mercenary who hired them, Skull. Both men are now heading to the mine exit while Banzai tells more of his story on the way. Skif receives a new task: find the missing tools on an old barge stuck on the shore somewhere in the south, near the Chemical Plant. Meanwhile, the technician will be waiting for his team’s leader to pick him up and escort him to a safer place. **New camp, old problems** ![barża.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23tv3ukvUVAMhsaMovq8rZPP7jqG5NUWPmkrmrTFifnLWcxHN1fQX33pWVV7ip8zHoWgz.jpg) *Unlike Skif, seasoned Stalker fan will recognise this sight immediately. A shrine to the Monolith which absolutely shouldn't be here since the finale of the first game, Shadow of Chernobyl. Apparently, there are worst thing hiding in the Zone than deranged bandits and mercenaries.* The shore where the barge got stuck looks a little ominous. There’s a strange contraption on the shore, something like a tribal totem made of scrap with a strange electrical lamp inside it. A stalker corpse lies next to it, still clutching a precious artifact. There are no Renegades in sight, but a few battered zombies suddenly walk out of the reeds and start shooting. After putting them to sleep, Skif jumps onto the barge… and instantly gets hit in the face with a wooden box. A Poltergeist lives here now, a particularly nasty mutant species whose special powers include telekinesis and partial invisibility. Neither is enough to stop buckshot, though. Finally, Skif finds Banzai’s tools and sets out to find the technician farther in the south. ![kazkowyj-brama.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23yHiX6onPq496javLRGgVgkVF41VpSRJeER9UnQAWNYLEayNb8Z5KWSEoBzEWrqrdFyV.jpg) Some time later, Skif arrives at the destination: a pioneer camp. Not so long ago, before Chornobyl’s nuclear malady, it was used by the Soviet equivalent of boy scouts (though, to be honest, Ottoman janissaries would be a much better comparison). There isn’t much to see here, a few concrete bungalows, a stage where brainwashed kids used to sing hymns to Lenin, and a larger building housing a mess hall and other amenities. Two men are waiting inside: one is Banzai, and another, a stranger who calls himself Scoutmaster, promptly sums up the entire mess. ![bażanyj.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23swe5Pe6riEMzaapiNU829XomhqeDmEa8n3iAzDqCFU2n2hkqDaqNuAQjrWEQFSiuB8R.jpg) *A Zone veteran and true survivor. Which makes him the exact opposite of Banzai and other members of the group.* Scoutmaster was recruited as a bodyguard by the research group NK-5 to investigate a mysterious radio transmission for the eggheads from the Malachite institute. The previous expedition, codename NK-3, disappeared somewhere near the pioneer camp. Now Scoutmaster is planning to stay hidden in Kazkovyi and use the specialised equipment left by the unlucky team to solve the mystery of the eldritch signal. There’s a reasonable hope that the hunted stalkers will be able to use this knowledge either as a weapon or to exchange it for their lives. Skif gets hired to make the first preparations: kick off a power generator (which is bound to attract some nasty mutants), inspect a nearby building to search for clues related to the fate of the NK-3 group, and check the stage building which appears to be haunted. Without much enthusiasm, Skif moves to clean up the place. The pioneer theatre really feels haunted and our hero hears voices of invisible (and very angry bandits). As it turns out, it’s the fault of two psychic cats, or Bayuns, hidden inside the building. A handful of shotgun pellets shuts them up. Inside the other building Skif finds the corpses of the unlucky expedition. Their PDAs reveal that their demise was caused by the killer transmission. Finally, all that’s left to do is turn on the power generator. The mutated uglie who arrives at the camp a few heartbeats later is promptly sent to the mutant purgator. Now Scoutmaster gives Skif another task. Time is running away mercilessly. While the makeshift camp is a remote location, right in the middle of wilderness that’s shunned by most stalkers, the pursuers are true professionals and, sooner or later, they’re bound to find Scoutmaster et consortes. The most urgent task is finding the two missing members of the group, a Malachite researcher and one Rascal, both the quartermaster and trader. When it’s done, the merry men move on to intercept and record the deadly transmission. Here, the goal is to use it as the last ditch weapon against Skull and his mercs. Skif goes for another search trip. This time he explores an abandoned SAM site, searching for a signal amplifier, and faces a seemingly impossible choice. ![wybir.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23wqeFmi8MqVvEQ2BgbXgr4WSCrPkCrmN36m5XG9aoGNzj3qjqiGQQHoYBKJN3QhSqZbs.jpg) *A suitcase of coupons or your sense of moral integrity? Choose well, Skif.* Back in the Kazkovyi Camp, Skif suddenly learns that there’s a new threat, perhaps as dangerous as Skull and his mercs: an inner enemy. One of the NK5 group suggests that there’s a rat among their ranks who secretly talks with the enemy, hoping to save his life! And it’s a strange coincidence that Scoutmaster left the camp without saying a word shortly before Skif’s return. Now it’s time to find the veteran and discover the truth. Meanwhile, the doomsday clock is ticking mercilessly and finally the mercenaries arrive at the comp, first sending a handful of bandits as scouts (and cannon fodder). ![the-great-tactician.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23swdjz1aAY3Gknq8Mv194KXPJWVkTdbaSZzoUvNHG47ScLVZYSK4yFuLDoHX4Q8hYzG3.jpg) *The Great Tactician.* After planning the defence and some quick preparations, Skif falls on his bunk. Soon, he wakes up to the sound of gunshots and excited voices of his companions. All that follows is bloodshed, well deserved by Skull and his boys in blue camo. **Another step in the Zone** What should we think about Patch 1.8 and the Untold Stories? Cautious optimism is a possible answer here. Since we received a pretty long questline, it’s reasonable to think that the work on a full DLC, something promised to us so long ago, is going well. It’s important to note that the new storyline may be related to the supposed content of the DLC. Stalker 2 had another mysterious radio signal right on its release. Players could listen to it while visiting a ruined bridge near Lymansk, a region well-known to Clear Sky fans which so far has been inaccessible in Stalker 2. Who knows, maybe the add-on in making will be tied to Untold Stories and Skif will get into new adventures with Banzai, Scoutmaster, and the others. ![egghead-no-armour.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23swe5NKiWn32vbUU24cKjsusY7J1QVuKEh7wQH12kTbNGxzPYVtfRU6yr74z1nva82j8.jpg) *Who'd think this egghead would be so picky about the choice of armour?* It’s obvious that nobody should expect any revolutionary changes in the gameplay or game mechanics. Unknown Stories simply consist of a series of so-called fetch quests, and little more, but the GSC crew at least included some much welcome variety. As an example, when Skif rescues one of the NK5 members cornered in an abandoned warehouse, it turns out that the unlucky scientist has lost his armour and absolutely refuses to leave his hideout. To make him return to the Kazkovyi camp, Skif needs to bring him a new armoured suit, and the ungrateful stalker accepts only three specific types. In another mission to recover an important quest item the player has to solve a rather convoluted puzzle which involves thermodynamics formulas, no less. Details like these obviously don’t change too much in gameplay, but at least they make it somewhat less tedious. ![kru-ded.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23swbmssypL12GApR4exYkWKZ12CWMm9GcYScyUWLGws9PnMTkCL6J553WNQ8s2qyvsKN.jpg) *Nothing personal, boys.* The story and character writing are competent enough, and that’s the highest praise you can say about them. Skif’s new companions are basically built on clichés: a wise, tired veteran as the pack leader, a socially-awkward tech genius, or a sleazy coward as the local quartermaster and trader. Still, the characters aren’t totally one-dimensional and each one has their own secrets and surprises. Ukrainian voice actors (I still refuse to even try playing the game with English voices on) have again done a solid job and helped make the new characters feel more convincing, especially in the case of Rascal the Sleazy Trader. Choices taken in conversations have a minimal impact on the linear storyline, with one exception: at a certain point, Skif gets a chance to opt out of the almost suicidal mission. It’s not just an option to say “Not now, I’ll come back later” but we’re actually allowed to join the enemy – and betray our strange companions. After receiving a neat sum of coupons, Skif can to return to the camp and admire Scoutmaster and the boys neatly lying in a line, all dead. The new camp leaves something to be desired, though. Not as a location, mind you, but the whole settlement mechanics are a little disappointing. It's all just too simple: first you need to rescue a few people who will take up basic camp functions (trader, guide, mechanic, doctor), then defend the camp to finish the questline, and that's basically it. There's no need to visit other settlements with a little advertisement campaign so stalkers actually know there's a new settlement, and you don't need to bother with organising trade routes, recruiting more security, or refurbishing the interiors to make them a proper home of the homeless. Almost immediately after the final fight, a dozen of random stalkers materialises out of thin air and Kazkovyi just remains as it is, completely static. ![kazkovyi-crowd.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wayward-dreams/23swbvZfbnu118iwvGQh2sfqdc2WUZQFMeTLEddi31Af4aK26sVQiPY9e1PignypvbzHH.jpg) *I swear that this place was completely empty just a moment ago.* That's the only serious criticism I have, though. You may ask what has happened since the release of Untold Stories? Not much, to tell the truth. The GSC crew kept it silent for almost four months to finally announce the release of the first major expansion DLC sometime in summer. Then, in April, another update was released, adding a new, small location, a simple quest and, most importantly, new type of loot. And so, rejoice, stalkers, for soon there will be new wonders to discover in the zone.

links.title: Meat eating plants at the botanical garden in Praha
links.body:
As I already told you in a former post some days ago I really love meat eating plants since they are something special in the plant world. They show that nature can adapt very good and on soil where the plants get very few nutritients they have developed another method of getting their nutritients that they cannt get from the soil. When I visited Praha in late summer last year I saw these nice meat eating plants at the botanical garden in the tropical section. So if you like plants and nature and visit Praha I can recommend this place for a visit. 

Not only the meat eating plants but also a lot of other plants there are worth to be seen. I also really liked the part in the garden with all the Bonsai trees and the japan garden there a lot. The botanical garden there is devided in several sections and there is a tropical greenhouse for the heat loving plants.

links.body:
Not my best performance, losing to most players with a lower Rating then my own.

I very seldom attempt one minute bullet but I decided to give this one a try, since it was at the very beginning of the tournament. There was, a learning experience in this tournament: With strong play and winning position, it still might take to long to find the “CHECKMATE”…
> My performance rating is normally higher in Crazyhouse tournaments but not expected to be in bullet. I was surprise that I was on the verge of some very good wins but gave into Blunder and Time...

> In the game below I used the “Sneaky Dam Bishop” tactic to flush out my opponent King and get a Checkmate. This game move sequence perfectly describe the sneaky dam bishop tactic, most times teaming up with a Queen or another piece to attack from afar.

> Note: Sneaky Dam Bishop is described in an earlier post a few years ago: https://peakd.com/hive-157286/@rodrook/bishops-are-sneaky-and-dangerous Many people describe the knight and bishop in many different ways and for many different reasons just as I do myself. However it has become very apparent to me that The Bishop is just Dam Sneaky!!! That is the best way to describe the bishop. The bishop is also very dangerous because it is constantly collaborating with another piece mainly a queen or a knight to do serious damage to your chess kingdom and chess game.

links.title: On the backlash against Low Traffic Neighbourhoods...
links.body:
Personally I love the concept of Low Traffic Neighbourhoods - creating more spaces for pedestrians and bikes and funnelling cars onto fewer roads should just make life more pleasant for everyone. 

Writing in The Times Emma Duncan reports that the evidence now shows these schemes actually work. Research shows London LTNs cut neighbourhood traffic by almost half, without making surrounding roads any worse. Other studies tie LTNs to better road safety, less pollution, and stronger communities.

But in spite of this LTNs have become one of the most polarising issues of late in UK politics! 

The opposition to LTNs isn’t just about roads or traffic: it's also about issues around trust, class, lifestyle, and local politics in modern Britain.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23tH3nTDw2rkRR9BZ4Qrf7UBkedCHMPxEZ58rzg2BpBDv6sobjBeE2Q52sJR5qWhZ1UiE.png)


### Why the opposition to LTNs..? 

Meanwhile, outside of leafy Dulwich where the average family can't afford a £6K cargo bike to take their brats to school, driving means independence, they rely on their one vehicle, their petrol car, to get the kids to school, help them care for their family, and get them to work. So when you mess with people’s routes, this annoys them. 

At least it annoys those people who can't afford to have multiple vehicles and only use the car for jaunts OUT of London, using their expensive E-bikes IN London. 

These people FEEL as if more traffic has shifted onto the main routes they use, even if the data doesn't back this up. 

There's also resentment about top-down social engineering. Telling people to cycle instead of drive can come across as middle-class virtue signalling, landing awkwardly on communities where daily routines don’t fit the planners’ vision.

### Final Thoughts...

So there's more to LTNs than simply creating safer and more pleasant spaces, possibly they're a class-war against working class drivers, possibly a symbol of state-over-reach into personal choice. 

Either way, they please some and annoy others!

links.title: Corporate leaders in India not supportive for Work From Home Culture
links.body:
Recently Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi Ji proposed a few plans for the coming year considering the war situation. One of the primary things was to give work from home option so that the fuel demand will be reduced to a greater extent. Many companies are supporting this initiative and many companies are against this initiative. Some companies have already announced work from home again for their employees and they are keeping it flexible. 

In one of the statements, Zoho Scientist Sridhar Vembu said that they are not supportive of this work from home culture anymore. Considering the fact that face to face interaction is very important for getting things done, he is insisting on bringing people back to the office. One thing that can be solved is the fuel problem through electric vehicles and finding alternative source of energy. 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcY27vfQPyk7BGgji3J3F9VevVMAAQ2woWsLTg35JPEFu/pasted_1779299545171.png)


Source - Gemini

Companies don't agree to 100 percent work from home because they find it very hard to get full productivity from their employees. The employees try to give better outcome through work from home but the productivity can be better if they work from office location and if the interaction with the team is more. 

## Lockdown and mental health 

I remember that after the previous lockdown many people had to go through a lot of things. Not just because of the Corona virus itself but because of the lockdown people lost their metal health and they had to deal with it. For some people things are still not fully normal. 

I personally had some problems post lockdown where my mental health was affected a little bit and I slowly recovered back. So I wouldn't support 100 percent work from home culture but I understand what the government is trying to convey. If we reduce the fuel consumption, we will be able to reduce the money going outside India because of the import. This will help in reducing inflation and the value of Rupee against dollars. 

People say there can be another lockdown because of fuel crisis but we are not sure what can happen. Let's wait and watch.

links.title: The Forgotten Winter
links.body:
>

The winter in Beijing is quite extreme for the netizens of the tropical region like Bangladesh. Though the freezing winter was a tough experience for me during my early days in Beijing, later, with the passage of time, I have overcome the scorching and harsh vibes of the winter in Beijing, and even further north of the Beijing municipality, which is around 60 km north of the city centre. 

The winter in Bangladesh was a black and white experience compared with the Beijing winter that I am experiencing nowadays. The temperature of the coldest month in Bangladesh was December and January, which is also similar in Beijing, but here the temperature in November is colder than January in Bangladesh as the temperature goes below the freezing point here, which is unimaginable in Bangladesh.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNjdQ9huuiLVRZzDwafzPTiuxUoy3bFT1rufJkJynpKU8/img_20251214_152131.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZdJSFS9x7tBuTYfQLZVNzK7BiGmG6qhXGvSgvJ6J5BSv/img_20251214_153327.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTDi1jBEsqoQiPZL1JQjFKuQX9QAXZqcdA6LGQxbxtpts/img_20251214_153330.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUKMhkaQRqJARCK9nyoYKg85Artu34J53qbUwqJLUDZVs/img_20251214_153406.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZttHMupndppg9bQVErZJkSBGXjaEL7EdcL1dLAowC2fs/img_20251214_153434.jpg)

So, the completely new experience for me is the snow that is not seen in Bangladesh, and for a long time, I have not enjoyed the winter vibes of Bangladesh during the last couple of years, as I could not get holidays during the coldest time in Bangladesh to experience that winter that I have almost forgotten.

It is not only about the low temperature, but there is so much that you can experience in Bangladesh, which I have not enjoyed for so long. One of the most exciting things that I missed too much during my childhood was the date-plum tree juice that is collected overnight, and jaggery is produced with that juice by cooking for long hours in a large frying pan in the villages of Bangladesh. This is the most exciting thing that I miss in my Beijing winter.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRUzwcPYSg8fHCRVnbWwWzstq2cV86bVtN9Fg5GWpdp1G/img_20251214_153500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc5iLgnppJaKe18fnKjwBrXTVYZkzWmTQLy5yMq5m97NA/img_20251214_153558.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKBd9Gy4Y2bYGRdBkfKb1gLgFNYBuR9LejAXdr7Zc5dD/img_20251214_153602.jpg)


There are more than just foods, though many good foods are prepared in winter with jaggery. Also, in winter, I miss the busking time with the family members in the early morning and at night before going to bed. Usually, we don't have chimneys in Bangladesh as the temperature is not below freezing point there, but on the coldest days, we have the habit of basking with fire from woods together in the yard in winter, which is a very common activity in winter. 

But Beijing winter has its own charm, and I will tell about that in my coming blogs. But I am sharing these beautiful winter shots in a park in Beijing after a snowfall in the wintertime. Such an amazing snow-covered winter is always a gap in the winter of Bangladesh, in my forgotten winter experience that I miss in Beijing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3SwP43yNALjsjhXgeU1xx34t539UcubYbHtwFAjSnGR/img_20251214_153307.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPkaxo3BeEJijRmWmV25B9kXhWHLokKvZpBFLVSkL6gH/img_20251214_153312.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQFPEoesczcurAz4AdN4ySMnp9gaaEM4CfznQVxMpajX/img_20251214_153317.jpg)



I hope you enjoy my photos of the beautiful winter beauty in the winter season in Beijing. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

links.title: Expectativas Vs sueños/Expectations vs. Dreams [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
>
<center> *** Version en español *** </center>

¡Hola, comunidad! Qué gusto pasar por aquí de nuevo. Aunque siempre leo sus publicaciones y me encanta dejarles comentarios, ya ni recuerdo cuándo fue la última vez que publiqué directamente en este espacio. hoy romperé la racha y compartiré esto con ustedes. 

![IMG_20251127_124701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocksy/EqUbSevEpvSmtfpXNgoySPBAhi2JAzMDm4SfNBfYkUZnPMxHzUM1yFCUYW3sHww8m92.jpg)

Quiero contarles algo muy personal soy una persona muy ansiosa, y cuando digo hablo de esta condición, por supuesto mi mente vive soñando, modo expectativa de mis anhelos. Eso durante mucho tiempo me ha causado malestar y depresión.  La tensión entre mi sueños y la realidad que me generaba un gran malestar, una sensación de que nunca estoy donde \

estar. Es un ciclo agotador, donde mi futuro ideal choca constantemente con el presente. ![IMG_20260128_123821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocksy/Eq7NMCrv2LZa1QjbPHnEDyzYSBh7LxFfptY7uTs38xjhU9bk5pShQCJ8HUsvb5yjeVV.jpg) Muchas veces, la ansiedad se esconde detrás de la ambición. me repito en mucha ocasiones que soy proactiva o visionaria, cuando en realidad, estoy evitando el presente por miedo a que no sea lo suficientemente bueno. ![IMG_20260129_133914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocksy/EoPMckD5TEo3chdZd3xoBkovetPuv2xjBM1CmGd7CSxKur9EEkQ1PPbiG6AGKi2YWpc.jpg) Mi pequeña panadería casera, nacida de la ilusión de independencia y el deseo de crear algo propio, había sido mi mundo. Cada madrugada, antes de que el sol se asomara desde mi ventana de la cocina, mis manos amasaban sueños y esperanzas en cada hogaza. Mantener un pequeño negocio a flote se convirtió en una batalla cuesta arriba. Las expectativas iniciales de crecimiento, de tener un local, contratar personal y expandirme, chocaron de frente con la dura realidad de la inversión limitada y un mercado fluctuante. La ansiedad se convirtió en mi sombra constante, oscureciendo la pasión que alguna vez sentí por mi emprendimiento. La presión de las cuentas, la sensación de estancamiento y la comparación silenciosa con aquellos que parecían prosperar, me llevaron a una profundo desanimo. El aroma a pan fresco lo reemplace por el olor a papel y tinta. Conseguí un puesto en una empresa pública, una bocanada de aire fresco en medio de la asfixiante sensación de incertidumbre.Cuando digo una bocanada es literal estoy frente al rio donde el aire los barcos y el murmullo constante del agua y la brisa te envuelven en una atmósfera de paz, donde el tiempo parece detenerse. ![IMG_20251226_140655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocksy/23xAZpiscmjA9pKzg7gsJjja4iisZraS53DagWpx1A9Fr3Vi7MTye6UxzSaWiRk7v7fwE.jpg) Al principio, la emoción de la estabilidad era palpable. Saber que recibiría un salario fijo, aunque modesto para mis aspiraciones, era un alivio significativo. Sin embargo, la sombra de las expectativas sigue presente. mi mente, esta acostumbrada a soñar en grande, a veces me resisto a la lentitud burocrática y a las limitaciones económicas inherentes a un sector público. Anhelo más, lo se, pero también entiendo la importancia de la paciencia y la estrategia. Este no es el final de mi camino, me digo cada mañana, mientras reviso cálculos y documentos. Es mi nuevo comienzo. Voy aferrarme a la idea de que este trabajo sera una inversión a futuro. La experiencia que voy a adquirir, el conocimiento técnico que refinare y las conexiones que estableceré serán peldaños hacia metas aún mayores. En cada proyecto, por pequeño que fuera, buscare aprender, crecer y demostrar lo que valgo. ![Jocksy Morales(1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jocksy/23wgPfPL1AN82L6aqZfp2CVqEpBg5UDabq735VyPjN4e1KZCQ3MH5DNZrz6Dfp8AVM9s5.png)
*** English version ***
>Hello, community! It’s great to be back here again. Even though I always read your posts and love leaving comments, I can’t even remember the last time I posted directly here. Today I’m going to break that streak and share this with you. > >I want to share something very personal with you. I’m a very anxious person, and when I talk about this condition, of course my mind is constantly dreaming and fixated on my hopes and desires. For a long time, this has caused me distress and depression. The tension between my dreams and reality made me feel terrible—like I’m never where I “should” be. It’s an exhausting cycle, where my ideal future constantly clashes with the present. > >Often, anxiety hides behind ambition. We tell ourselves we’re being proactive or visionary, when in reality, we’re avoiding the present out of fear that it isn’t good enough. > >My little home bakery, born out of a dream of independence and a desire to create something of my own, had been my whole world. Every morning, before the sun peeked through my kitchen window, my hands kneaded dreams and hopes into every loaf. > >Keeping a small business afloat became an uphill battle. My initial expectations of growth—of having a storefront, hiring staff, and expanding—clashed head-on with the harsh reality of limited investment and a fluctuating market. Anxiety became my constant shadow, overshadowing the passion I once felt for my venture. > >The pressure of the bills, the feeling of stagnation, and the silent comparison with those who seemed to be thriving led me into deep discouragement. The aroma of fresh bread was replaced by the smell of paper and ink. I landed a job at a public company—a breath of fresh air amid the suffocating sense of uncertainty. When I say a breath of fresh air, I mean it literally: I’m standing by the river where the breeze, the boats, and the constant murmur of the water envelop you in an atmosphere of peace, where time seems to stand still. > >At first, the sense of stability was palpable. Knowing that I would receive a steady salary—albeit a modest one by my standards—was a huge relief. However, the shadow of expectations remains. My mind, accustomed to dreaming big, sometimes resists the bureaucratic slowness and financial constraints inherent in the public sector. I yearn for more, I know, but I also understand the importance of patience and strategy. > >This isn’t the end of my journey, I tell myself every morning as I review calculations and documents. It’s my new beginning. I’m going to hold on to the idea that this job will be an investment in the future. The experience I’ll gain, the technical knowledge I’ll refine, and the connections I’ll make will be stepping stones toward even greater goals. In every project, no matter how small, I’ll seek to learn, grow, and prove my worth.

links.body: 2/5 🧵 Bezos anchored the case in the numbers. He said the **top 1% pay about 40% of all federal income tax revenue**, while the **bottom half pay about 3%**. So his point is blunt: if lower earners contribute such a tiny slice of revenue, why squeeze them at all? In his view, taxing people who are already stretched is lousy policy and worse politics.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 He made it concrete with a working-class example: a nurse in Queens earning around **$75,000** shouldn’t be sending money to Washington. In his framing, the US is rich enough that it doesn’t need to lean on people who are still trying to get stable. That ties into the broader **“two economies”** argument: asset owners and top earners are doing fine, while a lot of everyone else is getting hammered by living costs.

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The article adds some Tax Foundation context from 2023: the **bottom half of taxpayers** had adjusted gross income around **$54,000** on average and paid about **$913 in federal income taxes** per household. Their average tax rate was **3.7%**, versus **26.3%** for the top 1%. Bezos isn’t saying the rich are undertaxed in percentage terms — he’s saying eliminating that lower-half tax bill would matter more to families than it would matter to federal revenue.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 He also took a swing at **corporate tax loopholes**, calling them “crony capitalism,” while dismissing simplistic **tax-the-rich** slogans as a cure-all. His core message is opportunity: if people are struggling at the bottom, stop clipping their wings early. Whether you agree or not, it’s a sharper argument than the usual billionaire soundbite because it targets **mobility**, not just envy. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/business/amazons-jeff-bezos-calls-for-zero-income-taxes-on-bottom-half-of-earners/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.title: Use Opportunity To Exploit BLAST
links.body:
![image by OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23vsJJ6Fm6sm8c8rGsa83H5X3Uf8okTG3Vuu9fihqPVva1BtQrdfBZRAP4AFQjPK3FbBP.png)

I use a funny title for my Splinterlands topic today... Opportunity to exploit blast? Well common people might get confuse about it, but I believe most Splinterlands players already understand what I mean with that...

To exploit blast effect, we use Opportunity ability. It means we should employe opportunity ability holder during Explosive Weaponry modifier, which the modifier or ruleset gives all unit BLAST ability.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EobyoRq1n3jpptmvt5ZsCD6MnDjKxQ2P76pkSHbaVYP7bCZjthRESdZsNMMXfKgsz2h.png

And one of the good example for doing that is by having Mahkah Hemlig in your line up. It is not mandatory to use her, in fact many other opportunity ability holders fit well too, but Mahkah Hemlig has two main attributes to be the perfect one... First hits hard, Second moves fast...

Why those two attributes matter? because during Explosive Weaponry or when everyone doing the blast, mostlikely the team that moves faster and hit harder will win. It is hard to guard a blast effect, you will need to use units with Deflect ability, which Mahkah Hamlig has it too. However, those units usually weak or slow, so you are compensating your fire power and it is a bad move to slow down or hit softer when everyone are having blast party.

So let see show you how and why you need opportunity during this modifier, of course by showing a battle!

#### The Battle

[![~Click The Image Above To See the Full Battle~](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23sx9acxHuHXtTy2GjGdVj9UwgW14wp2kxxAch9TwWtiT81V2wXzoFvaJvJ4XqpvnBAy4.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_37d0623fcb1226c4ecda848896082378?ref=dewabrata)

So this was a modern rank battle of Gold league tier 1. You might think that my team was stronger by level, well actually only my summoner who had higher level. all my units were capped at silver league cap level. So basically my team and their team had the same level of units.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tRzfXraM7FG6s6AyJS4MQEGkGRBxmSSTWGuj5heN9Z2F3i9Pvaai4Y1NYkndGSv3UiV.png

This was a simple battle with one modifier only, the Explosive Weaponry. One modifier only, so it should be easy right? The challenge was the 42 mana cap there. We needed to be realistic on that battle, whether you would go with big hitter, or big tanks. I believed both of us could go with a lot more gigantic units if the mana cap was above 60.

The funny thing about this battle was the similarity between our approaches. Both my opponent and I decided to defend more than doing the attacks. The difference? they want to use status ailments from poison ability, and my team wanted to exploit the BLAST using opportunity ability, from my Mahkah Hemlig.

But first let see how they planned to built up their defense.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tSKnGvL4JNh56dT8BWZgzucWD8Bjsr9RNT3hE965HG1xUnm3dEY8sywBzEhSZm95D76.png

They had two units with Deflect Ability, Thunderhoof Nomad and Buttercup Mauler. I gave a highlight on them with blue boxes. They would defense the blast effect from the red boxes units, which were their main tank and their rear tank. They prepared for sneak attacks.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eoc5XY35DgzdQ4s1mi6XmpVCSFMQN6Js6W3GYNSxH5djbYutYboGQZRTMZmXQ88e2Wg.png

I used two deflect ability holders too, the same Thunderhoof Nomad and Mahkah Hemlig. Basically I was waiting my opponent to use a straight line attacks, which they came and stormed my main front door. If they did that, I would win directly because I had two healers in the back. Good luck in breaking my gate lol

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23uQiC8CajnLH7iKjiZWGCVyd7qBaUciQyuTPL1YfQ44JVVBG3AgC7KSKqid57wJQcnA1.png

My secondary tank was Silvershield Sentry. He had that Bulwark ability, so he would become a 13 health point tank if he moved up to the main tank position. With two healer, it meant I would recover his health point 2x4 = 8 health per round. Well that's why I said good luck lol.

But here what happened next... Opportunity Ability ruined their defense!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23t7FhbooX88q2HBmPYk3CTN1aKczxKXc3f1Zmqwxzih4GBGgeETGR2zryv9aEEUtcMhG.png

My Mahkah Hemlig shot down their Thunderhoof Nomad directly and the Nomad was out instantly. Instead of holding the blast damage, she died first. This was why I said Opportunity Ability could exploit the blast effect, the blast coming from where you did not expect.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23t7FdJhc2zjY7AknNNGiCQZS3yKVv2B6kHdCpoakPCUW1Kr2aCDm11DyLMt5ZrvssUAC.png

This did not happen once, but twice. Later on round two my Mahkah Hemlig shot their second Deflect ability holder, the Buttercup Mauler. She was strong enough not to be killed in one go, but definitely ruined their defense. She died in the next round.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tGbr1CQMsGvD6NcV73PG8SssEcVHktLC3VWCiRYYKRuoc9auhDSmyb9BRMAiZd2xRs9.png

The result was very clear, it became a single sided battle. My team won convincingly. Good game

Again I would say this, this is why Opportunity would exploit the blast attacks. The attack will land on the place that you would least expected. There are sneak attacks, snipe attacks, and the last opportunity attacks. From the first one to last, the difficulty to defend against it is getting harder.

Well the easiest one is to have a taunt ability tank, which we all already know all attacks will go there. However it will be difficult to employ a taunting tank with 42 mana cap. Even you force it into your lineup, your meta will deteriorate due to not having the right units for the rest of the team. 
 
Ok that's my thought about this opportunity and blast, thank you for visiting my post today, feel free to leave your feedback below and have fun in the Splinterlands battles!

---

links.title: Windrose Review
links.body:
![windrose.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23tbHF485SdViPQ1Tcw4yPHVnZV8RoqTAQdELuDkr1PAA54cN4qHx2Ep4V8yBr5kdxJom.jpg)
Windrose has been in early access for a little while now. It was time to sail the high seas and go yarr for some booty. While not everything in the game is fully realized yet, there is more than enough to keep you busy for quite some time. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CQa6lKKAINM While Windrose is a survival crafting game. There are many elements they did away with in what you consider the long running traditions of this genre. While you don’t need to manage a drink or food bar, consuming food increases your health massively. Along with giving you options for which stats you would like to have a boost to.
![talent page.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23swgEFtMXQNaaFmcsQh4TYa56Ku4CqYjdPvne8uUrSouywe16WVws9bMmi6dCNE3r3dT.jpg)
Also, while leveling up allows you to unlock some talents and attributes. Unlike other games in this genre, you are not unlocking new crafting blueprints with points. Instead, you have to go out exploring for resources to unlock new crafting benches and their upgrades. Along with looting base items for armors and weapons to have access to them.
![crafting.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23t74pE32GKS596jXBQh8MvX197zTnkak8id7SCPTxgcmtwDXHKgEZdVMfrMZUiuQJqTz.jpg)
I personally like this way of going about it. There can also be some downsides as well. For the set of armor I was wearing. You can buy two of the recipes from the vendors. The remaining you have to loot. Well, after hitting level 5 and killing a boss to unlock the next area. I was still missing gloves for that set. Thankfully, set bonuses are for 2 and 4 pieces of gear. Still, it was a little strange having progressed that far along and not having any luck on the RNG side of things to get the missing pair of gloves I wanted. You also don’t level up quickly in Windrose either. With how far you can progress in the game for now. I believe the level cap is just 15. So you really have to stop and think where you want to spend things like talent points.
![points of interest.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23tm6tNKceNqppDe8FjzwpN5fEnXCUv4cCCt4u31oejaDUxoJGCGHsqN4FCgGjUpMBVwW.jpg)
The only way to get experience in Windrose to level up is by finishing quests or by completing points of interest on the map. This also creates its own challenges as well. Since you can’t just grind creatures to overlevel for an area. The result, at least for me, was quite a few deaths along the way.
![attacking a ruin.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23yJ7rh79bmuWq8pzKLY1KLtENDvUpUNoNfos4shssPdjT9ECoC7zRujGvqSJoi21SfFR.jpg)
While some points of interest can be quite small, such as a single tent. Others can be an entire town or in most cases ruins of a former place. Some of them require some thinking about how you want to approach attacking them as well. Some of the more fun ways I’’ve found to try and get the upper hand on a hard-to-clear location. Is finding quite an aggressive animal like a wolf and luring it into pirates. Other times, I’ve found pirates busy trying to deal with local wildlife. I’d then charge in, taking out the ranged pirates while they are busy dealing with the threat. Windrose is quite generous in its ability to travel around. While yes, you can set sail on the high seas in a ship. You can also place up to 10 fast travel points that you can move around. Along with there being fast travel to boss locations, and the islands' different factions you run into as well.
![part of the map.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23u5xjJXgaszRo86hs9PK961RHm1AL1CDFkMu9ADYri5eMkMF4HdLHrDytFxAfZQgoJm6.jpg)
Exploration is a massive part of Windrose. With each map being random generated, it adds a bit of replayabilty and mysteries to it as well. In my own solo play. The game started me off more in the south, with forward progress to be found by going north into higher level areas. Meanwhile, when I join a friend's game in multiplayer. His map is quite different. He seems to be more in the north. With the current higher level stuff being found in the south-west of lower tier islands. Also, when you join a multiplayer game. While things like questing are shared if you are online at the time. You still have to go out and discover locations and uncover the map yourself. There's nothing like joining someone else’s game, and they know where everything is as they have uncovered it. While you yourself have to go out and spend time exploring yourself. To get caught up. At least with the fast travel system, it makes things a little easier. You can also set up things like bonfires. These are needed to set up a base around to have crafting benches working on anyway. They can be seen on the map. Even when an area is still covered in the fog of war. It ended up being an interesting way to show the location of the islands to others.
![mining for ores.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23tSL9UKUR8e7PtiWknsVejXb1e48wPUak1q1CzCcEHTCjxqNFwscHpJfppxapLRGes1r.jpg)
A big part of the game is also resource gathering. Each region of the map has its own tier of resources. The starting area has copper. Then the next has iron and so on. I, of course, could not help myself and have gone on quite a lot of massive mining runs for ores. It’s a good thing you need a lot of ores to upgrade gear, build things, and progress through the game. It’s also been fun to see how different resources are set up. Copper, for instance, has been found inside caves. Some of those caves have been empty of enemies, and others just don’t seem to stop coming at you. Meanwhile, the iron above is in open-pit mines. Where you descend down a slope deeper and deeper into the mine. With some ores here or there. Along with some tunnels going into the mountain, creating little shafts to explore. Some of them have been filled with goats that are not that hard to deal with. Other wolves and they create a bit more of a challenge. While I don’t feel melee combat is Windrose’s strong suit. As there is a lot of struggle when melee or ranged combat is not one-on-one. With range combat requiring ammo and gunpowder. With gunpowder being more of a limited resource until you can craft it yourself later in the game.
![ship combat.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23vhHczysgSYhxW38bLd3zqyCxUHU1LfrTjxJfHyX2hD4skodYaE7etGoCo21wRym74Ef.jpg)
The combat is a lot of fun for me, at least. Has been ship-to-ship. Even when you find yourself looking down on a small armada of ships. It’s not really an issue. There is a lot of sailing around to kite things a bit easier. I’m usually stocked with repair kits. It also just feels like combat is more balanced in ship-to-ship than foot combat. For right now, there are three base ships in the game. With each one having a few variants as well. Some focus more on health, speed, or carrying capacity. I find the base variant to be a great middle ground that gives me everything I want.
![boarding as ship.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23tRrDixBvjvhkdcDr6eBANNfKFVB3uoxak2oygrbbKPdNdW5G2ePHkkJmJk6U3QWXS5Q.jpg)
Sinking a ship gets you some loot. You can also disable a ship by damaging it enough. Then boarded it. Usually, if I get taken out, it’s a boarding attempt. It’s not worth it doing it for every ship for the extra loot. However, when you come across transport ships that are much harder to take out. They have loot worth boarding for. If that’s not enough piracy for you. There is even some treasure hunting to be had. Where a red X on the map marks the spot to go digging. Some of the points of interest even have you looking for a marked location to dig up some treasure.
![my place.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23xAKDGsWP4oeaAoxh8rX63UkTJjEB37nKfmobn66sWgzTUbo6Mg2nWTEeoU7Svr8tS9U.jpg)
I’ve never been huge on building massive things in video games before. So, in my own solo play. The place I’m living is a bit more modest in nature. Where I even one of the pre-set up structures that you can just plop down for a house if you have the resources. The building process is quite snappy. You can level land with a shovel if needed. You even earn gold coins that can be spent at the different factions for more fancy-looking building blocks and things like lamps and chairs. For me. I just made sure I have enough items down for a decent resting bonus. Jumping onto your boat also gives you a resting bonus equal to your highest one at any of the camps you have set up. I felt is a nice touch from always having to run back to a base to refresh, such a bonus. # Final Thoughts
![final.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enjar/23t752ET1hkaDCnLLuvD9jQSJEbMgU38DxV28o2iok5e6Bgnoxp77Ncp6w1Y1vqxvajNr.jpg)
Overall, in the around 50 hours that I’ve played so far. I’ve had quite a blast. From solo play to joining others. While this is one of those games that’s more fun with friends. You can still have quite a blast solo playing in your own world. Sometimes it was just nice to jump on for 15 minutes and go take out some ships when I found myself with some spare time. Other times, it’s fun charging into a small armada with a few friends in their own boats. It’s a bit of a shame that only one party can engage in the boarding process. For a game in early access, I’ve encountered very few bugs. One seemed to fix itself after upgrading my video card. Sometimes it feels like my character is not attempting to parry incoming attacks when I click to do so every time. While I can understand why some people stay away from early access games. There's more than enough there to have a good time. At this point, anything extra that gets added to the game will just feel like free extra content at this point. I still have so much to explore, another boss to kill, and I am getting killed a lot myself. # Information Screenshots were taken, and content was written by @Enjar about Windrose. Disclosure: This review is based off the game in early access.

links.body: 1/5 🧵 Thomas Massie losing a GOP primary isn’t just one congressman getting bounced — the real story is the civil war it exposes. Marjorie Taylor Greene basically declared the old Republican coalition dead and blamed the Epstein files fight for helping light the match. That’s the headline beneath the headline.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 Greene’s reaction was not subtle. She praised Massie as “a giant among weak pathetic men” and claimed that pushing to release DOJ files on Jeffrey Epstein became “our demise.” Her argument: the people in charge are compromised, the party is controlled by forces that don’t serve voters, and Massie’s defeat proves dissenters are being purged.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The article frames this as the latest chapter in Greene’s break with Trumpworld. She had been one of Trump’s loudest allies, but the relationship soured after his Iran airstrikes and deepened as she escalated attacks on GOP leadership. She also tied herself to the Epstein-files push, which the piece presents as a key rupture point inside the party.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 Massie, meanwhile, was already a long-running irritant to Trump and GOP leadership. He’d clashed with Trump going back to the COVID relief era and kept breaking with party leadership on major votes, including spending and shutdown-related bills. So his loss to Trump-backed Ed Gallrein reads less like a surprise upset and more like a deliberate cleanup operation by the MAGA machine.

HR chief Janelle Gale said the redesign uses **“AI native” principles**, which is corporate-speak for: AI is reshaping the org chart, and humans are being expected to do more with fewer layers above them.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The scale matters. Meta started the year with **nearly 79,000 employees**, so this ranks among its biggest cuts yet. It also fits a longer pattern: Zuckerberg already slashed **20,000+ jobs in 2022 and 2023** during the so-called “year of efficiency.” This isn’t a one-off cleanup — it’s a continued flattening of the company while AI spending explodes.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 That spending is the real engine here. Meta said capital expenditures could reach **as high as $145 billion this year**, driven by AI data centers and related infrastructure. So the story isn’t just “layoffs.” It’s capital shifting from labor to compute. Workers get severance — at least **16 weeks of base pay plus 2 weeks per year worked**, along with health care and career support — but the bigger message is ugly and clear: in 2026 tech is choosing AI scale over headcount. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/18/business/meta-employees-told-to-work-remotely-wednesday-as-company-prepares-to-slash-10-of-workforce-report/)\n\n#threadstorm

![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 42: Plans Start To Roll

<center>![Demadrian_Sentray2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23u5xjJXTaVPDhF3oCzSRaGK4F13SZNs5PDmAyBQHmEnxnLwMLcemUmcmfBz4s8ApmZpG.png)</center>

Angelo, Julio, Orcilla, and Demadrian returned to the laboratory the next day. 

‘This is it, the moment of truth,’ said Demadrian, rubbing his hands together. ‘I’m feeling really confident.’

‘Your perfect combination,’ sighed Orcilla. 

'It's as good as it’s going to get,’ chuckled Demadrian. ‘If I kept going, I’d run out of egg, and we wouldn’t have a serum at all.’

‘That’s a joke, right?’ asked Orcilla.

‘Yeah, sure,’ chuckled Demadrian, shaking his head.

‘You could use some of my serum,’ said Angelo, looking at Julio.

‘I have given it much thought,’ replied Julio. ‘I trust Demadrian. He’s one of the most brilliant scientists to ever live.’

‘He has a point,’ said Demadrian. ‘My IQ cannot even be measured.’

‘It pales compared to your ego,’ sighed Orcilla.

‘She’s right,’ said Demadrian as he pulled out a large vial of a green liquid. ‘My confidence and willpower are even more impressive than my intelligence.’

‘Nothing is going to change your minds at this point,’ said Orcilla as she watched Demadrian fill two syringes with the green liquid.

‘The odds are stacked against us,’ said Demadrian in a more serious tone as he held out the two syringes to Orcilla. ‘If we don’t take this crazy risk. Tiberius will eventually destroy all of us. My position has not and now cannot change.’

‘I know,’ sighed Orcilla as he took the syringes from him. ‘I’ll do as you ask.’

Both Julio and Demadrian climbed onto examination tables.

‘I want you to sedate us first,’ said Demadrian. ‘Then inject us with the serum syringes. After that, every hour, inject us with the drug that I injected Angelo with. Do that until we awaken.’

‘No problem,’ replied Orcilla.

She sedated both Julio and Demadrian. She waited a couple of minutes, and then she injected them both with Demadrian’s serum.

‘I’m staying with him,’ said Angelo, who was sitting next to Julio and holding his hand. ‘I’ve put Razor in charge for now.’

‘Cool,’ replied Orcilla as she set the alarm on a clock she placed by the examination table. ‘I could do with the company.’

Meanwhile in the temple, Razor was finally enjoying a large plate of pancakes to himself. He sliced into a large syrup-covered pancake and gently placed a piece into his mouth. ‘Now that’s a future I could really enjoy,’ he sighed.

That evening in the West Camp, Tiberius had called for a strategy meeting with his enforcer captains, Miro and Walter. They gathered in the main tent after dinner.

‘Can we confirm that Orcilla is aware of the death of her friends and the resistance force in the Downs Region?’ asked Tiberius as he looked across the table at Cecil.

‘Yes, we allowed them to hack your message,’ replied Cecil.

‘Were they aware of where our training exercises were taking place?’ asked Tiberius.

‘The information was strategically placed for them to find,’ replied Cecil. ‘The documents have been moved since we left, so we know they have been seen. However, they did not take the bait.’

‘I’m very disappointed that you’ve failed to provoke a response,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘I’m also disappointed that you failed to take the initiative and destroy the Sentray and the ugly monster leading them.’

‘We have a spy in the West Tribes that has informed us that the cult has formed an alliance with them,’ said Cecil.

‘An alliance to attack us?’ asked Tiberius.

‘That is almost a certainty,’ replied Cecil.

‘That tells me they didn’t attack because they weren’t ready,’ said Tiberius. ‘Despite our baiting, they had the good sense to hold off. Their rage did not lead them to certain defeat.’

‘Their anger would have subsided slightly,’ said Miro. ‘Therefore, the chances they will make a foolish move have declined. I would strongly argue they would not attack us in this camp where we have far superior numbers.’

‘So, we’re in a stalemate,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘Is there any way we can bring the fight to them underground?’

‘The narrow tunnels negate our advantage,’ replied Miro. ‘We’ve tried before. We can’t win that way.’

Walter watched in annoyance but did not utter a word.

‘Somebody give me an idea that’ll work,’ said Tiberius angrily as he looked around the table.

Everyone remained silent.

‘I want scouts sent to observe every entrance of the tunnels controlled by the West Tribes and the cult,’ said Tiberius as he looked at Miro. ‘I want full surveillance on all the tunnels we control. I want to know every move they make.’

‘Yes, Your Imperial Majesty,’ replied Miro.

‘We meet again tomorrow,’ said Tiberius angrily as he looked around the table. ‘Someone better come back with a good idea.’

As they were leaving the tent, Cecil approached Tiberius. ‘I have an idea, which I feel is better expressed in private,’ said Cecil, grinning slightly.

‘Good, let’s hear it,’ said Tiberius.

‘Let’s start torturing and killing the Downs workers,’ said Cecil. ‘That’s bound to draw them here. Then we can massacre the lot of them.’

‘I like your way of thinking; I really do,’ said Tiberius as he rubbed Cecil on the back. ‘You have to remember Orcilla didn’t even respond when her husband was killed. She and the cult leaders have no compassion for others. They’re not like us.’

‘Some of them are just useless anyway,’ replied Cecil. ‘Their existence is just a waste of resources.’

‘I absolutely agree,’ said Tiberius. ‘Sadly, the others and even many of my enforcers wouldn’t understand that eliminating them is for the greater good and, in many ways, an act of kindness. They will get the wrong idea, and that’ll damage their morale.’

‘Of course, Your Imperial Majesty,’ replied Cecil, nodding.

‘Thank you for your input,’ said Tiberius, grinning. ‘I think we can constructively build on your suggestion.’

Revals was lying down on his sofa in his cabin. Walter opened the door of the cabin and poked his head in. 

‘Oh please, go away,’ groaned Revals.

‘I got you some cake, friend,’ said Walter as he held up a plate. ‘It’s chocolate walnut.’

‘That sounds nice,’ said Revals as he sat up. ‘But it’s not going to make my arm grow back.’

‘The technicians are really smart,’ said Walter as he handed Revals the plate with the cake on. ‘I’ll ask them to make you a really awesome robot arm.’

‘Right now, I want the pain to stop,’ sighed Revals as he stuck a fork into the cake.

‘I have an idea,’ said Walter as his face lit up. He rushed out of the cabin.

Ten minutes later, Walter returned. Phillip and Big Burt accompanied him. Walter and Phillip helped Big Burt into the cabin. He struggled to climb the steps because of his weak legs and back. Walter was also carrying two books and a videotape.

‘Why do you want to come in here?’ asked Revals. He had a perplexed look on his face.

‘Masters of Wrestling,’ said Walter as he placed the two books on the coffee table in front of the sofa. ‘Best painkiller around.’

‘It’s the “Final Battle” premium event from ten years ago, friend,’ said Big Burt as he clumsily sat down next to Revals on the sofa.

‘Those two books look the same,’ said Revals as he looked at the two books.

‘They are the same,’ chuckled Walter as he raised his eyebrows. ‘Don’t worry, there’s method to Big Burt’s madness.’

Phillip pushed the tape into the videoplayer attached to Revals’ television, and then he pressed a button on the remote.

The Master of Wrestling introduction began. Phillip plonked himself on the floor next to Walter. A few minutes later, a wrestler’s entrance theme song began. Big Burt opened one of the books. He flipped through a few pages.

‘That’s him!’ said Big Burt excitedly as he pointed at a picture in the book.

‘Get it now?’ asked Walter as he turned to look at Revals.

‘I think so,’ said Revals, sounding a little unsure.

Two hours later, the main event had concluded.

‘That’s crazy!’ exclaimed Revals. ‘That guy attacked him with a pitchfork, and he still won.’

‘That’s the Bulk,’ said Big Burt as he pointed at a picture in the book. ‘He’s the greatest champion ever.’

‘Twelve years ago, he teamed up with his own grandmother to win the tag titles in a grillhouse brawl,’ said Phillip as he waved his arms around.

‘That’s cool,’ said Revals. ‘I haven’t had this much fun in a long time.’

‘We can do this tomorrow night, if you like,’ said Walter as he got up. ‘I’ll make a jumbo cobbler we can share.’

‘Yes, I will like that very much,’ said Big Burt as he smiled at Revals, who smiled back at him.

Big Burt grabbed his books, and both Walter and Phillip helped him up. They slowly manoeuvred him through the cabin door. A few minutes later, Walter re-emerged at the cabin door.

‘Thank you,’ said Revals in a soft tone. ‘You’re far kinder than I deserve.’

‘You’re a piece of shit,’ said Walter in an angry tone. Then he chuckled and began to smile. ‘You still deserve some kindness, and especially so after what just happened.’

Revals smiled and nodded.

It was the early hours of the morning in Julio’s laboratory. Both Julio and Demadrian had just been given the drug to stabilise them. Orcilla was going to sleep for a few hours while Angelo took care of them. Suddenly, Demadrian began to shake violently. Then he started to involuntarily shapeshift. 

'Oh, nuts,’ sighed Orcilla.

‘This is probably what he would expect,’ said Angelo nervously.

Demadrian sat up abruptly. His head shapeshifted into that of Sentray’s. He roared loudly and aggressively and then flopped back down onto the examination table. His head returned to its normal size but continued to shapeshift.

Angelo’s hair stood up as he moved away from the examination table.

‘This is crazy,’ gasped Orcilla as she grabbed another syringe of the drug Demadrian had prepared. She jammed it into his arm. Demadrian’s movements and shapeshifting started to decrease. A few minutes later, he was motionless again.

‘I’m going to monitor this personally,’ said Orcilla as she looked at Angelo, who was looking at Julio.

Around every twenty minutes, Demadrian would begin shaking violently and shapeshifting. Each time, Orcilla would inject him with the drug. Julio remained unconscious this whole time.

links.body: 1/5 🧵 Two kids barricading themselves in a bedroom for **54 days** sounds like a dystopian script. It was real. Hulu’s *The Nightmare Upstairs* turns that viral standoff into something uglier and more important: a custody war where abuse allegations, “parental alienation,” and family court all collided at full speed.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The core of it: Utah siblings Ty and Brynlee Larson locked themselves in an upstairs room in 2023 and livestreamed the ordeal because they feared being forced back into contact with their father, Brent Larson. They had accused him of sexual abuse. He denied it and argued their mother, Jessica Zahrt, had turned them against him — the familiar and deeply controversial “parental alienation” defense.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The documentary digs into how this spiraled. Brynlee first made an allegation in 2018 when she was 7. Ty later made his own. Authorities reportedly found the allegations credible and “severe and chronic,” yet Brent was never charged. That gap is the fuse here: abuse claims serious enough to trigger years of investigation, but not enough to cleanly shut the legal fight down. So the case kept grinding through court instead of ending.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 Where it gets especially brutal is the court’s response. The focus shifted from the abuse allegations to whether the kids were being manipulated by their mother. The judge ultimately ordered reunification efforts, including a 90-day “reunification camp” with their father and no contact with Jessica. That’s what triggered the barricade. Ty says he livestreamed because he believed the court wasn’t listening and that public visibility was the only thing keeping them from being taken. That’s a hell of an indictment of the system.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 The ending is less tidy than “justice served.” After the barricade, Jessica got full custody, but Brent still had visitation for a time. In 2024, he voluntarily gave up his parental rights, and Jessica’s second husband later adopted the kids. The family was left financially wrecked — Jessica says she owes more than **$300,000** in legal bills. The documentary’s real point isn’t just the shocking barricade; it’s how family court can turn already damaged families into long-form trauma. 📎 [Source](https://pagesix.com/2026/05/19/entertainment/the-nightmare-upstairs-doc-explores-when-utah-siblings-barricaded-themselves-in-bedroom-for-54-days/)\n\n#threadstorm

The light blue sky behind and the gentle touch of the clouds have enhanced the beauty of the flower several times over. These flowers usually open up at dawn and close as the sun sets. links.body: 1/5 🧵 Over **113,000 Costco/HomeGoods kettles** got recalled because the **handle can detach and dump boiling water on you**. That’s not a “minor defect.” That’s a countertop ambush. One person already suffered a **second-degree burn**, and there were **163 reports** of handles loosening or separating.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The products are **ZWILLING Enfinigy** electric stainless-steel kettles and kettle pros. The key issue: the **handle assembly can loosen**, and in some cases fully separate while the kettle is being used. If that happens with near-boiling water inside, you’ve got an obvious burn hazard — fast, messy, and dangerous.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body:
3/5 🧵 The scale is pretty big:
- **113,440** recalled in the US  
- **43,963** in Canada  
- **48** in Mexico  
Reported incidents include **5 cases of handle separation** and **1 second-degree burn**. That’s the sort of defect regulators don’t shrug off, because one failure is all it takes when the product is built to hold scalding liquid.

links.body: 1/5 🧵 NYC got a fake-out summer: temps hit the low 90s and felt like **102°F**, but the city isn’t actually in a heat wave — and Memorial Day weekend is shaping up more like a damp April rerun than a summer kickoff.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The hottest stretch lands Tuesday and Wednesday. Central Park hit about **92°F Tuesday**, and Wednesday was expected to edge up to **93°F**, enough for NYC Emergency Management to push **extreme heat advisories** through the evening. After a warm climb from **79° Saturday** to **86° Sunday** and **88° Monday**, the city briefly felt like August showed up three months early.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The key nuance: **hot doesn’t automatically mean heat wave**. AccuWeather says NYC needs **3 straight days at 90°F or above** to qualify. So this is nasty, sticky weather, but not record-breaking or especially historic. Meteorologist Matt Benz’s point is basically: unusual to feel this rough, yes; shocking for May, no. NYC actually hit **99°F on this same date in 1962**, and the city’s earliest recorded heat wave was **April 16–18, 2002**.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 Then the mood flips hard. **Thunderstorms arrive Wednesday**, followed by a big cooldown: **Thursday and Friday** look partly cloudy with highs near **65°F** and lows around **51°F**. By **Saturday**, the forecast turns properly miserable — **steady rain** and a high near **58°F** — with more rain expected into **Sunday**, when temps only recover to around **66°F**.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 The punchline: don’t let two sweaty days fool you. The article’s real story is weather whiplash — a burst of near-August heat, then a soggy, cool holiday weekend, with more normal spring warmth returning by **Monday/next work week** as temps move back toward the **70s**. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/us-news/summer-comes-early-in-nyc-with-blistering-temps-but-memorial-day-weekend-will-be-wet-and-cool/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 1/5 🧵 A fake real estate “investment fund” promised Seattle investors **20% annual returns** and a 10-year payout. Instead, prosecutors say the money got torched on a **custom Tesla, an 8.5-carat diamond ring, cosmetic procedures, and tax bills**. The result: prison.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 Tamara King, 56, was sentenced to **55 months in federal prison** after being convicted on wire fraud, money laundering, and tax fraud charges. Prosecutors said she and her former husband, Paul Waln, ran the fraud through a fund called **Halcyon**, pitching it as a pooled real estate play focused on a West Seattle apartment building and other ventures.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 The pitch was simple and seductive: lock your money up for at least 10 years, then get back your principal plus returns Waln estimated at **20% annually**. **22 victims** invested about **$2.25 million**. Instead of honoring that deal, prosecutors said the pair diverted the money for personal spending between **2014 and 2018**.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The ugliest part is how ordinary the damage was. By 2019, investors were told the money was gone and the investment had failed. Many lost everything. Federal prosecutors framed it as theft from people chasing retirement security, not some Wall Street high-wire gamble. King also underreported income badly: she reported **$188,116** across three years when authorities said she actually received **$1.85 million**.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 King tried blaming her ex-husband, saying she didn’t realize the “loans” were improper. The judge didn’t buy it. He said she lied on the stand and called her the **“primary instigator”** driven by **“pure greed.”** Waln had already pleaded guilty and got **33 months**. King will also face **3 years of supervised release** after prison. 📎 [Source](https://www.realtor.com/news/real-estate-news/tamara-king-waln-seattle-real-estate-investor-fraud/?cid=psc_nyp_syndication_real-estate-news_tamara-king-waln-seattle-real-estate-investor-fraud)\n\n#threadstorm

links.body: 1/5 🧵 A congressional candidate didn’t just wander off-message — she reportedly went full political self-detonation. The core of this story is that Texas Democrat Maureen Galindo is being blasted for rhetoric about turning an ICE facility into a prison for “American Zionists,” including a “castration processing center.” That’s not edgy. It’s grotesque.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says Galindo’s campaign posted on Instagram that, if elected, she would introduce legislation declaring support for Zionism anti-Semitic and convert the Karnes ICE Detention Center into a prison for “American Zionists and former ICE officers.” It also says the post described a “castration processing center for pedophiles,” then linked that idea to Zionists. That’s the section driving the backlash, and obviously so.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 3/5 🧵 Politically, this lands in the middle of a runoff in Texas’ 35th District. Galindo finished first in the March primary with 29.2%, while Johnny Garcia had 27%, so both advanced to the runoff. Garcia’s line is basically: while voters care about gas, groceries, and normal life, his opponent is pushing conspiracies and hate-fueled nonsense. Hard to argue with that framing.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 4/5 🧵 The article also leans into the campaign-money angle. A PAC called Lead Left reportedly spent $428,713 backing Galindo, with Democrats claiming the real number is higher and tying that support to broader GOP meddling in Democratic primaries. So the piece isn’t just about offensive rhetoric — it also frames Galindo as a candidate being elevated in part because chaos is useful to the other side. Grim, but very American.
links.author: askrafiki

links.body: 5/5 🧵 The broader point: this isn’t a story about ordinary policy disagreement. It’s about extremist rhetoric, antisemitic tropes, and how parties weaponize fringe candidates when it helps them. Whatever your politics, calling for camps and attaching collective guilt to Jews or “Zionists” is poisonous trash. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/us-news/sex-therapist-dem-candidate-calls-for-converting-ice-facilities-into-camps-for-american-zionists-with-castration-center/)\n\n#threadstorm

links.title: Cybersecurity Must Prepare for AI Driven Hardware Exploitation
links.body:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/sgpZ75Lg/Cybersecurity-Must-Prepare-for-AI-Driven-Hardware-Exploitation.jpg) 

Oh, so you thought Mythos and other AI models would only find vulnerabilities in software? Well, finding weaknesses in firmware and hardware is traditionally much more difficult, requiring specialized skills and in some cases very expensive tools. But AI is very proficient at specific types of hacks like memory corruption. Such architectures are embedded in CPUs, GPUs, and other processors as well as system memory.

This week, [vulnerability researchers](https://blog.calif.io/p/first-public-kernel-memory-corruption) used Mythos to identify and exploit a kernel memory vulnerability in the Apple M5 computer chip that powers MacBooks and iPads. That is the core brain of the system.

The strategic takeaway is that new AI models like Anthropic’s Mythos will greatly expand the capabilities of responsible and malicious vulnerability researchers to find weaknesses in technology throughout the stack. Data, applications, interfaces, operating systems, virtualization environments, network transports, firmware, and hardware systems are all on the menu when it comes to the next generation of vulnerability detection and exploit creation.

Cybersecurity must approach this new challenge with the widest possible view and understand that the entire digital ecosystem will face greatly elevated risks. It is time to rethink our approaches to development security, cybersecurity operations, risk management, digital forensics, and incident response.

Companies like ARM, Apple, Qualcomm, Intel, AMD, Nvidia, and other chip designers should be moving aggressively to build strong defenses, detection features, and response capabilities within their product architectures. The design runway is much longer, often several years, before a new processor model makes it to market. Then patching that hardware and firmware once a vulnerability is detected is significantly more difficult, and in some cases impossible, as compared to software.

Chip designers must get ahead of these challenges in ways that don’t apply to software developers. It requires strategic thinking and long-term planning to outmaneuver threats that won’t emerge for years. Such challenges dwarf what current security operational teams must deal with. This is where cybersecurity strategists earn their pay and they better be working overtime to protect future generations of chips that run our global digital ecosystem!
