> ### Lux Favor Frontier Prize Wheel ![img_wheel-wheel copy2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/AK9MvAgosvRDk549p1zPPisqQ3LEcMf5MLwLCU3Q7qnGdd4ue2j3ZgfX7H7WwUR.png)

> **Lux Favor** is the brand-new reward system for the Frontier format. Unlike the Frontier Daily rewards that you need to win a certain number of battles before you can claim the rewards, in Lux Favor, the only thing you need to do is to log in to the game daily. This means that players does not necessarily need to play Frontier format to spin the wheel. Each day, a player will have 1 spin and depending on where the wheel stops, a player can get a chance to either win Frontier Energy, win Sparks Token, win Frontier Skins, Free Spins, or have a chance for a **Pit Fight Entries**, which is kind of similar to a boss battle. Also, the longer your daily streak is, the better the rewards that you can get. To claim your free spin, just switch to Frontier Format, Click on the Daily Streak button to get to the Daily streak page. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tbPh55Lce4abYqktSwR2vbKya5tyAhDDmAb6sMM3XFzFwB5XJrvP3uCqCWWAJ65RPhr.png) After that, just click continue to activate the streak shield and get your free spin. ![Screenshot 2026-05-20 044155.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23swkEUngwkiJHa5bYXA1i4ScQG1R3bTMV81fzsmPeAm4qJB7caZ6W9XeNW2aaBuEuXb6.png) You will then move to the **Lux's Favor** page where you can now use your free spin to spin the wheel. ![Screenshot 2026-05-20 044242.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tGXuXDRk8X55u4fN6UgqceXrAVXUS7dTJRyi3oeU5M4xVryTfDghiZ5r16s2pT1XFzZ.png) Defending on where the wheel stops, then you can win different prices, such as Sparks token of a chance to enter a Pit Fight. ![Screenshot 2026-05-20 044224.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23swe5QvL7sCMW2dAyepG3wMAqumGBrNUFfknhjvmu565xRwhueYn4M8wGsVum5RTbwJ5.png) ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

>

A **Fit Fight Challenge** is a one of the options that a layer can won in the Prize Wheel, which gives the opportunity one of the several fighters, each with different difficulty. The more difficult the fighter is the better rewards that it will offer, but unless you win against the fighter you will not be able to claim the prize.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tRxoY1YvQaSAyZ3UiNhssVw66sQLYdgCkDpdoRWmhLHmQPBH5WXVuYkZ7NHeuKEPbZp.png)

It seems that each of them has will have an enormous amount of health and huge stats  that will require your entire team to work together to win the battle. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23t7aQEmBaaafrE6TpPACsueqbHo7tz7QGzPWSrkqLKM8EY8Kn1GAbdBtBSbdkJegi4Ay.png)

However, players can use this to purchase items on the Sparks shop, which currently offers avatar items and frontier card skins. ![Screenshot 2026-05-20 044621.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tGXhTP7nMogB5vGQkL3aeLeryArQv4kDc6kmpoCw1Cvi1fz52hviZmZbuHcK1jD7QA1.png) ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

Trusting God is a key step to overcome doubts and anxieties from our life. Many times, fear comes when we focus too much on problems instead of God’s ability to help us. When we learn to pray and talk to God about what worries us, it helps our hearts feel lighter. God wants us to always have hope in him and trust him even when things are not going well.

body.title: The Dream of Life - Fantasy Fiction Short Story
body.body:
>Pixabay Standing on Little Ararat’s peak, Vartan observed his hometown, Yerevan. In the pocket of his tunic, sheltering from the harsh wind, his squat fingers played with two graceful jade discs, while his steed, foaming with fatigue, seemed suddenly reinvigorated at the sight of home after months of traveling.
As a merchant, he did not care how dangerous the journey was, nor how many moons had passed the long caravan: his mind incessantly weighed and estimated without respite Indian emeralds, Burmese rubies, Pakistani aquamarines. This was Vartan's life since the cradle: he made a profit, and he did it surprisingly well.
Life settled into the usual pattern upon his returning home. One boring day passed another until on a brisk early March night, something unexpected happened, he had a vivid dream. He awoke, upset and wet with sweat despite dawn’s breeze. In his family no one dreamed, there was no space for these frivolities. When he reflected upon it, maybe a couple of times he had dreamed of carving a gem or making a good deal, but he never had those surreal dreams like a sand mirage in the ocean. After this first vivid dream, they began to visit him more and more frequently, like the inevitable patter of raindrops in a downpour. People of the town began to remark on the dark circles under his eyes.
One storm tossed night he suddenly perceived that he was in the dream. This lucidity did not last long, he perceived the beating of his wings before the rules of the dream came back to swallow him and dictate the story, relegating him to a mere spectator. Night after night, he began to acknowledge the laws that governed that world and how to bend them to his creative power. Thin and rarefied realms could become dense with colors, shapes, and perfumes. The Escheresque geometries of dancing fractals disobeyed space and time. Gradually, Vartan learned to attribute a new meaning and content to the term comprehension. For every new dream he was immersed in, the breath of those universes and his soul were united in one single essence. In those dreams, Vartan traveled in the folds of reality, learned the language of angels and played dodge with them in the wind's of storms of unknown planets.
Soon, what was happening in Vartan's soul could not remain hidden to the eyes of the family, his friends, and the entire city of Yerevan.
___ ![stained-glass-1181864_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23tGXuYsNaB5SeUdrHCztXfFnafzKZdbnP1cPHKAFaVhuxqs6R3bdZCYYi39SMN7uNEuL.jpg)Image by

>Pixabay Vartan stared at his hands. Glimmers of lucid light streamed from each finger as he waved them in front of his face. Sparks traced patterns against the starless sky as the waves of [lake Sevan](https://www.google.co.uk/maps/place/Yerevan,+Armenia/@40.188722,44.4792899,10z/data=!4m5!3m4!1s0x406aa2dab8fc8b5b:0x3d1479ae87da526a!8m2!3d40.1791857!4d44.4991029) pulsed through indigo to azure; a somnolent heartbeat in the quiet night. He listened. Just at the edge of hearing wings were beating to the sea's rhythm. Suddenly, he felt his stomach lurch. The celestial flow of the river of dreams building inside, threatening to pull him into a maelstrom of images and wash him away. Vartan waved one hand in front of his face until it came into focus. The other dove into his pocket to grasp something hard and gritty, as real as anything could be in this sea of associations. His squat fingers played with the jade discs, just as he had a thousand times. That familiar click of stone on stone and the slide of their smooth edge rooted him firm in the soil. The murmuring wind fell still with the approach of Diniana the singing eagle. Her wings flowed over him, a smell of the breath of grass after a sun-shower. Silvering feathers rustled along outstretched wings, shading him in protection. Her wordless song healed and soothed. The spirit of spring alighted and looked at Vartan with an inquiring eye.
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
The cart rattled down the road that led away from Yerevan. Alin watched from the back of the wagon, gripping the cold metal of the cage like the fire of her rage could burn these bars away. “My child is dying” she screamed at the empty night. The babe lay still in her arms, deathly quiet against her as she tried to coax him to the breast. She could feel her sons labored breaths and that tiny heart beating in stuttering fits. A slow full moon rose in the east illuminating the pale strip of broken stone. The scar on the loam of this once great land. The Roman slaver Cassius glanced back at her scream and cracked the whip. “Good. I have no market for the brat.”
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
Vartan watched the land wheel and dip. Little Ararat’s peak seemed to burst from the earth, an angry pimple on the green face of the sacred fields. He pulled the jade discs from his pockets and slid his palm across their edge. Blood welled in his cupped hands, purple veins pulsed in his arms as lucent mana splashed the starless sky. He held his arms aloft as the heavens responded with a column of light, brilliant white engulfed them both as his life force poured from his wounds into the feathered back of Diniana.  \

> We are one > > We are one > > > We are one.
Diniana’s voice echoed through him. Or was it part of him? Vartan dived through the up-welling thermals and banked over the insubstantial roofs and spires of Yerevan. They shimmered in rainbow patterns of refracting light, blurring is if through a veil of smoke.  \

> Look through my eyes > > Look through my eyes > > > Look through my eyes.
The city pulsed from the smokescreen. Color’s merging to solid stone and the dream of people winding through the city streets. He turned to the south, a shimmering road appeared in his vision, straight as a furrow in the spring earth. A lone cart was crawling along the road. A sable smoky tail wound away from the cart. The essence of death’s presence. Vartan flexed his wings and plummeted like a lightening bolt.
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
Alin heaved a breath through her sobs as she stroked her son's hair. *Just one chance for life please god. I will do anything, promise anything if you let him live. Bring my husband back and my life before bondage. Please god, please, please, please.* > Please god > > Please god > > > Chance for life.
Alin looked up to the sky. The voice of her husband echoing through her mind. The faint outline of an eagle plummeted out of the heavens growing larger with each beat of her heart. A wind ripped through the cage, howling a hurricane as the wagon rattled and her chains broke. The bars of the cage snapped apart as the wagon slowed and she staggered out onto the sharp stones of the road.  Squirming like a worm in the sun, the slaver Cassius rolled in the dust clutching a jade disc buried in his chest. A black tail of smoke seemed to wind its way past the face of the moon. Her son gurgled in her arms as she looked down at two brown eyes twinkling. **The end.**

body.title: After the Drought, the Rain Arrives: A fresh Start for Our Plants in the Backyard
body.body:
*Thank you, Lord for the rain. It was a blessing from God in heaven*.

![IMG_20260519_143859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EpA4vmcCJWvy59fFhii7aSXX66xEm33TJeCakHMTUAx7WqnLWEqLLekReGSLvRWjC3M.jpg)
> I took the photos during the thunderstorm and it was a bit scary. 

I lost count of how many nights I slept on the floor with no cover and no blanket because it was boiling hot. It was real torture, day and night- not just for humans but also for animals and plants.

After a long suffering of the drought, the rain finally came. Everyone enjoyed the benefits, but there's a downside: when it rains,  the electricity gets cut off and the internet connection will be slow as a snail. But still, I am thankful,  because when it rains there's a lot of work in the farm especially in the sugarcane and rice fields. 

---
![IMG_20260519_144216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23x1DBTimBMf1XkMa4dhPNmC5V87vaYZcSQ4KTwN4YBFMDFsGvk1yYURRTKnnNfmwZVRf.jpg)
> The first thing I did was pull off the stems of camote. Cut them depending on your likings- I cut mine like this. I came back to the same spot that I planted days ago, but the plants had died. I made a small, but not-too-deep hole and put two to three sticks of camote stems in it. 

*<u>Pro tip: Press the soil firmly around the plant so it has a strong grip on the ground and the plant is sure to grow. </u>*



While staying at home, planting became one of my hobbies. Aside from enjoying the moment, it's also away to exercise early in the morning. 

I wake up at 7 AM, make my coffee, and relax for a little. I decided to be productive and remembered that the camote in the backyard was dying- it needed to be replanted somewhere. Actually, I've tried  planting ☘️ 10 stems the other day, but because the soil was too dry, they ran out of energy and died on the spot. Huhu. I tried my luck again after the rain, and yay, I was happy to see them start to grow. 



![IMG_20260519_145237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EpVDVSJJ99rEoYcQAzYWjZubn2rGesoJ7igUPNoGeRKM9Gq17eUuQrvb3fNgJKJJ93R.jpg)
> These are my favorite scenes every morning. 

 Let me show you, our plants in the backyard. The cucumber was planted by mama. It has flowers, but she feels bad for it because it hasn't grown any fruit yet. She checks it everyday and gets disappointed with the same result. I told her not to think negatively about it- negative thoughts aren't good for the plant. She ask me, 'where did you learn that?' I told her, 'somewhere from the internet' hehehe. 

I don't know what 'bisol' is called in English but my sister's bisol were the best because we harvested a lot . After harvesting the bisol, I cut off the root part and dug two holes for them so I can plant as many as I liked. I wanted to plant root crops because I really love to cook them, preferably some desert. 

The cute ginger shoots were gone! I mean they were cut off, and I don't know what happened- either the chickens ate them or my siblings accidentally cut them off. My heart is sad. Huhuhu. Thankfully, after three days the stick grew back! Yay!

I planted camote and alugbati- I don't know the English term- sorry, in an old rice sack. The camote is blooming beautifully, but the alugbati is still just surviving on its own. Thankfully, the rain helped them regain strength, and hopefully after a week the alugbati will finally have stems with leaves. 

May the rain pour into our lives with blooms of blessings and a renewed strength for every trial we encounter. 


Thanks for reading and stopping by! Love lots(⁠◍⁠•⁠ᴗ⁠•⁠◍⁠)⁠❤ 

---
Pictures were edited using my Realmi C25s. 

---

Where I let Aloy enjoy the natural beauties around her through the body poses of the photo mode, matching her expression to the calm waves. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9mnhiXygRMcetkPqFr8sfii9uVyK4oW6jjCkDkqZCnS/screenshot_7_.png) Then I noticed this bird at a far who was walking on the sand along the beach. So I tried this special pose for this photo, aligning the camera angle to capture the tiny creature framing the background perfectly with the ocean line. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeGoB3ecQCpW917EBgV5f8txagib39RZrPgz7gYhpEaF3/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPBp64Roa7nHtshrVzExMs1joLDUGJDDDbPmuKS7UEgLL/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXqUMGPDPahx86iaLE48u6UmtX8no8jJN3LAVicDsnJp4/screenshot_10_.png) Then as I was running for the bird to get a better look, it started flying away into the sea breeze. And I used the photo mode to get close to the bird where it looked like a giant bird, but it was not actually that giant. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZVND1VEmvquyPLwuCxdmvVRmhtLDbH4FedicsnHjxxzF/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSVa8MsnnCfYpxrhbmMscKH9HKAN7z3CHdD5Nn6L7bAki/screenshot_12_.png) Then I noticed some burrowers on my way who were scavenging around on my way. So I gave Aloy this pose that shows her calling the machine. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYxPg1YZg3GEfaTQfR54hwBGQ9Gtebnwet1WSDqUqs5f/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmenuDytJD6rN1DaFUZvDo9dePzE1TXRqQC9YK13mBCzkT/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZZnFLJ4Ydp1xLLio4T7viWkvErmQ5yYFcU7UK5XTh7Q/screenshot_16_.png) While I was going for another boat near the Burrower site, a Burrower had a glimpse of me from its patrol route. So I had to stay underwater for some time as it was looking for me, watching its scanning light pierce the water. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUc5gCT6dwspcTxF9tyGFRmoS2ChgxBiUzrbnWfzH3Ay1/screenshot_17_.png) As the Burrower lost sight of me and swam away, I went to the overturned boat I was going for earlier on the sandbank. And I tried this special pose that shows the strongest part of Aloy as she was posing having those vicious machines behind her. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfGmhndDUcbSRP2xoNQG62meNPLwSUVUVWRL6995iQM7o/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVksiJxeD6EXS9FKWsEbMLyBCXQk49tEavAEz4kuSWAwQ/screenshot_19_.png) It became night already, which gave me this amazing frame with the deep blue shadows casting over the shoreline. So I chose this special pose for a while, where she seemed to leaning on that coconut tree and waving at the moon peacefully. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaogYefUEceGCknNqYEfrSdwgmgmpb2HPvw6UzYWJrjz/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmafrxy96X4SqSxWdUPoNWzY6Pd5JpeVX3DM2CcWGmQ4f1/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYrNQ8AyauoeSNtVwiYDWUivo3CuDZacCyekpfUCj7XvD/screenshot_22_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYx8qmSvPZ8NsjQAoDkacE3GUhKgprgdPVbMs65tfxtug/screenshot_23_.png) Well, I was done chilling around this part for the moment, so I whistled to get attention of my Sunwing perched high above. And it was flying toward me from afar, cutting through the night air with its glowing shield-wing wings extended wide. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefabfuVmmmLttZPtET9S6jsrq9UwaBJkTGxmMikSpo22/screenshot_24_.png) After the Sunwing pulled me up on his back with a smooth swoop, I ascended his height to get above the clouds. And I reached this height from where I could see the moon perfectly, and I really liked this frame, so I captured it. --- The next post will be coming soon. Screenshots are my take from the game and I took the game logo that I used on the thumbnail picture from online. SEE YOU. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=frankevor/4b397622)

Im conclusion, i believe that we should allow everyone enjoy what they have labored for in peace without bringing them out to the public. body.title: Sometimes I Can't Help But Wonder What I Would've Done If I Had Stopped Him (Guilt)
body.body:
![sad-woman-crying.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/23xyfXUe7CsMXKcgEr9AE5i8tE9x8dBCqLsYPi2cQf8CzKQXQXUJJk6ve5cN7b6vsuhU6.jpg)
[Image from Magnific](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/sad-woman-crying_2767687.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=19353b44-2586-4e61-8948-397d008b3192&query=guilt+depressed)

Those words keep ringing in my head.

Micheal was a friend. Okay that's a lie — Micheal was much more than a friend. He was my crush. And I became close to him the way you become close to people during the worst moments of their lives — when his mum died.

But let me start from the beginning.



I met Micheal back in secondary school. I was a natural when it came to acting — our director always said I had the action but no words. So I was hardly ever given lines. But because of my build I was almost always cast in heavy roles — a king, a warrior, a mother — anything that required presence and action but not much talking. And honestly I was fine with that.

That's where Micheal came in. The charming young lad of the school choir with a beautiful alto voice. I never really understood singers — why people were so drawn to them — but for some strange reason I was drawn to him. Not for his voice initially. There was just something about him I couldn't put my finger on.


We ended up working together on a musical drama. Our drama group wasn't exactly known for singing so we had to collaborate with the school choir. We introduced ourselves and somewhere during one of our rehearsals he walked up to me and said — *why don't you talk much?*

I thought about it for a moment because it was a strange question.

*But I do talk* I replied.

*No you don't* he said. *This is a musical drama and everyone has lines except you.*

*Oh that* I said. *Well I end up jumbling my words and it causes chaos. My teammates and my director think I'm better at acting than talking.*

*But talking is part of acting* he replied. And walked away.

I didn't know what to make of this strange boy who was suddenly concerned about whether I spoke enough. I didn't particularly like it. But that's how we became close. Before I knew it he was giving me vocal exercises. And by our final play for the term — me, Karina — I had lines. Actual lines. I was more than pleased and I kept thanking God quietly that I had met Micheal.

Now thinking back I wonder if our meeting was orchestrated. If I hadn't spoken to him would he have made better friends. Would he still be alive today. Those questions eat into me every single day.



His mum died eight months later.

He broke down completely. His mum was his reason — the reason he worked so hard, the reason he wanted to be more and do more. And just like that she was gone.

I didn't know how to console him. That was uncharted territory for me. But I tried to be the friend he needed. I showed up anyway. Even when it was more than I knew how to carry.

Until the day it happened.

He called me twice. I still remember it like it was yesterday. I had gone with a friend to watch a football match at a stadium near my house. When he called the first time I put my phone on silent. I told myself I would call him back when I got home. But if I am being honest with myself — and I think I owe myself that honesty now — I was tired. Tired of being his emotional cushion. I just wanted one evening that was just mine. I didn't know what was about to happen. I couldn't have known.

At least that's what I've been telling myself every day since.



I got home. Our social group was buzzing with notifications. And then I saw the picture.

Micheal. Lifeless.

I told myself it had to be a prank. Who would play a prank like that. I raced to the park, boarded a bus to New Vill, arrived at his house. There was crying everywhere. His father said he found him. His neighbour — a classmate — was the one who posted the news.

And just like that Micheal was gone.



Till today I wonder. If I had picked that call. If I had reached out sooner. Could the results have been different. Would we have had a different ending.

I'll never know.

But for a long time I felt like I caused it. Like the two missed calls were a verdict and I was guilty.

I'm not sure I have fully stopped feeling that way. But I'm learning — slowly and not always willingly — that loving someone doesn't mean you can save them from everything. And that guilt, as loud as it is, is not always the truth.

Micheal deserved more time. He deserved his mum back. He deserved a world that was kinder to him.

And maybe I didn't deserve to carry that call like a crime for the rest of my life.

I'm still learning that. Some days are harder than others.

But I remember him. His alto voice. His simple demeanor. The way he walked up to a quiet girl who never had lines and decided she deserved to be heard.

That was Micheal. And no amount of guilt will ever take that away.

---

*This story is purely fictional. But if anything in it felt familiar — if you are carrying guilt about someone you lost, or if you are struggling silently the way Micheal was — please talk to someone you trust. You don't have to carry it alone.*

---

body.title: Humanity's biggest problem - Part 6
body.body:
What do we do now ?

Let’s recap what we have discussed:  Psychopaths and Sociopaths, a small but significant portion of the population ~4%,  are attracted to institutions and often start new ones or initiate practices that make all of our lives miserable, often with the help of people with good intentions - Lenin called them the useful idiots. 

Once the thieving and abuse are in motion, justified by lies and propelled by people’s ignorance, the system gets a life of its own. There are enough people in the world who will take advantage of these systems once they are in place and who will advocate against their elimination. The Military industrial Complex has been around since Eisenhower and employs many people who will fight to keep it alive, for example.

In Simon Sinek’s framework for [The Infinite Game](https://amzn.to/4nHdujM), players who engage to ‘win’ in a finite game cannot win in the infinite game, because the rules are different.
And so it is for the goal of reaching liberty, prosperity and peace. 

Aristotle knew this when he said “The price good men pay for indifference to public affairs is to be ruled by evil men” and certainly the people who segregated the powers of our government were aware of this, and Jefferson in particular.  If the tree of liberty must be refreshed from time to time, it really means, there is no end: fighting for freedom is a constant struggle, an infinite game.  They segregated the powers in the hope that this struggle could be less painful, would give the people more latitude and ample warnings to prevent the resurgence of totalitarianism. 

After centuries of slow decay we have a bureaucratic state that attacks anything that might threaten its expansion, leveraging all three of Graeber’s pillars of domination : violence, secrecy and charisma, and culminating with a United States Government that has been continuously at war for over 25 years, something else had to be tried.

Blockchain was the hope. Finally something that was unstoppable would answer to the creeping bureaucratic cancer by exposing its lies and subverting its services. 
After all, if government’s ideas were so good, why would they need to be mandatory ? 
Blockchain offered ways that money could not be inflated out of sight, leaked information could not be erased, fraud could be eliminated from voting. The dream was a full inversion of control. 
But soon after it started, you had to disclose your identity to use it. The casino attracted the same people with short term and shallow morals that would go along with the oversight, just because they might get rich before the exit door closes. 
Some, who never really knew about the original intent don’t even mind and still cheer for the US Government’s new permissions for Bitcoin ETFs and classifications of Tokens as assets.  I probably got this wrong, you’ll have to excuse my ignorance of the latest pronouncement from whatever 3 letter agency flexing its legalese.

The point is, none of it worked. Money is still the US Dollar, inflated 3-fold since the invention of Bitcoin, voting systems are still corrupted and the media still lies about every war the Empire wants to start.  

![w14433-small.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaXGmxsAgsohJhs8ga4W26S1EEJshLEgXTQjRLS1MFuKc/w14433-small.jpg)

So what do we do now ? 

Should we just fight the system with humor the way [Srdja Popovic](https://amzn.to/4dGn2XL) and others argue, as ridicule can sometimes bring a totalitarian system to collapse ?

A lot of Bitcoin maximalists will tell me to just wait. The system will collapse and Bitcoin will be come the money that nobody can inflate. I have objections to this that I don’t think can be reconciled, if any of them paid attention. The most important one has to do with the fact in a gold economy the cost of extracting an ounce of gold from the ground is almost the price of an ounce of gold. Not equal. Not more, just a little less. And if you think about this fact as an Austrian economist would, you would realize that it’s an exception to the normal direction of price setting, from final goods to the components of that good.  Gold does not derive its value from the desirability of the shovel that digs it. Another issue is that deploying twice as much capital to mining gold will have the expectation to produce twice as much gold, same as in any other industry, with the constraint that the capital - such as the shovel - priced in gold will need to be bought and amortized, which will affect its price. 
Follow these thoughts and you’ll see why Bitcoin **in its current form** can’t become money.  
My point here is that waiting for bitcoin to fix all this may not be enough.

The rest of the blockchain ecosystems are all scrambling to evade surveillance while the VCs that funded them with US Dollars are anxiously waiting for them to launch a real commercial application that will return the fund. 
Many closed-network applications that barely justify a blockchain could pull it off. For example putting QR codes on a blockchain for tracking shipping container content and custody can work as a decent application with successful revenue streams. A lot of blockchains like Hedera are going for these commercial applications as a way to generate revenue. Blockchain isn’t needed for this, but it does help a few things. And when you realize you’re relying on Hedera’s council partners to run the chain that tracks your QR codes, you might wonder if the whole thing might have been easier with a bunch of Kafka nodes on AWS.  
Perhaps prediction markets will still rise to make the most money, but the scheme is truly a redistribution, since none of it adds to the production structure of the economy, only to the consumption end of it, for now. Should someone start to actually use this commercially for actuarial purposes, we could talk about how the rest of the economy could leverage it, but at the present time, even life/health  insurers are not allowed by law to use true actuarial data which includes categories the government thinks will harm minorities - without proving it would, of course. 
The stablecoin promise is also very much a regulatory capture story at this point. I mentioned before that there is a good chance this could be good for the US Dollar system in the short run and disastrous in the longer term.  

So, naturally at this point, you’re wondering if our only options left are to buy spray paint and start spraying the Flock cameras that watch over everything, wear anti- face recognition gear or AI thwarting mechanisms and build home made anti drone guns. Is confrontation and Sabotage the only option left ?  

Well, no. 

But first, we’ll need to talk about the elephant in the room.

body.body:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWS1RGAKC3xRA5NxangrKtUWEvPHCNKsCpkMmz4SwkcVB/1779291902756.jpg)

Buen día, les presento el video timelapse del dibujo Aprendiendo.

Good day, I present to you the timelapse video of the drawing Learning. 

En el video apreciarán todo el proceso de realizacón del dibujo, desde los claros trazos iniciales para estructurar la figura humana, hasta los progresivos claroscuros donde los contrastes de los valores tonales nos permiten apreciar a la modelo retratada. Solamente faltó grabar la realización de la cuadrícula que me permite que los dibujos me queden similares al modelo y también perdí algún tiempo de grabación por falta de batería. 
Siempre debemos recordar que el arte no es perfecto y que los dibujos son realizados a mano, no son tan exactos como una fotografía pero se disfruta mucho hacelo y existen geniales dibujantes que sus dibujos son tan realistas como una foto. Lucharé por llegar a ese nivel 💪🎨

In the video, you will appreciate the entire process of creating the drawing — from the initial light strokes used to structure the human figure, to the progressive chiaroscuro where the contrasts of tonal values allow us to admire the portrayed model. The only missing part was recording the grid that helps me ensure the drawings resemble the model, and I also lost some recording time due to battery shortage.  

We must always remember that art is not perfect, and drawings are made by hand — they are not as exact as a photograph, but the joy of making them is immense. There are brilliant artists whose drawings are so realistic they look like photos. I will strive to reach that level 💪🎨.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNBUd9g3h6kqv1DzaM8GfLKmBwTz5t5p6ryL83jkJ52J/1779292983572.jpg)

Para realizar el dibujo utilicé:
- lápiz HB2. 
- lápiz 2B.
- extensor inventado ( parte posterior de bolígrafo).
- portaminas inventado de minas 5B.
- goma moldeable.
- pincel.
- hoja de papel para evitar ensuciarme la mano además de no dañar el dibujo al apoyarla directamente sobre él.

To create the drawing I used:  
- HB2 pencil.  
- 2B pencil.  
- improvised extender (back part of a pen). 
- improvised mechanical pencil with 5B leads.  
- kneaded eraser.  
- brush.  
- sheet of paper to avoid staining my hand and to prevent damaging the drawing by resting it directly on it. 

Pueden conocer más del dibujo en la siguiente publicación/You can learn more about the drawing in the following post:

https://ecency.com/hive-174301/@reyghart04/aprendiendo-learning-esp-eng

body.title: Repairing a broken ATM lock dial pad and technical experience.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260519145437.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuKdViZCAAs41oTVz6fv7W4rPEf51fR8yF54y99WtRde/IMG20260519145437.jpg) There is a special thrill in working with devices and electronic hardware. When a moving or sensitive device component breaks down, I like to examine it and get to the bottom of the problem. Yesterday, one such new and exceptional experience was when I got the opportunity to work with the dial pad of an ATM machine's security lock. ![IMG20260519145443.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPuppjpUvLMa6LB79HeYYyS4wJnDo4wz1Cx1ZMg8xkbMN/IMG20260519145443.jpg) Everyone knows how strict the security of an ATM machine is and how perfectly each part inside it is made. But due to long-term use or some mechanical fault, the dial pad of its security lock was completely inoperative or broken. After opening the external casing of the device, the real mystery came to light. After opening the lock, I checked the circuit board or PCB and the connecting wires inside it. As can be seen in the first picture, a white connecting cable is attached to the main casing, which exchanges data with the internal security system. However, there is some damage or signs of insulation cracking in a part of the cable, which can sometimes cause signal loss or short circuit. ![IMG20260519145433.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSzHZUxvnVQn1Lns51qMrQPq8YdZceGYfsMxjaukwGdVp/IMG20260519145433.jpg) The circuit board is seen in detail. A small buzzer is visible on the surface of the circuit, which usually produces a 'beep' sound when a button is pressed or the lock is opened. In addition, some small resistors, LED diodes and transistors are arranged quite neatly. The main reason behind the dial pad not responding completely was its internal connectivity and the weakness of some tracks on the PCB. In addition, the joint of the data cable was a bit wobbly. When I carefully separated the mechanical parts with the help of a hammer and screwdriver and took out the circuit, I realized that some components had stopped working due to overheating or carbon deposits. Repairing such sensitive security hardware requires a lot of patience and fine work skills. Because a slight wrong connection can lock the entire security system. ![IMG20260503131807~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVyeznjSYda3nCNPhBDfbGwPcmgwYsRcQT7vtjHFH18pM/IMG20260503131807~2.jpg) Seeing the overall condition of the lock and its internal complexity, I felt once again the wonderful combination of technology and mechanical engineering. This experience was truly amazing. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: Mesquite Health Center and Its Impact on Rural and Urban Health Improvement\n
body.body:
Healthcare plays a major role in shaping the quality of life in both rural and urban communities. Access to timely treatment, preventive care, and modern medical facilities can significantly improve public health outcomes. In many regions, the presence of community-based hospitals has transformed healthcare delivery. One such example is the growing importance of [mesquite health center](https://erofmesquitetx.com/) in improving access to essential medical services for diverse populations. Its services reflect how local healthcare systems can bridge the gap between underserved rural areas and densely populated urban centers, ensuring that no patient is left behind.



***



## Introduction to Community Healthcare Development

Community healthcare development focuses on bringing medical services closer to where people live.
It reduces travel time, increases accessibility, and improves early diagnosis of diseases.



***



## The Role of Mesquite Health Center in Modern Healthcare

The mesquite health center represents a model of accessible and patient-centered care.
It supports both emergency and routine services, making healthcare more reliable for all age groups.



***



## Bridging Rural Healthcare Gaps

Rural areas often struggle with limited hospitals, fewer doctors, and delayed treatments.
Facilities like Mesquite Health Center help reduce these gaps by providing essential medical support locally.



***



Improving Urban Healthcare Efficiency
Urban hospitals are often overcrowded due to high population density and patient flow.
Community health centers reduce pressure on city hospitals by managing non-critical cases effectively.



***



Emergency Care and Fast Response Systems
Emergency departments are critical for saving lives during accidents and sudden illnesses.
Advanced systems such as [Heart rhythm monitoring in ER](https://erofmesquitetx.com/emergency-ekg-services-in-mesquite-tx/) help doctors detect cardiac issues quickly and accurately.



***



Preventive Care and Early Diagnosis
Preventive healthcare focuses on identifying diseases before they become severe or life-threatening.
Regular checkups, screenings, and awareness programs reduce long-term healthcare costs.



***



Technology Integration in Healthcare Services
Modern health centers use digital tools, electronic records, and diagnostic machines for better treatment.
Technology improves accuracy, reduces human error, and speeds up patient care processes.



***



Patient-Centered Care Approach
Patient-centered care focuses on treating individuals with respect, empathy, and personalized attention.
It ensures that treatment plans are designed according to each patient’s unique medical needs.



***



Healthcare Education and Awareness Programs
Education plays a key role in helping communities understand diseases and healthy lifestyles.
Awareness campaigns encourage vaccination, hygiene practices, and regular medical checkups.



***



Supporting Chronic Disease Management
Chronic diseases like diabetes, hypertension, and asthma require long-term medical supervision.
Health centers provide continuous monitoring, medication support, and lifestyle counseling for patients.



***



Mental Health Support in Community Settings
Mental health is an important part of overall well-being that is often overlooked in society.
Community health centers offer counseling and therapy services to support emotional health.



***



Collaboration Between Rural and Urban Healthcare Systems
Strong coordination between rural clinics and urban hospitals improves patient referral systems.
This collaboration ensures that patients receive the right treatment at the right time.



***



Impact on Public Health Outcomes
Accessible healthcare leads to lower mortality rates, improved life expectancy, and healthier communities.
Centers like Mesquite Health Center contribute significantly to these positive public health changes.



***



Conclusion
Mesquite Health Center plays a vital role in connecting rural and urban healthcare systems.
It improves access, reduces hospital burden, and enhances patient care quality.
With modern technology and community-focused services, it strengthens public health outcomes.
Overall, it represents a powerful step toward a healthier and more connected future.

body.title: IMPF!
body.body:
Liebe Leser, Impflinge oder Ungeimpfte,

schon vor 2 Jahren erschien im Literaturmagazin **Kassiber**, in der 2. Ausgabe vom Mai 2024 ([link](https://www.liberladen.org/product/kassiber-2/)) etwas, das ich Euch nicht vorenthalten konnte: Eine Auflistung von sämtlichen in den deutschsprachigen Medien verwendeten Impf-Neologismen, also Wortneuschöpfungen rund um Corona und da vor allem ums Impfen, zusammengestellt von **Paul Kynik**.

Hier Screenshots dieses Werks, das es nur im Print-Format gibt (alle Rechte beim Autor). 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eo2ASMrGhTzJCWAySgwt51VVt48KsXpPWoQ1x2a58DtYnwL8HA4SaH7Hzb4Srux832U.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eo2AqkNrh57aWwy75hiYz8uet8ciTy3BYz6gZHhVabJe7vq2kPLGSRwHu3NvRpkgTq3.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23tSwkucU9jWSBxXPKKnFSLkLWhm1rxnvxM8MmKExiCvnLy5pb2KfaSpwMDxvYoz6ybto.png)

Hier ist wirklich alles dabei, hier nur ein paar Highlights:
*Impfdrängler*, die nach dem schnellen *Impfsegen* aus waren oder sich nur *herausimpfen* wollten,
*Show-Impfungen* von Politikern und (gekauften) Celebrities inklusive *Impf-Selfies*,
das legendäre *Bratwurst-Impfen*,
Maßnahmen wie die *Zwangs-Isolierung* 
und das Runtermachen von berechtigen *Impfkritikern* als *Impf-Hetzer*, *Impf-Leugner*, *Impf-Taliban*, *Auffrischungs-Unwillige* und nicht zu vergessen die *Pandemie der Ungeimpften*, was sich als komplette Lüge herausgestellt hatte.

Im Rückblick erscheint Vieles davon einfach bizarr, ich hoffe, die Leute begreifen das auch instinktiv, dass da eine Linie überschritten wurde und werden in Zukenft mehrheitlich nicht all diese Zwangsmaßnahmen so bereitwillig über sich ergehen lassen. Die Hoffnung stirbt zuletzt...

Ach ja, *Impflüge* habe ich vergessen, denn auch, dass die Gentherapien einen Fremdschutz boten, hat sich als Lüge herausgestellt...
Dieser verschlagene Gesichtsausdruck sagt ohnehin schon alles :)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/242ruTb5RqkwxDLAxNiRF7GfJgcfL7SiEoz8AWLyzStQHqKUcxL2Z9DccdGRXNHRvxtNF.png)
<sup>https://www.faz.net/aktuell/wirtschaft/neue-impfkampagne-der-regierung-kritik-in-den-sozialen-medien-17750792.html</sup>

Was sind für Euch erinnerungswürdige Begriffe?

body.title: Family Night Out After a Busy Week of Work and Enjoying Our Favorite Pizza and Night Snacks
body.body:
![Colorful Modern Photo Collage Photobook.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242DZZtDQjuyZEFA3rAz2zcCBxHBJhzfwyzyZcynRVNTCN9QFMiCnMiwqs9dkbDufwVNw.png)

After a long and busy week, I finally had the chance to unwind with my family. Since daytime is always filled with work and responsibilities, nighttime is the only time we can truly spend together as a family. That is why I really appreciate simple moments like this because even a short night out already feels very special for us.

![IMG_20251117_205622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xejosfVmpKa4tYW99f5z93gDrDChDdivH25fxRu56huvo7EsnHLr6sNM6RU1A6bNUyZ.jpg)

![IMG_20251117_205505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQmv2zVs3n74JgbUqsvpGyeVp8NJ9AVHUEzkbvMZwBosNU3HWDkW94791hAfri8Yp2v.jpg)

We decided to go to the city to relax and take a break from our usual routine. We visited the plaza first, and honestly, the fresh air and beautiful city lights already felt calming. Sometimes, simply being with the people you love is enough to make you feel better after a stressful week. Life has been very busy lately because aside from work, I am also helping with the preparations for our upcoming church fiesta. There are many things to do, so I have been feeling physically and mentally tired.

![IMG_20251117_211716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vi1iuSymvCCEPTbH3PXK3RkAur76WxEu1eNtv9yHAGV2C54Eqn8Y5prYZVCJo6TfFD2.jpg)

![IMG_20251117_211653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGj1YbWZeKmEP56DcqErUBpEENoiqJYhNx7mzjJUVvHUD26ifVtoBFxJ4UbqVp2k1FK.jpg)

![IMG_20251117_205454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tmQ5j4QaJq2SDbeZGM92FX2SNs18PjAnkepxth5Ukh3V9zuveegS6GWu6He9wzBbeKD.jpg)

While walking around, we bought some snacks like pizza, ice cream, and tea. Everything tasted so good, maybe because we were enjoying the moment together as a family. My daughter was very happy because we bought her favorite ice cream from MIKAS. Seeing her smile and excitement over simple things also makes me happy as a mother. We also ordered tea from Infinitea, and honestly, it was very affordable yet really delicious. Simple food becomes even more enjoyable when shared with family.

![IMG_20251117_205601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgS8YnHc72zTxanPzfFB5KfQLoEi2ga68bsUSyoCxMBf9DVGMgMwMxypqLBKTf9NP28.jpg)

![IMG_20251117_205342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgKKtg4ewft4jH65YhKVchUZiosvpnye5WaANBNqkzYL5SUusc9513TUWDSZBXgtLJv.jpg)

As I watched my family enjoy the night, I realized how important it is to give ourselves time to rest and refresh. Sometimes we become too focused on responsibilities and forget to pause and breathe. Life is not easy, especially when balancing work, family, and church activities, but moments like this help me recharge and continue moving forward.

![IMG_20251117_205717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xAXxHyzqbF6gTa4co1cQ1y5veUGZDNojZxq7Zb9odJjmrp7qwKQHgEdKAzkJpPXWutY.jpg)

Tomorrow will surely be another busy day, but at least tonight I was able to relax, laugh, and create simple memories with my family. It reminded me that no matter how stressful life becomes, spending time with the people you love will always be worth it.

![IMG_20251117_213950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242DEGgv7od9Aj5QguUXrpxbFaeSqEcAawFFQMjtvJvv3miiTv1uMGFkfQaQNCeDMEVfd.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned experience and photo and edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

body.title: Ghost Pokemon + Mega Chandelure ex From Pokemon Japan's Abyss Eye
body.body:
More cards have been revealed from the Abyss Eye Pokemon Japan set to be released on May 22. The English cards will be in the Pitch Black set in July 2026.

[Pokebeach](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/05/mega-chandelure-ex-and-more-cards-from-abyss-eye-revealed)

 

## Poltchageist 
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXaHzGejHK5sUMg7mYdvwou3PL5y9MHZaxTNZTmEyuQwu/poltchageist.png)

Poltchageist is a weak 30 HP Grass Basic Pokemon. It does have Fire weakness and a zero retreat cost. 

Furtive Drop for any 1 Energy places 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokemon. 

The Ghost Veil ability is a very unique and strong defensive ability. This Pokemon cannot be affected by effects of attacks or Abilities from the opponent's Pokemon. Ghost Veil protects against Munkidori, Dragapult ex's attack or Froslass (for example).


|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
| https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_095_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_130_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_053_R_EN_LG.png  |

 

## Sinistcha
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRu7y7wEAovf4jtRP1dPnGYcBuMsHfW53ebVrfo2EcA7c/sinistcha.png)

Sinistcha is the evolved form of Poltchageist. This also has the Ghost Veil defensive ability.

Matcha Spin for one Energy works if there are 6 or more Pokemon in your discard with the Ghost Veil ability. You place 4 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokemon.

I don't know if this attack is good. Someone will come up with some combos for spread damage and multiple knockouts.

 

## Shuppet
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRdn8eSVcjJjKTu3epMpCbixe64uRy2TdF3mquCWfs9wB/shuppet.png)

Shuppet as an attacker is not great but it does have the Ghost Veil ability.

 

## Banette
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCWfeFzjkBJEEqy9RjXMHDNyt1HXqsEDtdiAixLnVqMj/banette.png)

Banette is the Stage 1 evolution of Shuppet. The HP is not very high at 80 but it has the Ghost Veil ability as well.

For one Psychic Energy, the Doll Catch deals 80 damage plus you may search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. (Shuffle deck after.)


 

## Dhelmise
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmej6jSbfoKfCKYpGcyBdP5N1S3fK8cWA3cUqFbNsv6pbR/dhelmise.png)

This Dhelmise is a very dangerous attacker. Regretful Rage requires 1 Psychic Energy to deal 30 base damage. If you have 4 or more Pokemon in your discard pile with the Ghost Veil ability, then this attack does 140 more damage (170 in total).

It is not too difficult to get at least 4 Ghost Veil Pokemon in the discard pile. Even though Professor's Research is not in the format, you have discard cards like Ultra Ball, [Prism Tower Stadium](https://limitlesstcg.com/cards/jp/M4/80?translate=en), the not so used Naveen, Morty's Conviction, Iris's Fighting Spirit. Maybe the ACE SPEC [Brilliant Blender](https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Brilliant_Blender_(Surging_Sparks_164)) could be good (maybe overkill though).

|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
| https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/MEG/MEG_131_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/JTG/JTG_155_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpc/M4/M4_80_R_JP_LG.png  |
| https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_079_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TEF/TEF_155_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/JTG/JTG_149_R_EN_LG.png  |

 

---

One energy for 170 damage is pretty serious business. This one hit knockouts Meowth ex to get you 2 Prize cards. Attach a Brave Bangle to boost 30 damage against Pokemon ex. Combine this Dhelmise with Lillie's Clefairy ex to one hit knockout Dragapult ex. Dragapult ex in the Perfect Order format is the most popular attacker at around 35% metagame share. 

|   |   |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|
| https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_062_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_076_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/TWM/TWM_130_R_EN_LG.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/WHT/WHT_080_R_EN_LG.png  |


 

## Spiritomb
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnoed2vUzDHwtZQRKeMmjunoRkL4ZxLiSD5AkSvCZHQB/spiritomb.png)


Spiritomb is a 60 HP Basic Psychic Pokemon with Dark weakness, Fighting resistance and a one retreat cost. 

The Soul End is a niche attack that requires 13 or more Pokemon with the Ghost Veil ability in the discard pile. You then choose 2 of the opponent's Pokemon and quadruple the number of damage counters on each of them. 

In theory, you can get multiple knockouts, multiple prize cards or even win the game. The hard part is getting damage in the first place and meeting 13 Ghost Veil Pokemon in the discard pile.


 

## Litwick & Lampent
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX64yMV6B1MByUegioagMGt8GSGjicXKhEkDVTha6qbX7/litwicklampent.png)


Litwick is an okay early game attacker. It is needed for Lampent, Chandelure or Mega Chandelure ex. 

Lampent does not attack but the Returning Lights attack is good. You search your deck for up to 3 Lampent and put them onto your Bench. Being able to Bench evolved Pokemon is pretty powerful as you sort of cheat the evolution process. No need to wait for a turn.

 

## Mega Chandelure ex
---

|   |   |
|---|---|
| https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/m5-036u4gw7.png  | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/m5-113ezf2c.png  |


 

Here is Mega Chandelure ex. This Stage 2 Psychic Pokemon has 350 HP, Dark weakness and a two retreat cost. 

The Cursed Flame ability is active as long as Mega Chandelure ex is in play. The opponent's Active Pokemon's Retreat Cost is 1 Colourless Energy more. 

Phantom Maze requires 2 Psychic Energy for its attack. The base damage is 130. This attack does 50 more for each Colourless Energy in the opponent's Active Pokemon's Retreat Cost. The minimum damage would be 180 damage.


 

## Marshadow
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQbjbR2JoHB3F9gPtSpBtPKRxv7bNeBEHCn4AXQioEQTW/marshadow.png)

Marshadow is a 90 HP Basic Psychic attacker. The Shadow Knot attack for 1 Psychic energy does 30 damage times the number of Colourless Energy in the opponent's Active Retreat cost. This attack is okay but it is not dangerous enough for big Knockouts. 

 

## Gywnn Supporter
---

|   |   |
|---|---|
| https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/m5-078puf3g.png  | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/05/m5-117sgpzd.png  |


Gwynn looks like a very good Draw Supporter card. Discard up to 2 non-Rule Box Pokemon from your hand. Then draw 3 cards for each Pokemon discarded in this way. 

Note that Rule Box Pokemon include Pokemon ex, Mega Pokemon ex, Pokemon V (not in standard format), etc. You cannot discard these Pokemon.

The Gywnn supporter goes very well with decks that want discarded Pokemon cards like the Ghost Veil Pokemon.


 

## Notes
---

These new Ghost Pokemon from the Abyss Eye set is likely to offer good competitive deck archetypes. More Dragapult ex counters are kind of needed as the popularity of the deck is very high. Dragapult ex decks are a safe choice as the deck is not too expensive, it has a good draw engine, a good attacker and not many weaknesses. Dhelmise looks like a super dangerous attacker and Dragapult ex counter with Lillie's Clefairy.

Mega Chandelure ex looks okay. Not awful but not amazing. A deck around this may not be good right now. It could be a good deck archetype in the future. 

Ghost Veil looks like a decent deck archetype. Let's see what Japan comes up with when the set releases in a few weeks.

 

</center>Thank you for reading.</center>

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![iHeI40b3k77Cg17l_1000027471.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/iHeI40b3k77Cg17l_1000027471/iHeI40b3k77Cg17l_1000027471.webp)
![5zA5SHP4xBARHAW3_1000027478.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/5zA5SHP4xBARHAW3_1000027478/5zA5SHP4xBARHAW3_1000027478.webp)
![gP2HVWkk6byCE0Rr_1000027479.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/gP2HVWkk6byCE0Rr_1000027479/gP2HVWkk6byCE0Rr_1000027479.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

想必每个职场打工人都经历过类似的事情吧：自己或者自己身边的人兢兢业业多年，老板的饼画了一个又一个。
好不容易熬到老领导退休或者辞职了，以为这个空缺的位置将会是内部那个做的最好的人上，甚至是自己上，但没想到老板不知道从哪里找了一个完全陌生的人来当管理了。
以前就觉得，这估计又是哪个关系户进来摘桃子的。
但是现在我开始觉得，其实也不一定。
虽然的确有那种亲戚朋友什么的来摘桃子，但是也有一些就是进来当挡箭牌的。
我曾经遇到这样一个老板，身边的人都是跟着他同甘共苦的老人，甚至当初公司马上要倒闭了，有些人直接不要工资转成期权的去和那老板干。
结果干到最后，公司干成了，老板有点不舒服了。
本是庆功宴，结果老板吃饭吃到一半，叫进来一个人，说这就是以后公司的副总。
那些公司的老人瞬间有点不舒服了，他们以为这个岗位应该是他们这些人的其中一个。
但没想到，就这样空降了一个人过来。
空降就算了，好歹想着如今公司步入正轨，手里的期权好歹值钱了吧。
没成想没过几天，那新来的副总就找他们这些人挨个谈话，打算杯酒释兵权了……
上来就是一些专业的东西，什么当初说期权时候公司都没估值，期权值多少没明确。
而且期权要满工作年限，但是因为现在碍于种种原因，不得不辞退你，那期权以市场价回收……
各种乱七八糟的。
最后他们就去找老板，没想到老板却说，现在他在忙着筹备新公司的事情，那家公司的事情都全权给副总管理了。
这时候，他们才懂，原来老板之所以请个外人来，就是想给他们弄出去的。
或许是老板觉得自己出面有点不好弄，所以就找了这么一个背锅侠。
果然，后面等这批人清理的差不多了，那个副总也被优化出门了……
至此，后面进公司的人将不会有人记得这位老板曾经的操作，只会被他洗脑，他大可以继续说自己是不会亏待一起并肩作战的“家人兄弟”的……
美好形象又树立起来了，至于第一批并肩作战的兄弟，或许已经因为他的无情而无奈回到了老家了……
所以呀，慢慢就发现，管理其实就是背锅或者挡箭牌。
要是一直有压力需要你抗，那你还继续有价值，要是哪天没那个压力需要你挡了，那你也可以出局了……
诶，不禁又想起了那句：好赚的钱，凭什么你来赚呢？

body.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante chévere, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos de uno de mis hermosos gatos, Remy. Estos días han sido un poco estresantes, he estado en muchas responsabilidades de la universidad y el trabajo, y en este último han habido cambios, los cuales aunque no son negativos, ahora me elevaron el nivel de exigencia. A veces lo único que quiero es estar en casa y no pensar en nada más que en jugar en la computadora, descansar y estar con mis gatos, los cuales honestamente siempre me alivian los días de tanto estrés, siempre que llego a casa siempre los busco porque son lo primero que quiero ver al llegar. Remy es el gato más cariñoso de los tres que tenemos en casa, aunque las otras dos gatitas son muy dadas, Remy es especial en ese aspecto, ya que adora que lo carguen, pide demasiado cariño y es muy apegado con nosotros. Desde que lo ví por primera vez en una cajita con sus hermanas, siendo tan pero tan chiquito realmente me dirritió el corazón, nunca dimensione lo mucho que amaría a este gato y lo mucho que crecería. Dñsiempre me encantaron sus manchitas tan peculiares, una en un ojo que cubre hasta la oreja como si fuese un parche, una en la nariz que parece un árbol de navidad, una en el lomo que parece un número ocho, una en sus patas traseras que simulan pantalones, y otra en su colita. Es esponjoso y bello, con una personalidad traviesa e inteligente, siempre se le ocurren nuevas cosas que hacer y para hacer algún pequeño desastre, pero así lo adoro. Es muy juguetón con las otras dos gatitas, aunque a veces lo es demasiado y las dos gatas se agobian. Con Lia es muy cariñoso, duerme con ella, la lame y se asoman juntos a ver pájaros por la ventana. Remy realmente es un gato único y hermoso, lo amo demasiado, espero que les gusten estas fotos que les comparto el día de hoy!
Hello again! Today I’m come to your with a pretty cool new post, this time featuring a new photo set of one of my beautiful cats, Remy. These past few days have been a bit stressful; I’ve had a lot on my plate with college and work, and there have been some changes at work, which, while not negative, have raised the bar for me. Sometimes all I want is to be at home and think of nothing else but playing on the computer, resting, and spending time with my cats. Honestly, they always help me unwind on those super stressful days whenever I get home, I always look for them because they’re the first thing I want to see when I arrive. Remy is the most affectionate of the three cats we have at home although the other two are very affectionate too, Remy is special in that regard, since he loves being held, craves lots of attention, and is very attached to us. Ever since I first saw him in a little box with his sisters, so tiny, he really tugged at my heartstrings. I never imagined how much I would love this cat or how much he would grow. I’ve always loved his unique little spots, one over his eye that stretches all the way to his ear like an eye patch, one on his nose that looks like a Christmas tree, one on his back that looks like the number eight, one on his hind legs that looks like pants, and another on his little tail. He’s fluffy and beautiful, with a mischievous and intelligent personality, he’s always coming up with new things to do and causing a little mess, but that’s exactly why I adore him. He’s very playful with the other two kittens, though sometimes he’s a bit too much and the two girls get overwhelmed. He’s very affectionate with Lia, he sleeps with her, licks her, and they peek out the window together to watch the birds. Remy really is a unique and beautiful cat; I love him so much. I hope you like these photos I’m sharing with you today!

body.title: Rabindra Mix
body.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Rabindra Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/597f9f4f-4edd-4ef3-b7eb-673f9db64ba1.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/9upxAjPJjJMkVWcJP9gqo5) 
 
 Rabindra nació de la inquietud de un poeta que escuchaba el mundo como una partitura viva. Rabindranath Tagore no buscaba crear un estilo, solo dejar que el aire de Bengala, los cantos de los barqueros y los giros de la música clásica indostánica se encontraran en sus manos. Cada canción surgía como un organismo completo: la melodía respiraba con el verso, el ritmo acompañaba sin imponerse, y la estructura rara vez seguía los esquemas fijos de la tradición. Lo que hoy se reconoce como un subgénero musical lleva el peso de esa libertad inicial, aunque con el tiempo la academia y los escenarios le fueron dando contornos más definidos.

Los intérpretes que se acercan a este repertorio saben que no basta con dominar la técnica. El matiz está en cómo se sostiene una nota larga, en la pausa que precede a una palabra clave, en la manera en que el tabla o el harmonium dejan espacio al silencio. Tagore tomaba ragas conocidas y las doblaba hacia territorios más íntimos, a veces cruzando fronteras métricas o introduciendo progresiones armónicas que sonaban a occidente sin perder el acento bengalí. Con los años, esa mezcla dejó de ser un experimento personal para convertirse en un lenguaje compartido, transmitido de maestro a alumno, de generación en generación, con partituras que nunca pretendieron encerrar la emoción, solo guiarla.

La grabación y la radio cambiaron su alcance, pero también fijaron interpretaciones que luego se volvieron referencia. Músicos de distintas épocas adaptaron el material para cuerdas occidentales, coros sinfónicos o arreglos minimalistas, siempre con el dilema de conservar la esencia sin caer en la repetición vacía. En los estudios y los teatros se discute si la orquestación enriquece o diluye la voz solista, si el acompañamiento moderno respeta el pulso original o lo sobrecarga. Lo cierto es que el repertorio sigue creciendo en las manos de quienes lo tocan, porque cada frase contiene un mapa de posibilidades que invita a ser leído de nuevo.

Hoy convive con otras corrientes, se enseña en conservatorios, se versiona en festivales y se defiende en espacios donde la autenticidad pesa más que la novedad. Los que lo interpretan no solo ejecutan notas; sostienen una tradición que se niega a fosilizarse, que respira con cada cambio de afinación, con cada elección tímbrica, con cada decisión de cuándo callar. El sonido viaja, se transforma, pero guarda siempre ese hilo que lo une a su origen: la convicción de que la música no se construye para impresionar, sino para acompañar lo que el alma ya sabe decir.

La melodía que Tagore dejó escrita nunca se quedó en el pentagrama. Saltó hacia la página impresa y transformó la prosa bengalí, enseñando a los escritores a respirar con el verso, a medir las pausas no por la gramática sino por el latido interior. Los novelistas aprendieron a estructurar sus capítulos como ragas, con introducciones lentas, giros inesperados y desenlaces que no cierran del todo, sino que quedan flotando. La poesía, por su parte, absorbió esa dicción musical donde cada sílaba tiene peso específico, donde la repetición no es recurso decorativo sino necesidad emocional. Se escribía ya no solo para ser leído, sino para ser cantado en voz baja.

En el cine, esa misma cualidad se volvió arquitectura invisible. Los directores de la nueva ola no usaban las canciones como relleno, sino como columnas vertebrales que sostenían la tensión dramática. Una frase repetida en off marcaba el paso del tiempo, un silencio entre acordes revelaba lo que los personajes no se atrevían a decir, y la progresión de una raga dictaba el ritmo del montaje. La cámara aprendió a seguir la respiración de la música, a detenerse cuando la nota se alargaba, a acelerar cuando el ritmo se fragmentaba. El resultado fue un lenguaje visual que no ilustraba la historia, la escuchaba.

Hasta la ropa empezó a hablar con ese mismo tono. No por decreto, sino por ósmosis cultural. La austeridad elegante que rodeaba a los intérpretes y poetas se tradujo en telas sin brillo excesivo, cortes que priorizaban el movimiento sobre la forma, y una paleta que imitaba los atardeceres de los campos del delta. Los diseñadores no copiaban trajes, capturaban la atmósfera: la manera en que un chal cae como un glissando, cómo el pliegue de un sari marca una cadencia, cómo la ausencia de adornos grita más fuerte que la ornamentación. La moda se volvió extensión de una partitura que valora lo esencial.

En otros terrenos sonoros, la influencia se dispersó como semillas en tierra distinta. Jazzistas descubrieron en sus estructuras modales un puente natural para la improvisación, encontrando en los microtonos y las variaciones rítmicas un vocabulario fresco. Productores de música indie tomaron la intimidad de la voz solista y la colocaron frente a guitarras acústicas y baterías mínimas, manteniendo esa sensación de confesión nocturna. Incluso en la electrónica, donde el pulso suele ser mecánico, se colaron samples de harmonium y loops de tabla que buscaban recuperar la imperfección humana, el leve desvío que hace respirar un compás. Cada adaptación, cada cruce, demuestra que el lenguaje no se agota cuando se traduce, solo cambia de instrumento.

Se convirtió en un espejo donde una cultura entera se reconoce sin necesidad de explicarse. No fue un decreto ni una moda pasajera, sino una acumulación lenta de gestos compartidos: la abuela que tararea mientras dobla la ropa, el estudiante que silba un fragmento camino a la facultad, el activista que elige una estrofa para nombrar lo que las consignas no alcanzan a decir. Cada generación encuentra en esas melodías un refugio y un mandato, la certeza de que ciertas emociones tienen ya su propio sonido. Los músicos que lo sostienen en escena saben que no interpretan una lista de canciones, sino un archivo vivo de pertenencia. El aire de los ensayos huele a madera vieja y a resina de arco, a cuerdas que se ajustan milímetro a milímetro hasta que la afinación coincide con el recuerdo.

Su peso cultural no se mide en ventas ni en reconocimientos externos, sino en la manera en que atraviesa las estaciones y los rituales cotidianos. Las lluvias de julio traen una raga específica, el otoño pide otra, y cuando la primavera abre las flores del mango, ciertas frases resuenan en balcones y terrazas como si el calendario dependiera de ellas. En las universidades se cantan para marcar protestas o para celebrar graduaciones, en los hospitales se susurran junto a camas de convalecientes, en los trenes cruzan compartimentos sin pedir permiso. La frontera entre lo privado y lo colectivo se difumina porque la música no se exhibe, se comparte. Quien la escucha reconoce un tono familiar, una cadencia que le habla de su propia historia sin nombrarla.

Los archivos sonoros, las partituras manuscritas y las grabaciones de radio guardan más que notas: conservan el pulso de una sociedad que aprendió a nombrar su dolor, su duda y su esperanza a través de intervalos y silencios. Durante décadas de transformación política, migración forzada y reconfiguración de fronteras, esas canciones actuaron como hilos invisibles que mantuvieron unida la memoria fragmentada. No ofrecieron discursos, ofrecieron refugio sonoro. Los maestros que transmiten el repertorio no solo corrigen la entonación, enseñan a sostener la mirada mientras se canta, a respirar con la frase, a entender que cada nota lleva el peso de quienes la cantaron antes. La técnica se vuelve ética, y la repetición, un acto de fidelidad.

Hoy convive con la inmediatez digital, con la sobrestimulación de pantallas y ritmos fragmentados, pero su presencia no se diluye, se reordena. Los jóvenes lo descubren en versiones despojadas, en conciertos de pequeña escala, en talleres donde la voz se trabaja antes que el virtuosismo. No se trata de conservar una reliquia, sino de mantener viva una conversación que lleva más de un siglo abierta. El escenario sigue siendo un espacio donde se mide la distancia entre la tradición y el presente, donde cada interpretación es un acto de equilibrio entre el respeto y la necesidad de decir algo nuevo. La música no se queda atrás, camina al lado del tiempo, y en ese paso acompasado sigue marcando el compás de una identidad que no necesita gritar para existir. Basta con que una voz se eleve, que un instrumento responda, y que el silencio entre frases recuerde que algunas cosas no se explican, se sienten.

Es todo por hoy.

body.title: Why I Will Always Miss My Dad
body.body: > I have come to understand that it's very easy to create new memories, but very difficult to forget them, especially the memories of our happy moments, the ones that make us very happy and also sad. I have a lot of people who have contributed so much to my growth and learning in life, and that is why I find it difficult to forget them. It is very obvious that I can't forget all the experiences I had with them. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRTLke9QnvewEwf8mBFkabLix4LNPHafZFV1yu49WeNbr/IMG-20260520-WA0002.jpg **image is AI generated** In this post, I will be mentioning two people I have saved in my mind forever, and one of them is the person I miss very, very much, and that is because I can't see him again. That was how life took him away from me on the 16th of January this year. I can comfortably say that my mom and dad are good storytellers. You know, they used to tell me stories of how they started life and how life went for them when they were much younger, just like me. My mom loved telling me stories anytime we had free time, and she would open up by telling me what she passed through and how life went for her during her younger age. One interesting story she once told me on a faithful day has remained in my mind for so long now, and I can't forget it at all. She decided to tell me a story concerning how the Naira currency had value during their time. She told me how her parents used to send her to the market to purchase goods with just five naira, and after buying all the items she was sent to buy, she would still bring back some change in kobos. That is to tell you how Nigeria's economy was over 50 years ago. Imagine if I decide to start comparing the Nigerian economy now with back then... you are going to realize the big difference. This type of story is what I enjoy very much, and I can say it is a wonderful privilege for me to know what happened even before I was born. What makes it more interesting is that it's a story coming from my mom. She once advised me to be a good person and avoid trouble. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf9gtNVbtiQEP3tcoa7AnEvT5zfUWheyLLWkKnM4TikkV/IMG-20260520-WA0001.jpg **image is AI generated** Most times in life, if you decide not to look for trouble, then you will realize that trouble can still find its way to you. She advised me never to engage in fights. Her reason was that one bad side of engaging in a fight is that whether you are right or wrong, you will definitely find yourself in a mess. If you engage in a fight and end up injuring the other person, you will be in trouble. And if the person ends up injuring you, then you will also be in pain and in trouble too. That is to show that there is no benefit in engaging in fights, and they can never lead to any positive result or good impact. She gave me a convincing real-life story of two brothers who were dragging a knife over a piece of meat. During the process, the younger brother mistakenly stabbed the elder brother in the eye with the knife, and the man became blind for the rest of his life. My dad was the one who made sure that I took my studies very seriously. Not that my mom didn't contribute much, because she did, but my dad's effort was much greater in terms of my education. I can remember back then in primary school when my dad usually cross-checked my notebooks and classwork after school when I got home. He would ask me what I learned in school and also go through my books to see for himself what I was taught and how well I was doing. Also, my dad is very good at mathematics. He taught me at home and encouraged me to keep learning because education is the key to success. My dad also liked to impart knowledge to me through storytelling. He told me how my community was created and the struggles and efforts many strong indigenes had to put in before the establishment was successfully achieved, and many more. There are uncountable things that make me miss my mom and dad so much each time I begin to recall my experiences and all the time we spent together, especially my dad. The reason is this: my mom is still alive, she is living well and healthy, and I still have her around. I can always reach her, stay with her, and talk to her all the time... but dad is no more. Dad has travelled to the great beyond, and that is one of the reasons why I miss him so badly, because I can't see him again. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUhL1LWNwRSnRUdhkkgbN4crg8PzBcQKamVLXGXdLot6R/file_00000000447071f489b8378d4f8b276a.jpg **Thank you so much for taking your precious time to visit my blog and for your continuous support ❤️** ***Hope to See you soon 🥰...** **@Youngezeblinzz** **GREATNESS IN GOD 👑** https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVgsu9JD6DSbrgvXVGUFhv5XTnPapYMacjN8ewT2RKPQY/file_00000000c8547246811ab54988a356f4.png Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@youngezeblinzz/why-i-will-always-miss-my-dad-4he)

body.title: Pantallas que aíslan, la adicción infantil a los videojuegos. / Screens that isolate, childhood addiction to video games. ESP./EN.
body.body: >Image created by the Ecency AIImagen creada con la IA de Ecency para este post. / Image created by the Ecency AI for this post.
>Pantallas que aíslan, la adicción infantil a los videojuegos
>Screens that isolate, childhood addiction to video games

>Hace unas semanas vi algo que me llamó mucho la atención; fue un documental sobre algunos jóvenes chinos que se habían alejado de la sociedad y de sus familias gracias a los videojuegos. De hecho, había algunos niños chinos que iban a la escuela secundaria, pero en vez de participar en las clases, jugaban con sus teléfonos.

>Y muchos profesores comenzaron a poner quejas a los padres, y en ese momento se vio algo muy interesante, y es que en el caso de esos niños con los que se estaba haciendo el estudio o documental, los padres estaban tan ocupados en el trabajo y en otras actividades que casi no tenían tiempo para compartir con sus hijos, quedando estos al cuidado de la abuela, otro familiar, personal contratado o simplemente solos.

>Lo impresionante fue cuando los padres se dieron cuenta de la realidad, ya que vieron que sus hijos estaban en un proceso de aislamiento voluntario, no poseían amigos reales, sus relaciones personales eran a través de la pantalla con otros jugadores que no conocían realmente. Y finalmente, además de esta afectación social y familiar, se dieron cuenta de la afectación a nivel de salud, ya que los niños llevaban vidas sedentarias, eran desaseados, descuidados y mal alimentados, y todo eso sucedía por decisión propia.

>Otro punto interesante fue el ver las reacciones de los padres; algunos de ellos trataron de hablar con los hijos sobre el problema, otros trataron de regular el uso de los videojuegos y otros, en su desesperación al ver que sus hijos tenían un nivel de adicción tan grande, llegaron a cortar el cable HDMI, romper consolas de juego y computadoras.

>Finalmente, muchos de los padres se dieron cuenta de que el problema de adicción de sus hijos a los videojuegos era una situación real y realmente peligrosa para ellos, y al buscar ayuda, se dieron cuenta de que empresas privadas y un ente del Estado habían creado centros de rehabilitación para tratar la adicción de los jóvenes a los videojuegos.

>Lo más impresionante fue ver a los niños y niñas pasando por síndromes de abstinencia, es decir, depresión, crisis de violencia, alteraciones químicas en sus cuerpos que les provocaban mareos, náuseas y otros problemas derivados de la atención a las adicciones a las drogas. Lo que inclusive provocó un estudio más profundo sobre las adicciones a los videojuegos y las redes sociales.

>Finalmente, este documental nos enseña dos tareas fundamentales que debemos realizar los adultos con los niños de la casa. La primera es dedicarles tiempo y ver que realmente ellos estén llevando una vida alegre, plena y donde compartan y jueguen con otros niños.

>Lo otro que nos enseña es prevenir la adicción a los videojuegos y todo lo que ella conlleva para la vida de los niños: aislamiento, soledad, desaseo, mala alimentación, frustración, entre muchas otras situaciones. Por lo tanto, debemos estar vigilantes y dispuestos a tomar medidas y cortar el cable que da acceso a los videojuegos, si es necesario, para garantizar el desarrollo y la salud de nuestros niños.

>A few weeks ago I saw something that caught my attention a lot; it was a documentary about some young Chinese people who had become estranged from society and their families thanks to video games. In fact, there were some Chinese children who went to high school, but instead of participating in classes, they played with their phones.

>And many teachers began to complain to parents, and at that moment something very interesting was seen, and that is that in the case of those children with whom the study or documentary was being made, the parents were so busy at work and in other activities that they hardly had time to share with their children, leaving them in the care of the grandmother, another relative, hired staff or simply alone.

>The impressive thing was when the parents realized the reality, as they saw that their children were in a process of voluntary isolation, they did not possess real friends, their personal relationships were through the screen with other players they did not really know. And finally, in addition to this social and family affectation, they realized the affectation at the health level, since the children led sedentary lives, were sloppy, neglected and poorly fed, and all that happened by their own decision.

>Another interesting point was to see the reactions of the parents; some of them tried to talk to their children about the problem, others tried to regulate the use of video games and others, in their desperation to see that their children had such a high level of addiction, came to cut the HDMI cable, break game consoles and computers.

>Finally, many of the parents realized that the problem of their children's addiction to video games was a real and really dangerous situation for them, and when they sought help, they realized that private companies and a state entity had created rehabilitation centers to treat the addiction of young people to video games.

>The most impressive thing was to see the children going through withdrawal syndromes, that is, depression, violent crises, chemical alterations in their bodies that caused dizziness, nausea and other problems arising from attention to drug addictions. Which even provoked a deeper study on video game and social media addictions.

>Finally, this documentary teaches us two fundamental tasks that adults should perform with the children in the house. The first is to dedicate time to them and see that they are really leading a joyful, full life and where they share and play with other children.

>The other thing it teaches us is to prevent video game addiction and all that it entails for children's lives: isolation, loneliness, restlessness, poor nutrition, frustration, among many other situations. Therefore, we must be vigilant and willing to take action and cut the cable that gives access to video games, if necessary, to ensure the development and health of our children.
