body.title: THE POWER IN SECRECY
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Take it or leave it, there is power in secrecy, so much so that those with the biggest secrets sometimes are god-like. The reason some people are in power or have been in power for a very long time without anything close to an opposition challenging them is simply because only a handful of persons know their secrets. I have come to understand that you are only as powerful as the mysteries surrounding you. If everyone can read you, know what you are up to, trigger your actions and reactions and conveniently trick you into doing their bidding, then you are defenceless and are not as strong as you think no matter how rich you think you are or how rich you look. The world on its own is competitive, people try every day to find a reason to keep going, or a reason to do whatever they wish, and knowing a person’s secret is a sure way to do that. This is why those who know your secrets can easily order you around no matter how high and mighty you are, now imagine everyone knowing it…
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR52jvmxwEAEDLnQdngu8dMfschryCxPTHwebKoY4nRNZ/29838209_7505391.jpg 

<a href=\

>Image by freepik When it comes to finances, I believe secrecy is key. I do not believe that Elon Musk is the Richest man on earth as Forbes claims, I am very sure that there are multi trillionaires in this world that very little people know about. Can you imagine the pressure being the world’s richest man puts on a person, it puts you in a position where you always need to be on guard. Elon Musk for example can not just come to a country like Nigeria and move around without security because everyone knows who he is. This is the issue I have with transparency, especially financial transparency. All your transactions and decisions are monitored, any little financial mistake can be seen as weakness. Why should a person like to endure such a pressure, especially coming from the entire world. I do not see myself wanting such a life, I do not want to be wealthy with a target on my back, I love being anonymous and dangerous. That way when you cross me and I retaliate you don’t see me coming. I love to be seen as weak and ordinary, especially financially. It would help me sleep well at night knowing that I do not answer to anyone. It is easier to do everything to guard a secret than dealing with the repercussions of that secret being exposed. I remember when I started working for the first time and made the mistake of telling my family how much I was earning. It made them totally dependent on me and made me work exclusively for them. I was always giving them everything I earn and they were not even thinking what I had left for myself. I guess it was because things were hard and I was the only one with an actual job, but the day I decided to get myself something, it was as though I had committed the greatest sin on earth. I felt bad because I knew I deserved to be spent on just as much as I was spending on them. It was really not my duty to cater for the whole family, it was my parents duty, and doing it because I loved them was making them complainant. links.title: Steamed Chocolate Buns
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmStpTnDFPJNQgGrJr8qUYeHatroavLgjZiBPgjXqMpEP2/1779291397848.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today I’m going to share a simple bun recipe I made for breakfast last night—soft chocolate-filled buns that are, most importantly, easy to make and don’t require many ingredients. Okay, let’s get started!

**Ingredients:**

- 15 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp yeast
- 2 tbsp granulated sugar
- 100 ml milk
- 50 ml water
- 1 tbsp margarine
- a pinch of salt
- chocolate filling 

**Steps:** 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNV5DebyJzFrJv37skCpheKFvcGYKx4KobeA2MqXSaZNH/1779291431384.jpg)

- Add the all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, a pinch of salt, and yeast to a mixing bowl

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNx6Ttt46R7nz6ZBpwPe7Vp8nfzjGVfpKciSuabThqX56/1779291465234.jpg)

- Add the milk and water to the mixing bowl 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWoDi8n989TzMtpxLRLfQwV4odgdRBd2mZBxnhBMrcTgK/1779291489358.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXSBiiFMy1D7yEwzw1xz2mn6cGN1MAAfLTRx7ozuEzYrX/1779291489533.jpg)

- Mix the ingredients until combined and a dough forms

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVs8E7ZhpFJPnYu2dD17PMAQeLL6kWqEqADBJuzfsRKF6/1779291945676.jpg)

- Add the margarine to the dough

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCX1ZLukpCLo1u7cbUt7eKa6DYbcoKKUjqEK9SBWmjKE/1779291945868.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcfToiUjG5EqJuX7afBEoaGZbjdRHRxWBYmmAzoV5uH7H/1779292007228.jpg)

- Knead the dough again with the margarine until the dough becomes smooth and elastic

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWuKx4UpfUjRvxgk14afH3ejqUFc4DW6vCGY291tNC3Rt/1779292031688.jpg)

- Let the dough rest for 1 hour until it rises significantly

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWUYsrb5JS8YewKZSVjghVWq2i7EiYcUcPpx6uveg9Mmz/1779292053217.jpg)

- After rising, knead the dough again

- Divide the dough into 8 portions

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXoapDZi969j4E1bppVXcipdmYbtmFDAUonEF9h8HQG6F/1779292082851.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhZzsKsLWniPSSPGtyo4rSoEuW2DWqgiQ1zkJLEViBHS/1779292083044.jpg)

- Take one portion of the divided dough and flatten it

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcCZW2Mh1csAmpRGkaH5c5sJ7gXb7MympnbLpVGh4jUnz/1779292106025.jpg)

- Place the chocolate filling inside the dough

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSfkgZw6SCM1f2E995GDyvRmB5ckX5yzkzYQMC61AUv4p/1779292170675.jpg)

- Close the dough and shape it into a round like this

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvzFUUSXRRuNArk1ZQYvDpaW78gWYLmq1D276CjiH19s/1779292201957.jpg)

- Place the dough in a baking pan greased with margarine and repeat until all the dough is used

- Let the dough rest for 15 minutes before steaming 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS23rcTb6feivabtgsnBXj3FyLdn3o6c3umTu8NDB2gNb/1779292236554.jpg)

- After 15 minutes, place the baking pan into a steamer filled with previously boiled water 

- Steam the buns for 20 minutes 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYhViB5xFbChjFZdhr1U9UeZAdErbPymkp9PQhJYtWbhm/1779292287755.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUuEGgZDSEmQuLLg4stQgBDQzzg1yegNzn4sfkG739DYc/1779292287940.jpg)

- Once the buns are done, let the chocolate-filled buns cool to room temperature

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSxmN8JHM1dwB7ZxJ1RJTGnf1WDDMMXh8t4A2kMCGL411/1779292326254.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmepKA4uj7pric272Ni4W9bzQ8K9GJeR9Po8HrtguZgnfT/1779292326571.jpg)

- The steamed chocolate-filled buns are ready to eat

links.title: SOCIAL MEDIA INFLUENCE ON CHARITY
links.body:
![17792623185006501094519799413746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/23uFW8QRfV9J2xZAgjoS8tW3JF2DXvPSuEHnDi8wKesLyMMpj3SatsxAA5bpSAwYBDy2x.jpg)

[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/love-africa-travel-medicine-6646870/) 

Social media has had many positive and negative influence on the human lives in different aspects that affect people. Hence, the question of the influence of social media on charity is one that we cannot over emphasize because some charity platforms has been helpful and pose positive influence in the lives of the people they help while  some others have become a negative influence to them and has made them bend to peer pressure that has affected them and their mental Health. 

So based on our current experience on what social media can and cannot do, it is safe to say that social media has changed the perspective or the ways by which people support charity. There are many platforms across different social media such as Facebook, tiktok and Instagram that allows people to spread awareness for those that cannot afford data to come online and air their concerns. 

One of the social media platforms that catch my attention especially on tiktok and Facebook is a guy called Bayuztv, in this guy's videos we see how he goes out of his home early in the morning and help kids who are going to school especially in public schools by getting them notebooks, school bags, sandals, socks,stationeries, pay their school fees and so on. I like his strategy because he doesn't just give to those who would be ungrateful or not appreciate the effort rather he gives to children whom he sees that needs these things. 

Again, there is another guy on tiktok who helps bike Men by getting them some liters of fuel. Watching these videos Gladens my heart because it is so amazing to think of people and support their businesses by getting them resources that would grow them. As we are all aware in Nigeria, problem of price hike in fuel as made many to step down from the biking business causing people to diversify into illegal businesses. 

In essence, charity through social media platforms gain the popularity it deserves through sharing of pictures and videos which allows people both women are brought to raise funds. 

>The Influence Of Social Media On Charity\

body.title: Steam still struggles with dangerous malware hidden in free games [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/48PwoXgJN9aWyRgTcBq9rGxPghA2zqLNx5jsWoEqkKyhw1UWMpxCSatQFST7ze5mU7.png) --- Steam is once again at the center of a controversy regarding a security issue that Valve has yet to fully bring under control: the presence of video games containing malware right on its own platform. Although the company has removed several suspicious titles in recent months, new cases continue to emerge that put users' accounts, passwords, and even their money at risk. The most recent incident revolves around free-to-play games published by unknown developers which, on the surface, appear to function as normal gaming experiences but actually harbor malicious files capable of stealing personal information. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7G3yvtjHtYX6E6f8rWGWTSNFFafctvk65CwDXkXEwZNxwcSZSEaC1p5QaMCL5ozX7S.png) --- One of the most widely discussed cases involved *PirateFi*, a free-to-play game that remained available on Steam for several days before Valve detected that it contained malicious software. Upon discovering the issue, the company began sending messages to those who had downloaded the game, going so far as to recommend formatting their computers and changing all their important passwords. The malware utilized in these titles is typically designed to capture credentials stored in web browsers, session cookies, banking details, and cryptocurrency wallets. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/243qGrEekf18cY3H4WbZah3E3C6sv3xDYZGByjHysx8H2HhKv9H32m6wRvXqNW4nyx7XV.png) --- Some programs can even take partial control of the infected computer. The situation has become so severe that the FBI recently opened an investigation regarding video games distributed on Steam that concealed tools designed to steal cryptocurrency and users' private data. Another particularly serious case involved *Block Blasters*, a free-to-play game that remained active for months and which, according to cybersecurity researchers, managed to steal over $150,000 in cryptocurrency. The scandal intensified after an affected streamer lost funds intended for their cancer treatment. Furthermore, it was discovered that the game had accumulated fake positive reviews to project an air of legitimacy within the store. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDe3stFc6bWAnRCNFm5veJC4TK26EajaUwegyamKoiZ54eQZEm7tEohiZskAzAyES3.png) --- These incidents have sparked strong criticism directed at Valve and its oversight systems. Steam receives thousands of video games every year, and many users believe the company prioritizes the sheer volume of releases over a thorough security review. Although confirmed cases remain relatively few compared to the platform's massive catalog, experts warn that these types of threats could increase in the future due to how easy it is to hide malware within small or seemingly innocuous projects. The community has also shared numerous accounts of account theft, scams, and malicious software associated with Steam. On Reddit, several players describe how they lost digital items, money, or access to their profiles after downloading suspicious files or falling victim to scams involving fake moderators and external websites. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/48QtjJytVLCCju1P84CTzcLT52fKf2u7XngNnQEEmGDR8y4v3hwpkB3KJctjh4eoD9.jpg) --- In light of this situation, experts recommend enabling two-factor authentication, avoiding the download of games from unknown developers lacking reliable references, and being particularly wary of free titles with few genuine reviews. They also advise against opening links sent by strangers and suggest periodically reviewing the authorized access permissions on one's Steam account. This issue makes it clear that even massive, well-established platforms can become targets for cybercriminals. And while Valve has taken action by removing some dangerous games, many players believe the company is still far from fully resolving a threat that continues to grow within Steam.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/48PwoXgJN9aWyRgTcBq9rGxPghA2zqLNx5jsWoEqkKyhw1UWMpxCSatQFST7ze5mU7.png) --- Steam vuelve a estar en el centro de la polémica por un problema de seguridad que Valve aún no logra controlar del todo: la presencia de videojuegos con malware dentro de su propia plataforma. Aunque la compañía ha eliminado varios títulos sospechosos en los últimos meses, continúan apareciendo casos que ponen en riesgo las cuentas, contraseñas y hasta el dinero de los usuarios. El incidente más reciente gira alrededor de juegos gratuitos publicados por desarrolladores desconocidos que, en apariencia, funcionan como experiencias normales, pero esconden archivos maliciosos capaces de robar información personal. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23z7G3yvtjHtYX6E6f8rWGWTSNFFafctvk65CwDXkXEwZNxwcSZSEaC1p5QaMCL5ozX7S.png) --- Uno de los casos más comentados fue el de PirateFi, un juego free-to-play que estuvo disponible en Steam durante varios días antes de que Valve detectara que incluía software malicioso. Tras descubrir el problema, la empresa comenzó a enviar mensajes a quienes lo habían descargado, recomendando incluso formatear el ordenador y cambiar todas las contraseñas importantes. El malware utilizado en estos títulos suele estar diseñado para capturar credenciales almacenadas en navegadores, cookies de sesión, datos bancarios y carteras de criptomonedas. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/243qGrEekf18cY3H4WbZah3E3C6sv3xDYZGByjHysx8H2HhKv9H32m6wRvXqNW4nyx7XV.png) --- Algunos programas incluso pueden tomar control parcial del equipo infectado. La situación se ha agravado tanto que el FBI abrió recientemente una investigación relacionada con videojuegos distribuidos en Steam que escondían herramientas para robar criptomonedas y datos privados de los usuarios. Otro caso especialmente grave fue el de Block Blasters, un juego gratuito que permaneció activo durante meses y que, según investigadores de ciberseguridad, logró robar más de 150.000 dólares en criptomonedas. El escándalo creció después de que un streamer afectado perdiera dinero destinado a su tratamiento contra el cáncer. Además, se descubrió que el juego había acumulado reseñas positivas falsas para aparentar legitimidad dentro de la tienda. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vsDe3stFc6bWAnRCNFm5veJC4TK26EajaUwegyamKoiZ54eQZEm7tEohiZskAzAyES3.png) --- Estos episodios han provocado fuertes críticas hacia Valve y sus sistemas de control. Steam recibe miles de videojuegos cada año, y muchos usuarios consideran que la compañía prioriza la cantidad de lanzamientos antes que una revisión exhaustiva de seguridad. Aunque los casos confirmados siguen siendo relativamente pocos comparados con el enorme catálogo de la plataforma, expertos advierten que este tipo de amenazas podría aumentar en el futuro debido a lo fácil que resulta ocultar malware en proyectos pequeños o aparentemente inocentes. La comunidad también ha compartido numerosas experiencias relacionadas con robos de cuentas, estafas y programas maliciosos asociados a Steam. En Reddit, varios jugadores explican cómo perdieron objetos digitales, dinero o acceso a sus perfiles tras descargar archivos sospechosos o caer en engaños de falsos moderadores y páginas externas. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/48QtjJytVLCCju1P84CTzcLT52fKf2u7XngNnQEEmGDR8y4v3hwpkB3KJctjh4eoD9.jpg) --- Ante esta situación, los especialistas recomiendan activar la autenticación en dos pasos, evitar descargar juegos de desarrolladores desconocidos sin referencias fiables y desconfiar especialmente de títulos gratuitos con pocas reseñas reales. También aconsejan no abrir enlaces enviados por desconocidos y revisar periódicamente los accesos autorizados en la cuenta de Steam. El problema deja claro que incluso plataformas gigantes y consolidadas pueden convertirse en objetivos para los ciberdelincuentes. Y aunque Valve ha reaccionado eliminando algunos juegos peligrosos, muchos jugadores creen que la empresa todavía está lejos de resolver por completo una amenaza que sigue creciendo dentro de Steam.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

#### [Old town and promenade of Cannes](https://ecency.com/@duskobgd/old-town-and-promenade-of) by @duskobgd

> *What a beautiful and fabulous walk. And I have to tell you that when I explore a new place, I do the same thing: I head to the highest point first because I know my energy will run out later. But from the old town, the walls, the tower, the church (which, by the way, is absolutely wonderful) all the way to the boardwalk, passing by all those stairs, it makes for a great walk and a visit to a place steeped in history, and I love that.
It’s impressive to see how high up they started and then to see the sea, the restaurants, and the places where the fishermen store their gear. A place that shines at every moment.*

<center>
![LEN Divider - Pick2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptofiloz/23vhKckUthotT4G75iuSazJXjJYtZZpUqAkYAj8TuSYAwpQcsTBJZxGeMRLm3XYNiVnZ2.png)

> *It’s fascinating how both our eyes and our brain work when it comes to vision, and how they work together to make us see a scene in black and white or in color. There were many things I didn’t know; our body is a perfect and complex machine that allows us to perceive our surroundings in different ways.
I like that you didn’t edit the photos but instead took two shots of the same place to see the difference, even though there are slight variations from what I’ve seen, they’re natural. The photos are spectacular; it’s hard to pick a favorite, but the last two with the distant views are the ones I like best.*

<center>
![LEN Divider - Pick3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptofiloz/23vhKckUthotT4G74RAZkFg39g7xkai4vXWirc1vVhf9g3ZRSkqbWVSKhQBGyAJ1dH7PJ.png)

body.title: Into The Odd, Surreal, Awkward & Fascinating...
body.body:
>What happens if I tell you that inside one single physical place, literally a themed bar, completely different worlds somehow coexist in harmony? The surrealism of the artwork, the classic American lighting of an old-school bar, and at the same time this strange feeling of being trapped in an era that feels distant, but somehow always finds a way to crawl back into our lives sooner or later. Sorry if this intro feels a little chaotic, but I wanted it to mirror the atmosphere of the place you’re seeing in these photos. Because honestly, trying to explain this place in a normal way would almost feel unfair to it.

*\n\n*

>A friend recommended it to me, so I drove to a nearby city and ended up inside this hidden bar filled with 1930s jazz, heavy swing influences, and that unmistakable aura of seduction and decadence that belonged to a time when these kinds of spaces weren’t exactly socially acceptable, let alone normalized. And somehow, what started as a random recommendation from friends who don’t even live in this country anymore ended up leaving a weird little mark on me. Also, I need to confess something: the beer there was so ridiculously good I completely forgot to photograph it before finishing it. That alone should tell you enough.

* ![1000237716.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wqXfaotCm4DGtW5Zg2FyVkQGXL968w36zwe9K3waFGhbUsmXsCbcdGqzYBo4tVuaL77.jpg) ![1000147174.jpg](image-6-1000147174.jpg)![1000098656.jpg](image-7-1000098656.jpg) *

>Every few steps I took, there was another painting, another bizarre visual creation staring back at me. None of the works had proper titles, and apparently the artist never publicly shared their identity either. Some pieces were only labeled with things like “Work 1” or “Canvas 47,” and that was it. Honestly, it’s hard to translate how overwhelming and meaningful abstract art can feel when it’s placed inside something as human, primitive, and ordinary as a bar made for drinking and conversation. Historically speaking, those concepts shouldn’t even work together. And yet somehow, they absolutely do. The result is hypnotic.

*\n\n*

>And the music… God, the music deserves its own paragraph. I have to praise the sound system in that place because the quality was unreal. Warm vinyl frequencies everywhere, the kind of sound that feels alive instead of digital and sterile. Sadly, the owner wasn’t there that night, so I didn’t get the chance to ask him how he came up with the idea of blending post-Great Depression jazz culture, surrealist art, American modern aesthetics, and the ugly little human instincts that make all of us so predictable and mischievous at the same time. Because that combination shouldn’t make sense, and yet it somehow creates an atmosphere that completely consumes you.

* ![1000205596.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tvCaQ1PLueGPtAqnJN5iSsPEvmodoPRccp2yxXqnZ3ZL75Baporge5N5ho9Z5Hsi6ut.jpg) *

>Uncomfortable, strange, bizarre, seductive, and honestly beautiful in its own twisted way. This isn’t just a place to drink alcohol. It’s designed to overwhelm your senses. Even the bathrooms, which I couldn’t fully photograph because some of the imagery was way too explicit, were completely committed to the concept. The women’s restroom had provocative illustrations of men covering the walls and floors, and the men’s restroom had the exact opposite. I’ll let your imagination handle the details. But yeah, the whole place felt fearless, excessive, artistic, and strangely magnetic. I’m already planning to go back. Hopefully next time I’ll meet the owner, because now I genuinely need to understand how and why a place like this even exists. Until then, I’ll just leave this little piece of inspiration here with all of you, beautiful people.

* ![1000185288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tm9cXrgL95dWHz2kV5MjkQA2qGkaVEvWL83UrkmSeKN5JXBsFGgx5Zpt9AHQNZ2USH9.jpg) ![1000167570.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/Eo6CETmL1DiV6u8Me3FepghDvnXEDnj1RDcKxNuPBhFXow81KftygMBxDRVvZGj8amr.jpg) **

body.title: Book: A Silent Friend. My Actifit Report Card: May 20 2026
body.body:
> How are you all? I hope you are well by the grace of Allah. Today I suddenly felt like writing about a topic. The topic is very simple, but for me it is associated with very deep feelings. And that is—books. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c9da98a1-e0ea-4ef8-b3ef-ad80b6338e69.jpg) I always think that people need a companion in life with whom they don't have to pretend. In real life, we mix with many people, talk, laugh. But can we say everything to everyone? No. There are some feelings that remain only within ourselves. And during those unspoken words, books feel closest to me. There is a different world of books. When the mind is very restless, it feels so peaceful when I open a book. It feels like I am not just reading the words, but also feeling them. Many times, I am silent for a long time after reading a line of a book. Because those words seem to touch the unknown feelings inside my own mind. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0d86f678-ee7a-49a2-b678-10201e224c56.jpg) The most beautiful thing for me is that books never force anyone. They only show the way. What is good, what is wrong, how people can change themselves—they explain these things very simply. But they leave the decision up to the people. I like this very much. Because in real life, there are many people who want to impose their own opinions along with giving advice. But books are completely different. When I am alone, I feel the company of books more. I don't realize how much time passes while reading a good book. Sometimes I find similarities between my life and the characters in the story, and sometimes it feels like the book has written down the words I didn't say. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9c1ef62b-fefd-4d85-aa59-6c0157b5e00e.jpg) Nowadays, people want everything very quickly. They find joy in watching a few seconds of video. But the feeling of reading a book is different. Books teach people to be patient. They teach them to think deeply. They give me the opportunity to think about my mistakes. Books have helped me stay calm during many bad times in my life. When I felt like no one understood, I found a little comfort inside the pages of a book. Books never complain, never move away. Every time I get closer, they give me something new. To be honest, a book is not just a collection of paper and words. A book is a feeling that gradually becomes very close to the human heart. So I believe that if there is a true silent friend in life, it is a book.

En uno de mis paseos me encontré con esta antigua droguería, un lugar en el que preparaban medicinas tradicionales y antiguas. Ignoro si aún opera o si es una especie de casa museo, solo pasé rápidamente por ahí.  A través de la ventana se podían ver frascos con rótulos que indicaban productos que quizá hoy no se usan de la misma manera y yo supongo que es meramente decorativo. Sin embargo esos siguen siendo principios activos de medicamentos que las farmacéuticas fabrican y distribuyen. 

Mirar por esa ventana fue viajar en el tiempo.

Recordé que en Cumaná había una farmacia (quizá más de una) que preparaba algunos productos (fórmulas magistrales), sobre todo ungüentos y  seguian fórmulas antiguas que habían pasado de generación en generación. 

Hoy recurrimos más a lo que viene una caja, que está aprobado, certificado, estandarizado, pero antes, las abuelas de esas fórmulas nacieron en el meson de algún boticario. 

La ciencia sigue avanzando, pero siempre habrá un lugar para las tradiciones y recetas heredadas. Porque en casi todas las casas hay un remedio casero que nos dejó alguna abuela. 

Fotos de mi autoría.

body.title: Rutina de hombro, antebrazo, pierna, pecho y triceps [Calistenia con peso]
body.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yrELyRALBcw

Les comparto una rutina de calistenia con peso que hice hace unos días. Empecé con press militar sentado, realizando 10 repeticiones con un movimiento excéntrico lento, y lo combiné de inmediato con extensión de antebrazo. Para ahorrar tiempo y optimizar el entrenamiento, suelo hacer biseries (ejercicios combinados) siempre que el movimiento lo permita. En este caso, el press militar sentado encaja perfecto con las extensiones de antebrazo, ya que puedo apoyar los brazos en las piernas cómodamente. De esta combinación completé 5 series de 10 repeticiones.

Luego pasé a las zancadas con una pesa de 20 kilos. Esta vez quise hacer algo distinto para exigirle más al músculo: hice 5 series de caminatas aumentando 2 pasos en cada serie. Empecé con 10 pasos y terminé con 18, cerrando cada serie con una caminata corta cargando el peso (farmer's walk). Después, pasé al press de pecho inclinado combinado con extensión de tríceps; hice 15 repeticiones de press y 10 de tríceps, completando solo 4 series.

Esa fue toda la rutina de ese día. De eso hace ya unos cuatro días y desde entonces no he podido entrenar como es debido por distintas razones. La principal fue que se estropeó la pantalla de mi teléfono. Me tomó tres días conseguir el repuesto y repararlo; pensé que me quedaría incomunicado por un buen tiempo, pero logré solucionarlo. Aunque no quedó perfecto y no puedo exigirle mucho al pobre aparato, al menos funciona. Por cierto, si alguien me quiere ayudar, ¡acepto un teléfono de regalo, que ya casi es mi cumpleaños! jaja.

Espero que les guste la rutina. Aplíquenla con un debido entendimiento de su cuerpo y aprendan a escucharlo. No se exijan más de lo que pueden dar; siempre es preferible que les tome un poco más de tiempo alcanzar la meta a que pierdan meses de progreso por una lesión.


----


ENGLISH

I want to share a weighted calisthenics routine I did a few days ago. I started with seated military press, doing 10 reps with a slow eccentric (lowering) phase, and supersetted it with forearm extensions. To save time and maximize my workouts, I usually perform compound or combined sets whenever the movements allow it. In this case, the seated military press transitions perfectly into forearm extensions since I'm already seated and can rest my arms on my legs. I did 5 sets of 10 reps for this combination.

Next, I moved on to lunges with a 20kg weight. I wanted to try something different to challenge the muscle further, so I did 5 sets of walking lunges, increasing the count by 2 steps each set. I started at 10 steps and finished at 18, completing each set with a short loaded carry. After that, I did incline chest press supersetted with tricep extensions—15 reps for the chest press and 10 for the triceps, completing just 4 sets.

That was the entire routine for the day. That was about four days ago, and I haven't been able to train properly since then for a few reasons. The main one was that my phone screen broke. It took me three days to get a replacement part and fix it. I thought I'd be without a phone for a while, but I managed to repair it. It didn't turn out perfect, and I can't push the poor thing too hard, but at least it works. By the way, if anyone wants to help a brother out, I'm open to a phone as a gift since my birthday is coming up! haha.

I hope you guys like the routine. Give it a try, but make sure to understand and listen to your body. Don't push yourself beyond your limits; it's always better to take a bit longer to reach your goals than to lose months of progress to an injury.

body.title: Another Graffiti? Yes!
body.body:
>It is my pleasure to share with you the few pieces I’ve been working on these past few days. The truth is, I’ve been completely consumed by what’s known as an economic crisis, family problems, and a few other difficulties. I know and acknowledge that in many cases it’s better to keep these things to myself and not talk about them, but it’s also good to express this point of view so you can understand the deep feelings that drive, motivate, and inspire me to keep searching for my own peace, my own space, and my own center—and yes, this is through graffiti.

Fone; =====

>One of the most important aspects is the range of colors and materials to use, since I usually rely on a combination of leftover paint, mixed pigments, and a can of spray paint.

\n\n

>That’s true. There might be a bit of frustration when we talk about progress and evolution, since more than a decade has passed and I’m still essentially doing the same kind of work—the same art, the same graffiti, similar lettering—but this also involves a rather important aspect, which is where we maintain our authenticity and strict cultural guidelines.

\n\n

>This doesn’t mean I don’t want to evolve—I’ve shared with you on previous occasions mural work, advertising projects, and different types of lettering—but the support is literally nonexistent. Making an investment without seeking your support is completely unreasonable, since even with the right materials and tools, it’s not easy—not to say impossible—to secure commissions that cover the costs and investment.

\n\n

>For me, it would be wonderful to get started with this work—creating digital prints, custom designs, printing T-shirts, carrying out interventions in public spaces, and bringing messages of social awareness and protest to the streets. Yet this entire cultural and artistic aspect is overshadowed by a broader situation that concerns us all.

* * * * * * *

>I am always grateful to all of you in the community for all the support and encouragement I’ve received. Honestly, my daily life has been so hectic that I’ve stopped paying attention to some of your posts, and I apologize for that. I think this is the second time I’ve said this, but I’ll be much more attentive to what you share with us, since mutual support is what allows our community to grow.

* * * *

body.title: Bolstering the Witch's Chosen
body.body:
https://youtu.be/HNXYsvrG5N4

[Originally uploaded to Bilibili.tv](https://www.bilibili.tv/en/video/4799607319697920)

Nicole has had a rough development cycle. In her first iteration she was the original form of the Second Descender, a higher power who had been corrupted into a powerful pawn of the game's primary antagonist. She was then changed into an angel while the pawn side was separated and changed into being a member of four equally powerful pawns. Angels were still meant to be extremely rare in this world because most of them were forced to give up their minds or their powers. Nicole became the only angel to give up neither but at the cost of her voice. Then miHoYo created Zibai and also made her an angel. She has her voice, powers and mind thus Nicole was demoted again. Even so, she was an angel meaning she was still at a godlike power level. In practice, she should have worked in conjunction with an even more powerful witch. Now she's been relegated to being a power boost for the new gimmick in the game.

Nicole has become a higher rarity edition of the highly praised Bennett support character. They both serve the purpose of applying ATK stat buffs to their team however Bennett requires the use of his Burst to do which needs enough Energy to use. Nicole's buff comes from her skill which can be used at any time. However the cost for both is not being able to apply their element which is part of the main combat system of the game. Reactions make up the brunt of a team's damage.

But this is why Durin is also on the banner. Durin's buff is entirely made up of applying his element and then improving on the damage its reactions can produce. In other words, it's a good idea to have both Nicole and Durin on the same team. And in fact, this means Nicole only has one true team, a Varka team that's rounded out by Venti. All three of these teammates are part of the game's new gimmick.

As for the rest of the banner's characters, Razor and Fischl are both part of that same gimmick as is the new character Prune. Fischl on her own is still a very good character since she can apply tons of Electro for reactions. Razor not so much. Prune can substitute Venti on that previously mentioned team but isn't as good because she's not as rare.

![](https://images.hive.blog/p/3auKdN6FdQE2iiW17bo7xtnLUAj4m3whUUyRTZSwow32zgGcDAv6DUXxPxSWa2?format=match&mode=fit&width=768)

And if you like discussing the storylines of games please click here to check out [Hive Gaming Theories!](https://hive.blog/trending/hive-157640)

body.title: Staying the Night at the Tsitsikamma Storms River Mouth Rest Camp, Eastern Cape, South Africa
body.body: > ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tvVzJdJrh5MukgyXm2BvMmFSWc9QyCF1YUnchgjr8tgHxq9xRkKz4HDLQtWVqH7dv8g.JPG) We were driving with much anticipation, both to what was about to come, and where we stayed. As we drove through what seemed like a north America forest road, we found the boards: Kayak and Lilo, and Tsitsikamma forest camp! The weather was a bit gloomy, but what did we expect? Nothing much but this was perfect weather for reading a book and staying in bed. But nonetheless, here were we with our anticipation! This was the most beautiful section of our road trip, the part where we stayed and drove in the forests. So, please join me on this virtual journey to our new destination for the next couple of days. # Arriving in the Forest: A Prime Spot We drove through cultivated \

and then it turned into the wild forest. The sounds and smells changed. Our little home for the weekend was inside of one of these wild forests. 

|![4.1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23t74jrnPXmVAbZwB62jkpJ3n84cHEYR2uEdqnzbLNriaBBvQWNrJ6bPBsLuKa6A2P3vy.JPG)|![4.2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23uEqp97KDVtonz7SNdu74TST42BgEK7NKH2qh5RUdBZEbT5FdGLhULJijgsw9eGG2WG2.JPG)|![4.3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xKQNYxxbM8ef3twAS6QH8HEhgMWaRhUh7QJfxS8CZgUxXvtXfMpew5VtGoQcxou4K1c.JPG)|
|-|-|-|

We had the perfect spot. Hidden away from everyone. Silence. Rest for our souls. This is what our minds yearned and our bodies needed. It was already more than a 1000 km that we drove from starting in Pretoria, so this was a well deserved rest. 


|![7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xA22qZ9EJTnt39MdVsXPCGcq8nwJEgcbfynQ11tZnxTDpS4fuuf1zdMM8e3xdj4bDFQ.JPG)|![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23yTYbbkx9V4SD4pHknF2wtgCpDvKe2r5rHdCrN1BBnqXbLDFYvofVpVht3N1awEDKFMr.JPG)|![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xKhpgEgHZsBuEfhxikoDQopARcBxcT4SRaFBEjzTF2ZosnT2v6GkK6J1r8MyPmUeEby.JPG)|
|-|-|-|

Our little home had it all. A small stoep or verande where we could braai (BBQ), a bed, a shower. And that was all we needed. It was heaven after a whole day's driving. 


![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wMN4eMABTKWJmZnEvuFuWYYcnNT1nBhzKxCutzfGZjQbcmFZc3pXsqUjYJWK3nEq1nK.JPG)

![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23w2EtoYhfeMpZRQfC6UP3MqWiQEHU28ZndAQ5BXpEHDyF3odc7qDatB9KYZAkF32H7tk.JPG)

___

# The First (but Luckily Last) Visitor

Because you live in the forest, you cannot not have the visitors. Luckily we only had one. When you book your stay, they tell you to always keep your doors and windows closed. Monkeys and baboons love to visit. We looked up after some noise and then we saw our little friend. 


![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wWrwUZUi1PbMMtWceK8vry9SRpNwqf8vgXaa6VKq2cVDyszSU47XYuofSuPUJDZN7Sp.JPG)

___

<div class=\

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23w2h39tg2iq5ngJSTqt2BqK8bHuQYHrDGJWgPpANXKbnCNYFaMnxkbh9hhgfdG3ymHpZ.JPG) ___ # Enjoying a Drink with a View After unpacking, keeping our things safe from the monkey friends, we strolled down to the beach to enjoy some well deserved drinks. ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wqCMKw9Af5iDLWVYAqth7ufocHxHQ4LEz5GmsAYxYz9ZB6JxWeehjQ9bgUVfbEmRFcm.JPG) ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xoWg5f2kK7WNqqWn1ALaBArzgFJzKSfqHBG5L5BbvDHhSFuBaFxq6Qyqrsr2UpjYSHh.JPG) ___ I do not know what view was more beautiful, my wife or the ocean. But I could luckily snap two photographs! ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23vhsMc3AA7fM8y9N3sY3YUSdWuZwqT4Cz1VSxwTLWWWMY37xuF3RAZtmEwarSjq8Qdzx.JPG) We settled down for a drink or three. The view was amazing. Sadly, the proper restaurant burnt down, so we sat outside. But this was still perfect, you had the smell of the ocean and everything happening right at your feet. ___

> ![24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wgApAonjE5fUAJRK38zQYkpFFfiZNMWVWGjAkYyQLpbwhKvNFMJUAo8R3PggKf9D9r9.JPG) ___ # Getting Ready to Cook... Only To Realise Something Horrible... After the drink, we headed back to our little room. As I lit the fire, I started looking for a \

. The piece of grid that you cook your food on. There...was...nothing. I saw some other people close by and they informed me that you needed to bring your own. In my life have I never heard of a lodge or home where you needed to bring your own rooster when the braai is supplied. 

___

<div class=\

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wBc8h4TJ3Sc2LtKYGZQhYFyLrkusEWYV2UUdnw1pTgxTdESHCkxnwdQZsyn1FRpsqwi.JPG) ___ I quickly drove to the local shop in the nature reserve. I had literally 3 minutes to spare. I looked for a rooster only to find out they only have one left, in the back of the store. How lucky can one be? ![27.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/243BXfuiNDjkNTpDhdLfDAkwSoGNEkhCdZPLMLWjedQbBaPAWbM1otgzNHtDUTzFr682e.JPG) ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tGVvJzHfzrqc64hXxrwbB6ovtXGZRbJEzkGm7jQcyM82qDhYRbjwJuMYVWzetEyA3fE.JPG) ___ # But So the Adventure Ends... In between the braai \

and leaving, we did some other stuff as well... But more on that later! 

For now, we had to head home. But it is always sad to say goodbye to such a beautiful place. 


![29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/245mkL18QkAB5nD7HmN6iTToThcQXS5XPKD9hKA1by91kuw98qSYjiynMjBeaR8KC9eTn.JPG)

___

<div class=\

> ![31.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/243WMaf11uxjkauuSEqkR3JkERFDz2fM8vH7DAvTxe3VQLo26LXUU47yajsURi3zwT6wx.JPG) ___ Our next visit also promised beautiful stops and exciting trips... For now, happy travels. *All of the musings and writings are my own, albeit inspired by the breathtaking beauty of this place. The photographs were taken with my Nikon D300.* [//]:# (!worldmappin -34.023273 lat 23.889359 long d3scr)

body.title: Dreams – Dare to dream Big ?
body.body:
/>

When I found this old picture, it brought back so many memories.

I was very young and had just started my working in 1998. This picture was taken for our company's new year's greeting card. I started my career as an international buying agent in Jakarta. We produced and exported garments especially Jackets, to the European Countries. That’s why we were wearing winter Jackets in the picture. It was my first year as the youngest employee in the company, My bosses were Dutch and Italian men. I learned a lot there, especially how to communicate in English language. I worked at the company for 11 years and it had been a great experience.

First year, I started from scratch to senior level. The company’s growth was significant each year. I started there as single until I got 2 kids. Wow I never thought that I would stay that long. Life was like a roller coaster there, sometimes happy, and joyful, and sometimes bitter but it made me learn about many things in life. My emotional growth, friendship and how is the real working world looks like.

I realize that I should pursue my dreams, I can’t be in one place for long time. I know that my dreams come true in the very best time and I met great people that though me useful knowledge for life especially what is the meaning of life its self, wisdom, love and how to become successful.

Simple tips : Just write down your dream list, stay calm, focus on action, pray, and surrender to God for the result. Believe it or not it works perfectly.

Thank you to all of my readers, I appreciate and May God bless you with a beautiful day, Stay Healthy and Happy.. Love Love

Introduction


Hello everyone, Worldmappin friends! I'm @lauramica, and today I'm sharing our Travel Digest for this Wednesday. I hope you enjoy the posts we'll see today! ❤️ This time, our featured posts take us to a beautiful fort in Serbia, we see some nature in Turkey, and we discover a peaceful little town in Venezuela. We'll also visit other places around the world like France, Spain, the Philippines, and Bangladesh—a little bit of everything! Thank you all for sharing your posts on the map! Have a wonderful day! 😃❤️


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Golubac Fortress on the Danube - Serbia by @dragan1957

Today I will guide you to another historical landmark in my country, Serbia. This is a medieval fortified town known as the Golubac Fortress located along the banks of the Danube River.I call it the Fortress on the Water.Now, who built the fortress, that is, the city, is little known. body.title: Boosting Battle Power: My New Gold and Common Acquisitions【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
body.body:
> 

Saludos, gamers que dan vida a #Splinterlands. ¿Cómo va su semana hasta el momento? La mía algo movida y por ende he estado ocupada para compartir con ustedes y otras comunidades, pero hoy estoy de vuelta para traerles mis más recientes adquisiciones de cartas, algunas son doradas y otras son comunes.


> Greetings, gamers who bring #Splinterlands to life! How's your week going so far? Mine's been a bit hectic, and I haven't been able to share much with you and other communities, but I'm back today to show you my latest card acquisitions—some are gold, and some are common.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>


<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2DPTJgc1mRBzodHcceecNxFfJwbrBhaRfESsUExdJfYiw48FEiHBs6RsczxG6Z6UZp.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

Así va mi avance en las ligas de Frontera y Moderno. No he jugado mucho en Moderno como quisiera, igual tampoco me va tan bien por allá como en Frontera. El rango de Oro I es exigente conmigo y prefiero enfocarme en las partidas que gano por allá que en subir mi rango de Bronce III. Además, necesito comprar más cartas, sobre todo las de dragón para ir mejorando mi mazo, pero por ahora me conformo con estas que adquirí.

> This is how my progress is going in the Frontier and Modern leagues. I haven't played as much in Modern as I'd like, and I'm not doing as well there as I am in Frontier. The Gold I rank is demanding for me, and I prefer to focus on the games I win there rather than climbing my Bronze III rank. Besides, I need to buy more cards, especially Dragon cards, to improve my deck, but for now, I'm happy with the ones I've acquired.



|![Aimee Whisperwind_lv1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23zGRkxtywHx1odPrrH13VsL1Bx5BVWbrAc1566d8XgGySzPQLiBbFCog9HRaZyoJN5fZ.png)|![Aimee Whisperwind_lv2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23zGRqhfFW2nm7TSMK6AiMHWHMFLwWSZjPKfg83m4Jn1ggmBKeSak2XKsPMFahueJ7Ybs.png)|
|-|-|




<div class\

>

Antes de seguir invirtiendo en las cartas Dragón, decidí comprarme algunas de Aimee Whisperwind; una en nivel 2 y otras dos en nivel uno. Esta carta es muy buena y hace bastante daño, además de que es rápida para bajarle la vida a las cartas de mi oponente. Esta fue una de las cartas más caras que me tocó comprar, pero valió la pena el gasto.

> Before investing further in Dragon cards, I decided to buy some Aimee Whisperwind cards; one at level 2 and two at level 1. This card is very good and deals a lot of damage, plus it's quick at reducing my opponent's card health. This was one of the most expensive cards I had to buy, but it was worth the expense.

|![Lenore Nevermore_lv2_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/242hQFKGF2xfWVe9W7c95ZAKmoDFerxFfPfrhuyMzQrY4eU5fpMY8DuRRsELH9hKLPk2C.png)|![Lunaki Howler_lv2_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23yd1ZCi7jjc1CMriVEXXZFtoZkghGEvrRMA14n8m9Qk9CjsbQFcJTZGPbDHeCnxYWEWy.png)|
|-|-|

Las cartas doradas no podían faltar en mi compra, saben que me encantan y las estoy coleccionando. Esta vez tocó el turno para Leonore Nevermore y Lunaki Howler. Ambas cartas suelo usarlas bastante en mis batallas de Frontera, así que me servirán de mucho para subir de rango por allá.

> The gold cards were a must-have in my purchase; they know I love them, and I'm collecting them. This time, it was Leonore Nevermore and Lunaki Howler's turn. I tend to use both cards quite a bit in my Frontier battles, so they'll be very helpful for ranking up there.

<center>![Necrulencian Thief_lv1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23ywgDJM28zHhdSU46tsLtu3QpevvPuJh3PUjwwioXtbsXp7hPdF5CUWBmHerT7hRzSTP.png)</center>

<div class\

>

Por último, pero no menos importante, no pude dejar de comprar Necrulencian Thief. De ella compré varias con la finalidad de subirla de nivel. Además de que estaban a un excelente precio, no pude dejar de comprarlas casi todas. Esta carta es especial para mí. Me gusta bastante. Hace mucho daño. Es rápida y su poder es muy útil en las batallas. He ganado varias partidas gracias a ella.


> Last but not least, I couldn't resist buying Necrulecian Thief. I bought several of them to level them up. Besides being at a great price, I couldn't resist buying almost all of them. This card is special to me. I really like it. It deals a lot of damage. It's fast, and its power is very useful in battles. I've won several matches thanks to it.


<center>![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tRxoXgeYhr8s7yf53HQTBJ6KYDvCvM687YEcGURST3GAVUua7T8NtcJ5Gf3TAw8VWwH.png)</center>


<div class\

> Por ahora, mi inversión fue algo alta, pero valió la pena el gasto. Estas cartas me hacían falta para mejorar mi mazo. Mientras transcurren los días, espero conseguir mejores ofertas la próxima vez. Así que deséenme suerte ya sea para conseguir cartas doradas o más cartas de dragón. Si llegaste al final de mi post, te doy las gracias infinitas por haberlo leído. ¡Hasta una próxima publicación! 🌸 > For now, my investment was a bit high, but it was worth the expense. I needed these cards to improve my deck. As the days go by, I hope to find better deals next time. So wish me luck, whether it's for getting gold cards or more dragon cards. If you made it to the end of my post, thank you so much for reading it. Until next time! 🌸

body.title: Film Review: The Baader Meinhof Complex (Das Baader Meinhof Komplex, 2008)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/nSQW9S9YXQO93nWRnKRwiozamrx.jpg)


Until very recently, when prominent US company CEOs became assassins’ targets, the popular imagination—particularly among those whose historical understanding is filtered through Hollywood’s lens—had almost exclusively associated ideologically motivated terrorism with the far right. The actual tapestry of the late 20th century is, of course, infinitely more complex and nuanced. The 1970s, a period so turbulent it earned the grim moniker ‘the years of lead’ in multiple European nations, was profoundly marked by left-wing revolutionary fervour that frequently erupted into deadly action. It is this fraught era that German director Uli Edel sought to capture in his 2008 epic docudrama, *The Baader Meinhof Complex*. An ambitious, sprawling, and often brutally visceral reconstruction of the rise and fall of the Red Army Faction (RAF), the film attempts to grapple with one of postwar Germany’s most traumatic and defining episodes. Yet, for all its scale and meticulous craft, it ultimately delivers a narrative that is more forensic than insightful, a coldly efficient chronicle that struggles to penetrate the chaotic hearts and minds of its subjects.

The film is adapted from the seminal 1985 non-fiction work of the same name by Stefan Aust, the renowned journalist and long-time editor of *Der Spiegel*. Aust’s account, drawing on his personal acquaintance with some of the RAF’s founders, provides a formidable foundation. Edel and the late, celebrated producer Bernd Eichinger (whose passion project this was) translate this into a cinematic endeavour of unprecedented scale for German cinema at the time. The budget is evident in every frame: from the impeccable period detail of late-1960s West Berlin to the sun-baked training camps in Jordan, and in a cast list that reads as a who’s who of German acting talent. Moritz Bleibtreu, Johanna Wokalek, and Martina Gedeck embody Andreas Baader, Gudrun Ensslin, and Ulrike Meinhof with a fierce, restless energy. Bruno Ganz, still fresh in audience minds from his portrayal of Hitler in *[Downfall](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-downfall-der-untergang-2004)*, brings a weary, cerebral gravitas to Horst Herold, the federal police chief pioneering modern, computer-based counter-terrorism.

The film’s structural ambition is clear. It meticulously traces the radicalisation process, beginning with Ulrike Meinhof’s introduction as a left-wing journalist holidaying with her family on Sylt. Her disillusionment is catalysed by the violent police response to protests against the Shah of Iran’s 1967 visit, culminating in the shooting of student Benno Ohnesorg (Martin Glade). The film convincingly portrays this moment as a seismic fracture, the point where legitimate protest curdles into a conviction that the West German state is a ‘fascist police state’ in need of violent overthrow. The subsequent attempted assassination of student leader Rudi Dutschke (Stefan Blomberg) further fuels the fire. Edel’s direction in these early passages is arguably at its most effective, generating a palpable sense of escalating outrage and moral certainty. We see Meinhof, estranged from her philandering husband Klaus Reiner Röhl (Hans Werner Meyer), drawn into the orbit of the increasingly militant Baader and Ensslin. Their progression from fiery rhetoric to the arson of department stores, and finally to the audacious prison break that marks Meinhof’s point of no return, is portrayed with a propulsive, almost thriller-like pace.

This first act does attempt, albeit superficially, to contextualise the rage. It hints at the formative shame of the ‘68er generation over their parents’ Nazi complicity, and gives voice to slogans condemning American imperialism and Israeli policy that sound disconcertingly contemporary. Yet, as the narrative advances, Edel’s stated intention—to first present the RAF as idealistic, almost romantic revolutionaries, and then to systematically strip away that romance—becomes the film’s defining, and ultimately limiting, methodology. After the group’s training in Jordan and their return to wage a campaign of ‘expropriations’ (armed robberies) and bombings, the film shifts gear. The arrest of the core members and their protracted, theatrical trial in Stammheim prison, the hunger strike and death of Holger Meins (Stipe Erceg), the rise of the ‘second generation’ under Brigitte Mohnhaupt (Nadja Uhl), and the catastrophic events of the ‘German Autumn’ in 1977—including the kidnapping and murder of industrialist Hanns Martin Schleyer (Bernd Stegemann)—are all reconstructed with scrupulous, almost clinical detail.

Herein lies the film’s central flaw: it becomes a prisoner of its own chronology. Edel opts for a breathless, episodic procession of events—shoot-outs, bombings, prison protests, kidnappings—connected by a relentless voiceover and newsreel montages. The effect is one of exhaustive documentation but profound emotional and intellectual distance. The internal dynamics of the group, the ideological fissures that led to Meinhof’s isolation and suicide in 1976, the true nature of their disillusionment as their revolution spiralled into nihilistic bloodshed—these are gestured at but never deeply explored. The film shows us *what* happened, often with shocking graphic violence and a considerable amount of nudity (justified narratively by the characters’ embrace of the sexual revolution, yet occasionally feeling gratuitous and exploitative), but it consistently fails to grapple with the deeper *why* beyond the initial catalysts.

Attempts at nuance are made, chiefly through the character of Horst Herold. In a shrewd dramatic device, he is given a fictional subordinate, played by Heino Ferch, to whom he can articulate his surprisingly reflective philosophy. Herold argues that terrorism must be understood through the lens of genuine social grievance, a nod to his own left-wing past. This provides a rare moment of complexity, suggesting a state apparatus capable of analytical thought rather than mere repression. However, this remains an isolated island of insight in a sea of brutal fact. The aftermath of the Stammheim suicides and the long, ambiguous legacy of the RAF in German society are rushed in a brief, inconsequential epilogue, leaving the profound historical and psychological aftermath largely unaddressed.

Consequently, *The Baader Meinhof Complex* is a technically masterful, ambitious, and historically important film that nonetheless feels hollow at its core. It demonstrates how immense budget and star power can recreate history with impeccable accuracy, yet fail to illuminate it. In Germany, the film provoked intense debate, modest box office returns, and fierce criticism from victims’ families—a reaction that perhaps underscores its failure to provide a definitive or deeply satisfying narrative. It is less a complex analysis of the Baader-Meinhof phenomenon than a complex, lavishly produced re-enactment of it. For viewers seeking a detailed timeline of RAF atrocities and state response, it is unparalleled. For those seeking to understand the tragic human pathology of revolutionary violence, the twilight of idealism, or the lasting wounds on the German psyche, the film offers only shadows and echoes, lost amidst the gunfire and the stark, cold light of its own meticulous reconstruction. 


RATING: 6/10 (++)

So I wanted to speak to Sigurd about our immediate plans, and he gave me a room that's my own to use. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbT7wFTWtmAcuRjtqfhYJA4q3DfFgi97sVGKguRHheUnP/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVguuThEnzhfCzv2Hvy1k1agMnA4SVbSfrJqN9jdUq6ab/screenshot_4_.png) After Sigurd left to tend to the other settlers, I checked around the room and found this letterbox. It included the first letter of Sigurd, mentioning Randvi will drop any letter I receive into this box for me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZMnUrX1iFxQhnxmaiUAfx6YAWKCNnAYnEhQZDqFwwpow/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedzLQEDoH92QB2QVaGASieWb4vfmfgNZNU6UGHeSss7k/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBWxwNudxZgRtPZBjYyDFvQbpxszsMAm8GctU2nDEHdj/screenshot_7_.png) Then I checked this sturdy wooden bed, that Eivor mentioned as a bed better than many he has slept in during his long travels, and a good place to recover. I let him sleep for the night. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZTdbS2gnACDcYjVkZHdgrfzukTPhGtvBahU9SBYe8FiJ/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjMj11WxmBuXm3AiSLMvHWiKE6WQvfUzSJ53G4DNLQmZ/screenshot_9_.png) At the morning, I met Sigurd at Rowan's stable to see off our guests. There I found Basim was taking his leave from Sigurd, riding a horse out through the camp gates. He moved silently without saying a word to Eivor. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5BEH6ze7mG1nfYQqnZpeCCajtynkp45JATiJxDyazkk/screenshot_10_.png) After meeting Sigurd, he said he was riding to another land to a town called Repton to forge alliances. He expect me to join him when I have finished here, helping the hidden ones secure the surrounding territories from the rival factions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT91DtYBCE5S4LRf4tKWJ4sAfEzSCkTRcphvBZn1ZjNs8/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW929N8EnRctYfkr1GiMPwvxYyX3aX87sBHhT45td3T5V/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYpHvcf5sdGEFiVHKTWxR5NoVPbshxRcBbirjTbST3M1F/screenshot_13_.png) After Sigurd left the stable grounds, Eivor suddenly saw this glimpse of his future self through a strange spiritual distortion. It seemed like he has awakened Ragnarok itself, surrounded by blinding light and ancient power in the vision. And he looked like Odin in that vision. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXaBR7eJzwsW1x9tDCd2VWrrrQ8ofiis26ehijA71Lik1/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmco9pLNmeGhZEEz8vA3ffkqKJj8DAqArQ6c8gMS6HLk3f/screenshot_15_.png) Then I talked with Rowan at the stable to expand our options for mounts. I tried to build the stables to improve our settlement's infrastructure, but I didn't have enough supplies for it yet. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd5QwY6D1r3Le8ds33VQUbYeMEM6FRwcdiybz9PR711tt/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtNRNpxLuD1ibwBVRmfYfopND2LVQNz6zgGSdkb9wmTP/screenshot_17_.png) Then I had to speak to Randvi to find another source of work for the clan. As Sigurd plugged earlier, she has more than one task for me here, and I found her inside the longhouse checking the alliance map for targets. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/a894d19e)

body.title: Splinterlands - Leveling Up some Foundation cards
body.body:
![ll.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tmBhVX2cgsDi61Esqb6Ho5C4v1wFG3a9QbiV8Ce8bzaUw5UMu6uUVqPuJB1mEZw7p5e.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I'm going to level up some of my foundations cards so they can perform better on the battlefield and therefore I can win many more battles.

First, I will level up the rare archon, the fey Aurelia (gold foil) from level 2 to level 3. I have this archon at level 4 in regular foil, but I leveled up my gold foil so I can summon her in some battle tournaments that only require gold foil cards. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRt5E5qm8BRm7ekEJnC6ipJ7z3jm21TKdMsnD6KEUbYfNYCevXyWaUZ2icHHcFRdjyo.png)

body.title: Arsenal are the Premier League champions.
body.body:
> Arsenal's roar echoed once more across England, this time not as an echo of a glorious past, but as the vibrant voice of a powerful present. After 22 years of waiting, the Gunners lifted the Premier League trophy, restoring to North London the certainty that greatness is not forgotten, only delayed. This title is not just another trophy: it is the culmination of a project that seemed destined for failure and now stands as a symbol of resilience.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzrzr9S4AS9ZHWMpqyUkQM12JEqZ1xqqr2hZ71hFyYjZ/hituzjmwyaakhjy.jpg)[source](https://x.com/premierleague/status/2056833488641302622/photo/1) Mikel Arteta, the architect of this feat, has gone from apprentice to master. His calm demeanor and obsession with detail have transformed Arsenal into a solid unit, capable of withstanding Manchester City's pressure and imposing their will with authority. For him, this championship is more than a medal: it's the validation of years of work, nights of doubt, and the conviction that football is built with patience and faith. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRZFw2WDrs4AM9jFAboA1fp7dv8omEcYhbPxhLZwtZaWt/hit3vqzxyaawnkp.jpg)[source](https://x.com/LigasTopFutbol/status/2056869272819765562/photo/1) The fans, who for two decades lived between the nostalgia of the \

and the resignation of second-place finishes, are celebrating today with tears and chants. The parade announced in Islington will be more than a party: it will be a ritual of identity, a reminder that Arsenal not only competes, but reigns once again. Every red flag waving in the streets is a collective heartbeat that unites generations, from those who remember Henry and Bergkamp to the youngsters who grew up without seeing their team win the league. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGn1nHUMoyHtbgZvnrNWi8UZsTpdpLWH1PMWn4HZu64n/hitxry1wgaexbvk.jpg)[source](https://x.com/SoyFan10/status/2056833618262077571/photo/1) But this title doesn't stop in England. It's also the prelude to a continental battle: the Champions League final in Budapest against PSG. Arsenal arrives with renewed confidence, certain that the drought is over and that history can be written in golden letters. The Premier League is the springboard, the Champions League the summit. If they manage to conquer Europe, the double will become the ultimate epic, the story that will forever mark the club's memory. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhdGxedCWoSE6pk3NtKgmpZM1woQpZ4MfxUHGXFrmPGq/hiwpv2fxuaavn1x.jpg)[source](https://x.com/premierleague/status/2057037364338540562/photo/1) Right now, Arsenal is not just a team: it's a symbol of perseverance, an epic anthem that reminds us that glory may take time, but it never dies. For Arteta, for the players, and for the fans, the 2026 Premier League title is the rebirth of a giant. And now, with their sights set on Budapest, the Champions League dream feels closer than ever. Credits: I used Google Translate.

body.title: The Day I Cut the Cord
body.body:
Some relationships in life are ones we embrace with all our heart. We trust them blindly sharing our happiness our secrets even our dreams with them. I too had a friend like that someone I thought was a true companion in my life. I believed he would stand by me through every hardship but sometimes a person can read faces yet fail to understand intentions.

Time went on and my faith in that friendship only grew stronger. I never once imagined that the same person would one day break my trust. But when the truth came out, my heart fell silent. His words his conversations and his friendship all started to feel like a painful betrayal. The deepest hurt was that the wound wasn’t given by an enemy but by someone close to me.

For many nights I kept wondering where I went wrong. Maybe I trusted people too much or maybe every smiling face isn't sincere. But then I realized that sometimes protecting your self respect matters more than saving a relationship. That’s why I quietly ended contact with him. I made no scene voiced no complaints I just distanced myself from a friendship that no longer had any truth left in it.

Ending the connection wasn’t easy because the memories were still there in my heart. But sometimes in life you have to leave certain people behind in order to move forward. Now I’m more cautious than before but not weaker. I’ve learned that not every close person is sincere and every betrayal doesn’t come to break you it comes to make you stronger.

Even today, when I think of that friendship my heart does feel a little sad but there’s no regret. Because when certain relationships end a person doesn’t fall apart they rediscover themselves.

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

title.title: 当然可以！以下是一些旅游博客的主题建议：\n\n1. **隐秘的旅行目的
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g395dac23d2a7950210d268fdedfa109d84f91421219d52366bbbbefb975391357345cdd9951ed7bf4827f2680a2c5f1d95047a014023d41b5e08d607e80673db_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 隐秘的旅行目的地

旅行是探索世界的绝佳方式，而有些地方则远离喧嚣，等待着我们去发现。本文将带您走进一些不为人知的隐秘旅行目的地，帮助您开启一段独特的旅程。

## 1. **阿尔巴尼亚的锡拉库萨**

锡拉库萨位于阿尔巴尼亚的海岸线，是一个被蓝色海水环绕的小镇。这里有未被商业化的海滩、古老的城堡和热情好客的当地人。您可以在这里享受宁静的时光，品尝新鲜的海鲜，感受地中海的魅力。

## 2. **斯洛文尼亚的布莱德湖**

布莱德湖以其如画的风景而闻名，但仍然保持着相对的宁静。湖中有一座小岛，岛上有一座古老的教堂。您可以租一只小船，划向岛上，享受湖边的美丽景色和清新的空气。

## 3. **葡萄牙的阿尔加维**

虽然阿尔加维在夏季吸引了大量游客，但仍有一些隐秘的海滩和小镇等待着探索。比如，卡尔哈奥海滩（Praia da Marinha）就是一个隐藏的宝石，拥有令人惊叹的悬崖和清澈的海水，是游泳和浮潜的理想之地。

## 4. **日本的冲绳群岛**

冲绳群岛是一个远离日本本土的热带天堂，以其美丽的海滩和丰富的文化而闻名。尽管一些岛屿较为知名，但仍有许多小岛保持着原始的自然风貌，适合喜欢潜水和徒步旅行的游客。

## 5. **摩洛哥的阿伊特本哈杜**

阿伊特本哈杜是一个被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产的古老村庄，位于摩洛哥的高阿特拉斯山脉。这里的红土建筑和壮丽的山景让人仿佛置身于电影场景中。您可以在这里体验传统的摩洛哥文化，品尝当地美食。

## 结语

探索隐秘的旅行目的地不仅能够让您远离人群，还能让您体验到更真实的当地文化和生活方式。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些鲜为人知的地方，开启一段独特而难忘的旅程吧！

title.title: Utility Lines
title.body:
>

Sometimes, it is absolutely insane how many \

appear in photos I've taken over the years. Even out in the country, it's often difficult to snap a photo of a barn in a field beside the road without catching a couple of power lines somewhere in the shot.

I thought the Queen Anne-inspired house in the following photo was lovely and wanted a picture of it. Many, many years ago, I lived just a couple blocks from that house and passed it almost every day on my to work, church, shopping, or some other destination. While revisiting the area a few years ago, I decided to stop my car long enough to get a quick snap of it. When I took the photo, I noticed there were some utility lines in the shot, but thought I would edit them out, using my trusty PaintShopPro™ software, as I have done countless times in the past.

\

you may ask...? Yes, no exaggeration. I have spent hours upon hours, editing hundreds of photos, carefully using tools such as the Clone Brush and Push Brush, tediously removing the lines. Then one must re-blend the affected areas with the Smudge Brush and Clone Brush to smooth the tones of the blue sky, the trees, and anything else that the power lines crossed.

\n\n

>

Closer inspection of the photograph on my computer screen revealed a veritable nightmare of editing that lay in front of me. Not only are there clearly visible lines and cables in the shot, but zooming into different areas show wispy traces of lines here-and-there. To help demonstrate what I'm talking about, look at the following, where I have traced the lines — and I know there are others that I failed to trace, but my eyes were quite bleary by this point! LOL! It would take hours of work to clean up this mess in a halfway acceptable manner.

For those that might be confused by the plethora of wires and cables, I can explain. Some of the wires and cables shown in the photo provide electrical service to the area, while others carry telephone signals for landline phones or cable-TV signals (each provider has their own cables). There are likely cables for other purposes up there of which I am unaware, such as security systems, traffic-light control, and so forth. The steel cables that are seen slicing diagonally through the image are \

that are used to secure the big utility poles to help keep them from toppling in high winds, or if a vehicle loses control and strikes one.

\n\n

>

My laptop came pre-loaded with an AI app (Copilot™), but I'd never used it until recently when I asked it to help enhance/restore some old family photos. It did a great job restoring and enhancing the old, faded photos! I honestly do not know what made me think of this next idea, but one day I decided to see if it could assist in removing utility lines and poles. OMG, it did it, beautifully in just a couple of minutes! The result is shown below!

>

One thing that truly amazed me: If you scroll back up to the first photo in the post and look closely, you will notice that the brown utility pole was casting a shadow on the house (to the immediate right of the first upstairs window). When the AI removed the pole, it also removed the shadow of that pole on the house, without my having to ask it to do so! 😯

So below is the final edit by me in PaintShopPro™ where I removed the hood of my car from the bottom of the photo as well as the shadow of another utility pole across the pavement. I probably could have asked the AI to do that, too, but I've learned (the hard way) that running a photo thru the AI too many times often introduces other errors, even when \

is specified in the prompt. 😒

\n\n

All I used for a prompt was \

>

Please don't misunderstand: I do not intend for this to be a turning point where my future images will be heavily touched by AI. I will still be editing photos and applying filters manually with PaintShopPro™ and other tools, but will definitely use AI's assistance here-and-there as each case warrants.

Also: ➡️ I will not use AI for writing — not even proofreading or translating! ⬅️

I hope my sharing this tip will help others edit their photos faster and easier! If you have any similar tips, please share them in the comments!

**NOTES** * All writing is always by me with NO AI used, not even for proofreading. * Photos by me, with enhancement by Copilot™ AI

It has been a long time since I last shared photos from one of my regular break spots — Torgau. Lately I have been there a bit less often, but there was a time when I visited this place very regularly because we had many deliveries there. My dad even used to joke that I probably had my own summer house there. 😁 The number of deliveries in Torgau decreased and because of that my visits there became less regular as well.

Nevertheless every single time I stay there overnight, I still go to my favorite place by the lake. This week the qurator’s contest theme is “peaceful”, so I thought my sunset shots from Torgau would fit the topic perfectly. For me, this place always radiates an incredible sense of peace and harmony.

I really enjoy spending weekends there and going for an evening walk by the lake while admiring the beautiful sunsets every single time. It is a moment when I can slow down, sit on a bench and simply think for a while. A moment that reminds me that views like these are exactly why I love my job so much. 🙂

title.title: Kasino ilman rekisteröintiä nopeasti – nopeat kotiutukset
title.body:
# Kasino ilman rekisteröintiä nopeasti

Kun mä testaan kasinoita suomalaisille, yksi asia nousee aina yli muiden: miten nopeasti pääsee pelaamaan ja saako rahat ulos ilman turhaa säätöä. Kasino ilman rekisteröintiä kiinnostaa juuri siksi, että porukka ei jaksa enää täyttää pitkiä lomakkeita tai odottaa sähköposteja kuin VR:n myöhäistä junaa.

Tässä jutussa käyn suoraan läpi, miten pelaa ilman rekisteröitymistä oikeasti toimii, missä kohtaa Pay N Play tulee peliin ja milloin kyse on pelkästä markkinointipuheesta. Mä katson myös maksunopeutta, bonusehtoja, RTP:tä, asiakaspalvelua ja sitä, mitä lisenssi kertoo suomalaiselle pelaajalle.

**Näin Nopeat Talletukset Ja Kotiutukset Toimivat**

Kun pikakasinoiden nopeus kiinnostaa, maksutavan rooli korostuu heti ensimmäisissä vaiheissa. Pelaaja huomaa eron usein jo siinä, kuinka sujuvasti talletus menee läpi ja millä tahdilla kotiutus voi myöhemmin lähteä liikkeelle.

Moni vertaa maksupalveluoperaattoreita käytännössä sen mukaan, miten nopeasti talletus ja nosto onnistuvat, ja siksi esimerkiksi [nopeat Trumo kasino](https://trumokasinot.net/) -vaihtoehdot nousevat helposti keskusteluun, kun etsitään sujuvaa pankkitunnuksilla pelaamista ja nopeita kotiutuksia.

![](https://i.ibb.co/xq4N3whQ/f152fd0519d7.jpg)

Kun toiminta on näin suoraviivaista, pelaajan ei tarvitse käyttää aikaa ylimääräiseen säätöön, vaan voi keskittyä itse pelaamiseen ja kotiutuksen odottamiseen.

### Trustly, Brite Ja Zimpler

Trustly, Brite ja Zimpler ovat ne nimet, jotka toistuvat pikakasinoiden yhteydessä koko ajan. Mä katson niitä aina saman kysymyksen kautta: kuinka nopeasti talletus menee läpi ja millä tahdilla nosto oikeasti liikkuu.

Lähteiden mukaan Trustly mainitaan lähes aina nopeiden pikakasinoiden yhteydessä. Zimpler nousee myös esiin, ja Brite kuuluu samaan porukkaan, kun puhutaan pankkitunnuksilla pelaamisesta.

### Kotiutuksen Pullonkaulat

Nopea kotiutus ei silti tarkoita automaattista kotiutusta joka kerta. KYC-tunnistautuminen voi alkaa vasta voiton nostossa, vaikka pelaaminen olisi mennyt aluksi ilman mitään lisäselvityksiä.

Tässä kohtaa moni huomaa, ettei “nopea” aina tarkoita samaa kuin “heti tilillä”. Jos paperit jumittaa, niin nopeus katoaa kuin märkä hanska pakkasessa.

### Maksutavat Ilman Turhaa Säätöä

E-lompakot, nettilompakot, pankkisiirto ja debit-kortti voivat olla mukana, mutta pikakasinon logiikka nojaa yleensä verkkopankkiin. Jos haluat nopean aloituksen, verkkopankki on yleensä se suorempi tie.

Kun talletus ja nosto hoituvat samalla periaatteella, koko pelaaminen tuntuu vähemmän tuskaiselta. Ei mitään ihmeellistä, vaan käytännön arkea.

## Mikä Kasino Ilman Rekisteröintiä On

Kasino ilman rekisteröintiä tarkoittaa käytännössä sitä, että erillistä pelitiliä ei luoda tavalliseen tapaan. Pelaaja menee sivulle, tallettaa verkkopankkitunnuksilla ja pääsee peleihin ilman pitkää kirjautumisrumbaa.

Moni sivu kutsuu itseään rekisteröitymättömäksi kasinoksi, vaikka taustalla on vain nopeampi tunnistautuminen. Kun malli toimii kunnolla, käyttäjä ei huomaa muuta kuin sen, että homma etenee suoraan peleihin.

### Pay N Play -malli Pankkitunnuksilla

Pay N Play -kasino nojaa verkkopankkitunnuksiin. Ne hoitavat vahvan sähköisen tunnistautumisen, joten erillinen käyttäjätunnus ja salasana jäävät pois.

Tämä on se syy, miksi suomalainen kasino ilman rekisteröitymistä tuntuu nopealta. Yksi talletus, yksi tunnistus, ja homma lähtee käyntiin.

### Rekisteröinnin Puute Käytännössä

Kun pelitilin avaaminen jää pois, pelaaja säästää aikaa heti alussa. Silti kotiutuksessa voidaan pyytää tietoja, jos henkilöllisyys pitää varmistaa.

Ei salasanaa, ei pitkää lomaketta, ei sähköpostisirkusta ennen ensimmäistä kierrosta. Siinä koko idea aika suoraan.

## Lisenssi, Valvonta Ja Turvallinen Kasino

Kasino ilman rekisteröintiä ei ole sama asia kuin valvomaton sivu. Lisenssi ja valvonta merkitsevät paljon, kun mietitään, mitä suomalainen pelaaja oikeasti saa vastineeksi.

Lähteissä näkyy vain muutama vahvistettu lisenssi: Malta ja Viro. Monen muun kasinon kohdalla lisenssitieto jää puutteelliseksi, ja se on rehellisesti sanottuna punainen lippu.

### MGA Vai Viron Lisenssi

MGA-lisenssi tuntuu monelle tutummalta, koska Malta on tunnettu peliviranomainen EU-alueella. Viron lisenssi taas näkyy lähteissä, mutta tieto ei aina ole yhtä selkeä pelaajalle.

Se mitä pelaaja huomaa, on yleensä se, kuinka paljon sivu kertoo ehdoista, valvonnasta ja kotiutuksista. Jos tietoa on niukasti, mä suhtaudun siihen aina epäillen.

### Turvallinen Tunnistautuminen

Verkkopankkitunnuksilla pelaaminen on monelle helpompi vaihtoehto kuin erillinen käyttäjätunnus. Tunnistus tuntuu tutulta, koska samaa käytetään muutenkin pankkiasioissa.

Se ei poista kaikkia tarkistuksia, mutta tekee aloituksesta helpomman. Pelaaja pääsee vähemmällä vaivalla peliin sisään.

### Vastuullinen Pelaaminen Käytännössä

Jos homma alkaa karata käsistä, talletusrajat ja peliesto kannattaa ottaa käyttöön heti. Ei sitä tarvitse dramaatisoida.

Budjetti on budjetti. Jos se paukkuu jo alkukuusta, ongelma ei ole kasino vaan oma peliraja.

## Bonukset, Kierrätys Ja Pienet Kirjainlaskut

Suuret tervetuliaisbonukset näyttävät hyvältä, mutta bonusehdot ratkaisevat pelin. 100 € bonus kuulostaa kivalta, mutta jos ehdot sitovat voitot tiukasti, jälki on helposti laiha.

Lähteissä korostuu kierrätysvapaita ilmaiskierroksia ja cashbackia, mutta yksityiskohtaiset rajoitukset jäävät usein epäselviksi. Mä en koske bonukseen ennen kuin ehdot on luettu edes pintapuolisesti.

### Kierrätysvaatimus Arjen Tasolla

Kierrätysvaatimus tarkoittaa sitä, kuinka monta kertaa bonus tai sen voitot pitää pelata läpi ennen kotiutusta. Jos luku on korkea, bonus voi olla käytännössä pelkkää näennäistä hyvää.

Tarkista ainakin kierrätys, aikaraja, maksimipanos ja se, mitkä pelit kelpaavat. Muuten rahat voi kadota kuin lompakko taksiin.

### Cashback Ja Ilmaisvedot
