title.title: Confección de lindo gorro ideal para trabajar 🪡🧵❤️ [esp/eng]
title.body:
>

___Saludos queridos amigos de NEEDLEWORKMONDAY!___ 🪡🧵🥰❤️

Espero estén disfrutando de un agradable día, el día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes la confección de un gorro para mantener el cabello  recogido, de esos que utilizan los trabajos para seguridad, acompáñame y te comparto el paso a paso:

> Greetings, dear friends of NEEDLEWORKMONDAY! 🪡🧵🥰❤️
>
> I hope you're having a wonderful day. Today, I want to share with you how to make a hairnet, the kind used in workplace safety. Join me as I share the step-by-step instructions:

<div class=\

>

![Logotipo Salón de Uñas Moderno Ilustrado Rosa.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQpxb1fTGjW5eRnEWMDw14DyD7Nz1WX9nyU5kccWJBTRc/Logotipo%20Sal%C3%B3n%20de%20U%C3%B1as%20Moderno%20Ilustrado%20Rosa.png)

<hr>

<div class=\

> ___MATERIALES___ > MATERIALS Mi hija, en su trabajo le exigen utilizar este tipo de gorros para mantener su cabello controlado, ya que esta es una empresa de alimentos, allí le dieron solamente uno, así que me pidió que le hiciera otro gorrito de estos para alternar el que tiene, le pregunté si no importaba la tela, ya que tenía unos retazos de una sábana que hice recientemente, y ella me dijo que no importaba, así que manos a la obra, aquí les dejo la lista de materiales a utilizar : - retazos de tela ( con 1/4 m de tela aproximadamente sale este gorrito) - tijeras - Cinta métrica - Hilo - Máquina de coser > My daughter is required to wear these types of hairnets at her job to keep her hair under control, since it's a food company. They only gave her one, so she asked me to make her another one to alternate with the one she has. I asked her if the fabric mattered, since I had some scraps from a sheet I recently made, and she said it didn't matter. So, let's get to work! Here's the list of materials you'll need: > > - Fabric scraps (approximately 1/4 meter of fabric is enough for this hairnet) > - Scissors > - Measuring tape > - Thread > - Sewing machine

> ___PASO A PASO___ > STEP BY STEP Voy a guiarme con el modelo de gorro que tiene mi hija, lo dibujaré en mi cuaderno de apuntes y luego lo pasaré a la tela, la parte del Centro es como un pequeño óvalo, los lados es casi un rectángulo, sólo que va un poco redondeado en las orillas, y lleva dos tiras para poder atarse y mantener el cabello recogido, luego de dibujarlo, voy cuadrando mis retazos de tela, haciendo cada figura, la figura de los lados, la dibujé un aproximado, y luego la perfeccioné, de alto le di 19 cm para poder hacerle el ruedo. > I'm going to use my daughter's hat pattern as a guide. I'll draw it in my notebook and then transfer it to the fabric. The center part is like a small oval, the sides are almost a rectangle, only slightly rounded at the edges, and it has two straps to tie it and keep the hair up. After drawing it, I'll square up my fabric scraps, making each shape. I drew the shape of the sides approximately, and then perfected it. I made it 19 cm high so I could make the hem.

> |![IMG_0441.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY4Pwea8GJxBH5kGcraAwZXNC28AL9GFecJboruWWYsH9/IMG_0441.jpeg)|![IMG_0442.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeR71UvwErkSjdAEobUZ2ssum9BQuHnjseYqJUKC8bGfo/IMG_0442.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_0446.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRjaeWE7exkLXYWV9JfknVsiK9UXJjtnHmihwyu9EbE5F/IMG_0446.jpeg)|![IMG_0448.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXoYZ4A15UZbMDXPyBRnBWuXzSxbCDCCDGy5FD4oWshUg/IMG_0448.jpeg)| Luego de dibujar cada figura, voy cortando cada pieza, para las tiras, corté dos tiras de 5 cm de ancho aproximadamente, en total son tres piezas, el óvalo y las dos piezas de los lados y dos para las tiras > After drawing each shape, I cut out each piece. For the strips, I cut two strips approximately 5 cm wide. In total there are three pieces: the oval, the two side pieces, and two for the strips.

> ![IMG_0450.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWCuWqaAC7RfShzxWZw8TLe11STh3nagL9S9V7G2nY9M/IMG_0450.jpeg) En el siguiente paso vamos a comenzar con las costuras, hacemos un pequeño piquete en el centro de la figura de óvalo, luego vamos a unir las dos tiras de los lados. Esta será la parte central, luego vamos uniendo con costura al óvalo del Centro hacia la orilla, en mi caso, el óvalo me quedó un poco largo, pero no están importantes, ya que al final le hacemos un pequeño ruedo y no afectará > In the next step, we'll begin the sewing. We'll make a small snip in the center of the oval shape, then join the two side strips. This will be the central part. Next, we'll sew the oval from the center outwards to the edge. In my case, the oval ended up a little long, but that's not important, since we'll hem it at the end and it won't affect the final result.

> |![IMG_0451.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRtkWw2FCAT2QYhfaC71piDc2utHgV5oeVEwENLQsWuiJ/IMG_0451.jpeg)|![IMG_0452.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb11hY8sShT6qnJbyrHnAph5ru6GPkbFWhFcZr4NjBayk/IMG_0452.jpeg)| |---|---| Le hacemos ruedo en el otro extremo de la tela de los lados, donde finaliza el óvalo. Allí vamos a agregarle las tiras, dejando los centímetros del ruedo, para las tiras decidí cortar una sola tira a la mitad y hacerlas que me quedaran bien delgadas, ya para finalizar hacemos el doblez en la parte inferior de la tela de los lados, de aproximadamente 1 cm de ancho para el ruedo y así ya está listo este lindo gorro para recoger el cabello > We hem the other end of the side fabric, where the oval ends. There we'll add the strips, leaving the hem allowance. For the strips, I decided to cut a single strip in half and make them very thin. Finally, we fold over the bottom edge of the side fabric, about 1 cm wide, for the hem. And that's it! This cute hair hat is ready.

> |![IMG_0453.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7fkpSHi1i1beVVhznV2aSNU6mfGS4BaqARwAoCfEgQn/IMG_0453.jpeg)|![IMG_0455.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTGC6iVBozYfRjMWu8jTRCWVYj5yF8Cmm4einVTLURTFh/IMG_0455.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_0456.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZcprxBzZzm8hVUptT5QKBQgwHcLWgrHvbwc64duts8Ci/IMG_0456.jpeg)|![IMG_0457.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcdn3farDq7cJdfceqerA6y4At3nLYveXbzCSTPDkYKgm/IMG_0457.jpeg)| Sé que ahora mi hija querrá que le haga más gorritos de estos y poder llevar uno diferente cada día a su trabajo, ja ja, ventaja de qué su madre sea costurera ☺️, me encantó la confección de este gorrito es bastante sencilla y quedan muy lindos, espero les haya gustado, eso es todo por hoy amigos, me despido, deseándoles muchas bendiciones, hasta otra oportunidad > I know my daughter will now want me to make more of these hats so she can wear a different one to work every day, haha, one of the advantages of her mother being a seamstress ☺️. I loved making this hat; it's quite simple and they turn out very cute. I hope you liked it. That's all for today, friends. Goodbye, wishing you many blessings. Until next time!

> |![IMG_0462.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVDJwAQxTMRf9EqEHcYBbaPrsY1NWQCnv5gVgPho1QzHJ/IMG_0462.jpeg)|![IMG_0461.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZCnxNcH1udpeQKH9Rv9VL6AcvLFoVmW6HNKB3e5gqvXg/IMG_0461.jpeg)| |---|---|
![14 sin título_20241126180154.PNG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTHVyi75ZjssR4rHoFxZQLfegNCrYGW91CBUipRdJE81p/14%20sin%20ti%CC%81tulo_20241126180154.PNG) ***las fotos aquí compartidas son de mi propiedad tomadas con mi teléfono iPhone 16, la edición fue hecha en Canva, para la traducción del inglés utilice el traductor de Google***

title.body:
<div class='text-justify'>

## The Pork Trinity Brunch: A Brothy Awakening for Champions!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNc1J8mmwYBAYhVnsx6Hbm9PAzgzjD5SHtTqBu38j72nH/image.png)


**Wakey wakey, my fellow flavor chasers!** It’s your favorite foodie, Sakol, bringing you another epic culinary adventure! Forget your avocado toast and fancy pancakes because today’s brunch is all about **HARDCORE THAI STREET FOOD!** We are going full pork, full broth, and full throttle. This is the kind of meal that wakes up your soul and prepares you to conquer the day. Let’s dive spoon-first into this legendary trio!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUpHgUUdC6AqnbvgDwLh8chRf5GX7BN3x52P9U6Zq3mEm/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5xEW2aYZiuCfGKrDB6KMH916Se62EtDucydGXKe1nWc/image.png)


* **Braised Pork Soup (Gao Lao Moo Tun):** We kick things off with the dark, mysterious, and deeply comforting Gao Lao! No noodles here to distract you—just pure, unadulterated meat and broth. The broth is a masterclass in patience, brewed for hours with Chinese herbs until it’s rich, sweet, and aromatic. And the pork? Oh, sweet heavens. It’s braised so perfectly that the fat just melts on your tongue. One sip, and you’re instantly wrapped in a warm, savory blanket!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZporQfUkM1LytGKETUsx6bMywJbtTs1JpLfLhXGKK9Q/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjtKHWWmPqccdw1o9DkvRmMb7vwLwW1aJX48nJ5YQaFf/image.png)


* **Pork Blood Soup with Rice (Tom Lued Moo):** The ultimate morning cure! Don't let the name intimidate you; this is a bowl of pure, peppery perfection. The clear broth hits you with that sharp, waking-up kick of white pepper. The pork blood cubes are like delicate, savory jelly, and the offal is cleaned to absolute perfection—zero gaminess, just a tender, chewy delight. Pair this with a spoonful of hot, steamed jasmine rice, and you have a match made in breakfast heaven!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcNgvdMSzuVoNMxuEAX5vwYRmqPWuBscYpAj7u8aqVfEi/image.png)


* **Egg Noodles with Pork in Thick Blood Broth (Ba Mee Moo Nam Tok):** For the grand finale, we turn up the intensity! The \
broth is legendary—thickened with a splash of pig's blood, giving it a rich, earthy, and boldly spiced profile that coats the back of your throat. But the real star here is the \

(egg noodles). They are springy, yellow ribbons of joy that soak up that intense, spicy-sour-salty broth like a sponge. Every slurp is an absolute flavor bomb!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWYrXWP5SHFXeGNqCbtkmSbfAS2Wc6hgvTAGPZRQPqaJ7/image.png)


**Sakol’s Verdict:** This isn't just brunch; it’s a **masterpiece of meat and soup!** We traveled from the herbal depths of the braised pork to the peppery wake-up call of the blood soup, and finished with the rich, intense explosion of the Nam Tok noodles. **10/10, absolutely legendary!**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeiMjN5hteC6gHsMAc52snAPGMRyANHeuytqTq6D6dvzb/image.png)

title.title: Relationships change.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/31633098/pexels-photo-31633098.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/colorful-formal-group-portrait-outdoors-31633098/) Sometimes I think about one thing, in fact, the relationships we had in the past are no longer with people. For example, in the past, many people had good relationships with people in our family. We have neighbors or relatives with whom our family members have very good relationships. But when the generation changes, that is, when we grow up, those relationships no longer survive well. Then we slowly try to build relationships with other people in a new way. At one time, the relatives in our family used to come to our house. They used to come to our house almost constantly to meet people. We had a different relationship with them that is not worth expressing in words. Slowly, all the relationships are sinking. It seems as if these relationships no longer have any meaning. In fact, this is the reality of our life. The world is moving forward, our generation is moving forward. And in this way, when people step from one generation to another, relationships automatically change. Then the previous relationships are not valued much. However, sometimes it is seen that some people keep the relationships intact to some extent in some cases. In fact, a person's life changes. Just like we do not eat the same food in the afternoon that we eat in the morning. Similarly, we do not see the kind of relationship we had with people in our family before. Maybe new relationships have been formed with other people. We see this in every aspect of life, in our society and our environment. So relationships change, this is the reality. title.title: Today’s Victims Were Yesterday’s Survivors: And We’re Still Not Talking.
title.body:
I'm not feeling my best at the moment, and I don't understand how anyone in Nigeria will. Because, tell me why we always wake up to sad news each and every day. If it is not k!llings, it will be k!dnapp!ngs, and if it's not that, then it will be one sad news or the other. Families are now left to cry and wallow in sadness, bl@@dshed each and every day. Not even a god news in a day.




![1001054980.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wgQ19pcmvrvGvbBCVHnFMhtxoGACT8Q8LeopQT4nUzbokHHjHMQ6XS3JuGfhMpAGosY.png)




Most painful and heartbreaking part is, it is becoming normal, let me just say, it has become normal. We've gotten so used to it that it's no longer news. The moment it happens we talk and all, and in just few hours we've switched to doing other things and act like nothing is happening.



Now, the question is, Until when will this continue, until when are we as a citizen continue to allow this?




The few states or places we do claim to be safe are no longer safe, terrible news is what's flooding our Internet spaces, snd we thought we had a government. Obviously, we don't. The first assignment of a government is to protect the lives and properties of her citizens. Any government that fails at that is a failed government.




We can no longer travel, traveling is even big, we can no longer go to places of worship, schools, markets and all. We are not dafe in our streets or even in our houses. We can no longer sleep peacefully and .... It's just too heartbreaking and heart wrenching.





A lot of people who are supposed to speak out too, people who have platforms and those that should stand up and act are now silent, a lot of our religious leaders are building big cathedrals forgetting that this people that are being k!illed are the one's who are supposed to worship there, they've forgotten that if this k!llings should persist no single human will be in those worship centers and those big cathedrals can even turn a hideout of this terror!st later.




![1001054952.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23ycuYFa9upDgbw7Xsat337V8TpCkxtTgVSGEFiCJ8MDJFULGiHmQ9ZD8oyirMaMs2GnF.png)



I said something the last time I talked about something like this, I said *\

* That is not a curse and its not me wishing anyone bad, it's just the truth, those that d!ed yesterday never thought anything like that will happen to them. The abduction that took place last week was a reminder that a lot is happening in this country, the place the incident took place was just about 2hours ride to my place.. isn't it getting closer to us?





And like I said earlier, we are begining to see these things as normal. We are losing our humanity already. We are seeing these things and act like its nothing, the happenings in the country has made us less of a human, no sympathy, no empathy... No nothing. Just yesterday my colleague at work was showing me how one of the teachers that was k!dnapped close to us was behe@ded, guess what, she was eating at that moment she gave me the phone, and when I returned it, she was still eating. Not even a pause or a stop, k!ll!ngs, abduct!ons and k!dnapp!ngs, are now normal. 



A lot of us know what is happening. We've seen, we've heard, and we know. So, let us all focus. Do away with banter's and clout chasings. Forget the trending topics and the issues of infidelity, focus on your safety first. Stop getting distracted, nothing is as important as your security.



![1001054967.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/2423ya6Lm6qoiK5b383gETEcxCPimq6xFXUJ9GqsQVzyxuiaMjnC2LyvxzrW6um6bWSTr.png)




Call out the government, tag those that can be tagged, demand for actions, demand for better, protest if needed, demand a leadership change if that's the solution, demand that the ruling government step down if need be. This is nothing to be scared of, they are already killing and kidnappings all around us, so why fear a government that's responsible for your safety.



We are humans. And we don't deserve to be taken out and k!lled/æbducted like we are some sort of...🤦 We deserve to live in peace.

title.body:
![header](https://media.sdafintech.com/sda-sec-solana-rails-ultrawide-20260520.png)

# The SEC Just Opened the Tokenized Stock Sandbox — and the RWA Era Is Officially On

This week, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission did something the digital asset industry has been waiting years for: it unveiled its first dedicated framework for trading tokenized versions of stocks and real-world assets on-chain.

## What the SEC actually announced

The framework — which the SEC calls an \

— creates a regulatory pathway for trading tokenized securities on-chain. In plain terms, the world's largest capital market has formally recognised tokenized real-world assets as legitimate financial infrastructure, rather than treating them as an experiment to be policed after the fact.

It is a clarity milestone. For years, builders in this space operated in a grey zone. This framework replaces guesswork with a defined runway.

## The momentum was already there

The SEC isn't creating this trend — it's catching up to it. The numbers tell the story:

- **$1.5 billion** in tokenized assets is already trading, up roughly **30% in a single month**
- **DTCC** — the backbone of U.S. securities settlement — begins production tokenized-asset trades in **July 2026**
- **Nasdaq** and **NYSE/ICE** have both received approvals for on-chain settlement
- Institutional names from BlackRock to State Street have moved tokenized products to market

This is no longer a fringe narrative. It's an infrastructure shift.

## Solana is the chain powering it

Here is the detail that matters most for this community: when capital markets went looking for rails to tokenize on, they overwhelmingly chose **Solana**.

Tokenized-equity platforms built on Solana SPL tokens have cleared more than **$25 billion** in transaction volume. The reason is technical: Solana's SPL Token-2022 standard bakes compliance-grade features — transfer controls, conditional logic, programmable rules — directly into the token layer. That makes it the natural home for regulated, real-world assets.

## Where SDA fits

SDA Token tokenizes renewable energy on **Solana SPL Token-2022** — the exact same standard now carrying institutional finance on-chain.

SDA didn't pivot to catch this wave. It was built inside it: a MiCA Article 6 utility token, supervised by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA), operating out of Helsinki, Finland. While the U.S. is now building its first sandbox, SDA has been operating as a regulated, real-world-asset project on the leading tokenization chain since launch.

## The takeaway

The question is no longer *whether* tokenized real-world assets become mainstream finance. The SEC just answered that. The question is *which projects are positioned* when they do.

SDA — renewable energy, tokenized on Solana, regulated under MiCA — is one of them.

Through playing, their imagination and creativity become stronger day by day.That is why I think parents should not waste this valuable time. title.title: New Turn in Crypto and Banking: Signs of Major Change in US Policy
title.body: > How are you all? Today I am sharing with you an important recent political and economic update that could bring major changes to the crypto and fintech industry in the future. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYM9Yubg5ttf9fiP3zavA8WEe8NooTsu1VZNo5stqBSz4/Trump-Orders-Fed-to-Review-Crypto-Access-to-U.S.-Payment-Rails-1536x864.jpg [Source](https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/trump-orders-fed-to-review-crypto-access) Recently, former US President Donald Trump signed an executive order, in which he instructed the Federal Reserve and other financial regulatory agencies to reconsider the barriers to entry for crypto and fintech companies into the banking and payment systems. The main purpose of this directive is to examine the rationale for the restrictions that have long kept crypto companies out of the main US payment rails, such as Fedwire. The most important aspect of this policy, in my view, is that now the Federal Reserve and other agencies will have to review the existing rules within three months. Then, new steps will have to be taken accordingly within six months. This is a very fast regulatory timeline, which is rarely seen in such a complex financial sector. The focus of this whole discussion is the “master account.” Simply put, this account is the door through which banks and large financial institutions directly connect to the federal payment system. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYT2qqaLvxfS2egikK3dbwHEzmGLEphBULwbiZpivvbPC/jon-tyson--R1LY6FycaM-unsplash.jpg [Source](https://unsplash.com/id/foto/piring-bulat-biru-dan-putih--R1LY6FycaM) Until now, crypto and non-bank fintech companies have been excluded from this facility, often having to rely on banking partnerships at additional costs. The new guidance says that it will also be necessary to consider whether this framework can be extended to non-bank companies. Potential for the crypto industry If this change is implemented, it could be a major turning point for the crypto industry. Because having direct access to the payment rail means faster transactions, lower costs, and more liquidity. In addition, some regional Fed branches have already approved accounts for some crypto-related institutions on a limited basis, which gives an indication of the future direction of this policy. Controversy and concern However, the banking sector is seeing mixed reactions to this decision. Big banks feel that having different rules for similar activities could create inequities in the system. On the other hand, the fintech and crypto sectors see it as a door for innovation. The Federal Reserve is also gradually working on a “limited master account” model, where some features will be limited but participation in the payment system will be allowed. All in all, this executive order is not just a policy decision, but it could have a major impact on the future financial structure. It remains to be seen how much the gap between crypto and the traditional banking system will narrow. The next few months are going to be very important for this industry. title.title: 再游副都统衙门
title.body:
距离金州老街坊不远就是那个非常有名的也是非常值得一游的金州副都统衙门了，这个古朴的院落在去年第一次来这里的时候印象就非常深刻，当时还是是小桃红盛开的春季，而现在小桃红已经谢了，院内的树木全都变成了绿色，春意盎然，一派勃勃生机。 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRX3swRi8BNHHKRj48migGTdmEZvjZWjSs8PivFgCBEXT/hou.jpg)

这里是国内保存最为完好的清代二品军事衙署，承载着辽南地区百年军政变迁和海防印记。 这里是历任金州副都统的办公之地与眷属居住之所，实行“前衙后邸”的规制，也就是前院办公理政，后院则是居家生活的地方。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZvanYqp91rd4DfnXfhCFcNWFHDGqR5mbtjhLmbngMbs/tingzi.jpg)
***后花园水池里的金鱼！***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSch7AfsqQJKvapwBU7utyNxgTkjxdwkP53ScxtZe7CJ2/liyu.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2xkTkQiGSGgxzDPGyKnAtEn434gf6F4u8orSVAexfWv/hall.jpg)
***这棵树下，还有只小猫呢！***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT4dSJLrTqSrsoovaGUantqCg11zdayHBsr8vqq4G7X2U/cat.jpg)

而最后一个清代的副都统就是闫福升，原名闫培元，字锡三，晚清辽南爱国武官。 这里也可以称作是他办公的故居。 但是闫福升跟民国时期，山西的大军阀阎锡山可不是一个人，最初我听着以为两个人是一个人呢， 后来一查才知道，两人根本完全不搭边。

闫福升在任期间正是沙俄侵占旅大时期，他在衙门坚守国土，抵制沙俄入侵，拒绝割让金州主权，拒不签署卖国协定。沙俄强占金州时，闫福升被当做清廷要人扣押，并被流放偏远地区做苦役。

他被抓之后，副都统衙门终结了历史，辽南八旗军也就此瓦解。因此衙门内的展览厅里就有重点陈列他甲午战争抗倭，不屈不挠，舍身卫国的事迹。 

如今再次走进这个五进院落，仿佛再次触摸到曾经的历史，感受着既有大堂的庄严肃穆，又有后花园的清新别致，古色古香的厢房，屋内留存的清代家具，陈设摆件，如同看到了当时人的生活场景，很好的还原了当时的生活状况。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsrsvZPzQ6bfX4dcEfq8omKKW95sajBwosbBu5sPQ2ek/qianyuan.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRdundyQycZiCNa6RipPkp9mGAjbCjD3gSzZWdV5eEXgk/xiangfang.jpg)



因为此前来过的原因，只是花了不太多的时间，又走了一遍，但还是被这里的建筑布局所震撼和惊叹。这些古建筑很好的展示了中国古代建筑的风格和布局，遵循了中国传统的中轴线对称布局，规整有序，层层递进，展示了明清时期的建筑风格，每次来都有不同的感受。

青砖黛瓦承载的岁月沧桑，谁又能想到当时这个古宅大院的风云变幻，走进这里既能感受古建筑的匠心之美，还能铭记历史，感受这座百年衙署的丰厚底蕴，所谓前人栽树后人乘凉，正是有着那些保家卫国的勇士才有我们今天的幸福生活，也让我们读懂历史，且行且珍惜！

title.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 41: Painful Lessons
title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 41: Painful Lessons

-----

It was just after sunset in the West Camp. The Downs workers had finished their dinners and had returned to their cabins to entertain themselves or watch old Masters of Wrestling shows. Walter was still being held in the trailer. He was no longer tied up or gagged, but he was in the presence of two enforcers who would not let him leave the trailer.

Horns began to blare out from outside the main gate. The vehicle carrying the imperial guards had arrived. Hovering above this vehicle were the two flying vehicles flown by Tiberius and Miro.

The main gate opened. Revals and Cecil rushed out to greet the Emperor whose flying vehicle was now only a few metres off the ground.

‘Welcome to our humble camp, Your Imperial Majesty,’ said Revals as he continuously bowed as he approached Tiberius’ flying vehicle.

‘Stop acting pathetic,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘We’ve travelled a long way. My most loyal and devoted imperial guards are hungry and need to be fed now.’

‘Oh yes, of course,’ said Revals as he moved aside to let the imperial guards’ vehicle pass. Cecil looked at Revals, shaking his head. 

Tiberius and Miro landed their flying vehicles in the middle of the camp. Both Tiberius and Miro climbed out of their flying vehicles. Revals energetically rushed over to them.

‘Where’s my son?’ asked Tiberius, sounding frustrated. ‘Why isn’t he here to greet me?’

‘I’ve been carefully mentoring him, but he’s not quite ready yet,’ chuckled Revals. ‘I’ll take you to him.’

‘Meet with Captain Cecil,’ said Tiberius as he turned to Miro. ‘I need to spend time with my dear son.’

‘He’s in that trailer right over there,’ said Revals as he darted ahead of Tiberius to show him the way.

Tiberius sighed and followed behind him. Four imperial guards accompanied him.

Revals opened the trailer door. He, Tiberius, and the imperial guards entered.

‘Hey piece of shit, I see you brought more of your morons to visit me,’ shouted Walter as he pointed at them.

‘No, no,’ said Revals in a panicked tone. ‘This is the Emperor, your father, Your Imperial Highness.’

‘Haha, the nutcase!’ remarked Walter. ‘I remember now.’

Tiberius began to laugh. Revals nervously joined in. The laughter continued for a few more seconds, and then Tiberius abruptly stopped.

‘A product of your mentoring, I suppose,’ remarked Tiberius as he glared at Revals.

‘Well, he’s a work-in-progress,’ replied Revals.

‘What the hell is wrong with you?’ shouted Tiberius. ‘Get on your knees, all of you.’

Revals, the four imperial guards, and the two enforcers immediately dropped to their knees. However, Walter remained standing.

‘I see you take orders from no one,’ said Tiberius in a calm tone. ‘That’s something I can admire…’

‘Oh shut up, nutcase!’ shouted Walter. ‘Being frozen for a million years doesn’t make you special.’

'Guards, grab him!’ shouted Tiberius as he pointed to Revals. 

The imperial guards grabbed Revals, and the enforcers stood up. 

‘Get me a sword,’ said Tiberius to an enforcer.

‘Let me guess, you’re feeling a little insecure?’ asked Walter as he raised his eyebrows.

‘I’m sorry, son,’ replied Tiberius in a gentle tone. ‘I failed you. I gave you a weak mentor.’

‘I don’t need a mentor,’ said Walter angrily. ‘I certainly don’t need you.’

Tiberius sighed. He lifted his head slightly and took a deep breath.

The enforcer entered the trailer carrying a sword.

‘Stretch out one of his arms across the table,’ instructed Tiberius as he looked at the imperial guards holding Revals.

‘Oh please no,’ whimpered Revals. ‘I’m so sorry. I swear I can do better.’

‘I know you can,’ said Tiberius. ‘That’s why this needs to be done.’

‘You’re beyond nuts,’ said Walter as he leaned towards Tiberius.

‘Grab him and hold him,’ said Tiberius as he looked at the enforcer not holding the sword. ‘He needs to see this.’ Tiberius then turned to an imperial guard. ‘Put a rag in his mouth. I don’t want him losing his tongue.’

The enforcer grabbed Walter, who didn’t resist, and Revals burst into tears. An imperial guard shoved a rag into his mouth.

‘He’s not so bad,’ said Walter. ‘Let’s maybe talk about this.’

‘I’m doing this because I love you,’ said Tiberius. ‘I want you to reach greatness. I want him to be better too.’

‘I understand I shout a bit much,’ pleaded Walter. ‘I can stop that.’

‘Yes, I agree you can, and I will make sure you do,’ replied Tiberius, nodding. ‘Cut off a few fingers.’

The enforcer holding the sword swung it with force, cleanly chopping off three of Revals’ fingers. Revals screamed in pain. 

‘Your Imperial Majesty, please,’ begged Walter as he tried to turn his head away. The enforcer grabbed him tighter, forcing him to watch.

‘Now the rest of the hand,’ said Tiberius as the aggression in his voice increased.

The enforcer swung his sword again, and this time he cleanly chopped Revals’ hand off at the wrist. Blood spurted from his wrist. Revals gasped in desperation as drool dripped from his mouth.

Walter started to cry. The enforcer pushed his face close to the severed hand.

‘Let’s trim a bit more off his arm, shall we?’ chuckled Tiberius as he looked at the enforcer with the sword.

The enforcer looked at Tiberius.

‘I’m sorry, did that sound like a request?’ shouted Tiberius as he glared at the enforcer. ‘Cut off another chunk of him!’

The enforcer swung his sword yet again, this time slicing through around halfway up Revals’ forearm. This time blood only dripped out. Revals’ head flopped onto the table.

Tiberius looked at Walter. ‘This is lesson one,’ said Tiberius calmly as the enforcer yanked Walter's head up by the hair. ‘If you don’t keep your stupid mouth shut. Lesson two will be taught by one of your friends. Do you understand?’

‘Uhuh,’ sobbed Walter.

‘That’s wonderful,’ said Tiberius as he clapped his hands together. ‘Now get the superintendent some medical attention. I think he feels a little unwell.’

The imperial guards carried Revals out of the trailer.

‘Make sure he gets some of our seaweed cure,’ called out Tiberius.

The enforcer dropped Walter to the ground. Tiberius and the enforcer left the trailer, leaving Walter alone.

The imperial guards cauterised Revals’ wound to stop the bleeding. Then they injected him with some of the seaweed treatment.

The next morning, Tiberius invited the leaders and the senior members of the camp to breakfast. This included Miro, Freddy, Walter, Revals, Cecil and a dozen other less senior captains. Revals was awake but was still in tremendous pain. His arm was heavily bandaged and was covered by a long shirtsleeve.

‘It’s great to see so many energised and enthusiastic faces,’ said Tiberius as he looked around the table. ‘You’ve all done amazingly well considering the stress you’ve had to contend with.’

The captains applauded.

‘Defeating the occupying forces without a single casualty was truly a great accomplishment,’ said Tiberius as his eyes scanned the row of captains. ‘Scaring away the Sentray is beyond impressive.’

Tiberius noticed Freddy frowning. ‘Some of you might think they weren’t too bad,’ continued Tiberius. ‘They have mastered the art of deception. They savagely attacked your superintendent. They ripped off a huge chunk of his arm. Through pure courage, he never let any of you know of his suffering.’

Most around the table gasped in shock as they turned to look at Revals, who looked incredibly ill. Walter stared at Tiberius but didn’t say anything.

‘Most of you haven’t seen my amazing son, Walter, in a while,’ said Tiberius as he smiled at Walter. ‘He has been selflessly attending to the superintendent. Isn’t that right, son?’

‘Yes, I have, Your Imperial Majesty,’ said Walter as he looked at his hands.

‘How are you feeling now?’ asked Tiberius as he turned to look at Revals.

‘I… I feel much better,’ replied Revals as he trembled in fear. ‘Thank you, Your Imperial Highness. Thank you, enforcers and Captain Cecil, for rescuing me.’

‘This is absolutely disgusting,’ said Miro as he got up and walked over to Revals. ‘The monsters who did this will pay.’

‘Monsters like traitors will pay,’ said Tiberius as he looked at Miro.

After breakfast, Freddy approached Miro. ‘Excuse me, sir,’ said Freddy. ‘I haven’t been able to contact my family in the Downs Region. I’m really worried about them.’

‘You are Freddy, Eugene’s brother, am I right?’ replied Miro.

‘Yes, I am,’ said Freddy proudly. ‘He’s the Head Enforcer.’

‘He has a very demanding and important job,’ said Miro as he rubbed Freddy on the shoulder. ‘I’m sure he’ll contact you soon.’

‘My Mummy and Daddy?’ asked Freddy.

‘They will too, I’m sure,’ sighed Miro as he tried to get away.

The previous night in the underground tunnels. Maskameera had been loaded into a vehicle. Four followers were transporting her to an opening near to the crash site of her flying vehicle. Despite being heavily sedated, Maskameera was beginning to come around. 

The followers were listening to music and were unaware that Maskameera was breaking out of the compartment she was held in. Suddenly there was a loud noise. The followers stopped the vehicle. Two of them got out to check on what caused the noise. Maskameera was outside the vehicle and had moved onto the roof. 

The followers walked towards the rear of the vehicle. On reaching the back, they saw the back panel had been knocked off. Maskameera had moved to the top front of the vehicle. She used her long arms to smash through the windows on either side of the front cabin. She ripped the driver from his seat and hurled him into the tunnel wall. She then leapt on top of the other follower who had exited the vehicle. She slammed him into the tunnel wall, breaking his neck. 

The two followers who were at the back of the vehicle rushed towards Maskameera. She grabbed them by the neck with each of her hands. She squeezed them incredibly hard and then slammed their bodies into the tunnel wall, killing them instantly. Maskameera turned to look at the driver she had tossed from the vehicle. He was slowly crawling towards her. She walked over to him. She drove her foot down hard onto his back, almost snapping him in half.

## Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide

![Loop_Series.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uFHJ6RctoaR7JdX6JCqpxxZqfbR1uEmwbcd6NoJfaiCzK5S3sGDs5tFqqvNGY7ouzYh.gif)

Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide is the final book in the Sapien Loop trilogy. It continues directly after the events of the second book. The world above and the world below merge into one world. The conflicts in the underground world are brought to the surface. The new ruling elite attempt to crush any resistance from above and below in an attempt to create a new global empire.

Currently, three books from the series have been published on Amazon; see the links below:

Ohh bro, how I understand you, I have a 45 size. I don't know much about sizes (EU, US, ASIA), but in Russia, mine is just 45, and it's big, though I know ppl with 47, but it's a freaky size I think...

So yeah, it's a big problem to find something that fits you, especially if you are in places where white ppl are a rare sight for locals.

I found the way to order from Lazada, but their sizes very often don't match the description. Anyway, it's work after a long chat with the seller and sending a lot of measurement numbers with your feet.

And if I go to the city, where there is a mall (like T21, for example), I immediately try to find something suitable for my feet, even if it's not suitable for appearance, just for the feet 😂, and then buy 2 pairs. After some time, repeat this quest.

About sneakers and shoes, not too difficult, I mean difficulty, but not too much for me, of course. 

But about sleepers, omg... 🤦 I buy only on Lazada because nothing fits, and I like the simple, like open-toed slippers but made of foam, you just stick your foot in and go. 

And of course, the big question is the budget. For example, for me, 1 pair of sneakers must not cost more than 900-1200B.
Sleepers 350B not more.
Shoes 700B-1200B

About shirts and trousers, the same. Especially about trousers  👖, they are my nightmare. Last time I bought 4 pairs when I found my size. One pair cost me a bit more than 300B. There was a big deal, a discount at the mall.

I am 183cm and 100kg-110kg

title.title: Cooking Blog: Adobong Manok One Of My Favorite Food
title.body:
![Copy of Your paragraph text (2).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpEJiQL3tR4xq7oB6J2KhGFTS5DGpRgmiEyHiH6NMLT42dd3B1cfvQptHZbtB65gDmQ.gif)
Hello, how are you? Do you prefer manok(chicken) or baboy(pork) when cooking adobo? Mine is mostly chicken, one of the reasons is that it is easy to cook and not time-consuming like the one with pork, but sometimes there are good pork that is easy to tenderize. Adobo is the one easiest dish I ever cook and I sometimes people hate cooking it because they end up taste bitter and I remembered when go on the motorcycle roadtrip with my dad one of his friend pocket lunch is adobo same as we and you know we like to share our food to other and when he tasted our adobo he said it is delicious and then he asked ask to get some of his adobo and yeah his taste like straight soy sauce LOL. I wonder if he never touched his adobo, but I am proud that he likes the adobo from our pocket lunch. ----
Ingredients I Used:
![00.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokedzRCaViXULLY9Ne8EZWs3V5URuheei4H8gNb6Dbpwyp9EVmBGFQb5brqdXShFSr.JPG)

>
  • 1/2 Cup Cooking Oil
  • 5 Tomatoes
  • 1 Carrot
  • 1 Bell Pepper
  • 1/2 Kg Chicken
  • 5 Cloves Garlic
  • 1 Red Onion

>
  • 4 tbsp. Soy Sauce
  • 1 tbsp. White Vinegar
  • 1 tsp. Brown Sugar
  • 1/2 tsp. All-In-One Seasoning
  • 1l Water
  • 1/4 tsp. Ground Pepper
-----
Let's Cook!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGytLX4vpfCbtHhviBh4FWTcp2ReWB1t1TbKXDH2Qy47zH3pMzAve1PGi4pqwRoddF.JPG) In a hot pan, I added about a half cup of cooking oil. ----

> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokee4yJ3AyXumeBWwHQckN3GBWJYnT8wy9XFbWWbnNY8g7RvRSV3gQarf4oGbpbnuA.JPG) Then I like to fry the carrots, potatoes, and red bell pepper, which gives a unique taste to the adobo. Cook until browning starts appearing. Set them aside for later. ----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7DAG51btb9ZqwjenLXqejv3J2SH7A1Nyu6xTAHLiQGMxXBXqghLRJ1WPejhc9UcA.JPG) After that, before I put in the chicken, I reduce the cooking and leave about a tablespoon of it, and then cook the chicken until it changes color to pinking to pale. ----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoGyvxgY29tUqsAqYRmqaJNnNLNPWvd2fzm31kLyxP6U7HoSdvsGVA3i9jJ2NEm5v43.JPG) Then I added the aromatics like garlic, red onion, and bell pepper, adding bell pepper to the adobo makes the sauce taste better, try it some times. I bet you will like it. ----
> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoke8Uabm7m6E3UhiMoMJ8sQwaAaELvqZyokFYeeLE3GVqBj2CZmbF6bdBnbmMzTHpk.JPG) I added 4 tablespoons of soy sauce. ----
> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2L5qPAopqyMm3Nyw3gJ97t1wH3ioVfPrRUq7FvEFs3wes5nd8wQ5nJzmtED4uFfK.JPG) Half a teaspoon of all-in-one seasoning. ----

> ![23.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2JRpDCitQ7F4x6pagbxYsUJTUHKhVg1ccFYHVWaca821dC38WmczmefDpKFeKqtB.JPG) And then I added 1 litre of water. Let it cook for about 20-30 minutes on medium to low heat, making sure to look every 5-10 minutes to prevent the dish from burning. ----

title.body: El Esplendor del Josefino: Un Espectáculo de Fuego en la Naturaleza / The Splendor of the Josefino: A Show of Fire in Nature ============================================================================================================================ ¡Hola, querida comunidad de Ecensy! Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una serie de fotografías que tomé recientemente en **_la Comunidad del Corozo_, estado Barinas**. Esta hermosa vista siempre me llena de asombro cada vez que llega esta época del año. Se trata del florecimiento del **Josefino**, también conocido en otras regiones como **_Flamboyán o Árbol de Fuego_** (científicamente llamado **Delonix regia**). Hello, dear Ecensy community! Today I want to share with you a series of photographs that I recently took in **_The Corozo Community, Barinas State_**. This beautiful view always fills me with wonder every time this time of year arrives. It is the blooming of the **Josefino**, also known in other regions as **_Flamboyant or Flame Tree_** (scientifically called **Delonix regia**).

/> ### Un regalo para la vista / A treat for the eyes Este árbol es una auténtica obra de arte de la naturaleza. Durante la mayor parte del año puede pasar desapercibido, pero al llegar su temporada de floración, se transforma por completo. Sus ramas se cubren de un rojo intenso tan denso y vibrante que parece una gran llama encendida en medio del paisaje urbano. This tree is a true work of art from nature. For most of the year it can go unnoticed, but when its flowering season arrives, it transforms completely. Its branches are covered in a deep red so dense and vibrant that it looks like a great burning flame in the middle of the urban landscape.

/> Es imposible caminar cerca de uno y no detenerse a contemplarlo, buscar diferentes ángulos o capturar el momento con la cámara para perpetuar su majestuosidad en el horizonte. It is impossible to walk near one and not stop to contemplate it, look for different angles, or capture the moment with the camera to perpetuate its majesty on the horizon.

/> ### El milagro en detalle / The miracle in detail Al acercar la mirada, la flor del Josefino se revela como un secreto esculpido en hilos de fuego y seda. Cada uno de sus pétalos parece capturar la intensidad del sol tropical, extendiéndose con una delicadeza soberbia que desafía al viento. Looking closer, the Josefino flower reveals itself as a secret sculpted in threads of fire and silk. Each of its petals seems to capture the intensity of the tropical sun, spreading with a superb delicacy that defies the wind.

/> Es un diseño perfecto de la naturaleza, donde los estambres se elevan como finas líneas de oro y un pétalo central, pintado con destellos blancos y amarillos, corona la flor como si fuera una pequeña obra de arte abstracto. Contemplarla de cerca, suspendida entre el verde de sus ramas, es entender que la verdadera belleza no solo está en la inmensidad del árbol encendido, sino en el milagro detallado de cada una de sus flores. It is a perfect design of nature, where the stamens rise like fine lines of gold and a central petal, painted with white and yellow flashes, crowns the flower as if it were a small piece of abstract art. Contemplating it up close, suspended among the green of its branches, is to understand that true beauty is not only found in the immensity of the burning tree, but in the detailed miracle of each of its flowers.

/>

### Curiosidades sobre el Josefino / Fun facts about the Josefino

*   **Origen tropical:** Aunque es nativo de Madagascar, se ha adaptado perfectamente a nuestros climas tropicales.
    
*   **Sombra perfecta:** Además de su belleza visual, su copa en forma de paraguas ofrece una frescura inigualable.
    
*   **Significado:** Para muchos, su floración es un recordatorio de la resiliencia y la fuerza de la vida, floreciendo con intensidad bajo el sol más radiante.
    

*   **Tropical origin:** Although it is native to Madagascar, it has adapted perfectly to our tropical climates.
    
*   **Perfect shade:** In addition to its visual beauty, its umbrella-shaped canopy offers unparalleled freshness.
    
*   **Meaning:** For many, its flowering is a reminder of the resilience and strength of life, blooming with intensity under the most radiant sun.
    

### Un suspiro de fuego y hojas / A sigh of fire and leaves

Ver al Josefino en su máximo esplendor es contemplar la poesía misma de la tierra. Sus ramas parecen brazos abiertos que sostienen un cielo encendido, donde cada flor es una chispa de vida que desafía la monotonía del día a día. Es un recordatorio silencioso de que, incluso en los días grises, la naturaleza siempre guarda un destello de fuego para iluminar nuestro camino.

La naturaleza siempre encuentra la manera de recordarnos lo hermoso que es nuestro entorno, solo debemos aprender a detenernos y observar.

**¿Cómo conocen a este árbol en su país o región? ¿Tienen alguno cerca de sus casas?** ¡Me encantaría leer sus comentarios y experiencias en la sección de abajo!👇

To see the Josefino in its full splendor is to contemplate the very poetry of the earth. Its branches seem like open arms holding up an ignited sky, where each flower is a spark of life that challenges the monotony of everyday life. It is a silent reminder that, even on gray days, nature always keeps a gleam of fire to light our way.

Nature always finds a way to remind us how beautiful our environment is, we just have to learn to stop and observe.

**How do you know this tree in your country or region? Do you have one near your home?** I would love to read your comments and experiences in the section below!👇

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

When I take photos that involve capturing movement, I tend to be a bit particular about making sure they’re as sharp as possible and that the motion is perfectly frozen in time. This makes me very selective when choosing which photos to share, but I believe there are some shots that aren’t quite perfect in that regard that are still worth sharing, and I’d like to show them to you today; I hope you enjoy them.

Cuando hago fotografías donde debo capturar el movimiento, suelo ser un poco estricto con intentar que sea lo más nítido posible y que el movimiento quede perfectamente congelado. Esto hace que sea muy exigente al elegir las fotografías, pero considero que hay fotografías no tan perfectas en ese aspecto que valen la pena compartir y se las quiero mostrar el día de hoy; espero que las disfruten.

>

I don't think it's always that difficult to achieve what I mentioned at the beginning, but when you don't have the necessary tools or the environment isn't ideal for the task, it can certainly become much more challenging which is why not all photos turn out as perfect as you'd like them to at first.

Creo que no siempre puede ser tan complicado lograr lo que menciono al principio, pero cuando no tienes las herramientas necesarias o el entorno no es el mejor para realizarlo, sin duda se puede dificultar mucho, de ahí que no todas las fotografías pueden ser tan perfectas como las quieres al principio.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGvuF3MRudEZnqSj3MVeVGAbuXtQTmPS1bFBu26jCMmSbc6igZEuAKX4k8HXfr6efH1.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGwCgL4uDg8rhPZzK19zoL1TuEwUjaeVSwMW2teJ4c7sZvMWt8W9q8bYHFVJzPDHnQT.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wByKSdUY53nkCfhduVWLNZemUzfP5icTQDShABq4qHi9Fe9FRcYZzz33yyrJZri2tYn.jpg

>

Similarly, I believe it all depends on the perspective from which you view the final result, because sometimes a little movement in the photos is what captures the true atmosphere of the place; after all, there’s a lot going on, and even more so from one place to another, which forces you to be constantly on the move.

De igual manera, considero que todo depende de la perspectiva con que veas el resultado final, porque a veces, un poco de movimiento en las fotografías es lo que demuestra el verdadero ambiente del lugar, porque, a fin de cuentas, hay muchas cosas sucediendo y más de un lugar a otro, lo que te obliga a estar en constante movimiento.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vhqH6xSVDiheh6zqx5XDMc6eXW348KNzzLHCA8MchwPwxwhYWkHzosK3JEXkuPHN8q2.jpg

>

That wraps up today's post. Thank you once again for taking the time to look at my photos and read what I've written; I really appreciate it. I hope you're all doing great and have a wonderful Wednesday. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Hasta aquí la publicación del día de hoy; les agradezco un día más por ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo; lo aprecio mucho. Espero que todos se encuentren genial y tengan un excelente miércoles. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

Hi Holozing and Threespeak Community.

Our post today is a character from a game on this platform, which we have seen as a reference. We have created a painting of it today, and you will see that this work has been done with a lot of time and effort. The character in it is standing in a beautiful garden and is watering the flowers and plants.

Hola, comunidad de Holozing y Threespeak.

Hoy les presentamos un personaje de un juego de esta plataforma, que nos sirvió de inspiración. Hemos creado una ilustración de este personaje, y verán que le hemos dedicado mucho tiempo y esfuerzo. El personaje aparece en un hermoso jardín regando las flores y las plantas.

![IMG_20260520_044946.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbmWqKKbqXTU2wbNhd7GfkcQfK8MJntAokVkoYREMZeuW/IMG_20260520_044946.jpg)

So here, first of all, I try to make sure to provide a reference picture because it is very important to provide a reference picture after posting in this community because when I first posted in this community, I did not provide that picture, and then someone told me that I cannot post here without this picture. This post that has been prepared has taken two whole days to be made. Some time we work and then some time we rest. 

Para empezar, me aseguro de proporcionar una imagen de referencia, ya que es muy importante hacerlo después de publicar en esta comunidad. Cuando publiqué por primera vez, no la incluí, y alguien me dijo que no podía publicar sin ella. Esta publicación me ha llevado dos días completos. A veces trabajamos y otras veces descansamos.

Because here, to complete each and every thing, we have to take care of each and every thing. First, we made a sketch of it with a pencil and then after that, here with black color. Now we outline it so that each and every thing becomes clear. Then after that, we outline all the larger sketches with black color. Then after that, it is the turn to color it. The way it is in this reference picture, 

Aquí, para completar todo, debemos prestar atención a cada detalle. Primero, hicimos un boceto a lápiz y luego, con color negro. Después, delineamos para que todo se vea con claridad. Luego, delineamos los bocetos más grandes con color negro. Finalmente, le damos color. Tal como se ve en esta imagen de referencia.

So the best effort is to color it so that each and every thing can be seen clearly. And this character's name is Cinelara and she plays a very important role in this game. Slowly we are completing all our things and now we have also brought other colors which are pencil colors which will make things even more beautiful when we start using them. In the beginning we made this character of this game first and then we started making the rest of the second part there. 

Así que el objetivo es colorearlo para que todo se vea con claridad. Este personaje se llama Cinelara y tiene un papel muy importante en este juego.  Poco a poco vamos terminando todo y ahora también hemos traído otros colores, lápices de colores, que harán que todo quede aún más bonito cuando empecemos a usarlos. Al principio creamos primero este personaje del juego y luego empezamos a hacer el resto de la segunda parte.

The things used in it are: first a pencil has been used and then it has been darkened using black color and then after that all the plants have been created with the help of this color, 

En la parte superior se puede ver un árbol y el cielo. En la imagen de referencia se aprecia todo, así que intentamos recrearlo por completo. ¿Qué te pareció el resultado? ¿Te gustó? Los materiales utilizados fueron: primero, un lápiz, luego un color negro para oscurecerlo y, finalmente, las plantas.

The way the plants have green color and then you can see the background up that a tree has been created there and the sky is also visible in the upper part. The upper part of this character and the wings were made with a lot of effort, and then we see here that we have given a water shower in its hand from which it is giving water. This character is currently standing in a beautiful garden, 

Las plantas son verdes, y en el fondo se ve un árbol y el cielo. La parte superior del personaje y las alas se elaboraron con mucho esfuerzo. Aquí vemos que le hemos añadido una ducha de agua en la mano. El personaje se encuentra en un hermoso jardín.

So you can see in the lower part that we have painted it green, just like the color of grass is green, and here you can also see that there are trees on each side and there are also different types of flowers, so he is enjoying this painting a lot at the moment. Here, we have created this character by looking at the reference picture that was given in Discord and every single thing is made exactly the same way. His feet, hands and upper face are also made exactly the same way. 

En la parte inferior, el jardín está pintado de verde, como el césped. También se aprecian árboles y flores de diferentes tipos, lo que indica que está disfrutando mucho de la pintura.  Aquí, hemos creado este personaje basándonos en la imagen de referencia que se proporcionó en Discord, y cada detalle está hecho exactamente igual. content.description:
Hi Holozing and Threespeak Community.

Our post today is a character from a game on this platform, which we have seen as a reference. We have created a painting of it today, and you will see that this work has been done with a lot of time and effort. The character in it is standing in a beautiful garden and is watering the flowers and plants.

Hola, comunidad de Holozing y Threespeak.

Hoy les presentamos un personaje de un juego de esta plataforma, que nos sirvió de inspiración. Hemos creado una ilustración de este personaje, y verán que le hemos dedicado mucho tiempo y esfuerzo. El personaje aparece en un hermoso jardín regando las flores y las plantas.

![IMG_20260520_044946.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbmWqKKbqXTU2wbNhd7GfkcQfK8MJntAokVkoYREMZeuW/IMG_20260520_044946.jpg)

So here, first of all, I try to make sure to provide a reference picture because it is very important to provide a reference picture after posting in this community because when I first posted in this community, I did not provide that picture, and then someone told me that I cannot post here without this picture. This post that has been prepared has taken two whole days to be made. Some time we work and then some time we rest. 

Para empezar, me aseguro de proporcionar una imagen de referencia, ya que es muy importante hacerlo después de publicar en esta comunidad. Cuando publiqué por primera vez, no la incluí, y alguien me dijo que no podía publicar sin ella. Esta publicación me ha llevado dos días completos. A veces trabajamos y otras veces descansamos.

Because here, to complete each and every thing, we have to take care of each and every thing. First, we made a sketch of it with a pencil and then after that, here with black color. Now we outline it so that each and every thing becomes clear. Then after that, we outline all the larger sketches with black color. Then after that, it is the turn to color it. The way it is in this reference picture, 

Aquí, para completar todo, debemos prestar atención a cada detalle. Primero, hicimos un boceto a lápiz y luego, con color negro. Después, delineamos para que todo se vea con claridad. Luego, delineamos los bocetos más grandes con color negro. Finalmente, le damos color. Tal como se ve en esta imagen de referencia.

So the best effort is to color it so that each and every thing can be seen clearly. And this character's name is Cinelara and she plays a very important role in this game. Slowly we are completing all our things and now we have also brought other colors which are pencil colors which will make things even more beautiful when we start using them. In the beginning we made this character of this game first and then we started making the rest of the second part there. 

Así que el objetivo es colorearlo para que todo se vea con claridad. Este personaje se llama Cinelara y tiene un papel muy importante en este juego.  Poco a poco vamos terminando todo y ahora también hemos traído otros colores, lápices de colores, que harán que todo quede aún más bonito cuando empecemos a usarlos. Al principio creamos primero este personaje del juego y luego empezamos a hacer el resto de la segunda parte.

En la parte superior se puede ver un árbol y el cielo. En la imagen de referencia se aprecia todo, así que intentamos recrearlo por completo. ¿Qué te pareció el resultado? ¿Te gustó? Los materiales utilizados fueron: primero, un lápiz, luego un color negro para oscurecerlo y, finalmente, las plantas.

title.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well because I am too. See you again with me who will tell you my story about my activities today.

This time I will cook something, a simple but very delicious food. This time I will make a steamed cake filled with chocolate or here it is usually called Bakpao with chocolate filling (I don't know the real meaning of bakpao but usually what is meant here is steamed bread with various fillings). and Bakpao is one of the breads that I like the most.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 19.23.23 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/EoCjdqGBRhW5bpjXWEk732gqn7hu7YBrktN1iMjWyMztbdSZYGaFrc31wTq555Hfyzk.jpeg)

*Ingredients*

* 250 grams of wheat flour 
* 3 grams of yeast 
* 25 grams of sugar 
* 125 ml of full cream milk 
* 30 grams of margarine
* chocolate bar


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 19.23.15.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/Eoc8Uy6rL3iJ722ECp86RgN8MperWVPrij7w79JnKBuLHiGdqNyj1EnA9c72Q4X9Z7T.jpeg)

*How To Make*

* Mix flour, yeast and sugar, stir until smooth 
* Pour full cream milk gradually then stir the dough until mixed 
* After that, knead the dough using your hands until the dough is evenly mixed 
* Add margarine and stir again until smooth 
* Let the dough rest for 10 minutes covered with a cloth so it doesn't dry out 
* Take some of the dough 
* Flatten the dough and fill with chocolate 
* Let it rest for 20 minutes covered with a cloth before steaming 
* Steam for 10-12 minutes


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-20 at 19.23.16 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/Eo6LsHogKuC6Vz77kVgaQmLmTvVo1wV8kmtLN1cbucRPs2sV8WScwsz1zJbPQWUNAB4.jpeg)

A single click, the downvote, has been transformed from a tool of curation into an instrument of silence. *Agree with us, or be diminished.* It works on the uncertain. It works on the dependent. But it does not work on the documented. And so, the record grows. Not with rumor, but with receipts. Not with accusation, but with analysis. Writers, investigators, truth-tellers: they are migrating to Blurt, to Steemit, to spaces where voice is not subject to the hidden hand of coordinated disapproval. This is not polemic. This is proof. This is an **ecosystem node**. 🔹 **Voting Weight:** With ~874k HP, a single 100% upvote can allocate ~$3-5 in curation rewards. A -10% downvote can reduce a post's earnings by 10-30%. This account does not simply hold value—it *orchestrates* it. --- ## II. The Smoking Gun: Voting Behavior Forensics ### Documented Downvote Activity (Last 24 Hours) ``` 11 hours ago: Voted \

by @kgakakillerg with -10%
[+6 additional -10% votes on @kgakakillerg content in same window]
```

### Pattern Analysis

🔴 **Targeted Suppression:** Multiple -10% votes against accounts (`@bpcvoter1`, `@kgakakillerg`) that have published content critical of Hive governance or downvote practices.

🔴 **Temporal Clustering:** Downvotes executed in concentrated bursts (e.g., six -10% votes within one hour), suggesting automated or batch-processed retaliation—not organic curation.

🔴 **Asymmetric Impact:** A -10% vote from an account with 874k HP carries disproportionate weight against smaller creators, potentially reducing their rewards by 20-40% when combined with other downvotes.

🔴 **Narrative Alignment:** The downvoted content includes themes of \
—precisely the discourse that challenges established influence structures.\n\n> *\

*

---

## III. The Broader Ecosystem: Follow the Value

### Transaction Flow Red Flags

🔸 **Curation Reward Concentration:** Hundreds of micro-rewards from `reward.app` for curating content by `@samostically`. This suggests a **reciprocal curation arrangement**—a common tactic for mutual reward amplification.

🔸 **Loan & Payment Patterns:** Regular HBD transfers labeled \

to accounts like `@mayor-001`, `@bala41288`, `@tegoshei`. While not inherently suspicious, combined with voting power, this creates potential **quid-pro-quo dynamics**.

🔸 **Swap Obfuscation:** Frequent `graphene-swap` and `keychain.swap` activity could be legitimate arbitrage—or could be used to break audit trails between reward receipt and exchange deposit.

🔸 **Dividend Streams:** Regular `spi-payments` for holding SPI tokens indicates participation in external token ecosystems, creating potential cross-platform influence vectors.

### The Delegation Web
```
@neoxian → @neoxiancityvb (27,334 HP delegated, Jul 2019)
@neoxian → @neoxian.cardhold (12 HP delegated, Jun 2019)
@neoxian → [4 accounts] (59,591b RC delegated)
```
*Observation:* Long-standing delegation relationships suggest entrenched network effects—not ad-hoc collaboration.

---

## IV. Context: Why This Matters Beyond One Account

This investigation is not about @neoxian alone. It is about a **systemic pattern**:

1. **Weaponized Reputation:** When downvotes are used to punish dissent rather than curate quality, the platform's incentive structure inverts.
2. **Centralized Influence:** Accounts with massive HP can effectively act as unofficial gatekeepers, regardless of formal governance.
3. **Chilling Effects:** Creators self-censor to avoid financial penalty—a subtle but profound form of control.
4. **Migration as Protest:** The exodus to Blurt, Steemit, and other platforms is not abandonment—it is accountability through exit.

> *\

We are turning on the light.

If you are reading this on **Blurt.blog**, you are experiencing something profound: a platform where:

✅ **No downvote button exists** to silence dissent  
✅ **Rewards reflect engagement**, not allegiance  
✅ **Transparency is structural**, not performative

It is like discovering Bitcoin in 2009. But this time, you know what to watch for. You understand the difference between decentralization and **decentralized feudalism**—where power is distributed, but still concentrated in the hands of a few.

Power that fears scrutiny is already confessing its fragility.

The blockchain does not lie.  
But it only speaks to those who know how to listen—and how to amplify what it says.

title.body:
>  



El productor se quitó los audífonos y el estudio quedó en silencio, mientras Alessandro cruzó los brazos, Michelle miró a Lucas nerviosa y Dani seguía atenta hasta que habló —La canción no se guardó completamente— Por unos segundos nadie decían nada hasta que —¿Cómo que no se guardó? —preguntó Michelle. Allí el productor señaló que la computadora estaba fallando y algunas pistas se guardan y otras no. 


Lucas se dejó caer en el mueble, donde habían pasado horas creando algo único, cada acorde, cada mezcla entre español e italiano había nacido en ese momento y era perfecta. Stewie observó la pantalla y reviso si todavía existía alguna copia, mientras que Alessandro caminaba lentamente por el estudio —Lo sentimos muchísimo —dijo uno de ellos—. Michelle estaba frustrada, ya que había llegado muy lejos, cansancio y de repente todo se dañó.


Alessandro se acercó al centro del estudio y comentó —La primera versión fue increíble, pero quizá la segunda pueda ser todavía mejor— Lucas levantó la mirada, Michelle tomó aire y Dani volvió a recuperar la sonrisa. Esa noche salieron del Studio Aurora agotados, pero también más unidos, sin embargo, nadie decía nada mientras caminaban hacia el hotel.



>The producer took off his headphones and the studio fell silent. Alessandro crossed his arms, Michelle glanced nervously at Lucas, and Dani remained attentive until he spoke. \
For a few seconds, no one said anything until, \

Michelle asked. The producer explained that the computer was malfunctioning; some tracks were saving while others weren't.

#

>Lucas slumped onto the couch where they had spent hours creating something unique. Every chord, every blend of Spanish and Italian had been born in that moment and was perfect. Stewie watched the screen and checked if any copies still existed, while Alessandro paced slowly around the studio. \

one of them said. Michelle was frustrated; she had come so far, exhausted, and suddenly everything was ruined.


#

>Alessandro approached the center of the studio and commented, \

Lucas looked up, Michelle took a breath, and Dani's smile returned. That night they left Studio Aurora exhausted, but also more united; however, no one said anything as they walked towards the hotel.



![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23tv44QBmZhaLR8hVWmor78kVUasuF6dPwnBcKLcaCS7gw8dbiU7Xwv3LehZkvWN5E8h5.jpeg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/keyboard-musical-instrument-music-6558944/)




Al día siguiente todos regresaron al estudio, donde había nervios, pero también una energía mucho más fuerte. Lucas comenzó tocando en la guitarra con más fuerza, Michelle escribió nuevas frases en español mientras Alessandro complementaba con letras en italiana, Dani ayudaba marcando ritmos, mientras Stewie estaba pendiente en la computadora.




Durante horas trabajaron sin detenerse, hasta que llegó crear ese final de la canción y comenzó Lucas tocando aquel acorde especial, Michelle comenzó a cantar, Alessandro respondió en italiano y allí la batería entró justo a tiempo, al igual que el piano logrando que todo encajara a la perfección. 


Cuando terminaron la canción, el estudio quedó completamente en silencio mientras el productor revisaba la grabación final. Esta vez se quitó los audífonos y comentó —Ahora sí, quedó perfecta. Todos se emocionaron Dani gritó de la felicidad, Lucas levantó la guitarra mientras Stewie, aunque intentó mantenerse serio, terminó sonriendo también. Alessandro chocó las manos con los músicos italianos y el productor se acercó inmediatamente a Banda 17.


>The next day, everyone returned to the studio, where there was a palpable sense of anticipation, but also a much stronger energy. Lucas started playing the guitar with renewed vigor, Michelle wrote new phrases in Spanish while Alessandro added lyrics in Italian, Dani helped by keeping the beat, and Stewie kept an eye on the computer.

#

>They worked tirelessly for hours until they reached the song's ending. Lucas began playing that special chord, Michelle started singing, Alessandro responded in Italian, and then the drums kicked in perfectly, as did the piano, making everything fit together flawlessly.

#


>When they finished the song, the studio fell completely silent as the producer reviewed the final recording. This time, he took off his headphones and said, \

Everyone was thrilled. Dani shouted with joy, Lucas raised his guitar, and Stewie, though he tried to remain serious, ended up smiling too. Alessandro high-fived the Italian musicians, and the producer immediately approached Banda 17.



![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/2432NC7RpmmkSHSHZFtfDMFR29MQF9r7EFoQKueLhKfAZSgutKfcBVUiXWnE7qG7d2gcL.jpeg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/music-musician-performance-singer-3140247/)



Esta nueva canción tenía una mezcla entre español e italiano, las guitarras, el piano y las voces hacían que aquella colaboración se sintiera única. Lucas cerró los ojos escuchando la versión final y dijo —Valió la pena empezar de nuevo— Y mientras la música llenaba todo el Studio Aurora, Banda 17 comprendió que acababan de crear una canción que jamás olvidarían.


>This new song had a mix of Spanish and Italian; the guitars, piano, and vocals made the collaboration feel unique. Lucas closed his eyes, listening to the final version, and said, \

And as the music filled Studio Aurora, Banda 17 realized they had just created a song they would never forget.

title.body: > With the current price of Hive, it would be really astonishing to wake up one day and find out that Hive has pumped and reached $1. You can say unbelievable, and yes, especially now because of the current price and how it's far from that reality. But then, this is crypto we're talking of, and anything can happen. Like how Hive fell drastically to the price we have it at today, it can go up like that too. That's the power of crypto. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVbsM2TAzpbSFMyhGzS79X7sjqnJBo26yxvfq6SoNGAR5/file_000000005624720aad6694c63089346b.png) It would be an unbelievable reality for virtually all Hivers. Even for the ones who might not care about the financial benefits, it would do something for them. I'll say it's a win for every Hiver out there. The time and effort into creating and posting content in whatever form will prove to be worth it now more than ever before. Well, I heard there was a time Hive reached that price, if I'm not wrong. But for many other Hivers and me, I believe this would be new and wonderful. If Hive reached $1, what would I do? I'll surely be happy about the news. I imagine that a friend and fellow Hiver chats with me to inform me about the price of Hive, or I somehow come across it and I go on to check it and see that indeed it's $1, I'll certainly be happy. This would mean more for every Hiver; better gain, better reward, more motivation and more effort. And for the blockchain, it would mean more engagement, more growth and more investment. After all that excitement about the great news, it would be time to make critical decisions. Do I withdraw now? Do I buy more Hive? Do I stake more HP? Do I convert Hive to stable currency and save? Much could be running through my mind at that moment and that period. As much as it's a good one and something that Hivers have hoped for, even me, one needs to think not just in the moment alone, the momentary benefit, but consider the future and long-term impact. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmceqM9YgoJKdeqXXBw1nEKSDMVUU1P4oTcgPSGCqacPCP/file_000000007eb87243b3a8f7ed681a6ba1.png) There are some things I would do, one of which would be to stake some Hive to increase my HP and ultimately my power in the blockchain. This would give more weight to my curations and governance power. I would also withdraw. Yes, what better time than that? I believe that would serve some of my needs well considering that it would be much better compared to now. Certainly, I won't be withdrawing all of the liquid Hive I have. As I would withdraw, I would be considering the future too. That's why I would hold some and convert some to stable currency and save for a foreseeable rise again. Hive pumping up to $1 would also have me encouraged and doing more. The reward is a big motivation and Hive at that price would be a motivation to keep showing up and even doing better. I see this also playing out in getting others to join Hive. I mean, Hive at $1 is an interesting hook. This is my response to the [IndiaUnited Contest.](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-1f12d114200f6?referral=daverick) --- *Images are AI generated.* --- ###### Thank you for reading!

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

title.title: Un mes en Altera: Lo bueno y lo malo
title.body:
Creo que hace algo mas de un mes que escribi mi primer articulo sobre Altera, la aplicacion que tenia que cambiar Hive por completo. Lo cierto es que creo que he probado todas las funciones de altera menos la creacion de Tokens. Hoy mismo mande BTC nativo a una cartera diseñada solo para eso. Asi que creo que ya puedo hacer un primer balance de la aplicacion.

Lo bueno:
* Trabajo tecnico impecable. La aplicacion hace exactamente lo que dice. Lo hace rapido y lo hace bien. Aun no me he encontrado ningun problema operativo.
* Buen interfaz. Muy limpio intuitivo y muy facil de seguir. Todo es transparente y facil de seguir si quieres comprobar tus operaciones.
Lo malo:
* Su principal problema la liquidez. Sigue teniendo una liquidez marginal que no permite ni arbitrar, ni invertir y tampoco grandes operaciones. Eso evita que haya volumen y sin volumen las operaciones son simplemente marginales. 
* La incorporacion de mas mercados se esta retrasando asi como los estimulos para que los inversores añadan liquidez. Espero que no conseguir que se aprovara su propuesta no deje este proyecto que tanto a tardado en el dique seco.

Mi resumen es el que tuve el primer dia buena tecnologia pero nulo plan financiero. Sin liquidez no hay aplicacion por bueno que sea el servicio nadie perdera dinero usandolo.

🔸 **Loan & Payment Patterns:** Regular HBD transfers labeled \

to accounts like `@mayor-001`, `@bala41288`, `@tegoshei`. While not inherently suspicious, combined with voting power, this creates potential **quid-pro-quo dynamics**.

🔸 **Swap Obfuscation:** Frequent `graphene-swap` and `keychain.swap` activity could be legitimate arbitrage—or could be used to break audit trails between reward receipt and exchange deposit.

🔸 **Dividend Streams:** Regular `spi-payments` for holding SPI tokens indicates participation in external token ecosystems, creating potential cross-platform influence vectors.

### The Delegation Web
```
@neoxian → @neoxiancityvb (27,334 HP delegated, Jul 2019)
@neoxian → @neoxian.cardhold (12 HP delegated, Jun 2019)
@neoxian → [4 accounts] (59,591b RC delegated)
```
*Observation:* Long-standing delegation relationships suggest entrenched network effects—not ad-hoc collaboration.

---

## IV. Context: Why This Matters Beyond One Account

This investigation is not about @neoxian alone. It is about a **systemic pattern**:

1. **Weaponized Reputation:** When downvotes are used to punish dissent rather than curate quality, the platform's incentive structure inverts.
2. **Centralized Influence:** Accounts with massive HP can effectively act as unofficial gatekeepers, regardless of formal governance.
3. **Chilling Effects:** Creators self-censor to avoid financial penalty—a subtle but profound form of control.
4. **Migration as Protest:** The exodus to Blurt, Steemit, and other platforms is not abandonment—it is accountability through exit.

If you are reading this on **Blurt.blog**, you are experiencing something profound: a platform where:

✅ **No downvote button exists** to silence dissent
