# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

Yesterday I got a message from Vinted, according to which, one of my listed products was hidden, due to violating the terms. This notification took me by surprise obviously, not to mention they stated that in case of a repeated rule violation, my account will be terminated. I'm always making sure to respect the rules, so the first thing I did was check what that was about. 

It was one of my denim bags that got flagged, and as each bag is unique, I had to see what the problem was. After some investigation I learnt that indeed, I broke the rules. 

When I listed my bag, at the *brand* section I stated \
, because during my research I saw most of the sellers listed their handmade and unique bags under this brand/name. This made me think these unique, handmade bags can be called \

>Unsplash So yes, I broke the rules, misled the potential buyers, but not willingly, or knowingly. Does this count? Nope, it doesn't matter. Do I get a pass because I didn't know the rules, or I let myself believe what I wanted? Nope, I don't get a pass. The only thing I could do is delist the bag and list it again, without a brand name, obviously. Most likely a lot of sellers are in a similar situation, but that doesn't change anything. I am responsible for my actions and don't get any preferential treatments just because others did the same. The funny thing is, this incident made me think of Hive 😂. title.body:
​El futuro es impredecible. Lo que empezó con simples chatbots, ahora se ha extendido y las IA abarcan ya prácticamente todos los campos de nuestra vida cotidiana, algunas genéricas y otras muy especializadas en determinados campos.

​Adaptarnos a ellas y encontrar cuál es la adecuada para lo que hacemos en el día a día marca la diferencia entre lo que éramos hace un mes y lo que somos hoy. Nuestro crecimiento profesional depende en gran medida no solo de adaptarnos a las nuevas tecnologías, sino de la velocidad con la que lo hacemos.

​Otra herramienta, que aunque no entra dentro de la categoría de IA y que apenas lleva unos meses en el mercado es CircuitBit, se la recomiendo a los técnicos de reparación de dispositivos móviles, sobre todo a los que no tienen un elevado presupuesto para adquirir licencias más costosas como Borneo y DZKJ.

​Ahora, vale aclarar que son herramientas, no varas mágicas; el cómo las usemos y cómo nos interrelacionemos con ellas nos dará la cuantía del éxito en el resultado final.

---‐‐‐--------------‐------------------------------------------------

The future is unpredictable. What started with simple chatbots has now expanded, and AI currently covers practically every field of our daily lives—some generic and others highly specialized in specific areas.
​Adapting to them and finding the right one for our daily work makes the difference between who we were a month ago and who we are today. Our professional growth depends largely not only on adapting to new technologies, but on the speed with which we do it.
​Within the world of electronic equipment repair, a very common tool is iFixit, a global platform for technical manuals in which I have developed a lot of trust in my daily routine.
​Another tool, which although does not fall into the AI category and has only been on the market for a few months, is CircuitBit. I highly recommend it to mobile device repair technicians, especially those who do not have a high budget to purchase more expensive licenses such as Borneo and DZKJ.
​Now, it is worth clarifying that these are tools, not magic wands; how we use them and how we interrelate with them will determine the measure of success in the final result.

title.title: 生活碎片（30） ｜校园中的一抹蓝
title.body:
上一学期刚开学的时候我就注意到路边的树的叶子长得格外好看，单片叶片是细长的形状，组合起来的完整叶片就像是一片绿得纯粹的羽毛，也是那么轻盈飘逸，远看更有一种朦胧梦幻的氛围感。当时还专门搜了一下这是什么树，结果是蓝花楹树。我一直都挺喜欢蓝花楹的，不过还是第一次好好观察没开花的它。不过当时正值九、十月份，开的花也凋落了，等到四支六月时才是它的花期。


![23.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWh5xLBpq1kfwRSz9u3ydFLJuk6LgBHguAtJkBYcyif46/23.jpg)


![24.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcy9W3RXe8WXsooFhGxY88kKiV368CZuoGCE4pwXv8yqD/24.jpg)


这段时间蓝花楹正值花期，我们学校里的蓝花楹也都开了，本来每棵树都长得很高大，一棵树上的花都密密麻麻的有许多，而一路上那么多树，越发凸显出蓝花楹那一抹纯粹、幽雅的蓝色。有一次下过雨后我走在树下，发觉一些开得正好的花朵被雨水打落在地面上，这时候我又得以近距离观察它的花朵，蓝花楹的花朵花型有些类似于喇叭花，但没有喇叭花张得那么开，更为纤细柔丽。


![26.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTv7bzR4DffoU5LWdsbJxryFfKanJJgS8eLN2YBBakLZs/26.jpg)


![25.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKJTioU7MtvRfSmmHwWD84LW4Ync8ycCCv1KxHa2UTFj/25.jpg)


蓝花楹一开，感觉自己走在了不同的校园里，路上走的、骑自行车的；或着急、或悠闲自在的学生们都无法忽视那头顶上优雅迷人、独具沉稳气质的蓝花楹景观。就算花落下来也是极美的，朵朵花落在草坪里，就像是在棕绿色的画布上形成了蓝紫色的渐变，不过就是有些可惜罢了，因为花渐渐地落下，花期也要渐渐过去了。


![27.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakG6aHBQyrjZuaVaWdLY1pUsF3N2bS2PGjJPCgzsTPrS/27.jpg)


![28.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcwwzXGCWiuNh6NQRmdrSWjRZTiuNnUdTNX8EmcQUtGdU/28.jpg)


今天的分享就到这里了，我们下次再见！

title.body: I used large grow bags last year, two of them, and did get quite a few, but not as many as advertised, more like 7 pounds per bag. The best part of them was how beautiful the plants were, hence my planting them in that elevated planter, which has housed strawberries one year (gorgeous!) and green beans the next (so easy to harvest!). It's likely to be spectacular planted with purple leaved sweet potatoes! Onions on the west side - I got great onions from that planter last year - and early lettuces on the east side. \n\nI remember that my slips looked even worse last year, and took a few weeks to get going, but they took off after that. I think yours are probably fine. Where did  you get them? Mine are from FEDCO, Vardaman variety.

title.title: La Soledad - Mensaje diario de 5 minutos
title.body:
La soledad llegó a mi vida sin avisar, y yo, que tanto le temía, decidí recibirla. 
La abracé, la entendí, me hice su amiga y poco a poco, me fui enamorando de su silencio, de su paz, de la libertad que trajo con ella. 
Ahora puedo decir no sin miedo, puedo alejarme de lo que me daña, puedo estar sola sin sentirme vacía,  porque descubrí que la soledad no es ausencia, es presencia: La Mía. 
Y es más que suficiente.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsfKVVEgniLKYvD7sqkN9ascFjBDGwZL5mztWgWdFoyb/1779287207730.jpg)

ENGLISH
Loneliness came into my life unannounced, and I, who feared it so much, decided to embrace it.

I hugged it, I understood it, I befriended it, and little by little, I fell in love with its silence, its peace, the freedom it brought with it.

Now I can say no without fear, I can distance myself from what hurts me, I can be alone without feeling empty, because I discovered that loneliness is not absence, it is presence: My own.

And that's more than enough.

title.title: Voltage and Lux's Favor: Two New Events in Splinterlands
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdffnK9tYSH4ns1VqwUQTkd6ma3WCLowEJ2vmAQygH22i/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Two exciting events are happening in Splinterlands. One is already live while another will be launched to the public on May 25. 

***

# Voltage Event

The “Voltage” event is a collaboration between Electroneum and Splinterlands. It's designed to connect both ecosystems through land gameplay, rewards and limited edition collectibles. Players will be able to use a new special card called ElectroFox to generate Electroneum Voltage Points (EVP) on land plots, which can later be redeemed for rewards including ETN tokens. The event is expected to launch to the public on May 25. Around $20,000 worth of ETN planned for the initial reward pool.

The event will launch a new card, ElectroFox. It's the first card that has utility on land and on battles. In battle, it is an aggressive Legendary Fire card with abilities like Opportunity, Inspire, Amplify and Painforge. It does have a drawback in Electrified which damages allied units each round though it can potentially empower units in certain strategies. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQH7KHVgHMnpQ479ii6TFToiu7yGoSwi1hZF6SBrkBEn/image.png)

On land, assigning ElectroFox to plots helps players earn EVP and unlock special reward chests tied to the Voltage event.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWrd6Mu39VUsnF9bvqGzxeB3gCFmY5LyHoQvs8snEuB9Z/image.png)

***

# Lux's Favor


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU1nVN4ue1Ntkg1YZXizUBqXZ9fnz7GtVXVZtLVn7t3xw/image.png)

There is a wheel to spin daily where we can earn a variety of rewards. I'm not sure about the black prize yet and I guess the hat is related to Lux Vega. The one I got was Sparks. It's a new token that we can spend on the Sparks shop where we can buy cosmetics for Lux Vega and Frontier cards.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPBsbvRoeEKoe48eSt1sCzjA1FYKqsJghdUBs1SWQ3iXN/image.png)

Since I don't have Lux Vega, I'm looking to buy skins for my favorite Frontier cards like Little Sister, Dread Tafarian and Time Bandit. These are cards that I use even in Modern mode. 


***

# Final Thoughts

These events show how Splinterlands continues to improve beyond simple card battles. From collaborations between blockchains like Voltage to fun engagement events like Lux's Favor. The events adds new ways for players to earn, compete and stay connected to the world of Praetoria. As the game keeps expanding its utility and earning potential, players who stay active today may be positioning themselves for even bigger opportunities ahead. There's also the possibility that new players will try to play Splinterlands through the collaborations. Now that we have the opportunity to welcome new players, the team will have to find ways to retain them.

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 40: It’s His Day

![Flying_Sapes.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23tS2tm4dUjR8igsjPX4bwrdv5n7Pm3ZXGiNKte3ezWHs1b4PC6W1xGuhJtS6rPNJw4L9.png)

In the cult underground city. Julio had decided it was time for Angelo to be given the new 19CE serum. Razor was not showing any negative side effects, and his advanced healing ability was on par with that of Orcilla.

Julio escorted Angelo down to his laboratory for the procedure.

‘How are you feeling, High Philosopher?’ asked Julio as they entered the corridor leading to the laboratory together.

‘I’ve been dreaming of this day my whole life,’ replied Angelo. ‘Now it’s come. I crave the safety of my glass world.’

‘You mean the higher power did not reassure you?’ asked Julio in a concerned tone.

‘I have been visited every night,’ replied Angelo. ‘The message is conflicting. We face great danger in every direction. This procedure is the least of my deep concerns.’

They entered the laboratory together. Orcilla, Demadrian, and Razor met them. 

‘You look much taller close up,’ remarked Demadrian as he looked up at Angelo.

‘Everyone seems tall to you,’ chuckled Orcilla.

‘You’re looking really sharp, Razor,’ said Angelo as he walked over to the examination table.

Razor looked at Julio. Julio nodded in response.

‘Never felt better, High Philosopher,’ replied Razor as he clenched his fists. 

‘Thank you for taking this risk for me,’ said Angelo as he sat on the examination table. 

‘It’s an honour, High Philosopher,’ said Razor as he stood up straighter. ‘I’d do anything for you. Plus now I feel invincible.’

‘I look forward to joining you,’ said Angelo as he grinned.

‘Try to relax,’ said Orcilla as she approached Angelo holding the needle. 

Angelo smiled and nodded.

Orcilla jabbed Angelo in the arm with the needle and then slowly injected the serum into him. Angelo watched on. He seemed a little nervous.

‘How are you feeling?’ asked Orcilla as she pulled the needle from his arm.

‘I feel… I feel a little light-headed,’ replied Angelo as his eyes fluttered a little.

‘That’s perfectly normal,’ said Orcilla calmly. ‘Your body is undergoing enormous changes. The DNA, the building blocks of your body, are being reformed, pulled apart and put back together with a few new pieces.’

Angelo grimaced in pain, and his breathing became heavy. Julio clutched his hand to calm him down.

His pain intensified. His eyes became bloodshot, and blood began to drip from his nose. Julio slowly laid him on his back.

‘It’s going to be okay, my High Philosopher,’ said Julio with calmness in his voice.

Angelo began to seize. His whole body was shaking violently.

Demadrian rushed over to Angelo. He was holding a needle. He stuck him in the neck with it and rapidly injected the substance into him. A few seconds later, Angelo passed out.

‘What did you inject him with?’ said Orcilla angrily as she looked at Demadrian. 

‘Just something to stabilise him,’ replied Demadrian. ‘There’s nothing genetic in it. Be grateful. I just saved his life.’

‘Thank you,’ said Julio, nodding.

‘When I take my serum, I’ll need a shot of this stuff every hour,’ said Demadrian. ‘I doubt I could make it without it.’

‘Julie didn’t need it,’ sighed Orcilla.

‘She’s a first-generation new Linap,’ remarked Demadrian. ‘She’s built a little differently than me. And that experiment was nuts. None of them should have survived. I’m not willing to die in that manner.’

‘Razor, I’d like you to stand in for me,’ said Julio. ‘I need to stay with the High Philosopher.’

‘It would be an honour,’ said Razor as he saluted. 

‘I’ll stay here too to keep an eye on him,’ said Orcilla as she dragged over a machine to monitor Angelo’s vitals.

‘You’ll all be glad to know I’m in the final stages of my serum,’ chuckled Demadrian. ‘Yes, I work that fast.’

Julio nodded in acknowledgement, and Orcilla was too busy setting up the machine.

The next morning, Angelo began to stir.

‘Hey Orcilla, he’s waking up,’ said Julio in an excited tone.

Orcilla rushed over to check on Angelo.

‘High Philosopher, how are you?’ asked Julio.

‘I feel strange,’ croaked Angelo. 

‘That’s okay,’ said Orcilla. ‘We progress at different speeds.’

‘You should eat some pancakes,’ remarked Demadrian. ‘They’ll perk you up.’

Angelo tried to sit up, but it was a struggle.

‘You don’t need to rush,’ said Orcilla as she rubbed Angelo’s arm.

‘I feel a little nauseous, but I still want those pancakes,’ chuckled Angelo.

‘I’ll head up to the temple and get you some immediately,’ said Julio excitedly. He then rushed out of the laboratory door.

‘Being right never gets boring,’ chuckled Demadrian as he looked at a printout of his analysis of his serum.

‘Well, let’s hope you can keep that up,’ said Orcilla as she grinned at Demadrian.

Razor was in Angelo’s temple room. A guard had just placed a huge stack of pancakes in front of him. Razor’s eyes bulged in anticipation. He grabbed the bottle of syrup and was about to squirt it all over the pancakes.

Suddenly, Julio rushed into the room. ‘Well done, Razor!’ exclaimed Julio in excitement. ‘You’re truly absorbing the vibrations of the higher power.’

Razor stood up and saluted Julio. Julio grabbed the plate of pancakes and the bottle of syrup and then rushed back out of the temple.

‘Hmm, are pancakes the price of enlightenment?’ Razor asked himself as his eyes darted from side to side.

A few minutes later, Julio rushed into the laboratory with the plate of pancakes.

‘Okay, you work faster than I do,’ remarked Demadrian.

‘Thanks to Razor,’ said Julio. ‘I think he might have established, through the higher power, a psychic connection with the High Philosopher.’

Angelo began to laugh as he finally managed to sit up. ‘You took his pancakes, didn’t you?’

‘Well, yes,’ chuckled Julio as he placed the plate of pancakes on a side table. ‘The timing couldn’t have been better. It has a divine feel to it.’

Julio put his arms around Angelo and hugged him. ‘You have your sense of humour. You must be feeling better.’

‘You should still take it easy,’ sighed Orcilla as she watched Angelo eagerly attack the pancakes with his fork.

‘Tomorrow, it’ll be our turn,’ said Demadrian to Julio. ‘We will be truly transformed. But the path will be very unpleasant.’

‘I understand,’ said Julio, nodding.

After eating the pancakes, Angelo felt much stronger and could even stand up.

‘Hey Angelo,’ said Demadrian. ‘Do you feel like a punch in the face?’

‘That sounds tempting, but I’ll have to politely decline,’ replied Angelo as he poked his tongue out slightly. ‘What I really want to do is see the outside world with my own eyes.’

‘I’ll tell Razor to take you flying,’ said Julio. ‘I’ll take you up to see him now, if you like. I know he must be deeply concerned for you.’

Angelo and Julio exited the laboratory together.

Meanwhile, in Angelo’s temple room, a guard had placed another stack of pancakes in front of Razor.

‘Oh gosh, they smell good,’ said Razor as he grabbed the syrup bottle.

Suddenly, Julio and Angelo entered the room.

‘Razor, I want you to take the High Philosopher flying,’ said Julio in a forceful tone.

‘I would be ever so grateful,’ sniggered Angelo as he desperately tried to stop himself from laughing.

Razor quickly stood to attention and saluted to Angelo.

‘Guard,’ said Julio firmly. ‘Take these pancakes down to the laboratory. Our wonderful guests must be very hungry.’

Razor’s mouth dropped open as he watched the guard take the plate of pancakes out of the room.

‘You’re really a great sport,’ said Angelo as he patted Razor on the shoulder. ‘You’ll dine with me tonight.’

Razor grinned and nodded.

An hour later, Razor, Julio, and Angelo arrived on the hill where they trained. Razor was fitted with his wings. Angelo was looking around at the scenery in amazement.

‘This is amazing,’ said Angelo as his eyes widened and darted. ‘The cool air blowing in my face, the sounds, and the beauty all around. My screens didn’t capture any of this.’

‘I’ve never seen such joy in you before, High Philosopher,’ remarked Julio. 

‘The pranks gave me a lift, but this is something different,’ replied Angelo. ‘It’s a new level of joy I have not experienced before.’

‘Well, be prepared to experience yet another level,’ said Julio as he rubbed Angelo’s arm. He turned to Razor and said, ‘Strap him on and let him fly.’

Razor strapped himself to Angelo.

‘Are you ready?’ asked Julio.

‘I’ve been ready since you designed them,’ replied Angelo energetically.

Julio nodded to Razor, and he smiled back.

‘Haahahaha!’ screamed Angelo as they launched into the air. ‘Oh yeah! Oh yeah! Oh yeah!’

Razor took them high so that Angelo could see for miles in every direction.

‘It’s so beautiful,’ said Angelo. ‘It’s like some of my dreams, but so much better.’

They flew over some mountains and then dropped down lower to gain a better view of a small herd of Sapes. They looked like Hamlet, but smaller and slimmer.

‘That’s them for real,’ said Angelo in delight. ‘I dream about them all the time.’

Up ahead, just above them was a flock of flying Sapes. They were quite large. They had grown far bigger since the fall of Sapey six years earlier.

‘That is something I haven’t even dreamt of,’ gasped Angelo. ’Such beauty is amazing.’

Razor flew upwards so they could fly with the Sapes. Razor pulled up between a few of them.

‘Hello!’ shouted Angelo. ‘Come on, Razor, say something. Julio isn’t here.’

‘You may speak,’ said Julio into Razor’s earpiece.

‘Holy moo, Sape!’ shouted Razor as he looked at a flying Sape that was almost in touching distance.

The Sape turned and looked at Razor and Angelo and onked in response.

‘Silly you!’ called out Angelo. ‘These Sapes “onk” not “moo”. Only the spotted ones “moo”,’

‘Baaa!’ squealed one of the Sapes.

‘Then there’s that one,’ chuckled Angelo.

They flew around for another fifteen minutes before returning to the hill where they started. They landed gently in front of Julio. Razor unstrapped Angelo.

‘This is the life,’ said Angelo in delight as he spun around. ‘I want to be in this world.’

‘This will soon become your reality,’ said Julio in a stern tone. ‘Before that can happen, Miro, the “Emperor”, and finally the “Empire” must fall.’

‘We’ll talk of this soon,’ said Angelo. ‘I just want to enjoy this moment a little longer.’

‘Of course, High Philosopher,’ replied Julio, nodding.

Razor’s eyes darted back and forth between Angelo and Julio.

That afternoon, Julio visited Maskameera in her cell.

‘The serum has been a success,’ said Julio. ‘Our guards will escort you back to your world.’

‘How kind of you,’ replied Maskameera.

Julio’s face lit up as he stared at Maskameera through the small window in the door. Maskameera smiled back at him. Suddenly, Angelo’s song began to play in the frequency that only Maskameera could hear. She dropped to the ground in pain while clutching her ears.

Julio turned around to face two guards. ‘She’ll be safe to sedate now,’ he told them. ‘Take her back to the flying vehicle she crashed in.’

The guards entered the cell. They both injected her with a strong sedative, which knocked her unconscious.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

title.title: [ENG/ESP] The most beautiful animal (The Tocororo)
title.body:
> The Cuban Trogon (Trogon temnurus) is an endemic jewel of Cuba, considered the national bird since 1988. Its scientific name, Priotelus temnurus (formerly Trogon temnurus), places it in the Trogonidae family, a group of beautiful, arboreal tropical birds. It measures about 25-28 cm and has plumage that mirrors the colors of the Cuban flag: an iridescent green back (appearing turquoise blue in the light), a white breast and belly, and a bright red underbelly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5ARa21qmydiviAPFjygEMRYMVQLJVPTi7nVaS457QTw/1778093396696.jpg) This is my favorite animal, and I invite you to learn about some of the most important aspects of its life: Where does it live? What does it eat? Scientific elements that characterize it, such as its song, sex, physiology, nesting, and other points of interest. Finally, I'll share five curious facts about this bird, considered one of the most beautiful in existence. I hope you enjoy this post. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5GyWA4uztoMGkNkFKo6g4qYDiCRLkhChRHn52y7yFri/1778093418287.jpg) **Habitat and Diet** It lives in humid, mountainous, and gallery forests, from Pinar del Río to Guantánamo, including the Sierra Maestra and the Sierra del Escambray, the two most important mountain ranges in Cuba. It prefers mid- to high-altitude areas, although it also adapts to semi-deciduous forests. Its diet is omnivorous and includes fleshy fruits (such as those of the yaya or almácigo tree), large insects (grasshoppers, caterpillars), spiders, and occasionally small lizards. It is a key seed disperser in its ecosystem. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaWfFJZQmhr4G2KLtpL4s8wGqGoA94apaaC958AWx6EAH/1778093441291.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfC2pJCKez4t8Unw2RNGrYuqTpam8DSt91E1stNqdixk/1778093466191.jpg) **Interesting Scientific Facts** 1. Distinctive Call: Its common name is onomatopoeic due to its repetitive \

call, which it emits especially at dawn.

2. Unique Nesting: It does not build elaborate nests. It takes advantage of natural cavities in rotting logs or, surprisingly, excavates its nest in arboreal termite mounds using its weak but persistent beak.

3. Subtle sexual dimorphism: Males and females look alike, but the female has a grayish (not black) throat and less extensive red underparts. Both incubate the 2-4 bluish-white eggs.

4. Fragile physiology: It is very sensitive to stress. In captivity, it refuses to eat and dies quickly, which is why it has never thrived in zoos. This makes it a symbol of freedom. To illustrate this, when the Cuban Trogon is confined to a cage, it beats its chest against the walls until it is freed or dies.

5. Scent gland: It possesses a uropygial gland that secretes a substance with a scent of ripe mango or jasmine, a unique trait among trogons.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYr6DSE6aCV669bpM4a1jErH4ZkhBrXf3MQwsFed9mbwq/1778093410520.jpg)

**5 Interesting Facts**

1. National Bird for its Aesthetic Beauty: It was chosen not for its biological rarity but because its three colors (red, blue, and white) match the Cuban flag. Cuba is the only country in the world whose national bird has exactly the same colors as its flag.

2. Feathered Meteorologist: Rural tradition says that if the Cuban Trogon (Tocororo) sings from high above, facing the sun, there will be good weather; if it sings hidden among the foliage, rain or hurricanes are on the way.

3. Silent and Short Flight: Its wings are rounded and its pectoral muscles weak, so it only makes short, noisy flights. It prefers to move by hopping among branches.
4. Nesting coordinated with termites: Choose active termite mounds because the internal heat and hard structure protect the eggs from predators and maintain a stable temperature. The termites do not attack the chicks.

5. \

species: Its presence indicates a mature and well-preserved forest. Where it disappears, it is a sign of severe deforestation. For this reason, it is an umbrella species for conservation in Cuba.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrv79CC5Z4ureQK7YhjUQCNffo5xURyJ7kdupEkACDqy/1778093433625.jpg)

**A final comment**

The Cuban trogon (Tocororo) appears on the coat of arms of Holguín province (where I lived for 17 years) and on numerous Cuban postage stamps. Its song inspired poems by Nicolás Guillén, Cuba's national poet, and songs of the nueva trova movement. It is not globally threatened, but deforestation and climate change could affect its existence.

It is illegal to capture or export it. In popular culture, it is said that \

means to be free and loyal to one's land. This Caribbean trogon is not only beautiful: its biology is a compendium of unique adaptations that make it a scientific and cultural emblem of Cuba.

Note: I used DeepL Translate.
The images and content are my own and are part of a research project conducted by the author on Cuba's national bird.




ESPAÑOL


**Una introducción necesaria**

El tocororo es una joya endémica de Cuba, considerada el ave nacional desde 1988. Su nombre científico, Priotelus temnurus (antes Trogon temnurus), lo ubica en la familia Trogonidae, un grupo de aves tropicales de gran belleza y hábitos arborícolas. Mide unos 25-28 cm y posee un plumaje que replica los colores de la bandera cubana: dorso verde iridiscente (que se percibe azul turquesa con la luz), pecho y vientre blanco, y un vientre inferior rojo intenso.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5ARa21qmydiviAPFjygEMRYMVQLJVPTi7nVaS457QTw/1778093396696.jpg)





Este es mi animal más lindo y, les invito a conocer algunos de los elementos más importantes de su vida: ¿Dónde vive?, ¿de qué se alimenta?, elementos científicos que lo caracterizan como canto, sexo, fisiología, anidación y otros elementos de interés.
Para el final les dejo cinco elementos curiosos de esta ave, considerada una de las más bellas que existe.

**Espero que les guste esta entrega**.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT5GyWA4uztoMGkNkFKo6g4qYDiCRLkhChRHn52y7yFri/1778093418287.jpg)



**Hábitat y alimentación**

Vive en bosques húmedos, serranos y de galería, desde Pinar del Río hasta Guantánamo, incluyendo la Sierra Maestra y la Sierra del Escambray, las dos elevaciones más importantes de la geografía cubana. Prefiere altitudes medias y altas, aunque también se adapta a bosques semicaducifolios. 

Su dieta es omnívora e incluye frutos carnosos (como los de la yaya o el almácigo), insectos grandes (saltamontes, orugas), arañas y, ocasionalmente, pequeños lagartos. Es un dispersor clave de semillas en su ecosistema.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaWfFJZQmhr4G2KLtpL4s8wGqGoA94apaaC958AWx6EAH/1778093441291.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfC2pJCKez4t8Unw2RNGrYuqTpam8DSt91E1stNqdixk/1778093466191.jpg)




**Elementos científicos interesantes**

1.Voz característica: Su nombre común es onomatopéyico por su canto repetitivo \

, que emite especialmente al amanecer. 
2.Anidación singular: No construye nidos elaborados. Aprovecha cavidades naturales en troncos podridos o, de forma sorprendente, excava su nido en termiteros arbóreos (comejenes) usando su pico débil pero persistente.
3.Dimorfismo sexual sutil: Macho y hembra se parecen, pero la hembra tiene la garganta grisácea (no negra) y el rojo ventral menos extenso. Ambos incuban los 2-4 huevos blancos azulados.
4.Fisiología frágil: Es muy sensible al estrés. En cautiverio se niega a comer y muere rápidamente, por lo que nunca ha prosperado en zoológicos. Esto lo convierte en un símbolo de libertad. Para ratificar lo anterior, cuando el Tocororo es encerrado en una jaula golpea su pecho contra las paredes de esta hasta quedar libre o morir.
5.Glándula odorífera: Posee una glándula uropigial que segrega una sustancia con olor a mango maduro o jazmín, un rasgo único entre los trogones.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYr6DSE6aCV669bpM4a1jErH4ZkhBrXf3MQwsFed9mbwq/1778093410520.jpg)

**5 elementos curiosos destacados**

1.Ave nacional por su belleza estética: Se eligió no por su rareza biológica sino porque sus tres colores (rojo, azul y blanco) coinciden con la bandera cubana. Es el único país del mundo cuya ave nacional tiene exactamente los mismos tonos que su bandera.
2.Meteorólogo emplumado: La tradición campesina dice que, si el tocororo canta desde lo alto y mirando al sol, habrá buen tiempo; si lo hace oculto entre la fronda, se avecinan lluvias o huracanes.
3.Vuelo silencioso y corto: Sus alas son redondeadas y sus músculos pectorales débiles, por lo que solo realiza vuelos cortos y ruidosos. Prefiere desplazarse a saltos entre ramas.
4.Nidada coordinada con termitas: Elige termiteros activos porque el calor interno y la estructura dura protegen los huevos de depredadores  y mantienen una temperatura estable. Las termitas no atacan a los polluelos.
5.Especie \

: Su presencia indica un bosque maduro y bien conservado. Donde desaparece, hay señal de deforestación severa. Por eso es una especie sombrilla para la conservación en Cuba.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrv79CC5Z4ureQK7YhjUQCNffo5xURyJ7kdupEkACDqy/1778093433625.jpg)



**Un comentario final**

El tocororo aparece en el escudo de la provincia de Holguín (donde viví por espacio de 17 años) y en numerosos sellos postales cubanos. Su canto inspiró poemas de Nicolás Guillén, el poeta nacional de Cuba y canciones de la nueva trova cubana. No se encuentra amenazado globalmente, pero la pérdida de bosques y el cambio climático podrían afectar su existencia. 

Es ilegal capturarlo o exportarlo. En la cultura popular, se dice que \

significa ser libre y fiel a la propia tierra. Este trogón caribeño no solo es bello: su biología es un compendio de adaptaciones singulares que lo convierten en un emblema científico y cultural de Cuba. Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate. Las imágenes y el contenido son de mi propiedad y es parte de un trabajo de investigación realizado por el autor, sobre el Ave Nacional de Cuba.
