a Caracas. Las nuevas rutas (parte 2)
title.body:
Desde hace meses estamos presentando un modelo analítico basado en los arquetipos de Game of Thrones y lo empezamos a revelar la semana anterior (ver Parte 1: [El nuevo mapa](https://peakd.com/hive-186119/@potterplux/de-westeros-a-caracas-el-nuevo-mapa-parte-1)). No era una analogía simpática. Era una gramática del poder: la misma que mueve ejércitos, sanciones, narrativas y alianzas en el mundo real.

Hoy, ese modelo no solo se mantiene vigente, sino que se expande y se confirma en nuevos escenarios globales. Y el próximo movimiento —el encuentro entre Trump y Xi— definirá si estamos ante una paz fría o el preludio de una tormenta mayor. (**¿Y por qué hablo en futuro si el encuentro ya ocurrió?**) Siga leyendo 😎


![lucid-origin_A_minimalist_geopolitical_concept_a_glowing_chess_piece_in_the_shape_of_Cuba_hal-0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/AK2BkdJYACkATpsc9GqzpoPC6drkgJ1hqzAC4ZGE7DchoWLHMwnmtW4apSBUQQC.jpg)



### Acto I: El Modelo y su validación

## **El Modelo en acción: Lo que ya anticipamos**

Antes de que los titulares explotaran, documentamos el cerco a Venezuela. No fue una predicción afortunada. Fue la lectura correcta del tablero.

El **checkmate en Venezuela** mostró cómo el cerco a Caracas era el movimiento lógico de un patrón que ya habíamos descrito:

- Guerra híbrida
- Bloqueo narrativo
- Intervención por delegación
- Intento de control directo de recursos (el petróleo)

Fue el equivalente al \

ejecutada: la jugada brutal, directa y sin máscaras para eliminar a un líder y tomar el control estratégico. Ese análisis no especuló. Documentó. Y los hechos le dieron la razón.

## **El Modelo se expande: Irán ya estaba en la mira**

Lo que ocurre ahora con **Irán** no es una noticia aislada. Es un capítulo del mismo libro (incluso previo a Venezuela). Irán es el nuevo \
: al que se le aplica la misma lógica de máxima presión, sanciones asfixiantes y narrativa de \

.

- Las rutas energéticas y el estrecho de Ormuz son el campo de batalla.
- Los precios del petróleo y la seguridad de las cadenas de suministro están en juego.
- La alianza tácita con China y Rusia es la respuesta natural al cerco occidental.

El modelo que leyó Caracas ya había leído a Teherán. No es coincidencia. Es consistencia estructural. Pero era preciso \

(se acerca la [Copa del Mundo 2026](https://www.fifa.com/es/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026) que se llevará a cabo **del 11 de junio al 19 de julio en Estados Unidos, Canadá y México**).

## **El tablero global fracturado: más allá de Irán**

El modelo no solo explica conflictos bilaterales. También ilumina la fractura del sistema multilateral:

- El \
impulsado por Trump fue la confirmación de que el hegemón, cuando no controla el tablero, crea su propio espejo, su propia institucionalidad paralela.\n- La ONU enfrenta el dilema de la \

: ¿se adapta o se vuelve simbólica mientras el poder real migra a nuevos foros?
- América Latina queda atrapada en medio: presionada por EE.UU., cortejada por China, y con un margen de maniobra cada vez más estrecho.

### Acto II: El Encuentro Trump-Xi y el nuevo tablero global

## La pieza que faltaba: el encuentro de los Dos Reyes 

(¿y no son **Tres**?) 🤔

En días anteriores, Trump y Xi se sentaron en la misma mesa. En el lenguaje de Game of Thrones, es el \

: dos reyes, cada uno con su ejército, sus alianzas y su idea de cómo debe ordenarse el mundo. ¿Qué podía salir de ahí?

|Escenario |Probabilidad |Implicación|
|-|-|-|
|Pacto tácito de no agresión|ALTA|Estabilidad temporal, pero rearme silencioso|
|Escalada abierta|BAJA|Caos global, huida hacia activos refugio|
|Teatro diplomático sin cambios reales|MEDIA|El statu quo se mantiene, pero la tensión subyacente no desaparece|
|Redefinición de esferas de influencia|MEDIA-ALTA|América Latina, Medio Oriente y el Ártico como nuevos tableros secundarios|

El modelo sugiere que lo más probable es una \
: acuerdos en lo económico, confrontación en lo estratégico. Pero el diablo está en los detalles\n\nTrump ya salió de China y enseguida empezó a \

la narrativa de un G2 (sugiriendo a China y EE.UU., y dejando de lado a Rusia). Obviamente, es una táctica para intentar separar a China y Rusia. Sin embargo, tan solo 4 días después de que Trump saliera de China, llegó Putin (y no fue solo, sino con el \

de los [ejercicios nucleares militares entre Rusia y Bielorrusia](https://amp.dw.com/es/rusia-inicia-tres-d%C3%ADas-de-ejercicios-nucleares/a-77208420)). Desde luego, nada es casual. El tablero ha cambiado. En la siguiente jugada, parece que el **Panda** y el **Oso** tienen más en común que el **Águila**. Por supuesto, un encuentro es la clave para \

al otro.

> Pero no nos apresuremos: **la mesa está lista** (gestos), pero **la cena aún no está servida** (contenido).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr3ZSAiZ7Qw

## Lo que estos encuentros nos dejan: 
Independientemente de lo que se haya decidido (o no) en ambas cumbres, el tablero ya no es el mismo:

- **Para los mercados**: Aumenta la prima por riesgo geopolítico. La volatilidad será la norma, no la excepción.
- **Para los activos soberanos**: Bitcoin y el oro dejan de ser \

y se convierten en herramientas de cobertura estructural contra la fragmentación del orden.
- **Para los países pequeños** (incluyendo América Latina): se estrecha el margen de maniobra. La neutralidad será un lujo cada vez más costoso.

[El modelo de Game of Thrones](https://peakd.com/hive-186119/@potterplux/de-westeros-a-caracas-el-nuevo-mapa-parte-1) que previamente presentamos no predice el futuro mágicamente. Lo que hace es revelar la gramática del poder: cómo se construyen las alianzas, cómo se fabrican las amenazas, cómo se mueven las piezas cuando el tablero se agranda.

## El G2 ya existe, pero es un pulso entre 3 reinos.

Lo que vimos en **Caracas** empezando el 2026 se pretende replicar en **Teherán** (o mejor dicho, es parte del mismo Acto en la puesta en escena). [Lo que ocurrió en Panamá](https://peakd.com/hive-184127/@potterplux/1989-redux-otra-vez-panama) se tamiza en cada nueva fractura del sistema multilateral. Y lo que decidan —o hayan decidido— Trump-Xi-Putin en su cumbre diferida definirá si la nueva temporada es de guerra fría o de fuego abierto o de un nuevo tipo de convergencia.

¿Es un cambio de ciclo o **un cambio del sistema**?

Creo que la pregunta ya no es \

El invierno no es una metáfora. Y el mapa se sigue dibujando.


![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLJ9tXcJL661SaWv4idTCbsYVJyYo6XSUNwRPjYdNhxiTtiMtECDNEpD5xLnYoF7pk8F754oLP4PKBbsVvn4uBUrM43wgfvgQfe5k2ckV5y4ZvgHtKfHp.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/23w387vaR3MikYwdvNHH4CYs52bkYTe3ZcBLFDTW78uZaZZFWqign43QQwSsaXFnNdDqN.jpg)

## El tablero sigue cambiando: el pulso entre los reyes.


![Semaforo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/potterplux/243zrUq8TL4Fzv1vjCzKCcHrPqk7tB37M7VCdty1umWfujjPv8pc6dCbeGVuis6Nckhrx.png)
<sub>Imagen creada por el autor</sub>

El efecto semáforo revela claramente que hay zonas de contrapeso (verde), zonas de tensión (amarillo) y zonas de fractura (rojo). 

> No olvidemos el auge de **Brasil** y **México** (con más del 60% del PIB y de la población de América Latina) porque mientras los reinos se reparten los platos, [Brasil y México parecen estar haciendo el menú](https://www.cronista.com/colombia/actualidad-co/preocupacion-entre-donald-trump-xi-jinping-y-vladimir-putin-dos-paises-de-america-latina-se-convertiran-en-potencia-mundial-y-reconfiguraran-la-economia-y-las-alianzas-internacionales-para-siempre/).

> Tampoco hemos olvidado a la **India**, pero [¿se trata de una potencia emergente o de un espejismo económico?](https://www.dw.com/es/india-milagro-econ%C3%B3mico-o-espejismo/a-75901315)

Sin embargo, hay un actor que merece su propio capítulo. Un testigo silencioso que ha resistido décadas de cerco y que ahora, en este nuevo tablero fracturado, podría estar ante su momento más complejo y a la vez más lleno de oportunidades.

En la Parte 3 de esta serie, dedicaremos un análisis exclusivo a **Cuba**.

Allí veremos:
- ¿Cómo se ha aplicado el modelo del \

a la isla durante décadas?
- Las nuevas amenazas de Trump (embargo total, designación como patrocinador del terrorismo).
- La oportunidad que abre la grieta global: China, Rusia, desdolarización.
- Por qué Cuba es mucho más que un símbolo y podría ser un termómetro del nuevo orden.

**Cuba**: ¿La manzana de la discordia o de Guillermo Tell?
En nuestro [modelo arquetípico de Game of Thrones](https://peakd.com/hive-186119/@potterplux/de-westeros-a-caracas-el-nuevo-mapa-parte-1), ¿es Cuba un personaje o una trama?

- El lobo huargo de Winterfell
- El cuervo que vigila en el Muro
- El látigo roto en Bahía de los Esclavos (Slaver's Bay)
- El dragón de tres cabezas en Dragonstone
- La aguja de Arya Stark


¿Cuba es el **Riverlands del Caribe**: un territorio que todos quieren, que nadie termina de controlar del todo? 

Por lo general, una chispa prende la pólvora (si no está húmeda). Hay muchas señales que convergen en Cuba, pero muchos ven escenarios apocalípticos porque están leyendo estas señales de otro modo: solo ven chispas y pólvoras. Sin embargo, nuestro modelo ve otra cosa. Ojalá tengamos razón.

Solo adelantamos que ese capítulo sobre Cuba es justo publicarlo en la comunidad [HiveCuba](https://peakd.com/c/hive-10053/created) @hivecuba 

No se lo pierdan…en estos días.

title.title: Mount Bozburun and Hasdümen Village / Bozburun Dağı ve Hasdümen Köyü ( EN-TR)
title.body:
Hello,

We took a short trip with our fellow teachers from school to Hasdümen Village, nestled at the foot of Mount Bozburun—considered one of the most majestic peaks of the Taurus Mountains, which encircle the Mediterranean like a vine. However, this place has an atmosphere quite different from that of ordinary villages.  Nestled right in the heart of nature, with its hidden historical ruins, streams flowing with ice-cold water, and mysterious tales passed down from the past to the present, it was a place that captivated you the moment you arrived. One of the village’s most striking features was the crystal-clear spring water that emerged from deep within the earth, flowing from the mountains. For the villagers, this water was not merely a necessity—it had become the very essence of life itself. They had named this natural spring, which they would never trade for any other water, Pınargözü. 


>Merhabalar,

>Akdeniz'i adeta bir sarmaşık gibi çevreleyen Toros Dağları'nın en heybetli noktalarından biri sayılan Bozburun Dağı'nın eteklerinde kurulu Hasdümen Köyü'ne okuldaki öğretmen arkadaşlarımızla küçük bir gezi gerçekleştirdik.  Ancak burası sıradan köylerden çok farklı bir atmosfere sahiptir.  Doğanın tam ortasında saklanmış tarihi kalıntıları, içinden buz gibi sular akan dereleri ve geçmişten bugüne anlatılan gizemli hikayeleriyle insanı ilk anda etkisi altına alan bir yerdi.  Köyün en dikkat çeken yanlarından biri ise, dağların içinden doğup gelen  ve toprağın derinliklerinden çıkan o berrak kaynak suyuydu. Köy halkı için bu  su yalnızca ihtiyaç için değil, adete hayatın kendisi olmuştu.  Başka hiçbir suya değişmeyecekleri bu doğal kaynak suya da Pınargözü adını vermişlerdi. 

[//]:# (!worldmappin 37.23838 lat 31.00054 long  d3scr)

![IMG20260519151543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS9wEZcJXqXehMQzA5966gZK7bvASN9czoaJzCSx63pm6/IMG20260519151543.jpg)

![IMG20260519134155.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfD9RjxDxWpZGNDqfRXxLCERL6JHC95rozTRgjed5qvH2/IMG20260519134155.jpg)

In memory of the teachers who were leaving our school, we all set off together for the village of Hasdümen, located in the Serik district of Antalya. This village was also the place where our fellow teacher was born and raised. It was Pınargözü—a place everyone in the village used and spoke of with admiration, a place that brought a sense of coolness to one’s heart just hearing its name.  

>Okulumuzdan ayrılacak olan öğretmenlerimizin anısına hep birlikte Antalya'nın Serik ilçesine bağlı olan Hasdümen Köy'üne doğru yol almıştık.  Bu köy aynı zamanda öğretmen arkadaşımızın doğup büyüdüğü topraklardı.  Buraya köyde herkesin kullandığı ve  hayranlıkla bahsettiği adını bile duyunca insanın içinde serinlik hissettiren Pınargözü idi.  


![IMG20260519141325.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ7DWsTLLfCfCSeUKFtNzJeYW4xdGbnF8EaWWxoX1cBdQ/IMG20260519141325.jpg)


![IMG20260519120328.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaFQKLHxZims3DcYC7Jnhuv1mv2Y6ywNRfCRNf7jEKRyX/IMG20260519120328.jpg)



![IMG20260519142251.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7mbqpfwduDeFcJLHwJCo4Vs9NJqpKgkRUvjUoAJ5Fqr/IMG20260519142251.jpg)

![IMG20260519120305.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnczb2rXZKdg2rNsLkmeerw6j4xxiiWV99raMNnhVRcY/IMG20260519120305.jpg)

![IMG20260519150707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyKzgF95Uoi9toyxHUqFvf4kKNLHuWoXjSs8dukuoMcL/IMG20260519150707.jpg)

As we made our way toward the foothills of the Taurus Mountains, the scent of the village began to fill the air. The white stone and concrete gave way to pine trees and reddish-brown soil. As we continued along the road, I felt we were getting closer to nature. Hasdümen is small but looks like a treasure hidden among the greenery and the surrounding mountains.  

>Torosların eteklerine doğru ilerledikçe, köyün kokusu hissedilmeye başlamıştı. Beyaz taş betonlarının yerini çam ağaçları kırmızı renge çalan toz topraklar almıştı. Yolda ilerledikçe doğaya bir adım daha yaklaştığmızı hissediyorumdum.  Hasdümen küçük ama etrafını çevreleyen dağlarıyla yeşilliklerin arasında saklı kalmış bir hazine görünümündedir.  


![IMG20260519133738.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRnBCDbgKt7kdWscoGfU7yRxJQQRgSKFUPciGUHJZjymq/IMG20260519133738.jpg)


![IMG20260519140715.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJTk4TMUWfLqpBhyTzVRFJ1wQQWk7iRNjCPNGfCKmJrY/IMG20260519140715.jpg)



![IMG20260519152126.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6u2XwJfVA1CBv8YENSYrhDHfd7b9p5vXjSrzz8EocPn/IMG20260519152126.jpg)

![IMG20260519141146.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSA8XnyJ6AdS1x4tUHWycLXV2GwVN2xKBaW5x7paT2qEo/IMG20260519141146.jpg)

Most people in this village make their living through livestock farming, agriculture, and trout farming. In particular, the trout restaurants established around the crystal-clear natural spring water provide a livelihood for the people living in this natural setting.  Scattered among the mountains surrounding the village are a few single-story, detached houses. All of these houses are connected to the village of Hasdümen. The village has a school, a mosque, and a bridge that serves as the main access route to all the homes. Beneath this bridge flows a stream called Çetince, which the villagers use for their vineyards and gardens. 

>Bu köyde insanların çoğu hayvancılık, tarım ve alabalık işletmeciliğiyle geçimini sağlıyor. Özellikle buz gibi doğal kaynak suyun çevresinde kurulan alabalık restoranları bu doğanın içinde yaşayan insanların geçimini sağlıyor.  Köyün etrafında dağların arasında tek katlı müstakil bir iki evler var. Bu evlerin hepsi Hasdümen köyüne bağlanmış. Köyde bir okul,  bir cami ve birde herkesin ortak kullandığı tüm evlere gidecek yolu belirleyen bir köprü var. Bu köprünün altında da köy halkının bağ ve bahçesinde kullandığı Çetince adı verilen bir dere suyu geçiyor. 


![IMG20260519150623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbnhvJ1ia8w8sUsXBKTUi2gLxgQVvN1fGQQfV48aUvK8f/IMG20260519150623.jpg)

![IMG20260519140944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmapDPwfv3j3aREiqyaD4qao2HvqVJYTjBQiXQWCFVZJTW/IMG20260519140944.jpg)


![IMG20260519120426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwwqr4tg2x5J3Qf55NU45gYC99WQ9LHZahqkd9QJXqC7/IMG20260519120426.jpg)


![IMG20260519120342.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXLPAJTkioamGZP6CaMjubqzKAVMBrNLK6qoJf4gQ2uvJ/IMG20260519120342.jpg)

![IMG20260519135206.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ3refbn8SLeAVwV5BrGBfSUDq9AY96Qr1KGLpM54W7Uq/IMG20260519135206.jpg)


![IMG20260519134354.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNV9VeZu5fiRB26o7BgUczPaaJwtkTSoejHAJ2hdkXtth/IMG20260519134354.jpg)

On our way to Pınargözü, we stopped briefly at the bridge in Hasdümen Village.  Although it was a bit late, we all prepared and ate breakfast together by the stream, using the food we’d brought from home.  As the steam rose from our tea on the small stove, the sound of the water was soothing to all of us.  It was hot. The sun was really starting to make its presence felt. We couldn’t resist, so we took off our shoes and waded into the stream. 

>Pınargözüne giderken Hasdümen Köyü köprüsünde kısa bir mola verdik.  Sabah kahvaltısını da biraz geçte olsa bu dere kenarının kıyısında evden getirdiklerimizle hep birlikte hazırlayarak yaptık.  Küçük tüpümüzün üstünde çayımızın buharı yükselirken suyun sesi hepimize iyi geliyordu.  Hava sıcaktı. Güneş kendini iyiden iyiye hissettirmeye başlamıştı. Dayanamayıp, ayaklabılarımızı çıkartıp derenin içine girdik. 


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-19 at 14.44.57.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTtP9LfcV25sm5jKiFwM8PGBERfgL6BqFcJUT8TQEaH8/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-19%20at%2014.44.57.jpeg)


![IMG20260519134405.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeMQXp7uBUL77pGFR92F7ZMYPND7xGy85F12pKiptnphe/IMG20260519134405.jpg)


![IMG20260519134358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbGz1WN1rLijzcVkdKYvXrsg5pP54MN45bxMUadi2V3q/IMG20260519134358.jpg)

![IMG20260519135243.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYAkbssDdL7Yw8K8QURoordr2V3mNpQQK2QUhzjRM96Wy/IMG20260519135243.jpg)


![IMG20260519134315.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJ9EPdFDdQ6c72Xo8B6wbrL1kWo6rq1ixQHtFdP8tM3U/IMG20260519134315.jpg)
Even though it was late May, the water was really cold and natural. We spent about an hour in the water. After we finished breakfast, we hit the road again.  

>Mayıs ayının sonlarında olmamıza rağmen su gerçekten de çok soğuk ve doğaldı. Suyun üstünde yaklaşık bir saat zaman geçirdik. Kahvaltımızı da yaptıktan sonra tekrar yola koyulduk.  


![IMG20260519133833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUjqzN96VccunGyCVdbjfYsGpJn8SpknTiiTkSTVkpgdE/IMG20260519133833.jpg)


![IMG20260519134651.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUiYjh3ChRzhc7rFVaUidLrf1SNKbpGGdD82U37DQXkXb/IMG20260519134651.jpg)


![IMG20260519134708.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRCKDseLNLYUM8nbN1iyvUuAxH38skRnDimbe4jqbsvci/IMG20260519134708.jpg)

![IMG20260519120643.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaBZCNDoMBziyPQDRMdw6NQkyZ9E4cjzjhqMB6jWWUmMD/IMG20260519120643.jpg)

It was impossible not to wonder where the name Pınargözü came from. The villagers named it Pınargözü because the powerful spring waters in the area emerge from between the rocks, just like an eye. It truly feels as if the water is peering out from the heart of the mountain. The video below shows how the water emerges from between the rocks. 

>Pınargözü isminin nereden geldiğini merak etmemek mümkün değildi.  Bölgedeki güçlü kaynak sularının kayaların arasından adeta bir göz gibi çıkması nedeniyle köy halkı tarafından Pınargözü adı verilmiş. Gerçekten de su dağın kalbinden bakıyormuş gibi hissediliyor.  Aşağıdaki videoda suyun kayaların arasından nasıl çıktığını gösteren bir video var. 

https://youtube.com/shorts/7zSaPMBr07U

![IMG20260519150635.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbNDRq57srQB1f5nH63RjChEmJbnmuTXk35S4jLpQgLVh/IMG20260519150635.jpg)

![IMG20260519150710.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeqt2SSFtpgDMYshV8f5tdpxoiRqrDaCfR4xrtY4zvdPU/IMG20260519150710.jpg)


![IMG20260519152734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZJMHk2qeBCBhBt7FtTCygz3QGDJf3NnwZqyrxyHbs3Ni/IMG20260519152734.jpg)


![IMG20260519150811.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYtMjgThBfQUwZG3GsHjqQQ5YHum2yoJyF5p5v1suUzdh/IMG20260519150811.jpg)

We had reached the very source of the Pınargözü. Bozburun Mountain, rising directly across from us, looked magnificent. The light-colored rocks on its peaks stood like a giant wall, as if shaped by the wind and the passage of time over the years. Combined with the dark green forest cover on its lower slopes, the mountain looked like a layered painting created by nature’s own hand. Especially when looking at the points where it meets the sky, it gives one a sense of freedom. 

>Pınargözünün tam kaynağına ulaşmıştık. Tam karşıda yükselen  Bozburun Dağı ise, muhteşem görünüyordu. Zirvelerindeki açık renkli kayalıklar  sanki yıllardır rüzgarla  ve zamanla şekillenmiş  dev bir duvar gibi duruyor. Alt kısımlarındaki koyu yeşil orman örtüsüyle birleşince dağ, doğanın kendi elleriyle çizdiği katmanlı bir tabloya dönüşmüş gibi görünüyor.  Özellikle gökyüzüyle birleştiği noktalara bakınca insana bir özgürlük hissi veriyor. 


![IMG20260519151203.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQTpyZVqgCyJTfoUoGnCEsz73k1PZoPK5WjCWbtJy36ty/IMG20260519151203.jpg)


![IMG20260519151548.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPcoFBbLnvhmZnvabWFg2Jdp5YaQU6szJ2F2dsumsCKK7/IMG20260519151548.jpg)


![IMG20260519152145.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcugdPjRZi7x9WFzGwwSRyzZoGPHEe3nSLA49WznrnoGg/IMG20260519152145.jpg)

![IMG20260519170238.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyrcteuAAVcnzEW2Evv9jvbuGEwfGhLKF4foG3uQLcMP/IMG20260519170238.jpg)

The most striking aspect of this mountain landscape is that, even though the mountain appears massive, imposing, and inaccessible, the villagers at its base go about their daily lives. The trees, houses, streams, and people have, in a sense, learned to live in its shadow. That is why what we see is not merely a mountain landscape; it also highlights the harmony between nature and humanity. 

>Bu dağ manzarasının en etkili yanı ise, dağ çok büyük heybetli ve ulaşılmaz görünsede eteklarinde köy halkı hayatına devam ediyor. Ağaçlar, evler, dereler ve insanlar onun gölgesinde yaşamayı bir nevi öğrenmişler. Bu yüzden gördüğümüz sadece bir dağ manzarası değil; aynı zamanda doğayla insanın uyumunu gözler önüne seriyor. 

![IMG20260519151858.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMnZnXgZsJeKVWpDngCybrM1UNvu2WgLmEmdKEKuvzso/IMG20260519151858.jpg)


![IMG20260519151925.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQUSnbx6jsN1uSWmPvFrovRKqWFb443BkuYUHSnv2XyT6/IMG20260519151925.jpg)


![IMG20260519151426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6iM6okkpXSeCnqRh1sCK3M8f6jYJsL2pV9m7ttpU3sX/IMG20260519151426.jpg)

As we left Hasdümen that day, we took with us not only beautiful views, but also a deep sense of peace and a profound admiration for nature.

title.title: Unknown Yet Inspiring Filipino Heroes of the Faith (Part 2 of 2)
title.body:
I know you don't know any holy people and don't really care at all. Why? Because most people would rather watch/read the news or controversial stuff that are actually garbage and makes watchers/readers angry. If you'd rather fuel your hate then you will never appreciate the good life at all, let alone people who are the ones who lift us up from the mire we're in. As I always say: Ignorance of Catholicism is not bliss. **If you want a better life, start reading and learning about the lives of saints.** Plenty of such in the Catholic Church, many are already featured online. Let's be inspired by them and emulate them instead of wallowing in useless TikTok vids and Reels. Prefer someone who's not ancient? Well here are four remarkable Christians who are inspiring and worth aspiring to be! They were ordinary people whose life stories need to be imbibed so we can try our best to live holy lives. ‼️**You can read [Part 1 of this post](https://ecency.com/hive-141359/@artgirl/remarkable-but-unknown-heroes-of?referral=artgirl) for context *before going further*.** You'll learn how one is declared a saint in the Catholic Church, etc. If you already read it and got inspired, get ready to be blown away by the following pious Christians!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWEthLSJhbzsoRw14Vvs6fZwfCdYrreDQNenUkxCY1wv/image.png) [photo source](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-art-creative-relaxation-girl-1283009/)




# 📖 The Dedicated Catechist: Servant of God *Laureana \

Franco* This person is kinda more related to me than any of the rest I have written. Why? Because she's a poor catechist, like what I'm trying but failing to be. Haha. Of course she is way holier and saintlier than I. Actually at times I don't even want to teach kids if they don't know how to behave and such. Oh it's such a struggle to be holy and to do the will of God. Anyway, what is Ka Luring's story? She resigned from her first job and became a full-time volunteer catechist for most of her life! I mean, wow. Poverty is next to godliness eh??? Despite having no job she would teach children about the faith. Priests would even ask her to pray for certain problems, plans or projects they have!!! Imagine that! The poor woman would pray and fast for days to weeks for their intentions until she is told everything is well with whatever she prayed for. 😱 It's hard to fathom but saintly people can really embrace being poor yet live a generous and sacrificial life!!! Lord have mercy on all of us selfish people. 😅
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyxfih2astrvjkxSi2my7GjETR6KSDzjFrpSPpqUieeV/prayer_for_beatification_ka_luring.png) [image source](https://sanlazarodebetania.wordpress.com/?s=ka+luring)

There's also a story of how a priest maltreated her. In anger, he threw an ashtray at her head and she got hospitalized for it. And yet she forgave him easily. I'm like, wth... Normally such a story would raise our ire against the clergyman. How could a man of God treat a woman, a church volunteer, in such a terrible way?!? And yet she, the victim herself, never hated him for what happened to her! Now you may be wondering... How in the world can most of us understand such people who easily and readily forgives? That incident is another perfect example of why it is hard to be holy. But forgiving someone can be done. If she can do it, so can we!!! Thru constant prayer, frequent confession, spending time with Jesus in the adoration chapel, accepting our crosses and following Jesus Christ we will one day be more charitable and merciful towards others. Step by step, little by little, we can make it if we do our best everyday. **We must ask God's grace for it to happen!** Watch this to learn more about her and be inspired! ♥️
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vTl9l6aJI3k&t=5s



# 🩸 Martyred for the Faith: Servant of God Fr. *Rhoel Gallardo* Oh boy, who would think there would be people killed for their faith in God in this day and age? And yet all over the world this is still happening. I didn't think much of such stories until I found out about Fr. Rhoel Gallardo sometime in 2024. Just like St. Lorenzo Ruiz, he refused to give up the faith even if they tortured him. Find out more about his life story in this short feature video and how he got martyred in 2000.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kiQoVyzdQ80

There's actually a movie about his life story released just last year. So sad I wasn't able to watch it. Anyway here's the trailer of In Thy Name!
https://youtu.be/XNDwloraIcA?si=ciSk6CGLDtPsk_ag

There's also a documentary film to be released this month! Seeds of Peace is actually available for block screenings too. You can watch the [teaser video here](https://www.facebook.com/share/v/14coi5vvTX5/). Like St. Maximilian Kolbe, he suffered much before he was murdered. And yet now his life story serves as modern inspiration for every Christian out there. Definitely if you pray and ask for his intercession for any difficulty in life your prayers will surely reach God.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ8A38Vba12zTA9K3aHMDK7KZyFkAMzPTBRgXAfXgNB7D/prayer_for_beatification_fr_rhoel_english.png) [source](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18wNxcV78E/)



# 🙏 Future Millennial Saint: Servant of God *Darwin Ramos* Here's a teenager who started as a street kid and then happily endured a sickness until death. He died of Duchenne muscular dystrophy when he was only 17 years old. Watch this to know what a Servant of God is and how such a person behaves. And some details on how to become a declared saint by the Vatican.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H6VWO0mb_b0

I am actually not very familiar with him even if his cause for sainthood was initiated by the bishop of the Diocese of Cubao (where I'm in). Didn't know about him until last year I think but I still never checked much on him until last month. But now I finally know more of Darwin thru this news documentary! And wow, his life was truly inspirational indeed.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QVEnpEYegqM

If you know of anyone who has illnesses that seem to be impossible to heal, you can pray and ask for his intercession. Don't forget to document the before and after so everything can be solid evidence. 😉
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEzNpj67Hh6XgMGWoHzpzL5weRm5KHPBgHR3nQmrThzw/prayer_for_beatification_darwin_ramos_english.png [source](https://darwin-ramos.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Flyer-bent-in-two-Darwin-Ramos-74x105-WEB_page-0002-1.jpg)



# 😇 A Gen X Servant of God: *Niña Ruiz Abad* Who would have thought this girl would be known by someone in Spain? Well look here's a guy who learned about her and tells the story of this inspiring Catholic teenager. Of course this is in Spanish but there's an English auto-dub for us non-Spanish speakers.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xJ2fZplEq8

Otherwise feel free to watch this and learn why she became a Servant of God on the way to sainthood. Who is she? Find out in this video.:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ziL_gEZb2jo

I didn't know about Niña Ruiz Abad until 2 yrs ago when I attended the [33rd Eucharistic Congress](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1GDtA5N81V/). Her mom spoke about her life and they also gave away prayer cards with her relics. I think hers is the first ever saint relic I ever got. Anyway, what do you think about her life story? You can also pray and ask her intercession using this official prayer.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9v9aF2HZoL5tLZU8SMAZNig5Xkz41NVgNxEG7FYqU2e/prayer_for_beatification_ni_a_ruiz_abad.png) [left image source](https://pintakasiph.wordpress.com/2024/08/16/god-above-all-the-journey-of-servant-of-god-nina-ruiz-abad/) | [right image source](https://www.facebook.com/share/1HQ2Knj7Px/)

We can pray and use any of those I shared above so we can experience a miracle if God wills it. Nobody will become a saint unless we ask for the intercession of these people who are already officially recognized by the Vatican. If we aren't praying how can they make miracles happen? They won't be declared saints if nobody asks for their assistance. That's why anyone who needs help in life, especially those with illnesses can definitely ask favors from the Lord thru them. # The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**

**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

**Hello Hive Family,** most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world (***you know who you are***), thank you for being here with me once again.

**<u>💭 My Current Situation</u>**

For almost a month now, I’ve been feeling down due to personal struggles. Work and personal life have both been tough. Being a freelancer is never easy, and lately, I lost some of my clients because of downturns in their businesses. That means I need to look for new job opportunities to cover my basic necessities, bills, loans, and other financial obligations.

As the sole breadwinner, supporting my mother and sometimes my siblings’ families, the weight feels overwhelming. Honestly, I don’t have enough funds for myself, and that leaves me stressed, depressed, and haggard as days go by.

I’ve been working for more than a decade already, and deep inside, I want to take some rest. But if I stop, where will I get the funds to sustain everything? That’s the dilemma I face every day.

![collage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eos1in9518G1WxHM4ts9PirkRzWDM9zPv4vXjiDXBQMoeyLYSLCUZzaXF9FWVNJoobd.jpg)

**<u>🌹 A Ray of Hope</u>**

Yesterday, when I urgently needed money for my mother’s medication, one of my trusted friends here on Hive helped me by buying my accumulated Hive and HBD. I won’t mention the name for confidentiality, but you know who you are; **thank you from the bottom of my heart**. Because of you, I was able to send partial funds for my mom’s medication.

This help means the world to me. It reminded me that Hive is not just a platform; it’s a community where kindness and support truly exist. I’m forever grateful to Hive because it gave me a way to access emergency funds when I needed them most.

**<u>🌈 Starting Again</u>**

I’m starting again here, hoping for your support and encouragement. Hive is far different from other social media platforms; it’s a place where real people connect, uplift, and help each other. I’m truly grateful for this community, and I will continue to share my reflections, my journey, and my gratitude.

**Thank you, dear readers, for taking the time to read my reflections.** Your support means more than words can express. Let’s continue to inspire each other, even in the hardest times.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Walmart’s teen hiring pipeline just hit a wall. The big shift isn’t that child labor laws suddenly changed — it’s that stricter enforcement is making a lot of Walmart roles effectively **18+ only**, right as summer job season starts. For a chain that has long been a first stop for teens, that’s a pretty brutal timing problem.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The core issue is the **Fair Labor Standards Act**. Workers under 18 can’t operate or even clean certain power-driven equipment — things like **meat slicers, saws, meat choppers**, and other hazardous machinery. In a modern Walmart, that matters a lot because deli and bakery sections aren’t side businesses anymore; they’re central to how many stores operate.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 That restriction doesn’t stop at the deli counter. The same rules also block teens from using larger equipment such as **forklifts, skid-steers, and cherry pickers**. Put plainly: once you remove access to key tools across deli, bakery, stocking, and back-room logistics, a huge chunk of store labor becomes off-limits to minors. That’s why this looks less like a minor compliance tweak and more like a hiring model change.
title.author: askrafiki

title.author: sarangzg7

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article also frames this inside a wider labor squeeze. Parts of **Southern California** are heading into another **minimum wage increase in July**, with some areas moving above **$18/hour**. At the same time, employers are under more pressure to follow labor rules because of California’s **2024 PAGA reforms**. So Walmart is dealing with compliance pressure on one side and rising labor costs on the other. Not exactly a relaxing quarter.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Wall Street’s ugliest scandal just got uglier: a JPMorgan executive is now suing her accuser for defamation, saying the whole “sex slave” story was a malicious fabrication built to torch her career and pressure the bank into paying millions. That flips this from a shocking misconduct case into a brutal fight over who weaponized the legal system.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Lorna Hajdini’s lawsuit says Chirayu Rana ran a months-long smear campaign against her in the workplace, with third parties, in the press, and in court. Her filing flatly denies every allegation of abuse, racism, and sexual misconduct, and argues the claims were invented for “personal enrichment” — bluntly, to wreck her name and extract money from her and JPMorgan.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The article leans heavily on details meant to undermine Rana’s credibility. It says JPMorgan’s internal investigation found no evidence supporting his allegations, and claims Rana refused to participate or provide proof. It also repeats prior reporting that Rana lied about his father dying to get bereavement leave — except his father was later found alive. That’s the kind of detail that doesn’t just look bad; it poisons trust fast.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Hajdini’s side also attacks the mechanics of Rana’s original case. One of his key claims was that she controlled his bonus and used that power coercively, but the article says internal HR documents showed she had no authority over his compensation or promotion and that they reported to different managing directors. title.body:

Español

Hay algo de lo que casi nadie habla en terapia, y me atrevo a decir que ni siquiera en muchos espacios de neurodiversidad. La disforia de género ya la conocemos más o menos, pero ¿qué pasa cuando la sensación de no encajar no viene del cuerpo, sino de la propia estructura de pensar, sentir y procesar el mundo?

Eso es, más o menos, lo que llamo disforia de neurotipo.

No es un diagnóstico oficial. No viene en el DSM. Pero como psicólogo que atiende a personas autistas, con TDAH, altas capacidades o simplemente con cerebros que funcionan distinto, la veo todos los días. Y duele.

Duele cuando intentas explicar algo sencillo –como que el ruido de fondo te hace imposible pensar– y te responden \

. Duele cuando te fuerzas a hacer contacto visual hasta que te duele la cara. Duele cuando te das cuenta de que has estado enmascarando tanto tiempo que ya no sabes qué era realmente tuyo y qué era un personaje para que no te rechazaran.

Esa incomodidad constante, esa sensación de ser un alien en tu propia cultura, no es solo estrés. Es disforia. Es el desajuste profundo entre tu forma natural de funcionar y un mundo construido por y para mentes neurotípicas.

Y ojo, no digo que lo neurotípico esté mal. Digo que lo neurodivergente no es inferior, pero el entorno te lo hace sentir así cada día.

Lo paradójico es que muchos pacientes llegan diciendo \

, y lo dicen como si fuera un defecto. Cuando empezamos a desmontar eso, aparece el alivio. Pero antes del alivio, tiene que pasar por el duelo. Duelo por el niño o la niña que fue castigado por estimularse. Duelo por el adolescente que se odiaba por no poder ser \

.

La disforia de neurotipo también se parece a la experiencia de ser zurdo en un mundo de diestros, pero llevado al extremo: no es solo el lápiz, es la forma de amar, de descansar, de trabajar, de divertirse. Todo está al revés.



Lo más bonito –y más jodido– es que cuando logras rodearte de otras mentes divergentes, la disforia baja. Porque de repente no tienes que traducirte todo el tiempo. Dejas de ser \

. Eres simplemente.

Por eso, desde Holos Lotus, invito a que hablemos de esto sin diagnóstico médico de por medio. Se puede sufrir disforia de neurotipo sin ser autista, sin tener TDAH. Basta con que tu cerebro funcione en una frecuencia distinta a la mayoría, y que esa diferencia no sea bien recibida.

Si alguna vez sentiste que naciste en el planeta equivocado, pero no por el cuerpo sino por cómo piensas, bienvenidx. De eso va esto.

Comparte tu experiencia o cómo reconoces esa disforia en ti o en alguien cercano. Nos leemos.

English

Title: Neurotype dysphoria – when your brain doesn't fit in a neurotypical world

(Image 1 suggested: a person sitting in front of a broken mirror, each fragment showing a different version of themselves, with abstract blue and orange backgrounds. Feeling of fragmentation and searching.)

There's something almost nobody talks about in therapy, and I dare say not even in many neurodiversity spaces. Gender dysphoria is relatively well known, but what happens when the feeling of not belonging doesn't come from your body, but from the very structure of how you think, feel, and process the world?

That is, more or less, what I call neurotype dysphoria.

It's not an official diagnosis. It's not in the DSM. But as a psychologist who works with autistic people, ADHDers, highly gifted individuals, or simply brains that work differently, I see it every day. And it hurts.

It hurts when you try to explain something simple –like background noise making it impossible for you to think– and they answer \

It hurts when you force yourself to make eye contact until your face aches. It hurts when you realize you've been masking for so long that you no longer know what was truly yours and what was a character you created so people wouldn't reject you.

That constant discomfort, that feeling of being an alien in your own culture, isn't just stress. It's dysphoria. It's the deep mismatch between your natural way of functioning and a world built by and for neurotypical minds.

And don't get me wrong: I'm not saying being neurotypical is bad. I'm saying being neurodivergent isn't inferior, but the environment makes you feel that way every single day.

The paradox is that many patients come in saying \

and they say it as if it were a flaw. When we start breaking that down, relief appears. But before relief, there has to be grieving. Grieving for the child who was punished for stimming. Grieving for the teenager who hated themselves for not being able to be \

Neurotype dysphoria also resembles being left-handed in a right-handed world, but taken to the extreme: it's not just the pencil, it's how you love, how you rest, how you work, how you have fun. Everything is backwards.



The most beautiful –and the most painful– thing is that when you manage to surround yourself with other divergent minds, dysphoria decreases. Because suddenly you don't have to translate yourself all the time. You stop being \

You just are.

That's why, from Holos Lotus, I invite you to talk about this without a medical diagnosis as a requirement. You can suffer from neurotype dysphoria without being autistic, without having ADHD. It's enough that your brain works on a different frequency from the majority, and that difference isn't well received.

If you've ever felt like you were born on the wrong planet, but not because of your body –because of how you think–, welcome. That's what this is about.

Share your experience or how you recognize this dysphoria in yourself or someone close to you. See you in the comments.

Does not a sphere have three dimensions?  Starting from the center and imagining straight lines proceeding therefrom to the surface of the sphere, lines drawn in the three spatial directions that cross the center of the sphere can characterize the sphere in Cartesian coordinates.  The arc of the surface of the sphere is easily described between these points by geometrical formulae.  

There is no conflict between circular physical phenomena and Cartesian coordinates.  The issue is that the moon does not circle the Earth in it's orbit, because the Earth is not stationary, but is traveling in it's orbit around the sun, which is traveling it it's orbit around the Milky Way galaxy.  The actual path traveled by the moon is a reason defying wriggle in terms of absolute Cartesian coordinates.  

Of course, there are no absolute Cartesian coordinates, because everything only exists in relationship to everything else, and the closer something is the more relationship between them is influential.  Neat thing about gravity is that it isn't a force.  It doesn't take any time to reach out between massive bodies and affect them, like light or electricity does.  Gravity is simply the shape of spacetime, and the effect of mass distorting spacetime doesn't travel, because the shape of something doesn't travel.  

If you hit a rock with a hammer and break it, how long does it take the shape of the rock to reach the rock?  It takes no time at all, because the shape of the rock is the rock.  Gravity is the same way.  The shape of spacetime doesn't have to reach anything, so it doesn't take any time to affect mass that is embedded in it.  

Hope that helps.

## Welcome to the Weekly Writing Prompt from The Ink Well
We provide *one weekly writing prompt* for short story writers. You may choose to use the prompt to write a fictional story (made up from your imagination) or a creative nonfiction story (based on your real life experiences). 

**IMPORTANT**: To be considered for curation, you *must* include one of these tags on your post:
* Fictional stories: #fiction
* Creative nonfiction stories: #creativenonfiction

You must also read and comment on the work of two other community members. Remember: We look for this when we curate your story. If we don't see this engagement, we will provide a reminder.

It is also *very* helpful to the admin team when authors add Fiction or Creative Nonfiction (or CNF for short) to the story title!

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)


### Before You Post in The Ink Well
Be sure to check out our community rules before posting in this community. You can find them at the top of our [home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created). They also appear at the top of a new post window.

Please also check out these additional helpful resources:

* Peruse our collection of great writing resources on everything from character development to how to write dialogue in our [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well). 
* Learn more about creative nonfiction, how it differs from fictional stories, and tips for success in [our post on creative nonfiction tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/creative-nonfiction-what-it-is-and-tips-for-success).
* Remember that we are *always* about quality first. Never about *quantity.* To achieve awards in The Ink Well, take the time to write quality stories and check them for errors. See the topic of the month, \

in the [March 2025 newsletter](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-walking-alone-on-a-field-in-dense-fog-16254468/) to learn about using tools (and using them properly) if you are not already doing this. **We do notice when you don't take the time!**

## Last Week's Winning Story of the Week

Thank you to everyone who shared a story for the last prompt, \

!

Each week we pick one of our favorite stories of the week and award the author 5 Hive. 

And we have a winner! Congrats to @marsdave for his story [*Room 17*](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@marsdave/room-17-fiction-7a5). 

Here's what our curators had to say:

> @marsdave tells a story that captures not only the challenges of one young person, but that also manages to transcend the individual experience to the universal. His protagonist rents one room in a large rooming house. This rental is almost symbolic, because all around him people are struggling with their separate issues. In a way, Marsdave's building becomes a Ship of Fools, everyone moving together living, trying to survive. The story is well told. It has a strong arc and it introduces interesting characters.    

Congratulations, @marsdave!

## Short Story Writing Prompt of the Week

This week's prompt is: \
\n\nHave you ever needed to return something, but could not find the receipt to prove that you purchased it? That is one interpretation of the \

prompt... but there are many more.

Think of a receipt as proof. It is physical evidence, perhaps even  important in a criminal investigation. A receipt shows the place and time something was purchased, for example. It shows intent. It demonstrates financial resources for purchasing something, which could have many possible meanings or explanations. Did the person who purchased the item(s) on the receipt come by those resources honestly?

Here are a few \

story ideas from ChatGPT:
* **Fiction**: 
** Tell the story of a crumpled grocery receipt found in a coat pocket and what it reveals about the past... for example, that a missing father had secretly been buying birthday cakes for years after leaving his family... or a lover who seems to have lost interest has actually been intending to propose marriage.
** Write a mystery or literary story in which a single receipt tucked into a wallet could unravel an alibi, expose an affair, or reveal where a character really was on an important night. 

* **Creative nonfiction**: 
** Reflect on discovering old receipts after a parent’s or other loved one's death and realizing how ordinary purchases, such as medicine, coffee, and cheap flowers, quietly documented a life of sacrifice and routine.
** Tell the story of how receipts were managed in your household. For example, you could describe growing up in a household where receipts were never thrown away because they represented accountability, debt, or fear of losing what little the family had. The receipt becomes more than paper — it represents security, love, fear or hope. 


Tell us a story — whether it's your own creative nonfiction story about how a receipt (or lack of one) impacted you, or a fictional story about a character whose life is heavily impacted in a situation having to do with a receipt.

As always, you do not need to actually use the prompt word(s). They are here to inspire your creativity!

We look forward to reading the product of your imagination or your personal experience! 

Good luck! And of course, you are welcome to use AI to generate ideas and images, but the writing must be *your own*! We do not accept stories that are AI-generated or heavily edited by AI. Only use tools like Grammarly to fix spelling and grammar issues.

Remember, as always, we are looking for the elements of *story*. These include: 

* Great first lines
* Good settings
* Well-developed characters
* Integration of action, dialogue and narrative
* A conflict that intrigues the reader
* A \

which results in the resolution of the conflict and brings the story to a satisfying conclusion
* And of course, we are looking for well-edited stories that are not littered with typos or grammatical errors — please use the free Grammarly tool for grammar and spelling checks (and not AI writing or rephrasing tools for revising)

You can find more on all of these topics in the [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well).

title.body: 3/5 🧵 That boardroom conflict matters because of what came next. In **December 2024**, Isak died after falling down a **320-foot ravine** in Catalonia while hiking with Jonathan — a hike Jonathan had allegedly proposed. At the time, Isak was reportedly considering changes to his will to create a charitable foundation, which adds another layer of tension around inheritance, control, and motive.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 After Isak’s death, Mango’s control structure became a major detail. The company is now run by **Toni Ruiz**, described here as Isak’s trusted lieutenant, with a **5% stake**. Meanwhile, Jonathan and his sisters inherited the remaining **95%**. So this isn’t just a family drama — it’s a battle sitting on top of a multibillion-dollar corporate empire.

今天是5月20日，不知道从哪一年开始，每年的这个520和521也被国人们当成了第三个情人节。
 
以前是2月14白色情人节，然后什么中国传统的七夕也是一个情人节。后来也不知道是商家为了宣传还是干嘛的，把每年的5月20号也当成一个情人节。
 
今天和往常一样起来，结果没想到收到了老公的一个小礼物，是一个小惊喜。我一看大概就是一个黄金饰品的一个首饰和包装袋。我以为他又要买那种傻大笨粗的送给我，然后我一想到现在的金价，一千来块钱也不便宜，正准备责备他说又乱花钱。不过我忍住了没有先说出来。
 
然后把首饰盒打开，发现里面是一枚千足金做的小铜钱的项链挂饰。然后我再仔细一看，正面和反面除了写了招财进宝之外，居然还刻了我和他的名字，也不是大名，就是刻的那种小名。咦，我顿时眼前一亮，觉得这个男臭男人还挺用心的。顿时心里还挺高兴的，这个东西虽然小，也花不了几个钱，但是我觉得他起码心里还有你。
 
于是我喜滋滋的把这个吊坠项链戴在脖子上就去上班了。然后今天上班的时候，公司有两个女同事，年轻一点的那种，就是20来岁刚结婚一两年那种，收到了她们老公的鲜花之类的，她们也是很开心。
 
其实我觉得过不过情人节都无所谓，只要平时你的伴侣时时刻刻能把你放在心上，心里有你。这比什么都重要，对吧？

title.title: Walking through the Afferdense Duinen
title.body:
# The Afferdense Duinen
Last weekend we had a family weekend in the eastern part of The Netherlands. Our youngest daughter had an international dancing tournament just across the border in Germany, so we decided to stay on a campsite in the area. 
Apart from the tournament there was time enough to explore the area. I had brought my bicycle, but because of the rainy weather I couldn't go for a ride. That's why I decided to explore the beautiful Afferdense Duinen next to the campsite on foot. Between the showers I left the campsite and walked straight into the forest. The weather was far from perfect, but that actually made the landscape even more interesting an refreshing.

![plas.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23zbHfftprWa8T1Xu5uCxuA1Lbb49pRzcuSkDQuv4LwfnwTLqvmieDrDbnDwPm6j4UKtw.png)

The trails were full of puddles after days of rain. The wet forest had a calm atmosphere and everything smelled fresh and earthy.

![regen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wMYHsd7qW4cs7eLxDkgUSqerzFYsCoqMNy4ZvaikuoJuifG86aZ5oa3e5XW5quXBqGb.png)

It was quite a dense forest with a lot of trees and a beautiful mossy forest floor.

![bos.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23wgHL88pzzqrJWp1pyvWA21W8Dy5SVrdRwyxaJvanfrUzq2fpcoRur1r4u54d4niG6HM.png)

After leaving the forest behind, I suddenly reached a more open area with wide views over the heathland. On top op a small hill I spotted an observation tower.

![toren.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/242hUVcuoTmE96E7X1UzX43FiScMVnLLXxQAr9RZd6NmD1zr1pM5PYk8ThxFqZNLkeibc.png)

I climbed the observation tower to get a better view of the area. 

![trap.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23uQto9bftr24CK9aQBVrsW3Q612hitMWYRypHMANZRWAQiJXAmFY1E7GrBNRopXUYYbY.png)

It gave me a nice view over the area. You can see the dunes with heather in the front and the forest stretching out in the back.

![view.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/244xshenjmXAoGn9gcQUc2F8jbphcr4QHG2wuvmExwhAgemsfD1tdDPC5kYTDV7zXX4B3.png)

After walking down I continued my walk over the open area.

![heide.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/243fkQ5r7Y824kFe4F6QsYBnxxYr6RDmYaSG3Vri9GPBjCbRwq9FPAiDzSDRHrjXzJiak.png)


A flock of sheep was peacefully grazing across the heath. In open heather areas like this nature reserve managers often use sheep to prevent trees from growing in this area. The sheep eat small plants, but not the heather. 

![schapen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/242DC11dcDWNJctxAbPAt3KyTGzPj19E6EAixVZ8Czmz6thSSoijv7Eg3HwwinzonJEMH.png)


![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)


I really enjoyed this walk through the Afferdense Duinen. Despite the wet conditions, this was a wonderful place for a walk. The combination of forestand the dunes made it very diverse. 
And nature is so fresh after some rain showers...

Thanks for reading and feel free to share your opinions in the comments.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Amos Ferrier survived combat and spent years helping other veterans rebuild their lives — and was killed over a bag stolen from his truck. That’s the part that punches you in the throat. The story isn’t just about a crime. It’s about how absurdly fast ordinary theft can turn fatal.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Ferrier, 38, was at Rick’s Coffee Bar in Minneapolis on Friday afternoon when he saw people going into his pickup and taking his bag. He ran outside to stop them. When the suspects got into their car to flee, he jumped onto the hood to try to keep them from escaping. They drove about a block with him clinging on before he was thrown off and hit his head on the pavement.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 Police found him unconscious and rushed him to Hennepin County Medical Center. He underwent emergency brain surgery but never regained consciousness, and he died Sunday. Two suspects — Riniyah Allen, 19, and Jalaya Frost, 18 — were later arrested and booked on suspicion of first-degree murder. The case is still under active investigation.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 What makes this hit harder is who Ferrier was. He served 15 years in the Army, had multiple deployments to Afghanistan, and was credited with saving lives there. After military service, he worked with **Every Third Saturday**, helping veterans navigate paperwork, claims, benefits, resources, and even suicide prevention efforts. By all accounts, he was the guy who showed up when people needed help.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: Es excelente que la empresa donde trabajas sea tan responsable con la higiene y la calidad de sus más de cincuenta productos. Eso habla muy bien del equipo del que formas parte.
title.author: solorzanot

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The final detail is the one that lingers: Ferrier’s family and colleagues are pushing both **accountability and forgiveness**. They want the suspects prosecuted, but they’re also choosing not to let rage be the whole story. That’s rare, and honestly stronger than vengeance. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/army-veteran-amos-ferrier-killed-after-confronting-suspects-trying-to-steal-from-his-truck-in-minneapolis/)\n\n#threadstorm
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Boston is testing something airports should’ve done years ago: move TSA **away from the airport**. Starting June 1, some Logan passengers can clear security in **Framingham** first, then head in without joining the usual terminal snake pit. That’s the real story here—not convenience theater, but a serious rethink of where screening happens.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The pilot is narrow to start. It’s for **Delta and JetBlue** travelers only, operating **5:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.** The remote checkpoint sits about **25 miles from Logan** in Framingham. Travelers can book a slot from **90 days to 90 minutes before departure**, pay **$9 each way**, and then take a bus leaving roughly **45 minutes before the flight**.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 Why this matters: Logan handles **43M+ passengers a year**, and long TSA lines became a national embarrassment during the recent federal funding mess. The article ties this directly to the **76-day partial shutdown** that ended April 30, when about **50,000 TSA officers missed pay**, more than **480 quit**, and some airports saw **40–50% callout rates**. That’s how you get wait times blowing past **4.5 hours**. Absurd system, predictable result.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 This isn’t just a Logan gimmick. It lines up with **TSA Gold+**, a new public-private screening model meant to give airports more flexibility and keep operations steadier even during federal shutdown chaos. Translation: the government is quietly admitting the old one-size-fits-all checkpoint model is brittle, and airports may need hybrid screening setups to keep travelers moving.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 Bottom line: this is a small pilot with real implications. If the Framingham setup cuts stress, reduces airport crowding, and proves reliable, expect pressure for expansion to more airlines—and probably copycats elsewhere. The airport of the future may start **before** you reach the airport. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/lifestyle/boston-logan-passengers-will-be-able-to-skip-long-tsa-airport-lines-thanks-to-new-checkpoint/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.title: Sushi, un platillo de celebración   🍥 👨‍🎓 Sushi, a celebratory dish
title.body:
>
#
***Una receta para un recuerdo: ¿Qué es una receta ligada a un recuerdo poderoso? Comparte la receta y la historia que hay detrás.***
Veo todas estas imágenes antes de comenzar a escribir y me saca unos cuantos suspiros; eso es lo bonito de captar momentos especiales y guardar esas imágenes para el recuerdo. Y de eso se trata hoy esta publicación que nace de nuestro reto semanal en la comunidad de Silverbloggers. >I look at all these photos before I start writing, and it brings a few sighs to my lips; that’s the beauty of capturing special moments and saving those images as memories. And that’s what today’s post is all about—it stems from our weekly challenge in the Silverbloggers community.
![arroz.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/Eoc8T18oBFsmQ6gkE8i2qk4JnqnDVWqJmub4N79aGYXMq2ks9mhjH8Q39hiCvxLV3nz.png)
#
***Sushi, un platillo de celebración***
Hoy les quiero contar de esta receta ya que me trae muchos recuerdos bonitos que alimentan mi espíritu y llena mi corazón de felicidad. Se trata de la vez que quise aprender hacer Sushi y de como dos personas especiales me apoyaron en el proceso. En enero del 2023 tuve la osadía de adentrarme en un mundo culinario que era completamente desconocido para mí; en ese tiempo iniciaba una de las amistades mas bonitas que he tenido en esta mitad de siglo de mi existencia. >Today I want to tell you about this recipe because it brings back so many beautiful memories that nourish my spirit and fill my heart with happiness. >It’s about the time I wanted to learn how to make sushi and how two special people supported me through the process. In January 2023, I had the audacity to venture into a culinary world that was completely unknown to me; at that time, I was beginning one of the most beautiful friendships I’ve had in this half-century of my life.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23vhyiiwktRESPpyJBQvmq1RfK9fcvn1BVewT4qnUzHCLZYZ7iAFbgpH4xAPfgHDaAMJJ.png)
Noraida es el nombre de esta mujer que me ha brindado una amistad bonita, sencilla, sincera, con su humildad ha sabido conquistar mi corazón y el de mi familia. Esa amistad comenzó en medio de la pandemia cuando todos buscábamos actividades que realizar mientras el mundo volvía a la normalidad, yo hacia caminatas con dos amigas hacia las montañas del Ávila y ella mostro interés en aquello que hacíamos cada tarde y se unió al grupo, yo solo la conocía de vista, pero luego fue naciendo una bonita amistad que se ha mantenido ya por unos cuantos años. >Noraida is the name of this woman who has given me a beautiful, simple, and sincere friendship; with her humility, she has won over my heart and that of my family. That friendship began in the midst of the pandemic when we were all looking for things to do as the world returned to normal. I used to go hiking with two friends in the Ávila mountains, and she showed interest in what we were doing every afternoon and joined the group. I only knew her by sight at first, but then a beautiful friendship blossomed that has lasted for several years now.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23uQtb6gaWdt2Y8qaBdGgZ2bgawaAg8v9rX5zpby3bqCsi6ac4mpRxKeqLNjbcPcZTVZL.png)
Mujeres al fin, mientras caminábamos hablábamos de comida, la casa, los hijos, nuestros sueños e inquietudes. Ella nos contaba de como su hijo y la novia hacían Sushi casi todas las noches y de lo fácil que era hacer este platillo. De inmediato mostré mi interés y ella con su buena disposición hizo los arreglos para que Michel y Junior me enseñaran. >Finally, as we walked, we talked about food, home, our children, our dreams, and our concerns. She told us how her son and his girlfriend made sushi almost every night and how easy it was to prepare this dish. I immediately showed interest, and she kindly arranged for Michel and Junior to teach me.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23wX1U8hu1TyU6aiXoWDxy2XrjGtMBKS68vujBdeWeccJhs4kS24b7FgXNJrdx1pawFJ8.png)
Mi profesora de Sushi
La verdad fue una experiencia maravillosa, no solo aprendí lo básico, sino que pude replicar mis conocimientos para llevarlos a otro evento especial en mi vida. >It was truly a wonderful experience; not only did I learn the basics, but I was able to put my new skills to use for another special event in my life.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/Eoc67NMFyTqeu5dX4UGn49VUG58T1YzXYGuUe6KQbBeHw6TN1Xv1ZUsG2cYbVhCmUkW.png)
# La graduación de mi hijo Israel Luego de haber aprendido hacer Sushi en el mes de enero tenía pendiente la graduación de mi hijo mayor en la universidad y como toda madre que ama a sus hijos le gusta celebrar, aunque sea con algo sencillo. # My son Israel’s graduation >After learning how to make sushi in January, my eldest son’s college graduation was coming up, and like any mother who loves her children, I wanted to celebrate—even if it was just something simple.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/EoeGQ7ez72H25bE8T8nY98LVJJ5rbE17N36WLezD7kp38tMvMXjQ9C71tz7oYkdSLHY.png)
El día antes del evento nos fuimos a Caracas con mi amiga Noraida quien se puso a la orden para acompañarme y guiarme en las compras y así evitar que comprara cosas sin necesidad que fueran alterar el presupuesto. Al día siguiente todos nos fuimos al acto, luego pasamos por un restaurant de Sushi y por la noche invite a varios amigos quienes celebraron conmigo ese momento único y especial. >The day before the event, we went to Caracas with my friend Noraida, who offered to accompany me and help me with the shopping so I wouldn’t buy unnecessary things that would blow the budget. >The next day, we all went to the ceremony, then stopped by a sushi restaurant, and that night I invited several friends over to celebrate that unique and special moment with me.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/EoGxRVECGJJv3PtSHTpkXT6zVZcYqFhSt8VD4cKQFai6tu1u4KrYq4P96XZnJK6CPrm.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23tvbtbA8VQaRLESZ6GMYAvZg1dsP97LtRFYnQQmfoHf7vMn6a8nQVjzApF7CVJvuq2Du.png)
Ellos no se podían creer que yo estaba haciendo Sushi y hablaban del sabor tan rico que tenía. La verdad es que todo eso me llenaba de orgullo, me emocionaba y me inspiraba para seguir haciéndolo. >They couldn’t believe I was making sushi and raved about how delicious it tasted. The truth is, all of that filled me with pride, moved me, and inspired me to keep doing it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23vsQY7DBN7ovvdLUkbgCDffqq3dB5FEQEH1ZZyGFStc4uQXFcCfirpLWu4S9oAeapSJE.png)
Aquí no vengo hablar de costos, ni nada de eso porque ya todos sabemos que el Sushi no es muy barato que digamos; aquí lo que importa es que esa receta tan especial ira siempre ligada con el recuerdo de ver a mi hijo graduado, triunfando, escalando un peldaño mas y por eso pido a Dios que lo siga guiando y lo siga acompañando para que siga cosechando mas logros en su vida. >I’m not here to talk about costs or anything like that because we all know that sushi isn’t exactly cheap; what matters here is that this very special recipe will always be linked to the memory of seeing my son graduate, succeed, and take another step forward, and that’s why I ask God to continue guiding him and walking with him so that he can keep achieving more in his life. --- #

> I had intended to share some of these photos with you over a week ago, but the power had other plans for me. In fact, I don’t even remember what I had written in that draft post anymore, since everything was lost in the process. But here I am again, and perhaps what happened was meant to be, because yesterday I ran into this little friend, this time in the middle of what would have been her breakfast—it was 7:00 a.m. when I found her on the coral tree, devouring a succulent bee.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fmbs25/23wgN4UUnLSix28tyFUUpk7tCRrRwaBNAzmioY5twCBu33PSSDk1k3DRbgyPRST8ncz3S.jpeg


The thing is, a little over three weeks ago, we found this green lynx spider on the “tree of happiness,” or Brazilian throne tree, while we were cutting some of its branches. We had decided to revamp the garden, and to make room, we had to prune some plants. At the time, I thought it was going to disappear from the garden, since we had destroyed what was essentially its home. In fact, for a moment I thought we’d killed it, because when one of the cut branches fell, it was on that very branch. But that’s not how the story went, and I realized that yesterday.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fmbs25/23xVKHup5x2VT9zbHtnBrY31HyYGpgqrd72bKuFNxVSxzeUnKNWmrQdNuw526QoQo7efr.jpeg


My son is terrified of spiders, but he loves it when I take pictures of them and enjoys reading about them or watching videos about them. So, on the two occasions we’ve encountered them, he’s been the one to call me over to take pictures, because he tells me he’s curious to see them up close—but he prefers to do that through photos rather than in person, hahaha. Yeah, I know, he’s a coward, hahaha.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fmbs25/23w2aXrtvvm4DMNzfQHnRxhh18eFwEH2EE6CXArpb1RMUHm3ot6teF6ENZuytANFhRHwj.jpeg


This green beauty is a natural pest control agent, which is why I don’t scare it away—unless I read somewhere that it lays 500 eggs at a time, as happened with the tiger spider. Believe me, they’re beautiful, and I love seeing them in the garden, but every time I see a female devouring the male, I scare them away. It really gets to me seeing that pile of little spiders scattered around the garden, and even more so, the huge amount of webs they spin.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fmbs25/23vsDeYBjR49MMU9PfX8PAfB8xeqzWdM8gC4tDZhLxktmAt5z8qUugw5SsdGCHv1rCbQk.jpeg


Okay, let's continue with the Green Lynx (Peucetia viridans). They love tropical climates, and with the heat we're currently experiencing in these latitudes, I think it's the perfect climate for them. A few months ago, I found a small lesser green lynx spider (Peucetia longipalpis), and for a moment I thought it might have been the same one. However, according to the iSeek app, they are not the same species. They are related, certainly, since they are from the same genus, but not the same species. Definitely, the insect world is vast; of that I have no doubt, and just like humans, even though we are related, we are not all the same.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fmbs25/23w2ctiCGWESV6ni4hUaQRNhngkL3LRUTaH7x2Mm1h8KbtRdEnhPZBProz8zoiUrB8udd.jpeg




https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcvVqhGMbF1KAHTn9Wh8FiRhmpAbiEuAKerVM7ugDnXfX/text16.png
Images owned by me, taken with my Redmi Note 14 phone camera, edited with Snapseed.

Thank you for taking the time to read this post, if you have any questions, criticisms or suggestions, please leave them in the comment box, and remember, you too can make magic in the kitchen and wherever you go!



______________________________

[ES]

Ok, continuemos con la Lince Verde (Peucetia viridans), le encantan los climas tropicales, y con el calor que ahora mismo está haciendo por estas latitudes, creo que, es el clima perfecto para ellas, hace unos cuantos meses me encontré una pequeña araña lince verde menor (Peucetia longipalpis) y por un momento pensé que esta podría haber sido la misma, sin embargo, según la aplicación de iSeek, no son la misma especie, familiares, sin dudas, pues son del mismo género, pero no las mismas especies, definitivamente, el mundo de los insectos, es basto, de eso no me queda dudas, y tal como los humanos, aunque seamos familia, no somos todos iguales.
