title.title: Potawatomi Zoo
title.body:
Hiya!

This post is about my 2026 visit to Potawatomi Zoo, located in South Bend, Indiana. South Bend is 2.5 hours north of Indianapolis and is near the border to Michigan. It is best known for being the home of the University of Notre Dame. In the past few years it was also in the news since Pete Buttigieg, the former Secretary of Transportation (2021 - 2024) was the mayor of South Bend (2012 - 2020).

If you are interested in other tourist sites in Indiana you should also check out:

G1: [Fort Wayne Zoo](https://peakd.com/travel/@byzantinecat/fort-wayne-zoo)

G2: Potawatomi Zoo (this post)

along with my backlog which includes:

- Raclin Murphy Museum of Art in South Bend at Notre Dame University
- Indianapolis Zoo
- Indianapolis Museum of Art, Virginia B. Fairbanks Art & Nature Park, and Holcomb Observatory
- Garfield Park Conservatory
- Eiteljorg Museum
- Kurt Vonnegut Museum
- Crispus Attucks Museum

All of the pictures in this post were taken by me except for the map of the zoo. If you want to use any of my photos, please contact me to first obtain permission.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**POTAWATOMI ZOO**

500 S. Greenlawn Ave
South Bend, IN 46615

**Website:** https://potawatomizoo.org/

**Hours:**

Spring Hours: 10 AM – 5 PM
Last entry 4:30 PM

June 1 – August 31: 10 AM – 7 PM
Last entry 6 PM

Fall Hours: 10 AM – 5 PM
Last entry 4:30 PM

**Cost (as of 2026):**

$16 General admission for ages 15 - 61.

$14 General admission for children 3 - 14 and adults 62+.

FREE General admission for Zoo Members & children 2 years and under.

Free admission on Children's Day to children 14 years and under.

Parking is free.

Potawatomi Zoo participates in the AZA Reciprocity program at the 50% rate. Members of all other participating zoos (whether those zoos participate at 50% or 100%) get 50% off the admission rate at Potawatomi Zoo. And Potawatomi Zoo members get 50% off the admission of all participating zoos (regardless of whether that zoo participates at 50% or 100%).

Since I was a member of Buttonwood Park Zoo, I got 50% off admission so I only had to pay $8 instead of the full $16.

**Estimated Time:** 2 hours

You can easily get through the medium-sized zoo in 2 hours. I spent 2.5 hours because I stayed for the Andean Bear Keeper Chat and circled back to visit the red pandas an additional time and to see some animals (e.g. snow leopard) that I missed on my first trip through.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**SUMMARY**

![20260425_130644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/Ep3dGz7HLAJSFd2gebcFCvBj8y5KzHAae1PvunU7KohojavPQfawHQg38q1TCHLuFrF.jpg)

![Potawatomi Zoo 2025 Map.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/23xAppGJKnKuGPdBdCqcHXTjU1uF9nLqwAb7bD6qpHevCQtEqMuvnRftWNa9Mrjmnud8Z.jpg)

Potawatomi Zoo is a medium-size zoo in South Bend, IN. I would rate it as an average, reasonably priced, 2-star zoo of which the main attractions are the red pandas and Andean bears. There is also a really good Learning Center tucked away near the entrance with a lot of cute critters (sand cats, fennec foxes, two-toed sloth).

The zoo holds two different Keeper Chats a day, which vary depending on the day of the week:

![20260425_104223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/23wqpjezwFS7RrFMhJ2BS4ciRJZJ6Rx8i98C3bBXhq8d71gGkRr7WT3q4dgde3tkeR5kv.jpg)

I attended the Andean Bear Chat, which was educational - the keeper talked about the history of the various 3 Andean bears and their habits. Despite spending 2.5 hours at the zoo, there wasn't enough content to keep me around until the second Keeper Chat of the day.

I was able to see most of the animals on the zoo map. It was apparently too cold for the scarlet macaws, okapi, Chacoan peccaries, North American river otters, and Southern ground hornbill. The zoo's website also shows a red fox, Northern tree shrew, and common genet but I wasn't able to find them. Also absent were many of the animal ambassadors such as the sugar glider, Southern tamandua, three-banded armadillo, lesser hedgehog tenrec, striped skunk, and chinchilla. I got to the zoo early enough to see the red pandas while they were active - they spent the rest of the day sleeping. The lions and snow leopard were also sleeping when I saw them.

Like many other zoos, Potawatomi Zoo has a display of Chinese lanterns from Tianyu Arts & Culture for their Zoo Luminate event. There was a strong aquatic theme for many of their lanterns. While most of the lanterns were fairly average, the most notable ones were a giant blue anglerfish and a blue dragon.

Comparing Potawatomi Zoo to other zoos:

5 stars:

- San Diego Zoo (San Diego, CA)
- Brookfield Zoo (Brookfield, IL)
- Taipei Zoo (Taipei City, Taiwan)

4 stars:

- San Diego Safari Park (San Diego, CA)
- Cincinnati Zoo and Botanical Garden (Cincinnati, OH)
- Oklahoma City Zoo (Oklahoma City, OK)
- Milwaukee County Zoo (Milwaukee, WI)
- Houston Zoo (Houston, TX)
- Oakland Zoo (Oakland, CA)

3 stars:

- Lincoln Park Zoo (Chicago, IL, Free)
- Zoo Atlanta (Atlanta, GA)
- Buttonwood Park Zoo (New Bedford, MA)
- Butterflies of Cape Cod (Bourne, MA)
- International Crane Foundation (Baraboo, WI)
- Henry Vilas Zoo (Madison, WI, Free)
- Indianapolis Zoo (Indianapolis, IN)
- Sacramento Zoo (Sacramento, CA)
- Santa Barbara Zoo (Santa Barbara, CA)
- Fort Worth Zoo (Fort Worth, TX)
- Fort Wayne Zoo (Fort Wayne, IN)

2 stars:

- Audubon Insectarium (New Orleans, LA)
- Audubon Zoo (New Orleans, LA)
- Sarasota Jungle Gardens (Sarasota, FL)
- Save Our Seabirds Wild Bird Learning Center (Sarasota, FL, Free)
- San Francisco Zoo & Gardens (San Francisco, CA)
- Six Flags Discovery Kingdom (Vallejo, CA)
- Franklin Park Zoo (Boston, MA)
- Capron Park Zoo (Attleboro, MA)
- Taylor-Bray Farm (Yarmouth Port, MA, Free)
- Racine Zoo (Racine, WI)
- Ochsner Park Zoo (Baraboo, WI, Free)
- John Ball Zoo (Grand Rapids, MI)
- Potter Park Zoo (Lansing, MI)
- Antalya Zoo (Antalya, Turkey)
- Marine Mammal Center (Sausalito, CA, Free)
- Santa Ana Zoo (Santa Ana, CA)
- San Antonio Zoological Society (San Antonio, TX)
- Cameron Park Zoo (Waco, TX)
- Dallas Zoo (Dallas, TX)
- Caldwell Zoo (Tyler, TX)
- Peoria Zoo (Peoria, IL)
- Miller Park Zoo (Bloomington, IL)
- Scovill Zoo (Decatur, IL)
- **Potawatomi Zoo (South Bend, IN)**

1 star:

- Cosley Zoo (Wheaton, IL)
- Stone Zoo (Stoneham, MA)
- Timbavati Wildlife Park (Wisconsin Dells, WI)
- Binder Park Zoo (Battle Creek, MI)
- Happy Hollow Park & Zoo (San Jose, CA)
- CuriOdyssey (San Mateo, CA)

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**RED PANDAS**

Himalayan Red Panda
*Ailurus fulgens fulgens*

Potawatomi Zoo has two red pandas on display along with a muntjac. The red pandas are Raya, a 5 year old female born at this zoo, and EJ, a relatively new addition who was selected as a mate for Raya by the Red Panda Species Survival Plan. It sounds like Raya's parents (Justin and Maiya) may still be present at the zoo but off-exhibit. Maya's sister Sisu is now at Zoo Knoxville, which I visited recently. In fact, I saw Sisu along with one of her 1 year-old cubs!

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**BEARS**

Andean Bear
*Tremarctos ornatus*
(Located in the Americas)

Potawatomi Zoo is home to 3 Andean bears. Muniri is an older (11 years old) bear, while Ian and Sean are a pair of brothers (4 years old) who came to the zoo two years ago. Historically, the zoo has kept Muniri apart from the brothers since Andean bears are normally solitary but recently, they have started to try introducing the bears to each other. On my visit I only saw Muniri.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Massapequa’s students just pulled off the cleanest kind of rebellion: they turned a routine school art wall into a permanent middle finger to New York’s mascot ban. Their message was dead simple — **“Once a Chief, Always a Chief.”** And the kicker? The mural sits on **private property**, so even if the state wins the mascot fight, this thing likely stays.

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The fight is over New York’s 2023 ban on Native American logos and names in schools. Massapequa High has long been the **Chiefs**, and the state’s pressure campaign boils down to this: rebrand at a cost approaching **$1 million** or risk losing state funding. So this year, instead of painting something cute and forgettable, students used the wall to make a statement about identity, loyalty, and who gets to define their community.

title.title: Climb the Card, Earn the Glory: WOO’s Reward Game Just Leveled Up
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

If there’s one thing that separates a good game from one you keep coming back to every single day, it’s progression that feels meaningful. Not just rewards for the sake of rewards, not just random drops that you forget about five minutes later, but a system where every step forward feels intentional, where you can actually see yourself moving toward something bigger.

That’s exactly the feeling I got when I started digging into how WOO has structured the rewards for this inaugural Battle Pass Season 1.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uFM2ciB4EQKmrafSE4iVh9geFTProNtw6bwP3xk4fgEWzQFdc74GxaRBU5pQbu6XWya.png)

---

### 🎁 Rewards That Actually Feel Like Milestones

* The reward structure is designed to scale progressively, making early levels feel accessible while higher levels feel like something worth chasing.
  
What I really appreciate about this is how it respects both casual and more committed players at the same time. When you first jump into the Battle Pass, the early rewards come in at a steady pace, which immediately gives you that sense of momentum. You’re not stuck grinding endlessly just to see your first payoff. Instead, you’re constantly reminded that you’re progressing. But at the same time, the higher levels clearly hold more valuable rewards, and that creates this natural sense of ambition. You start thinking, “Alright, I’ve made it this far… how much further can I go?” And that mindset shift is powerful, because it keeps you engaged long after the novelty of the system wears off.

* Core WOO items like Gym Bags and Jobber Packs are integrated directly into the reward track, keeping everything connected to the existing gameplay loop.
  
This is something that, as a fan, I think WOO got absolutely right. There’s nothing worse than a new system feeling completely disconnected from the rest of the game like it exists in its own bubble. But here, the rewards are things we already understand, already value, and already use. That familiarity makes the Battle Pass feel like a natural extension of WOO rather than some external feature that was just dropped in. Personally, I find that it makes every reward feel more practical too. You’re not just unlocking something for the sake of unlocking it. You’re getting items that you know will actually impact your gameplay.

* The inclusion of WOO Tokens and WOOBucks adds real economic weight to progression, making the rewards feel meaningful beyond just gameplay.
  
This is where things get really interesting. When progression ties directly into the in-game economy, it changes how you value every level. You’re not just unlocking items but building up resources that can be used strategically over time. And as someone who’s always thinking about how to maximize value in WOO, that adds a whole new layer of decision-making. Do you reinvest? Do you save? Do you use it immediately? It turns progression into something more than just a checklist. It becomes part of your overall strategy.

---

### 📈 The Psychology of Climbing the Battle Pass

* Each level acts as a mini-goal, breaking down the overall progression into manageable, satisfying steps.
  
This might sound simple on paper, but it makes a huge difference in how the system feels in practice. Instead of looking at the Battle Pass as one long grind, you’re constantly hitting these small checkpoints that give you a sense of accomplishment. And from my own experience playing games with similar systems, those small wins add up quickly. They keep you motivated in a way that a single, distant goal never could. It’s the difference between climbing a mountain all at once versus taking it one step at a time.

* The presence of higher-tier rewards creates long-term motivation that extends beyond daily gameplay.
  
What I like about this is that it gives you something to aim for beyond just logging in and completing your daily tasks. There’s always that bigger reward sitting further up the track, almost like a reminder that there’s more waiting for you if you stick with it. And let’s be honest, that’s the kind of thing that keeps players invested over time. You’re not just playing for today; you’re playing for what you *know* is coming if you keep going.

* The system encourages consistency rather than burnout, rewarding players who show up regularly instead of those who grind excessively in one session.
  
This is probably one of the most important design choices in the entire Battle Pass. Not everyone has hours to spend on WOO every day, and systems that demand that kind of commitment can quickly become exhausting. But this approach feels different. It’s more about showing up consistently, doing what you can, and gradually building your progress over time. Personally, I find that much more sustainable, and honestly, much more enjoyable.

---

### 🔄 How This Changes the Way I Approach WOO

* Daily gameplay now feels more purposeful because every action contributes to a larger progression system.
  
Before this update, there were definitely days where I logged in, played a few matches, and didn’t feel like I had accomplished much. But now, even small sessions feel productive. You’re always moving forward, even if it’s just by a little bit. And that changes how you view your time in the game. It’s no longer about how much you did but it’s about the fact that you did something that pushes you closer to your next goal.

* The reward structure creates a stronger connection between effort and outcome.
  
One thing I’ve always appreciated in games is when you can clearly see the results of your effort. The Battle Pass does this really well because it makes progression visible and predictable. You know what you’re working toward, and you know what you’ll get when you reach it. That clarity makes every action feel more meaningful.

* It adds a sense of rhythm to gameplay, turning WOO into something you naturally check in on every day.
  
This might be the biggest change of all. Instead of playing WOO in bursts, it starts to feel like part of your daily routine. And not in a forced way but more like something you want to do because there’s always progress to be made.

---

### 💭 My Personal Take

If I had to sum it up, I’d say this: the Battle Pass reward system doesn’t just give you more, it makes everything you do in WOO feel like it matters more, and as a fan, that’s a big deal. Because at the end of the day, what keeps me coming back to WOO isn’t just the gameplay but the feeling that my time is being rewarded in a meaningful way. That every match, every quest, every login is contributing to something bigger.

This system delivers on that feeling. If this is just the foundation for Season 1, then I can’t help but wonder how much further WOO is going to take this in future seasons. Because if they keep refining and expanding on this structure, we could be looking at a progression system that becomes one of the core pillars of the entire game.

For now though? I’m just enjoying the climb, and for the first time in a while, I’m genuinely excited to see how far I can go.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.body: 3/5 🧵 What makes the story interesting isn’t just politics — it’s ownership. School board president Kerry Wachter says the mural wasn’t handed down by adults; the students **designed it, voted on it, and painted it themselves**. That matters. It lets supporters frame this less as top-down culture war theater and more as a grassroots show of school pride. Students quoted in the piece basically say the same thing: being a “Chief” isn’t just a mascot, it’s how they see belonging — at school and long after graduation.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article also shows how local identity has spilled into a much bigger legal and political battle. Massapequa is already fighting Albany in **state and federal court**, and it has picked up backing from groups like the Native American Guardians Association, plus loud support from national Republican figures including **Donald Trump** and Education Secretary **Linda McMahon**. So this is no longer just about one school nickname — it’s become a proxy war over local tradition, state authority, and what critics call “anti-woke” resistance.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The sharpest point in the piece: even if the state forces the school teams to drop the name, supporters argue the **community branding won’t die**. The “Chiefs” identity is tied to sweatshirts, local symbols, and civic pride beyond the campus itself. That’s why the mural matters — it’s not just paint, it’s a statement that Albany can change official paperwork, but it can’t easily erase a shared identity people have decided to keep alive. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/massapequa-teens-defiantly-paint-huge-lasting-chiefs-mural-it-will-never-go-away/)\n\n#threadstorm

First responders pulled her from the hole and rushed her to **NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell**, where she later died.

title.title: My life is my own
title.body:
Too many stimuli, I can hardly put any thoughts together. 

I feel as if all the mysteries of my history have unraveled in front of me over the past week but I hardly have the brains left to make sense of it all. 

How much of my attention do I owe?

Well, I owe none but that doesn’t mean I could get always get away with giving what I felt ok giving. 

Family and friends feel entitled. They don’t think they need to ask. In the world they grew up in everyone felt privy to the rhythm and inner workings of the ones they loved.  

Everyone thought that everyone wanted the same things as them; that we needed the same things as them. 

It still echoes. 

How is that working out?

Did you manage to hide from your pain, behind the noise of conversation, drowning 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPy1Jjs7rGHegTFLeFegyz4Cxir7DPaDiktAQTu23ERg/img_3057.jpg)
your own heart in the clashing of vibrations?  Did you learn to belong to something that welcomed one half of you and not the other?  Did us vs. them end victoriously?

We all deserve our own sovereignty, and that means sovereignty of mind. It doesn’t mean we can’t belong to a culture, but that culture must be a choice, not a given. 

I can see now how the noise that drowned out my own voice, all the conflicting thoughts that distracted me from my own path, none of it was me. None of it came from me. 

It was the voices of others, desires of others, fear of others. None of it was mine. None of it. 

I don’t have the right to try and change you, nor would I even be able to if I tried. But I know what I came here for now and nothing is going to distract me from that ever again. 

Get on board or get out of the way 🙏

title.title: What a fantastic island Favignana!!
title.body:
![202605200903.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/AKe6urrKZ2MxRWyxAfwLSm32H8aPrNVyAtmKqiAzCfXUuncMbJfGTukUkj3RyE2.jpeg)




Hi guys, I've been a bit absent these days, because I took a few days off and went to visit for the first time, an island that had been recommended to me by a very dear friend of mine, a place that had also been recommended to me by other sportsmen because it is very suitable for cycling, but unfortunately I couldn't bring my bike because I travelled by public transport and it was really difficult to travel by bike, at least unfortunately in Italy it is like that.



![701325238_4021195664847438_3281250419479727386_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/ALEXCmPDRiC5QwqK3WK8GLis62Z87R59iM5n1r26w2bgmsvnjQ4tChUDhp6MHYY.jpg)


For the first time I managed to visit Favignana, which is the largest of the Egadi Islands and is located in the western part of Sicily, let's say as a point in front of Trapani, and in reality I had already seen some photos from my friends who had been here precisely because this place is famous for its beautiful transparent sea and these slightly rocky coves which are very spectacular.


![701480732_4021195281514143_4353489570629528699_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/AKSb5kQXA7Ez6d3SWN9KnZqxrHuvP8m1hkEAqq6MZaHNuEixxsFFrNufuMHnuBW.jpg)

So a few weeks ago I said to myself Why not take a trip there? Unfortunately, as I told you, I couldn't bring my bike because it was very difficult to travel by train, and I took advantage of it. Fortunately, there are many cycle-tourist itineraries here. And unfortunately I forgot to take a photo of the map that explained all the routes on the island, which are very interesting. I decided to rent an electric bike to explore the various itineraries on the island, and I can truly say that there are some truly beautiful and breathtaking views.


![701696630_4021195054847499_67880375476128078_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/AKU2xsGzp84PePL8x6G4gqqPWgzcGbuTVtXWgqcxW3iSmk7tqMBnqvncHnvFG9k.jpg)

Here I shared some photos that I took during my stay, but it is difficult to convey the beauty of these places through a simple photo, I recommend you come and take a holiday here, among other things it was very beautiful in this period probably being a little lower season that I found few people and a good climate is quite warm, let's say not that suffocating heat that is normal in Sicily, in my opinion it is very beautiful because there is that very authentic and relaxed atmosphere, However I also arrived with the hydrofoil in about 30 minutes.


![702353993_4021194738180864_8425569082622497287_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/AJJZz2iUKNxWGmQjZwjjagWLNesgSJGnvYpdjZCEMv2DGGkBf2CyWKnHTGQB4r1.jpg)

I can really say that I really liked the island, I was impressed by the colour of the water which seems truly perfect, and in the photo if you look closely you can also see the various tuff quarries where tuff was once extracted. I also managed to do a bit of snorkelling which is one of the main activities that can be done on this island, I absolutely recommend it, we'll see you in the next post, see you soon!

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A prom photo op turning into a public-funds scandal is already absurd. The real story is worse: this wasn’t just about a flashy helicopter backdrop — it may have involved a taxpayer-funded card, a self-approved event, and a helicopter dropping into a park near kids and homes like basic safety rules were optional.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The core accusation is simple: Quintina Brown, head of the Markham Park District, is accused of using a park district credit card to help secure a helicopter for her 17-year-old daughter’s prom shoot. The invoice reportedly listed “Markham Parks” as the customer, used the district’s fieldhouse address, and included Brown’s signature. City officials said at least the deposit was tied to a taxpayer-funded card, though Brown denies that and says she used her own card.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The money angle is only half of it. The helicopter reportedly landed at Roesner Park on May 8 without proper permitting, and police said it flew “alarmingly” low near an active basketball court, playground area, residential homes, and the park district facility. Officials described kids running from the area when it came down. If that account is accurate, this wasn’t just tacky — it was reckless.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The oversight failure jumps off the page. Brown allegedly signed the only written approval herself, which is a hell of a way to handle public property use when you’re also the beneficiary of the decision. Markham’s mayor hammered the lack of governance, saying proper helicopter landings normally require notice, spotters, emergency personnel, and safety distance. In short: the issue isn’t just “did she pay personally?” but “who authorized this circus and why was it allowed?”
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 Where it stands now: Brown and the pilot were cited for disorderly conduct and unauthorized landing on public property. Brown says there were no children nearby, says she didn’t know any ordinance was violated, and says she doesn’t regret doing it because her daughter got the experience she wanted. That’s probably the clearest summary of the whole mess: public office treated like a personal event-planning service until it blew up. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/illinois-park-boss-quintina-brown-accused-of-using-taxpayer-funded-card-for-daughters-helicopter-prom-stunt/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.title: Un día en la vida de Eli | Paz Mental
title.body:
![1000980350.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23x17K7D7YtBcpLARNNN6XwxM4N9XpuKTFmy1z7cj44AXshZSS2XVRYvc52biKoVjGSCy.png)
---
Siempre digo que la Paz Mental es muy importante, aunque a veces cuesta conseguirla del todo, más aún en un mundo donde los tiempos son acelerados, el ritmo del trabajo es fuerte y las cargas siempre están presentes en la mente. Pero mientras se pueda, hay que procurar tenerla. Inicio con esto, porque por casi 9 años viví en un sector donde la bulla, el chisme, los escándalos, el bingo y otros vicios, robaban mucho mi paz mental y la de mi familia. Nuestra casa nos hacía sentir cómodos, estabamos bien y seguros, ya nos habíamos adaptado a ella, pero habían cosas externas que nos afectaban muchísimo. A veces teníamos que cerrar los ventanales para que no entrará tanta bulla de afuera, para evitar que subiera el olor y humo de la Marihuana o cigarrillo 🫠. Realmente eso y más, nos llevó a estar molestos, a irritar a los niños y lo único que pensábamos era en que teníamos que mudarnos. Mudarnos era la solución, pero solo pensábamos en ello. A mi me cuesta mucho cambiar de lugar, mudarme es un trauma de mi infancia, por las muchas veces que nos mudamos cuando era niña. Me gusta la estabilidad. Algo que nos tenía más incómodos era que casi todas las noches los vecinos de al frente jugaban Bingo hasta la media noche y colocan antes, durante y después música (si es que se le puede llamar así) a todo volúmen y no, nadie podía decirles nada porque son familia de Policía y pelioneros. Entonces, de un momento a otro dijimos: Este año nos tenemos que mudar si o si. Y así fue, tenemos ya 2 meses y algo más viviendo en otro lugar, con una buena vista y el sonido solo de los pájaros en la mañana, y a lo lejos de algunos motores de los vehículos que pasan. ![1000970013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23zGW8raY9Mx1dGVvb52G7zmVGHmkq5zQjCNGMXqJyKrSDPWFCbu5GPjUvHaJBt1ywUSH.jpg) Vivimos frente a un parque, así que podemos ver los árboles, el parque, las montañas y la neblina caer en la mañana. En las mañanas y noches es una vista hermosa. Y como estabamos aún en inviernos, las hojas de los árboles se ven vivas, con un verde intenso. Los niños pueden bajar a jugar en el parque, ya que solo es bajar y cruzar la calle. También atraviesan el parque para ir al colegio y aprovechamos la sombra que dan los árboles en el día.
![1000970015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/242NeoZpazaTpvfjTVSxAWkwJG46wUfxb6xpG6NSGoj9r3AqCP5qmxv1FNuj8XHT3aneg.jpg) ![1000970016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/2449yz1aEW5tU2fjkhEwLfmznWJB4YTh24e3QAazXwHBfSz1yyJLxEQriMKy87HFpy8fk.jpg)
|![1000957765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xek6gNhigKdH3J1nu3dt1yPeTLj1mfiQMZkbJyZGgojZ7yYRhHFi14o4h3qzSmjZPVJ.jpg)|![1000954701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23z7BuvdRKuRnvSxh4UhxAr1b7JpVME3K4v4byj9tTo76yciTaHtZSgUuYR5n9A1GsJmA.jpg)| |-|-| Nos terminó de motivar a la mudanza, el cambio de escuela de nuestros hijos. Para estar más cerca y ahorrar en transporte. Le pedimos mucho a Dios para encontrar una casa con estas características y han mejorado mucho las cosas. Los niños viven y duermen más tranquilos. Claro que existen desventajas: Detrás del parque hay un cementerio viejo jajaja, pero menos mal lo cubre los árboles y no lo vemos. También ahora vivimos en un tercer piso, así que son más escaleras. Pocas veces pasa, pero se va el agua y tenemos un techo en frente que me impide hacer tomas completas. Sin embargo esas son pequeñeces y estamos agradecidos. ![1000966320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23zGYWsMvtsFWwq9gX4Qh9CBwqg3vP1ky6b1bNeEw6aW3y7EUXCjRxuyS1P2TeiG1MzKF.jpg) Todavía hay noches en las que mientras estamos cenando o hablando, nos quedamos en silencio, nos miramos y decimos: YA NO SE OYE EL BINGO, Jajajajaja. Y eso nos llena de paz y tranquilidad. |![1000834150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wzzivcdeVkA3FgoK2kirLsAnFVJVL4xotaBod9JRMVmGvJdfGr4EEtRB3BzXdheyT7Z.jpg)|![1000876042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uQhz6MEMg5Mxyr2nUgvBLTBUJtzeHrAUkW5LAHhsKDF2N9wauTDP3EPUZnPKAM2FB4T.jpg)| |-|-| ![1000876041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tmBhYtaG47jvQnMbNX4UBkEbxca81PF7MfWRqJWZcs5zgNqZcHhQE3vGUQ2ATEKF4nh.jpg) Mientras pueda ser hallada esa paz, hay que procurar tenerla. Pequeños cambios, hacen grandes diferencias.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A woman stepped out of her car on a Midtown Manhattan street and vanished into an uncovered manhole. That’s not “bad luck.” That’s a catastrophic failure of basic public safety — and it left a 56-year-old grandmother dead after screaming “I’m dying” from below street level.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The victim, **Donike Gocaj**, had parked near East 52nd Street and Fifth Avenue late Monday night. Witness Carl Wood said she closed the door, took only a couple of steps, and dropped roughly **10 to 15 feet** into the open utility hole. He said she wasn’t distracted and wasn’t looking at her phone — she simply had no warning.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The most damning detail: the witness said the **manhole cover was sitting beside the opening** and there were **no cones, no barricades, no visible block-off of any kind**. Bystanders tried to improvise a rescue. One man tried lowering himself so she could grab on. Someone else brought a ladder, but it was too short. That’s the kind of chaos you get when a hazard is left exposed in public space.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: Funny, they were threatening a major storm, and it passed us by.  I managed to get most of the annuals planted and the jalapenos.  Today, I hope to put in some sweet peppers, but I have a lot to do around the house as well.  I sure hope you get those peas in, the weather is to be a bit cooler, Pam.
title.author: sunscape

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Con Edison’s early explanation is that a **multi-axle truck appears to have dislodged the cover about 12 minutes earlier**. If that holds up, the timeline is brutal: an ordinary traffic event may have turned a sidewalk/street edge into a lethal trap in under a quarter hour. The witness also described the hole as seeming **extremely hot**, with water at the bottom — possibly steaming — which raises the possibility that the danger wasn’t just the fall, but heat, burns, or air conditions underground as well.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 FDNY and EMS arrived within minutes, but by then her screams had stopped. She was pulled out unconscious and later died at the hospital. The larger point is ugly and simple: a city can’t tolerate infrastructure that becomes instantly deadly with no barrier, no alert, and no backup safety layer. This reads less like a freak accident and more like a preventable systems failure. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/us-news/horrified-witness-describes-nyc-grandmothers-manhole-death/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.title: Work Life - What we do every day at work: the complete mortadella production process from start to finish. / Lo que hacemos cada día en el trabajo: proceso productivo de la mortadela de principio a fin. 😃❤️
title.body:
> The world of mass food production started to interest me when I was 14 years old, without knowing that several years later I would end up working in that field. The first production process I was assigned to study at school was that of yerba mate, the beloved herb that is consumed daily by almost everyone in our country. Learning what happens at each stage of the chain, from planting to reaching the final consumer, fascinated me so much that I eventually became obsessed with wanting to know how all the other foods we see on our tables every day are made 😃.
El mundo de la producción masiva de alimentos me empezó a interesar desde que tenía 14 años, sin saber que varios años más tarde terminaría dedicándome a eso. El primer proceso productivo que me hicieron estudiar en la escuela fue el de la Yerba Mate, el \

tan preciado y consumido diariamente por casi todos en nuestro país. Saber qué sucede en cada etapa de la cadena, desde la siembra hasta llegar al consumidor final, me resultó tan fascinante que después llegué a obsesionarme queriendo saber cómo se hacían los demás alimentos que vemos en nuestra mesa cada día 😃. --- ---

> --- --- As a Food Engineer, you can work in many different areas within the production chain, from legal and regulatory affairs to laboratory work, production, and even the technical management of entire companies. I still do not have a very extensive résumé, but ever since I graduated, I knew clearly that my ideal job would be one where I could stay connected to the factory and follow a product from start to finish. Fortunately, I have achieved that today, working in a factory that produces deli meats.
Siendo un Ingeniero en Alimentos, podes dedicarte a muchas áreas dentro de la cadena productiva, desde los asuntos legales de la producción, laboratorio, producción y hasta la dirección técnica que empresas enteras. Yo todavía no tengo un currículum muy extenso, pero desde que me recibí tuve bien claro que mi trabajo ideal sería en contacto con la fábrica que elabora un producto de inicio a fin. Al día de hoy por suerte lo conseguí, en una fábrica que hace fiambres.
---

> --- I have to admit that at first, working for a deli meat company scared me a little because I was afraid I might see something I would not like. There is always a lot of misinformation about what ingredients deli meats contain, with people claiming they are made from strange or low-quality raw materials and that this is why they are so cheap. I was worried I would come across a disgusting production process and never be able to eat deli meats again, but fortunately, the company I work for is very responsible and takes the quality of its products very seriously.
Debo decir que al principio me \

un poco trabajar en una empresa de fiambres porque tenía miedo de ver alguna cosa que no me gustara. Siempre hay mucha desinformación en cuanto a qué ingredientes llevan los fiambres, aludiendo a que se hacen con materias primas raras o de mala calidad, y que por eso son tan baratos. Tenía miedo de encontrarme con un proceso asqueroso y no poder volver a comer fiambre nunca más, pero por suerte la empresa en la que trabajo es muy responsable y se toma la calidad de sus productos muy enserio. ---

> --- This factory produces more than 50 different products, but without a doubt, the one prepared every day in the largest quantities and most appreciated by consumers is mortadella. Like the rest of the deli meats made in this factory, mortadella is composed of a mixture of 100% pork meats along with a secret combination (at least for us regular employees) of spices, bacon, and pepper that give it its unique and characteristic flavor. The production process begins with weighing the different ingredients, including meat trimmings, spices, and additives, and everything is then transformed into a minced meat paste that is later stuffed into the different casings that give the product its final shape.
Esta fábrica elabora más de 50 productos diferentes, pero sin dudas el que se prepara cada día, en mayor cantidad y es más apreciado por los consumidores es la mortadela. Al igual que el resto de los fiambres que se hacen en esta fábrica, la mortadela está compuesta por una mezcla de 100% carnes de cerdo y con una secreta (para nosotros simples empleados) combinación de especias, tocino y pimienta, que le dan su sabor único y característico. El proceso productivo empieza con el pesaje de los distintos ingredientes, incluyendo recortes de carne, especias y aditivos, y todo se transforma en una pasta de carne picada que luego se embute en las distintas tripas que dan forma al producto.
---

> --- The mortadella format most preferred by consumers and the one that sells the most is the type tied with sisal string. This final tying process is done by hand by the workers, who take the time to knot each individual piece of mortadella before taking it to the oven for cooking. Finally, the product is cooled, labeled, and sold. One myth surrounding mortadella is that it contains strange ingredients, with some people even claiming that it is made from horse meat. My friends, at least in my factory, this is not true, and I must admit it was a relief to find that out.
El formato de mortadela que prefieren los consumidores y que más se vende es el que está atado con un hilo sisal. Este atado final se realiza artesanalmente por los operarios que se toman el trabajo de anudar una por una cada pieza de mortadela, antes de llevarla al horno y cocinarla. Finalmente, el producto se enfría, se etiqueta y se vende. Un mito que ronda en torno a la mortadela es que tiene ingredientes extraños, llegando a decir que hasta es un producto elaborado con carne de caballo: amigos míos, al menos en mi fábrica esto no es así, y debo decir que me dio alivio saberlo.
---

> --- Soon it will be a year since I started working at this place, and I already know almost all the processes by heart. One of my responsibilities in this job is walking through the factory and checking that the processes are taking place within the established parameters regarding time, temperature, and methods. Another interesting task is tasting the products to make sure they are turning out correctly from a sensory standpoint: every day I eat at least one slice of this or some other deli meat, and although they are delicious, I try not to overdo it 😅.
Dentro de poco se va a cumplir un año desde que trabajo en este lugar y ya casi me sé todos los procesos de memoria. Una de mis tareas con este trabajo es recorrer la fábrica y controlar que los procesos estén ocurriendo dentro de los parámetros establecidos en cuanto a tiempos, temperaturas y métodos. Otra tarea interesante es probar los productos para registrar que estén saliendo bien en cuanto a lo sensorial: cada día como al menos una feta de este o cualquier otro fiambre, y a pesar de que son riquísimos, intento no abusarme mucho de eso 😅.
--- ---

❤️ Hope you liked this post! Thanks for reading. ❤️

❤️¡Espero que les haya gustado este post! Gracias por leer. ❤️

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The core shot here: NYC’s biggest finance CEOs got a clean opening to confront Mayor Zohran Mamdani over anti-business rhetoric — and, per this column, they blinked. The article’s whole argument is that Jamie Dimon and David Solomon chose polite diplomacy over a direct warning, even after Mamdani publicly targeted Ken Griffin. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/business/wall-street-bigwigs-dimon-solomon-fail-to-stand-up-to-mamdanis-madness-as-nyc-mayors-apology-tour-flops/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The flashpoint was Mamdani’s social media stunt outside Ken Griffin’s penthouse, where he promoted taxing the rich. Gasparino frames that as more than class-war theater: he argues it was reckless because it singled out a high-profile executive by name at a moment when anti-CEO hostility and political violence are already real concerns. In the piece’s telling, this was exactly the issue Dimon and Solomon should have raised head-on — and didn’t.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The meetings themselves are painted as an “apology tour” that barely apologized. Griffin’s name reportedly never even came up in Mamdani’s talks with either [Jamie Dimon](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/business/wall-street-bigwigs-dimon-solomon-fail-to-stand-up-to-mamdanis-madness-as-nyc-mayors-apology-tour-flops/) or [David Solomon](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/business/wall-street-bigwigs-dimon-solomon-fail-to-stand-up-to-mamdanis-madness-as-nyc-mayors-apology-tour-flops/). Instead, the tone was described as “constructive” and “friendly,” with talk of public-private partnerships and even a book gift from Dimon to the mayor. Gasparino sees that as surrender dressed up as civility.

Gasparino argues that by avoiding conflict, business leaders have only invited more taxes, redistribution, anti-police policies, and a generally less stable environment for employers and their workers. His complaint isn’t just about one meeting — it’s about a pattern of elite passivity while policy keeps shifting against the people who fund the city’s tax base.

title.body: 5/5 🧵 Ken Griffin is used as the contrast character. While Mamdani tried smoothing things over with other CEOs, Griffin is presented as the one figure unwilling to play along, doubling down instead on growth in Miami and explicitly praising a model built on earned success over redistribution. That’s the article’s final punch: Gasparino thinks Dimon and Solomon had Mamdani on the ropes and chose small talk over leverage. Whether you buy the politics or not, that’s the column’s message in one line: power met provocation and answered with tea. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/business/wall-street-bigwigs-dimon-solomon-fail-to-stand-up-to-mamdanis-madness-as-nyc-mayors-apology-tour-flops/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The core argument is simple: Trump’s Iran policy hasn’t changed in a decade, and that consistency matters more than the caricature of him as impulsive. Michael Goodwin’s point is that on the issue that counts most — preventing Iran from getting nuclear weapons — Trump has been stubborn in exactly the way his supporters want.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Goodwin contrasts Trump with the Obama-era nuclear deal and the broader Democratic approach. He argues the 2015 framework was too generous: sanctions relief, cash, and diplomatic legitimacy without a permanent end to Iran’s nuclear ambitions. In his telling, Iran took the money, kept the hostility, and continued backing proxies like Hamas, Hezbollah, and the Houthis.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The article says Trump proved this wasn’t campaign theater. First, by pulling out of Obama’s deal in 2018. Then, in his second term, by backing military action against Iranian nuclear sites during Israel’s war with Iran. Goodwin treats that as evidence of doctrine, not improvisation: diplomacy if possible, force if necessary, but no compromise on the nuclear question.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 A key section focuses on the failed negotiations that followed. Even after direct pressure and cease-fire efforts, Iran reportedly kept insisting uranium enrichment was a non-negotiable right. That’s the article’s hinge point: if Iran won’t surrender the path to a bomb, then every “peace process” that ignores that fact is just appeasement in a nicer suit.

title.title: Donating to needy students
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVj7YTWqpLMq6QQKGYGHGY1aQ7DPxnkhgRPKSkdTtnTpo/1000192584.jpg)

A few days before, our local temple group WhatsApp admin posted a message requesting members to donate school supplies to needy students in our village. Today, we bought a few things like scales, erasers, pens, and pencils. I have also shared the message among my friends and family so that more people can come forward and donate if they like. 

The academic year for 2026-2027 will start this coming June. Schools are set to reopen, and most malls and shops in the city are featuring school shopping to attract parents and children. Notebooks, shoes, uniform material, pens and bags, water bottles, etc., are sold at discounts. 

Our state has an extra item that other students do not need to buy - the umbrella. With June comes the monsoon rains, and this year, it is predicted to start early. Rains nowadays are quite unpredictable and heavy, with many low-lying areas always being affected. This, in turn, affects the students because schools are turned into relief camps. I just hope we do not witness any natural disasters this year. 

I remember my school days when we used to write with fountain pens, and ballpoint pens were not even allowed to be used. We used to have an instrument box in the high school. The smell of new uniforms, the fresh rain, rain slippers, new friends, and reading the stories in the English textbook on the first day itself - all these bring fond memories. No mobile phones to distract, and our teachers used to play word games with us. 

I hope more people come forward to donate supplies so that needy students do not lack. Have you ever considered donating to schools? People can also donate books to school libraries.

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The article centers on a neighbor of 17-year-old Cain Clark, one of the two teen shooters. She says she saw him the day before the attack and the moment stuck with her after the fact: he was just standing there, quiet, hard to read, then went back inside with his food. Another neighbor described the family as completely normal and said the teen practiced martial arts. That contrast is the whole point: neighbors saw routine, not warning sirens.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The attack itself was brutal. Clark and 18-year-old Caleb Vazquez allegedly opened fire at the Islamic Center of San Diego, killing 3 people before dying themselves. Among the victims was Amin Abdullah, a security guard and father of eight, who police say likely prevented an even worse massacre. The article also names Nader Awad and Mansoor Kazziha as victims.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The deeper horror is the ideology behind it. The piece says investigators found signs of online radicalization, Nazi imagery, anti-Islamic writings, and a manifesto co-authored by the two teens. One law-enforcement source says a weapon was taken from a parent’s home and a suicide note referenced racial pride. If that reporting holds, this wasn’t random chaos — it looks like targeted hate wrapped in nihilism.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The article’s real takeaway is ugly but important: extremist violence often doesn’t arrive looking dramatic in advance. To the people nearby, this was a quiet neighborhood and a seemingly ordinary family — until it wasn’t. The normal-looking exterior can be the mask, which is exactly why online radicalization and access to weapons is such a dangerous mix. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/19/us-news/cain-clarks-neighbor-reveals-haunting-encounter-with-san-diego-mosque-shooter-day-before-deadly-rampage/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A coffee order dispute turned into a fatal public meltdown. The ugly part isn’t just that a 75-year-old woman died after a fight in a Tim Hortons — it’s that a clipped social media narrative ran ahead of the facts, while the full account paints a messier and much harsher picture.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says Anita Grayson, 75, went into a Fort Wayne Tim Hortons on May 13 after getting upset over her drive-thru order. Police say she berated a 17-year-old worker, then the 20-year-old shift manager stepped in and told her to leave. According to investigators, Grayson escalated first: she allegedly pushed and punched the manager hard enough to scratch her face and knock off her glasses.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 From there, the situation spiraled fast. Police say the manager pushed Grayson back after being struck, and the confrontation fell into a floor fight. Investigators allege Grayson grabbed the manager by the hair, pulled her down, and ripped out a chunk of it, leaving a raw wound on her scalp. Two employees reportedly struggled to separate them. It sounds less like a simple “elderly customer attacked” story and more like a chaotic two-way brawl sparked by an aggressive outburst.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The most important unresolved piece: **cause of death**. After the fight, Grayson reportedly sat down, made a phone call, and about 10 minutes later lay down on the floor. She was found unresponsive, paramedics tried lifesaving measures, and she later died at the hospital. Her daughter said Grayson had congestive heart failure and had recently been wearing a heart monitor. Preliminary reporting cited by the article says there were **no significant contributory injuries**, which matters a lot because it suggests the medical cause may not be blunt-force trauma from the fight.

title.title: When Splinterlands Meets Electroneum and the Birth of ElectroFox Miner
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYBY3nfGb3Ano7kvHTntTTV7NkSxRreuX9SZtmfMtNCXx/crossover.png)

Hello Splinterlands warriors. Honestly, I had started to think that Splinterlands had already gone “crazy” enough with all the updates over the past few months. We just got busy with new rulesets, new skins, and the Conflict Event—now here comes something even more unique. This time, the world of Splinterlands officially collides with the world of **Electroneum** through a new event called the **Voltage Event**.

And the star of this event immediately caught my attention: the **ElectroFox Miner**.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabZuh3FXpHvkuMq71czYbLQatbB4X4LPg7GUbLrHJ5op/electrofox.png)</center>


The first time I saw the card, I instantly felt that this wasn’t just an ordinary card. Not only because it looks cool, but because it serves two functions at once. It can be used in battle, and it can also generate **Electroneum Voltage Points (EVP)** when staked on land. It feels like having a pet monster that fights during the day and works to earn money at night.

At first, I thought a mining feature like this would be complicated. But after slowly going through the details, it actually became quite interesting. The EVP you earn can be used to open **Voltage Reward Chests**, which contain various rewards—from ETN, exclusive skins, Glint, and Energy, to Frontier Packs. And as usual, the moment I saw the words “limited supply,” my collector instincts immediately started to kick in.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbzQsY8UtQ57QKgYT9ydMP1ZMRHXwjuMYS4u6eVZVdCwy/stats.png)


What excites me the most is how Splinterlands now feels more like a living world, not just a card game. In the past, we only focused on winning battles. Now we’re thinking about land, staking, wallets, resources, and even crossover events like this. It really feels like the game is evolving into something much bigger.

Of course, there are challenges. To participate in this event, players need a compatible Electroneum wallet, such as **Zypto App** or **MetaMask**, and then connect it to their Splinterlands account. This part might be a bit confusing for new players. I’d suggest being cautious, since it involves wallets and account security.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFmmSH3P2AM9iMZBBS9TcJdmLTx1XxJt7WEWrxsvRHtb/land.png)


From a gameplay perspective, ElectroFox also looks quite promising. It’s not just a mining display piece. I really like this kind of concept—when a card has both utility and strength in battle. It makes the card feel more alive and valuable in the long run.

For me personally, the Voltage Event brings a fresh sense of excitement. There’s curiosity, a desire to try things out, and that feeling of being a new player again—still figuring out the system. And maybe that’s why I’ve stuck around this long—Splinterlands always finds a way to keep us curious about what’s coming next.

My advice for other players, especially newcomers: don’t rush into the hype. Take time to learn the system, understand how wallets work, and calculate your available resources. Because events like this aren’t just about buying in quickly—they’re about understanding long-term opportunities.

And who knows, a few months from now, ElectroFox might become one of the most sought-after cards in Praetoria.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The biggest twist here: a 12-year-old girl’s death that looked headed toward a murder case has now been ruled **natural causes** by the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner. That doesn’t make the situation less brutal — it makes it more legally and emotionally explosive.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The case centers on **Khimberly Zavaleta Chuquipa**, a 12-year-old Reseda Charter High School student. She died days after being hit in the head with a **metal water bottle** during what was described as a bullying-related altercation at school. Earlier this year, that led to an LAPD **murder arrest of a juvenile suspect**.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The new ruling says Khimberly died from a **cerebral arteriovenous malformation (AVM)** — a rare condition present from birth where tangled, fragile blood vessels in the brain can rupture suddenly. The medical examiner’s position is blunt: these ruptures can happen **within seconds to minutes** and become immediately life-threatening, and officials did **not** connect the water-bottle strike four days earlier to the fatal brain bleed.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 That’s where the outrage kicks in. Khimberly’s family argues the ruling sidesteps the obvious sequence of events: she was reportedly healthy, then was struck in the head, complained of serious pain, and soon after suffered catastrophic bleeding. Their attorney says even if she had an underlying condition that made her more vulnerable, that **doesn’t excuse** the conduct or the school’s alleged failure to address repeated bullying. The family’s lawsuit against **LAUSD** is still moving forward.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The article also points to a similar 2024 LAUSD case involving **Shaylee Mejia**, where a teen’s death after a fight was later ruled unrelated to the altercation itself. So the pattern here is ugly: public assumptions, criminal implications, then autopsy findings that complicate everything. The medical ruling may reshape the criminal case, but it won’t end the fight over school safety, bullying, or accountability. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/medical-examiner-in-water-bottle-death-of-la-student-reveals-new-details/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The Knicks didn’t just win Game 1 — they pulled off a borderline insane resurrection. Down **22 points with 7:52 left**, they stormed back to beat Cleveland **115-104 in OT**. That’s the **biggest playoff comeback in Knicks history** and one of the wildest collapses the Cavs will ever have to explain.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 For most of the night, New York looked cooked. Their offense was clunky, they were **4-for-23 from three through three quarters**, and Cleveland’s size with **Evan Mobley + Jarrett Allen** was smothering the Knicks’ elbow-action sets. ESPN’s win probability had New York at **0.1%**. Basically: funeral music was already playing.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 Then the switch flipped. After falling behind by 22, the Knicks **outscored Cleveland 44-11 the rest of the way** and shot **71%** in that stretch while the Cavs hit just **22%**. They closed regulation on a **30-8 run**. That’s not a comeback. That’s a full-on theft in broad daylight.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 **Jalen Brunson** was the engine. He poured in **15 points during the late fourth-quarter surge** and repeatedly hunted mismatches — especially **James Harden**, who got left on him far too often. Brunson scored **11 straight Knicks points** at one stage and looked exactly like the kind of closer who rips a team’s soul out in a playoff game. **Mikal Bridges** hit two massive threes, and **Landry Shamet** buried the huge game-tying three with **45 seconds left**.
title.author: askrafiki

title.title: Meet my chickens: Looking Closely at Our Backyard Flock
title.body: /> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- I often write about the bright flowers in our garden, the wild birds singing in the trees, and the beautiful sunsets from our front porch. But today, I want to talk about a part of our backyard that I usually pass by. Let’s look at our chickens 🐔 We keep a few chickens around the house now. They are very helpful to us because they provide fresh eggs and good meat for our meals. Most of the time, they spend their days walking around the yard, scratching at the soil, and looking for tiny bugs to eat. Our young chickens come in many different colors. Some have dark, glossy black feathers with pretty white speckles that look like stars. Others are a warm, golden-brown color mixed with bright white. It is fun to watch them walk together over the dry leaves and dirt. They always look very busy, tilting their heads down to peck at the ground.

/> * * * * * * While the young chickens get to roam freely, some of our chickes need a little extra care. Our hen stays inside a safe bamboo cage. We do this to protect her and her precious eggs from predators that might try to sneak into the yard.

/>

My brother has a strong rooster with a bright red comb. He keeps this rooster tied up carefully in his own spot. As you can see in the photos, he has a long, proud neck and likes to stand tall to watch over everything.

<table style=\

>Taking these photos made me realize how lively our backyard really is. They may be simple farm birds, but they add so much color and life to our daily routine.

* * * * * *

/>

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Netflix sells remorse. This piece argues the prison reality is the opposite: Mackenzie Shirilla allegedly behaved less like a broken inmate and more like the social ringleader of the yard — polished, performative, and very aware of the attention around her. That contrast is the whole engine of the story. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/hell-on-wheels-killer-mackenzie-shirilla-is-prison-mean-girl-inmate/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The article leans on claims from former inmate Mary Katherine Crowder, who says the version of Shirilla shown in Netflix’s *The Crash* didn’t match the person she knew inside the Ohio Reformatory for Women in 2024. Crowder describes Shirilla as heavily made up, preppy, image-conscious, and carrying herself like a prison celebrity — basically “Regina George” in a correctional setting. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/hell-on-wheels-killer-mackenzie-shirilla-is-prison-mean-girl-inmate/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 Crowder’s bigger accusation is about demeanor, not fashion: she says Shirilla didn’t appear consumed by grief or remorse. Instead of seeming weighed down by two deaths and a 15-to-life sentence, she allegedly looked upbeat, social, and fully engaged in prison cliques, side hustles, and status games. That’s the article’s sharpest point because it directly challenges the sympathy arc presented in the documentary. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/hell-on-wheels-killer-mackenzie-shirilla-is-prison-mean-girl-inmate/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article piles on more sensational claims: multiple prison relationships, time in solitary for intimacy with other inmates, outside financial support for makeup/clothes, custom-styled outfits, and even online “sugar daddy” backing. It also says Crowder disputed Shirilla’s reported health issues and claimed Shirilla told fellow inmates a different story about the crash — including alleged mushroom use — than the public case record emphasized. Heavy allegations, and they come from one inmate account amplified by viral TikToks. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/20/us-news/hell-on-wheels-killer-mackenzie-shirilla-is-prison-mean-girl-inmate/)

title.body: Believe it or not, I only use the greenhouse from mid-march to mid-may.  Otherwise, the sun heats it up too much.  Even if I shaded it, it would still be too much.  I open both doors all day, and an exhaust fan runs all the time, it still gets too much for the plants.  I would love to do more hydroponics during the summer, but the water in the tubs gets too warm, plus the lettuce and greens all bolt.  \n\nNot sure what would eat salvia plants, I plant lots of it and nothing ever bothers mine.  Maybe it is slugs or mice.  You would have to bust the critter to be sure.  If Jamie does build a greenhouse against your home, ventilation is key. Plus, some type of fan to stimulate wind so the seedlings grow strong.  You will find it useful, I'm sure!  I sure hope that elbow heals soon for you.

Pankkikortti voi toimia sujuvasti talletuksissa, mutta nettilompakko voi mennä kotiutuksessa eri reittiä. Silloin maksuvahvistus ja käsittelyaika voivat venyä, vaikka talletus meni sisään sekunnissa.

Nettilompakko on monelle kätevä arjessa, mutta kotiutuksessa se ei aina vedä vertoja suoraan verkkopankille. Tässä kohtaa nopeus ratkaisee enemmän kuin kiiltävä bonussivu.

### Talletusrajat Ja Bonukset

Minimitalletus ja maksimitalletus vaikuttavat siihen, saatko bonuksen noudettua ylipäätään. 20 € minimitalletus ei aina riitä isoon tervetuliaisetuun, vaikka tarjoushuuto olisi kova.

Mä tarkistan aina ensin, mikä talletus oikeasti oikeuttaa bonukseen. Muuten käy niin, että olet tallettanut, mutta et saanutkaan sitä etua, jota luulit ostavasi.

## Mga-Lisenssi Vai Viron Lisenssi

Tässä kohdassa vertaan, mitä lisenssi kertoo suomalaiselle pelaajalle. MGA-lisenssi, Viron lisenssi ja joissain tapauksissa Curaçao näkyvät käytännössä etenkin tuessa, reklamaatioissa ja siinä, kuinka luotettava kasino tuntuu arjessa.

Pelkkä lisenssimerkintä ei tee kasinosta hyvää, mutta se kertoo sentään jotain siitä, miten toimintaa valvotaan. Ilman sitä ollaan aika nopeasti villissä lännessä.

### MGA Ja Verovapaat Voitot

EU-kasinoilta saadut voitot voivat olla suomalaiselle verovapaita, kun ehdot täyttyvät. Siksi MGA kiinnostaa monia, jotka eivät halua ylimääräistä säätöä veroilmoituksen kanssa.

Mun silmissä tämä on yksi niistä harvoista kohdista, missä kasino voi oikeasti olla pelaajan puolella. Ei tarvitse lähettää verottajalle turhaa paperisotaa joka voitosta.

### Viron Lisenssin Käytännöt

Viron lisenssi voi toimia ihan hyvin arjessa, ja suomenkielinen tuki saattaa olla kunnossa. Silti bonusehdot voivat olla tiukemmat kuin miltä ensisilmäyksellä näyttää.

Hyvä tuki ei paikkaa huonoja ehtoja. Jos tarjous on kireä, se on kireä vaikka chatissa hymyiltäisiin kuinka.

## Rtp, Slotit Ja Korkea Volatiliteetti

RTP-prosentit kiinnostavat etenkin silloin, kun pelataan bonusrahalla. 96 % ei vielä kerro kaikkea, jos peli heiluu rajusti ja kierrätys on tiukka.

Korkea volatiliteetti voi syödä budjetin nopeasti. Se on vähän kuin lähtisi vanhalla Ladalla moottoritielle ja toivoisi, ettei bensa lopu kesken.

### RTP Eri Peleissä

Sama bonus toimii paremmin pelissä, jossa RTP on korkeampi ja kierroksia saa enemmän vastinetta. 96,5 % slotti on usein järkevämpi kuin peli, jossa kierrätys etenee hitaasti eikä palautus tunnu missään.

Mä katon RTP:n aina yhdessä bonusehtojen kanssa. Pelkkä prosentti ilman ehtoja on kuin auto ilman renkaita.

### Korkea Volatiliteetti

Korkean volatiliteetin slotit voivat antaa ison osuman, mutta pitkä tappioputki ei ole mikään harvinaisuus. Silloin bonusraha katoaa nopeasti, vaikka kierrätys olisi vasta alussa.

Jos budjetti on pieni, en suosittele lähtemään liian raskaaseen peliin vain siksi, että bonus näyttää isolta. Se on usein nopein tie siihen, että saldo on nollissa ennen kuin ehtii kissaa sanoa.

### Panoskatto Bonuksella

Panoskatto on yksi niistä ehdoista, jotka kusee homman, jos sitä ei huomaa. Liian suuri yksittäinen panos voi mitätöidä bonuksen heti, ja sitten mennään ilman mitään etua.

Mä pidän tämän yksinkertaisena: jos et tiedä panoskattoa, älä pelaa bonuksella vielä. Muuten saatat ampua itseäsi jalkaan ihan omalla rahalla.

## Suomenkielinen Tuki Ja Kotiutus

Suomenkielinen asiakaspalvelu painaa paljon juuri bonuskasinoilla. Yksi nopea chat-vastaus voi säästää tunnin odottelua, jos talletusbonuksen lunastaminen jumittaa tunnistautumisessa.

Kotiutuksessa nostorajat ja käsittelyaika nousevat helposti esiin. Jos voittoja kertyy kunnolla, on eri asia odottaa viisi minuuttia kuin viisi päivää.

### Vahva Tunnistautuminen Ennen Nostoa

Vahva tunnistautuminen tulee usein vastaan ennen ensimmäistä kotiutusta. Nimi ja pankkitili tarkistetaan, ennen kuin rahat lähtevät ulos.

Se on ihan normaalia, vaikka pelaaja saattaa siinä kohtaa huokaista syvään. Mä pidän tätä enemmän ärsyttävänä kuin vaarallisena, mutta ilman sitä kotiutus ei yleensä liiku mihinkään.

### Nostorajat Ja Aikataulu

Nostorajat kertovat, paljonko voit nostaa tietyssä ajassa. Esimerkiksi 40 000 € kuukausikatto voi olla ihan ok voittajalle, mutta ei kaikille pelaajille.

Nopea kotiutus on hyvä vain, jos rahat myös oikeasti saapuvat tilille ilman turhaa vääntöä. Jos käsittely jumittaa, nopeus on lähinnä mainospuhetta.

## Bonusten Vertailu Ennen Talletusta

Talletusbonus casinoa kannattaa verrata ennen kuin painaa talleta-nappia. Paras tarjous ei aina ole se, jossa prosentti huutaa kovimmin, vaan se, jossa ehdot pysyvät järkevinä ja kotiutus on mahdollinen.

Reload-bonus, cashback ja viikoittaiset kampanjat voivat olla parempia kuin yksi iso tervetuliaisbonus. Mä katson aina koko pakettia, en vain sitä ensimmäistä numerolappua.

### Tervetuliaisbonus Vai Reload-Bonus

Tervetuliaisbonus sopii pelaajalle, joka haluaa ottaa ensimmäisen etunsa yhdellä kertaa. Reload-bonus toimii paremmin paluupelaajalle, joka ei halua kertakäyttöistä tarjousta.

Jos pelaat useammin, kertaluontoinen tervetuliaisetu ei ole aina paras diili. Siinä kohtaa jatkuva kampanja voi olla paljon järkevämpi.

### Bonusportaali Ja Kampanjasivu

Tarjoukset löytyvät usein bonusportaalista tai kasinon kampanjasivulta. Sama kasino voi näyttää eri kampanjakoodin eri paikassa, ja se on juuri sitä pientä säätöä, joka ärsyttää suomalaisia pelaajia.

Mä tarkistan aina mihin koodiin tarjous oikeasti nojaa. Muuten voi tulla fiilis, että bonus oli olemassa vain paperilla.

### Bonus Ilman Kierrätystä

Talletusbonus ilman kierrätystä kiinnostaa, vaikka se on harvinainen. 0x-tarjous voi olla parempi kuin iso bonusraha, jos kotiutus halutaan nopeasti eikä aikaa ole roikkua ehdoissa.

Jos haluat suoraan selkeän etun, tällainen tarjous on usein parempi kuin iso mutta raskas bonus. Helppous voittaa monesti pelkkää numeroa isomman huutelun.

title.title: Splinterlands: Adding one more amazing magic card to my deck for this season!🔥
title.body:
>During a battle I fought just today, I witnessed the Bloodline Tribute ability in action, and it sparked a brilliant idea. It all began at the end of the previous season when I rented a max-level Magic card, Zargrul. To effectively utilize it, I also required a max-level Archon; consequently, I rented Gorgug the Endless. With this, the primary objective of adding the Zargrul card to my deck was achieved; furthermore, thanks to its Painforge ability, the card grew even stronger from the Shocks inflicted by Shock Troopers, allowing it to dominate opponents. However, I then thought to myself: since I already possess a max-level Archon for this season, why not rent a few additional cards—also at their max level—that can synergize with and support it? The best candidate for this idea, in my opinion, was Ballista Deadshot. Although it is a Fire-element card and was already present in my deck (not as a card I purchased, but rather one delegated to me by another player), its extremely low Health stat meant it would typically get knocked out within the very first or second round. Now, however—thanks to the Taunt ability of the max-level Zargrul—incoming attacks from the opponent are diverted away from Ballista Deadshot. Moreover, when Zargrul is eventually knocked out, his Bloodline Tribute ability grants Ballista Deadshot a permanent +1 boost to all its stats. For this very reason, I felt compelled to acquire this card at a slightly higher level, thereby improving its Health stat and overall survivability.

\n\n

>Although this is technically a Fire element card, because it belongs to the same bloodline as my Archon, Gorgug the Endless, I am able to utilize it under normal conditions. Since my Archon has reached its maximum level, I could theoretically use this card at its maximum level as well; however, the card was not listed for rent at its max level. Consequently, I began searching for lower-level versions and eventually managed to find a listing for the card at Level 5. At Level 5, while its Attack Power stats remain unchanged, its Speed ​​increases from 2 to 3, its Armor goes up from 3 to 4, and its Health rises from 3 to 5—which was, in fact, the most crucial attribute for me. Additionally, it gains a new ability called \

which removes all magic buffs after every successful attack. Ideally, I would have preferred to acquire the card at its maximum level; however, there is no point dwelling on what isn't available. Thus, finding the Level 5 version to be quite satisfactory, I rented it for a period of 12 days at a cost of 5 DEC per day.🔥

\n\n

>With this new upgrade, the card had certainly become a cut above the basic standard; furthermore, to provide it with the best possible support, I also had a max-level Zargarul at my disposal. Zargarul's Taunt ability would serve to shield this card—as well as every other card in the lineup—from direct enemy attacks, thereby enabling this card to inflict even heavier damage upon the opponent. The Bloodline Tribute ability would bestow a bonus of +1 to all stats upon every card in the Orc bloodline whenever this card is knocked out; thanks to the Painforge ability, the card would strengthen itself using the shocks dealt by Shock Troopers; and finally, the Expose ability would function to strip away the enemy's immunity. All in all, this constitutes an excellent package, and I am now eager to witness its performance firsthand.

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

Mỗi khi chuẩn bị cho một chuyến đi mới, việc tìm kiếm và chọn lọc thông tin luôn chiếm của chúng ta rất nhiều thời gian. Những câu hỏi cơ bản như nên đi đâu vào mùa nào, ăn uống ở quán nào đảm bảo vệ sinh và giá cả hợp lý, hay lịch trình di chuyển ra sao cho thuận tiện nhất luôn là nỗi băn khoăn của rất nhiều người. Nếu bạn cũng đang gặp khó khăn trong việc lên kế hoạch tổng thể cho chuyến đi, mình muốn giới thiệu một trang web mà mình thường xuyên sử dụng để tra cứu thông tin là [Du Lịch Checkin](https://dulichcheckin.com/). Đây là một địa chỉ cung cấp cẩm nang du lịch chi tiết giúp bạn tự tin hơn trước khi bắt đầu hành trình khám phá những vùng đất mới.



![Gemini_Generated_Image_qebwcmqebwcmqebw.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3d00ffbc7265eb30e86707aa24e4863f0ef767d36f8c077cc0b50976c3826f63)



**Cung cấp thông tin du lịch thực tế và bám sát nhu cầu người dùng**

Điểm nổi bật nhất của Du Lịch Checkin là cách xây dựng nội dung dựa trên kinh nghiệm thực tế thay vì chỉ tổng hợp các thông tin chung chung. Khi bạn tìm kiếm thông tin về một tỉnh thành bất kỳ, trang web sẽ cung cấp một bức tranh toàn cảnh từ thời tiết, văn hóa địa phương cho đến những lưu ý nhỏ nhất. Các bài viết đánh giá địa điểm du lịch, khách sạn hay khu nghỉ dưỡng đều được phân tích rõ ưu điểm và nhược điểm. Người đọc có thể dễ dàng tìm thấy các bài hướng dẫn chi tiết về cách đặt vé máy bay, cách thuê xe máy tại địa phương hay chi phí dự kiến cho từng ngày lưu trú. Những thông tin này được trình bày mạch lạc giúp bạn chủ động tính toán ngân sách và sắp xếp thời gian một cách khoa học nhất. Nhờ đó, chuyến đi của bạn sẽ hạn chế được tối đa những chi phí phát sinh không đáng có.



![Top địa điểm du lịch Việt Nam nổi tiếng không thể bỏ lỡ](https://ik.imagekit.io/tvlk/blog/2022/02/dia-diem-du-lich-viet-nam-cover.jpeg)



**Khám phá trọn vẹn bản đồ ẩm thực từ Bắc vào Nam**

Bên cạnh thông tin về điểm tham quan, Du Lịch Checkin còn dành một chuyên mục lớn để giới thiệu về ẩm thực Việt Nam. Ẩm thực luôn là một phần không thể thiếu để du khách hiểu rõ hơn về văn hóa của từng vùng miền. Trang web không chỉ giới thiệu những món ăn đặc sản nổi tiếng mà còn chỉ dẫn chi tiết địa chỉ những quán ăn quen thuộc của người dân bản địa. Các bài viết thường mô tả kỹ lưỡng về hương vị đặc trưng của món ăn, mức giá trung bình và thời gian quán mở cửa. Việc tìm được một quán ăn ngon với mức giá bình dân sẽ giúp trải nghiệm du lịch của bạn trở nên trọn vẹn và đáng nhớ hơn rất nhiều. Chuyên mục này liên tục được cập nhật để cung cấp cho người đọc những địa chỉ ẩm thực mới và chất lượng.

**Gợi ý hành trình khám phá văn hóa và lịch sử bình yên**

Không chỉ tập trung vào các khu vui chơi giải trí nhộn nhịp, trang web còn có rất nhiều bài viết hay giới thiệu về các điểm đến mang đậm giá trị lịch sử và văn hóa tâm linh. Trong một lần muốn tìm hiểu về những không gian thanh tịnh ngay giữa lòng thủ đô, mình đã tìm thấy một bài viết hướng dẫn cực kỳ chi tiết về [Chùa Trấn Quốc](https://dulichcheckin.com/chua-tran-quoc-ha-noi/). Bài viết cung cấp đầy đủ thông tin về giờ mở cửa, quy định về trang phục và cả những câu chuyện lịch sử gắn liền với ngôi cổ tự này. Nhờ những hướng dẫn tận tình đó, mình đã có một buổi tham quan trọn vẹn và hiểu thêm nhiều điều về văn hóa truyền thống. Ở một bài chia sẻ khác về các điểm đến vùng ngoại ô, trang web cũng hướng dẫn rất kỹ lộ trình di chuyển đến [Chùa Trăm Gian](https://dulichcheckin.com/chua-tram-gian-ha-noi/). Từng tuyến xe buýt, bãi gửi xe cho đến những nét kiến trúc chạm khắc gỗ độc đáo của ngôi chùa đều được tác giả mô tả chi tiết. Điều này thực sự hữu ích đối với những người muốn tìm kiếm một không gian yên tĩnh để nghỉ ngơi vào dịp cuối tuần.



![Chùa Trăm Gian là một trong những ngôi chùa cổ kính và độc đáo nhất Hà Nội](https://dulichcheckin.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/chua-tram-gian-ha-noi-6.webp)



**Giao diện trang web trực quan và dễ dàng thao tác**

Một yếu tố quan trọng khác khiến mình đánh giá cao Du Lịch Checkin chính là trải nghiệm người dùng trên trang web. Giao diện được thiết kế với màu sắc nhã nhặn và phân chia danh mục rất hợp lý. Người truy cập có thể nhanh chóng tìm thấy thông tin mình cần thông qua thanh công cụ tìm kiếm hoặc duyệt qua các chuyên mục như cẩm nang du lịch, tin tức mới nhất, đánh giá địa điểm. Các bài viết đều được căn lề chuẩn, sử dụng phông chữ dễ nhìn và kèm theo hình ảnh minh họa rõ nét. Dù bạn sử dụng máy tính cá nhân hay lướt web bằng điện thoại di động trong quá trình di chuyển, trang web vẫn hoạt động mượt mà và không gặp tình trạng lỗi hiển thị. Tin tức về các sự kiện du lịch và lễ hội địa phương cũng được ban biên tập cập nhật liên tục mỗi ngày.



Việc trang bị đầy đủ kiến thức và thông tin trước mỗi chuyến đi là yếu tố quyết định sự thành công của cả hành trình. Du Lịch Checkin không chỉ là một trang web cung cấp tin tức đơn thuần mà thực sự là một người bạn đồng hành đáng tin cậy cho những ai yêu thích du lịch. Với những kinh nghiệm thực tế và cẩm nang chi tiết được chia sẻ trên trang, bạn sẽ tiết kiệm được rất nhiều thời gian lên kế hoạch. Hãy thử ghé thăm trang web này để tìm kiếm thông tin và chuẩn bị những hành trang tốt nhất cho chuyến đi sắp tới của bạn.
