title.title: A (new) milestone achieved by Brazilian cinema.
title.body:
<center>*This publication was also writen in* **SPANISH** *and* **PORTUGUESE**.</center>

<center>[Rolling Stone Brasil](https://rollingstone.com.br/cinema/onde-assistir-a-o-agente-secreto-indicado-a-4-categorias-no-oscar-2026/)</center>

<div class=\

> From time to time (even if it takes a little longer than necessary for this to happen), national cinema becomes a source of enormous pride not only for Brazilians themselves (especially for those who truly appreciate cinema in all its magnitude), but also for the **Seventh Art** as a whole. The recognition of what is done on the soil of this gigantic country that is **Brazil**, when it echoes around the world, opens different doors for different segments. Recently, the movie ***The Secret Agent*** (a political thriller with dramatic touches starring **Wagner Moura** and directed by **Kleber Mendonça Filho**) became a true cinematic phenomenon by winning no less than almost **100 global awards**. The worldwide success made this movie the most awarded Brazilian project of all time... Reinforcing Brazil's presence within an industry that continues to expand rapidly.
[Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/cultura/noticia/2025-05/o-agente-secreto-ganha-premio-de-melhor-direcao-e-melhor-ator-em-canes)
[Rolling Stone Brasil](https://rollingstone.com.br/cinema/o-agente-secreto-primeiro-filme-brasileiro-vencer-principais-premiacoes-de-criticos-dos-eua/)
After an exhaustive marketing campaign around the world, this movie made history by being nominated at numerous festivals and winning various awards. Among the most emblematic episodes are the four Oscars nominations (without wins, but applauded for the nominations; which, until then, are the largest in quantitative terms) and the Golden Globes nominations (with two wins). This certification of success paves the way for Brazil to achieve other accomplishments. Personally speaking, I am happy to see all this kind of recognition happening. However, the cinema already made here deserved much more recognition for previous projects (which, in my opinion, are much better and much more relevant than this one in focus). However, I understand that we are living in a different era, where a massive presence where not only technology helps to create more massive campaign effects, but a different financial reality helps to shape the ramification of films on the international scene (increasing recognition). Whatever happens, long live to Brazilian cinema! ---
**Un (nuevo) hito para el cine brasileño.**
De vez en cuando (aunque a veces tarde un poco más de lo necesario), el cine nacional se convierte en motivo de enorme orgullo no solo para los brasileños (sobre todo para quienes aprecian el cine en toda su magnitud), sino también para el **Séptimo Arte** en su conjunto. El reconocimiento de lo que se hace em **Brasil**, un país tan inmenso, cuando resuena en todo el mundo, abre puertas a diversos sectores. Recientemente, la película ***El Agente Secreto*** (un thriller político con toques dramáticos protagonizado por **Wagner Moura** y dirigido por **Kleber Mendonça Filho**) se convirtió en un verdadero fenómeno cinematográfico al ganar casi **100 premios Internacionales**. Su éxito mundial la convirtió en el proyecto brasileño más premiado de la historia, reforzando así la presencia de Brasil en una industria que continúa expandiéndose rápidamente. Tras una exhaustiva campaña de marketing a nivel mundial, esta película hizo historia al ser nominada en numerosos festivales y ganar diversos premios. Entre los episodios más emblemáticos se encuentran las cuatro nominaciones al Óscar (sin premios, pero aplaudidas por las nominaciones, que hasta entonces representaban el mayor número de nominaciones en términos cuantitativos) y las nominaciones al Globo de Oro (con dos premios). Esta certificación de éxito abre el camino para que Brasil alcance otros logros. Personalmente, me alegra ver todo este tipo de reconocimiento. Sin embargo, el cine ya producido aquí merecía mucho más reconocimiento por proyectos anteriores (que, en mi opinión, son mucho mejores y más relevantes que el que nos ocupa). No obstante, entiendo que vivimos en una era diferente, donde una presencia masiva, donde no solo la tecnología ayuda a crear campañas de mayor impacto, sino que una realidad financiera distinta contribuye a definir la proyección de las películas en la escena internacional (aumentando su reconocimiento). Sea como sea, ¡que viva el cine brasileño! ---
**Um (novo) marco conquistado pelo cinema brasileiro.**
De tempos em tempos (ainda que demore um pouco mais do que o necessário para isso acontecer), o cinema nacional se torna motivo de enorme orgulho não apenas para os próprios brasileiros (em especial, para quem realmente aprecia cinema em toda sua magnitude), mas também para a **Sétima Arte** como um todo. O reconhecimento do que é feito no solo desse país gigantesco que é o **Brasil**, quando ecoa mundo à fora, abre diferentes portas para diferentes segmentos. Recentemente, o filme ***O Agente Secreto*** (thriller político com toques dramáticos protagonizado por **Wagner Moura** e dirigido por **Kleber Mendonça Filho**) se tornou um verdadeiro fenômeno cinematográfico ao conquistar a marca de nada menos do que quase **100 prêmios globais**. O sucesso mundial fez desse filme o projeto brasileiro mais premiado de todos os tempos... Reforçando a presença do Brasil dentro de uma indústria que continua em uma franca expansão. Após uma campanha de marketing exaustiva mundo à fora, esse filme fez história ao ser indicado em inúmeros festivais e ter conquistado diferentes premiações. Dentre os episódios mais emblemáticos, as quatro indicações ao Oscars (sem vitórias, mas ovacionado pelas nomeações; que até então, são as maiores em termos quantitativos) e as indicações ao Globo de Ouro (com duas vitórias). Essa certificação de sucesso pavimenta o caminho do Brasil para outras conquistas. Particularmente falando, eu fico feliz por ver todo esse tipo de reconhecimento acontecendo. No entanto, o cinema já feito por aqui merecia muito mais reconhecimento por projetos anteriores (que na minha opinião, são muito melhores e muito mais relevantes do que este em destaque). Porém, entendo que estamos vivendo uma outra época, onde uma presença massiva onde não apenas a tecnologia ajuda a criar efeitos de campanhas mais massivos, mas uma realidade financeira diferente ajuda a moldar a ramificação dos filmes no cenário internacional (aumentando o reconhecimento). Seja lá como for, viva o cinema brasileiro!

title.title: Sea Fever                ...Finale               ...A Mystery Unfolding
title.body:
*She was a wanderess, bound by no boundaries, contained by no countries, tamed by no time, she was the force of nature’s course ― Roman Payne*


![Mermaid.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZGNaCABmyowbxu1TTP1C7KYr43m2RwYjr6qbqksF1uKX/Mermaid.png)
*Sea Nymph*


It seemed I was searching all my life, for something real and so essential, it would be like rain or sun, a necessity for life. Well, I finally met my elemental in the person of a bikini-clad girl on Florida’s Gulf coast. Did I mention it was during a hurricane watch? *Seemed appropriate*, I thought. But the young beautiful stranger seemed unfazed by storms. “What’s your name?” I asked. “You can call me Elle,” she smirked, as if amused by my formality.

I figured she was one of the free-spirited girls I often saw out riding the waves with their surfer boyfriends—all with bodies like Greek gods, tanned and comfortable to be clothed with the sun. But she wasn’t tanned and barely clothed and was already shivering, steepling her fingers and holding them to her lips, while water dripped off the ends of her hair. “You’re trembling,” I said, “ you need to come inside the house and get warm.” She nodded, so I quickly gathered up my things and we walked back to the weathered cottage that seemed to be listing in the wind.

“That doesn’t look too safe,” I remarked, but was more concerned with bringing her in out of the elements. Once inside, I lit a fire, and put the kettle on, but the only suitable attire I could find was a black shawl Claire had left the last time she visited. I had misgivings clothing her in Claire’s image, but the girl was cold, so I picked it up and draped it over her shoulders.

Somehow the shawl that looked bohemian and campy on Claire, transformed the girl into a morning-after vixen in my front room. I couldn’t take my eyes off her. Thankfully, the whistle of the kettle temporarily broke the spell and I rushed to take it off the pot-bellied stove. “Creamed Earl Grey is all I have,” I apologized. “That will be fine.”

Her eyes were on me the whole time. I had to will my hands not to shake as I poured the water into the teapot. Harry was restless and pushed out the screen door and with one or two graceful flaps was airborne and glided away down the beach. Gizmo hid somewhere in the back of the cottage, probably in the tiny storeroom. “Do you live here alone?” she asked. “Alone,” I smiled, “except for Gizmo my cat and a heron who adopted me called Harry, but they seem to have hid from the storm.” “That’s wise—elementals are very strong.” She had no idea how true her words were.

I handed her a mug and took a sip from mine and sat down. She cupped her hands around the mug as if for warmth and slowly sipped it, looking out to sea. “Do you think the worst is past?” I asked. She shook her head. “It hasn’t yet begun.” I felt a pang of alarm, but she seemed exhausted from being out in the storm. She put down the mug and stretched lazily, and then, leaned back resting her head against my shoulder. Within minutes, she was fast asleep.

I was free to stare at her and she was indescribably beautiful, but that wasn’t what fascinated me—it was her essence. She was as wild and untamed as the sea. I must have stared at her for hours feeling that same longing I felt down on the beach—that wistful, haunting melancholy that drew my soul the way the Moon exerts influence on waves. I seemed to sense that same deep, dark, roiling undertow, that desire to surrender and be swept out to sea, to be drowned forever in sea chambers far from human voices and the pull of human empathy.

A voice in my head said, *surrender and be free.* Suddenly, another voice broke through calling to me—*Richard, Richard*—I could hear my name being shouted above the din of the wind and thunder. A hand reached out and pulled me back from the sea. I awoke to Claire comforting me.

I have no explanation for what happened—how I got from the cottage to the waves, but Claire had misgivings and returned for me. If she hadn’t, I wouldn’t be here. She’s beside me now daily, and I panic if she’s not there. We’re making plans to return to Toronto—there’s a studio/gallery we both can share.

Harry’s up and left, but Gizmo’s still with me—he’ll stay in his carrier beside us on the plane. Elle disappeared, seemingly without trace, and I’m beginning to doubt she was ever real. The locals talk about mermaids who seduce men to their death in the waves. Maybe she was one. It’s a strange thing the sea—a mystery unfolding, in waves that will carry you away… Carry you to the unbending horizon, or down to sea caverns where mermaids stay.

title.title: Why I'm Still Here: A Healthcare Worker's Raw Truth About Nigeria's Three Impossible Choices
title.body: I was born here, I schooled here, and I am still here in Nigeria, and for a lot of people and me, Nigeria has failed us, and people are left with 3 options: work for someone and collect little wages, create a small business, but still suffer from a broken system where economics, security, and government policies are not your friend, the third option is the JAPA (migration) option. The third is the common one among Nigerians. This leads to a topic: **To Japa or Not Japa**\n\n

/> Some people argue that as a country, we demand the barest minimum, which is true. We demand less from our government, but we do not even have access to this minimum. The average Nigerian asks for access to electricity, affordable healthcare, security, and the dignity of rights, but this isn't true for the Nigeria of today. I am in the health sector, so I can tell you for free that health care isn't cheap in Nigeria, just as it is not in any other part of the world, but unlike Nigeria, they have insurance that can cover several illnesses. Yesterday, I was going to a town in Oyo state where a few local governments had just been attacked by gunmen two days ago, and all I could think of was my safety. I was scared all through the journey for my safety. I read all the Psalms I knew and prayed like I was praying for an entire country. I got back home and was grateful for surviving when I wasn't going to Afghanistan or any country at war. When I think of this, JAPA (immigration) comes to mind.

></center>

The employment debate then comes up, and I begin to wonder the type of country we live in. This is because there are a lot of unemployed youths in the country. In the past, people always said that when you studied a professional course, you would surely get a job, but that is not the case anymore. People who study professional career courses in school do not even get jobs. But then, when people migrate to other countries, especially Western ones, they often end up working blue-collar jobs for lower pay. While you might assume it is better to get a blue-collar job in a foreign country than stay unemployed here, the money to process a visa, flight ticket, and other necessities is enough to start life properly here.

With these different thoughts and more, I wake up every day just thinking of what the day would bring and what would happen tomorrow. While I always hope for a better today and a fulfilling tomorrow, I still always have my fears, and I am sure this is the reality of many Nigerians. At the end, we keep pushing till the very end.

Full Metal Ox Day 1907
Wednesday 20, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1972
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Salutations Lovely Ones. Welcome to another Hump day from paradise. It’s Wednesday, hump day, middle of the week day, peak day, never gonna freak day. It’s Wellness Wednesday. 

We are presenting a new vocabulary word for our arsenal.  

One of the first listens this morning revealed the opinion that English is woefully lacking in words that express abstract thoughts. It’s very likely that this is purposely done in order to keep us rooted in the materium. If you can think it, but can’t say it, then there no way to speak it into existence. 

The word, “emancipation” basically means, “out of hand.” We’d have a better idea of this if we called it, “ex,” meaning out, and of course, “man” (mano), meaning “hand.” (Mano a mano, hand to hand.) Slaves in the American south, were “in the hands” of their “owners.” What do we do with hands? We “hold” with hands. The “house holder,” or “slave holder.” The “property holder.” Human beings were chattel, capital, listed as such on ledgers. Transferred through inheritance, liquidation sales, and clearing debts.  

Emancipation does not mean the same as “liberty” or “freedom.” These concepts are implied, but it ain’t so. Maybe humans were “out of the hand” of the plantation system, and dropped into the pocket of the American White supremacy system. A hundred years after the War between the States, African Americans had been, “emancipated” but were not free.  

Abstract thinking. No vocabulary for that. No “spelling” words. No lyrics with which to “sing the universe into being.” Consider the words that you use everyday to describe your being and your current situation. I read them daily. I read you daily. 

I read the emotions. I read the propaganda from the Church of Barking Dogs. I watch how the heads tilt, how the eyes blink, and particularly the words and phrases used. 

Mind’s quest into the future is to remove its vibrations from the “hand” of the White Supremacy System. We created a word for that. Emindcipation. Ex, exit our Mind, from the, if you like, hive-mind, of this system, that attempts to corral us into an ever-narrowing flume of opportunities in which to thrive. To redefine terms like, “success” & “sovereignty,” into managed concepts that will not threaten the “holders” of the system, nor inspire, (breathe into), others to “free themselves from mental slavery.”   

The current version of this system convinces you that you are, sick, ill, unwell, unhealthy, or in many ways deficient and in need of constant & continuous help, aid, assistance, companionship, attention, which you must be managed, through a perpetual subscription service. It’s convinced you that whatever you have been told you have, (your are “given” a diagnosis), is yours. But at the same time you don’t actually “own” it. 

“My rheumatism is keeping me from living my best life.” 

“My PTSD is doing, whatever it is doing.” (Not saying that this stuff isn’t real. If you suffer, you suffer.) What the Supremacy complex is doing, is attaching these concepts to you. Your “Mind” is in the “hand” of whichever segment of the system is, “holding” it. And Manipulating your personal system. (Man = hand. Again.) 

Project your imagination into one of these “Emindcipation” seminars. And the “talk” has “awakened” something that has been anesthetized within. The question is, (from my own perspective.) “Okay. What next? You’ve informed me that I’m on the plantation. How do I get off? How do I exit?” 

(This is where the speaker sells you his book, and a perpetual  subscription for access to his podcast, and dangles the concept of mental freedom in front of you.) 

You must create your own exit. Most “experts” might tell you to “find” something. This implies that such a “thing” exists.   

It doesn’t. (Or maybe it does, but act as if it does not.) It must be created. When it is created it will be for you, and you alone, because it was fashioned by you and customized to your specific needs, quirks, experiences, fears and expectations. 

There may indeed be parts of this system that work in your favor. Maybe half of these parts benefit you. The question is, “Which half?” 

It’s a life-long process. And it gets easier and more beneficial as you progress. In my humble opinion, (as someone who’s been immensely miserable, perpetually angry, blissfully ignorant, un-apologetically  apathetic, and now in the emindcipation phase), it’s immeasurably worth the effort.  

Stay sane, stay safe, stay strong, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE.   





Emindcipation
Imminent Eminence  
New World Heroes
Freeing our mind from mental slavery.

Chapter 5. Human Stock. Human Shock!

Remember, this is not real. This is a simulated reality and we are looking into a simulated past. Zecheria Sitchin’s account of the Sumerian tablets was turned into a series of twelve books and a narrative that suggests that our current species, you know, the ones Yuval Noah Harari refers to as, “hackable animals,” was created by aliens, who were referred to as “gods.” It’s funny how “believers,” are all in on humans being created, what was it, on day six? (perfect number.) But they choke on their rosary beads if some dares to suggests that those “gods” might have been space aliens. Better to be made out of the dust of the earth, than merged into an ape. 

Speaking of apes, our place-holder candidate, Australopithecus africanus is out of the running. That species was already extinct for a million years by the time the Annunaki landed. But guess who was in town, and in the Levant. 

When I get this thing done, so that the timelines are solid, within a shar or two of Annunaki time, (3600 – 7200 Earth years, I am going to claim, like many philosophers before, that this was inspired by Divinity. Dictated to your humble scribe, by an ascended master, who gave Mind access to the akashic record and inspired, (breathed in, that’s what inspired means. Just like God breathed life into his creations). Where was I? Oh yes, then claim that whatever this becomes was divinely inspired and must be distributed to awakened humans all over the world. I will sign a few books. Appear on a few podcasts, sign the rights over to some Unicorn AI start-up movie studio, become a Double Jeopardy Question, and never be heard from again. 

But back to the important reminder. Every bit of info that comes my way, bears the name given to it by some human. For example, the polysyllabic, Australopithecus africanus, means “southern ape in Africa.” It doesn’t have anything to do with Australia. But where’s Australia on a “standard” globe? It’s in the southern part of the planet. Australopithecus is Latinized Greek. What does this have to do with Space Invaders? 

It’s to emphasize that everything is named by Man. That doesn’t make it real. And it damn-sure doesn’t make it true. It makes it a simulation. Whatever it “is,” is not what man calls it. That makes it a simulation.    
So who was walking upright in the area of Mesopotamia circa 100,000 earth years after the Annunaki landed? None other than Homo erectus. (The teenager in me can’t help a little giggle.)  

Homo heidelbergensis was also active in the regions of Africa & Europe.  

Here’s where your boy had been going in the wrong direction for many years. Because I was looking at this from a human perspective, and listening to Lloyd Pye (1946-2013), (he’s the one who suggested Australopithecus africanus as a candidate for the Annunaki’s slave species). It hadn’t dawned on me that, what are considered, “archaic humans” (homo erectus), for example, would look like primates to the Annunaki. Homo erectus had been on the planet for a million years before the Annunaki got here. We also must take into consideration the biases of whoever recorded the Sumerian tablets. The biases of whoever translated the Sumerian tablets. And the, “literary license,” editing and political correctness, of whoever produced Sitchin’s books.   
We have a demographic profile of homo erectus circa 450,000 years ago. This is what the Annunaki would have seen frolicking in paradise. 

Around 451,000 years ago, in the Lower Paleolithic Levant, (modern-day Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria), Homo erectus, often referred to regionally as Homo erectus sensu lato or possibly early Homo heidelbergensis by some taxonomies, occupied a strategic corridor between Africa and Eurasia.  

Demographically, this was a small, dispersed metapopulation, likely numbering in the low hundreds per clan range, with total regional population, perhaps a few thousand. They were medium-bodied (males 170 cm, (5’ 6”), 65 kg (145 lbs). females 160 cm, (5’ 3”), 55 kg, (120 lbs), robust, and showing marked sexual dimorphism. (You could tell the boys from the girls.) Life expectancy was low, perhaps 50% died before age 15, with few living past 40.  Social units likely comprised 20–30 individuals, several related females, older juveniles, and one to several adult males, practicing fission-fusion mobility to exploit seasonal resources. (They traveled with herds.) 

Sites near freshwater springs, indicate repeated occupation, with evidence of basalt hand-axe manufacturing and butchery of elephants, deer, and hippo. Group territories spanned roughly 100–200 km, with home bases reused for generations. Fertility was likely high, (3–5 surviving offspring per female) to offset chronic mortality from predation, injury, and drought. No burial evidence exists,  mortality management was probably rudimentary abandonment or scavenging. Culturally, they maintained Acheulean (stone) tool traditions with local chert and basalt. Their demographic resilience rested on extreme mobility, cooperative hunting, and efficient caloric extraction, a successful but slow replacing frontier population at the ecological edge of the genus Homo.

To put it into perspective, the Levant, 450,000 years ago was not populated by primitive, hairy, apelike \

for anyone to enslave. It was populated by highly successful, intelligent archaic humans who had already mastered fire, built shelters, and cooperated to hunt giant animals. \n\nWhile Homo erectus was indeed \

for 1.5 million years, by 450,000 years ago, the descendants of erectus had evolved larger brains and more complex social behaviors, making them much closer to modern humans than to the primitive stereotypes. 

Of course, to a civilization, nigh immortal, and strangers on a strange world, homo erectus would appear to their eyes, to be not much more than a beast. Ninmah mentions, in one of her descriptions, that they eat and drink like the animals. 

Homo erectus is a Latin term meaning \

referring to an extinct species of archaic human that lived from about 2 million to 250,000 years ago and is considered a direct ancestor of modern humans. This species is notable for its human-like body proportions and the ability to walk upright. 

Note the estimated date of “extinction.” 200,000 years after the Annunaki arrive. 

So here’s the look. But first, remember this is fiction. 
450K Annunaki arrive to mine gold. 100K years later, Annunaki workers revolt. Enki and Ninmah experiment with human-alien hybrids to create a “primitive worker.” Who do they use for these experiments? Homo erectus. The only bipeds in that area at the time. 100K years later, slave species created, archaic humans, extinct. 

This wasn’t even genocide. This was species-cide. 
I need air. 

This is only a movie, only a movie, only a movie.  
Some humans believe this. Ego believes this. Mind has doubts. We are tracking these stories for kicks and curiosity. If you are going to believe in alien intervention theory, you must also believe that a species that thrived and evolved on this planet for 1.5 million years, went extinct, coincidentally, 200,000 years after aliens arrive on Earth and create a slave species. 

We added a few more pieces to the seven dimensional puzzle tonight. Remember dimensions 6 & 7? We had to skew our perception to look at who’d be the mostly likely victims of these slave making colonizers. We thought, “primitive,” from a homo sapien perspective. That meant apes. Knock-knock. No answer. Our candidate had been extinct for 2 million years. We couldn't fathom that homo erectus could be considered, “primitive.” Well, not to us. But to advanced beings who can travel at the speed of light. Yeah. “Primitive.” Plus, homo erectus was the only upright walking critter in da hood. That narrowed things down considerably.   

On the bright side, we didn’t come from apes. 
See you tomorrow.

title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 39: Cruelty Knows No Bounds

-----

In the Downs Region, Tiberius had gone to visit Lily to watch her be whipped by his imperial guards again.

‘It’s amazing,’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘Every time I come back, your wounds are healed.’

‘The higher power heals me and curses you,’ said Lily angrily.

‘Even now you spout your garbage,’ said Tiberius as he slapped his leg. ‘I should up the brutality. Maybe I should tear off one of your limbs.’

‘Go ahead; I’ll be restored, and you’ll be cursed even more,’ replied Lily aggressively.

‘Well, I have some bad news,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘I’m leaving tomorrow. There’s a vile cult I need to eradicate.’

Lily scoffed.

‘I’d like you to pray for me and our glorious Empire,’ said Tiberius. ‘If you do that, I’ll spare you today’s whipping.’

‘Well, on that basis, I’ll gladly pray for you and our glorious Empire,’ said Lily in a slightly upbeat tone.

Tiberius and the two imperial guards dropped to one knee.

‘Dear Higher Power, please curse this bastard,’ said Lily aggressively. ‘Make him endure all the suffering he’s inflicting on others…’

‘Enough!’ shouted Tiberius as he returned to his feet. He turned to his imperial guards, who were still kneeling. ‘Get off your knees, you dumb shits!’ he shouted. The imperial guards rushed to their feet. ‘Whip her halfway to hell!’

The imperial guards began to whip Lily with as much force they could. 

‘Again! Again! Again! Again!’ shouted Tiberius. The imperial guards continued whipping Lily as hard as they could. Her blood splattered over the walls of the trailer. They continued for several minutes. Unlike previous whippings, Lily did not scream in pain.

‘Enough,’ sighed Tiberius. He walked over to Lily. She was entirely covered in her own blood. 

‘I’m not angry,’ whispered Tiberius. ‘Everything I do is out of love.’

Tiberius wrapped his arms around Lily and hugged her tight. He rubbed his face in her blood-drenched body. Blood poured from Lily’s mouth. She was unable to speak.

The next day, Tiberius called for a final executive council meeting in the hotel dining room before he headed to the West Camp.

‘I want our final meeting to be an informal one,’ said Tiberius in an upbeat tone. ‘You are more than just my executive council. You are my friends and family. I love all of you.’

‘Oh yeah!’ exclaimed Hermon, beaming in delight while the others lightly applauded. ‘I’ve been feeling it for some time.’

The restaurant manager reluctantly approached the table. ‘I’m sorry, Your Imperial Majesty,’ he said to Tiberius in a polite tone. ‘We have no meat to give you today.’

‘Why might that be?’ asked Tiberius while grimacing slightly.

‘The… the Sapes in the Downs Agriculture Zone have escaped,’ replied the restaurant manager in a nervous tone. 

‘Nobody cared to inform me of this,’ said Tiberius angrily as he looked around the table.

Everyone remained silent. The mood had suddenly soured.

‘Don’t sweat it; I’m leaving today,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘Make sure we’re well stocked on meat when I return victoriously.’ Tiberius turned to look at Head Enforcer and said, ‘Find out who helped the Sapes escape and deal with them appropriately.’

‘I’ll make it my priority,’ replied Head Enforcer.

‘That’s what I want to hear,’ said Tiberius, nodding his head.

Duffo raised both his thumbs to Head Enforcer. The tension had now died down.

The waiters placed plates with stacks of pancakes on the table. Tiberius nodded in acknowledgement. Hermon licked his lips in excitement. Duffo looked at Hermon shaking his head.

‘I don’t ask for much in my absence,’ said Tiberius as he looked around the table. ‘Continue with routine meetings. Act in the case of emergencies. Don’t push any new initiatives. You can consult me when I return if you have an “idea”. Just focus on maintaining order and stability.’

‘I assure you, the Downs Region is in safe hands,’ replied Duffo.

‘Excellent,’ said Tiberius. ‘Now, eat up and enjoy. I want to savour your delightful company.’

Everyone eagerly tucked into their pancakes. Tiberius slowly ate just one pancake. He was thinking about the battle ahead and his triumphant return to the palace that he hoped would be completed by then.

After breakfast, Tiberius pulled Duffo to one side while the others headed to the town square. 

‘I have another important task for you,’ said Tiberius as he and Duffo walked into a corridor off the main hotel lobby. ‘Lily is being held in a trailer in the former site outside the region.’

‘Accommodation fitting for a traitor,’ remarked Duffo in a smug tone. 

‘I want you to visit her every couple of days,’ said Tiberius. ‘I’ve got into a routine I think you might enjoy. Something a future Emperor needs to understand.’

‘I’m honoured to carry on this work in your absence, Your Imperial Majesty,’ replied Duffo, nodding his head confidently.

‘We must love our enemies,’ said Tiberius, smiling slightly as he reached up to rub Duffo’s broad shoulders. ‘It is our moral duty to help cleanse them of evil.’

‘There is no one who understands morality like you,’ said Duffo as he smiled at Tiberius.

‘True, very true,’ said Tiberius as he moved his hands down Duffo’s shoulders and onto his arms. ‘Look at you. You were born from trash, and I sculpted you into something. No wonder everyone mistakes you for noble blood.’

Duffo smiled and nodded. 

Tiberius patted Duffo on the arm and said, ‘I’ll see you in the town square.’ He walked back into the hotel lobby. Duffo stared at him as he left.

Hundreds of technicians had gathered in the town square. They were singing and dancing to bid farewell to their Emperor and Grand Vizier. In front of the statue, there were two small flying vehicles and a larger vehicle for the imperial guards.

Tiberius entered the town square. He was riding in his chariot. This time it was pulled by four imperial guards. Miro followed behind in another but smaller chariot pulled by two imperial guards.

Both Tiberius and Miro jumped off their chariots. Benny handed Tiberius a microphone. 

’Thank you, my beautiful citizens,’ called out Tiberius.

The technicians cheered jubilantly.

‘Today, I leave to take on our greatest enemy,’ said Tiberius as he positioned himself between the two flying vehicles. ‘I will fight alongside our courageous warriors. I will ensure we’re victorious. I’ll ensure the security and prosperity of our Empire!’

The technicians cheered loudly while waving their arms in the air.

‘I will not leave you unprotected,’ shouted Tiberius as he gestured towards Duffo, who had now made his way to the front of the crowd. ‘My son, Prince Duffo, will lead and govern you in my stead. He has my strong will and determination; trust in him.’

The technicians began to chant ‘Duffo’ loudly. Duffo waved back at them in delight.

Tiberius climbed into a flying vehicle and Miro into the other. Both took off at the same time. A dozen imperial guards climbed into the ground vehicle. The flying vehicles headed towards the Down Region’s gates, and the vehicle with the imperial guards followed. The technicians began to sing and dance again.

Meanwhile in the West Camp, Walter was being held in a trailer. He was tied to a chair and gagged. Revals had told him it was part of his mentoring programme. Walter was furious, but there was little he could do about it. In front of Walter were several screens showing him what was happening in the camp and the construction site. 

On one of the screens, Walter could see Big Burt being dragged from his cabin by his left leg by an enforcer. Walter desperately tried to break free from his restraints.

‘If you behave yourself, I’ll remove the gag and even untie you,’ said Revals, who was bending forward and grinning at Walter.

Walter nodded in response, and Revals pulled the gag off him.

‘That’s Big Burt, you piece of shit,’ shouted Walter in a frantic rage.

‘Your language!’ gasped Revals. ‘I’ve told you about this before.’

‘He has bad legs and a bad back,’ shouted Walter as he watched an enforcer kick Big Burt as he was dragged across the ground. ‘You can’t treat him like that.’

‘He doesn’t work enough hours and eats too much food to pay his rent,’ said Revals. ‘He gets a nice soft hay bale.’

‘I command you to give him back his cabin, you piece of shit!’ shouted Walter aggressively as his eyes started to become increasingly bloodshot.

‘No, no, your father was very clear, Your Imperial Highness,’ chuckled Revals. ‘I run the camp and construction site. You are to learn from my example.’

‘I want to speak to the head of the Economic Institute,’ demanded Walter. ‘Last I heard, you didn’t control my finances.’

‘Well, yes, I suppose you’re right,’ replied Revals, shrugging his shoulders. ‘I’ll set up a call for you.’

‘Put him on now, you piece of shit!’ shouted Walter. ‘This is a financial emergency.’

‘Sure, but… but please stop calling me that,’ said Revals, sounding frustrated.

‘It’s your name; get used to it,’ said Walter as he raised his eyebrows as he watched Revals type into the computer.

Two minutes later, Hermon appeared on one of the screens in front of Walter.

‘Who the hell are you, idiot!’ shouted Walter at the screen.

‘Oh yes, sorry, Your Imperial Highness,’ replied Hermon as he frantically combined his hair.

‘You’re not Colin,’ said Walter as he shook on his chair.

‘I’m a brilliant upgrade appointed by the Emperor himself,’ replied Hermon as he pumped his fists.

‘Good for you,’ sighed Walter. ‘I want you to transfer all my money to the Downs workers in West and East Camps.’

‘Oh, are you sure, Your Imperial Highness?’ stammered Hermon. ‘That’s a lot of money.’

‘Of course I’m sure,’ shouted Walter. ‘I’m not an idiot like you, who spouts random nonsense.’

‘This request is not cohesive with my economic plan, Your Imperial Highness,’ said Hermon as he raised his arms, pushing his palms towards the screen.

‘Your economic plan involves everyone sleeping in the dirt, idiot,’ shouted Walter.

‘That’s a wild conspiracy theory spread by that filthy weasel Benny,’ replied Hermon in an angry tone. ‘He’s jealous because I’m a genius and he’s a juice-addicted loser.’

‘How dare you say that about me?' called out a voice near Hermon. ‘After all I’ve done for you, that really hurts my feelings.’

‘You know what?’ whispered Hermon, leaning forward. ‘I suspect he’s tapped into this conversation.’

‘You know I’m sitting opposite you,’ called out the voice again.

‘Sort it out now or I’ll order some nutter to chop off your dick and barbeque it like a sausage, idiot,’ shouted Walter as rage grew in his eyes.

'Yes, absolutely, Your Imperial Highness,’ gasped Hermon. ‘I’ll get on it immediately.’

‘Make sure Big Burt is the first to get the money,’ said Walter as he glanced at Revals.

‘Hey, wait a second,’ said Revals, sounding a little surprised.

‘No problem,’ said Hermon confidently. ‘His account will be topped up in seconds.’

‘That’ll be all for today,’ said Walter as a smile came over his face. The call ended.

‘He’s got plenty of money now,’ said Walter as he looked up at Revals, who was scratching his head. ‘Get those nutters off him.’

‘You gave up all your wealth for them,’ said Revals, squinting his eyes slightly.

‘They’re my family; I love them,’ sighed Walter. ‘They mean so much more to me than some stupid numbers on a screen.’

Revals picked up a radio and briefly spoke with an enforcer. A few seconds later, the enforcers left Big Burt, who was lying hurt on the ground. Two Downs workers helped Big Burt to his feet and assisted him to his cabin.

‘I hope one day you’ll understand,’ said Walter as he looked at Revals again.

‘Oh, I understand,’ said Revals in a snarky tone. ‘You’re weak.’

‘And you’re a piece of shit,’ said Walter, shaking his head.

Meanwhile in the Downs Region, Hermon had just sent a list of all the Downs workers that Walter had decided to split his entire wealth with to his employees. Benny, who was sitting opposite him, was staring at him angrily.

‘How may I help you?’ asked Hermon in an upbeat tone.

‘You’re not fit to be the head of the Economic Institute,’ said Benny angrily as he slammed his juice packet down on the table.

‘You’ve been spreading crazy lies, rumours, conspiracies, and other rude things about me for years,’ responded Hermon angrily.

‘I haven’t done any of that,’ sighed Benny as he picked up his juice packet again.

‘Then why am I hearing your words coming out of the mouths of everyone, huh,’ said Hermon as he raised his eyebrows.

‘We’re all observing the same things,’ said Benny. ‘I’m sorry, it’s just reality.’

‘I don’t believe you,’ said Hermon, shaking his head. ‘If it’s not you, it’s somebody else out to get me. When you’re this smart, jealousy is bound to follow.’

‘One day you’ll have to leave this fantasy behind,’ said Benny as he rubbed Hermon’s hand.

‘I… I invented the cryogenic pods,’ said Hermon in a stressed tone. ‘No one can take that away from me.’

‘That was mostly Yvonne, but you played an important part,’ replied Benny as he squeezed his juice packet again.

‘Well, if you’re so smart, you can do all my work,’ snapped Hermon as he stood up abruptly. 

‘Great, that’ll save me time fixing all your mistakes,’ replied Benny chirpily.

‘You’re really pushing it now,’ said Hermon as he pressed down hard on the table. ‘I’m going to the hotel to enjoy more grateful company and drink fresh juice.’

‘Could you ask them to save me a piece of chocolate cake?’ asked Benny.

‘Haha, sure,’ chuckled Hermon as he exited the office.

In the lobby of the hotel, Hermon encountered Duffo, who was carrying an apple pie.

‘A nice treat on the go, eh?’ chuckled Hermon as he looked at the large lattice-crusted pie.

‘I’m showing kindness to someone in spite of their bad behaviour,’ said Duffo calmly. 

‘Haha, Benny again,’ chuckled Hermon. 

Duffo sighed and shook his head, and then he walked towards Head Enforcer, who was standing at the other side of the lobby.

‘I’m ready,’ said Duffo confidently. ‘Take me to the traitor.’

Head Enforcer glared at the pie for a moment, and then he looked up at Duffo and said, ‘Follow me, Your Imperial Highness.’

Duffo followed Head Enforcer down the main road and then out through the main gate. They soon reached the trailer Lily was kept in.

An enforcer opened the trailer door for Duffo. Duffo walked in. Lily was still strung up and still covered in blood.

‘Oh geez!’ gasped Duffo. ‘What’s happened to her?’

‘She is being cleansed of evil,’ said Tiberius through a speaker in the trailer.

‘I… I thought you were flying,’ replied Duffo, shuddering at the sound of Tiberius’ voice.

‘Head Enforcer informed me you were on your way,’ replied Tiberius. ‘I couldn’t miss my son’s coming of glory.’

Tiberius burst out laughing. Duffo was breathing heavily. He looked at Lily, who was staring at him. One of the enforcers was holding a camera, which provided a live feed to Tiberius’ flying vehicle.

‘Hand him a whip,’ said Tiberius.

Head Enforcer grabbed a whip and offered it to Duffo.

‘Yes, thank you,’ replied Duffo nervously as he took the whip from him.

‘Give her a good lashing,’ said Tiberius as intensity grew in his voice.

Duffo handed his apple pie to an enforcer. Then he closed his eyes and took a deep breath.

‘Come on, son, don’t keep her waiting,’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘That’s rude.’

Duffo cracked the whip a few times in the air. ‘I’m going to whip you so hard, you dumb bitch,’ gloated Duffo.

He continued to crack the whip in the air and laughed nervously.

‘Nice showmanship,’ said Tiberius. ‘Now get on with it. Embrace this moment. There’s no going back.’

‘Argh!’ shouted Duffo as he struck Lily with the whip. He was aiming for her torso, but he struck her face instead. This caused a huge laceration across her cheeks and nose, splattering blood across the wall of the trailer. The tip of the whip had caught her ear, taking a piece of it off. Lily dropped her head but did not scream.

‘What a hit!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘See if you can take out an eye next time.’

Duffo was in shock at the damage he had done. He dropped his head and began to pace.

After a few seconds he stopped. He stared at Lily, who was now looking at him again.

‘Take a good look!’ shouted Duffo. ‘This will be the last time you’ll ever see me, bitch.’

Duffo cracked the whip and struck Lily in the mouth. Blood spurted from her mouth. Her lips were badly split. This time Lily did not look away. She stared at Duffo with intense anger in her eyes.

‘Now that’s a look of love, son,’ chuckled Tiberius as an enforcer zoomed in on Lily’s face. ‘I’m disappointed you didn’t take out those beautiful pearly whites.’

‘I think that’s enough for today,’ gasped Duffo as he looked at the camera lens.

‘No!’ spluttered Lily. ‘Hit me again, you ball-less bastard.’

Tiberius burst out laughing. ‘Are you going to let her boss you around?’ shouted Tiberius.

Duffo chucked the whip on the ground. ‘You don’t tell me what to do!’ he shouted as he grabbed Lily by the chin.

‘Yeah!’ said Tiberius, sounding a little disappointed.

‘I want to do things to you with my hands,’ shouted Duffo as he moved his hand down to her throat. ‘I find a whip too impersonal.’

‘You’ve captured my essence in ways I couldn’t imagine,’ said Tiberius in excitement.

‘Now get out!’ shouted Duffo at the enforcers. ‘This is not for your poorly bred eyes.’

Head Enforcer nodded, and the two other enforcers left with him. To Tiberius’ frustration, they left with the camera.

Duffo smashed the speaker and microphone off the wall.

'Ah, damn it!’ shouted Tiberius as he thumped the dashboard of his flying vehicle.

Duffo looked at Lily, shook his head, and said, ‘I’m sorry, I didn’t expect this.’

Lily stared back at him.

Duffo sat down in a chair opposite Lily. He put his face in his hands and began to sob.

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779283737637-01a3543256be1a5b.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/06fc189a)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/06fc189a)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.body: W końcu mam kilka chwil, żeby naskrobać tutaj kilka zdań. Ostatnie dwa dni miałam nocki, a nocki niestety mi nie służą. Ale na szczęście udało mi się już przestawić na dniówki. Dzisiaj pewnie jeszcze wcześnie pójdę spać, bo trzeba będzie wszystko odespać, ale mam nadzieję, że od jutra wejdę już w swój naturalny dzienny rytm. Dziękuję za miłe słowa. Bardzo mi miło, że doceniasz moje fotkowe wypociny. I tak też zauważyłam, że sporo bardzo ciekawych profili fotograficznych opuściło Hive i też się zastanawiałam nad tym, co jest tego przyczyną. Bo z tego co zaobserwowałam, to szło im na Hive bardzo dobrze. Czyżby zabrakło cierpliwości? A może faktycznie cena Hive'a tak drastycznie spadła w dół, że wielu osobom się to już nie opłaca? Aczkolwiek z tym drugim mogłabym polemizować, bo wydaje mi się, że na innych platformach społecznościowych człowiek również publikuje swoje posty, a nie zarabia się tam na tym kompletnie nic. A tutaj jednak zawsze coś wpadnie. Mam nadzieję, że społeczność fotograficzna będzie się mimo wszystko na Hive rozwijała, jak i zresztą cały Hive. Że to wszystko co tutaj ludzie włożyli w zbudowanie tego blockchaina nie pójdzie na marne i będzie się nadal rozwijać.

title.title: (ESP-ENG) The Punisher: One Last Kill | A brief trip with Frank Castle - Special Review!
title.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>** 

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.



![1.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/Eo45JnMbCjvPjZd6DNVVbF8wFmTuWJJkSjX3J1MGec7PztnxWhAoDdu5TyFWCxsFabV.webp)


[Source!](https://www.disneyplus.com/es-ve/browse/entity-c5b69f75-f159-4749-873d-9a1d1a4eb878)

<div class=\

>The Punisher es de esos personajes que creo que Marvel no ha logrado darle la continuidad que merece. Hace como 7 años sacaron una serie en Netflix hecha casi en su totalidad por Jon Bernthal la cual para mi fue increíble pero que decidieron cancelar. Con el estreno de Daredevil introdujeron al personaje un poco en la trama pero sin mucho peso y ahora la gente de Disney y de la mano del mismo Bernthal nos traen este especial de menos de una hora en donde convivimos con un Frank Castle abatido mentalmente por la conocida perdida de su familia y por la duda que crece en él de si vale la pena seguir con lo que ha estado haciendo, su rol de vigilante vengador.

> The Punisher is one of those characters that I think Marvel hasn't given the continuity he deserves. About seven years ago, they released a Netflix series, almost entirely created by Jon Bernthal, which I thought was incredible, but they decided to cancel it. With the premiere of Daredevil, they introduced the character a little into the plot, but without much impact. Now, Disney, along with Bernthal himself, brings us this special of less than an hour, where we see a Frank Castle mentally broken by the well-known loss of his family and by the growing doubt within him about whether it's worth continuing what he's been doing, his role as a vengeful vigilante.

>Creo, solo es una suposición, que este especial se ubica con el final de aquella serie del 2019 y la epoca cuando aparece en Daredevil (aún no se sabe si saldrá en Doomsday). Como les decía en este especial tenemos a Frank teniendo una crisis existencial después de haber eliminado a toda una familia  perteneciente a la mafia italiana en Nueva York y relacionada con la muerte de su propia familia. Se sabe que Castle siempre ha sido un hombre atormentado por la muerte de su esposa e hijos, él nunca fue el mismo y es raíz de eso que nace \

. Con su vida sin un rumbo aparente y Nueva York hundida en la miseria en manos de criminales de todo tipo por la cabeza de Frank pasa la idea de no vivir más y es que la venganza parece no satisfacerle.

> I believe—this is just a guess—that this special takes place after the end of that 2019 series and during his appearance in Daredevil (it's still unknown if he'll appear in Doomsday). As I was saying, in this special, we see Frank having an existential crisis after eliminating an entire Italian mafia family in New York, a family connected to the death of his own. It's known that Castle has always been tormented by the death of his wife and children; he was never the same, and it's from this that \

is born. With his life seemingly aimless and New York mired in misery at the hands of all kinds of criminals, the idea of ​​ending his life crosses Frank's mind, as revenge no longer seems to satisfy him.


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wM4ehRMSo66WQcNcFqeShEtSqLLBNpuxYogqZ6bhZiAQ5NxkdvqPX9K9XRfJjKHmXyn.jpg)


[Source!](https://www.hardgame2.com/the-punisher-one-last-kill-review-marvel-se-vuelve-sombria-valiente-y-adusta/)

---


![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQfVtj4eU8Sdu3AvuCQF9SgU6DLMVpRNbG3J3Krs7yGKpC1ikPyXrbDoK12Hp5m7VeZ.jpg)


[Source!](https://www.comicsblog.fr/51867-Punisher__One_Last_Kill__un_premier_trailer_officiel_pour_le_retour_du_Punisher_sur_Disney)

<div class=\

>Todo cambia cuando de la nada aparece Ma Gnucci, una de las archienemigas de The Punisher, simplemente a informarle que todos los criminales estarán detrás de él en retaliación por la muerte de su familia en manos de Castle. Obviamente el factor supervivencia se activa en él y veremos como uno a uno va aniquilando a los que se le crucen en su camino. Basicamente esto es el especial, una pequeña muestra violenta y sangrienta de lo que puede hacer The Punisher. La verdad es que para los que somos fanáticos del personaje que le dedicaran algo ya son buenas noticias, es verdad que si hubiese sido más tiempo hubiera sido una película prácticamente, la idea de hacerlo tipo \

no es para nada mala. Como comentaba esto no llega a los 50 minutos pero la intensidad está garantizada.

> Everything changes when Ma Gnucci, one of The Punisher's arch-enemies, appears out of nowhere to inform him that all criminals will be after him in retaliation for the death of her family at Castle's hands. Obviously, his survival instinct kicks in, and we see him annihilate anyone who crosses his path, one by one. Basically, this is the special, a small, violent, and bloody sample of what The Punisher is capable of. The truth is, for those of us who are fans of the character, the fact that they dedicated something to him is already good news. It's true that if it had been longer, it would have been practically a movie, but the idea of ​​doing it as a \
isn't bad at all. As I mentioned, it doesn't even reach 50 minutes, but the intensity is guaranteed.

>La naturaleza de Frank es violenta por lo que todo lo que veremos serán golpes, disparos, huesos rotos, sangre, caídas y claro está, esa sensación de venganza que viene dada por un par de cosas que pasan en la corta trama. Bernthal como actor de acción es top, no creo que haya alguien más al que le quede este personaje como a él, se mimetiza mucho haciéndolo ver muy real (también porque es un buen actor). La mayoría de las escenas son hechas por él pero hay otra que no y es acá en donde la mayor critica a este especial y sobretodo a Marvel que ya es conocido por hacer estas burradas. El CGI. Hay una escena en donde Castle cae y se le ve cayendo obviamente y aterrizar, pues el CGI que usaron es tan malo para tapar la cara del doble que terminó pareciendo una caricatura de mal gusto.

> Frank's nature is violent, so all we'll see are punches, gunshots, broken bones, blood, falls, and of course, that sense of revenge stemming from a couple of things that happen in the short plot. Bernthal is a top-notch action actor; I don't think anyone else could pull off this character as well as he does. He blends in so well, making it look incredibly real (also because he's a good actor). He does most of the stunts himself, but there's one he doesn't, and this is where the biggest criticism of this special, and especially of Marvel, which is already known for making these kinds of blunders, comes in. The CGI. There's a scene where Castle falls, and you can obviously see him falling and landing, but the CGI they used to cover the stunt double's face is so bad that it ended up looking like a tasteless caricature. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23sJxbC6Wh1nMTa2M43M9fUJfi2VzR7hmr8jPGJCktyri1xrtqzxc1Y7YLUCvbJmEVBps.jpg) [Source!](https://www.techradar.com/streaming/disney-plus/it-sounds-like-im-listening-through-a-wall-disney-users-slam-the-punisher-one-last-kill-sound-issues-and-poke-fun-at-the-new-marvel-tv-specials-xbox-360-visuals) --- ![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQjr2w7fs6uVMJT6bq4vpaAc6zh9SQw8JWEeRstBWQYuGAd5t8aWAQbmULLGXvGzTxT.png) [Source!](https://www.reddit.com/r/Defenders/comments/1tblrum/thoughts_on_the_punisher_one_last_kill/)

>Que a ver, eres Marvel, no puedes hacer ese desastre de animación. Lamentablemente estamos acostumbrado a que esta gente haga estas cosas por lo que sorpresivo no fue. Esto no opaca lo entretenido y vistoso que termina siendo todo, los casi 50 minutos se pasan muy rápido. Le doy un 8/10, vale la pena verlo tanto por la actuación de Bernthal como por la increíble acción que hay. Está disponible en Disney+. Si son fanáticos de Marvel, de MCU y del personaje, se los recomiendo mucho. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo.

> Look, you're Marvel, you can't make such a mess of the animation. Unfortunately, we're used to this kind of thing from them, so it wasn't exactly a surprise. That said, it doesn't detract from how entertaining and visually stunning the whole thing is; the almost 50 minutes fly by. I give it an 8/10. It's worth watching for both Bernthal's performance and the incredible action. It's available on Disney+. If you're a fan of Marvel, the MCU, and the character, I highly recommend it. I've included the trailer below. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oSeqs_xeqv4 ***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Nos vemos en la próxima, un abrazo a todos.
***

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡See you next time! Hugs to all.

title.title: Danube Tower Vienna
title.body: > Today I want to make you empathize with my visit in the heart of Vienna, Austria, a magnificent monument that offers a uniquely beautiful panoramic view of the city - Danube Tower Vienna. This architectural landmark, 250 meters high, was built in 1964 as a communication tower, but later became a popular tourist attraction due to its spectacular view of the city. ![V (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZRcyS2NDmAEeCxPWuufKSnhGPDe6pHyKGajNezv45gbc/V%20(1).jfif) Upon arrival, I was greeted by the imposing structure that seemed to touch the heavens. My excitement grew with each step closer to the top. Inside the tower was an elevator that took me to the restaurant on the top level. As I traveled up, I watched the cityscape unfold below me, creating a kaleidoscope of colors and shapes. ![V (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUY4DqGwehHJiX8dzmTMEpV4rfZghGkXg8ceisL55pVoT/V%20(2).png) The restaurant featured huge glass windows that provided an unparalleled 360-degree panoramic view of Vienna. It was a sight to behold! The city streets hummed with life as historic buildings stood proudly, testifying to the city's rich history. On one side, the Danube River meandered through the center of Vienna, reflecting the sunlight on its surface. Sitting in the cozy booth, I ordered a cup of traditional Viennese coffee, which is emblematic of Austrian culture. As I sipped the aromatic drink, I admired my surroundings. The height of the tower provides a sense of weightlessness, making one feel as if floating among the clouds. As I enjoyed my coffee, I was struck by how well the restaurant was designed. Each table was strategically placed to provide optimal views of the city. The dazzling interior complemented the exterior, creating an atmosphere that was both elegant and soothing. I spent about an hour in this establishment, time seemed to stand still as I floated in the air watching the bustling city below me. If you ever visit Vienna, don't miss the opportunity to climb to the top of this architectural beauty and immerse yourself in its mesmerizing panorama. ![V (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSenDaT7uFV6bwvLFQCGsvxPvY4F55xFvYhsYFfsNaxRN/V%20(3).jfif) I then decided to check out the Mozart Monument, which is a beautiful tribute to one of the greatest composers of all time. This imposing monument stands prominently in the square. As I approached the monument, I was immediately struck by the detail of the sculpture. Mozart's face radiated a deep wisdom and passion for music, making it easy to imagine the genius behind his compositions. The statues surrounding it depicting scenes from his most popular operas add another level of cultural significance to this famous monument. ![V (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPfzSbE4aajKDQXNQtGh88DSLKs1196dNrr5nRfjKXqA/V%20(1).png) Finally, my day ended in front of the Ferris wheel, an iconic attraction. As an avid traveler, I couldn't resist the opportunity to experience this iconic Viennese attraction, especially when it was lit up at night. As I approached the Ferris wheel, I was struck by its sheer size. At 65 meters high, it is one of the highest observation attractions in Europe. The booths were beautifully lit, reflecting an inviting light on the facility. ![V (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWpM9tmPet1QAaKRAEqVihNJr79yYhZHuS6kQMZSeBZeH/V%20(2).jfif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 48.24015 lat 16.41003 long d3scr)

Donalds has a Donald Trump-like vision for the state of Florida, a Florida First mentality. That's something I can appreciate, especially his position on being strict with undocumented immigration. He has stated that he wants to make Florida more affordable, which is a nice talking point, so it is good that he has been mentioning the issues of overpriced insurance and housing costs.

As a Republican, he still defends the 2nd Amendment and wants to end the expansion of \

social politics in schools. Byron Donalds has also talked about expanding Florida's infrastructure to accommodate the influx of northerners moving to or visiting the South.

Although Republicans don't have a strong reputation on the environment, according to progressives, Byron Donalds is working to preserve the Everglades and protect beaches and natural resources.

Overall, he seems like a good guy, so it's hard not to support him in Florida. I'd like to see him as the next governor of the State of Florida.

title.title: The Silence in My House Now Echoes Check Up Bell - LOH 289
title.body:
By identifying which activities you do out of guilt or fear of disappointing others, and which you do by conscious choice, would this lead you to accept whether it is urgent or important to you?



This prompt triggers a lot but I will share my most recent one.

For me, it started with two unexpected scares in turns.

Two months ago, I had been with them and I left my four-year-old and eleven-months-old for just 2 minutes to use the convenience. I did not even relieve myself when i heard a loud scream and I rushed over to see my baby was bleeding from the left eye.  
I rushed to the eye clinic and the doctor checked him. We ran a treatment course for almost a month.  

During that time my spouse was away while everyone was expecting drama on his return.  
When he finally came back he said, “I hope you know that you are not a spirit to be everywhere. Don’t worry, he will be fine. Let the clinician do their work.”

He did not blame me but asked about the state of the eyes and treatment yet I was still worried.

***
Then came my own fall. I slipped on spilled water at home in the dark.  I wanted to get water to drink.  
I laid there close to an hour before I could move.
And when I fell, my two little humans were laughing like it was a play. I shook my head and got up with a struggle.  
I thought it was just a fall, until by day two I was still limping from the pain.  
I thanked God for no broken bones, and it wasn’t my one-year-old who’d just started walking.

So you see, my recent fall and the previous incident make it both a conscious choice and fear mixed together.  

I cannot leave them alone not even for a minute because it feels like they will be up to something. 

No unsupervised play or lone moments. It’s hard, but I try to keep them within reach.  

Constant floor checking, the lights stay on and toys get cleared immediately after use. 
What used to be a chore is now a keen safety check.

That fall shook me badly

They are both in explore to learn stage because my 4-year-old loves playing with water and wants to do everything by himself. My 1-year-old follows and copies everything he does. The fun could become risky.  

*I thought the vigilance stays behind but once or whenever I go out.
 I still have my home in my head. Their silence echoes like a check-up bell in my head.*

I’m try not to overthink to prevent anxiety, but I often worry a lot. So  I’m always making calls to check on them if I'm not available.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmezJjL4VUchqsQf3rAPziRgruDRHmkEDUosAT9tKcsFg2/1779280444680.jpg)

For me, it’s more important than urgent now.
The way I rushed to the clinic that day was like I lost my sense. They endless criticism about negligence and carelessness. 
I really don’t want that kind of scare anymore.  

*The vigilance started from fear but upholding it has become a conscious choice for my peace of mind, family serenity and welfare.
It is not only guilt nor fear of what people will say but a chosen priority  until my kids are older to understand and be more independent. * 

**My kid’s safety strenthens my peace of mind, family serenity and welfare.**

Image is mine.

title.title: Wednesday Walk - Finally Back
title.body:
I'm finally back for another #wednesdaywalk by @tattoodjay
![1000005080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/245mkBwPAfHhKwX5BgCZXyrwNkmHKVRtfoTm2NFzG1RW4idFAXmMhmHz2u79eZc4PhWbi.jpg)
I saw this old looking alleyway with lots of wires and thought it would make a nice watercolor someday. Have to come up with some kind of creature to inhabit the alleyway though.

![1000005066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EpC8smW4uiyVfXehYsnUJiy8yGdq6rUhU6y7Dw7KrrXw9DVNHDzbP2Ero9qvyxdjCTS.jpg)
Stuck at the park playground again while dodging various ticks that crawl around and keeping my daughter free of getting bitten by ticks as she slides and climbs the jungle gym over and over again.

![1000005077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EokbcgmTd5jMC1ETu8Rkp9TD2F51SJen8rCE3dcoSbsy4Y8HUegjiTkQE7scTPagXFQ.jpg)
A naughty squirrel that digs in the trash behind our condo. This time it found some cookies one of the neighbors threw away.

![1000005030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EoTcxLvTCBoENgXfyxc7UrTXkekzo4B3be7vXLmS9pJoTLSNevceNiuSMTKE3F7fMnb.jpg)
Back at the lake again. This year it is quite mucked up with algae.

![1000005187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EoK4pNNQsBx5ZkgNifTBYYhYYYC9cvXuE4LHGviPUFo8MWYHp2xwL6s7vtCjiiLvbFN.jpg)
I found some wild irises growing at a forest preserve. Most of them are yellow but this is a first seeing purple ones.

![1000005189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/23uFa4uWBnYb1g3NdFS4gz9BoZ5Krf8EEeUekoszyZhpabrrPuzMbi49YoHW92VwNpA1C.jpg)
Sadly a baby brown snake got run over on a bike path. I've really been hoping to catch one of these again to show my daughter, instead she got to see this dried out mummified one. 

![1000005202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EoeDyzpQKcHQkLf8ADkTooYPYAsw1846LT6XAgVC4nkTust6xEGzjHL2dTn35MwzziZ.jpg)
Now for a goose saga. 
![1000005201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EoyNWv693KoLTA6eYA4SuCnTykdEc4RrPTrxdKE5dX9X7MXMLUq2wcDdDXQk2rLkbhP.jpg)
Two families of geese hatched off my neighbor's balconies. This is one family and I think they recognized me as they walked right up to me. 

![1000005200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Ep7t5NFa4bqgNP4iGMim7MtZ4s1LZHBXSuUS42U7NhAuF3AodirbV1frdBueUqrXVri.jpg)
This might be the 5th generation of geese that have hatched off my neighbor's balcony. Now we are getting additional pairs of them nesting. 

![1000005142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Ep5kEQs6JW2ZV5xzQ22n8oWovEgbb6V7scSchjA8KbCbWEY2DmkkAe749CqrNCdxfBX.jpg)
Nice and tame by seeing us all the time. Plus they have only a quarter mile walk to the lake from the balconies. My neighbors and I often get roped into tossing stray babies off the balcony to the rest of their family as they head to the lake. 

![1000005141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/EoGvu2w2NUTpmGh3VsdeCn85oGax96ZJNbs57XTHjSSi9URCWiBufHY4DmQ9Bxs42jJ.jpg)
Sometimes we only notice a lone gosling by itself left on the balcony and we have to take it to the lake and try and find the family to reunite it with them.
![1000005137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sketch.and.jam/Eo8RrAUb3BVeVdnjuFsMQJbEX2sbW5Bkn4eXZibVqyHaLEF3oarWtVX6xYxzbYS93jv.jpg)
Fortunately there are at least three families of geese at the lake each year. They seem to adopt them readily as I doubt I am reuniting them with their original family. They'll sort themselves out eventually lol. As they grow I keep a count on how many of them survive. So far only one has gone missing so far out of 18. Maybe a skunk or fox got it. 

That's all for now, thanks for looking :-)

title.title: 20 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3109: cut the cord
title.body:
Cut the cord Bombs in movies are used to achieve a goal, or to gain an advantage, something like manipulating something in favor of whoever plants it. They don't always have a red and a blue wire; sometimes they add another color to increase the tension. The minutes tick by quickly, and the adrenaline is pumping. The bomb disposal expert, after following a specific protocol, knows exactly which wire to cut, but doesn't act quickly, even though he's certain that cutting the red wire to the detonator is the right move. A terrifying silence fills the air, a suspense that seems to stop time. It's as if words could detonate the bomb. The expert knows exactly when to order the red wire to be cut, but he hesitates, waiting until the last second to speak. The one with the wire cutters waits for the magic word, suspicious, but proceeds nonetheless, his chest about to explode. He has no certainty, yet he hopes to neutralize the bomb, but he can't shake the feeling that at any moment the boom will sound and it will all be over. Cortar el cable Las bombas en las películas, son utilizadas para obtener un fin, o una ventaja en algo, algo así como para manipular algo a favor de quien la coloca, no siempre trae un cable rojo y uno azul a veces le colocan un color más para aumentar la tensión. Los minutos pasan rápido y la adrenalina a mil por hora, mientras el experto en desactivacion después de cierto protocolo sabe realmente cual es el color a cortar, pero no actúa con rapidez aunque tenga la certeza de que cortar el cable rojo para el detonador, se llena de un silencio aterrador, un suspenso que parece detener el tiempo, es como si las palabras pudieran hacer detonar la bomba, el experto sabe que cuando exactamente mandar a cortar el cable rojo pero se detiene, espera hasta el último segundo para articular palabras, el que está con el cortacables en mano espera la palabra mágica, desconfía pero de igual forma procede con toda su caja torácica a punto de estallar, él si no tiene certezas sin embargo espera poder neutralizar pero no puede evitar la sensación de que en cualquier momento suene el boom y todo acabe. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPECxkjMi2fwnKPjYpfD5cfLNbmje7Q81hMDXswHAkqpq/1779283034966.jpg)

title.title: STREET ART #252 – Inspired by nature on the island, Mauritius
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCk8GHjqjVTe9cYqNVsXKuVEnGWJaAotyJt23UXiUVDJ/01.jpg)
Lovely work done by a Mauritian artist. This is the second time I have found paintings by Daphné Doomun. She has done this work on of the buildings located at the L'Aventure du Sucre Museum in Pamplemousse. The museum is inside an old sugar factory and when you visit it, you will learn a lot about sugar and how Mauritian history is connected with sugar. I have been here a couple of times, but this is the first time I see the paintings on the buildings.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzDegiYCNHEAXyGUfqUzSSnGNVRyvWfsFAUBdq15cGvm/02.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9pvkLtwXgxnsMywNX7agRT4qsKMGaaXrdRehQihT2vH/03.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKeK5X45AyEMyZ41epcRSr1wpJ64r6Zn7SD9WgUgVfdG/04.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmd28FzLDdJW4cn5HVkcoHax3fnTqBSqtqSAhAqfDGvH7q/05.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmZJSYpUTu2AejrtBHKjSvbbPRjocJvVhqydxXK6RkrbB6/06.jpg
The building that has become her canvas, is the kitchen belonging to the restaurant that is situated outside the museum building itself. She has decorated two walls with mofifs from nature on the island. It is nature here in Mauritius that has inspired her. She is showing the diversity of when it comes to plants and birds. Even the island is small, it has quite a diverse landscape.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdc7QxdNUXHLHZE7n33NXaqTXhW4uNpeg3NayVLiY4nJf/07.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmR94rnvmmigjJ7TxSHVzUb8GRzs3uZDUGjpFt8LojEy8i/08.jpg https://i.ecency.com/DQmf79JVXZUzebXpmeDeBkKQKBN9sQBv1Z5CJ2d7Jwt449D/09.jpg
She painted these walls as part of participating a workshop organized by L'Aventure du Sucre. The artists were given completely freedom to paint whatever they wanted. Last time when I found one of her paintings, the theme was life in the ocean (check link). This time she is inpired by nature. She has painted plants and birds that are native to the island. The Dodo and the pigeom I recognize. Daphé was born in 1989 here in Mauritius. She is a graphic designer, but has also worked for houses like Kenzo and Parfumes Civenchy. title.title: Everybody knows
title.body:
/>

They all say, transparency breeds trust. Publish every salary, every bonus, every contract on a website, and maybe inequality can no longer be concealed. Employees will be able to accurately compare wages, bring injustice to light and bargain from a position of strength, not silence.

But information isn’t neutral.

The minute income is made public, jealousy is given a voice. Families will compare; friends will compete; employers will value individuals in numbers alone; criminals will see targets; society will use money instead of character to define the measure of a human being and private thoughts will become the indelible part of every man or woman.

Transparency might be the key for employers to have accountability. Invisible discrimination, salary disparities and oppressive work conditions may not be able to exist in open sunlight. Employees, who previously remained ignorant to the fact they were being taken advantage of, may finally push for equal treatment.

However, transparency might result in other types of pressure. Employers will perhaps be less inclined to accommodate workers' requests for more time off for fear of reprisal. Workers, who are earning insufficient income, may be stuck between a rock and a hard place, because even if they are being paid a good salary they will still be judged and resented. When such information is public, nobody has the capacity to survive their situation, but the human mind reduces itself to an object that needs to be placed under a microscope.

Will everybody lose out?

Not totally.

Some practices are benefited by information sharing. Without secrecy, it is difficult for people to engage in corrupt activities. However, complete disclosure without protection can harm individual privacy and safety and impact on interpersonal relations within society. Therefore, a healthy society requires a balance between the sharing of information for purposes of ensuring fairness, and the preservation of private spheres in order to uphold personal individuality.

Once the income of everybody is known by everyone else, money will cease to be a tool for survival and will instead become a public measure of value.

The story of human beings tells that the fear of hardship cannot compete with the shame of constant social comparison.

今日天气算是正式进入夏季了，早晨20℃左右，午后气温就上31℃了…啊啊啊，感受一下夏日的热烈暴击吧

用某音的积分兑换了鲍师傅家的女王蛋糕，只需再支付0.11元即可，太划算啦…

这女王蛋糕还是老蛋糕的口感，不过我个人吃着觉得偏甜一点，中奖奶油味有点椰香浓郁可口，需要搭配上茉莉花茶，正好综合一下甜味，似乎也没觉得太甜腻…这样下午茶就OK啦…

天气开始逐渐热起来，尤其到了中午，气温就上30℃了，不少店铺开启空调，星巴克也不例外，只是他家空调有点太冷了，当然，和我正好坐下出风口的位置也有关系吧…

午后来星巴克，这次没有额外消费，饮品是在超市买好的，蛋糕也是通过某音兑换的，还去东百买了杨桃果脯以及红枣核桃糕…

茉莉花茶，小蛋糕，再来上一口杨桃果脯，还别说，这混搭还有点意思哈，直接整上水果茶咯…

对了，饮料还是农夫山泉家的无糖茶，正好遇到超市做活动，两瓶才7.8元左右，而且还可以参加扫码抽奖活动，这次很幸运，其中一瓶开盖后又扫中0.5元红包现金，直接入微信钱包…另外一瓶没中奖哈，不管咋样…至少对于我来说，他们家的中奖率真挺高的，从上月到现在为止中了5次奖咯…

虽说不是66元，666元大奖，至少来说，算得上小奖不断，心情舒畅哈哈哈哈哈，真是好运来。

今天还是520，又是一个有爱的日子，我也收到小礼物了，还是茉莉花茶店送的茉莉花呢，浓郁的茉莉花香啊，好闻的很。。

OK，今天先分享到这儿把，祝福大家520快乐！！

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**
