title.title: O Open Source Alcançou a Fronteira: O Que Mudou em 2026
title.body:
Por anos, a narrativa foi a mesma: modelos open source ficam 6 a 12 meses atrás dos proprietários. Eram bons para prototipagem, adequados para casos de uso simples, necessários para quem tem restrições de privacidade — mas não eram a melhor escolha se você precisasse do desempenho máximo disponível.

Em 2026, essa narrativa chegou ao fim. Não como hipérbole, mas como fato verificável em benchmarks públicos.

O Que Aconteceu
---------------

Quatro lançamentos em poucos meses definiram o ponto de inflexão:

**DeepSeek V4 Pro** (MIT, abril de 2026): 1,6 trilhão de parâmetros, 49 bilhões ativos, 80,6% SWE-Bench Verified — equivalente ao Claude Opus 4.6 proprietário.

**Llama 4 Maverick** (Meta Llama License, abril de 2026): 400 bilhões totais, 17 bilhões ativos, melhor que GPT-4o e Gemini 2.0 Flash em benchmarks multimodais, contexto de 1 milhão de tokens.

**Gemma 4** (Apache 2.0, abril de 2026): quatro tamanhos, do menor ao maior, todos com capacidades multimodais. O Google liberando sob Apache 2.0 — uma das licenças mais permissivas disponíveis.

**Mistral Medium 3.5** (MIT modificada, maio de 2026): 128 bilhões denso, 77,6% SWE-Bench, roda em quatro GPUs.

A Arquitetura MoE Como Denominador Comum
----------------------------------------

Um padrão técnico une os maiores lançamentos open source de 2026: quase todos usam Mixture of Experts. DeepSeek V4 Pro (1,6T total / 49B ativos), Llama 4 Maverick (400B / 17B), Qwen 3.5 da Alibaba (397B / 17B), Llama 4 Scout (109B / 17B).

O MoE resolveu o problema fundamental que limitava o open source: como ter capacidade de modelo grande com custo de inferência de modelo pequeno. A resposta foi ter muitos especialistas e ativar apenas uma fração em cada token processado.

O resultado prático: um modelo de 400 bilhões de parâmetros que custa para inferir como um modelo de 17 bilhões. Essa eficiência foi o que tornou viável ter modelos de fronteira rodando em hardware que organizações reais conseguem operar.

A Tabela de Benchmarks Que Importa
----------------------------------

<table style=\

>

US$ 1,50/M

O padrão é claro: os melhores modelos abertos chegam a 77-80% do benchmark principal de produção, enquanto os fechados estão em 85-88%. A diferença existe — mas é de 7 a 10 pontos percentuais, não de uma geração inteira. Licenças: Nem Todo Open Source É Igual -------------------------------------- A abertura técnica do código não equivale à abertura legal do uso. Em 2026, as principais licenças do ecossistema têm diferenças práticas importantes: **MIT (DeepSeek V4, partes do Mistral):** A mais aberta. Uso comercial irrestrito, sem obrigações de compartilhar modificações, sem restrições por tamanho de empresa. **Apache 2.0 (Gemma 4):** Similar à MIT em liberdade de uso, com proteção de patentes explícita. Padrão corporativo de fato para projetos de código aberto. **Meta Llama License:** Permite uso comercial para a maioria, mas empresas acima de 700 milhões de MAU precisam de licença especial. Usuários da União Europeia estavam restritos no lançamento. Não é open source no sentido técnico da OSI. Para compliance legal, a distinção importa. Para a maioria das empresas, MIT e Apache 2.0 são equivalentes na prática. A Meta Llama License exige análise caso a caso. O Que Mudou Para Quem Toma Decisões de Infraestrutura ----------------------------------------------------- Antes de 2026, a decisão de usar modelo proprietário versus open source tinha dois componentes: capacidade técnica (fechados eram melhores) e custo/privacidade (abertos eram mais baratos e privados). Em 2026, o componente de capacidade técnica quase desapareceu para a maioria dos casos de uso. A decisão agora é: **Use modelo via API proprietária quando:** suporte empresarial é necessário, SLAs são exigidos, a integração com o ecossistema (Azure, Google Cloud) tem valor, ou o caso de uso específico está nos 7-10 pontos percentuais superiores que apenas o Opus 4.7 ou GPT-5.5 entregam. **Use modelo open source quando:** privacidade de dados é não-negociável, volume é alto o suficiente para o custo de API ser relevante, customização via fine-tuning é necessária, ou você quer eliminar dependência de fornecedor. A Velocidade do Ciclo --------------------- Outra mudança estrutural de 2026: o ritmo de lançamentos. Em abril e maio de 2026, foram lançados DeepSeek V4, Llama 4 Scout/Maverick, Gemma 4 (4 variantes), Mistral Medium 3.5, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.3 e Qwen 3.6 Plus — todos em cerca de 60 dias. Esse ritmo tem implicações para quem toma decisões de plataforma. Escolhas feitas em janeiro de 2026 podem estar desatualizadas em março. A estratégia de \

está sendo substituída por arquiteturas de abstração que permitem trocar modelos sem refatorar a aplicação.

Conclusão: O Mapa Mudou
-----------------------

O ecossistema de LLMs em maio de 2026 é fundamentalmente diferente de um ano atrás. Open source chegou à fronteira. Licenças verdadeiramente abertas como MIT estão em modelos de capacidade de produção. O custo por token caiu entre 5x e 10x para casos de uso equivalentes.

Para quem constrói infraestrutura de IA, o desafio de 2026 não é mais acesso à capacidade — é escolha entre abundância. E isso, em comparação com o que existia antes, é um problema muito melhor de ter.

title.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 47 Telephone booth memories [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Miniatura para Youtube Guía de Viaje Moderno.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xp4L6PPKPNejKiHY9ap8WhwkKKj1LUxjWAdCGcHMZ4D8tD5cubbMajU9QhWe9HZMoPb.jpg)

Okay, let's talk about phone booths, those that are scattered around the city today, silent witnesses to the past. Here in Valencia, Venezuela, many have been vandalized; only the frame hangs where a phone once stood. Others survive unchanged, like the memories of those of us who used them. I remember how practical they were back in the '80s and '90s. You'd carry a small physical directory in your pocket with all the important numbers written down, just in case you needed to call someone. Nowadays, you have all that on your cell phone, right at your fingertips: directory and phone number. >Muy bien, hablemos de casetas telefónicas, esas que hoy en día están repartidas por la ciudad como testigos mudos del pasado. Aquí en Valencia (Venezuela) Muchas fueron vandalizadas, solo cuelga la estructura donde alguna vez hubo un telefono, otras sobreviven inmutables, como los recuerdos de quienes llegamos a usarlas. Recuerdo que era algo muy practico de usar por allá en los años 80 y noventa, uno solían andar con un pequeño directorio físico guardado en el bolsillo donde tenía anotado todos los números importantes, por si en algún momento necesitabas llamar a alguien, hoy en día todo eso lo tienes en tu telefono celular al alcance de tu mano, directorio y telefono.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/243M2iXBg9ajFypDsRKRWDpdWZVhU1uCXB9tzxEnEh7k5a45sd128YTfz9teroE8qsjbg.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/marcar-caseta-telef%c3%b3nica-verde-4397323/)

At first we used to use coins to make calls; I don't know exactly how many coins were used, but I do remember that when a call was about to end, a robotic voice would politely ask you to deposit more coins to continue the call. Also, if I remember correctly, there was the option to call collect, meaning the recipient paid the cost of the call.

>Al principio solíamos usar monedas para llamar, en este momento no sé cuantas se usaban exactamente, pero sí conservo el recuerdo de que cuando una llamada estaba a punto de terminar, una voz robótica te pedía amablemente que depositaras más monedas para continuar la llamada, también, si mal no recuerdo, existía la opción de llamar por cobrar, es decir que el receptor pagaba el costo de la llamada.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23wC5QguYN8pwymiYiMpM4H5H9tYgb5NC8MiczM4gFTA1K6FVZWMxjV3NwRH6AjT8Awaz.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/euro-mano-moneda-1041682/)

Later, public telephones evolved and no longer required coins; there were no more coin acceptors. Instead, they had a slot through which a card was inserted. This card was issued by the telephone company in my country (CANTV) and was called a \

(Single Card). I remember they had designs of beautiful Venezuelan landscapes, and many people collected them. The cards came pre-loaded with a certain amount of money that was used up when you made calls. I also remember that public telephones offered the option of displaying on the screen how much money you had left on the card.

\n\n>Después, con el tiempo los teléfonos públicos evolucionaron ya ya no requerían de monedas, ya no había receptores de monedas, en su lugar tenían una ranura a través de la cual se introducía una tarjeta, esta tarjeta era expedida por la empresa de teléfonos de mi país (CANTV) y se llamaba \

Recuerdo que veían con diseños de paisajes hermosos de Venezuela y mucha gente las coleccionaba. Las tarjetas venían cargadas con cierta cantidad de dinero que se consumía cuando realizabas llamadas. También recuerdo que los teléfonos públicos te ofrecían la opción de mostrarte en pantalla cuanto dinero te quedaba en la tarjeta.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/EoiUGErdMHiAotKdcDL54oEiUcMRoSujUiXn1gPdFCJnnHnex8KQ7otJsrU4e1mtnBd.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tarjetas-cl%c3%a1sico-venta-colecci%c3%b3n-8594729/)

Well, it has truly been a pleasure for me to share my experience with you on this topic that brings back so much nostalgia to all of us who lived through those years.

>Bueno, de verdad que para mi ha sido un placer compartir con ustedes mi experiencia acerca de este tema que nos trae tanta nostalgia a todos los que vivimos esos años,
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

an mich
Sehr geehrter Herr Pürner,

Ihre Mail habe ich erhalten und auch der begonnene Antrag auf Gebührenbefreiung ist bei mir eingegangen.
In dem Antrag haben Sie jedoch lediglich den Kopfbogen mit Ihrem Namen, dem Geburtsdatum und der Anschrift ausgefüllt.
Um Ihren Antrag bearbeiten zu können, müssen Sie auf dem Antrag ankreuzen, welche Leistungen bzw. welches Einkommen Sie innerhalb des Gültigkeitszeitraums Ihres vorherigen Personalausweises bezogen haben (innerhalb der letzten 10 Jahre).
Außerdem müssen Sie auf dem Formular angeben, welche weiteren Gründe bestehen, die eine Bedürftigkeit im Sinne des § 1 Absatz 6 PAuswGebV begründen.
Die Gebühr kann ermäßigt oder von ihrer Erhebung abgesehen werden, wenn die Person, die die Gebühr schuldet, bedürftig ist. Eine Bedürftigkeit im Sinne von Satz 1 liegt nicht schon dann vor, wenn Leistungen nach dem Zweiten Buch Sozialgesetzbuch oder nach dem Zwölften Buch Sozialgesetzbuch bezogen werden.
Ihrer Mail vom 06.05.2026 haben Sie einen Bewilligungsbescheid von Bürgergeld nach dem Zweiten Buch Sozialgesetzbuch, beginnend im Mai 2026, beigefügt. Dieser allein wäre also nicht ausreichend.
Zudem fehlt bei Ihrem Antrag Ihre Unterschrift.


Wenn man nur die Geschichte hinter dem Zettel kennen wuerde, nur diesem einem Zettel der letzten Wochen.... :-)

Ja das nicht so Witzig ich zu sein wie man da oben sieht.

Aber Tauschen will ich auch net meine lieben Mittrockennasenaffen, so ist das auch nicht.^^

Salve

title.title: Leo [Movie Review] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/AKbDU5FaoedxBTBkNzYUGHtmyUvrw2CrM8aABAV5A1TpVJjbiAXQ2rVsmAU2pmd.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/384705993195119662/)

Hello everyone! How are you? While browsing Netflix, I came across a movie I didn't have much faith in, and I started watching it more to kill time than out of genuine conviction. However, I discovered some interesting things that led me to write this review. >¡Hola Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Revisando Netflix me encontré con una película a la que no le tenía mucha fe, y que empecé a ver más con la intención de matar el tedio que por verdadera convicción, sin embargo fui descubriendo cosas interesantes que me llevaron a redactar esta review

![bv.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/48Z7ryN5FxLMaGrQmRwAJ2GeRpTNLD7V2jZffXxJLwD3NYpq9evp2HsG9AK7cvuC4m.png)

Leo is an old lizard and the mascot of a Florida elementary school. When he discovers he only has a year left to live, he seriously considers running away because he can't understand how, in 75 years, he's never experienced adventures outside or known what lies beyond his glass enclosure. But when the substitute teacher, Ms. Malkin, arrives, he truly has a chance. She encourages the children to take the mascot home to foster a sense of responsibility. However, the children discover that Leo can talk, and not only that, but instead of running away, he dedicates himself to listening to the children's needs and advising them about their insecurities and worries.

>Leo es un lagarto viejo y además la mascota de una escuela primaria de Florida, al descubrir que solo le queda un año de vida comienza a plantarse la seria idea de huir de allí porque no puede entender como es que en 75 años nunca a probado vivir aventuras en el exterior o saber que hay más allá de su prisión de vidrio, pero cuando llega la maestra sustituta, la Sra. Malkin es cuando verdaderamente tiene una oportunidad, ya que ella insta a los niños a llevar la mascota a su casa para fomentar el sentido de la responsabilidad, sin embargo los niños descubren que Leo puede hablar, y no solo eso, sino que en lugar de huir él se dedica a escuchar las necesidades de los niños y a aconsejarlos acerca de sus inseguridades y preocupaciones
https://youtu.be/o8yzcW11X0g
[Fuente](https://www.youtu)

After watching the film, it immediately made me think about many things, but especially the fear of aging and of not having fulfilled all our planned goals—that terrible fear of having failed or of not having lived enough because, despite reaching a certain age, we never dared to look beyond our own limitations. However, the film, through Leo, leaves us with an invaluable lesson: it doesn't matter how intensely you live life, or whether you dedicated yourself to doing what you wanted, or whether you overcame your own challenges; what matters is the legacy you leave, the advice you give, how others remember you, having given your best to improve a place, a situation, a relationship—that's what truly matters. >Al terminar de ver la película me hizo pensar automáticamente en muchas cosas pero en especial el miedo al envejecimiento y a no haber cumplido con todas las metas previstas, ese terrible miedo a haber fracasado o a no haber vivido lo suficiente porque a pesar de tener cierta edad nunca nos atrevimos a mirar más allá de nuestras propias limitaciones. Sin embargo la película, a través de Leo, nos deja una valiosísima lección, y es que no importan con cuanta intensidad vivas la vida, o si te dedicaste o no a hacer lo que deseabas, si superaste tus propias retos, sino el legad que dejas, los consejos que das, la manera en que otros te recuerden, el haber dado lo mejor de ti para mejorar un espacio, una situación, una relación, eso es lo que importa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uQhgoMwwE1acmYqjwP8QEdXe3Sn2xg9AwyZckKwZ7oFW1jRZeweuu5Pzi4XSEkE7YRD.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/392798398767944443/)

The film also shows us the real fears of children, those insecurities that everyone has and that many of them are different from each other, depending of course on the context of each family: some deal with a lack of self-esteem, others with the overprotection of their parents, others are dealing with their parents' divorce, or suffer bullying at school, in short, but the important thing in the midst of all this is to generate trust to make communication more fluid, and in this way manage to connect with the children to show them that they are not alone.

>La película también nos muestra los miedos reales de los niños, esas inseguridades que todos tienen y que muchas de ellas son diferentes entre sí, dependiendo del contexto de cada familia desde luego: algunos lidian con falta de autoestima, otros con la sobreprotección de sus padres, otros están lidiando con el divorcio de sus padres, o sufren acoso escolar, en fin, pero lo importante en medio de todo esto es generar confianza para hacer que la comunicación sea más fluida, y de esta manera lograr conectar son los niños para demostrarles que no están solos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xyLzWG4C8iPiwREbd3WPNtYTaiNGRMPqRTPMMLZCAaM8X9XqvZcn9Js49VQ72DEUFLk.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/956029827155982878/)

But we also discover that it's not just children who need help; adults also have traumas and insecurities that often limit their own abilities or end up hurting others, as is the case with Mrs. Malkin. However, Leo also gives her the opportunity to listen to her, to understand her, and ultimately helps her rediscover herself and realize that she is capable of doing many good things, for herself and for others. So, the film truly surprised me in a very pleasant way.

>Pero además, también descubrimos que no solo los niños necesitan ayuda, los adultos también tienen traumas e inseguridades que muchas veces limitan sus propias capacidades o terminan lastimando a otros, como es el caso de Sra. Malkin, sin embargo Leo también le da la oportunidad de escucharla para entenderla y finalmente la ayuda a redescubriese a si misma y saber que es capaz de hacer muchas cosas buenas, por si misma y por otros. Así que de verdad la película me terminó sorprendiendo muy gratamente.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23w2gtWGYCSXUG8s3yHDGViw56MUvfRyev3STwASRCwMtPJwozqfXqNNkQdy8nAV2sEFJ.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/956029827155982976/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

title.body:
![-702398839_18358985365234756_6885390659009826435_n~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZF5MqXqETfcoYwS3FcTRwAR9jTqDShtDn4Af4umqzwX/-702398839_18358985365234756_6885390659009826435_n~2.jpg)


REZEPT 
Guten Morgen 🙋🏻‍♀️,
Diesen „Kuchen“ gabs am Wochenende und den werd ich sicher öfter mal machen.
Gesund und zuckerfrei. Die Früchte kannst du individuell austauschen.
Dazu gab’s bei mir ne Portion Quark für extra Proteine.
Viel Spass beim ausprobieren.

## Zutaten: ##

🍓200g Haferflocken
🍓Prise Salz
🍓1 TL Backpulver
🍓2 sehr reife Bananen, zerquetscht
🍓2 Eier
🍓300ml Milch
🍓etwa 100g Früchte nach Wahl, ich hab gefrorene Erdbeeren genommen

Zubereitung:

1️⃣Den Ofen auf 180 Grad vorheizen.
2️⃣Eine Auflaufform mit Backpapier auslegen.
3️⃣Alle Zutaten, bis auch die Früchte, miteinander verrühren.
4️⃣Teig in die Auflaufform geben und mit Früchten toppen.
5️⃣Ab in den Ofen, für ca. 35-40 Minuten.
6️⃣Individuell servieren.

Tip: Du kannst auch noch ein paar Samen oder Nüsse in den Teig oder oben drauf geben.
![703394573_18358985377234756_3928148609995680728_n.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNiz5uASG2G3G8YTqK9d7Dcaa3q5BEp2yFNABUJPuDtHW/-703394573_18358985377234756_3928148609995680728_n.jpg)

title.title: The Plant Structures You Think You Know (But Probably Don't)
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVr9FqBmtSwgGLsGMHWHmeByWQc6zT11cbTGUyJx1euiv/20260520_114519_collage.jpg)

I used to believe that beans are runners, not until I did my research and came up with a note. What captivated me most was discovering that there is a clear disparity between runner beans and stolons.

Runner beans do not have nodes which doesn't qualify it to be a runner as clearly stated in my article. Additionally, they may spread in a net-like fashion, making them look similar to potatoes or any other runner. 

Potato stems have nodes, which are points where new roots grow. These nodes might become specialized to store starch or nutrients. Thats why we have our yummy potatoes being propagated by stems. 

*What about the famous ginger?*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNSEQcEfPoFbjrMKggTo4ttTjkf5G4DJZZxgMtyLAL4zg/img_20260520_130403_2.jpg)

 Yes, it is a rhizome, which also runs horizontally but not above the ground. From my article, you can clearly see that Rhizomes differ from stolons, but they share a similarity in their horizontal growth pattern in that they grow horizontally. 

Bermuda grass is actually a stolon and not a rhizome, though its growth pattern shares some similarities with rhizomes — I sincerely did not know that.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNgqUCQuJE8ckHHVGF48acf2UiuEHm7H1yAg4NASSbpJ9/20260520_133952_collage.jpg)


However, yam and cassava are neither stolons nor rhizomes, as they do not have nodes that share similar hoeizontal groth as stolons. Cassava grows from the base of the stem.

Yam is a stem tuber, just like potatoes. Cassava, however, is a root tuber.

Hmmm!  I won't forget...


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbihVeANsA6WKPTnpu5Soe1iRiwS95HfznMfAhUYh62Tb/img_20260520_130414_2.jpg)


Plantain and pineapple are propagated through suckers. Plantain is a rhizome, and the small offshoots it produces are called suckers. Pineapple, however, is not a rhizome but can be propagated using suckers, slips, or crowns.

You can find the link to my short note to understand better.


[Article](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CoZ_fGr4b3UvyFWitXRRydFNizeXEwtQ/edit?usp=drivesdk&ouid=103452801886504999260&rtpof=true&sd=true)

Thanks for visiting

title.title: Welcoming my cousin in Venezuela [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Miniatura para Youtube Un día Conmigo Divertido Rosa y Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23w2yaw15RU5E3VBamD7XH45jz7ueMqFeVtmETncVgmFBkNac6pzEkh9Sfj5Zo1jg8Gi6.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

A few days ago, my family had the immense joy of welcoming back my cousin, who currently lives in Spain. She missed her country and her people terribly, so she took some time off and flew to Venezuela (my country) to reconnect with her roots. True to our faith, and even more so to her Salesian upbringing as a former student of the Don Bosco Catholic school, my cousin organized a family gathering in one of the school's common rooms. One of the priests, who is also an alumnus, is a great friend of hers, and in fact, he was the one who celebrated the thanksgiving mass for my cousin's arrival. >Hace días tuvimos la enorme dicha en la familia de recibir de vuelta a mi prima quién actualmente vive en España, ella extrañaba demasiado su país y a su gente, así que tomó unos días libres que tenía y voló hasta Venezuela (Mi pais) para reencontrarse con su esencia, y fiel a nuestra fe y más aún a su formación salesiana como exalumna del colegio católico Don Bosco, mi prima organizó una reunión familiar en una de las salas comunes de dicho colegio, ya que uno de los sacerdotes que también es un exalumno, es un gran amigo de ella, y de hecho fue él quién llevó a cabo la misa de acción de gracias por la llegada de mi prima.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.03 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eq5DvBXVRipP3M7Pyp6dcX7XxusW8zRUkzrNpGBsWoVepK3L8RFp8ucJH8BkCU6RfMi.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.02 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23ydA1vq5M75Ca7CMPqgnmaDPcrKGJ1zh4JDFZCLurBjhu2ejkmvWbBA5utzyqWcMGx9a.jpeg)

After the mass, my cousin led us to the school library, which also serves as a common room. Everyone in the family was excited; some had seen it before, but my parents, my sister, and I saw it for the first time that day. It really hadn't changed at all in three years.

>Al terminar la misa mi prima nos condujo hacia la biblioteca del colegio que también funciona como sala común, todos estábamos emocionados en la familia, algunos ya la habían visto con anterioridad pero mis padres, mi hermana y yo la vimos fue ese día, realmente no había cambiado nada en tres años.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.02 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpNoTbN729K1TbNPcHDYRekyQivmUNi38wWg5xFgxL26E8dwRqro4VnB6FsPuzaQmkn.jpeg)

Inside, we settled in for breakfast as a family and chatted amongst ourselves, something we hadn't done in ages. My cousin told us about her experiences living in Madrid and Barcelona, ​​her difficulty with the Catalan language, and also about her experience as a doctor practicing abroad and her volunteer work at a nursing home where she met a friendly old man (Javier) with whom she became good friends because he reminds her of our grandfather.

>Allí dentro nos dedicamos a desayunar en familia y a conversar entre nosotros como teníamos muchísimo tiempo sin hacerlo. Mi prima nos contó como fue su experiencia viviendo en Madrid y Barcelona, su dificultad con el idioma catalán y también su experiencia como médico ejerciendo en el extranjero y su trabajo como voluntaria para un ancianato en el cuál conoció a un simpático viejecito (Javier) con el que hizo una buena amistad porque le recuerda a nuestro abuelo,
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.59 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpEKkoTKhUZQMtKoCeh7hr6SDLUZydaqH7KorX7QYBSpc49vuHXjgSw7HfN8DQShuVE.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.59 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23ynSNPcSoNFXk3sCdFgCBcyRC5Lq3uaekpVhZtRySfbrSScrdbeVgw9Wu8e5Vmeh9wJJ.jpeg)

Two of my cousins ​​were a little sad because the day before they had been at their paternal grandmother's funeral, but this nice family moment was enough to lift their spirits and remind them that they have a lot of support, so they seemed much more cheerful while we chatted and planned a girls' night out, one that we still owe each other, by the way.

>Dos de mis primas estaban un poco tristes porque el día anterior habían estado en el funeral de su abuela paterna, pero este buen momento familiar fue suficiente para levantarles el ánimo y recordarles que tienen mucho apoyo, así que se veían mucho más animadas mientras conversábamos y planeábamos una salida entre chicas, una que todavía nos debemos, por cierto.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.01 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EqYvYUpB8HbBiS52kEEZfbH1SxfJWQvE42NMRwW3z8YFUCBLu4QDVgesft4nrM8Qttr.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.07.01 PM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/243M9AXMB993urJupLbwBf9Jz8UDwPRhAtCi9M4EjTUXzSezQ4QR3guq4ZDhLvrkLoTxU.jpeg)

And of course, I wasn't going to miss the opportunity to immortalize the moment with my cousin. At Grandpa's house, we always had a wonderful way of growing up, under the motto that we were more than cousins, we were siblings. That's why we still consider ourselves family, and despite the distance that separates us, despite some of us now living far from our country and our roots, the love for family remains within us, the love for traditions, the teachings, the wise advice of our grandparents, our childhood pranks, our camaraderie—everything is intact. In the photo below, my cousin and I are with the oldest cousin, whom we've always called \

\n\n>Y por supuesto que yo no iba a perder la oportunidad de inmortalizar el momento con mi prima. En casa del abuelo siempre tuvimos una hermosa manera de crecer bajo la consigna de que éramos más que primos, éramos hermanos, por eso así nos consideramos actualmente, y a pesar de la distancia que nos separa, a pesar de que algunos viven hoy en día lejos de su país y sus raíces, el amor por la familia lo llevan dentro, el amor por las costumbres, las enseñanzas, los sabios consejos de los abuelos, nuestras travesuras de niños, nuestra camaradería, todo está intacto. En la foto de abajo mi prima y yo estamos con la mayor de las primas a quién llamamos \

desde siempre.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.40 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wX3cvwYbChTXMN1a4QDdAWcz3u6JovJETNU2LVymCzMEZzpa3YbN3udbQeufW4smftq.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.41 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vi1x3w2fKjJp43kP6jxHQK9o7zNozjsFXKwLqJ3sZCPXNKfmZbsUphCJHvSvXyGovpm.jpeg)

We took a tour of the school to see how much it had changed over the years, and just when I was about to think the changes were limited to a few murals that weren't there before, we discovered they had added a new chapel in what used to be a classroom dedicated to the automotive engineering program, which they no longer offer. It's quite lovely and can accommodate several people. It's not as large as the school church (which I showed in the first photo), but this is a chapel, so the atmosphere is much more intimate. I liked the stained-glass windows at the entrance.

>Dimos un recorrido por el colegio para comprobar cuanto había cambiado en todos los años que habían pasado, y cuando estaba a punto de pensar que el cambio se reducía a unos cuantos murales que no solían estar allí antes, descubrimos que habían añadido una nueva capilla en lo que antes era un salón dedicado a la mención \

que ya no imparten en el colegio. Es bastante bonita y tiene capacidad para varias personas, no es tan grande como la iglesia del colegio (que mostré en la primera foto) pero esta es una capilla, así que el ambiente es mucho más íntimo. Me gustó el detalle de los vitrales en la entrada.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.22 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Ep7u69Q6AYmMGdwbBVRvXszyXSX9sZ8wsscQgQ5BX1Rbk1gc4rPdtaT8Fw11iPt46Y1.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.05 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoiUpLThN8Ntx6T8uf7HnL9KQpMtHRGbSgykGgBbo6eo5edMvqyhH5ckBrj7PbduhVT.jpeg)

Here I am with my beloved aunt Victoria, my cousin's mother who arrived from abroad. Her face shows the happiness of having received her daughter, and although she only came for a visit, it still comforts us to have her here for at least a few days.

>Aquí estoy con mi amada tía Victoria, la mamá de mi prima que llegó del exterior, en su rostro se nota la felicidad de haber recibido a su hija, y aunque ella solo vino de visita, igualmente nos reconforta tenerla por aquí al menos unos días.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.07 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xyZkPi6gfmy5c4jG6EtbVXwD9WsAVRUbhqXwUs6B3AR7NHpeReVuEWa7pNvXVSvPcq6.jpeg)

Here I am with my mom, my sister, my cousins, and my only uncle on my mom's side, the spoiled one of the house. He's one of those uncles you adore because he's always making you laugh 😄

>Aquí estoy con mi mamá, mi hermana, mis primas y mi único tío por parte de mamá, el consentido de la casa, él es de esos tíos que adoras porque siempre está haciéndote reír 😄
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.19 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xySmXnphSGr2DNgTVzwyrFksqa6ySPCWfWMLuX9DSrzgXyyFUcjHoMXnuR6iPnK15LT.jpeg)

We had more than just a pleasant time; we had a blessed, happy, and unique family moment, which is why I am extremely grateful to God, and also to you for allowing me to share it here.

>Pasamos más que un momento agradable, pasamos un momento en familia, bendecido, feliz y único, por eso estoy sumamente agradecida con Dios, y también con ustedes por permitirme compartirlo por aquí.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)
>Imagen diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva.

All images in this post are my own, taken with a ZTE Blade A51.

>Todas las imágenes de este post son de mi propiedad, las tomé con un teléfono celular ZTE Blade A51.

 Hey everybody! Episode 194 of the show is out. In this episode, I spoke with Robert Gourlay. Robert is a scientist, in, I think, the best definition of that word, someone who is an innovator, a pioneer, a philosopher, and who looks at the world through a holistic lens. He has dedicated his life to the study of water and how structured, negatively charged water supports and helps humans and life to flourish. We spoke about his background, how an NDE helped to open him to his passion for water, what structured water is and the benefits, how to improve health through water, water on a micro and macro scale, climate science, and much more. title.title: Stroll, Art, and Clouds / Paseo, Arte y Nubes
title.body:
![Collage de fotos vertical recuerdos de viaje simple azul.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23u69dMsZnvD8qEr6yQpNjW5xDb2Hy7TriXar4Yhq3cb5JX6UMRW5VjPTJjkj4PJK2yBh.png)






<div class=\

> Towering over the city of Caracas stands one of the city’s most exotic and enigmatic hotels, a space that has evolved over the years into a true icon of the capital while captivating both locals and visitors alike. Exploring it is a comforting experience, and walking through its halls is like traveling to a past that remains alive.

> Sobre la ciudad de Caracas se encuentra uno de los hoteles más exóticos y enigmáticos de la ciudad, un espacio que se ha transformado con el pasar de los años en un verdadero icono de la capital y al mismo tiempo ha cautivado a propios y visitantes. Recorrerlo es una experiencia reconfortante y caminar entre sus instalaciones es como viajar a un pasado que se mantiene vivo.
![1-IMG_20260423_174107 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/2423sLyb1Nv5omr5d1PTXVTqdjMvmB5M8g8uZv8a7SJqF2dRTk2Jft5RBKSqRsYykte3g.jpg) ![1-IMG_20260423_174107 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eonjbdm7eSTQu8i4ZVRUurvunC8y9G98au59zuVMwnCKrTcCZrU7wzPdyn1G86xNisv.jpg) ![1-IMG_20260423_174107 (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep5njKxPJDuEzxoRGKXWsWNu6ZDGf2YQ7zghpZi8DPSQYeeVYciDhVZXeB2G9DhDtak.jpg)

> This time, my Wednesday feature focuses on that area of the Hotel Humboldt that serves as an exhibition hall—a place where abstract art takes center stage in a truly captivating setting, where figures of all kinds, colors, and a touch of kinetics intertwine to offer us a fresh and engaging experience, where each piece tells a different story and where, from an individual perspective, we’ll create a truly unique interaction.

> En esta oportunidad, mi pasado del miércoles se centra en esa área del Hotel Humboldt que se nos presenta como una sala de exposiciones, un lugar en donde el arte abstracto se convierte en el protagonista de una escena totalmente cautivadora, en donde las figuras de todos los tipos, los colores y algo de cinetismo se entrelazan para brindarnos una experiencia fresca y atractiva, en donde cada pieza nos cuenta una historia diferente y en donde, desde el punto de vista individual, generaremos una interacción realmente única.
![IMG_20260423_174301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23vhuntf31dHBxLvyUaASGFiF3meospsMvHhEkNFsydCqqduYFfKErPvrVYemU4e3K84x.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174351(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep7uCGZRMNoYxKaBWNK3y4e8ynsX8dvRgDfdx9NCHD4Hcy9mRc1XLnWdzGVhwyfTMxn.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep1WyM3gVe3N71u4VUAJbfPjJkp1g1Zt8E3s2eoqfLM7kEY3gVY4ZFogg4GPYEy5TM3.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wMf2uReiCYy8BmceD4tCv9JFn7765AYW42eeWdC2HYc5QxcJnnNnjv2sGdcB9hEpW1i.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Ep3foLQuvUJt5hLyPiz8im7bEEN7HANef5dpnFcVdeTWeuFhWKhp69agNhjH5rPPA8S.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoEoaRAQfN6StnXV6e1DktjF3BgHCabAtbwK4XexeU3DLXsFvHhzcdJgqxixRHsJs1L.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpGQJRRBj93YipjGhDPhqSy84eg9Woi7wwUtxevtYZihay7AgcELVFdnJ7ptuQgkoy7.jpg)

> At the same time, elements and materials that were part of the hotel’s original furnishings—dating back to the 1950s—have been preserved and have now become true museum pieces. All these pieces stand out for their similar colors, great sturdiness, and a sense of solidity that has stood the test of time.

> Al mismo tiempo se conservan elementos y materiales que forman parte del mobiliario original del hotel, los cuales datan de los años 50 y que ahora se han convertido en verdaderas piezas de museo. Todos estos aparatos se destacan por tener colores similares, una gran robustez y al mismo tiempo una sensación de solidez que ha logrado perdurar en el tiempo.
![IMG_20260423_174736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/243WRLUx5TUCLD8hwYW4f122GSnwE7GzXARywZv6J4N2kSUFTr2sEMXY9yn5ycV4h31F6.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqBcgQcE4pCBWLeAP57xUD8C3gpoKQnf5m8NyusJ28MbPgtNm47L4u2pFrf2kw9iP1w.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EqfGtuGJ54tPKYzUcRNaPBbHqnQ36xfQwqB38cZJU5wVGjmDDvSVtAk8yZpzG7aarYH.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpviKQfy7CXnKDTBLdxXBTsNv8BunFZkgcYHeMHK8kRkJXL3BETScYXC9AEnd1n1wrv.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EonmWiF61rnBecoFtS3yRVeCZeh6cJFMssSiACRL41v5CJmgjTaTRBVySTqbwRGWZMz.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpnDJwJ3tW1wtepfd35Mp3KhCszrVaFxcPzudKwrTUEF7ZQKEyD8kGQMhGNMtVyimmN.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpVC8TmDbi29PJDiJRtmyYG6rpbiRXHb2k1DR2UQUbtV1dkmkwc2tELzUsd1M7bLQ6o.jpg)

> This is how this tour becomes a journey through two eras: on one hand, we encounter the 21st century with its dynamism, energy, and colors; on the other, the 20th century presents itself as a space that is somewhat more subdued and somber, yet at the same time remarkably enduring.

> Es así como este paseo se convierte en una especie de andar entre dos épocas: encontramos al siglo XXI con su dinamismo, sus vibras y colores y, por el otro, el siglo XX se nos presenta como un espacio un poco más sobrio, pesado, pero al mismo tiempo muy duradero.
![IMG_20260423_174920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpNopE41VSkAvpsSvWrRZBpoARktBWZv2Fked1WptcUckDHQwdVe6c4CWx7Dfv1EZ1G.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpLgw593PENGq3MAwWfFxa3C13cnJm1P6mLDTRcqcGMS2sUcrYQU915acKQTXkNRXaJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_180653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23uFYHfpJ14W3QUjF1tqzyWLQ9G7CGUQX8v1UEe5HQxVZYJBkDuMWpSjRzy1EWtTnB8BL.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182046.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpGQnhyGKmN4abV8caNEKC5pZWo36jGzNVupTnQjwDTvaJvKofwEMRsZY9SCoubEsMi.jpg)

> It is a very interesting experience, as it showcases two very different eras, yet their purpose remains practically the same: to offer guests and visitors a high-quality experience that leaves an indelible mark, one that will undoubtedly make a difference and leave a beautiful memory of the city of Caracas.

> Es una experiencia muy interesante, ya que se trata de una muestra de dos épocas muy distintas, pero cuya finalidad sigue siendo prácticamente la misma: brindar a los huéspedes y visitantes una experiencia de alta calidad y con una huella indeleble, la cual sin duda alguna marcará la diferencia y dejará un bonito recuerdo de la ciudad de Caracas.
![IMG_20260423_174516(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eo263ptNcAXmsfm9xavrQLeD7SGqPvBvVqbMR4oSro9NGo6A9PzWz2Q2pxsGoLnbLLz.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpCAopAN1ME1qkuDZDfDawtkghFZqXp9q9otfj2f28weeonqbsota593TGQRKZXuUbu.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpNpJRLgyyPgBj3ZfDsTWC1EThTwfV2YawudUkB78eCbCNe6wfAjUrvWNVT3SsNpj65.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EpEJGHrxcs9myzYMAvnPBSN2wti1hGq76NJgkLSs5UFFXD3oUU1ekP8qCYft6NNj59N.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_174855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eq5Dwi36o6KRQxEpyoSv4oKhpxHE4QsyXuYJcVo78XcevCrutzkMUdQ8AtEBEzVYUT9.jpg)

**_Saludos amigos de Hive & Liketu | Greetings friends of Hive & Liketu._**
 
   _Desde que descubrí el sushi se ha convertido en mi más grande vicio y como no si pasé tantos años queriendo experimentar y cuando finalmente lo hice lo amé y no sé cómo pude vivir tantos años sin saber lo delicioso que era._ >_Since discovering sushi, it has become my greatest vice, and how could it not, after spending so many years wanting to try it? When I finally did, I loved it, and I don't know how I could have lived so many years without knowing how delicious it was._ _Aqui en Brasil tuve la oportunidad de probar el sushi y con esa experiencia descubrí mi restaurante favorito llamado **Ohana Sushi Bar** al cual siempre voy, sobretodo cuando hacen el famoso **Festival de Sushi** y la última vez que fui fue para aprovechar uno de ellos._ >_Here in Brazil I had the opportunity to try sushi, and with that experience I discovered my favorite restaurant called **Ohana Sushi Bar**, which I always go to, especially when they have the famous **Sushi Festival**, and the last time I went was to take advantage of one of them._ _Como a mi me gustan todos los rolls que sirven en **Ohana** es bastante difícil elegir cuales comer, ya que son muchos y de nombres no sé nada, solo tomo algunos de los que me parecen más deliciosos y los acompaño con salsa de soya y salsa tarê, esta vez hasta incluí una pequeña porción de papas fritas que para mí combinó bastante bien con el sushi._ >_Since I like all the rolls they serve at **Ohana**, it's quite difficult to choose which ones to eat, as there are so many and I don't know any of their names. I just pick some of the ones that look most delicious and have them with soy sauce and tare sauce. This time I even included a small portion of French fries, which I thought went quite well with the sushi._

title.body: - Donald Trump powiedział, że irańscy przywódcy \
go o zawarcie umowy. Jeśli chodzi o ewentualne wznowienie walk, powiedział: \

, jeśli porozumienie nie zostanie osiągnięte.

- New York Times podało dość rewelacyjne wiadomości dotyczące planu USA i Izraela z początków wojny z Iranem. Według cytowanego przez gazetę amerykańskiego urzędnika, administracja Trumpa planowała osadzenie w Teheranie po obaleniu dotychczasowego reżimu... Mahmuda Ahmadineżada, byłego prezydenta. Na początku wojny Ahmadineżad miał przebywać w areszcie domowym, osadzony tam przez reżim. W pierwszych godzinach po ataku podawano, że zginął w amerykańskim bombardowaniu, ale potem zdementowano tę wiadomość. NYT twierdzi, że amerykańskie uderzenie miało właśnie na celu uwolnienie go z aresztu. Sam Ahmadineżad początkowo miał wyrazić chęć współpracy z Amerykanami, ale potem zmienił zdanie. Jak było naprawdę - nie wiadomo. Ta informacja nie jest potwierdzona, więc wolę być ostrożny.

- Korpus Strażników Rewolucji zapowiedział, że w razie ponownego ataku \
a Iran uderzy w Izrael i USA \

.

- Mohsin Naqvi, pakistański minister spraw zagranicznych, już drugi raz w ostatnich dniach przybył z nagłą wizytą do Teheranu. Naqvi ma rozmawiać z najwyższymi przedstawicielami irańskiego rządu.

title.title: Per què els gats són millors mascotes que els gossos
title.body:
En el debat etern entre amants dels gossos i dels gats, molts defensen els canins per la seva lleialtat i energia. Tanmateix, quan es mira amb detall les necessitats reals de les persones actuals, els gats emergeixen com la millor opció per a la majoria de llars modernes. Independents, nets i poc exigents, els felins ofereixen companyia de qualitat sense els inconvenients que sovint comporten els gossos.

### 1. Independència: la llibertat que tothom desitja
Els gats són animals autosuficients per naturalesa. Poden passar hores sols sense patir estrès ni destruir la casa, cosa ideal per a persones que treballen fora o viatgen ocasionalment. Un gos, en canvi, requereix atenció constant i pot desenvolupar ansietat per separació si el deixes sol més de poques hores. Amb un gat, pots sortir a treballar tranquil·lament sabent que et rebrà content quan tornis, sense retrets ni destrosses.

### 2. Manteniment baix i estalvi de temps
Treure el gos a passejar dues o tres vegades al dia, amb pluja, fred o calor, és una obligació diària que molts subestimem. Els gats fan les seves necessitats en una safata de sorra que només cal netejar un cop al dia. A més, es netegen ells mateixos, de manera que rarament necessiten banys. Això suposa un estalvi enorme de temps i energia, especialment en ciutats on el ritme de vida és intens.

### 3. Perfectes per a espais petits
Vivim en pisos cada vegada més petits. Un gat s’adapta meravellosament a apartaments de 40 o 50 metres quadrats, sempre que tingui un rascador, joguines i algun lloc alt per observar. Un gos de mida mitjana o gran, en canvi, pot patir i generar problemes de convivència per manca d’espai i exercici. Els gats converteixen qualsevol racó en el seu regne particular.

### 4. Neteja i higiene
Els gats són extremadament nets. Enterren els seus excrements i tenen poca olor corporal. Els gossos, especialment les races grans o les que bavegen, poden omplir la casa d’olors i pèls difícils de controlar. A més, la sorra per a gats moderna neutralitza olors de manera molt efectiva, cosa que facilita la convivència en edificis amb veïns.

### 5. Menys despeses i menys soroll
El cost anual d’un gat sol ser inferior al d’un gos: mengen menys, no necessiten passejades que desgasten les sabates ni entrenaments professionals. Tampoc borda ni destorba els veïns a les hores intempestives. Un gat ronca suaument o miola de tant en tant, però manté la pau domèstica.

### 6. Longevitat i vincle emocional
Els gats solen viure entre 12 i 18 anys (i alguns fins i tot més), mentre que molts gossos de races grans no superen els 10. El vincle amb un gat és més subtil però profund: ells trien quan volen moixaines i et regalen moments d’afecte autèntic. No és una lleialtat “incondicional” com la del gos, sinó una relació basada en el respecte mutu.

### Conclusió: Depèn de tu, però els números parlen clar
És cert que els gossos són fantàstics per a persones molt actives, famílies amb nens petits o qui busca un company d’exercici. Tanmateix, per a la majoria de la població urbana i ocupada del segle XXI, els **gats guanyen per golejada**. Ofereixen companyia, elegància, tranquil·litat i baix cost de manteniment sense sacrificar l’afecte.

Si busques una mascota que s’adapti a la teva vida i no al revés, tria un gat. No te’n penediràs. I recorda: un gat no és “fred”, simplement és intel·ligent i respectuós amb el teu espai vital. 

¿Gat o gos? La resposta, avui dia, és clara.

title.title: Relato: Sobre la seguridad social
title.body:
> Rebeca sentía que su mente convulsionada. Su abuela Valeria, de 88 años, se había caído de bruces al suelo al perder el equilibrio en el patio de la casa. Cayó de frente o de lado; ella no lo pudo ver porque estaba en su habitación.

La llevaron a urgencias del centro de salud cercano. Le dijeron que debía guardar reposo, que debía ponerse compresas frías. Ni siquiera fueron a misa el domingo justamente para que la anciana no se esforzara mucho.

Tres días después, tuvo que llevarla de nuevo al centro de salud debido a que su rodilla estaba demasiado hinchada, de donde la canalizaron al hospital de la seguridad social; ahí la atendieron después de un par de horas de espera, en donde le recetaron diclofenaco y paracetamol, así como una inyección de una medicina para el dolor y la desinflamación que no especificaron en el parte médico. Y al día siguiente, tras regresar con su madre de la pedicurista, tuvo que llevarla al médico particular de la farmacia, pues los tres dedos medios del pie derecho se habían hinchado.

No entendía por qué se dio esa situación. Hasta le preguntó a su abuela qué había hecho, si estuvo parada todo el día, y quizás en la cocina, cuando se supone que debía estar caminando un poco y reposando; conociendo a su abuela, era probable que sí, solo que ella no se atrevería a admitírselo, como todo adulto mayor acostumbrado a ser activo desde su infancia.

Mientras se sentaba en la silla a secarse el cabello después del baño, Rebeca reflexionó con detenimiento.

Podía entender que los médicos de la seguridad social tienen el tiempo medido, que no hay suficientes medicinas, que el presupuesto cada año es más corto. No podía culparlos de no brindar la atención que se quisiera a cada caso. Sin embargo, el hecho de que la salud pública se haya convertido en una burocracia era aniquilante. Ya no se trataba de las vueltas; se trataba de que si había una urgencia, no podían acudir al hospital de manera directa. Tenían que ir primero a consultar con el médico familiar para que éste dé la orden de traslado para ser atendida.

Peor si se trataba de un adulto mayor. La seguridad social, por lo que amistades y conocidos le han señalado, y ella misma se había dado cuenta, le daba mayor prioridad a alguien joven y sano que aún pueda aportar en impuestos para solventar su funcionamiento. Las medicinas que le daban a los ancianos eran solo paliativos; los cuidados eran mínimos. Prácticamente estaban dando a entender a las familias de este tipo de pacientes que lo mejor era dejarlos consumir por la enfermedad.

El sistema de salud privado no requería tanta burocracia, pero sí mucho dinero. Algo que Valeria, quien tuvo que dejar de lado su pequeño negocio para estar al cuidado de su abuela, no tenía. Por lo tanto, tendría qué endeudarse para poder llevarla a una atención médica más especializada, mandando a la mierda toda la burocracia sanitaria que, viéndolo bien, era más un obstáculo que debe arrancarse de raíz.

title.title: Get up Daily 5-minute message
title.body: I woke up that morning like so many others, but something inside me had broken the night before. I had received an unexpected medical diagnosis for my young son. The doctor's words echoed endlessly in my head: \

I felt like the ground was giving way beneath my feet. For days, I moved like an automaton, caring for him, smiling at him, but inside I was in freefall.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYh2DgEmRvps1omdRGwsAp6ySpemJuaTgm54ES1H3ewwR/mother_and_baby_1646450_1280.webp)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/09/05/12/22/mother-and-baby-1646450_1280.jpg)



The hardest part wasn't the fear, but the guilt. I wondered if I had done something wrong, if I could have prevented it. Every cry of his pierced me like a knife. I shut myself away in a thick silence, distancing myself even from those who offered me a helping hand. One afternoon, as I rocked him to sleep, I saw his calm, trusting face, still unaware of any label or prognosis. And I understood that he hadn't given up. He was still there, fighting every day to grow, to smile, to crawl toward me.

That image hit me with the force of a sudden awakening. I realized that getting back up didn't mean denying the pain or pretending to be strong. It meant accepting that I was broken, but that I could rebuild myself from a different place. I picked up the phone, called my sister, and cried unfiltered. The next day, I sought a second opinion. I joined a support group for parents. I started writing down what I felt, letting go of the guilt like someone releasing a rock that was too heavy.

Today, my son is still in therapy; there are good days and bad days. But I learned that getting up is a small, everyday act: choosing the bed over the abyss, making breakfast with a glimmer of hope, laughing with him even though the future is uncertain. The fall was real, and the scars remain. But there's also the certainty that you can hit rock bottom and, from there, discover that you still know how to swim. 

Getting up isn't about going back to being the same person you were before; it's about building a deeper, more human version of yourself, capable of inhabiting fragility and transforming it into tenderness. And that, even though it hurts, is also a way of soaring.

title.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Emergency surgery for the soul.   ||   Cirugía de emergencia para el alma.
title.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
Emergency surgery for the soul
***

> For years I carried invisible cables that connected me to other people’s fires and to my own shipwrecks. **“Cut the cord”**, I repeated to myself in front of the mirror, realising that this phrase is more than just an idiom; it is a message of survival. Disconnecting hurts deeply because it means letting go of what once defined us, even if it is now nothing but stagnant poison.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/244ojqoRNQfyyVewJqZNTH1dF6Qu8EheLaEVzcHNxEGspvrBN1PHeu94hCNk9WgLwT3BU.png) [](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
I realised that my body was somatising all that accumulated noise. Living submerged in the toxicity of people who drain the light and in the persistent echo of past situations is like trying to run underwater. If I don’t *cut the cord* right now, I’ll drown. I have spent entire nights ruminating on grudges and anxieties of the present, allowing my hyper-connection with the outside world to mutate into a sickness of the soul. But today I choose to use the scissors. Cutting the cord is not an act of selfishness or coldness; it is the first breath of freedom after suffocation. It means understanding that I am under no obligation to be the receptacle for every drama or the hostage of my past. By disconnecting from the external chaos, I manage to tune into my own frequency. The silence that remains when you stop feeding the ties that consume you is strange, but it is a fertile and necessary silence. Now I walk more lightly. Reality is still there, but it no longer drags me by the neck. In the end, letting go of the cord does not leave me adrift; it allows me to decide my own course without the weight of what makes me ill. Disconnecting is the only way to be fully present for yourself. *** ***

# ***
Cirugía de emergencia para el alma
***

> Durante años cargué con cables invisibles que me conectaban a incendios ajenos y a mis naufragios. **«Cut the cord»**, me repetí frente al espejo, entendiendo que esa frase es más que un modismo, es mensaje de supervivencia. Desconectarse duele profundamente porque implica soltar lo que alguna vez nos definió, aunque ahora sea puro veneno estancado.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/242YJNaU2ACjPd9yPAVEJUASJLpgJNSZqKUzsHQGaEjfZn1vfXokwyiAk8kmbhJkETRNF.png) [](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
Me di cuenta de que mi cuerpo estaba somatizando todo ese ruido acumulado. Vivir sumergido en la toxicidad de personas que drenan la luz y en el eco persistente de situaciones pasadas es como intentar correr bajo el agua. Si no *corto el cordón* ahora mismo, me ahogo. He pasado noches enteras rumiando rencores y ansiedades del presente, permitiendo que la hiperconexión con el afuera mutara en una enfermedad del alma. Pero hoy elijo usar las tijeras. Cortar el cordón no es un acto de egoísmo ni de frialdad, es el primer aliento de libertad tras una asfixia. Significa entender que no tengo la obligación de ser el receptáculo de cada drama ni el rehén de mi ayer. Al desconectarme del caos externo, logro sintonizar mi propia frecuencia. Es extraño el silencio que queda cuando dejas de alimentar los vínculos que te consumen, pero es un silencio fértil y necesario. Ahora camino más ligera. La realidad sigue ahí, pero ya no me arrastra por el cuello. Al final, soltar el cable no me deja a la deriva; me permite decidir mi propio rumbo sin el peso de lo que enferma. Desconectarse es la única forma de volver a estar presente para uno mismo.
*** ***

After getting the boys to school I went to my weekly session and then stopped at North 40 for dog food, but I ended up getting some of the parts for the irrigation install as well. Once home I rummaged in my stockpile and found I have all the fittings I will need with the ones I bought. Still a list of parts to get but that should be this afternoon. ![IMG_20260519_111911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xVAd9kbwRVKuuWKiX9tjmorv7DwRm1tep69sHYNGtyPK3pynEMymSgxtnroQoTBP3yT.jpg) Went out for a ride and had every intention of it being a recovery ride. ![IMG_20260519_121414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSWJt2obdxtLaAc5jjHDy5NJvubUWHJ7pgowK3XwHsQpyTbGRpbwYVjazA6GDQ7ep7s.jpg) I was feeling okay and my legs weren't horribly sore while riding. I was just rolling along and found myself in Deer Park so figured out different path through on 6th. ![IMG_20260519_121418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242Ncf5ii1yiUucgw9vGmTpcjxNKyuPAjt1tZJeoeqJA3HjMhmjnFzKhhh3usAQ3HUeB2.jpg) I really tried to keep the ride mellow but am stronger feeling so it was hard to reign myself in the whole time. ![bike 5-19 graphs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGaDayvpzTUpZmf5Ks3Qm7jx9KWxVy9gbVZFk5iHfK8WzfUU6Zndpq5jxu6PHH9pbMC.JPG) ![bike 5-19 stats.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/EnynyiACTKLNymHq9BYd2rRL59kwcng8eecNXdM1AuHRTJy2aLDzGPDSfNuSgZU22zC.JPG) I got dinner going and then went out and mowed the path and yard while the rice went in the instapot. ![IMG_20260519_180140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xKk2WK2jG4h1x9qJaGYjj1mRygkmPNAWCCD7H9qz2t3EMPKBfgxpSGpvzqRAgjcBnMT.jpg) ![IMG_20260519_180146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vho89rmZTGKP2JenoZDdtkF79juF2LgMChuNwHPB6hc3KP9JRRo2872kALBYQeAmCcV.jpg) After eating I got the trailer hooked up for the grain run I have done already. It was an early bedtime for sure. ![IMG_20260519_191313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u61B9LyJ24f6YHprG9tiopp1G5KBHzgba2Lfxgs9uGFAnRNFXLyhgb3LMks8XZeRh8X.jpg) I have been to town and the grain is emptied from the trailer. Unhooked it and will take @stryeyz to work and boys to school, then I hook up trailer again and drive to the valley home depot to rent the trencher, go trench the irrigation lines, return the trencher back to the valley, then go to horizon to pickup the rest of the parts for the install, then pickup @stryeyz after work. ---

title.title: The Key to Stress-Free Learning: Finding the Right Automatic Driving Instructor
title.body:
The journey to gaining your driving independence relies heavily on the guidance, patience, and expertise of your teacher. For individuals who prefer a modern, streamlined approach to driver education, working alongside a specialized [automatic driving instructor](https://www.oxforddrivingschool.co.uk/automatic) provides an unparalleled level of confidence and accelerated skill development. By removing the physical complexities of a clutch and manual gear changes, a dedicated instructor can focus your attention entirely on road safety, hazard perception, and defensive driving.

At Oxford Driving School, our team of qualified professionals is dedicated to helping you master the art of smooth, confident automatic driving in a supportive environment.

### The Advantages of a Dedicated Automatic Instructor

An experienced automatic driving instructor brings highly specialized teaching methodologies to your lessons, transforming what can be an intimidating process into an empowering experience:

**Targeted Cognitive Coaching:** Because they don't have to spend valuable lesson time coaching your physical coordination through gear changes, your instructor can focus on developing your high-level visual scanning and road strategy.

**Anxiety Elimination:** Nervous learners often experience stress surrounding stalling or rolling back on inclines. A professional automatic teacher knows exactly how to build your confidence using the natural stability of an automatic transmission.

**Modern Fleet Expertise:** Automatic vehicles are packed with advanced technology, from regenerative braking to digital driver-assist systems. Your instructor will ensure you thoroughly understand how to use these modern features safely.

**Test-Route Strategic Planning:** Our specialists are intimately familiar with local test center routes, ensuring you practice precision maneuvers under real-world testing conditions.

### What You Will Master During Your Instruction

Our comprehensive curriculum ensures that you develop into a well-rounded, safe driver ready for any traffic scenario:

**Precision Speed and Brake Control:** Developing a refined touch for smooth acceleration and balanced braking, which is essential for managing automatic vehicle crawl in heavy traffic.

**Advanced Hazard Perception: **Training your eyes to look far ahead, identifying potential road dangers, pedestrians, and changing signals well in advance.

**Flawless Maneuver Execution:** Breaking down complex tasks—such as parallel parking, reverse bay parking, and emergency stops—into simple, memorable visual reference points.

**Independent Navigation Mastery:** Building the confidence to follow satellite navigation systems and road signs seamlessly while maintaining total control of your vehicle.

### Why Train with Oxford Driving School?

As a premier destination for driver education, Oxford Driving School pairs exceptional customer service with industry-leading training frameworks.

**DVSA-Approved Professionals:** Every single one of our automatic instructors is fully certified, background-checked, and regularly assessed to ensure they deliver top-tier coaching.

**Dual-Controlled Safety:** Train with complete peace of mind in our late-model, meticulously maintained automatic fleet equipped with dual instructor controls.

**Tailored Lesson Scheduling:** We fit around your lifestyle, offering flexible door-to-door pickup and drop-off options from your home, school, or workplace.

**Progress Tracking Accountability:** We provide clear, structured feedback after every session, allowing you to visually track your progress toward test day.

### Fast-Track Your Road to Freedom

Learning to drive shouldn't feel like an uphill battle. By choosing a dedicated automatic driving instructor, you are selecting a modern, practical, and highly efficient path to passing your driving test. Let our patient team guide you out of the passenger seat and into a life of unrestricted personal freedom.

title.title: The Slump
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmebDQWVreK2RRKujut7dwKeqw7E1znxPYF8DvGr11Pad3/PXL_20260506_205902420.webp)

---------------------------

As we wait for the super regionals to start in college softball, it's time to turn our attention back towards the MLB.  To be fair, there is also college baseball happening right now, but to be honest, I have never really been able to get into NCAA baseball.  I'm sure it's exciting, but for some reason the few games I have tried to watch just didn't land with me.  Which is really kind of funny because I have no problem going to a minor league game at our local field, but for some reason the two just seem so far removed for me.

It's probably just a mental thing because I am sure the talent isn't much different.  I guess it probably depends on what schools you are watching.  

Anyway, as I said, I am digging back into the MLB today.  This will hopefully be a shorter post than my last couple of softball posts have been.  

In my home league, the American League, the Tampa Bay Rays continue to sit at the top with 32 wins on the season.  The Yankees are just slightly below them in the AL East with 30 wins.  From there it is a long drop down to Toronto with 21 wins.  

In my neck of the woods, the Cleveland Guardians are the top team in the AL Central with 28 wins on the season.  The White Sox are a bit behind them with 25 wins and then Minnesota with 22 and Detroit and Kansas City with 20 wins.  The good news is Detroit was able to move up past KC to at least not be in the last spot.  

I hope this slump is just a temporary thing and by the end of the summer we will see the Tigers roaring towards the playoffs.  

Finally, in the AL West, the Athletics are barely holding on to the top spot with 24 wins.  The Texas Rangers and  Seattle Mariners are right below them with 23 wins, and then the Angels are bringing up the rear with the worst record in the AL and all of the MLB at 17 and 32.

Things have gotten a little tighter in the National League, and they no longer have the massive lead they did just a few weeks ago.  In fact, the Braves are only one game ahead of Tampa Bay with 33 wins on the season.   The rest of the NL East has a long road ahead of them to catch up with Atlanta.  Philly is down at 25 wins on the season and Washington is below them with 24.  

Miami is holding on with 22 wins and the Mets bring up the rear with 21 win.  Still better than the Tigers!

In the NL Central we have Milwaukee at the top with 28 wins, but St. Louis is hot on their trail also with 28 wins.  The Cubs have 29, but they have some key loses that put them in the third spot in the division.  Finally Pittsburgh is down at the bottom of the NL Central with 24 wins.  Again, still better than the Tigers!

Finally, in the NL West the Dodgers are still the top dog at 30 wins with San Diego just below them at 29 wins.  Arizona has 24 wins, San Francisco 20 and Colorado once again sits at the bottom with 19 wins which is the worst in the NL.  However, I should point out it is only one or two fewer wins than the Tigers or a handful of other teams in the AL, so even the worst team in the NL isn't that bad compared to the AL.   

What does that tell you?

title.title: Finally Graduated From High School With a Heart Full of Gratitude
title.body: > **Finally Graduated From High School With a Heart Full of Gratitude** ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23x1QHT6eoTASCM2a4i7FJg8tJg8d96D5TAvBcjTTmXvZ5Z6q3aoVrCae9isyz55qLkBW.png) Graduation Day, one of the best and the most unforgettable days in a student's life. This is the day where you can finally say, 'I made it,' because after all the stress and sleepless nights, we finally graduated. Before, I always used to wished that I would finally graduate from high school. But I realized it wasn't easy at all, there were a lot of expense and pressure, especially knowing that college is already coming. It was really a challenging journey, but I made it through. **Graduation Practice** ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23viJhHwznziLRH6CvYhzpGSeuSotniJ4quRxJWdXMEnm9F1dMPBFv5oYZ4uUR6kcwQ24.png) Of course, before graduation there were practice for several days. On the first day, I was very excited because we thought our graduation practice would be held in an air-conditioned place since it was at Hagnaya Beach Club. But it turned out we were wrong, it was extremely hot, no joke at all. We just kept sharing our mini fans because the heat and humidity were really unbearable. It was so hot that we could hardly handle it. Good thing that if someone didn't have a mini fan, other who had one would kindly lend theirs. It really showed how helpful and supportive everyone was during that hot and exhausting day. **Graduation Day** ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23wMuSHEUcfB5LtLK8nD7eZrRTD43AshgcKrms5CAu2gUe8EC4fehNoGC4VRn3gS6GFhb.png) Before our graduation day, I really struggled to sleep because I was so excited. I even cried that night because I couldn't fully accept the reality that we wouldn't be in the same school anymore next school year with my friends. It was such a bittersweet feeling. On the day of my graduation, I woke up really early because the ceremony was scheduled around 12 noon, so I still had plenty of time to prepare. But just like I mentioned in my previous blog, I practiced doing makeup, but it didn’t really work out, I wasn’t able to learn it properly. So in the end, I just went for a simple makeup look instead. ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23viK4QbTaiwk4gSXE7gKojmoiFXojiwJFwM52DRq36y8t8Li3AYF7awLyUFzoRK9qiiN.png) We thought our graduation would start at 12 noon, so we arrived at the venue which is at the Hagnaya Beach Club around 11:30 AM. But it ended up starting very late. That was honestly the most frustrating part of our graduation day. Can we all just stop normalizing ‘Filipino time’? It’s really not okay anymore. We actually started around 1 PM. Since there were about 705 graduates, we had to stand for the processional and wait for everyone to finish lining up and walking down the aisle before the program officially continued. It was really painful, especially for our feet, because we were standing for almost 2 hours. It was exhausting, buut we had no choice but to endure it. ![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23wXGF7AcDkYKyLojWunWn631m8AhZFDqcvFuf4HTAczDKbHskJCKmutUCuZWgq5kj53W.png) After the processional, the program finally started, but thhen I had to wait again for about 2 hours before I could go up the stage to receive my diploma and medals. It was longg, tiring, and honestly exhausting, but in the end, I still made it. I really made it. Thank you, Lord. The funny part was during our valedictorian's speech. It was already around 7 PM and everyone was getting really hungry. While she was delivering her speech, parents and graduates started shouting, asking her to hurry up because we were all starving. It was honestly funny at that time, but we couldn’t really do anything because she also deserved that moment, she worked really hard for it. **Graduation Song** ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xLBXJDE8yb5x66RmzLr9memqJGufcjnSaEMPfocXcHH8jBA2xZqNNr9EdNAHmW5E1u7.png) After her speech, the graduation song started. Our graduation songs were ‘Sarangola’ and ‘Won’t Last a Day Without You.’ Even during the first song, ‘Won’t Last a Day Without You,’ I already started crying because that was the moment it finally sank in, I had really graduated already. By the time ‘Sarangola’ played, I couldn’t sing anymore because I was already crying so much. I really related to the lyrics, and that was the moment I started wishing high school didn’t have to end yet. I didn’t feel ready to leave all those memories behind. **Gifts** ![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23x1RvwuUibxRw26uxFcvgQeuwFT6NDum7vHi7BaBCLapFGvkBZS2C29Puh8ZX2XiJP5j.png) My classmates also gave me gifts, and I honestly didn’t expect it at all. Thank you so much, Bia, Pressy, and Euniq. I love you all so much, you will always have a special place in my heartt. ![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23wMqWGYo4Qinm2vJ1Dy6rZpz635a7EBCiDWEAy18rSmb46cqA9BDrykUAYH6MCuZzyiM.png) I honestly didn't expect to receive so many flowers, there were three of them, and I even had a hard time carrying them all. Thank you so much, Siah, Mama, and Ate April. I really appreciate it a lot. ![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xAnQWxspReSavZTd3UvpmqVhYHaqiNmJiXa6ADdiYSGQojKwCqainycKMWBZvrqP2jy.png) After the program ended, our Grade 9 teacher approached us, and when was already crying because she said it was her last advisory class. She told us she was going to miss us and that we were already leaving her. In that moment, we all ended up crying too. **Celebration** ![10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23xpMfcSdx7sFWegUxQN6jFMyVPQd65vcCRUSu8ERNo4kQb8Q4br3wXu4pShfYcLUFeKV.png) After graduation, we went out to eat with my whole family to celebrate. It was such a fun and fulfilling moment, we were really happy and full. Even though we didn’t have much money, my parents still found a way to celebrate, even in a simple way. I really appreciate it. I love you, Mama and Papa. There is nothing else I can do but thank my parents and the Lord, because I was able to reach this moment, I finally graduated from high school. Thank you for everything, and thank you for trusting me.

Hola, amigos de Hive Hoy me siento muy emocionada de compartir con ustedes una pieza cargada de sentimiento y ternura titulada \

, una composición del maestro Ángel Carpio que toca las fibras más profundas del alma. En esta ocasión, he querido interpretar este hermoso tema en la tonalidad de Re Mayor, contando con el honor y el privilegio de tener el acompañamiento musical del Maestro Ramón en el cuatro, quien con su destreza logra el marco perfecto para esta melodía. Esta interpretación nace desde el corazón y va dedicada con todo mi amor y respeto a todas esas hermosas madres que día a día nos brindan su luz, su guía y ese sacrificio incondicional que nos permite ser quienes somos ellas son nuestro primer refugio y el ejemplo más puro de entrega que existe en el mundo. Para mí, la música es la herramienta más poderosa para expresar lo que a veces las palabras no alcanzan a decir, y a través de esta letra quiero honrar ese vínculo sagrado que nos une. Espero que disfruten de este video tanto como yo disfrute grabarlo, pues cada nota lleva una carga de gratitud y cariño inmenso. Como siempre, aprovecho este espacio para enviarle un gran saludo y mi eterno agradecimiento a toda la comunidad de Music por ser una ventana tan especial para los artistas y por el apoyo constante que nos brindan para seguir creando y compartiendo nuestro arte. Se despide con mucho afecto su amiga @Yoxibeth, deseándoles lo mejor y esperando que esta canción resuene en sus hogares y llene de alegría el corazón de todas las mamás. title.title: Learning to be creative
title.body:
![275140.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23vsQfDAa4LAR4oAdcsGNzCFoFNXpCD6t8H3qDTiAyAUWr7Bmq8duCAzFeeLCcMPpymTu.png)


<hr>


I was once an **SEO writer** for a blog, over 11 years ago. This was when stuffs like Ad sense and Google ads were relatively new. 

Google paid people for dropping Ads on their blogs and website and I was lucky to land a job that paid weekly for content creation on a job website, although it wasn't a lot of money but that was the time that taught me the essence of creativity. 


You could not senselessly add keywords, you needed to blend them well enough so it wouldn't look like you're trying to spam or chase the money, also you had to write so well that search terms would reference your website, or customise your contents to that effect. 


It was the golden age of content creating and people referenced Google a lot more than they actually did with YouTube and it was something.

 Fast forward to 2026 you actually now need to do more, there are lots of people who are even more creative when it comes to content, this means that the expectation out there is now higher and platforms like YouTube or Facebook are being to optimise their platform to this effect. 


Someone told me they demonitized the channel of another person they know on YouTube, and when I looked at channel I laughed because I just knew the reason why their content was demonitized.


 This isn't to say we're not all guilty of being \

sometimes, it just means that if everyone knew that they would need to offer a lot more in this digital age, they would have done a few different things in their hay days. A lot of us have been guilty of not predicting that it'll get tougher to compete. 

A lot of people in the game of making money have taken it upon themselves to be better and this means that they'll milk the possibilities available to them to even make more money and make opportunities difficult for those who didn't upgrade or become better. 

Of course, upgrading, improving or becoming better is not as comfortable. Some people will upgrade, others will not, and this means that the game will become difficult for those who do not upgrade and take away their ability to earn, make money, stay relevant and remain in business. 

## It's 2026

> *The game got harder* 

In 2025 alone, a lot of YouTube accounts were demonitized and that was because a lot of creators saw loopholes to abuse the system and that made a lot of money from this, unfortunately YouTube shutdown this loopholes, making it very difficult for these guy to continue taking advantage of that infinite money glitch.

 Of course if everyone was shipping this type of content then YouTube would lose all its creators, but it was everyone, infact, on the contrary a lot of people already bettered their art or craft and took advantage of the already available audience and exploded their pages. 

### Is it a good thing? 

Well this is subjective. A lot of us had opportunities in the past and we didn't tag advantage of them, now these opportunities are almost no longer available, are now too saturated or the rules of the game gave changed. 

It's what it is, and most times you have to be updated, upgraded and you need to become very creative to actually continue to compete. The competition is crazy in 2026, it's no longer the golden age of infinite money glitch, nowadays you need to do a lot more to actually get a little.

title.title: 两根内存条引发的“官司”
title.body:
![a1.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779279872631-p8kr8.jpg)
买家仅退款不想退货发起了维仅

看到上面的维权，我不由一愣：这是咋了，我成反派了？！

事情起因也算简单。前些天我不是开起了闲鱼卖家么，就拿了些东西练练手：挂了些显卡、内存条和岳州窑。这几天也卖了些货，进展还算顺利。但今天就发生了件让人无语的事：一买家拍走了我的两条内存条，但测试说是没点亮！我说既然没亮，那就退货退款吧。**对方竟然直接就仅退款货就不退了！** 我一看直接炸了：白嫖到我身上了！

![a2.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779280274139-rze1p.jpg)
这两条“惹事”的内存条

![a3.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779280350077-wsodp.jpg)
对方的申诉：说是内存原因导致电脑不能用！

我嘀个天，就这烂理由，还想来碰瓷？！我不禁一顿咔咔，历数其“三大罪”，希望平台严肃处理！

闲鱼平台：
  @风行无悔1 买家因内存条一事申请退款却拒绝退货一事，实则是企图霸占他人财物，其阴险用心和恶劣行径希望平台严查严惩！

  理由有三：
  一、 内存条是正品行货，品质极佳，没有故障（已附购买时的京东标据）。@风行无悔1 买家胡搅蛮缠、混淆视听，实则是企图霸占他人财物！
  二、 就算内存条有问题我也已经同意退货退款了，还有什么不满意么？！买卖不成仁义在。为什么买家非要截留货物？！
  三、内存条不会导致买家所谓的电脑问题（就是坏的也不会），所提交的证明根本无从证明。稍有电脑知识的人都知道插拔内存条根本不会导致电脑问题，除非他电脑本身就有问题，他不过是想碰瓷。

希望平台方严查此事，保障卖家利益。建议平台封禁此用户 @风行无悔1 ，一点小事都不愿协商解决，非要浪费大家的时间和精力，其心可诛！

写完上传后，心里也畅快了不少。无由地为了这件无谓的小事浪费了大好地心情、浪费了大好的时间，真是不应该啊。

其实当时交流时就有点感觉不对，对方一个劲地讲价，一个劲的缠啊，一个劲地要给他便宜。当时我就有点不耐烦了：也就100来块钱，没必要这么磨吧。现在也证实了我的感觉：这人就是爱占人便宜！


![a5.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779280855139-2ay0w.jpg)
对方的芝麻信用 较差！

打开对方的名片，才发现对方的芝麻信用较差！都是有原因的，只是没有早点发现。看来以后还是要筛选一下买家：对信用差的直接拉黑即可，省点事！
