title.title: Pasta gratinada con pollo cremoso al curry/Pasta au gratin with creamy chicken curry 🍝😍
title.body:
> Hello foodies! Un nuevo día en la cocina tratando de preparar cositas nuevas, porque en serio comer todos los días lo mismo y de la misma manera termina cansando, pero tampoco es fácil preparar cada día algo diferente, así que es todo un tema, pero se hace el intento y el día de hoy les comparto uno de los inventos que terminó siendo una comida súper rica. Se trata de **pasta gratinada con pollo cremoso al curry**.
Hello foodies! Another day in the kitchen trying out new recipes, because honestly, eating the same thing every day in the same way does get a bit tedious, but it’s not easy to cook something different every day either, so it’s quite a challenge. Still, I give it a go, and today I’m sharing one of my creations that turned out to be a really delicious meal. It’s **pasta au gratin with creamy chicken curry**.
![1001035876.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035876.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Como saben la pasta cremosa es una de mis favoritas, y lo genial de ella es que la puedes combinar con una gran variedad de ingredientes, y en este caso, yo decidí preparar una pasta cremosa con pollo al curry, pero la verdad es que quería darle un toquecito diferente. así que decidí llevarla al horno y gratinarla con queso mozzarella y la verdad es que fue todo un acierto. Lo cremoso e intenso del pollo al curry, con el queso derretido y dorado fue una combinación simplemente deliciosa, así que sin más vamos con la receta.
As you know, creamy pasta is one of my favourites, and the great thing about it is that you can pair it with a wide variety of ingredients. In this case, I decided to make a creamy chicken curry pasta, but I actually wanted to give it a slightly different twist. So I decided to bake it in the oven and top it with melted mozzarella, and it really was a great success. The creaminess and richness of the chicken curry, with the melted, golden cheese, was simply a delicious combination, so without further ado, let’s get on with the recipe.
![1001035400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035400.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 1 pechuga de pollo 500 grs de pasta corta 1/2 cebolla grande 3 dientes de ajo 2 y 1/2 cucharaditas de curry 1 cucharadita de jengibre 2 cucharadas de salsa de soya Albahaca 2 latas de crema de leche 250 grs de queso mozzarella Sal 2 cucharadas de aceite
## Ingredients 1 chicken breast 500 g short pasta 1/2 large onion 3 cloves of garlic 2½ teaspoons of curry powder 1 teaspoon of ginger 2 tablespoons of soy sauce Basil 2 tins of double cream 250 g mozzarella cheese Salt 2 tablespoons of oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Para la preparación de nuestra **pasta gratinada con pollo cremoso al curry** lo primero que hice fue cortar la pechuga en cubos medianos y condimentarla con curry, jengibre, sal, y la salsa de soya. Y lo dejé marinar por una hora en el refrigerador.
To make our **pasta au gratin with creamy chicken curry**, the first thing I did was cut the chicken breast into medium-sized cubes and season it with curry powder, ginger, salt and soy sauce. I then left it to marinate in the fridge for an hour.
![1001035308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035308.jpg) ![1001035310.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035310.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Para iniciar con la preparación de la receta puse a cocinar la pasta como de costumbre y mientras mientras tanto me encargué de cortar la cebolla y el ajo muy finamente para preparar nuestro sofrito.
To start preparing the recipe, I put the pasta on to cook as usual, and in the meantime I chopped the onion and garlic very finely to make our sofrito.
![1001035327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035327.jpg) ![1001035329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035329.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente en una sartén profunda agregué las dos cucharadas de aceite y una vez caliente, incorporé la cebolla junto con el ajo y media cucharadita de curry y sofreímos durante cuatro minutos para luego incorporar el pollo.
Next, I added two tablespoons of oil to a deep frying pan and, once it was hot, I added the onion, garlic and half a teaspoon of curry powder and fried them for four minutes before adding the chicken.
![1001035330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035330.jpg) ![1001035331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035331.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Doramos muy bien y agregamos 7 hojitas de albahaca cortada en tiras, para luego agregar la crema de leche junto con media taza del agua de la cocción de la pasta. Incorporamos todo muy bien y cocinamos por cinco minutos.
Brown well, then add 7 basil leaves, cut into strips, followed by the double cream and half a cup of the pasta cooking water. Mix everything together thoroughly and cook for five minutes.
![1001035334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035334.jpg) ![1001035335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/EoAbcdmr5b3akmUCrG36rTvgoRWmVvUUrceMESEybQGW2yVofXRkJgbbNs2fguWMXP2.jpg) ![1001035336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/EoAbGCmX15QYdWofHwi2vUBLv1nvmDznkcCrChfb3T8L7Wms4ZvKA5Ggp9tJMP91S5B.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto incorporamos la pasta a la crema de pollo con curry, y mezclamos todo muy bien. Agregamos media taza del líquido de la cocción de la pasta y dejamos que ésta termine de cocinarse en nuestra salsa. Esto lo hacemos sin dejar de remover. >At this point, we add the pasta to the chicken and curry sauce and mix everything together thoroughly. We add half a cup of the pasta cooking water and leave the pasta to finish cooking in the sauce, stirring constantly. ![1001035337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035337.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En cuanto nuestra pasta esté al dente, agregamos la preparación en una bandeja apta para el horno, incorporamos el queso mozzarella rayado y llevamos al horno a gratinar. En mi caso, mi horno tiene gratinador, así que una vez que calenté el horno, encendí el gratinador y en cuestión de unos siete minutos estaba perfectamente dorado y listo para comer.
Once the pasta is al dente, transfer it to an ovenproof dish, sprinkle over the grated mozzarella and place in the oven to brown. In my case, my oven has a grill function, so once the oven had heated up, I switched on the grill and in about seven minutes it was perfectly browned and ready to eat.
![1001035337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035337.jpg) ![1001035332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035332.jpg) ![1001035398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035398.jpg) ![1001035399.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035399.jpg) ![1001035401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rlathulerie/1001035401.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El resultado? Una combinación de sabores, textura y olores que sin duda alguna hicieron de este almuerzo una experiencia súper deli, así que si no han preparado la pasta de esta manera los invito a probarla. >The result? A combination of flavours, textures and aromas that undoubtedly made this lunch a truly delicious experience, so if you haven’t tried making pasta this way, I urge you to give it a go.

[Source](https://s2.qwant.com/thumbr/474x592/c/a/fb72455d8db1c525665c8606f2e2ab6cfd52d89aa011c0b33baab06a0a41a1/OIP.Noy0vdqDnPRKRNdQVYmfXQHaJQ.jpg?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftse.mm.bing.net%2Fth%2Fid%2FOIP.Noy0vdqDnPRKRNdQVYmfXQHaJQ%3Fpid%3DApi&q=0&b=1&p=0&a=0)
*Series poster /Affiche de la série*


***Synopsis :***

Peter Sutherland is no longer the night-shift agent who answers the phone to organise the safe extraction of agents and people in danger in the field. Now, he is out in the field himself and sometimes needs to make a call to be extracted as a matter of urgency.

Peter works for the government and is therefore in contact with the President of the United States and a few people within the White House, particularly in the Secret Service. 

To protect the woman he loves, he had to distance himself from it; otherwise, she would have been used to manipulate him. 

When he was young, his father asked him to promise to always do what is right, and that is what Peter will do, even in his professional life.


> Peter Sutherland n'est plus l'agent de nuit qui répond au téléphone pour exfiltrer des agents et personnes en danger sur le terrain. Maintenant, il est lui-même sur le terrain et a parfois besoin de téléphoner pour être exfiltré en urgence.
> 
> Peter travaille pour le gouvernement et est donc en lien avec le président des Etats-Unis et quelques personnes au sein de la Maison Blanche, notamment dans les Secret Services. 
> 
> Pour protéger la femme qu'il aime, il a dû s'en éloigner, sinon, elle aurait été utilisée pour le manipuler. 
> 
> Quand il était jeune, son père lui a demandé de lui promettre de toujours faire ce qui est juste, et c'est ce que Peter fera, même professionnellement.


--- 

***My opinion and a few facts /Mon avis et petites infos :***

It’s often the same old story. Peter has to gather information and win the trust of key figures, whom he must then rescue from the clutches of the enemy, all whilst evading his own pursuers; even if he comes out of it battered and bruised, he’s still alive.

A fourth season is planned, but it will be the final one, as the series was subsequently cancelled.

> C'est souvent le même genre d'histoire. Peter doit obtenir des infos, puis la confiance de personnes-clés qu'il devra sauver des griffes de l'ennemi, en échappant lui-même à ses opposants, même s'il en ressort cabossé, il est en vie.
> 
> Une saison 4 est prévue, mais elle sera la dernière saison, la série ayant été annulée ensuite. 

The main cast members are all back, and a few new faces have joined the line-up for this season’s storyline:

Gabriel Basso: Peter Sutherland
Fola Evans-Akingbola: Chelsea Arrington 
Amanda Warren: Catherine Weaver 
Louis Herthum: Jacob Monroe 
Albert Jones: Aiden Mosley, Deputy Director 
Génesis Rodríguez: Isabel de León (season 3)
Stephen Moyer: the Father (season 3)
Callum Vinson: the Son (season 3)

Jennifer Morrison: Jenny Hagan, First Lady of the United States (season 3)
David Lyons: Adam Corrigan (season 3)
Suraj Sharma: Jay Batra (season 3)
Zach Appelman: Theo Miller (season 3)

> Les acteurs principaux sont toujours là et quelques autres se sont ajoutés pour le sujet de la saison :
> 
> Gabriel Basso : Peter Sutherland
Fola Evans-Akingbola : Chelsea Arrington

I hope the end of season 4 is well done, as it’ll be the last one and they’ve had plenty of time to prepare.

Every now and then, a bit of action and espionage is a nice change of pace.

Enjoy your evenings in front of the telly, and see you soon, 

> J'espère que la fin de la 4e saison sera soignée, puisque ce sera la dernière et qu'ils ont été prévenus à temps.
> 
> De temps en temps, un peu d'action et d'espionnage, ça fait du bien et ça change un peu.

> Bonnes soirées-tv et à bientôt, 


Florence

title.title: Text Me!
title.body:
![1000136886.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/23yJUqsnYSYi1wGhHAS3TWoWbhVbnDBFA5szRYtDTrZ8R36AxHHXTERJcG3vPybaA1Gxa.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)


<div class=text-justify>

Bernard held the car door open for Tina who slipped elegantly into the driver's seat, started the ignition and pulled the door shut. She wound down the window with a smile. “Remember, *text me*,” she said softly.

He frowned slightly but nodded. “Fine, only because you insisted. We can't keep playing hide and seek forever. I'll call you when you're in bed.”

“Okay,” she said. They kissed briefly before she drove away. It was her cousin's wedding that weekend and she wanted to speak to her parents first before introducing Bernard to them.

Her knuckle whitened as she gripped the steering wheel tight. Bernard was the son of Malcolm Crawford, chairman of Crawford Inc, the same company that had bought her father's company when he was almost bankrupt some years ago and dismantled it. 

Her father had tried to buy the company back before it was split and sold off but Malcolm refused and ever since, the two men became corporate rivals.

Tina didn't know all this until she'd fallen in love with Bernard. Now they were trapped in a dilemma, unsure how to convince their families that they wanted to be together. 

*On the wedding day*

Tina sat beside her mother, cheering and applauding as her cousin shared a first dance with her new husband. Her mother gently nudged her with a smile. “You haven't mentioned dating anyone since your last break up,” she said. “It's been months.”

Her mouth went dry. She forced a small smile and cleared her throat. “Mom, I…I don't think I'm ready to date anyone just yet. Okay?”

Her mother's brow furrowed with disbelief. “Why not?”

Tina stood abruptly from her seat. “Mom, please let it go. You'll be the first to know when I meet someone, alright?” Then she turned and hurried to the powder room without waiting for a response.

When she returned a while later to their table, her mother was smiling with a knowing look. She raised a brow but her father appeared and led her mother onto the dance floor. Then she sat and glanced at her phone resting on the table. 

Her breath caught instantly. There was a text message on the screen from Bernard and her mother had seen it. *I miss you, baby. Call me when you're free.*

Tina groaned and buried her face in her hands wondering how she was supposed to explain the text to her mother.

title.title: Kemer Flower Paradise and Exclusive Coffee
title.body:
![IMG_20260520_122629_684.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYa3mBRaBWyphLQv7QfN3fCxfKYKfLPKmxVR5psxhcP9G/IMG_20260520_122629_684.jpg)

***Today I invite you to take a walk with me and enjoy the flower paradise of Kemer***

![IMG_20260520_121421_302.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUAc2JdrxQ6QRf3xAauUukCfhz2ArFsmQCciNPxPGeRo2/IMG_20260520_121421_302.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121527_436.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbdAAU1TxTAJe5unE5tULBPbszjfgTYK743DpJePZEP33/IMG_20260520_121527_436.jpg)

I've been living here for four years, but every spring I find myself immersed in this intoxicating aroma again and again and admiring these flowering trees 🙂
Flowers in Kemer bloom all year round. These beautiful flowering trees have different colors: red, yellow, purple and create like flower walls!

![IMG_20260520_121530_979.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXP8kWyp1fSd9jhhsmFKNGmNuDNRc8S6idPR82eW5es2W/IMG_20260520_121530_979.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121417_017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSfwp6SUhuXw5J3e81h5qYRMTunBQvaL3JUB42LLGrA8V/IMG_20260520_121417_017.jpg)

You know how positively it affects our mood. Perhaps that is why people who come here once to relax come again and again. This is a great place to get rid of depression and restore your health, walking along these cozy streets.
This year in Kemer it was unusually cold and suddenly the heat came. Usually it's always like this, the temperature rises sharply and we are already looking for shade. I like to wear a hat. But my daughter @bugavi likes to be in the style of an oriental woman 🙂

![IMG_20260520_150804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3rbcxUYNahDHBxr1jTwBXf3ZTpzQYNpXCppV2sEZk9b/IMG_20260520_150804.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_133007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdYjnQrT3Jvo3mGxaAjaUZGwnQ3HdkXv1EnwSC1AtP11u/IMG_20260520_133007.jpg)

A week ago, my youngest daughter @darine.darine went to work - to help squeeze natural juices and smoothies. This is the first work experience in her life. She is very creative and has no complexes.  Put a turban on the head and glued a paper mustache. It was fun 😄

![IMG_20260520_133105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmch2eoimboEMvsNkTG145ffah9EvQQRWYDbpYGfZQ53xF/IMG_20260520_133105.jpg)

I bought myself a banana-strawberry smoothie and we went for a walk along the embankment. There are many entertainments on the beach. You can go on boat trips, ride water scooters... But this show is worth special attention: a professionally trained guy hugs a tourist and dances with her in the air, on a water jet!

https://youtube.com/shorts/iAKUONh_pio?si=B5U-wc1iCtAe2FCP

![IMG_20260520_133144.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdm3HqacahgXQoX9fNgEagSoy5z89pwoRy4gepo42jZPC/IMG_20260520_133144.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_133727.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTVye8iUXxe1U6sJfLSPi5F4hVTEVT4ANPKxooBBnwqTH/IMG_20260520_133727.jpg)

We walked along a magical alley along the sea, where there were also tall palm trees and flowering trees. And suddenly I saw an amazing meadow with small flowers that seemed to create a purple carpet.

![IMG_20260520_133631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmei8tjGUqG9MqsqDEsWuQWXGf1zt5YfHacPdUj8NNA5dG/IMG_20260520_133631.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121457_181.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSFVe2WyPMdvYZcCLe6ULiKLk81DUveNsihPFSwrwSgY8/IMG_20260520_121457_181.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121453_710.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSXibdg6Emg7dnZqyk4212DYprL3Km7BES2onktgvX2hG/IMG_20260520_121453_710.jpg)

I get a special pleasure from looking at roses. I love to go up to a sun-warmed rose and smell its captivating aroma. They are so colorful!

![IMG_20260520_135347.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbXToMUteWkbfg1zFdSz1ENG5wMM3FbCmZvv94u4ehVhr/IMG_20260520_135347.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_135507.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgojA1Ntb7nVNC4vatzCDjmJZJg1irptNweDRjeRs8tT/IMG_20260520_135507.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_143743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVJ42LL7LSMz6zsvYfqxp1LvBV3AequfeYW7qgjZJVWzu/IMG_20260520_143743.jpg)

And to conclude our walk, I will show you an exclusive cafe. It is hidden in a courtyard on the main street, where a Turkish gentleman brews real Turkish coffee on hot coals!

![IMG_20260520_121537_351.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbAmYXJRZve88YwPCm7RS8bbcRtdLLdB4FqL5RfXD2yP/IMG_20260520_121537_351.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121534_033.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmduCCmoHyDxmzjMUCML7YNtinT4peqZ8BUpQR3ejZyGAm/IMG_20260520_121534_033.jpg)

In my hometown of Lviv, we often saw people making coffee on the sand, and here it's similar, but Turkish.
This process can be observed, photographed, or videotaped, but be careful because hot coals can get on your clothes!

![IMG_20260520_121544_195.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSwhhrrwsry8ENvE8rJbPmQ713zNK3sZZJtSFjk3PHNB4/IMG_20260520_121544_195.jpg)

W ostatnim czasie wtorki to najbardziej wyluzowane dni w tygodniu. Głównie dlatego, że co 2 tygodnie jest wynajem szafy po rosyjskojęzyczne spotkanie o polskiej kulturze. Nie robię więc wtedy żadnych wydarzeń i mam czas na nadrobienie zaległości. Tak miało być też wczoraj, ale całkiem niespodziewanie zaczęło łapać mnie przeziębienie. Dość niespodziewana sytuacja jak na maj. Wszystko przez remont w sąsiednim mieszkaniu, który znów przeniósł się w okolice naszej ściany i od rana nie dawał spać. W efekcie moje moce przerobowe spadły o połowę. Plany były wielkie, a skończyło się tylko na zrobieniu kilku koniecznych rzeczy (wydarzenia na Facebooku). Najgorsze jest to, że na chorobowe nie mogę sobie pozwolić bo już jutro Dzień Otwarty w ramach IV Małopolskiego Forum Animatorek i Animatorów. KBK odwiedzą uczestnicy tej imprezy, żeby zobaczyć na własne oczy jak działa nasz system. Całe szczęście, że udało mi się dziś wyspać, a i pogoda jest o wiele lepsza niż w ostatnich dniach.

>There are people who don't think the dinosaurs existed? That's a new one for me.

Only a few, but it is interesting!

Total Denial (Satanic Deception): A small fraction of fundamentalist Christians reject dinosaur existence entirely. They believe the fossils are tricks meant to undermine the literal interpretation of the Book of Genesis and evolution.

Young Earth Creationism (YEC): Major proponents like the Answers in Genesis ministry (and their Creation Museum) do not deny dinosaurs existed. Instead, they believe dinosaurs coexisted with humans and went on Noah's Ark, eventually dying out due to post-flood environmental changes or human hunting.

Old Earth Creationism (OEC): Many Christians accept the scientific fossil record, believing dinosaurs roamed and went extinct millions of years before humans were created. They interpret the \
of creation in Genesis as figurative, vast periods of time rather than literal 24-hour days.

title.title: What Happens If The Iran–US–Israel Conflict Never Truly Ends?
title.body:
![IMG-20260520-WA0055.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmenkGvXATra23g5RVnQhFAAfvTkBFewZ9TpqyCsWwmTHP/IMG-20260520-WA0055.jpg)
The world is once again watching the Middle East with growing anxiety. Recently, Iran warned that it could expand the war if the United States and Israel launch new attacks. The warning came amid ongoing tensions involving military threats, energy security, and geopolitical instability. 

For many people, this may sound like *\

* But personally… I think the world may be underestimating how dangerous long-term uncertainty in the Middle East could become for the global economy. 

Because modern economies do not only depend on money anymore. They depend on:
* **Stability**
* **Confidence**
* **Energy flow**
* **Investor psychology**
* **Global trust**

And prolonged geopolitical conflict slowly damages all of those things.

---

## Why The Middle East Still Controls Global Economic Stability

Even though the world is rapidly advancing in AI, digital finance, and technology, global economies still depend heavily on energy. And the Middle East remains one of the most important energy regions on Earth. 

One critical area is the **Strait of Hormuz**. This narrow sea route carries a massive portion of global oil and gas shipments every single day. When tensions rise there:
1. Oil prices react immediately.
2. Shipping costs increase.
3. Insurance costs rise.
4. Markets become nervous.

This is why even political statements from Iran, Israel, or the US can suddenly impact stock markets, crypto, inflation expectations, gold, and currencies worldwide. Energy is still the foundation beneath the global economy.

---

## The Modern Economy Has Become Extremely Sensitive To Uncertainty

One thing I notice today is this: **Markets no longer react only to actual war. They react to the possibility of instability itself.** That is important because uncertainty creates fear, and fear changes economic behavior:
* **Businesses** delay expansion.
* **Investors** reduce risk.
* **Consumers** spend less carefully.
* **Governments** become defensive.

And slowly… economic momentum weakens. This is why long-term unresolved conflict may become more economically dangerous than short-term military escalation itself. The modern world is deeply interconnected psychologically.

---

## If This Conflict Continues For Years, What Could Happen?

Personally, I think several major long-term risks could emerge if tensions continue without clear resolution:

### 1. Persistent Inflation Pressure
If Middle East instability continues, oil prices may remain volatile, transportation costs stay elevated, and production costs increase—making inflation harder to control globally. This is dangerous because many economies are already struggling with inflation from previous years. If inflation remains high, central banks may keep interest rates elevated longer, meaning borrowing becomes expensive, housing weakens, and economic growth suffers.

### 2. Global Markets Could Become Increasingly Fragile
Modern financial systems depend heavily on confidence. Repeated geopolitical crises slowly weaken investor psychology, causing markets to react emotionally instead of rationally. We are already seeing signs of this today; one military threat can suddenly move oil, Bitcoin, gold, stocks, and bond markets simultaneously. 

### 3. Supply Chains Could Face More Pressure
The global economy depends on massive shipping networks. Conflict near major trade routes creates delays, higher shipping costs, and supply chain disruptions. This affects ordinary people directly through rising food prices, fuel costs, consumer goods, and general living expenses.

### 4. Psychological Fatigue Could Spread Across Societies
This may be one of the most underestimated risks. When people constantly hear about war threats, inflation fears, and geopolitical tension, their nervous systems remain under stress. Stressed populations struggle with focus, long-term planning, creativity, and emotional stability. Economies weaken not only financially… but psychologically.

---

## Why The World Feels More Fragile Today

Personally, I think the world economy today is already under enormous pressure from multiple directions: global debt, inflation, AI disruption, political polarization, slowing growth, and rising geopolitical fragmentation. 

The Iran–US–Israel situation adds another layer of instability on top of an already fragile system. The global economy no longer has much emotional margin for additional shocks.

### Could This Push More People Toward Alternative Assets?
Possibly. Historically, uncertainty pushes people toward **gold, Bitcoin, commodities, and decentralized assets** as they search for protection outside traditional systems. Bitcoin is slowly evolving from a *\

** If global instability continues increasing, that trend may accelerate.

---

## So What Should Ordinary People Do?

Honestly… most ordinary people cannot control geopolitics. But we can control preparation. I think the next decade will reward people who become mentally resilient, financially disciplined, adaptable, and emotionally calm during uncertainty.

Here are some important things we can do:
* **Reduce Unnecessary Debt:** High debt becomes dangerous during unstable economic periods. Flexibility matters.
* **Build Emergency Savings:** Cash flow stability creates psychological stability too.
* **Learn About Macroeconomics:** Understanding inflation, energy markets, interest rates, and geopolitics helps avoid emotional panic.
* **Diversify Income Sources:** Relying on only one system may become increasingly risky.
* **Protect Mental Health:** Mental resilience could become one of the most valuable assets of the future because panic destroys decision-making.

---

## Final Thought

Personally, I do not think the greatest danger today is one single war. I think the bigger danger is **permanent global instability**—a world where tensions never fully disappear, uncertainty becomes constant, and populations slowly adapt to living under chronic pressure. 

Economies can survive short crises. But long-term psychological and financial instability slowly weakens societies from the inside. And maybe that is the real challenge of the modern era: *Not surviving one collapse… but learning how to stay strong while uncertainty never fully ends.*

***

**What do you think? Could prolonged geopolitical conflict slowly reshape the global economy permanently… or will the world eventually stabilize again?**

***

title.title: La locura que se vive en el ascenso en Países Bajos / The madness that is experienced in the promotion in the Netherlands
title.body:
Esta posiblemente fue una de las historias en el fútbol europeo más surrealistas, pues un equipo que terminó en la novena posición de la tabla general, celebró una derrota necesaria en el último juego de la fase regular, con la cual obtuvieron el acceso a los Playoffs de ascenso en la segunda división de PaísesBajos. Como era evidente, perdieron en la primera fase, pero todo lo que sucedió para que se diera este momento fue algo totalmente ilógico.

> This was possibly one of the most surreal stories in European football, as a team that finished ninth in the overall standings celebrated a necessary defeat in the last game of the regular season, which secured their place in the promotion playoffs of the Dutch second division. As expected, they lost in the first round, but everything that happened to lead up to this moment was completely illogical.

<center>![bild.jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1xsu9stM62yHjB5ykUumETuoom9UraGKoYtsE3M3udC/bild.jpg.jpg)</center>

<center> <a href=\

>Fuente Y es que si lo vemos desde un punto de merecimiento, el FC Den Bosch no cumplía con este requerimiento mínimo, y todo esto se vió por el complejo sistema de clasificación, donde un equipo que terminé incluso mas bajo en la tabla general, pondría colarse en esta fase definitoria. Su forma de colarse fue luego de ser el mejor equipo en las primeras 9 jornadas, donde llegó a ser el líder provisional de la segunda división de Países Bajos. > From a merit-based perspective, FC Den Bosch didn't meet the minimum requirement, and this was due to the complex qualification system, where a team that finished even lower in the overall standings could qualify for this decisive phase. Their qualification came after being the best team in the first nine matchdays, where they even became the provisional leaders of the Dutch second division. El formato de la Eerste Divisie es algo enredado, para comenzar, los dos primeros clasificados ascenderan de forma directa, mientras que los Playoffs no se deciden enteramente por esta sencilla regla. Dos de los 6 puestos para luchar por esto se consiguen al terminar tercero y cuarto en la tabla general, mientras que los 4 restantes se logran al ser los líderes de miniligas que se conforman por 9 o 10 jornadas, lo que completa las 38 jornadas del torneo (esta parte de la división si no la entendí bien). > The Eerste Divisie format is somewhat complicated. To begin with, the top two teams are automatically promoted, but the playoffs aren't entirely determined by this simple rule. Two of the six playoff spots are awarded to teams finishing third and fourth in the overall standings, while the remaining four are won by winning mini-leagues consisting of nine or ten matchdays, which together make up the 38 matchdays of the tournament (I didn't quite understand this part of the division). Esto permite que un equipo que tuvo una racha positiva, sin importar lo hecho en el resto del torneo, pueda luchar por el ascenso, haciendo que equipos como el FC Den Bosch entren en este grupo. Así mismo, hay otras reglas, como que los equipos filiales no pueden ascender, viendo como pese a que el filial del PSV Eindhoven terminó en una mejor posición, su temporada finalizó con el cierre de la fase general. > This allows a team with a winning streak, regardless of their performance in the rest of the tournament, to compete for promotion, which is why teams like FC Den Bosch are included in this group. There are also other rules, such as the ineligibility of reserve teams for promotion. This is evident in the PSV Eindhoven reserve team's higher league position, as their season ended with the conclusion of the regular season.
![jong-ajax-speler-dennis-johnson-in-duel-met-fc-den-bosch-speler.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWUzeUzWwAoixE8ZsKBjc5985i8xj3dVXUofybb4wWqi/jong-ajax-speler-dennis-johnson-in-duel-met-fc-den-bosch-speler.jpeg)

>Fuente Ahora, para terminar de entender este formato debo aclarar una cosa, pues el FC Den Bosch no fue realmente el mejor en esa primera liguilla, sino que se metió ahí colado. Esto sucedido ya que si un equipo que ganó alguna de estas miniligas, pero consiguió un boleto directo a la fase definitiva, dará ese puesto al siguiente equipo en la tabla general, situación que dió el cupo tanto al Almere City, al RKC Waalwijc y al Roda JC. > Now, to fully understand this format, I need to clarify one thing: FC Den Bosch wasn't actually the best team in that first mini-league; they just got in by default. This happened because if a team wins one of these mini-leagues but also secures a direct spot in the final stage, they will give that spot to the next team in the overall standings. This is what gave Almere City, RKC Waalwijc, and Roda JC their place. Llegando a la última jornada, los equipos que luchaban por esa última liguilla eran el ADO Den Haag, ya ascendido, el Willen II, tercero en la tabla general, y el Vitesse, decimoquinto de la clasificación. Es por eso que esa derrota en la última fecha del FC Den Bosch hizo que el campeón ganará también ese tramo del torneo, lo que les dió el pase a los Playoffs, y tal vez nos quitó la posibilidad de algo mas sorprendente, ver a uno de los equipos de la zona baja ascendiendo de categoría. > Heading into the final matchday, the teams vying for that last playoff spot were ADO Den Haag, already promoted, Willem II, third in the overall standings, and Vitesse, fifteenth in the table. That's why FC Den Bosch's defeat on the final matchday meant the champions also won that stage of the tournament, securing their place in the playoffs, and perhaps depriving us of something even more surprising: seeing one of the teams from the relegation zone promoted. Aunque todo esto fue una locura, los sueños del ascenso rápidamente se desvanecieron, pues fueron eliminados apenas en los octavos de final, con un contundente 5 a 2 en el global frente al Almere City, equipo que terminó 5to en la tabla general. El año pasado, el Telstar fue quien dió la sorpresa, pese a terminar 7mo en la tabla general, consiguiendo además mantenerse este año en la Eredivisie, mandando en el proceso al finalista de este año a la division de plata. > Although it was all a crazy adventure, their dreams of promotion quickly faded, as they were eliminated in the round of 16 with a resounding 5-2 aggregate defeat against Almere City, who finished 5th in the league. Last year, Telstar were the surprise package, despite finishing 7th overall, and they also managed to stay in the Eredivisie this year, relegating this year's finalist to the second division in the process.
![images.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTnyjYhu7x6q6PEFJoTx8UBKmiBQBK8PMtxCgE5oHvNpy/images.jpeg)

>Fuente Ya a pocas horas de jugarse la final del Playoff de ascenso, la lógica se ha preservado, pues Willen II, tercero clasificado en la segunda división, tendrá en sus manos el ascenso, aunque será un poco más complicado por el rival que tendrán que enfrentar. Si no fuese lo suficientemente complejo todo este sistema, la promoción será frente al FC Volendam, equipo que terminó 16avo en la tabla de la Eredivisie, y quien de entrada, tiene toda la ventaja para mantenerse en la primera división. > With just hours to go before the promotion playoff final, the expected outcome has held true: Willem II, third in the second division, will have promotion in their own hands, although it will be a bit more complicated due to their opponent. If this whole system weren't complex enough, the promotion playoff will be against FC Volendam, the team that finished 16th in the Eredivisie table and who, from the outset, have a significant advantage in remaining in the first division.

#1153 - Fun Shots After An Early Morning Jog at Diliman for Wednesday. 

A happy Wednesday wonderful Hive family no matter where you are located today! Wishing you all a smooth and pleasant Wednesday. May you find inspiration in the little things and keep a smile on your face. Stay safe and enjoy your day😉. 

Now for our daily shots when my wife and I went for an early morning run at the University of the Philippines Diliman Campus. It is one of our favorite places because the Academic Oval provides a safe, scenic loop perfect for jogging. We aimed for 5 kilometers under the ancient acacia trees. 
![1000021027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvc5Cux56FM4kLuXiHgCUdwJkRMfPd9wFgEQL5tqfmkDtzwfxwXCBxXhCHf1ioQCNK2.jpg)

We decided to slow down and catch our breath right in the middle of the Academic Oval. We walked to one of the lush gardens near the inner circle to stretch. It had rained the night before and the leaves on the plants were covered in droplets. 
![1000021024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhs97FDVMM7TrYKiw8CXuRk7mcwSBv2FS5nesGEiBxEjtvbQTecgiBZ7aELDKcJwaWY.jpg)


We leaned in closer and saw a some red insects. I recognized them immediately as red cotton stainers back when we were kids. They were vivid against the green leaves.
![1000021021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23xVAmT3UuitP8pERTz4dGhhyvYK5VNUKoHpprVUbQqTwGUhsZCRkFRVDjRBaC5k4sZdp.jpg) 
 
We spent several minutes just observing them and taking photos. I tried to get some really close up shots to show their backs. It was amazing to see so much life in such a small spot. 
![1000021030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23x1DBU4HhsCgrav7WMfSQCYqmsVjA1b4ANTXtAwJ4Mvj2tYH282XSkyu3eV4EJJCXKXY.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Quezon City, Philippines.

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQTXitZnwsjBJEhD68krQ2j2UUXfKq36oMBC1kmR78kj/1776389424665.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYN3eZCRwGW9QUBZUYzx69UHctBtxZFpAwGhzPTLxnR6u/1776389424744.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

Chapters Read: 16-20

Ah man, as I said before in my ramble post the other day, I've been massively down in the dumps. It's pretty bonkers just how bad. Crazy burnt out mentally AND physically. Catastrophic cortisol levels man. It's just off the charts. My blood is probably so thick with cortisol you could likely clean a grill with it. In fact, if a vampire from this series bit me, they'd probably just instantly have a panic attack. 

But yeah, in times like these I truly thank God for my favorite books. Time to dive back into this series. Can't believe I've fallen behind this much honestly. I've just been super busy. When life is painful like this, may as well escape into this other realm for a little while. 

These last chapters of *Hunters of the Dusk* were solid! Evanna is such an enigmatic character. She is like equally likeable and annoying, it's rather odd. I suppose that's on purpose but yeah. The whole 'I can't take sides' attitude she has is rather annoying at times but, I suppose that's how it's gotta be for her. The whole high and mighty and wise thing is a bit tiresome at times especially after Kurda who was also high and mighty and whatnot. But I'm just nitpicking. 99 percent of my posts about this series is essentially me praising it enthusiastically. It only makes sense for me to mention parts that bug me here or there. This series really leans into the whole like, 'taking sides is foolish' vibe which is rather exhausting at times. But I do believe if I remember correctly, this series sort of develops in a different sort of way as we proceed. I don't know, these books are really thought provoking in my opinion. I guess that's the struggle with life. Avoid confrontation constantly or constantly stand on the fence? I suppose that's the infinite battle of life. 

Harkat's latest dreams are wild. The fact that his dream portrayed him being impaled by spikes should have maybe been a dead give away that he was Kurda. LOL. I have hindsight now but yeah. 

Vancha revealing more of his past of literally being a half-vampaneze was wild. Vancha is a complicated cat. His rawness and complex nature is pretty unique. Him running into his brother Gannen is pretty nuts. It's remarkable how swiftly this series sort of makes Vancha feel very important and deep, its pretty impressive. Really adds intrigue to the whole story in general and adds complexity to the vampires and vampaneze as a whole and their conflict and history. Gannen literally saved Vancha's life many years ago when Vancha couldn't stand being a vampaneze any longer. Then when Paris fond Vancha just adds soooo much lore. The way this series quickly paints a picture and a backstory and just throws information at the reader is so good. 

I also sort of wonder if Vancha running into his brother was a mild form of foreshadowing that The Lord of the Vampaneze is Steve. Darren and Steve aren't brothers of course but ya know, it's similar. 

Vancha is just, in general, a way more interesting character to me than he was in prior reads. I guess when life whoops you enough times, you understand other characters differently, I dunno. 

Then when Evanna drops the bomb that the servant was The Lord of the Vampaneze that was pretty mind-blowing. That's another reason Evanna bugs me slightly. She doesn't wanna like take sides or involve herself, but she literally straight up tells them that that was The Vampaneze Lord AND that Gannen is the primary protector. Perhaps she was semi-obligated to tell them so they're aware that they missed one of their four remaining opportunities. 

I wonder what Steve was thinking in that moment when he saw Darren and Mr. Crepsley. I am unsure if he specifically knew that they were actually two of the hunters or not at that point in time. Maybe that will be revealed later. Perhaps this encounter is when he begins plotting big time...

It's rather curious that Steve has just one protector while there's three hunters. I wonder how Gannen feels about Steve being rather uh, intense. Vampaneze are different, but not lacking morals or decency entirely. It's been said many times that there's many respectable vampaneze. I mean Mr. Crepsley straight up calls Steve evil, I just wonder how Gannen or others feel about Steve. 

It's also interesting in general how Steve is like, potentially singled out as a potential 'chosen one' of sorts. Like he simply is the guy for the vampaneze, he's yet another character with main character energy. This series does a remarkable job at making several characters have main character energy. Even though Steve is the main bad guy, he does have main character energy thrust onto him. 

I guess I point this out because I think of Mr. Tiny. I don't peg him as being a simple 'good guy, bad guy' type of creator. Since he's basically pulling nearly all of these strings. In addition, Darren or Steve are both destined to be The Lord of the Shadows anyway! I mean, I wonder what's up with Mr. Tiny there. Does he really see Darren as the good guy and Steve as the bad guy or like, what? Maybe he simply doesn't care. 

I dunno, what Darren does at the end of the series, I doubt Steve would have done. Steve also does many blatantly heinous things throughout the series and will do more as well. 

I mean, many of these themes throughout the book, sort of entertain the idea of perspective, and how neither side is truly fully in the right or fully in the wrong or whatnot. 

It's easy to think Darren is totally the good one as he's the main character. But then when you consider how Kurda was also intended to save the vampires FIRST, it makes you wonder. Then consider how Kurda is sort of still alive, it's like maybe Kurda is STILL the real 'chosen one' as corny as that may sound. I mean, Harkat/Kurda is still heavily involved in this war. He's a live wild card. He's an unofficial fourth hunter.

In fact, technically since Kurda still kinda exists, and Mr. Tiny said Kurda was their first chance to eliminate the Vampaneze Lord threat, perhaps that means this 'first chance' is still fully valid and active???? 

Bruh. 

Speaking of Kurda/Harkat, I've always wondered why Harkat is so strong. I don't recall it ever explained that Little People are super strong. I mean, they do have oddly nifty abilities and advantages over humans and are formidable but it's not really explained to what extent. Is that another hint that Harkat was a vampire? Does some of Harkat's s strength come from his past life? When they ambush the vampaneze, Vancha assigns two vampaneze to Harkat while Darren was to attack one vampaneze and a servant they suspect to be a half-vampaneze or vampet. Perhaps it was because Darren is more valuable to their overall mission and Harkat is seen as more expendable? But the fact that Harkat handles himself well is still astonishing. He can literally kill vampaneze and nobody seems to even question how. Also, prior to them all agreeing to ambush the vampaneze, Harkat seems to show a desire to fight whereas Kurda was more of a pacifist. Perhaps that's like, a character development thing. LOL. The Kurda within him wants to be less plotty and more actiony. 

I don't know, I just wanna keep reading!!! Love this series!  On to book eight!

title.title: Fresh Air And Beautiful Views in Dancalan Seawall: Sunset Walks With My Aunt!🌅
title.body:
A Pleasant and Beautiful Day to everyone!🤗🌺

Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @wednesdaywalk community!😍

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. This is @lj1728 and this is actually my second time sharing in this community my simple life story with you all.💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23z7QHeoHt1hTDkg1GqvfUB869UvagQXNydAoq91nkJy8SFKzmsgT7cGxMvKD2rvNqUjz.png)

After another day long day at work, I felt excited because I already had plans with my aunt again. Recently, we have been enjoying our afternoon walks together at seawall. It has become part of our simple routine not only to breathe fresh air but also to stay active and achieve atleast 5,000 steps every day since both of us have a sedentary lifestyle. Walking has become our little way of exercising while also spending quality time together.

![IMG_8278.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCG1FeU6j7KafrBkrPeikbLuF9TeKQfrJMjfKiaAMua3XZSC8KxtDGRwCKByhstnRdw.jpeg)

![IMG_8273.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EogPfrEWLfnHXgnCjJdFfxA5G9MVbFC97ZHydHhvxCNFbXh3B4rcHGQVqXT13kVSpjC.jpeg)

As planned, after my office work, I went straight to my aunt’s house to fetch her. The weather was nice that afternoon, and the cool breeze already made us feel relaxed while preparing for our walk. We both changed into comfortable clothes and rubber shoes because we knew we would be walking for quite some time. We headed to the beautiful “Dancalan seawall”, one of our favorite places to visit lately.

![IMG_8271.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EqBdb4hNbQHH3rPE7Tpf8iozAvwDi3c5gBhRAntx9EFK3xrRYyyuoNBDseeBjefVCdX.jpeg)

![IMG_8274.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EqYub1Axwt1TVj9h7jiTrhgxpZv3L7R9PocjKdUcuS7befQbxHmg2sdwjgzPFJrW9BV.jpeg)

![IMG_8264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Eqb1f6ncdnTyHqpwN6xfB9L3CAGvLiyZqbGo3EC1LsoL8YqNtpvi7jT4s5nBvBjyLfH.jpeg)

Everytime we go there, I always appreciate the peaceful view of the vast sea. The sound of the waves instantly makes me feel calm and refreshed after a tiring day at work. The seawall is also full of life because many people spend their afternoons there doing different activities. Some were jogging while others were simply walking like us. There were also families and couple relaxing together while watching the sea and some children were happily playing around. Along the side of the sea, we noticed several boats parked quietly, adding more beauty to the scenery!

![IMG_8290.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23r1j4CjTX6zYP9LiwzyNnkuzeEMr82fTwqKZYfPFfYhyajacqfV2Zr6bGLNSyHEVDocJ.jpeg)

![IMG_8263.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EqfGKHcnSxnPaTXT7SgSs48h2KicuUV6vEDJdWswVpgdCGtoxoSM9JJX3Kp4CRpMCoW.jpeg)

![IMG_8289.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Eq379gZX1fLahqXD2fyecyhmUZPZUpmYmxt3L9AGz3ouwXqeRSdqqQQQmby3mMbQt8y.jpeg)

While walking, my aunt and I talked about random things, shared stories, and sometimes laughed together because we remembered some happy moments. I realized that walking is not only good for our health but also for our minds and emotions. It helps me release my stress in work and truly appreciate the simple beauty around us.

![IMG_8284.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EpXKUwc4QytwWT1wFcnXzDgj9p5vpDtpAtEPSDUTpbrDJM7Ui8smGXmroQ98ku8z9TR.jpeg)

![IMG_8276.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/Eqb21C5fqXNSZBkXNBfRs6f18qjZ7tY6bWPpfZM7YRsw5Qc4oC6aGUNZJGt4HE6vrwF.jpeg)

![IMG_8281.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EppLkCKApkefPjT4K6mXWsv9vri4J8W6QFdPXDvgBpKteRgbQooxhbJTzP9eBr2hiHH.jpeg)

As the sun slowly started to set, the sky looked even more beautiful with its warm colors reflecting on the sea. We ended our walk feeling tired bit fulfilled.

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.✍️👩‍💻

Lots of love,
LJ💗

title.title: Restauración ecológica en la finca Buena Vista
title.body: Toda gran restauración comienza en el seno de una semilla. Aquí custodiamos el futuro de nuestro ecosistema, respetando los tiempos de la naturaleza. ![24680.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7jHqsET6ct3YD2wPSTArRXxq87vv9JzoomPTogQ4LsA/24680.jpg) Sanar la tierra es también sanarnos a nosotros mismos. Nuestras manos son solo el puente para que la vida vuelva a reclamar su espacio ![24683.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcfji8MBZiyyr5WHwGsm2qgjnyjqq8WXSHJtkfyst9hxC/24683.jpg) La restauración ecológica no es solo técnica; es un acto de reconciliación con el paisaje que nos sostiene. ![24671.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGgQV2mrXMSxdFQ1PAV5HG5RTNLGXTDbggaSH2xWJqGu/24671.jpg) Paso a paso, el verde recupera su lugar. Estamos devolviendo la estructura y la función a suelos que hoy vuelven a prosperar. ![24674.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcGuxGNFMdrYYBKx59bFth5gnoxKx4Gq7qF46QjchSEpD/24674.jpg) Mirar el horizonte y saber que estamos dejando un legado de vida. La restauración es nuestra mejor respuesta ante el cambio climático. La vida regresa en los detalles más pequeños. Cuando los polinizadores vuelven, sabemos que el esfuerzo de restauración está funcionando.

/>

About the Author
Alexander Arango - Agroecología | Restauración Ecológica. Construyendo resiliencia ambiental y sistemas regenerativos 🌎.

title.title: 📷 9 Years Here On HIVE
title.body:
_Hello dear friends,__



And another year has gone by. Nine years ago, I signed up for the blockchain that later became HIVE. As far as I can remember, it must have been May 17, 2017, when it happened. Well, it was a life-changing decision that I still don’t regret to this day. On the contrary, I’ve met so many cool people here.



🚴🚴🚴🚴


__Hallo liebe Freunde,__


_und wieder ist ein Jahr vergangen. Vor 9 Jahren habe ich auf der Blockchain angemeldet, aus der dann später HIVE hervorgegangen ist. Soweit ich mich erinnere, muß es damals der 17. Mai 2017 gewesen sein, als es geschah. Nun, es war eine einschneidende Entscheidung, die ich bis heute nicht bereue. Im Gegenteil, so habe ich hier doch viele coole Leute getroffen._




</center>![20260508_171455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/242XyQaUWYARNzsTrKywiFmcrr59xDT7zY8HN3yWUFw9tox4Hoik2iTcNhPr7B8Kpi9HX.jpg)


___________________________________________________________________________

</center>![20260429_182059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/242NYJ6vAiezvVqhXCNSxBmK7ELsbTTaLkHg4pKzp32CxBFp7s6S9b3nudeDJhE1u2yNU.jpg)



One thing never changes. My HIVE birthday falls on the day after my “real” birthday. So, of course, it's easy for me to remember the date for HIVE. ;-)

🚴🚴🚴🚴

_Eines ändert sich nicht. Mein HIVE Geburtstag fällt um einen Tag versetzt mit meinem \

Geburtstag zusammen. Daher kann ich mir das Datum für HIVE natürlich gut merken._ ;-)


</center>![20260508_173204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244e8XfEKEV4xo7k2LrGkLbtoTbDE17bqBUykb92opxFiUirb5ww9TXRBCBau7x53JrB2.jpg)
___________________________________________________________________________


</center>![20260508_170007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244KEjv1X59TwjRq9Wpk4ju7aqtcfn1n9z1yEcYRddpwCZVPraKWpqpYZmE9rE2WQoMJ9.jpg)


In the lovely month of May, we finally had some consistently warmer days. At least until the Ice Saints, who once again lived up to their reputation. Of course, I took advantage of that to go on lots of short bike rides on my eMTB. I took all of the photos above in the Schenkenwald forest, which is currently under serious threat of having to make way, in no small part, for wind turbines. That would mean losing my personal oasis of well-being. Hopefully, it won’t come to that.



🚴🚴🚴🚴

_Im Wonnemonat Mai hatten wir ja endlich konstant schon wärmere Tage. Zumindest bis zu den Eisheiligen, die ihrem Ruf mal wieder alle Ehre gemacht haben. Das habe ich natürlich wieder für viele kurze Radtouren auf meinem eMTB genutzt. Die obigen Bilder habe ich allesamt im Schenkenwald gemacht, der aktuell leider akut bedroht ist, zu einem nicht unerheblichen Teil für Windkraftanlagen weichen zu müssen. Damit würde ich meine persönliche Wohlfühloase verlieren. Hoffentlich kommt es nicht dazu._


</center>![20260504_183525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/244KGggAXbS5JnDk2RxV2ZNuX6w3juHxfzSGrmDejiPRLSu67DGr7XfJror6ebuwYpTMo.jpg)


___________________________________________________________________________


</center>![20260518_133654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zktsW7VnhFNVeRJxjRBGut8iLiwhHkxFSbSAngwuJUt6sMSaiibxy2DECMwUSLdHNA7.jpg)


You can also spot some interesting animals now...

🚴🚴🚴🚴

_Auch einige interessante Tiere kann man nun entdecken..._




</center>![20260419_190316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23ynNWnocGeQNduwpTqux7gz73eZYyQdAXrjJzEw35U4Y6kHPLyidWpK8PAnrGELPpRoH.jpg)



___________________________________________________________________________


</center>![20260508_163402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23yJGFYFyn1Jv1JSBXdgPTuGW2v1AaN8U1H63NoSSGbCr6xUbcpxbeoJSPQnn47N89kdp.jpg)


Hawthorn is good for the heart. And it’s a pleasure to look at, too.


🚴🚴🚴🚴



_Weissdorn ist gut für das Herz. Und schön für das Auge zudem._

___________________________________________________________________________


</center>![20260423_182428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/245mg2SHNR3SaHaqRyGtrpuHiWNH8yeQM23qNv7TUA8SUvRfeKdGLM6725cBkcF4KQcCw.jpg)



Our outdoor pool opened a week earlier this year than in previous years. I generally like to visit our local swimming lakes before the outdoor swimming season starts. There are two of them near me. However, the spring was very chilly. We couldn’t go in the water without getting frostbite until May. In previous years, I was already swimming frequently as early as April. 

🚴🚴🚴🚴

_Unser Freibad hat dieses Jahr eine Woche früher aufgemacht als die letzten Jahre. Grundsätzlich gehe ich gerne vor der Freibadsaison an unsere Badeseen. Wir haben hier zwei davon in meiner Nähe. Das Frühjahr war allerdings sehr kühl. Man konnte erst am Mai ohne Frostbeulen ins Wasser. Die Jahre davor war ich stets schon im April oft baden._


</center>![20260426_185928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23ua8rh2iyNWeeCJDhvgBifyHViXHTMHdGjHhi58PqH8GKGogvy9h8SqcNsv1JzWsyktC.jpg)


</center>![20260423_184646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zRvdrjTeLqVRVyFVX1cqGPiRxBEGEC7hniyk1S11469bZM1Quco5btpqCQSgpTRWtxz.jpg)



___________________________________________________________________________




</center>![20260516_185933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23zv7AmMnkM53t5LhcFuD2uhHAhbSFqJvoqAC1LzjWFn4Pu3Ej5QiYn99FVhuyDHyfDZ2.jpg)


This is another lovely spot where I often stop to recharge my batteries in a meditative way. You hardly ever see a soul here, even though it’s just a stone’s throw away from Wertheim. I hope you enjoyed my short post. See you soon, dear HIVER...

🚴🚴🚴🚴

_Das hier ist auch eine schöne Stelle, an der ich oft innehalte, um meditativ Kraft zu tanken. Hier sieht mal im Grund nie eine Menschenseele, obwohl man doch nur etwas mehr als ein paar Steinwürfe von Wertheim entfernt ist. Ich hoffe, mein kurzer Beitrag hat Euch gefallen. Bis bald, werte HIVER..._


</center>![20260429_182022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andyjaypowell/23z774z4rMY5CfXCuY7JSn8c5sgYGLQUpmL4P6NmajFhqTH2GthduVmEwHY1WyW88UJGb.jpg)

title.title: Charlie y las primeras notas del banjo - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
![bnn.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWaa2EfVau45K7SFdDxSTzrvz4kFNkZfWEtougYbBodAq/bnn.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/m%c3%basico-canci%c3%b3n-country-banjo-349790/) En las afuera de la ciudad, estaba Charlie un pequeño niño con apenas siete años cuando descubrió que la música era parte de su vida, además su familia era muy reconocida en Risingstar. Donde cada vez que escuchaba una melodía en la radio vieja de su abuelo, sus ojos brillaban y se emocionaba mucho, mientras que sus amigos corrían detrás de un balón, él se quedaba quieto, escuchando cada nota e imaginando que en algun momento muchas personas iban a escucharlo a él. Una tarde de luego de que Charlie regresara del colegio su padre entró con una caja larga y envuelta con cuidado, donde este niño se emocionó y pregunto —¿Es para mí? —Su padre sonrió y le entregó ese gran regalo. Charlie fue quitando el papel poco a poco mientras sus manos temblaban de la emoción y entonces lo vio —Un banjo— La madera era perfecta, cada detalle hacía que fuera una reliquia y esas cuerdas lista para ser tocadas, mientras que Charlie estaba muy feliz porque ese era su sueño. Esa noche no pudo dormir de la felicidad que tenía, se sentó en el mueble y se quedó abrazando el banjo como si fuera un gran tesoro. Sin embargo, ahora venía otra tarea y era aprender a tocarlo. >On the outskirts of town lived Charlie, a little boy who was just seven years old when he discovered that music was a part of his life; moreover, his family was well known in Risingstar. Whenever he heard a tune on his grandfather’s old radio, his eyes would light up and he’d get really excited. While his friends ran after a ball, he’d stand still, listening to every note and imagining that someday many people would come to listen to him. # >One afternoon after Charlie returned from school, his father came in with a long, carefully wrapped box. The boy got excited and asked, “Is this for me?” His father smiled and handed him that big gift. Charlie slowly unwrapped the paper as his hands trembled with excitement, and then he saw it—a banjo. # >The wood was perfect; every detail made it a treasure, and those strings were ready to be played. Charlie was overjoyed because this had been his dream. That night, he couldn’t sleep because he was so happy. He sat on the couch and held the banjo close, as if it were a great treasure. However, now came another task: learning to play it. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY1FjrG1tdQQW4CtokixWombNihHbFRVsUWyoEbyay5ru/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/35563838/) Los primeros días fueron un desastre, nada salía bien y sus dedos dolían, ya que nunca había tocado un instrumento como ese, donde Charlie lo único que hacía era respirar y volver a intentarlo. Día tras día, las cosas fueron empeorando y llegó un momento donde pensó —¡Nunca voy a aprender!— dejando el banjo sobre la cama. Las lágrimas comenzaron a caer, sus dedos estaban rojos, adoloridos y quería rendirse. Todo cambio cuando su abuelo llegó a la casa, tomó el banjo y lo colocó nuevamente en las manos de Charlie. —La música no nace perfecta y las canciones siempre vienen después de muchos errores— dijo el abuelo. Charlie bajó la mirada y volvió a respirar profundo, para así volver a comenzar a practicar y poder ser muy distinto a los demás. >The first few days were a disaster; nothing went right, and his fingers ached, since he had never played an instrument like that before. All Charlie could do was take a breath and try again. Day after day, things got worse, and there came a point when he thought, “I’ll never learn!” and set the banjo down on the bed. Tears began to fall; his fingers were red and sore, and he wanted to give up. # >Everything changed when his grandfather came home, picked up the banjo, and placed it back in Charlie’s hands. “Music isn’t born perfect, and songs always come after many mistakes,” said his grandfather. Charlie looked down and took another deep breath, so he could start practicing again and be very different from everyone else. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYzj4DNY3638p67mFq7QYHZaSTHooWdXn7wHNS7uFUjo/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/calle-sentado-chaqueta-musico-17872048/) Pasaron semanas y fue allí cuando sus dedos comenzaron a moverse con seguridad, además las notas pasaron de escucharse rotas a más fluidas. Hasta que una tarde luego de muchos intentos Charlie tocó una secuencia de notas, solo por unos segundos, pero fueron perfecta para llenar toda la habitación de felicidad y Charlie quedó sorprendido, ya que lo había logrado. Su abuelo simplemente cerró los ojos para escuchar la canción nacida de esfuerzo, paciencia y sueños. Charlie miró el banjo entre sus manos y sonrió, puesto que había conseguido sus primeras notas. >Weeks went by, and that was when his fingers began to move with confidence, and the notes went from sounding choppy to more fluid. Until one afternoon, after many attempts, Charlie played a sequence of notes—just for a few seconds—but they were enough to fill the entire room with happiness, and Charlie was surprised that he had actually done it. His grandfather simply closed his eyes to listen to the song born of effort, patience, and dreams. Charlie looked at the banjo in his hands and smiled, for he had played his first notes.

Este sábado se graduaron mis dos últimos residentes, y aunque sabía que este momento iba a llegar, creo que lo esperaba con tantas ganas como ellos.

La mañana comenzó en el teatro de mi hospital, donde se realizó el último ejercicio de examen con discusión de tesis. El ambiente estaba cargado de tensión. Se sentía en las miradas, en los silencios, en esas respiraciones profundas antes de responder cada pregunta. Yo, mientras tanto, estaba en una mezcla rara entre nervios, orgullo y felicidad absoluta.

Y es que además del examen, aquello parecía una máquina del tiempo. Volver a ver a muchos de mis profesores y compañeros de residencia removió recuerdos por todas partes. Me vi reflejada en ellos, en aquellos años intensos de guardias eternas, cafés fríos, estrés compartido y tantas historias que solo entiende quien ha vivido una residencia médica.

Pero mis muchachos brillaron. Y cómo brillaron. Ambos terminaron con excelentes notas, demostrando todo lo que han crecido, aprendido y luchado para llegar hasta aquí. Yo los miraba y no podía evitar pensar en cuánto cariño les tomé en el camino. Porque sí, uno intenta mantener cierta “distancia profesional”, pero hay residentes que simplemente se convierten en parte de tu vida.

Y entre toda la seriedad académica, hubo un detalle que me robó completamente el corazón: el cake. Divertido, original y perfectamente decorado para la ocasión. Creo que nos reímos más alrededor de ese cake que durante toda la tensión previa del examen. Nada como el humor para aliviar años de presión acumulada.

Como ya es tradición en estas graduaciones, no podía faltar la actividad de celebración. Aunque esta vez decidieron innovar: una el sábado y otra el domingo. Porque claramente un solo día no alcanzaba para celebrar semejante logro.

Nos fuimos rumbo a la localidad del Coco, bastante alejada de la ciudad y, para sorpresa de nadie, sin cobertura en los teléfonos. Honestamente… fue perfecto. Como en los viejos tiempos. Sin notificaciones, sin llamadas, sin el ruido constante del mundo. Solo nosotros, las conversaciones, las risas y el disfrute real del momento.

Hubo cerdo asado, cerveza de tonel y, por supuesto, algo que jamás puede faltar en una actividad de urólogos holguineros: el dominó. Ese juego capaz de unir generaciones, despertar rivalidades amistosas y sacar el lado más competitivo hasta del más tranquilo. Entre fichas golpeadas sobre la mesa, discusiones sobre quién trancó a quién y carcajadas interminables, entendí que esas son las cosas que realmente construyen los recuerdos.

Y mientras los veía disfrutar, pensé en lo rápido que pasa todo. Ayer eran residentes llenos de dudas y hoy son especialistas listos para abrirse camino solos. Uno siente orgullo, sí, pero también una nostalgia bonita… como cuando terminas un libro que no querías que acabara.




# English Version 






This Saturday my last two residents graduated, and even though I always knew this moment would come, I think I had been waiting for it just as eagerly as they had.

The morning began at my hospital’s theater, where the final examination exercise and thesis discussion took place. The tension in the room was impossible to ignore. You could see it in every look, every silence, every deep breath before answering a question. Meanwhile, I was caught somewhere between nerves, pride, and complete happiness.

Beyond the exam itself, the day felt like stepping into a time machine. Seeing so many of my professors and residency colleagues again brought back a flood of memories. I saw pieces of myself in all of them, in those intense years of endless shifts, cold coffee, shared stress, and countless stories that only someone who has lived through residency can truly understand.

But my two residents shined. They truly did. Both finished with excellent grades, proving just how much they have grown, learned, and fought to reach this point. I looked at them and realized how deeply attached I had become along the way. You always try to keep a certain “professional distance,” but some residents simply become part of your life.

And in the middle of all the academic seriousness, there was one detail that completely stole my heart: the cake. Funny, creative, and perfectly decorated for the occasion. I honestly think we laughed more around that cake than we did during the entire stressful exam process. Nothing relieves years of pressure quite like good humor.

As tradition goes, a graduation celebration could not be missed. This time, though, they decided to make it even better: one gathering on Saturday and another on Sunday. Because clearly one day was not enough to celebrate such an important milestone.

We all headed to El Coco, a small place far from the city and, unsurprisingly, with no phone signal at all. Honestly, it was perfect. Just like the old days. No notifications, no calls, no constant noise from the outside world. Just us, good conversations, laughter, and the simple joy of being fully present.

There was roasted pork, draft beer, and of course, something that can never be missing from a gathering of urologists from Holguín: dominoes. That table game that somehow brings generations together, sparks friendly rivalries, and reveals everyone’s competitive side. Between the sound of domino pieces hitting the table, playful arguments over who blocked whom, and nonstop laughter, I realized those are the moments that truly become memories.

As I watched them enjoying themselves, I could not stop thinking about how quickly time passes. Yesterday they were residents full of doubts, and today they are specialists ready to build their own paths. There is pride, of course, but also a beautiful kind of nostalgia, the same feeling you get when you finish a book you never wanted to end.

title.title: An unlikely scene / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU1nLfZcfJe7twxaoWWrbPoawKTD4QGTXLsa8ohfp9Hzk/_7505500_copia_2_.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings hivers.

Sometimes I see things on the street that are, at the very least, curious. People in funny or seemingly meaningless situations that somehow work perfectly in a photograph. Like this man who, from where I was standing, looked as if he had taken over the street itself. Sitting there with his armchair right in the middle of the road, he seemed completely at home, as if he were in his own living room.

Without hesitation I pointed my camera at him and captured these curious, amusing images. After looking a bit closer, I realized that in front of him there was a huge screen where a movie was about to begin. It is interesting how the whole narrative changes with just a slight difference in angle.

Still, I am fascinated by these scenes that make little sense at first glance until you get closer and discover what is really happening.

Just street photographer things, I guess.

I hope you enjoy the photos.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctDi49u3Rhovt3fWgypsjmiSez8WY73FfjsGDeR6a8oq/_7505486_copia_2_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX4exdHjVzfv6Qi7s8ebmGTmkCwNvnzdL7NhhuXe7t3Ff/_7505489_copia_2_.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVJoBEaH5SD1Fep54DFoqjBznjCSGNXeaYn91PNpGaNM2/_dsc8067_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcg2bgkg7ZcbwFAK7YrPdAsqLCr2umCSfFBuj4DgSWEy7/_7505700_copia.jpg)


Saludos hivers.

A veces veo cosas en la calle que resultan como mínimo curiosas. Personas en actitudes graciosas o aparentemente sin sentido que sí quedan bien en una fotografía. Como este señor que, desde donde lo estaba viendo, parecía haberse apropiado de la calle. Sentado con su sillón en medio de ella, daba la impresión de estar en la sala de su casa.

Sin pensarlo mucho le apunté con la cámara e hice estas fotos curiosas, graciosas. Al acercarme un poco más me di cuenta de que frente a él había una enorme pantalla donde estaba por comenzar la proyección de una película. Es interesante cómo el discurso cambia con apenas una diferencia de ángulo.

Aun así, me fascinan estas escenas que resultan difíciles de entender hasta que te acercas e investigas qué está pasando realmente.

Nada… cosas que nos pasan a los fotógrafos callejeros.

Espero disfruten las fotos.



* * *

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbaoVN8qMsuGMf8j661BnNRQ4GtdkmBxgxFREZjir7TJ/whatsapp_image_2026_05_09_at_18.50.55.jpeg) Things have been twisting into many unexpected turns. From training a _zero experienced_ team of children's choir to hospital and government runs, there is no room to feel depressed. 🤣 (unless deliberately... I digress!) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9bsPXCj2G5icUyAhSqRuyFWdewntw3swGGBXvMca8mq/image.png) I wished I could tell you that things are much easier with pleasant mornings and fresh air surrounded by nature; however, when life tries to give us lemons, the ability to turn those into lemonade and savor its every moment is an art not many people could muster these days. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctRqpM7DSj9cTAaoAxhg4bu6vQruwzMbFgb15g6i55VX/image.png) Days when mom could actually have more energy travelling out of home and enjoy her favourite mashed potatoes with us at her favourite fast food restaurant, are days we cannot take for granted. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcQ76vhUsQwv4Uvk75GWTQWiTzzJoTgYs2epTkRssF6wD/image.png) Other days when sleep is deprived, queuing for medicine at the break of dawn could break our spirit, but looking at such a provision from government hospitals where most other more developed countries do not provide, encourages me not to take this _offering_ from the government as entitlement but a grace of God that we still have a functioning country (though imperfect) that is still capable. (There is no perfect country—except the Kingdom of Heaven—that will not be here for a little longer) https://vt.tiktok.com/ZSxBJVKTS/ (A short routine of constant busyness, but definitely fruitful) Every rare occasion when I get to do my own thing (other than work and care) is a _Selah_ (paused) moment, especially piled up delayed tasks are finally cleared off—item by item. Hello hivers, an happy Wednesday to you all! Yesterday the paintings I exhibited in a place not so far from my home came back at home and I can say it was a very nice experience because while they were placed there I received many beautiful words from people. ❤️ This morning, as usual, I woke up soon and, after I gave food to my cats and after my first cup of coffee, I started to work with brushes and colors.
