title.title: We Begin Percival Rackham's First Trial in Hogwarts Legacy
title.body:
![1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t7F8LcNnmmWPFpEs2bp3nvj2evMgL2iNpoKWejWHtu93rWFB9UXN5ArMx6c5aveeUXh.gif)


Hey gamers, how are you all doing? Hope everyone is doing great! My adventure in Hogwarts Legacy continues and this time we're finally getting into the action that everything has been building toward. As we left things in the last post, Percival Rackham revealed the first trial through the living map in the Map Chamber, and the location marked was a tower far to the north of Hogwarts in the North Ford Bog region. Professor Fig was going to head there ahead of me to scout the area while I made my way over independently. And honestly, thank goodness for the broomstick and the Floo Flame fast travel network because without both of those getting to this tower would have been a serious journey. The North Ford Bog area is remote — genuinely out there on the edge of the map — and flying north on the broom with the landscape rolling out beneath you actually makes for a pretty spectacular approach to what's coming.

**Meeting Professor Fig to Investigate the Tower**

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tS37FZW3hg9HGq3Z2e65rstz4SyvFRGp7KjgaL6pyBVByYvyEcfevrpP7ivxLg7BRZr.jpg)

I fast traveled to the Jackdaw's Tomb Floo Flame in the Forbidden Forest to shorten the trip as much as possible, then hopped on the broom and flew the rest of the way north following the quest marker. And as I approached the tower ruins and descended, there was Fig waiting for me exactly as promised — standing at the base of the ruins looking up at the tower with that familiar expression of focused concern he gets when something isn't sitting right with him. And sure enough, something wasn't right at all.

Before we could even think about entering the tower, Fig pulls me aside and tells me to look at what's in front of us. The ruins surrounding the tower base are absolutely crawling with goblins — Ranrok's loyalists, the same faction we've been running into throughout the story. And the fact that they're here, at this specific tower, at this specific time, is not a coincidence. These goblins somehow know this location matters. They don't know exactly what's inside or what the trials are, but they clearly have enough intelligence on ancient magic and the sites connected to it to have sent a force here to investigate and potentially block access. Fig suggests we use Disillusionment to go invisible and try to take as many of them out quietly before the situation forces us into open combat. Smart move. And this is also the moment the game properly introduces Petrificus Totalus — the full Body-Bind Curse — as a stealth takedown tool.

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbRcRmC1hsVkF5JfazNoAvuDnbBDNyj2nGZ1qhkhp1hUJp5FRRSt6FZq9urpGL8v9sT.jpg)

The mechanic is simple and incredibly satisfying once you get the hang of it. Activate Disillusionment to go invisible, crouch, move silently behind an enemy who hasn't spotted you, wait for the prompt to appear, and cast Petrificus Totalus. The target gets hit with the curse, goes completely rigid, and drops to the ground without making a sound. For weaker enemies it's an instant takedown. For stronger ones like Sentinels it deals massive damage and staggers them badly. Either way it's clean, quiet, and leaves no alert for nearby enemies if you time it right. Moving through the goblin camp this way — picking them off one by one from the shadows — felt genuinely like something out of a spy film set in the wizarding world.

**Fighting Ranrok's Goblin Loyalists to the Death**

![0423 (1)(3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5vsP3FyfybzQjWT6XnQ7BNf3syrPWAj8j3EHJ7s4UnALFzVrqnMaGcqenaQSi4XfyV.jpg)

The stealth approach only gets you so far though. At a certain point the remaining goblins spot movement or find one of their fallen comrades and the whole camp goes on alert, which means the fight breaks open into full combat. And this particular group of loyalists is not a pushover. You've got a mix of Loyalist Warriors, a Loyalist Sentinel, and a Loyalist Assassin mixed into the camp, each requiring a slightly different approach to deal with effectively. The Warriors are straightforward — break their shields with the matching spell color and unload damage spells. The Sentinel has a massive health pool and hits like a freight train so keeping distance and using Ancient Magic throws when they're available is the play. The Assassin is fast and aggressive and will close distance on you constantly, so dodge rolls and Expelliarmus to disrupt their attacks are essential.

What Fig said at the start proved true throughout this fight — the goblins absolutely suspect this tower has significance. There were too many of them, positioned too deliberately, for this to be a random patrol. Ranrok's network is closing in on the same trail we're following, just from a different angle and with very different intentions. It adds a layer of urgency to everything because every time you see his loyalists show up it's a reminder that we're in a race even if the finish line isn't fully visible yet. Once the last goblin goes down, Fig gives you a nod and the path to the tower entrance is clear.

**Finding the Tower Entrance and Meeting Percival's Portrait**

![0423 (1)(9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbP7HqNXqtSMQkRJSjhoY9nXKqrZjBdksGFCRfpfEJL49X6s9cTWNx2BC9SMum64RCG.jpg)

The tower itself is worth taking a moment to appreciate before you charge straight in. It's ancient, weathered, built from the same kind of deep magical stonework you saw in Jackdaw's Tomb and the Map Chamber — the kind of construction that tells you whoever built this place was working with knowledge and craft far beyond ordinary wizarding architecture. There's a chest sitting right in front of the entrance door that's easy to miss if you walk straight past it, so make sure you grab it before heading in. Fig casts Alohomora on the door and it swings open, and from there you climb upward through the tower looting everything along the way — small coin piles hidden in corners that Revelio lights up, another chest mid-climb, items tucked against the walls on each landing.

At the top of the tower, waiting on the wall in a portrait frame, is Percival Rackham. Another instance of his portrait, similar to the one in the Map Chamber but positioned here specifically as a gateway to the trial itself. The conversation with this version of Percival is brief but important. He confirms that the trial entrance is below, back at the base of the tower, and that he can give you no further guidance about what waits inside. The trial was designed to be faced alone — Professor Fig cannot follow you in. Whatever happens inside is between you and the ancient magic Percival left behind. Fig acknowledges this with his characteristic mix of reluctance and trust, tells you to be careful, and sends you back downstairs to find the entrance.

**Percival Tells Me What I Must Do — Alone — Following the Ancient Magic**

![0423 (1)(14).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23t72sVjwWzgkmBEc5scBM2iSuDgkD8qtT7s3eE243FmX3rtBKBmmkRvGac2EVw2mmK9V.jpg)

Back at the base of the tower, you start looking around for what Percival described and this is where your ability to perceive ancient magic becomes literally essential rather than just narrative flavor. There are golden swirling traces of ancient magic visible on the floor — the same kind of visual signature you've been seeing throughout the game — and they're pointing toward a specific spot on the ground. You follow them, stand on the marked point, and the game prompts you to investigate the ancient magic pool beneath your feet. You interact with it, a portal rips open in front of you, and without Fig, without backup, without any safety net — you step through.

![0423 (1)(13).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swdkYCM3FuDdS9or6t9nmF6SDcP47ZuK1RnLUwH4fpJL1CXQmwrEApuekE5h7kuTEJ9.jpg)

What follows immediately after stepping through the portal is a short corridor section that moves quickly and linearly, pulling you deeper into the trial space. Percival's voice guides you in fragments — not holding your hand, not explaining everything, just nudging you to pay attention to the ancient magic around you and trust what you perceive. The trail of golden traces continues through the corridor and leads you downstairs as soon as the path allows it. Every turn feels deliberate, like the trial was constructed with specific intention about what you should notice and when. There are small chests tucked into side alcoves along the way — always worth grabbing — and the architecture shifts as you go deeper, becoming more refined and more clearly purposeful than the rough stonework of the tower above.

**We Arrive at a New Place — The Real Trial Begins**

![2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tGXnKbWyty1oyhSRR5WvFdRqQ8ef9dSSB1X96WKyathRzdmDFnUXEFcDGxKYHrppg6r.gif)

Following the ancient magic traces through the opening corridors eventually brings you into a chamber that feels fundamentally different from everything that came before it. It's large, carefully constructed, and radiates that specific quality of ancient magic energy that you've come to associate with the deepest and oldest parts of the wizarding world. There are portals here, floating platforms suspended in the air, and ancient magic pools positioned in ways that make it immediately clear this space was built as a puzzle — something to be navigated and solved rather than just passed through.

This is where the real trial begins. And this is exactly where we're going to leave things for today, because what comes next inside this trial chamber deserves its own full post to do it justice. The platform puzzles, the combat encounters with the Pensieve Guardians, and the revelation waiting at the end of this trial are all significant enough that cramming it into the end of this post would sell it short completely. So gamers, the anticipation is real. We are standing at the threshold of Percival Rackham's first trial, the ancient magic is swirling all around us, and what comes next is going to be one of the most memorable stretches of the entire game so far. See you in the next post!

body.title: 🐝 Ірландія і бджоли: 1500 років разом
body.body:
/>

Сьогодні відзначається World Bee Day, і Ірландія з 1500-річною історією бджільництва бере в цьому активну участь.

Бджола в Ірландії була чимось більшим, ніж просто комаха — священна істота, повноправний член суспільства і божественний захисник. Тихе дзижчання бджолиного вулика гельською мовою називали «звуком сонця».

Задовго до британського завоювання ірландський Brehon Law регулював права бджолярів і бджіл — Bechbretha (Бджолині вироки).

The Theft of Honey — крадіжка сусідського меду вважалася не просто злочином, а зневагою до духовних цінностей, адже бджоли вважалися шляхетними створіннями з правом на власний мед.

The Swarm Right — якщо бджолиний рій залишав старий вулик і оселявся на сусідській землі, закон передбачав чотирирічний період чесного поділу меду між колишнім і новим господарем сім'ї.

Retribution to Stings — якщо людину вжалила бджола, їй належала компенсація у вигляді меду. Але якщо людина вбила бджолу — вона назавжди позбавлялася права на мед. Життя кожної бджоли мало цінність.

У ірландських бджіл є навіть своя покровителька — Saint Gobnait of Ballyvourney. Легенда розповідає, що у 6 столітті ангел наказав Гобнайт знайти «місце воскресіння», що привело її на пагорби графства Корк, де вона заснувала центр медицини і бджільництва.

Ще один святий, St. Domnóc, вважається прабатьком домашніх бджіл — його бджоли були так прив'язані до нього, що супроводжували його у всіх морських подорожах. Зрештою він разом зі своїм роєм, Saint Swarm, висадився на «медових берегах» графства Вексфорд і став засновником ірландського домашнього бджільництва.

Native Irish Black Bee — різновид медоносних бджіл, яким не страшна ірландська дощова погода і прохолода. Вони звикли збирати нектар у тих умовах, де теплолюбні європейські види просто не вижили б.

Ірландські монастирі збирали і постачали бджолиний віск та мед до Північної Європи. Ірландський мед нерідко обмінювали на французькі вина і китайський шовк — настільки великою була його цінність.

Сьогодні в Ірландії докладають усіх зусиль, щоб зберегти корінні види бджіл — на острові їх налічується понад 100 різновидів, включно з медоносними бджолами і джмелями. У 2015 році розгорнули кампанію з висаджування польових квітів у містах, на підприємствах і фермах, щоб бджолам було смачно і привільно на барвистих галявинах.

Щороку ірландців просять утриматися від скошування трави — No Mow May — щоб у пік літнього цвітіння бджоли мали вільний доступ до медоносних рослин.

Бджоли в Ірландії — це партнер і друг, а не ресурс. І Brehon Law, написаний 14 століть тому, досі захищає дзижчачу смугасту спільноту від можливих неприємностей.

Bzzz 🐝

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1907
Wednesday 20, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1972
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Emindcipation
Imminent Eminence  
New World Heroes
Freeing our mind from mental slavery.     


![1972.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQMp8BgcAGqwxpYUKYRmWhyZitEXVQ3Jo6jajFtkoAyZD/1972.png)

  

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1907_full_5-20-26_1972_emind:c?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.

Chapter 5. Human Stock. Human Shock!

Remember, this is not real. This is a simulated reality and we are looking into a simulated past. Zecheria Sitchin’s account of the Sumerian tablets was turned into a series of twelve books and a narrative that suggests that our current species, you know, the ones Yuval Noah Harari refers to as, “hackable animals,” was created by aliens, who were referred to as “gods.” It’s funny how “believers,” are all in on humans being created, what was it, on day six? (perfect number.) But they choke on their rosary beads if some dares to suggests that those “gods” might have been space aliens. Better to be made out of the dust of the earth, than merged into an ape. 

Speaking of apes, our place-holder candidate, Australopithecus africanus is out of the running. That species was already extinct for a million years by the time the Annunaki landed. But guess who was in town, and in the Levant. 

When I get this thing done, so that the timelines are solid, within a shar or two of Annunaki time, (3600 – 7200 Earth years, I am going to claim, like many philosophers before, that this was inspired by Divinity. Dictated to your humble scribe, by an ascended master, who gave Mind access to the akashic record and inspired, (breathed in, that’s what inspired means. Just like God breathed life into his creations). Where was I? Oh yes, then claim that whatever this becomes was divinely inspired and must be distributed to awakened humans all over the world. I will sign a few books. Appear on a few podcasts, sign the rights over to some Unicorn AI start-up movie studio, become a Double Jeopardy Question, and never be heard from again. 

But back to the important reminder. Every bit of info that comes my way, bears the name given to it by some human. For example, the polysyllabic, Australopithecus africanus, means “southern ape in Africa.” It doesn’t have anything to do with Australia. But where’s Australia on a “standard” globe? It’s in the southern part of the planet. Australopithecus is Latinized Greek. What does this have to do with Space Invaders? 

It’s to emphasize that everything is named by Man. That doesn’t make it real. And it damn-sure doesn’t make it true. It makes it a simulation. Whatever it “is,” is not what man calls it. That makes it a simulation.    
So who was walking upright in the area of Mesopotamia circa 100,000 earth years after the Annunaki landed? None other than Homo erectus. (The teenager in me can’t help a little giggle.)  

Homo heidelbergensis was also active in the regions of Africa & Europe.  

Here’s where your boy had been going in the wrong direction for many years. Because I was looking at this from a human perspective, and listening to Lloyd Pye (1946-2013), (he’s the one who suggested Australopithecus africanus as a candidate for the Annunaki’s slave species). It hadn’t dawned on me that, what are considered, “archaic humans” (homo erectus), for example, would look like primates to the Annunaki. Homo erectus had been on the planet for a million years before the Annunaki got here. We also must take into consideration the biases of whoever recorded the Sumerian tablets. The biases of whoever translated the Sumerian tablets. And the, “literary license,” editing and political correctness, of whoever produced Sitchin’s books.   
We have a demographic profile of homo erectus circa 450,000 years ago. This is what the Annunaki would have seen frolicking in paradise. 

Around 451,000 years ago, in the Lower Paleolithic Levant, (modern-day Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria), Homo erectus, often referred to regionally as Homo erectus sensu lato or possibly early Homo heidelbergensis by some taxonomies, occupied a strategic corridor between Africa and Eurasia.  

Demographically, this was a small, dispersed metapopulation, likely numbering in the low hundreds per clan range, with total regional population, perhaps a few thousand. They were medium-bodied (males 170 cm, (5’ 6”), 65 kg (145 lbs). females 160 cm, (5’ 3”), 55 kg, (120 lbs), robust, and showing marked sexual dimorphism. (You could tell the boys from the girls.) Life expectancy was low, perhaps 50% died before age 15, with few living past 40.  Social units likely comprised 20–30 individuals, several related females, older juveniles, and one to several adult males, practicing fission-fusion mobility to exploit seasonal resources. (They traveled with herds.) 

Sites near freshwater springs, indicate repeated occupation, with evidence of basalt hand-axe manufacturing and butchery of elephants, deer, and hippo. Group territories spanned roughly 100–200 km, with home bases reused for generations. Fertility was likely high, (3–5 surviving offspring per female) to offset chronic mortality from predation, injury, and drought. No burial evidence exists,  mortality management was probably rudimentary abandonment or scavenging. Culturally, they maintained Acheulean (stone) tool traditions with local chert and basalt. Their demographic resilience rested on extreme mobility, cooperative hunting, and efficient caloric extraction, a successful but slow replacing frontier population at the ecological edge of the genus Homo.

To put it into perspective, the Levant, 450,000 years ago was not populated by primitive, hairy, apelike \

for anyone to enslave. It was populated by highly successful, intelligent archaic humans who had already mastered fire, built shelters, and cooperated to hunt giant animals. \n\nWhile Homo erectus was indeed \

for 1.5 million years, by 450,000 years ago, the descendants of erectus had evolved larger brains and more complex social behaviors, making them much closer to modern humans than to the primitive stereotypes. 

Of course, to a civilization, nigh immortal, and strangers on a strange world, homo erectus would appear to their eyes, to be not much more than a beast. Ninmah mentions, in one of her descriptions, that they eat and drink like the animals. 

Homo erectus is a Latin term meaning \

referring to an extinct species of archaic human that lived from about 2 million to 250,000 years ago and is considered a direct ancestor of modern humans. This species is notable for its human-like body proportions and the ability to walk upright. 

Note the estimated date of “extinction.” 200,000 years after the Annunaki arrive. 

So here’s the look. But first, remember this is fiction. 
450K Annunaki arrive to mine gold. 100K years later, Annunaki workers revolt. Enki and Ninmah experiment with human-alien hybrids to create a “primitive worker.” Who do they use for these experiments? Homo erectus. The only bipeds in that area at the time. 100K years later, slave species created, archaic humans, extinct. 

This wasn’t even genocide. This was species-cide. 
I need air. 

This is only a movie, only a movie, only a movie.  
Some humans believe this. Ego believes this. Mind has doubts. We are tracking these stories for kicks and curiosity. If you are going to believe in alien intervention theory, you must also believe that a species that thrived and evolved on this planet for 1.5 million years, went extinct, coincidentally, 200,000 years after aliens arrive on Earth and create a slave species. 

We added a few more pieces to the seven dimensional puzzle tonight. Remember dimensions 6 & 7? We had to skew our perception to look at who’d be the mostly likely victims of these slave making colonizers. We thought, “primitive,” from a homo sapien perspective. That meant apes. Knock-knock. No answer. Our candidate had been extinct for 2 million years. We couldn't fathom that homo erectus could be considered, “primitive.” Well, not to us. But to advanced beings who can travel at the speed of light. Yeah. “Primitive.” Plus, homo erectus was the only upright walking critter in da hood. That narrowed things down considerably.   

On the bright side, we didn’t come from apes. 
See you tomorrow.

body.title: The Grey Warden and MemeHive — A Journey of Loyalty, Community, and Decentralized Creativity
body.body:
There are moments in decentralized communities where numbers alone fail to tell the real story.

A wallet balance can show accumulation.
A richlist can show position.
A staking percentage can show influence.

But none of those things truly explain why someone stays committed to a community for years.

Today, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on my journey with the MemeHive Tribe, the MEME token ecosystem, and the incredible creators who continue to bring life, humor, creativity, and culture to the Hive blockchain every single day.


---


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmemVCkVy7enNzC6pzpkxaPukRKpooVZtQnG6mu5C8Yt4v/1779277883825.png)
(Image was created by AI based on the content of my blog information)
https://he.dtools.dev/richlist/MEME

The Journey of @greywarden100

Over the years, I have quietly continued to support the MemeHive ecosystem through long-term staking, curation, participation, and belief in the platform itself.

As of today, my account:

@greywarden100

currently holds approximately:

17,000,389+ MEME staked

making it:

the largest visible wallet on the MEME richlist

approximately 18.17% of the circulating supply

approximately 6.8% of the maximum token supply


This was never about flexing numbers.

It was never about attempting to dominate a community.

And it was certainly never about trying to become “important.”

What truly matters to me is supporting a decentralized culture where creators could post freely, express humor openly, and build value through creativity rather than through centralized control.

That is what MemeHive represented to me from the very beginning.


---

Why MemeHive Matters

Many people outside Hive do not fully understand what makes communities like MemeHive special.

MemeHive is not simply a token.

It is not merely a frontend.

It is not just another “meme coin.”

MemeHive became a living ecosystem where:

creators earn for originality,

curators reward quality content,

communities form around humor and culture,

and decentralized social media becomes something real rather than theoretical.


On centralized platforms, creators build audiences they do not own.

Algorithms control visibility.

Corporations control monetization.

Accounts can disappear overnight.

But on Hive and within tribes like MemeHive, creators actually participate in ownership of the ecosystem itself.

That changes everything.


---

The Power of Curation

One of the most overlooked aspects of Hive is curation.

People often focus only on posting.

But curators are essential to the ecosystem.

Without curators:

quality content gets buried,

communities stagnate,

engagement collapses,

and ecosystems slowly die.


The ability to support creators through staking and curation is one of the most powerful aspects of decentralized social media.

Being able to help reward creators who consistently produce entertaining, original, and valuable meme content has honestly been one of the most enjoyable parts of my Hive journey.

There is something deeply satisfying about seeing talented creators receive recognition for their work.

Especially in an internet era where creativity is constantly exploited by platforms that give very little back to users.


---

Long-Term Commitment

The MEME token has existed through multiple market cycles.

Bull markets.
Bear markets.
Periods of high activity.
Periods of slower activity.

Yet despite everything, MemeHive has continued to survive.

Why?

Because communities survive longer than hype.

That is one of the greatest lessons blockchain teaches over time.

Temporary speculation fades.

But real communities endure.

My position was built gradually over years of belief in the ecosystem, not through short-term speculation.

The fact that my entire MEME balance remains staked reflects that long-term mindset.

Not because I expect perfection.

Not because every day is easy.

But because decentralized communities require people who are willing to stay committed beyond hype cycles.


---

Respect to the MemeHive Creators

I want to sincerely thank all the creators who continue posting on MemeHive and Hive.

The meme creators.
The curators.
The grinders.
The artists.
The shitposters.
The commentators.
The community builders.

You are the reason the ecosystem has value.

Not the token itself.

Not the market price.

Not the richlist.

The people are what create value.

Without creators, a token is just a database entry.

Without community, staking means nothing.

Without participation, decentralization becomes empty marketing language.

The creators are the heartbeat of MemeHive.


---

The Importance of Decentralized Social Media

We are living in a time where centralized platforms increasingly control:

speech,

monetization,

visibility,

discoverability,

and creator income.


Hive represents an alternative model.

An imperfect one, yes.

But an important one.

A place where users can still own their accounts, their communities, and their digital presence.

MemeHive contributes to that broader vision by creating a fun and culturally active corner of the Hive ecosystem where humor and creativity can thrive.

Sometimes memes say more truth than long essays ever could.

Sometimes humor becomes one of the strongest forms of communication on the internet.

And MemeHive embraced that reality early.


---

Gratitude

I am genuinely honored to have been able to support MemeHive over the years.

Being recognized on the richlist is meaningful, but the real reward has been participating in a decentralized community filled with creative people who continue showing up and building regardless of market conditions.

That kind of resilience deserves respect.

To everyone who has ever:

posted memes,

curated content,

delegated,

supported creators,

or helped keep MemeHive alive,


thank you.

The Hive ecosystem only survives because communities continue believing in decentralized participation.

And MemeHive remains one of the most unique and entertaining tribes on Hive.


---

The Grey Warden Continues Watching

The blockchain remembers.

The communities remember.

And long after hype cycles come and go, what remains are the people who stayed.

To MemeHive, to Hive, and to all the creators still building:

Respect.

— @greywarden100
The Grey Wardens

body.title: When Sheep Solve a Murder
body.body:
A murder mystery solved by sheep. That premise alone got me into the cinema.

I expected something light and forgettable. *The Sheep Detectives* turned out to be more than that. Not dramatically more. But enough to stick.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcj2638nevnSNWSyPtHEnyBi13JKp8avL4XETo4v1YtRF/1779278502783.jpg)
[img source](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/MV5BNTFmZWI4YmMtNmQ0ZC00ZGQwLTk1OWEtZjAyZmIzOGY0MGFiXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg) 

The setup: a shepherd reads murder mystery novels to his flock every night, thinking they can't understand a word. When he turns up dead, the sheep know it was murder. And they think they know exactly how to solve it.

The film is directed by Kyle Balda, best known for the *Minions* franchise. The script is by Craig Mazin, adapted from Leonie Swann's 2005 novel *Three Bags Full*. The voice cast behind the sheep includes Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Patrick Stewart, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Rhys Darby, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. Hugh Jackman plays George, the shepherd.

With that cast, the film had to do something right. It does.

---

## The Sheep Work. The Humans Don't.

The sheep are genuinely good characters. Each one has a distinct personality without being a caricature. The visual effects make them feel real, they move with actual weight, which sounds like a small thing but makes a huge difference.

What makes them interesting is how they see the world. Their logic comes from detective novels, overheard conversations, and what they believe to be true. That gap between what they think they know and what is actually happening is where the film finds both its humor and its sadness.

They are not trying to solve a crime. They are trying to understand what it means that their shepherd is gone. That is what the film is actually about.

The human characters don't get the same treatment. They exist to move the plot. I felt nothing when the shepherd died, which says a lot. The film cares more about the sheep than the people, and it shows.

The mystery is the weakest part. The sheep don't do enough actual detecting for a film built on that premise. The clues come together a little too conveniently. The final reveal lands, but it doesn't hit hard.

The tonal shifts are also uneven. The film goes between comedy and grief, and those transitions are sometimes smooth, sometimes not. A few scenes feel like they belong in a different movie.

None of it kills the film. But it keeps it from being as sharp as it could be.

The film commits completely to its premise. It never winks at the audience. It treats its sheep characters with full seriousness, even when they are debating murder theories in a field in the rain. That sincerity is what makes the emotional moments land.

There is a real theme of grief underneath everything. The sheep are processing loss the only way they know how, through the framework of stories. That is a small, quiet idea, and the film carries it well.

I didn't expect to feel anything watching this. I did. Not a lot. But enough.

>Es en esos días, cuando reconozco que estoy haciendo demasiado, es un llamado urgente a bajar la velocidad, recordándome que mi creatividad y mi bienestar necesitan espacio, silencio y sobre todo, una estructura amable que me permita respirar en lugar de solo cumplir una to-do list infinita.
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.

>Sé que identificar qué hacemos desde la culpa y qué hacemos desde una elección consciente cambia totalmente nuestra forma de vivir. Cuando algo realmente es importante para mí, suele sentirse ligero incluso en el esfuerzo. Pero cuando actúo desde el miedo, todo pesa más de lo necesario y es ahí, cuando veo que hay que aprender a diferenciar ambas cosas, y preguntarse si algo es verdaderamente urgente o si solo estoy reaccionando a la presión externa. Interiorizar en mis procesos mentales, me lleva a una valiosa lección:

>Aceptar esta verdad, me ha permitido priorizarme sin hacerme egoísta, entendiendo que también tengo derecho a elegir mi paz. Este discernimiento nos libera de la trampa de la prisa; me permite aceptar que mi única urgencia real es vivir con coherencia y proteger la paz con la que construyo los cimientos de mi vida a los 20s.
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.

>Sometimes the deepest exhaustion doesn’t stem from what we do, but from the reasons why we refuse to stop. We forget how much we’re worth, who we truly are inside, and we set aside what nourishes our souls in favor of routine, because we live at a frantic pace that pushes us to ignore the signals from our own bodies and minds, confusing productivity with self-worth. Learning to pause, listen to the inner silence, and assess which commitments we carry out of self-love and which out of sheer inertia is the first step toward regaining our peace. In this week’s <span class=\
>Ladies of Hive, I pause to reflect on those boundaries that we sometimes let get lost in the daily noise.
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.

>Lately, I’ve realized that I feel exhausted when I try to meet expectations that didn’t come from me. Wanting to be there for everyone, respond quickly, get more done, handle other people’s emotions, and also take care of myself is a daily struggle that can become a silent burden. Sometimes I do so many things out of fear of disappointing others that I end up disappointing myself. My body starts asking for breaks while my mind insists on pushing forward, and it is amid that noise that I have come to understand that resting is not a waste of time. It is also an emotional and physical need that deserves respect.

>It’s on those days, when I realize I’m taking on too much, that I get an urgent call to slow down—a reminder that my creativity and well-being need space, silence, and above all, a gentle structure that allows me to breathe rather than just ticking off an endless to-do list.
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.

>I know that distinguishing between what we do out of guilt and what we do as a conscious choice completely transforms the way we live. When something is truly important to me, it usually feels effortless. But when I act out of fear, everything feels heavier than it needs to be, and that’s when I realize I need to learn to differentiate between the two, and ask myself if something is truly urgent or if I’m just reacting to external pressure. Reflecting on my thought processes leads me to a valuable lesson:

>Accepting this truth has allowed me to prioritize myself without being selfish, understanding that I, too, have the right to choose my own peace. This insight frees us from the trap of rushing; it allows me to accept that my only real urgency is to live authentically and protect the peace with which I’m building the foundation of my life in my 20s.

body.title: Who are the giants in Genesis 6:4 || Mcgi Topic Review
body.body:
**“Genesis 6:4 (KJV): There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.”**

In Genesis 6:4, the “giants” are often understood as the Nephilim. Many people believe that these giants lived in the ancient days even before the great flood that made Noah to build an ark. The Bible describes them as the offspring of the “sons of God” and the “daughters of men,” showing a time when human life became morally corrupt and violent. Some interpret them as very tall or strong humans, while others see them as symbols of wicked and proud people in that generation.
https://youtu.be/jCvN2KQjxjo?si=W4arrSMa5BE--o08
The presence of the giants in Genesis 6:4 shows how far humanity had drifted away from God before the flood. It reflects a period of disobedience, violence, and moral failure, which led God to judge the earth through Noah’s flood. This passage teaches that human strength alone cannot stand against sin, and it reminds us of the importance of living in obedience to God.

body.title: ✂️ Hay momentos en los que toca soltar [Eng - Eng] ✂️ There Are Moments When We Need to Let Go.
body.body:
>

*20 de mayo de 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Día 3109: Corta el cable.*

Hay momentos en la vida en los que, aunque quisiéramos aferrarnos con todas nuestras fuerzas, simplemente no queda otra opción que soltar. Puede tratarse de una etapa, de una costumbre, de un lugar, de una persona o incluso de una idea que durante mucho tiempo nos acompañó. Y aunque al principio cuesta aceptarlo, con el tiempo entendemos que dejar ir también forma parte natural del crecimiento.

A todos, en algún momento, nos ha tocado despedirnos de algo importante. No siempre porque queramos, sino porque la vida sigue su curso y nos obliga a avanzar. Y aunque soltar muchas veces duele, también es cierto que detrás de cada despedida suele esconderse una nueva oportunidad para sanar, aprender y descubrir que todavía somos capaces de seguir adelante.
____________

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTJeg1To9AfMNNpCTr37YszdHBBbq2DUA8o6wi3yehA9/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
____________

Recuerdo con total claridad aquel mes de marzo de 2019, como si hubiera ocurrido ayer. Fue uno de los momentos más difíciles de toda mi vida. Ese día me tocó tomar la decisión de viajar a este hermoso país llamado Argentina con la esperanza de abrir un nuevo camino para mi familia. Como tantos venezolanos, me fui cargado de sueños, de incertidumbre y de ese nudo en la garganta que solo entiende quien ha tenido que dejar atrás a las personas que más ama.

La escena quedó grabada para siempre en mi memoria. Estaba en el terminal Big Low Center de Valencia, en el estado Carabobo. Allí estaban mi esposa Gesmary, mi hijo Jorge Luis y mi adorada hija María de Jesús despidiéndose de mí. Recuerdo perfectamente a mi pequeña levantando su mano y diciéndome adiós con esa ternura que siempre la caracterizó. Yo también levanté la mía, sin imaginar siquiera que esa sería la última vez que la vería con vida. Solo de escribirlo se me aprieta el pecho, porque hay recuerdos que uno jamás logra acomodar del todo.

La vida me ha obligado a soltar muchas cosas. Tuve que soltar mi país, mi profesión, mis costumbres y la rutina que conocía. Más adelante me tocó enfrentar el dolor más grande que puede vivir un padre: la partida de un hijo. Y si soy completamente sincero, hay cosas que todavía no he podido soltar. La ausencia de María de Jesús sigue siendo una herida abierta que aprendí a llevar, pero que nunca dejará de doler.

A veces escuchamos que debemos “cortar el cordón” y seguir adelante, como si eso fuera tan sencillo. Pero cuando el amor es verdadero, ese cordón no se corta del todo. Cambia de forma. Ya no puedo tomarla de la mano, abrazarla o escuchar su voz, pero sigue unida a mí en cada recuerdo, en cada oración y en cada paso que doy. Vive en mi corazón y en todo lo que hago con amor.

Con el tiempo he comprendido que soltar no siempre significa desprenderse por completo. A veces significa aprender a convivir con la ausencia, aceptar lo que no podemos cambiar y seguir caminando con el alma llena de recuerdos. Significa honrar a quienes amamos viviendo de una manera que los haga sentir orgullosos de nosotros.

Hoy sigo adelante por mi esposa, por mi hijo, por los sueños que todavía quiero alcanzar y también por María de Jesús, porque su recuerdo me acompaña y me da fuerzas incluso en los días más difíciles. Ella ya no está físicamente a mi lado, pero jamás se irá de mi corazón.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Hoy entiendo que todos, en algún momento, tenemos que soltar algo que amamos profundamente. Y aunque algunas despedidas duelen más que otras, también nos enseñan el verdadero valor del amor, de la fe y de la esperanza.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este hermoso espacio donde podemos transformar nuestras vivencias en palabras que nacen del corazón.

Gracias por leer y acompañarme una vez más. Y ahora te pregunto, ***¿qué ha sido lo más difícil que te ha tocado soltar en la vida?***

*Los leo en la caja de comentarios.*

body.title: Ether ETFs Just Had Their Biggest Day Ever. The Timing Is Interesting.
body.body:
Ether ETFs Just Had Their Biggest Day Ever. The Timing Is Interesting.

$726 million in a single day. That's the record for Ether ETFs — and it came right after a week where Bitcoin ETFs bled $1 billion.

The contrast is worth sitting with for a moment.

---

### What Actually Happened

The $726M inflow wasn't spread evenly. Most of it went to BlackRock's ETHA and Fidelity's FETH — the same two funds that have dominated Ether ETF flows since launch. Grayscale's ETHE saw minimal activity, which tells me this is new institutional allocation, not rotation out of existing products.

What makes the timing notable: just days earlier, Harvard filed its quarterly 13F showing a full exit from both Bitcoin and Ether ETF positions. An endowment selling while other institutions are buying at record pace.

That's not a contradiction. Endowments and asset managers have different time horizons and different risk frameworks. Harvard's exit says nothing about Ether's long-term trajectory. But it does suggest that institutional flows are becoming more nuanced — buying and selling happening simultaneously rather than in waves.

I haven't found exact breakdowns of who the buyers were in yesterday's $726M. The ETF issuers report aggregate flows, not client identities. But the scale suggests it's not retail.

### The Cycle Question

K33 Research published a note this week arguing that Bitcoin's four-year cycle is breaking down. The reasoning: institutional involvement, ETF-driven price discovery, and corporate treasury allocations are smoothing out the boom-bust pattern that defined crypto from 2013 to 2022.

I think they're half right.

The retail-driven speculative cycle — where new entrants flood in after a halving, drive prices up, then panic sell 12-18 months later — is probably weakening. ETFs change the onramp structure. Instead of everyone buying at once during a mania phase, institutional capital trickles in through measured allocations regardless of where we are in the halving calendar.

But crypto isn't just Bitcoin. And it isn't just ETFs. The on-chain economy — DeFi lending, liquid staking, L2 activity, token launches — still runs on attention cycles that look a lot like the old four-year pattern. The asset may be maturing, but the ecosystem underneath it hasn't shed its cyclical DNA.

### What This Means for Ether Specifically

The $726M ETF inflow suggests institutions see Ether differently than Bitcoin right now. Bitcoin ETF flows had been positive for six weeks straight before the $1B reversal. Ether ETF flows have been choppier — up weeks followed by flat weeks, never sustaining a multi-week streak.

Yesterday breaks that pattern. $726M isn't a choppy up-day. It's a signal.

The question is whether it's the start of a sustained trend or a one-off. If Ether ETF inflows stay above $200M/day for the rest of the week, it changes the ETH/BTC narrative significantly from where we were just a few days ago.

I don't have a strong view on which direction this goes. The data is too fresh. But the structural shift — institutions now having two distinct ETF onramps and choosing between them based on relative value rather than just \

— is new. And new structures create opportunities that aren't visible in the old cycle framework.

### What I'm Watching

Three things over the next week:

- **Ether ETF flow persistence.** One record day is noise. Five consecutive days above $200M is a trend.
- **ETH/BTC ratio.** If Ether's relative strength holds above 0.04, the structural downtrend I wrote about earlier this week has a genuine challenge.
- **K33's thesis playing out.** If Bitcoin trades in a narrow range through June despite the halving having passed, the \

argument gains credibility. If we get a sharp move either direction, the cycle is alive.

The old playbook assumed booms and busts driven by retail FOMO and fear. The new playbook might be slower, steadier, and harder to trade. But it might also be more sustainable.

Not sure which one I prefer yet.

body.title: ДПСУ запустила сервіс перевірки обмежень на виїзд за кордон
body.body: Державна прикордонна служба України нарешті зробила щось справді зручне. Тепер через «Особистий кабінет» на сайті ДПСУ кожен може самостійно перевірити, чи є у нього обмеження на виїзд за кордон — без черг, дзвінків і походів до відомств. Просто заходиш, перевіряєш, бачиш результат.\n\n

/>

[джерело](https://dpsu.gov.ua/uk/news/51551-teper-pereviriti-obmezhennya-na-viyizd-za-kordon-mozhna-onlajn-u-realnomu-chasi)

🔹 Що саме перевіряє сервіс

Тут відображаються обмеження, які наклав суд або виконавча служба. Найчастіше — через борги. Наприклад, несплачені аліменти більше трьох місяців, штрафи або інші виконавчі провадження. Важливо розуміти: сам факт того, що ти в реєстрі боржників — ще не заборона. Потрібне окреме рішення суду або постанова виконавця.

⚠️ Але є один нюанс

Якщо обмеження пов'язане з воєнним станом — наприклад, для військовозобов'язаних — цей сервіс не допоможе. Такі обмеження діють за іншими правилами і в кабінеті просто не відображаються.

📋 Як це працює

Все досить просто:

Авторизуєшся через id.gov.ua, BankID, Дія.Підпис або КЕП

Входиш до кабінету на порталі ДПСУ

Система автоматично перевіряє дані

Одразу бачиш результат — або «Обмежень немає», або «Є тимчасове обмеження»

Жодних очікувань. Результат з'являється миттєво. Перейти на сервіс можна з сайту Держприкордонслужби або за прямим посиланням: t.ly/-kNw4.

body.title: 带媳妇和朋友吃烤串
body.body:
媳妇和朋友聊天，和感慨到好久没有和她朋友（闺蜜）一起聚聚啦。那有啥感慨滴，把朋友夫妇约出来，一起聚个餐呗。

![20260519_123116.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzq61xdnPqG7joVxbXDDvuC2pAmapV7Lf1ejerjtCUSF/20260519_123116.jpg)

于是媳妇就问朋友夫妇是否有空，她闺蜜有空，但是她闺蜜老公等着主持单位的一个重要会议，出不来，那就没办法了，我们三人聚聚吧。

依然纠结去哪吃的问题，朋友家离皇姑万象汇比较近，要不就选择在那集合，然后再看看附近有什么好饭店，再具体定。

我们提议顺路去朋友家接她，以往聚会几乎都是这个操作，毕竟她离那近，开车过去不合算（停车费5元一小时那）。

结果朋友说她这次骑电动车过去就好，难道是因为油价上涨的缘故？现在好多朋友都搞了电动车，既方便又省钱，哎，要不改天我们也搞一个小电驴？

快到约定的时间，我们出门准备前往万象汇，结果上车的时候我才发现大汽车的油量告警啦，原本我想着上午出去加油的，结果忙着忙着就忘了。

于是让媳妇和朋友说一声，让她也晚点出发，我们去加个油先。

呜呜呜，油价好贵，这跳动数字哪里是油啊，分明是我的血汗呀。
![20260519_113015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhR6Z4SQqorVCnXDg3pioidKuPb8YDhenJjQoRH1oLBz/20260519_113015.jpg)

原本还纠结是在万象汇里边吃还是去附近吃，结果到那的时候下起了小雨，不用纠结了，去万象汇吧。

到达负二停好了车，准备上楼。
![20260519_120714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTrdRxEeMW7gtn21tAZmrzVow7k3anKkyrdfFYiAzywKs/20260519_120714.jpg)

朋友竟然准确地在电梯出口等我们，哈，万象汇N台电梯，她咋堵的这么准呢？
![20260519_121014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZxHa7kHyd3c3Z7WzbUZ9sEaCzLKRA8BcsbaQYSw9nj3m/20260519_121014.jpg)

又是一起纠结吃啥，最后决定去北丐先生
![20260519_121201.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2grawHiHTLLfXyxa5Mm5GPME61nTn9YxLbFqE7b4Qej/20260519_121201.jpg)

哦对了，这是加油站送的咖啡，每次加油都可以免费领咖啡，但是我闲麻烦，从未领过，这是第一次领呢
![20260519_121853.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPVdUJyRGCDK8RGa2NCn4Tzm5he47gNrMLMzbW4iCG1zs/20260519_121853.jpg)

北丐先生环境还不错
![20260519_121903.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRSJrx8NZ9SufQsG6cbbemPz7hxvuXPjQtKegaEe2ZbRp/20260519_121903.jpg)

我们坐在窗边（没有窗）
![20260519_121936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJZCYrW6dq66RAxxxs5bgj8NwYuShejMuKnksYnL52nk/20260519_121936.jpg)

我们团购了一套四人餐，里边送两杯柠檬茶，给柠檬茶和我的咖啡合个影

炒肝尖，很好吃

什么海鲜虾仁野馄饨

body.title: Excessive anger is also Harmful to your Health.
body.body:
Hi Hivelearners friends.
Here I want to say that there are many people around us who have absolutely no control over it. After a while, these people realize that the more angry they get, the worse their health will start to deteriorate. Initially, in their youth, they may not realize that they are getting sick, but gradually, when they start getting older, they will start to realize that their health is deteriorating. Due to excessive anger, their blood pressure also starts to rise.
And then these are two or three diseases that a person has to live with for the rest of their life. Even now, we are seeing many people who get so angry even over a small matter, and they also have diabetes, blood pressure, and they are taking a lot of pills every day. The biggest disadvantage of this is that such a person does not have a good relationship with his family because whenever something is said, this person immediately gets angry and this is not good at all.
Even if you are sitting in a gathering, we see that people get angry there too. And if some children come to their house, they start getting angry with them. Here, it is a fact that with the passage of age, Here we have seen many people who are 55-60 years old. They seem to get angry more often and immediately start fighting. Or mostly those boys who are just 18-20 years old who have not seen this world, they are ready to fight with everyone,

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/couple-arguing-while-sitting-on-a-sofa-Oqs5eczHzHY)
Especially those who study in colleges and universities. But later, with the passage of time, every person starts to understand everything that many things cause problems and therefore it is better that we should make our mood and our morals such that later we do not have problems and people do not start to fear us. And then it happens that people stop meeting such a person completely and he starts living in his own world and then he goes into depression.
We all have come to this world to support each other and to help each other. So what I mean here is that all the people who feel that they get angry easily should definitely get themselves checked by a doctor. If they get themselves checked,

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-driving-a-car-gesturing-with-hand-l9WYBIbcG9A)
The doctor will definitely give them some medicine that will start changing their mood and then slowly they will start living like a normal person because a normal person does not get angry so easily and they continue to live their life peacefully. We have seen many people who used to be like this before, but after taking medicine gradually over time, they have now completely recovered and are living a much better and normal life.
The harm of getting angry is that the heart rate also increases and many things inside us start to deteriorate. Therefore, if there is such a person in our house or a relative of ours, we must definitely take him for treatment.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/couple-standing-back-to-back-with-arms-crossed-2CffF-UiVnE) Who is djbravo? Djbravo real name is Asad-chughtai and I am from Pakistan. Asad-chughtai is a writer, blogger, crypto trader, and nature lover. My goal is to share these special places and natural sights with all of you.

body.title: To The Woman Who Never Asked Me to Become Someone Else
body.body:
*“ You don’t seem to have direction in life”, that’s what they’re concerned about.*

<div class=text-justify>


![DSCF1851.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23u5ZbSbxSpz4cemm6SexB3iXfnPBEWpP4U4BELEztWeAZZcrVgdFggBtRXVyNEsjtrMr.JPG)



*Lately, I am hearing that a lot, the more I dive into this society and the way it thinks, the more disconnection I experience. The older I get, the more I just want to quietly get away from civilization and it’s honestly not something new. Living a monastic life and devoting a life to a certain teaching sounded even more appealing these days.*

At least, that’s a version of me, a  contingency, a plan Y in parts of my life where A, B, C, or even D no longer work, 

As I am older and recently coming out of a devastating life and rebuilding everything, I wanted to take everything at my own pace. Yet somehow, I’ve been dragged into life that I was running away from once and following someone else’s pace. The more I feel so far away from the life I dreamed about or even the life I used to have where the version of me was happier. 

I know, we could never be 100% happy but I know where my contentedness is compared to the life I have now. 


![DSCF1779.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/242YE9H8zHHWQxm4U1A22iEdD9eofs6URepSfeK7YpCXgdRWZXNoW5ooGmh9GQYZbHfgg.JPG)


I enjoy the comfort of spending time with my beloved mother, sipping coffee and chatting about many random things. 

Even if I have to work, I could have so many other options in life. It’s just that I don’t expect to be judged. Some of my jobs have been really unconventional but money has always been the end goal and I know how to get there. That has never been the issue. 


Yet in another parts of my life, my unconventional life seems to be quite an issue. These people base happiness on status, wealth, and achievements in life that they were willing to sacrifice everything. For me, all that matters is just if I have enough freedom to do whatever pleases my heart. 


That being said, recently I spent time with my mother again, seeing her so happy drinking her tea and eating the pastry in a recently opened cafe in town. 


 I was reminded once again of life that I used to have/the reason I worked hard in life. 



![DSCF1755.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/241tmxJjEFnhakoJAf2rk9wceLaQEZA9W7MFSxpFzBC2fJ8SFdUrBr9AKtnokUDwp9BM7.JPG)

Though I lead an unconventional life, she is the only one who accepts me, for who I am. She never wants to mold me into a certain person. She just wants the best for me. And that’s all I ever ask for. Most importantly, her unwavering love helped me through everything.

Frankly, that's enough. 

To my beloved mother and the most beautiful woman in my life, I'll always be forever thankful and grateful for everything she does.


<hr>

body.title: Reflection Shots in Buenos Aires - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
> It’s always a pleasure to take this kind of shot, where reflections take center stage and the city is shown from a different—and even more interesting perspective. There are many places in the city where you can use puddles as a backdrop to create something unique, and on Corrientes Avenue, you have plenty of spots to use them to your advantage. This happens after a day of heavy rain, and even when it’s not raining, you can use the reflections provided by the large glass-fronted buildings. This set includes photos of various neighborhoods, including the famous Corrientes Avenue, the business district in the Retiro neighborhood, and one photo in particular that isn’t about reflections but rather perspective: a building in a very narrow space inside a passageway on Santa Fe Avenue. So, you'll see different skies because these are photos taken on different days at random times. I hope you enjoyed it. Have a nice day :)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWDrMN8FqLEKJARqVjg9chaaz5FpxhvyDqcN5CAS6vA6/1779244111619.jpg)

It's a beautiful today and I hope you are all doing great, I bring all greetings from this part the world believing you are having lovely time with your sng project. Today from my sewing room, I will be sharing with my very first attempt on making a shirt and a trouser made from same fabric for a little boy, well in previous post,  I have shared the making of the trouser with an elastic waist band which was not actually my first time, but this is special to me as I successfully made the top and trouser from the same fabric and todayi bring to you the complete outfit the a step b ste process of making the shirt.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQCfmssCpgJmEZPEPz416NUZyKDgDoBLJcbYjQq5RDHD/1779244929278.jpg)

For awhile now, I have had it in mind to make a shirt for my husband but I was actually scared of ruining the fabric fortunately fo me, a friend of mine brthis particular fabric that should help her make outfit for her family including her little son and I decided to give it a try and luckily for me, the outcome was really nice.

Let me take you through the cutting and sewing process below 

For the making of the top, I folded my fabric in two with the chest measurement and seam to cut out the front part with extra 3\

longer than the front part and it was cut out 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd4AC2KvBAyk4vGVBSH3gaDRdhktnKB8KZXCzS7ZS3AyF/1779245925540.jpg)

The two fabrics were placed together and it was slanted at the top by 1.5\

before the shoulder, armhole and neckline were cut out 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaRMVPdgzn2nMNHNejP7qRDA3kcT8UTdS38afbzjhVpfY/1779246261728.jpg)

I have 2 pieces for the front, one for the button and the other for the button hole and 1 piece for the back 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVAphNSahkWGTsTQPAUBqsriUcNcuzZPRD2VZEwFbv6b7/1779246491974.jpg)

The front and back were sewn together with the extra inches for the button and button hole folded and sewn in


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaEe9zh2Gdpe6jq28H8y1nCM9n2VEHyupNTgWm27r8EwK/1779246624719.jpg)

I measured round the neckline and it was used to cut out 2 pieces of the collar and collar stand 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmakBxWuLzZHQ2pv9DGe73cWBV6GZ36RYTMM1nUwwWK5xL/1779246721163.jpg)

The collar was sewn to the neckline with a neat finishing as I went ahead to cut out the sleeves for both armhole 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXHJ2XUQVktqHjppLuh7QP5VgwUPVbjFKe9s56wczd45/1779246926610.jpg)

Finally, the sleeves were sewn together on the armhole circumference with the hem of the outfit folded in and with my hand needle and thread, I fixed button to the appropriate places with button holes 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2SuA75wkAVFYND96HcYmR2kuiKCpNxvHxJf1BFYPHCc/1779247196678.jpg)

This is the final and beautiful outcome of the shirt and trouser I made for my friend's little boy 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQCfmssCpgJmEZPEPz416NUZyKDgDoBLJcbYjQq5RDHD/1779247368598.jpg)

I hope you like the beautiful outcome, join me in my next post as I will be sharing with you other beautiful creativity from my sewing room.

# Thanks so much for your time, support, comment and encouragement. Until my next post, do have a great day.

body.title: “Turbulence” – a love triangle in a hot air balloon
body.body: Great Britain, 2025, action film, director: Claudio Fach, starring: Hera Hilmar, Jeremy Irwin, Kelsey Grammer. This movie, to me, is really about how even the best of us can do some pretty bad things. Sure, you could say they've been proven to be good people, but that doesn't mean we can't expect more from them in terms of doing the right thing. On the other hand, you could look at it from a totally different angle. Maybe this film is actually about taking justice into your own hands, without waiting for someone else to make things right. The beauty of it is that everyone who watches it will come away with their own interpretation - and that's what makes it so great. You can see it as a story about morality, or as a story about taking control of your own destiny. Either way, it's a powerful message that will leave you thinking long after the credits roll. So, a married couple is going through some difficult times. She recently lost her unborn child and is depressed because of this. And he seems to support her. And then one day he meets a woman who wants to embellish his forced sexual restraint. And then this threesome suddenly finds themselves in a hot air balloon. How will the relationship develop in this triangle? From the first frames it is clear that passions cannot be avoided and that all this will lead to tragedy, because a hot air balloon is not the safest mode of transport, especially for those who are figuring out a relationship. So who will survive? #cine #cinema #film #moovie

body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 38: Test Day
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 38: Test Day

-----

In the cult underground city, it appeared Orcilla had managed to create a serum very similar to 19CE. She was confident that it would significantly boost Angelo’s immune system with no serious side effects. Julio wanted it to be tested before it was to be administered to Angelo. Demadrian agreed that should be the case, but the testing needed to be limited because they only had one egg, and he needed more Sentray DNA for the serum he was working on.

One of Angelo’s guards had volunteered to test the serum. He was sitting on an examination table in Julio’s laboratory.

‘What’s your name, sir?’ Demadrian asked the guard.

The guard looked at Julio. Julio responded by nodding.

‘My name is Razor; I’m a senior guard for the High Philosopher and a lieutenant in the flying division,’ replied Razor.

‘Excellent,’ said Demadrian as he patted him on the back.

‘Razor, are you a willing volunteer for this procedure?’ asked Orcilla.

‘I would do anything for our High Philosopher,’ replied Razor.

‘Even if it involves turning into a hideous monster,’ chuckled Demadrian.

‘That’s not going to happen,’ said Orcilla in a slightly agitated tone. ‘You might feel ill for a while and possibly lose consciousness. After that, you’ll feel fine.’

‘I’m willing to accept whatever happens,’ replied Razor in a confident tone.

‘You might get a full head of hair,’ chuckled Demadrian.

‘How would injecting him with DNA from the hairless Sentray cause him to grow hair?’ asked Orcilla, shaking her head.

‘He’s bald; he must have something seriously wrong with him,’ replied Demadrian. ‘If your serum works, it’ll cure him.’

Razor rubbed his bald hair and frowned.

‘He’s fine,’ said Julio, shaking his head. ‘None of us have hair.’

‘Okay, let’s begin,’ said Orcilla.

Razor held out his arm. Orcilla jabbed him with a large syringe and then slowly pushed the serum into his body.

‘How are you feeling, Razor?’ asked Orcilla in a calm tone.

‘Hehe, I feel funny,’ chuckled Razor. Then his eyes turned in, and he fainted.

‘Argh, you killed him!’ shouted Demadrian.

‘Shut up!’ said Orcilla angrily. ‘This is expected.’

Julio checked Razor’s pulse.

‘He seems fine,’ replied Julio. 

‘How do you dispose of your dead down here?’ chuckled Demadrian.

‘Could you be any more disrespectful?’ asked Orcilla in an angry tone.

‘Only if you ask politely,’ said Demadrian, raising his eyebrows slightly. 

‘It’s okay,’ said Julio. ‘We love our jokes down here.’

‘I have noticed,’ replied Orcilla, smiling slightly. ‘Would it be okay to miss lunch today? I would like to monitor Razor in person.’

‘I’ll have some food brought down to you here,’ said Julio. 

‘Thank you,’ replied Orcilla.

‘I’d like to stay with her,’ said Demadrian. ‘I don’t trust her with my good friend Razor.’

‘No problem,’ replied Julio. ‘I’ll leave you both to it.’ He then left the laboratory to meet with Angelo.

Demadrian winked at Orcilla. She sighed and shook her head.

Julio entered Angelo’s temple room. Angelo was sitting at the table facing the glass divide. He looked concerned.

‘We’ve got some news from Volo and the flyers,’ said Angelo as he looked at Julio, who was walking towards him. ‘Demadrian was sort of right.’

‘Have they taken back the camp?’ asked Julio.

‘Yes, but a conflict was avoided,’ replied Angelo. ‘Our friend Octavius left without a fight.’

‘Considering the numbers they have, that was the only thing he could do,’ replied Julio. ‘I’m surprised they did not try to pursue him after he left.’

‘I have more news,’ said Angelo, shaking his head. ‘The resistance in the Downs Region has been defeated. They were found and executed.’

Angelo turned his computer around so that Julio could see the photograph of the dead.

‘That’s interesting,’ remarked Julio as he looked carefully at the bodies.

‘We’ll have to tell Orcilla,’ said Angelo.

‘She needs to see the photograph for herself,’ replied Julio.

‘The photograph was planted for us to find and for her to see,’ said Angelo. ‘They want an impulsive response.’

‘Despite how upsetting this photograph is,’ said Julio. ‘Orcilla will not insist we act impulsively.’

Meanwhile, at the laboratory, Demadrian continued to work on his serum, and Orcilla was still monitoring Razor, who remained unconscious.

‘With the quantities you’re using, you won’t have the luxury of being able to test it,’ said Orcilla as she looked over at Demadrian.

‘I won’t need to,’ replied Demadrian. ‘It’ll be perfect.’

‘With my approach, we can make dozens of vials of the serum,’ said Orcilla. ‘Surely that’ll be as effective as whatever you’re going to make, and it’ll be safer.’

‘No, it won’t,’ replied Demadrian. ‘I’m making something far more powerful. I won’t fail.’

‘I don’t doubt you will,’ said Orcilla as she scrunched her face slightly. ‘I’m more afraid that you won’t be able to control yourself after the transformation. You’ll be as much Sentray as you are Linap.’

‘I’ve told you before,’ said Demadrian in a frustrated tone. ‘I’m going all out to stop Tiberius. If it ends me too, so be it.’

‘Once you’ve taken it, there is no going back,’ said Orcilla.

Julio entered the laboratory carrying a tray with three pasties on it.

‘They look alright,’ said Orcilla as she looked at the tray.

‘This time you get leftover follower food,’ chuckled Julio.

‘I thought they only got baked potatoes,’ said Orcilla.

‘We have access to a greater variety of food and ingredients,’ responded Julio as he placed the tray down on a counter. ‘Just one of the advantages of access to the surface.’

‘I’m greatly impressed,’ remarked Demadrian. ‘You act quickly.’

‘I have some bad news,’ said Julio as he looked at Orcilla. ‘The enforcers have taken back the West Camp, and the resistance has been defeated.

Julio handed Orcilla a printout of the photograph. 

Orcilla stared at the photograph, a tear formed in one of her eyes, but she did not say anything. Demadrian walked over to her. He stood next to her and looked at the photograph.

‘We need to discuss our next steps,’ said Julio.

‘I told you he was unimaginably evil,’ said Demadrian as he rubbed Orcilla’s arm.

Orcilla rubbed her right index finger over Daily’s body.

‘I understand if you need some time to process this,’ said Julio.

‘Do you know how many enforcers they have at the camp?’ asked Demadrian.

‘Several hundred thousand,’ said Julio. ‘They’re heavily armed and well equipped.’

‘Do they know we’re observing them?’ asked Demadrian.

‘They would have discovered that Octavius hacked into the communications with the West Camp,’ replied Julio. ‘I think it’s unlikely they are aware of our flyers.’

‘We need to draw them out of the camp,’ said Demadrian. ‘Then we hit them hard. They won’t know what hit them.’

‘Until we hit them; then they will,’ said Orcilla forcefully. ‘They’ll just overwhelm us with firepower.'

‘What do you suggest we do then?’ chuckled Demadrian as he shook his head.

‘We move on the Downs Region,’ said Orcilla. 

‘Wait, I actually like that idea,’ said Demadrian. ‘They won’t see that coming.’

‘Then we should let them see it,’ said Orcilla as she handed the photograph back to Julio.

Demadrian frowned, then he smiled. 

‘I’m back,’ said Razor as he sat up suddenly.

Orcilla walked over to Razor and then punched him hard in the face. Razor fell off the examination table and landed on the floor.

‘I know you need to let out your anger, but why Razor?’ asked Demadrian as he slumped forward and held his arms out in front of him with his palms facing upwards.

‘Just a simple efficacy test,’ said Orcilla as she held her hand out to Razor to help him up. ‘How do you feel now?’

‘Betrayed and violated,’ said Razor angrily as he stood up.

‘I mean physically,’ said Orcilla as she looked at his bloody nose. ‘Are you in pain? 

‘After the initial impact, the pain just went away,’ said Razor as he wiped the blood from his face.

‘That’s great,’ said Demadrian as he rolled up his sleeves. ‘I’d love to conduct a few more tests just to be sure.’

‘Go ahead,’ said Julio. ‘We want to be sure before we inject the High Philosopher.’

Demadrian leapt on top of Razor and began frantically punching him in the head.

After three minutes, Demadrian had to stop hitting Razor. His fists were bruised and swollen. Julio handed him an ice pack to help with pain. 

Razor had climbed back onto the examination table. His face had stopped bleeding, and the swelling was beginning to subside. He was staring at Demadrian, and his nostrils were flaring in rage.

‘After my dosage, you can smash me as hard as you can,’ said Demadrian as he winked at Razor.

‘It’ll be my pleasure,’ said Razor as he clenched his fists.

‘Enough!’ said Julio angrily. ‘You do not speak to our guests in this manner.’

‘The serum can cause more aggressive emotions, but they will subside once he fully adjusts,’ said Orcilla as she patted Razor on the shoulder.

‘I want him observed for a few more days before we proceed to inject the High Philosopher,’ said Julio. He turned and left the laboratory.

‘I need some time to myself,’ said Orcilla as she walked towards the door. ‘Would you be okay keeping an eye on Razor for a bit?’

‘No problem,’ chuckled Demadrian. ’Razor and I are great friends.’

Razor raised his eyebrows up and down and beckoned Demadrian with both his hands.

‘Lovely,’ sighed Orcilla as she walked out of the room.

Julio had gone to visit Maskameera. She was sitting at the back of her cell eating a pasty.

‘This is actually pretty good,’ remarked Maskameera. ‘You’re getting better with your food.’

‘Everything you said has been accurate,’ said Julio as he peered through the cell door window. ‘A serum has been made from the egg and is currently being tested.’

‘Then you owe me my freedom,’ said Maskameera as she put the last piece of pasty into her mouth.

‘That was the deal,’ sighed Julio. ‘I’ll honour my word. You’ll be released to the surface once the High Philosopher has been given his dose of the serum.’

‘I could still be of help,’ said Maskameera as she stood up. ‘I know a lot about your enemy.’

‘Thanks, but no thanks,’ replied Julio. Then he walked away from her prison cell. 

Maskameera pressed her face against the extra-thick glass in the door window. She sneered as she watched Julio walk away.

body.title: [Movie] In A Galaxy Far, Far Away...
body.body:
Star Wars (A New Hope) is the film that started it all, an instant blockbuster that showed that films could garner fanbases as large as the biggest bands ever to perform.

There have been many reiterations of this film, with additional special effects. Personally, I like some of the additions, but I believe there should have been an official version of the film left entirely unaltered. 

Luckily, there is a fan-made (de-specialised edition) which is fantastic. If you have never seen that version, it is well worth watching. 

As far as I'm concerned, this film is the pinnacle of creativity. It was produced at a time when misfits received funding and were allowed to freely create and bring their wildest dreams to life.

The spaceships, set design, aliens, weapons and armour helped to create vast worlds, and through the lens we got to see a sliver of an alien universe, to then be left to imagine what else was out there.

Technology was created specifically for this film, which then went onto revolutionize modern cinema. Many of the things we take for granted in modern cinema today can be attributed to the great individuals who worked on this movie, who were all brought together by George Lucas to help him bring his vision to life.

I have been a fan of Star Wars for as long as I can remember, and the entire franchise has inspired my love of writing, model making, and essentially all of my creative endeavours.

_Rating: **91/100**_

---

body.title: Drive back to Sydney day. New pasta dish day : May 19 2026
body.body:
Never going to be an activity day but there will be steps. Loading the car for the drive back to Sydney. Unloading the car on the Sydney side. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4618ce4f-7354-426c-be17-5b31bdbde818.jpg) Did walk up to the shops to get a few key ingredients for a visit from my wife's grandson. Pink hibiscus on the way ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/af18819e-5f35-43f1-a298-124c3072d9b2.jpg) Not often seen flower just up from the hibiscus - iNat does not have an ID that relates to what I saw We had a visit from my wife's son - they stayed an hour. As Ouma was on the phone, the visit followed a different course. Sit on the floor says Ollie. We played cars a while. Banana lollies came out before Ouma came off the phone. TV did go on - 1962 episode of The Jetsons ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/07369a22-1137-4d4e-a387-9fe5489d2e13.jpg) © Hanna-Barbera Was a fun episode so far ahead of its time - robotaxis, robot maids, video calls, Google home - and more - worth watching. Ollie Was taken in. No photos as Oupa had to sit on the floor Dinner idea was a creamy bacon and mushroom pasta dish - no tomatos and no cream in the fridge. Did the Google search ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/34afee69-880c-4874-8767-2868bc9b908a.jpg) Crisp up some bacon - from a dry pan ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5f513217-3c87-46e4-99d9-b4a3d2658c38.jpg) Brown uo some mushroom slices - add a little butter - want them browned well Meanwhile cook the spaghetti - save a cup of the cooking water. The starch is the key to getting a creamy story. Set aside - saute chopped garlic and spring onion and one chilli - maybe 30 seconds. Toss in the preserved pasta sauce ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f75a500a-561c-41b5-9f43-f70f2106cd5d.jpg) Mix through. Toss in the cooked bacon and mushroom. Get it warm and then fold through the pasta Recipe note: recipe said to sprinkle chilli flakes at service time. One chilli cooked in with the garlic was too spicy for my wife - OK for me. It was spicy
