body.title: Lionel Richie christens Acrisure Amphitheater: Grand Rapids, MI
body.body:
[//]:# (!worldmappin 42.95965 lat -85.67670 long  d3scr)

<center>![PXL_20260516_023249798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vsBmhceQPr3gviFQQH4MD5nV4HGmRCZUm9REG3PsxHVvtG2R177rWrY93g5XebeAHJH.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

Grand Rapids Michigan is no stranger to entertainment.  They have a venue called the Van Andel Arena that I have been to several times for concerts over the years.  In fact, I still remember my first concert there.  It was Green Day and Blink 182 way back in the 2000's and it was absolutely amazing.  In addition to the Van Andel, they also have a great big conference center where special events are held pretty much every month of the year.

Now, for better or worse, there is a new venue in Grand Rapids if you want to catch a show.  Right along the Grand River is the brand new [Acrisure Amphitheater](https://www.acrisureamphitheater.com/).  When I saw the opening act for the venue was going to be Lionel Richie, I knew I had to get tickets.  We had the chance to see him several years ago when he had his residency in Vegas.  It was always a regret that we didn't buy the tickets, so finally getting the chance to see him was a no brainer.

<center>![PXL_20260515_200918818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23zGVjNJ3kdEzr5kDzugUSJ5zz7VxKRn7U2Q4u8ajjhwo8iguXirkkVEdVxhks9Uv8faX.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

We rolled into Grand Rapids around 4:30 PM, so we checked into our hotel and then went for a walk to get something for dinner.  We ended up at a place called [Gimmie's Par and Grill](https://www.gimmespar.com/).  It's a golf themed joint where they have a large bar area with every TV showing golf footage as well as a simulator on the upper level.


<center>![PXL_20260515_201210356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tbnfrrTwqxRbhXbD9E5YBjXrr7QCD9BMunkiXMocUXRZqkWZho9AJGbXzWH1zMahKjU.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260515_201634296.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vsLA1XqCHtdDAiRpj7wEwd5MsKKvgcJSinXpjMzfcBSJGJUTP1g8EFdpLyzK8TFJcpQ.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260515_201639277.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xARfQAabFi4oWqXy7BYAQW8izpJUKtRBvXcMG5M5BSM6ah5fW1jpMnRyAw6Xfi3i1fa.jpg)</center>

--------------------------

Neither myself or @mrsbozz are golfers really, but the place looked interesting, so we stopped in.  I got a Wild Turkey 101 on the rocks and my wife was annoyed to have to settle for a captain morgan and diet pepsi to drink.  There is a meme where someone asks for a diet soda, then when the server asks if Diet Pepsi is okay, the person says they will just have water.  Diet Coke is a must and everything else is just a poor substitute.


<center>![PXL_20260515_201850647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23uQroztC4NMw1yQYhRVXWwcp19PyznVJLw86URrDaFKL1ktQ4P4wUsrWcrYmYZCChjvi.jpg)</center>

<center>![PXL_20260515_203611786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23zknd43arYQXoK8Q1zYmAxZiZJE3exeWEwY9iVuyngDqDFvLYt2fxUMVdriDtsM7XwY4.jpg)</center>

<center>![PXL_20260515_203619041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xAVK24cQ7eiAaMxmZb9LGvJuND3xwLJeEMre9ZZZZWftJALuECwrDMoHgpTbV4TdhVY.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

We started off with some soft pretzel bites that came with a really good pimento dip, but sadly that is where things kind of fell apart.  @mrsbozz got the top pita sandwich that she said was just kind of meh.  She wasn't too sure about the prosciutto.  As for my chicken sandwich, the flavor was pretty meh.  The chicken was bland and the extra stuff they added on just couldn't make up for that.  

We quickly ate what we were comfortable eating and then we paid the bill and left.


<center>![PXL_20260515_213154653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wgDKLaXSeBbiN6vZkedpzuikCuHNkkDLUSPmrkqkkCyaefPavxR8RMpCGxw35j7eczc.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

It's too bad that Gimmie's was kind of a bust because there are so many good places to eat in Grand Rapids.  I really felt like I missed the mark on that one.  As we were heading back to our hotel, we decided to stop into [The B.O.B](https://www.thebob.com/).  The BOB has been around for a long time in Grand Rapids and though it shut down for a short time, it's back open now.  It's a three or four story bar with different sections on each level.  The most important thing is that they had Coca Cola products, so we sat at the bar and had a few (more) drinks before we headed back to our hotel.


<center>![PXL_20260515_232452437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EpnBHKBXkvBfFjo5Mmzq8ZQjK68xywHD6U45fVusaTkpQhfXCQqdwdVvZddFK76afrC.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260515_232515055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/244oV3BrCoAoF48FhJPFznRQBM5W4mxs1o9sng7z8Z8Qc5Q386ZxdpNz472cfurKkgXfM.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260515_233631757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/242Nf6Mu81RvAACGQS2gc4GEXi7ZvaC7EBiJrNZxvDaHfJVrLGhDFGDSsCGiAbW4ZmjnT.jpg)</center>

-------------------

The Acrisure Amphitheater hasn't been without its controversy, between noise ordinances, parking issues, and other random things, there are some people who aren't too happy to see this project come to fruition.  As an outsider though, I think it is an absolutely beautiful facility with only a few minor issues as far as I could see.  The biggest issue is the fact that they didn't have dedicated lanes through the lawn section for people to get from the top of the hill to the bottom.

This led to people fighting their way through the crowd and just kind of jamming through any way they could.  For example, see that girl in the first photo above in the red shirt (her back is to the camera)?  So @mrsbozz and I were standing at the back of the lawn.  At one point red shirts mom tried to walk right between my wife and I.  She said excuse me can I get through?  I said you are really going to walk right between my wife and I?  I mean common sense would have told you that you go to one side of a couple or the other.  However, we all know entitlement is rampant these days and for whatever reason the lady thought she deserved the right of way.  

Anyway, she eventually went around then goes back and complains to red shirt who promptly stands up and starts waving her arms at us and screaming.  Which cause @mrsbozz to mimic and mock her.  Things finally settled down, but honestly, if they just had clear aisles like most venues with lawns do, it wouldn't have been an issue.  


<center>![PXL_20260515_233635631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/242Xvr72gfuUmCUnw1kHSbKNfCKxEhNzRRuFYiAKZVpD5xYcm8kpMxGYu1bnLfM5K2h8v.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260516_001538271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wMY18TJjt4CStnLywGtNd5xLoH4q8JZ4RcQtJs2bRVsYY7DEexcFdY5kXK4yEuhXEG8.jpg)</center>

------------------------

All the people around us thought it was pretty comical red shirt reacted the way she did, and by the end of the night you could tell most everyone was getting tired of people trying to squeeze through them every five seconds.  Perhaps my wife and I just aren't nice people, but it's shocking how people are so entitled these days that other people's personal space is an afterthought to them.


<center>![PXL_20260515_234008845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tvc9Sj7htZvYkSyPmiyV2yKeYX5EBijm3BZnqV8p1ds1hg2qP7GHBJVjtRkMfjsedGM.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

The opening act was a local guy named Brian Vanderark who you 90's kids might recognize from the band The Verve Pipe.  He sang about five songs and then made way for the second opening act The War and Treaty.  They are so freaking good, if you haven't listened to them, I encourage you to check them out.  The do a little soul, a little country, a little blues, it's all over the place, but in such a good way.  They are so talented and were a perfect opening act for the show.


<center>![PXL_20260516_011034942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tkpM85Jouwjda2QfZqz6pfqj2fDmFH2CPUKJTrDkPnQmt2a5Es9Lva7xSBHuJcL1u4N.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260516_012229494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EoASy71eFpiaEqTQHVGC9tq4hnRAZfVosfqSucTZjDWnE6JYPcu4ejQ1AVbXPG5wTuv.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260516_013053545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EoGqBbLmB4GGhngqqnH68x5PF7ZF5yCi6Y8rmMR7ij8wQjpeUb3P7tNhT5EnSkZGaMM.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260516_013738969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23uQfjyVUbERGviBsowaDFYucFVUkyo4wHX6iM9ZFMpjVXgJbYYAPS6VRvCA1TpsVniMb.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

Finally, Lionel took the stage and all I can say is wow!  He started off with \

which was a little shaky and I was worried if his voice could hold up through the concert, but he quickly got into a groove and he sounded just about as good as you would expect for someone who is 76 years old or so.  We didn't eat or drink at the venue, but the vendor selection looked pretty high end which is about right for Grand Rapids.  Beers were something like $20 a can which seems a bit high, but as I said, they need to pay for the new venue somehow!

Lionel sang all his hits and it was really a fantastic show.  It's one of the few concerts that I found myself singing along to pretty much every song and actually dancing.  Acrisure has a full slate of artists lined up for the inaugural season of the amphitheater, so if you find yourself in the Grand Rapids area and it isn't sold out, try to get yourself to a show!

body.title: 124 Años de la República de Cuba: un legado de Libertad que no se puede borrar
body.body:
![](https://v3b.fal.media/files/b/0a9ae330/UMsYN-QaShTDA-OmA3Zf0_YjgTIxyE.jpg)

Este 20 de mayo de 2026 se conmemora el 124 aniversario de la proclamación de la República de Cuba. Aquel mediodía de 1902, en una solemne ceremonia en el Castillo del Morro, la bandera de la estrella solitaria ondeó por primera vez sobre un suelo cubano libre de la soberanía española. Era la culminación de tres décadas de lucha independentista y el nacimiento de una república, un hito que merece ser celebrado por todo aquel que ama la libertad, más allá de las limitaciones con las que aquella primera república inició su andar.

Es innegable que el advenimiento de la República de Cuba vino lastrado por la imposición de la Enmienda Platt, un apéndice que cercenó momentáneamente la plena soberanía. Esta realidad ha sido utilizada por la historiografía oficial del régimen dictatoral actual a tildar despectivamente aquella fecha como una mera “fiesta de los anexionistas”. Pero reducir el 20 de mayo a un simple acto de frustración es un error histórico. El izado de la bandera en 1902 representó la victoria de un pueblo que no se rindió ante el colonialismo y que supo alcanzar una meta fundamental en su camino hacia la emancipación: la independencia formal de España y la construcción de su propio Estado nacional, por imperfecto que fuera en sus comienzos.

Por eso, en el entorno actual, marcado por un régimen totalitario que busca deslegitimar y borrar esta fecha del calendario patrio, reivindicar el 20 de mayo es un acto de resistencia cívica. Durante décadas, la dictadura ha intentado suprimir cualquier celebración, negando un feriado que antaño era de júbilo popular. Quienes hoy insisten en menospreciar este día ignoran que la verdadera independencia no es un regalo concedido, sino un proceso continuo que empezó mucho antes de 1959 y que aquel 20 de mayo marcó un hito irreversible. Celebrarlo es honrar a los mambises que lucharon, **es reconocer que la patria es más grande que sus gobernantes de turno** y es mantener viva la memoria de que, incluso bajo una república imperfecta, los cubanos vislumbraron y construyeron una nación.

Frente al intento de imponer un relato único que solo legitima al régimen, recordar y conmemorar este 124 aniversario es reafirmar el anhelo de una Cuba libre, soberana y democrática. La República nació el 20 de mayo, y celebrarlo hoy es un compromiso inclaudicable con el pasado de lucha y el futuro de libertad.

***

body.title: How much money do you have - Privacy or transparency? [EN/PT]
body.body:
>

There is a thin line between transparency and invasion of privacy, so to speak. Transparency itself is a great measure to prevent any wrongdoing or even serve as a warning sign that something suspicious may be happening. We can take our own Hive as an example, which uses blockchain technology, where every transaction and even interactions or any other actions remain permanently recorded. With a bit of attention and investigation, it is easy to identify users who are somehow “farming” Hive improperly or outside the common sense of our community. But, in a way, aren’t we also somewhat exposed regarding the amount we hold in our wallets?

This is an example, our own Hive, if things worked the same way in real life. It is a very efficient transparency mechanism, but it exposes everyone’s financial situation. Of course, here we can hide behind pseudonyms, we do not need, and should not, provide personal information, so even while exposed, we are somewhat safe. Still, some information should be carefully protected. You never know where malicious people are, and well, the internet is full of them, along with countless tools that make this kind of tracking easier. Even so, here we choose to participate. We can decide whether we want everything in one place, we can choose to expose only part of it or not, and here, we still have choices. In real life, well, we know how that can be...

But well, the real question is that if this same mechanism were used by the State as a way to make everything more transparent and improve the efficiency of detecting infractions and crimes, things could become very different. Of course, corruption, crimes, money laundering, underground markets, and many crimes directly and indirectly related to money could be easily detected. Transparency would be there for anyone who wanted to verify it. A certain sense of order could emerge from this, but let’s be honest, should this kind of power really be given to the State?

I think this should be the very last thing we should allow, do you know why? Because people who commit crimes, one way or another, will always find ways to erase their tracks. Countless possibilities would appear for criminals to hide what they do, but the people who would truly end up in the hands of the government would be the population. Besides that, it would be very dangerous for anyone to have access to what you own. Even living with other people would become a little strange. Imagine having a good amount of money saved and that relative who always shows up asking for borrowed money knowing exactly how much you have in your wallet. So, it would be inconvenient in every possible way, even in small examples like this.

Privacy is not just a right, it is a necessity. Transparency should exist, but only for those who must be held accountable, such as governments and politicians. The attention should mainly be directed there. But anyway, I believe there are limits, and once those limits are crossed, rights become corrupted, and measures like these would create far more problems than solutions. In the end, the ones who suffer and face the worst consequences will always be ordinary people. Privacy is a right that should never be corrupted, because in the end we would only be giving the government even more power and control over us. The balance simply does not work.

Holy is a week observed by many believers as the week which everyone is expected to remain holy and avoid sin. The Bible clearly teaches about the events that happened during the final week of Jesus’ earthly ministry, including His entry into Jerusalem, His crucifixion, and His resurrection. However, the Bible does not specifically command Christians to celebrate a yearly tradition called “Holy Week.” Instead, believers are encouraged to continually remember Christ with sincere worship and obedience.

Many Christians see Holy Week as a helpful period for prayer, repentance, and meditation on the sacrifice of Jesus. When practiced with true faith and respect for God, it can strengthen spiritual life and remind people of Christ’s love for humanity. At the same time, the Bible warns against following religious traditions without understanding or genuine devotion to God.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQiQrvayQZdjYbZ2Ns1zS8X1dxBUDr5JsfR6Z6hm9Ab5J/snapshot_53.png)

There is no sign of rain here. It used to rain occasionally in Tsushima, but in Izuhara, the whole place suddenly becomes covered in smoke and fog. It is not clear where this smoke comes from. As evening falls, the whole place turns into a ghostly atmosphere. Even though I was a little scared, I enjoyed this mysterious beauty. I took many pictures while riding around, because the place seemed very unique and mysterious to me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWG2MeQtSwE8wiNbhTmEs6JBjuigv7jwSPDU5J9HJbs15/snapshot_54.png)

Then I thought it would be a good idea to start a main mission. The mission was called \

The main purpose of this mission was to gather help. If we want to save the entire Tsushima from the Mongols, we need more soldiers. For this, the plan was to get help from the Fighting Monk Shogun. But to contact him, we need to send a message to the mainland.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjTWH4UAyWmkdS9yQRqjUaWEweGybwL7EjiVd8kE8rNL/snapshot_55.png)

The problem is, the Mongols have blocked the entire sea route. So it's impossible to send any ships in general. Then Lord Shimura tells of a skilled smuggler named Goro. He can secretly cross the sea without the Mongols seeing him. So now my job is to find Goro.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpvk2rL8uBxpJocFke4pSq25BvUdN9yQNYEQL8HiyDhS/snapshot_57.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfGvz1LD2qMk7vaGU2xM5WBu8Ubx14E2J8SVBCuDs1gJt/snapshot_58.png)

Goro can be found in a place called Umugi Cove. I started heading south to get there. But the problem was, the map didn't show the exact location of Umugi Cove. So I had to search across a large area. As I wandered around for a long time, I saw many more beautiful and mysterious scenes of Izuhara. I stopped occasionally to take pictures.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRsR8uzgn67mQKj1EN7r2LEU7sbT4ziemQxycX5TcCC2U/snapshot_59.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwEjP7MNeS84GxdyjrTb6SkzEfM5dXMv7rnMfbUgAdPP/snapshot_60.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsgQh5F8UjEaBmMeBHgkbhzLwvtYfxU3W2s6XgbPrcLG/snapshot_62.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ3pQFfmGHD7nDN9zjVsDQwPdQz724vZHQq61XYai79JJ/snapshot_63.png)

After much searching, I finally found a narrow road hidden in the middle of the mountains. As I walked along that road, I saw a huge open space in front of me. Surrounded by mountains on all sides, this place is not at all recognizable from the outside. When I entered, I saw small houses made of wood and bamboo, a beautiful bridge, and a calm lake next to it. The place was truly extraordinary.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWND8ETBXj45fqJq5dWtyGt1ufMitPR6VbncarTM1mxN/snapshot_65.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRY5Jr5P6GMiiXj7L46Arf5X3Q6CVVQYX9nfHxEBbmBbv/snapshot_64.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuV8rm5e1hBa3D9GA7bGFEkXYaSiv8h4t4ZeQTzpUwoB/snapshot_66.png)

As soon as I entered, a straw hat ronin came to talk to me. At first he thought I was a ronin, but then he realized I was a samurai. He told me that if you want to meet anyone here, you have to get permission from Lady Sanjo first. Then I went with him to Lady Sanjo. She recognized me and spoke to me respectfully. Later, he also told me where Goro was.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmShGjqCNVfFbXKn14vh4fxu9szrujFPyfdBrka11ZJsGP/snapshot_67.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVnjdGjWmWx8jD7hsvAqMBboQEMvDS6kGU92CwYCAUVhV/snapshot_68.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKC4Fuf39fshPDr91s4DmL5hCxYdCmJAfvKQa8GzGxsN/snapshot_69.png)

The residence inside the cove was amazing. They have built their house using wood and bamboo. The long bamboo bridge connected from one end to the other.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNP8DTzUHDnMpkBHQS3HNNm5ych153FfGDwZTZdw1bxk/snapshot_70.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeni1PkYTBhMDPZbTc8WtSexLhhGKdae8ZCHTPzSeZXx/snapshot_71.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcoDhd1otA9hLcjC4doeHNY1VX7wJZwoNn1GiSkerUBpM/snapshot_72.png)

Finally, I met Goro. At first, he didn't want to believe that Lord Shimura and I were still alive. After hearing everything, he agreed to help, even though it would risk his life. Then he gave me a map and told me where to meet him in the next step. Thus ended the first part of the mission \

.

body.title: Lunaki Howler Remains My Favorite Magic Monster - Magic Attackers Dominated My 58 Mana Battle
body.body:
![CHAOS.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uFRhTBCBoCBjB4KEtDqhmzHRvwVjHf8V6C1ggwysU3Gt4ar43JTvs2AJ99i83rLFds2.png)


In the 58 mana battle rules an amazing and tough battle was seen where, because of the best strategy and monster positioning I achieved a great victory. I will dedicate my this victory to all those monster cards who holds magic attack powers.

The opponent also selected very good monsters and his positiong was also good. so it was expected that this battle would remain interesting until the end... 

It was difficult to tell which side was stronger and who was going to win. The battle kept changing sides but because my positioning was better, the match slowly started moving in my favor.

Two important modifiers were included in this battle. The first rule was that all units would lose their abilities that means no special ability of any monster would work. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 110649.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tRrXbYTUm6fKmyJbwqsUm6rcdi5wyGYY6i31sEQBqo6ZEpyFbR19KEvx95ZntetNQBA.png)

The second rule was Explosive Weaponry in which all units deal 50 percent extra damage to their target. Keeping these rules in mind I planned my whole strategy. Also you need to check the modifier rules before starting the battle which will help you in selection of monsters accordingly.

Since abilities were not going to work I focused on high health and high armor tank monsters so they could survive longer on the front line. Along with this I preferred magic attacker monsters because in such rules magic attacks hit directly on health and there is no special protection to save the opposing unit.

I selected six monsters while the opponent also brought six units into the field. My main effort was to keep strong tank monsters on the front line that could also do melee attacks while magic and ranged attackers were placed in the back line. 
![Screenshot 2026-05-20 110614.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tmMvN3tmHz4QrfGpEXi2FuoLmGjHcHQmLyaH9qUuPRv2jkuiUGRfUvJK7xPtkPDsbY9.png)

The speed of the battle remained quite slow because neither abilities were working nor any speed boost was available but my magic attackers showed an excellent performance.

In today’s battle my favorite and best monster was Lunaki Howler which is an excellent magic attacker. Whenever you get a rule where abilities do not work you should focus more on magic attack monsters because they damage health directly. That is why Lunaki Howler played an important role in this battle.

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 110754.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vrrb9cPYVydH9a1J13s93k2jLQZXseLvwp9QR9RqCtWVVjLskXLFVLvc7h8hVuULEdH.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 110733.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23zGYWpGy7xSJgZywdZcmrGVu9oFQD51rSwHQQQ9vmcKHJF6Fwod766YaZFP2k6fb1t2k.png)
If we talk about this monster’s stats its mana cost is 7 which makes it a great choice for high mana battles. It has four health which is considered quite good for a backline monster. 

Similarly its speed is +2 which is very important for a magic attacker so it can attack quickly and also increase the chances of enemy attacks missing. Its magic power is one that means it continuously dealt damage to enemy units every round.

Lets talk about the market price of this monster, at the beginner level this card is available at a very cheap and reasonable price. 

This card can easily be bought for only $0.011 and you can add it to your deck and use it especially well in such rule modifiers. In my opinion it is a very good and budget friendly magic attacker monster.
![Screenshot 2026-05-20 110526.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/EoEiisD53CmPyf3LQSZ43WXZS9LKewkpGD2eB56xaX78gFEDu7gmi269WqFAqzkNLVQ.png)

What do you people think about this monster? Do you have it in your decks? We will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Розпочала підв'язування помідорів
body.body:
![IMG_20260520_122007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/2423uvWRRupYZqahCxGFooB73tWNSMAG3Pv6m7oUmBc53z1GM4wBaEirDThv6F688uJft.jpg)


Привіт, друзі! Розпочала сьогодні підв’язувати помідори в теплиці. Чоловік мене питає:
— А чого так рано? Вони ж іще малі, можуть самостійно рости, стебла міцні.

А я йому відповідаю, що потім буде незручно. Треба зараз, поки помідори ще невеликі, понатягувати шпагат догори, щоб потім не ламати гілок і не мучитися. А далі вже буду тільки легенько підмотувати стебла до готових ниток.

А щодо шпагату, просила чоловіка купити мені спеціальний шпагат для підв’язування помідорів, коли він буде в Епіцентрі. А він каже:
— Я ж скоро мінятиму картридж у водяному фільтрі, там якраз є така нитка.

І справді — картридж у фільтрі зроблений із намотаної нитки, тож після заміни я використовую її для помідорів. Насправді дуже навіть непоганий варіант. Можливо, не такий міцний, як спеціальний шпагат, але на один сезон точно вистачить.

Поки що я лише почала, ще не закінчила. Зараз зробила невеличку обідню перерву, написала допис — і знову йду в теплицю підв’язувати решту помідорів.

Доводиться працювати з перервами, бо день сьогодні доволі сонячний, і хоча час від часу насуваються хмари,  в теплиці спека суттєва, навіть попри провітрювання. Думаю, вже найближчими днями будемо натягувати затіняючу сітку. Самій мені буде важко, тож доведеться просити чоловіка допомогти.

Сонячні дні — це, звісно, добре, але температура в теплиці тоді стає просто екстремальною.

![IMG_20260520_121900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/245mxo4nUxaunxcZwP5f3ZAHGzj4eHrsuxyj572LGZpsKYG8oYgbDbDjYEzFhNVkTVWpR.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_121939_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/245caaLy9PJQeqXo7iQVEHLcFv1FFTTvboGCmUrFSmGyivadHit5gCQpzYcXxcVXii6wE.jpg)

body.title: BEACH TOURISM // A family vacation full of exciting stories at Ujung Blang Beach, Bireuen.
body.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS3cjjGMmc6B5TfSE8WjvabWa15CbwZ7KzufonHW8ZkDk/1779271115050.jpg)

In this post, I'll share an exciting experience and a special moment I spent with my family during our vacation at Ujung Blang Beach in Bireuen,it was a trip we had been planning for a long time, and we were finally able to make it happen recently.
Actually, the Ujong Blang Beach tourist destination is not too far from my house in Bireuen, but what often prevents us from enjoying this moment is everyone's work schedule.

Yesterday was the perfect time for us to go on this trip. Of course, this was a very special moment, so before starting the journey, we prepared a lot of equipment and supplies such as cooking some culinary dishes from home that we will bring to the beach. We finally started the trip at exactly 1:00 pm.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSp3FDmvzxchxLDXKpSVmcd1XQfZ4NYaczPKx1gYoiRms/1779271115111.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf22MrYb9ggdHLL79v94j7GzmmHGwhhPbFa9Z1mJRYm8P/1779271115216.jpg)

This tourist spot is located in Ujong Blang village, Kuala District, and this is one of the villages in Bireuen city that offers many beach tourism destinations, everyone is free to choose according to their own taste, and each place has its own uniqueness and characteristics.
The tourist destination we chose at that time was called \

, the reason is that this place has a large enough size so that it can accommodate many visitors, and this is one of the tourist destinations that is very often visited by tourists who come with their families, this place is friendly and there are lots of additional ornaments and ornamental plants that are refreshing to the eyes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT97b1LXH5wUnfsfLLwHzEUoGtR1T8RJjx1mYgtNzNEgi/1779271115349.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuWw3wfuqXMfc9rewL984H6Ca4E9DHH6dC9KDeANvdPc/1779271115450.jpg) The parking area is also quite spacious, accommodating many vehicles, both cars and motorcycles. After parking my motorcycle in the designated area, we immediately headed to the main area to find a suitable cottage. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZQVXkUNv7DCUNLZwU6AgL4BcnbCUrbwTNPSBn3MUqcZ9/1779273822052.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdmgixB7GXLm5EkULbFCj8bPyFabjsFH9fYMpDLKJFPVC/1779273822157.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUdpiG6e1yPPWuHQRkoBpH51W4fbcFEiMNHELsunq2H1B/1779273822250.jpg) From the main area alone, I was greeted by several beautiful ornaments and ornamental plants, of course this is one of the reasons why I chose this place, and this place is also still filled with lush trees so it can provide a calming natural impression. As usual, the cottage I chose was the one at the very end or the one closest to the beach, the reason being that I wanted to enjoy a clearer and wider view of the beach and feel the fresh sea breeze directly. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexF4p2ymmuCSwZukjNfkmVzf1GqyPazkYGKUmbJ815zS/1779274144778.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ7gCWq9zCZFjNH36VG6ftCfJ2cQcBqdteYwYm59xPVC8/1779274144881.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2crdECwizwKjKnE5JypFeNTQxACXUzU8r9ZFPs65h7u/1779274144966.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUYr4WjdJpWAu6bPQhP2A5rMEbsX3pQSkMxbTDH6N7F2/1779274145048.jpg) It was a joy beyond words. I experienced so many exciting moments here, especially the warm time I shared with my family. The beautiful beach view stretched clearly before my eyes, but unfortunately, the seawater was a little murky and the waves were quite strong, making it unsuitable for swimming. As we can see, at that time, the number of visitors who came to this place was not too crowded, but this is normal because I visited this place at 1:00 pm, many beach tourist destinations in Aceh only become busy in the afternoon starting at 4 pm. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTypW275uGLKhq8E5eGDncaMttWHty52fLuWj88CWRx6z/1779275045660.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNRzpqndRjXN6DCMXR47TuNbu6PpNMB8RKSzZpoUKbSfv/1779275045751.jpg) It could be said that this is a family vacation, and there's one unique tradition that's never missed during a holiday like this: preparing a traditional Acehnese dish called Kuah Pliek—a traditional Acehnese curry similar to lodeh vegetables but rich in spices. Eating together with family is incredibly enjoyable and satisfying, especially with the beautiful natural scenery. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCgEzsrMMSktrmdtfZu1AA5jCTpyn6PeApVB4GzJjgiN/1779275628309.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2QFngmekfewP4Ax6t9hh9wPFyPLcAkFZnBzT6dooAkB/1779275628377.jpg) After eating together, we immediately got busy with our own activities,I decided to get up, walk around, and look for moments to capture. Meanwhile, my aunts were busy looking after their children playing on the beach,and it was a very sweet ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVANZ48aeoEEj8yzcFD2C7tjsKZ8bNoPyNJbKSEjF7xgc/1779275628449.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoNiaseABcwn8HDtMdabmf7sxgFT7oNmL8tb9J9w25bq/1779275628520.jpg) The weather at that time was also very good, not too bright and not too cloudy, some of my nephews also asked and invited me to play with them, there was no other choice but to comply Lol ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZeMCJEoRzxuBRYCchFWWg8woevBoDKecAjxxa3G9UxY5/1779275628598.jpg) However, for some reason, the sea water was very murky and the waves were quite big, so it was not recommended to swim there. In fact, I strictly forbade my nephews from swimming, even at the edge. ----

So, while she can work and study, of course, she can go to his concerts or events and at least be somewhat close to him that way. --- ![MV5BZGEyZDBlNDEtZmI4Mi00MGM1LWJkOWItNDVmODAwZjJjMjI2XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xVbuazoscJUxRsyKYvLJqzAx9Jis6cQgdeAh6wsmiSABf87ukm4bsCz5HJF4Jq7ymvg.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt37532722/mediaviewer/rm2381634050/) ---

He suffers from severe depression and believes himself to be inferior to everyone else. It's as if the Tamon they know is just a facade, an act he puts on to hide who he really is. body.title: Why Chester Homes Are Attracting More Young Families
body.body:
[Estate agents Chester](https://amovehomesproperty.co.uk/estate-agents-in-chester/) specialists are witnessing a clear and lasting trend in 2026  the rising numbers of young families selecting Chester as the place to settle down. The reasons for this choice go far beyond the well-documented historic charm of the city. Chester is ticking an exceptionally wide array of boxes for purchasers aged 30-44 with children, from school performance data and green space accessibility to competitive housing price compared to adjacent cities. Any relocation or investment in this market will require an understanding of what is bringing this population to the city and what aspects are most important.



![ChatGPT Image May 20, 2026, 04_26_13 PM.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/07a0e9bae9872341cd4dd4579bed86aa372b810ec9565374bda124090fd7b2aa)


Chester’s Buyer Profile The Demographic Shift Reshaping Demand
Office for National Statistics and local planning authority data reveals that net inward migration of households with dependent children to Chester and the wider Cheshire West area has increased by 12% between 2023 and 2025. The main places people are moving to are Greater Manchester, Merseyside and London  cities where the price of housing, lack of space and density of people in cities are making families rethink their alternatives.

UK Finance regional data for Q4 2025 shows that the 30 to 44 age group currently accounts for almost 41% of all mortgage approvals in the Chester CH1 to CH4 postcode cluster. This is up five percentage points on the corresponding amount in 2021 and suggests a substantial generational shift in who’s buying in the city rather than a short-term blip.


**School Quality: The Big Reason to Move**
Education quality is always top consideration for migrating families and Chester’s offering in this area is objectively outstanding. Data from Ofsted published in 2025 shows that 78% of primary schools within the local authority area of Cheshire West and Chester are rated either Good or Outstanding. Many schools including those in the CH2 and CH3 postcodes are rated Outstanding at secondary level and are hugely over subscribed, good news for the strength of parental demand.


The presence of the University of Chester also enhances the city’s educational ecosystem more generally. Although not the primary reason for couples with small children to relocate to Chester, the university offers a cultural and economic infrastructure  libraries, artistic venues, opportunities for part-time jobs for spouses  that increases Chester’s attractiveness as a long-term foundation for family life.


There is a quantifiable premium for properties within the catchment regions of schools with consistently good performance. Local valuation data for 2026 indicates that homes in the catchments of the most popular primary schools in Upton, Christleton and Waverton are priced between 8% and 14% above the Chester-wide average. Even when broader market conditions soften, demand from families supports this differential.


Quality of life, safety and green space For families migrating out of congested metropolitan centres, Chester’s ratio of accessible open space to residents is a big lure. The city combines the best of both worlds, with open countryside on its boundaries just minutes from the centre, and the River Dee corridor, comprising the Meadows, Grosvenor Park and the larger riverfront walking network, providing a recreational amenity that few other cities in England of a similar size can match.


Cheshire Constabulary’s 2025 annual report crime figures show Neighbourhood crime levels in Chester are substantially below the national average for towns and cities of a similar size. For parents for whom the safety of the city is partly a factor in their location decisions, this data gives an objective foundation for what many see as a subjective “feel” of the city.


Air quality monitoring data from the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs shows Chester is well under acceptable criteria for all significant pollutants and has no Air Quality Management Areas declared in its main residential areas. Increasingly health-conscious young families are considering environmental circumstances when they are deciding to move.


**Cost Competitiveness vis-à-vis Other Cities**
One of the most compelling structural reasons for Chester’s strength is its pricing position vis-à-vis the major cities it competes with for talent. The average house price in Chester in early 2026 is around £285,000 compared to around £320,000 in Liverpool, £380,000 in Manchester and over £520,000 in Leeds for similar family sized homes. Chester opens up semi-detached and detached property for dual-income households earning combined salaries in the £70,000 to £100,000 range that would be well out of reach in the larger cities.

<div class=text-justify>

**Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!**

Today is another day for me to share another blog post here in the community with my ***\

*** post in which I do really enjoyed and loved to do. I am happy to share some of my life activities after all circumstances that happened to me. I am happy to be back and I hope that everyone will be blessed and loved also what I am sharing. In the past days, I have shared the happenings during the Summer Class of my Nephew held here at the School. I am the one who looked at my Nephew and helped him too. Today will be another happening of my life that I'll be sharing since the Summer Class has ended as the Teacher have a Seminar to attend for few days but she give my Nephew something to study at home. My greetings and I will always give thanks first before I continue to all my supporters here in the community. Thank you to the Admins and all Curators. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS1SF1ZVKxv26ekMJc14p9N5Kqs3i31nXV1gDLi3yCaQQ/1779270640419.png) Since today my Nephew doesn't havea class as the Summer Class has finally ended, my Mother told me that we need to go to the Market to buy some goods and many more. When I heard about this, I immediately agreed as needed to pay the Electricity Billing in our Church knowing that I have the payment for the Billing. We then prepared immediately as we need to go early so we can go back home early too. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQz23W18yzbbdSJstAZt6DqaA2Pv3qDzT3GZ24MGQ3HWw/1779272488623.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZdq9SezrJr9Vx5dsEqpu1wdYX4YtGy5h5Cfrbhw5uKwg/1779272488790.jpg) That was around 9:00 in the morning when we finished all the things we needed to finished before we go to the Market. My Nephew is also very happy and excited as this is what he loved to do too. When we arrived at the Electricity Station where we can pay the balance of the billing, It is good as only few were their paying for their balance too. I then fall in line as it is a first come first serve basis. It took me only around 15 minutes before my turn to pay the balance. My Mother now then told me to pay the electricity bill in our house so, we can pay it now. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBV9av4qkxVQgWE7E2hnonjx7JnRcUgasydu4WvQKg9s/1779272866775.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoub4AJZhNLmubdtbMdH6KTHz4SAZwDWAubfshCFhPbb/1779272866917.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbg2ULeJr7JULfcRxWwj6x6p6GpGFj5Wgvq9puMmwCESF/1779272867079.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUxrbRXvBX1qY61x2ZPeNrNQAQts4u5AFGaCpuLpzSD8G/1779272867185.jpg) After I finished paying the Electricity Bill, we then immediately went to the Market and go to the Grocery Store where we can buy some goods and other important stuff we needed to buy. When we go inside, my Nephew told me that he will be going to carry the basket where all vegetables and other goods which my Mother bought to be placed after. He is very happy carrying the basket while he keeps on following his grandma who is very busy choosing of what to buy. While he is busy following his grandma, I am also busy taking pictures of him. My Nephew is indeed very cute and so adorable. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbGc7WoSeXoS8yzyNv9QqKyt6ehx99qSPocS3DEod6mHD/1779274893608.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfX3YB3BvhdMUFgo4STn4UCDG5gHY9BA65A7bUZrnvviN/1779274893723.jpg) That was around 11:00 in the morning when we finished buying all goods and stuffs we needed in our house and now, it is time for us to go home as it is about to lunch time. By the afternoon at around 5:00, I then take good care of my Hen with her Chicks. They were very hungry at the moment that is why, I give them immediately their foods and water. After a while, they have then immediately went to sleep as it is about to dark which means it is already evening. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfrDrYF79spD4JKFhTZZFxDGEN7AXftqoUutftWMfru9/1779274777608.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNodPk8rBQJpgokkU5VGNQkyZB61WmJ8F2oQq6SA86ZYE/1779274777748.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJpGH6K4VJgB3YfvyhjAFoLq6tpaSTLmH1xT9avHJt4o/1779274777819.jpg) By that time also, my Mother already started cooking our dinner in which I have then helped her so we can take our dinner early. What she is now cooking is what do I really love to eat, and it is a Beef Soup with vegetables. This are some of what we bought in the Market this morning, and now it is time to cooked for our dinner. The Beef was already cooked early in the afternoon by my Mother so it can be soft when we eat it. She took around and hour cooking it to make it soft immediately. Now, since the Beef is already soft it is easy to finished it cooking. We then added some vegetables so it can make more delicious when we eat it. After then, we finished cooking it is now time for our dinner. The whole day today for me is not that too busy for me as I don't have any activity to do with but thank God for I am happy and blessed from all the activities I've did today while here at home. From paying the Electricity Bill, Market day and even my cooking moments. Thank you God for a wonderful day. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: Nature fooled me.
body.body:
I said in a previous post that thankfully we had no uprooted trees in our area.
![041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242Nf6Gyuv5DgFXhZpReUtgDLCjT9H35xYb7WjssYYSCRphAmKrMpzagp9Tq8NvaRD8Lp.jpg)

In fact, we did and I just didn't know about it, as two trees in a park surrendered to the gale force winds.

Not only that, as a school was also hit with severe damages. The story goes that the principal was worried about the safety of the children in the classrooms, and so he gave the order for all of the children to be ushered into the school's hall. We were told that a few minutes later all hell broke loose, as the school's windows were blown out, and the classrooms lost their roofs. Metal carports in the school's parking area were blown apart, and the roof sheets were folded up like pieces of paper. Thankfully no children were hurt.
Come and look at those trees. 

We saw this mountain from a road in the town, but I couldn't get a clear shot of it because of the buildings in the way. I know this spot on the outskirts of the town and that was why we came to this area, so that I can get fairly clear shots of the clouds and the mountain. 
![030.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqWkiVTQQuuvXNN8EE8Ctq8RyFeRhYxYGDdbvJ4VmCUprT8QuhHNu3GLnyXgPhaZP6Q.JPG)

But then a short distance away this photo below drew my attention. 
![027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqfEScLYQ9QkQoYZp3rFkiWnsVLuDfFpFTY32tQvg3fhw67qMZGBqjLWFtr6wwP1rvp.JPG)

I could hear nature laughing at me, as this very much looked like two uprooted Stone Pine trees.
![025.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep3eGmq926TyjFwmgcRML39Ukb3aydhkJ2hvRi1rS68QC2pUKL3ina9vAYyRwmA5jzr.JPG)

Very big trees but they were no match for the force of the storm winds.
![036.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqhQG2h4jfz89JJfc6Rkqtv52W4h4MM8GUK5oD9d9j4JZDsYkDtFUkXSitmSRuKAZBR.JPG)

The one tree even smashed a part of the playground equipment. It is a public park, where the residents take relaxing walks, some even with their dogs, and playground equipment were installed below the trees. 
![038.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqFs2GHTfSsj5YD9KGe81t6XW43b3o5VSpK4Pxg7UGzVHUzixGNwKQjGMg981wcvrCT.JPG)

Here is a closer look at the blue and yellow metal frame that was once a swing or something like that. 
![035.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eo6JwEbsudymdD6VVQp1ZFW8jgsVHmvJDf4N7s4nAbnZ9X9c4UFJXrN3BXs9u2k6Btj.JPG)

A look at the rear of the trees. 
![039.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EprRb5JBcmGr9Gw9THve3NQD8rdHoaCm4BfxsFQjZVT12g1sNa5qPsCEaL7cJvFTee1.JPG)

The storm was done, but the wind was still very choppy as you can see in the clouds. 
![021.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep1XSmB2awjaNDMF3yiLG681CA2XiJKv4HiLf8RFaNZShkig2XLa7hX76ynRSBJ92rd.JPG)

Further to the story of the damages at the school, some trees also fell on to the prefab classrooms where some of the children were in before the principal summoned them to the gathering in the school hall. The prefab classrooms were totally destroyed, so the principal's timing was excellent, as one could only imagine what would have happened if there were children in those classrooms. We think that the principal deserves a hero status. The media here is filled with reports about the storm damages, and it is going to cost millions to repair. 

Emergency teams are active all over the province as overflowed dam walls broke and sent tons of water into the rivers below the dams, that causes the rivers to go into flood, and it is a chain reaction because everything that is close to the widening of the river's path is washed away. The water is so strong that it can even lift farm tractors. Warnings are out not to cross low level bridges in the flooding rivers, but sadly it has already cost some lives and cars that are simply swept off the bridges by the force of the water. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

body.title: Del Horno al Código: Cómo estoy aprendiendo HTML desde mi móvil para salvar mi Panadería en Caracas 🇻🇪
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEc7c4H4v5YnQFE4fetASGeSZPqWhjzYeybDRKXucQSJ/1779275303061.jpg)
¡Hola, comunidad de Hive! Soy Darwin José Zamora, panadero de oficio en Caracas y, desde hace unos días, un apasionado aprendiz de código. Hoy no vengo a venderles nada, vengo a contarles cómo la necesidad me sacó de mi zona de confort (la harina y el horno) y me puso frente a una pantalla de móvil a escribir etiquetas HTML.

Ser emprendedor en Venezuela no es fácil. Entre la inflación y la falta de herramientas accesibles, gestionar mi pequeña panadería, \

, se volvió un reto. Me sentía frustrado porque no tenía cómo mostrar mis productos de forma profesional ni cómo llevar un control claro sin gastar dinero que no tengo.

En lugar de rendirme, decidí usar lo que tenía a mano: mi teléfono. Con la ayuda de la Inteligencia Artificial y muchas horas de ensayo y error, logré lo que hace una semana me parecía imposible: creé mis propias herramientas digitales para mi negocio. Todo hecho desde un celular, entre horneada y horneada.

Aquí pueden ver mi proceso con el código:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUFfZ26LENZBQjNBFyiHKX3hc7FyRWhEDDdzhgzugTr6N/1779275441993.jpg)

Y este es el resultado final, mi Reporte Maestro:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT558uWM5JXB4GAjK8aJKhba2unR8FBbtoGXCE937BFwj/1779275510124.jpg)

He desarrollado generadores de recibos, calculadoras de precios y este boletín informativo. 

Pero esto no es solo por mí. Mi sueño es que mi panadería prospere para poder impulsar mi proyecto \

, donde quiero llevar pan artesanal a niños y abuelos en las calles de mi sector. Sé que la tecnología es el puente para lograrlo.

Si estás pasando por un momento difícil, te digo: no te detengas. A veces el éxito no llega por el camino que esperas, sino por el que decides construir con tus propias manos.

¿Qué opinan de este avance? ¿Alguna recomendación para este panadero-programador?

body.body:
![MOON Cover.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23wC1PRdqeoRhx8dATPUZ9HqAJ3gRNDzYJgqs9chGDUGvJPizYC8ffU2apeho7mvcFduE.png)

 *Image Source: Made in Canva / Hive.Pizza*

---

     
    
<div align=\

> 
  
  
 This post is about the game #moon that runs on the #hive #web3 platform, where we monetize our content and play #play2earn! If you have experience with the classic webgame **Ogame**, this game is for you! Join us!



 ---
  

# What is MOON 

**MOON** Multiplayer Orbiting Optimization Network (MOON) is a free-to-play space strategy game with thousands of players playing together at the same time trying to become the best in the Universe. All you need to play is a standard browser.




![participação.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23vhUHuvqNiXEHmWbmeBRfMZzj3kX53ida5nvCoc1ct8hyN45ryK7jqfogzb6odW9v7H3.png)

# Universe 2

We ended our participation in Universe 2 with the snapshot taken earlier this morning by the MOON team. This means that nothing done from today onward will have any impact on the prize distribution.

The dynamics of Universe 2 were different, since the announced plan was that galaxies would be randomly extinguished until only a few *safe* galaxies or solar systems remained. Whoever had a planet established in one of the safe solar systems would win!

### The first safe system

I didn’t notice the announcement of the first safe system when galaxy 7:75 was chosen. That happened because the announcement was made outside the game, through HIVE posts. At that point, I had already lost interest in the game due to the ongoing issue of players using multiple accounts, which in the original OGAME would result in bans, but in HIVE MOON is not actively addressed. 

### The second safe system

When it was announced that it would be in galaxy 9, I worked on the migration and set up several operational planets in that galaxy. I was already well distributed across the game’s 150 solar systems, waiting for the announcement of which system would become safe. 

When the ingame notification arrived, I was unlucky with the timing: I had left the game 17 minutes before the notification, and only returned nearly 40 minutes after it because I was traveling. That time gap made me lose the best opportunity, the one I was most prepared for. When my colony ships started arriving at destination 9:20, I was already 16 minutes behind other players, such as @mengao, for example. 

I launched 12 colony ships, but managed to secure only 2 planets in winning coordinates.


### The third safe system

Due to my heavy investment in the previous attempt, I ended up sacrificing some strategic planets that I later missed when the third system, 9:80, was announced. Because of the geographical distance, I was left out, arriving 1 hour late when my ships reached the destination.

# Conclusion

Universe 2 was a very interesting learning experience, and I’m glad it has ended. I had invested heavily at the beginning of the game to build my structure and stay at the top, but I failed to understand the true dynamics of the game. 

It ended up becoming a disappointment to play in Universe 2 because of the current \

. I cannot guarantee that I will participate in the next universe. ![CPBR Dividers Post.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23uQG3CuRgff84MfJ9gxY4CHGuWHqZVrPi6brfHBKixvQmwFsTE24c1K8nzssHMfhRS9G.png) I would like to thank the entire **HIVE PIZZA** team for making it possible to relive this game that I had played many years ago on another platform. I hope the new universe launches soon, and I intend to stay active from the very first moment! Thank you very much everyone, and see you next time!!! --- ![Capa MOON.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23wC1PRdqeoRhx8dATPUZ9HqAJ3gRNDzYJgqs9chGDUGvJPizYC8ffU2apeho7mvcFduE.png) *Image Source: Made in Cana / Hive.Pizza* ---

> 
  
  
 Essa publicação é sobre o game #moon que roda na #hive, plataforma #web3, onde monetizamos nosso conteúdo e jogamos #play2earn! Se você tem experiência com o clássico webgame **Ogame** esse jogo é para você! Junte-se a nós!



 ---
  

# O que é MOON 

**MOON** Multiplayer Orbiting Optimization Network (MOON) é um jogo de estratégia espacial Free-to-play com milhares de jogadores a jogar juntos ao mesmo tempo a tentar ser o melhor do Universo. Tudo que precisas para o jogo é um navegador padrão.




![participação.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23vhUHuvqNiXEHmWbmeBRfMZzj3kX53ida5nvCoc1ct8hyN45ryK7jqfogzb6odW9v7H3.png)

# Universo 2

Encerramos a nossa participação no Universo 2 com o snapshot realizado nesta madrugada pela equipe MOON. Isso significa que nada mais do que for feito de hoje em diante terá impacto sobre a distribuição da premiação.

A dinâmica do universo 2 foi diferente, sendo que a promessa realizada é que seriam extintas as galáxias, de forma aletatória, até que restassem apenas poucas galáxias ou sistemas solares *seguros*. Quem estivesse estabelecido com planeta em algum dos sistemas solares seguros, ganharia!

### O primeiro sistema seguro

Eu não fiquei sabendo do anúncio do primeiro sistema seguro, quando foi escolhida a galáxia 7:75. Isso porque o anúncio foi feito fora do jogo, nas publicações da HIVE. Naquele momento eu já tinha me desinteressado pelo jogo devido ao eterno problema de jogadores com múltiplas contas, que no caso do OGAME original eram banidos, mas que no HIVE MOON não são combatidos. 

### O Segundo sistema seguro

Anunciado que seria na galáxia 9, trabalhei na migração e montei diversos planeta operacionais nessa galáxias. Eu já estava bem distribuído ao longo dos 150 sistemas solares do jogo, aguardando o anúncio de qual sistema seria seguro. 

Quando a notificação chegou ingame, fui logrado pelo azar do horário: eu sai do jogo 17 minutos antes da notificação, e retornei quase 40 minutos depois da notificação, pois eu estava em trânsito. Esse lapso de tempo me fez perder a melhor oportunidade, aquela que eu estava melhor preparado. Quando minhas naves colonizadoras começaram a chegar no destino 9:20 eu já estava 16 minutos atrasado com relação a outros jogadores, como @mengao por exemplo. 

Eu disparei 12 naves colonizadores, mas consegui alocar apenas 2 planetas em coordenadas vencedoras.


### O terceiro sistema seguro

Devido ao meu alto investimento na tentativa anterior, acabei sacrificando alguns planetas estratégicos que fizeram falta quando o terceiro sistema 9:80 foi anunciado, e devido à distância geográfica fiquei de fora, com 1 hora de atraso quando minhas naves chegaram.

# Conclusão

O Universo 2 foi um aprendizado muito interessante, e fico feliz que tenha encerrado. Eu havia investido muito no começo do jogo para me estruturar e estar no topo, mas não fui eficiente em entender a verdadeira dinâmica do jogo. 

Acabou se tornando uma decepção jogar neste universo 2, devido as \

vigentes. Não posso garantir que estarei no próximo universo. ![CPBR Divisores Post.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crazyphantombr/23uQG3CuRgff84MfJ9gxY4CHGuWHqZVrPi6brfHBKixvQmwFsTE24c1K8nzssHMfhRS9G.png) Eu agradeço a toda equipe **HIVE PIZZA** que proporcionou reviver esse game que eu já havia jogado muitos anos atrás em outra plataforma. Espero que o novo universo seja lançado em breve, e pretendo estar ativo desde o primeiro momento! Muito obrigado a todos e até a próxima!!!

*\

*

How do you walk through the masked ball without losing yourself?

If a request feels heavy, if a compliment feels calculated, if a promise feels too sweet—pause. That unease is not weakness. It is wisdom whispering.

**2. Remember: real care does not rush.**

**3. Speak. Always speak.**

Your image, your time, your trust—these are not products to be sold. They are pieces of your soul. No amount of money, no flood of flattery, is worth trading them away.

---

## IV. The Courage to Walk Away

It is not weak to walk away. It is not rude to say no. It is not unkind to protect yourself.

The person who truly cares for you will respect your boundaries. The person who does not will reveal themselves in their anger, their guilt-tripping, their sudden silence. Let that revelation be your compass.

You are not responsible for managing their disappointment. You are responsible for honoring your own worth.

---

The digital world is vast, and not all who wander it are lost. There are genuine souls, true friendships, real opportunities. But they do not ask you to dim your light to find them.

Stay aware. Stay connected. Stay vocal.

And if ever you feel the tug of a hook disguised as a hand, remember:

> *The truest freedom you can claim is the right to protect your own heart.*

The selection of a pump will take into account flow, maximum operating pressure and whether it has a speed compatible with the application operators desire. Furthermore make sure it is compatible with supporting elements like hydraulic valves, hydraulic tanks and the hydraulic power pack.

Construction sites subject hydraulic systems to dust, vibration and heavy loads in hot or cold temperatures. Precision engineering and high quality materials will assist in making them more efficient, thus leading to less downtime, and ultimately a lesser requirement for hydraulic repair service.

## **Check maintenance and service support**

One of the important aspects while choosing construction equipment hydraulic piston pump? is assessing long term maintenance needs. Well designed pumps are easily serviceable, which makes a huge difference on both downtime and repair costs.

Monitoring and routine inspections of hydraulic valves, filters, hoses along with hydraulic tank are done to enhance equipment reliability. They can also apply pressure testing, system diagnostics and hydraulic repair to prolong the lifetime of a piece of equipment.

Operators prefer approved hydraulic component manufacturers like omfb, which is known to manufacture reliable hydraulic solutions for transport and construction sectors.

Choose hydraulic pumps suited to the specifications of the machinery, capable of working under adverse conditions and designing for seamless integration with pto and hydraulic systems.

Construction businesses can improve the productivity of their equipment while reducing unforeseen failures by making sure they pick designs that focus on performance, compatibility, durability and professional hydraulic service backup. Choosing the correct hydraulic piston pump for your application is not just technical decision but a long term investment in operational success.

**Ingredients**

One kg chicken 🍗 

One cup yogurt 

Half packet milk cream 

Onions 

Green chillies 

Ginger 

Garlic 🧄 

**Spices**

Salt 

White pepper 

Black pepper 

Garam masala 

Cumin seeds 

Christmas flakes 

Cashew 

Fresh green coriander

First I washed chicken under water and put aside in the strainer . Then I cut onions ginger garlic  cashews and green chillies . I fried one minute in the oil and took out in  the mixer .

body.title: Our First Experience Walking Through Rome, Italy
body.body:
> Happy mid-week to everyone, and welcome to Wednesday Walk! These photographs capture the first major walk I took with my wife and friends in the city of Rome, right after stepping out of the train station—because if there was one thing we were absolutely clear on, it was that we wanted to explore the city on foot so as not to miss a single detail. I experienced the same emotions as always, allowing myself to be captivated by the architecture; yet in Italy, I believe that art is synonymous with the street—something evident not only in the sculptures and fountains that peek out from every corner, but also in the design, colors, cobblestone streets, and narrow pathways...
![IMG_20251015_115626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23qrLVeQyP6rBucScPkEAa4usi1voowNArt7H3QaNC5NFW8BXdjzymHgh4Thcye5NpBLR.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251015_110639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2432KknUyho8WVaY1toHXXfhQdJeTPGWA8f7Jcxm5phbssi9szqVWi5i2wDaYPvgEcKXf.jpg) ![IMG_20251015_115520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yTdC64P4DgQbW7H49fogmUCngPkTXJndA5aUav32rphSrnvR7sNprDWhCc4ca1HZiaz.jpg)
In general, the layout of most of the places I visited featured a large square with an imposing Catholic church facing it, a square that typically also boasted a towering obelisk. What did vary slightly, however, was the presence of a fountain situated on either side of the obelisk. Just as I do in my own country, I walked through the streets, falling in love with every detail—whether by gazing down at the pavement beneath my feet or by turning my eyes toward the skies above. In Rome, it seems that the taller a building stands, the richer it is in artistic and architectural details—so much so that one feels compelled to sit down for a while to truly observe and uncover them all.
![IMG_20251015_120319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23ujk8jaTK7XvVtH65iQwkxwP2Q6AMGqtN9JhBDas1ucjJVrZ1GM6kmxKBnumoEPvejrY.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251015_120155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/243zi6vbUjybkfnnfbtEzSt1zusiK3DvGxBbCERukHKq7ZuCEJocrE1KXkZJxh3t6udLt.jpg) ![IMG_20251015_115918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zRxjPML6UYh9rvj7A75EttvR5wrfZDKg3Hv8sGvAxA7uB9p9UvvQ8xYsSs8wvb2rk55.jpg)
I’m not sure what the best part of this walk was... The fact that I was exploring a new city on the European continent; that I did so with my wife; that I was accompanied by two of my best friends; the art found around every corner; the fact that it was a first-time experience; or even the simple fact that it happened to be a Wednesday—just like the name of this community, but brought to life. We were incredibly excited for so many reasons. This was, in fact, just the first of many walks; later that very day—in the afternoon—we were scheduled to visit the Colosseum, but there were still many hours to go. So, as we explored the area, we also kept an eye out for places to eat and spots where we could exchange our currency for the local cash. That is how we stumbled—quite by accident—upon the Trevi Fountain, though that wouldn't be the day of our official visit! 😅
![IMG_20251015_123612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23sdfpogHYCzpEeaSco1pMHT3CtC8DvWCKk5RgQCfC6FD8Wy7eeFs8DejeLEe3jcxqEdQ.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251015_132108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/2458V6PfSzDsQhNAUoZ88DddByL9J1Nxz9KD11m71mhesAZqxkntwxg1GiSYrjke1p3Mi.jpg) ![IMG_20251015_131913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zS4xQZGx2RAjYupc9HMxTWKrY6sokYLvjTz1cgw4wZJ41tGgXcczv6yPTTdUahkqpSk.jpg)
There was simply no way that this day—and that first walk through Rome—could be anything other than special. Yes, we happened to be out during the hours when tourists take over the streets, but so what? We were tourists, too! 😅 It was lovely to see the Trevi Fountain during those early hours on Wednesday—though just look at the crowds! We went back early Saturday morning, and that worked out perfectly; I feel it made for a truly special conclusion to this walking tour. Afterward, we grabbed lunch at a McDonald's; we couldn't find anywhere else to eat quickly, as our scheduled time for the Colosseum was fast approaching and we were quite a distance away. You could say we were learning the ropes the hard way—but we were happy nonetheless! 🙏 Thanks for reading and for your wonderful support; I hope you continue to have the very best of days! ✌️
![IMG_20251015_132914.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/EpnDiWSYHiAyn9RXa7HrEwVYtSiMK6nc1WKRFDdBGZrAbZQfbxvX2nbgN3CULhDdzxU.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 41.90004 lat 12.48390 long Rome d3scr)

#

![How to Choose the Right Petrol Chainsaw for Farming and Tree Cutting.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/39cb7dd6ef8463f2939f19f347e8e26fa1f72fd55288c73da9a36386b5e6226c)



Choosing the right petrol chainsaw for farming and tree cutting is very important for farmers, gardeners, and wood cutting professionals. A high-quality petrol chainsaw helps complete farming and tree cutting work faster, improves productivity, and reduces manual effort. Before buying, it is important to understand which petrol chainsaw is best suited for your farming and wood cutting needs.

When selecting a petrol chainsaw for farming and tree cutting, always check the engine power. A powerful engine is ideal for cutting thick wood, large trees, and handling heavy-duty farming work. For light agricultural work and garden maintenance, a medium-sized petrol chainsaw can be a practical option. The guide bar length should also match the type of wood cutting work you perform regularly.

Safety is another important factor while [choosing the right petrol chainsaw for farming and tree cutting](https://www.srujanee.in/view/how-to-choose-the-right-petrol-chainsaw-for-farming-and-tree-BvlWWReS). Features like chain brakes, anti-vibration technology, and comfortable handles improve safety and make the machine easier to control during long working hours.

Farmers should also consider fuel efficiency, chain quality, and spare parts availability before purchasing. The right petrol chainsaw for farming and tree cutting can save time, increase efficiency, and make agricultural and wood cutting tasks much easier and more effective.

body.title: Jon Lennon en el ojo del Ciclón (en/es)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPnMUgZcRRUwseV6F8PJsVFk1Rt6bcrdpwhvoHmurkZus/1779271241496.jpg)


ENGLISH VERSIÓN.

Street greetings, but full of art for everyone in this community.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeXUU991JMpQqVouyMgxtyjr8n8VZJaBG1ghPJ1fuiSdg/1779272129116.jpg)


When one day I dared to write a few lines about \

, I really didn't think that I would have to return to the subject again and again, because perhaps it didn't have the real dimension of that community project on a corner of Old Havana, exactly where O. Relli and Villegas shake hands.

And the thing is that, that first time, I wrote from my visual act that hit me in the face. artist's retina before the baroque creative environment in which the excellent sculptor Leo de Lázaro, project manager, develops. But on 
 visits, I have been discovering an inner order in all that apparent chaos.



But one of the things that has struck me most about the Eye of the Cyclone project is the stage of expansion it is in at the moment. The artist has been taking over, based on his credibility and commitment to art and the community, the outdoor spaces of the premises where he has his studio and a personalized gallery.

And in this growth he has involved other artists with murals alongside his own work.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfT6wm1RhhHtsFndDAxNcBCghGGqCtWRGdW5yV8RoR1eC/1779272407499.jpg)

In this context, I cannot help but be entertained and enthused by the way he integrates sculpture and architecture, which enter into a harmonious dialogue from the intention of suggesting the unfinished state of the pieces. This is the case of his very particular John Lennon, of which he only shows a very well modeled head to give us a convincing portrait of the leader of the \

who changed the musical map of the fifties.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZH5NiyqXL722ZjazSmh5U1kCCmL9WCyhzncDKxX8k9R/1779272968605.jpg)

Leo's Lennon, located at a height above the viewer's angle of view, looks at the front walls on the opposite sidewalk, without intending to interact with the passerby. Just look poetically, with a sweet and gentle look; with his typical hair and behind his glasses, an architecture and a city he had never been to. Maybe missing being there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmToJnbMscHbAYsoJ2mh5hHWJCzSmkh4rMyGxVojUA5eUi/1779272834987.jpg)


The artist has the habit of embedding his creations in the walls, removing the surroundings and leaving the cracks alive. He removes layers of plaster and shows the interior architecture, the skeleton of the walls, and thus leaves them with what provides a spontaneity and a feeling of unfinished, as if saying: \

This Lennon must be looked at from the intention of the unfinished to up there in the perfection of the modeling of the face. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYGX1mNpNgSQDo2X5jhL4aXZ1nYegbfGsbHx9sM5ZmNwE/1779273081724.jpg)

It gives me the impression that the artist proposes a more spiritual vision of the musician-poet, or of his music and poetry magnified in his compositions, which made him transcend all physical borders to become an artistic metaphor on a street in Old Havana.

From my modest knowledge of the subject, the sculpture seems quite original to me and manages to harmoniously integrate into the city's architectural environment.

A different John Lennon surprises us from a height on a nearby wall in the artistic empire of the Eye of the Cyclone.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPVerA6KhsdD1zeaCnM2HXzZDeziPwyaGzR81ZiimxrMm/1779273218041.jpg)

I invite you to visit it when you pass through Old Havana.

Original text of my authorship.

VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL 

>Saludos callejeros, pero cargados de arte para todos en esta comunidad.

>Cuando un día me atreví a escribir unas cuantas líneas sobre \

, realmente no pensé que tendría que volver una y otra vez sobre el asunto, pues quizás no tenía la dimensión real de aquel proyecto comunitario en una esquina de La Habana Vieja, exactamente en donde se dan la mano O. Relli y Villegas.

>Y es que, aquella primera vez, yo escribí desde mi acto visual que me golpeó la retina de artista ante el barroquismo del entorno creativo en que se desarrolla el excelente escultor Leo de Lázaro, gestor del proyecto. Pero en visitas posteriores, he ido descubriendo un orden interior en todo aquel aparente caos.

>Pero una de las cosas que más me ha impactado del proyecto del Ojo del Ciclón es la etapa de expansión en la que está en estos momentos. El artista se ha ido apoderando, a partir de su credibilidad y compromiso con el arte y la comunidad, de los espacios exteriores del local donde tiene su estudio y una galería personalizada.

>Y en ese crecimiento ha involucrado a otros artistas con murales junto a su propia obra.

>En ese contexto, no puedo dejar de recrearme y de entusiasmarme ante la manera que tiene de integrar escultura y arquitectura, que entran a dialogar armónicamente desde la intención de sugerir el estado inacabado de las piezas. Este es el caso de su muy particular John Lennon, del que solo muestra una cabeza muy bien modelada para darnos un retrato convincente del líder de los \

que cambiaron el mapa musical de los años cincuenta.

>El Lennon de Leo, ubicado a una altura por encima del ángulo de vista del espectador, mira a las paredes del frente en la acera opuesta, sin pretender interactuar con el transeúnte. Solo mira de manera poética, con una mirada dulce y apasible; con su típica melena y detrás de sus gafas, una arquitectura y una ciudad en la que nunca estuvo. Quizás extrañando estar allí.

>El artista tiene el hábito de empotrar sus creaciones en las paredes, descarnar su alrededor y dejar las hendiduras vivas. Quita capas de revoque y muestra la arquitectura interior, el esqueleto de las paredes, y así las deja con lo que aporta una espontaneidad y una sensación de inacabado, como diciendo: \

>A este Lennon hay que mirarlo desde la intención del inacabado hasta allá arriba en la perfección del modelado del rostro. 

>A mí me da la impresión de que el artista propone una visión más espiritual del músico-poeta, o de su música y de su poesía magnificadas en sus composiciones, que hicieron que trascendiera todas las fronteras físicas para convertirse en una metáfora artística en una calle de La Habana Vieja.

>Desde mis modestos conocimientos del tema, la escultura me parece bastante original y logra integrarse armónicamente al entorno arquitectónico citadino.

>Un John Lennon diferente nos sorprende desde la altura en una pared cercana en el imperio artístico del Ojo del Ciclón.

>Los convido a visitarlo cuando pasen por La Habana Vieja.

Vietnam is a country full of breathtaking landscapes, delicious street food, and friendly people. From the peaceful rice terraces in the north to the colorful lantern streets of Hoi An, every corner of Vietnam feels magical.
 Vietnam

 One of the most amazing things about Vietnam is its natural beauty. The famous Ha Long Bay looks like a scene from a fantasy movie, while the green mountains of Sapa offer unforgettable views. The local culture is rich with traditions, festivals, and warm hospitality.
 The food is another reason why travelers fall in love with Vietnam. Fresh spring rolls, pho noodles, and Vietnamese coffee create a unique taste experience that visitors never forget.
 If you ever get the chance to visit Vietnam, make sure to explore both the busy cities and the quiet countryside. Every place has its own charm and story to tell.

 • Beautiful natural landscapes
 • Delicious and affordable food
 • Rich culture and history
 • Friendly local people
 • Great places for photography

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 첫사랑의 재회
어린 시절의 첫사랑, 소중한 기억이 담긴 작은 마을에서 다시 만난 두 사람. 시간이 흘렀지만 서로에 대한 감정은 여전히 남아있다. 과거의 아쉬움과 현재의 현실 사이에서 그들은 다시 사랑을 찾을 수 있을까?

## 2. 서로 다른 세계
한쪽은 도시의 성공적인 비즈니스맨, 다른 한쪽은 시골의 순수한 예술가. 두 사람은 우연히 만나 서로의 세계를 이해하고 받아들이며 사랑에 빠진다. 그러나 그들의 배경 차이는 그들의 관계에 어떤 도전을 가져올까?

## 3. 시간 여행자의 사랑
미래에서 온 시간 여행자와 현재에 사는 평범한 소녀의 사랑 이야기. 그들은 서로 다른 시대에서 만나 서로의 삶을 이해하고, 사랑을 지키기 위해 시간의 장벽을 넘으려 한다. 하지만 시간의 흐름은 그들에게 어떤 시험을 안겨줄까?

## 4. 비극적인 운명
운명적으로 만난 두 사람은 서로에게 끌리지만, 그들의 사랑은 비극적인 사건으로 인해 위협받는다. 가족의 반대, 사회적 편견 등 다양한 장애물 속에서 그들은 사랑을 지키기 위해 어떤 선택을 할 것인가?

## 5. 우정에서 사랑으로
오랜 친구인 두 사람은 서로에 대한 감정을 깨닫게 된다. 하지만 우정이 깨질까 두려워 고백하지 못하고, 그 사이에 생기는 오해와 갈등이 그들의 관계를 시험에 들게 한다. 결국 그들은 사랑을 선택할 수 있을까?

## 6. 이민자의 사랑
새로운 나라에서 새로운 삶을 시작한 이민자와 그곳에서 태어난 현지인의 사랑 이야기. 문화적 차이와 언어 장벽을 극복하며 서로를 이해하고 사랑하게 되는 과정을 그린다. 그들의 사랑은 어떻게 서로의 삶을 변화시킬까?

## 7. 재능과 사랑
음악가와 작가의 사랑 이야기. 두 사람은 서로의 예술적 재능을 존중하며 사랑에 빠지지만, 각자의 꿈을 이루기 위해 서로를 멀리해야 하는 상황에 처한다. 그들은 사랑과 꿈 중 무엇을 선택할 것인가?

## 8. 운명적 만남
우연히 만난 두 사람은 서로에게 끌리지만, 그들의 과거가 그들을 가로막는다. 서로의 상처를 치유하며 사랑을 키워가는 과정을 통해, 과거를 극복하고 새로운 미래를 향해 나아갈 수 있을까?

## 9. 비밀스러운 연애
사회적 지위나 배경이 다른 두 사람의 비밀스러운 사랑. 그들은 서로의 차이를 극복하고 사랑을 키워가지만, 주변의 시선과 압박이 그들의 관계에 어떤 영향을 미칠지 고민하게 된다.

## 10. 사랑의 재발견
오랜 결혼 생활에 지친 부부가 서로를 다시 발견하는 이야기. 일상의 반복 속에서 잊고 지낸 사랑의 감정을 되찾기 위해 노력하는 그들의 모습은 많은 이들에게 공감을 불러일으킨다.

이처럼 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리는 각기 다른 감정과 상황을 통해 독자에게 깊은 감동을 줄 수 있습니다.

body.title: The Pain Hidden Behind Smiles
body.body:
Sometimes a person keeps smiling in front of the world, but deep inside there is a storm that nobody can see. Today I read a beautiful Urdu ghazal that touched my heart deeply. Every line felt connected to real life because many people silently carry pain, disappointment, and loneliness while pretending everything is fine.
The poetry talks about people who only enjoy watching someone fall. When a person is successful, surrounded by happiness, and moving forward in life, many people stay close. But when hard times arrive, most of those people disappear quietly. This is one of the bitter realities of life.
I personally experienced something similar a few years ago. During a difficult period, I expected support from some close friends. I thought they would stand beside me because I had always been there for them. But when I needed emotional support the most, many of them stayed silent. That silence taught me an important lesson: not everyone who smiles with you truly cares for you.
One line from the poetry especially stayed in my mind. It explains how people become happy after seeing someone broken or defeated. Sadly, jealousy exists everywhere today. Instead of encouraging others, many people secretly wait for someone’s failure. Social media has made this even more visible. People compare lives, success, money, and fame every day. Because of this comparison, sincerity has become rare.
But I also believe difficult moments reveal the real faces around us. Hardships work like a test. They show who genuinely values us and who was only present for personal benefit. Sometimes losing fake people is actually a hidden blessing because it makes us emotionally stronger and wiser.
Another powerful message I understood from this ghazal is that silence itself can express pain better than words. Many people cannot explain what they feel. They hide tears behind smiles and continue life quietly. We often judge others without knowing their inner struggles. This is why kindness is very important. A small kind word can heal someone more than we imagine.
In our daily lives, we should try not to become the kind of people described in this poetry. Instead of enjoying someone’s weakness or failure, we should support and encourage each other. The world already has enough negativity. Genuine kindness and loyalty are becoming rare treasures.
Poetry like this remains timeless because human emotions never change. Whether it was years ago or today, heartbreak, loneliness, fake friendships, and hidden pain are still part of life. Good poetry touches hearts because readers see their own experiences inside the words.
At the end, this ghazal reminded me that real strength is not in pretending to be happy all the time. Real strength is surviving pain quietly, learning from betrayal, and still keeping humanity alive inside the heart.
Thank you for reading my thoughts. Have you ever experienced a situation where people changed after your difficult time started? Share your experience in the comments.

body.body:
We have to kill the beast https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/okvciWwlWOpZ1LKhXWQGjIs1152.jpg
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/270572-lord-of-the-flies/images/backdrops)
