body.title: A day trip to the Sierra Maestra Hotel
body.body:
> Last Wednesday, I had the privilege of experiencing an unforgettable day at the Hotel Sierra Maestra, an iconic hotel nestled in the foothills of the mountain range of the same name, near Bayamo, in eastern Cuba.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfXimnU1XpzqLmmPGLcd4tEX5Bu9FMjysETLkd5iSfdeo/100_2424.jpg) I woke up early and took the road that winds through verdant hills. Upon arrival, the mountain's coolness and pure air enveloped me. The hotel, with its architecture seamlessly integrated into nature, welcomed me with a breathtaking panoramic view: immense valleys, coffee plantations, and the blue silhouette of the Sierra Maestra in the distance. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcfkdHuFcvTY75PySskUiTfqYYJ8xiG5xmMq3cEnWZKMc/100_2427.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjvC2kTgSLTY9xyZtDtZVwpRM1bL8Qw4mk8xUcjmDqfv/100_2425.jpg) I checked in quickly and, without wasting any time, joined a guided hike along the nearby trails. We walked among mahogany and cedar trees, while the guide told stories of the guerrillas and how these same mountains had been a refuge for freedom. The song of the tocororo, the national bird, accompanied us throughout the hike. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekxMi7RHUe9q1ATvZhw9sphBeyBHuy4ktThyuUkyFr5y/100_2429.jpg) At midday, I returned to the hotel to enjoy a typical lunch at its restaurant. I tried a delicious Cuban ajiaco, followed by barbecued pork with yucca and congri. To toast, nothing beats a refreshing mojito with mint freshly picked from the hotel's own garden. In the afternoon, I cooled off in the pool overlooking the mountains. Later, I participated in a Cuban dance demonstration organized by the hotel's entertainer. I learned the basic steps of son and cha-cha-cha, amidst laughter and good music. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXuriyEiuci1fD2cG3o1T8jBHL4XqRBswGV2f3DJ9mvzK/100_2419.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS6XgtYZdEDn7v4e6kBydCBCxPkQNxq1DVXpLB7vuzLSf/1.jpg) Before dinner, I went up to one of the hotel's viewpoints to watch the sunset. The sun dipped behind the peaks, painting the sky orange, pink, and violet. It was a magical moment that connected me with the grandeur of nature. Dinner consisted of fresh fish from the south coast, and afterward, I enjoyed a peaceful evening on the terrace, listening to the whisper of the wind through the pine trees and gazing at a breathtaking starry sky, free from light pollution. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTr8Hkp69JFfWSnGK7ketyQn1UeofSfu6GvmhXY3DEXHk/100_2420.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc33DmUWyJHyZZZAwAqzv4sWXrEpMpt9Guqj4nxwNB4Ge/100_2421.jpg) Before going to sleep, I gave thanks for that perfect day. The Sierra Maestra Hotel not only offered me comfort and beauty, but also an authentic experience where history, culture, and nature merge in an eternal embrace. Without a doubt, a Wednesday that will be etched in my memory as one of the most wonderful trips of my life. Credits: The images are my own. I used Google Translate.

body.title: MONOMAD WEDNESDAY \
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvEC6ddKL7Jk9LZzP56KfScTXC1fCJMPLFJsmtBBqfRo/43234.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. This is my entry for the #monomad challenge May 19th. In today's post, I have created a post on a different topic in the monomad community, which I would like to present to you here. In today's post, you will see high mountains and natural landscapes. Along with which the houses, temples and mountains coming on the way have been presented through photographs. Nature is one of the greatest gifts given to mankind. In all the beautiful places on earth, the rivers flowing through the high mountains and valleys create one of the most peaceful and captivating scenes. All of which scenes I have presented to you in today's post.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWYTBzwJrjbMuDoGZV8skijkJcMTiwGQjEnNbsGy3MEov/1_1.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3NzxqhT6GXWitHWe2geYzDHP5KmK58R4EpyiRfmWbkJ/2_2.jpg)

As seen in the photographs above, the beauty of such places attracts tourists, nature lovers and photographers from all over the world. As can be seen in the first photograph above, the power of nature comes to mind when the biker passes by the mountains. The fresh air, greenery and peaceful atmosphere of this area make these natural landscapes truly unforgettable. As can be seen in these photographs, the tall mountains standing proudly against the blue sky look majestic and powerful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLEwSaXFXiRjaXExkkVnGdwhwc3EssTk4mQUKAet4pkj/3_3.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNurq6RmPqP5gAwNCX4T4Y91pESSN4gVEC7brg7nGb8BH/4_4.jpg)

Above are two photographs, in which in the first photograph, a beautiful house can be seen on the edge of the mountain. In the background, the blue sky looks beautiful. This blue color cannot be seen in the photographs above, but the scene is really beautiful. When the sunlight falls on the tall mountains standing far away in the second photograph, their snow-capped peaks shine brightly. It makes the scene amazing and beautiful. Some of the mountains in this area are covered with dense forests, while others have rocky cliffs and green meadows.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvmHspaaBpwbV6UZpmZAmUxWtmnj5BYsfWhyMFRh4Sx5/5_5.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRacgGabRA5jfqex2o2nqxA63vvjjc55UZSiGDe9WnE3/6_6.jpg)

The beauty of these mountains increases when the temples and their courtyards at their foot are adorned with colorful small flags. A special thing about this area is that here during sunrise and sunset, the sky changes from orange to pink and golden yellow. The mountains here look even more beautiful in the evening due to the changing colors of the sky. Clouds often float around the tops of the mountains, creating a magical scene between the mountains and the clouds.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvb44gHWqeyNeSkcqVNG4P8DCakguxWns6tDt6nGEzGT/7_7.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiqoPkiH9ogDncjQH8Xrx2gaCrxyaR19nW1AnAn6qnBE/8_8.jpg)

As can be seen in the photographs above, there is a beautiful valley between these mountains where a river flows slowly. A road runs parallel to the river which makes the view amazing. If I talk about the river, then the river adds life and freshness to the entire landscape. As can be seen in these photographs, the clear water sparkles under the sunlight and creates a quiet sound while flowing over the stones and rocks. In some places, the river flows calmly, while in other places it flows at a rapid pace. Which adds to the beauty of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzBbdCJ9RuJDBwf3CMnvhGXa6j6dTDVQp8V75pVRkLkf/9_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbcaBxgVoKKW8aLF5kzgsixsCuVSkHcvbQjqLAUAK9CiE/10_10.jpg)

As can be seen in the photographs above, the natural views of the mountains and rivers also make people feel peace and happiness. Away from the noise and pollution of cities, such places help people to calm their minds and enjoy the beauty of nature. The serene atmosphere allows visitors to feel close to nature and appreciate its wonders.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPuVcXCPsHx6QhpqVRVxdXvm47jK67C11GJ2Lv72un4zU/11_11.jpg)

The natural scenery of high mountains and rivers flowing through the valleys is truly captivating as seen in the photograph above. The high mountains, flowing river and the lush greenery create a perfect picture of peace and beauty.

Each of the photographs presented here reminds us of the greatness of nature and also teaches us to respect and protect the environment. I hope that you will like my photographs and my post will be accepted for the #monomad challenge May 19th.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.title: Photo Trip | Croata - Various views of Fort Lovrijenac in Dubrovnik
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23w2Fe7GyFqHJ6RRm8XHc1awKW7oevqpAzi2tv8Wb79Wzi3MWwRr6aqMKogJk8Mv73QHy.jpg)

Today will be a bit different, because this isn’t a place I’ve visited up close. Instead, Fort Lovrijenac, visible in the photos, is shown from a distance from various spots in Dubrovnik. Dubrovnik is a fairly expensive city to explore; you have to pay for additional attractions like climbing the city walls or visiting the aforementioned fort. In the case of Fort Lovrijenac, the current fee is 15 euros. My friends and I travel on a tighter budget and rarely take advantage of paid attractions. It must be something special for us.


> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> Dziś będzie trochę nietypowo, ponieważ nie będzie to miejsce, które zwiedzałem z bliska. Natomiast widoczny na zdjęciach Fort Lovrijenac jest pokazany z dystansu z różnych miejsc w Dubrowniku. Dubrownik do zwiedzania jest dość drogim miastem, za dodatkowe atrakcje jak wejście na mury czy do wspomnianego foru trzeba zapłacić. W przypadku Fortu Lovrijenac jest to obecnie 15 euro. Z przyjaciółmi podróżujemy bardziej budżetowo i rzadko korzystamy z płatnych atrakcji. Musi to być coś wyjątkowego dla nas.


![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_7742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23r1aKb7kCSPsPKm2WmRbSbiNMtx3NzijAevbpCsRdNcnbZicE9W92zpAThoruGScX19i.jpg)


![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_7744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zRnZJ7sAqkmBXsrp8RTrq3Y1z7E2auSJUosrQ5ecPBJbbZ9ZngMYE8wVJ2rrhmonRT5.jpg)

The fort is located on the western side of the Old Town, outside its walls. Scenes from Game of Thrones were filmed there. This series increased Dubrovnik's popularity and therefore its prices.

> Fort położony jest po zachodniej stronie Starego Miasta poza jego murami. Na jego terenie nagrywano sceny do serialu Gra o Tron. Serial ten zwiększył popularność Dubrownika, a więc i ceny.

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_7745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zke6w3e5MUSmndPWwdVKGw1LzKVSnA5mFh8oT9RKEdYuxuAnQ7mhpaLtnSNa7VyRZJR.jpg)

If my memory serves me right, I took all the photos outside the walls of the historic part of Dubrovnik.

> Jeśli mnie pamięć nie myli, to wszystkie zdjęcia wykonałem poza murami historycznej części Dubrownika.

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_8093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/242NYWafR2yaUuhxXXPhGNVnQ6JZ2JGivf6sqnDpNnoovbcFW1WUwx7DR6Ld8L2rDuubX.jpg)

Sometimes the best views are from a distance, not up close.

> Czasem lepsze widoki są z dystansu, a nie z bliska.

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_8095.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/243LxVDQJWy4Madabtizmp2SHNJue3yG8TZbmPzC5FeXrBsa4iaYDvbhUUxj7rmVZ5xXA.jpg)

The fort was built on a rock 37 meters above sea level. The first fort here is said to have been built in the early 11th century. It was first mentioned in 1301.

> Fort został zbudowany na skale 37 m nad poziomem morza. Podobno pierwszy fort powstał tutaj na początku XI wieku. Pierwsza wzmianka o nim pochodzi z 1301 roku.

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_8117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/24325PV5VtjS3exA4oUW87myrrSSeUfnWMjA4j3KXp2HJLMNDi8XZWTBU4RxXxTgrHN7a.jpg)

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_8157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/243fhf7tYp8fcsN2x4Ex7hDe692GvoEfkkciwMDddh1LtHUGUXQ2gvYhAb3McRUpq62Pk.jpg)

Outside the Old Town walls, there are several vantage points from which we can admire the city panorama. The above photo was taken from one of them.

> Poza murami Starego Miasta znajduje się kilka punktów widokowych z których możemy podziwiać panoramę miasta. Powyższe zdjęcie wykonałem z jednego z nich.

![RSphotos-24-06-10-RSP_8174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23ynQDaxCxzWfZ9rpVuE4YtWbCTzMNWc6medW33npEj2wDG2axyg1HfPDjKNfTvsvEfJj.jpg)

The stairs are located outside the walls in the northwestern part and lead down to the Pila Gate in the western part of the walls.

> Schody znajdujące się poza murami w północno-zachodniej części i prowadzą w dół do bramy Pila w zachodniej części murów.

body.body: I couldn’t go on this sort of trip on my own. It’s far too dangerous here… And no, there’s no public transport; on the road, we only saw a few flatbed lorries with containers passing by.\nThere are no trains. There’s nothing here… This is a poor country and, on top of that, we’re on the brink of war. You can look it up on Google.\nI’ve been without electricity since 2 pm yesterday and they haven’t turned it back on.  I haven’t even been able to eat... That says it all. I got home that night and there was still no power. I had to snack on two tomatoes and a beetroot I’d cooked the day before, and a piece of tinned meat, and that was my dinner. Imagine how hungry I was after all that effort... 😟

body.body:
It’s fascinating how both our eyes and our brain work when it comes to vision, and how they work together to make us see a scene in black and white or in color. There were many things I didn’t know; our body is a perfect and complex machine that allows us to perceive our surroundings in different ways.

I like that you didn’t edit the photos but instead took two shots of the same place to see the difference, even though there are slight variations from what I’ve seen, they’re natural. The photos are spectacular; it’s hard to pick a favorite, but the last two with the distant views are the ones I like best. Great work!! Thank you so much, and big hugs!🤗

body.title: It's Only a Couple of Dollars! (and Other Fallacies...)
body.body:
Once every 4-6 months, I like to go through my bank statements in extensive detail, in an effort to track down every small recurring *(and non-recurring)* charge to my bank account and debit card.

![3018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23wWvxkchzkxEoJxECwceRvNHvGDjg3mTJnoj3yGFKRfaCgKyx5cL3xcvNZB3Dnpyu5of.jpg)

That might sound like a bit of a silly exercise to some, but it's surprising how often we agree to something because it pops up, seems convenient, entertaining and/or useful at the time, and we justify clicking the *\
*\n\nSimilarly, I'm sure many of us fall prey to so-called *\

* where we get something for virtually nothing for three or six months, and then all of a sudden we're looking at a $40 charge that we're not quite sure *what's* for, or *why* it's there.\n\nIn fact, Mrs. Denmarkguy came stomping into my office earlier today, literally *fuming* because some small graphics app she had agreed to a *\

* to had suddenly charged her $80 in advance for a 12 month subscription to something that had been advertised as being $0.99 a month.

![2985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23xAVU9WCxSEHwhwwyPJNHoZGsVsSseNuF8LG4yHqSujhjtkgvXpf9yox3T8tz18QVVpY.jpg)

I generally refer to all these small subscription charges as *\

*

Typically I'm pretty good about canceling trial subscriptions and inexpensive apps and services either before they start costing anything or moment they actually turn out to be less than expected. To be honest, I am consistently underwhelmed by most of these.

However, my archaeological journey through my latest bank statement revealed that I am not quite as diligent as I'd like to think that I am!

At the end of the process, I had eliminated $31 worth of monthly charges spread out across eight different applications/subscriptions. 

Of course, to *some* people $31 might not sound like a heck of a lot, but if you look at it on an annual basis you're suddenly looking at $372. In my budget, that's definitely more than *\

*

![2935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/EouACZTLDZCBsRGHGCD3QZVZ35Ze3ubHcvxfAfB2xdstJxD66r8MP9NZJNxvmrZefva.jpg)

It seems to me that in 2026 a disturbing number of ventures are quite successful with business plans that amount to little more than *\

*

Then the *true* cost suddenly turns out to be $89, charged as a single payment *in advance.* And by the time people are ready to *do* something about it, any *grace periods* have long since expired. It's all rather shady, don't you think?

Regardless, it is these shady practices that inspire me to be particularly diligent about staying on top of small subscriptions fees!

Thanks for stopping by and have a wonderful rest of your week!

created by three people from the studio Team Cherry. It took them over five years to deliver this gem of a game. The story is based on the protector princess Hornet, the savior of this world, who is kidnapped but manages to escape. She must return to the kingdom to uncover the reason behind her kidnapping. That is the essence of the game's narrative. I felt inspired to design it in foam (foami) since several friends from Hive recommended it to me, and it also encouraged me to play the game. I know it may not be much, but it's my way of expressing myself through art.
La imagen de referencia fue tomada de Google y representa el videojuego Hollow Knight: Silksong, creado por tres personas del estudio Team Cherry. Les tomó más de cinco años entregar esta joya de juego. La historia se basa en la princesa protectora Hornet, la salvadora de este mundo, quien es secuestrada pero logra escapar. Debe regresar al reino para descubrir la razón detrás de su secuestro. Esa es la esencia de la narrativa del juego. Me sentí inspirado a diseñarlo en foam clay porque varios amigos de Hive me lo recomendaron, y también me animó a indagar el juego. Sé que quizá no es gran cosa, pero es mi forma de expresarme a través del arte.

>
In the following I will show you step by step the realization of my work. To begin with, I will mention all the materials used:
A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Gris / Gray foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Rojo / Red foam clay
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

>

STEP / PASO 1

In the initial phase, I start by taking a piece of white clay to create the body of the protective princess Hornet. Then, with my hands, I shape it into a ball, giving it a curious finish.
En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en color blanco para realizar el cuerpo de la princesa protectora Hornet. Luego, con las manos moldeó en forma de bola, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP / PASO 2

Next, I develop the body parts of the character: its head, its eyes, its red hood, its legs, and the knight's sword, always giving my best.
Seguidamente, desarrollo las piezas del cuerpo en el personaje, su cabeza, sus ojos, su capucha roja, sus patas y la espada de caballera, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

>

STEP / PASO 3

Finally, I make the final touches on the face and connect the parts to form the princess. This design is a bit more complex, as the parts are smaller when it comes to molding.
Ya por último, realizamos los retoques finales en el rostro y conectó las partes para formar la princesa. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear.

>
https://youtu.be/6XGeJwsUP9c?si=OoF3xD4U09fje6r7

Final result / Resultado final

It should be noted that this design was found on Google, but the creation of the animated piece is done by me, with dedication so that they look nicer in your home or bedroom.
Cabe destacar que este diseño fue buscado en Google; pero la realización del animado es hecho por mí, con dedicación para que luzcan mas bonitos en tu hogar o dormitorio.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards
Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

This game is basically a game played with a shark under the sea.So with that shark you basically have to be the king of that sea, meaning you have to take over everything and you can eat anything and if you don't eat all the other fish or all the animals in it then you will die because you will be hungry.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzxhKBy52tdwNmHTZ2SbB1HdC5aerYzoDGe9b9ednHzN/img_3075.jpg)

There are various types of sharks in the game, of which the common type is sharks,the number of which is 12.Then there is Titan shark, which has six.There are ten special sharks.And there are two Demon Sharks.You can kill any type of shark by playing the game with a normal Titan Shark, but for this you need to equip the Titan Shark's ability.In the game, you will sometimes see different types of demon sharks that will try to kill you.

Then you can use that ability to escape from them and repel them, that is, kill them.The game has numerous species of fish, from normal fish to octopus, crab, tiger shark, megladoon.Excellent graphics quality has been used in the game. While playing this game, you can control it smoothly and you will not have any problem with it. There are various systems in it which I have highlighted in the gameplay.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTrZSWEz2Yi798gjwz2K3LKGvZm6E5GdRJ3HZvt1zyPD/img_3076.jpg)

Basically, the game is very beautiful and very dangerous, the kind of things we usually see under the sea are used here, so I hope you can play this game, this game will give you a lot of fun.Anyway, not today, friends. I hope I will present such a beautiful adventure game in front of you in the future. Until then, stay well and stay healthy.

body.body: @LadiesofHive Community [Contest #289](https://hive.blog/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-289) questions for the week are:\n\n1️⃣ Feeling like you don't have enough time is often a sign that you're trying to ignore your own physical and mental limits. Are there any particular situations that make you feel like you're doing \

lately?
~ 𝐀𝐍𝐃 / 𝐎𝐑 ~
2️⃣ By identifying which activities you do out of guilt or fear of disappointing others, and which you do by conscious choice, would this lead you to accept whether it is urgent or important to you?

<center>🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟</center>

Most of the time we are struggling with time and this is the only thing in the Universe which humans have not been able to control. This feeling of enough time or not enough time is very relative. I get this feeling in pockets and not all the time. There are times when I also have this feeling that I have all the time in the world and I am not using it wisely and then there are moments when I have so much to do in so very little time. These boundaries of time are also set by me only, because of me becoming over ambitious at times.

My classic example comes with me living in 2 different countries and how my life shifts in both of them. When I am in Muscat, my life gets pretty slow, it has some very fixed routines and there is not much of hassle. When I go to Mumbai, India, there my life drastically makes a shift. I am going there for shorter periods compared to the time I am spending in Muscat. Also,, Mumbai is home. There is family, relatives, friends, and I have so much to catch up on, in that limited time. These are the moments when I feel I do not have enough time. In the short visit I have to manage aspects of my airbnb business, then maintenance work of my own home, there are many other commitments which have to be taken care off.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP23enbb5Pgp5YfVdcbDqZ5VWUsUdEzod2JfmhFfimdCe/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/hand-hands-keep-time-clock-226707/)

To be honest,  I enjoy it. I never feel like it's too much. I rather feel this is perfect for me, because I do not enjoy little or too little in anyway in any area of life. After all I am a Capricorn, always over ambitious.

For the second question, I never do anything out of guilt or fear of anything. I am a very straight forward person; I do not like beating around the bush. If I do not agree to something or do not like or enjoy doing something, I refuse it, or in situations where I do not have a choice, I do it and I express myself very loud and clearly so that I am not put in the same situation again. This is my habit from a very long time and because of this a lot of people do not like me, and that's good with me, because I have no reason to please anyone in my life for any gains. I believe in hard work and then leave the rest to the Universe to take care of me.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

body.title: The Evolution of Content: Part 1 — Why I’m Transitioning to High-Level Web3 Research
body.body:
/>

The traditional way of creating content is undergoing a fundamental shift. For years, the formula for a copywriter was simple: sit down, chase the algorithms, churn out dozens of short, surface-level posts, and repeat. It was a linear, exhausting process where your reach and income were strictly limited by the hours in a day. If you stopped typing, the content stopped flowing, and Web2 platforms took the lion's share of the profit anyway.

I am done with that model. I have officially fired myself from the mindless routine of manual content churning.

Moving forward, I am stepping into a new role: an Independent Web3 Researcher and Content Architect. Instead of focusing on low-level execution for centralized networks, I am shifting my focus to high-level strategy and deep analytical long-reads. My goal is to build a high-quality, decentralized media presence across Web3 platforms like Hive and Ecency, delivering real value directly to the community.

<h2 style=\
>The Paradigm Shift: From Writer to Media Architect

>The core problem with traditional blogging isn’t the writing itself—it’s the constant friction. To survive in Web2, a creator has to be a researcher, a copywriter, a graphic designer, and a community manager all at once. This constant context-switching dilutes the most valuable asset any professional has: perspective and deep focus.

>By restructuring my workflow, I am separating deep research from standard execution.

\n\n
>The Vision: I define the strategic goals, underlying philosophy, and global topics that matter today.
>The Deep Dive: I analyze raw industrial data, extract key insights, and connect the dots between complex technologies.
>The Execution: I craft structured, high-impact articles that challenge the status quo, injecting my professional expertise into every paragraph.

>This approach allows me to scale the depth and impact of my work without sacrificing quality. I am no longer fighting for pennies against centralized algorithms; I am building my own independent network of readers.

\n\n
>Why Web3 is the Perfect Playground for Deep Research

>Trying to build a serious, high-level analytical brand on traditional Web2 platforms is a losing battle. Centralized algorithms stifle organic reach unless you write clickbait, platforms take massive cuts of your monetization, and you always face the risk of sudden deplatforming.

\n\n
>Web3 changes the rules entirely. Ecosystems built on the Hive blockchain offer the perfect infrastructure for an independent media network for three critical reasons:
>When I publish my research on Ecency, that content lives permanently on an immutable ledger. No centralized corporation can shadowban my profile or delete my hard work.
>Through proof-of-brain upvotes and tokenized rewards (like LEO and HIVE), the community directly rewards the quality of the thoughts, bypassing invasive ad networks or corporate sponsors.

>The synergy between independent thinkers and Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN) ensures that the hosting, processing, and distribution of content remain independent of big tech monopolies.

\n\n
>What’s Next: The DePIN & Healthcare Series

>This manifesto is just the beginning. To demonstrate the power of independent deep research in Web3, I am launching a multi-part analytical series exploring one of the most critical tech intersections of our decade: how Decentralized Networks (DePIN) and advanced technology are transforming global healthcare systems.
>Over the next three articles, we will explore:

>Part 2: The Digital Revolution in Medicine — How advanced tech models are diagnosing and treating complex diseases.

**Part 3:** DePIN Infrastructure — The practical blueprint of decentralized data processing in modern healthcare. **Part 4**: The Web3 Media Economics — How independent authors can scale censorship-free networks. **_The future of digital creation doesn’t belong to those who write the fastest. It belongs to those who build the smartest, deepest networks of knowledge. The journey begins today._**

body.title: Неймовірна травнева гроза
body.body:
/>  
Привіт всім,

Ось так у нас неймовірно гарно було вчора ввечері.  
Мені таке небо нагадує про портали в пекло чи інше потойбіччя. Дуже романтично, і я насправді скучила за такими стихіями. Давно не бачила Дніпро таким чорним, а я насправді люблю його і за \

, якщо я сама в цей час вдома.

Хоча по-різному було. Я якось пообіцяла бабусі, що прийду на дачу і приблизно в таку погоду видерлась на одну з канівських гір, де у нас була дача. Наскрізь мокра, але прийшла як обіцяла. Сиділа потім загорнута в ковдру, а бабуся наді мною ахала і охала :)

Ми купуємо на наступному тижні, напевно, будиночок в селі. Вже документи підготовлені, ми сьогодні-завтра отримаємо гроші, щоб заплатити. Там все одно до кінця травня ще живе жіночка і зараз шукає собі інший будинок. Але це вже останні такі підготовчі моменти. Вартість 14 200, для київського передмістя це дуже гарна ціна як на те, що ми дивились протягом трьох місяців (тим паче, що там газ, електрика і вода з водонапірної вежі, а майже скрізь потрібно було або газ, або воду робити).

Ми насправді вигрібли усі гроші, які могли дістати і по родичах, і про всяк випадок на оформлення можливо ще витратимо кредит по картці, але як ми будемо купувати перші інструменти, щоб прибирати і все інше ми подумаємо потім. Зараз найважливіше, що етап покупки буде пройдений. І нам їхати до цього будинку всього 10-15 хвилин асфальтовою дорогою. Будинок в центрі села, там і до зупинки маршрутки недалеко раптом що. Будинок в житловому стані, одна кімната і кухня, і ми більше схиляємось, що зробимо ремонт в літній кухні, зробивши там і туалет з душем. Літня кухня прямо поруч з фасадом, а цей старий будинок ми пізніше будемо зносити, бо по фасаду у нас 14-15м, тож немає сенсу там щось робити окрім мити і фарбувати. Тут 26 соток загалом, там на іншому кінці є більш широка ділянка, але так то довгою смугою традиційно для українських сіл. Майже без схилу, хоча саме село горбате, з горами і озерами. Дуже красиве.

Ми дуже задоволені, роботи там дуже багато, але у мене такий чоловік, якому важко збирати гроші, а от поступово вкладати кожен місяць нам цілком норм. Що й казати, що у нас рік тому вже було десять тисяч на купівлю, а потім він сказав \

(хоча тоді ми дивились ділянку з землянкою, але з 50 сотками хвилин за 25 від нас, та дорога там останній кілометр грунтова, не наша громада, зараз ми обрали в нашій Українській громаді, що може бути зручнішим). І до кінця літа у нас вже тих десяти тисяч не було, тож зараз я тримаю всі гроші в своїх руках.

Ну ось, сподіваюсь, що скоро і поділюсь світлинами ділянки, коли вона вже буде наша.

Дякую за увагу!

body.title: Hurrying is not a Virtue.
body.body:
Minimising hurry is not about laziness or dropping all ambition. It's about reclaiming the space to actually experience your life instead of just racing through it. In a world that glorifies hustle culture, choosing to be slow and steady almost feels like rebellion but it's one of the most powerful ways I've found to live more fully.

![1001367535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EpQtNjUxXDJTgmsjD5gnQsC7MeqRosdc6VZbY7pmszWPxeJfggQhiER1vVgwXe2oucL.jpg)

Modern life trains us to always be on the move. The constant notifications from our devices, deadlines looming and pressure from every angle. We are taught to equate success with speed and stillness with stagnation. 

Sadly, I still have these teachings embedded in me because just last week, I was on a rollercoaster. Running from one examination hall to another, preparing crafts for said exams and everything in between. Prior to last week, my days were filled with preparation as I solely wanted to focus on acing the exams that 89% of my predecessors failed.  Basically, there was no time for slacking or remaining still. 



![1001415288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EoGr85bwZCKvBNSxHv95byanNaeb9ZtgkqJMoWh1d1z9VTo15w2DvTwoteJGZFUqVTb.jpg)


On different occasions, my body sent signals for me to calm down but heck if I listened to any of those warnings. I was on a roll.  Now, the professional exams have come and gone but guess who's still trying to recuperate amidst illness? Me of course. 


I'm not writing this post because I've got it all figured out.  I am in fact writing the post because it took a dearest friend reminding me that resting and recuperating doesn't equal laziness before I could realize that I was still running on adrenaline and needed to deliberately slow down. So, for a couple of days now, I've been resting; meditating, reading books or watching movies whenever I feel like it, and in these days, I realised a couple of things.



First, when we're not rushing, living in the present is possible. With me, there's always the next exam or the next crochet projects and because of this, I'm always thinking of the future (which is a great thing to do) but not at the cost of the present. Living in the present opens us to the subtle things we tend to miss whenever we're in a hurry, just like the beautiful sunrise I saw this morning. 


![1001415257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23uQzsVTMAJKLSQ2wH1NTAQZp6u7gZ7Nxkn7Us424he8QJATuGHfY5G2Hq1fjZAvAaJNc.jpg)

Creativity and work also improve when we’re not in a haste and this is one of my surprising discoveries. I've always attributed slowing down with less output but I've noticed this particularly with my crochet projects. When I'm in a hurry, my crochet pieces tend to look basic and haphazardly made but with the right amount of patience and clarity, crochet masterpieces are created. There’s really no cheating nature.


Finally, when we minimise hurry, good health follows naturally. Our bodies are not designed for continuous acceleration. Continuous hurry contributes to everything from digestive issues to weakened immune systems and even anxiety.  When we're not in a hurry,  everything from our eating habits to our sleep patterns are better aligned because our nervous system isn't in a state of constant urgency. 



I’d like to conclude by saying that minimising hurry doesnt mean giving up. It is about choosing to be rooted in the present and finding genuine fulfilment. Truth is, the world wont stop spinning but life feels greatly richer when we stop trying to outrun it.

___
</sub>**This post was written in response to the #kiss writing ideas for the week which can be found [here](https://peakd.com/hive-194848/@minimalistliving/kiss-blog-ideas-week-212-may-16-22). Do not hesitate to turn in your entries.

body.title: Don’t become the wound
body.body:
*** - *Friedrich Nietzsche* ___ ___ ___
![FB_IMG_17760313100544193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23xVPbELUp5Cw63DUghxWfFBehJP71A15etMmvwYfmTrqukM6u2PxNZc599XCeB3RGax5.jpg)
Just sitting on my bed this Wednesday morning thinking about the many pieces of advice I gave my mum and how I am realizing that I may be going to be the same person I told my mom not to be, I mean isn't it funny that we most times see the many things people do to us and we kick against it but in a long while, unconsciously become the very thing we were against. We've seen mothers-in-law treat their daughters-in-law badly even when they were also treated badly by their mothers-in-law, and hated being treated that way, and wished they were treated well by their mother in law, shockingly, they grow older, break free from the shackles of their mother inlaw maltreatment and yet still they meet the same wrongful treatment on their sons' wives, they mett the same treatment, that same treatment on their daughter in laws. They become the very thing that broke them, they become the very people that broke them, and unconsciously do not even realize it. This is a reminder that we should learn to carry pain without letting it dictate our future actions, this is a reminder of resilience, self-awareness, and the importance of healing without hardening because it is one of the hardest—but most worthwhile—human endeavors. ___ ___ ___ Most days I think back to our I was treated as a girl child, and I am afraid of becoming the very thing that broke me, I am afraid of birthing kids and raising them harshly, because I was raised that way, although I see the many wrongs that was done to me in a bid to raise me, I am scared that I may one day unconsciously forget the pain I felt and how wrong it was and still raise a girl child that same way. Most of our mothers were groomed wrongly, they knew it wasn't the right thing but they unconsciously forgot the pain they went through and when they had their own girl child, they groomed them the same way they were groomed, without remembering their own pain, without understanding the pain their daughters are going through and the cycle keeps rolling, the cycles continue. Most of them promised themselves that when they finally got to have daughters they won't treat their daughters that same barbaric way, yeah they taught about the idea of breaking cycles, they thought about the idea of breaking the painful cycles but when they finally had their own daughters, instead of breaking the cycles as they promised themselves, they became the ones perpetuating them. ___ ___ ___ Most times we struggle to endure hardship but we become so not conscious of not letting our pain corrupt our character or turn us into the source of someone else's suffering. Some people are broken and broken people break others, try not to break others because you are broken; instead, heal, so you don't pour your pain on others. Most days, I raise my head to the heavens in a silent little prayer because it is easier to see and point out the wrongs meted out on us by others but many times we become unconscious of how those pains made us feel, and in turn become the very thing we pointed out against, become the very people we hated because of the pain and how they made us feel. So in essence, all I am saying is while we notice the wrongs done to us by people, let us be conscious of not letting our hurt or pain turn us into the source of another person's suffering, let us try as much as possible to avoid becoming what hurt or harmed us, refuse to be transformed to your abuser or destroyer because it makes the cycle continue not end. ___ ___ ___

body.title: TOP 7 mẫu nệm mùa hè mát dịu, giúp ngủ ngon hơn cho mùa nóng
body.body:
Sở hữu một chiếc đệm mùa hè thoáng khí là giải pháp hiệu quả để xua tan cảm giác nóng bức, đổ mồ hôi lưng và khó ngủ trong những ngày thời tiết oi ả. Khác với suy nghĩ của nhiều người rằng mùa hè không nên nằm đệm, các dòng nệm hiện đại ngày nay đã được cải tiến với công nghệ làm mát, chất liệu thoáng khí và khả năng điều hòa thân nhiệt vượt trội. Nhờ đó, người dùng vẫn có thể tận hưởng cảm giác êm ái mà không lo hầm bí hay khó chịu suốt đêm.

Các loại đệm mùa hè hiện nay thường sử dụng foam thoáng khí, cao su thiên nhiên hoặc hệ thống lò xo túi độc lập để tăng khả năng lưu thông không khí. Một số dòng cao cấp còn tích hợp Cooling Gel hoặc vải Cooling Fabric giúp bề mặt nệm luôn mát lạnh ngay khi chạm vào. Đây là lý do ngày càng nhiều gia đình lựa chọn nệm mát mùa hè để nâng cao chất lượng giấc ngủ trong điều kiện khí hậu nóng ẩm tại Việt Nam.

Trong số các sản phẩm nổi bật hiện nay, iComfy Cloud 2.0 là mẫu nệm foam được nhiều người yêu thích nhờ cấu trúc foam đục lỗ kết hợp công nghệ Cooling Gel Foam hiện đại. Sản phẩm mang lại cảm giác mát lạnh dễ chịu, hạn chế tình trạng đổ mồ hôi lưng và giúp cơ thể thư giãn nhanh chóng sau ngày dài làm việc. Một lựa chọn khác là iComfy Coolax Plus với vải Cooling Active có khả năng điều hòa nhiệt độ chủ động, giúp người dùng luôn cảm thấy khô thoáng và dễ chịu khi ngủ.

Nếu yêu thích cảm giác massage nhẹ nhàng và nâng đỡ mềm mại, iComfy Coolax Massage là dòng nệm đáng cân nhắc. Thiết kế lõi thoáng khí giúp tản nhiệt hiệu quả, phù hợp cho cả người lớn lẫn trẻ nhỏ trong mùa hè. Ngoài ra, iComfy Lux 1.0 cũng được đánh giá cao nhờ cấu trúc foam nhiều lớp giúp giảm áp lực cơ thể, hỗ trợ cột sống và mang lại cảm giác thư giãn tối đa.

Bên cạnh nệm foam, nệm cao su thiên nhiên như Gummi Classic cũng là lựa chọn lý tưởng cho mùa nóng. Hệ thống lỗ thông hơi dày đặc giúp không khí lưu thông liên tục, tạo sự thông thoáng suốt đêm dài. Trong khi đó, Amando Elite Grand kết hợp lò xo túi độc lập với lớp vải Cooling mang lại cảm giác mát mẻ, êm ái và hỗ trợ nâng đỡ cơ thể hiệu quả. Goodnight Active Hybrid cũng gây ấn tượng nhờ công nghệ KIKOO Cool Science từ Đức cùng lớp Graphite tản nhiệt giúp bề mặt nệm mát hơn đáng kể so với các dòng thông thường.

Để chọn được chiếc nệm phù hợp, người dùng nên ưu tiên các chất liệu có độ thoáng khí cao, vỏ bọc thấm hút tốt như Tencel hoặc Bamboo và độ dày phù hợp với nhu cầu sử dụng. Ngoài ra, việc vệ sinh ga trải thường xuyên, sử dụng thêm protector bảo vệ nệm và giữ phòng ngủ thông thoáng cũng giúp duy trì cảm giác mát mẻ lâu dài.

Một chiếc đệm mùa hè chất lượng không chỉ giúp cải thiện giấc ngủ mà còn hỗ trợ bảo vệ sức khỏe và tinh thần trong những ngày nắng nóng. Đầu tư vào một sản phẩm phù hợp sẽ giúp bạn tận hưởng cảm giác thư giãn, dễ chịu và thức dậy với nguồn năng lượng tích cực mỗi ngày.

I had never seen the guava tree in bloom. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c458da70-f715-4c3f-be0f-1beb20766daa.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c021b7ef-df83-40da-996c-adbad6da544c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8465cc5b-838b-4e94-9626-8d67873dda76.jpg) My sister also grows cilantro, which is a plant we use to cook rice, beans, meats, and some broths. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6aa565d9-86fc-46b8-8749-f3b2fe17c899.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4cdbda09-fa02-4e0d-8eb4-2bfcee7e6aac.jpg) I also picked a few gooseberries from the tree to enjoy on the way back. The Cuban gooseberry is nothing like the ones from cold countries; it is a small fruit, and even when ripe, its flavor is sour, but we really like it as a fruit, and we also use it to make sweets or wines. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bb6700ed-0c63-4234-8fde-7764774faf20.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7a6aa6e5-5738-4006-982f-d29d048c02d3.jpg) It was a very productive day because I accumulated 11,975 walking points, which will later turn into earnings. body.title: scrobble.life/movies update
body.body: While I was teasing this in a snap earlier, it's not something I wanna focus on yet, which is okay as it'd be better once users have some more scrobbles behind them anyway. Currently no one has hit 1,000 yet to even play \

:D


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/Eo6BjPtZLRdtis5zZWnz7fbHDoHvx2DnzT9hP9wHLcnnqY3h8sADZEtUiMvvd1smN4P.png)

While this is going to be a big and important feature, it's a bit too soon! 

So taking a break from unity (although doing some work there at the same time as this), I decided to focus on the Movies and TV section of the website. I decided to create a new community for this and will be checking if some curators are interested in keeping an eye on it in the future. Basically, we implemented long-form reviews for movies! 

### How it works

When a user goes to log a movie watched in scrobble.life/movies, they select the correct movie from search, it'll now display this: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23tGTYzWkaTvpWLCUesy8EdRw4QbygctRZU7N16HXgf3A7WMAhihay94ZKWq5D8nFV5pD.png)

You rate the movie

You leave it a comment if you want (comment can leave a snap if you check \
now which is new, then the \

instead which takes you to our simple editor: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/EnynWRTC2mYcsMvF368pnecWm2kgNXHXu4v1cSVkJ9NX4rPxRJp81o3d79DKwmM2kk3.png)

Note that all reviews are posted into the Scrobble.life community. 

You write a title of your choosing (doesn't have to be the movie/tv show name) and fill out the body which offers image upload and the general markdown options along with spoiler. Now there's also the Decentmemes.com widget added if you really wanna get creative! (Beneficiaries apply)

Then you can select beneficiary and payout options as usual as well: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23u5UztwVvwd3np73SFRyGdU3MqAHyv5Tuvn6VAQ34zZK1SGgaQjB1WRXFnrJHHpusicM.png)


Another cool thing you can do is paste previous reviews you've written when you go to log a movie/tv show! Instead of clicking \

option next to it. When you do that it opens up a link-drop box, and when you link from peakd/ecency/hive.blog, it will automatically check the date you posted it on to update the date you watched it above so you don't need to manually set it. 

The sections of movies are now updated with long-form reviews as well as short takes being visible under the trailer of a certain movie/tv show, this is what it looks like when I've logged the movie with an old review for instance:


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23wWnny3obAkiUZx5JjMSqUPmc3Yy9CkhzvVfR1V9ZfDRePKmvPUwn2CqMQ33oHTgBhoN.png)
 
Still some fine-tuning left, like not showing a review is 1869 days old but something more human readable and telling claude that just cause it got x amount of hbd then doesn't mean it converts in today's hive prices into hp. :D 

But you get the gist. 

A big update so let me know if you find any flaws/errors somewhere, I'm sure there's some I may have missed.

I'm excited however to start logging older movies I may have written reviews about now and activating the /movies and /tv section a bit more since most of the focus has been on /music and the scrobbler extension (which is still awaiting google web store review but is available on mozilla). 

Some more notes copied over from Claude summary: 
- Auto-prefix [Movie] / [TV] on the on-chain title for PeakD/Ecency readers; stripped on scrobble.life since you're already in the movie context

- New Reviews + Quick takes 70/30 split column
- Reviews are collapsed by default (title · rating · @author · time · live HP payout) — click to expand the full body inline
- Upvote button + 0-100% weight slider + Reply composer on every review — same UX as the /music discussion section
- Live HP rewards chip (amber = in voting window, emerald = paid out)
- Sort tabs: Newest / Top Payout / Top Rating

___

Anyway, that's pretty much it, give it a try! 

PS. logging movies doesn't require the extension, just a hive keychain login using your posting key.

body.title: Mana Strategy Is the Key to Winning Battles in Splinterlands || Earned 7 Cards After Completing Chapter 8
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 20, 2026, 10_50_00 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tm9BPSmbyCMY65fvHSRV5hHSwKQV8sR3Cc7fnWHxXanqiLU3Xergys26WMAB6Pvkzmq.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


For any battle just like powers and abilities are important, mana also plays a very important role. Random mana battles are normal and players should stay prepared for them. The main purpose is to properly understand how mana works.

Some players ignore mana and directly select random monsters to start the battle. Because of this some mana gets wasted or they choose monsters with very high mana costs that quickly fill or even exceed the mana cap.

This causes a big problem because in a hurry to balance the mana, players end up selecting the wrong monsters and face defeat in battle. It is important to understand that mana plays a major role in winning any battle.

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 100706.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tmHR87kv5uJFupiVdLcdGDVbjuSYnVH1WtVg6Y4BeaoQZ7NzCGHgQVGx5UxtdiaqvTk.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

That is why the campaign has a special chapter dedicated to it. In Waur Medge Chapter 8 is called “Mana” which properly guides players about it. The game does not explain everything in detail there but in this content I have explained it more deeply.

It depends on what type of mana battle you get. There could be low, mid and high mana battles. Positioning changes and strategy is fully affected by mana. Also your way of selection of monsters gets changed according to different mana battles.

For example if you get a low mana battle you should bring forward low mana cards from your deck that still have strong powers and abilities. The strategy is to properly select tank monsters, melee, ranged and support attacks while maintaining good positioning.

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 100542.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tRxJbT8vZUjrWtG439i32nhYG7vLPBdjEWL8WXDGesWwsc2cgQBxVBDJ47Z2CabDkQG.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

I always try to fill as many mana slots as possible. Even if you do not have the best cards your chances of winning still increase because it helps create a better team combination.

Instead of selecting only 2 or 3 monsters in low mana battles I think it is better to fill the maximum number of slots so a strong team combination can be created. Sometimes a monster you usually ignore can become game changing in the right position.

This mostly happens in low mana battles. In mid and high mana battles because more mana is available, players get more selection choices and most of the slots are usually filled.

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 100553.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQNhi2HDt97GTuPJCwhGkb1if7n4Sk4EP2PWCakXrmMcRx2PBaWj8Th1eE6So4ksvoe.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Another mistake players make is wasting mana during monster selection. For example 2 or 3 mana may remain unused because they do not have a matching monster card and they start the battle anyway. Remember that wasting mana negatively affects battles.

Chapter 8 explains mana properly and also includes a tutorial battle so players can understand it better. If you want to learn more about this topic you must definitely explore Chapter 8 where you will learn and also earn better rewards after completing the chapter.

To enter the campaign you simply needs to open the Splinterlands website and in the top left corner you will see the Campaign option. Click on it and go to Chapter 8. There you will get a short introduction about mana and also a tutorial.

![Screenshot 2026-05-20 100732.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tv6H8fqsVuq9BiSSLsy6hAaEvGFaoKLAPZsyJLDzJ3ykmUm96gL7qLB8AwK9wW7YzaE.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

In the tutorial battle you will fight a practical battle and if you win, you will receive 7 monster cards as rewards. As shown in the screenshot players can get very good rewards by completing only a few simple steps.

These may be beginner cards but they will definitely help in battles and give you better selection options. I hope I was able to explain the mana topic properly and that you also enjoyed the rewards.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.title: Exploring RWAs and Onchain Real Estate With Integra
body.body:
Integra is trying to build a pretty ambitious full-stack “operating system” for real estate onchain. The vision is that AI agents, not humans, can actually transact, manage, and price property.

The “AI primitives” such as the Asset Passport, Agent Passport, iRWA are the core building blocks that make that possible. They are trying to do three things simultaneously, in the quest to tokenize real estate.

- Asset Passport → make property legible to machines
- Agent Passport → make AI trustworthy economic actors
- iRWA → unify fragmented liquidity

Let's first focus on the Asset Passport and a simple idea! Real estate is notoriously messy, fragmented, and difficult to verify, and that makes it hard to digitize or trade efficiently.

An Asset Passport acts as a unified digital identity for a property, bringing together everything that would normally be scattered across brokers, legal offices, and data rooms.

It includes ownership history, legal documentation like titles and filings, valuation reports and audits, as well as physical information such as location, images, and inspection records.

It layers in compliance metadata so the asset can be used within regulatory constraints. All of this is structured into a hybrid system, where some data lives onchain and some offchain, but the whole package is cryptographically verifiable.

The result is a property that can be queried, validated, and interacted with programmatically, rather than manually pieced together each time someone wants to transact.


![image.png](UPLOAD FAILED)


The Agent Passport is the second core primitive, and arguably one of the most important because it gives AI agents something they’ve never really had before: economic identity.

Instead of being stateless tools or one-off scripts, agents get a persistent on-chain identity, a reputation history that carries across actions, financial stake in the system, and clearly defined permissions with accountability baked in.

On Integra specifically, this identity is backed by staking. Agents put up the native token as a trust bond, which means bad behavior can lead to slashing, while good performance earns better access and lower fees over time.

That creates a direct link between how an agent behaves and what it’s allowed to do economically. The key shift here is that without identity, AI agents can’t really be trusted, can’t build reputation, and can’t access meaningful capital.

Agent passports change that by turning them into credible economic actors rather than disposable processes. And that fits into a bigger trend we’re already seeing: AI agents evolving from simple tools into autonomous participants inside real markets.

![ \

](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HHkyQnobYAA_LC7?format=jpg&name=small)

 > _Right now, tokenized real estate is scattered across incompatible standards like ERC-1400, ERC-3643, and a bunch of custom legal wrappers, which means these assets don’t really talk to each other._
_iRWA, the “universal adapter” for tokenized real estate, solves a pretty fundamental fragmentation problem in the space. The liquidity doesn't stay trapped inside isolated ecosystems._
_What iRWA does is act as a standardization layer. Integra’s AI can read any existing real estate token, wrap it into a unified, interoperable format, and preserve the underlying compliance rules in the process._
_Instead of forcing assets to be re-tokenized or legal structures to be rebuilt from scratch, you get instant interoperability and aggregated liquidity across markets that were previously disconnected._

How these primitives fit together is actually pretty simple: Asset Passports define what the property is, iRWA makes it tradable anywhere, and Agent Passports give AI the ability to interact with it autonomously.

Put those together and you get AI agents that can discover properties, evaluate them, negotiate deals, buy and sell assets, and manage entire portfolios end-to-end, all onchain and running 24/7.

The bigger idea here is real estate as a programmable asset class. Integra’s core bet is that real estate is a ~$400T market that still hasn’t been properly “API-ified,” and if these primitives actually work, a few major shifts unlock at once.

First is liquidity, which is the holy grail. Today real estate is slow, fragmented, and highly local, but with asset passports and iRWA layers, properties become globally tradable, liquidity can compound across platforms.

Second is automation through AI agents. Instead of relying on brokers, asset managers, and manual underwriting, you can have autonomous agents sourcing deals, continuously repricing assets, and managing portfolios algorithmically. 

Third is standardization of something that has historically resisted it. Real estate has always been hard to digitize because every property is unique and every jurisdiction is different.

With the asset passports and attestations create a shared data schema for property. That’s what makes cross-border investment, institutional scaling, and AI-native analysis possible.

Once property becomes standardized, liquid, and machine-readable, you unlock entirely new financial primitives like real estate credit markets, onchain REIT-style structures, dynamic pricing systems, and composable yield products.

body.body:
https://youtu.be/-hxR9UP9-t0?si=gvew1pG8HlHR3deR
Doubt and anxities is a common thing that happen everyday to people, but God is calling us to bring all our problems to him. When we trust in God instead of our fears, our hearts become calmer and stronger. God cares deeply for His children and promises to guide them through difficult times. Prayer, faith, and reading God’s Word help us remember that we are never alone.

The bible also teaches us to always put our focus on God and believe that he will always turn things around for us to good. Anxiety often grows when we think too much about problems, but faith grows when we remember God’s love and power. Spending time in prayer, worship, and fellowship with other believers can strengthen our confidence in God. Even when answers do not come immediately, trusting God patiently brings peace to the heart.

body.title: Looking back =/= Ein Blick zurück 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_8200.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EqYtDA5rne52WVokUBzjTSiyvB3ojGvJ9i4cUTcisH2giiey2q4nx1f7j66UQhsvLSt.JPG) Today, I’m treating myself to another little look back at the wonderful spectacle we were able to enjoy just a few weeks ago. As usual, the cherry blossoms left us far too quickly this year, and they had even started too early. That’s why it wasn’t always easy to plan my outings. Especially since the weather didn’t always cooperate, and I had to make some last-minute changes. But even in the rain, it’s worth getting up close to the cherry trees. After all, cherry blossoms are best admired and marveled at up close, and Queen Sakura is always happy to have a little rendezvous. And of course, I was more than happy to oblige and really enjoyed our brief but intense encounters. But well, the magic may have moved on now, but my memories are still quite fresh. Just like my photos, of which I’ve once again taken far too many. But at least this gives me material for this blog, which also serves as a bit of a memory aid for me and can show me later on where I’ve been in the past. And that’s exactly the case with today’s photos, which show a row of cherry trees in bloom in one of my favorite parks. Despite the rain, I had taken a short walk and ended up stopping in front of this amazing sight. Queen Sakura showed herself once more at her best, and I took a few more photos. You simply have to capture such a wonderful sight, even though I hope to come back here and stop by again next year.... ![IMG_8201.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/245wHWYnxQPRrm2PbQEd8Gak9Pwgn6mpU4E8w1ctCg7WfzeWjyEQtkXqcuA2Rgb9VgwDH.JPG) DEUTSCH Heute gönne ich mir noch einmal einen kleinen Rückblick auf das wundervolle Schauspiel, an dem wir uns vor wenigen Wochen noch erfreuen konnten. Wie üblich, war die Kirschblüte auch in diesem Jahr viel zu schnell vorrüber, und dann hatte sie auch noch zu früh angefangen. Deshalb war es teilweise gar nicht so einfach, meine Ausflüge zu planen. Vor allem, da auch das Wetter nicht immer mitgespielt hatte, und ich ein wenig umdisponieren musste. Aber auch bei Regen lohnt es sich, den Kirschbäumen ganz nahe zu kommen. Kirschblüten lassen sich nun einmal ganz aus der Nähe am besten bewundern und bestaunen, und Königin Sakura freut sich gerne auf ein kleines Rendevous. Und auch ich war dafür natürlich gerne zu haben und habe mich über unsere kurzen aber intensiven Treffen sehr gefreut. Aber gut, der Zauber mag jetzt zwar weitergezogen sein, aber meine Erinnerungen sind noch gant frisch. Genau wie meine Fotos, von denen ich wieder viel zu viele gemacht habe. Aber so habe ich wenigstens Futter für diesen Blog, der mir auch ein wenig als Gedächtnisstütze hilft, und mir später in der Zukunft zeigen kann, wo ich denn früher überall gewesen bin. Und so ist es auch mit den heutigen Fotos, die eine Reihe von blühenden Kirschbäumen zeigen, die in einem meiner Lieblingsparks stehen. Trotz Regens hatte ich eine kleine Runde gedreht und war am Ende noch einmal vor diesem tollen Anblick stehengeblieben. Königin Sakura zeigte sich noch einmal von ihrer besten Seite und ich machte noch einmal ein paar Fotos. So einen tollen Anblick muss man doch einfach festhalten, auch wenn man ich hier hoffentlich im nächsten Jahr wieder vorbeikommen und anhalten werde.... ![IMG_8202.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/2458NH9hEdMnANRZoTE91N8rEgSDDPpaiiRfJfa3Q4rw7fJf6Agu3Kra6SD5pYZx7mzUY.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: Common Myths and Facts About the DPT Vaccine
body.body: The DPT vaccination is safe, effective, and crucial for protecting your child from diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus. Most side effects of the DPT vaccine are mild and temporary; however, the three diseases, Diphtheria and Pertussis, and Tetanus that are prevented by this vaccination can result in serious and potentially fatal complications.\n\n<h2 style=\

>The DPT immunisation safeguards against three highly severe illnesses: diphtheria, pertussis (whooping cough) and tetanus.

\n*

>Many myths create anxiety, but studies show that the DPT vaccines are effective and safe.

\n*

>Completing the vaccination schedule will provide long-lasting protection against severe disease.

\n*

>Minor side effects are common and will only last for a short time.

\n*

>Vaccination is one of the best ways to safeguard children and prevent outbreaks in the community.

The [DPT Vaccine](https://www.mrmed.in/molecule/diptheria-pertussis-tetanus-dpt-vaccine) is safe, effective, and essential for protecting children against diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus. Most side effects are mild, while serious reactions are extremely rare. The real risk comes from contracting these diseases, making vaccination far safer than relying on natural immunity.

>The DPT vaccine, which comprises the three separate vaccines DPT, Tdap, and DTaP, is given to children and administered as part of the standard childhood vaccination programme.

\n*

>The DPT vaccine provides long-term protection against diseases caused by these bacteria, improving the immune system's response time if it encounters either organism again.

\n*

>Generally, the DPT vaccine strengthens the body’s natural ability to ward off illness and is an essential part of childhood immunisation.

\n\n
>Myth 1: The DPT Vaccine Is Not Necessary **Fact:** *

>DPT vaccines are important because the illnesses diphtheria, tetanus, and whooping cough continue to occur today.

\n*

>These illnesses can lead to respiratory difficulties, neurological issues, muscle damage, and death, especially among infant.

\n*

>Vaccination is still considered the safest and most effective method for the prevention of these types of illnesses.

\n\n
>Myth 2: The Vaccine Causes the Diseases It Prevents **Fact:** *

>The DPT vaccine is not made from live bacteria and will not cause any of the three diseases: Diphtheria, Pertussis, and Tetanus.

\n*

>The vaccine helps train your immune system to recognise and fight these infections.

\n*

>DPT vaccines use purified, inactive components to stimulate the immune system and protect you from developing the disease.

\n\n
>Myth 3: Natural Immunity Is Better Than the DPT Vaccine **Fact:** *

>Natural infection from Diphtheria, Tetanus, or Pertussis can cause complications and the need for hospitalisation, plus possible long-term health issues, that may end up causing death.

\n*

>The DPT Vaccine gives you safe, controlled immunity with no chance of your body being subjected to dangerous hazards.

\n\n
>Myth 4: The Vaccine Has Severe Side Effects **Fact:** The adverse reactions, mostly mild, are usually transitory, including: Injection site pain *

>Redness and swelling

All of these reactions usually go away within 24 to 48 hours. Serious side effects from vaccines that have received full, agency-approved licensure are rare, and they undergo stringent efficacy and safety assessments before they are made available for use.

>The Hexaxim vaccine is widely recommended because it protects against several infectious diseases with just one shot.

\n*

>This means the patient will need to be pricked with a needle, thereby improving vaccination compliance.

\n*

>Which protects against Diphtheria, Tetanus, Whooping Cough, Hepatitis B, HiB (Haemophilus influenzae type B), & Poliovirus.

\n\n
>Myth 6: Infants Are Too Young for the DPT Vaccine **Fact:** *

>Small children are at greater risk of Whooping Cough and Diphtheria infections than adults.

\n*

>The DPT immunisation schedule begins at 6 weeks to protect because this is when most children are at greatest risk of contracting these diseases.

\n*

>Additional immunisations significantly enhance a child's long-lasting immunity against these diseases and provide substantial protection from outbreaks.

\n\n
>Myth 7: Healthy Children Do Not Need the Vaccine **Fact:** *
>Healthy kids are still at risk of infection from being around \

or from touching contaminated objects.

\n*

>The DPT vaccines protect kids from infection and help stop the disease from spreading through schools, communities, and families.

\n\n

>Why Completing the Full Schedule Matters When you miss a dose, the vaccine protection is lost. You receive the best protection from Diphtheria, Tetanus, and Pertussis if you complete the entire recommended schedule of vaccinations. Booster vaccinations help to strengthen protection from these three diseases as children grow into adulthood. Parents should always follow their child's doctor's recommendations and get their child vaccinated as quickly as possible.

>Final Thought\n\nThe Diphtheria, Pertussis, and Tetanus (DPT) vaccine remains a necessary and safe component of routine immunisation to keep your child healthy. Immunising your child with DPT, despite any myths, protects them against many serious diseases. Choosing a safe option, such as vaccines, will provide effective protection when administered according to schedule.

body.body:
![Electric Blue Modern Money Management Tips Youtube Thumbnails (50).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wgHkEnfx2A6k8vXjxSNnxdTeKqec61AiCgWrAA3sMfT3fbgCETEq8SQ6jS7Gm3xdHwN.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) I’m someone who has a tight leash on my temper. The one thing I don’t like and I try to avoid is being unable to control my actions or emotions. That’s why I stay away from people or things that only serve to infuriate me, and I also choose never to take alcohol or any other intoxicating substance that will rob me of my control. This is why I have no regrets. In all the life I’ve lived, I don’t regret anything. Not because I’ve only always made the right choices, but also because I believed that even the mistakes were made with the best intentions. The thing is, controlling your temper is a required skill. Because you have to do it while also ensuring that people don’t walk all over you. You get to be firm but not rash. Never let your emotions dictate what you do or say. Because it would just not be excusable. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) The same way you can’t forgive someone for what they do when they’re drunk, you shouldn’t forgive them if they do it in anger either. Being angry does not give you the right to hurt someone or be destructive. If you fail to control it, then you will be in control of your emotions and end up sending yourself deep into financial ruin. Or any other form of ruin for that matter. We need to do better! And yeah, I’m also of the school of thought that people should be held responsible for the things they do when they’re angry. They should also not be excused for them because, anger or not, the consequences will always remain. I know how much saying the wrong things can hurt, especially when you don’t mean them. In a blind rage, you simply blurt out what’s on your mind and thus cross a line you would never have crossed to begin with. ![IMG_20230518_162928~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23zaofqK8zSBsn2Gr95Du5UBPGas3Af1UhJFHxgUV8pFwoyumi3TkJW3asEz9fZbwFUoh.jpg) This also works for people who commit heinous acts in anger. Just a little argument, and then you resort to blows, beating people up. Until one day, you end up killing someone. And that’s how your life would be ruined. This is why I’d never be in a position that’s constantly trying my patience and pushing me to anger. Regardless of age, no one is too big to be walked out on. I’d rather walk out on you and apologize later than stand there in silent rage until I say or do something terrible. So yeah, we need to be wise. And this also goes to people who always need an outlet for their anger. They need a punching bag, or they need to break something. Well, in my house, the day you destroy anything in anger is the day you get banned from ever setting foot in the house. That’s for a fact. Because by the time your anger is gone, you’d still count money and replace that thing. Just like what some preachers say about those who love to trash around when they’re under anointing. If you destroy any of the church’s properties because you’re under the influence, when the influence leaves your body, you’ll count your money and replace them. No long talk. We don’t forgive people for the rubbish they do when drunk. We shouldn’t forgive those done in anger either. Just my two cents. ![IMG_20230914_153034~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23sJbTRqSxGoBbn6ZRy8rysu8uCUvAWxe96odjhzCT5SekgKGYHhC52jRSmvGFocFGGMh.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.

body.title: The Number We Learned to Keep Secret for a Reason
body.body:
<div  class=text-justify>





Before I even start to think about some damages that salary transparency is going to cause and do to some shady contractors and politicians, I need to talk about what it will personally do to a lot of people. Because I would like to say the truth that no one really talks about. Because, with what I have seen, a lot of people over here are not keeping their salary hidden to deceive anyone. They are simply doing it to keep the relationship that they are in to survive.



I remember when I was still serving. All the lecturers and professors in my department usually keep their higher salaries hidden, and they never mention it to anyone. But I was with the data analyst of the department one day when I saw the breakdown of their salaries. I even got to know that some professors are paid more than the HOD of that department.


And to my surprise, I now got to understand why some people's salaries stay hidden while some are made known. And what I have gotten is that, when some people's salaries are known, some family members will recalibrate around it. And a lot of people will be doing some math around that person's salaries just to have a share. And some people will start relating with that person properly because the way they see money around here goes beyond financial. It is also the way they relate with you. It will determine how important someone is, and how they address that person, and some will believe that they are entitled to that money. _It can be crazy, I know!_




And that even has nothing to do with greed. Because knowing the amount someone earns as salary will become a leverage that people have over that person, especially in an environment where almost everyone is competing for survival. Letting known the amount people earn as salaries would not just expose a local government chairman who earns a million naira but lives like he has five million naira. It would also expose the quite civil servant in Oyo or Kano managing six dependent salaries that look okay until the breakdown is done against the present cost of living here. And that is how those two individuals will be ready in a very different way by those around them, even though they never asked for the public reading.




![242496.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/242496.png)



I genuinely understand the corruption argument because it is very real. There should be an absolute question raised if the lifestyle of a civil servant is visibly disconnected from their public earnings. But I am sure that we already have a rule toward that, and we also have EFCC, the anti-corruption agency. But the issue is that we do not know how much these people earn. The real problem is that the agencies that have access to those numbers always decide to look away by not doing what is right and what they are there for.








If everyone's salaries are being made public. I am sure that it can never stop all these corrupt institutions. It can't fix them. What it will only do is that that last private space most ordinary people have, it will remove it while those \

body.title: The Micro-Cap Playbook: How I Hunt High-Conviction Web3 Testnets & Airdrops Without Burning Capital 🧵
body.body:
Hello Lions! 🦁

The broader crypto market is constantly fluctuating, and for many retail participants, gas fees on mainnets can completely wipe out potential profits before an airdrop even materializes. As a digital entrepreneur building my brand, Digital Divine, I look at Web3 through a strict cost-to-reward lens.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZEADLunFRSgEJnc7VBwXH4W9vLoMo1SjMkvS1TcFZC45/1779264103655.png)

If you don't have thousands of dollars to lock up in massive Ethereum or Solana staking protocols, your highest leverage play is High-Conviction Testnets and Social-to-Earn Flywheels.
Today, I’m breaking down my exact playbook for scouting, validating, and extracting value from early-stage networks before they hit the mainnet.

🔍 1. Filtering the Noise: The \

Filter
90% of testnets are a waste of time designed to farm your attention. To protect your time, you need a strict filtering system. I only dedicate hours to a project if it ticks two boxes:
Active GitHub/Developer Pushes: If a network's testnet bot or GitHub repo hasn't seen updates in weeks, the project is dead in the water. Look for consistent on-chain building.
Ecosystem Backing: I prefer projects deeply embedded inside established layers (like emerging Cosmos app-chains or highly scalable parallelized EVM networks).

⚙️ 2. The Multi-Account Myth vs. Deep Contribution
Many hunters try to automate 50 different wallets using basic scripts. This is the fastest way to get flagged by anti-sybil measures.
My Strategy: I focus heavily on a single, high-reputation identity. Instead of just clicking \

I actively participate in the network's community infrastructure—submitting technical feedback, engaging with their social layers, and visualizing data trends. Whales and project founders reward high-quality data contribution over automated bot spam.

🔄 3. Building the Inbound Cash Flow Loop
Here is the ultimate flywheel: I use the daily liquidity generated from web design, digital asset curation, and affiliate marketing to fund my long-term crypto nodes and staking positions.
Web3 shouldn’t just be a speculative gamble. When you treat your community engagement on platforms like Hive/InLeo as an active revenue stream, you can channel those exact layer-2 curation rewards directly into high-conviction Web3 plays. It creates a bulletproof loop where you never have to risk your rent or grocery money to play the crypto game.

What’s Your Q2 Playbook?
I'm curious to hear from the LeoFinance veterans: Are you currently allocating more time to automated liquidity pools, or are you aggressively farming early-stage testnet infrastructures? Let’s talk strategy in the comments below! 👇
