body.title: 🇨🇺 Elegancia y Líneas de Oro: La Leyenda Inmortal de Tony Oliva en la MLB/Elegance and Golden Lines: The Immortal Legend of Tony Oliva in MLB
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXscUZMae4rKDotDNgVaE7ekiSKs8mMNqe4RhP82yH87Y/img_20260516_144711_640.jpg)
Como historiador apasionado de nuestro deporte nacional, es un honor desenterrar las raíces y el brillo de Pedro Oliva López, inmortalizado en la geografía de las Mayores como Tony Oliva. 

Su historia es la de un artista del bateo que desafió la nostalgia del exilio para firmar una de las trayectorias más estéticas y dominantes de los años 60 y 70.

Nacido en las llanuras tabacaleras de Corralillo, Pinar del Río, Oliva no llegó a debutar en la extinta Liga Profesional Cubana debido al corte histórico de 1961. Su viaje al norte fue una odisea de fe: llegó a Estados Unidos en la primavera de ese mismo año con un visado gestionado a última hora. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As a passionate historian of our national sport, it is an honor to unearth the roots and brilliance of Pedro Oliva López, immortalized in the geography of the Majors as Tony Oliva. 

His story is that of a batting artist who defied the nostalgia of exile to sign one of the most aesthetic and dominant trajectories of the 60s and 70s.

Born in the tobacco plains of Corralillo, Pinar del Río, Oliva did not make his debut in the defunct Cuban Professional League due to the historical cut-off of 1961. His trip to the north was an odyssey of faith: he arrived in the United States in the spring of that same year with a visa arranged at the last minute.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuMBUPuYczMPMivdgneMnJEUSVf4bifCX8dwrk4e9kA8/img_20260516_144651_996.jpg)
Toda su carrera en la MLB (1962-1976) estuvo ligada a una sola franquicia: los #Twins de Minnesota. Sin embargo, su madero también dejó huella en el #Caribe; durante los inviernos, se convirtió en una leyenda de la Liga de Béisbol #Profesional de Puerto Rico vistiendo la camiseta de los Lobos de Arecibo, donde también sembró terror en el pitcheo oponente.

Oliva fue el terror de la Zona de Strike. Rompió los esquemas de la Liga Americana al conquistar tres títulos de bateo (1964 con .323, 1965 con .321 y 1971 con .337). Su juego era tan completo que en 1966 se llevó el Guante de Oro como jardinero derecho por su impecable defensa y potente brazo. Con respecto al Bate de Plata, este galardón no existía en su época (fue creado en 1980), pero de haber existido, su vitrina estaría abarrotada. Además, su consistencia lo llevó a ser seleccionado a 8 Juegos de Estrellas de manera consecutiva (1964-1971).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

His entire MLB career (1962-1976) was tied to a single franchise: the Minnesota Twins. However, his wood also left a mark in the #Caribbean; during the winters, he became a legend of the #Professional Baseball League of Puerto Rico wearing the Arecibo Wolves jersey, where he also sowed terror in the opponent pitching.

Oliva was the terror of the Strike Zone. He broke the schemes of the American League by winning three batting titles (1964 with.323, 1965 with.321 and 1971 with.337). His game was so complete that in 1966 he won the Gold Glove as a right fielder for his impeccable defense and powerful arm. With regard to the Silver Bat, this award did not exist at the time (it was created in 1980), but if it had existed, its showcase would have been crowded. In addition, his consistency led him to be selected to 8 consecutive All-Star Games (1964-1971).


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYBNzFUXWiK2KixtPQzM77YnYCGBNUXYx18DAr1MuRg4/img_20260516_144702_000.jpg)
Tony Oliva ostenta un hito que lo separa de cualquier mortal que haya pisado la Gran Carpa: es el único jugador en la historia de la #MLB en ganar el título de bateo en sus dos primeras temporadas completas (1964 y 1965). En su año de novato oficial (1964), no solo lideró el promedio, sino que encabezó la liga en hits (217), dobles (43), carreras anotadas (109) y total de bases (374), barriendo de forma unánime con el premio al Novato del Año.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tony Oliva holds a milestone that separates him from any mortal who has stepped foot in the Big Tent: he is the only player in the history of #MLB to win the batting title in his first two full seasons (1964 and 1965). In his official rookie year (1964), he not only led the average, but led the league in hits (217), doubles (43), runs scored (109) and total bases (374), unanimously sweeping the Rookie of the Year award.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4ECTgM32mAM3LPRB4t3GHPivxAXjDPCfJt27cWZPXJp/img_20260516_144706_649.jpg)
Te preguntarás por qué Tony si su nombre era Pedro? Pues te cuento que detrás del nombre \

se esconde una de las picardías burocráticas más divertidas del #béisbol. Cuando los Twins le enviaron el pasaje para salir de Cuba en 1961, el documento de Pedro (su nombre real) no estaba listo, pero el de su hermano menor, Antonio, sí. Para no perder la oportunidad de su vida de salir del país antes de que se cerraran las fronteras, Pedro tomó el pasaporte de su hermano. Al llegar a Estados Unidos, el scout que lo recibió lo llamó \

al leer el papel. Pedro decidió mantener el nombre para evitar problemas migratorios, convirtiéndose para siempre en Tony Oliva ante el mundo entero, mientras el verdadero Tony se quedaba en #Cuba cultivando la tierra.\n\nHoy en día, Tony Oliva es reverenciado como la definición pura del \

. Aunque unas rodillas maltrechas y traicioneras frenaron una carrera que iba directo a romper récords absolutos, el mundo del béisbol nunca olvidó su grandeza. Su tardía pero ultra justa exaltación al Salón de la Fama de Cooperstown en 2022 por el Comité de Días de Oro sanó una herida histórica.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You might be wondering why Tony if his name was Pedro? Well, I'm telling you that behind the name \

hides one of the funniest bureaucratic shenanigans in #baseball. When the Twins sent him the ticket to leave Cuba in 1961, Pedro's (his real name) document was not ready, but that of his younger brother, Antonio, was. In order not to miss the opportunity of a lifetime to leave the country before the borders were closed, Pedro took his brother's passport. When he arrived in the United States, the scout who received him called him \

when reading the paper. Pedro decided to keep the name to avoid migratory problems, becoming forever Tony Oliva before the whole world, while the real Tony stayed in #Cuba cultivating the land.\n\nToday, Tony Oliva is revered as the pure definition of the \

Although a few battered and treacherous knees stopped a career that was going to break absolute records, the baseball world has never forgotten his greatness. His belated but ultra-righteous induction into the Cooperstown Hall of Fame in 2022 by the Golden Days Committee healed a historic wound.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJWvjFoGVjko37qVtsPMHhNBjYDpsb65c5tuh4yu9ZF1/img_20260516_144656_812.jpg)
En conclusión, Oliva no fue solo un bateador excelso; fue un embajador de la resistencia del pelotero cubano. Su número 6 cuelga retirado en el Target Field de #Minnesota, recordándonos que la elegancia de un swing caribeño puede congelar el frío del norte y derretir las barreras del tiempo.

Hasta aquí la sección de #Leyendas Cubanas del Béisbol, nos vemos el próximo Miércoles.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In conclusion, Oliva was not only an excellent hitter; he was an ambassador of the Cuban baseball player's resistance. His number 6 hangs retired at the Target Field in #Minnesota, reminding us that the elegance of a Caribbean swing can freeze the cold of the north and melt the barriers of time.

My plan B whenever I can't get my bike fixed is I always carry my debit card with me so I can walk to a nearby train station and get home by train.

body.title: Night violet flowers.
body.body:
Night violet flowers.
I was walking in the park with friends today. It's very beautiful here, and the weather is nice—not hot, cool after yesterday's heavy rain.
I took a photo of the violet.

Violet flowers are grown indoors, in flowerbeds, and in parks.

In the evening, violets are very fragrant; their scent can be smelled from several meters away.

Night violets are also called hesperis.

They love care. They love watering. But they don't like marshy areas.

There are 53 species of violets. Violets can be found in many countries.
Violet flowers come in purple and white.

Last year, I had a violet growing near the fence at home. The scent filled the entire yard in the evening. You could even smell it outside the gate. Everyone enjoyed walking past and smelling this pleasant aroma.

body.title: Splinterlands: Chaos Furybringer is great in Equalizer
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Chaos Furybringer.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/Eondqsy1K9WkDGUoAXXG9PEzwKJq5PF4UjenFKkQFUbnkDNdeJCpGP8hPHrUKv6AM3R.png)
Chaos Furybringer is a fire splinter that costs 6 mana. This card has reach to start. Leveling this card increases its stats, and I find it as a fairly decent card to use in Foundational battles due to its fast speed, and it's one of the better backup tanks.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vhUDf784JQDR7ehTTyg3hst48Ta38C7fzt4yAXLEaN8kDnxYoQTh8q4Mn2XtJoJpCXf.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Holy Protection and Equalizer. This means that all monsters start off with the same health and they gain the divine shield ability. There is also 27 mana available, and I can use every [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for water and life.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Barthalamas|6|Summoner|+1 speed|
|Frankarsgard|7|1st||
|Chaos Furybringer|6|2nd|Reach|
|A'lan Musketeer|8|3rd|Double Strike|
|Total Mana:|27|||
My summoner is Barthalamas for the +1 speed. My tank is Frankarsgard. After that is Chaos Furybringer and A'lan Musketeer.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. Chaos Furybringer is a perfect fit due to its low health but high stats in the other attributes. A'lan Musketeer was used because of the double strike, and it makes things die quite fast. With that, I only have 7 mana left so Frankarsgard just made more sense.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmKnUvMAK9XYCTL4N9tC5381ZDDdFKqQYCLy5bYUfsPu1XD8GWbtjm9js6ZUeSCASZi.png)
At first glance, I think that this match can go either way, but I have the damage and speed advantage. It just depends on whether or not I can kill my opponent fast enough.

### Round 6

![round 6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFXmqXAGzyfjJNcS6xSdue7irtJYTf8kddFxfrnqAayGGLk8ccQ96afNAPtoJuxZ1Pw.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent's lineup has just one monster left, and I still have two so this is my win because I have higher speed than my opponent.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFXmqBz5kEe4uDUU4Uusx33EEoSSZKr1rYNP858bv69P1nPp4jH3iWMZhM2NfzN6NRP.png)
I won the match as I expected.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. Chaos Furybringer and A'lan were great damage dealers. In particular, Chaos Furybringer just worked well as a backup tank. I just had more damage and speed so my opponent was fighting an uphill battle.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_65330de0491e06bf7da559324aa1aef1?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-chaos-furybringer-is-great-in-equalizer-9gz)

body.title: The Weight Of Saying Yes.
body.body:
One thing I most time think about is time, we all say how fast time flies. And recently I was reading a post where someone was talking about what if the hours in a day were to be increased, as it is 24hours now, what if it should become 30 or 30+hours, will it still be enough?



![1001037613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/EokecnE5LfLEWbCTwcK5MJfFy58CV3pAJMMExLs1C4BZTMfCWPBdmJyU149Vj87XHFA.jpg)



The simple truth is, no. Because each and every day already has its own task. Some are even postponed till the next, while we do away with some. That's why you find out that, even when the day is almost over, you still find yourself trying to catch up or meet up with a thing.


Last week Thursday happened to be one like that, I had to do a lot of things. I had to get something in the market, I was the president of my CDS group and we are having a personal hygiene awareness at a school, while doing and preparing for all of that, my members were calling me to come pick them or help explain to the bike man the location where the school we are using is, and some of my customers who needed clothes for the upcoming Muslim festival were as well bombarding me with calls and Whatsapp messages of the kind of clothes and shoes they want.



And what would you have me do, I was doing all of it at once. My LGI who was our boss was also asking me to make calculations of everything we contributed, what we spent and what we have remaining. After the whole program and all, I began receiving calls from some members who came for the program and had forgotten either their powerbank, charger, cap and such at the school we used. It was a very stressful day for me. At the end of the day, I looked at how my session for the program went, it didn't go the way I wanted, because I was not organized, I was glad I had chosen about three other people to talk as well, if not it would have been somehow. 


![1001036992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1001036992.jpg)



Around 8 PM that day, I couldn't even do anything again, I had written, typed and all to an extent that my hands were already shaking. Even I know I'm tired, because it was obvious I had ignored my limit. That evening I called my LGI and told him we would need to choose executives amidst us, I can't keep doing it all alone, the weight of those tasks are just too much for me. And even though my body was complaining, I have no one to hand them (the tasks) over too, the few who helped that day didn't do much too.





So, now I'm beginning to see things and allow myself some rest. I drw out my plans, go for the most urgent one's and put the rest on the waiting list, if I later have time for them, fine, and if I don't, it should wait. Also, I'm starting to speak up now and ask for help, because at the end of the day I need to respect my limits in order to be more productive.
 





Also, this other topic happens to be one I can't over look. Reason being that I've found out that there are some things that I do at times and later find out that I didn't do them because I want to, but it was out of guilt and fear.


About two months ago, two of my junior colleagues in school called me because they needed help with their projects. I was taking a class when they called, it was a WhatsApp call, so I picked it up and agreed to help them on the spot. The truth is, I said yes to them because I didn't want to disappoint them. Throughout that week I had to inconvenience myself and my students for them. Because I'm a school teacher, I need to teach my students and I also need to prepare and do certain things for myself and well.


![1001037768.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1001037768.jpg)


At the end, I was weak, drained and exhausted, because I didn't act out of choice but our of fear of letting them down, and out of guilt that, what if they didn't meet up with the deadline or what if they go ahead with it and failed.





I can tell you that that decision of mine and the toll it had on me and my health, and I fell sick for over a week. It was after I recovered I sat myself down and had a rethink. Since then, if there's anything that pop's up, I ask myself if it's something I want to do, or it's something I'm doing out of guilt or fear. And that has helped me to turn certain things/task down, while I focus on things that I want to do and are important.


And that's how I realized how powerful choice can be. Because before doing a thing or agreeing to do a thing, it is important that we know the reason behind what are saying yes or no to. And I can tell you in all honesty that it has helped me be in control of the things I do, it has helped me manage my time, it has helped reduce my stress and it has helped me live more for myself.





🌹

**Images are mine.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

我爸做公交车手机丢了，恰好路过某营业厅，他就想着去那里补办电话卡，再一起买手机(很执着的认为官方靠谱且不会P人

买手机后，在店员的推销下选购了一款159的家庭融合套餐(流量多话费时长多)，当时人家给我爸的解释改这个套餐纯免费，完全没有解说任何159的事，还强调是因为买手机才绑定的优惠福利。记得和家里人绑定，别的也没说啥

等我妈收到订购短信，发到家人群后，我和我姐都说每月消费得满159后才行，要是不绑定家人，就得我爸自己消费满159，我爸不信非说人家讲的免费

无奈解释不清了，还是给人工客服打电话确认吧！对方先挂了电话查询，后回电说159套餐生效了，必须3年➕后到期才能终止，又补充说我爸妈的加一起可以达到159(按89原价)，但这个月得补交十几元，之后每个月都不用补交了

*OS我觉得如果不打这通电话，以后每个月还得再补交十几元，因为老爸改之前，人家根本都没说这些，即使每个月扣十几元，也不一定能注意到，也不知道消费必须满159*

又问了下对方为什么消费者在店里时，不给解释这些呢？一直都认为免费，容易误会啊，还有和家里人绑定有时间限制吗？对方说这个月底前必须绑定完成，否则我爸自己得补交到159

事后我查了查套餐详情:
老妈套餐原价89，实扣30
老爸套餐原价119，实扣60
电话里工作人员说的扣费情况是89+60=149
不明白为啥是原价➕折扣价后组合的费用，总有种为了KPI欺负一些不注意细节的老年人感

肥嘟嘟的小猫咪好乖巧，这睁一只眼是在嫌弃人吗？哈哈哈哈哈

**感谢你的支持和阅读！祝阖家安康！财源滚滚🤑**

body.title: Mid-May Update From the Laughing Dragon Garden!
body.body:
How time flies, regardless of whether you're having fun or not!

Seems like we were just celebrating apple blossoms, and now we are well into late spring in the Laughing Dragon Garden. So, we are well past due for a garden journal update!

![3014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23u67UQypCGo81aK1aezpSY4Vx7yjGGuHs2c1bFYqo9sNXhu72pGxnUVqT8jU1gtg1gtW.jpg)
*I started rescuing \

pansies out of our lawn a couple of years ago, and now they are all over the garden!*

Although we got a bit of a late start this year — thanks to a couple of late cold spells and busy personal lives — it looks like we're on our way to having a great season!

Our raised beds underwent considerable soil improvement and *\
* from having several bags of enriched soil added to each, along with some chicken manure. Everything was thoroughly turned over and mixed and allowed to *\

* before planting and sowing began.

![3015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23xp6UYHTVYGnL8G3wUasg8PoQpNkzTxS5sfnuMFXxyzwhZMgXXPYxvFkMcdjxKBvfr91.jpg)

Meanwhile, the roses are starting to bloom, and one of them actually offered us up a surprise.

We had a lovely pink rose which got severely knocked back by a hard freeze, and in 2025 it did not flower at all... producing only lots of greenery. This year, however, it is full of buds and is setting lots of deep red flowers!

![3016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23w2jHMjyGgrMYepyMtV7nHzvQYY6wtzYuNkVkVwgt2PibFqzNxHytbPiWaHR6zQ8CrcV.jpg)
*Our formerly pink roses*

Our best guess is that it died back all the way to the root stock and it is now the root stock that is coming back up and flowering in the form of a deep red climbing rose. We are planning to *\

* it to grow all over the fence behind it.

Meanwhile, the herb bed is jumping!

![3017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23wWtovQA9qQsXvPUxWPjXyM8YV5Yfud4xHkkKfYL1xKNXLzrk3qNytc1QzVD7cWwV97R.jpg)

Herbs have consistently been the biggest success story in the Laughing Dragon Garden. They pretty much take care of themselves and keep growing and coming back year after year, some through self-seeding, and some simply because they're perennials.

Some marjoram that was on the property when we moved here has become one of our favorite forms of deer resistant ground cover.

![3019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23wqg8iHFKj2Abicfvs8NBZxHojByaB15SYi6Kt68wV1oqBNh8B3SYP8CA6YDoQNqbkve.jpg)

Although we're not really *\

* we let the chives Bloom because they attract lots of bees and other pollinators. Besides, the flowers are pretty and we can collect the seeds and get wild chives to grow all around the property. Which is a good thing, because they are *also* deer resistant!

![3021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23u633axPiXQYH9vKT3UPFnDSzu8grts1pYxVx2Boei29VvnGCBngXW6cgZc7TnqzZJPs.jpg)

I am particularly happy that my tarragon plant is doing as well as it is, having died back completely during the winter. Tarragon tends to be rather fickle and doesn't necessarily do well in our gray and damp northern climate.

Meanwhile, what *was* some extremely feeble and anemic winter spinach has suddenly decided to take off and grow with a vengeance, and now we suddenly have lots of fresh spinach this early in the season. 

![3022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/48XAj5NetqfPbAMeajJM4aR3B5CG45mzeEntUB7jgV5rmn7tieEXRYhLAt77QNxxMn.jpg)

In fact, there will be some for dinner tonight!

It's a little old and woody for salads, but definitely worthy of being turned into *cooked* spinach as a vegetable.

![3033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23x155uDJMtof5sJxdXCrtnB8iFvehgPwhpXpfbKNftoz8eKtEdFZmGXxbsFA5tMF5eYy.jpg)

The strawberries are doing quite well, and hopefully we should see the first ripe berries by mid-June.

We used some of the old plants, removing them completely from the bed, improving the soil and then replanting them, a technique that has been quite successful for several years.

![3023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/EoeDss69EQRErP27GYudBeRjBwsRqXMfkp1SpeKozo6mYU74pdpahzNnCeh4pvNMM8k.jpg)

We did add a few new plants in this year, as the *\

* are starting to become five to six years old, which is stretching our luck a bit. However they still seem to be producing quite well.\n\nThe thing about strawberries is that most of the modern hybrid varietals tend to revert to their *\

* state after about 3-4 years.

![3024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23xp4BzCvoerLGvWNP7iakekqdZkEzgfUqTFuW2cmEQ6QtvM3f94wTzxafCz4VYmTeV8y.jpg)

Meanwhile, this year's tomato plants are doing quite well! Unlike the ones we have gotten in past years, they don't seem to be suffering from *\
* which is certainly a welcome change!\n\nWe grow primarily Roma's which are really good for sauce, we're just a couple of plants providing the more conventional *\

* tomatoes.

![3025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23w2iyYdTPyZRb1z5zWcp5LsCEdD5xw1BQ1nidukJ7JN7eJPCoeaKqf6XsfX9ygZosstr.jpg)

We have actually *cut back* on the number of tomato plants we keep, following the great tomato overflow of 2021, where our 12 plants yielded something on the order of 120lbs *(50+ kg)* of fruit!

We're not big tomato eaters/users because we both have allergies to anything from the nightshade family.

![3026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23uFRhWZPMgARCtBAqRGaJc9RPgznrRTArizUdxViEFoy4xnhD6wG7XfBmDHizFrMEwpE.jpg)

So, those tiny little Sprouts in the pot *(above)* are my attempt at once again growing red peppers!

The last time I successfully grew hot peppers was in 2014, and they grew in virtually pure chicken manure and were extremely successful. Then our neighborhood association next the idea of people keeping chickens and nothing has been the same since.

I have tried growing them numerous times, but the end result has been a couple of small wrinkly peppers. Maybe this will be the year...!

![3027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23u69LVTGZVWTMxqH82brC8NKXRLWvJJs1uLJL7Pj2wmur8MRyUmAH68SPeguzWbNkezC.jpg)

We have a few winter squash plants that we purchased a small plants from a nearby nursery, and I'm also trying to grow acorn squash from seed. The latter are taking their sweet time but they have finally started sprouting.

Next, we have the beginnings of some fancy purple spotted pole beans that we bought on a whim while buying the plants at the nursery. We're growing these from seed. It's completely new to us, so we'll see.

![3030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23wC7QPQmXwMwJo7iGboejLyunDf1tvXvkVVRK6xHWXipR5byYgsmkyDDWJRrHDyPLPpc.jpg)

Sadly, our regular green pole beans — which normally are incredibly bountiful — all appear to have had the seeds rot in the ground without germinating. So we get to start over and the bean harvest will be a bit late this year.

![3029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/EoGw4jdpsPCNhrL24LiL8WpVHtDXfZ3xhhVJVQkV85kZ4pzkonVKcPyVhZjm6yB9Puq.jpg)

As always, we have a large volume of arugula *(also known as \

in some parts of the world)* and salad greens happening. At upper right you can *just* see some of the self-seeded arugula from last fall *(which is still going strong)* and although it's very peppery it adds a nice extra spice to our salads.

![3032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23wqbctCSNkkWfNdLV7GB5UhiPgLt9jPduRwNgNwe2RaPJH8PPLrciSLeHqoE2PPHBbmc.jpg)

Although we had lots of flowers on our apple trees, it's still a little early to be able to tell whether we're going to have a good apple crop this year. In fact, the tiny green apple pictured above was the only one I could find so far. Hopefully more will develop as the weeks and months roll on by.

![3028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23xARfmMXtYB57BDeFEnD7nAYwF3JBxmnBb2fazxiWsjTRxws6Q1FCg8y2xRTMHy2B1W5.jpg)

On a more fun front, we're growing more flowers this year. The picture above shows a long row of sweet peas that are going to hopefully be trained to climb up some netting on the side of the garage. It's a nice sunny location so they should give us some nice and fragrant flowers!

Normally, we have sunflowers in this bed... but those will have to be made a new home, this year!

![3031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/EoeEuiUepoVyRpejWwEfREjUR6jqTdpbq8MYgZP7AXeULbBccH2Gs8dssZmA2Zsd4Kz.jpg)

And here we have lots of seedlings in the starter pots, which are going to hopefully become some colorful zinnias!

Most of the rest of the garden is not far enough along to make for interesting content, but we should be ready for the next update within 7-10 days, especially if we have some more sunny and warm days.

Thanks for visiting — till the next one!

![silver hive logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23tS2gALUETDDPXZM8ToPDGinNTXWVbbNEarHfPS7gDLv9XGN5MdCJUUkNCEdF7j8kpgB.png)

![signature_5.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cosmictriage/23tvAw5hUvdo1QjSGQ8n4ve8RzDzE31KBx21qxrosoCYQ5cwp5giXc4aXxjuDBugQyFkZ.gif)
Thank you for reading, please share your thoughts because I love comments and then take a minute to look at the community of **[Silverbloggers](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316/created)** and join us if you think you qualify. *(If you think you qualify, you probably do!)* 

***All photos are my own!***

body.title: Creating Seamless Care Experiences with Integrated Telehealth Technology
body.body:
Healthcare is rapidly evolving with digital innovation reshaping how providers and patients interact. Among these advancements, integrated telehealth solutions have emerged as a powerful approach to delivering efficient, connected, and patient-centric care. Rather than functioning as standalone virtual consultation tools, integrated telehealth systems combine multiple healthcare technologies into a unified ecosystem that streamlines clinical workflows, improves patient experiences, and enhances healthcare outcomes.  
As healthcare organizations increasingly prioritize accessibility and operational efficiency, integrated telehealth solutions are becoming essential for hospitals, clinics, specialty practices, and healthcare networks seeking scalable care delivery models.  
**What Are Integrated Telehealth Solutions?**  
[Integrated telehealth solutions](https://www.osplabs.com/healthcare-provider-software-solutions/telehealth-software-solutions/) are comprehensive healthcare platforms that connect virtual care capabilities with existing clinical and operational systems. These solutions combine telemedicine functionality with electronic health records (EHRs), patient management systems, billing platforms, scheduling tools, wearable devices, and communication channels.  
Instead of managing disconnected applications, healthcare providers gain a centralized environment where patient data, consultations, prescriptions, and administrative functions operate together seamlessly.  
**Challenges in Telehealth Integration**  
Despite substantial advantages, healthcare organizations may encounter challenges during implementation.  
Common obstacles include:  
• Integration complexity with legacy systems  
• Regulatory compliance requirements  
• Data security concerns  
• Staff training needs  
• User adoption resistance  
• Infrastructure limitations  
A successful implementation strategy typically involves careful planning, interoperability standards, and scalable technology architecture.  
**The Future of Integrated Telehealth Solutions**  
The future of telehealth integration is likely to involve artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, wearable technologies, and personalized healthcare experiences. AI-powered systems may assist providers by identifying health risks, automating documentation, and improving treatment recommendations.  
As healthcare continues shifting toward value-based care models, integrated telehealth ecosystems will play a central role in delivering connected, efficient, and proactive patient care.  
**Conclusion**  
[Custom telehealth software solutions](https://www.osplabs.com/healthcare-provider-software-solutions/telehealth-software-solutions/) are redefining healthcare delivery by connecting technology, providers, and patients within a unified digital ecosystem. By streamlining workflows, improving accessibility, and supporting data-driven care, these systems help healthcare organizations meet evolving patient expectations while enhancing operational performance.  
Organizations adopting integrated telehealth solutions today are building a stronger foundation for the future of healthcare, where care is more accessible, coordinated, and patient-focused.

body.title: What Are My Plans If Hive Reaches $1?
body.body: > Hello everyone and welcome to my blog, So.... okay so let me just say this..... even typing it sef... Hive at $1 feels a little wild, like, I have to stop and actually imagine it for a second, so my first reaction? honestly, it would be that mix of i knew it! and wait, is this real? energy, so you know that feeling when something you believed in for so long finally starts making sense to the rest of the world? Yeah.....that. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpPBjKEy6PhQNEQR2sDw8FijQ2xcvfadTyt5AtMsHes7/1779260911174.png) But after the initial screaming into a pillow moment, I would actually sit down and think. Here's the thing I am not selling at $1, And I know that sounds a little stubborn but hear me out, the way I see it, $1 is not a destination, It is more like a confirmation, It is the market finally catching up to what those of us who've been here already know about this blockchain, selling at $1 would feel like leaving a party right when it is getting good, So yeah i'm powering up aggressively, if Hive hits $1, my first move is to stack more HP because that's where the real leverage is on this platform and yes be in profit a bit, maybe sell and buy back again. Now in terms of goals a $1 Hive would genuinely shift things for me,the content I create, the time I put into my posts, the curation I do , all of it starts to carry more weight, ehat I earn in a week could actually feel meaningful in a very practical, real life kind of way, I am not talking about quitting my job tomorrow or anything dramatic, but I would start treating my Hive activity more like a proper income stream and less like a side hobby I do between other things, that mental shift alone would change how seriously I show up here. ***Can Hive go beyond $1 though?*** Absolutely yes, and I do not say that just because I am invested , see I say it because the fundamentals are actually there, fee less transactions, fast blocks, a real community of people actually using the chain for something, most crypto projects are just vibes and white papers, Hive has people blogging, gaming, building apps, that is rare, $1 would just be like the first floor of a much taller building. But here is what I think people do not talk about enough none of this happens without the community, like, the price doesn't pump because of hype alone, it grows because people keep showing up, keep creating, keep engaging, every post, every comment, every upvote is a tiny vote for the ecosystem's survival, we are literally the product and the customers and the shareholders all at once, that is a crazy amount of power if we use it right. So yeah, If Hive hits $1, I celebrate for exactly five minutes and then I get back to building, because $1 is just the beginning of the conversation. ***Image Is Generated with Chatgpt*** ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

body.title: Around the City of Bandung
body.body:
Greetings 
How are you, my kind friends?. Thank you for the Wednesdaywalk inspired by @tattoodjay. A few weeks ago, while in the city of Bandung. I walked along several streets, such as Dewi Sartika street, Banceuy street, Pungkur street and Cikapundung street.


![IMG_20260520_090903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23zkrj7vi8zZsdt2SyawZTXgDaeCxwxty2EjvVtTc5c5AAgpZWuEg2eF5LFUDZRQUMvxW.jpg)




The road mentioned is a busy central area in Bandung. These streets are commercial areas, marked by several malls, supermarket and shops lining the streets. There is a shopping center, or as the locals call it the Kebon kelapa mall. 


![IMG_20260520_091000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/241tZ87UhUCUTpQVACaqwzSZzeGQ8ZuccTrQYmvKA4K44sUXVcXk299N6Q3RNEUu6zbWG.jpg)


![IMG_20260520_091156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/241tYsgBrVwzy3uRwcYMKQCskGiZyCjbTBv5Kb27PybC1a7fP3kCBBk2szGGgyHQjFywQ.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_091137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23z7GEcsUF22eg1MvzFBGfKYswm8gCFdVcsYcGhVu4RPvicr7Txwb8HxhzE393j4CfGvT.jpg)




Before the shopping center was built, this area was used as an inter provincial bus terminal. I used to come here often on the bus back to my hometown. A memory of the past. 

Dewi Sartika street functions like Pungkur street, as a commercial area. There are supermarkets and shope along the road. Street is taken from history, Dewi Sartika is a national Hero and is remembered as a main street.





![IMG_20260520_090847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23yTf8SJebKwtZ8azCswddAfGYaVcstwEN748i84aKqXkNLAtngKxzPTM4PjHHkn3i7JV.jpg)


![IMG_20260520_091210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23zknhrDVh6BuUcmUN9ZvGLoFi3fPDC62x8uSiY1tyDWaBySxdD4GNHBLKVRXancFQkYy.jpg)


After walking from Pungkur street and Dewi Sartika street. Then the destination is to go to the station past the Grand Mosque of Bandung. Past west Cikapundung street looks deserted during the day, with only a few vendors. In the afternoon and evening, the street is quite busy, with many culinary vendors. 


![IMG_20260520_090822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/2423wXziEAaJJHkz1GTjtRz4Ro2AWDS9QsK5p2VXMxCXkfTsEnPQ3xx66YVx617iNmEqq.jpg)





![IMG_20260520_090704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23tmBVVjWotR6zd1tDBfxiR8VA42Hf6vWYEr8KDHdoeotMvdVTkbjtnR5YzZY7Z7Nxn7E.jpg)

![IMG_20260520_090646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23x16wVw4HxE9efyqaWSJ6yEpUb3tyENDrfEUEA5Uah2dcaAi8degKctC4kbK6uKncdU2.jpg)


A shopping center was built long ago and is located at the end of west Cikapundung street. 

Banceuy street has been famous for a long time,it is a street that sells vehicle spare parts, as well as various decorative lamps. 


![IMG_20260520_090554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hsidik/23wqkB3hng8cYxwg8AdVbdvaHmsxkZLwTjCi4nUd28c6c5kMTvGngdKNftKKupB1hpZPE.jpg)

body.title: Old town and promenade of Cannes
body.body:
For almost every seaside town, there seems to be a pattern?
At the highest point, there is a fortified city, and outside its walls, houses from ancient times.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVGfb59i8Cb48uxf6m7gCfhnAG1fGciDobBJm5umZAc4t/1779220325952.jpg)

Further along, the city spreads out in three directions. It cannot only expand towards the sea (except for Monte Carlo, where construction experts build buildings in the sea).

Such is Cannes, a city on the Cote d'Azur known for the Cannes Festival and the red (or pink) carpet, on which the stars of the movie screen (or the stars of TV series) walk.

We have a clear plan when we walk around a city like this. 
First, while we are still rested and full of strength, we will climb to the highest part of the city.
The view of the city is always the most beautiful from that highest point, and it can often help us decide which way to go for a walk.

We came to Cannes by train and took a bus from the train station a few stops, to shorten the walking through the streets as much as possible to the first point on our tour plan today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXj88HsSDXKHPH4fFA2L9wSEoduLGcFNkENfVXck5zXP2/1779220371925.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc91DXjN5jTWeWL5b6a7N5T5ZxjiEMpa9ZJG1Pye8Xihb/1779220356046.jpg)

We got off the bus at the foot of Le Suquet, which represents the historic heart of Cannes - it's an older district located on the hill of Mont Chevalier above the Old Port.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUT3LKKMu2f6sCDHypCozfdpwGZEVvrFq8Cfvym471CwN/1779220406651.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKtUH4gDZU6VC8GLz8jLq6WkPnGp8R9VL59zbRQkLsWw/1779220406738.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPwE5Z2eXDUizeGjnuQP3Pagy5vHGSzHdkGNfAqRsZeyM/1779220406812.jpg)

The history of the settlement in this place is over 2,000 years long. From an ancient and Roman fortification, through a medieval monk's estate from the 12th century, to a traditional fishing village before the modernization of the city in the 19th century.

At the very top of the hill, there is the Place de la Castre, a lookout point with a 360° panorama of the Bay of Cannes and the city, medieval castle and museum. A former monastery from the 12th century, today it is an ethnographic and historical museum (Musée des explorations du monde).
There is also the recognizable 22-meter-high Tour du Suquet defensive tower from afar, as well as the Église Notre-Dame d'Espérance, a 17th-century late-Gothic stone church known for its summer music festival and acoustics.

One flight of stairs, another flight of stairs, a third flight of stairs... And that freshness and strength we had in our legs is slowly waning.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4g2F3BFqgAm967oXkejNxAhJSKSwALFbRk1qSaqVsw7/1779220425791.jpg)

Luckily, we didn't have any other, fourth steps, because the question is how to overcome them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUXkhYrxpKbxuKRfivPDwdt9yPAzneC8MnEpNGU31jQgo/1779220444512.jpg)

Climbing the hill, we walked into the beautiful old town.
Although steep and high, inaccessible and with a lot of stairs, I would like to live in a house like this on a hill.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaPv7DRciwHwdJSB6LrznRjf8EFf2KA9oMf3SkXWbvEp8/1779220471012.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZp1ST8Jn6vphrngD2F3sA2dZQeMMkTcJPcmxUvKBcs7S/1779220471115.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWb56C85uUC9DSRMxe5ob5VABDDAWMSijNdF1wMorKH5g/1779220471279.jpg)

Next to the plateau and the viewpoint from which there is a fantastic view of Cannes (that is, on one of its, slightly smaller half), and on which the name of the city is located.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWsUQsWVhLaScqdHP1rcePZVWBTkQdDSXZFNLK2rdTrVK/1779220534780.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeq57hfqkUdR24wvUHfdaBiZGKnCJgZNox5jiTsvJi6Xb/1779220561311.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPrSDB1MY1YJrpBHcZHwAYFqcBCt3XpuV3Sfi9KwKAbwC/1779220561586.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc6khYjhAdQAgFiETsV93EJD1i2anKGfHCdKc2X2B1uiJ/1779220561668.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3MpmHexFj4ihnSNWWL9Dv4Ne6hygdP6QroPtdMYx2u3/1779220577929.jpg)

There is a tower, the Église Notre-Dame d'Espérance de Cannes cathedral and the Musée des explorations du monde.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQDKcPo7PdApTV3ECKTEw5iUu1xV5JNq6MZDS4QvJUu12/1779220606380.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ24x2LJu3uwWoKEm6AMizTVuhedMrkAczVQtPzAp1moC/1779220606447.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY1uaGV6gjTPqvYBiy4gFknibpYFYvYTVTt1o3DvejDcs/1779220690590.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRjr5JNyFakPd5mG1Jhj1FdJ7973p1ehXwY7hZEdegMp/1779220690666.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNUE3kWo8B5VfxiK8fwgqG28PRD327bcMLFxGAKa1XbcV/1779226412613.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbA9wfN1ekrWfCd7vwoGwNFXBkCpLgExsZjcpNXwDwGQ6/1779220712507.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZK6reEPVw8bjFwR3CuMXNBqDYWGb3SVS6jnHH7YobBMb/1779220712587.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbDb86dvJQL1PbyzUDh8wX7rFDcCpNr1qsTxA4YjsDnof/1779220606499.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXa4Yatvs2A9Pswvd6gWtymyUvmH5BkvDisZESy94DKKg/1779220606566.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSejSFqMvsL2TvPS2JaUCRe5epuVJBE2mhUnGtHp6tvMn/1779220606634.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPMNFgeQeyVsmXvsBFYdwbKgyASVQK6WaaCrva2CMSmTa/1779220498592.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVA6ijazCrw1jjLc2y9HvEqpiXDqPn2J7rpPzWWJZcSw7/1779220498685.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUVYkYzrEt8bRKeVetXcsJ22wUGMaN5yHtB8ajxhUBGts/1779220498793.jpg)

We stayed for a short time in the park of the museum (there was no time to enter), took a few photos of the walls of the old town and entered the cathedral.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeXY5ZLHuVZCU61BmQTRkAwxEzgSitxm5M7Q9SBny35P/1779220638991.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMenwDvx2ifKUa325rFXLgZZ2G1PtqzWDpriSZbmS85w/1779220639102.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRTidGJPkefnBwCTApTQrY6VQv8bBzjV3YwonjfBDpxx/1779220639185.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRTmJtGd7uZWfKwc2vT6Z7hEgUeCqGqUMTazqAGvmxKpL/1779220639349.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYXut7QCzzxXQAsEjsBfpX68GWa2HYVgJS6V7Hdy8A1nw/1779220657862.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvc4qTuzMLJEaeZfnLXP5H1JNSPBi6V9X78SDtwNvnSy/1779220657951.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcVmtSyuw8amUQ3rtqGs9CcJiwPqN84HsVywvRZq8UgW9/1779220658026.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEkSPB2MUKW9KTNvixPhMN8CwBMqqkd3fLMCsRWPyr39/1779220658103.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeBNaHGfKV4Kj8pVYNsLSmjs4NfRLpu7zi13yyCpoGAwK/1779220690352.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZw1NzaR49GY4eVmAGodWL6Tkc1Br3kcMSFJJnmqjFXBu/1779220690426.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJFiKZmUwpqn1k41CXZF8WTVs95bA9mDV6GPT3EhYe4s/1779220690521.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwHGKBVtv9VuQ4rDUgmiKQFLzUBXhnDCHPFZdc3zzCkv/1779220712662.jpg)

Still rested, we didn't take a break and on some fourth, fifth and sixth steps, while passing by interesting gardens, sculptures and monuments, we went down to sea level.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcvmhNukR85pyPNy6Bn5GUKsYksxmpVkXYYfFtkL2bZ7n/1779226493733.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAPYy8ofgfHb6u7CQaGuiP5rHuZnFfeTCBFZsgTHzFcf/1779226493824.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJYMNhAXDRCGxoVrzd1ZM7G6WqicqfPxzXtpx9rV1gFs/1779226493918.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHPKgzr3qkzHr3eSX4u7WjMfjwrKZvhpuEbhj5DkgNAS/1779226494015.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRh3ZbSdY3ZjDG5b9NaCtcJQxNVTuSueTk3butwSowJ1f/1779226494126.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXW7g6B1Pb9cMHiA98s31GHkZrUFyUp3QJzhTLd3APAsu/1779226605196.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbimSgAjFqNTKNNMhZPqSJkgkTGSEYCyLrnP31PCgxxrn/1779226605295.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCJHS1nMFahVfSpr4YL891f2vJ44DAFuChnSQZG6Yb3P/1779226605379.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqJkCyGfpWtAZzyW7aqn1refiF23C8gNu5EB7z2UmFAX/1779226605462.jpg)

We came across the port of Cannes.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoE6gpRE4bu2JMam7J8UP5zQKXPxfgqVNutzvtmpAwq8/1779220735177.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcLtPkJUoSkUZvoeRdTShHwLfDD3dy9mqQjzsAfrsFPKg/1779220735283.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeu48QPEaDHfKh71YF1MQiPEjJQR5mycVwzaqoAKznADN/1779220735347.jpg)

Here, my attention was not attracted by yachts and ships, but by a few small houses.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCAusjSpCLEqG4PYAUogHzgWrK9puKcxPWssyWi6AMLr/1779220750980.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNochA3LzpHAVB7ujcFP5YK8517XsFwom7VAjeaNx5Q7J/1779220751073.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbj6BPjL6DgeT85L2Me95uAu4KBhoFoZA8w9Ptjpx8T7a/1779220751148.jpg)


At first I thought that these houses, with old photos of Nice fishermen, were there only as a reminder of some old times, when Cannes was a fishing village, but these are actually houses where fishermen keep their equipment and where they store their catch.

And not far from the area where hardworking fishermen prepare their nets for the next night, the promenade begins.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPj8hDtgGC5QC7GUmpDizYA3DvG7wSRnKeDSn1FRMWahr/1779220776330.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQr7ct83xDQmU4AUji5Qu6y8t4npK6H8rCGe73f7V2EXQ/1779220776414.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXbuvxueq1rkxgKorbRojeiwxhsq9o2AjdMVWQg9Y31mA/1779220776497.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVZBA4FuUG2DJDMKw3WSjNGUvFvbzT6YBrRcrqFqXRp2n/1779220776658.jpg)

Restaurants, fountains, hotels, an area with benches where you can rest, a covered summer stage. Everything that turns a walk through a city into a pleasure.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3nMUSYCtrezXsGAZXBF6VMkZfGojigN2SFipM2yZ4ha/1779220798119.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWngZGn8wxupBbG4Ly8cjNKx14QxXcj7uREAyyGaZgtAt/1779224940220.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTQTb2fT97KXGww82fXnHEGaT12P896isF3MD2Kip1vpA/1779220798209.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQw7webWny1YEhMmJE4QwFf4ETjtRwsxwcZK9tAcVNvsV/1779220798283.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmajAo8V5QL2nmyoSkrzG4VKr5ZkdtmFV3ZwtjrxBmE2z3/1779220825775.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZca1YF2NHrKf5MRy4XEWV3tUcQb1vtfp5WrqG1sFy4DQ/1779220825848.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc5jtfknz4rLHk7NkMH7jCChiAXiUoSUB7pe9HSeFgRP1/1779220825925.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoHLFyvSyaSnCGXP3JnQhgGgeoDMScjdfHs1WoQNXuF2/1779220826007.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmURRWo1wktVoyL7hre484Qk9ky5ChkCAR8ztrr21XYpEF/1779220826085.jpg)

I will not write about the Palais des Festivals et des Congrès de Cannes this time because you can see it in the [previous post](https://ecency.com/hive-163772/@duskobgd/french-riviera-cote-dazur-cannes-the-city-of-festivals).

But that's why I'm going to share with you the photos and the story of La Croisette, the famous promenade by the sea.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmap2cLKRVY1fGkg7A84ewJhFVjJUGKgRjjZTrXSkns4JN/1779220876653.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUXM7JmonisttB7tid3aP6gqdq3i4o9tjpcBCmLjf3ma/1779220876737.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKYCKPBCpwnzXY2oQqJDkATNQ8rvxZqZbUiL3UJQSFKM/1779220876802.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUThMyiDREnbd2CNBU62DcYwTqApFCEU7nALnDr2ycjF/1779220876864.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRioXrgqU6VQRgNPUmHKMsThK5nrqu7rSo7bi2gifiJHX/1779220876940.jpg)

The Promenade de la Croisette is an iconic boulevard in Cannes, about 3 kilometers long, that runs along the coast, connecting the historic district and the area with the Palais des Festivals in the west to the promontory and Port Canto marina in the east.
This boulevard is the social epicenter of the Côte d'Azur.
What used to be a narrow path by the sea coast, covered with stones and sand, in the middle of the 19th century, when the tourist potential of this region was recognized, the city began to develop rapidly.

A large number of British and Russian noble families were regular visitors to Cannes at the end of the 19th and the beginning of the 20th century, so in that period the city got some of its most famous buildings.

One of the most famous buildings in this part of the Cote d'Azur is the Hotel Carlton. 
Which is on all the Cannes maps.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcvg1EoMhCuKCPELejxJieXUM5ogsHe5mLq23CgS5e2qZ/1779220908655.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzL3QB6yBv3G8eNEnvNpgkMQmv9ciw4SfRDRvCcZgaYi/1779220908744.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmer2XeQABQuewXwDXCDzF6efccBwSrD2y8Ew99tRgXPLL/1779220908877.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdd58mTn4mBopZsNJ9vXip7teP48k1Zf6S6e1tPpTGnTy/1779220908985.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHCRDNyADSjaSG8MhhkfyekpaC7tsvUDBBMn5EQk73sW/1779220909073.jpg)

Built in 1911, the construction costs were financed by a nobleman of the Russian Imperial Romanov family.

The hotel has domes, for the construction of which the architects got the idea based on the breasts of the most famous French courtesan of that time, Caroline Otero, under whose name the hotel's restaurant operated for many years.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdymnuG8ChMvXavjK6ekAD5BARenXHkVQQPWX2i6GC68/1779220926206.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRipdGNJcvNvxS9fWskYHeYZ84EXfHMgJ72tDXVcmLzZ/1779220926329.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVHvK9bpC4hZnA7X3A6QUHUDrDhAbrLqf8tLeHtgaAoC/1779220926438.jpg)

In 1922, the first conference of the League of Nations (a meeting of the organization that was the forerunner of the UN) was held in the Carlton Hotel.

Until 1930, Cannes was a winter destination visited by the aristocracy from the north, however, in 1930, the Carlton management decided to leave the hotel open for guests during the summer, arranged a sandy beach and thus laid the foundation for summer tourism on the Cote d'Azur.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTR1JEty1G4YbbDd8jLpKnaSz5JpzWr1527pH37g8oELj/1779220947167.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf3S5C7NteeybXy8NNv6xh2YNXwVKEEWwJqPT8vJFjzju/1779220947255.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYv5JZvGBjtgcsB9jdyc3wdfMSJwydpuE8q3KgqE8Qt4v/1779220947366.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYg3E1zqr2Ems1RhHNucTwS3SikMGNeTfVRRVn1ZPqPq/1779220947451.jpg)


Today, on La Croisette, on those three kilometers, there are a large number of private beaches, with very high usage prices, and I'm glad that I'm in Cannes this Wednesday just for a walk and that I don't need the services of bars on the beaches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVPzkxc8CKSHow3z5eytkiHAAi3bJ8193qsMiESWUp1aB/1779220967892.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHAiCys5tZbMinSFDvAMeY5gf9ggZdoQEfLcG8tCnArU/1779220968072.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUXM7JmonisttB7tid3aP6gqdq3i4o9tjpcBCmLjf3ma/1779220968148.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYUcbeWMv9cVVbQbSHp67Vys59cWt3AmiWPqjczPwZY91/1779220968202.jpg)

In addition to the Carlton Hotel, along La Croisete there are many other famous buildings, hotels and private villas, as well as a large number of luxury brand shops.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexpYJuABfLYhTRUuaXwmCeApMda8c6SnS5MhoyWnkDdU/1779226010430.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTmTpneGwxutQgzWgvPakw4Q2YbUuRVn2j6G1LpLaMcL2/1779226010539.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSnFJSEZL3B8UREvshv5S5ujo5FvvtH2HwA7VNQz3x6J/1779226010643.jpg)
In the photo above, I caught a lot of soap bubbles
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBWUnnSShSg4UpejtY56msQXETEF6zz8zuZgfmJ642a3/1779226010736.jpg)
*Hotel Barriere Le Majestic (1926)*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcBjs5dsEGHoqZ48GbXgR7f44xPHZnNCJ3akhURDQwBpf/1779226068898.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyiTaUYbVpJEpdZR96XifQsEZsFjCKGHEpJa77kWc7y6/1779226069004.jpg)
*Hotel Splendid Cannes, the first hotel in Cannes built in 1871 in the Belle Epoque style*


It is interesting that there are chairs at every step of the set list, where you can rest, make a snack and enjoy the view of the sea. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdTJ7iBrfzkN3piSBadaNbkg6mDnBdpmF82tAeXy1mTi4/1779226129982.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSn3X54Qx7C3fzPrnmV7CntbyzEv72WDA8hC1277WkNpa/1779226130088.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsKYXAz86LfrsPZhghVovsv9w6JbLBSEemtpgeVRPYdk/1779226130175.jpg)

On one such break, I made this shot, a boat hiding behind the Hyde sign of a private beach.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPU7MyBMi9RzikNuHW3ACpUhoBjcjkntmqRWeKrFgUas/1779220967981.jpg)


We ended our walk around Cannes with a tour of the central streets and shops, because you should buy something for yourself in Cannes, and what kind of Serbs would we be if we didn't take a walk through RUE des SERBES, a wide boulevard that leads to the train station.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2rwnuaF1aayc6MDzYieE3Api5JDmUMdWt8eBDbEG6Bz/1779226758960.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfWZUqV3fPdJVgvycRjN9LspsTjJMEZBq6Y2FAvpgk13g/1779226759077.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf8WwTYkbfLuRHFxLDnWVyw7Vbv5XMeYq8DUnPymbF8Yq/1779226759155.jpg)

We finished #wednesdaywalk, boarded the train and drove away from Cannes.

body.title: Project Hail Mary (2026) || Movie Review
body.body:
![1000111163.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23vhyikGRnrHdKeQDRAFmYnVvyMkBVw34ZFWTVXoTWsb1dSNt2LxEfsKxo9BqedDcqDbb.jpg)
I'm always skeptical of movie adaptations of popular books, especially ones I've read because creators often cut important scenes or make changes that contradict the spirit of the original story. Usually, it's the readers that end up disappointed. The book version of *Project Hail Mary* has received positive ratings on Goodreads and although it's been sitting on my TBR for a while, seeing the trailer made me nervous. Fortunately, those doubts disappeared once I watched the movie. **Project Hail Mary(2026)** is an American sci-fi directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller based on Drew Goddard's screenplay of the popular novel of the same name by Andy Weir. It stars Ryan Gosling as the lead actor, Sandra Hüller, James Ortiz, Lionel Boyce and other supporting actors. ![1000111155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoAYjJqdTRbSfdRdo9LxM4MbNp8rxJWhRpwdAtzgQwjD1eR33bhZf7ATyAhepSQJiMZ.jpg) The opening scene shows Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) waking up from a deep sleep with medical wires attached to his body and tube in his mouth. A robotic voice announces that he's awake. He pulls out the tube, coughs and rolls off the bed. He can't remember who he is, why or how he's in the spacecraft. Then he discovers the bodies of his two dead astronauts and in confusion goes through their luggages. ![1000111156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23xARfo7XBkmaU49hXzsk99c9ugZycBoCsEbjMt2rN7dYtm7ffYiuER9TT1AcBbyT5Fsm.jpg) ![1000111161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Eo6J4TZTdpiEp6SByWbNF41kg7Buk9foNuZHgdXfBMwhLC3gfGnE3cKEWrdzjjRGy7F.jpg) While playing around with the buttons of the craft, his memories start to return bit by bit. In flashbacks, he was recruited by Eva Stratt (Sandra Hüller) because of an infection draining the sun and causing the celestial body to die. If not stopped, Earth would cease to exist. Since he's the only living person in space who can help, he pilots the spacecraft further into space until he comes across another craft. There's an alien in it who is on a similar mission to save his world. Can they work together to save their worlds? #### My Review And Rating Not many cinephiles are drawn to sci-fi movies because their plots are science-driven and packed with technical terms and concepts that are sometimes difficult to understand and follow. But *Project Hail Mary* is a movie that adds humor, friendship and heart to science fiction adventure. The plot is brilliant and fascinating, fixated on the idea of planets working together in harmony to make life better. ![1000111162.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EowFCWHLNd5p6rMRBDuaNubrQHRes9RVnEnJ1Lz5gwikzo6iKeAa2yuTc4avvLsnvTN.jpg) ![1000111158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EogLPrMhkuaxHdM1ANaA4UoiHrs4uCwKVUu5nnaM8PwobisJRcqjPEAUagNr6Mi7JYF.jpg) I think the adaptation of Andy Weir's book was well done even though I have not read it yet. I'm not surprised if some parts of the book were trimmed out in the movie yet it doesn't negatively impact it. I expected viewers would be bogged down with many science details or terms but it wasn't so. The storytelling is seamless and the problem—the infection and decline of the sun—is easily understood by any adult who watches it. ![1000111157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoAZDVdU5QdEdE1vihF2AK2STLdXuz3ceJ5wWJDewCEboUkM1DSY4KNkRJVaJ4dZgHv.jpg) ![1000111159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Eoc6ckmCG1LHBSmLsPteT8cpZcDg5SwAqeMJ3SxYjX4NxLDkoYBtzr1YB41teVrrGKJ.jpg) The only flaw I see is the slow pacing at the beginning where it's just Ryan Gosling alone in the spacecraft either speaking to himself or roaming around without doing much. I almost got bored until the extraterrestrial being came into the movie. Also, the ending was unnecessarily stretched. The cast's performance is outstanding, especially Ryan Gosling. He's charismatic as an A-list actor and uses that charm to endear the audience. He brings humor into every dialogue and shows a kind of vulnerability in his relationship with Rocky that is touching. Every expression and word portrays a kind of emotional honesty that feels real and you want to love him for it. As the only living astronaut in space with no hope of returning home, he played his role perfectly. His bromance connection with Rocky is what gives this movie a heart. We are focused on the science but quickly remember that beyond all the infection hassle are two beings looking to connect and save their worlds. I love how the directors slowly build the relationship between the two. Their interactions, curiosity and discoveries aren't rushed and feel real. ![1000111160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EppJjMcsKCJ7ReCjJigebawXzApXAjKQr9m39p5zY5njWsnR3WMUeUFMnepPBb57JuP.jpg) The cinematography is beautifully done. The visuals and transitions are stunning. The move between the present and the flashbacks are smooth except for the scene where Rocky tries to save Grace. The red, blinking flashes are a little uncomfortable to watch. Rating this movie, I'd give it 7.5 stars out of 10. It's a fine adaptation that commits to the themes of hope in the midst of despair, friendship and connection to save the world. It's worth watching and I'd recommend it to all sci-fi fans. https://youtu.be/m08TxIsFTRI?si=cgUhnp8aoolh8OD- ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are screenshots from the movie* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Proyecto_Salvaciaon-366657509-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

Hello hive gaming community, how are you all? I hope are well by the grace of Almighty Allah. Today i have a new gaming vedio the division resurgence. the division resurgence the game was very popular on PC and it was a very interesting game.I used to play that game in my free time.The game was interesting because it was based entirely on mission.Although games are for entertainment but we can often understand and learn a lot from games.Although the games are made for entertainment, in reality countries around the world have stockpiles of such weapons and this is how they fight.


Games are realistic and when they use sophisticated torture, it reminds me of the Iran-US war.These days, when you play games, it seems like there are more terrible things happening in different countries of the country.Only by playing games can I understand how dangerous real weapons are.War never brings anything good.


This is how to kill the enemy and the strategy of war.Here you have to survive and kill the enemy.This is a land campaign and frontal war, but here you have to move forward strategically.Each mission has a different challenge, so the player never gets bored. In addition, the game has the opportunity to get new events and rewards every day, which increases the interest in playing regularly.


One of the most interesting things is that the game developers have made the game in such a way that it is perfectly optimized for low-end devices.In the game, you can create your own clan as you wish and add members to that clan.The game has different modes such as team deathmatch,free for all,defuse the bomb,arms race tournament,kill confirmed etc.I really like playing this game and this game will make you concentrate a lot.


The graphics of the game are very beautiful and the sounds are very nice and the control system in it is very nice and good, which will make a player fall in love with it the first time they play it.Each weapon in the game has a different gun sound and damage system, making the game feel much more realistic.The game has a multiplayer mod system.If you want, you can play this game with friends in multiplayer mode.There are many maps in the game. Today i have a new gaming vedio the division resurgence. the division resurgence the game was very popular on PC and it was a very interesting game.I used to play that game in my free time.The game was interesting because it was based entirely on mission.Although games are for entertainment but we can often understand and learn a lot from games.Although the games are made for entertainment, in reality countries around the world have stockpiles of such weapons and this is how they fight.


Games are realistic and when they use sophisticated torture, it reminds me of the Iran-US war.These days, when you play games, it seems like there are more terrible things happening in different countries of the country.Only by playing games can I understand how dangerous real weapons are.War never brings anything good.


This is how to kill the enemy and the strategy of war.Here you have to survive and kill the enemy.This is a land campaign and frontal war, but here you have to move forward strategically.Each mission has a different challenge, so the player never gets bored. In addition, the game has the opportunity to get new events and rewards every day, which increases the interest in playing regularly.


One of the most interesting things is that the game developers have made the game in such a way that it is perfectly optimized for low-end devices.In the game, you can create your own clan as you wish and add members to that clan.The game has different modes such as team deathmatch,free for all,defuse the bomb,arms race tournament,kill confirmed etc.I really like playing this game and this game will make you concentrate a lot.


The graphics of the game are very beautiful and the sounds are very nice and the control system in it is very nice and good, which will make a player fall in love with it the first time they play it.Each weapon in the game has a different gun sound and damage system, making the game feel much more realistic.The game has a multiplayer mod system.If you want, you can play this game with friends in multiplayer mode.There are many maps in the game. You can play on any map you want or like.But this game is very exciting to play.

body.title: 지식재산권 전쟁의 타임라인: 특허소송 과정의 5단계 흐름과 대응 전략
body.body:
2026년 현재 인공지능, 첨단 바이오, 이차전지 등 고도화된 기술 혁신이 시장을 주도하면서 기업 간의 지식재산권(IP) 분쟁은 단순한 법적 공방을 넘어 기업의 사활이 걸린 경영 전략의 핵심이 되었습니다. 피땀 흘려 개발한 독점적 기술을 경쟁사가 무단으로 침해하거나, 반대로 자사의 신제품이 경쟁사로부터 허위·과장된 특허 침해 공격을 받을 경우 법적인 해결책인 '특허소송'은 피할 수 없는 전장이 됩니다.

그러나 특허소송은 일반 민사소송과 비교했을 때 기술적 전문성과 고도의 법리적 논증이 결합되어 있어 그 과정이 매우 복잡하고 방대합니다. 소송의 각 단계마다 적절한 조치를 취하지 않으면 막대한 손해배상 책임을 지거나 어렵게 확보한 원천 기술을 시장에서 빼앗길 위험이 있습니다. 지식재산권 분쟁의 시작부터 종결까지의 핵심 특허소송 과정을 명확히 이해하고, [도아특허사무소](https://doahip.com/)와 같은 전문 법률 파트너와 함께 각 단계별 전략을 어떻게 수립해야 하는지 명확히 분석해 드립니다.

**1단계: 소송 전 분쟁 탐지 및 경고장 발송 (Pre-Litigation)**

특허소송이 법원에서 본격적으로 개시되기 전, 침해 사실을 인지한 특허권자는 철저한 사전 조사와 증거 수집 단계를 거쳐야 합니다. 경쟁사 제품을 분해·분석하는 리버스 엔지니어링(Reverse Engineering) 등을 통해 자사 특허의 청구범위(Claims)와 상대방 제품의 기술적 구성을 일대일로 비교하는 침해분석(Claim Chart 작성)이 이 단계에서 이루어집니다.

침해 정황이 확실시되면, 특허권자는 일반적으로 침해 행위의 즉각적인 중단과 합의를 요구하는 '경고장(Cease and Desist Letter)'을 발송합니다. 경고장을 수령한 피고 측은 당황하여 즉각적인 반응을 보이기보다는, 즉시 도아특허사무소의 전문가를 통해 해당 특허의 유효성을 검토하고 '문언침해'나 '균등침해' 성립 여부를 냉정하게 따져봐야 합니다. 소송 전 단계에서의 영리한 협상과 방어 전략 수립은 본격적인 법정 싸움으로 번지기 전에 분쟁을 조기에 종결시킬 수 있는 가장 비용 효율적인 기회입니다.

**2단계: 소장 제출 및 답변서 접수 (Pleadings)**

사전 협상이 결렬되거나 조기 합의가 불가능하다고 판단될 경우, 원고(특허권자)는 관할 법원에 특허권 침해금지 및 손해배상 청구 소송을 제기하며 본격적인 소장(Complaint)을 제출합니다. 소장에는 원고가 보유한 특허권의 요지, 피고 제품이 특허를 침해한 구체적인 사실 관계, 그리고 이로 인해 발생한 경제적 손해액의 규모가 명시됩니다.

소장을 송달받은 피고는 법원이 정한 기한(통상 30일 이내) 내에 답변서(Answer)를 제출해야 합니다. 이 답변서에서 피고는 침해 사실을 부인하거나, 원고의 특허 자체가 기존에 존재하던 기술(공지기술)로부터 쉽게 발명될 수 있어 무효라는 '특허 무효의 항변'을 제기하게 됩니다. 이 초기 서면 공방 단계에서 사건의 핵심 쟁점과 향후 소송의 방향성이 결정되므로, 양측 모두 법리적 뼈대를 완벽하게 구축해야 합니다.

**3단계: 본안 전 가처분 신청 및 증거조사 (Discovery & Preliminary Injunction)**

특허소송은 최종 판결이 나오기까지 수년이 걸릴 수 있기 때문에, 원고는 본안 판결 전에 피고 제품의 생산 및 판매를 긴급하게 중단시키기 위한 '침해금지 가처분(Preliminary Injunction)'을 신청하는 경우가 많습니다. 가처분이 인용되면 피고는 소송 중에 제품을 팔 수 없어 치명적인 타격을 입게 되므로, 피고 측은 가처분 심문 단계에서부터 사력을 다해 방어해야 합니다.

동시에, 소송의 성패를 가르는 가장 중요한 단계인 '증거조사(Discovery)' 절차가 진행됩니다. 특히 영미권 국가의 에드버서리(Adversary) 제도나 국내법상의 증거 수집 절차를 통해, 양측은 상대방의 내부 기술 문서, 이메일, 연구노트, 회계 장부 등 소송과 관련된 방대한 자료를 강제적으로 교환하게 됩니다. 도아와 같은 전문 기관은 이 증거조사 과정에서 자사의 핵심 기술 비밀은 철저히 보호하면서도, 상대방의 침해 고의성이나 구체적인 매출 자료를 확보해 재판에서 유리한 고지를 점할 수 있도록 핵심 증거를 선별하는 전략을 실행합니다.

**4단계: 변론 기일 및 청구범위 해석 (Markman Hearing & Trial)**

증거조사가 완료되면 법원은 본격적인 변론 기일을 열고 양측의 주장을 심리합니다. 특허소송에서 가장 독특하고도 중대한 분쟁 요소는 바로 '특허 청구범위 해석(Claim Construction)'입니다. 특허 문서에 적힌 단어와 문장의 법적·기술적 의미를 어떻게 정의하느냐에 따라 침해 여부가 완전히 뒤바뀌기 때문입니다.

법원은 이를 위해 별도의 심문 기일(미국 기준 마크맨 청문회, Markman Hearing)을 열어 각 기술 용어의 범위를 확정합니다. 청구범위 해석이 끝나면 사실상 승패의 윤곽이 드러나는 경우가 많습니다. 이후 진행되는 본안 재판(Trial)에서는 기술 전문가들이 증인으로 출석하여 판사나 배심원을 상대로 해당 기술이 왜 특허를 침해했는지, 혹은 왜 침해하지 않았는지를 프레젠테이션과 감정을 통해 증명하는 치열한 공방이 전개됩니다.

**5단계: 판결 및 불복 상소 (Judgment & Appeal)**

모든 변론과 증거조사가 마무리되면 재판부는 최종 판결을 내립니다. 판결의 결과는 크게 세 가지 형태로 나타납니다.

침해 인정 및 손해배상: 피고의 침해가 인정될 경우, 피고 제품의 생산·판매 금지 명령(영구적 침해금지 청구)과 함께 원고가 입은 경제적 손실 및 피고가 얻은 부당 이익에 대한 배상 명령이 내려집니다. 고의적 침해가 인정될 경우 징벌적 손해배상이 적용되어 배상액이 수배로 늘어날 수 있습니다.

비침해 판결: 피고 제품의 기술 구성이 원고의 특허 범위에 속하지 않는다고 판단되면 피고가 승소합니다.

특허 무효: 피고의 무효 항변이 받아들여져 원고의 특허 자체가 처음부터 없었던 것으로 무효화될 수 있습니다.

1심 판결에 불복하는 당사자는 고등법원이나 특허법원(특허 전문 상소법원)에 상소(Appeal)를 제기하여 다시 한번 시시비비를 가릴 수 있습니다. 상소심은 새로운 증거를 찾기보다는 1심 판결의 법리적 오류를 잡아내는 싸움이므로, 더욱 정교한 특허 법리 분석이 요구됩니다. To get more details, please contact:

I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. links.title: Dear Gold: An Apology
links.body:
# Dear Gold: An Apology

I owe you an apology.

For two years I told anyone who would listen. Gold. Own gold. The Fed will capitulate, real yields will roll over, the dollar will soften, central banks in Beijing and Riyadh and Ankara are already loading up — you just had to be patient. And then it worked. $3,000, $4,000, $5,000 an ounce. The first full week above five grand happened at the end of February, right before the bombs fell on Tehran. Operation Epic Fury. The market called it the ultimate safe-haven moment. Gold at $5,275. Every newsletter from here to Zurich was composing their victory lap.

And then the metal looked the war directly in the face and decided to sell off.

It's now at $4,550, give or take. Down roughly 13% from that peak. While Brent crude trades near $100 a barrel, up 44% since the Strait of Hormuz went dark. An active war in the Persian Gulf, 14.5 million barrels a day of Gulf production knocked offline, aluminum getting scarce because the Gulf accounts for a sixth of global supply, fertilizer chains fraying because ammonia needs natural gas and natural gas needs the Gulf — and gold, the asset you are legally required to love during geopolitical crises, is bleeding out.

I need to explain this, partly to you, partly to myself.

The metal doesn't care about headlines. It never did. Gold cares about one thing above everything else: real interest rates. And what the war has done — perversely, catastrophically for the gold thesis — is destroy the rate cut story completely. Before the bombs, the market was pricing two or three Fed cuts by year-end. Inflation was cooling. The terminal rate looked like it had a ceiling. Gold had a clean tailwind. Then Brent went from $70 to $100 over ten weeks, producer prices in Japan came in at 4.9% versus a 3% estimate, U.S. consumer inflation hit a three-year high, and the CME FedWatch tool now shows zero cuts as the dominant scenario for all of 2026. More than that: market-implied odds of a Fed *hike* now exceed those of a cut. Read that again. The next policy move in the United States of America, according to derivatives pricing, is more likely to be up than down.

Real yields went with it. And gold, which generates no income and competes directly against the 30-year Treasury at 5.2%, had no answer.

This is the part that should embarrass every macro pundit who has spent three years constructing elaborate geopolitical arguments for why this time, finally, the old monetary order was breaking down. The dollar would lose reserve currency status. De-dollarization was a structural secular trend. Central bank gold buying was the harbinger. All of it was true, sort of. Central banks are still buying. The dollar's share of global reserves fell to a 30-year low. The framework wasn't wrong. The timing was. The war that was supposed to validate the thesis has instead turbo-charged exactly the monetary dynamic — sticky, energy-driven inflation forcing a hawkish Fed — that most reliably suppresses the metal.

Morgan Stanley's Amy Gower put it plainly: when the energy shock reduces hopes for lower interest rates, gold struggles as a safe haven. Goldman's commodity team, Daan Struyven's crew, are still calling $5,400 by year-end. Seventy percent of central banks at their recent conference expect global gold reserves to rise. The structural bid is real. But right now, structural bids are losing to the interest rate calculator.

And here's where it gets genuinely interesting, or genuinely nauseating depending on your positioning.

The macro setup today is almost a laboratory for testing what kind of shock gold actually needs. You want inflation? You have it — energy-driven, commodity-chain-disrupted, three-year high on CPI. You want geopolitical terror? You have a war, a closed strait, drone strikes on Saudi refineries, nuclear facilities in the UAE taking hits. You want fiscal recklessness? The U.S. just passed a bill adding $3.8 trillion to the debt, Moody's stripped the AAA rating a year ago, the 30-year Treasury hit 5.2%. You want dollar weakness? Reserve share at a 30-year low.

What you don't have — what gold actually needs — is the fourth ingredient: a credibility break. A moment when the market stops believing the Fed can or will handle the inflation. The 1970s under Arthur Burns wasn't just high inflation, it was inflation that the Fed was seen as too weak or too political to fight. The 2020 pandemic boom wasn't just stimulus, it was a period when nobody believed institutions could anchor expectations. Gold needs the system to look broken, not just stressed. Right now, perversely, the war has made the Fed look more necessary, not less. Yields are rising *because* the market expects the Fed to act if inflation stays hot. That's a functioning credibility regime. It kills gold.

Meanwhile, tonight, Jensen Huang will get up in front of an earnings call and report somewhere north of $79 billion in quarterly revenue, a 14th consecutive beat, and the market will decide whether the AI story — now carrying a $5.4 trillion market cap and described by one analyst as representing nearly 16% of U.S. GDP — can sustain a bid in an environment where the 10-year sits at 4.7%. The hyperscalers have collectively committed potentially $700 billion in capex for 2026, most of it flowing to NVDA. The Blackwell architecture is ramping. The Rubin architecture is being announced. A trillion-dollar order book through 2027.

The GPU and the gold bar are not obviously connected. But they are both expressions of the same root question: does the future justify its price? For gold, the answer right now is that the future it was betting on — lower rates, softer dollar, crumbling institutional trust — keeps getting delayed by the very crisis that was supposed to deliver it. For Nvidia, the question is whether $79 billion a quarter is the floor, and whether a 5.2% long bond yield eventually forces even the most bullish hyperscaler CFO to do the same math everyone else is doing.

The war gives you the oil spike. It gives you the inflation. It gives you the geopolitical terror.

It didn't give gold the one thing it needed.

And as the Strait of Hormuz stays dark, oil stays above $100, the Fed stays frozen at 3.5–3.75%, and the most expensive company in human history prepares to report its quarterly earnings into a bond market screaming about the cost of money — the thing I find most striking is how little the system looks like it's breaking.

Stressed. Strained. Running hot on every circuit.

But not broken. Not yet.

I'm sorry, gold. The thesis wasn't wrong. The world just isn't obliging.

links.title: My Wednesday Walk Around Alnick Gardens, Northumberland, UK
links.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmY32xndUemJdU82B4vusme2S7ntdvCNoCbopkTezvz6cp/InCollage_20260519_181837272~2.jpg

While on a recent trip to Northumberland, UK, we visited Alnwick Gardens, a popular visitor attraction known for its beautifully designed gardens.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTkWaFtoZMMiGvjbQ1NgkBLhzfpxoBjxngBYv2Wih5tc/Messenger_creation_59BC2151-0A24-4C34-A9E1-A7C346A1E3A4~2.jpeg

This is my #wednesdaywalk initiated by @tattoodjay.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmegjfpaTktojKQRv5gKYENrTYYNiDzcotxoyXtQqaxnvN/Messenger_creation_AEF220AA-DE18-4161-93ED-288F7DDF6355~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmbQvcWKeeX7eamHoetjK46sno4XmEEuwvd1Qt8tKmfxbx/Messenger_creation_38FCEBDA-3AD7-46BD-A897-D15EA4D51115~2.jpeg

It is part of the larger Alnwick Estate, near Alnwick Castle. The site covers several acres and has a range of themed areas, making it an interesting place to explore.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmW566WRhg4FVqbUrrJJ1joZn5bAisbk9EM3Jhz2zqwiMM/Messenger_creation_166C79BE-730F-4FEF-A753-CF770D97E974~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYKB5BYtqWPttfSoCK6PM2gBVwCasbBQvy9eiLsNdgECE/Messenger_creation_ED7DB8DD-495F-4514-B84E-C35342CB0FEB~2.jpeg 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRoA4gK7UM1ayoewFWGZ4adbZexv83f8vtFqghsBuvxJd/Messenger_creation_E6E67CC0-BD33-4C47-BAEA-813A7C5EA152~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVh1LEzWEXZzotYiACLfd5Fpzwy9kcazmnePHQgkSzAcv/Messenger_creation_B3AAE3E4-BEC4-4D08-9674-FE17EBA18775~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRbKr9k7WNPibUmyXDpzmB9QnPrt4wP4YxYYAqC8UNpc/Messenger_creation_24421B6C-3A08-4A6B-BDF0-7B250FB078CA~2.jpeg

One of the main features is the Grand Cascade, which is a large set of water fountains and pools. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcfzK2sjNMEn6FiSLNw9U4ZEcLZt7hMEkhyWRmBfYuDhF/Messenger_creation_8F68A165-604A-44BB-AD55-F028C90F0857~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmNa1Piy1QPw4PWWNmdt9cS2Q81kg7jrrJR2aZA5t5x5rE/Messenger_creation_2CB58D02-611D-46CA-9697-6C2991171A00~2.jpeg

A mallard duck had taken up residence in one of the pools.  If there is any water about, a duck will be there!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYh6eGt32QEvz1gnzZJCVETW1qmcs8HceVm4VvSVvHUFv/Messenger_creation_49ECA49D-EC2D-4E72-82CE-5BBBA5AAE7DE~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYctQo9yMYd5kHe3FMRNEW2GPahmCN8MECyHAeDcGDKFN/Messenger_creation_7158793E-44F8-475D-B6D2-B51D30210DC8.jpeg

There is also a treehouse section. The Treehouse Restaurant is built among the trees and connected by wooden walkways. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYtnJS49QoHiu67QGPiV3B9Ba6dpt9MKNvkmj9GeQkxj8/Messenger_creation_A96EB91A-78C6-4205-BCD1-E30AB2A0AFA9~2.jpeg

Another well known part is the Poison Garden. This area contains plants that are harmful or toxic. Visitors can only enter on guided tours (I wonder why?) 😄  We gave it a miss in favour of prettier things.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwCS2koGMWvVKGPgRKQt9JqTqQYGC664DS4x8Tgz1h6G/Messenger_creation_42E12B1B-A151-417F-8034-D7598D17E5FE~2.jpeg

The gardens also include a rose garden, a bamboo labyrinth, and open lawns. There are areas for children to play in, so there's something for everyone.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRBuVZC4UUwiSoTh9VGQgddQfvDJFHL4QBgpuzsgXRDkA/Messenger_creation_B0FDD63B-2BB5-421B-9112-DC3CDF8494A1~2.jpeg

We really enjoyed walking around the different areas of the gardens. The weather was fairly mild, which was good. There were plenty of places to stop and sit to take in the views. Overall, Alnwick Gardens is a mix of traditional gardens and modern attractions.
