links.title: Learn how to cut and sew a beautiful flair dress.
links.body:
# Hello Hive



![1000215214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uQvsEp7b1UYziQAnScRTLJaongjPGEzSuNGWRvg1FYzaXrBG6yXhrEKyfpokLCMFqXT.jpg)

Happy new day to us all. I hope that we all had a peaceful night rest. 
It's yet another day to arise and shine. And I want to share with the community this beautiful flair dress I was able to cut and sew yesterday

![1000215211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wqpj6Zt6dc7NppKrRT2FUtKPwJtjxhQZD4VvkvtJ9uM2cLocrbbaE7JvLacLEnQRYbL.jpg)

I was lucky enough to get back home early enough from the farm yesterday and just before it became dark I decided to sew this beautiful flair dress. Usually whenever it's time to wear a native wear in church I always get caught unprepared. Every end of the month is thanksgiving service in church and to this  effect we must all appear in traditional wear. We love to celebrate in our traditional wear. Due to the load of my work I may not remember to make me a dress ready as at when the time will come hence I decided to start a gradual process of preparing for this outfit. 



![1000215226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFXjoDo46HajqnbaSmDUXpP5nw79KdsYNJGCaYiceHoFN1Gb7MKUNnjejkQb1gTwe4J.jpg)

I have this fabric that had remained from an outfit I have made for my sister earlier, after much delibration on which design to make of it I decided to sew me a flair dress again since this is something that often fits me so well and which I find it comfortable to wear. Compared to wearing tight fitted corsets and bustier this is the simplest comfy design of traditional wear you can get out here.


I started with cutting all the various pieces out from the flair part to the flair and the corresponding linings 


![1000215238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/243fp7Aqng42nMsknhe4MCp3eZMmfRtkKkepPSMzRC2oK9WFBXX6rG7WC5VSPCt8vNW55.jpg)




When I started stitching it, I noticed that the linings and the flair weren't properly cut and was giving me some hard time staying fitted, I had to losing the stitches and recut here 


![1000215189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/243BZnTLp2F7FDvYp9RcxWqdoTEDtGNjrTJUKTWqNWApikFAtrN1QNneeAV31e9BG5JtZ.jpg)

Then I stictched the front block first using a size 6 measurements 


![1000215259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23yJNh8CyBQwzH4r7G4jWoiRK8cU6K9DjmYrqpcs1Lzrdz7SFscndJx3afEcFdNdu3iKE.jpg)

Much ironing is needed to flatten these seam lines 


![1000215253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoAah73H6p51rbf2LcMpYVTSvv6kKf1GQ1Cb4E4nxEMidXmyLXHnSAQeAVzi6Kk72if.jpg)

Next was the stitching of the back block 


![1000215244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EpVCWkxSBBLDpEBQjjVBkK3AgpZ1BmQdwj46iKzjRMQvzEix72SJKXwZYYipLAt7ATF.jpg)


-----

![1000215247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Ep3fmbc2gCAtQTPF634CJYNMWE7Heb5Qevf8mTYYTkkjLuEMkZgJXJWxKtQFmZMgZGc.jpg)


Having done that, it is often commendable to check the fitting of your outfit while sewing midway. This will enable you to correct any cutting and sewing errors before the dress is finally completed. 

Check the shoulder, busy and waist and ensure that they are fitted 


![1000215262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoK8JjH2qeKGjJLSqvgAVQfdARURZJMz8w1yHBgmknqcqfPAxBCSsnfwXse2gkGGZ7Z.jpg)


The final step was joining the lower flair part to this upper part, which I did and here is the result of what we have 



![1000215192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zGW4A7JvLG8w2DsZ513kUWUYEEuVBWoPrvnXLtKRtUy4sjGrReKnLMyYcCngbkSxsvY.jpg)


I made an assymmettric neckline for the dress but the one challenge I am having now is deciding a sleeve design that will match this outfit. 
Suggestions are welcome please. Sometimes I get too many sleeve idea in my head but deciding on which one will match the design of a dress is usually a challenge.

links.title: Sound Made Visual: Creating Music-Reactive 3D Shapes
links.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779259192001-b7d2dd137aad38b0.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=corpsekaizen/af999616)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=corpsekaizen/af999616)


---

Some Tinkering and you can check how much reactive this visual is to sound:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yszdWyykxTk

TouchDesigner is a visual programming tool that lets you create real-time interactive visuals without writing traditional code. Instead of typing commands, you connect colored boxes, called \

, together, and each node performs one specific job.

This is how the network looks with the base shape. You may notice that the visual above is completely different—I just used a bloom effect and feedback, then composited it. If you are new, you may not know, but the idea is to understand how the visuals work. They move from the basic shape of a circle, which I feed to noise, and that noise is influenced by my song, which in turn gives out that shape that moves throughout. You can see a still image here.

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=stevenson7/50fce453)


---

Right up there as one of my shortest gym sessions yet.

I had someone over earlier yesterday, and the person stayed longer than anticipated. Normally, I can get my workout done in about one hour thirty minutes at worst, or one hour on a good day. Yesterday though, I only had about thirty minutes.

Eventually, I realized you can still get solid work done in the shortest amount of time if you just lock in.

For my new routine, the workout included:

- Bench press

- Dumbbell incline press

- Back squat

- Cable lateral raise

- Shoulder overhead press

- Rope tricep pushdown


I got in and went straight to the bench. I even had a little time to squeeze in one set of cable bicep curls with the lads. After that, I moved to the incline DB press, then the machine shoulder press, cable lateral raises, tricep pushdowns, and finally closed out with squats at 120kg.

Didn’t even feel like I was going to collapse, lol.

Here’s your cue to do the work anyway. The time might be short. The conditions might not be perfect. It still doesn’t change the fact that something is always better than nothing.

Doing the work, no matter how little, is far better than not doing it at all. If anything, it builds character.

Well, thank you for reading. Till the next one. God bless.

body.title: I Protest! Even if You're Only Blowing Your Nose...
body.body: Seems to me that some people like to *\
* no matter *what* is going on, and they do so *relentlessly,* even when their voices are *utterly irrelevant,* when taken in context.

/>

I suppose some people would describe them as *trolls,* but I'm not sure that's an appropriate designation. They are not really there to cause havoc and provoke a reaction... they just want to make sure that their *very specific* opinion about a *very specific* topic is heard, no matter *what* the context might be. They are the ones who insist on screaming *\

* at the chess club meeting, even if people playing chess have zero connection to whales.

The sad thing is that they fully *believe* that they are somehow helping their cause by stating their case... but they are actually being such a source of *irritation* that people will not only go out of their way to *avoid* them, but might actively UN-support their cause just because their endless *song-of-one-note* protests are annoyingly shrill and irrelevant.

And somehow, they remain eternally blind and closed off to even the mere *suggestion* that their energies might be better used at an ocean fisheries conference than as a source of disruption for aforementioned chess players.

Which brings up the occasionally *\

* subject that context *does* matter. ![CC-L-0096-Cat.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.leo/2432NLpCpjSsutmKJVgiLPzishBsXPb29v8vyQay3FKrZgM37oMkQtK9FmcuUyqJ7sWL7.JPG) Maybe it's just a personal pet peeve, but those who just blatantly plow into something, even though they are irrelevant to the *context* of the situation, just annoy me to no end! It always feels a bit like someone passing out business cards for lawn mowing services at a funeral. *READ THE ROOM!!* It is almost as if they have been trained into the belief that being obnoxious is a positive trait!

/>

On a different level, however, I can't help but think that this is actually a form of marketing laziness. You promote yourself to the people who are *in front of you*, simply because they are there rather than taking the time to promote yourself to the people who actually *care* about what you have to offer. Perhaps this is simply an expression of so-called *retardmaxxing*, the latest new Internet gimmick, which encourages people to just *take action* without really thinking anything through because it's better than being stuck in overthinking. Sorry, but we live in a world where the signal-to-noise ratio is already leaning far in favor of *\

* so having an extra channels of noise added to the mix is not eaxctly welcome... at least not from where *I* am sitting!

Perhaps part of where I end up taking issue with the whole thing stems from the fact that these load and disruptive voices are invariably *negative and complaining* about something... and often something that's unlikely to change because the vast majority of the world doesn't actually *care.*

But I guess the world will *always* have its challenges and annoyances... and it's up to *us* to deal with them as best we can!

Thanks for coming to visit!

Hello, everyone in this wonderful photography lovers community! 😊 
‎

‎Well, have you ever noticed how amazing the sun is whenever it starts to go down? 
‎
‎As it slowly sinks deeper toward the horizon, it gives out even more of its beautiful colors, in soft and lovely shades. 
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYZ5NyLDgdRKwLME5BSPFf4AAyu1ejSDiYQTLh2i8oHhF/1779259067537.jpg)

‎
‎It was exactly what I saw that day. The sky turned into such a bright, warm orange.
‎
‎So vivid and so alive! 
‎
‎And as the scenery around slowly became darker, that orange color just stood out even more, glowing so beautifully.
‎
‎Though in real life, that orange was so bright and stunning.
‎
‎It looked like a glowing fire spreading across the whole sky! 
‎
‎But when you looked at the photos, my camera just couldn’t keep up with how magical it actually was. 
‎
‎Some details didn’t come out as clear or as colorful as what my eyes could see. 
‎
‎That happens sometimes, right? Even so, I still share them because I want you to see this wonderful moment, even if just a little bit of its charm is preserved here.
‎
‎I hope these pictures still bring a little bit of that sunset joy to you. Thank you so much for letting me share my moments here, and I’d really love to hear what you think about them! 🧡
‎
‎Until my next simple joys...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**

The rain is continuous at the moment and that is why you should also continue to reduce the amount of weed competition in your farm so that it will help a lot of situations on the farm. Gone are the days when you can absolutely calculate when the rain will fall or not. But at this present time the rain falls at any given time even without precipitation. this is the more reason why you need to open up as a farmer to accommodate the friends method of weeding so that it will help you more faster. 

Planting of the crops as well must be done and the updated up to date. It is one thing to cultivate seed and it is also another thing for the seed to go up and germinate. So there are a lot of choices to make in agriculture. If you can't go for the crop production you can as well go for the animal production in a smaller quantity then move higher when the time comes. 

These are also some of the sighted crops on the farm before the weeding also commenced here. Like I always say that the weeding aspect is a must to ensure good production.

body.body:
QUESTION: Is Iran threatening to cut internet cables in the straight of Hormuz?

![AI.jpg](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/world-travel-pro/79a827ac5d6f5b3b311c7d961b70dd08e8aa7ba8.jpg)

ANSWER: Yes, [Iran](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=/m/03shp) is actively using the threat of disrupting or cutting undersea internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz as a strategic pressure point. [1, 2] 
The Islamic Republic has expanded its traditional leverage over global oil shipments into the digital realm, explicitly warning international technology giants and foreign militaries that these underwater lines are highly vulnerable. [2, 3] 
## The Nature of the Threats

* The Financial Ultimatum: In May 2026, Iranian military spokesperson Ebrahim Zolfaghari officially stated, “We will impose fees on internet cables.” State-linked media detailed that global tech firms like Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Amazon must pay transit and licensing fees to operate communication lines running through what Tehran claims as its offshore territory.
* Asymmetric Retaliation: Iranian state-linked news agencies, including Tasnim, have issued warnings that simultaneous damage to several major cables—whether accidental or deliberate—could trigger severe digital outages. Geopolitical analysts view these statements as direct warnings to the United States and its allies: if Iran's infrastructure or ports are targeted by military strikes or blockades, Iran can retaliate by severing the cables. [2, 3, 4, 5, 6] 

## Why the Strait of Hormuz is a \

* The Global Internet Backbone: Over 97% of international data traffic travels via subsea fiber-optic cables rather than satellites. The Strait of Hormuz is a primary conduit linking the digital networks of Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
* Physical Vulnerability: Cables like the Falcon and Gulf Bridge International (GBI) run directly through Iranian territorial waters. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) possesses the combat divers, mini-submarines, and naval mines required to easily access and sever these lines. [2, 5, 7, 8, 9] 

## Immediate Global Impacts

* Maintenance Paralysis: Following Iran's declarations, major maritime cable repair operators, such as Alcatel Submarine Networks, paused all regional repair operations due to safety and insurance risks.
* Compounded Failures: Because previous conflicts already damaged adjacent internet cables in the Red Sea, the freeze on repairs in the Strait of Hormuz means that any new cable faults could become permanent for the duration of the conflict, threatening severe data slowdowns and financial network disruptions across multiple continents. [2, 10, 11]

body.title: Wingbreak and Ambush, a great combination when you expect Flying units!
body.body:
<centers>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wMePDhX8WyxchNBrzmyBof54JkRNNf7rPz1hYnQQ2Wv9MhEEqrWJLTyrqDWachok3YF.png)
</centers>

Hey you all, now I'm making more Splinterlands content again I realize how much I use my Dragons 😆 well you can't blame me... they're just awesome!

Most fights I have I am the underdog and I'm fighting against higher level opponents, this time around I was the higher level player but facing Nidhogr that's no guarantee for success at all!
In the previous battles I could see Nidhogr and with only the Dragon and Life splinters allowed, I knew what to prepare for, I like to counter what I think my enemy will play and when I expect dragons, I like to bring my two flying counters, best used against Rage but they work great against all flying monsters, especially when combined with Akane.

<center>
![teeth banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2kqTN8gBpWz7rz7ZmFQEDWAiPGQLJues1o7u42f9bzzU4qSUaFjgPSVQRN5NV5UDFV.png)
</center>

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wX5hPxew47Yx6swUP6Zhb6DWCsCzWyuy4zTc14xD7tA4k8wzHYB67A8GaUKXVDps47n.png)
</center>

Looking at the enemy team, this line-up is not right... I wonder if @jiiee was out of time, it happens to me a lot as well that I am distracted on another tab while waiting for an opponent and I only have a short time left to assemble my team. 😅

With the *Blast* ruleset, you would want a unit with *Deflect* in the seconds position to stop the blast damage, but while my Night Reaper has it, the level 1 Night Reaper in the other team doesn't so that's a big difference in this battle. Also that Caravan Guard should be farther to the back, and I would have put the Godsnot Sorceress all the way to the back because it's the main damage dealer, you would want it to last as long as possible, I'm not complaining though because sometimes easier fights are very welcome after facing higher level opponents and it's not the main reason why I'm sharing this fight, it's about what's about to happen with the enemy Night Reaper... 😈

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wX7RB215qPxYR5f8x6ut52eZiBuz9Sr67K6L2PQamxMpVAp9aGkGcDNf4PyyzDtYu1Y.png)
</center>

Obviously I gave the *Ambush* ability my Archon brings to both units with *Wingbreak*, Desolation and Night Reaper. This time it's super effective because of the added *Blast* ruleset.
My opponent choose to give the extra speed and *Execute* ability to the back of the team, good choice.
Nidhogr is a really, really nice Archon!

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wX7ZRErp9JqQJ4cw7YvzHjdHCiVB2bWbn8wPnPaqqHufNxkuM1UgxcqfbtBySswT86f.png)
</center>

I usually bring this Ambush / Wingbreak counter to quickly kill Rage, but it works even faster against Night Reaper and it didn't even survive long enough to make it to round 1... 😇

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wgWfoMmvwGkaYH1ETqBsAtEPNRRu9xBbQvZTD43nc1N7eMATZpX3MAx6Q5phD68Lru3.png)

body.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQScqaY9ZjmaRzQ96jgCMqYSQG543J6Rv7SforBh9pLYx/20210504_140532.jpg) </center>

<center> Here are my week two hundred and fifty nine recommendations for _Three Tune Tuesday_ <center>

#### **Drum roll please.....** </center>

# <center> Snow Patrol - Chasing Cars </center>

As I was saying recently, I'm going to take some inspiration from the Irish Public and a recent poll. 

I don't listen to the radio all that much these days. I am more inclined to be listening to a Podcast or an album on Spotify, but when I do tune in my wireless, it tends to be Today FM that I listen to and they did a Top 100 Irish songs of all time poll in the run up to St. Patrick's day.

I am going to give ye the top Thirty three over the next eleven weeks from this count down. Why? Well, I'm Irish and non Irish people are always asking me to say Thirty Three and third which sounds more like Thurty Tree and Turd with our accent!

We are edging ever closer to Ireland's official favourite song!!

So here we are at number 6 and this one is special to me as it reminds me of my Granny. This was topping the charts in 2006 when she died. We were very close as she lived with us for the last ten years of her life.

https://youtu.be/GemKqzILV4w?is=n0tj0Opmn0nBwjJR

# <center> Hozier - Take Me To Church </center>

I suspect the vast majority of you will know this one. Hozier went from little known to world renowned in a few years and is super talented.

Take Me to Church was his breakthrough hit released all the way back in 2013. The song combines soulful vocals, blues-inspired rock, and powerful lyrical imagery to explore themes of love, identity, and criticism of institutional religion. Hozier uses religious metaphors throughout the track to describe human relationships and personal freedom, creating a dramatic and emotional atmosphere that helped the song stand out internationally. Its haunting melody and passionate delivery quickly earned critical acclaim and widespread radio success and rightly so.

The song’s music video also gained major attention for its portrayal of discrimination and violence against a same-sex couple, reinforcing the song’s message about intolerance and social judgment. “Take Me to Church” became a global hit, reaching the top charts in multiple countries and earning a Grammy nomination for Song of the Year. It remains one of the defining songs of the 2010s and established Hozier as one of Ireland’s most successful modern artists.

https://youtu.be/PVjiKRfKpPI?is=gulAQluioOno1Jxi

# <center> The Cranberries - Dreams </center>

We will finish out with this song from iconic Irish band The Cranberries.

I don't need to say much here. The song speaks for itself.

Timeless.

Special.

Beautiful.

Thank you Deloros.

Rest easy ❤️

https://youtu.be/Yam5uK6e-bQ?is=PYCdeP7BH1avEYf2

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 260th week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

# <center> The jist is as follows </center>

#

Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs which I like to listen to and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize - more on that later.

# <center> HBI contest - win up to 6HBI </center>

#

Share your Three Tune Tuesday songs below or create a post with #ttt or #threetunetuesday and mention me so I can find the post.

I'll pick the three songs I enjoyed the most each week as the winner and transfer 1 share of HBI to the winner when this post pays out 7 days from now, but wait there's more...

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday Sponsors </center>

#

We have a sponsor list of six people who selflessly offer HBI in addition to my one. They are as follows @tengolotodo @bozz @coquicoin @ablaze @seki1 @inthenow

Due to a very busy life on my side, the winner posts often come after a delay and may come over 4 to 8 consecutive days. That's just how I do it, so please be patient while awaiting HBI and understand that only my 1HBI is guaranteed. The others are dependant on our lovely sponsors seeing these posts and sending on the HBI. That means some weeks winners may get 3 shares and other weeks they may get more.

Thanks a million to our sponsors above once again and any winners please bear in mind that some people only pop on here every few months, so be patient while waiting for the HBI.

<center> Best of luck!

# <center> Sin é, That's all folks, thanks for stopping by. </center>

That's it for another week. Those are your three songs for this week. Let me know what you think - good, bad or indifferent? Did you like them all or just one or two?

Also, as I said before, I love getting good steers for new tunes, so please tell me about the latest and greatest from your playlist below and I'll be sure to check em out.

_The YouTube videos shared are not owned by me and I am simply sharing great music with the community here on Hive_

## <center> Thanks as always for stopping by everyone and a big shout out to @stickupcurator whose continued generous support to #ttt is noticed and truly appreciated - thanks gents. </center>

# <center> Peace Out </center>

body.title: Quality of life enhancement supporting seniors with compassion
body.body:
Canada has an aging population, and families have begun to recognize the value of dependable and caring senior support providers. The provision of [professional elderly care in Kelowna](https://missionvillas.ca/elder-care/) enables older adults to undertake daily tasks with dignity, comfort, and independence, while receiving assistance that is tailored to their changing needs. No matter if seniors need occasional assistance or daily ongoing support, you can provide personalized and prescribed care solutions for their physical and emotional satisfaction.

Flexibility is one of the most important benefits of modern senior support. Several caregivers providing senior home care in Kelowna develop a personalized care plan that depends on the information you provide them with regarding your health conditions, mobility, and lifestyle choices. These services could be things like reminders to take medication, preparing meals, exercising more easily, help with personal hygiene, keeping you company, and going places. It ensures that seniors do not have to move far from their loved ones but get the care and attention they need.

Social connection is another crucial ingredient for successful aging. Moreover, the health effects of isolation and loneliness are more grievous in older adults, especially those who live alone. Look for companionship services that promote social interaction, involvement, and participation in activities to stimulate cognition. In fact, families looking for elderly care services in Kelowna often prefer caregivers who can offer companionship more than just practical aid!!

There are many factors that have played a key role in shifting demand for senior care services, but safety is at the top of the list. Aging adults may struggle with balance, memory at home, and/or chronic health issues, which make them more susceptible to accidents. You have been trained to monitor health changes, support mobility, and enhance a safer living environment. Kelowna home care service makes sure the elderly loved one's needs are fulfilled, providing reliable and dignified support to elderly people while limiting family stress.

Nutrition and wellness are as important for long-term health. Most are trained to help with menu planning, gentle exercises, and healthy routine habits that promote wellness. At the same time, ongoing support for seniors often leads to greater confidence and greater participation in social and recreational activities.

Today, families are seeking out care environments that honor personal autonomy. Modern elder support, on the other hand, supports independent life in a more active way rather than restricting someone. This harmony between aid and freedom is one of the primary reasons Kelowna elderly care continues to experience a rise in demand.

Change is important, and when our healthcare needs change as we get older, loving professional support becomes integral to maintaining the quality of our lives. Well-planned elderly care services are loved by family members as they give them consolation, while facilitating better and more promising life aged individuals in a caring setting, which can give them genuine feelings of serenity.

Adam Levine is the author of this article. For further detail about [senior care service fees](https://missionvillas.ca/service-schedule-and-fees/), Please visit the website: missionvillas.ca.

body.title: ‎THE FINAL DAY DRAMA: Glory, Survival, and One Last Fight
body.body:
‎What a season this has been in the Premier League. As the campaign draws closer to its end, the emotions keep getting bigger, the pressure keeps getting heavier, and every single point now feels priceless. This is exactly why football remains one of the most exciting sports in the world.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXGs1SenejMPNZNfkTSQmQxxHbUAc5zwTRaSQ38A6hLLc/file_00000000eb7c7243aebef2d86e2b7ab6.png 

‎
‎While watching my darling team playing yesterday nighy, Chelsea gave me and the rest of the fans something to smile about after securing a massive 2-1 victory over Tottenham Hotspur.
‎
‎Though that result may not completely guarantee European football next season, but it keeps the dream alive. Moving into 8th position is a huge boost at this stage of the season because every club wants to finish strong and secure a place in Europe. For me, this Chelsea side has shown resilience, fighting spirit despite all the ups and downs throughout the season. They still have one more hurdle to cross, and their fate will hinge on the final Premier League matchday results.
‎
‎And on the other hand, that defeat was a painful blow for Tottenham Hotspur. A club that once looked comfortable is now facing serious relegation battle. It is shocking to even imagine Tottenham fighting to survive on the final day of the season, but football can be very cruel and unforgiving. Tottenham Hotspur survival now hangs in the balance alongside West Ham United, and honestly, I cannot wait to see how the drama unfolds. The battle to avoid relegation sometimes feels even more intense than the title race itself because one result can completely change the future of a club.
‎
‎Then comes the biggest headline of all and which is Arsenal are finally Premier League champions after 22 long years of waiting. What a moment for the club, the players, and especially the fans who have stayed loyal through all the difficult years. Manchester City’s 1-1 draw against Bournemouth yesterday night officially ended any hope of catching Arsenal, and that result handed the Gunners the title before the final game of the season.
‎
‎I believe this triumph will mean more to Arsenal fans because of how long they waited for it. Seasons of disappointment, near misses, criticism, and rebuilding have finally led to this unforgettable achievement. Congratulations to Arsenal for proving that patience, belief, and consistency that there is always light at the end of the tunnel.
‎
‎All eyes shift to the final day drama, Europe qualification and relegation survival since the title race is over. One last match, one last battle, and possibly one final twist before the curtain closes on an unforgettable Premier League season.

# HiveSuite

  - Replies (Inbox + My Friends)  
  - Post Detail  
  - Profile Composer  


- Passed `allowLandscapeVideos` support to all related kit components.  

- Kept text-only composers unchanged to avoid unnecessary UI modifications.  

- Cleared Vite cache and verified successful clean builds after implementation.  


- Outcome:
  - Improved flexibility for video creators within the Hive ecosystem  
  - Better support for professional horizontal video content  
  - Consistent media upload experience across all composer flows

  - Blogs  
  - Communities  
  - My Feed  
  - Profile  
  - Friends  


- Improved navigation consistency and scalability across the application.  


- Outcome:

- Added notification filters for better categorization.

- Added on-chain “Mark as Read” functionality.  


### Skeleton UI Migration

- Replaced traditional loaders with skeleton UI across all pages.  

- Unified theme styling and layout consistency throughout the application.  


### Stability Improvements

- Fixed React hooks rendering bug causing inconsistent component behavior.  


- Outcome:
  - Improved perceived performance  
  - More stable rendering behavior  
  - Better visual consistency across the platform

body.title: Перформанси Obert.Eve у Києві
body.body:
Досить цікава і нестандартна подія очікується в Києві 24 травня. У цей день, о 15:30, у київському Concert Hall, що вул. Кирилівська, 41 відбудеться шостий OBERT.EVE — перформанс-подія, що поєднує танець на пілоні, електронну музику та джем-формат.
Заснуваали OBERT.EVE дівчата, які об’єднані прагненням розвивати полденс-культуру поза межами усталених форм та упереджень — Саша Романова, Олена Укроп і Надін Купець. Спільнота сформувалася навколо pole dance для взаємодії і свободи самовираження.
Кожна подія перформансів отримала свою відмінну концепцію. Цього разу основою став міфічний змій, що поїдає власний хвіст і замикається у досконале коло, - Circle of One, або Уроборос. Він є символом переродження, нескінченного циклу життя і смерті. Саме його вибір робить черговий OBERT.EVE VI містичним ритуалом трансформації через танець.
> *«Уроборос — це про переродження тут і зараз, серед війни. Після довгої зими, втрат і темряви приходить весна — і як пора року, і як внутрішній стан. Це про надію, силу та готовність починати знову щодня», — розповідає співзасновниця OBERT.EVE Олена Укроп.*[цитата](https://liroom.com.ua/afisha/obert-eve-circle-of-one/)
У програмі заходу є кілька форматів, нетипових для полденсу: джем для танцівниць і танцівників будь-якого рівня та батл професійних перформерок. Вперше на OBERT.EVE батл обійдеться без суддів. Хто проходить далі та перемагає — вирішуватимуть глядачі оваціями.
Діджей-сети зіграють Reshat та Ivan Onsha. Окрема частина заходів — перформанси танцівниць і танцівників світового рівня під виступ \

артиста у колаборації з відомим артистом НІХТО. Свій pole-перформанс представлять і організаторки події — спільно з театрально-електронним дуетом Mariia & Magdalyna. На афтепаті вперше з лайв-виступом вийдуть Sakal & Vaushee, а завершить подію dj Nekit. 
Також нагадаю, що під час заходу відбудеться збір коштів та аукціон на підтримку Сил Оборони, який проведе стендап-комік Василь Байдак.

This song, specially dedicated to Africa hosting the World Cup 2010, is full of nostalgia whenever it comes to play. It's full of magic in music and one can't just stop wondering how such a song was made that made it stick so hard that whenever a World Cup event is coming up, this song is among the songs one uses to catch the feelings of the moment even when an original song for that particular World Cup year has been released.  
The YouTube views keep increasing because it's just timeless. It's currently at 4.5billion views and it's going to keep increasing because it's worth reliving every moment.

During the time I was in school, I had a hostel mate whose phone was very terrible and was always crying for lack of space while he had almost deleted everything on his phone. He has just one video on his phone and it's this song by Shakira, Waka Waka. He deleted everything and refused to delete the video because he loves it so much. This video is his go-to video whenever he has leisure time with his phone.

I really wish we could have an iconic song again like that in the future.  
Just like what a lot of people have been saying, they say that songs these days are more of AI and that's a lack of originality and they hardly match up with what we had when AI was not in existence.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Challenge #04889-M140: Culture Shock
body.body:
![galen-crout-8skNUw3Z1FA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23u66w7oS5WYpBkqVYbicajX7mY1YPUQPrDqH8CYMtrFtkBzp97Nxk6pHFJ3iHpSVotWg.jpg)

> What are the bad things about the Alliance? What are the good things about the Greater Deregulation? And what are things both sides agree on? -- Anon Guest

[AN: That's a very good question]

Every utopia is someone's dystopia. The opposite holds true. Someone's paradise is someone else's hell. The Alliance has laws that are meant for the equity of all its citizens, including guarantees for health, welfare, and happiness. This also means that every citizen of the Alliance is under a modicum of surveillance.

If a citizen neglects their own welfare, the law is in place to _make_ the welfare happen. This can reach the point where the local security officers are involved.

At least the offense \

is not a black mark on the citizen in question. Only those guilty of the most severe crimes in the Alliance go to more than remedial therapy. The Alliance prefers to prevent crimes before anyone can come to harm.

This, of course, is anathema to anyone in Deregger Space. There, the highest value is freedom. Or so they say. The more money and power you have in Deregger Space, the more freedom you have. It also happens that the more money you have, the more power you have and the more money you get.

There's many citizens of Deregger Space who like where they are, no matter how they're treated. They say that their days are well-ordered, they don't need to worry about what they're doing every day. Their CEO is in charge of everything. They wear the corporate merchandise, watch the corporate entertainment, work the corporate hours, and believe the corporate news. It was all sorted out for them. Everything in its place and every person was also a thing.

They know who has the rights, they know where they belong, and they know what they deserve.

Put one in the other's place, and either of them would collapse for various reasons. They're very different worlds with very different philosophies. And one such place where the worlds meet displays the dissonance for any given observer.

Human Ziin was currently unaware that they had just wandered into the Deregger side of Miss Match Station. After all, the floors were just as clean and the restaurants shared similar style of names. Even the vendomats took Galactic money. They were even used to the displays automatically changing to their home tongue because of their tracker pin and comms. That was how safety worked.

The only clue that could have told Ziin that they were in the wrong place was that the clothing of the locals was just a little more lackluster. What did make Ziin wonder was that nobody present had their ID tracker pin with all the codes and indicators there for easy reading.

None of them were wearing their _pronouns_ or _names_.

Ziin froze in place, accidentally in the way of Unskilled Worker Somsak and his mop.

\
Ziin awkwardly danced around Somsak to a tile that had already been cleaned. \
They automatically reached for their change pocket for tips.\n\n\
They flailed from an idea, since Somsak didn't have pockets in their unitard. \
\n\nSomsak kept mopping according to his rote pattern. \
\n\nZiin paused with the Quarter-Hour coin in their hand, hovering over the turbid water in the mop bucket. \

Ziin spent most of their wait quietly concocting a plan to educate these Dereggers about the freedoms they could have. One that would _not_ start an interstellar incident.

[1] Sir and Cogniscent are agreed-upon universal terms of address and thus don't always cause upset wherever they're used.

body.title: THE STANDARD IS SET
body.body:
![IMG_20251225_094659_424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23xerYkvE42diqWfTs5iwLunK4eXwd4b4MF7yVokjuzeyvoMJ9q9kjEkdiRqzvddCM3ZB.jpg)

There is something remarkable about the eagle. It does not struggle for identity, neither does it compete for validation. It simply knows where it belongs, in the heights. Eagles soar at altitudes where even machines like jets glide through the skies. And at that level, you will hardly find any other bird keeping pace. The only bird that flies that high as the eagle is another eagle.

That alone is a message.

An eagle does not accidentally rise to such heights. It is built for it. Its wings are designed for elevation, its vision for precision, and its nature for solitude at the top. It understands that altitude is not just a place, it is a standard.

![lv_0_20251225191506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23wr3V4jp8WUJEq6g1wZi13S7BSR6XUz8jNhFaR89ZkDoaG5j1WZ4wc46s8aHYetkxqjy.jpg)

Now imagine an eagle choosing to flock with pigeons. What a degrading situation it will find itself. 
At first, it may seem harmless, just a little adjustment, just a temporary alignment. But over time, something begins to shift. The eagle that once ruled the skies now finds itself flying lower, not because it has lost its power, but because it has adjusted its standard. It is no longer stretching its wings to their full capacity, it is shrinking to fit the environment.

And that is where many people miss it.

You cannot truly lift someone by lowering yourself. Standards are not tools for compromise, they are pillars of identity. The moment you begin to reduce who you are, what you carry, and the heights you are called to, just to accommodate others, you are not helping them rise, you are teaching them to remain comfortable in mediocrity.

Growth is not contagious through compromise. It is inspired through example.

![IMG_20260101_112120_433.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23yJXaMuXvZ2k7JXvAg38hyvAtWQs6k6gvG5mn5D9CsDxBxt92B6SBnV2zkfWVWxQjZzn.jpg)

If someone desires to rise, let them look up and stretch. Let them be challenged by your altitude, not comforted by your descent. Because when you come down just to make others feel equal, you rob them of the opportunity to become more.

The eagle does not apologize for flying high. It does not seek approval from birds that were never built for that altitude. It stays true to its nature, and in doing so, it preserves the standard.

And here is the truth.
Not everyone in your circle is meant to journey with you to your next level. Some relationships are seasonal, some associations are limiting, and some environments are simply too low for where you are going.

Know your height. Know your capacity. Know your standard.

Because once the standard is set, it must be protected.

Do not lower your flight to fit into spaces that were never designed for you. Stay in your altitude. Those who truly desire growth will rise to meet you there.

After all, at that level, only eagles remain. In relation to class and standards I killed the urge for entitlement. 

Nobody owes me anything not attention, or opportunities, not even a dime!

If I want something, I go for it.

If I need something, I work for it.

If I desire a certain kind of life, I build towards it.

Yes.

The moment you stop expecting things from people, you take your power back.

There won't be any forms of disappointment or unnecessary pressure. 

No waiting on anyone to come through for you.

Just you and you alone showing up for yourself.

It’s not always easy o, but it’s freeing because everything I have, I know I earned.

Moreover that everything I want, I know I’m capable of getting.

![lv_0_20260320095035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23x1KmJDc9qGaxytmxHoJgqUQ5t5ajSu1nVUiwtTkZPhsqSF2JtzTMzNq1iRuuQrcDJLH.jpg)

body.title: Your Inner Peace Is More Important Than The Image You Want To Create
body.body:
>

In the world of today, a lot of people are so concerned about their image; that is how they appear to others, their reputation, how successful they look, and even how much attention and validation they get from people. In fact, social media and appearance have made it seem like image is very important. But why you might impress people temporarily with image, there is something that offers a more valuable thing to you; this is your inner peace. It is what gives you genuine happiness, stability, and clarity. You will be surprised, but the truth is that someone who has Internal peace is more likely to live a far healthier and more fulfilling life than someone who only looks successful on the outside.

<center>![pexels-bertellifotografia-13872497.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfLQqvkpD4NzuyAt3US5ajVpXnQ9Wfy6f5cwhKm4ut22q/pexels-bertellifotografia-13872497.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouette-of-boy-raising-his-hands-during-sunset-13872497)</sub></center>

There was one of my friends that I observed her lifestyle and I understood that it is not everything you see on social media that is what it is. We are friends on social media and also offline, but her life in both are entirely different. She would buy expensive things and borrow some, just to snap and make videos, then post on her social media handles with a lot of catchy titles. All these were to appear classy in the eyes of others and to feel \

But the people that know her closely know that she was struggling financially and emotionally too, because she was more concerned about public image instead of her peace of mind.\n\nImage is external, and it is how others see you. But peace is internal, because it is how you feel within you even when no one is watching you. Trust me, no matter what you portray to be, you know who you really are. Someone may appear confident, rich, popular, successful on the outside, yet may be struggling with pressure, anxiety, emptiness, or even one form of emotional instability or the other. How someone looks on the outside does not always show how they are in the inside. I remember what a mentor once said; \

One of the dangers of living for image is that it puts you under undue and continuous pressure. This will lead to the feeling of desperation to do anything just to maintain your public image. A lot of people have trapped themselves trying to impress others, or to maintain their appearance, or to even gain approval. They may even spend more than their limit, pretend that everything is fine, compare themselves to others, and at the end, they will feel empty within. This is because, over time, the lifestyle they are trying to pretend to be living will become unsustainable and exhausting, because it is built on the quest for external validation. Inner peace makes one to live with calmness and with contentment. Not because they have everything, but because they value what they have, and they make the most of them. Inner peace also comes from self-awareness, emotional balance, having healthy values, being free from the need for unhealthy comparison. Someone who has achieved inner peace does not need constant attention to feel valuable. Their confidence is not built by what people will think of them nor on public opinion, but it is built from within.
![20260519_173209.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMJdwGjThHg7urcegUTZ8PUdq1wtMQLnM6WP6psdQhm7/20260519_173209.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouette-peace-sign-at-sunset-37622763)
Inner peace affects the emotional and mental well-being of an individual positively. When you have a peaceful mind, it will help you to think clearly, make better decisions, and also handle the issues of life better. Without peace of mind, a lot of things about life will cease to make meaning, including success and achievements. What brings satisfaction is not just about what you have achieved, neither is it the quest to achieve more, but the peace of mind that you have over what you already possess. You will not feel the need to compare yourself with someone else, you will not feel jealous or insecure about what others have, and you will not have the desperation to have what others have. This does not mean that your life is without challenges, but it simply means that you have achieved a form of emotional stability even in the presence of challenges. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Hard-hard-hard week
body.body:
Hi, guys!

This week has been incredibly challenging for me. So much work, and yet I just don't have the energy to do it. I have to shoot a huge amount of advertising for the FanCon festival, and I'm constantly asking for more and more games to advertise, so the work just never ends. It's the same with books, of course. There are so many of them, I need to read them all urgently, and I simply can't get it all done. But it's okay, I'll manage somehow.

I already have quite a long list of publishers I work with, so the deadlines for reviewing books for each of them have stretched out. So far, no one has expressed any dissatisfaction, and I hope that stays the case. We haven't been able to reach an agreement with some publishers yet, but I hope that will happen in the future. So, I'm continuing to work.

With all that, I naturally have no time for anything else. I'm so immersed in my book blog that I simply don't have time for anything else in my life. Plus, I'm planning a blog overhaul, and that will also take a huge amount of time. In short, time is everything to me. I need so much of it for everything.

So I don't know how to organize my schedule to get everything done. Right now, it seems simply unrealistic, and I'm completely out of time. But today, I'm planning to film eight more videos, so I need to close the written blogs and get to work. And if I have time, I also need to film a toy commercial.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.title: MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak [Part 1/3]
body.body:
# MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak

**Source:** https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MV_Hondius_hantavirus_outbreak

The ship departed from Ushuaia, Argentina, on 1 April with plans to visit Antarctica and several islands in the South Atlantic. A passenger died on board on 11 April. His body was taken ashore in Saint Helena on 24 April, where 30 passengers disembarked, including his wife, who died two days later in a Johannesburg hospital. Another passenger died on board on 28 April. A British passenger was sent to Johannesburg on 2 May for treatment in critical but still stable condition. Although the ship was docked at Praia, Cape Verde, for three days, no one disembarked, as local facilities were unable to handle a safe evacuation. After receiving approval from Spanish health authorities, the ship departed for Tenerife, Canary Islands, on 6 May with additional medical resources and 147 individuals on board, arriving on 10 May. Passengers disembarked and evacuation flights repatriated passengers to six European countries and Canada. As of 15 May 2026, former passengers are hospitalized or quarantined in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Saint Helena, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, Turkey, and the United States.
On 18 May, MV Hondius arrived in Rotterdam where everyone was retested and then disembarked. The two Dutch medical officers returned home for self-quarantine. The 23 crew from four countries entered quarantine in Rotterdam. The body of a deceased passenger was removed for cremation, and the vessel began disinfection in preparation for returning to service.[12][13]

Background
Hantavirus

Hantaviruses are a group of over fifty types of viruses that infect rodents and sometimes humans.[14][15] In rodents, Hantavirus infection, while usually persistent, does not result in symptoms. Hantaviruses may transmit through rodent populations via aerosols or droplets from infected rodent feces, urine, saliva, and blood;[14][16][unreliable medical source?] through the consumption of contaminated food; or from virus particles shed from skin or fur.[17] 
Andes virus is a species of the Hantaviridae taxonomic family of viruses and the only known hantavirus to spread via human-to-human transmission. Past human outbreaks have indicated that transmission of the Andes virus is possible under specific close-contact conditions.[9][10] The routes and mechanisms of transmission have not been definitively characterized, but airborne transmission is considered a possibility.[9][10] Transmission typically occurs in cases of close sustained contact, such as household exposure, caregiving without personal protective equipment, and prolonged exposure in poorly ventilated or crowded settings.[9][10] In humans, Andes virus usually causes hantavirus pulmonary syndrome – a severe illness affecting the heart and lungs with an incubation period of one to seven weeks.[18] Andes virus outbreaks are associated with high case fatality rates of 20 to 40 percent.[9]
On 6 May, it was confirmed that the Andes virus, which is normally found in the Andes mountains of Argentina and Chile,[19] was responsible for the outbreak on the MV Hondius .[16][20] The spread of the virus on board has been at least partially attributed to human-to-human transmission.[21] Early reports identified Ushuaia, Argentina, as a possible site of infection. However, no cases of the virus have ever been recorded there or in the region of Tierra del Fuego, and the city lies 1,500 km south of the endemic range of the long-tailed mouse subspecies known to carry the virus.[22]

MV Hondius

The MV Hondius is owned by the Dutch company Oceanwide Expeditions.[23] The ship has accommodation for 196 passengers across 95 cabins, and a crew of 72.[24] The ship departed from Ushuaia, Argentina,[23] on 1 April with 114 passengers and 61 crew.[25] The first people infected had been travelling farther north in Argentina and into Chile before arrival in Ushuaia.[26] The ship had plans to visit Antarctica and \

.[23] 
After disembarkation at St. Helena, 149 people of 23 nationalities remained on board Hondius.[25][15] Passengers mostly came from Spain, France, the United Kingdom, and the United States, while the bulk of the crew came from the Philippines.[27] Berth prices on the cruise ranged from €14,000 to €22,000.[28]

Itinerary and key events
Tristan da Cunha13–15 AprilStops made by the MV Hondius during the outbreak and end of voyage in Rotterdam.[25]
1 April: MV Hondius departs Ushuaia, Argentina.[16]
6 April: The first person begins showing symptoms.[29]
11 April: The first person dies on board the ship;[23] it is originally attributed to natural causes.[29]
13–15 April: Hondius makes a stop in Tristan da Cunha.[30][31]
24 April: Hondius stops in Saint Helena, where 30 passengers disembark.[21] Among them are the deceased passenger's wife and his remains, both subsequently airlifted to Johannesburg, South Africa.[16]
26 April: The wife of the first victim dies in a Johannesburg hospital.[23]
2 May: The second on-board fatality[23] and third overall.
3 May: The ship arrives at Praia, Cape Verde.[16]
4 May: The first positive test for the Andes virus is received.[1]
6 May: The ship leaves Cape Verde for the Canary Islands. Three more people are evacuated from the ship to the Netherlands, including the ship's doctor.[16]
7–9 May: The ship with 147 people aboard continues sailing to the Canary Islands, with three deaths and six confirmed hantavirus cases across multiple countries.[clarification needed]
10 May: The ship arrives at the Port of Granadilla in Tenerife. Disembarkation begins; repatriation flights follow.
11 May: Two additional people from the ship test positive, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to seven.[32] All passengers and some crew disembark the MV Hondius and are repatriated.
12 May: One Spanish passenger from the ship tests positive, the 13 others negative.[citation needed]
13–17 May: The ship is at sea with 27 crew, sailing to Rotterdam. On 15 May, one suspected American case proved to be negative,[5] and Canadian health authorities reported the first positive test.[33]
 18 May: The ship arrives at the Port of Rotterdam, where it docks and the remaining passengers and crew disembark.[12][13]

Timeline
April
The ship departed from Ushuaia on 1 April with 175 passengers and crew.[25] On 6 April, a 70-year-old Dutch man began showing symptoms,[29] and he died on board on 11 April,[23][29] initially attributed to generic natural causes.[29] The ship stopped at the British Overseas Territory of Tristan da Cunha on 13–15 April.[30][31] On 24 April, the Dutchman's body was taken off the ship[16][23] upon the ship's arrival at the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena. At this time, 29 passengers disembarked the ship, including the deceased body; among them was the man's 69-year-old widow, who later took a plane to South Africa.[49][50] The disembarked passengers were from 12 countries and returned home before contact tracing began.[51]
On 25 April, the widow, who had unknowingly contracted the virus, boarded KLM flight KL592 from Johannesburg to Amsterdam, but she was removed from the plane before takeoff due to her medical condition,[52] and she died in a hospital in South Africa on the same day.[16] The widow was on the plane for 45 minutes.[53] After stopping in Saint Helena, the ship continued on to the British Overseas Territory of Ascension Island,[54] where an ill British passenger was removed and flown to South Africa for hospital care. On 27 April, Hondius left Ascension Island.[55]

1–5 May
On 2 May, a German woman died on board,[23][34] and, as of 8 May, her body remains on board the ship.[56] Following the identification of the outbreak on 4 May,[50] passengers were told to limit close contact and frequently use hand sanitizer.[57] On 2 May, the World Health Organization (WHO) first received a report of the hantavirus outbreak.[58]
On 3 May, the ship docked in Praia, the capital of Cape Verde.[16][23] The authorities said they were sending medical supplies and officials to support the ship, and officials in Praia also expanded safety protocols near the port as a precautionary measure.[23] The Cape Verdean government announced the creation of an isolation area and the coordination of a multidisciplinary team to assist the ship's passengers and crew.[59][60] Around the same time, South African officials began precautionary contact tracing.[23] By 4 May, gene sequencing had identified the Andes virus in at least one infected person.[61]

6 May
The first evacuation flight was carried out by an air ambulance (LX-RHC) of Luxembourg Air Rescue.[62]
On 6 May, the ship was anchored outside Cape Verde, a country not deemed capable of dealing with the medical emergency on board.[16] Despite the objections of the Canary Islands' president, Spain approved the plan for the Hondius to dock in Tenerife, citing its moral and legal obligation to the passengers.[63]
The Swiss government confirmed that a man infected with hantavirus was being treated in Zurich, Switzerland. Swiss authorities confirmed that the patient was a passenger on the cruise ship, bringing the total number of infections to eight.[40] The man was one of the 30 passengers who disembarked on 24 April.[28] On the same day, it was announced that three more people experiencing symptoms had been sent to the Netherlands by two air ambulances for treatment; these were a 56-year-old Briton, a 41-year-old Dutch national, and a 65-year-old German, one of which was the ship's doctor.[16][64][56]
The first plane carrying two patients landed in the Netherlands on 6 May; the German national was later transferred to University Hospital of Düsseldorf and the Briton to Leiden University Medical Center.[65][66] The second plane carrying the Dutch national diverted to Gran Canaria and awaited a replacement aircraft after experiencing technical issues in its life support systems.[67][68] On 6 May, the ship left Cape Verde for the Canary Islands.[69] Four medical experts embarked while the ship was leaving Cape Verde. Two of these were medical specialists from Amsterdam University Medical Center and Central Military Hospital, a military hospital in Utrecht. The two others were epidemiologists from Italy and the Netherlands, meant to investigate the scope of the virus on the ship.[25] The selection, transport, and coordination of these experts was assisted by the WHO and European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control.[70]
Two anonymous Argentine investigators claimed that the leading hypothesis was that the index case—the Dutch citizen who showed the first symptoms—had contracted the virus.[71][72] On 6 May, the Argentine health ministry published a report detailing the movements of the index case, the Dutch citizen who presented the first symptoms, prior to the ship's departure; the report showed he had gone on a four-month road trip between 27 November 2025 and 1 April 2026, spanning Chile, Uruguay, and Argentina. Meanwhile, the National Ministry of Health and the Malbrán Institute are advancing the epidemiological investigation at the local level, capturing and testing rodents along the route the Dutch passenger travelled, as well as conducting contact tracing. The index case had returned to Argentina from Uruguay only four days before departure.[73]

7 May
On 7 May, one of the flight attendants on the flight from Johannesburg to Amsterdam on 26 April was admitted to Amsterdam University Medical Center on suspicion of infection, having been in contact with the deceased Dutch woman.[74] On 7 May, the diverted flight carrying the third patient from the ship landed in the Netherlands, and that patient was hospitalized at Radboud University Medical Center.[74] Later that day, the patient tested positive for the virus.[75] The same day, the Singapore Communicable Diseases Agency announced that two of its residents who had been on the cruise and on the same flight as the Dutch woman from Saint Helena to Johannesburg—one of them symptomatic—were being tested.[76] They tested negative on 8 May.[77]
A comprehensive risk analysis of the individuals on the two flights the deceased woman had taken was completed by GGD Kennemerland, the Dutch municipal health service responsible for Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. Five individuals were categorized as high risk for having assisted the woman in leaving KLM flight KL592; the hospitalized flight attendant is one of them. An additional 50 individuals were deemed lower risk, as they had been seated within two rows of the woman. The GGD is still attempting to contact these individuals.[53] The remaining individuals have been informed and are considered to be at the lowest risk.[78] From the first flight from Saint Helena to Johannesburg, three individuals have been tested due to symptoms; two of those tests have since come back negative.[79]
It was reported that two patients had been identified as having the Andes virus in lab work by the National Institute for Communicable Diseases of South Africa.[80] The same day, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) told the BBC that all thirty people who left the ship during its stop in Saint Helena had been identified and contact traced.[21] Two of these were Britons who are currently isolating without symptoms.[56] The Quebec Health Minister confirmed that three Canadians are isolating in Quebec and Ontario. Two of them disembarked in Saint Helena on 24 April, and the third flew on the same flight as the deceased woman to Johannesburg.[51] On 7 May, Oceanwide Expeditions said the ship was expected to arrive at the Port of Granadilla, Tenerife, in the early hours of 10 May.[81][82][83]

8 May
On 8 May, it was confirmed that the second British national in a health facility in South Africa, who had been on the same flight as the deceased Dutch woman, tested positive. Another Briton was suspected by the UKHSA of having contracted the virus on the island of Tristan da Cunha, where the ship was docked between 13 and 15 April.[41][84] This individual was currently hospitalized on the island, and their spouse was isolating.[85] The KLM stewardess tested negative for the virus on 8 May.[86] On this day, GGD Kennemerland announced that everyone on flight KL592 was being monitored and in contact with the GGD, an escalation of the prior risk analysis which only deemed the two rows around the deceased to be at risk.[citation needed] Secretary of State for Health Javier Padilla Bernáldez also confirmed that a Spanish passenger on KL592 was symptomatic and hospitalized in Alicante. The individual sat two rows behind the deceased, and was thus classified as lower risk.[87] The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) classified the outbreak as 'Level 3' emergency response, the lowest on the CDC classification scale. The US administration announced the publication of a full report on the outbreak later that day.[88][better source needed] In a press conference, the Director of Epidemiology and Environmental Health for Tierra del Fuego's Ministry of Health stated that the patients on the Hondius were unlikely to have been infected in the province.[89]
Evacuation plans for the arrival of the ship on the Canary Islands were being finalized. Spain was coordinating the arrival of the ship with 22 countries, and the WHO. Almost all countries were sending evacuation aircraft for their citizens, and the EU provided two aircraft for those who did not have an assigned flight.[90] Countries had differing quarantine plans for their nationals once evacuated.[91][92]
There had been three deaths, with two confirmed to have been caused by hantavirus.[8] The other one remained under investigation.[8] As of 8 May, the WHO reported two probable cases and six confirmed cases, for a total of eight.[8] The UKHSA reported one additional suspected case, with two Britons being confirmed infected.[93][94]
The sequences of the virus isolated from a Swiss resident was published on virological.org on 8 May. The isolate was designated \

. Nextstrain pages were set up for this outbreak using these sequences on the same day.[95]

9–10 May
On 9 May, the ship was en route to the Canary Islands and expected to arrive early on 10 May.[96]

Edinburgh of the Seven Seas, the only settlement on Tristan da Cunha. One inhabitant is suspected of having the virus.
On 10 May, British military personnel from the 16 Air Assault Brigade parachuted down to Tristan da Cunha from a RAF A400M Atlas, where one of its 220 residents, an earlier passenger on the ship, was suspected of having contracted the virus. As the island has no airstrip, parachuting was the only option given the time-sensitive nature of the situation – the nearest port (in South Africa) is over a week sailing time away. In total six paratroopers, a Royal Air Force (RAF) consultant and an army nurse  arrived to the island while oxygen supplies and medical aid were also dropped.[97] This comes after the island reported their oxygen reserves being at a critical level, ruling out sending equipment by ship from Ascension Island.[98] 
The ship arrived in the Port of Granadilla, around 05:30 WET on 10 May and began disembarkation.[99][unreliable source][100] Spanish health minister Mónica García described the planning to prevent hantavirus spread as \

.[101][58] At Spain's request, an EU air ambulance stationed in Norway and crewed by Norwegian doctors was sent to Tenerife to be on stand-by in case of any serious illness found during disembarkation.[102] The passengers disembarked in order of their homeward-bound flight departure time, with the Spanish nationals disembarking first. The first evacuation flight took off at 13:31 WET.[103] When the French evacuees arrived at a French hospital, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced that one of the five French nationals showed symptoms fitting the virus during the flight.[104] As of late 10 May WET, seven evacuation flights had taken off, transporting 94 passengers to six European countries and Canada.[105][106] 
Some of the ship's crew stayed on board to take it to Rotterdam in the Netherlands after its planned departure from Tenerife on 11 May for the disinfection of the entire ship.[107] The body of a passenger that died on board will also remain on the ship until its arrival in Rotterdam.[108] The rest of the crew were to be evacuated by a Dutch government plane on 11 May.[109]
A flight transporting evacuated passengers landed in Manchester around 21:00 on 10 May. The passengers—consisting of twenty UK citizens, one German national residing in the UK, and one Japanese man (who was evacuated at Japan's request)—were hospitalized at Arrowe Park Hospital, the location of UK's initial quarantine during the COVID-19 pandemic.[110]

11–12 May
On the morning of 11 May, it was announced that the symptomatic French national had tested positive, with her health worsening overnight. Additionally, one asymptomatic American tested positive, and another had mild symptoms.[111] The French government increased its public health alertness level, and had identified 22 French nationals who were high risk contact cases with infected individuals.[112] Later, the WHO reported that the woman was in \

, and that she had already shown symptoms while on the ship. In the evening of 11 May local time, one of the Spanish nationals who had arrived in Spain the day before tested positive. The 13 other Spanish nationals tested negative.[113]
During the evacuation of the final passengers aboard the MV Hondius, a Spanish officer died of a heart attack at the port.[114] Around 20:00 WET, the ship left Tenerife for Rotterdam with 25 crew members and two medics from the RIVM after all passengers and 35 crew members successfully disembarked and were repatriated.[115] The body of the deceased German national was still on board.[116] The journey is expected to take six days, with the ship arriving in the evening of 17 May.[117] In total, 122 individuals disembarked the ship in Tenerife and were repatriated to their home countries, or the Netherlands for those nationalities that did not provide their own evacuation flights.[116]
On 12 May, a Spanish passenger was confirmed positive, exhibits symptoms, and was isolated in hospital. Twelve hospital workers in Nijmegen, Netherlands, failed to comply with protocols and were placed in isolation.[118]

13 May
Since the hospitalization of the French passenger on 10 May, her condition has worsened. On 13 May, French authorities stated that she is on life-support. They also said that this is \

.[44] That same day, the WHO posted its third official update regarding the outbreak, and adjusted one of the previously confirmed cases to inconclusive after a second test came back negative, awaiting a third test from the American national who had shown no symptoms.[119]

15 May
On 15 May, the CDC announced that an American passenger who had developed flu-like symptoms on board and who had initially been listed as having \
test results was retested with negative result and showed no antibodies, meaning he was never infected.[5]\nA Canadian passenger isolating in British Columbia tested \

, with the patient hospitalized and three others under medical observation. While awaiting national laboratory confirmation, health officials are treating the case as positive during the 21-day isolation period.[33]

18 May
The Hondius arriving in Rotterdam. On the left is a tour boat from where the press could follow the arrival.
On 18 May, MV Hondius docked in Rotterdam. Disinfection of the vessel began, estimated to take 3 to 4 days, to prepare for a new departure on 13 June. Five crew members, including the captain, will stay on board during the disinfection.[13] The remaining on-board were tested again and disembarked. Of those, the two Dutch medical workers went home, where they would self-quarantine. The 20 non-Dutch crew (17 from the Philippines and 3 from Ukraine) entered into quarantine for six weeks in separate cabins. The body of the deceased German woman was taken off board to be cremated in the Netherlands.[13][12] The status of the Canadian passenger was updated by the national lab and \

positive.[48]

On board health care and monitoring
The Hondius is equipped with a cabin for the ship's doctor and an infirmary.[120][121] It is intended more for the minor health problems typically arising at sea, and stocks anti-inflammatory drugs, some over-the-counter medications, and oxygen tanks. It lacks the kind of sophisticated equipment such as scanners or ventilators needed to diagnose or treat serious respiratory illness.[122][non-primary source needed] The ship has one doctor.[70]
By the end of April, the ship's doctor was among the two crew members who were very ill and confined to quarters. On 1 May, one of the passengers, who was a doctor, began rendering medical assistance to other passengers and crew. As the situation escalated, he also provided health care information resources for passengers on board, as well as became the central point of contact on board for health authorities.[122][non-primary source needed] While docked outside Cape Verde, two doctors and one nurse made three trips to the ship to provide additional care to passengers.[123]
On 6 May, four medical experts embarked while the ship was leaving Cape Verde. Two of these were medical specialists from Amsterdam University Medical Center and Central Military Hospital [nl] in Utrecht. The two others were epidemiologists from Italy and the Netherlands, meant to investigate the scope of the virus on the ship.[25] The selection, transport and coordination of these experts was assisted by the WHO and European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control.[70]

International response
The World Health Organization (WHO) issued guidance aimed at port facilities and health authorities and agencies handling the disembarkation and monitoring of individuals on the MV Hondius.[124]

Passenger monitoring and contact tracing
The WHO has been coordinating monitoring of those who disembarked or were evacuated with health care agencies in twelve countries, including Canada, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the United States.[125]
