 Australia – Australia announced they are sending a plane to evacuate the Australians, New Zealanders and nationals from some Asian countries.[108] Six people, including 4 Australian citizens, one Permanent Resident of Australia and one New Zealand citizen, are to be quarantined at Bullsbrook Quarantine Centre for at least 3 weeks (also known as the Centre for National Resilience, which was originally planned for use during the COVID-19 pandemic).[127]
 Canada – As of 12 May, there are 16 individuals in Canada being monitored for potential exposure.[128] Four Canadian nationals who were on board the MV Hondius were flown to CFB Bagotville, Quebec, on 10 May and were transferred to Victoria, British Columbia, where they are to self-isolate for at least 21 days.[129][130] One passenger initially tested \

by the national lab.[48] On 12 May, the Government of Canada announced that any passengers who had been aboard the MV Hondius after 1 April would be prevented from boarding a flight to Canada.[131][132]
 France – Five French nationals were on board the MV Hondius and were evacuated to Paris on 10 May. They were expected to be hospitalized for 72 hours, followed by 45 days of home quarantine.[133] One French evacuee developed symptoms of the virus while in flight[134] and later tested positive for hantavirus. She was hospitalized in intensive care in a Paris hospital.[135][42] The virus infecting her was sequenced, and the French Minister of Health stated that there was no evidence that a new or more dangerous or transmissible variant had emerged. Around twenty contacts in France remained hospitalized as of 16 May, but none have shown any symptoms.[45]
 Germany – One German passenger died aboard the ship.[125] Another German national was evacuated on 6 May and is currently hospitalized in Germany,[136] but has since tested negative.[8]
 Netherlands – Eight passengers and five crew hold Dutch nationality; two passengers have died as of 8 May, one of which after she was evacuated to South Africa.[137]
 Philippines – There were 38 Filipino citizens on board the MV Hondius, consisting of 24 hotel staff and 14 deck and engine staff. The crew was to be evacuated to the Netherlands in three batches, where they were to undergo a 42-day quarantine upon arrival.[138][139] The first four crew members were evacuated on 10 May.[140] The Philippine Department of Health does not plan to quarantine the crew again once they are flown back to the Philippines.[141]
 Singapore – Two Singapore residents were passengers on the ship and were also on the same flight as a confirmed hantavirus case from Saint Helena to Johannesburg on 25 April. Upon returning to Singapore, both were isolated at the National Centre for Infectious Diseases for 30 days[142] and were tested negative for the virus as of 8 May.[77]
 Spain – Spanish citizens onboard are to be transferred to the Gómez Ulla Military Hospital in Madrid for isolation.[143] The decision by Spanish authorities to transfer patients to the Spanish capital was opposed by president of the Community of Madrid Isabel Díaz Ayuso.[125][144][145]
  Switzerland – A Swiss national who disembarked in Saint Helena tested positive and was admitted to a hospital in Zurich.[125]
 Turkey – Three Turkish nationals were on the ship and were repatriated on 10 May on a separate government chartered flight.[146] One Turkish national, who disembarked at Saint Helena on 24 April, drew controversy after attending public events in Turkey following the outbreak announcement, as shown in photographs. The national ministry of health had not imposed quarantines at the time.[147] However, the individual claims the picture was taken before the WHO announced the outbreak.[148] Since then, quarantines have been imposed according to WHO guidelines, including for the repatriated nationals from the ship.[149]
 United Kingdom – One British national left the cruise ship in Tristan da Cunha and seven nationals in Saint Helena. There are two other confirmed cases: one evacuated to the Netherlands, and the other to South Africa.[125] On 10 May, medical clinicians and specialist equipment were delivered to Tristan da Cunha by paratroopers from the 16 Air Assault Brigade.[150] On 10 May, in Tenerife, 22 individuals – 19 passengers and three crew – were taken off the ship and screened for hantavirus. They were placed on chartered flights which landed in Manchester \

. They entered a 72-hour quarantine in self-contained flats at Arrowe Park Hospital in Wirral, then were ordered to self-isolate for 45 days at home.[151] Among these 22, there is one German national residing in the UK and one Japanese individual evacuated at the request of Japan.[110]
 United States –  On 11 May, seventeen American passengers were repatriated on a US government medical flight to Nebraska. They were scheduled to be transported from Offutt Air Force Base near Omaha to the National Quarantine Unit at the University of Nebraska Medical Center for monitoring and evaluation.[152][134][153] As of 15 May, 41 people in 16 states were being monitored, about half in health care facilities and half at home. The sole passenger who previously had inconclusive test results was confirmed as not infected.[5] One asymptomatic American is isolating on Pitcairn Island.[154]

Misinformation and disinformation
Several conspiracy theories emerged online following the outbreak. Some made the false claim that the outbreak was caused by Israel, and that the name of the virus is derived from the Hebrew word for scam or fake (hantavirus takes its name from the Hantan River in Korea).[156] Other false claims portray the Hantavirus outbreak as a side-effect of the COVID-19 vaccine[157][158] and as a scheme by pharmaceutical companies to sell vaccines, citing Moderna's development of a hantavirus vaccine in 2024.[156][159] Several AI-generated images with false information about the outbreak have circulated on social media.[157] Unsupported claims that Ivermectin can cure hantavirus were endorsed by former US Congress member Marjorie Taylor Greene.[156][160]
The World Health Organization addressed the misinformation regarding the outbreak in Q&A sessions on social media.[159]

body.title: Beef and cheese 🥟 empanada with guasacaca; a perfect combination 😋
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Nada más criollo que una empanada acompañada de una deliciosa guasaca; el día de hoy preparé carne molida para el almuerzo y decidí dejar un poco porque tenía en mente hacer unas empanadas para la cena; así que, para realzar un poco su sabor les agregué un poco de queso blanco y, por supuesto preparé una deliciosa guasaca; tuve una cena espectacular! sencilla, fácil de preparar y muy deliciosa, y además muy criolla y tradicional

> **
ENGLISH
** Nothing is more traditional than an empanada served with a delicious guasaca; today I made ground beef for lunch and decided to save a little because I had in mind to make some empanadas for dinner; so, to enhance the flavor a bit, I added some white cheese, and, of course, I made a delicious guasaca; I had a spectacular dinner! Simple, easy to make, and very delicious—and also very traditional and authentic. ![1000898012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFRuwyDQwK9mtW7fqdjg7mKyadVhbzPgsUMN7KUhSxupYd8YBeUh7kyYGiC2UtPE9eg.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** harina de maíz blanca, aceite, queso blanco, guiso de carne molida

> **
INGREDIENTS
** white corn flour, oil, white cheese, ground beef stew ![1000897941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EokdaPE9M2LAPHHEwBGof54vUK1JkRqAAvCQP6uKfktLwm8M5EwgVZCm7omTEWrpArC.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Coloqué la harina en una taza, agregue sal, agua, amase hasta que estuvo compacta; luego tomé pequeñas porciones, estiré lo más finamente posible coloqué una cucharada colmada de guiso de carne molida, agregué queso rallado, doble y marqué las empanadas y luego llevé a freír en aceite muy caliente

> **
PROCEDURE
** I put the flour in a bowl, added salt and water, and kneaded it until it was firm; then I took small portions, rolled them out as thinly as possible, placed a heaping tablespoon of ground beef filling on each, added grated cheese, folded them over, sealed the edges, and then fried them in very hot oil. ![1000897969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tmLE2a3jyqYAeuCbrPJeoY6w6LA4yheKaz3ugZhgnQi4k9sL3enYHNpWrHzsMrkDdvb.jpg) ![1000897970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tvgK1JeCSGQmkUxG3ShQLNhm4vJRJoXpKvQBf5RWgQng7vN1Hq9nLDXs3ZdiWyXgH7E.jpg) ![1000897971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tmHec4rQNe91PenffDQTZFuDKYL8q3y1YgwotGTU2vEpUDfpUuFpseoNzaY98XEbZvM.jpg) ![1000897972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23u5bbZAPEa3Sxpintx3umh6VgrQ88351g39RnVGhuHPL513rW4FTGs7ViLPp7KNb42g5.jpg) ![1000898011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xKjk925cpczEGsLWMGEgb8G38yWNzc1BmJtSXL7oqc2SbBxDqCTERWErT2HezrVBfKT.jpg)

body.title: The Next Pandemic: Hantavirus?
body.body:
# The Next Pandemic: Hantavirus?

**Source:** https://www.gavi.org/vaccineswork/next-pandemic/hantavirus


      

Spread from rodents to humans, old and new world Hantavirus has become endemic in many continents, but are sporadic cases of person-to-person transmission strong enough evidence to fear its pandemic potential?


In April 1993, concerns of a mysterious plague outbreak shook the Native American region bordering Utah, Colorado, Arizona and New Mexico. After the mysterious deaths of a young Navajo couple in New Mexico, state officials struggled to identify the cause, but were able to link symptoms to a dozen more cases in this region. It was later discovered that a novel species of hantavirus had emerged, known as Sin Nombre Virus (Spanish for “No name”), which eventually claimed the lives of 13 people. This outbreak is now known as the “1993 Four Corners outbreak” and has raised concern about the evolution of hantaviruses.

Orthohantaviruses are a viral genus which are able to cause disease in humans. These are transmitted through inhalation of aerosols from infected rodent excretions and cause a range of haemorrhagic and pneumonic symptoms. Particular species such as Hantaan orthohantavirus and Dobrava-Belgrade orthohantavirus have most likely been circulating in regions of the world for centuries, while Sin Nombre virus and Andes virus species were isolated in the 1990s. This distinction between old and new world viruses is significant regarding morbidity and mortality as well as their potential to become pandemic. Human-to-human transmission of hantavirus is very rare, but even so epidemics remain a public health concern, particularly because of the risk of household infections and nosocomial spread, where transmission occurs within hospitals and clinics.

DISEASE: Hantavirus

Where is it circulating? Hantaviruses can be found endemically across most of the world. Hantavirus haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) has been around for many centuries, predominantly circulating in European and Asian countries. However, in 2006 a species called Sangassou virus was isolated in an African wood mouse in Guinea. Further seroprevalence studies (which determine how many people have antibodies against a certain pathogen and thus are likely to have been exposed) suggest its presence in Côte d’Ivoire and the Democratic Republic of the Congo although no cases have been reported. On the other hand, hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) or hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) is regarded as a New World disease because it was first isolated in the 1990s. Since then, it has become endemic across North and South America, with species such as Andes virus being of particular concern in Chile and Argentina.

Pandemic threat: Low. Annually approximately 200,000 global cases and hantavirus-like symptoms are reported. However, the long incubation period combined with the emergence of New World species causing HPS mean that hantaviruses are becoming an increasing concern. Similarly, epidemics of person-to-person transmission of the Andes virus in Argentina and Chile indicate it can evolve to sustain human-to-human transmission.

How is it spread? Rodents can become infected with the virus but don’t become diseased. The virus is most commonly transmitted to humans when they come into contact with aerosols from infected saliva, urine or faecal matter of infected rodents. Also with small epidemics in 1996, 2006 and 2018 epidemiological data has linked the cause to person-to-person transmission.

Case fatality: Rates for HFRS generally range between 5-15%, compared to HPS which are between 35-50%.



Incubation period: Hantavirus incubation ranges from two to four weeks. This long incubation period can allow more people to become infected before preventative measures can be put in place to stop spread of the disease.

Symptoms: Initially symptoms are similar to influenza - fever, aches and vomiting. HFRS causes internal bleeding (haemorrhaging) which may lead to kidney dysfunction, while HPS is associated with pneumonic symptoms, such as accumulation of fluid in the lungs, which may result in cardiovascular shock.

Diagnostics: Hantaviruses can be detected using reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) of lung tissue, blood clots and nucleated blood cells. Immunological assays can also identify the presence of antibodies during the infection; this is done using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) or rapid immunoblot strip assays (RIBA). It is likely that many cases go undetected as symptoms may be misinterpreted for other infections. In one case, a woman in Colorado believed she had fallen ill with SARS-CoV-2 after a camping trip, but tested positive for hantavirus.

Are there vaccines or treatment, or ongoing R&D? In 1976, a South Korean physician called Ho Wang Lee was the first person to isolate Hantaan virus and produced a vaccine against HFRS in 1990. This inactivated whole viral vaccine has only been approved in China and South Korea due to  limited evidence for its efficacy. There is no vaccine against HPS, however there are four types in development: three in phase 1 of clinical trials and one in phase 2a. Hantavirus is treated using symptomatic preventions such as ventilation and often ribavirin, an anti-viral medication. There are limited studies determining the efficacy of ribavirin, which is likely why case fatality rates are so high.

HOW COULD WE LOWER THE RISK OF IT BECOMING PANDEMIC?

On an individual basis, it is important to avoid risk of exposure by storing food in containers and maintaining a clean house. If rodents infest a home, it is important to implement a rodent control program and clean excrement to prevent inhalation of aerosols. Like all emerging and re-emerging diseases, genomic and serological surveillance is important in monitoring the progression of mutations to prevent spread of more infectious hantavirus species. In areas susceptible to Andes virus, healthcare systems should be prepared to implement prevention strategies for person-to-person transmission to protect patients and healthcare workers.

title.title: Про їжачків
title.body: Джес на прогулянці зустріла їжака. Голосний \

, моє попередження - не чіпати, фотосесія. Заодно зафіксувала поруч кущ калини, щоб знати пору року та розташування: звісно, калина ж є символом України.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Eo6J4a4bByYgDGJpLEKBq8RVPfFPUUrdEb56iGDjSgx1votHNyc2UAxM7am3EmTxEet.jpg)
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23uQiCDET3oYy5257FcJ7ZkaVLwFKzieTAsnHE6j4ucu6wGXwKgpfLzD1xF8JapdGisvQ.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EoCiCRXXSRwqH29LT3AvY224Ss2x4PGiadXi7Tg6foddFT5ATL4RJaXvNrZzfgp6wSC.jpg)

Думаю, немає в Україні людини, яка б у своєму житті не стикалася з їжаком. Вони живуть всюди, - і в селах, і в містах. Особливо активними стають у квітні - травні, і саме тоді їжачка можна побачити зблизька, навіть погодувати чи сфотографувати, а якщо вмієш уберегтися від його колючок - то і на руки взяти.
Але мало хто з нас знає, наскільки корисна ця тваринка і як важливо знати про її потреби. Мені сподобалася картинка з інтернету, створена ШІ. 

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/244UzARYWRQCRCX95xkP7KUrJtjJa7nkLTaxjZoFHs8omKek6xGNdKKHW8EeK2ENRFCYF.jpg)
[Джерело](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=26601949959487307&set=a.1394343664007951)

Як ми можемо переконатися, їжаки дуже корисні для людини. Вони оберігають наші сади, поля, городи від таких шкідників, яких досить важко позбутися. Таким чином, їжак рятує нам врожай.
А от про молоко я не знала. А в дитинстві ще й мала свого \

їжачка, якого регулярно поїла молоком. І гарненько отримувала прочухана за це від мами. 
Розкажу, як це було. 
Молоко я носила від тітоньки із села. У такому бідончику з кришкою. В цю кришку дуже зручно наливати молоко. Але той бік, який я ставила на землю, щоб їжак міг попити, бруднився. А я після їжакової трапези про це забувала і просто накривала бідончик. Все сміття, що начіплялося із землі, потрапляло в молоко... 
Так мама мене і викрила.😁
І це добре, бо той їжачок міг загинути від мого молочка.

body.title: Squash bug
body.body: > Among the lush cucumber plants, something caught my attention. There, I found a small, unique-looking insect with a beautiful body pattern like a natural painting. I slowly approached the insect's location. It was a squash bug, or Leptoglossus gonagra in Latin. The first time I saw it, it was on a cucumber flower. However, as I approached, it scurried away to hide. Luckily, I had already turned on my camera, so I managed to capture the beautiful moment, even though I was a little tired from chasing it.

> This was the first time I'd encountered a leaf-footed bug with this pattern. The pattern on its body is incredibly beautiful, resembling a tiny, neatly arranged mosaic. At first glance, the pattern seems ordinary, but upon closer inspection, it's truly captivating. The orange blends beautifully with the glossy black. As the sun begins to shine on its body, its appearance becomes even more stunning. The surrounding green leaves create a perfect backdrop, making its appearance even more prominent, as if the world around it were deliberately giving way to its beauty.

> As it trotted slowly, its long antennae continued to twitch, as if it were telling me not to come near it. But I didn't care, her charm kept making me want to get closer. Her long legs were carefully spread apart, as if she didn't want anyone around her to see her scared of me. Lol, it looked hilarious.

body.title: Una mesa de galleta / A cookie table
body.body:
<center>

Traje de un país lejano 
una galleta de color claro,
es wafer con sabor avainillado
y mi perro se queda intrigado. 

Retiro el farol de una mesa pequeña
y pongo la galleta con delicadeza,
así,  más grande quedará la mesa
y pongo la lámpara sobre ella. 

>I brought back from a faraway land
a light-colored cookie,
a vanilla-flavored wafer,
and my dog is intrigued.

>I remove the lantern from a small table
and place the cookie there gently,
so the table will have more room,
and I set the lamp on top of it.

![53173.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zbTcmo5A6P3SSgn7b23nJ2SCvuj2ZPqNjFrfddxuKL3ajhtPGvAAFxrDg7biAQUFppd.gif)

Se ve bastante original,
y me marchó para almorzar,
mi perro siente el olor sin igual
y se acerca con curiosidad. 

Las galletas huelen muy agradable 
y mi perro la muerde con afanes,
la disfrutá, muy bien sabe,
es una mesa de sabor inigualable. 

>It looks pretty unique,
and I went off to have lunch,
my dog picks up the unmistakable scent
and approaches curiously.

>The cookies smell really good,
and my dog eagerly takes a bite,
he enjoys them, he knows a good thing when he sees it,
it’s a treat with an unbeatable flavor. 

![53174.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/242Y9mhFrtaAdT7TSdHJU7J9j5UVNekXHojoRt3wxtms7e8Z77hhQPMTJJ7vEUPMYyLZM.gif)

Y cuando regreso al lugar,
la mesa mordida está,
hablo con mi perro, que carisbajo va,
él sabe que actuó mal. 

Es solo una mesa de galleta,
no voy a pelear por situaciones de esas
es mi culpa por traer cosas excéntricas 
para agrandar la mesa pequeña.

>And when I return to the spot,
the table is chewed up,
I talk to my dog, who looks downcast,
he knows he did something wrong.

>It’s just a cookie table,
I’m not going to make a big deal out of something like that,
it’s my fault for bringing in weird things
to make the small table bigger.

body.title: Which editions will be the most affordable to buy in 2026?
body.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

About 9 days ago, I posted an article discussing the correct order for leveling up cards, In that post, I discussed rarities, keeping in mind all the new players who have no idea what they’re about, as well as the order in which I believe cards should be leveled up, considering the limited budget many players have—as is my case. If you have a larger budget, the order is completely different, since you should play more aggressively and go for cards that offer greater versatility and board control. That’s why, for those who haven’t seen that post, I’ll link it at the end of this post.

So today I want to expand on that information, but this time from the perspective of editing. You could say this is the second part of that post, and as I mentioned, we’ll cover recommended edits, how to properly manage resources and budgets, what kind of strategy you can apply, and a few other details that will surely be very useful for all of you. So, if you’re just getting started, this will be perfect for you.

**If you missed the first post, I’ll just link it here so you can click [HERE](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@cieliss/what-is-the-correct-order-for-leveling-up-your-level-cards-in-splinterlands) and read it before continuing with this one. After that, continue with this one and stick around until the end.**

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Which editions are worth buying in Splinterlands?</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

As I mentioned earlier, this post is aimed at users with limited funds, so I’ll proceed in that order to help those players—who I’m sure are quite numerous these days. So, pay close attention; the information is fairly straightforward, so you shouldn’t have any trouble:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>More affordable editions</center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/EoGw4LCTvgKmqLP9crQEGwi6GKcBv6rutBACt5t27mM2FUavsoc51UsVLtrFyH1M3m6.png)

* **Chaos Legion:** Without a doubt, this is currently the most affordable edition available in Splinterlands, and that’s because there’s a high supply of these cards. I won’t go into detail about that, but what is certain is that they’re great cards in terms of gameplay, so if you’re on a tight budget, this is the best option.

* **Rebellion and Conclave Arcana:** These are the sets I’ve chosen because they represent the current meta, and the point of investing is to stay up to date. That’s why I’m not going with Untamed, Beta, or—let alone—Alpha, since the real demand is for these last two. Although I would prioritize “Arcane Conclave,” since it’s the newest set and will take much longer to transition to “Wild Format,” so it will remain in the meta for quite some time, and there are quite a few accessible “Common and Rare” cards. Epics and Legendaries depend on the specific card, but read the first post to see the order.

* **Cards Crafted as “Thessok Hunter”:** I’m including them here because if you’re active in “Land Plots” and have resources, crafting these cards—though I have no idea if there’s still an opportunity to do so—is a good option, especially since they fall under the “Arcane Conclave” framework, and their abilities are quite strong and all part of the META. 

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>Resource Management and the Budget</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Here we’re taking things to a whole new level, since managing all your resources is almost as important—if not more so—than the battle strategy we use while playing. That’s why I’ve put together a series of practical tips for this section that you can use to manage your resources effectively, avoid wasting them, and handle other important details that are sure to help you:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Budget Management and Strategies</center>

* **Buying or Opening Packs:** This is a pretty common question in the community, but if your resources are limited—which is the focus of this post—and you just want to play, buying individual cards and building your deck from there will always be the best option. On the other hand, buying “Packs” isn’t a bad idea, but you shouldn’t open them; they should serve as a medium- to long-term investment—but only for those still available in stores. Since those that are out of stock and can only be obtained through “Hive Engine” involve speculating on their price, this can be riskier and doesn’t guarantee you’ll make a profit.

* **Using GLINT:** This is something I’ve said many times: managing your GLINT will help you a lot as you progress through the game, especially if you’re new. The right way to use it is in the shop to buy “Draws” of specific rarities so you can gradually complete the current reward deck. Of course, that’s not all—you should also buy chests and always keep a reserve for “Energy” and any other “Items” you might need, such as positions.

* **Free-to-Play:** This is one of the \
cards, especially in Campaign mode and then by playing \

mode.

* **Moderate Spending:** Here, I recommend renting high-level cards to move up a league, which will earn you more SPS. Of course, you should have a good amount of SPS in staking, which you can also rent, but the key here is that you own your “Archons,” since they are the most expensive; that way, “renting” will be much more affordable.

* **Competitive:** You should try to acquire \

cards—not just because of their high market value, but because they can give you a significant advantage in the game. While this is difficult, you could earn a huge reward in one fell swoop. It requires luck, but it could help you win more and reinvest those winnings to complete your deck. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif I hope this post has helped you round out the information from the first part. Now, with all these tips, you have a complete guide on what to do to balance a deck properly on a tight budget. Of course, this will take time, but the key is consistency, so stick with it, and I’m sure you’ll see results in the medium and long term. What did you think of the information? If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment on this post—I’ll be happy to answer them.

body.body:
Як красиво зараз в садах та парках. Щоправда, стверджувати це може той, хто не має алергії. Та й той хто її має, всеодно тішиться такою красою, просто щоб ця втіха не супроводжувалась ще й мукою через закладений ніс, чи сльозотечу, чи чхання і кашель - мусить закидатись протиалергічним препаратами.

title.title: Oil Prices Are Falling Again… But Is The World Really Becoming More Stable?
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUkWzgNpaxpwxkH9amXMKy6SAGu2VoG9kJEfDsZnK5mx6/1000702839.png 



Recently, global oil prices moved lower after reports suggested that the United States and Iran may be making progress in diplomatic negotiations.
At first glance, this may sound like positive news.
Lower oil prices usually mean:
cheaper energy
lower transportation costs
reduced inflation pressure
and potentially more economic stability
Markets reacted quickly.
Investors immediately began pricing in the possibility that:
geopolitical tensions may ease
sanctions on Iran could eventually soften
and global oil supply might increase again
But personally…
I think this situation reveals something much deeper about the modern global economy.
Because today’s markets are no longer driven only by economic fundamentals.
They are increasingly driven by:
geopolitical fear
uncertainty
emotional reactions
and global instability.
And oil sits at the center of all of it.
Why Oil Still Controls So Much Of The Global Economy
Many people underestimate how important oil still is.
Even in an era dominated by:
AI
crypto
digital finance
and advanced technology
the global economy still depends heavily on energy.
Oil affects almost everything:
transportation
food prices
manufacturing
shipping
airlines
electricity
logistics
and industrial production
This is why even small movements in oil prices can ripple through the entire world economy.
When oil rises sharply:
inflation usually increases
central banks become more aggressive
markets become nervous
and consumers suffer
But when oil falls:
inflation pressure may ease
investor confidence often improves
and markets become more optimistic
This is why oil remains one of the most politically sensitive assets on Earth.
Why Iran Matters So Much In Global Energy Markets
Iran is not just another oil-producing country.
Iran sits in one of the most strategically important regions in the world.
The Middle East controls a massive portion of global energy flows.
And near Iran lies the Strait of Hormuz: one of the most important oil shipping routes on the planet.
A significant percentage of the world’s oil passes through that narrow region.
That means any tension involving Iran can instantly affect:
oil supply fears
shipping risks
insurance costs
and global market psychology
This is why headlines involving Iran often move markets very quickly.
Sometimes faster than actual economic data itself.
The Market Reacts To Fear Faster Than Facts
One fascinating thing about modern markets is this:
Markets often react to expectations before reality changes.
Even the possibility of improving relations between the US and Iran can influence prices immediately.
Because investors constantly try to predict:
future supply
future conflict
future inflation
and future economic conditions
In many ways, markets today operate like giant emotional forecasting machines.
And fear spreads extremely fast.
This is why:
one political statement
one military threat
one negotiation update
or one diplomatic meeting
can suddenly move:
oil
gold
stocks
bonds
and crypto markets globally
The world economy has become deeply interconnected emotionally, politically, and financially.
Why Falling Oil Prices Could Help The Global Economy
If oil prices continue stabilizing or falling moderately, several positive effects could appear.
1. Inflation Pressure Could Ease
High energy costs increase prices across the economy.
Lower oil prices may help:
transportation
food distribution
manufacturing
and consumer costs
This gives central banks slightly more room to slow aggressive interest rate policies.
2. Consumer Spending Could Improve
When fuel prices fall, ordinary people often have more disposable income.
That can temporarily support:
retail spending
travel
and economic activity
3. Markets May Become More Optimistic
Lower energy costs often improve investor confidence.
Risk assets like:
stocks
crypto
and emerging markets
sometimes benefit when inflation fears decline.
But There Is A Bigger Problem Underneath
Personally…
I do not think lower oil prices automatically mean the global economy is suddenly safe again.
Because the deeper issue is uncertainty itself.
The modern world is increasingly fragile due to:
geopolitical tension
debt pressure
inflation
supply chain risks
slowing growth
and global political fragmentation
Oil prices simply reflect these tensions.
They do not solve them.
And honestly, the world today feels extremely sensitive to instability.
One conflict can affect energy.
Energy affects inflation.
Inflation affects interest rates.
Interest rates affect markets.
Markets affect consumer confidence.
And confidence affects the economy itself.
Everything is connected.
The Global Economy Is Becoming More Emotional
One thing I notice more and more is this:
Modern economies are increasingly psychological.
Markets no longer move only based on hard numbers.
They move based on:
fear
confidence
narratives
uncertainty
and expectations about the future
This is why geopolitical news now moves markets so aggressively.
Because investors are trying to survive in a world that feels less predictable than before.
And in uncertain environments, people become emotionally reactive.
What Could Happen Next?
There are several possible scenarios.
Scenario 1: Tensions Continue Easing
If negotiations improve further:
oil prices may stabilize
inflation pressure could soften
and markets may remain relatively optimistic
Scenario 2: Tensions Escalate Again
But if diplomacy fails:
oil could spike sharply
inflation fears may return
and global volatility could increase rapidly
This is why markets remain nervous even during temporary optimism.
Because the world economy today depends heavily on fragile stability.
My Personal View
Personally, I think the biggest lesson here is not only about oil.
It is about how vulnerable the global economy has become to uncertainty.
A single geopolitical headline now has the power to influence:
inflation expectations
global markets
investor psychology
and even public confidence
That tells us something important.
The modern financial system may appear stable on the surface…
but underneath, pressure is constantly building.
And perhaps the most important skill in this era is not predicting every market move…
but staying mentally calm while the world becomes increasingly unstable.
Final Question
Do you think falling oil prices are a sign that the world economy is becoming more stable…
or are markets simply reacting emotionally to temporary geopolitical optimism?
#EYS | Turning Patience Into Power 🌍💎

Gracias a mi primera ganancia en esta plataforma de Hive me logré comprar unas acuarelas escarchadas y un cuaderno con la portada de una de las obras de Van Gogh. 
En este momento tenía ese cuaderno y pensaba que quería llenarlo de dibujos que estuvieran a la talla de lo lindo que es el cuaderno y como no tenía ni idea que hacer pensé en hacer flores, porque me gustan mucho las flores y tenía mucho que no las dibujaba así que pensé;

-¿por que no hacerlas?

Fue cuando hice está flor que honestamente no recuerdo cómo se llama, pero me encanta lo linda que es. 

La hice y me encantaba pero la veía muy vacía, como si le faltará algo así que después de pensar y pensar se me ocurrió estrenar las acuarelas etc este dibujo y pensé en hacerle un círculo porque era lo más sencillo y así no me complicaba tanto y no le restaría protagonismo a la flor. Lo hice y brilla mucho si es un poquito transparente pero brilla bastante.

title.title: The encounter with a lily that stopped time for me [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUmBAdyoi7jHbwyB2G6ZjRT3ffUvyifePzYAY5nx9EptU/1779253473436.jpg)




***
***
Today, during my daily walk through these tropical streets that I already know by heart, something curious happened to me. My heart stopped in front of a lily. It was not the first time I had seen one like this. I had come across them before in neglected gardens or forgotten pots, but I had never truly stopped.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZy4gwkfbFCWQpvF1N6Qaej9F7vaCCUhoFY4d3ApBHqxx/1779253558713.jpg)



***
I do not know its name, and there is something beautiful in that ignorance, because I do not need a botanical label to explain what I felt. It was there, amidst the oppressive heat of the afternoon and the ground still damp from the early morning rain, standing upright as if nothing around it mattered, and it finally won me over.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas1NrA4e3f5SgU8d9KGz1JRtNX3kUE3Ws3oWFeDGQzAW/1779253558593.jpg)

***
Its flowers were enormous, and I am truly not exaggerating, they were the size of a deep plate, open with a generosity that almost seems like a miracle in this climate. The white of its petals was not that cold, hospital or laboratory white, but a warm white, with shadows, as if it had absorbed some sunlight filtered through the leaves but what left me breathless were the fine, precise lines running from the center to the edges in shades that I could not call purple or pink with certainty. It was a wild glamour, and I say glamour because the word elegance falls short. This was more: it was a flower dressed for a gala in the middle of the noisy, green chaos of my tropical city.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQwSCk2fTTkcD9iFzr4TYkzpnLWdorPsoHKTEiSCmfNC/1779253558829.jpg)


***
I knelt on the sidewalk to look at it properly. The air smelled of wet earth and distant jasmine, and seeing that lily was like encountering something you did not expect but you needed. In these days when everything moves fast, when the heat makes us sharp and routine dulls us, an enormous flower with purple lines reminded me that I am still capable of adoration.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpKNnk5PNu9CyUxL6Xs7VVF3GSthbw7WqSvNTeFDg1QR/1779253558443.jpg)

***
I do not know if I will see it again because maybe by tomorrow it will already be wilted, as large flowers often are fragile, like everything that dares to shine in the tropics, but that does not matter. It left its image engraved on me, and now, as I write, I close my eyes and I still see that white stained with purple pink, moving gently with the breeze.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDK4sugFpmYzp4s9mUU816uH4cdnx4WbHTbtmqKhidoM/1779253558767.jpg)


***
Sometimes you go out for a walk without looking for anything, and life plants a lily in the middle of the asphalt to remind you that beauty does not ask for permission.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1779067886188.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.  
𝑨𝒍𝒍 **𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒎𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏-𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒆 (𝒏𝒐 𝑨𝑰).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒊𝒈𝒏𝒆𝒅 𝒃𝒚 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
𝑳𝒐𝒗𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒕? **𝑼𝒑𝒗𝒐𝒕𝒆, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕, 𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈** 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔 𝒐𝒇 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒕𝒚! 💗</sub>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>El encuentro con un lirio que me detuvo el tiempo </center>




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNacAuCxH8JBpkaiCF9AamcwwvtHwtysHdU2nAyZWxCqg/1779253473581.jpg)


***
***





Hoy, en mi caminata diaria por estas calles tropicales que ya conozco de memoria, me pasó algo curioso. El corazón se me detuvo frente a un lirio. No era la primera vez que veía uno así. Lo he cruzado otras veces en jardines descuidados o en macetas olvidadas, pero nunca me había detenido de verdad.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZy4gwkfbFCWQpvF1N6Qaej9F7vaCCUhoFY4d3ApBHqxx/1779253558713.jpg)

***
No sé su nombre y hay algo hermoso en esa ignorancia, porque no necesito una etiqueta botánica para explicar lo que sentí. Estaba ahí, entre el bochorno de la tarde y el suelo aún húmedo por la lluvia de la madrugada, erguido como si nada a su alrededor importara, y finalmente me ganó.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas1NrA4e3f5SgU8d9KGz1JRtNX3kUE3Ws3oWFeDGQzAW/1779253558593.jpg)

***
Sus flores eran enormes, y de verdad que no exagero, pues eran del tamaño de un plato hondo, abiertas con una generosidad que en este clima casi parece un milagro. El blanco de sus pétalos no era ese blanco frío de hospital o de laboratorio, sino un blanco cálido, con sombras, como si hubiera absorbido un poco de luz de sol filtrada por las hojas pero lo que me dejó sin aliento fueron las líneas finas, precisas, que bajaban desde el centro hacia los bordes en tonos que no sabría si llamar púrpura o rosa. Era un glamour salvaje, y digo glamour porque la palabra elegancia se queda corta. Esto era más: era una flor vestida de gala en medio del caos verde y ruidoso de mi ciudad tropical.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQwSCk2fTTkcD9iFzr4TYkzpnLWdorPsoHKTEiSCmfNC/1779253558829.jpg)


***
Me arrodillé en la acera para mirarlo bien. El aire olía a tierra mojada y a jazmín lejano, y ver ese lirio era como encontrarse con algo que no te esperabas pero que necesitabas. En estos días donde todo va rápido, donde el calor nos vuelve cortantes y la rutina nos opaca, una flor enorme de líneas púrpuras me recordó que aún soy capaz de adorar.
***




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpKNnk5PNu9CyUxL6Xs7VVF3GSthbw7WqSvNTeFDg1QR/1779253558443.jpg)

***
No sé si volveré a verlo porque tal vez mañana ya esté marchito, porque las flores grandes suelen ser frágiles, como todo lo que se atreve a brillar en el trópico, pero eso no importa. Me dejó su imagen grabada, y ahora, mientras escribo, cierro los ojos y sigo viendo ese blanco manchado de rosa púrpura, moviéndose apenas con la brisa.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDK4sugFpmYzp4s9mUU816uH4cdnx4WbHTbtmqKhidoM/1779253558767.jpg)

***
A veces uno sale a caminar sin buscar nada, y la vida te planta un lirio en medio del asfalto para que recuerdes que la belleza no pide permiso.


<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1778037185350.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmas1NrA4e3f5SgU8d9KGz1JRtNX3kUE3Ws3oWFeDGQzAW/1779253558593.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** 🍃
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒆ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
¿𝑻𝒆 𝒈𝒖𝒔𝒕ó 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂 𝒑𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒂𝒄𝒊ó𝒏? **𝑽𝒐𝒕𝒂, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒖𝒆𝒂** 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒂𝒚𝒖𝒅𝒂𝒓 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒓 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒂𝒔. 💗</sub>

---

I cringe even calling these #podcasts because well...I'm used to having some structure when I post a pod.

At least I have in years past....

Now, I just shoot from the hip.  And tonight I had this big huge #biblejournal post planned and well, God had be go another direction.

And I spoke from the heart. I was all over the place.

But if you do listen to the ramblings, I think you will see that it's a passionate message about....Life.

Especially life in Christ.

I hope you enjoy the talk.  Post a thoughtful comment, which shows me you actually listened to the show because I have some rewards to give out :)

---

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A Wednesday of work and stories blossoming in the Valley
title.body: > **Sharing my post in the #WednesdayWalk community has become one of my weekly routines—a tradition I look forward to with excitement and joy, thanks to the wonderful initiative of our friend @tattoodjay. Every week, I feel like this space is like an open window to show a little piece of my day, my travels, and life on our beloved island. Before I tell you about my outing today, I want to send you my warmest greetings and wish you a wonderful day and a promising week, full of good news and moments worth remembering. My journey began very early in the morning. Although we had to work, the day looked light, without any major complications. The first stop was the Sunsol Unik Hotel, where we had to submit a quote for some trench filter loads. Afterward, our plan was to head to the Valley to visit a friend’s bottling plant who needed a little support and advice. The road to the Unik Hotel was lined with those vibrant landscapes that so characterize the island. The weather was warm, but not as stifling as it had been weeks ago, when the heat seemed to envelop everything. Even so, we know that these days it’s essential to stay well-hydrated and protected from the sun. Despite the drought that has been with us for months, the island always finds a way to show off its beauty**

> *Compartir mi publicación en la comunidad #paseo de miércoles se ha convertido en una de mis rutinas semanales, una costumbre que espero con entusiasmo y alegría gracias a la hermosa iniciativa de nuestro amigo @tattoodjay. Cada semana siento que este espacio es como una ventana abierta para mostrar un pedacito de mi día, de mis recorridos y de la vida en nuestra querida Isla. Antes de contarles cómo fue mi paseo de este día, quiero saludarles con cariño y desearles un día maravilloso y una semana prometedora, llena de buenas noticias y momentos que valgan la pena recordar. Mi recorrido comenzó desde bien temprano en la mañana. Aunque teníamos que trabajar, el día se presentaba ligero, sin mayores complicaciones. La primera parada era el Hotel Sunsol Unik, donde debíamos entregar un presupuesto para unas cargas de los filtros de trinchera. Después, nuestro plan era dirigirnos al Valle para visitar la planta embotelladora de un amigo que necesitaba un poco de apoyo y asesoramiento. El camino hacia el Hotel Unik estaba lleno de esos paisajes vibrantes que tanto caracterizan a la Isla. El clima estaba cálido, pero no tan agobiante como semanas atrás, cuando el calor parecía envolverlo todo. Aun así, ya sabemos que en estos días es indispensable mantenerse bien hidratados y protegidos del sol. A pesar de la sequía que nos acompaña desde hace meses, la Isla siempre encuentra la manera de mostrarse hermosa.*
![1000475863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7ta6kpaiyCbn1uTn6qSgpfbmbRieSWLU2rp1JxKFCqnj5ZK1hTpdDFF6AEQYNEBSn.jpg) ![1000475865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK4tCrkUJqNxkBEegcCEyhmz8AaMwSQ86svpUUq9wKVyYFeShueZWTVj3iXATkTy6c.jpg)
> **When we arrived at the hotel, we were warmly welcomed, as always. We handed over the quote and left, since we weren't scheduled to service the tank or the laundry filters that day.**

> *Al llegar al hotel fuimos bien recibidos, como siempre. Entregamos el presupuesto y nos retiramos, ya que ese día no tocaba hacerles servicio ni al tanque ni a los filtros de lavandería.*
![1000475849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xVPTsK7qkR4T2dS4a22aCCXJ2ZpckuH6Xfu1Dc23PKfFPF73WGZnZVtSruD57FdJKjn.jpg) ![1000475823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7ve2uNUzwrKUT2qtQ6kzWGcMiE3j7YBigWpo3KUN8ayXFi7JrQYvprFX9ZmyR3T57.jpg) ![1000475819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqYtDBB3QR85mA2dqyf4NGwty3QfmLDTeFsMN3Z8Wy3pG55qnGcA3SsX35uPCkKVgfn.jpg)

> **With that first task completed, we continued on our way to the Valley, to the home of our friends who run a small bottling plant. They needed some guidance, and, as always, it was a pleasure to help.**

> *Con esa primera tarea cumplida, continuamos nuestro recorrido hacia el Valle, a casa de nuestros amigos que tienen una pequeña planta de llenado de botellones. Ellos necesitaban orientación y, como siempre, fue un gusto poder ayudar.*
![1000475825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq365DyRjM9DjAHa2FFYGV797RMbrCeCAHFpT6TkD1mkNaDQLmjZnrVWkeFfB93KDh6.jpg) ![1000475824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXJzehjoQostPeL795prHeAHdvp75btrvhKZRcHG2aoJ4sdYmNq7nCVm9dUPehD2jA.jpg) ![1000475821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXKw3CsWQ1vMUYk8HrFtLs8h73iMc3ndnm7XEZwGDF4GtS73WeWpH68B7NbH3Yasqc.jpg) ![1000475860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqQNd3TVYqWxLPcdaQmF4ov2BznrPG3XRTubmaCr5QLjzB8Laumyz2KtrEgGYnq8GSc.jpg)

> **As we left his house, we decided to take a walk down River Street, a place I love. Not just because of the river that runs through it—though it’s currently dry due to the severe drought affecting the entire island—but because of the enormous trees that line the entire street. Their thick trunks seem to hold decades of stories, as if each one were a silent guardian of the valley.**

> *Al salir de su casa decidimos pasar por la calle del río, un lugar que me encanta. No solo por el río que la atraviesa —aunque ahora está seco por la fuerte sequía que azota toda la Isla— sino por los enormes árboles que bordean toda la calle. Sus troncos gruesos parecen guardar historias de décadas, como si cada uno fuera un guardián silencioso del Valle.*
![1000475832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiUgGUXvctRBHSyTHBMxWNvRaiC4Yqy3DAtPhWDxwPtR35h6AcCgF15W7kMb5chmxT.jpg) ![1000475831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK5qmKzGkDEXKEiVF3aRKpsMuLCNpd2xmDTaAcScz3XwWDcDg2YDL6ucTjzf1cS9Ez.jpg) ![1000475829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eokcgpr72bzw3xJCV42wGhLdzwVYMRV5HUPccr9FNMVVMByzmmmXE2D1aNzg4hnXguq.jpg) ![1000475847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EokcfkVjMBRYhrqWCofzfspXu4cbxYEgpZajJ1UrE3yjw2f9nssKAB1wXAQnfT1tnp3.jpg)

> **Since we were there, we took the opportunity to stroll through its streets and around its plaza, which is always lined with shops selling handicrafts dedicated to the Virgin. It’s an area that stays bustling all year round thanks to the devotees who visit the Basilica del Valle. They come from all over the country—many even outside of the festival season—just to pay homage to the island’s patron saint.**

> *Ya que estábamos allí, aprovechamos para recorrer sus calles y su plaza, que siempre está rodeada de locales vendiendo artesanías alegóricas a la Virgen. Es una zona que mantiene movimiento durante todo el año gracias a los devotos que visitan la Basílica del Valle. Vienen de todas partes del país, muchos fuera de las fechas festivas, solo para rendirle honores a la patrona de la Isla.*
![1000475852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnqTWPp3pRRmFjgxt333jaXbrUGuzrkD9GDX61EMz7canXodGTtdpgXB7nBL7SCA2C8.jpg) ![1000475851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnaZDiYuSFT2tSeEEa38SLpGr3vo8ucbSbHGuVVQea9f4sNc3ptXmPvhkWAjFTSeqFo.jpg) ![1000475854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnoK8C2iWczo7ByEpJxnZ89WenEZGXkbErBvUGRvQfCXfHx7sePcbYAfEMGjEGmJYNK.jpg) ![1000475855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXJzec3icEPMr16iVtAWZaECuncTHK68Ut5tz4ADpw62uoEadKsh5ZdZrLwpPSeDav.jpg) ![1000475857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eqd9Uk7UE2V5pLRqCKUJLaw5BXqFzfEAeZaxwjfKQbMmFSTkRkvuyvuiqC5ByEFA2g5.jpg) ![1000475853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxqicMWkgy9FGVXzSPz1d6V5uC9oNXj1jamshvwB9eYQv1Yi1MUKAbqZQLVqkfyAYV.jpg) ![1000475856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFsXY7qsvUJxMtucqB2sNKPJSCyJPkCJGYKf6sPWwJ94y5pciqA5tBpia7GnuqARV2.jpg) ![1000475858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7vW3E1UhSfy4pjuyuY2P6KG2z6Yhb4w12MAPpNsqohuJnmC31Bi2UfAFZ9SmWzveL.jpg) ![1000475846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCqjVJ63eSGHusiwbjTRZPg5kKv5xe5n55Vz6n1RvSuu9Eo1zp2AnBJkvwVnZFgW7.jpg) ![1000475840.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LvYAtNzm5jDmv99HRrk3WkWiNiYo3eSjeBxFnPDwrUYWW9MdAJihNMxfpr3xF5Ka.jpg)

> **In fact, due to the large number of parishioners who would arrive at certain times of the year, the Campo Eucarístico del Valle was created—a spacious area designed to accommodate the tens of thousands of people who could not fit inside the basilica. It is truly impressive to imagine the faith that moves so many people.**

> *Incluso, debido a la cantidad de feligreses que llegaban en ciertas épocas, se creó el Campo Eucarístico del Valle, un espacio amplio para congregar a las decenas de miles de personas que no podían entrar en la basílica. Es impresionante imaginar la fe que mueve a tanta gente.*
![1000475830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5EVprZHXNuUGJwcHwBau96dkRfYph7TVYqGQDJnipS2gtkYdWH8kgLT2NQ1aiUELm.jpg) ![1000475834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnYRPCHAFb5nR2ft47dfjW2hp8eSKaLWtCrT6DEK3wNZiDy491QQwHVpHj3NyU8Mn9d.jpg) ![1000475836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqL8F7dLSRpp3rxEmHLVV87u8dT7pRFnSYyrDvLDagW46fyrjCMFot8FpRgn9uZ3Ze6.jpg)

> **After exploring this beautiful place, we headed home with the satisfaction of having completed our tasks for the day and, moreover, having enjoyed a walk that holds more than just a simple story. They are living testaments to devotion, tradition, and love for our land. I’ll see you next Wednesday. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Después de recorrer este hermoso lugar, nos marchamos a casa con la satisfacción de haber cumplido nuestras tareas del día y, además, haber disfrutado de un paseo que encierra más que una simple historia. Son testimonios vivos de devoción, tradición y amor por nuestra tierra. Me despido de ustedes hasta el próximo miércoles. Hasta pronto. Chao.*
https://images.ecency.com/DQmX41osuLQUYYCyZK8X9Bw9HS64BTvn2S2qu3uWyowNJd4/la_laguna_tania5_copia.png

>

title.title: It's probably a good thing that people come up with wise sayings...
title.body:
It's probably a good thing that people come up with wise sayings that can be followed and relied upon quite wisely in various life situations. Furthermore, these sayings are like a Rubik's Cube: you can spin them around indefinitely, and one such saying goes that where there are no fish, even a crayfish becomes a fish for a fisherman. It seems there's nothing here about landscapes or the sea, but, unfortunately, there are different kinds, some of which can completely disappear from the maps of the world, like the Aral Sea. Therefore, in principle, such a sea could compete with a small puddle, on the surface of which I saw a small landscape of trees, reflected and rippled by a light breeze comparable to a sea breeze, which leaves gentle ripples on the expanse of the sea. And to make the landscape look more interesting and even a little surreal, I took this photo in a negative version. ![1wertPHOTO_20190228_090239.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmc77oovqhHQCZL1kZbw41Y84G2xWJXYvYvFdgz5Nb5xLs/1wertPHOTO_20190228_090239.png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.title: Class Of The Elite Review (1)
title.body:
Hello fellow anime fans,

So I just started Classroom of the Elite and I’m currently on Season 1… and let me just say, this is not the kind of school anime I thought it would be at all.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSp6ZUSoBFvZh89pq2cdvRMRUAQHCTiqGhLgyFJqhKhV5/1779253480104.jpg)

At first, I went into it thinking okay, normal high school vibes, maybe some smart students, maybe a little competition here and there… but nah this one is deeper than that, this school is not just about reading books and passing exams, it is literally like survival of the smartest.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhExBR5TYNhTnCQVNWQ32XWjmi9bDF1KPa1U1RrWKACt/1779253498779.jpg)

So the story is set in this elite school where students are placed into different classes from A to D, with A being the best and D beiing well, the problem children kind of class, and of course, our main characters end up in Class D, but the twist is, this school gives students points every month like money, and how you behave determines if you keep getting those points or not.

Sounds simple right? It’s not.

Because one small mistake, and your whole class suffers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmjugaKAxpYwcC1z1B7XUVrfvEwvvTZWrTnokkY9dT39/1779253509112.jpg)

Now let’s talk about the main guy, Kiyotaka Ayanokoji, this guy ehn… I don’t even know how to explain him properly, at first, he just looks like one quiet boy that does not like stress. Always at the back, minding his business, not trying to shine, but as the episodes go on, you start noticing something is off, like he knows way more than he is showing.

And that is when it starts getting interesting.

Because while everyone is trying to survive school normally, Ayanokoji is out here lowkey controlling situations without people even realizing it, No noise, no drama, just calm calculations, It’s actually scary how he thinks 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVtzsbHu6PoGZGkJj8DhJRpFAXWWVkmsmwuhjpaHH47b/1779253521897.jpg)

Then there’s Suzune Horikita, She’s very serious, doesn’t like unnecessary friendship, and just wants to climb to Class A by all means, At first, she comes off as cold, but as the story moves, you start to understand her a bit more, she is trying, but she is also learning that she can’t do everything alone, One thing I really like about this anime is how it plays with people’s minds, like, it is not about fighting or superpowers, it is about strategy, manipulation, and reading people, you will see characters smiling with you, but deep down, they are planning something else entirely.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwB1Wvy9uoEM9yVjA4Nh9aeDCBrk6LS7CnNvGNiBQAYJ/1779253532196.jpg)

And don’t even let me start with Kikyo Kushida… that one? Just be watching her carefully, that is all I will say 

Season 1 especially focuses on introducing the system of the school and how unfair it can be, there are tests that don’t even feel like normal tests, situations where trust is tested, and moments where you are like wait, what just happened?

And the best part? You can not always predict the outcome.

There were a few times I thought I understood what was going on, then boom, plot twist, especially towards the end of the season, that last part really shows you that Ayanokoji is not just some random quiet guy.

At all.

If I am being honest, I have not even finished the whole series yet, but Season 1 alone has already pulled me in, It is the kind of anime that makes you think, observe, and even question people’s intentions in real life sef 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1QX1CqLV3TpCJuf6nHhzYmTMtYPec83Fs3ZQDrTxDCR/1779253543069.jpg)

So yeah, if you are looking for something different from the usual action anime, something more psychological and smart, this one is definitely worth watching.

And me? I’m not stopping here o,  I need to see what this Ayanokoji guy is really about

*Aikay*👾

title.title: The work of charity
title.body:
---



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4Ce1rieVsoGRU9MEgQSGzVSt5VVY3t3yweoB8d55EmC/pm_1774635361740_cmp.jpg)

**Picture from one of our outrea, faces blur**


---


Charity is something nice and it comes with blessings. I must say that rendering service for the neeedies or less privilege is one thing that I really enjoy and it brings maximum peace of mind. And I like to tell people that the world need more people that are humane.  I am a member of different chairty organization and I have my own charity organizations. Now social media has been helping us get support from people who wish to help, support or partner. Most of these people that support are people that I have not met in person before, and before someone support you with funds to carry out a project, it means the person has a level of trust in you and you must ensure not to disappoint them.
‎
‎Normally , in our own case we ensure we take some pictures during the project and  since we got some of the support from social media platforms, we do post some of the photos there so that the donors and supporters will see and  know that we have used the funds judiciously and to ensure the privacy of the beneficiaries, we use the face blur app, to blur their faces. We don't do that to gain praises.

‎
‎Also there are times I do my own personal charity solely from my pocket without any support , in such cases , no camera is seen around. It's only between me, the beneficiaries and God.
‎
‎But as the prompt rightly stated, social media has made it easy to get people that are in need and also support them. At times we witnessed people doing crowed funding just to help others. And people can easily come online and seek for help and will get help . In the other hand, a lot of people abuse the use of social media to seek for help. At times they fake being sick just to raise funds for themselves, after raising the funds they disappear. And some people also disguise in the name of charity organizations or influencers , get defraud the public and then they don't use the funds judiciously.
‎
‎In the aspect of using social media to scam people we have seen and heard that a lot , some even from influencers, just like the recent case we heard in this country some months ago.
‎
---



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXDgiYEmhsXw9jJS7YHidxzKjG4YmRP4CWh3f2WddH7sY/jpeg_20241019_081428_8315690160467156343.jpg)



---

‎My advice is , for organizations that may get support, grant and partnership from other bodies, using camera is not that bad, because to verify that the said project so funded was carried out, they sponsors might need pictures and videos. But in as much as pictures are being taken, ensure that the faces of the beneficiaries are covered for privacy sake.
‎And if as an influencer or a Charity organization, when you get support for a particular project, ensure you use the fund to deliver the project well. So as to get blessings from God and more support.

---

title.title: Can You Crack SSC While Working or Studying? A Realistic Guide.
title.body:
Preparing for competitive exams like SSC while managing a job or college can feel overwhelming. The question most aspirants ask is simple: Is it really possible? The honest answer is yes — but only with the right strategy, consistency, and guidance.  
At DOTS Academy, many students have successfully cleared exams like the SSC Combined Graduate Level Exam while balancing work or studies. It’s not about studying all day — it’s about studying smart every day.  
Understanding the Challenge  
When you’re working or studying, time becomes your biggest constraint. Unlike full-time aspirants, you cannot dedicate 8–10 hours daily. But that doesn’t mean you are at a disadvantage.  
In fact, working professionals and students often develop:  
• Better time management skills  
• Strong discipline and routine  
• Focused study habits  
These qualities can give you an edge if used properly.  
Smart Strategy for Busy Aspirants  
If you’re preparing through SSC coaching in Kerala or self-study, your approach must be realistic and structured.  
Here’s what works:

1.  Set Practical Study Hours  
    • Aim for 3–5 hours daily instead of unrealistic long schedules  
    • Use early mornings or late evenings effectively  
    • Stay consistent rather than studying in bursts
    
2.  Prioritize Important Topics  
    Whether you are enrolled in SSC CGL coaching in Kollam or attending SSC online coaching Kerala, focus on:  
    • Quantitative Aptitude basics  
    • English grammar and comprehension  
    • Reasoning practice  
    • General Awareness (daily updates)
    
3.  Use Online Learning Wisely  
    Today, SSC CGL online coaching in Kerala and Online SSC classes in Kerala make preparation flexible.  
    • Attend recorded classes anytime  
    • Revise difficult topics multiple times  
    • Practice mock tests regularly  
    This flexibility is especially helpful for working professionals.  
    Choosing the Right Coaching Support  
    Guidance plays a huge role in success. Whether you’re aiming for:  
    • SSC degree level coaching in Kerala  
    • SSC higher secondary level coaching in Kerala  
    • CHSL coaching in Trivandrum or CHSL coaching in Kollam  
    Make sure your coaching provides:  
    • Structured syllabus coverage  
    • Regular mock tests  
    • Doubt-clearing sessions  
    • Personal mentorship  
    For aspirants in cities, options like CGL coaching in Trivandrum, SSC coaching in Kollam, and SSC coaching in Trivandrum offer classroom support, while online platforms ensure learning from anywhere.  
    Daily Routine That Actually Works  
    Here’s a simple routine you can follow:  
    • Morning (1–2 hours): Learn new concepts  
    • Daytime: Work/college  
    • Evening (1–2 hours): Practice questions  
    • Night (30 mins): Revise and take short quizzes  
    Even with a tight schedule, this approach keeps your preparation steady.  
    Common Mistakes to Avoid  
    Many aspirants struggle not because of lack of effort, but because of poor strategy.  
    Avoid these:  
    • Studying without a clear plan  
    • Ignoring mock tests  
    • Switching resources too often  
    • Comparing your progress with others  
    Stick to one reliable source — whether it’s SSC coaching in Kollam or SSC coaching in Kerala — and trust the process.  
    Staying Motivated Throughout the Journey  
    Balancing responsibilities and preparation can feel tiring. There will be days when you feel like giving up. That’s normal.  
    Keep reminding yourself:  
    • You don’t need perfect conditions to succeed  
    • Small daily efforts create big results  
    • Consistency beats intensity  
    Surround yourself with the right environment — mentors, peers, and structured programs like SSC degree level coaching in Kollam or SSC CGL coaching in Kerala can make a big difference.  
    Final Thoughts  
    Cracking SSC while working or studying is not easy — but it is absolutely possible. With disciplined effort, smart planning, and the right guidance, you can turn your limited time into a powerful advantage.  
    DOTS Academy has seen countless aspirants transform their dreams into success stories through focused preparation and consistent support. Whether you choose classroom programs or SSC online coaching Kerala, what matters most is your commitment.  
    Start where you are. Use what you have. Stay consistent.  
    Your SSC success is closer than you think.

title.title: Rustic Yogurt Chicken Masala
title.body:
## <center> Hello all Bloggers </center>

Hi guys...! How are you all, I hope you all are well.
Today my in this blog I will share with you guys a new recipe. 
Last time I shared the recipe of Street-Style Loaded Kabab (Shami) Burger, I am happy you all liked my recipe and gave me great feedback. 
Today I am going to share with you guys the recipe of Rustic Yogurt Chicken Masala.
Let's see how I made it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV11eWAizKjvjeRVvy5AbM4xYSmhk5DFGeqz3vckCrfGE/1779251329334.png)

***

## <center> Ingredients </center>

-  Chicken ( 600 grams )
-  Oil       ( 1 cup )
-  Onion  ( 100 grams )
-  Ginger-Garlic Paste  ( 3 sp )
-  Tomato  ( 150 grams )
-  Yogurt ( 1 cup )
-  Ground Red Chili, Salt, Chili Flexes & Turmeric ( according to taste )
-  Ground Black Pepper & Hot Spice ( 1 tbsp )
-  Fresh Green Coriander ( handful )
-  Green Chillies ( 2 or 3 )

***

## <center> Process </center>

Guys, so far I have shared most of the recipes with you, so today I am going to share a new dish with you guys. 
So, without wasting time, I will tell you how to make it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLzYCzhSJCbj9GMv4ZtrnLi4kqVVDQW25hZ6YTaagMTZ/1779251178732.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVtK16iKbssgGQ9ntwVrAvuqFGs98Do4Qx8tNYXeFAU9E/1779251178798.jpg)|
|-|-|

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXidhdh2vpeUJHWxo5EPwHSoSnsRRFpsjgLM4N3rt8Fn/1779251178862.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaKjLtDAuSk5Di92NjzHF3PBe2BoZ6VUWxhi9bYik8LvE/1779251178919.jpg)|
|-|-|

So first I added cooking oil to a pot and added chicken to it and fried it. 
When the chicken turned brown, I added finely chopped onion to it.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7rR115p7AZLWVK3U653ByAvV1EiRe6Q7oXayVVtEFKP/1779251178972.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHgNKqpzxATWxK6XmobvsiTniHhUSVGhVtGRvjjABHXk/1779251226582.jpg)|
|-|-|

Then I added ginger-garlic paste to it and fried it for some time. 
Now I added tomatoes to it and left it on the simmer for some time. 

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVumQLBnnsWUEDzoWpssjddqkLWpks5Gs5geHgMfxBv4D/1779251226640.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEyKEaxZD1HUoaTKhpieyMX9qVeadegSyeS3yPsUyvDk/1779251226705.jpg)|
|-|-|

After removing the simmer, you can see that the tomatoes have cooked well and I easily removed their skin. 
Now I added ground spices to it which included salt, ground red chili, turmeric and crushed red chili (chili flexes).

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHAgXBkarDExqbtjrvigkkiF1ZGUMTZpdEDHFwxkxvF1/1779251226765.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmad58dqrP71LUHZquHuvpeFRPXjXsMzBaqZ8QoYLhSxri/1779251226821.jpg)|
|-|-|

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbhAPzsvG8e9J8MAxPFFMd4JWiK7hiBvsW56RX3NAbNd5/1779251257749.jpg)

Now I added finely chopped green chillies to it and then added yogurt to it and roasted it well until the meat released the oil.

|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVLSM1V22wGhErX4PnDUK59q25gk9MTCPbkqZV9gFerqR/1779251257824.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUacnWiY7cNUC6yhDQSVuAgrpS8kvhvJdLRsGXQcP4g6A/1779251257877.jpg)|
|-|-|

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSUDRnF1NaDpHFESfwVrcMckvBhReZhxTKhdyTL2QNGgh/1779251257940.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSmou1HSJxBqXxGtknPAUsLB48M23YXKg54d3AS8qSXYr/1779251257995.jpg)|
|-|-|

Now I added ground black pepper to it and cooked it for a while and finally added hot spices and fresh coriander leaves.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRocDZKN9KL4JxjSMABskKo1TRrKhFK62PaE3EJqrYAU9/1779251303043.jpg)

This dish looks incredibly rich, creamy, and comforting.  
A beautifully balanced desi-style creamy chicken dish that feels both traditional and restaurant-worthy.

***

## *Final Look:*

The tender fried chicken coated in flavorful yogurt gravy, combined with the aroma of black pepper and hot spice, gives it a perfect homemade gourmet touch. 
The fresh herbs on top make it look even more appetizing, while the glossy texture of the curry shows how deeply the spices are infused into every bite.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5NB2vDBwF1mtGQYQLbhrXnjiU26FQWs3btgdSP5Jk8r/1779251303104.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX9iDSKKFobKvqpQJH1MNzByxya54iyh5Kvz2QhmUSzKJ/1779251303153.jpg)

***
***

I hope you all like my recipe. I will wait for your comments. Now we will meet in the next post with a new recipe. Until then, Good Bye...🤗

title.title: 5,485 Aceh Hajj Pilgrims Depart, 17 Fail to Depart Due to Illness and Death
title.body:
![Jemaah Calon Haji_01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNMxVd32EHUUohZ8jBBjjtWfb6Ba4JuWgYiJNT9JoyqJ/Jemaah%20Calon%20Haji_01.jpg)
***
A total of 5,485 prospective Hajj pilgrims from the Banda Aceh Embarkation have departed for Saudi Arabia as of the departure of Group 14 on Tuesday (May 19, 2026). Of the total quota of 5,502 pilgrims, 17 were confirmed to have failed to depart due to death or illness.

The Head of the Hajj Organizing Committee (PPIH) for the Banda Aceh Embarkation, Arijal, said five prospective pilgrims died before entering the Hajj dormitory. Nine others postponed their departure due to illness, while three pilgrims became unfit to fly after arriving at the dormitory.

\

said Arijal.

In the 14th or final group, 390 pilgrims departed for the Holy Land, consisting of 162 men and 228 women. The majority of the pilgrims came from Bener Meriah Regency.

Overall, this year's Aceh Hajj pilgrims embarked for the Hajj pilgrimage, comprising 2,166 men and 3,319 women. Banda Aceh City had the largest number of pilgrims, with 689, followed by Pidie with 571 pilgrims and Aceh Besar with 542 pilgrims. Simeulue had the smallest number, with 27 pilgrims.

Meanwhile, eight pilgrims from Aceh are still undergoing medical treatment. Five are being treated in hospitals in Saudi Arabia, and three are being treated at Dr. Zainoel Abidin Regional Hospital in Banda Aceh.

In Saudi Arabia, two pilgrims are still undergoing intensive care at King Abdul Aziz Hospital: Safiruddin from Aceh Besar due to complications from diabetes and Zainab Ibrahim Amin for lumbar and pelvic fractures. Three other pilgrims have reportedly recovered and returned to their accommodation.

Meanwhile, in Banda Aceh, Indonesia, two pilgrims remain in intensive care, including a pilgrim from Southeast Aceh who was declared unfit to fly due to heart failure and severe lung problems.

As the peak of the Hajj pilgrimage approaches, which takes place in Arafah, Muzdalifah, and Mina (Armuzna), the Indonesian Hajj and Umrah Committee (PPIH) urges all pilgrims to maintain their health, get plenty of rest, and follow the instructions of officials while in the Holy Land.

In Group 14, the youngest pilgrim is Muhammad Alfaruq Addawami Bin Ahusama, 15, while the oldest is Maryono Bin Pangat Adam, 95, both from Bener Meriah Regency.[]



***

![Jemaah Calon Haji_01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcDfnsnJZD985dZVtJqfqiQQ9j9hp13SYYW2KkJCyC5W/Jemaah%20Calon%20Haji_01.jpg)

title.title: 19 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3108: the crosswalk
title.body:
/>

“The thing is, situational awareness is still key, Pearlie. For example, I am sojourning with your cousin Vincent in Tinyville right now, a place where if you only know to cross at the crosswalk, you are going to have to walk a country mile down these country roads.”

“You know,” eleven-year-old Velma Trent, “Grandma Jubilee is so right.”

“Ain't it the truth,” said Velma's eight-year-old sibling partner in quality eavesdropping, Gracie Trent. “I mean it takes forever to get to a crosswalk in Tinyville. Why didn't the chicken cross the road? Because she couldn't find a stoplight, or a crosswalk, and so had to fly!”

“And why do they call it jaywalking anyway?” Velma said. “I never see blue jays walking, and I never see people walking in a J shape across the street either.”

“How would you even do that, though?” Gracie said. “A L shape would keep you on the sidewalk, but a J shape would scoop you right back into the street!”

“That's probably why it's illegal, because think of the accidents as people fall off the curb back into the street,” Velma said.

“Ain't it the trurh – some laws really do make sense when you really do think about them,” Gracie said.

Defense Minister (Menhan) Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin said that the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) has divided tasks to support the national food self-sufficiency program.

Sjafrie said that the Indonesian Army (AD) and Navy (AL) will later manage the agriculture and food sectors.

This was conveyed by Sajfrie in a meeting agenda with Commission I of the Indonesian House of Representatives at the DPR Building, Central Jakarta, Tuesday (19/5/2026). He said that Indonesian Army soldiers will be assigned to manage corn and rice farming.

Meanwhile, Indonesian Navy soldiers will be assigned to manage soybean farming. According to him, soybeans are one of the food commodities that are widely imported from abroad. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU1Pz2Rkpc5ktcbYKZG2gkQeNGnXdH6TDSkeCVohQDMfP/c01a3d6a-26ed-442f-bb13-0e12613e2298.png
