title.title: 🇬🇧 #SUB40 – Another Month of the Project. Less Chaos, More Control. / 🇵🇱 #SUB40 – kolejny miesiąc projektu. Coraz mniej chaosu, coraz więcej kontroli.
title.body:
![20260510_093052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjyfV5wNsidKUCoBUgPwtVMo4FMMBCCQUC99ZXtoZ2Wt/20260510_093052.jpg)
![20260510_091804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXocjAzMvPkmfXZoeRgGnwmBkxrxHVVTFZ3iNL7So6dB2/20260510_091804.jpg)
--- 🇵🇱 Minęły kolejne tygodnie projektu SUB40 i chyba pierwszy raz mam poczucie, że progres zaczyna być widoczny nie tylko w pojedynczych treningach czy cyfrach z Garmina, ale w całym sposobie biegania. To był miesiąc bardzo mocnej pracy progowej, treningów VO₂max, świadomego pilnowania rytmu i nauki kontrolowania wysiłku zamiast chaotycznej walki od pierwszych kilometrów. Coraz częściej podczas mocnych jednostek i startów pojawia się poczucie, że organizm zaczyna współpracować zamiast tylko „przetrwać”. --- 🇬🇧 Another few weeks of the SUB40 project are behind me, and for the first time it feels like progress is becoming visible not only in workouts or Garmin numbers, but in the overall way I run. This month was filled with hard threshold sessions, VO₂max work, conscious rhythm control and learning how to manage effort instead of fighting chaotically from the very beginning of a race. More and more often during hard sessions and races, it feels like the body is finally starting to cooperate instead of simply trying to survive. ---
![20260510_061928.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfUTKUgPniFjnYvxCpL5DZdQ79V1zDx9g6L5AZTPUC1PY/20260510_061928.jpg) ![20260510_064309.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPnZWthppg2KRcwCZuax3T8HYxgyunXBJCTr7xBx1qsFQ/20260510_064309.jpg) ![20260510_070701.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfGYJgyJ8FbENfjyLHeMpMsFpAkaWDK4LS2RjutXxgKie/20260510_070701.jpg)
![Screenshot_20260519_055507_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYk5Xjs5n8gETAo2gKMugHexoq3Z7mYeYhsyraFYS5Beo/Screenshot_20260519_055507_Garmin%20Connect.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260519_055619_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSYd9zvEmhV9kJHvrZACJv5Wy7t7dhSfNjXUpaNLnuPin/Screenshot_20260519_055619_Garmin%20Connect.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260519_055603_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaqTq4qGhAygCLWufhbfCyWeMRA5nXwEyvvDrx3NoT4wv/Screenshot_20260519_055603_Garmin%20Connect.jpg)
🇵🇱 Parametry – rozwój projektu SUB40 VO₂max: 50 → 51 → 51 Próg mleczanowy: 4:46/km → 4:33/km → 4:33/km Tętno progowe: 165 bpm → 168 bpm → 166 bpm Moc progowa: 404 W → 415 W → 410 W Moc względna: 4.95 W/kg → 5.09 W/kg → 5.02 W/kg Ocena wytrzymałości: 6271 → 6581 → 6652 HRV: 66 ms → 66 ms → 55–59 ms Masa ciała: 82 kg → 81.3 kg → 81.6 kg Status treningowy: Efektywne → Efektywne / Zrównoważony → Utrzymanie Te liczby coraz wyraźniej pokazują, że progres w projekcie SUB40 nie jest przypadkiem ani efektem pojedynczego „dobrego dnia”. Najważniejsze nie jest samo VO₂max czy predykcje Garmina, ale fakt, że organizm zaczyna stabilniej funkcjonować przy coraz wyższej intensywności. Próg mleczanowy przesunął się wyraźnie do przodu, poprawiła się ekonomia biegu, a jednocześnie parametry regeneracyjne nadal pozostają stabilne mimo dużego obciążenia treningowego. Coraz bardziej widać też zmianę jakościową — trening przestaje być tylko budowaniem wydolności, a zaczyna rozwijać realną zdolność do kontrolowania wysiłku i utrzymywania mechaniki biegu pod zmęczeniem. --- 🇬🇧 Metrics – evolution of the SUB40 project VO₂max: 50 → 51 → 51 Lactate threshold: 4:46/km → 4:33/km → 4:33/km Threshold heart rate: 165 bpm → 168 bpm → 166 bpm Threshold power: 404 W → 415 W → 410 W Relative power: 4.95 W/kg → 5.09 W/kg → 5.02 W/kg Endurance score: 6271 → 6581 → 6652 HRV: 66 ms → 66 ms → 55–59 ms Body weight: 82 kg → 81.3 kg → 81.6 kg Training status: Productive → Productive / Balanced → Maintaining These numbers increasingly show that the progress in the SUB40 project is not accidental or based on a single “good day.” The most important thing is not just VO₂max or Garmin predictions, but the fact that the body is now functioning more efficiently at increasingly high intensity levels. Lactate threshold has clearly improved, running economy is better, and at the same time recovery markers remain stable despite the heavy training load. There is also a noticeable qualitative shift — training is no longer only about improving fitness, but about developing the real ability to control effort and maintain running mechanics under fatigue. ---
![20260510_072830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYr9pFQJippyTPQnDYAqrmkPjzRyi2Y7XtKxe5saXfrE/20260510_072830.jpg) ![20260510_082713.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ5fhyzqR8fpnfDdY24zckFSVQHKdyCgW6j5N8RJACMCt/20260510_082713.jpg) ![20260510_091111.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcu5ZYZyyEv9V23iEat7L4ufqVZgoyP5b6isXwg8UX527/20260510_091111.jpg)
![Screenshot_20260519_055753_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb7Xe2QHkeKjyu5cNrF2s4HWnDPda44Lb4VLuaPj6t3eY/Screenshot_20260519_055753_Garmin%20Connect.jpg) ---
🇵🇱 Predykcje Garmin również zaczynają wyglądać coraz ciekawiej: 5 km: 21:09 → 20:08 → 20:13 10 km: 45:38 → 43:36 → 43:56 Półmaraton: 1:44:43 → 1:39:41 → 1:39:10 Maraton: 3:55:21 → 3:43:16 → 3:40:43 Jeszcze kilka miesięcy temu takie liczby wydawały się kompletnie nierealne. Dziś pierwszy raz zaczynam mieć wrażenie, że organizm naprawdę powoli idzie właśnie w tym kierunku. --- 🇬🇧 Garmin predictions are also becoming more and more interesting: 5K: 21:09 → 20:08 → 20:13 10K: 45:38 → 43:36 → 43:56 Half marathon: 1:44:43 → 1:39:41 → 1:39:10 Marathon: 3:55:21 → 3:43:16 → 3:40:43 A few months ago these numbers felt completely unrealistic. Now, for the first time, it actually feels like the body is slowly moving toward them. ---
![23KQwnti57su7J5iE4gM.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTZArLXkDLdZ3hmqHKhoJos74LavzMW64YC9G7SNzryS2/23KQwnti57su7J5iE4gM.jpg) 🇵🇱 Najważniejszym startem ostatnich tygodni był oczywiście Bieg Fiata w Bielsku-Białej -> [link](https://hive.blog/hive-193552/@ptaku/actifit-ptaku-20260518t144430367z). Deszcz, mokra trasa, ponad półtora tysiąca zawodników i bardzo lokalny klimat, bo to praktycznie moje tereny. Wynik 45:15 i nowy rekord życiowy na 5 km — 22:03 — oczywiście cieszą, ale jeszcze ważniejsze było coś innego. Po raz pierwszy od dawna miałem poczucie naprawdę świadomego biegania. Bez przepalenia początku, bez chaosu i bez klasycznej ściany w drugiej części dystansu. Negative split zaczyna działać nie tylko w teorii, ale też w praktyce. --- 🇬🇧 The most important race of recent weeks was obviously the Fiat Run in Bielsko-Biała -> [link](https://hive.blog/hive-193552/@ptaku/actifit-ptaku-20260518t144430367z). Rain, wet roads, more than fifteen hundred runners and a very local atmosphere since this is practically my home area. The result — 45:15 and a new 5K personal best of 22:03 — was great, but something else felt even more important. For the first time in a long while, I truly felt in control of the race. No reckless opening, no chaos and no classic collapse in the second half. The negative split strategy is slowly becoming reality, not just theory. ---
![20260510_093043.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSrwzyuhnB3o73GXvsLS14k73YdrFJ4AXSnvPi3CiXNTW/20260510_093043.jpg) ![20260510_094022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqN1DzHhJYN5FdqCdiyC2CVzqvHhM5ZKPK74Gwp5i7VQ/20260510_094022.jpg) ![20260510_101203.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQE77tuV8o7Q7ebGi9aKNPbMFCNDA12QEYtKwp9hdUmnV/20260510_101203.jpg) ![20260510_101442.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU41QqPHoMhaKdVMEr6GLEj8MZUFtcLc7SdcVXMZfTF4s/20260510_101442.jpg) ![20260510_102246.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYH4rCW1HVP7sow2PY4ezt8SYmoYnr9brVNEAAQHKhXjN/20260510_102246.jpg) 🇵🇱 Największy progres? Chyba głowa. Coraz wyraźniej widzę, że organizm potrafi utrzymywać rytm i biomechanikę nawet przy bardzo wysokiej intensywności. Kadencja nie rozpada się na końcówkach, ruch pozostaje bardziej kontrolowany, a ciało coraz lepiej toleruje wysiłek w okolicach progu i powyżej niego. Limiter nadal pozostaje głównie oddechowy. Powyżej około 170 bpm pojawia się wyraźne ograniczenie wentylacyjne, ale mięśniowo organizm dalej chce biec szybciej. I to daje bardzo ciekawy obraz tego, gdzie ten projekt może dojść w kolejnych miesiącach. ---
🇬🇧 The biggest progress? Probably mental. More and more clearly I can see that the body is able to maintain rhythm and biomechanics even at very high intensity. Cadence no longer falls apart late in races, movement stays more controlled and the body tolerates threshold and above-threshold effort much better. The main limiter still seems to be breathing and ventilatory tolerance. Above roughly 170 bpm the respiratory system becomes the bottleneck, while muscularly the body still wants to go faster. And that paints a very interesting picture of where this project may go in the coming months. ---
![DJI_20260510090214_0007_D.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU28ZEwT3p9ekBUrWBdkeQtMFaF6Q92LPec1tjsdiff25/DJI_20260510090214_0007_D.jpg) ![DJI_20260510090444_0012_D.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSTr85YVDMnfcD13HKQTvhiMPyTi8RhKUyEk3MwA7G1s/DJI_20260510090444_0012_D.jpg) ![Screenshot_20260519_055528_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXTjvk1QGQ9BnowPDVjik9yjrNMkyBvdh8sskPC2B7TDN/Screenshot_20260519_055528_Garmin%20Connect.jpg)
🇵🇱 Projekt trwa dalej. Nadal jest sporo do poprawy — szczególnie w zakresie spokojnego aerobowego biegania, które Garmin regularnie mi wypomina 😅 Ale pierwszy raz mam poczucie, że SUB40 przestaje być odległą abstrakcją, a zaczyna być realnym kierunkiem rozwoju. Najważniejsze jednak pozostaje jedno: to już nie jest bieganie „na czuja”. To zaczyna być świadome ściganie. --- 🇬🇧 The project continues. There is still a lot to improve — especially easy aerobic running, which Garmin keeps reminding me about 😅 But for the first time, SUB40 no longer feels like a distant abstraction. It’s starting to feel like a realistic direction of progress. Most importantly: this is no longer random running based purely on feeling. It’s slowly becoming conscious racing.
![DJI_20260510083302_0002_D.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUgj1RBf1YRF4HzL4B6ixxRkJv3THMj9xpGK6ety1q8sC/DJI_20260510083302_0002_D.jpg)

Sitting in my ute taking a quick break I thought I'd share some autumn 🍂 colors photographed this morning in Nelson. 

I've been quiet around here, the reason being too busy, I've been having only Sundays to rest for the past five to six weeks. Work has been that hectic I am looking for the slightest of chance to take leave even two days leave will leave me refreshed but I have no idea when that will be possible but in the mean time enjoy these photos, I like the look of them. 

Keep well and don't work too hard like me 😀

![Messenger_creation_430B9150-604E-48D7-87D3-3FCA92E50BD1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wgSRzXx5wj8a2a5LAnMA5aG5ynaL1EJM27Cscq2tfdPCJXLMLFscpMMAHhkTL4xmqCx.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_30EC9EA9-A399-4C34-908E-4271C6A47492.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23u69VbhUxhE6WyFvskmMuQTiXiykMmDGJzC9JffEwxxHkNBcT9C882KhmU234obNQ72j.jpeg) One of the simple yet relaxing places I visited earlier was the Bantayan Baywalk, a peaceful coastal spot where both locals and tourists gather to enjoy the fresh sea breeze and stunning ocean view. The place may look simple compared to other famous destinations, but the calm ambiance and beautiful scenery truly make it memorable for visitors who appreciate quiet moments near the sea. Earlier today, I spent time roaming around the baywalk while watching fishermen preparing their pumpboats and locals buying and selling fresh seafood near the shore. The reason why I came here with my boyfriend was to buy fish for breakfast, and I realized I should feature it in my Hive. I bought some fresh fish there, which made the experience feel even more authentic and close to the daily life of Bantayanons. From the baywalk, I could also see some small islands beautifully resting across the clear blue waters while the sea looked so calm, perfect, and stunning under the daylight. The sound of the waves together with the cool breeze created a peaceful atmosphere for us that instantly made me appreciate the simple beauty of island living even more. It was one of those quiet travel moments that may seem ordinary to others but becomes unforgettable because of how calming and genuine the experience feels. ![orca-image--1763808666.jpeg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpA8LLGcVgcCTzdjyVWuAW56CTftYjyvsGrUF7BBEWvsXVcKLqqCJZdM7bAYRd1EhSM.jpeg) ![orca-image--247597672.jpeg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wC3Frw4pXCRV9UWXEHeN5iSumXPJnizC86Q7PViRJT71X6iswfWCrKdrbF1PVaz2bcb.jpeg) ![orca-image-945588188.jpeg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wgFFe5wUQTZiwRhRufbckB13F7ekAtkim7ZFWGcWwh9R2DE5UYMkGrFWrACbKSvCPui.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_4FBF9C95-41F2-4920-9667-44DB4A983D18.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVF4bPrjH4TcPBqXVXyAMgwgxbZPF7mReDCPdf8Fdcq9G152wrcjTfYGoanbGocJBwx.jpeg) Well, this is not just a travel blog since I am celebrating my first Hive birthday today here in this community where I mostly share my life stories. It is of great enthusiasm and contentment to have my first birthday here in Hive. It was just a random post I saw on X last year about this platform and saw some onboarders living in the same locality as me posting about this platform on Twitter. At first, I was hesitant, but something in me was telling me I should give it a go since I have always loved writing about things I love the most, like my lifestyle, traveling, food, and even the most mundane days of my life. I could have scrolled past what I saw on Twitter that time and still regret it. I could have tried another writing platform and still regret it. I would live my life happily, travel and eat in different places, and talk about my ideas and still wonder what I could have become if I chose writing in Hive. It was my first birthday yesterday in Hive, and I almost forgot it since I never thought of how long I have already been here as I enjoyed the journey and meeting a lot of friends in this platform. It has been one year since I started writing in different communities of Hive, and many things have happened and can be shared. The sail was smooth and alive, and through this platform, my travel, food experiences, and daily life made sense and came to the arrival of being valued as readers read my blogs. I have met many people in my town, especially when I was still on the onboarding program, interacted and connected with many Filipino Hivers through Discord accounts, and even crossed borders to connect with foreign friends who write beautiful and educational blogs in different communities. Worldmappin community has been a safe place to share my travel experiences and connect with other travelers who have already pinned thousands of travels on the maps. Daily Blog community gave life and meaning to my mundane life, and Wednesday Walk challenged me to roam and visit different corners in different places to see what is lying there for me. HivePH, my very own home in Discord, is where I was able to connect with many Filipino Hivers, especially at times of catastrophe and emergency, where the concept of bayanihan comes to life again. In one year, I have written 238 posts, and I hope I can do my 365 posts in a year in Hive soon. I also wrote 1,427 comments, received 85,000 upvotes, and had 1,750 replies in just a year. I was awarded the Top 3 Most Upvoted Daily Blog badge, won in different small competitions in Hive, and was active on Snap before. I hope this year flourishes and brings me many happy experiences in this platform, as much as I will give to Hive unconditionally. Thank you for reading my blog this time dearest Hivers and travelers! I hope to see you around here soon and encounter each other's stories. See you in my future narratives! title.title: Rajshahi Central Botanical Garden and Zoo.
title.body: > ![InCollage_20260520_101712135.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUPf9yYhmBFdL3WwY9MHw4BZzUabqcCaVrNSrMkP8k21C/InCollage_20260520_101712135.jpg) Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. When we went to the banks of the Padma during our trip to Rajshahi, we thought that we would see a zoo here. Which was basically located on the banks of the Padma. Basically, we came down from the banks of the Padma where there was a small road and the botanical garden was on the side of the road. Since I had never been to Rajshahi before, I was very keen to enter here. Due to which we bought a ticket there for 20 taka per person. Then we went inside. ![IMG20260221165139.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTbcywyuuuyDLn8Saz6zxACDHU5A8Wh8YLuaTkgaHgg22/IMG20260221165139.jpg) ![IMG20260221165125.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdRu62o8shYptiSMbqbowESS2kCDBo8BB8m5XKoDH9hsq/IMG20260221165125.jpg) ![IMG20260221165308.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPfvPdm82u3mhwor3jVZqSpJshQxBXsBQ1o4hmF1jBvVo/IMG20260221165308.jpg) ![IMG20260221165425.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyp2Zf76qnJ84wpjhWWEUtNzWMyW92STHYJoUfDWgiH5/IMG20260221165425.jpg) ![IMG20260221165429.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvMWXKw8kjVUoYuywxcJN3mF44PDd3STo2KSdX21MTBL/IMG20260221165429.jpg) ![IMG20260221165824.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd5T58D8ZVr19A83BvCe9TeATQkgZPrfC4gh5N42zX3sj/IMG20260221165824.jpg) ![IMG20260221165828.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmex2fKyrc8L9ho5f77ZzmJ9ovi9TTMs2S53skhLmeu8iS/IMG20260221165828.jpg) ![IMG20260221165830.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbBQ9KcKtik22mAbX1X8eCRExpBxCVCSLodC4T1KDevWf/IMG20260221165830.jpg) ![IMG20260221165833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZE5ypQ65suGWEfY6qwuouAuEWUXLhXXiY3QsDNtNqydY/IMG20260221165833.jpg) Since we entered in the afternoon, we could not stay there for long. Since it was the month of Ramadan, due to which the call to prayer would be given after a while and everyone would break their fast, we could not stay there for long. However, we entered. After entering, we saw that several more people entered there. We got to know them. title.title: Frank Castle is Back - My Punisher One Last Kill Review
title.body:
<div class=text-justify>


I recently got a chance to watch the special episode The Punisher: One Last Kill. Disney has finally decided to dedicate some content to this character after the two seasons he had on Netflix. This special acts as a bridge between the two universes, providing continuity to Frank Castle's story since we will be seeing him in several upcoming productions
>Recientemente pude ver el episodio especial de \

. Finalmente Disney decide dedicar a este personaje algo de contenido, tras las dos temporadas que tuvo en Netflix. Este episodio especial es literalmente un puente entre los dos universo, para darle continuidad a la historia de Frank Castle ya que este personaje le veremos presente en varias de sus próximas producciones.
![1000397476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/EpT58fMhyQz6KCDWVcuafCNZzzzQqPRkeDYb9xkYuuURRh9pkLsZXatTjpUnNQMj5b1.jpg)
In this special episode, we see Frank tormented by the past. The loss of his family still hurts him, causing him to hallucinate and preventing him from living a normal life. His actions in eliminating members of the Gnucci family have brought severe consequences to that part of the city; people are being harassed by thugs, and there is no one to stop them. >En este episodio especial vemos a Frank atormentado por el pasado, la perdida de su familia aún le hace daño, le hace alucinar y le impide llevar una vida normal. Sus acciones al eliminar a los miembros de la familia Gnucci, han traído severas consecuencias en esa parte de la ciudad, las personas están siendo acosadas por los maleantes, no hay quien los detenga. Deep in his sorrow, it seems like nothing will pull him out of that world of pain. However, an encounter with Ma Gnucci brings him back to who he was, when she informs him that she has put a bounty on his head to avenge her son's murder. This unleashes violence in his community as everyone goes after him, and innocent people get caught in the crossfire, until he decides to take action. He breaks his promise not to fight again—first to defend himself, and then to clean up the mess on the streets. >Sumido en su pesar, parece que nada lo apartará de ese mundo de dolor, pero un encuentro con Ma Gnucci le hace volver a ser quien fue, cuándo ella le comunica que le puso precio a su cabeza, en venganza por haber asesinado a su hijo. Esto desata la violencia en su comunidad, todos van tras el, los inocentes se ven afectados, hasta que decide actuar rompiendo su promesa de no volver a pelear, primero para defenderse, luego para limpiar el desastre de las calles. This episode runs for 50 minutes. There is a warning at the beginning that this is mature content, so do not assume that just because it is on Disney, it is suitable for the whole family. The violence is quite explicit and abundant. The action choreography is top-notch, and there is very little CGI—thankfully, because it is pretty bad—but that does not really hurt the production overall. >Este episodio tiene una duración de 50 minutos. En un comienzo se da la advertencia que es un contenido exclusivo para adultos, asi que no por estar en Disney se debe creer que se puede ver en familia. La violencia es bastante explícita y abundante, las coreografía de acción son muy buenas, el cgi es poco, menos mal porque es bastante malo, pero nada que perjudique la producción en general. For Marvel fans, this content is worth checking out. It turns out this short episode is canon, serving as a preamble in the MCU for the new Spider-Man movie coming out this year, as well as the Doomsday film. So, if you want the full picture of everything that is coming up, this short is definitely worth a watch. >Para los fanáticos de Marvel es contenido que vale la pena, resulta que este corto episodio es canon y en el MCU es preámbulo para la nueva película de Spiderman que se estrenará este año, así como también la de Doomsday, por lo tanto para tener un panorama completo de todo lo que está por venir, vale la pena ver este corto.
https://youtu.be/oSeqs_xeqv4?si=i12jaa9ycsQAj60X

title.title: Unboxing - Video making kit - My experience (Esp/Eng)
title.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Hace varios días mi micrófono para grabar por teléfono terminó de dar las últimas, se estropeó, tenía tiempo fallando, de hecho vino con desperfectos de fábrica, lo compré hace 4 años y ya estaba dando su vida útil, sobre todo con la batería pues eran inalámbricos, además de conector tipo C. No sé mucho de estas cosas, tampoco sé mucho de micrófonos excepto que debe ser bidireccional para que no capte el ruido del entorno y solo tu voz. Estaba buscando características más útiles para mí, primero que fuera bidireccional y que el conector de salida fuera Jack 3.5 mm, encontré este que presento hoy, ahora te cuento mi experiencia.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! A few days ago, my phone recording microphone finally gave up the ghost; it broke down. It had been playing up for a while – in fact, it had a manufacturing fault from the start. I bought it four years ago and it was already reaching the end of its useful life, particularly the battery, as it was wireless, and it also had a Type-C connector. I don’t know much about this sort of thing, nor do I know much about microphones, except that it needs to be bidirectional so it doesn’t pick up ambient noise and only captures your voice. I was looking for features that would be most useful to me: firstly, that it was bidirectional, and secondly, that the output connector was a 3.5 mm jack. I found the one I’m presenting today, and now I’ll tell you about my experience. ---

Compré el producto ayer, por más de la mitad del precio que lo venden aqui y el envío es gratuito. en la ciudad tenían un costo de 25$ en Mercado libre 12$ la diferencia por la misma marca y el mismo producto era abismal. El producto me llegó al siguiente día, es decir hoy y al llegar a casa procedí a desempacarlo, puedo decir que el embalado fue bueno cuidando que el producto no se golpeara.

I had a look on Mercado Libre; the prices are more affordable and it’s the same product, but you know that buying there carries the risk of receiving something in poor condition... That wasn’t the case for me today, so don’t worry... I bought the product yesterday for less than half the price they charge here, and delivery is free. In town it cost $25, on Mercado Libre $12 – the difference for the same brand and the same product was huge. The product arrived the next day, i.e. today, and when I got home I unpacked it; I can say the packaging was good, ensuring the product wasn’t damaged.

>

[Esp]

Presento en sociedad el Kit De Grabación Para Telefono, Trípode, Micrófono Y Luz Led, marca: Maki, modelo AY-49. 

Estéticamente el producto se ve muy bien, los materiales el plástico de buena calidad, probé la luz led y funciona correctamente, es cómodo, fácil de armar y desarmar, no ocupa mucho espacio.

Pero... no lo recomiendo, no es bidireccional como dicen, capta todo el el sonido externo como un vulgar micrófono de balita, no tienen diferencia alguna en cuanto a calidad de sonido, por lo que no me sirve para grabar mis videos de tarot, este tipo de ruido que capta no puede camuflarse, no puede editarse sin que mi voz quede robotizada en la edición del vídeo.

El producto no promete con lo que dice el vendedor y no coincide en sus características que dice la caja. ¿Me estafaron? Tal vez. No lo recomiendo.

Mejor ahorren para un micrófono de los caros, averigüen bien las marcas vean bien las características en su caja y no crean en el vendedor, menos si es compras online, no en vano dice el dicho: \
Espero mi experiencia te sea de utilidad.

> [Eng] I’d like to introduce the Maki AY-49 Mobile Phone Recording Kit, which includes a tripod, microphone and LED light. Visually, the product looks great; the plastic is good quality. I tested the LED light and it works perfectly. It’s comfortable to use, easy to set up and take down, and doesn’t take up much space. But... I don’t recommend it. It isn’t bidirectional as they claim; it picks up all external sound just like a cheap lavalier microphone. There’s no difference whatsoever in sound quality, so it’s no use to me for recording my tarot videos. The kind of noise it picks up can’t be masked, and it can’t be edited without my voice sounding robotic in the final video. The product doesn’t live up to the seller’s claims and its features don’t match what’s stated on the box. Was I ripped off? Perhaps. I don’t recommend it. You’re better off saving up for a more expensive microphone, doing your research on the brands, checking the specifications on the box carefully, and not trusting the seller—especially if you’re shopping online. As the saying goes: ‘You get what you pay for’. title.title: Upper training | My Actifit Report Card: May 19 2026
title.body:
Getting back to my Actifit posts, today I want to tell you that I tried some new upper body exercises and honestly, I felt super weird doing them… I'm already feeling the effects of masculinity (just kidding, lol). I did cable bench presses and cable crossovers, but this time kneeling instead of standing. I don't know how to explain it, but it felt really strange at first, although I also liked trying something different and getting out of my usual routine a bit. The rest were more typical exercises for me: flyes, push-ups, lateral raises, shoulder presses… the usual classics. Anyway, I'm increasingly aware of how much I've changed since I started training. Before, upper body training intimidated me a lot, and now I just show up and work out. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3C7F313F-E3FB-44A5-8F07-0BD3A829D8D61779251666.6673331) Versión en Español Retomando mis publicaciones en Actifit, hoy quiero contarles que probé algunos ejercicios nuevos de tren superior y sinceramente me sentí súper extraña haciéndolos… ya estoy sintiendo los efectos de la masculinidad (es broma, lol). Hice press de banca en polea con cable y también cables cruzados, pero esta vez arrodillada en lugar de hacerlos de pie. No sé cómo explicarlo, pero se sintió rarísimo al inicio, aunque también me gustó probar algo diferente y salir un poco de mi rutina habitual. El resto sí fueron ejercicios más normales para mí: aperturas, flexiones, elevaciones laterales, press de hombro… ya los clásicos de siempre. Igual, cada vez me doy más cuenta de cuánto he cambiado desde que empecé a entrenar. Antes me intimidaba muchísimo el tren superior y ahora simplemente llego y entreno.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@josehany/actifit-josehany-20260520t043615862z)_

>Una de las primeras playas más bonitas después de Conoma, Conomita y punta la Cruz entrado al Estado Sucre/Cumaná acá en Venezuela está \

,es una de las playas más bonitas de esta zona según las personas de acá y certifico eso,el sábado teníamos un viaje planeado entre mi familia amigos y yo para allá,es una playa muy limpia y oelaje bajo,la tonalidad de colores de las aguas de la playa es muy hermoso tiene diferentes tonalidades que se reflejan en el agua,hay muchos toldos en esta zona y personas que trabajan prestando servicios de viajes en lancha ,paseos en inflables acuáticos,venden comida,ropa, salvavidas, flotadores y mas, también cuenta con un baño que según me cuenta mi mamá cuando venía en su juventud para esta playa el baño se ha conservado exactamente igual y eao a ella le trajo gratos recuerdos.Lo que me sorprendió es que tienen servicio de internet/wifi que puedes pagar por el precio de 5$ por persona todo el día que estes allí,aunque yo tenia señal Movilnet en la playa no fué necesario pagar por internet,pero mi tía si lo vió necesario ya que ella no tenía senal al ser de otra operadora. # > _One of the most beautiful beaches after Conoma, Conomita, and Punta la Cruz, as you enter Sucre State/Cumaná here in Venezuela, is \

It's one of the most beautiful beaches in this area, according to the locals, and I can confirm that. On Saturday, my family, friends, and I had a trip planned there. It's a very clean beach with calm waves. The colors of the water are stunning, with different shades reflected in the water. There are many beach umbrellas and people offering boat trips, inflatable water rides, food, clothing, life jackets, floats, and more. There's also a restroom that, according to my mother, has remained exactly the same since she came to this beach in her youth, and that brought back fond memories for her. What surprised me is that they have Wi-Fi service that you can pay for at $5 per person for the entire day you're there. Although I had Movilnet signal on the beach, it wasn't necessary. I paid for internet, but my aunt saw it as necessary since she had no signal because she was with a different provider._

>Cuando entramos me emocioné mucho porque después de casi 4 horas de camino al fin habíamos llegado aunque el viaje no lo ví tan lejos pues si es un poco retirado de donde vivimos,el agua estaba súper fria asi que dejé para bañarme a mitad de mañana,ya les había comentado en otro blog anteriormente que después visitamos isla piscina ,esas islas que se ven al frente de la playa es Isla piscina e Isla Arapo,hay negocios restaurantes de aquel lado de la zona,donde puedes pasar un rato agradable,después del viaje en lancha si me bañé en la playa decidí desayunar aunque ya lo habia hecho temprano ,luego mis amigos y yo fuimos a dar un paseo por la orilla de la playa y ver con que noa conseguíamos,vimos que habían mas personas en donde termina la playa pues en ese lado no daba tanro el sol como en el medio de la playa,tambien muchos más negocios de ventas de inflables. # > _When we arrived, I was so excited because after almost four hours of travel, we had finally made it, although the trip didn't seem that long since it's a bit far from where we live. The water was super cold, so I waited until mid-morning to swim. I had already mentioned in another blog post that we later visited Isla Piscina (Pool Island). Those islands you see in front of the beach are Isla Piscina and Isla Arapo. There are shops and restaurants on that side of the area where you can have a pleasant time. After the boat trip, I did swim at the beach and decided to have breakfast, even though I had already eaten earlier. Then my friends and I went for a walk along the beach to see what we could find. >Yo tenía desde los 12 años que no venía así que serían 14 años después que tuve que ir a esa misma playa,recuerdo cuando mi papá nos traía mucho a mi mamá y a mi a esa playa siempre comprabamos comida allí y pasábamos un dia agradable,está vez fué así pasamos un dia súper agradable que ni nos dimos cuenta en que momento pasó,amo esta playa volvería a ir nuevamente,me gusta la calma del oleaje lo limpio que está y loa sitios en lancha que puedes visitar estando cerca,me encantó 😍 espero que la próxima okaya donde vayamos sea otra y así poder ir a otras que igual llevo tiempo que no he ido como playa colorada que esta mas adelante que Arapito allí mismo en el estado Sucre.Espero les hayan gustado estás bonitas fotos que pude capturar,ya seran parte de mi recuerdo de este viaje que pasó super rápido,hasta pronto nos vemos en otro blog de aventuras 🥰. # > _I hadn't been here since I was 12, so it was 14 years since I had to go to that same beach. I remember when my dad used to bring my mom and me there a lot; we always bought food there and had a great time. This time was the same; we had a super nice day that didn't even realize how long it was over. I love this beach and would go back again. I like the calm waves, how clean it is, and the places you can visit by boat nearby. I loved it! 😍 I hope that next time we go, we'll go to another beach so we can visit others that I haven't been to in a while, like Playa Colorada, which is further along than Arapito, also in the state of Sucre. I hope you liked these beautiful photos I was able to take; they will now be part of my memories of this trip that went by so fast. See you soon in another adventure blog! 🥰_

title.title: 둘째의 학부모 참관수업
title.body:
오늘은 둘째의 학부모 참관수업이 있는 날입니다.
아내가 교육을 받으러 가서 오전에 저 혼자 휴가를 내고 학교를 찾았습니다.
교실에 도착을 하니 아직 아무도 안오셨더라구요.

![KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_09.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma9od9NDJf85UqwjasZDEoQVyuXnmMU5QRX3HKDFNo93D/KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_09.jpg)

학기초에 담임선생님 상담을 위해서 찾은 후 두번째 입니다. 둘째가 6학년이니 아마도 학부모 참관수업은 오늘이 저에겐 마지막이겠죠? ㅠ

수업에 방해가 될까 싶어 멀리서 복도 사진만 좀 찍어봤습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_07.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyLdUJRAfpYE4HAtZYyijsM6JjND4CdGNczuJp7WCvsi/KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_07.jpg)

3교시 수업을 참관했었는데요. 
젊은 남자 선생님의 목소리와 눈빛에 우선 믿음이 갑니다.
아이들이 부모님이 오셔서 그런지 약간 상기되어 있는 모습도 느껴졌습니다.
지금까지 살아오면서 성공했던 경험과 앞으로 하고 싶은 버킷리스트에 대해서 발표하는 시간을 가졌습니다.
막연한 발표가 아니라 버킷리스트를 이루기 위해서 내가  어떤 모습으로 노력해야 하는가까지 설명하는 모습에서 부모님들이 다들 대견해 하는 듯 했습니다.

40분 수업 이후, 엄마가 함께 오지 못한 것에 대한 아쉬움도 좀 보였네요. 하지만 아빠에게라도 모듬으로 활동했던 것들을 보여주면서 자랑도 합니다.

![[꾸미기]KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRTQAdsRmiHveXxqAc4Np6ZonLibiAhuVzsb4wnwCfWjv/[%EA%BE%B8%EB%AF%B8%EA%B8%B0]KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_03.jpg)

주차할 곳이 없어서 학교 앞, 마트에 주차를 해놨는데 마트에서 잠시 둘째가 있을 학교를 바라봤습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcoi3iSDDPDBGhcFtFUw12Y1TMc6PL9TznUB2yaF66Rfk/KakaoTalk_20260520_130440829_01.jpg)

이렇게 시간이 가는게 많이 아쉽네요.

title.title: A short trip to the heart of history; Visiting the Behesht Museum of Mashhad, poetic and beautif🤩
title.body:
Hello to all my good and dear friends. I hope you are well. I missed you so much.
I am very happy that I had an opportunity to be with you again and from time to time, in addition to my main work, which is photography, I take a tour of the nature and the surrounding cities and record photos to share with you.

Last week, we went to Mashhad city in Khorasan province with a friend, and when we were looking for a parking space on the street, my friend and I sat in the vicinity of this cultural center until our wives left the parking lot.

The atmosphere and environment were pleasant to me and the spring wind was blowing. My friend was shocked but I took my mobile phone and took some pictures for you.


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۷۳۱.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXbctxYwZRtEbsFtzgijevZNnPyi2Co2sDDwLzwSnDFs/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B7%DB%B3%DB%B1.jpg)

Although the sunlight and the day were not a good time for photography, I tried my best to take the best photos for you. 
Farhangsarai Behesht is located in the holy city of Mashhad in Razavi Khorasan province. In the heart of the modern streets, there is a charming old texture that seems to have remained a memory of the culture and art of Iran in this place.
This cultural center belongs to the first Pahlavi period, which was registered as a historical work in 1384 AH.
The garden of this cultural center is a public place for people to use the poetic space and the building of this place is the venue for sewing classes, calligraphy, painting, doll making, Quran reading, etc. for public use, especially during summer leisure 

I will upload some photos from different angles. The door and wall of this place are full of poems by prominent poets and artists of our country, which add more beauty to the cultural place.

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۸۲۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRw7N7F6bHL8q3tn4FBoTHGGGtPVUwbXAejvtUGjfubue/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B8%DB%B2%DB%B4.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۹۲۲.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQMiHZhjgPXPNQZAC1JE4Z7wUEA5pXKb67GwyATLfzNws/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B9%DB%B2%DB%B2.jpg)


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۰۱۲.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJSE34sZGpNsiPrTyfeBBZ1SyshcVxiXefvcyu3yJRdv/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B0%DB%B1%DB%B2.jpg)

I have uploaded some photos of the main building of this place. But the sunlight really bothered me.



![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۸۰۶.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetGizh2F13kCaeQMLnRqh6u1hmT1QS6VacmWtFxTbfZR/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B8%DB%B0%DB%B6.jpg)
The environment was very poetic. It reminded me of my school and high school days. I had a lot of fun for a few minutes in the middle of all the hustle and bustle of the city. 

On both sides of the entrance of this cultural center, there were statues of poets, scientists and philosophers of Iranian history, some of which I photographed for you. And a few that I couldn't take a good photo of because they were in direct sunlight.


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۷۴۶.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYx3UDfVQwpyKAwCXerYANzNcMJQrvuskqvCU6SKg7j51/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B7%DB%B4%DB%B6.jpg)



![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۳۱۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXZCDQgJCn2n5kbVjYPDtCkEvDE5a8cVQFcwVWQpnMCpq/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B3%DB%B1%DB%B4.jpg)


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۸۵۰.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmecauWz744GVCZU66dNu27ueW3tStumRw4LB6n8Yq5n8Z/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B8%DB%B5%DB%B0.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۸۴۲.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSMTYJkJTxuCHfcMBso6N7LrY7qrH6P9xmJ4pe6rwvgNK/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B8%DB%B4%DB%B2.jpg)

For example, Sheikh Tusi, who was one of the prominent and historical researchers, I liked the angle of the statue and took two close-up photos. Intelligence and intelligence were evident from his penetrating gaze.


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۱۲۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS27HGt8HHoodn998XU9HR3Aad6JSiPwDZUTYvDTuz73h/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B2%DB%B4.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۲۲۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYp2AoBYBZqGNgv8UF36mJwsfn2YArSvu7w4TxP5f8wyM/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B2%DB%B4.jpg)

![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۲۴۵.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWoY8N7drjMFmfaTq4KiRt1jn3mqPrPzFdkj4y27tjPNQ/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B2%DB%B4%DB%B5.jpg)


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۷۵۷.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP7FKB2PkbH2ncWzRFRbvRJyWuBYmSaX3SEpxcuRMq5pN/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B7%DB%B5%DB%B7.jpg)

Although this cultural center has an old texture, it still maintains its cultural identity and is always the focus of its enthusiasts. In my opinion, it is located in the pleasant climate area of ​​Mashhad and people who are interested in these places stay here for hours and review the culture and history of the past.


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۳۹۴۲.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYxoYzJJR3etbgqnSEyHGs1bYw7uYyUT4woMusWxgG62r/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B3%DB%B9%DB%B4%DB%B2.jpg)

A beautiful carriage, which was obviously very old, was under the shade of one of the trees, whose color combination with the green leaves of the trees was interesting to me, and I closed this beautiful frame for it.




![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۰۳۴.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNfRD4EbC9TZTqtReb51eRmhDbqAV9BaLXxoHHg2Dt6nx/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B0%DB%B3%DB%B4.jpg)


![۲۰۲۶۰۴۱۸_۱۱۴۰۴۷.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb7JhhBZxQU1hNLJ56P4Sngo4bqEuvpeeirq1TrucDy98/%DB%B2%DB%B0%DB%B2%DB%B6%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B1%DB%B8_%DB%B1%DB%B1%DB%B4%DB%B0%DB%B4%DB%B7.jpg)

I stood under the building of Farhangsara and photographed from the angle facing the street. And I saw that it had an interesting view.
I hope you like it too.
From now on, I will try to share the culture and history of my city and country with you more. The culture and religion of any country is very valuable for a citizen and conveys the originality of a person. 

I love you very much and I am very happy to be with you. Being with you made me more interested in history.
Until another trip and another introduction 

goodby.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZs62Rp3tog3G9Rag2jsaAaXiUZGsLYv7YXy2MQV3eva/1779245247189.png)

[ENG]
Hi bloggers and Amazing Drinks community! Today I’m going to share a “golden” drink, you may already be familiar with its health benefits. This drink has many benefits. Some of its benefits include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and boosting immunity, as it contains a blend of cinnamon, turmeric powder, and a little ginger. Let’s get right to it

**Ingredients:**

- 250 ml milk
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 thumb-sized piece of ginger
- a pinch of black pepper

**Steps:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVAA3xqkhzGLWkxtRV7Z5p6PpLa4RTAq2G6FPwNDUp2mv/1779245345998.jpg)

- Pour the milk into a sauce pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXS3YvJStt3s62rqjDW4v4FkaUFWJS9onCSMCoa3mwYbV/1779245461321.jpg)

- Add the cinnamon powder and turmeric powder

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUR5Qr7d4pwp6g9tLr3uXQ9PQuZsXQVHkMjXDZEXSCPN2/1779245553121.jpg)

- Add a pinch of black pepper

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRey6EqXEYkjvMfVD7cL1k927EcaTRSyMit6FwoDvUSJr/1779245570976.jpg)

- Peel the ginger and cut it into small pieces

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4iUq2NodQZLzkSbfCRJ5hDvtUuTFkFR8kaboNeriwZg/1779245606301.jpg)

- Put them to the sauce pan 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7GNTY3q5PDgojm8rRf7TFqcGjSEr5gEoe64DMs75pCF/1779247200891.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvuZXekh9corN3pfMiFuDStKjbXp7wdA7vCXh6HpjkQf/1779247201043.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdW5G8jGpLH1pouT7AcZG8mcTyB7b9RwVz8gDG4QaVJT/1779247201169.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPw9zeU2ZqBxg5uUWjGQq7SKJER2uEyqGB2BP5otmt4Wf/1779247201340.jpg)

- Heat the pan with low heat and stir the milk until the spices are well mixed

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXY3FaoEaxB9rY39NAMfPDwT8VFomEdUXsEwxgyZBJjWb/1779247270072.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmec2vKQBriHL9oL8ziYieYHW4Hw8w1AvSvhfSa24NnviK/1779247270205.jpg)

- Then cook until bubbles form around the edges of the saucepan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSiyXvp5LUwMtVcxtVwMjwWbmtJ7TQthD2qPYJQwkzuxe/1779247284120.jpg)

- Turn off the heat then remove the milk and strain it 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamQNoiDQX1DiyLm9dMufRbcBLY5dikrRZnEB5crrCkRw/1779249740007.jpg)

- Pour the milk into a glass

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgwdhXd46C3Di7YWT2Tak1tx1eGdLfq3B6N6aR6Ntn1u/1779250037865.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRkMrgDZj3tbTE4YRFksRfeV3w5bW11ZDZ6bknAaPCvWk/1779250038081.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLCohdDemngqMU48JsAu7igWqn3HsTCwqCjSPDvaGeDs/1779250038265.jpg)

- Serve while warm, or add ice to the glass for the cold version

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNU4T3K7gGN6PDtTNXBkb6YqJL9Kjbk1DR7xqEDV935hZ/1779250181338.jpg)

- Golden milk is ready to enjoy

[IND]

Hi bloggers dan amazing drinks komunitas, hari ini aku akan membagikan sebuah minuman 'emas' yang kalian mungkin juga sudah tau efek baik dari minuman ini. Minuman ini memiliki punya banyak manfaat, Beberapa kebaikan minuman ini adalah sebagai anti inflamasi, mengurasi rasa nyeri, dan meningkatkan imunitas karena memiliki campuran kayu manis, kunyit bubuk, dan sedikit jahe. Oke langsung saja

**Bahan-bahan:**

- 250 ml susu 
- 1/2 sdt bubuk kayu manis
- 1/2 sdt bubuk kunyit 
- 1 ruas kuku jahe
- sejumput lada hitam

**Langkah-langkah:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVAA3xqkhzGLWkxtRV7Z5p6PpLa4RTAq2G6FPwNDUp2mv/1779245345998.jpg)

- masukkan susu ke dalam wajan
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXS3YvJStt3s62rqjDW4v4FkaUFWJS9onCSMCoa3mwYbV/1779245461321.jpg)

- tambahkan bubuk kayu manis dan bubuk kunyit ke dalamnya

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUR5Qr7d4pwp6g9tLr3uXQ9PQuZsXQVHkMjXDZEXSCPN2/1779245553121.jpg)

- tambahkan sejumput lada hitam 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRey6EqXEYkjvMfVD7cL1k927EcaTRSyMit6FwoDvUSJr/1779245570976.jpg)

- kupas jahe dari kulitnya dan potong kecil-kecil 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4iUq2NodQZLzkSbfCRJ5hDvtUuTFkFR8kaboNeriwZg/1779245606301.jpg)

- masukkan jahe ke dalam wajan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb7GNTY3q5PDgojm8rRf7TFqcGjSEr5gEoe64DMs75pCF/1779247200891.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvuZXekh9corN3pfMiFuDStKjbXp7wdA7vCXh6HpjkQf/1779247201043.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdW5G8jGpLH1pouT7AcZG8mcTyB7b9RwVz8gDG4QaVJT/1779247201169.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPw9zeU2ZqBxg5uUWjGQq7SKJER2uEyqGB2BP5otmt4Wf/1779247201340.jpg)

- hidupkan api dengan api yang kecil dan aduk susu sampai rempah tercampur rata

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXY3FaoEaxB9rY39NAMfPDwT8VFomEdUXsEwxgyZBJjWb/1779247270072.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmec2vKQBriHL9oL8ziYieYHW4Hw8w1AvSvhfSa24NnviK/1779247270205.jpg)

- lalu masak hingga muncul gelembung di pinggiran sauce pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSiyXvp5LUwMtVcxtVwMjwWbmtJ7TQthD2qPYJQwkzuxe/1779247284120.jpg)

- matikan api lalu angkat susu dan saring 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamQNoiDQX1DiyLm9dMufRbcBLY5dikrRZnEB5crrCkRw/1779249740007.jpg)

- pindahkan susu ke dalam gelas

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdgwdhXd46C3Di7YWT2Tak1tx1eGdLfq3B6N6aR6Ntn1u/1779250037865.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRkMrgDZj3tbTE4YRFksRfeV3w5bW11ZDZ6bknAaPCvWk/1779250038081.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLCohdDemngqMU48JsAu7igWqn3HsTCwqCjSPDvaGeDs/1779250038265.jpg)

- sajikan selagi hangat atau tambahkan es ke dalam gelas kalau untuk versi dingin


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNU4T3K7gGN6PDtTNXBkb6YqJL9Kjbk1DR7xqEDV935hZ/1779250181338.jpg)

title.title: Changing habits is harder than it seems
title.body: >Desde noviembre del año pasado he estado cambiando algunas cosas en mi vida, algunas bastante significantes y otras no tanto, he estado buscando un mejor estilo de vida cambiando algunos malos hábitos, pero aún no puedo sentirme completamente plena con tanto estrés a mi alrededor. Este año ha sido bastante raro en muchos escenarios y no me ayuda a sentirme mejor todo lo que vivimos diariamente en este país. A pesar de eso agradezco haber tenido el valor de dejar atrás algunas cosas que me estaban dañando muchísimo más. > Since last November, I’ve been making some changes in my life—some pretty significant, others not so much. I’ve been trying to improve my lifestyle by breaking some bad habits, but I still can’t feel completely fulfilled with so much stress all around me. This year has been pretty strange in many ways, and everything we go through on a daily basis in this country doesn’t help me feel any better. Despite that, I’m grateful that I had the courage to leave behind some things that were hurting me much more. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>No ha sido facil, pero he logrado cosas que antes veía imposible, por ejemplo, dejar el cigarrillo, pero ya les hablé de eso muchas veces, hoy quiero enfocarme en otras cosas, mi otro logro es que he regulado mi horario de sueño… Aunque soy una persona nocturna que encuentra el mundo lleno de paz en las noches/madrugadas eso era algo que me hacia daño durante el día, me sentía con mucho menos energía, normalmente me quedaba los fines de semana o los días libres de la escuela de mi hijo, primero me dormía hasta las 6 o 7 am luego el tiempo se redujo un poco mas a veces me acostaba a las 3 am y otras 4 o 5. Acostarme tan tarde me ponía muy nerviosa porque ya veía que estaba amaneciendo y la ansiedad de dormir antes de que salga el sol era horrible, a veces no dormía bien y terminaba descansado 1 hora o máximo 4 > It hasn't been easy, but I've achieved things I once thought impossible—for example, quitting smoking—but I've already told you about that many times. Today I want to focus on other things. Another achievement of mine is that I've regulated my sleep schedule… Although I’m a night owl who finds the world full of peace at night and in the early morning, that was something that was hurting me during the day—I felt like I had much less energy. I’d usually stay up late on weekends or on my son’s school days off. At first, I’d sleep until 6 or 7 a.m., then the time gradually got shorter; sometimes I’d go to bed at 3 a.m., and other times at 4 or 5. Going to bed so late made me very nervous because I could already see that dawn was breaking, and the anxiety of trying to fall asleep before the sun came up was horrible. Sometimes I didn’t sleep well and ended up resting for just an hour or, at most, four. ![IMG_20260506_062049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoeD2GP2gXEfe8g5s7Zp6thkwrVkK3j7Ptw6EitN1m3xyVzDqAmBmJmjrayebDzf593.jpg)

>Ahora estoy durmiendo un poco mas temprano, aunque mi meta es dormirme a las 9 pm pero nunca he logrado hacerlo, el día se pasa tan rápido a pesar de que madrugo y siento que no me da tiempo de todo en tan pocas horas, a las 9 normalmente estoy fregando y cocinando en mi casa, asi que ha sido imposible dormir a esa hora, últimamente me duermo entre las 10:30 – 11:00 PM. Aunque me cuesta levantarme aun temprano ya que levantarme temprano toda mi vida ha sido una de las peores cosas que me pueden pasar jajaja, pero después de un rato despierta me siento con mucha más energía que antes, es decir, en esos momentos donde me acostaba tarde me despertaba con mas sueño como si no hubiese dormido nada. > Now I’m going to bed a little earlier, although my goal is to fall asleep by 9 p.m.—but I’ve never managed to do it. The day goes by so fast, even though I get up early, and I feel like I don’t have enough time to get everything done in such a short time. By 9 p.m., I’m usually cleaning and cooking at home, so it’s been impossible to sleep at that hour. Lately, I fall asleep between 10:30 and 11:00 PM. Although it’s still hard for me to get up early—since getting up early has been one of the worst things that could happen to me my whole life, ha ha ha—after I’ve been awake for a while, I feel much more energetic than before. I mean, back when I used to go to bed late, I’d wake up feeling even sleepier, as if I hadn’t slept at all. ![Snapchat-658109058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23w2ipLguGYb3NBhs2JaL3roRH6BhXZiNdxmbotattMBXxjj5sbErGXyVi5tVnnTCNtvK.jpg)

>Una de las metas que me propuse en diciembre del 2025 fue mejorar mi alimentación, pero ha sido IMPOSIBLE con este infierno que vivimos en mi país, una dieta normal es muy costosa aquí, no puedo comprar yogurt, frutas, suficiente proteína, es casi imposible eliminar las harinas/azúcar porque si quito todo eso no tendría nada que comer, ya que son muy pocas las verduras y frutas que puedo comprar a la semana. Espero en algún momento conseguir una solución que me permita mejorar mi alimentación porque sinceramente estoy harta de comer siempre lo mismo y siento que eso tambien me dará aún más energía para el día a día. > One of the goals I set for myself in December 2025 was to improve my diet, but it’s been IMPOSSIBLE with the hell we’re going through in my country. A normal diet is very expensive here; I can’t afford yogurt, fruit, or enough protein. It’s almost impossible to cut out flour and sugar because if I cut all that out, I’d have nothing to eat—there are very few vegetables and fruits I can afford to buy each week. I hope to eventually find a solution that will allow me to improve my diet because, honestly, I’m sick of always eating the same thing, and I feel like that will also give me even more energy for my day-to-day life.

Discovering the Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture, Medellín

Located in the heart of vibrant Medellín, right on Plaza Botero, the Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture is an architectural masterpiece that commands attention. Designed by Belgian architect Agustín Goovaerts in the 1920s, this building is a living testament to the Flemish Neo-Gothic style right in the heart of Colombia.

The first thing that captivates you upon arrival is its imposing facade, which resembles a chessboard. Once you step through its doors, the city’s hustle and bustle fades away, giving way to an oasis of history and art. Its vaulted corridors, high ceilings, and inner courtyards invite you to stroll slowly as you discover local art exhibitions, the department’s historical archive, and the Art Gallery.

The true hidden treasure lies in climbing to its dome. From there, the panoramic view of the plaza—surrounded by Fernando Botero’s monumental sculptures and contrasting with the elevated metro—offers one of the most authentic and unmissable snapshots of Medellín’s transformation.

Verdict: More than just a museum, the Palace serves as a bridge between the stately past and the modernity of Antioquia’s capital. A must-see for anyone seeking to understand the soul and culture of the City of Eternal Spring.

Conociendo El Palacio de la Cultura Rafael Uribe Uribe, Medellín

Ubicado en el epicentro de la vibrante Medellín, justo en la Plaza Botero, el Palacio de la Cultura Rafael Uribe Uribe es una obra de arte arquitectónica que se roba todas las miradas. Diseñado por el arquitecto belga Agustín Goovaerts en la década de 1920, este edificio es un testimonio andante del estilo neogótico flamenco en plena Colombia.

Lo primero que te atrapa al llegar es su imponente fachada que emula un tablero de ajedrez. Una vez cruzas sus puertas, el bullicio de la ciudad se disipa para dar paso a un oasis de historia y arte. Sus pasillos abovedados, los techos altos y los patios internos te invitan a caminar despacio, mientras descubres exposiciones de arte local, el archivo histórico del departamento y la Galería de Arte.

El verdadero tesoro escondido se encuentra al subir a su cúpula. Desde allí, la panorámica de la plaza, rodeada por las monumentales esculturas de Fernando Botero y el contraste con el metro elevado, ofrece una de las postales más auténticas e imperdibles de la transformación de Medellín.

Veredicto: Más que un museo, el Palacio es un puente entre el pasado señorial y la modernidad de la capital antioqueña. Una parada obligatoria para quienes buscan entender el alma y la cultura de la ciudad de la eterna primavera.

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g4dc1c48191344b27a8408bb0678f62a9198588332aeefce3a09a05d178d683fb3898b095dabced3cabbf480b4d927d6b4b95f9d77d02a2d69ef8ecf97b569ca2_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 探索四季

四季更替是自然界中最迷人的现象之一。每个季节都有其独特的魅力和特征，值得我们细细品味和探索。在这篇博客中，我们将深入探讨春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的特点，以及如何在每个季节中与自然亲密接触。

## 春天：万物复苏

春天是生命重新焕发的季节。随着气温的回升，冰雪融化，大地开始复苏。花朵竞相绽放，树木抽出新芽，鸟儿也开始欢快地歌唱。

### 春季活动建议
- **赏花**：去公园或花田欣赏樱花、郁金香等春季花卉。
- **徒步旅行**：在温暖的阳光下，选择一条适合春天的徒步路线，享受大自然的美丽。
- **种植**：开始你的花园，种植一些春季花卉或蔬菜。

## 夏天：阳光明媚

夏天是活力四射的季节，阳光普照，万物生机盎然。这个季节适合户外活动，与家人和朋友一起享受阳光和自然。

### 夏季活动建议
- **海滩日**：去海滩游泳、冲浪或晒太阳，享受清凉的海风。
- **露营**：选择一个风景如画的地方，进行一次露营，体验星空下的宁静。
- **户外运动**：参加徒步、骑行或水上运动，保持活力。

## 秋天：丰收的季节

秋天是收获的季节，树叶变得五彩斑斓，空气中弥漫着丰收的气息。这个季节是反思和感恩的时刻。

### 秋季活动建议
- **采摘**：去果园采摘苹果、梨等水果，享受丰收的乐趣。
- **观叶**：在公园或山间欣赏秋天的红叶，感受大自然的色彩变换。
- **感恩节活动**：与家人朋友一起庆祝感恩节，分享丰收的喜悦。

## 冬天：宁静与思考

冬天是一个宁静的季节，白雪覆盖大地，万物沉睡。虽然寒冷，但冬天也有其独特的美丽和魅力。

### 冬季活动建议
- **滑雪**：前往滑雪场，享受滑雪带来的刺激与乐趣。
- **温泉**：在寒冷的冬季，享受温泉带来的温暖与放松。
- **节日庆祝**：参与冬季节日庆祝活动，与亲朋好友共度美好时光。

## 结语

四季的变化让我们感受到自然的奇妙与美丽。无论是春天的生机、夏天的热情、秋天的丰收还是冬天的宁静，每个季节都有其独特的魅力。让我们走出家门，亲近自然，去探索和享受这四季的变幻吧！

title.title: 🤍 Learning to slow down and trust the process
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWNfm3USbqYASVhBMqR89UriJk1TnWxp5fDsHWeayi1oG/IMG_8617.jpg 

Lately I’ve been trying to remind myself that not everything has to happen so fast. Sometimes I get anxious thinking about the future, about money, about whether all the effort I’m making today will really be worth it one day.

Working with online sales sounds easy to some people, but it can actually be really draining 😅 There are days where I spend hours checking messages, uploading products, creating content, and trying to stay motivated even when I feel mentally tired.

But moments like this, just resting for a little while and disconnecting from everything, help me breathe again. They remind me that life is not only about surviving or working nonstop. I also want to enjoy my youth, feel pretty, take care of myself, and create a future where I can live with more freedom and less stress ✨

I know I’m not there yet, but I’m proud that I haven’t given up on myself.

One step at a time 💫

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@sofyar/-learning-to-slow-down-and-trust-the-process-51m)

title.title: Encuentros cercanos
title.body:
![1000870404.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR38fkuf7ZqoDF7bXPoVYVQh1FdjQp7mMdb9XmbAgcyCL/1000870404.jpg)

En nuestro diario devenir vamos viendo cómo avanzan las historias, como cambian las vivencias familiares, me reúno con un primo de toda la vida, estudiamos juntos en el Humboldt de Oriente. La vida a veces nos da unas volteretas y nos marcan para siempre. Dos hijos y uno de ellos autista.

Recuerdo años atrás cuando ya tenía un diagnóstico del primero y venía una niña en camino. En el eco se veía un \

una deformación,  el médico puso sobre la mesa abortar. Y mi primo buscaba respuestas. Pregunto a sus hermanos, me pregunto a mi, no dejó con quién hablar. Pero era una decisión que solo ellos podían tomar. Le dije que le preguntará a la madre, es solo ella la que tiene la conexión especial con la hija. 

Decidieron no abortar, aquella protuberancia desapareció en los siguientes ecos y es una joven muy inteligente. 


![1000870398.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYXws1P1Y83jifsSN1EC8GZFoZazzWGryiE5Xw7DFmnN/1000870398.jpg)


Pero y hay un pero, como dije al principio la vida da muchas vueltas, están disgustados, casi no se hablan. Mi primo se arrepiente de volcar mucha atención en el hijo especial y abandonar a la hija más inteligente. El supuso qué ella entendería y no fue así. 

En toda familia o relaciones hay problemas, a mi me cuesta que haya comunicación entre los dos hijos que tengo aquí en Madrid con el qué está en Venezuela, yo soy el vínculo que los mantiene unidos. 


![1000870403.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT7t34NcYy7ShfuKJRaiery6Ruem2xEPuMC23zexxJVhf/1000870403.jpg)

Soy ese café que va mezclando las mejores etapas, que va dejando una huella en ellos aunque no se den cuenta, voy contándoles historias aunque parecen no escucharlas. 


![1000869024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdF9DFmbkQNN8v3yGWmrY81YTeEsh1zJtCFR5RgKEHhGG/1000869024.jpg)

![1000869020.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVECK1L1PEcHVRknvo4BRxgqDPiRQC49R6c4WmfhuNSRt/1000869020.jpg)

He caminado mirando la sombra que dejan los espacios que no son completados. He tratado de sanar a otros, mientras curó mis propias heridas de amor. No soy perfecta, no soy eterna, soy solo una dama que camina admirando la vida en cada pasillo que le toca andar. 


![1000869013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR5zeN9DktFSZC34kiHyqcfi8aR7LEhbH8wJrePpoWnYv/1000869013.jpg)

Soy la reconstrucción de las partes que integran un todo, una gran ciudad, un rincón y espacio. Soy la mezcla del amor que bate el café de las mañanas, este parada dónde esté. 


![1000870304.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQet5sPfiaSHGMNtJ6pNfMHhXHdiEWzfEBbJopnv4Xuym/1000870304.jpg)

![1000870396.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTocxXU3BHse1BrPwN9mp9npV8xQYABZN43Qdt153wQ1w/1000870396.jpg)

![1000869082.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWPNwW7U9PYi4HmvXkHCKB1bYWU8ozwP6m5w4zf8vHsD/1000869082.jpg)

Soy visitas al médico para saber que el cuerpo está bien y lo celebra con patatas. Soy el ejercicio diario de la escritura constante y el acompañamiento certero que vamos bien y que siempre todo puede mejorar aquí y allá. Sólo hay que saber esperar, que las piezas caigan por su propio peso. 


![1000870428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeynW2sw16XA6nUV9fwuW4WnXRhj2c34YDSboYBdACMxS/1000870428.jpg)

![1000870427.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVn45Mz5gvXY1SyDxMceuuPrv3U9vUhWMGnDR794pYjw/1000870427.jpg)

Somos esos patitos en Parquesur buscando alejarse de la madre para encontrar aventuras.

title.title: Tacarigua, un rincón colorido en la Isla de Margarita[ESP-ENG]
title.body:
> Hola, querida comunidad de @hivemargarita, espero estén pasando una excelente semana. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes que desde hace un tiempo he el municipio Gómez, aquí en nuestra bella Isla de Margarita, especialmente por el sector de Tacarigua, porque mi hijo asiste al gimnasio como parte de su entrenamiento de atletismo. Sin darnos cuenta, este pueblito se ha convertido en parte de nuestra rutina semanal, un lugar que vemos con frecuencia y que ya sentimos cercano. Pero hace poco tuvimos una pausa de tres semanas por varias circunstancias y ese pequeño descanso hizo que mi regreso a Tacarigua se sintiera completamente diferente. La última vez que había pasado por allí, recuerdo que estaban pintando algunas fachadas. Se veía bastante movimiento de brochas y colores nuevos en las paredes y ya desde ese momento el sector empezaba a verse mucho más bonito. Pero esta vez, cuando volví después de esas semanas, la transformación estaba completa. Me impresionó muchísimo ver tantas casitas con colores vivos, agradables, frescos, que llenan el paisaje de alegría. Es increíble cómo un toque de color puede cambiar la energía de un lugar. Lo que más me encantó es que, a pesar de esta renovación, Tacarigua conserva su esencia. Muchas de las viviendas son construcciones antiguas, de esas que tienen ventanales grandes, puertas de madera altas con mucha historias y detalles que hablan de la tradición margariteña. Me parece que se hizo un trabajo muy bonito al respetar esa arquitectura original, dándole vida sin alterar su identidad. Ese equilibrio entre lo tradicional y lo renovado es lo que hace que el sector se vea tan especial. Mientras pasaba por sus calles, sentí una mezcla de nostalgia y alegría. Nostalgia porque Tacarigua siempre ha sido un lugar muy bonito y alegría porque ahora luce más bonito que nunca. Es un recordatorio de que nuestra isla está llena de rincones que merecen ser vistos con calma, apreciados y valorados. A veces, en la rutina, dejamos de mirar. Pero cuando algo cambia, cuando un lugar se renueva, nos invita a detenernos y volver a conectar. Para mí, que paso por allí por la rutina de mi hijo, ha sido un regalo ver cómo este pueblito se ha llenado de color. Y estoy segura de que para quienes viven allí también ha sido motivo de orgullo. Me despido invitándolos a que se den una vueltica por este sector tan bonito del municipio Gómez, en esta paradisíaca Isla de Margarita. Está precioso, lleno de color y con ese encanto auténtico que lo hace único en nuestra querida Margarita. Gracias amigos por pasar, Saludos y Bendiciones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
**ENGLISH**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
Hello, dear @hivemargarita community, I hope you’re having a great week. Today I want to share with you that for some time now I’ve been passing through the municipality of Gómez quite often—here on our beautiful Margarita Island—especially the Tacarigua area, because my son goes to the gym there as part of his track and field training. Without realizing it, this little town has become part of our weekly routine—a place we see often and already feel close to. But recently we took a three-week break due to various circumstances, and that short hiatus made my return to Tacarigua feel completely different. The last time I passed through there, I remember they were painting some of the facades. You could see a lot of brushstrokes and new colors on the walls, and even then the neighborhood was starting to look much nicer. But this time, when I returned a few weeks later, the transformation was complete. I was really impressed to see so many little houses painted in bright, cheerful, fresh colors that fill the landscape with joy. It’s incredible how a touch of color can change the energy of a place. What I loved most is that, despite this renovation, Tacarigua retains its essence. Many of the homes are old buildings, the kind with large windows, tall wooden doors full of history, and details that speak to Margariteña tradition. I think they did a beautiful job of respecting that original architecture, breathing new life into it without altering its identity. That balance between the traditional and the renovated is what makes the neighborhood look so special.As I walked through its streets, I felt a mix of nostalgia and joy. Nostalgia because Tacarigua has always been a very beautiful place, and joy because now it looks more beautiful than ever. It’s a reminder that our island is full of spots that deserve to be explored at a leisurely pace, appreciated, and cherished. Sometimes, caught up in our daily routines, we stop looking. But when something changes, when a place is revitalized, it invites us to pause and reconnect. For me, as I pass through there as part of my son’s routine, it has been a gift to see how this little town has come alive with color. And I’m sure that for those who live there, it has also been a source of pride. I’ll sign off by inviting you to take a little stroll through this beautiful part of the Gómez municipality, on this paradise-like Margarita Island. It’s gorgeous, full of color, and has that authentic charm that makes it unique in our beloved Margarita. Thanks, friends, for stopping by. Greetings and blessings. title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![IkFef0F4QWgx1zPC_IMG_7389.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/IkFef0F4QWgx1zPC_IMG_7389/IkFef0F4QWgx1zPC_IMG_7389.webp)
![Ly7ozvgQmQp532MW_fd86e1d17ffb353323c110bd9f5c5b.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/Ly7ozvgQmQp532MW_fd86e1d17ffb353323c110bd9f5c5b/Ly7ozvgQmQp532MW_fd86e1d17ffb353323c110bd9f5c5b.webp)
![qzZpKnzsyANO9Z8x_a539cb0d15c3eea769ccc3358de309.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/qzZpKnzsyANO9Z8x_a539cb0d15c3eea769ccc3358de309/qzZpKnzsyANO9Z8x_a539cb0d15c3eea769ccc3358de309.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

只要是在单位上过班的人，应该都能感同身受一件事，那就是对领导的吐槽永远不会停止。当然也有体恤下属的好领导，但实在是少数。

现任领导班子和以前相比，最明显的就是极度不尊重教师，听不进半点意见。我还记得订购一轮复习资料时，我们觉得学校指定的资料实用性差，提议更换成合适的版本也全然不被采纳，只能硬性从中挑选。这些资料发到学生手里基本用不上，平日里上课我们反倒要自己找优质内容打印，这些情况他们向来视而不见。

后来又一刀切要求使用衡水金卷作为学生晚自习的定时练，我们提前做了后都觉得题目不合适，依旧必须按他们的要求完成，还要全批全改，稍有不从就立刻通报批评。

这临近高考，考试安排愈发密集，一周两场周考早已成为常态。我们多次申请顺延调整，毕竟考试太频繁，学生没时间巩固消化知识，试卷讲评也十分仓促，严重耽误正常教学进度，可领导执意按原定计划进行。久而久之学生早已身心俱疲，答题敷衍潦草、作文写不完的情况随处可见，这些现状也始终得不到重视。

更无语的是早在两年前各年级组办公室都装上了大屏实时查看教室监控，原本用于维护秩序、保障安全的设备，彻底沦为了监视工具。领导们随意截取学生上课犯困、闲谈的画面进行公开通报，还依靠着监控紧盯老师们的到岗情况，将其作为考勤考核的工具，这样的做法很不合理。

今天我喜提了一次通报，说我8点10不在岗，我就是那个时间从教室出来的，因为8点20要开考务会，我提前出来上个厕所，再赶去阶梯教室参会，这途中不需要时间的吗？偏偏就是在这个时间点被判定离岗通报，他们向来只凭监控画面下定论，从不核实具体缘由，解释也没用，通报都出了。

这样的通报向来看人下菜碟，当时和我一同走出教室的还有隔壁班两位老师，其中一个却安然无事，说到底不过是那位老师平日里和领导走得亲近罢了。

最讽刺的是四川省早就出台过规定，明确鼓励教师实行弹性坐班，核心就是不搞僵化打卡考勤。可我们学校完全无视政策，哪怕老师只是短暂离岗处理急事，只要没在办公室，立刻通报，各种考核惩罚接踵而来。我们每天六点多起床，七点就到教室盯班，工作时长早已远超标准，却连一点合理的灵活空间都没有。

好啦，通报就通报吧，我早就无所谓了。眼看着很快就要放假，能暂时远离这样压抑的环境，想想都觉得舒心自在！

title.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear creative friends. I hope you are all well and blessed with good health and happiness. Yesterday was a holiday here in Colombia, and I took advantage of the day to go to the mall where I usually buy supplies for my jewelry pieces. I went because I needed some 18-gauge wire, but I ended up finding something I’d been wanting to try for a while: 0.7mm elastic cord for making clasp-free bracelets. As soon as I saw it, I knew it was the perfect time to give it a try. When I got home, I laid out all the materials on the table and began working at my own pace. I love the moment of preparing every detail, combining colors, and watching as the pieces gradually begin to take shape. This time I made some elastic bracelets with 3mm and 4mm Murano beads in various colors and some in shades of blue, combined with Goldfield beads, and I really enjoyed the whole process because they’re easy to make and turn out very delicate.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridos amigos creativos. Espero que estén todos bien con abundantes bendiciones de salud y bienestar. Ayer fue lunes festivo aquí en Colombia y aproveché el día para ir al centro comercial donde normalmente compro los insumos para mis piezas de joyería. Iba porque me hacía falta alambre número 18, pero terminé encontrando algo que quería probar desde hace rato: hilo elástico de 0.7 para hacer pulseras sin broche. Apenas lo vi, supe que era el momento perfecto para intentarlo. Cuando llegué a casa organicé todos los materiales sobre la mesa y comencé a trabajar tranquilamente. Me encanta el momento de preparar cada detalle, combinar colores y ver cómo poco a poco las piezas empiezan a tomar forma. Esta vez elaboré unas pulseras elásticas con muranos de 3 mm y 4 mm de colores variados y unas de tonos azules, combinados con balines goldfield, y la verdad disfruté muchísimo todo el proceso porque son fáciles de hacer y quedan muy delicadas. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png ![1000682925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/EonmQhqWANCxmFSsCu53485sD8TtJfM8xHCQPdgn36BLGVsZ5fcPnvYA2X1J7ffnEwi.jpg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png
> #### Materials • 0.7 mm elastic cord • 3 mm Murano beads • 4 mm Murano beads • Goldfield seed beads • Scissors

> #### Materiales • Hilo elástico de 0.7 • Muranos de 3 mm • Muranos de 4 mm • Balines goldfield • Tijeras https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tvm4ftG3U2dtiy2FXY3caqUNgjewjcbZWA3HcMa5kwt2BBa8U8Q1rQ7Lwp9yJ4EogGv.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tHE2k7bLsmoBJ2y18aLc5zF2zTRqZijbccw3mtcqqpzZBZ8ufstjEML4rmW98m2iy8u.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png

> #### Step by Step 1. Cut the thread The first thing I did was cut a piece of elastic thread about 25 centimeters long. I like to leave it a little longer so I can work comfortably and tie the knots properly at the end. 2. Stringing the Murano beads. Next, I began stringing the Murano beads onto the cord. I placed the Murano beads in groups of five, separating them with goldfield beads. Little by little, the bracelet took shape, and I began to notice how beautiful the combination of materials looked. I really liked the contrast between the Murano beads and the subtle shimmer of the goldfield beads. They’re small details, but they make the piece look elegant and delicate at the same time. 3. Adjusting the size As I added the pieces, I checked the size to make sure the bracelet would fit comfortably on the wrist. That’s one of the advantages of working with elastic thread: the bracelets are easy to wear and don’t need a clasp. 4. Tying the knots Once I finished adding all the materials, I tied several knots to secure the bracelet firmly. This step is important to ensure it’s durable and can be worn every day without any issues. In the end, I was very happy with the result. Sometimes the simplest projects are the ones I enjoy making the most. These bracelets turned out delicate, comfortable, and very versatile for pairing with different outfits.

> #### Paso a paso 1. Cortar el hilo Lo primero que hice fue cortar un pedazo de hilo elástico de aproximadamente 25 centímetros. Me gusta dejar un poco más de largo para trabajar con comodidad y poder hacer bien los nudos al final. 2. Insertar los muranos Después empecé a insertar los muranos en el hilo. Fui colocando los muranos de cinco en cinco y separándolos con los balines goldfield. Poco a poco la pulsera fue tomando forma y empecé a notar lo bonita que se veía la combinación de materiales. Me gustó mucho el contraste entre los muranos y el brillo sutil de los balines. Son detalles pequeños, pero hacen que la pieza se vea elegante y delicada al mismo tiempo. 3. Ajustar el tamaño A medida que iba agregando las piezas, revisaba el tamaño para asegurarme de que la pulsera quedara cómoda en la muñeca. Esa es una de las ventajas de trabajar con hilo elástico: las pulseras son fáciles de usar y no necesitan broche. 4. Hacer los nudos Cuando terminé de insertar todos los materiales, hice varios nudos para asegurar bien la pulsera. Este paso es importante para que quede resistente y pueda usarse todos los días sin problema. Al final quedé muy contenta con el resultado. A veces los proyectos más sencillos son los que más disfruto hacer. Estas pulseras quedaron delicadas, cómodas y muy versátiles para combinar con diferentes looks. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tSch7h5fkcWwebTStUTDP32JMmnPGMAV9oj2Cs5NyLD4ea6iJ5khR3op5VoCjqJyMSV.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tmQ1sBP8fyELW5wCtWcep86jmqNDFaLdwUAP781HxjStSpWkpyyWVVYERhai6kok1zF.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tbnXn6vv1q8quxD1rHmo5zjkmjR8ovZSU71zJXDZTmwepRCMtQ24jeLEsjP6cCxYx1J.png All content in this publication is original content and personal creative work. The dividers and banner are my designs in Canva. The photos are my own, taken with my cell phone. Todo el contenido de esta publicación es contenido original y trabajo creativo personal. title.title: 🌙 Quiet nights and peaceful thoughts
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmba8LbC1swzaM6jiECVvSQczYeoEYLXmyAYaPe1cHQ9zU/IMG_3006.jpg 

Tonight felt calm in the best possible way ✨  
No rush, no stress… just a little moment to breathe, relax and enjoy the silence after a long day.

Being a lawyer means spending most of the time solving problems, reading documents and always thinking about the next thing to do. Sometimes I forget how important it is to simply pause for a while and reconnect with myself 🤍

I’ve been trying to appreciate these small moments more. A comfortable outfit, soft music, good lighting and feeling at peace for a couple of hours can honestly make a huge difference.

Maybe life is not perfect yet, but little by little I’m building the version of it that I dream about 🌸

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jakyrivera/-quiet-nights-and-peaceful-thoughts-yo)
