![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/244AKXEZaBcrHSkT2nJxkYZeo17dAX3cVULDDFGkcVSs6tJipBPWDEi9XoGbQdkzPASCy.png)

Greetings Hive folks, and especially to the wizards at @magi.network! I decided to participate in the contest despite not having much knowledge about trading, pools, and betting. However, we're all here to learn, and here's my humble entry. Like many others, I'm learning as I go.


This was the first thing I saw when I arrived at the Magi Network website:

https://magi.eco/
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/EoAgyeRsu2SRqGhrk84KKrUWsjvtNunNwgHXVH8YPSWjDi8sFVvVddpbX78xNLb4Sse.png)

There, they tell me that the Magi Network is:

*A next-generation cross-chain protocol that enables native asset settlement, multi-chain wallet smart contract interactions, and unified access to assets across multiple blockchains, all from a single self-custodial wallet of your choice.*

Essentially, what this means is that the Magi Network is a new and improved technology for connecting different cryptocurrencies and networks (such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, or Binance Smart Chain). Previously, these networks were like deserted islands that didn't communicate with each other. Magi becomes the super-ship that connects them all.

This means you can exchange one currency for another directly without intermediaries. Furthermore, you can use \

lending platforms, NFT purchases, or any application on any network, regardless of which network your money is originally on. The technology handles the paperwork and conversions behind the scenes to make everything work. Another interesting aspect of this protocol is that you won't have to open ten different wallets (one for Solana, another for Bitcoin, another for Ethereum). You can use your existing wallet and from there you'll be able to see, move, and control all your money across all networks, as if it were all in a single bank account. In short; Magi Network is a new tool that lets you use your favorite crypto wallet to store, exchange, and use any cryptocurrency from any network directly, without a hassle, without switching apps, and without losing control of your keys. Basically, they want to make managing crypto as easy as sending a WhatsApp message, regardless of the network your money is on. This seems like a great option to me, and I think it will be one of the best alternatives on Hive. I invite you to join me to see how it works. The first thing I'll do is send Hive from my Hive wallet to the Magi Network, and once there, I'll convert my Hive into HBD to stake them and earn a 12% APR. It's a good idea; this way, I earn money, make transactions within the Magi Network to participate in the contest, and also take the opportunity to learn more about it. Cryptocurrencies. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tRvZp19Knq4qz6B1QNcpMUMs7VSum2p5cd9jgauvxq9YoDLb4MaTMCJnNwFsFCvcupQ.png) 1- Go to Deposit, choose the Hive Main Network ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tbJmkG7pcFXbibHHKKTa9vYWUMCfFvJALzwUJtCJ5mz7QKShHgEAdFPQ3VrpevpcDdQ.png) Enter the amount of 20 Hive to transfer from Hive to your Magi Network wallet Accept the transaction and that's it, your Hive is in your account 20 hive are in the Magi Network wallet. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23t72Qt2TdbAXdyVZxPMEZnxos157SKgK6WWSkesTmaKhzARXx5zZrQs58yfuJxRZAEXX.png) 2- Let's convert them to HBD Go to Exchanges and choose to exchange the 20 hive that are in the Magi Network for HBD ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tGTG3W3ij6uio3kc9MQJsxpCFJjVS9mU5RNEeMzwyBWpcj8bB9nAwkFye4fbciJAzBN.png) We check that the amounts are correct, see that it appears to send to the same Magi Network, and click Exchange. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tGTPirN7rCbc9qo4YM8SRsJdMQCD7YXew8vW3iN2CDp1V2ZPGtUozriGSHXbiT3zDJc.png) We review the Exchange status, make sure everything is correct, and We traded. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tGXZimpPAZtcDwqT2nhujC3XSfoZzGJdeadHmJodJSS57xcmKZ6FLB8RQW171p1cp9X.png) ### Done, here we have 1,186 HBD equivalent to $1.17 USD Now we'll let these HBD earn a 12% APR ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23tRtg3MhkCLasqxvd6UUV6FAC4DNke6nnzhbY7groVGWW3ifcXwu1MQvkE7ah17A81X5.png) I tried to bet and it looks like I need to withdraw the amount I converted on HBD to my Hive Wallet. I'm learning as I go. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/23uQGcwX5WbvfMe3FEXZUMHPRwbGq6kmbxaguUCLbtCXKGpGQGdm5Qycg3avz1qAxPRwU.png) Once I withdrew my HBD to my Hive wallet, I proceeded to place the bet in the Magi Network wallet. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/EobzGd3HGuSn7cQPPGmYZtoggUjNnmH77rHVevouGoh93WjSjaDST5EAkqiSx8LxntV.png) All right, guys, I've bet 1,506 HBD, my first bet on Magi Network. Network** Happy to participate in the contest, to learn, and to be in this new and fascinating world of cryptocurrencies. Thanks for reading my post. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/242DfhkUbLPQw1raVo5TCw7HPRRWUW82pDF6XB4fHNwMHfUXTmPknn1LejYRCK8qLngWm.png) **Screenshots from https://altera.magi.eco/ I used Google Translate**

Estoy al igual que muchos aprendiendo sobre la marcha.





Esto fue lo primero que vi cuando llegué al sitio de la **Red Magi**
https://magi.eco/
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cositav/EoAgyeRsu2SRqGhrk84KKrUWsjvtNunNwgHXVH8YPSWjDi8sFVvVddpbX78xNLb4Sse.png)

Allí mismo me dicen que **La red Magi Network** es:  
*Un Protocolo de próxima generación entre cadenas que permite la liquidación nativa de activos, interacciones de contratos inteligentes de monederos multicadena y acceso unificado a activos de múltiples cadenas de bloques, todo desde un único monedero autocustodio de su elección.*

En sí lo que esto quiere decir es que la Red Magi es una tecnología nueva y mejorada para conectar diferentes criptomonedas y redes (como Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana o Binance Smart Chain). Antes, estas redes eran como islas desiertas que no hablaban entre sí. Magi se convierte en el superbarco que las conecta a todas.

Significa que puedes cambiar una moneda por otra directamente sin usar intermediarios. Ademas; puedes usar los \

, plataformas de préstamos, compras de NFT o cualquier aplicación de cualquier red, sin importar en qué red esté tu dinero originalmente. La tecnología se encarga del papeleo y las conversiones por detrás para que todo funcione.

Otra de las cosas interesantes que puedo ver de este protocolo es que no vas a tener que abrirte diez billeteras diferentes (una para Solana, otra para Bitcoin, otra para Ethereum). Puedes usar tu billetera de siempre  y desde ahí vas a poder ver, mover y controlar todo tu dinero de todas las redes juntas, como si estuvieran en una sola cuenta bancaria.

En fin; **Magi Network** es una herramienta nueva que te permite usar tu billetera cripto favorita para guardar, cambiar y usar cualquier criptomoneda de cualquier red directamente, sin dar mil vueltas, sin cambiar de aplicación y sin perder el control de tus llaves.\

body.title: Much done, text long. My Actifit Diary: May 19 2026
body.body:
I wanted to write a diary, but it somehow turned into a [post on the main account.]( https://peakd.com/hive-126152/@beelzael/the-greatest-gift) Oh, well, that’s good. Bringing some thoughts to digital paper is progress. Which reflects today. Looking back, I really accomplished a whole lot today. I didn’t go to the gym, though, which explains why I’m not completely exhausted. I could have, but I decided to give other things priority – like having a walk with Ellie during sunset, being able to take wonderful pictures. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/12d53f6e-227d-4e68-875e-4c50ffdd1c31.jpg) First step of the day was getting Nero medicated. Never fun, but I kind of have the trick now (it’s dissolving meds in tuna water). The we had the last bit of the formation for the Nuevo Sol workers about threads and stitches and fabrics and such. That was good, as I realized that I had learned a lot about it while translating, being able to answer many questions myself and actually ask the listeners questions. Which they generally had answers to – that is good, too. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ad198e1c-9c7b-460c-bd9d-790143525211.jpg) Next step was to get to Ibarra, to the DINAPEN, the police in charge of matters that regard children. I thought it was just to deliver a paper the judiciary had given me, but they told me to wait, that they could do it right away – if I had a car. Because they weren’t given any gasoline for their police trucks, so they were running empty. Well, that’s Ecuador, too. I told them that Lily wasn’t in Ecuador anymore, but they still had to go and check for themselves. Due diligence, although 2 other bodies of the judiciary had already confirmed that she wasn’t there. Well, whatever. I know the rules. Wave and smile. Went there, did confirm she wasn’t there, then went back to Ibarra, then back to the manufacturing facility to leave the car with Ellie again. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c559f61a-b522-4700-82bc-fe049835af60.jpg) Back home, I had a quick bite to eat and then my mom called. We talked quite a bit about her moving process, the emotional part about it and how hard it is on her. I know now why she didn’t reply much to me in the last weeks. But she’s getting out of the hole, was brave enough to ask for help (which is phenomenal since she never does, she only helps others, but it’s hard to help *her*), and is improving overall. We talked about the Lily situation, too, about the progress, the escalation in defamation against me from the mom’s side, and how I’m trying to handle that by staying cool. I can’t prove a negative, anyway. In theory, the mom would have to prove that I did something wrong, and since I didn’t, that’ll be hard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/05906515-c23b-42e3-9ba9-719f93d7ed04.jpg) Nero got his tube removed since he’s eating and drinking well. I picked him up after talking with my mom and walking for a little, settling almost all of the debt with the hospital. Only 80$ more and I’m done with that, thanks to donations. He’s doing really well, and I’ll let him out in the garden tomorrow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/aadc8a68-7bd1-481e-ad8c-833f59bdc77d.jpg) Then, Ellie swung by to measure some pants on me. And I went to her place with her, to do a nice walk that I mentioned before. Since I almost got to 15k steps, I decided to walk around inside the house a little to get there. That’s a great mark. Talking about marks – my Actifit account is now 1k HP heavy, and has 100k Sports token staked. Quite nice. Okay, 500 HP were seed HP from my main account, but still. That’s some good progress for a small niche account. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5397b9d9-b68f-4825-b36f-e844f37d9195.jpg) Oh wow this post is getting long. Sorry about that. If you didn’t read it all, you’re excused. Hope you liked the pictures, though! Thanks for reading and have a good night!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260520t030349834z)_

body.title: Television Review: Sons of the Harpy (Game of Thrones, S5x04, 2015)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/xJK24ELjz04a05saADPXkYafa21.jpg)


**Sons of the Harpy (S5x04)**

Airdate: 3 May 2015

Written by: Dave Hill
Directed by: Mark Mylod

Running Time: 50 minutes


The path taken by *Game of Thrones* in its fifth season, which began to significantly diverge the series’ plots from George R. R. Martin’s as-yet-unfinished literary source material, started to exert a palpable strain on the show’s internal logic and character integrity. While earlier seasons had taken liberties for the sake of adaptation, Season 5 marked a more aggressive restructuring, condensing and redirecting narratives to service a television finale Martin himself had not yet written. This shift began to affect even the fates of core characters, with some meeting ends very different from those suggested by the published novels. *Sons of the Harpy* (S5E04), a superficially solid piece of television, is a crucial inflection point where this new trajectory first draws significant blood, sacrificing a beloved character not for profound narrative necessity, but for a somewhat contrived thematic shorthand. The episode thus functions as a harbinger of the creative compromises that would later define the series’ contentious final chapters.

The episode’s primary dramatic weight lies in the political coup unfolding in King’s Landing—another quiet, ruthless realignment. The plot here is a meticulous chess game, moving pieces with cold efficiency. Cersei Lannister, increasingly isolated after her father’s death and her children’s alienation, makes her most audacious power play. By urging the pious but weak King Tommen to appoint the radical High Sparrow as the new High Septon, she forges an alliance with the grassroots fanaticism of the Faith. Her next move is breathtaking in its historical recklessness: convincing Tommen to restore the Faith Militant, a military order disbanded two centuries prior. Almost overnight, a small army of zealots begins purging the capital. Their targets—taverns, foreign idol vendors, and Littlefinger’s brothels—are symbolic, but their ire is particularly reserved for ‘sinners’ engaged in homosexual acts. This campaign culminates in the very public arrest of Ser Loras Tyrell, whose sexuality was the worst-kept secret in the city. Margaery’s furious demands for his release fall on the ears of a paralysed boy-king; Tommen’s desire to avoid conflict renders him useless, a pawn in his mother’s game. Simultaneously, Cersei deftly removes another Tyrell obstacle by dispatching Mace Tyrell to Braavos for ‘debt negotiations’ with the Iron Bank. In a single episode, Cersei dismantles her primary rival house with chilling precision, replacing the complex feudal politics of the novels with a swifter, more televisually direct seizure of power.

Meanwhile, the narrative expands geographically, dedicating considerable time to the new frontier of Dorne. While not the first episode set in the southern kingdom, *Sons of the Harpy* is the first to feature Dorne on the animated map of the opening credits, formally welcoming viewers to this new arena. The plot here, however, feels notably thinner. Jaime Lannister, accompanied by the ever-cynical Bronn, arrives on a covert mission to retrieve his daughter Myrcella from the Water Gardens. Their initial skirmish with a Dornish patrol offers a competent, if unremarkable, action beat, showcasing Jaime’s struggling swordsmanship with his left hand. Parallel to this, Ellaria Sand recruits Oberyn Martell’s bastard daughters, the Sand Snakes—Obara (Keisha Castle-Hughes), Nymeria (Jessica Hanwick), and Tyene (Rosabell Laurenti Sellers)—in a plot to murder Myrcella before she can be taken. The setup is functional, but it already hints at the simplified, almost pantomime portrayal of Dornish politics that would plague this storyline, reducing the nuanced scheming of Prince Doran and his court to a straightforward revenge quest.

In the North, the tone is one of grim foreshadowing. Sansa Stark’s arrival at Winterfell is punctuated by a visit to the family crypts, where she is met by Petyr Baelish. Their conversation weaves family history with cold political calculus. Littlefinger, soon to depart for the capital, analyses Stannis Baratheon’s impending campaign against the Boltons. He posits that whether Stannis wins or loses, Sansa, positioned as a Stark in Winterfell, can bide her time and ultimately rule the North. This scene reinforces Sansa’s transformation from pawn to potential player, though it also tethers her fate to the machinations of a man whose endgame remains inscrutable.

At the Wall, Stannis prepares his departure for Winterfell. Jon Snow, now Lord Commander, again refuses the king’s offer of legitimacy and Winterfell, honouring his Night’s Watch vows. More intriguing is the visit from Melisandre, who attempts to seduce Jon in the firelight, a scene that provided the episode’s obligatory (and by now routine) fan service via Carice van Houten’s bare breasts. Jon’s refusal, citing fidelity to the dead Ygritte, is met with Melisandre’s ominous echo of Ygritte’s catchphrase: “You know nothing, Jon Snow.” The line is a potent piece of foreshadowing, linking Jon’s lineage and destiny to the Red Priestess’s magic in a way the books had only hinted at, demonstrating the show’s occasional skill at condensing prophetic elements.

The episode also tidies up a dangling thread from *[High Sparrow](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/television-review-high-sparrow-game-of-thrones-s5x03-2015)*, revealing that Jorah Mormont, having captured Tyrion Lannister, is taking him eastwards to Meereen in a desperate bid to win back Daenerys’s favour. This sets in motion one of the season’s strongest narrative mergers, pairing two of the show’s finest wits.

All these manoeuvres, however, are but a prelude to the episode’s controversial centrepiece: the events in Meereen. After a touching scene where Ser Barristan Selmy shares memories of her brother Rhaegar with Daenerys—a rare moment of personal history for the often-mythic Targaryens—the city’s unrest boils over. Daenerys again refuses Hizdahr zo Loraq’s plea to reopen the fighting pits, a refusal that frames her as inflexible. The Sons of the Harpy, aided by a prostitute named Vara, launch a coordinated attack. They first slaughter a group of the sellsword Second Sons, then use the commotion to lure a large Unsullied patrol into a narrow alleyway trap. The ensuing massacre is brutally efficient, shot with claustrophobic intensity within the cavernous Diocletian’s Palace in Croatia. Ser Barristan, hearing the conflict, intervenes. In a valiant last stand, he helps save the life of the gravely wounded Grey Worm but is himself surrounded and mortally stabbed. It is a spectacular, well-choreographed fight, and a seemingly heroic end for a legendary knight.

Yet herein lies the episode’s—and arguably the season’s—most consequential and criticised narrative decision. In George R. R. Martin’s published works, Ser Barristan the Bold is very much alive, acting as Daenerys’s steadfast Hand in Meereen. His death in *Sons of the Harpy* constitutes the first major, irreversible departure of a primary character’s fate from the source material. The showrunners, David Benioff and D. B. Weiss, later explained the choice was made to underline Daenerys’s growing isolation in Meereen by removing her most trusted and honourable advisor. To say this explanation did not sit well among the fandom is a profound understatement. Barristan Selmy, portrayed with dignified grace by Ian McElhinney, was one of the last true embodiments of Westerosi chivalry—a living link to the era of Aerys II and a moral compass in a murky world. His death felt less like a natural culmination of his arc and more like a pragmatic, even disposable, plot device to streamline Daenerys’s descent into harder-edged rule. While the action sequence itself was commendable, the decision left a bitter taste for many book readers and show fans alike, who often cite it as the series’ first significant ‘fumble’—a moment where expediency seemed to trump narrative richness. The visceral violence of the Faith Militant’s attack on a prostitute named Merei was reportedly subdued from initial plans, yet the narrative violence done to Selmy’s story resonated far more deeply.

Written by Dave Hill in his debut script for the series, *Sons of the Harpy* is, on a technical level, a competent piece of television. It advances multiple plotlines with efficiency, features strong production values and decent action, and continues the season’s work of condensing Martin’s sprawling narrative. However, it also embodies the emerging double-edged sword of this adaptation strategy. The King’s Landing plot is a taut, thrilling political thriller, but the Dorne plot feels undercooked and generic. The thematic beats at the Wall and Winterfell are effective, but the core event in Meereen—the death of Ser Barristan—exposes a troubling precedent. It signals a willingness to sacrifice deeply embedded character integrity and fan investment for the sake of a simplified emotional beat and narrative convenience. In this sense, *Sons of the Harpy* is not merely an episode about a masked insurgency in Slaver’s Bay; it is the episode where the show’s own insurgent departure from its source material first struck down a knight in earnest, revealing that from this point forward, no character’s fate was sacred to the original text, for better or for worse. The consequences of that choice would echo far beyond the streets of Meereen.



RATING: 6/10 (++)

body.title: - RCN / Prime Video.
body.body:
>

Have you ever wondered what the most successful soap opera in the world is?

This question is too easy to answer. Back in the late 90s, Colombia, specifically the RCN Channel, presented what would mark a new era in television. For a long time, we'd been taught that aesthetics and perfection should be part of a good film and television production, showing us a somewhat distorted view of reality, portraying beautiful people as good and \

people as bad.

>***¿Alguna vez te has preguntado cuál es la novela más exitosa del mundo?***

>***Esta pregunta se responde demasiado fácil. Por allá a final de los 90, Colombia, específicamente el Canal RCN presentó lo que marcaría una nueva era en la televisión. Desde hace mucho tiempo,  nos enseñaron que la estética y la perfección deben ser parte de una buena producción del cine y la televisión, mostrándonos una visión un poco distorsionada de lo que es la realidad, colocando a gente guapa como buena, y a los \
>\n\nThis telenovela, written by Fernando Gaitán, along with Liliana Hernández, and directed by Mario Ribero, tells the story of Beatriz \

Pinzón Solano, a woman who, not being considered beautiful, dedicated her life to studying, thus gaining the necessary merits to forge a future through her own efforts. From the beginning of the telenovela, it was shown that this was not enough, since wherever she went, a beautiful woman replaced her, or she was simply discarded because of it.\n\n>***Esta telenovela escrita por Fernando Gaitán, junto a Liliana Hernández, y dirigida por Mario Ribero, cuenta la historia de Beatriz \

Pinzón Solano, una mujer que al no ser agraciada dedicó su vida a estudiar, y así tener los méritos necesarios para forjar un futuro desde su esfuerzo, y desde el inicio de la telenovela mostraron que esto no era suficiente, ya que, donde quiera que llegaba, una bonita la reemplazaba, o simplemente era descartada por esto.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/244V8pm5wMEqpHDsrLo6DDVfvMtmnVPg8Z3hELck2AdYAfGJzcs64Eq5y8a3LpjGXHJqn.png)

[Amazon Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/-/fr/detail/0N8WNLWPTPTLE1UY02RTMBMZEL)

<div class\
>\n\nThen, Betty arrived at the fashion company \

and although she was rejected at the first interview, her future boss argued that he needed someone qualified for the position, and she got the job based on her merits. From here, a new chapter in her life began. Full of excitement, she introduced herself, and since her boss (quite the ladies' man) was already committed, he decided to hire her for her looks, so as not to be distracted and to fully fulfill his commitment to the company. And so we see such a remarkable story that impacted the entire world.\n\n>***Luego, Betty llegó a la de empresa de modas \

, y a pesar de que fue rechazada a la primera entrevista, quien seria su jefe abogó de que necesitaba a alguien preparada para su puesto, quedandose por sus meritos con el trabajo. Desde aquí empieza una nueva etapa en su vida, ella con toda la emocion se presenta, y como su jefe (todo un Don Juan) estaba comprometido, decidio contratarla por su apariencia, para no distraerse y cumplir su compromiso con la empresa a todo dar, y asi vemos una historia tan priginal que impactó en el mundo entero.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EqDoQGsYSYE2T5vvswusrn1vDRdF3yd7qyjiHrstUX9kXdrh8Uunu6tQQQxQh5Xy8jK.png)

[Univision](https://www.univision.com/entretenimiento/cultura-pop/yo-soy-betty-la-fea-esconde-una-tragica-historia-ocurrio-cuando-concluia-la-filmacion)

<div class\
>\n\nActor Jorge Enrique Abello recently stated that the telenovela \

wasn't originally planned as it is today. It was created without any vision and solely to fill a gap in the broadcast schedule. Initially, only 30 episodes were planned to fill airtime, but it only took a week for it to become a massive ratings hit, leading the writers to extend the episodes and the storyline, which didn't follow the same plot we know now. \
became so popular that it was even watched more than the World Cup, earning a Guinness World Record for the first on-screen kiss between the character and her co-star.\n\n>***El actor \

, en recientes declaraciones, dijo que esta novela no fue planeada tal y como la vemos. Esta novela fue creada sin visión alguna y con el único propósito de llenar un espacio vacío en las transmisiones. Originalmente, organizaron solo 30 episodios para cumplir con el relleno, pero bastó solo una semana para que fuese un boom total en audiencias, llevando a los escritores a alargar los episodios y su historia, la cual no planeaba la misma trama que hoy conocemos. Betty ha sido tan famosa que en su tiempo fue más vista que hasta el mismo mundial de futbol, llevándose un Record Guinnes, por el primer beso en pantalla del personaje con su otro protagonista.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23tRtCtziep8TXnaSkdgqgjZHz61QEGBirT7sG6rn6JnNVjNYEcPYn5w9GBzXyowc6Yxj.png)

[Fandom](https://beatriz-aurora-pinzon-solano.fandom.com/es/wiki/Ecomoda)

<div class\

>

After its initial success and finale, there was considerable public pressure to bring the novel back to the screen, and it did, but without the same results. With some of the original cast members absent, this series was indeed very short, with only a few episodes. Although it maintained the same feel as the original, it was ultimately removed from the canon and is considered one of the worst television sequels.

>***Tras todo su éxito y final, hubo mucha presión de parte del público en que la novela volviera de nuevo a la pantalla, y se hizo, pero sin el mismo resultado. Con la ausencia de algunos del elenco, esta serie si fue realmente corta, con pocos episodios, a pesar de que esta mantenía la misma vibra que la anterior, esta fue deshecha del canon de la historia y considerada de las peores continuaciones de una historia televisiva.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23yTma2Za94j9zDmAHcin5ffoYKZ244oxwpzJUeMXuP46JHK7uWxaYbqPEbvt8VhCujvg.png)

[Univision](https://www.univision.com/entretenimiento/cine-y-series/asi-se-ve-betty-en-las-versiones-de-otros-paises-de-yo-soy-betty-la-fea-cual-es-la-mejor-video)

<div class\

>

If you want to know the impact this novel had, it was adapted into more than 25 different versions in various countries, and the original version was dubbed into more than 20 different languages. I think that's the least relevant aspect, though it doesn't diminish its amazingness. In fact, there's even an animated version called Betty Toons, which takes place in a school, and although it doesn't make sense, everyone there is a child. Elizabeth Olsen also mentioned that she was a huge fan of the original novel, so much so that she and some friends tried to translate it, and she and her friends even created a musical based on it for an English class project.

>***Si quieres saber cuál fue el impacto que esta tuvo, decir que esta fue adaptada a más de 25 versiones diferentes versiones, de diferentes países y doblada su versión original a más de 20 idiomas distintos, creo que es lo menos relevante, aunque no le quita lo sorprendente, de hecho, existe hasta una versión animada llamada Betty Toons, en donde se desarrolla en una escuela y aunque no tiene sentido, todos son niños. También, Elizabeth Olsen se pronunció en una oportunidad diciendo que en su tiempo fue muy fan de la novela original, tanto, que trató junto a algunos amigos de traducirla, y junto a esto creó con sus amigos un musical de la misma, para un proyecto de su clase de inglés.***

\

is considered the most successful Latin American production, consistently ranking in the top 10 on all platforms that have acquired the rights, such as Netflix and Amazon, making it the most profitable telenovela. So much so, that there's a hugely popular meme that says, \

based on the fact that the telenovela's plot revolves around saving Ecomoda from bankruptcy.\n\n>***Yo Soy Betty, La Fea, es considerada la producción más exitosa de Latinoamérica, estando sin detenerse en los tops 10 de todas las plataformas que han tenido sus derechos, como Netflix y Amazon, siendo la telenovela más rentable. Tanto así, que existe un meme superpopular que dice, \

, con base en que de eso va la trama de la novela en sí, de salvar de la bancarrota a la Ecomoda.***

<center>

![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg)

</center>

https://youtu.be/hMGDI7y9NfA?si=JHFImF8prtMWusu8

<div class\

>\n\nAmazon didn't rest on its laurels, and opted to return to the original story with a plot set 20 years after the events of the first installment, but completely ignoring the story told in its sequel \

, bringing a new success to the platform.\n\n>***Amazon no se quedó dormido, y aposto por regresar la historia original con una trama basada a 20 años después de lo visto en su primera entrega, pero ignorando totalmente la historia contada en su secuela \
, llevando un nuevo éxito a la plataforma.***\n\nCurrently, \

remains one of the most popular shows on Amazon, and I, for example, as a huge fan, watch it every day. I've already seen it five times, and incredibly, I still enjoy it as much as the first time. So, if you want to enjoy this comedy-drama telenovela, you can find it on Amazon. Thanks for reading, I hope you'll give it a try, and if you've already seen it, rewatching it is always a great option. >***Actualmente, Yo Soy Betty, La Fea, se mantiene en Amazon siendo lo más popular en la plataforma, y yo por ejemplo, como una gran fan, la veo todos los días, actualmente, la he visto ya 5 veces e increíblemente, la sigo disfrutando como el primer día. Ya sabes, si quieres disfrutar de esta telenovela de comedia y drama, puedes hacerlo desde Amazon. Gracias por leer, espero te animes a verla, y si ya la viste, volver a verla siempre es una opción.***
![ornamento-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EonrHYGZEBekMPPVDUTfoJ2qMNJNoTdnsRFE94hBB6s7v8NnLKpzg4uxuheGcyndkRA.jpg) ***Considera unirte a nuestro trail de curación en HIVEVOTE haciendo clic en la imagen inferior, Les agradecemos todo el apoyo.*** [![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/EoEiLUu5NE5JATd3Z9HvD2pGB7Qm8KhjzhrdoJFsvjVyr47YqWkEd8p2SCoGFZTJ6Aq.png)](https://hive.vote/dash.php?i=1&trail=takeru255) **A todos los artistas ahí afuera en HIVE, si alguna vez se sienten solos y perdidos, únanse al [canal de Discord](https://discord.gg/Cx3byvqq4U) de Bokura No Digital World** ![Zeli.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zeli/23xAqC2MYVRqfcTEfh4LkFthtevC33RJPFizV9v2LAsiwqwn7TNpKMu9ZQ5fhGmGQExQU.png)

body.title: A lovely afternoon spent together as a couple, buying birthday gifts for my husband.
body.body:
>
![1001735924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKF8UHsandqefpJ1RiRpm8KiiDirndmh7dPNhspnVAnLTcu4gF4g35ZX6jPVxYo.jpg)
Feliz martes para mi queridísimos hivers lectores, deseo de corazón que estén teniendo una semana de mucho provecho y que aprovechen para compartir y pasar tiempo de calidad con sus seres queridos, la noche te voy aprovecho para compartirles otro contenido resaltando el compromiso y la convivencia familiar, linda tarde de paseo, comprando regalos de cumpleaños para mi esposo. El mes pasado específicamente el 12 de abril estuvo de cumpleaños mi esposo y compañero de vida, y por supuesto, cuando hablamos de cumpleaños, hablamos de celebración y de los regalos que no pueden faltar con la finalidad de honrar y sorprender agasajando a nuestros seres queridos, un día previo es su cumpleaños lo sorprende invitándolo a salir al centro comercial pasar un buen tiempo de calidad como pareja también en busca de los diferentes obsequios, en esta oportunidad, fueron dos pares de sandalias también un pantalón y franela. body.body:
<center>
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNytZxJJeurc19QhcCn9vix2SbbWbfYqmnnh5aHaquJoA/imagen.png)
<sup>imagen creada con ia / image of my property  </sup></center>


<div class=\
>\n\n*Esta es mi participación vez en este [encuentro de @talentos invita a escribir sobre \

](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-futuro-es-un-misterios), con un tema que tiene mucha tela que contar, si escribí contar, porque cada quien corta esa tela en su mejor manera de contar lo que piensa de sobre \

*.

![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png)

# ***El final de mi Pasado, mañana voy caminando en mi propia luz***

#

Cuando leí el título simplemente pensé en una imagen que muchas veces te dicen y es, al final del túnel hay una luz, buenos así yo veo el futuro que voy por un túnel un poco oscuro y logro ver el final del túnel una luz, pero mientras camino yo mismo voy reflejando luz es como si cuando yo camino ilumino todo a mi alrededor, pero eso no quiere decir que delante de mí todo está oscuro y que mi futuro está allá en esa luz al final del túnel.


Esa imagen me lleva directo a reflexionar sobre el tema que nos propone nuestra amiga Angélica en esta semana, *el futuro es un misterio*, que no te quede la mínima duda y claro que lo es, a veces, nos quedamos como un palo de agua esperando a que las cosas se arreglen solas, postergando decisiones cruciales para mañana, como dice el dicho, pensando que el futuro nos va a traer una varita mágica.


Qué nos pasa cuando postergamos nos quedamos en él más luego, en el algún día, a lo mejor, siempre pasa por puro miedo a lo desconocido, a no saber qué pasará si cambiamos de rumbo, o quizás, porque pensamos que esperar cuál es la mejor opción, que, si aguardamos el tiempo suficiente, todo será mejor por obra y gracia de nuestro amigo CHUCHU, pero, y si esa luz al final del túnel no es más que el reflejo de la que nosotros mismos estamos proyectando.

El futuro es como no saber si te va a picar, pero que no puedes evitar que te dé vueltas en la cabeza, a veces, nos enferma la mente imaginando escenarios catastróficos o esperando una felicidad que nunca llega, pareciera que nos condicionáramos a nosotros mismos, a nuestros pensamientos, a nuestro cuerpo, como dice Angélica, somos capaces de crearnos padecimientos por puras fantasías del futuro.


Qué haría yo si hoy tomara la decisión de cambiar algo, como dicen por allí, agarraría el toro por los cachos, si tuviera que elegir un solo cambio, sería aprender a vivir más el presente, dejar de preocuparme tanto por el que pasará y enfocarme más en el que estoy haciendo hoy, escribiría en mi hoja en blanco, en una columna, todos los pros: paz mental, disfrute del momento, mayor conexión con mi entorno, y en la otra, los contras, habrá algún contra, quizás el miedo a soltar el control, pero es un contra que se desvanece cuando te das cuenta de que el control es una ilusión, jajajajaja y me da risa porque cuando uno es casado casi no tiene control jajajajaja solo lo pensé y lo escribí, jajajaja


Soltar el control es como soltar el papagayo, o como decimos en Ciudad Bolívar, el volador y dejar que la brisa lo lleve a donde tiene que ir, es liberarse de la carga de querer saberlo todo, de querer predecirlo todo.

Es confiar en que la luz que reflejamos en el túnel es suficiente para iluminar nuestro camino.


#


![Baner ingles version.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanzjoseg/23xpWDZp2s4Rg8d9JJWHp6XaG32dzE8iQYegC7gnsvpH2bugrHW6wuf8nTXa8UuRsEHB6.jpg)


<center>
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMBhu1kww6dyFBjU5bxjG2C3egvkrfwkvXoDGHnyXVba/imagen.png)
</center>



*This is my participation in this [invites you to write about \

.](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-futuro-es-un-misterios), with a subject that has a lot of fabric to tell, yes I wrote tell, because each one cuts that fabric in his best way to tell what he thinks about  \

*

-------



# The end of my past, tomorrow I walk in my own light.
#
When I read the title, I simply thought of an image that people often mention: there is a light at the end of the tunnel. Well, that is how I see the future—I am walking through a somewhat dark tunnel, and I manage to see a light at its end. However, as I walk, I project light myself; it is as if my steps illuminate everything around me. But that does not mean everything ahead of me is pitch black and that my future only exists in that light at the end of the tunnel.

This image leads me directly to reflect on the topic proposed by our friend Angélica this week: the future is a mystery. Let there be no doubt about it, of course it is. Sometimes, we stand around like a sudden downpour, just waiting for things to fix themselves, postponing crucial decisions for tomorrow, as the saying goes, thinking the future will bring us a magic wand.

What happens to us when we procrastinate? We get stuck in \

This always happens out of pure fear of the unknown, of not knowing what will happen if we change course, or perhaps because we think waiting is the best option—that if we wait long enough, everything will improve by the grace and work of our friend Jesus. But what if that light at the end of the tunnel is nothing more than the reflection of the light we are projecting ourselves? The future is like not knowing if something will bite you, yet you cannot stop it from spinning in your head. Sometimes, we make ourselves sick by imagining catastrophic scenarios or waiting for a happiness that never arrives. It seems like we condition ourselves, our thoughts, and our bodies; as Angélica says, we are capable of creating ailments for ourselves out of pure fantasies about the future. What would I do if I decided to change something today? As they say, I would take the bull by the horns. If I had to choose just one change, it would be to learn to live more in the present, stop worrying so much about what will happen, and focus more on what I am doing today. I would write on my blank sheet of paper, in one column, all the pros: peace of mind, enjoying the moment, a deeper connection with my surroundings; and in the other, the cons. Would there even be any cons? Perhaps the fear of letting go of control, but that is a con that vanishes when you realize that control is an illusion, hahahahaha. And it makes me laugh because when you are married, you have almost no control, hahahahaha. I just thought it and wrote it, hahaha. Letting go of control is like releasing a kite—or as we say in Ciudad Bolívar, el volador—and letting the breeze take it wherever it needs to go. It is freeing oneself from the burden of wanting to know everything, of wanting to predict everything. It is trusting that the light we reflect in the tunnel is enough to light our path. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png) ---------- ***Para ser feliz solo debes tomar tu propia decisión. / To be happy, you just have to make your own decision***. # ----------------- ####

body.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 10-26-2019 - 10X Speed
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779245016597-794fd478ba8a73eb.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/0ddd46e6)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/0ddd46e6)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: Bees are nature's workers [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
>

I don't know if you've ever had the same experience as I have, there are certain times when someone tells you something or you read a piece of information, and you never forget it. Well, in my case, one of those things has been the importance of bees to our planet, and it's something I remember every time I take pictures of them, so I hope you enjoy them.

No sé si les ocurre como a mí, que hay ciertas ocasiones en que alguien te cuenta algo o lees una información y nunca más lo olvidas; pues, en mi caso, una de estas cosas ha sido la importancia de las abejas en nuestro planeta y esto es algo que recuerdo cada vez que les hago fotografías, por lo que espero que las disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vi6AorD9fKBRzcNBxDEbZdLzAFGdTnouLYhHG2JAH7tKk5UkhqZHS61pKYUJ135FhLM.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xKxeAHsVBCudw8iGbeUK2GgJS9wVwsrMC9j9Hpt5rX5e8j6Ak8UjmtGEazNmr58AgvZ.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xL8sZHrBKgF1zpZ4LpEucafZ3x7pN6FSKaaxqE6uBr6xZLHwVGk6pNRLTsfnGhn45Un.jpg

>

Personally, a couple of years ago I wasn't aware of the important work they do, but it's interesting to see how these tiny creatures we see on plants and flowers in general play such a vital role and have been helping us immensely for a very long time.

Personalmente, hace un par de años no era consciente del gran trabajo que realizaban, pero es interesante ver cómo estos pequeños animalitos que vemos en las plantas y flores en general tienen un trabajo tan importante y que nos ha ayudado en gran medida desde muchísimo tiempo.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wCDvsXXEsGGiCst7znnaCw32ZpZEdRn29iKnLBCspFoG43N4448BCyPw18UEeDAWjgb.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23zbPpNyJjdGineDBKG3hWW8LMLFU3j3BKn4qWujz9pW5CjbHWMZCw7H6ptQ973PnmgzG.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23z7L8HapWdZFR6pdTBAeigveW3UNGpiRzrd1Wo6wJKXsWDNgRYfYuPVfZPcdUB9C6yza.jpg

>

I find it quite lovely to watch the bees at work, landing on flowers, searching for nectar, and then staying there for a couple of seconds before flying off to another flower and repeating the process over and over until they’re full enough to return. In these photographs, I think you can really see that constant effort as they move from flower to flower.

Se me hace bastante lindo ver a las abejas trabajar, posarse en las flores, ver cómo buscan y luego quedarse por un par de segundos, para luego volar en dirección a otra flor y repetir una y otra vez hasta estar lo suficientemente cargadas para regresar, y en estas fotografías creo que se aprecia a la perfección ese esfuerzo constante en distintas flores.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wqsF7gZCVXsRScbKL6igK8pUsfhNRMerpDc2XvkczJW6nu6ckxLZWvvv87oyqdDN74i.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/24241rCxxUFpGYivwxBn7xtEs8ANoCgDgE5wreybxv3GmKpim9sxbUASHkbQprwvo4Knu.jpg

>

That's all for today; this is another series I'm adding to the many bee photos I've taken, so I hope you enjoyed them. Thank you so much for stopping by again today, I really appreciate it. I hope you're all doing great. See you next time, dear friends and photography lovers!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; es una serie que sumo a las tantas fotografías de abejas que he hecho, por lo que espero que las disfrutaran. Muchas gracias por pasarse un día más por aquí, lo aprecio. Espero que todos se encuentren genial. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos y amantes de las fotografías!

/>

body.title: Back in the garden after a week / 一週間ぶりの庭
body.body:
Last weekend I stayed at a makerspace for three workshop days in a row, so I left the garden mostly to nature for a while.

Earlier last week, the temperatures were still quite low high around 10 degrees, but my tomato seedlings had already grown too much. I took a gamble and planted them, and I was a bit worried about them — but they survived! The tomatoes did their best 🥺 

Now that we are past mid-May, which is usually considered the border for late frost here in east Germany, the weather forecast finally shows warmer days above 20°C from this week onward. Yesterday I loaded all the squash seedlings into the car and brought them to the garden, and this morning I went back on my bike to plant them.

![DF2E4D82-00EB-4C8B-8D48-DA5D9A606803\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGxUEYJW2VjQHNMUKJ2y2zPyxKGCSXyfG7JaidHUCKQsaJd8SMS1Ucx1FTDqW9M1Zv.jpeg)

The cardboard mulch I use for weed control and keeping moisture in the soil does not look beautiful right now, but the pumpkins and zucchinis will soon grow large enough to cover it all.

![4F5A8746-71C6-4CE8-AA11-DC822859F6FC\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoK5pgbxJR1XHVGWVyqy4FyB97phD9fHW62ULQAKET9kzW2ei3CbWHFEfv8eUEiXYUW.jpeg)

I also planted corn and beans together with the squash to try the companion planting technique known as the “Three Sisters.”

[Three Sisters - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three_Sisters_(agriculture))

While weeding around the new seedlings, I also found a pleasant surprise: a Hosta that I thought had disappeared had come back 🥳 To make sure it would not get lost again, I transplanted it into the shady Hosta zone where I planted other Hostas from the plant market earlier this month. Maybe next spring I can finally harvest and eat some young Hosta shoots.

![6E7CDEA1-8311-4C54-B412-EC7BB78EF4CA\_1\_102\_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eoc74yoj6JQkgXzLKPsRZpF8JPTiUmj2hYqhnZFyifexqp7Nz5N7MA1JX8YpQ3WAnPm.jpeg)

Another thing I did was move the strawberries that remind me of my mother. They had become extremely vigorous in the raised bed and were creating shade for the other plants, so I transplanted them beneath the apple tree that my mother also loved. This year seems to be a great strawberry season both on the balcony and in the garden, and I am really looking forward to the harvest.

![F224192F-C6BF-4823-B20B-6D8CF532B6E6\_1\_102\_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoeDxDU13w4jBBLFFVuQu3eSBRMatDNKFiJ4nt4MUoqPXS2FnyqgwE1wYq5fgzhprQH.jpeg)

And, this is what the whole garden currently looks like. This year I decided to document it with panorama photos.

![5036D6EE-318D-4243-8ABE-7F26DFF421FC\_1\_102\_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EowFAs7dXHuBzzBvort2rGrcJGdYh5U7qp6EkBmkNP38VtfnT4fEgVKFsQ5nXpJu1kR.jpeg)

Happy gardening! 

---

先週後半はメイカースペースに泊まり込みでワークショップ3連発。ということで、庭は自然にお任せしていました。

先週前半は気温がまだ低めで、でもトマトの苗がずいぶん育ってしまっていて、ギャンブルで植えてきてしまい、心配だったのですが、無事生き延びてくれていました。トマトたち、がんばった 🥺

遅霜の境と言われる5月半ばを過ぎて、天気予報でも今週からは最高気温が20度を超える暖かい日が続くようで、昨日瓜類の苗を車で庭に運んで、今日また自転車で朝から庭に行って植え付けてきました。

![DF2E4D82-00EB-4C8B-8D48-DA5D9A606803_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoGxUEYJW2VjQHNMUKJ2y2zPyxKGCSXyfG7JaidHUCKQsaJd8SMS1Ucx1FTDqW9M1Zv.jpeg)

除草と保湿目的のダンボールマルチの見た目はあまりよくありませんが、これからかぼちゃやズッキーニが大きく育って隠してくれる予定です。

![4F5A8746-71C6-4CE8-AA11-DC822859F6FC_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoK5pgbxJR1XHVGWVyqy4FyB97phD9fHW62ULQAKET9kzW2ei3CbWHFEfv8eUEiXYUW.jpeg)

スリー・シスターズという名前で知られる、かぼちゃととうもろこしと豆を一緒に植えるコンパニオンプランティングテクニックを試すべく、とうもろこしや豆の苗も一緒に植えてきました。

苗を植えつけながら草むしりをしているとうれしい発見もあって、どこかにいってしまったかなと思っていたHostaが出てきていました。行方不明にならないように、植物市で買ってきたHostaを植えた日陰のHostaゾーンに移植しました。来年は早春にHostaを食べられるかな？

![6E7CDEA1-8311-4C54-B412-EC7BB78EF4CA_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Eoc74yoj6JQkgXzLKPsRZpF8JPTiUmj2hYqhnZFyifexqp7Nz5N7MA1JX8YpQ3WAnPm.jpeg)

あとは、レイズドベッドに母との思い出のいちごがものすごく元気で、ちょっと他の植物に影を作りすぎていたので、母が好きだったりんごの木の下に移しました。今年はバルコニーも庭もいちごが当たり年のようで収穫が楽しみです。

![F224192F-C6BF-4823-B20B-6D8CF532B6E6_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EoeDxDU13w4jBBLFFVuQu3eSBRMatDNKFiJ4nt4MUoqPXS2FnyqgwE1wYq5fgzhprQH.jpeg)

庭の全景はこんな感じです。今年はパノラマ写真で記録しています。

![5036D6EE-318D-4243-8ABE-7F26DFF421FC_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EowFAs7dXHuBzzBvort2rGrcJGdYh5U7qp6EkBmkNP38VtfnT4fEgVKFsQ5nXpJu1kR.jpeg)

それではみなさん、Happy Gardening!

body.title: A Walk Where My Eyes and My Soul Rest
body.body:
Today, I would like to share a few frames from my walk again for the Wednesday Walk community. Actually, I walk in many places near my home. Sometimes I take a short street walk, sometimes I walk around near the beach, sometimes I just take a few rounds around my house. But this time, the place I walk is one of the farthest tracks among the places that can be considered close to my home. Despite this, it feels very good to me every time I come. Because this is a bigger, more lively, more fun and more motivating place than other walking areas in my opinion.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcwgs8RMWAE4ANo9xNYH7jiJqNT6Cggyn3MYnvjUvXD4e/img_1790.jpg)


This track is not just nice for walking. It is also a place that is good for the human soul. It's beautiful for my eyes, it's beautiful for my ears. There are greenery, trees, flowers and small ponds on one side. On the other hand, the sounds of birds, light wind and calm movements of people walking. It is really precious to find such a space in the city. In a crowded and busy city like Istanbul, sometimes people need such places to return to themselves.

![IMG_1747.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpLeWqdGgwEBXXXg63xNkhHC6Ni6fzrSCot63Z87mrs2MuBSYRhP6VMTT3FFhmgNTBK.jpeg)


When I started walking, it wasn't quite dark yet. The sky was cloudy, but this cloudy weather added a different beauty to the park. Sometimes sunny weather is very nice, but walking in such light indoor and cool weather is also very pleasant for me. In the first photos, you can see lush trees, small areas surrounded by stones and the buildings behind. The city and nature stand side by side here. There are apartments and modern buildings on one side, trees, lawns and a peaceful park area on the other. This image always makes me think: Even if a person lives in the city, he should not break ties with nature.


![IMG_1748.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EprSAiFGLCHamYqEbhwT7aG1kLtseLV6ko2XhHFF3iCsEpL9Q2um4AvBxWL4xf3RPVK.jpeg)

![IMG_1749.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpNmtC1yzp6gM3CeTwhKcZBWJeCbQWesaEb6CZXvZUgzkRaTBRo6yWpfLxXtjsMzrAH.jpeg)

One of my favorite places on the track is the red walkway. Even the color of this road gives people energy. It motivates me to see the road in front of me as I walk. I encourage myself by saying, \

I normally walk here for an average of one and a half or two hours. I walked almost that much on this walk. Sometimes I check the step count, sometimes I don't look at all. Because some walks are not just for sports. Sometimes a person needs to clear his head, rest his heart and breathe a little.


![IMG_1751.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqQL8s7qFcuHMsKU6E8AvBm5aNDPqMRkMa1oU4dXLPahtc6MJUuLuQihdEedM6kMoSg.jpeg)

![IMG_1752.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpnAp7bpuX8nSmzzzsUEePbJteB4iPr15xdZm1gpqC6DtcUGkDWWPPhsqNhfNTc9xVm.jpeg)


The sounds of birds were really beautiful while walking. Sometimes we forget to hear bird sounds in city life. The sound of cars, people's hustle and bustle, phone notifications, jobs, responsibilities, the sounds of nature remain in the background. But it feels so good to hear the sound of the birds clearly while walking here. Those voices give me peace. It's like bringing people to themselves. After a while, people start to think more calmly. I think that's the best part of walking. It moves not only the body, but also the mind, but also calms.


![IMG_1755.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqNCNP9Sq72n8apBKn7uwWTpU3rfSqT1CToLW36z629WsnArSPtBTfiuURzXs1Ko3AG.jpeg)

![IMG_1758.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqNDG49qeAiy9xcB3NNDMqMdQo2LyTQggPriuHmspzoaft8rP1vu4gi1tEnMAE1idsv.jpeg)

There are different areas in the park. Children's playgrounds, seating areas, small bridges, ponds, walking paths among the trees and beautiful cafes... Especially the giraffe-shaped slide in the playground looked very cute. When the evening lights came on, the atmosphere of the park changed even more. The day is beautiful, the evening is beautiful. It was also very pleasant to walk under the lights. As it got dark, the sky turned dark blue and the parking lights began to illuminate the road. At that moment, the walk became more peaceful.


![IMG_1760.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Epxj79SbCrqkCayiAcwSLHNrkiQB8Ht8GDm9WwcAD8pzEDUaJFbb1RWJrEcWA6cNkm7.jpeg)

![IMG_1761.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpEAaHnksYx4iFE1WSa5ir7oJJce8sZ8zNXYjtfMYZBcSy3WkguyCdSvvKu7tyoSQ8A.jpeg)


There is a tree with a pink bloom in a photo. I think it was one of the most beautiful views of the park. There is a small area of water next to it, greenery behind it and the minarets of the mosque in the distance. This frame seemed very peaceful to me. There is both nature, city and a spiritual feeling. At moments like this, people want to stop and look a little. While I was walking, I sometimes stopped, took pictures, watched around. Because this walk was not just to step fast. It was also to notice the beauties I saw.

d3scr)


![IMG_1764.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eq56qnNv1fxmVzKxnsfjnmnfAfwJALhuDvVnhBmLCdgjDbzot2YNRuyCq6jBeRyrDzx.jpeg)

![IMG_1765.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpSw3UfCRL5UX99QanRRZzSfnE8Jcq1PAevcm23kkfStwVdaU3WZjSYoQAbdMcMrgmi.jpeg)


While walking here, I also thought that I was grateful to my Lord for my life. Sometimes we expect big things. But in fact, being able to walk, get some fresh air, spend time in a beautiful park, hear the sounds of birds and even have enough time to have a coffee is a great blessing. When people realize these, they feel more peaceful. I also feel it often during the walk. There are moments in the intensity of life that seem small but are actually very valuable. This walk was one of them for me.


![IMG_1766.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Epn9w89Yeg8UkJubBYbVfNu7QjjNcAi7tV6eHvgxwHBmUXWAgGrNFTjUJM2TWNQnAcg.jpeg)

![IMG_1767.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqDhAz9iXWRNiiGm1K2wrjM7ngzX3muiDTNTss2J2Pq5wRhC71m3qVk5eMX3AnQb95A.jpeg)


Walking is also very important to me in terms of health. I can maintain my weight, but I also have excesses to give. I know I have to take regular walks every day for this. Sometimes it's not easy to do that. Sometimes people are lazy, sometimes they get tired, sometimes they say \

. But after I started walking, I say I'm glad I left. Because as I move, my energy increases. When I get home, I feel lighter and better. That's why I want to see walking not just as a sport, but as a beautiful routine of my life.


![IMG_1769.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoryq8Shq1FTYxkthpmxkB4KfsCWo25upbbjC4XejJbBGttgk7JYvB7qUNRgE2EmLx3.jpeg)

![IMG_1789.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpXJzeuQ4D4YbjRsS6D5AckXH48eT4UqdsfwLs2fRUwRuZK2ErqyWKZ7PXpBfQjqBfq.jpeg)


Another good thing about this track is that there are nice cafes where I can sit after the walk. I usually sit in one of the cafes on the track after I finish my walk. I have a coffee, rest a little and complete the pleasure of the walk. I think this little reward makes the walk more motivating. First a long walk, then a hot coffee... Moments like this are very good for me.


![IMG_1792.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EppKnvzEMxkfZDRvg3yk2BVrGsT6ceEHaz6RA5yMpbWqSqi3PM7vgKJa6KPU9jpuVxo.jpeg)


This walk reminded me again: Sometimes we don't need to make big plans to be good for ourselves. A nice park, a little time, a comfortable shoe and an open heart can be enough. While walking, one listens to both his body and soul. While I was walking on this track, I did not break away from the city and got close to nature. Bird sounds, flowers, roads, lights and the blue of the evening were very good for me.


![IMG_1791.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23wX1dCRyeXLoPq3wVmv49H7C4GNBH2wxA6s8ya3VaxNtaV5xxjWj4iQuHHkhMhGL6kzN.jpeg)


It is very pleasant for me to share this walk for the Wednesday Walk community. Because here I am sharing not only a walk, but also what that walk makes me feel. I hope you will feel the peace of this track while looking at the photos. For me, this walk didn't just mean taking a step; it meant breathing, being grateful, being motivated and taking good care of myself.

body.title: Estupidez humana: Una venda voluntaria que muchos no se quieren quitar [esp-eng]
body.body:
​
![1000027992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tvaH8J9ZPbf5QfUDddkdN1tTPemLLqwTf8tb2jjTZwdN65iuzKr9zGa51wsnFP6bDKG.jpg)
​Ante una lectura del trabajo del Dr. @emiliorios en @holos-lotus sobre la [estupidez](https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/el-peligro-de-la-rigidez-mental-es-la-estupidez-mas-peligrosa-que-la-maldad-esta-es-una-conversacion-esen), caigo en cuenta de lo profundo de esta frase, acto, efecto y reacción. ​En su trabajo expone lo siguiente: “La estupidez es esa rigidez mental que rechaza las perspectivas diferentes del ser humano, y que esta es, inclusive, más dañina que la misma maldad. Además, incorpora en su discurso el ámbito político, siendo el ejemplo más certero que cada uno puede ver en estos tiempos”. ​

Mi punto de vista en lo político

​En esta vereda del lado político, siento que lleva una bandera sin color, y es que en mi visión personal, referente a mi propio país, Chile, veo a dos bandos sumamente marcados, siendo específicamente izquierda y derecha. ​En este sentido, la estupidez da cátedra de aquello, ya que en ambos sectores vemos a partidarios de sus respectivos partidos con el estandarte de defensa “acérrima y paupérrima”, la cual es un partido de ping-pong 🏓 o tenis 🎾 con un inicio marcado, sin embargo, sin final avisado. ​La estupidez 🙃 del defensor político escapa significativamente de su raciocinio, donde la cordura de los “pares” se distorsiona en “pro y defensa del sector político” al que sienten que pertenecen. ​En este ámbito, el campo de batalla suele ser las redes sociales, donde despotrican de un sector al otro, dejando de lado las culpas de su propio lado; es decir, el lado que no les corresponde es la vereda fea del barrio y viceversa. ​Para mí, esa negación o más bien idealización es un sentido de “pertenecer” a un modelo, cuando no es así. En medio de esto, pasan por alto la regla más importante, y es que los políticos, independientemente del país que sean, se rigen ante el pueblo, mismo que es el real jefe; sin embargo, la estupidez humana ha logrado crear un falso coliseo con “pseudo dioses” que gozan con las batallas que la gente logra en sus defensas.
![1000027994.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wgHHn3FASkTWgzrmDk2zq5qfhdaZria56cw9u5Uf6cALBAeDVufEXG3N5xuDAenEJjP.png)
​En ese sentido, el político que es el empleado de la ciudadanía se convierte en el jefe por voluntad de quien lo protege a capa y espada, aquel que de manera inverosímil recibe descalificaciones verbales por su causa; no obstante, eso no les molesta y allí la estupidez está más que latente. Y, al final de cuentas, ese político al que una persona **X** ha defendido, al final del día no conoce su nombre, dirección o si es que tiene o no pan 🥖 en su mesa. ​En ese sistema de estupidez colectiva, decidí quedarme en la azotea del edificio, mirando la panorámica completa, los cuatro lados del edificio, dos de izquierda y dos de derecha, y mientras entre ellos discuten, yo veo cómo los cimientos del mismo se agrietan.
![1000027995.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wWpSUBm2kX7oAkKpYA8xuquJmNwfNqzEh7iuSzJ5nABZsMM1KYTLMxvzQA1MXmgNjbF.png)
Mi sector político no existe, mi visión es más igualitaria y a la vez dudosa, ya que es injusto que un médico que salva vidas gane menos que un político que vive del mismo Estado, es decir, de todos, mientras sus bolsillos se llenan y el estúpido que los defiende apenas y llega a fin de mes o de quincena. ​

Análisis de la estupidez en la psicología

​Sería pecar de arrogantes si alguna vez pensáramos en que podemos arreglar a las demás personas, o más bien caeríamos en la estupidez más burda que el ser humano cree a cabalidad. ​Es decir, nadie puede cambiar la esencia de una persona; es más, quizás al comienzo pueda fingir para agradar, pero a la larga la máscara cae y lo que uno es, es lo que realmente por fin se asoma.
![1000027996.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFRyrAUVdtdRnG16QpBQkEiXmx9AtzKshBuBCfnK7eyZGFey3M9o5CcCBf3qXr5zBGX.png)
​Con esto quiero decir que, en cierto punto, tema o acción, hemos sido estúpidos de algún modo, quizá por confiar en que sí podíamos solos o por confiar en alguien que nos traicionó; pero luego analizamos y entendemos, y esa estupidez se vuelve pasajera. ​Sin embargo, sí hay personas que viven en este estilo de vida, y una cosa cierta es: “que la estupidez no es sacar malas notas o errar en alguna labor o trabajo”. Estupidez es: renunciar a nuestro pensamiento crítico y analítico de la racionalidad del evento, acción o persona, y distorsionar estas visiones a propia voluntad. ​Y es que, como dice el Dr. @emiliorios, el malo por lo menos sabe que es malo; el estúpido es malo, cruel y malévolo, pero sin obtener ningún beneficio. ​

¿Notas la diferencia?

​El malvado o malvada busca un provecho o beneficio, mientras el estúpido o estúpida solo lo hace por reflejo o porque realmente esto se encuentra insertado en su ADN. ​Entonces lo que distingue notoriamente a la estupidez humana no es la ignorancia natural, sino la falta de voluntad para razonar ante los actos cometidos, el egoísmo intelectual y la disposición a seguir ciegamente estilos y tendencias. ​Como decía la famosa frase atribuida a Albert Einstein: ​\

. *** ###
🙃 English 🤔
***
![1000027992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tvaH8J9ZPbf5QfUDddkdN1tTPemLLqwTf8tb2jjTZwdN65iuzKr9zGa51wsnFP6bDKG.jpg)
​Having read Dr @emiliorios’s piece on @holos-lotus about [stupidity](https://ecency.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/el-peligro-de-la-rigidez-mental-es-la-estupidez-mas-peligrosa-que-la-maldad-esta-es-una-conversacion-esen), I realise the depth of this phrase, act, effect and reaction. ​In his work, he states the following: “Stupidity is that mental rigidity which rejects perspectives different from one’s own, and that this is even more harmful than evil itself. Furthermore, he incorporates the political sphere into his discourse, which is the most accurate example that everyone can see in these times”.

My political viewpoint

​On this political front, I feel he is flying a colourless flag; for in my personal view, regarding my own country, Chile, I see two sharply defined camps, specifically the left and the right. ​In this sense, stupidity reigns supreme, as in both sectors we see supporters of their respective parties flying the banner of ‘staunch and wretched’ defence, which is a game of ping-pong 🏓 or tennis 🎾 with a clear start, yet no end in sight. The stupidity 🙃 of the political defender significantly escapes their reasoning, where the sanity of their ‘peers’ is distorted into ‘supporting and defending the political sector’ to which they feel they belong. In this sphere, the battlefield is usually social media, where they rail against one side or the other, ignoring the faults of their own side; that is to say, the side that does not belong to them is the ugly side of the neighbourhood, and vice versa. For me, that denial—or rather, idealisation—is a sense of ‘belonging’ to a model, when in fact it is not so. In the midst of this, they overlook the most important rule, which is that politicians, regardless of the country they are from, are accountable to the people, who are the real bosses; yet human stupidity has managed to create a false colosseum with ‘pseudo-gods’ who revel in the battles the people wage in their defence.
![1000027994.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wgHHn3FASkTWgzrmDk2zq5qfhdaZria56cw9u5Uf6cALBAeDVufEXG3N5xuDAenEJjP.png)
In that sense, the politician, who is the people’s employee, becomes the boss by the will of those who protect him tooth and nail, those who, implausibly, face verbal abuse for his sake; yet this does not bother them, and therein lies the stupidity, more than evident. And, at the end of the day, that politician whom a certain person has defended does not, at the end of the day, know their name, address, or whether or not they have bread 🥖 on their table. In that system of collective stupidity, I decided to stay on the roof of the building, taking in the full panorama—the four sides of the building, two on the left and two on the right—and whilst they argue amongst themselves, I watch as the building’s foundations begin to crack.
![1000027995.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wWpSUBm2kX7oAkKpYA8xuquJmNwfNqzEh7iuSzJ5nABZsMM1KYTLMxvzQA1MXmgNjbF.png)
My political camp does not exist; my view is more egalitarian and yet dubious, as it is unfair that a doctor who saves lives earns less than a politician who lives off the same State—that is to say, off everyone—whilst their pockets are filled and the fool who defends them can barely make ends meet by the end of the month or fortnight.

Analysis of stupidity in psychology

It would be arrogant of us to ever think we can fix other people, or rather, we would fall into the crudest form of stupidity that human beings fully believe in. In other words, no one can change a person’s essence; what’s more, perhaps at first they might pretend to please, but in the long run the mask slips and what one is, is what finally comes to the surface.
![1000027996.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFRyrAUVdtdRnG16QpBQkEiXmx9AtzKshBuBCfnK7eyZGFey3M9o5CcCBf3qXr5zBGX.png)
​By this I mean that, in a certain situation, issue or action, we have been foolish in some way, perhaps by trusting that we could manage on our own or by trusting someone who betrayed us; but then we analyse and understand, and that foolishness becomes a passing phase. However, there are indeed people who live this way, and one thing is certain: ‘stupidity is not about getting bad marks or making a mistake in some task or job’. Stupidity is: giving up our critical and analytical thinking regarding the rationality of the event, action or person, and distorting these views at will. ​And the fact is, as Dr @emiliorios says, the wicked person at least knows they are wicked; the stupid person is wicked, cruel and malicious, but without gaining any benefit. ​

Can you spot the difference?

The wicked seek personal gain or benefit, whilst the foolish do so merely out of habit or because it is simply ingrained in their very nature. What therefore most clearly distinguishes human foolishness is not natural ignorance, but rather a lack of willingness to reflect on one’s actions, intellectual selfishness, and a readiness to blindly follow fashions and trends. As the famous quote attributed to Albert Einstein goes: ​\

</sub>
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)</center>
